More important, the physical integration of micro-/nanodevices in microrobot systems is still in its embryonic stage, interdisciplinary collaboration will be vital to integrate comprehensive micro-/nanodevice capabilities and unlock the biomedical potential of microrobot systems. 神经尘埃作为智能尘埃在神经接口领域的应用拓展，是下一代低侵袭脑机接口极具前景的候选方案。本项目提出以微机器人作为载体赋予神经尘埃移动能力，其核心价值在于：通过少数可移动神经尘埃精准控制多靶点生物电时序信号，大幅减少植入电极数量（“以空间换通道”）；同时，其微尺寸支持经血管导入，避免开颅手术，实现“无创介入”。这些移动神经尘埃微机器人将逐步集成神经激励、感知、信息处理、通讯及组网等功能，实现“一尘一世界”的高度物理集成。 实现上述愿景的关键挑战之一是微能源供给。 本项目致力于将微型电池等能源器件作为收集或机载电源集成到微型机器人本体，以开启移动型神经刺激器等应用。我们开创性地设计了一种微型机器人神经刺激器原型，其核心机械结构创新在于采用自卷曲批量制造工艺，成功将微型电池集成于运动机构人工细菌鞭毛（ABF）上。这不仅为可移动微型机器人型神经刺激器的靶向神经刺激应用提供了能源保障，也为解决微纳器件在微型机器人系统中的高效集成难题提供了突破性方案。

11219825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11219825.value: 有效的蛋白质形态搜索和蛋白质形态定量算法

11219825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11219825.value: Proteoforms are the different forms of proteins generated from the genome with various sequence variations, splice isoforms,and post-translational modifications. Proteoforms play a pivotal role as drivers in biology Proteoform identification is the first step to fully understand biological processes In this project, we will focus on proteoform search using top-down mass spectrum. The classic algorithms for computing alignment between spectrum mass graph (SMG) and proteoform mass graph (PMG) use dynamic programming approaches and the speeds are slow and output quality is not very accurate. A refined alignment between PMG and SMG was defined in our previous work. In ths project, we will design efficient algorithm for computing the refined alignment between SMGs and PMGs. A big open problem in this area is the accuracy of existing search algorithms. At present, there is no real dataset of top-down spectra with known proteoform sequences. Besides, there is no software simulator to generate top-down spectrum with an input peoteoform sequence. Thus, the existing methods use various indirect measures to justify their search quality. In this project, we will design the first top-down spectra simulator to generate a top-down simulated spectrum with an input proteoform sequence. The proposed simulator will form a crucial tool for evaluating the accuracy of all the existing search methods. Besides, we have obtained a set of real top-down spectra of two known antibody sequences with the help of the company, Bioinformatic Solution, Ont., Canada. Those real datasets will be used for testing the accuracy of the existing methods. 蛋白质变体是由基因组生成的不同形式的蛋白质，具有各种序列变异、剪接亚型和翻译后修饰。蛋白质变体在生物学中起着关键驱动作用。蛋白质变体的识别是全面了解生物过程的第一步。在本项目中，我们将重点关注使用自上而下的质谱进行蛋白质变体搜索。用于计算谱质量图（SMG）与蛋白质变体质量图（PMG）之间对齐的经典算法采用动态规划方法，速度较慢，并且输出质量不够准确。在我们之前的工作中，定义了PMG与SMG之间的精细对齐。在本项目中，我们将设计高效的算法来计算SMG与PMG之间的精细对齐。 我们还将设计用于混合蛋白质形式的识别和定量的算法，以便用于多重质谱。

11220125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220125.value: 具有超低檢測極限的多路復用感測器的共軛零反射點

11220125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220125.value: An optical zero-reflection point (ZRP) exhibits enhanced sensitivity associated with phase singularities and the fastest slope change of the reflectivity curve. To date, ZRPs have been demonstrated using different lithography-free and fabrication-error tolerant techniques. However, ZRPs are observed under very specific conditions which hindered the manipulation of ZRP for multiple spectral positions or polarizations. We will take advantage of our recently developed concept of Optical Vernier Sensing (OVS) platform formed by a lithography-free metal and dielectric multilayers for efficient manipulation of multiple ZRPs for s- and p-polarizations. The sensing platform is based on synergic collaboration of surface plasmon polaritons (SPP) and photonic waveguide (PWG) resonances and can routinely deliver experimental ultralow limit of detection (LOD) of refractive index unit (RIU) changes as low ~10^-8 RIU with demonstrated stability of more than 6 months. The OVS is based on measurements of the relative amplitude ratio  and phase difference  of the s- and p-polarized reflectance which naturally form a two-scale optical sensing system when the ZRPs for s- and p-polarizations overlap. This results in enhanced contrast of sensing akin to the traditional Vernier scale. The more striking outcome is the ability to manipulate the ZRPs, providig an additional degree of freedom to “reset” the sensor operation and return it to its higher sensing state. This reset to maximum sensitivity is done via AoI tuning. Because ZRP are topologically protected, they can exist at different RIUs and it is possible to keep track of the total RIU changes, effectively providing a wide dynamic range with ultralow LODs by simply adjusting the AoI. We developed two proof-of-principle OVS examples and will study the systematic ability to create multi-spectral ZRPs (MSZRPs) from the multiple photonic modes in the dielectric waveguide coupled with the SPP in the metallic layers. Our foundation results have been validated by i) Fresnel coefficient and transfer matrix algorithm, and ii) the the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method to model spectroscopic ellipsometer (SE) data at large AoI. We will incorporate modifications to our recently homemade spectroscopic imaging ellipsometer (SIE) to enable a spectroscopic line-scan ellipsometer (SLsE) as well as an angle- and spectroscopic- resolved ellipsometer (ASE). The implementation of our FDTD strategy to model the TRSE data will enable deconvolution of material-only effects and structure-only effects. The successful completion of the proposed research work will have many future ramifications supporting innovative and advanced technological and scientific applications in sensing. 光學零反射點 (ZRP) 表現出與相位奇異性和反射率曲線最快斜率變化相關的增強靈敏度。迄今為止，已經使用不同的無光刻和製造誤差容忍技術證明了 ZRP。然而，ZRP 是在非常特殊的條件下觀察到的，這阻礙了對 ZRP 在多個光譜位置或偏振方面的操縱。我們將利用我們最近開發的光學遊標感測 (OVS) 平台的概念，該平台由無光刻金屬和電介質多層膜組成，可有效操縱多個 ZRP 以實現 s 和 p 偏振。此感測平台基於表面等離子體極化子 (SPP) 和光子波導 (PWG) 共振的協同作用，並且可以常規地提供折射率單位 (RIU) 變化的實驗超低檢測限 (LOD)，低至 ~10^-8 RIU，並證明穩定性超過 6 個月。 OVS基於s偏振和p偏振反射相對振幅比和相位差的測量，當s偏振和p偏振的零參考點(ZRP)重疊時，自然形成雙尺度光學感測系統。這可以增強感測對比度，類似傳統的遊標尺。更引人注目的是能夠操縱ZRP，從而提供額外的自由度來「重置」感測器操作並將其恢復到更高的感測狀態。這種重置到最大靈敏度是透過調整AoI來實現的。由於ZRP受到拓撲保護，它們可以存在於不同的RIU（反射率單元），並且可以追蹤RIU的整體變化，只需調整AoI即可有效地提供寬動態範圍和超低LOD。我們開發了兩個原理驗證的OVS範例，並將研究如何系統地從介質波導中的多個光子模式與金屬層中的SPP耦合來創建多光譜ZRP（MSZRP）。我們的基礎成果已透過以下方法驗證：i）菲涅爾係數和傳輸矩陣演算法；ii）時域有限差分法 (FDTD)，用於模擬大角度 (AoI) 的光譜橢偏儀 (SE) 資料。我們將對近期自製的光譜成像橢偏儀 (SIE) 進行改進，使其能夠實現光譜線掃描橢偏儀 (SLsE) 以及角度和光譜分辨橢偏儀 (ASE)。採用 FDTD 策略模擬 TRSE 數據，將能夠對僅材料效應和僅結構效應進行反捲積。擬議研究工作的成功完成將對未來產生許多影響，支持感測領域的創新和先進技術與科學應用。

11220225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220225.value: 一种神经元自适应的无线皮层内脑机接口方法

11220225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220225.value: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces (iBCIs) promise disruptive tools to demystify the brain, overcome neurological disorders such as Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s diseases, and restore/expand sensory and motor functions. Recent advances in neuroengineering have developed high-density (HD) neural probes that pack thousands of electrodes to record massive neuronal ensembles simultaneously, enabling brain sensing at unprecedented scales. However, realizing this potential in practical, untethered iBCI systems remains highly challenging. The key barrier stems from a widening gap between the bandwidth- and power-intensive nature of HD probes and the stringent resource constraints of probe controllers. To bridge this gap, we propose (1) NeuroSense, an intelligent power controller for HD probes, and (2) NeuroZip, an efficient coding and streaming framework for neural signals. Once the probe is implanted into brain tissue, NeuroSense and NeuroZip optimize sensing and communication based on the characteristics of neurons, enabling highly efficient utilization of limited resources. This neuron-adaptive paradigm represents a novel shift from conventional designs, which lack awareness of the underlying neuronal population, leading to poor efficiency and performance. This project will take an interdisciplinary approach that embraces basic neuroscience in theoretical modeling, efficient optimization, and practical prototyping of wireless iBCIs. We model neural sensing circuits, neural signal codecs, and neural decoders as black boxes, allowing our approach to generalize to current and future iBCI systems. In-vitro and in-vivo experiments conducted on live recording datasets and small animals show that our preliminary designs reduce neural decoding errors by up to 40x for representative applications, strongly supporting the feasibility of the proposed works. The success of this project holds promises to enable a wide range of research and clinical applications, including translational systems, neural prostheses, and long-term studies of learning, memory, and disease progression. The results of this project will shed light on a broader range of resource-constraind learning applications facing similar challenges, such as battery-free computer vision and artificial intelligence of implants. 皮层内脑机接口（iBCIs）有望成为颠覆性工具，用于揭示大脑奥秘，克服帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病等神经疾病，并恢复或扩展感觉与运动功能。神经工程的最新进展已经开发出高密度（HD）神经探针，这些探针集成了数千个电极，可同时记录大规模神经元群体的活动，从而以前所未有的规模进行脑信号感知。然而，要在实际的、无线化的 iBCI 系统中实现这一潜力，仍然面临巨大挑战。关键障碍在于高密度探针所需的大带宽和高功耗，与探针控制器严格的资源限制之间的鸿沟日益扩大。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了两个方案：（1）NeuroSense —— 一种智能电源控制器，用于高密度探针；（2）NeuroZip —— 一种高效的神经信号编码与传输框架。一旦探针植入脑组织，NeuroSense 和 NeuroZip 将基于神经元的特性来优化感知与通信，从而实现对有限资源的高效利用。这种“神经元自适应”范式代表了一种从传统设计的根本性转变。传统方案缺乏对底层神经元群体的感知，导致效率与性能低下。本项目将采取跨学科方法，结合基础神经科学的理论建模、高效优化方法与无线 iBCI 的实际原型设计。我们将神经感知电路、神经信号编解码器和神经解码器统一建模为黑箱，使所提出的方法能够推广到当前及未来的 iBCI 系统。基于活体记录数据集与小动物的体内外实验表明，我们的初步设计可在代表性应用中将神经解码误差降低高达 40 倍，强有力地验证了所提方案的可行性。该项目的成功有望推动广泛的研究与临床应用，包括转化系统、神经假体以及学习、记忆和疾病进程的长期研究。项目成果还将为其他同样面临资源受限挑战的学习应用提供启示，例如无电池计算机视觉和植入式人工智能。

11220325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220325.value: 應用于微電網的智慧功率與資訊傳輸：樂高式功率模組能源路由器的創新設計與應用

11220325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220325.value: This research project aims to develop a Lego power module-based energy router (LPM-ER) for efficient power and information transmission within microgrids. The proposed system incorporates reconfigurable, adjustable, and programmable power modules to facilitate agile power and information exchange among electric vehicles (EVs), renewable energy sources, and energy storage units. The design offers high flexibility, enabling energy and information regulation at the smallest unit level with power modules. EVs equipped with batteries and high mobility can serve as large-scale distributed energy storage units, effectively storing substantial renewable energy. Technologies like vehicle-to-everything (V2X), energy Internet, and energy routers, enable seamless power and information exchange among EVs, power grids, buildings, and other entities. However, integrating EVs into power grids alongside renewable energies necessitates further research. Existing hardware systems lack the flexibility and efficiency required for variable power regulation and simultaneous energy and information transmission, underscoring the need for novel control methods and hardware platforms. This project focuses on developing a Lego power module-based energy router to facilitate integrated energy and information transmission within microgrids. This approach aims to achieve several outcomes. Firstly, it seeks to fully utilize the latent potential of EVs for enhanced power and information exchange. Secondly, it aims to construct power converters similar to Lego modules, providing adjustability, reconfigurability, and programmability. Thirdly, the project aims to enable efficient energy scheduling and optimization among Lego power modules, enhancing convenience and cost-effectiveness. Lastly, it intends to implement a sophisticated smart algorithm to promote sustainable and efficient electricity consumption through value-driven power coordination. The research is structured into four main work packages. Work Package 1 involves designing a system framework for the LPM-ER to establish power and information connections within microgrids. Work Package 2 focuses on assembling various types of Lego power modules, facilitating interconnection and switching. Work Package 3 addresses regulating energy and information flow among Lego power modules. Work Package 4 concentrates on developing smart algorithms for microgrid optimization, leveraging the LPM-ER, EVs, renewable sources, and storage units. The research team has expertise in two key domains, namely the energy and information interaction among EVs, renewables, storages, residences, microgrids, and the development of the energy router. The team has produced over 20 relevant publications in reputable international journals, demonstrating significant expertise and fundamental. The project success has the potential to revolutionize energy and information transmission, leading to substantial innovation in the field. 本項目旨在開發一種基於樂高式功率模組的能源路由器（Lego Power Module based Energy Router），以實現微電網內高效的電能與資訊傳輸。電動汽車（EV）兼具電池儲能與高移動性特徵，可作為大規模分散式儲能系統，有效消納可再生能源。車聯萬物（V2X）、能源互聯網與能源路由器等技術的結合，使EV與電網、建築等主體間的能量資訊交互成為可能。但當前EV與可再生能源發電協同並網仍存在研究空白：現有硬體系統難以滿足功率靈活調節及能信同傳的需求，亟需開發新型控制方法與硬體平臺。本項目通過樂高式模組化能源路由器的研發，採用可重構、可調節、可程式設計的功率模組，靈活支撐電動汽車、可再生能源與儲能系統之間的能量與資訊交互。其創新性體現在：以功率模組為最小單元構建系統，實現能源與資訊的精細化調控，兼具高度靈活性，將為學界和工業界帶來突破性進展。項目成果有望革新能源資訊傳輸模式，推動領域創新發展。

11300125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11300125.value: 利用量子系統更有效地從隨機源提取能量

11300125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11300125.value: Harvesting energy from ambient sources can reduce the need for large batteries and grid power of mobile devices. Many ambient energy sources, e.g. electromagnetic radiation or human motion have randomness (entropy), and are not directly suitable for charging batteries. Existing methods for conditioning the power output have inherent efficiency limits. We recently discovered that a quantum method for conditioning the power output exists that does not have those inherent limits. The recently discovered method exploits the possibility of the harvesting system taking several trajectories that lead to the same final state at a given time, such that several force profiles chosen at random can lead to the same charging up of the quantum system. A key example involves the experimentally proven phenomenon of Rabi oscillations between energy levels, for which multiple trajectories take the lower energy state to the excited state. The quantum system is deterministically excited to the highest energy level after interacting with the source for a fixed amount of time, irrespective of the overall phase shift of the external force wave. We will push this method for enhanced energy harvesting towards maturity. We will expand the known sets of force profiles for which the method is applicable. We firstly tackle a list of candidate force profiles and quantum harvesting systems, aiming to show that the general method can be applied many cases in that list. We will then develop a computer algorithm to automatically find suitable harvester systems for given sets of force profiles. We will develop a general framework for understanding when this method can be applied and for how to quantify its performance and fairly compare classical and quantum harvesters. We thus expect to show that this method is widely applicable and superior to other methods in many regimes. The proposed project supports the UN sustainable development goal of increasing energy efficiency. 2,045 / 5,000 我們思考能量收集中的一個基本問題：給定一個部分隨機的能量源，是否有可能在不轉移隨機性或承擔其他熱力學成本的情況下提取能量？在最近的研究中，我們對此給出了肯定的答案，描述了一些場景和協議，原則上可以從一個具有隨機性的場中提取能量，但不轉移任何隨機性，也不會耗散能量。這些協議從根本上優於現有的會耗散功率的整流方法，或將隨機性轉移到反饋系統的反饋惡魔式協議。這些協議利用了能量收集系統在給定時間內採取多條軌跡達到相同最終狀態的可能性。我們解釋了為什麼這些協議不違反基本的物理原理。一個關鍵的例子涉及實驗上已證實的能階間拉比振盪現象，它利用了狀態空間中將低能態轉化為激發態的眾多旋轉軸。量子系統在與源相互作用一定時間後，會被確定性地激發到最高能階，而與外部位能的隨機初始相位無關。 我們致力於對這一現象進行更全面的理解，並致力於探索在不發生熵轉移的情況下實現這種能量轉移的可能性。本計畫分為三個部分：(i) 特殊情況，包括連續變數系統和量子遊走哈密頓量；(ii) 一種用於尋找協議的系統機器學習方法；以及 (iii) 一種用於尋找協議並更深入地理解這一現象的系統分析方法。 該項目涉及一項潛在新技術的基礎。它支持提高能源效率的永續發展目標，並研究日益成熟的量子技術是否有助於提高能量收集效率。

11300525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11300525.value: 深度學習中誤差動態分析的新理論框架

11300525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11300525.value: Machine learning, particularly through the use of deep neural networks (DNNs), has garnered significant attention due to its remarkable performance and successful applications across diverse fields, including life sciences, social sciences, and engineering. Despite these practical successes, our theoretical understanding of DNN properties is still evolving. Initially, DNNs were often viewed as "black boxes," achieving input-output data fitting without clarity on underlying mechanisms. This opacity has led to challenges in interpretability and performance guarantees, including issues related to transferability, accuracy, generalizability, and robustness. In recent years, various interpretable DNN models have been proposed, driven by new theories and insights. However, these approaches are primarily assessed through numerical experiments, which often lack rigorous error analysis and convergence guarantees. The central questions arise: 1) How can we guarantee a given level of accuracy based on the scale of networks and sample size? 2) What factors influence the occurrence of errors? The existing theoretical frameworks for deep learning are indeed sophisticated, yet they often treat neural networks simply as large parameterized models. Error estimation is typically performed in a separate, coarse-grained manner. The insights derived from these analytical frameworks often fail to address the complexities associated with high dimensionality and overparameterization, which are prevalent in deep learning and contradict many practical observations. As a result, these studies do not adequately capture the intricacies of large-scale deep neural network architectures or the complexities of training processes that involve various optimization techniques. To bridge this gap and enhance the applicability of theoretical insights in real-world scenarios, a more integrated approach is required. In this proposal, we aim to develop a comprehensive and specific theoretical framework for deep learning that emphasizes a deeper understanding of the interplay between approximation ability, training processes, and generalization for large-scale deep neural network models. We will introduce a new mathematical framework for error analysis that encompasses approximation error, optimization training error, and generalization gap, as well as the interactions among these aspects. Our innovation lies in connecting deep neural networks with minimization over features and dictionaries, treating them not merely as end-to-end parameterized models but as systems influenced by the dynamics of forward and backward propagation. The anticipated results will be benefit for both the theoretical analysis community and practitioners in industry. Furthermore, the insights gained may guide the development of more efficient and accurate network designs and algorithms. 機器學習，尤其是深度神經網路（DNNs）的應用，因其卓越的性能和在生命科學、社會科學、工程學等多個領域的成功應用而備受關注。儘管在實際應用中取得了諸多成就，但我們對深度神經網路特性的理論理解仍在不斷發展中。起初，深度神經網路常被視為“黑箱”，它們能實現輸入輸出資料的擬合，但其潛在機制卻不明確。這種不透明性引發了在可解釋性和性能保證方面的挑戰，包括可遷移性、準確性、泛化性和魯棒性等相關問題。 近年來，在新理論和新見解的推動下，各種可解釋的深度神經網路模型被相繼提出。然而，這些方法主要通過數值實驗進行評估，往往缺乏嚴謹的誤差分析和收斂性保證。由此產生了核心問題：1）如何根據網路規模和樣本量來保證特定的準確度水準？2）哪些因素會影響誤差的產生？ 現有的深度學習理論框架確實較為複雜，但它們往往將神經網路簡單地視為大型參數化模型。誤差估計通常以一種獨立、粗細微性的方式進行。從這些分析框架中得出的見解，往往無法應對深度學習中普遍存在的高維度和過參數化帶來的複雜性，這與許多實際觀察結果相矛盾。因此，這些研究未能充分捕捉大規模深度神經網路架構的複雜性，以及涉及各種優化技術的訓練過程的複雜性。 為了填補這一空白，並增強理論見解在現實場景中的適用性，我們需要一種更具整合性的方法。在本提案中，我們旨在為深度學習構建一個全面且具體的理論框架，著重深入理解大規模深度神經網路模型的逼近能力、訓練過程和泛化能力之間的相互作用。我們將引入一個新的誤差分析數學框架，該框架涵蓋逼近誤差、優化訓練誤差和泛化差距，以及這些方面之間的相互作用。 我們的創新點在於將深度神經網路與特徵和字典的最小化問題相聯繫，不再僅僅將其視為端到端的參數化模型，而是將其看作受前向傳播和反向傳播動態影響的系統。預期的研究成果將對理論分析界和工業界的從業者都有所裨益。此外，從中獲得的見解可能會為更高效、更準確的網路設計和演算法開發提供指導。

11300825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11300825.value: 嵌套球⾯設計：理论、计算和应用

11300825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11300825.value: Numerical integration, a vital mathematical technique for approximating function integrals, is commonly referred to as "quadrature" for one-dimensional cases and "cubature" for multidimensional cases. In ancient Greece, the Pythagorean doctrine understood the area calculations through the construction of squares (quadrature). Archimedes' work on the areas of spheres and parabolas are among the highest achievements of the antique analysis while figures like Galileo and de Roberval explored quadratures in finding areas of cycloid arc and hyperbola in medieval Europe. In the late 17th century, Newton and Leibniz independently developed integration principles, leading to the formulation of quadrature and cubature rules. One of the most important quadrature rules was studied by Chebyshev in 1874, which is an equal-weight quadrature rule. A significant extension of equal-weight quadrature rules to the sphere led to the concept of spherical designs, which are related to many areas ranging from pure and applied mathematics, such as algebraic combinatorics, associated schemes, number theory, modular form, machine learning, and quantum computing. In this project, we shall investigate a special type of spherical designs: nested spherical designs. We aim to provide a deep mathematical understanding of nested spherical designs and significant improvement in the performance of spherical data analysis tasks as well as the cutting-edge techniques for geometric deep learning through various tasks including (i) the existence and optimal asymptotic bound of nested spherical designs, the well-separated property of the nested spherical designs, the numerical computations and applications of nested spherical designs, and many others. Spherical designs provide an ever-growing vast horizon of theory and applications. The further development of spherical designs in terms of nested spherical designs can unlock new insights into algebra, geometry, analysis, and beyond. 数值积分是逼近函数积分的重要数学技巧，在一维情况下通常称为“求积法”，在多维情况下通常称为“立方法”。在古希腊，毕达哥拉斯学派通过构造正方形（求积法）来理解面积计算。阿基米德关于球面和抛物线面积的研究是古代分析学的最高成就之一，而伽利略和罗伯瓦尔等人物在中世纪欧洲探索了求积法，用于求解摆线弧和双曲线的面积。17世纪后期，牛顿和莱布尼茨各自发展了积分原理，并由此形成了求积法和立方法。最重要的求积法之一是由切比雪夫于1874年研究的，它是一个等权重求积法。等权重求积规则向球面的重大扩展，催生了球面设计的概念。球面设计与纯数学和应用数学等诸多领域息息相关，例如代数组合学、关联方案、数论、模形式、机器学习和量子计算。在本项目中，我们将研究一种特殊的球面设计：嵌套球面设计。我们的目标是通过各种研究任务，包括（i）嵌套球面设计的存在性和最优渐近界、嵌套球面设计的良好分离性、嵌套球面设计的数值计算和应用等，深入理解嵌套球面设计，显著提升球面数据分析任务的性能，并推动几何深度学习的前沿技术发展。球面设计为理论和应用提供了广阔的前景。嵌套球面设计在球面设计方面的进一步发展，可以为代数、几何、分析等领域带来新的见解。

11301225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11301225.value: 弗雷德霍姆行列式大間隙漸進研究中的常數問題

11301225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11301225.value: Fredholm determinants are functions associated with trace class operators acting on intervals. They generalize the concept of determinants in linear algebra and have significant applications in mathematical physics, including random matrix theory, determinantal point processes, random permutations, quantum and statistical mechanics. For instance, in random matrix theory, Fredholm determinants give the so-called gap probability, which is the probability of having no eigenvalues in given intervals. One of key properties about Fredholm determinants is their asymptotic behavior as the width of the interval tends to infinity. This asymptotic problem has attracted a lot of research interest over the past 50 years. However, determining the constant term in the large gap asymptotics remains a well-known and challenging problem. In the current project, we aim to tackle this longstanding problem by developing the existing research in this field. We will focus on Fredholm determinants associated with several important kernels, which play crucial role in characterizing local behaviors of models under critical scenarios. Our approach will be based on the Riemann-Hilbert method and delicate uniform asymptotic analysis. After determining the constant terms, we will also investigate the total integrals of related Painleve functions and explore potential underlying universal features of these constants. 弗雷德霍姆行列式是定義在跡類算子上的函數，它們是有限維線性代數中行列式概念向無窮維情形的自然推廣。 這一理論在數學物理中具有廣泛的應用，涵蓋隨機矩陣、行列式點過程、隨機排列以及量子與統計力學等多個領域。舉例來說，在隨機矩陣理論中，弗雷德霍姆行列式給出了所謂的「間隙概率」，即在特定區間內不存在特徵值的概率。 弗雷德霍姆行列式研究的核心問題之一，是刻畫其在區間長度趨於無窮時的漸近行為。 過去五十年來，該問題引發了大量深入研究，並取得了顯著進展，但仍有一些關鍵難題尚未解決。 本項目將聚焦於其中一個長期懸而未決的漸近常數問題。 我們將以若干重要的積分核函數為研究對象，這些核函數在描述臨界狀態下模型的局部行為時起著決定性作用。 基於黎曼-希爾伯特方法和精細的一致漸近分析，我們將系統地研究與之關聯的弗雷德霍姆行列式，並精確求解其漸近展開中的常數項。 此外，我們還將並進一步揭示這些常數背後可能存在的普適規律，以及探討相關潘勒韋函數的整體積分性質。

11301425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11301425.value: 銅對銅鍵合的電鍍銅晶粒工程和表面鈍化

11301425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11301425.value: Three-dimensional integrated circuits (3D ICs) have emerged as the most promising solution to address the physical limitations of Moore’s Law. By leveraging the vertical dimension, 3D IC involves the vertical stacking of silicon chips, utilizing microbumps and through-silicon-via (TSV) technologies. The current bonding techniques rely on Cu bumps or pillars capped with solder materials, but issues arise in finer-pitch packages. Recently, direct Cu-to-Cu (Cu-Cu) bonding has attracted attention because of its potential to replace solder joints using tiny direct Cu-Cu connections, thereby providing higher interconnect density to enable advanced packaging technology with pitches of 10 μm and below. However, challenges such as high bonding temperatures and extended processing times pose significant hurdles for Cu-Cu bonding in large-scale industrial production. The high thermal budget can lead to device damage, particularly affecting temperature-sensitive components, and may result in problems like wafer warpage, misalignment, and thermal stress due to varying thermal expansion coefficients of materials. In addition to the inherent properties of copper, another critical issue is the rapid formation of surface copper oxide during long processing time after electroplating and before bonding. This copper oxide layer acts as a barrier to successful bonding, especially under low-temperature conditions with limited driving forces. To reduce the thermal budget for Cu-Cu bonding, research has explored grain engineering with (111)-oriented nanotwinned (nt) Cu or nanocrystalline (nc) Cu. The nt-Cu joints still exhibit a sharp interface and weak bonding strength when bonding below 200 °C, requiring heating above 250 °C to improve cross-interface bonding quality. On the other hand, the rapid recrystallization characteristics of nc-Cu enable grain growth across the bonding interface, yet the self-annealing effect of grain growth at room temperature limits its practicality during extended processing times. Therefore, this project aims to fabricate a metastable copper material that remains stable during processing at room temperature while enabling substantial grain growth during bonding at elevated temperatures. We propose two structures to achieve metastable Cu, nc-Cu electroplated onto nt-Cu and composite structure combining nc-Cu and nt-Cu. Moreover, to address Cu surface oxidation, we propose developing a DCB (dynamic covalent bond) chemical coating material with real-time responsiveness to external stimuli, providing temporary passivation to prevent oxidation and allowing for easy removal before bonding. The objective of this project is to provide a promising and practical approach to attain superior bonding quality, lower operating temperatures, and increased throughput for direct Cu-Cu bonding in advanced electronic packaging. 三維積體電路（3D ICs）已成為解決摩爾定律物理限制的最具前景的方案。藉由利用垂直維度，3D ICs涉及矽晶片的垂直堆疊，採用微凸點和穿硅通孔（TSV）技術。目前的鍵合技術依賴於銅凸點或銅柱，加覆錫焊料，但在更精細封裝中出現問題。近來，直接銅對銅（Cu-Cu）鍵合因其潛力取代錫焊接點，並利用微小的直接銅對銅連接，從而提供更高的互連密度，以實現10 μm及以下排距的先進封裝技術。然而，高溫與長處理時間等挑戰，對大規模工業生產中的銅對銅鍵合構成重大障礙。高熱預算可能導致器件損壞，尤其溫度敏感元件，並可能因材料熱膨脹係數差異引發晶圓翹曲、對位不良與熱應力等問題。除銅本身的特性外，另一個關鍵問題是在長時間電鍍後、鍵合前快速形成的銅氧化層，這層氧化物成為鍵合的障礙，特別是在低溫、推動力有限的條件下。 為降低銅對銅鍵合的熱預算，本研究探索了含有（111）取向奈米孿晶銅（nt-Cu）或奈米晶（nc-Cu）的晶粒工程。奈米孿晶銅在200°C以下鍵合時仍呈現明顯界面和較弱的鍵合強度，需加熱至250°C以上以改善界面間的鍵合質量。另一方面，nc-Cu的快速再結晶特性使晶粒能在鍵合界面上長大，但其在室溫下的自時效退火效果限制了其在長時間加工中的實用性。因此，本研究旨在製造一種在室溫下處理時依然穩定、在高溫鍵合時能大幅晶粒長大的亞穩銅材料。我們提出兩種結構以實現亞穩銅：一是將電鍍的nc-Cu覆蓋在nt-Cu上，二是結合nc-Cu與nt-Cu的複合結構。此外，為應對銅表面氧化問題，我們計畫開發一種具有即時反應能力的動態共價鍵（DCB）化學塗料，提供暫時性鈍化層，以防止氧化並允許在鍵合前去除。此項目旨在提供一種有前景且實用的方法，實現卓越的鍵合品質、降低操作溫度並提高先進電子封裝應用中的銅對銅直連鍵合的產能。

11301525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11301525.value: 面向重要类别优先与群组级样本偏差鲁棒性的 Neyman–Pearson 分类框架

11301525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11301525.value: Dr Wang, Y. X. Rachel Prof Yao, Shunan

11301525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11301525.value: Addressing error asymmetry and sample bias in classification tasks is crucial, particularly in biomedical applications. Error asymmetry refers to the differing importance of classification errors, e.g., failing to identify a disease-positive case (type I error) can have more severe consequences than misclassifying a negative case (type II error). Group-wise sample bias occurs when certain groups within the dataset are underrepresented or overrepresented, resulting in reduced classification accuracy for underrepresented groups. This project introduces the NPRG (Neyman-Pearson Classification Robust to Group-wise Bias) paradigm to address the challenges of error asymmetry and sample bias in binary classification problems involving multiple groups. This framework aims to control population-level type I errors conditional on the groups and manage maximum type II error disparities. We will derive the oracle NPRG classifier and develop an NPRG umbrella algorithm that adapts to various scoring-type classification methods to achieve these high probability controls in practice. Additionally, the project will extend the NPRG framework to multi-class classification with a hierarchical structure that ranks classes based on their importance. This extension introduces the H-NPRG (Hierarchical NPRG) paradigm, which aims to control both group-conditional under-classification errors (misclassifying cases into less critical classes) and disparities in group-conditional over-classification errors (misclassifying cases into more critical classes). A corresponding H-NPRG umbrella algorithm will be developed to ensure high probability control. In conjunction with this multi-class classification problem, we propose a prediction-based feature ranking criterion, the HNPC (Hierarchical Neyman-Pearson Criterion), which delivers consistent sample-level rankings and remains robust against class-wise sampling bias. The project will develop theories to validate the high probability controls of the proposed umbrella algorithms and the consistency of HNPC. We will also conduct numerical experiments to assess their performance. Additionally, the project will include three case studies (kidney allograft prediction, Alzheimer’s disease stage classification, and COVID-19 severity classification) to demonstrate the broad applicability and effectiveness of our framework across diverse biomedical contexts. 在分类任务中处理误差不对称与样本偏差至关重要，尤其在生物医学应用中。所谓误差不对称，是指不同类型分类错误的重要性不同，例如漏检疾病阳性个体（I 类错误）可能比将阴性个体误判为阳性（II 类错误）带来更严重后果。群组级样本偏差指数据集中某些群组被低估或高估，导致预测偏斜，并使代表性不足群组的准确率下降。 本项目提出 NPRG（Neyman–Pearson 分类的群组偏差鲁棒性，Neyman-Pearson Classification Robust to Group-wise Bias）范式，以解决涉及多群组的二分类问题中的误差不对称与样本偏差挑战。该框架旨在在群组条件下控制总体层面的 I 类错误，并约束最大 II 类错误差异。我们将给出 NPRG 的 oracle 分类器，并开发可适配多种打分型分类方法的 NPRG 伞式算法，以在实践中实现高概率控制。 此外，项目将把 NPRG 扩展至具有层次结构的多分类情形，对类别按重要性进行排序。该扩展形成 H-NPRG（分层 NPRG）范式，目标是在控制群组条件的“欠分类”错误（将样本误判为更不重要类别）的同时，控制群组条件的“过分类”错误差异（将样本误判为更重要类别）。我们将开发相应的 H-NPRG 伞式算法以确保高概率控制。配合多分类问题，我们提出基于预测的特征排序准则 HNPC（分层 Neyman–Pearson 准则），可在样本层面实现一致的特征排序，并对类别层面的采样偏差保持稳健。 本项目将给出理论结果，证明所提伞式算法的高概率控制与 HNPC 的一致性；并开展数值实验评估其性能。此外，我们将通过三个案例研究（肾移植排斥预测、阿尔茨海默病分期分类、COVID-19 重症程度分类）展示该框架在多种生物医学场景下的广泛适用性与有效性。

11301625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11301625.value: 酶啟發的溴介導H₂O₂在CeO₂表面生成單線態氧及其在先進水處理中的配位結構與表面排列的作用

11301625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11301625.value: The growing demand for effective ways to tackle persistent organic pollutants (POPs) in water treatment has led to increased interest in advanced oxidation processes (AOPs). These processes use reactive oxygen species (ROS) to transform pollutants into less harmful substances while also improving disinfection. Common industrial AOPs, such as H2O2/Fe2+, H2O2/O3, H2O2/UV, and O3/UV, primarily generate hydroxyl radicals (•OH) by activating H2O2 and O3. Although many nanomaterials have been explored to facilitate their activation, these radical-based AOPs inherently exhibit low selectivity for target contaminants and can be significantly affected by pH and the presence of background anions in water. Given this, non-radical AOPs, such as singlet oxygen (1O2) and high-valent metal species, are recently gaining interest for their superior selectivity, broad pH applicability, and greater resistance to interference from background anions, making them promising alternatives for treating POPs. Early studies often produced 1O2 by disproportionating superoxide radicals (O2•⁻) generated from the catalytic activation of H2O2. However, the rapid consumption of O2•⁻ by various species in the Fenton and Fenton-like reactions significantly reduces 1O2 yield. Researchers later turned to peroxymonosulfate (PMS) and found that single-atom catalysts can activate PMS through a non-radical pathway, achieving nearly 100% selectivity for 1O2 production. Despite this, single-atom catalysts' complex preparation and characterization limit their practical applications. Additionally, H2O2, which produces only water and oxygen, remains a preferred oxidant for industrial use compared to PMS. Nature may offer a solution through bromoperoxidases (BPOs), which produce 1O2 and HOBr in the presence of H2O2 and Br⁻ via a non-radical pathway. Mechanistic studies suggest their production primarily results from a competition between H2O2 (to yield 1O2) and H2O (to yield HOBr) for the reactive BrO species coordinated to the enzyme’s vanadium center. While both ROS can be used for water treatment, producing the more reactive 1O2 with Br⁻ as a co-catalyst is particularly appealing. Although H2O2 is often present in lower concentrations than H2O in aqueous solutions, we have found that CeO2 nanoparticles enclosed by the (111) surface not only mimic BPOs but preferentially enhance 1O2 yield while suppressing HOBr production. This project aims to investigate how the coordination structure of surface Ce sites and their atomic arrangement mediate/catalyze these reactions. The potential of using CeO2 to treat POPs will also be explored to guide the design of catalysts that maximize 1O2 yield in H2O2-based AOPs. 隨著對水中持久性有機污染物（POPs）高效去除方法的需求增加，越來越多的人關注高級氧化製程（AOPs）。這類製程透過活性氧物種（ROS）將污染物轉化為低毒物質，同時提升消毒作用。工業中常用的AOPs技術（如H₂O₂/Fe²⁺、H₂O₂/O₃、H₂O₂/UV和O₃/UV）主要透過活化H₂O₂和O₃來產生羥基自由基（•OH）。儘管已有許多奈米材料被開發用於促進上述活化過程，但這些基於自由基的AOPs本質上對目標污染物的選擇性較低，且易受水體pH值和背景陰離子濃度的影響。有鑑於此，以單線態氧（¹O₂）和高價金屬物種為代表的非自由基AOPs因其優異的選擇性、更寬的pH適用範圍及更強的抗背景陰離子幹擾能力，成為用於處理POPs的極具前景的替代方案。 早期研究大都透過催化活化H₂O₂而產生的超氧自由基（O₂•⁻）的歧化反應來產生¹O₂。然而，在類芬頓和芬頓反應中，O₂•⁻會與多種物質快速反應而被消耗，導致¹O₂產率顯著降低。研究人員隨後轉向過氧單硫酸鹽（PMS）的研究，發現單原子催化劑可透過非自由基路徑活化PMS，達到接近100%的¹O₂選擇性生成。儘管如此，單原子催化劑複雜的製備與表徵工藝限制了其實際應用。此外，相較於PMS，H₂O₂作為氧化劑的分解產物僅為水和氧氣，因而是工業應用的更優選擇。 我們發現自然界中的溴過氧化物酶（BPOs）或許能提供一個解決方案。BPOs在H₂O₂和Br⁻存在時，可經由非自由基途徑同時產生¹O₂和HOBr。機理研究表明，這兩種活性物質的生成源於BrO中間體（配位於酶的活性中心釩上）對H₂O₂（生成¹O₂）與H₂O（生成HOBr）的競爭反應。雖然這兩種活性氧物質均可用於水處理，但以Br⁻作為助催化劑生成的高活性¹O₂更具應用價值。儘管水溶液中H₂O₂的濃度通常遠低於H₂O，但我們發現(111)晶面包覆的CeO₂奈米顆粒不僅能模擬BPOs的催化行為，還可選擇性提升¹O₂產率並抑制HOBr生成。本計畫將重點探討CeO₂表面Ce活性位點的配位結構及其原子排佈如何介導/催化上述反應。同時，也將評估CeO₂處理POPs的潛力，從而為設計高¹O₂選擇性的基於H₂O₂的AOPs提供理論指導。

11302125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11302125.value: There are a number of manufacturing processes in which one must pressurize the hole of a tube composed of viscoelastic material. In the blown film process, sufficient pressure is required to cause the hole to expand and ultimately generate a thin film. In the production of micro-structured optical fibers, pressurization is necessary to prevent surface-tension-driven hole closure. Unfortunately, a range of issues plagues such manufacturing techniques, such as instabilities and high sensitivity to defects. Polymeric materials are typically used in the blown film process, while recent work has shown significant promise for using polymeric materials in the manufacture of micro-structured optical fibers. It is therefore of paramount importance to consider how viscoelasticity inherent in polymeric materials interacts with surface tension, inertia, and viscous forces to control the flow. This proposal is motivated by the goal of understanding how the viscoelastic properties of the fluid can be best utilized to achieve the main manufacturing objectives. We will address these questions by deriving a set of long-wavelength equations that describe the flow. This represents a serious challenge because the pressure in the hole drives a radial flow that precludes the use of previous techniques employed in the literature for threads without holes. Nevertheless, we will derive a new method based on a weakly elastic assumption to obtain a relevant system of equations. Once we have derived the long-wavelength equations, we will determine how hole closure and stability issues in drawing are affected by viscoelastic effects. We will also examine the linear and nonlinear stability of a uniform thread and explore how to leverage viscoelastic rheology to achieve the manufacturing goals for the blown film process. 有好多製造過程都要對由粘彈性材料組成嘅管入面嘅孔加壓。喺吹膜過程中，需要足夠嘅壓力先可以令個孔膨脹，最終產生薄膜。喺微結構纖維嘅生產中，加壓係必要嘅，以防止表面張力驅動嘅孔閉合。不幸嘅係，一系列嘅問題困擾住呢啲製造技術，例如唔穩定同對缺陷嘅高度敏感。聚合物材料通常用喺吹製薄膜工藝，而最近嘅研究顯示咗用聚合物材料製造微結構光纖方面有重大嘅前途。因此，考慮聚合物材料固有嘅粘彈性係點樣同表面張力、慣性同粘性力相互作用，以控制流動係至關重要。呢個提議嘅動機係想了解點樣最好咁利用流體嘅粘彈性去達到主要嘅製造目標。我哋透過推導一套描述流動嘅長波方程嚟解決呢啲問題。呢個係一個嚴重嘅挑戰，因為孔入面嘅壓力會驅動徑向流動，令到唔可以用之前喺文獻入面用嚟處理冇孔嘅無螺絲螺紋嘅技術。不過，我哋會推導出一個基於弱彈性假設方程去得到一個相關系統嘅新方法。一旦我哋推導出長波方程，我哋就會確定粘彈性效應係點樣影響圖中嘅孔閉合同穩定性問題。我哋亦會檢查一條均勻嘅絲嘅線性同非線性穩定性，同埋探討點樣可以利用粘彈性流变學去達到吹膜工藝嘅製造目標。

11302225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11302225.value: 機器學習力場的開發用於研究奈米受限水/冰的電凍結/融化和新相行為

11302225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11302225.value: Confined water is involved in numerous natural and industrial processes in various forms (e.g., confined water by cell membranes and pipelines). When the confinement reaches the nanoscale or sub-nanoscale, water can exhibit new properties that differ from those of bulk water. Among the types of nanoconfinement, two-dimensional (2D) nanoconfinement has attracted considerable attention over the past two decades. This is due in part to the increasing number of 2D layered materials produced with their inter-layer spacing being naturally on the sub-nanometer or nanometer scale, and the intriguing physical properties of nanoconfined water and ice observed in experiments and computer simulations. Many novel properties originate from the interplay between 2D nanoconfinement and water’s intricate hydrogen bond network under various external conditions, such as temperature, pressure, and surface hydrophilicity. Theoretically, 2D nanoconfined water has been extensively studied using classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. These studies have revealed various structural, thermodynamic, phase transition, and transport properties of 2D nanoconfined water/ice for specific water models. Although some of the simulation results have been validated experimentally, recent ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations based on density-functional theory (DFT) methods have indicated the limitations of classic water models in describing certain physical and nearly all chemical behaviors of water/ice under specific environmental conditions. However, the high computational cost of AIMD simulation limits its application to relatively large-scale systems and long simulation times. The recent development of machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) has made MD simulations of larger systems and longer timescales (beyond nanoseconds) more accessible while retaining the accuracy of DFT methods. In this proposed project, we will develop a more generalized MLFF (for MD simulations) capable of describing water interactions not only under 2D confinement but also in the presence of external electric fields. This generalized MLFF will allow us to explore novel electro-freezing/melting phenomena of 2D nanoconfined water, water dissociation behavior, and the possible formation of new 2D ferroelectric ices while performing MD simulations on larger systems and over longer timescales than AIMD permits. In addition, we will investigate the effects of electric fields on novel 2D water/ice phases, such as bilayer superionic and bilayer hexatic phases. Exploring the rich phase behavior of nanoconfined water will not only expand our fundamental understanding of water and its solid form (ice) but also will enable the exploitation of new properties of nanoconfined water for applications in nanofluidics, electroporation, and cryogenic storage.

11303125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303125.value: 耦合偏微分方程在透明邊界條件下的模態形成新進展及其應用

11303125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303125.value: We propose to study pattern formations of coupled partial differential equations (PDEs) with transparent boundary conditions and consider their applications. This peculiar type of PDE systems stem from quantitatively characterizing invisibility/nonscattering phenomena and studying certain longstanding geometrical inverse problems in the wave scattering theory. Two types of pattern formation have been discovered and unveiled in the literature: the global boundary-localisation and surface-resonance, and the local vanishing near singular/high-curvature boundary points. In this project, we will make new developments on the global and local pattern formations and consider their novel applications in different physical contexts. First, we will study three new global pattern formations: (i) the interior Lp-concentration with p>2; (ii) the phase/amplitude changes due to the presence of topological or geometrical inclusions; (iii) the boundary-localization and surface-resonance of exterior transmission eigenstates. For the proposed research in (i), in addition to verify the existence of such a new pattern formation, we will further derive sharp estimates on the spectral densities of the boundary L2-localization and interior Lp-localization to provide a global picture on the distributions of the two peculiar modes. Second, we will study a novel local pattern formation: the interior vanishing in thin or narrow regions of product type. These include scenarios where the scattering inhomogeneities possesses thin or narrow ends or bridges, or themselves are thin- or narrow-shaped, say e.g. (possibly curved) tube or slab. In such cases, the transparent boundary conditions are only prescribed on the lateral boundaries. Hence, it represents a local pattern formation. We will conduct a systematic study on this local property in different mathematical and physical settings, and derive comprehensive and sharp characterisations. Third, the proposed studies will be conducted for the Helmholtz and magnetic-Schrodinger operators governing scalar waves, and the Maxwell and Lame operators governing vectorial waves, as well as several coupled-physics ones. Furthermore, we will consider novel applications associated with both scalar and vectorial wave scattering. These include a novel wave imaging scheme of recovering embedded topological and geometrical inclusions; new chracertizations of scattering/nonscattering phenomena; establishment of novel unique identifiability results for the related geometrical inverse scattering problems and artificial generation of customized field concentrations. Finally, we will go beyond the wave scattering problems to extend the local pattern formation to coupled systems with nonlinear and time-dependent PDEs. We will also consider the related applications to several inverse problems associated with these PDEs. 本研究擬探究具透明邊界條件的耦合偏微分方程模態形成機制及其應用。此類特殊方程體系源於波散射理論中隱形/非散射現象的量化表徵及經典幾何反問題研究。現有文獻揭示兩類模態：全局性邊界局域化與表面共振，以及局部性奇點/高曲率邊界處的場消失現象。本項目將深化全局與局部模態形成研究，並開拓其在多物理場景的創新應用。 首先，針對全局模態將探究三項新機制：內部Lp聚集（p>2）、拓撲/幾何夾雜物引發的相位/振幅變化、外部傳輸本徵態的邊界局域化與表面共振。其中對Lp聚集現象除驗證存在性外，將建立邊界L2局域化與內部Lp聚集的光譜密度精確估計，揭示雙模態分佈規律。其次，將研究乘積型細窄區域（如管狀/板狀結構）的內部場消失這一新型局部模態，系統分析側邊界透明條件約束下的場分佈特性，構建多物理場景的普適表徵框架。 研究將統一涵蓋標量波與矢量波體系，並拓展至耦合物理系統。創新應用涉及拓撲/幾何夾雜物的新型波成像技術、散射/非散射現象的本質表徵、幾何反散射問題唯一可辨識性理論及定制化場聚焦的人工調控。最後突破波散射範疇，將局部模態形成機制拓展至非線性時變耦合PDE系統，並探索其在相關反問題中的新應用。

11303225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303225.value: 針對耦合納維-斯托克斯與比奧方程組的非貼合混合方法

11303225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303225.value: The coupled Navier-Stokes and Biot equations are fundamental for modeling a variety of physical phenomena encountered in real-world applications, including the interaction between blood flow and vessel walls, oil and gas extraction, heat transfer, and electromagnetism. Nevertheless, developing effective numerical schemes for these coupled equations presents several challenges. First, the complex interface conditions that characterize the interaction between fluid and poroelastic regions require careful treatment to ensure stability and accuracy. Second, unfitted methods provide an attractive solution for multiphysics problems; however, adapting the discretizations to accommodate unfitted meshes, especially in the presence of small cuts, requires delicate design. Finally, although the development of decoupled schemes is essential for improving computational efficiency, maintaining unconditional stability without compromising accuracy presents a significant challenge. Addressing these challenges through innovative numerical schemes is vital for advancing our ability to effectively solve the coupled Navier-Stokes and Biot equations, ultimately enhancing our understanding of the underlying physical processes. The objective of this project is to address the above challenges with the development of a new computational paradigm with rigorous mathematical analysis. Our project will concentrate on four main areas of research: (1) the design and analysis of a parameter-robust scheme on fitted meshes; (2) the development of unconditionally stable decoupled schemes on fitted meshes; (3) the design and analysis of unfitted hybridizable methods; and (4) the design and analysis of unconditionally stable decoupled schemes on unfitted meshes. Concerning the spatial discretizations, we will use the pressure-robust hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin methods, where the interface conditions can be treated as essential or natural boundary conditions. We will adapt the proposed method to work with unfitted meshes, which offers an attractive option for solving multiphysics problems involving complex or moving interfaces. Moreover, we will develop appropriate stabilization terms to accommodate the small cuts. The design and analysis of unconditionally stable decoupled methods for fitted and unfitted meshes present a significant challenge. Our objective is to overcome this difficulty by developing tailored Robin-type boundary conditions. Furthermore, we aim to prove the energy inequality for the proposed scheme, which will also facilitate the proof of convergence. We will validate the accuracy, efficiency, and capabilities of the scheme through rigorous mathematical analysis and extensive numerical simulations of benchmark problems. We anticipate that this project will establish a new mathematical framework for analyzing multiphysics problems, and the developed methodologies can also have implications for various applications. 耦合納維-斯托克斯與比奧方程組是模擬血流-血管交互作用、油氣開採、熱傳導及電磁現象等實際物理過程的基礎框架，然其數值求解面臨三重挑戰：複雜界面條件需精準處理以確保穩定性與精度；非貼合方法雖適用多物理場問題，但需針對微小切割單元設計特殊離散格式；解耦方案雖提升計算效率，卻難以兼顧無條件穩定性與精度。本項目旨在建立具嚴謹數學分析的新計算範式，重點突破四大方向：(1)貼合網格參數魯棒方案設計與分析；(2)貼合網格無條件穩定解耦方案開發；(3)非貼合雜交化方法設計；(4)非貼合網格無條件穩定解耦方案構建。空間離散將採用壓力魯棒雜交間斷伽遼金法，其界面條件可作本質/自然邊界條件處理，通過擴展至非貼合網格解決複雜移動界面問題，並設計微小切割穩定項。針對解耦穩定性難題，將開發定制化羅賓型邊界條件，證明能量不等式並推導收斂性，最終經數學分析與數值模擬驗證方案精度與效能，建立多物理場問題新數學框架。

11303325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303325.value: 電驅動放大自發射促進金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦激光器件發展

11303325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303325.value: Metal halide perovskites are emerging as crucial materials in optoelectronic applications, particularly as emitters in light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and as gain media in optically pumped lasers. Their tunable emission spectra and compatibility with solution-based processing make them ideal for developing electrically driven laser diodes, representing a significant shift from traditional lasing technologies that rely on epitaxially grown III-V semiconductors. However, despite their potential, the development of perovskite laser diodes remains largely experimental, with few breakthroughs. The development of perovskite-based laser technologies faces several challenges. These include producing high-quality, low trap-density films through solution processing, achieving the high current densities required for effective population inversion, maintaining operational stability under demanding conditions, and integrating optical resonators into functional perovskite LEDs (PeLEDs). Each issue is critical for advancing PeLEDs to meet the stringent requirements of practical applications. This proposal aims to overcome these scientific barriers by employing groundbreaking approaches in material chemistry and device architecture. Our high-risk, high-reward initiative seeks to propel the field toward substantial technological breakthroughs with the following key tasks: 1.) Solution-based fabrication of perovskite films with ultra-low trap densities: develop a novel solution-based method for fabricating perovskite films with ultra-low trap densities to reduce non-radiative losses and enhance the materials' optical qualities, which is crucial for high-performance perovskite laser diodes; 2.) Enhancing film stability and efficiency: improve the stability and efficiency of perovskite thin films to enhance their performance under intense operational conditions and lower the threshold for amplified spontaneous emission (ASE), a vital step toward efficient laser operation; 3.) Tackling device degradation and efficiency roll-off: address issues of device degradation and efficiency roll-off at high current densities by developing a miniaturized, transparent PeLED with an innovative all-inorganic architecture that enhances optical efficiency and current injection capabilities; 4.) Modulating gain properties: investigate the effects of electrical excitation on the gain properties of perovskite materials through advanced optical and electrical excitation experiments in PeLEDs, aiming to reduce the ASE threshold and facilitate the realization of functional perovskite laser diodes. The culmination of these efforts is expected to yield a prototype PeLED that demonstrates electrically driven ASE. By addressing these technological challenges, this research will significantly enhance the scientific and commercial viability of perovskite-based technologies, facilitating their wider adoption in laser applications and marking a significant advancement in the development and application of electrically driven lasers. 金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦因其可調控發射光譜和溶液製程兼容性，成為光電領域極具潛力的材料，尤其有望推動電驅動激光二極管的開發，突破傳統外延生長III-V族半導體激光技術的局限。然而，鈣鈦礦激光二極管的發展仍面臨多重挑戰：溶液法制備低缺陷密度高質量薄膜、實現高電流密度下的粒子數反轉、保障高電流密度運作條件下的穩定性，以及光學諧振腔與鈣鈦礦發光二極管（PeLED）的功能集成。 本項目擬通過材料化學與器件結構的創新性突破，攻克上述關鍵技術瓶頸：1）開發超低缺陷鈣鈦礦薄膜溶液製備新方法，抑制非輻射損耗，提升光學性能；2）增強薄膜穩定性與效率，降低放大自發輻射（ASE）閾值；3）設計全無機透明微型PeLED結構，解決高電流密度下的效率滾降與器件退化問題；4）通過光電激發實驗研究電泵浦增益特性，降低ASE閾值。最終目標是研製出可實現電驅動ASE的PeLED，推動鈣鈦礦激光技術的科學突破與商業化應用，為電泵浦激光器發展奠定堅實基礎。

11303425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303425.value: 有機鋅硼化合物的合成、反應性研究以及在催化中的應用

11303425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303425.value: Organozinc compounds are versatile intermediates in synthetic chemistry, exhibiting reactivity similar to that of organolithium and Grignard reagents. Traditionally, zinc-carbon bonded reagents function as mild carbon-centered nucleophiles; however, recent interest has shifted toward heteroatom-zinc species, which introduce unique reactivity through the Zn-heteroatom bond. Among these, boron, with its vacant 2p orbital in the 3-coordinated state, represents a particularly promising option. Zinc-boryl species can provide access to the nucleophilic reactivity of the boryl moiety, which is challenging to achieve with conventional Lewis-acidic organoboron species. Additionally, zinc serves as an attractive alternative to expensive noble metals, positioning zinc-boryl compounds as promising catalysts for various borylation reactions. Currently, known zinc-boryl species are limited and primarily consist of nitrogen-stabilized bulky boryl frameworks, which exhibit constrained reactivity due to steric hindrance. Zinc boryl species derived from diboron(4) reagents (e.g., B₂pin₂ and B₂cat₂) have been proposed as key intermediates in catalytic borylation reactions, yet their synthesis has proven elusive. Our preliminary results demonstrate that stable Zn-B bonds can be achieved through the incorporation of β-diiminate ligands at the Zn centers. Based on this, we have successfully synthesized two examples of Zn-B bonded compounds from B₂pin₂ and B₂cat₂. Notably, the Zn-Bcat species has shown significant reactivity toward unsaturated substrates and holds promise for valuable catalytic applications. Building on these findings, we aim to expand this research by synthesizing a series of zinc-boryl compounds using known diboron reagents. We will explore the reaction chemistry of these new compounds by varying ligands and assessing their reactivity with small molecules and unsaturated substrates. Furthermore, we anticipate that these compounds will exhibit the nucleophilic reactivity of boryl anions, facilitating new boron-element bond formations with various electrophiles. We envision that these zinc-boryl species will promote catalytic borylation reactions in organic synthesis. This study is expected to yield novel nucleophilic boryl reagents, uncover new reactivity of Zn-B bonds, and develop innovative catalysts for organic synthesis. Our findings will enhance the understanding of main-group compounds, metal boryl species, and their applications in synthetic chemistry. 有機鋅化合物是有機合成中常用的試劑，其反應性類似於有機鋰和格氏試劑。傳統上，鋅碳鍵合試劑作爲溫和的以碳爲中心的親核試劑；然而，最近的研究興趣逐漸轉向含雜原子的有機鋅物種，這些物種通過鋅-雜原子鍵引入獨特的反應性。硼元素由於其存在空2p軌道，因而相較於其他主族元素其具有獨特的電子性質。有機鋅硼有可能展現硼基部分的親核反應性，而這在傳統路易斯酸性有機硼物種中是難以實現的。此外，鋅作爲昂貴貴金屬的有吸引力的替代品，使得鋅-硼化合物可成爲各種硼基化反應的有效催化劑。 目前已知的有機鋅硼化合物非常有限，主要由氮穩定的大型硼基框架組成，這些框架由於空間位阻而表現出受限的反應性。我們的初步結果表明，通過在鋅中心引入β-二亞胺配體，可以實現穩定的Zn-B鍵。基於此，我們成功合成了兩種來自B₂pin₂和B₂cat₂的Zn-B鍵合化合物。值得注意的是，Zn-Bcat物種對不飽和底物表現出顯著的反應性，並在催化應用中展現出潛力。 在這些髮現的基礎上，我們計劃通過使用已知的二硼試劑合成一繫列鋅-硼基化合物，進一步擴展這一研究。我們將通過變化配體和評估這些新化合物與小分子和不飽和底物的反應性來探索其反應化學。此外，我們預期這些化合物將表現出硼負離子的親核反應性，促進與各種親電試劑的新硼-元素鍵的形成。我們設想這些鋅-硼基物種將在有機合成中促進催化硼化反應。本研究預計將産生新型親核硼試劑，揭示Zn-B鍵的新反應性，並開髮創新催化劑用於有機合成。我們的研究結果將促進主族化學以及金屬硼基化合物在合成化學中應用。

11303825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303825.value: 证明奇异几何正则化的数值可计算性

11303825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303825.value: The question whether a singularity (points at which the fabric of spacetime breaks down) is removable by coordinate transformation has been of central importance in General Relativity since the time of Einstein. In fact, General Relativity has only been considered a consistent theory when it became clear that the troublesome singularity at the black hole horizon of the Schwarzschild spacetime is removable. Until today, singularity formation is a major challenge in analytical and numerical methods for solving the equations of General Relativity. However, beyond ad-hoc coordinate constructions, General Relativity lacked a unifying principle for identifying when singularities are removable, and it lacked a general procedure for removing them. The P.I., in collaboration with B. Temple, recently discovered a system of non-linear elliptic partial differential equations (the RT-equations) which provides such a general procedure for removing singularities by coordinate transformation, and which establishes boundedness of the spacetime curvature as a definitive criterion for when a singularity is removable. By developing an existence theory for the RT-equations, we gave a mathematical proof that singularities with bounded curvature are removable above a threshold regularity (degree of differentiability). This regularization of the spacetime geometry is general enough to remove spacetime singularities at fluid dynamical relativistic shock waves, (resolving an open problem in Mathematical Physics), but does not yet apply to the more severe singularities of black hole type. The first goal of this project is to develop a mathematical proof that the regularization procedure of singular geometries by the RT-equations is sufficiently stable to be computable by numerical methods. This could be transformative for the theory of Numerical Relativity by proving that the RT-equations provide a computable algorithm for removing singularities in numerical simulations (of, for example, gravitational waves or black hole formation) which does not rely on modifications of the Einstein equations that violate the laws of General Relativity. The second goal of this project is to extend the regularizations by the RT-equations below the threshold regularity they currently require, in order to address more severe singularities, for example, at black hole horizons. This would fully establish the theory of the RT-equations as the unifying principle for identifying removable singularities, together with a computable algorithm for removing them, that has been missing in General Relativity since the days of Einstein. 自爱因斯坦时代以来，奇点（时空结构崩溃的点）是否可以通过坐标变换去除一直是广义相对论的核心问题。事实上，只有当人们清楚地认识到史瓦西时空黑洞视界中那个棘手的奇点是可以去除的，广义相对论才被认为是一个自洽的理论。迄今为止，奇点的形成仍然是解析和数值方法求解广义相对论方程的一大挑战。然而，除了特设的坐标构造之外，广义相对论缺乏一个统一的原理来识别奇点何时可去除，也缺乏一个通用的去除奇点的程序。 首席研究员 (P.I.) 与 B. Temple 合作，最近发现了一个非线性椭圆偏微分方程组（RT 方程），该系统提供了一种通过坐标变换消除奇点的通用方法，并确立了时空曲率的有界性作为奇点可消除的明确标准。通过发展 RT 方程的存在性理论，我们给出了数学证明，证明曲率有界的奇点在阈值正则性（可微度）以上是可消除的。这种时空几何的正则化足够通用，可以消除流体动力学相对论冲击波中的时空奇点（解决了数学物理学中的一个未解决的问题），但尚不适用于更严重的黑洞类型奇点。 该项目的首要目标是建立数学证明，证明RT方程对奇异几何的正则化 程序足够稳定，可以用数值方法计算。这将对数值相对论产生变革性的影响，因为它证明了RT方程提供了一种可计算的算法，用于消除数值模拟（例如引力波或黑洞形成）中的奇点，而无需依赖于违反广义相对论定律的爱因斯坦方程的修正。 该项目的第二个目标是将RT方程的正则化扩展至低于其目前所需的阈值正则性，以便处理更严重的奇点，例如黑洞视界处的奇点。这将完全确立RT方程理论作为识别可移除奇点的统一原理，并同时提供可计算的移除奇点的算法，而自爱因斯坦时代以来，广义相对论中一直缺少这一理论。

11303925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303925.value: 颗粒表面有机过氧自由基化学的实验室研究

11303925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303925.value: The proposed research aims to quantify how aerosol particle size, viscosity, and organic molecular structure influence NOx-free organic peroxy radical (RO2) chemistry, emphasizing the specific role of the particle surface. RO2 is critical in atmospheric chemistry, contributing to the production of secondary organic aerosols (SOA), that affect air quality, human health, and climate change. NOx-free RO2 chemistry is now recognized as increasingly important due to shifting to sustainable energy. Despite its significance, the fate of RO2, particularly at the particle surface, remains poorly understood. The challenge lies in the difficulty of distinguishing between surface and interior reactions within the submicron particles, as well as the instability of certain products. To overcome these challenges, we will employ a novel technique, Easy Ambient Sonic-Spray Ionization Mass Spectrometry (EASI-MS), with low-energy ionization to preserve labile compounds and separately detect the compositions of the particle surface and its interior. The RO2 reaction kinetics will be investigated in the flow tube with a movable inlet. Additionally, we will develop a multiphase kinetic model to account for processes of surface reaction, diffusion, and interior reaction inside the submicron particles. By integrating data from the EASI-MS measurement and the multiphase kinetic models, we will obtain a Surface-Associated Factor (SAF) to quantify how much the reactions on the particle surface contribute to the overall reactions in the particle. Quantum chemistry calculations will be conducted to illustrate energy differences on the particle surface and its interior. With this approach, we aim to investigate how the surface of aerosol particles affects the mechanisms and kinetics of NOx-free RO2 chemistry, characterized by the SAF that depends on the molecular structure and the surrounding microenvironment. Specifically, we aim to quantify the effect of particle size, particle viscosity, and molecular structure on NOx-free RO2 chemistry and derive a corresponding empirical value for SAF. The outcome of our research will not only pave a new framework for assessing surface and interior reactions for submicron particles but also provide a valuable parameter for future estimation of surface-associated reactions for RO2 chemistry that are key to the SOA. We believe our research will ultimately deepen our understanding of the surface reactions of aerosol and provide valuable insights into broader organic processes. 11304525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11304525.value: 研究稀有跃迁事件的过渡路径理论机器学习算法

11304525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304525.value: The study of rare transition events on energy landscape is one of the important research themes in computational and applied mathematics, with far-reaching implications for statistical physics, materials science, and theoretic chemistry. Transition Path Theory (TPT) creates an important theoretical framework based on potential theory to precisely characterize rare events. Although TPT is extremely successful, it faces challenges when applied to complex, high-dimensional systems. Traditional algorithms struggle with the curse of dimensionality and complex landscape scenario, which limits the practical applications. This research aims to develop new algorithms for studying rare transition events on energy landscape, based firmly on theoretical foundations of TPT and leveraging advances in machine learning to extend their reach. The goal is to advance state-of-the-art computation of key TPT constructs — committor functions — to characterize rare events in challenging new problem domains. The following methodology is the focus of the project. First, using an optimization-based method, the committor function associated with over-damped Langevin dynamics is calculated using the variational formulation. Two ideas are explored: (i) the importance sampling based adaptive training of committor function by using deep learning and normalizing flow techniques, and (ii) the localized representation of reactive current function by incorporating the multitple pathways. Second, a self-consistent iterative approach assisted with reactive distribution is suggested to train the committor using flow-based generative models. Validation is based on committer analysis and reaction rate. Comparisons are also carried out using benchmark examples. The application of biology and organic reactions to the real world is also pursued. Overall, this work aims to overcome current limitations and accelerate characterization of rare events in complex, high-dimensional systems by integrating machine learning into the theoretical foundation of TPT. The algorithms developed promise to extend the reach of TPT to previously intractable problems, advancing the frontier of rare event simulation. 稀有事件在能量景观上的研究一直是计算数学和应用数学的重要研究主题之一，并在统计物理、材料科学和理论化学等领域具有广泛的影响。 由Vanden-Eijnden和Weinan E提出的过渡路径理论（Transition Path Theory, TPT）基于势理论建立了一个重要的理论框架，能够精确地描述跃迁稀有事件。尽管TPT取得了极大的成功，但在应用于复杂的高维系统或数据驱动问题时面临挑战。传统算法在处理维度灾难和数据场景时表现不佳，限制了其实际应用。 本研究旨在开发基于TPT理论基础的新算法，同时利用机器学习的进步来扩展TPT的应用范围。目标是推进TPT关键构造（如承诺函数、反应流和最大通量路径）的最先进计算，以便在具有挑战性的全新问题领域中表征稀有事件。 该项目采取了两种互补的方法。 第一种是基于模型的方法，计算由过阻尼朗之万动力学相关的变分公式定义的承诺函数。具体而言，探索了两个方向：(i) 使用深度学习技术对承诺函数进行自适应训练；(ii) 通过局部化表示计算流函数。第二种是数据驱动的方法，利用基于流的生成模型直接从分子动力学模拟数据中恢复承诺函数，仅需要轨迹快照。 总体而言，通过将机器学习与TPT的理论基础相结合，本研究旨在克服当前的局限性，加速复杂高维系统中稀有事件的表征。所开发的算法有望将TPT的应用范围扩展到以往难以处理的问题，推动稀有事件模拟的前沿发展。

11304825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11304825.value: 基於金屬性過渡金屬硫族化合物的質子電極研究

11304825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304825.value: Clean and renewable energy is one of the most effective tools in fighting the looming climate change, which leds to a growing demand for energy storage systems that can efficiently store and supply electrical energy. Lithium-ion batteries have long dominated the energy storage landscape with substantial commercial success mainly owing to their high energy density. However, their inherent safety risks have catalyzed the search for alternative battery technologies, such as proton batteries. Utilizing the smallest and lightest ion, protons, these batteries not only offer distinct advantages such as high energy capacity high speed, and low cost, but also superior operational safety, and environmental sustainability. Despite these benefits, a key challenge hindered the progress of proton battery technology: identifying suitable electrode materials capable of efficiently storing protons while maintaining high electrical conductivity, rapid charge-discharge rates, and long-term stability. Recent advancements in materials science have yielded many promising functional materials for diverse application. In particularly, layered (semi)-metallic transition metal dichalcogenides (LS-TMDs), offer unique combination of physical and chemical properties, including excellent electrical conductivity, layered structures with intrinsic interlayer channels, and large active surface areas. These features not only facilitate fast proton transport but also enable high charge storage capacity, positioning LS-TMDs as ideal candidates for next-generation proton batteries. This project proposes a systematic exploration of layered semi-metallic transition metal dichalcogenides (LS-TMDs) as proton-hosting electrode materials by cohesively integrating material development, micro- and macroscopic electrochemical measurements, in-situ/ex-situ characterizations, and theoretical calculations. We aim to address three critical questions: (1) What is the proton storage and transport mechanism in LS-TMD materials? (2) Are LS-TMDs suitable candidates for proton electrodes? (3) Which LS-TMDs show the greatest promise as proton electrode materials? To systematically tackle these questions, this project is divided into four phases: (1) microelectrochemical analysis of the intrinsic proton storage properties of LS-TMDs; (2) experimental and theoretical investigation of the proton-storage, proton transport and phase transition mechanisms; (3) development of mass fabrication techniques for practical LS-TMD electrodes; and (4) comprehensive performance optimization and evaluation of LS-TMD electrodes. The success of this project will expand fundamental knowledge of proton electrochemistry in electrode materials and pave the way for high-performance proton battery technology, providing a viable, eco-friendly alternative to conventional Li-ion batteries. 質子電池作為一種新興的儲能技術，展現出滿足未來清潔與高效能源需求的巨大潛力。相比於已商業化的鋰離子電池，質子儲能系統利用質量最小的質子作為載流子，實現超快離子傳輸速率，並在水性電解質中展現優異的化學穩定性，具有操作安全性高與環境友善等顯著優勢。然而，其廣泛應用仍受限於缺乏高性能電極材料，難以同時兼顧高能量密度、快速充放電能力與長期循環穩定性。近期研究顯示，層狀半金屬過渡金屬二硫族化合物（TMDs）因其優異的電子導電性、層間質子傳輸通道與高比表面積，成為極具潛力的質子電極材料候選者。本研究將系統性探討半金屬 TMD 作為質子電池電極的電化學性質，並利用片上電化學元件（On-Chip Electrochemical Microdevice, OCEM）平台，在微尺度下研究質子嵌入機制與動力學行為。同時，我們將整合原位分析技術，即時觀測充放電過程中的結構演變與化學變化，以建立材料結構與儲能性能之間的關聯。預期成果將有助於優化質子電池的能量密度、充放電速率與循環壽命，深化對質子儲能機理的理解，並推動高性能、永續性質子電池的實用化發展，為鋰離子與其他金屬離子電池提供綠色替代方案。

11304925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11304925.value: 相变超表面中的自调节高Q谐振

11304925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304925.value: High-Q resonance metasurfaces are of great interest for their ability to significantly enhance light-matter interactions at a two-dimensional interface, amplifying electromagnetic fields and enabling highly efficient optical processes. However, the strong light-matter interactions associated with high-Q resonances pose a major challenge: heat accumulation. When metasurfaces are exposed to high-energy laser pulses, rapid heat buildup can occur, leading to a rise in temperature that risks damaging the nanostructures. This damage undermines the high-Q resonances by destroying the carefully engineered nanocavities, leading to the loss of their enhanced optical properties. This research proposes the development of high-Q resonances in phase-change metasurfaces that can self-regulate light-matter interactions. Phase-change materials (PCMs) are incorporated into the metasurfaces to mitigate the thermal accumulation issue. These materials exhibit a dynamic change in refractive index when exposed to heat, switching between dielectric and metallic states. As the temperature rises, the phase transition disrupts the conditions necessary for high-Q resonances, reducing the strong light-matter interactions and thereby limiting further heat buildup. This self-regulating mechanism acts as a safeguard, preserving the integrity of the nanostructures by preventing excessive temperatures and maintaining the functionality of the metasurface. The integration of PCMs into metasurfaces provides a novel solution to the longstanding issue of thermal management in high-Q resonance devices. By automatically modulating resonance conditions in response to thermal changes, the metasurface can dynamically balance high performance with structural stability. This approach not only preserves the enhanced light-matter interactions but also extends the lifespan of the metasurface under intense operational conditions. The successful development of self-regulating high-Q metasurfaces will have broad applications in areas such as nonlinear optics, laser miniaturization, and advanced biosensing technologies. By addressing both thermal stability and performance, this work will pave the way for more resilient and efficient optical devices, expanding the practical applications of metasurface technologies in fields like quantum optics, harmonic generation, and holography. 高Q谐振超表面因其能够显著增强二维界面的光物质相互作用、放大电磁场并实现高效的光学过程而备受关注。然而，与高Q共振相关的强光物质相互作用带来了一个重大挑战：热量积累。当超表面暴露于高能激光脉冲时，会发生快速热量积聚，导致温度升高，从而有可能损坏纳米结构。这种损伤会破坏精心设计的纳米腔，从而削弱高Q谐振，导致其增强的光学特性丧失。 本研究提出了在相变超表面中开发高Q共振的方法，使其能够自调节光物质相互作用。相变材料 (PCM) 被整合到超表面中以缓解热积累问题。这些材料在受热时会表现出折射率的动态变化，在介电状态和金属状态之间切换。随着温度升高，相变会破坏高Q共振所需的条件，从而降低光与物质的强相互作用，从而限制进一步的热量积聚。这种自调节机制起到了保障作用，通过防止温度过高并维持超表面的功能，从而保护纳米结构的完整性。 将PCM集成到超表面中，为高Q共振器件中长期存在的热管理问题提供了一种新颖的解决方案。通过根据热变化自动调节共振条件，超表面可以动态地平衡高性能和结构稳定性。这种方法不仅可以保持增强的光与物质相互作用，还可以延长超表面在高强度工作条件下的使用寿命。 自调节高Q超表面的成功开发将在非线性光学、激光微型化和先进生物传感技术等领域具有广泛的应用。通过解决热稳定性和性能问题，这项工作将为更具弹性和更高效的光学设备铺平道路，扩大超表面技术在量子光学、谐波产生和全息术等领域的实际应用。

11305025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11305025.value: 包含物理意义明确的伴随偏微分方程和内置估计子的基于兴趣量的自适应最小残差有限元方法

11305025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11305025.value: In this project, we plan to develop goal-oriented (quantity-of-interest (QoI) based) adaptive minimum residual (MinRes) finite element methods with physically meaningful adjoint PDEs and built-in estimators for methods including the least-squares finite element methods (LSFEM) and the discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) with optimal test functions. We also plan to extend the ideas to reduced basis and deep neural network methods. In many scientific and engineering applications, we are interested in accurately computing the quantity of interest from numerical solutions of the underlying PDE models. The accurate computation of QoI often needs to design accurate and efficient adaptive algorithms, such algorithms are the so-called goal-oriented algorithms. The minimum residual finite element methods, including the least-squares finite element method (LSFEM) and the discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) method, have been developed for a wide range of scientific and engineering applications. One main advantage of MinRes methods (including both LSFEM and DPG) is a "built-in" a posteriori error estimator. There are two known approaches, one for the LSFEM and one for the DPG method for the QoI-MinRes methods, but none of them can use the physically meaningful dual problems and the "built-in" MinRes estimators of the corresponding problems. Our goal is to develop goal-oriented adaptive MinRes using the "built-in" a posteriori error estimators for both the primal (original) and physically meaningful dual (adjoint) problems. The main tool to use is the corrected functional value, which is a combination of some discrete evaluations of the QoI, by which an error relation without the Galerkin orthogonality can be established. Besides, with the idea developed by the P.I., we can use a non-intrusive least-squares (LS) functional error estimator to estimate a numerical solution obtained by a non-MinRes/LS method. We plan to develop non-intrusive goal-oriented adaptive methods for non-MinRes-based methods. Using the same ideas, we will develop a goal-oriented adaptive LS reduced basis method with a true-error certification and balanced, greedy algorithms. We will develop least-squares/physics-informed neural network methods with QoI-enriched functionals. 在本项目中，我们计划开发基于目标导向（基于感兴趣量（QoI））的自适应最小残差（MinRes）有限元方法，结合物理意义明确的伴随偏微分方程（PDEs）和内置误差估计子，适用于包括最小二乘有限元方法（LSFEM）和具有最优测试函数的非连续Petrov-Galerkin（DPG）方法。我们还计划将这些思路扩展到降阶基方法和深度神经网络方法。 在许多科学与工程应用中，我们关注从底层PDE模型的数值解中精确计算感兴趣量（QoI）。QoI的精确计算通常需要设计准确且高效的自适应算法，这类算法被称为目标导向算法。最小残差有限元方法，包括最小二乘有限元方法（LSFEM）和非连续Petrov-Galerkin（DPG）方法，已被广泛应用于科学与工程领域。MinRes方法（包括LSFEM和DPG）的一个主要优势是具有“内置”的后验误差估计子。目前已知两种方法，一种针对LSFEM，另一种针对DPG方法，可以用于QoI-MinRes方法，但这些方法均无法利用物理意义明确的伴随问题和相应问题的“内置”的MinRes误差估计子。 我们的目标是开发基于目标导向的自适应MinRes方法，利用“内置”后验误差估计子，同时适用于原始（原问题）和物理意义明确的伴随（对偶）问题。主要工具是修正泛函值，通过对QoI的某些离散组合，建立一个不依赖Galerkin正交性的误差关系。此外，我们可以使用非侵入式最小二乘（LS）泛函误差估计子来估计非MinRes/LS方法得到的数值解。我们计划为非MinRes方法开发非侵入式目标导向自适应方法。基于相同的思路，我们将开发具有真实误差认证和平衡贪婪算法的目标导向自适应LS降阶基方法。我们还将开发基于最小二乘/物理信息神经网络方法，结合QoI增强的功能。

11305125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11305125.value: 基于非局域超构透镜的高品质因子自旋复用成像

11305125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11305125.value: Bright-field and edge-enhanced imaging can provide morphological information of amplitude and phase objects. Multiplexing these two imaging techniques facilitates the detailed visualization of intricate structures, such as biological tissues and cells. Meta-lenses, known for their compact size and flexible electromagnetic manipulation, are potential candidates beyond traditional bulk devices for multiplexing imaging. Professor Din Ping Tsai (Co-I of this project) has demonstrated the high-efficiency and broadband meta-lenses. Local responses are employed to independently control the electromagnetic properties of each meta-atom, offering unique capabilities such as achromatism, tunability, and multimodal perception. Despite these advancements, the lack of spectral modulation introduces the crosstalk between different wavelengths, hampering the imaging quality, especially for biological samples requiring precise wavelength specificity. To introduce additional spectral and momentum modulation, nonlocal responses are involved by effectively manipulating the collective resonant responses of multiple meta-atoms, leading to substantial applications, such as nonlinear generation, edge detection, and spatial radiation control. However, the performance of current nonlocal meta-lenses - such as quality factor, efficiency, and manipulation dimension - remains constrained by the trade-off between local and nonlocal responses, and the potential for multifunctionality in these meta-devices has not been explored. Here, we propose and fabricate the nonlocal meta-lens for high-quality-factor spin-multiplexing imaging. Quasi-bound states in the continuum (q-BICs) are designed to be excited for a high quality factor of ~100 and incident-angle dependence. Fano effect from interactions between q-BIC and in-plane Mie-type resonance generates a transmission peak (dip) with (without) geometric phase for output left-handed (right-handed) circular polarization. Enhanced polarization conversion efficiency of ~80% is expected, accompanied by a minimal unconverted value, surpassing the theoretical limit of traditional thin nonlocal metasurfaces. In addition, the design ensures geometric rotation robustness, providing stable phase modulation and minimal phase change for two spin states, respectively. Leveraging these effects, the wavelength-selective focusing and bright-field imaging can be realized to have an efficiency enhanced by at least ten folds at resonant wavelength compared to the nonresonant one. The other output spin state is utilized for edge-enhanced imaging, capable of resolving micrometer-scale objects. The successful accomplishment of this project offers a vital approach for efficient high-quality-factor meta-lenses. The advantages of our nonlocal meta-lens are compact size, high efficiency, customized high quality factor, and multifunctionality. We believe the significant impact of this project can promote the revolution of next-generation imaging technology, such as biomedical detection, virtual reality/augmented reality display technology, and nonlinear/quantum applications. 明场成像与边缘增强成像可为振幅与相位物体提供形貌信息。将这两种成像技术进行复用，有助于更细致地观察复杂结构，例如生物组织和细胞。超构透镜凭借其结构紧凑、电磁调控灵活等优势，有望取代传统体块光学器件，成为复用成像系统中的核心组件。项目的共同主持人蔡定平教授已展示了具有高效率和宽光谱响应的超构透镜。该设计利用局域响应，实现对每个超构原子电磁特性的独立调控，使得消色差、可调谐性和多模态感知等功能成为可能。尽管取得了一系列进展，当前超构透镜仍缺乏光谱调控能力，从而导致不同波长之间产生串扰，特别是在生物样品成像等需要高波长选择性的应用中，成像质量会受到显著影响。 为了引入更多的光谱与动量自由度，本研究进一步引入非局域响应，通过有效调控多个超构原子的集体共振，实现如非线性信号产生、边缘检测及空间辐射调控等关键应用。然而，现有非局域超构透镜的性能表现——包括品质因子、效率与调控维度——仍受限于局域与非局域响应之间的权衡，其在多功能集成方面的潜力尚未被系统探索。 本项目提出并实现了一种用于高品质因子自旋复用成像的非局域超构透镜。设计中激发了连续域准束缚态模式，使器件具备约100的高品质因子以及对入射角的敏感响应。连续域准束缚态模式与面内米氏共振之间的相互作用诱发法诺效应，左旋圆偏振输出出现具备几何相位的透射峰，而右旋圆偏振则对应无几何相位控制的透射谷。该机制实现了约80%的偏振转换效率，同时显著抑制了未转换部分，突破了传统薄型非局域超表面的理论极限。此外，该设计对几何旋转误差具有良好的鲁棒性，可为两种自旋态分别提供稳定的相位调控和极小的相位变化。借助上述机制，器件实现了波长选择性聚焦和明场成像，在共振波长下效率相较非共振波长提高至少一个数量级；而另一自旋态可用于边缘增强成像，能够解析微米尺度结构。 本项目的成功将为高效、高品质因子超构透镜的发展提供关键思路。所提出的非局域超构透镜兼具结构紧凑、高效率、可定制高品质因子以及多功能集成等突出优势，预计将为下一代成像技术，特别是生物医学检测、虚拟/增强现实显示、以及非线性与量子光学应用，带来重要推动作用。

11305625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11305625.value: 管道中可壓縮歐拉流的自由邊界的確定問題

11305625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11305625.value: This project aims to develop rigorous mechanisms and mathematical theories on determining the free boundary in a finitely long nozzle for multi-dimensional steady compressible Euler flow by studying several important problems. In particular, it mainly focuses on the location of the subsonic contact discontinuity with a given pressure at the outlet of the nozzle, the location of the transonic shock with combustion phenomenon in a finitely long nozzle, and other related problems. Starting from the seminal works in [6, 7, 42], there are many results on the steady gas flow with a free boundary in nozzles, for example, transonic shocks in nozzles [3, 4, 8, 12–15, 20–24, 28–34, 38, 39, 41, 43] or contact discontinuities in a finitely long nozzle [25–27]. Following [18], we will impose the receiver pressure condition at the exit of the nozzle, the slip boundary condition along the nozzle walls, and appropriate boundary conditions at the inlet of the nozzle depending on whether the incoming flow is supersonic or subsonic. Mathematically, these problems can be formulated into a free boundary value problem governed by nonlinear equations. The key difficulty is that the free boundary can be arbitrarily shifted for uniform flows. Therefore, finding plausible mechanisms to determine the free boundary location in a horizontal flat nozzle is a longstanding mathematical open problem. Recently for the transonic shock in a horizontal flat nozzle problem, two mechanisms have been introduced based on the non-flatness of the nozzle wall in [24] and the non-zero swirl velocity in [22]. However, rigorous mathematical analysis for such problems is far from being satisfied.
