Existing imaging methods face notable limitations: optical microscopy lacks specificity for lipids, Label-free microscopy provides only general class-level chemical information without identifying individual molecules, and electron microscopy, though it offers ultra-high spatial resolution, cannot provide molecular information. Hard ionization techniques like SIMS and LDI achieve fine spatial detail but cause extensive molecular fragmentation, which limits the detection of endogenous molecules. Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization (MALDI) mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) offers a promising solution by using a soft ionization process that preserves molecular structures and provides broad molecular coverage. However, traditional MALDI MSI is typically limited to spatial resolutions of 5 to 20 micrometers, which is insufficient for capturing subcellular details. This proposal seeks to create a comprehensive, label-free MALDI MSI workflow capable of achieving a spatial resolution of 250 to 300 nanometers, comparable to the level of optical microscopy, for detailed subcellular molecular visualization. The core idea of this research is to enhance the spatial resolution of MALDI mass spectrometry imaging by physically expanding the sample size. We originally proposed and developed the concept and method of Expansion Mass Spectrometry Imaging (ExMSI), which overcomes the limitations and challenges of hardware design for ultra-small laser spots and sample preparation. In previous work, we successfully reached 500 nm resolution with a 10-fold sample expansion. Now, we aim to push the spatial resolution further, to 250 to 300 nm, using a 20-fold expansion. This advancement will enable imaging at the nanometer scale with the ability to detect a wide range of molecules while preserving their integrity. The proposed ExMSI platform will provide an unprecedented view of molecular details at the subcellular level in cultured cells and brain tissues, significantly advancing our understanding in fields like cellular biology and neuroscience. It represents a powerful tool for researchers seeking new insights into the complex molecular processes underlying health and disease. 本專案擬發展一種新型免標記膨脹質譜成像技術，通過整合物理組織膨脹方法與高分辨質譜成像技術，突破傳統質譜成像的空間解析度限制，實現亞細胞水準的分子視覺化。該技術具有以下創新點：（1）建立無需標記的樣本前處理方法，保持原始分子資訊完整性；（2）開發基於水凝膠膨脹的組織處理新策略，顯著提升空間解析度至光學顯微鏡水準；（3）構建配套的資料分析方法，實現複雜生物樣本的高通量分子成像。本專案將在腦科學和腫瘤研究領域開展應用驗證，重點解析神經元突觸和腫瘤微環境中關鍵生物分子的空間分佈特徵。研究成果將為生命科學基礎研究提供全新的高分辨分子成像工具，並為疾病機制研究提供重要技術支撐。

12301925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301925.value: 圖像處理中基於數學模型引導的深度神經網絡框架

12301925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301925.value: Image processing is a critical area of research with extensive applications across various fields. Over the past decades, numerous mathematical models and algorithms have been developed, which have demonstrated significant performance and have been widely adopted across different domains. Recently, deep neural networks have shown superior performance in a variety of image processing tasks. However, the design of most neural networks is empirical, and the mathematical rationale behind their success remains largely unclear. The connections between these networks and established mathematical models and algorithms require further investigation. Although there have been attempts to integrate neural networks with mathematical algorithms and prior information, most existing works merely replace components of mathematical algorithms with networks or append network by operations induced from prior information. A systematic approach that seamlessly incorporates neural networks with mathematical models, providing clear mathematical explanations, is still lacking. This proposal aims to develop a framework for designing mathematical model-guided neural networks tailored for image processing applications. The project contains two parts. In the first part, we develop our framework for general image processing models, which comprise a regularization term and a fidelity term. Utilizing the hybrid splitting method, we propose an operator-splitting algorithm to solve these models. This algorithm is a model-guided neural network as it is essentially a neural network with activation functions derived from the underlying mathematical model. As a result, each component of the network has a precise algorithmic interpretation. Our framework is general enough to be applicable to a wide range of models and tasks. In the second part, we explore the application of the proposed framework to various types of models and tasks, using the ROF model and Euler's elastica model as examples for image denoising, inpainting, and deblurring. Our framework offers a systematic approach to integrating neural networks with mathematical models and priors. This integration leverages the strengths of classical models within neural networks, thereby advancing the state-of-the-art in image processing. Our framework elucidates a deep connection between deep neural networks and mathematical models, providing an innovative perspective on the design and explainability of neural network architectures. This approach holds the potential to substantially advance the development of future deep learning methodologies. 圖像處理是多個學科中的重要問題，並具有廣泛應用。過去數十年來，研究者們開發了眾多數學模型與算法，這些方法不僅展現出卓越的性能，更在各領域獲得了普遍應用。 近年來，深度神經網絡在各類圖像處理任務中表現出超越傳統方法的性能。然而，現有神經網絡的設計多基於經驗性探索，其成功背後的數學機理仍不明確。這些網絡與傳統數學模型、算法之間的內在聯繫亟需深入探究。儘管已有研究嘗試將神經網絡與數學算法及先驗信息相結合，但現有工作大多僅用網絡替換算法中的某些模塊，或將先驗信息轉化為網絡運算進行簡單疊加。目前仍缺乏一種系統性的方法，能夠將神經網絡與數學模型有機融合，並給出清晰的數學解釋。 本課題旨在建立一套面向圖像處理的利用數學模型引導神經網絡設計的框架。研究包含兩個組成部分：第一部分針對由正則項和保真項構成的通用圖像處理模型，基於混合分裂法提出算子分裂算法進行求解。該算法本質上是一個激活函數源自數學模型的神經網絡，因此每個網絡組件都具有精確的算法解釋。該框架具有普適性，可廣泛應用於各類模型與任務。第二部分以ROF模型和歐拉彈性體模型為例，將所提框架應用於圖像去噪、修復及去模糊等任務。 本研究提出的框架為神經網絡與數學模型及先驗知識的融合提供了系統性解決方案。通過將經典模型優勢融入神經網絡架構，該研究將推動圖像處理技術的創新發展。該框架將揭示了深度神經網絡與數學模型之間的聯繫，為神經網絡架構的設計與可解釋性研究提供了新的視角，對推動未來深度學習方法的發展具有重要價值。

12302125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302125.value: 雙探針反應性導向分析法識別飲用水中有毒反應性副產物

12302125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302125.value: Disinfection is a crucial process for effectively preventing waterborne diseases from spreading in water supplies to human communities. However, during the reaction between disinfectants and impurities in source water, harmful disinfection by-products (DBPs) can form. While many DBPs are known, and some are recognized as carcinogens, a significant number of DBPs remain unidentified. Therefore, high priority should be given to identifying DBPs that are inherently toxic, or that might be further converted into other hazardous byproducts upon water disinfection. In this study, a pioneering biomimetic approach – dual probe reactivity-directed analysis (DP-RDA), combining i) amine-and thiol-reactivity and ii) high-resolution mass spectrometry – is proposed for the identification, characterization and prioritization of unknown toxic DBPs generated in disinfected water. Amines and thiols represent the nucleophilic sites that can be bound by electrophiles (i.e., reactive DBPs), and their reactivites are toxicologically meaningful and well correlated with toxicities of DBPs. While the current single probe-RDA approaches do enhance the “visibility” of unknown toxic DBPs, the number of unidentified DBPs that can be captured is limited by the unique chemical properties of a single probe. In contrast, the DP-RDA method can not only capture both amine-reactive and thiol-reactive DBPs, but also reveal the previously overlooked hazardous DBPs. Given the structural variability of natural organic matter (NOM) in our source waters, it is likely that numerous emerging DBPs are generated during water disinfection. In order to advance our understanding of the impacts of these unidentified DBPs on water safety, we need to investigate: (a) the effects of different organic matter as precursors of amine-/thiol-reactive DBPs; (b) their formation mechanisms; and (c) their occurrence in our drinking water. To respond to these concerns, this work will first develop a DP-RDA-based technique, integrating the use of both amine and thiol probes to specifically detect and trace these harmful DBPs formed during water disinfection. The formation mechanism of these emerging DBPs will then be investigated using different types of selected precursors and NOM upon chlor(am)ination. A comprehensive occurrence study of these emerging DBPs in the Greater Bay Area (Hong Kong and Shenzhen) and Barcelona will also be conducted, utilizing the developed method for examining drinking water samples. The chemical data produced in this study will contribute to the fundamental understanding of the formation of toxic emerging DBPs through chlor(am)ination. This work will significantly advance our ability to keep our drinking water safe and our ecosystems healthy.

12302225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302225.value: 基於微流體模型與 3D 質譜成像探索細菌生物膜對治療的反應

12302225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302225.value: Bacterial biofilms, found in diverse environments including the human body, pose significant challenges due to their complex growth dynamics and regulatory systems. These microbial colonies are often responsible for persistent infections in lung infections, chronic wounds, and implanted medical devices. There is an urgent need for new strategies and therapeutic agents to effectively eradicate biofilm infections. While existing research has focused on biofilm resistance mechanisms, less understanding has been acquired to their complex structure, environmental heterogeneity, and adaptive responses, all of which contribute to biofilms' resilience and inform potential treatment strategies. Understanding these facets is crucial for developing effective elimination methods. Additionally, the incubation model significantly impacts biofilm studies. Most research on biofilm responses to external stimuli has utilized flowcell models, simulating high-shear environments. However, biofilms also thrive in low-shear conditions, such as those grown on the gas-tissue interfaces in lung and diabetic foot. Without the stress and draining effect from the shear flow, these static biofilms have distinct characters, while metabolic and signaling molecular distribution could be better preserved for analysis. Furthermore, antibiotic testing typically involves fixed concentrations, which does not reflect clinical scenarios where fluctuating antibiotic concentrations diffuse into infected tissues and biofilm, exposing some bacteria in the biofilms to lower concentrations that complicate eradication efforts. Similarly, some dispersal agents were reported to enhance treatment efficacy in a flowcell model, but it remains unclear whether the conclusion is valid for the significantly different static biofilms. A better model is demanded for studies on this topic. To address these challenges, we propose developing a microfluidic device that simulates realistic biofilm treatment under localized stimulation. This platform will create controllable drug gradients, allowing us to study biofilm responses in heterogeneous environments without shear flow. Also, we will employ a novel moisture-assisted cryo-section (MACS) technique we recently developed for high-resolution 3D mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) of bacterial colonies. This technique provides detailed visualization of the spatial distribution of molecules within biofilms, revealing their multi-layered molecular organization. Using this method, we will compare the signaling molecules in biofilms grown on this platform with those cultured conventionally, validating the visualization of quorum sensing (QS) regulation processes. We will also investigate the fundamental questions with dispersal agents under static biofilm condition, and investigate the potential of using adjuvants to enhance the effectiveness of antibiotic treatment. This work aims to provide an upgraded framework for understanding QS regulation and dispersion, and developing future treatment strategies. 細菌生物膜存在於多種環境中，包括人體內部，因其複雜的生長動態與調控系統而構成重大挑戰。這些微生物菌落往往是導致肺部感染、慢性傷口及植入式醫療設備中持續性感染的元兇。當前亟需開發新策略與治療劑以有效根除生物膜感染。儘管現有研究多聚焦於生物膜的耐藥機制，但對其複雜結構、環境異質性及適應性反應的理解仍顯不足——這些因素共同造就了生物膜的頑強特性，同時也為潛在治療策略提供了線索。深入理解這些面向對於開發有效根除方法至關重要。 此外，培養模式對生物膜研究具有重大影響。目前關於生物膜對外部刺激反應的研究多採用流體腔模型，以模擬高剪切力環境。然而，生物膜同樣能於低剪切力條件下繁衍，例如生長於肺部及糖尿病足部氣體-組織交界處的菌落。由於缺乏剪切流造成的應力與沖刷效應，這類靜態生物膜呈現獨特性狀，同時其代謝與信號分子的分布狀態能更完整地保存以供分析。 另一方面，抗生素測試通常採用固定濃度，此方式無法反映臨床實際情境：在感染組織與生物膜內部，抗生素濃度會因擴散作用而波動，導致生物膜中部分細菌暴露於低濃度藥物環境，從而增加根除難度。同樣地，雖有研究報告指出在流體腔模型中分散劑可提升療效，但此結論是否適用於特性迥異的靜態生物膜仍屬未知。因此，該領域研究迫切需要更優化的實驗模型。 為應對這些挑戰，我們提出開發一種微流體裝置，能在局部刺激下模擬真實的生物膜治療情境。此平台將生成可控制的藥物梯度，使我們能於無剪切流的異質環境中研究生物膜反應。同時，我們將採用近期開發的新型濕度輔助冷凍切片技術（MACS），對細菌菌落進行高解析度三維質譜成像（MSI）。此技術能精細呈現生物膜內分子的空間分布，揭示其多層次的分子組織結構。透過此方法，我們將比較在此平台上培養與傳統方式培養的生物膜中信號分子的差異，驗證對群體感應（QS）調控過程的可視化研究。我們亦將探究靜態生物膜條件下使用分散劑的基礎科學問題，並探索佐劑提升抗生素療效的潛力。本研究旨在建立升級版研究框架，以理解群體感應調控與分散機制，從而推動未來治療策略的開發。

12302825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302825.value: 催化的碳-氧鍵斷裂/碳-膦鍵構建合成軸手性膦配體

12302825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302825.value: Chirality is a fundamental concept in chemistry, with chiral molecules playing critical roles in medicine, agriculture, and materials science. Traditional methods for synthesizing these important chiral compounds rely on organic synthesis, particularly asymmetric synthesis. Among the various strategies, asymmetric catalysis stands out as one of the most effective and promising approaches. The advancement of previously underexplored catalytic asymmetric reactions opens up new opportunities and challenges. Axially chiral phosphine ligands are among the most powerful tools in asymmetric catalysis, essential for inducing chirality in the formation of chiral centers. These ligands not only improve the performance of catalysts but also enhance their stability by modifying their structural components. Despite their importance, straightforward methods for constructing axially chiral frameworks are still limited, hindering their wider application in industry. Given the high demand for axially chiral phosphine ligands, developing novel, efficient, and practical methods for their direct synthesis is crucial. This research focuses on innovative approaches involving C-O bond cleavage and C-P bond formation to meet the increasing need for these compounds in asymmetric catalysis. By exploring diverse synthetic techniques for creating axially chiral phosphine ligands, this study aims to broaden the available strategies in asymmetric catalytic reactions. Additionally, it seeks to enhance our understanding of the electronic properties and potential applications of these ligands. The findings from this research are expected to be of significant interest to both academic researchers and the fine chemical industry, potentially driving advancements in catalysis and related fields. 手性是化學中的一個基本概念，手性分子在醫藥、農業和材料科學領域扮演著關鍵角色。傳統合成這類重要手性化合物的方法主要依賴有機合成，尤其是不對稱合成。在眾多策略中，不對稱催化因其高效性和前景廣闊而脫穎而出。催化不對稱反應的進展，為這一領域帶來了新的機遇與挑戰。 軸手性膦配體是不對稱催化中最有效的工具之一，對於誘導手性中心形成至關重要。這類配體不僅能提升催化劑的性能，還能通過調節其結構組分增強穩定性。儘管其重要性毋庸置疑，目前構建軸手性骨架的直接方法仍十分有限，阻礙了其在工業中的廣泛應用。 考慮到軸手性膦配體的高需求，開發新穎、高效且實用的直接合成方法至關重要。本研究聚焦於通過碳-氧鍵斷裂和碳-磷鍵形成的創新策略，以滿足不對稱催化中對這類化合物日益增長的需求。 通過探索多樣化的軸手性膦配體合成技術，本研究旨在拓展不對稱催化反應的可用策略。同時，研究亦致力於深化對這類配體電子特性及潛在應用的理解。此項研究成果預計將引起學術界和精細化工行業的廣泛關注，有望推動催化及相關領域的發展。

12304225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12304225.value: 光倍增有機光探測器中暗電流抑制的機制研究

12304225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304225.value: Organic photodetectors (OPDs) offer a promising alternative to conventional inorganic counterparts due to the customizable optical and electrical properties of the organic semiconductor materials. Photodiode-type OPDs are limited to an external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 100%. The photomultiplication (PM) effect is demonstrated in OPDs achieving an EQE of > 100%. Different PM OPDs having dispersed electron or hole traps in a bulk heterojunction (BHJ) have been reported. Under illumination, light-induced current can be produced, due to the trap-assisted charge injection at the BHJ/electrode interface in a PM OPD under an operation voltage. However, the ratios of donors to acceptors that produce either electron or hole traps in a BHJ must be very low. An excess fraction of the donor molecules creating hole traps, or an extra fraction of acceptor molecules producing electron traps in a BHJ, will result in a high dark current in a PM OPD. This occurs because a high density of charge traps forms a percolation pathway, causing hopping conduction by the charges in the BHJ. The performance of the PM OPD deteriorates as the donor-to-acceptor ratio shifts away from the respective optimal values. In addition, a low donor-to-acceptor ratio across a BHJ also requires a high operation voltage, impacting the practicality of the PM OPD as a viable option for different applications. This project proposes to develop a novel approach to mitigate the dark current in PM OPD by employing a charge trap gradient absorber. The donor-to-acceptor ratio is not uniformly across the BHJ, instead it has a vertical gradually changing ratio of donor to acceptor. The use of a charge trap gradient BHJ has two advantages: (1) it effectively eliminates the charge percolation pathway due to the existence of a very low charge trap density region, which reduces the dark current, (2) it creates a high charge trap density region to enhance the band bending in the BHJ near the electrode vicinity, and thereby facilitating an efficient tunneling charge injection due to an accumulation of the trapped photo-generated charges. This design helps to reduce the dark current and enhances trap-induced tunneling charge injection simultaneously at a low operation voltage. The resulting technology will enable high-performance PM OPDs for a plethora of applications in areas such as high-resolution image sensing, weak light detection, security monitoring, artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, and optical communications. 有機光探測器憑藉其可調控的光電特性，作為傳統無機光探測器的替代技術正受到廣泛關注。其中，光倍增效應使有機光探測器的外量子效率突破傳統光電二極體型元件的100%限制，為實現高靈敏度探測提供了可能。然而，光倍增型有機光探測器普遍面臨暗電流高的問題，主要源自於體異質結中的高給受體比例引發的高密度電荷陷阱。這些陷阱可形成電荷貫通路徑，導致跳躍導電現象，顯著降低有機光探測器的信噪比與穩定性，並提高了工作電壓，限制了其微光探測等實際應用中的可行性。 本計劃提出並研究一種新型「電荷陷阱梯度吸收層」結構，透過在體異質結中建構垂直方向上給受體比例漸變的梯度分佈，在體異質結內部低陷阱密度區可以阻斷電荷跳躍通道降低暗電流，在靠近電極區域形成高陷阱密度空間電荷富集區誘導形成的能帶彎曲的電荷注入，從而為實現高性能、低功耗、弱光響應靈敏光倍增型的有機光探測器奠定理論基礎與技術支撐。計劃成果可望廣泛應用於高解析度成像、微光探測、安全監控、人工智慧、物聯網和光通訊等前沿領域，具有重要的科學意義和應用價值。

12500925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500925.value: 解構開源人工智慧平臺中的治理機制：通過數位助推方法促進大型語言模型的採納與發展

12500925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12500925.value: Prof Fang, Yulin Liu, Xiao Chen

12500925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500925.value: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has revolutionized artificial intelligence, with open-source platforms like Hugging Face emerging as crucial hubs for collaboration and innovation. These platforms democratize access to cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and foster vibrant developer ecosystems. Nevertheless, traditional platform governance approaches struggle to adapt to the unique challenges posed by LLMs, including their scale, complexity, and potential societal impact. While existing literature has explored factors influencing open-source software project success, there remains a significant gap in our understanding of the specific dynamics surrounding LLM models within these platforms. This research proposes a novel approach that leverages digital nudging theory to examine the effectiveness of various platform governance mechanisms in promoting LLM development and adoption. Our framework incorporates different types of digital nudges, including presentation nudges (leaderboards), information nudges (trial spaces), and nudges with facilitation (implementation of advanced models like Llama 3). By examining these nudges in the context of open-source AI platforms, we aim to provide insights into effective governance strategies that can foster innovation, ensure fairness, and promote responsible AI development. Our study comprises two main components: a panel regression analysis of LLM data and a quasi-experimental design to examine the impact of implementing advanced models. The first phase of the study (Study 1) investigates how different types of digital nudges influence LLM project popularity and adoption, considering the moderating effects of model type. The second phase (Study 2) explores the impact of introducing Llama 3 on the Hugging Face platform, analyzing changes in LLM developers’ behavior output. Through this multi-faceted approach, we contribute to the literatures on digital platform governance, open-source software development, and ethical considerations in AI advancement. Study findings will inform platform designers, policymakers, and AI practitioners on effective strategies for fostering a thriving, innovative, and responsible AI development community within the rapidly evolving landscape of LLMs. 大型語言模型(LLMs)的快速發展徹底改變了人工智慧領域，Hugging Face這樣的開源平臺已成為協作創新的重要樞紐。這些平臺使前沿人工智慧技術的獲取變得民主化，並培育了充滿活力的開發者生態系統。然而，傳統的平臺治理方法難以適應大型語言模型帶來的獨特挑戰，包括其規模、複雜性和潛在的社會影響。雖然現有文獻已經探討了影響開源軟體專案成功的因素，但我們對這些平臺內大型語言模型特定動態的理解仍存在顯著差距。 本研究提出了一種新穎的方法，利用數位助推理論來檢驗各種平臺治理機制在促進大型語言模型開發和採納方面的有效性。我們的框架整合了不同類型的數字助推，包括展示性助推(排行榜)、資訊性助推(試用空間)，以及具有便利性的助推(實施像Llama 3這樣的先進模型)。通過在開源人工智慧平臺背景下研究這些助推機制，我們旨在為有效的治理策略提供見解，這些策略能夠促進創新、確保公平性並推動負責任的人工智慧發展。 我們的研究包含兩個主要組成部分：大型語言模型資料的面板回歸分析和檢驗先進模型實施影響的准實驗設計。研究的第一階段(研究1)調查不同類型的數字助推如何影響大型語言模型專案的受歡迎程度和採用率，同時考慮模型類型的調節效應。第二階段(研究2)探索在Hugging Face平臺上引入Llama 3的影響，分析大型語言模型開發者行為輸出的變化。通過這種多維度的方法，我們為數位平臺治理、開源軟體發展以及人工智慧發展中的倫理考量等文獻做出貢獻。研究發現將為平臺設計者、政策制定者和人工智慧從業者提供有效策略，以在快速發展的大型語言模型領域內培育一個繁榮、創新且負責任的人工智慧開發社區。

12501325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12501325.value: 揭示顧客之聲：科技革新時代下人機服務團隊對顧客建言行為的影響探究

12501325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12501325.value: Prof Mende, Martin Prof Scott, Maura

12501325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501325.value: Today’s service customers are no longer mere bystanders but active participants and “partial employees,” who contribute ideas and suggestions for improving service processes. Such customer voice is a critical form of engagement that firms actively seek to enhance but often struggle to achieve; in their daily interactions, 96% of customers resist voicing their opinions (Hyken 2020). Furthermore, among the limited research into drivers of customer voice behaviors, we find little consideration of the potential effects of advanced technologies, such as artificial agents (AA; e.g., robots, chatbots), when leveraged alongside human service employees. Such uses are increasingly common though, and AA are taking over substantial service provision roles. In an effort to address the potentially critical relationship between using AA and promoting customer voice, the proposed study will examine how customers perceive multi-agent service teams (comprising human employees and AA) and the resulting effects on their voice behaviors. By leveraging self-categorization theory (Turner 1999), we propose that two opposing mechanisms determine the effects of human–AA (vs. human-human) service teams on customer voice behaviors: trait complementarity(TC) and trait transference(TT). Furthermore, we account for two key forms of customer voice—promotive and prohibitive—to specify their distinctive implications for firms. Beyond these focal considerations, our research will include various contextual factors, such as customer characteristics, collaboration form, and team features, with the recognition that they might also influence the effects of human–AA teams on customer voice behavior. Some preliminary findings provide initial evidence that both forms of customer voice behavior are prevalent in human–AA service team settings. To test the main hypotheses, we plan to conduct a series of studies, incorporating both field and experimental methodologies. We have secured collaboration letters from companies in multiple service contexts, which promises to enhance the feasibility of our studies. The proposed research project will represent the first empirical effort to elucidate the intricate interplay among human service providers, AA, and service customers engaged in voice behaviors. We believe the resulting findings can enrich scholarly understanding of appropriate strategies for promoting various customer behaviors in contemporary, technology-driven service landscapes. They also will offer insights into some bright and dark sides of adopting human–AA service teams and reveal underlying psychological mechanisms and boundary conditions that drive these effects, which can provide valuable insights to firms seeking to navigate the evolving contemporary service landscape effectively. 現今的服務顧客已不再只是被動的旁觀者，而是積極的參與者與「部分員工」，他們會提出改進服務流程的構想與建議。此類顧客聲音（customer voice）是企業極力追求卻往往難以實現的關鍵參與形式；在日常互動中，高達96%的顧客不願主動反饋意見（Hyken 2020）。此外，在有限的顧客聲音行為驅動因素研究中，我們發現鮮少探討先進技術如人工智慧代理(AA) (例如服務機器人、聊天機器人）與人類服務員工協作時可能產生的影響。然而，此類應用日益普遍，AA 正逐步承擔大量服務職能（Gray and Suri 2017）。 為探討「使用 AA」與「促進顧客聲音」之間潛在的關鍵關聯，本研究將檢視顧客對多代理服務團隊（由人類員工與 AA 組成）的感知，及其對聲音行為的影響。基於自我分類理論（self-categorization theory; Turner 1999），我們提出兩項對立機制—特質互補性（trait complementarity, TC）與特質轉移（trait transference, TT）—來解釋人機 (human-AA) vs. 人際 (human-human）服務團隊對顧客聲音行為的差異效應。此外，我們區分顧客聲音的兩種關鍵類型（促進性與抑制性），以釐清其對企業的獨特意涵。除核心機制外，本研究亦納入顧客特徵、協作形式及團隊屬性等情境因素，探討其對人機團隊與顧客聲音行為關係的調節作用。 初步研究結果顯示，兩種顧客聲音行為在人機服務團隊情境中均普遍存在。為驗證核心假設，我們規劃結合實地調查與實驗法進行一系列研究，並已獲得多個服務業場域的合作意向書，確保研究可行性。 本計畫將成為首項實證研究，闡明人類服務提供者、AA 與顧客聲音行為間的複雜互動。研究成果不僅能深化學界對當代科技驅動服務環境中顧客行為促進機制的理解，更將揭示人機團隊應用的利弊，並挖掘其背後的心理機制與邊界條件，為企業在快速演變的服務生態中提供策略性洞見。

12501425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12501425.value: 股票網紅與中國市場的散戶交易

12501425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501425.value: China’s stock market is unique, driven by its dominance of retail investors. The behavioral biases of small investors have been a critical factor contributing to the underperformance of the Chinese stock market. Retail investors usually follow influencers on social media to guide their investment decisions. Theoretically, Pedersen (2022) pioneered that influencers affect the naive investors’ belief and price movements. Anecdotal evidence suggests that influencers utilize social media to manipulate stock prices. Despite their pivotal roles, little research has focused on the credibility of influencers' information and their potential involvement in market manipulation. Rational posts by influencers could reduce information asymmetry and provide investment value to retail investors, while irrational or misleading content might harm market efficiency. This project seeks to explore the topical structure of influencers’ discussions and assess the credibility of their information. Leveraging the unique structure of the Chinese stock market and a proprietary account-level retail trading dataset covering more than 20 million accounts and 4,000 stocks, we aim to evaluate how influencers impact retail investors’ beliefs, trading behavior, and overall market efficiency, providing evidence of their potential in market manipulation. We have four primary objectives. First, we characterize the topical structure of influencers’ discussions by employing the cutting-edge topic modelling techniques (BERTopic). Second, we assess the credibility in the influencers’ information by linking their topic allocation to firm-level news and macroeconomic dynamics. Third, using a comprehensive account-level retail trading dataset, we examine how different topics influence retail trading and whether these trading activities correspond with stock price movements, aiming to uncover evidence of influencers’ potential in market manipulation. Lastly, scrutinizing the topic allocation between influencers and naive investors, we unveil the belief spillover process in social networks. Moreover, we also plan to explore how different topics affect price informativeness and market efficiency in the Chinese market. Our study has several contributions. Academically, we advance the application of AI and machine learning with large language models in finance by exploring the multi-dimensional topic structure of influencer discussions. The identified topics open potential avenues for further research in various markets. Practically, we assess both the credibility and potential manipulative roles of influencers, while also highlighting their possible positive contributions to market efficiency. Finally, our findings provide valuable insights for policymakers and regulators, offering recommendations to better monitor influencer activity and ensure the stable operation of China’s stock market. 中國的股票市場具有獨特性，主要由散戶投資者主導。散戶投資者的行為偏誤是造成中國股市表現不佳的關鍵因素之一。散戶投資者通常會在社交媒體上追隨網紅，藉此指導他們的投資決策。理論上，Pedersen (2022) 開創性地提出，網紅影響了散戶投資者的信念及價格波動。根據經驗證據，網紅利用社交媒體操控股價。儘管網紅在股市中的作用至關重要，然而，對於網紅信息的可信度以及他們是否涉及市場操控的研究仍然相對較少。網紅理性發佈的內容可以減少信息不對稱，並為散戶投資者提供投資價值，而非理性或誤導性的內容則可能損害市場效率。本研究旨在探討網紅討論內容的主題結構，並評估其信息的可信度。利用中國股市的獨特結構以及涵蓋超過2000萬帳戶和4000支股票的散戶交易數據集，我們旨在評估網紅如何影響散戶投資者的信念、交易行為和整體市場效率，並提供證據來顯示他們在市場操控中的潛在作用。 本研究有四個主要目標。首先，我們通過最先進的主題建模技術（BERTopic）來刻劃網紅討論內容的主題結構。其次，我們通過將網紅發帖的主題分配與公司層面的新聞和宏觀經濟動態相連接，來評估網紅信息的可信度。第三，使用大規模散戶交易數據集，我們檢視不同主題如何影響散戶交易，並分析這些交易活動是否與股價波動相關，旨在揭示網紅在市場操控中的潛在證據。最後，通過分析網紅與散戶投資者之間的主題分配，我們揭示社交網絡中的信念外溢過程。此外，我們還計劃探索在中國市場中不同主題如何影響價格信息性及市場效率。 本研究的貢獻主要體現在兩個方面。理論上，我們通過探索網紅討論的多維主題結構，推進了AI和機器學習在金融領域中的應用，尤其是在大型語言模型方面。所識別的主題為未來在不同市場中的進一步研究開辟了潛在的方向。實踐上，我們評估了網紅信息的可信度和其可能的操控角色，同時也突顯了他們對市場效率的正向貢獻。最後，我們的發現為政策制定者和監管機構提供了寶貴的見解，並提出了監控網紅活動以確保中國股市穩定運行的建議。

12503225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12503225.value: 內部稽核職能與會計估計：來自非上市公司的因果證據

12503225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503225.value: Internal audit function (IAF) has long been recognized as a key component of corporate governance with an important monitoring role. The Institute of Internal Auditors defines an effective IAF as one of four building blocks of corporate governance. In response to egregious accounting frauds in the 2000s, the IAF has received greater attention from financial media, standard setters, and regulators. Prior literature focuses on the existence or quality of an IAF and examines various outcomes of the IAF. However, none of these studies provide strong causal inferences because the presence or quality of an IAF is likely to be endogenously determined. In this proposal, I plan to study the causal effect of IAF on accounting estimates using a novel regulatory setting in the U.S. insurance industry. U.S. insurers, which are largely private firms, are regulated at the state level and each state has the authority to determine when and how to adopt certain regulatory requirements. U.S. states adopted the IAF regulation on a staggered basis between 2016 and 2021. The staggered adoption across states, along with the exemption threshold for small insurers, allows for a staggered difference-in-differences research design to provide causal evidence on the effect of an IAF. Given that IAF is an important governance mechanism, I hypothesize that IAF can reduce the bias in accounting estimates. The insurance industry provides a unique setting to study accounting estimates because of the special statutory reporting requirements regarding loss reserves. Insurers’ loss reserve is the single largest estimation item in the balance sheet, representing around 50 percent of total liabilities. U.S. insurers must disclose the gradual settlement of claims over time and record all revisions of the loss reserve estimate. Data on future settlement and revisions corresponding to each prior year’s loss reserve estimation provide an indication of the bias in this accounting estimate. To the best of my knowledge, the proposed study is the first to study the causal effect of an IAF using an exogenous shock affecting a large sample of private firms. My proposed research can improve our understanding of how IAF affects insurers’ accounting practice which is important to the stability of the financial system. The findings are likely to have policy implications such as allowing for an evidence-based approach in consideration of whether to mandate IAF requirements for other industries. 內部稽核職能長期以來被認為是公司治理的關鍵組成部分，並在監督方面扮演著重要角色。國際內部稽核師協會將有效的內部稽核職能定義為公司治理的四大基石之一。自2000年代爆發嚴重會計舞弊事件以來，內部稽核職能受到了財經媒體、標準製定者及監管機構的更多關註。過去的文獻多著重於內部稽核職能的存在或品質，並探討其帶來的各種結果。然而，這些研究都未能提供強而有力的因果推論，因為內部稽核職能的存在或品質，很可能是內生決定的。 在本研究計劃中，我計劃利用美國保險業一項新穎的監管背景，研究內部稽核職能對會計估計的因果影響。美國的保險公司大多為非上市公司，並由各州進行監管，每個州都有權決定何時及如何採納特定的監管要求。美國各州於2016年至2021年間，分階段採納了內部稽核職能的相關規定。各州分階段的採納，以及對小型保險公司的豁免門檻，為分階段的雙重差分研究設計提供了可能，從而能夠對內部稽核職能的影響提供因果證據。 鑑於內部稽核職能是重要的治理機製，我提出的研究假設為內部稽核職能能夠減少會計估計中的偏誤。保險業因其對損失準備金的特殊法定報告要求，為研究會計估計提供了獨特的情境。保險公司的損失準備金是資產負債表中最大的一項估計項目，約佔總負債的50%。美國保險公司必須披露索賠隨時間逐步結清的情況，並記錄所有損失準備金估計的修正。針對每個先前年份損失準備金估計，後續結清和修正的數據，可用以評估此會計估計項目的偏誤。 據我所知，本研究計劃將是首度利用影響大量非上市公司的外生衝擊，來研究內部稽核職能的因果影響。所提出的研究有助於我們理解內部稽核職能如何影響保險公司的會計實務，而這對金融體系的穩定性至關重要。相關研究結果亦有望為政策製定帶來啟示，例如在考慮是否對其他產業強製要求內部稽核職能時，提供實證依據。

12503325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12503325.value: 生存網路，匯率與貨幣政策

12503325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503325.value: Exchange rate policy is central to the monetary policy debate. According to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) report, less than 25% of its members employ flexible exchange rate regimes, although Friedman (1953) calls for exchange rate flexibility. Whether the policymaker should implement a fixed exchange rate largely depends on the welfare cost induced by exchange rate movements. The exchange rate’s dual role in the goods and financial markets implies that two types of distortions coexist. First, in reality, firms have monopolistic power and price to markets. They choose a different export price from the domestic price, leading to efficiency loss because of the deviation from the law of one price. Ideally, in an efficient economy, firms should not distort the market by setting disparate price. Second, with financial frictions in their production procedure, firms cannot use the resource efficiently. Exchange rate fluctuations generate inefficiency because of the financial frictions when firms borrow in foreign currency. Because of dual distortions of exchange rates, the first deputy director of IMF, Gopinath and her colleagues suggest the limit of exchange rate flexibility. The academic literature has seldom addressed two distortions simultaneously. This proposal aims to characterize the exchange rate’s dual distortions. Notably, these distortions are at the firm-level. Existing studies assume that a representative firm can adequately characterize the aggregate effect of exchange rate distortions. However, this assumption is questioned by recent production network literature, which argues that the network architecture may amplify or attenuate the aggregate effect of the micro-level distortions. A primary research question of this proposal is to explore how international production networks determine the macroeconomic response to micro-level distortions induced by exchange rates. The project aims to revisit traditional views on exchange rate flexibility and stability within a framework that includes international input-output linkages. It seeks to understand the dual role of exchange rates in both the goods and financial markets and their aggregate effects on the economy. Analytical solutions and the loss function are to be derived to highlight the precise welfare cost of exchange rate movement and the role of production network architecture. Provided the analytical solutions, the project will derive the optimal policy and explore the necessity of exchange rate flexibility. Lastly, quantitative exercises are provided to compare the welfare costs of various monetary policies. Policy implications for RMB internationalization and the exchange rate regimes in Hong Kong will be provided. 匯率政策在貨幣政策的討論中佔據核心地位。根據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的最新統計，只有不到25%的成員國採用了靈活的匯率制度，儘管Friedman（1953）主張匯率應具有靈活性。政策制定者是否應當實行固定匯率，很大程度上取決於匯率波動引發的福利損失。由於匯率在商品市場和金融市場中發揮著雙重作用，這意味著匯率波動導致兩類扭曲。首先，現實中企業具有一定的壟斷力量並針對不同國家或地區的市場做出最優定價，它們會選擇不同於國內價格的出口價格，從而因違反一價定律而導致效率損失。在理想的高效經濟中，企業不應通過制定不同價格來扭曲市場。其次，企業在生產過程中面臨金融摩擦，導致資源無法得到有效利用。當企業以外幣借貸時，匯率波動會因為金融摩擦進一步引發效率損失。正因匯率的雙重扭曲，IMF第一副總裁Gopinath及其同事提出了靈活的匯率政策具有局限性的觀點。 本研究旨在刻畫匯率的雙重扭曲。值得注意的是，這些扭曲主要體現在企業層面。現有研究通常假設所謂“代表性企業”可以充分反映匯率扭曲的整體效應，但這一假設受到最前沿的生產網路文獻的質疑。該文獻認為，生產網路結構可能會放大或減弱微觀扭曲的整體效應。本建議的核心研究問題是探討國際生產網路如何決定匯率引發的微觀扭曲對宏觀經濟的回應。項目將重新審視傳統關於匯率靈活性和穩定性的觀點，並納入國際投入-產出關聯的分析框架，旨在理解匯率在商品和金融市場中的雙重作用及其對經濟的總體現效應。專案將推導分析解和損失函數，以刻畫突出匯率波動造成的具體福利損失及生產網路結構的作用。在獲得分析解的基礎上，本研究將進一步推導最優政策，並探討匯率靈活性的必要性和和局限性。最後，項目將進行量化分析，比較不同貨幣政策的福利成本，藉此提出對人民幣國際化和香港匯率制度的政策含義。

12504525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12504525.value: 中國法拍房市場：現狀、成因與法律執行的實證分析

12504525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12504525.value: The market for foreclosed properties in China has expanded significantly, with residential foreclosure transactions totaling 150 billion yuan by 2023 and a 12% year-on-year increase in listings in the first half of 2024. With this expansion, the average success rate for foreclosure auctions dropped to 17% during the same period, pointing to considerable market challenges, particularly with low initial auction success rates. Despite the growing importance of foreclosures, few studies have examined the reason for the low success rates and the role of legal enforcement in the market. Effective legal enforcement is crucial for foreclosure auctions. After a property is auctioned, the winning bidder pays the required amount to acquire it. However, the previous owner or tenants may refuse to vacate, preventing the purchaser from taking possession. In such cases, forced eviction ensures the purchaser can rightfully occupy the property. Since more effective legal enforcement can expedite the foreclosure process, it increases the likelihood of successful property recovery and facilitates lenders' ability to recoup losses. In China, the legal basis for forcible eviction in judicial auctions is grounded in the “Civil Procedure Law of the People’s Republic of China”, which empowers courts to enforce evictions when judgment debtors fail to comply with effective civil judgments. Despite this strong legal foundation, enforcement is inconsistent. There are significant regional disparities in how these laws are executed, leading to varying degrees of risk and uncertainty for buyers. Some local courts may not rigorously enforce eviction measures, creating inconsistency and unpredictability in the judicial auction process. In this paper, we aim to explore the following research questions. First, we seek to understand the causes behind the variations in legal enforcement of foreclosure auctions across different regions and within the same region. Specifically, we will investigate how economic development, local social stability, demographic factors, and the presence of organized crime influence courts' tendencies to enforce or avoid forced evictions in foreclosure auctions. Additionally, we will examine whether different types of lenders (e.g., institutional vs. individual; local vs. non-local) experience unequal treatment during the foreclosure process. Second, we aim to assess the effects of effective legal enforcement on foreclosure outcomes, bank lending behavior, and housing prices. Understanding these effects will provide valuable insights for policymakers in designing and implementing regulatory frameworks that ensure fair and efficient foreclosure processes, ultimately contributing to the stability and health of the housing market. 近年來，中國的法拍房市場經歷了顯著增長。到2023年，住宅法拍房的成交總額達到1500億元，同比增長10%。四川、廣東、河南等省份的供應量尤為突出。2024年上半年，全國掛牌法拍房數量上升至20.2萬套，同比增長12%。鄭州、廈門、福州、蘇州等城市的增長更為明顯，漲幅均超過40%。儘管市場規模迅速擴大，2024年上半年法拍房的平均成交率卻降至17%，較去年同期下降了7個百分點。首次拍賣的成交率僅為12%，而進入“二拍”的法拍房成交率則提升至23%。這一差異凸顯了法拍房市場所面臨的諸多挑戰。 儘管法拍房市場的重要性日益提升，學界對此領域的關注和研究仍有待加強。很少有研究深入探討法拍房的現狀、成交率低的深層原因，以及法律執行在市場中的作用。法院判決的執行與產權轉移過程中涉及的法律複雜性，都可能顯著影響成交率。隨著經濟壓力加大和房地產市場持續下行，法拍房供應預計將繼續增加。這一現象亟需更加深入的研究，以理解市場運行機制、成交率低的原因以及法律執行的作用，從而為政策制定者和投資者提供有價值的參考。

12600425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12600425.value: 一圖之傷，甚於千言？香港多模態仇恨言論的系統性研究

12600425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600425.value: Hateful rhetoric is a rampant problem in today's online environments. Despite a growing body of research on online hate speech, including understanding it and its impact, there are notable gaps. First, previous research has focused primarily on hate speech as expressed in text, neglecting the critical role of visuals in this phenomenon. Given the multimodal nature of social media platforms, failing to consider multimodal hate speech—which combines text and images to express hate—undermines attempts at understanding and hinders efforts to develop effective solutions. Second, most empirical research on multimodal hate speech has been conducted in Western countries, raising questions about the generalizability of these findings to other contexts. Third, the majority of experimental studies on the impact of multimodal hate speech have employed single-exposure, one-shot designs, providing limited insights into the duration of the effects described and the potential consequences of repeated exposure. Finally, there is a dearth of research on strategies to combat multimodal hate speech, so it remains unclear whether approaches that have proven effective in countering textual hate speech also work for multimodal hate speech. Therefore, the current project aims to address these critical research voids by systematically examining the characteristics, effects, and countermeasures of multimodal hate speech in the context of Hong Kong. Using a multiple-method approach and building upon the research team's previous work on examining hate speech, we will conduct a series of studies to gain a deeper conceptual and empirical understanding of multimodal hate speech. Specifically, Study 1 will involve a quantitative content analysis to explore and identify the characteristics of multimodal hate speech on social media. Study 2 will be a longitudinal experiment to investigate the short- and long-term effects of exposure to multimodal hate speech on prejudicial attitudes and discriminatory behaviors toward targeted groups. Study 3 will experimentally examine the effectiveness of counter-speech (e.g., providing facts to refute hateful claims) in mitigating the negative consequences of multimodal hate speech. As one of the initial attempts to conduct a holistic investigation of multimodal hate speech, this project will contribute unique theoretical insights into this phenomenon by linking hate speech research with relevant and valuable resources in the visual communication literature. Additionally, the results will provide practical guidance for policymakers and those involved in the creation and management of online platforms to address the potential harm of multimodal hateful content and foster more respectful and inclusive online environments. 當前網路環境中，仇恨言論日益嚴峻。盡管針對網絡仇恨言論的研究日益增多，涵蓋了其表現形式和影響機制，但該研究領域仍存在顯著空白。首先，既往研究主要聚焦於文本形式的仇恨言論，忽視了視覺表達在此現象中的關鍵作用。鑒於社交媒體平臺的多模態特性，若忽略對多模態仇恨言論（即結合文本與圖像表達仇恨的內容）的考慮，將阻礙全面理解該現象，並影響有效應對策略的制定。其次，現有關於多模態仇恨言論的實證研究多集中於西方國家，其研究結果在其他社會文化背景下的適用性存疑。第三，當前探討多模態仇恨言論影響的實驗研究，普遍采用單次曝光、一次性的設計。這種方法難以深入揭示其影響的持續時間，也無法充分評估重復曝光可能帶來的潛在後果。最後，針對遏制多模態仇恨言論的策略研究尚顯匱乏。因此，那些在應對文本仇恨言論中被證明有效的方法，是否同樣適用於多模態形式，目前尚不明確。 因此，本項目旨在通過系統性地檢視香港背景下多模態仇恨言論的特徵、影響及應對策略，以填補上述關鍵研究空白。我們將採用混合研究方法，並基於研究團隊先前在仇恨言論領域的工作基礎，開展一系列研究，以期獲得對多模態仇恨言論更深入的概念性和實證性理解。具體而言，研究一將採用定量內容分析，探索並識別社交媒體上多模態仇恨言論的特徵。研究二將是一項縱向實驗，旨在調查接觸多模態仇恨言論對目標群體偏見態度和歧視行為的短期和長期影響。研究三將通過實驗，檢驗反駁言論（例如，提供事實來駁斥仇恨主張）在減輕多模態仇恨言論所引發負面影響方面的有效性。 作為對多模態仇恨言論進行系統性研究的初步嘗試之一，本項目將整合仇恨言論研究與視覺傳播領域的相關理論資源，從而為理解這一現象貢獻獨特的理論洞見。此外，研究成果還將為政策制定者以及參與在線平臺創建和管理的人員提供實用指導，以應對多模態仇恨內容的潛在危害，並營造更為尊重和包容的網絡環境。

12601125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12601125.value: 人工智能驅動下金融服務轉型中現有銀行與金融科技平臺的策略耦合：以香港和深圳為例

12601125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601125.value: Recent research in financial technologies (FinTech) has shifted from emphasizing competitive disruption by FinTech firms to recognizing the cooperation and interdependence between FinTech start-ups and incumbent banks, particularly in the widespread digital technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI). While numerous national-level analysis has examined the penetration of disruptive technologies in the financial services and subsequent transformation of banking operations, customer service and risk management, a significant gap remains in exploring the salient role of AI in the evolving interplay between financial incumbents and FinTech platforms, especially in diverse city-regions of the Global South. Drawing upon the focal notion of strategic coupling from the Global Production Networks (GPN) theory, this project develops a multi-scalar, cross-sectoral analytical framework to explore the AI-driven digital transformation of incumbent banks and the emergence of digital banks in the context of subnational city-regions. Leveraging the expertise and synergies of the research team in economic and financial geographies, the project investigates and compares the strategic relationships between financial incumbents and FinTech platforms in two pivotal cities of China's Greater Bay Area: Hong Kong, a global financial centre, and Shenzhen, China’s "Silicon Valley" for technological innovation and a birthplace of FinTech platforms. Particular emphasis is placed on the emerging cross-border dynamics of AI-enhanced digital financial services between the two cities. A mixed-method approach will be employed to gather and analyze both quantitative data and qualitative insights through questionnaire surveys and semi-structured interviews with a diverse array of stakeholders, including traditional and digital banks, FinTech startups and giant platforms, regulatory agencies, industrial experts, as well as individual and corporate consumers in the two neighbouring metropolises. The project specifically examines how the distinct technological, market, and regulatory contexts of Hong Kong and Shenzhen influence the AI-driven restructuring and interplay between financial services and FinTech development at both city and regional levels. This research contributes to the developing research on the restructuring and intersection between financial services and FinTech industries in the era of AI by: 1) conceptualizing the strategic coupling of commercial banks and FinTechs in the digital transformation; and 2) providing a nuanced city-regional analysis of the dynamic relationship between the established financial incumbents and FinTech platforms in the digital financial services in China. The conceptual framework and empirical findings may generalize and offer profound insights applicable to other city-regions navigating the nexus of digital finance and financial innovation in the proliferation of AI and technological advancement. 金融科技 (FinTech) 的研究已從強調金融科技公司帶來的競爭顛覆，轉向關注金融科技初創企業與現有銀行之間的合作與相互依存關係，尤其是在人工智慧 (AI) 等廣泛應用的數字技術領域。儘管許多國家層面的分析已從改變銀行運營、客戶服務和風險管理等各個方面考察了人工智慧在金融服務領域的滲透，但在探索人工智慧在金融機構與金融科技平臺之間不斷發展的關係中的獨特作用方面， 現有研究仍存在巨大空白，尤其是針對全球南方不同城市和區域的分析。本項目充分利用研究團隊在經濟地理和金融地理領域的專業知識和長期合作研究基礎，探究人工智慧驅動下現有銀行的數位化轉型，以及粵港澳大灣區兩大樞紐城市——全球金融中心香港和被譽為中國科技創新“硅谷”及金融科技發展數字平臺發源地的深圳——金融科技的興起和發展。研究將特別關注這兩座相鄰城市之間人工智慧驅動下數位金融服務的跨境發展動態。本研究將拓展全球生產網路（GPN）理論中的戰略耦合概念，並結合全球金融網路（GFN）的視角，構建一個多尺度、跨行業的分析框架，探討和比較香港和深圳在人工智慧驅動的金融服務轉型中，金融機構與金融科技平臺之間的戰略關係。本研究將採用混合方法，通過問卷調查和半結構化訪談，收集並分析定量資料和定性見解，訪談物件涵蓋兩地的傳統銀行、數字銀行、金融科技初創企業、監管機構、專家和消費者等各類持份者。本項目將重點探討香港和深圳獨特的技術、市場和監管環境如何影響人工智慧驅動的金融服務轉型，及其在城市和區域層面與金融科技發展的相互作用。該研究旨在為人工智慧時代金融服務與金融科技行業相互作用的新興文獻做出貢獻：1）重構商業銀行與金融科技公司在其數位化轉型中戰略耦合的理論框架；2）對中國成熟金融中心和金融科技樞紐的動態關係進行細緻的城市-區域層面的實證分析。期許本研究的分析框架和實證研究結果可為其他全球城市-區域在人工智慧技術蓬勃發展的背景下，如何應對數位金融與金融創新的交交互發展提供具影響力的洞見和政策建議。

12602525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12602525.value: 家庭中的數位化勞動如何分配？一項關於中國城市家庭的數位化勞動、性別和代際關係的研究

12602525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602525.value: Digital labor has become part of our daily work and life and transformed our society in the past decades because of the rapid development of digital technology and media. Although rich literature has examined digital labor in the public domain, little research has explored digital labor in the family. With the digitalization of family life, digital labor is intertwining with physical, emotional and mental labor in housework and childcare, and becoming part of domestic labor. The division of domestic labor is an important topic in family and gender studies. However, it remains unclear how digital labor is practiced and divided in the family and how family relationships and gender/intergenerational dynamics shape this division. To fill the gaps, the proposed project will adopt a multi-method and multi-voice research design to examine the practice and division of digital labor in urban Chinese families. The research subjects will include urban married couples with dependent children and grandparents providing regular assistance in childcare and housework in a megacity Shenzhen in South China. An intersectional framework of gender, generation and class will be applied to explore (1) how digital labor in housework and childcare is practiced and divided between husbands and wives; (2) how digital labor in housework and childcare is divided between parents and grandparents; (3) how social class shapes the practice and division of digital labor between middle-class and working-class families. Qualitative in-depth interviewing, time-diary method, field observation, and online observation of digital communication and interactions will be used to collect data from husbands, wives and grandparents from 30 middle-class and 30 working-class families in Shenzhen. The proposed project will enrich both theoretical and empirical knowledge of digital labor and deepen the understanding of the division of domestic labor and family relations in the digital era. By revealing the dynamic interplay between the family and the digital, the project will generate social implications for professional practitioners and the public to reflect on the impacts of family digitalization and for policy makers to reflect new social inequalities in the digital era and explore policy assistance in dealing with these inequalities. 隨著數位化技術和媒體的迅速發展，數位化勞動已經成為我們日常工作和生活中的一部分並且改變著我們的社會。雖然有不少研究已經探討了在公共領域的數位化勞動，但是家庭中的數位化勞動卻鮮少被研究。隨著家庭生活的數位化，數位化勞動正與體力勞動、情感勞動和腦力勞動一起成為家務勞動的一部分。家務勞動的分工一直是家庭研究與性別研究的重要議題。然而，我們對家庭中數位化勞動如何分工以及家庭關係和性別/代際機制如何影響這一分工仍然知之甚少。本研究將採取多方法、多視角的研究設計來探討中國城市家庭中的數位化勞動的實踐與分工。性別、代際和階層的交叉理論視角將被應用於探索：（1）家務與育兒中的數位化勞動如何在夫妻之間進行分工；（2）家務與育兒中的數位化勞動如何在代際之間進行分配；（3）社會階層如何影響中產家庭與工薪家庭的數位化勞動的實踐與分工。研究物件為中國城市家庭中的已婚夫妻和祖父母。研究方法包括深入訪談、時間日誌、田野觀察和網路觀察。該研究將豐富數位化勞動的理論和實踐知識並且深化對數位化時代家庭關係和家務分工的認知。通過揭示家庭與數位化技術之間的關係，該研究將影響公眾和相關專業從業人事對數位化技術發展的反思並且推動相關政策發展以應對數位化帶來的新的社會不平等。

12602625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12602625.value: 青少年社交媒體新聞參與的實時批判性思維干預設計與驗證

12602625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12602625.value: Dr Liu, Tongxi Prof Song, Yunya

12602625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602625.value: Research on critical thinking in social media environments has revealed a significant discrepancy between users' awareness of its importance and their actual behaviors, particularly among adolescents. In attention-competitive social media environments, young users often overlook critical thinking when engaging with content, despite recognizing its value. This gap is especially concerning for news consumption, as it impacts adolescents' understanding of current events and civic discourse. The disparity arises because an overwhelming array of social media elements vie for users' attention, overshadowing analytical thinking. Traditional educational efforts, often integrated into media literacy programs, provide a crucial foundation by imparting knowledge and skills about media and content credibility within a classroom context. However, they fall short in prompting critical thinking during real-time social media engagement. To address this gap, real-time intervention is needed. Digital nudges—subtle elements imbedded in user interfaces that guide behavior without restricting choices—have shown effectiveness in changing user behavior in domains such as energy conservation and online privacy maintenance. Previous studies have showcased the potential of nudges in guiding users' attention towards critical thinking, but research in this area remains limited. This study proposes to investigate digital nudges as a strategy to redirect adolescents' attention to critical thinking when engaging news on social media. The project will design and test critical thinking nudges as visual cues and interactive elements within social media interfaces. These nudges will focus on: (1) encouraging skills including cross-referencing sources, fact-checking visual content, and seeking social verification; and (2) fostering awareness of users' shared responsibility in promoting authentic information dissemination. We propose a mixed- method approach with the research to be conducted in two phases. Phase 1 (Qualitative Exploration; N=60) involves creating mock-up nudges and gathering user feedback through focus groups with adolescents. The insights gained will inform the refinement of nudge presentation and placement in Phase 2 (Experimental; N=280), which employs a 3 (between-subject skill) x 2 (between-subject shared responsibility) x 2 (within-subject news authenticity) experimental design with a control group. A simulated Instagram interface will be developed to capture participants' critical thinking and engagement with the nudges. The expected outcomes include the development of Open Educational Resources, community educational activities, and dissemination of research findings. This research aims to contribute to the development of evidence-based digital real-time intervention tailored to young social media users, empowering them to navigate the complex social media landscape and fostering a more discerning digital society. 在社交媒體環境中，批判性思維研究揭示了一個關鍵矛盾：儘管青少年普遍認同其重要性，但在實際行為中卻往往忽視（尤其在注意力競爭激烈的社交媒體場景中）。這種認知與行為的落差對新聞消費影響尤甚，直接衝擊青少年對時事與公共議題的理解。究其原因，社交媒體上過載的內容元素持續爭奪用戶注意力，導致分析性思維被邊緣化。傳統媒體素養教育雖通過課堂情境傳授內容可信度評估的知識與技能奠定基礎，卻難以促發用戶在即時社交媒體互動中的批判性思考。 為此，本研究主張引入「實時干預」機制。數位助推——即嵌入用戶介面、不限制選擇卻能引導行為的微妙設計元素——已在節能減碳與網路隱私保護等領域證實其行為改變效力。既有研究雖初步展現助推技術引導批判性思維的潛力，相關實證仍屬匱乏。本研究擬探討如何透過數位助推策略，在青少年接觸社交媒體新聞時重定向其注意力至批判性思考。 具體而言，本研究將設計並測試整合於社交媒體介面的視覺提示與互動式助推元素，聚焦兩大目標：(1) 培養跨來源比對、圖像事實查核、社會化驗證等技能；(2) 強化用戶對促進真實資訊傳播的共享責任認知。研究採用混合方法，分兩階段實施：第一階段（質性探索，N=60）透過青少年焦點團體收集對原型助推設計的反饋，據此優化第二階段（實驗研究，N=280）的介入方案。實驗採用3（技能類型，組間）×2（共享責任提示，組間）×2（新聞真實性，組內）因子設計，配合控制組，於模擬Instagram介面中觀測參與者的批判性思維表現與助推互動數據。 預期成果包括開發開放教育資源、社區教育活動方案，以及實證研究發現的推廣。本研究的學術貢獻在於建構專為青少年社交媒體使用者設計的證據本位即時干預模型，協助其應對複雜的數位資訊生態，最終促進更具辨識力的數位公民社會發展。

12602825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12602825.value: 自動化自我形象：探究智能手機相機及應用程式中的降噪技術及其對青年自我吸引力的影響。

12602825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602825.value: Noise is a constant presence in the world. Whether it is visual or auditory noise, noise-cancelling technologies allow individuals to customise their experience of the world. For instance, headphones with audio noise-cancelling technology allow the user to eliminate unwanted and unpleasant environmental sounds and listen to music on a rowdy bus or a loud aeroplane. Today, noise-cancelling technologies are ubiquitous in smartphones for image denoising tasks. Thanks to recent advancements in artificial intelligence, these technologies automatically eliminate unwanted visual noise (e.g., skin imperfections such as wrinkles and acne), transforming a noisy photograph (e.g., a selfie) into one that is deemed noise-free and pleasant. By 'intelligently' and automatically reconstructing parts of an image, superimposing new artificially created elements, noise-cancelling technologies offer users a noise-free image of the self that requires no editing and is ready to use. However, although these technologies provide individuals with solutions by freeing them from unwanted noise, they also affect the individuals' perception of the self by determining automated standards of beauty and self-desirability and contributing to body image concerns, dissatisfaction, and anxieties. Since their recent appearance on smartphones, noise-cancelling technologies have become an increasingly prominent feature of daily life. However, they have been overlooked in media and visual cultural studies. Therefore, this research attempts to fill the gap in the literature by demonstrating the personal and social implications of noise-cancelling technologies. It uses as a case study the growing numbers of body image concerns, i.e., dissatisfactions, anxieties, and disorders, among Hong Kong young adults, which are becoming increasingly prevalent at an alarming rate. These, along with Snapchat dysmorphic disorder, are often characterised by an excessive preoccupation with the physical self, where individuals seek solutions (e.g., cosmetic surgery) to look like the noise-free versions of themselves. The research, situated at the intersection of media, visual culture, and ethnography, employs qualitative methods with the following objectives: a) To provide a theoretical framework for studying the personal and social implications of noise-cancelling technologies in smartphone cameras. b) To demonstrate how these denoising procedures influence beauty standards, body dissatisfaction, and anxieties, thereby affecting young adults' self-image and desirability. c) To conduct an ethnographic study that generates an exploratory qualitative dataset for evaluating new forms of self-desirability and body image concerns among young adults in Hong Kong. d) To use these findings to organise awareness activities for camera users. 雜訊在現實世界中無處不在。無論是視覺還是聽覺雜訊，降噪技術都讓人們得以自主調控對世界的體驗。例如，具備音頻降噪功能的耳機，能讓用戶在嘈雜的巴士或喧鬧的飛機上隔絕不必要的環境聲音，安心聆聽音樂。 如今，智能手機已普遍使用降噪技術進行圖像降噪處理。隨著人工智能的最新突破，這些技術能自動消除多餘的視覺雜訊（如皺紋、暗瘡等肌膚瑕疵），將一張帶有雜訊的照片（如自拍）轉化為公認無雜訊且悅目的影像。通過「智能」且自動地重建圖像局部、疊加新的人工生成元素，降噪技術為使用者提供無需後期編輯、即時可用的無雜訊自我形象。然而，儘管這些技術為人們解決了雜訊困擾，卻也通過設定自動化的審美標準和自我吸引力規範，影響著人們的自我認知，加劇體像擔憂、不滿與焦慮。 自智能手機引入降噪技術以來，其已成為日常生活中愈發顯著的特徵。但在媒體與視覺文化研究領域，這一技術卻遭到忽視。因此，本研究旨在填補文獻中的空白，揭示降噪技術對個人與社會的影響。研究以香港年輕人中日益普遍且令人擔憂的體像問題（包括不滿、焦慮及障礙）為案例，這些問題的發生率正以驚人的速度攀升。此類問題與「Snapchat 畸形障礙」相似，均表現為個人過度關注自身體貌，甚至尋求整容等方法，以求達到如無雜訊影像中那般的樣貌。 本研究立足於媒體、視覺文化與民族誌的交叉領域，採用質性研究方法，旨在達成以下目標：a) 構建一套理論框架，用於研究智能手機相機中的降噪技術對個人與社會的影響。b) 闡述這些降噪過程如何影響審美標準、體像不滿及焦慮情緒，進而左右年輕人的自我形象與吸引力認知。c) 開展一項民族誌研究，收集探索性的質性數據，評估香港年輕人中新型的自我吸引力與體像問題的現狀。d) 依據研究結果，為相機使用者組織相關的意識提升活動。

12603125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12603125.value: 混合實境遊記故事創作對青少年正向品格發展的影響

12603125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12603125.value: With the accessibility of digital platforms (e.g., social media, games) and the vividness of related digital experiences, digital natives have less tendency toward direct experiences in the real world. Mixed reality (MR) or augmented reality (AR), combining virtual settings with physical environments, can be a promising approach to arousing youth’s curiosity and motivating their engagements in the real world. Using mixed-reality technologies (e.g., mobile AR), a person visiting a physical place can creatively combine images of virtual items (e.g., a virtual pet) with location-based real-world images (e.g., a landmark). A sequence of composite images at different locations, like a storyboard, forms a travelogue that shows and tells an imaginative adventure story (e.g., exploring with the virtual pet). Studies of games and gamification suggest that facilitating users to create stories analogous to their real-world behaviors can enhance intrinsic motivation, leading to long-term engagement (Nicholson 2015; Rapp 2017). Enabling youngsters to create stories in mixed-reality travelogues can motivate real-world exploration. Moreover, developing a travel narrative involves adopting fictional characters’ perspectives and imagining possible paths along the journey, which can enhance one’s potential in perspective taking and mental simulation. In the long run, the young generation will be able to develop corresponding character strengths (Peterson & Seligman 2004). This project will be a generative and exploratory study. It will investigate the possibility of engaging young people in exploring the real world and investigate the effects of mixed-reality travelogue creation on their curiosity about the real world, abilities of imagining being in different situations and adopting different perspectives. The process will involve designing and developing a mixed-reality travelogue system (see Figures 1&2) that helps users compose stories. Before visiting a real-world location, users create characters and imagine adventures at the location by using generative-AI tools. While visiting, they dynamically composite the AI-generated contents onto on-site images using mixed-reality technologies. After visiting, they review the composite images. We plan to involve 60 young participants in field trials of the system. Each participant will take pre- and post-trial surveys that assess one’s strength of curiosity (based on existing scales like Kashdan et al. 2018’s five-dimensional curiosity scale), tendency of imagining, and ability of perspective taking (based on existing scales like Davis 1980’s fantasy and perspective-taking subscales). Changes in assessment results between surveys will provide insights on promoting related aspects in youth’s character development. 隨著數位平台（例如社交媒體、遊戲）的普及與其互動刺激的數位體驗，數位原生族群對現實世界體驗的投入程度普遍較低。混合實境（MR）或擴增實境（AR）透過將虛擬情境與真實環境結合，有潛力激發青少年的好奇心，並促使他們更積極參與現實世界的探索。透過混合實境技術（例如行動裝置上的AR），使用者在造訪實體地點時，能創意性地將虛擬物件（如虛擬寵物）的影像與具地理定位的現實影像（如地標）結合。這些在不同地點所產出的合成影像，串連起來如同一組故事板，構成一段虛構冒險旅程的遊記（例如與虛擬寵物一起探險）。 遊戲與遊戲化研究指出，促使使用者創作與其真實行為類比的故事，有助於提升內在動機，從而帶來長期的參與（Nicholson 2015；Rapp 2017）。因此，引導青少年創作混合實境遊記故事，能有效激勵其對現實世界的探索。此外，遊記創作的過程涉及採擷虛構角色的視角，並想像旅程中的可能路徑，這有助於發展其視角轉換（perspective taking）與心理模擬（mental simulation）的能力。從長遠來看，這有助於青少年發展相關的品格優勢（Peterson & Seligman 2004）。 本研究將採取生成式與探索性的研究取向，旨在探討引導年輕人探索現實世界的可行性，並進一步調查混合實境遊記創作對其現實世界好奇心、想像不同情境的能力與視角轉換能力的影響。研究過程將設計並開發一套混合實境遊記系統（見圖1與圖2），協助使用者進行故事創作。在造訪現實地點之前，使用者將透過生成式AI工具創作角色並構思其在該地點的冒險情節；造訪期間，他們可使用混合實境技術，將AI生成內容動態合成至實地拍攝的影像中；造訪後，使用者可回顧這些合成影像並重新構思故事內容。 我們計劃邀請60位青少年參與系統的實地試用。每位參與者將在試用前後填寫問卷，評估其好奇心強度（參考如Kashdan等人2018年提出的五維好奇心量表）、想像傾向，以及視角轉換能力（參考如Davis 1980年提出的幻想與觀點採擇次量表）。透過比較前後測問卷的變化，將可提供促進青少年品格發展相關能力的重要啟示。

12603225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12603225.value: 探究失智長者之照護網絡：建構超越二元關係的照護能力

12603225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12603225.value: Prof Bai, Xue Prof FUNG, Wai Tung Prof Lee, Jaemin

12603225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12603225.value: It has been estimated that more than 333,000 people aged over 60 will be suffering from dementia in 2039 in Hong Kong. Dementia-related care needs are multicomplex, consisting of cognitive symptom management, general health care, daily activities, and personal safety. Historically, caregiving research has predominantly focused on the dyadic relationship between the primary caregiver and care recipient. However, a dyadic care approach limits the utilization of care from broader social contexts, failing to meet the comprehensive needs of older people with dementia (PWD). It is proposed that research on dementia care should be expanded to a broader care network perspective, enhancing care capacity and fostering collaboration among potential caregivers. In this study, care network refers to a system where caregiving responsibilities are distributed among multiple caregivers, comprising family members, non-family members, and paid carers. This study aims to answer the following questions: (a) What are the structural patterns (i.e., configuration) and functional mechanisms (i.e., caregiving activities) of care networks for PWD? And how do the dynamics of care networks for PWD change over time? (b) To what extent do individual attributes of care recipients and caregivers influence the structural and functional characteristics of these care networks? (c) How can care capacity for PWD be enhanced through coordination and collaboration among different care providers within care networks? (d) How do the care networks affect the care outcomes and quality of life for PWD, as well as the caregiving burden and stress experienced by caregivers? Social network analysis (SNA) is a robust approach to investigates the patterns of relations among social actors across various levels of analysis. It enables researchers to identify structural patterns and functional mechanisms that traditional dyadic models may overlook. This study adopts a longitudinal mixed-methods design including both quantitative and qualitative SNA. The quantitative SNA will involve a two-wave network survey administered to 390 participants with a six-month interval. This survey will visually map and analyze the interconnections among multiple caregivers and PWD, capturing changes in networks over time. Qualitative SNA will be conducted through in-depth interviews among 40 participants to capture an insider perspective of the care networks. The qualitative interviews aim to elucidate the nuanced meanings of caregiving relationships and the mechanisms underpinning the construction of care networks. By integrating both quantitative and qualitative methods, this mixed-methods SNA will provide a more complete picture of care networks. 據估計，至2039年，香港60歲及以上長者中將有超過33萬3千人患上失智症。失智症照護需求極為複雜，涵蓋認知症狀管理、一般健康照護、日常生活協助及個人安全等多重面向。過去，照護領域的相關研究多著重於主要照顧者與被照護者的二元關係，然而，此種「二元照護模式」限制了來自更廣泛社會資源的照護參與，難以全面滿足失智症長者的多元照護需要。基於上述限制，本研究提出失智症照護研究應擴展至「照護網絡」層面，以加強照護能力、促進潛在照護者間的協作。本研究所指的「照護網絡」指照護責任分工於多位照護者之間，包括家庭成員、非家庭成員及專業照護人員。本研究欲解答以下問題：（i）失智症長者照護網絡的結構模式（如網絡組成）及功能機制（如照護活動）為何？其動態又如何隨時間演變？（ii）照顧者及被照護者之個人屬性對這些網絡的結構及功能特徵具何影響？（iii）可如何藉由照護網絡中的不同照護者協調與合作，提升失智症長者的照護能力？（iv）照護網絡對失智症長者的照護成效與生活品質、以及照顧者所承受的負擔與壓力有何影響？社會網絡分析能深入探究社會行動者間的各層次關係模式。此研究採用縱向混合方法設計，結合量化與質性社會網絡分析。量化部分，將對390名參與者進行兩波網絡調查，藉此可視化及分析多位照護者與失智症長者間的互動連結，並捕捉網絡隨時間的變化。質性部分則透過40位參與者深入訪談，呈現照護網絡的內部視角；訪談旨在闡釋照護關係的細緻意義，以及建構照護網絡的內在機制。透過量化與質性方法的結合，此混合社會網絡分析方法有助於完整描繪失智症照護網絡的全貌。

12603525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12603525.value: 香港中小學英語教師對技術賦能的變通性評估方式的理念轉變及其與教師評估實踐動態發展關係的研究 及其與教師評估實踐動態發展關係的研究 香港中小學英語教師對技術賦能的變通性評估方式的理念轉變 及其與教師評估實踐動態發展關係的研究

12603525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12603525.value: Alternative assessment refers to assessments other than conventional paper-and-pen assessments, namely podcasts, project work, e-Portfolio assessment, or other multimedia modes of assessment. Alternative assessment has been an increasingly popular discourse in education reform agendas around the globe. The meritocratic assessment system in Hong Kong, in particular, has shifted the public attention from undesirable competition (i.e. norm-referenced assessment) to alternative assessment (i.e. criterion-referenced assessment), which is necessary to alleviate the negative washback effects of high-stakes exams on pupils in both primary and secondary education. Technology advancement has also exerted a significant impact on assessment because Hong Kong English teachers, like their counterparts in other parts of the world, have begun integrating various levels of technology into education for instructional and evaluative purposes to assess pupils’ language skills in emergencies, such as the pandemic or unpredictable natural disasters. Against this backdrop, teachers’ understanding and use of technology-enabled alternative assessment and their immediate experience of different alternative assessment methods better suited to support pupil learning than conventional and psychometric methods in their classroom contexts are considered topics of great interest. Nevertheless, most current studies focus on teachers’ conceptions of one single alternative assessment method rather than their overall conceptions of multiple alternative assessment methods (e.g., online peer assessment, e-Portfolio assessment, or AI-powered automatic writing evaluation systems) adopted over time. Thus far, research on the development process of teachers’ conceptions and practices of assessment is scant so there is inadequate evidence to hypothesize the dynamic development relationship between teachers’ conceptions and practices of assessment in a systematic manner. To address these conceptual and practical gaps, this proposed project aims to investigate about 500 Hong Kong primary and secondary school English teachers’ conception development and practice changes of technology-enabled alternative assessment over one year with the combination of a longitudinal and a microgenetic study. This proposal is likely to yield impactful and innovative findings by identifying the contextual factors that affect Hong Kong English teachers’ conceptual understanding and cognitive engagement of specific technology-enabled alternative assessment methods, such as beliefs, digital competence, or a larger exam system. More importantly, it further explores the relationship between Hong Kong English teachers’ conceptions of technology-enabled alternative assessment and their actual assessment practices to build a dynamic developmental model.

12604125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12604125.value: 超越現代化與日本知識份子對前現代歷史的反思

12604125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12604125.value: This project is a study of modern Japanese intellectual discourse on the question of modernity in the mid-twentieth century. Through the nineteenth and twentieth centuires, modernity has often been associated with “the West,” and the dominant intellectual discourses narrated the civilizational development as an emanation of modernity from the West as a center to the periphery of “non-West.” Under these conditions, modern Japanese intellectuals struggled to determine their cultural identities and navigate social changes. While some intellectuals were proud of the exceptionally successful modernization of Japanese society in comparison with other non-Western countries, some found the key foundation of Japanese culture and social development in such a non-Western tradition. As an extension of such a discussion of Japan’s modernity, an interesting attempt to “overcome modernity” emerged within Japanese intellectual discourses in the context of the economic crisis and war of the 1930s and 1940s. Importantly, this attempt featured the unique world-historical status of Japan as a leading non-Western country and highlighted the significance of the historical past prior to the modern period (both in Japan and Europe). This project focuses on leading intellectuals who examined the significance of the pre-modern past to produce discourses calling for overcoming modernity: Japanese writer Shimazaki Tōson (1872-1943), Japanese historians Ōrui Noburu (1884-1975) and Suzuki Shigetaka (1907-1988). Although they belonged to different intellectual circles, they shared a common interest in critically examining Western modernity and found important value in the pre-modern past. Shimazaki and Suzuki focused on the Middle Ages in Europe and Japan and attempted to articulate the unignorable value of those periods. Ōrui studied the Renaissance in Japan and Europe and emphasized its value, which could not be included in the achievement of modernity. Through this examination, my project contributes to articulating the logic of Japanese intellectuals for overcoming modernity and its transnational range of perspectives. As a result, this study will expand the perspective of modern Japanese and global intellectual history. 本項目旨在研究二十世紀中葉現代日本知識分子關於現代性問題的討論。在十九世紀和二十世紀，現代性常常與「西方」聯繫在一起，主流的知識論述將文明的發展敘述為現代性從西方中心向「非西方」邊緣擴散的過程。在這樣的背景下，現代日本知識分子在確立自身文化認同和應對社會變革時面臨著巨大的挑戰。一些知識分子為日本社會在現代化過程中取得的成就感到自豪，尤其是與其他非西方國家相比；而另一些知識分子則在非西方傳統中尋找日本文化和社會發展的關鍵基礎。作為對日本現代性討論的延伸，在20世紀30至40年代的經濟危機和戰爭背景下，日本知識分子的論述中出現了一種「超越現代性」的有趣嘗試。值得注意的是，這一嘗試突出了日本作為領先非西方國家在世界歷史中的獨特地位，並強調了現代時期之前（無論是在日本還是在歐洲）歷史過去的重要性。 本項目聚焦於幾位探討前現代歷史意義、並提出「戰勝現代性」話語的重要知識分子：日本作家島崎藤村（1872-1943）、歷史學家大類伸（1884-1975）和鈴木成高（1907-1988）。儘管他們屬於不同的學術圈子，但都共同關注對西方現代性的批判性反思，並在前現代歷史中發現了重要價值。島崎藤村和鈴木成高關注日本和歐洲的中世紀，努力闡釋這些時期不可忽視的價值；大類伸則研究了日本和歐洲的文藝復興時期，強調這一時期的價值無法被視為現代性成就的一部分。通過這樣的研究，本項目有助於闡明日本知識分子超越現代性的邏輯及其跨國視野，從而拓展現代日本與全球思想史的研究視角。

12604325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12604325.value: This research project involves the digital capture of Hong Kong neon signs as cultural artefacts to be documented in an online multimedia repository comprising images, stereoscopic virtual reality video and sound clips as well as textual descriptions. Following a period of intense decline, there has recently been increased public attention on the rapid loss of Hong Kong vernacular neon as an intrinsic part of the city’s visual and cultural identity. This research is timely and urgent in the face of an accelerated decline in the number of functional neon signs in HK that will likely imminently see few remaining. From the 1950s, the ubiquity of neon signage in Hong Kong greatly contributed to the city’s unique visual culture and vibrant sense of self. Vernacular locally produced artisanal neon signage advertising global brands but mostly local businesses lead to a unique sense of place for both Hong Kong residents and international visitors. Beginning with a preference for less expensive energy efficient LED signage and then accelerated by restrictive government policy from 2010, the cityscape has rapidly changed so as to bear little resemblance to that of 20 years ago. From an estimated 120,000 in 2011, recent estimates have placed the current remaining number of functioning neon signs at around 400. There is, however, no authoritative figure for the number of remaining signs. This research seeks to confirm the actual figure of extant neon signs and to digitally archive those that remain before their likely imminent removal in order for them to be experienced in the future as historical cultural heritage that gave to Hong Kong a sense of place. Existing attempts to document neon typically focus on the visual, often in still images, while the intrinsic quality of neon is arguably it’s flow and fluctuation and its relationship with the fabric of its environment. This research will therefore attempt to build an audio-visual archive that approximates the physical experience of neon signs with audio recordings that reference the lived experience. VR footage captured both day and night will be utilised to capture an immersive experience of the intrinsic temporal quality of neon within the cityscape. The project will also seek to encourage a re-appraisal of the value of Hong Kong vernacular neon by facilitating glass-bending and neon mounting workshops for young artists with one of the few remaining neon artisans still working in Hong Kong. 項目摘要（非專業人士閱讀版本）： 本研究計劃旨在以數碼方式記錄香港霓虹燈，作為本地文化遺產，並建立一個線上多媒體資料 庫，內容包括照片、立體虛擬實境影片、音訊片段及文字說明。近年來，公眾日益關注香港本 土霓虹燈在城市急速轉型中快速消失的現象，認識到霓虹燈是香港視覺景觀與文化認同中不可 或缺的一部分。本研究具備高度時效性與迫切性，因為香港現存霓虹燈的數量正持續銳減，或 將於不久將來幾近消失。 自二十世紀五十年代起，霓虹燈的普及深刻地塑造了香港獨特的視覺文化與城市活力。本地工 藝師製作的霓虹廣告牌，既服務國際品牌，亦主要為本地商戶所用，為香港市民與海外訪客營 造出獨具一格的城市景觀與地景感。隨着成本較低且更節能的 LED 燈牌廣泛應用，加上政府 自二零一零年起收緊相關管制政策，城市景觀迅速轉變，與二十年前已大不相同。據估算，二 零一一年香港約有十二萬個霓虹燈牌，而最新估計顯示現存霓虹燈牌僅約四百個，惟實際數字 至今仍欠權威統計。本研究將致力確認現存霓虹燈牌的實際數量，並於其完全消失前進行系統 性的數碼存檔，使公眾日後仍能透過這些資料，感受並理解香港獨特的歷史地景與文化記憶。 目前既有關於霓虹燈的紀錄多集中於視覺層面，且大多以靜態圖像為主。然而，霓虹燈最具本 質特色之處，在於其光影的流動與變化，以及與周遭城市環境的互動關係。因此，本研究將建 構一個視聽兼備的資料庫，透過記錄真實生活情境下的環境音訊，呈現霓虹燈的實體感與臨場 感，並利用日夜不同比時段的虛擬實境影片，捕捉霓虹燈在城市景觀中所展現的時間流動性與 沉浸式體驗。 此外，本計劃亦將舉辦玻璃彎管及霓虹燈安裝工作坊，邀請現時仍於香港從事相關技藝的少數 霓虹工藝師，與年輕藝術家及公眾交流與學習。藉此，一方面促進工藝傳承，另一方面鼓勵社 會重新認識與評價香港本土霓虹燈的藝術與文化價值。

12605425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12605425.value: 借助實時驅動聲音設計的數據 —強化無人機第一人視角的現場感

12605425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12605425.value: There is no broadly used system that enables a first-person view (FPV) drone pilot to participate in drone control and operation with an acoustic element. In FPV flying, the pilot wears a pair of goggles that displays real-time video from the drone’s perspective. Ocularcentrism limits the feedback mechanisms available for FPV pilots to experience a sensation of flight. This problem stems from rotor noise and inferior sound signals compared with high resolution video signals. Propeller noises that pilots are accustomed to hearing from afar are also detached from the immersive video feed. As a result, pilots are left with an aurally impoverished flying experience. Enhancing aural feedback is important because it can revolutionize FPV drone piloting. The purpose of this research project is to enhance the embodied telepresence experienced by FPV drone pilots through the integration of real-time, data-driven sound design. This study aligns artistic creativity with innovative drone technologies to improve upon the PI’s previous transdisciplinary research evaluating the qualitative effects of immersive sonification in FPV drone piloting. It seeks to address significant human-drone interaction questions related to ocular and aural experiences shared between the human mind-body and the drone machine. (i) How FPV pilot's understanding of aerodynamic spatial awareness and movement changes with the introduction of ocular and synthesized aural feedback? (ii) What types of additional drone sensors, algorithms, sonification techniques, and sound designs further enhance the out-of-body aerial experience? (iii) How can immersive sound designs be customized to the three major FPV flying types: freestyle, racing, and aerial cinematography? By incorporating electroacoustic transducers, such as headphones, and employing precise methods derived from physical computing, FPV drone pilots hear real-time sounds that are both spatial and designed to enhance the feeling of flight. The sound designs are controlled by in-flight data sourced from drone sensors, flight controller algorithms, aerobatics, and operator inputs. By expanding the sensory dimensions of the aerial experience beyond the visual realm, the resulting auditory output enables FPV drone pilots to transcend the limitations of ocularcentrism in drone control and access an aural landscape that induces an enriched sense of spatial awareness while airborne. The research project engages a major research gap in artistic creativity within human-drone interaction and significantly contributes to the FPV community by making advancements in aural feedback within drone technology. 目前尚未有普及化的系統，能為第一人視角（FPV）無人機飛手提供融合聽覺元素的操控體驗。在FPV飛行中，飛手雖透過頭戴顯示器獲取無人機即時影像，但「視覺中心主義」限制了飛手感知飛行體感的反饋機制。此問題根源在於：相較於高解析度影像訊號，螺旋槳噪音與低品質聲音訊使飛手慣常聽聞的遠距槳聲，與沉浸式影像畫面產生剝離，導致飛行體驗陷入聽覺貧乏狀態。強化聽覺反饋至關重要，因其將徹底革新FPV無人機操控模式。 本研究旨在透過即時數據驅動的聲音設計，提升FPV飛手的具身臨場感。本計畫融合藝術創意與創新無人機技術，延續主持人先前針對「沉浸式聲音化技術對FPV飛行質性影響」的跨學科研究，致力解決人機互動中涉及身心感知與無人機載具的視聽體驗核心問題： (一）當導入視覺與合成聽覺反饋時，FPV飛手對空氣動力學空間感知與運動理解的變化機制為何？ 二）哪些類型的無人機感測器、演算法、聲音化技術及聲音設計能進一步強化「出體飛行體驗」？ 三）如何針對FPV三大飛行類型——自由花式、競速穿越、空中攝製——定制沉浸式聲音設計方案？ 透過電聲換能器（如耳機）與物理運算精準方法，FPV飛手將聆聽到兼具空間定位與強化飛行體感的即時合成音效。此聲音設計由無人機感測器、飛控演算法、特技動作數據及操作者輸入即時驅動。研究成果將飛行體驗的感官維度突破視覺侷限，使FPV飛手得以超越「視覺中心主義」的操控框架，在升空狀態下透過建構的聲景場域，獲取更豐沛的空間感知能力。本計畫不僅填補人機互動研究中藝術創造性的重大缺口，更透過聽覺反饋技術的突破性進展，為FPV領域作出實質貢獻。 The translation of the project abstract to traditional Chinese was done by DeepSeek R1 on the HKBU GenAI platform. 29 August 2025

12607025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12607025.value: 兔園冊子難登大雅之堂 經義類舉業用書於朝鮮的流傳與影響

12607025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12607025.value: "Tu Yuan Ce Zi兔園冊子" originally referred to an encyclopaedia-type book “leishu類書”called "Rabbit Garden Imperial Book Repository兔園策府", which was first compiled in the Tang Dynasty and served as a children textbook in private schools. Its content was easy to understand. However, the name was later used to refer to the preparatory books for the imperial examination in the Ming and Qing Dynasties to satirize the mentality of scholars who were more interested in pursuing high scores and passing the exam than studying the classics. In fact, these exam preparation books are not entirely bad. From a modern academic point of view, they do have some value. Firstly, there are many types of preparation books. Through the question-types in these books, one can understand the direction and content scholars focused on when they were preparing for the exam.
