From a commodity economy perspective, these books led to the development of the publishing industry in the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and a small number of them were indeed excellent works and received good reviews from the Siku treasury officials. These encyclopaedia-type reference books can also contribute to the collection of lost documents, so their academic value cannot be completely wiped out. The applicant noticed that in libraries in South Korea and Japan, there are some examination preparation books that have been lost in China. They can be said to be the only existing copies overseas. These books were very likely banned by the imperial court and despised by scholars at that time, so they were not preserved and handed down. They were, however, indirectly brought to foreign countries due to wars or exchanges with diplomatic envoys and were well preserved in foreign lands. This research project aims to explore what ancient Chinese examination preparation books are currently collected in Korea and how they spread to Korea. Did they impact the imperial examination and the interpretation of classics by literati in the Joseon Dynasty? Was there any continuation and imitation of these books in the Joseon Dynasty? If so, what was the purpose of their compilation? Were they written to make a living? Or were they published for profits? Or was it the intention of the successful candidates of the Imperial examination to pass down the experience to future generations? Was there any sequel in the Joseon Dynasty? 「兔園冊子」原本指的是一部名為《兔園策》(或稱《兔園冊府》、《兔園冊》)的類書，其於唐代編纂之初，是作為私塾的童蒙教科書，故以淺顯易懂的內容構成。但日後被借指為參加科舉考試時補助備考用書，以諷刺士人比起潛心研讀經書義理，更熱衷尋求高分中舉的心態。舉業用書因目的性強烈，在明清被譏為「兔園冊子」之流，故官府不收或禁止，藏書家亦不收藏，重要圖書目錄多不具載。後又經天災人禍大都佚失，能完整留存下來的少之又少。事實上，這些舉業用書並非全然不好，以現代學術觀點來看，至少具有數點價值。首先，舉業用書有多種型態，透過擬題型舉業書籍，可使我們了解當時讀書人研讀經書應試時的準備方向與內容。若以商品經濟的層面來看，舉業用書帶動了明清出版業的發達，少部分更有佳作並獲四庫館臣佳評。而類書型舉業用書，更可資輯佚散失文獻之功，故不可全然抹滅其學術價值。 申請人留意到在韓國與日本的圖書館中，留存一些已於中國本土佚失的舉業用書，可謂海外孤本。這些書籍很可能是當時遭受朝廷的禁毀與學者的鄙視，故未能流傳下來，但因戰爭或外交使臣的交流間接帶到外國，反在異域良好地保存下來。例如以《了凡四訓》聞名於後世的袁黃(1523-1606)編著便是其一。故本研究計畫旨以「兔園冊子難登大雅之堂? ——舉業用書於朝鮮的流傳與影響」為題，探查現存藏於韓國的中國古代舉業用書有哪些?其流傳至朝鮮的情形?對朝鮮時代的科舉考試、文人解經內容有無影響?朝鮮時代有無續衍仿照之書?若有，其編纂目的為何?為求謀生而寫?抑是出版商為求牟利而編?甚或高中科舉者為傳承成功經驗於後代子孫?朝鮮時代有無續衍之作等。

12607725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12607725.value: 極境之中的實踐研究：以條件限制詩歌應對氣候危機

12607725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12607725.value: The unprecedented climate crisis requires a radical rethinking of the historical role of poetry in observing nature. This practice-based research project engages the adverse effects of climate change by using constraint-based writing methods to engender a new orientation toward this global crisis, thereby renewing the possibilities for agency and reflection. In 2023 alone, the world witnessed multiple broken climate records: the hottest day on record, the hottest June on record globally, record low Antarctic sea ice levels, and more. This crisis encompasses Hong Kong, which faces rising temperatures, rising sea levels, and increased rainfall, as well as the Greater Bay Area and the whole of mainland China. This project responds to the climate crisis in an urgent and novel way by means of constraint-based poetry that explores our experience of extreme weather events. In contrast to commonly used free verse or received poetic forms to depict the natural world, this project employs sui generis constraint-based writing strategies derived from Western (Oulipian) and Chinese literary traditions to produce new insights into our relationship to the climate crisis and its attendant constraints. Central to this initiative is computer coding that will enable the researcher to create visualizations of site-specific climate change data via poetic forms. Constraints in this context are seen not only as limitations imposed by climate change, but also as tools for fostering creative engagement and meaningful action. The project outputs include a manuscript titled In Extremis that will increase awareness of climate change’s adverse effects, underscore humans’ role in the crisis, and explore how human behavior can mitigate these impacts. A critical article that analyzes constraint-based poetry writing will be included within the manuscript itself, offering a hybrid work that bridges creative writing and scholarly research. This research project advances work in creative geography and creative writing studies, as it seeks to reorient our understanding of climate change. The impact will extend beyond literary innovation, fostering a global community of engaged citizens enabled to reflect on and respond to the constraints and possibilities inherent in addressing the climate crisis.

12608425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608425.value: 多尺度公正轉型：中國大興安嶺禁伐與森林轉型

12608425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608425.value: This study aims to understand how a multi-scalar framework can identify regions, firms, and individuals disproportionately affected by forest transition, marginalized in decision-making, or neglected by transition policies. This study conceptualizes just transitions as a complex, multi-scalar process occurring at regional, firm, and individual levels. The regional level entails the broad socio-economic and spatial transformation of entire areas and cities, including economic diversification, infrastructure development, and landscape restoration. The firm level pertains to the transformation of affected enterprises (e.g., decarbonizing existing operations or developing new business strategies compatible with carbon neutrality). The individual level refers to the transformation of workers and local residents’ livelihoods, lifestyles, living conditions, locations, and identities. We will analyze the implications of the transition processes in terms of distributional, procedural, and recognitional justice. While each level has its own transformation dynamics and justice implications, the levels are also interrelated through top-down and bottom-up dynamics. This project also broadens the debate on just transitions beyond its narrow focus on energy transitions by engaging with the forest sector. The transition from deforestation to reforestation is crucial for achieving carbon neutrality. Since introducing a complete logging ban on natural forest in 2016, China has tipped toward a reforestation transition. However, previous studies on China’s forest transition have rarely considered its social justice aspects. This study draws on the case of the Greater Khingan Range in northeast China, where the logging ban has profoundly impacted regions, firms, and individuals. In sum, this study will (1) advance just transition theory with a multi-scalar perspective, (2) develop the justice aspect of forest transitions, and (3) recommend knowledge and policy practices to ensure a just forest transition. The empirical work will be carried out at three sites in the Greater Khingan Range: Jiagedaqi (the region’s administrative center), Huzhong (a former timber production site), and Mohe (a border town on the China-Russia border). We will conduct 150 interviews with government officials, managers, forestry workers, and local residents. We will also organize three deliberative workshops to collaboratively explore the concept of a just transition. Finally, we will a comprehensive database of the various forms of forest transition measures at the regional, firm, and individual levels in China. The PI undertook initial preparatory work for this study in 2020 and 2022 to obtain a preliminary understanding of the situation, evaluate the practicality of the research, and develop local contacts and collaboration. 本研究運用多尺度框架，理解森林轉型的整體過程，並探討在此過程中受到不公平待遇、在決策中被邊緣化，或被轉型政策忽視的地區、企業與個人。本研究將「公正轉型」概念化為一個複雜、多尺度的過程，涵蓋區域、企業與個人三個層面。區域層面涉及整個地區與城市的廣泛社會經濟與空間轉型，包括經濟多元化、基礎設施建設，以及景觀修復。企業層面指的是受影響企業的轉型，例如使現有業務去碳化，或發展符合碳中和目標的新商業策略。個人層面指的是工人與當地居民在生計、生活方式、居住條件、居住地點與身份上的轉變。儘管每個層面皆具有其自身的轉型動態與正義意涵，這些層面亦透過自上而下與自下而上的互動彼此關聯。本研究將從分配正義、程序正義與認同正義三個面向，分析森林轉型過程所帶來的影響。 本研究將「公正轉型」的討論從以能源轉型為主的狹隘焦點擴展至森林部門，藉此拓展其理論與實踐的適用範疇。從砍伐到造林的轉型對實現碳中和至關重要。中國自2016年全面禁止天然林砍伐以來，已逐步邁向以造林為導向的轉型。然而，過去針對中國森林轉型的研究鮮少關注其社會正義層面。本研究以中國東北的大興安嶺為案例，該地的禁伐政策對地區、企業與個人造成了深遠影響。 總結而言，本研究將：（1）以多尺度視角推進公正轉型理論，（2）深化森林轉型中的正義面向，以及（3）提出知識與政策實踐建議，以確保森林轉型的公正性。實證研究將在中國大興安嶺地區的三個地點進行：加格達奇（地區行政中心）、呼中（伐木生產基地）、以及漠河（邊境城鎮）。我們將進行150場訪談，對象包括政府官員、企業管理者、林業工人與當地居民。此外，將舉辦三場協商式工作坊，以共同探討「公正轉型」的概念。最後，我們將建立一個涵蓋中國區域、企業與個人層面的森林轉型措施資料庫。首席研究員已於2020年與2022年進行前期準備工作，以了解當地情況、評估研究的可行性，並建立在地聯繫與合作關係。

12608925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608925.value: 青少年社群媒體使用的時間動態與幸福感：一項針對縱向研究的連續時間元分析

12608925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12608925.value: Dr Chu, Tsz Hang Prof Valkenburg, Patti M.

12608925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608925.value: Social media has become integral to young people's lives, shaping their social interactions and worldviews during a crucial life phase (Valkenburg & Piotrowski, 2017). While worries about its addictive nature and psychological harm are widespread, there is a troubling lack of concrete evidence to verify these concerns. Despite extensive research, considerable uncertainty persists about how social media use relates to well-being, particularly over time (Valkenburg, 2022). For instance, does social media use engender short-term benefits but long-term repercussions? While there has been a recent increase in longitudinal studies, enabling assessments of bidirectional effects and temporal patterns, no meta-analysis has yet offered a robust and comprehensive view of the temporal dynamics of social media use and youth well-being. This knowledge gap largely stems from the significant methodological limitations of traditional meta-analytic approaches in handling varying measurement occasions within and across longitudinal studies, a likely source of inconsistent findings between studies. To address these challenges, we will adopt recent methodological advancements by conducting the first-ever continuous time meta-analyses (Dormann et al., 2020) of longitudinal studies on social media use and youth well-being. Drawing on transactional media effects theories (Valkenburg & Peter, 2013), we will investigate the reciprocal over-time influence process between the media effect of social media use on well-being and the selection effect of well-being on social media use among young people. For example, to what extent does excessive social media use lead to youth depression versus pre-existing depression driving excessive social media use? Our robust meta-analytic evidence will offer a comprehensive yet nuanced understanding of media and selection effects around youth social media use over time, clarifying consistency of effects across studies, particularly regarding developmental stages and gender, and providing a strong empirical basis to theorize the temporal dynamics of these effects. Harnessing the conceptual strength of longitudinal evidence, our novel meta-analytic approach will scrutinize how media and selection effects vary across multiple time intervals: their appearance, duration, relative sizes, consistency, and symmetry. We will also identify the optimal time intervals and sample sizes for observing significant effects related to social media use, facilitating more effective and reliable future research and interventions. With the expertise of the PI and Co-Is, a skilled meta-analyst (T.H. Chu) and a world-leading authority in (social) media effects on youth (Patti Valkenburg), we are well-equipped to execute this innovative project and provide groundbreaking insights into the temporal dynamics of social media use and youth well-being. 社群媒體已成為青少年生活中不可或缺的一部分，在他們人生的重要階段塑造著其社交互動與世界觀（Valkenburg & Piotrowski, 2017）。儘管人們普遍擔憂其成癮性與心理危害，但令人憂心的是，至今仍缺乏具體證據來驗證這些疑慮。 儘管已有大量研究，但關於社群媒體使用如何影響幸福感，特別是隨時間推移的影響，仍存在相當大的不確定性（Valkenburg, 2022）。例如，社群媒體的使用是否帶來短期益處卻造成長期後果？儘管近年來縱向研究有所增加，使評估雙向效應和時間模式成為可能，但目前尚無任何元分析能對社群媒體使用與青少年幸福感的時間動態提供嚴謹且全面的見解。此知識鴻溝主要源於傳統元分析方法在處理縱向研究內部及跨研究間不同測量時點時存在重大方法學限制，這很可能是造成研究間結果不一致的原因。 為應對這些挑戰，我們將採用最新的方法學進展，進行首個針對社群媒體使用與青少年幸福感的縱向研究之連續時間元分析（Dormann et al., 2020）。基於交易性媒體效應理論（Valkenburg & Peter, 2013），我們將探討社群媒體使用對幸福感的媒體效應與幸福感對社群媒體使用的選擇效應之間，在青少年群體中隨時間推移的相互影響過程。例如，過度使用社群媒體在多大程度上導致青少年憂鬱症？又或者是原本存在的憂鬱傾向促使青少年過度使用社群媒體？ 我們嚴謹的元分析證據將提供一個全面且細緻的理解，闡明青少年社群媒體使用中媒體效應與選擇效應隨時間變化的動態關係，釐清不同研究間效應的一致性（特別是在發展階段和性別方面），並為理論化這些效應的時間動態提供堅實的實證基礎。憑藉縱向證據的概念優勢，我們創新的元分析方法將深入檢視媒體效應與選擇效應在多個時間區間內的變化：包括其出現的時機、持續時間、相對大小、一致性以及對稱性。我們也將找出觀察與社群媒體使用相關顯著效應的最佳時間區間與樣本大小，以促進未來更有效且可靠的研究與介入措施。 憑藉首席研究員與共同研究員的專業知識，其中包括一位技術純熟的元分析專家，以及一位在青少年（社群）媒體影響領域享有世界聲譽的權威，我們具備充分能力執行此項創新計畫，並為理解社群媒體使用與青少年幸福感的時間動態提供突破性的見解。

12609325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12609325.value: 書法互動景觀：香港場域特定書法中形式、情動與體驗維度之協同作用

12609325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12609325.value: This research posits site-specific Chinese calligraphy in Hong Kong as a vibrant and determinant catalyst that can generate cultural, sensory and affective connections that enhance our experience and understanding of the city in terms of our relationship with environment and sense of place and community. Site-specific calligraphy often creates new concepts, ideas or viewing experience beyond the intrinsic, verbal meaning of Chinese characters through a thoughtful consideration of how a calligraphic work, its presentation and reception on a specific site can substantiate one another. This research offers a new methodology for examining the interactions of the following factors: 1) the semantic meanings in calligraphic works; 2) the conditions of site specificity including factors of geographical location, topographical specificity, architectural setting, 3) site-specific calligraphy’s capability of generating and transmitting sensory and affective experiences in a manner that, upon perception, enhances our experience and perception of our relationship with environment; and 4) the synergistic effects of the factors above. This unprecedented methodology offers a more effective, multifaceted analysis and interpretation of calligraphy as a more encompassing form of site-specific art. The research will start with the PI’s identification of more than 90 site-specific Chinese calligraphy in Hong Kong. Images and moving images of works of site-specific Chinese calligraphy will be collected and organized into a systematic digital archive. Based on the knowledge and inspirations from the digital archive, a new body of 10 creative works of site-specific Chinese calligraphy will be produced by the PI and other invited calligraphers and new media artists specializing in incorporation of calligraphic elements in new media artworks. The use of interactive computer graphics and other technologies in new media art has the transcendent power of creating an immersive environment for the audience to interact with the artworks. In the final stage, a website will be created to house the digital archive of more than 100 images and moving images, disseminate new knowledge, and hold an online exhibition of the site-specific Chinese calligraphy of Hong Kong. A series of academic papers will be written for conference presentations, and a fully illustrated book manuscript will be written for publication. These scholarly and creative outputs will generate new interests among practitioners in the field and contribute to a deeper understanding of how calligraphy as traditional art and culture transforms as contemporary art in Hong Kong, China, fostering broader cultural and scholarly discourse within China studies. 本研究將香港的場域特定中文書法視為一種充滿活力且具決定性作用的催化劑，能夠在文化、感官與情動的層面上產生連結，進而提升我們對城市的體驗與理解，尤其是關於人與環境的關係，以及地方感與社群意識。場域特定書法常透過對書法作品、其展示方式及在特定場域中的接受情境的深思熟慮，創造出超越漢字語義本身的新概念、想法或觀看體驗，使各元素相互強化、相得益彰。 本研究提出一套嶄新的方法論，以探討以下因素之間的互動關係：一）書法作品中的語義意涵；二）場域特定性的條件，包括地理位置、地形特徵與建築環境等因素；三）場域特定書法在感官與情動(affective)層面上生成並傳遞經驗的能力，並透過觀者的感知過程，深化其對人與環境關係的體驗與認知；四）上述各項因素之間的協同效應。此前所未有的方法論，提供了一種更有效且多面向的分析與詮釋途徑，將書法視為一種更具包容性的場域特定藝術形式。 研究將由首席研究員（PI）辨識香港超過90件場域特定中文書法作品開始，並收集其影像與動態影像，建構成系統化的數位資料庫。基於此資料庫所提供的知識與啟發，PI與其他受邀書法家及擅長將書法元素融入新媒體藝術的新媒體藝術家，將創作出新的場域特定中文書法作品。新媒體藝術中運用互動式電腦圖像與其他技術，具有創造沉浸式環境的超越性力量，使觀眾能與作品互動。 研究最終階段將建立一個網站，收錄超過100件影像與動態影像的數位資料庫，傳播新知識，並舉辦香港場域特定中文書法的線上展覽。研究成果將包括一系列學術論文以供會議發表，以及一本附有完整插圖的書籍手稿以供出版。這些學術與創作成果將激發書法領域從業者的新興興趣，並促進對書法作為傳統藝術與文化在香港、中國轉化為當代藝術的深入理解，進而拓展中國研究領域中的文化與學術對話。

12609525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12609525.value: 亞裔澳大利亞文學中的水想像與水形態：以移民視角研究去殖民海洋人文學

12609525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12609525.value: This research project will offer the first decolonial blue humanities perspective on Asian Australian literature. It stands as a crucial intervention at a time when climate disruption of water cycles is exacerbating border crossing, yet the significance of migrant, refugee, and ethnic water narratives remains largely unexplored. On the one hand, settler colonial nation-states like Australia have been using environmental discourses of water, oceans, and climate to dehumanize migrants and refugees as invasive threats to white humanism, underscoring the need to decolonise the liberal possessive “human” as the agent of planetary history. On the other hand, Asian Australian claims for place, justice, and multiculturalism tend to overlook their own complicity with settler colonial logics of nation and property ownership, which risks reinforcing Indigenous dispossession alongside extractive capitalism. While previous diasporic and transnational studies have mobilized abstract or capitalist water imaginaries to counter racism, I explore, through Asian Australian literary and artistic production, how racial differences are reproduced through capitalist accumulation and the different visions from migrant and Indigenous relationalities with water in various narratives of the Gold Rush, pearling, Pacific plantations, refugee migration, and climate change. How do bodies of water materialise settler humanist infrastructures of race, property, and mobility? How are land-based colonial, heterosexual, and capitalist subjectivities continued or ruptured in aqueous modes of relationality? In what ways Asian Australian writers and artists are able to take initiatives and produce decolonial and post-anthropocentric narratives of water, oceans, and climate? This project will combine methods of cultural analysis, environmental history research, and creative practice to: (1) theorize water agencies of colonial and racial subjection in ecologies of migrant labour, placemaking, corporeality, and interracial relations; (2) develop ecomaterial and ecocultural modes of inquiry into the role of water in constructing Asian Australian subjectivity; (3) illuminate how oceanic imaginations can elucidate a more-than-human biopolitics in refugee studies; 4) increase dialogue between Asian diasporic and Indigenous Australian and Pacific Islander studies regarding decolonisation and climate futures; (5) produce a book monograph and a climate art exhibition to amplify migrant perspectives about water’s creative-connective capacity in gestating climate and water action. Through an innovative study of Asian Australian hydro-criticism, the project will help to expand blue humanities by understanding how waterscapes are significant for cultural and aesthetic production, and how water movements of race and diaspora are constitutive in the making and unmaking a colonial hierarchy of life and things. 本研究項目將首次從去殖民的藍色人文學視角探討亞裔澳大利亞文學。在當下氣候變化加劇水循環紊亂、推動邊界跨越的背景下，該項目具有重要的學術介入意義。然而，移民、難民及族裔與水相關的敘事意涵，至今仍缺乏深入研究。一方面，像澳大利亞這樣的定居殖民民族國家，常藉助有關水、海洋與氣候的環境話語，將移民與難民非人化，視為對白人“人文主義”的入侵威脅。這凸顯了有必要對自由主義所塑造的佔有性“人”進行去殖民化，並重新理解其作為全球歷史主體的意義。另一方面，亞裔澳大利亞人在爭取歸屬、正義與多元文化的過程中，往往忽視了自身與定居殖民國家及財產所有權邏輯之間的共謀關係，這種忽視可能進一步加劇對原住民土地的剝奪與掠奪性資本主義的延續。以往的離散與跨國研究，多以抽象或資本主義的水意象來對抗種族主義；而本項目將通過亞裔澳大利亞文學與藝術作品，探討種族差異如何在資本積累過程中被再生產，以及在淘金熱、採珠業、太平洋種植園、難民遷徙與氣候變化等不同歷史與當代敘事中，移民與原住民群體在與水的關係上如何展現出各異的願景。通過對亞裔澳大利亞水文學批評的創新性研究，本項目將拓展藍色人文學的研究範疇，揭示水域景觀在文化與美學生產中的重要作用，並探討種族與離散群體的 “水之流動”如何在構建與解構殖民體系下生命與物的等級結構中發揮創生性作用。

12610625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12610625.value: 跨國生產與最優關稅：理論與量化評估

12610625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12610625.value: Trade conflicts and tariff wars pose significant threats to the international trade system and globalization. Since 2018, the U.S. has initiated tariff wars against China, which responded with retaliatory measures. Beyond the intensification of U.S.-China trade tensions, other major economies, such as the EU and Japan, have also engaged in trade conflicts to varying degrees. Countries are increasingly imposing unilateral tariffs that they consider optimal, aiming to maximize their own welfare, often at the expense of their trading partners. While the incentives and consequences of optimal tariffs and resulting tariff wars have been widely studied, existing research has largely overlooked the role of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in shaping these tariffs. This study aims to address this gap by developing a multi-country-multi-sector general equilibrium model that incorporates trade, multinational production (MP), and tariffs. Using comprehensive data on sectoral bilateral trade flows, MP sales, and tariffs across major economies, the study will conduct counterfactual analyses to understand how optimal tariffs are affected by MNEs’ global operations as well as their political influences. MNEs play a key role in optimal tariffs and tariff wars for three reasons. First, as the largest players in global production and trade, their responses significantly influence the overall impact of tariffs. Second, MNEs wield considerable political influence, and their interests can shape tariff policies. Third, recent tariff wars frequently involve policies affecting international investment and multinational production (MP), making it crucial to understand how trade and MP policies interact in today’s global economy. This study extends existing trade models on optimal tariffs by incorporating quantitative models of multinational production (MP), based on my previous research, that capture key aspects of MNEs’ global operations in a tractable way. By applying this new model to updated data on trade, MP, and tariffs, the study contributes to the growing body of economic research on the motivations and consequences of optimal tariffs and tariff wars, as well as the interactions between trade and MP policies in shaping international economic competition. 貿易衝突與關稅戰爭對國際貿易體系及全球化進程構成重大威脅。自2018年以來，美國對中國發起關稅戰，中方隨之採取反制措施。除中美貿易摩擦持續升級外，歐盟、日本等其他主要經濟體也不同程度地捲入了貿易衝突。各國日益傾向於實施其認為最優的單邊關稅政策，旨在實現本國福利最大化，卻往往以犧牲交易夥伴利益為代價。 儘管最優關稅及其引發的關稅戰爭的動因與後果已得到廣泛研究，但現有文獻大多忽視了跨國企業在關稅形成過程中的作用。本研究通過構建包含貿易、跨國生產和關稅政策的多國多部門一般均衡模型，試圖填補這一空白。利用主要經濟體部門級雙邊貿易流量、跨國企業銷售額及關稅的全面資料，研究將進行反事實分析，以理解跨國企業的全球運營及其政治影響力如何影響最優關稅的制定。 跨國企業對最優關稅及關稅戰爭產生關鍵影響的原因有三：首先，作為全球生產和貿易的最大參與主體，其應對策略顯著影響關稅政策的整體效果；其次，跨國企業擁有強大的政治影響力，其利益訴求能左右關稅政策的制定；第三，近年來的關稅戰爭往往涉及影響國際投資和跨國生產的政策，因此理解貿易政策與跨國生產政策在當代全球經濟中的互動機制至關重要。 本研究基於筆者先前提出的跨國生產量化模型——該模型以可操作方式捕捉跨國企業全球運營的核心特徵——對現有最優關稅貿易模型進行拓展。通過將新模型應用於最新貿易、跨國生產和關稅資料，本研究為正在興起的關於最優關稅與關稅戰爭動因後果的經濟學研究作出貢獻，同時深化了對貿易政策與跨國生產政策如何塑造國際經濟競爭格局的理解。

12612325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12612325.value: 评估极端天气和空气污染对城市出行的影响

12612325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12612325.value: The impacts of climate change and air pollution on urban mobility or daily travel have aroused much research attentions in transport studies. Existing studies have typically focused on the impact of either climate change such as extreme weather or air pollution on urban mobility. Not many efforts have been spent to compare the impacts of these two factors and estimate their joint effects, despite their significant practical values in allocating limited public resources to address different challenges. This project is proposed to address these knowledge gaps. The study will comprehensively assess the impacts of temperature and air pollution on human mobilities by different transport modes in Chengdu, a provincial city of China, not only for the availability of the city’s data on weather conditions, air pollution, and daily trip making by various transport means, but also for the city’s great variations in weather conditions and air quality throughout the seasons. We plan to set up a panel dataset that includes transport demand and travel distances by different transport modes including subway, bus, private car, taxi, ride-hailing, and bike-sharing–coupled with data on weather conditions and air pollution levels. We will first employ non-linear panel distributed lag models to estimate both the contemporaneous and lagged effects of temperature and air pollution on transport demand and travel distances by different transport modes. Furthermore, we will use machine learning-based interactive fixed effects counterfactual and matrix completion estimators to examine the joint effects of temperature and air pollution on urban mobility. This project will enrich the existing knowledge about the travel behavior impacts of extreme weather and air pollution and contribute to a better understanding about the socioeconomic consequences of climate change. Practically, the outcomes of this project will offer valuable policy recommendations for improving urban mobility management and prioritizing policy interventions to enhance the climate change resilience of urban mobility systems. 气候变化和空气污染对城市出行或日常交通的影响，已引起交通研究领域的广泛关注。现有研究通常聚焦于气候变化（如极端天气）或空气污染对城市出行的单一影响。相比之下，关于比较这两种因素的影响并估算其联合效应的研究还较为有限，尽管这对于合理分配有限的公共资源以应对不同挑战具有重要的现实意义。为填补这一知识空白，本项目应运而生。研究将全面评估温度和空气污染对成都市不同交通方式下人类出行的影响。选择成都市作为研究对象，既因为该市拥有关于天气状况、空气污染和各种交通方式日常出行的数据，也因为其全年气候和空气质量变化显著。 我们计划建立一个面板数据集，涵盖地铁、公交、私家车、出租车、网约车和共享单车等不同交通方式的出行需求和出行距离，并结合天气状况及空气污染水平的数据。首先，我们将采用非线性面板分布滞后模型，估算温度和空气污染对不同交通方式出行需求及出行距离的即时和滞后效应。此外，我们还将利用基于机器学习的交互固定效应反事实估计器和矩阵补全方法，分析温度与空气污染对城市出行的联合影响。 本项目将丰富关于极端天气和空气污染对出行行为影响的现有知识体系，有助于更好地理解气候变化带来的社会经济后果。在实践层面，本项目成果将为提升城市出行管理、优化政策干预优先级以及增强城市出行系统应对气候变化的韧性，提供有价值的政策建议。

12612525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12612525.value: 國家的旅程：探討中國旅遊中的國旗使用

12612525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12612525.value: Prof Sakamoto, Arthur Prof Tsang, Stephanie Jean

12612525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12612525.value: National flags are an essential ingredient in the nationalist playbook, being used to pledge allegiance, to commemorate holidays, to serve as staging for speeches, to drape coffins, to represent sports teams, to sell merchandise, to identify ships and other vehicles, and to be desecrated as sign of resistance. Yet most thinking around flags considers them rather stationary and attached to particular places or events. Few studies have considered how flags circulate spatially, e.g., the factors that influence carrying flags while traveling. Moreover, few studies provide systematic understandings of flagways across social groups and different situations by using large-n datasets. Chinese tourists in particular have begun utilising national flags in travel. On the social media platform Little Red Book, a hashtag has appeared entitled “Taking the Chinese Flag on Tour”, which has over 44 million page views. Given the rise of China as a regional and global power, it is timely to investigate how the application of China’s national symbols is connected to changes in its social, economic, political and geopolitical situation. This study uses online social media posted by mainland Chinese to study the situational nature of flagways. It uses qualitative analysis of 1000 social media posts from Little Red Book (under hashtag “Taking the National Flag on Tour”) to understand how flags are deployed while traveling and how official meanings interact with vernacular micro rituals of flag-waving. Then it introduces an innovative methodological approach to studying national symbols by using a systematic sampling of flags through visual content analysis of images from the travel website Mafengwo, scraping a total of 100,000 travelogues per year. This allows the accomplishment of something akin to a “census of flags”. By harnessing machine learning tools, we use image captures to measure flag prevalence and geographic distribution. We use this data to answer the following questions: (a) How have official flagways changed over time in recent Chinese history and to what new situations and spaces have they been applied? (b) Among what type of material spaces, regions, infrastructures, and people are Chinese travelers more likely to engage with flags? (c) What types of reactions do Chinese travelers have when encountering flags? (d) How do domestic contexts differ from foreign contexts with respect to flag reactions? (f) What influences do demographic factors like age and gender have on flagways? 國旗是民族主義的關鍵要素，廣泛用於宣誓效忠、紀念節日、作為活動和演講的背景、覆蓋棺木、代表體育隊伍、銷售商品、識別船隻及其他交通工具，甚至被褻瀆以作為抵抗的象徵。然而，關於國旗的研究往往將其視為靜態的，與特定地點或事件相聯繫。很少有探討考慮國旗在空間上的流動，例如影響人們旅行時攜帶國旗的因素。此外，鮮有研究通過使用大樣本數據集，對不同社會群體和情境下的國旗使用方式進行系統性的理解。 中國遊客尤其開始出現將國旗帶入旅行的現象。在社交媒體平台「小紅書」上，出現了一個名為「帶著國旗去旅行」的標籤，其瀏覽量已超過4400萬。隨著中國作為地區和全球大國的崛起, 現在正是時候去探討中國國家符號的應用如何與其社會、經濟、政治及地緣政治的變化相聯繫。 本研究利用中國大陸網民在社交媒體上發布的內容，探討國旗使用的情境性質。透過對「小紅書」中「帶著國旗去旅行」標籤下的1000則貼文進行質性分析，以理解國旗在旅行中如何被使用，以及官方意涵如何與民間的微型揮旗儀式互動。接著，本研究引入一種創新方法，通過對旅遊網站「馬蜂窩」上的影像進行視覺內容分析，以系統抽樣方式收集國旗影像資料，每年抓取10萬篇旅行日誌，從而完成近似於「國旗普查」的研究。 藉助利用機器學習工具，本研究使用影像辨識技術測量國旗的普遍性和地理分佈。並基於這些數據回答以下問題：（a）在近代中國歷史中，官方國旗使用方式如何隨時間變化，並被應用於哪些新的情境和空間？（b）在哪些实体空間、區域、基礎設施和人群中，中國旅客更可能與國旗互動？（c）中國遊客在遇到國旗時會有什麼反應？（d）在國內情境與國外情境中，對國旗的反應有何差異？（f）人口統計因素（如年齡和性別等）對國旗使用方式有何影響？

12612625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12612625.value: 關鍵決策中的選擇迴避及其對人工智能發展的啟示

12612625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12612625.value: Dr Chan, Christian Shaunlyn Prof IP, Ka Wai

12612625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12612625.value: Important decisions are often difficult to make. Consequently, people may defer decision-making to other agents when faced with difficult choices, even if the decision has significant implications for their own well-being. However, while sporadic evidence of choice avoidance exists in some contexts, we do not yet fully understand its prevalence and how it varies across different decision problems. To what extent are individuals willing to delegate decision-making authority in difficult decisions, such as determining who to harm in an unavoidable car accident or deciding which employee to promote when multiple candidates qualify? What psychological and contextual factors influence this willingness? These questions require urgent attention today as artificial intelligence (AI) systems rapidly expand into domains with profound policy and ethical implications. Through a series of pilot-tested survey experiments informed by insights from political philosophy and behavioral sciences, this study aims to measure the prevalence of choice avoidance among Hong Kong citizens and elucidate the underlying factors that drive such behavior. Specifically, we will conduct experiments embedded in a probability-based online survey across four distinct contexts: autonomous driving, human resource management, public policy, and health insurance consumption. Participants will be randomly presented with decision scenarios varying in informational complexity, moral conflicts, and potential consequences of failure. We will then measure their willingness to delegate the decision to another agent, randomly presented as an AI system or a human being. To contextualize the experimental findings within respondents’ lives and explore the influence of institutional and cultural factors, we will conduct in-depth interviews with 60 participants. This project’s findings will have significant theoretical and practical implications. Theoretically, while extensive research exists on the burdens that difficult decisions place on human beings, these insights remain isolated from studies examining humans’ willingness to delegate decision-making authority to another agent. As a result, existing evidence of humans’ desire for decision-making typically comes from questions that put respondents in a detached, receiving-end perspective, rather than confronting them with the burden of hard decisions. This project will bridge the literatures on decision fatigue and desire for decision and establish the necessary concepts and tools to evaluate choice avoidance. Practically, as AI systems gain increasing capacities, understanding when and how choice avoidance occurs is crucial for formulating policies that ensure the continued relevance of human judgments in our future development. 人們在面對困難決策時往往會將決定權委託給他人，即使這些決策關乎自身福祉。隨著人工智能系統迅速擴展到不同決策領域，我們必須對選擇迴避的普遍程度及其在不同情境下的變化作更深入的調查。 本研究旨在測量香港市民選擇迴避的普遍程度，並闡明其潛在驅動因素。我們將在四個不同情境中進行網上問卷實驗：自動駕駛、人力資源管理、公共政策及醫療保險消費。參與者將隨機面對不同複雜程度的決策情境，我們將測量他們把決策委託給人工智能系統或人類的意願。為深入了解實驗結果並探討制度與文化因素的影響，我們亦將對60名參與者進行深入訪談。 本項目在理論和實踐層面均具重要意義。理論上，本研究將連接「決策疲勞」與「決策渴望」這兩個現有文獻，彌補過往研究的不足。實踐上，隨著人工智能能力不斷提升，理解選擇迴避的發生時機和方式，對制定相關政策以確保人類判斷在未來發展中的持續相關性至關重要。

12612825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12612825.value: 賦能淨零城市：基於智慧數據驅動網絡與能源社區可擴展性的潛能釋放——香港、首爾與布裡斯托爾城市生活實驗室的比較研究

12612825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12612825.value: Dr Cheung, Darren Man-wai Dr Choi, Byron, Koon-kau Dr Chun, Kwok-pan Prof Fogg-Rogers, Laura Prof Fung, Timonthy Dr Kim, Hana Dr Kwok, Kam-chau Prof Leung, Kwok Hi Michael Prof Lo, Alex Prof McLellan, Benjamin Prof Rodrigues, Lucelia Dr Siu, Alice Prof Tai, Samson Prof Wong, Paulina Prof Yun, Sun-Jin

12612825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12612825.value: The urgency of tackling global climate impacts has intensified the need for cities to achieve ambitious net-zero emission goals by 2050. While a shift toward decarbonisation and digitalisation is essential, government initiatives and market solutions have significant limitations. Engaging households with smart energy technologies (e.g., smart metering) is crucial, yet household engagement has had limited effects, and effective scaling of this engagement remains largely overlooked. This 30-month transdisciplinary action research aims to explore how smart urban living labs (ULLs) can enhance household engagement at home and in communities, ultimately contributing to a city's net-zero goals by utilising smart energy data to fully foster innovation in social networking. The research will establish three community-based ULLs in Hong Kong, Seoul, and Bristol, testing an integrative model of data-empowered network innovation. The project will develop an 18-month ULL Prototyping and Engagement program, involving 90 local residents (30 from each community). The program will consist of three workshops: VR-enabled Envisioning Workshops, Carbon-coin Co-learning Workshops, and Prototyping Workshops, all supported by seven experimentation initiatives (EIs) such as VR-based energy scenario games and AI-moderated dialogue platforms. These EIs will use a combination of smart energy technologies (e.g. smart metering), immersive technologies (e.g. virtual reality (VR)), and AI technologies (e.g. chatbot) to facilitate networking. Participants will co-create and test nine prototypes aiming at developing new products, services, as well as policy frameworks. The global perspective of this comparative study involving Asian and European cities will achieve important theoretical and empirical advancements. By examining how traditional social structures are reshaped and new consumer-utility relations emerge in post-pandemic cities, we will elucidate the determinants, mechanisms, and effectiveness of social networking as an up-scaling mechanism. The interdisciplinary project will be delivered by a 28-member international research consortium, including 14 researchers from two local universities, six leading overseas universities (including Stanford and Seoul National University), alongside 13 organisational partners from business, education, and civil society sectors in the three cities. Our team will develop a systemic perspective by integrating expertise in big data analytics, immersive technologies, energy scenario developments, social innovation, energy governance, and public engagement. We will employ a mixed-method approach to collect real-time electricity consumption data, quantitative survey data, and qualitative insights from focus groups, interviews, and workshops to analyse how networking functions. Our robust dissemination and impact plans will ensure the timely release of journal articles, policy reports, an e-energy portal, promoting societal impacts and evidence-based policymaking. 應對全球氣候影響的迫切性，加劇了城市在2050年前實現雄心勃勃的淨零排放目標的必要性。雖然向脫碳和數位轉型至關重要，但政府措施和市場解決方案仍有顯著限制。動員家庭採用智慧能源技術（例如智能電錶）至關重要，然而，家庭層面的參與效果有限，並且有效擴展此類參與的策略迄今在很大程度上仍被忽視。 這項為期30個月的跨學科行動研究旨在探索智慧城市生活實驗室(ULL)如何在家庭與社區層面增強住戶參與，最終透過利用智慧能源數據全面促進社交網絡創新，助力城市實現淨零目標。本研究將在香港、首爾爾布裡斯托爾建立三個以社區為基礎的城市生活實驗室，並測試一套數據賦能的網絡創新整合模型。 本項目將開發一個為期18個月的ULL原型設計和參與計劃，涵蓋90位當地居民（每個社區30名）。該計畫將包含三類工作坊：虛擬實境(VR)賦能的創想工作坊、碳幣共學工作坊，以及原型設計工作坊，所有工作坊均由七個實驗性倡議(EIs)支援，例如基於VR的能源場景遊戲與人工智慧(AI)主持的對話平臺。這些實驗倡議將結合智慧能源技術（例如智能電錶）、沉浸式技術（例如虛擬實境(VR)）與AI技術（例如聊天機器人）來促進社交連結。參與者將共同創造並測試九個原型，旨在開發新產品、新服務和政策框架。 本研究透過涵蓋亞洲與歐洲城市的比較視角，將在理論與實證層面實現重要突破。透過檢視後疫情時代城市中傳統社會結構的重塑以及新的消費者-公用事業關係的出現，我們將闡明社交網絡作為擴展機制的決定因素、機制與成效。 本跨學科項目將由一個 28 人的國際研究聯盟執行，成員包括來自兩所本地大學的 14 位研究人員、六所海外頂尖大學（包括史丹佛大學與首爾大學），以及分別來自三個城市的企業、教育及公民社會領域的 13 家合作機構。我們的團隊將整合大數據分析、沉浸式技術、能源情境開發、社會創新、能源治理與公共參與等專業知識，以建立系統性視角。 本研究將採用混合方法收集即時電力消耗數據、量化調查數據，並透過焦點小組、訪談和研討會獲得的定性資料，以分析網絡的運作方式。我們完善的傳播和影響力計劃將確保及時發布期刊文章、政策報告和電子能源入口網站，促進社會影響和循證政策制定。

12613625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613625.value: 徐靈府與杜道堅注釋下的《文子》

12613625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613625.value: As a starting point for this investigation, the PI will provide an annotated English translation of the entire transmitted Wenzi. This task has not yet been accomplished. Until now, the only full translation of the work is the French rendition by Levi (2012). There are also partial translations by De Harlez (1891) into French, Kandel (1973) into German, Cleary (1992) into English and Le Blanc into French (2000). Their respective merits notwithstanding, neither of these works amounts to a full-blown annotated translation of the transmitted Wenzi. The new annotated version will explicate the Wenzi’s relationship to other prominent texts in Chinese intellectual history, above all, the Laozi and the Huainanzi. While some of this work has already been done by scholars such as Ding (1999), Levi (2012), van Els (2018) and Ho (2004 and 2019) etc., issues such as the exact relationship between the Wenzi and the Huainanzi, as well as the role of the Laozi in the composition of the Wenzi remain controversial. Also, the relationship between the textus receptus and the Dingzhou-manuscript will be revisited. Next, the PI aims to translate the commentaries to the text by Xu Lingfu and Du Daojian. These two interpretations of the Wenzi have been chosen for several reasons. First, they represent the only complete commentaries of the Wenzi while others have been either lost or transmitted only partially. Secondly, the exegetical endeavors of Xu and Du proved to be very influential in the reception history of the Wenzi. At the same time, the two Daoist masters operate with different exegetical techniques and, most importantly, provide a very different interpretation of the key elements of the text. For instance, for Xu Lingfu, the royal protagonist, King Ping, is King Ping of Zhou, whereas Du Daojian sees in him King Ping of Chu. Thus, in view of the differences between these historical figures and their historical epochs, the teaching promulgated in the Wenzi is respectively understood as responding to radically different political situations. Finally, the exegesis of the Wenzi, which in the transmitted form (almost) exclusively consists of Laozi’s utterings, will be compared with the most representative early interpretations of the Laozi. This part of the investigation will help establish whether and how the Wenzi commentators were influenced by the Laozi exegesis. The study will shed new light on the interrelation between different strands within the early Chinese commentarial tradition. 作為本次研究的起點，主持人將提供一部帶有註釋的英文全譯本，涵蓋現存《文子》全部篇章。此項任務迄今尚未完成。至今為止，唯一的完整譯本是Levi（2012年）的法文譯本。 此外，還有部分譯本，包括De Harlez（1891年）的法文譯本、Kandel（1973年）的德文譯本、Cleary（1992年）的英文譯本，以及Le Blanc（2000年）的法文譯本。儘管這些譯本各有其優點，但均未達到對現存《文子》進行完整且帶註釋的全譯的標準。 新的註釋版本將闡明《文子》與中國思想史上其他重要文本，尤其是《老子》和《淮南子》之間的關係。雖然丁原植（1999年）、Levi（2012年）、van Els（2018年）及何志華（2004年、2019年）等學者已對此有所探討，但《文子》與《淮南子》之間的確切關係，以及《老子》在《文子》成書中的角色，仍存在爭議。此外，現存文本與定州簡本之間的關係也將被重新審視。 接著，主持人計劃翻譯徐靈府與杜道堅對《文子》的注釋。選擇這兩部注釋有多重原因。首先，它們是唯一完整保存下來的《文子》注釋，其他注釋要麼已失傳，要麼僅部分流傳。其次，徐、杜兩位道士的詮釋在《文子》的接受史上具有重要影響力。同時，兩位道士採用不同的詮釋方法，且最重要的是，對文本核心元素的理解存在顯著差異。例如，徐靈府認為書中的王主角「平王」是周平王，而杜道堅則認為其為楚平王。鑒於這兩位歷史人物及其所處時代的差異，《文子》中所宣揚的教義也被分別理解為對截然不同政治情境的回應。 最後，將把現存文本中（幾乎）完全由《老子》言論組成的《文子》詮釋，與《老子》的早期代表性解釋進行比較。此部分研究將有助於確定《文子》注釋者是否以及如何受到《老子》詮釋傳統的影響。該研究將為揭示早期中國注釋傳統中不同脈絡之間的相互關係提供新的視角。

13100325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13100325.value: 提升城市森林的功能：通過功能性狀的方法解析微氣候、落葉種類和分解者在落葉分解中的作用

13100325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13100325.value: Prof Guénard, Benoit Prof Lai, Derrick Yuk-fo Dr Wong, Mark K.L

13100325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13100325.value: Functional urban ecosystems are increasingly vital for delivering essential ecosystem services that support human well-being, particularly under climate change. These services are underpinned by urban biodiversity and their interactions. Urban policies have concentrated on integrating urban forests into city landscapes to mitigate the increasing heat and enhance urban biodiversity and associated services. However, the inherently stressful urban environment can act as a filter, limiting the species available for interactions and, consequently, impacting service provision. Understanding how anthropogenic activities affect species interactions is therefore crucial for developing effective strategies to optimize ecosystem services. Leaf litter decomposition plays a pivotal role in this context. Globally, this process contributes approximately 60 billion metric tons of organic carbon annually, enriching soil and mediating nutrient cycling. While litter decomposition is primarily influenced by climate, and the effects of litter quality and soil decomposers are generally considered less important. However, in warmer regions, the high richness and abundance of detritivores (soil animals feeding on leaf litter) can strongly determine rates of litter decomposition. Additionally, because of highly variable building topography and greening practices across urban environments, microclimates and litter quality can be extensively altered. Despite this, few studies have empirically investigated how these factors shape litter decomposition in the world’s subtropical and tropical cities. This study leverages a functional trait-based approach to assess the relative importance of detritivore communities, microclimate, and litter quality in driving litter decomposition across a rural-urban gradient in Hong Kong. The innovative functional trait-based approach provides a powerful means for comparatively assessing the resource use and fitness of organisms based on standardized measurements of their physical characteristics (‘traits’). This will allow us to analyze how well leaf litter resources match detritivore dietary preferences under varying environmental conditions, thus providing insights into the influence of urbanization on trait matching and species interactions across trophic levels. We hypothesize that stressors associated with urban environments (e.g., elevated temperature) will induce divergent selection pressures on plants and detritivores, resulting in trait mismatches that negatively affect litter decomposition rates. Specifically, elevated temperature may favor plants with thicker leaves to reduce water loss, while simultaneously reducing the size and biting force of detritivore species, thus weakening litter-detritivore interactions and slowing decomposition. The findings will inform the development of litter-based solutions to enhance detritivore biodiversity and utilize their services to promote functional urban forests in rapidly growing cities across tropical and subtropical Asia. 在氣候變遷的背景下，城市生態系統所提供的各項生態系統服務，對於支持人類福祉至關重要，其功能性也因此更顯突出。這些生態系統服務的基礎是城市生物多樣性及其物種間的相互作用。各項城市政策著重於將城市森林融入城市地景，藉此緩解日益嚴重的熱島效應，並提升城市生物多樣性及相關的生態服務功能。然而，城市環境中固有的壓力，如同過濾器一般，可能會限制物種間的互動，進而影響生態服務的供給。因此，深入了解人為活動對物種互動的影響，對於制定有效策略以優化生態系統服務至關重要。 落葉分解在城市生態系統中扮演著至關重要的角色。此過程每年在全球貢獻約 600 億公噸的有機碳，不僅能豐富土壤，更能調節養分循環。一般認為，氣候是影響落葉分解的主要因素，其次才是落葉品質和土壤分解者的作用。然而，在較溫暖的地區，豐富且大量的分解者（以落葉為食的土壤動物）往往能顯著影響落葉分解的速率。再者，由於城市環境中建築地形和綠化措施的高度多樣性，微氣候和落葉品質也可能產生極大的變異。儘管如此，鮮少有研究深入探討這些因素如何影響亞熱帶和熱帶地區城市的落葉分解。 本研究採用基於功能性狀的方法，旨在評估分解者群落、微氣候及落葉品質，在驅動香港鄉郊-城市梯度下的落葉分解過程中，各自扮演的相對重要性。這種創新的功能性狀方法，透過對生物體物理特徵（即「性狀」）進行標準化測量，提供了一種強而有力的途徑，得以比較評估生物體的資源利用方式與適應能力。藉此，我們將能分析在不同環境條件下，落葉資源與分解者食性偏好之間的匹配程度，進而深入了解城市化對於不同營養階層間性狀匹配及物種互動的影響。我們假設，城市環境中的壓力因子（例如高溫）將對植物與分解者產生差異性的選擇壓力，進而導致性狀不匹配，最終對落葉分解速率造成負面影響。具體而言，高溫可能有利於葉片較厚的植物，以減少水分散失；同時，也可能降低分解者的大小及咬合力，削弱落葉與分解者之間的交互作用，並減緩分解作用。本研究的結果，將可為制定基於落葉的解決方案提供參考資訊，以提升分解者的生物多樣性，並利用其生態服務功能，促進熱帶及亞熱帶亞洲快速發展城市中，具備完整功能的城市森林發展。

13100425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13100425.value: 外來尼羅口孵非鯽對香港淡水生物多樣性及食物網結構的生態影響

13100425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13100425.value: Invasive alien species (IAS) pose significant threats to global biodiversity. Among them, the Nile tilapia Oreochromis niloticus (Cichlidae) is a highly prevalent alien fish in freshwater ecosystems worldwide. Its invasion has negatively affected the diversity of invertebrates and fish, two of the most diverse taxa in freshwater environments. Furthermore, it can disrupt ecosystem functions. For instance, the excretions of O. niloticus can increase nutrient levels, leading to algal blooms. However, the knowledge regarding the invasion of O. niloticus is geographically biased, with limited quantitative data available for regions like Asia, including Hong Kong. Since understanding its ecological effects is crucial for developing effective mitigation plans, this proposed project aims to quantify the ecological impacts of O. niloticus on invertebrate and fish community structure and ecosystem functions, including primary production and nutrient levels, in Hong Kong fresh waters. To achieve this aim, the project outlines three objectives. First, ex-situ mesocosm experiments will be conducted to assess the ecological impacts of Oreochromis niloticus on invertebrate communities, functional diversity, and ecosystem functions. These effects will be compared with those of another nonnative cichlid and a functionally similar native fish species in Hong Kong (Objective 1). While mesocosm experiments allow for accurate quantification of the ecological effects of these fish, laboratory findings may be criticized for their limited relevance to natural environments. Therefore, cage exclosure experiments will be conducted in natural field settings to validate the impacts of O. niloticus (Objective 2). Lastly, gut content and stable isotope analyses will be performed to investigate the interactions between O. niloticus and coexisting native and nonnative fish species, assessing whether native fish exhibit shifts in their dietary and isotopic niches in the presence of O. niloticus in Hong Kong streams (Objective 3). These analyses will help identify native fish species potentially affected by O. niloticus through predation and competition, guiding future research on quantifying these effects. This project represents the first comprehensive investigation into quantifying the ecological impacts of O. niloticus in Hong Kong. The findings will contribute to the Hong Kong Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan, aiding the management of invasive alien fish. This study will directly and immediately inform the management by assisting in prioritizing conservation efforts for species vulnerable to O. niloticus presence. Moreover, by advancing our understanding of cichlid invasion ecology, this study will inform long-term management strategies of IAS and sustainable development policies in Hong Kong and neighboring regions. 外來入侵物種對全球生物多樣性構成重大威脅。其中，尼羅口孵非鯽（Oreochromis niloticus，慈鯛科，俗稱尼羅羅非魚）是淡水生態系統中極為常見的外來魚類，已廣泛入侵全球多個地區。牠的入侵會對淡水中兩個最多樣化的類群—無脊椎動物（如昆蟲）及魚類—的多樣性帶來負面影響。此外，牠亦會擾亂生態系統功能，例如誘過提升水體中的營養量誘發藻類大量繁殖。然而，目前關於尼羅口孵非鯽入侵的相關研究主要集中於特定地區，亞洲尤其是香港的生態數據相當不足。鑑於了解外來入侵物種的生態影響對制定有效緩解措施十分重要，本研究計劃旨在量化尼羅口孵非鯽對香港淡水系統中無脊椎動物和魚類群落結構，以及生態系統功能的影響。 為達到此目的，本研究設有三大目標。首先，我們將在實驗室進行實驗，以評估尼羅口孵非鯽對無脊椎動物群落、功能多樣性及生態系統功能的影響，並將其與另一外來慈鯛及一個功能類似的本地魚類進行比較（目標一）。其次，考慮到實驗室實驗雖能精確量化魚類效應，但其結果或與自然環境存在差異，因此，我們亦會在自然環境中進行實驗，驗證尼羅口孵非鯽在野外的生態影響（目標二）。最後，我們將透過解剖和穩定同位素分析，探討尼羅口孵非鯽與香港溪流中共存的本地及非本地魚種之間的互動，評估本地魚類會否因尼羅口孵非鯽而改變牠們的食性和生態位（目標三）。此分析將有助識別可能受尼羅口孵非鯽捕食及競爭影響的本地魚種，為未來研究提供指引。 本研究為香港首個系統性及全面性的尼羅口孵非鯽生態影響評估，成果將對香港生物多樣性策略及行動計劃有實質貢獻，有助管理本地外來慈鯛種群。本研究的發現將直接支持相關物種保育工作的優先排序，並透過深入了解慈鯛的入侵生態學，為香港及鄰近地區制定長遠的外來入侵物種管理策略與可持續發展政策提供科學依據。

13100525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13100525.value: 在變化的世界中珊瑚的韌性：調查浮游生物攝食與珊瑚白化之間互動的基因因素

13100525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13100525.value: Corals and the reef ecosystems they support provide critical ecological and economic services including high biodiversity, storm surge protection, and ecotourism. The existence of reefs is due to a partnership that coral form with algae that live inside their cells. Each symbiotic partner has access to different sources of nutrition: corals are animals that can feed on plankton (heterotrophy) while algae can assimilate inorganic nutrients through photosynthesis (autotrophy). Corals and algae exchange nutrients with each other, maximizing their sources of nutrition and resulting in nutrient recycling. The extent to which corals rely on heterotrophic vs. autotrophic nutrients varies across species, contributing to the coexistence of diverse coral assemblages on reefs. However, corals face a threat to their existence due to global climate change; as ocean temperatures rise, the relationship between corals and their symbiotic algae fails leading to the ejection of algae, a process known as coral bleaching in which the coral becomes bright white. Previous work demonstrated that corals that rely more on nutrition from their algae are the first to bleach during thermal events, while corals that consume more plankton persist longer under elevated temperatures without bleaching. Despite the clear link between trophic strategy and bleaching, it is unknown if and how the abundance of planktonic food affects coral bleaching resistance. Further, current understanding of the genes involved in feeding is limited and there have been no investigations into the genetic underpinnings of the interaction of heterotrophy and temperature stress. In this project, we will conduct a controlled experiment where we manipulate the abundance of plankton and the thermal stress experienced by two coral species: a predominant autotroph highly susceptible to bleaching and a predominant heterotroph that exhibits resistance to bleaching. Samples will be collected at five time points during the experiment for stable isotope analysis to assess trophic status and RNA extraction to assess gene expression. This work will inform how corals with different trophic strategies respond to the combination of food abundance and thermal stress, and reveal the genetic mechanisms behind delayed bleaching in heterotrophic species. These results will have critical ramifications for predicting the responses of coral communities to future climate scenarios as well as identifying the most resilient coral species and individuals for use in reef conservation and restoration activities. 珊瑚及其所支持的珊瑚礁生態系統提供了重要的生態和經濟服務，包括高生物多樣性、風暴潮汐防護和生態旅遊。珊瑚礁之所以能存在，是因為珊瑚與生活在其細胞內的藻類之間形成了共生關係。每個共生伙伴都能獲得不同來源的營養：珊瑚是以浮游生物為食的動物（異營），而藻類則通過光合作用吸收無機營養物質（自營）。珊瑚和藻類相互交換養分，最大化各自的營養來源，從而達到養分的再循環。珊瑚對異營和自營養分的依賴程度因物種而異，這種差異有助於多樣珊瑚群聚在礁區的共存。然而，珊瑚正面臨全球氣候變遷所帶來的生存威脅；隨著海洋溫度上升，珊瑚與共生藻之間的關係會崩解，導致藻類被排出，這過程被稱為珊瑚白化，使珊瑚變白。過往的研究顯示，那些較依賴藻類提供營養的珊瑚，在熱事件中首先白化，而傾向攝食浮游生物的珊瑚在高溫下撐得更久而不白化。儘管營養策略與珊瑚白化之間的關聯已相當明確，但目前仍不清楚浮游生物豐富度是否以及如何影響珊瑚對白化的抵抗力。此外，對參與攝食行為的基因了解有限，至今尚無研究探討異營與溫度壓力交互作用的基因基礎。在這個項目中，我們將進行一個控制實驗，操控兩種珊瑚物種所經歷的浮游生物豐富度和熱壓力:一種是以自營為主、對白化高度敏感的珊瑚，另一種則是以異營為主，對白化具有抗性。實驗期間將在五個時間點採集樣本，用於穩定同位素分析以評估營養狀態，以及提取RNA以分析基因表現。本研究將有助於了解具有不同營養策略的珊瑚，如何對食物豐度與熱壓力的組合做出反應，並揭示異營珊瑚物種延遲白化的基因機制。這些結果將對預測珊瑚群落在未來氣候情境下的反應，以及辨識最具韌性的珊瑚物種與個體以應用於珊瑚礁保育與復育工作，產生關鍵性的影響。

13100725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13100725.value: 探討藍珊瑚（Heliopora coerulea）耐熱性的遺傳基礎：在溫暖海域茁壯的活化石珊瑚

13100725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13100725.value: Prof Chan , Benny Kwok Kan Dr Wang, Hao Dr Xu, Ting

13100725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13100725.value: Shallow-water coral reefs are biodiversity hotspots, covering less than 2% of the ocean floor yet supporting more than quarter of all marine life. However, these vital ecosystems face existential threats from climate change and anthropogenic impacts. Recent genomic research has opened new opportunities for understanding coral evolution, coral-algal symbiosis, and environmental resilience, but genome studies are lacking for many coral species. The blue coral, Heliopora coerulea, is a living fossil reef-building octocoral that historically thrived in warm waters worldwide during Cretaceous. Today, blue coral is recognized for its remarkable resilience to bleaching events, rapid growth, and current expansion in tropical and subtropical regions, making H. coerulea a promising candidate for coral reef restoration. However, the adaptive molecular mechanisms of H. coerulea to warm waters and its symbiotic partnerships with zooxanthellae remain poorly understood, hindering its effective use in conservation efforts. To address these knowledge gaps, we propose a comprehensive genomic analysis of H. coerulea and its interaction with algal symbionts. Leveraging our newly generated reference genome for H. coerulea, we will compare its genome with those of scleractinian corals exhibiting varying degrees of bleaching susceptibility to uncover the genetic basis of thermal adaptation. We will employ single-cell RNA sequencing to characterize different cell types, particularly those involved in hosting algae, and to identify symbiosis-related gene clusters involved in metabolic exchanges, nitrogen cycling, and immune regulation. Additionally, we will conduct laboratory thermal exposure experiments coupled with single-cell RNA analysis of both the coral host and its algal symbionts to elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying bleaching resilience in the H. coerulea holobiont. Overall, this study will address the knowledge gap regarding the thermal resilience of various coral taxa in conservation efforts, particularly focusing on their genetic adaptations to thermal stress. The findings will improve our ability to predict how coral reef ecosystems respond to rising ocean temperatures and will inform evidence-based strategies for conservation and restoration. 淺水珊瑚礁是生物多樣性的熱點，雖然其覆蓋面積不足海洋底部的2%，卻支撐了超過四分之一的海洋生物。然而，這些重要生態系統正面臨氣候變遷與人為活動的威脅。近期的基因體學研究為理解珊瑚演化、珊瑚-共生藻關係及環境適應開闢了新途徑，然而許多珊瑚物種仍缺乏完整的基因體資料。 藍珊瑚（Heliopora coerulea）是一種現存的活化石八放珊瑚，歷史上曾於白堊紀廣泛分布於全球暖水域。由於其對白化事件的耐受性、快速生長及在熱帶與亞熱帶的擴張，藍珊瑚被視為珊瑚礁修復的潛力物種。然而，對其適應暖水域的分子機制及與蟲黃藻的共生關係了解仍然不足，限制了其在保育中的應用。 為填補此知識缺口，我們提出針對藍珊瑚及其共生藻互動的全面基因體分析。利用新建立的藍珊瑚參考基因體，將與不同白化敏感性的石珊瑚進行比較，以揭示其耐熱性的遺傳基礎。我們將運用單細胞RNA定序技術，鑑定不同細胞類型（尤其是與藻類共生的宿主細胞），並解析涉及代謝交換、氮循環及免疫調控的相關基因群。此外，結合熱暴露實驗與單細胞RNA分析，將闡明藍珊瑚抵抗白化的分子機制。 本研究將填補珊瑚耐熱性在保育應用中的知識空白，特別聚焦於其對熱脅迫的遺傳適應。研究成果將提升我們預測珊瑚礁生態系統對海水升溫的反應能力，並為基於證據的保育與復育策略提供科學依據。

13200425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13200425.value: 基于层次化表示的高效可扩展点云压缩

13200425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13200425.value: Prof Cong, Runmin Prof Yuan, Hui

13200425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13200425.value: Point clouds are collections of 3D points representing the surfaces of objects or scenes in space. They offer a high level of detail, making them widely used in fields such as autonomous driving, virtual reality, online education, and cultural heritage preservation. However, point clouds face significant challenges due to their substantial data volume, inherent sparsity, and unstructured nature, which render their processing, storage, and transmission exceedingly inefficient. The unordered, unstructured, and unconnected characteristics of point clouds make it difficult to eliminate redundancies between points, resulting in significant data redundancy. Effective point cloud compression is crucial for removing these redundancies and plays a key role in point cloud processing systems, enabling the widespread application of this technology. A critical component of point cloud technology is scalability. Scalable point cloud coding allows the data to be represented in hierarchical layers, enabling the transmission of a basic, lower-resolution version of the point cloud when resources are limited. As more bandwidth or computational power becomes available, additional layers can be transmitted to enhance detail and accuracy. However, existing point cloud compression techniques fail to fully exploit scalable coding, lacking the ability to create layered representations that adapt to varying bitrates and quality requirements. These methods do not adhere to minimal description principles in representations, resulting in inefficient compression that cannot meet the demands of real-world applications. To address these challenges, we propose a novel scalable point cloud compression paradigm aimed at optimizing both compression efficiency and visual quality. Specifically, we propose a hierarchical representation that segments point clouds into a base layer and enhancement layers, tailored to hierarchically preserve key details while minimizing data size. Based on rate-distortion optimization, we introduce a scalable coding method that utilizes inter-layer predictions and conditional coding to reduce redundancies between layers, significantly improving compression performance. Additionally, to tackle the issue of visual quality degradation after compression, we propose an enhancement technique that leverages optimal transport theory to refine perceptual quality. In conclusion, our proposed framework offers a scalable and efficient solution for point cloud compression, capable of significantly reducing data size without sacrificing quality. In the long term, this research aims to contribute to the widespread adoption of point cloud technology by making it more feasible to use in bandwidth-limited and resource-constrained environments. 点云是由一组三维点组成的集合，用来表示空间中物体或场景的表面。点云具有高度的细节表现力，因此广泛应用于自动驾驶、虚拟现实、在线教育以及文化遗产保护等领域。然而，点云因数据量巨大、固有稀疏性以及非结构化特性，导致其处理、存储和传输效率极低，面临着显著的挑战。 点云的无序性、非结构化以及未连接的特性使得难以消除点之间的冗余，从而产生大量的数据冗余。有效的点云压缩对于消除这些冗余至关重要，并在点云处理系统中发挥关键作用，推动该技术的广泛应用。 点云技术的一个关键要素是可伸缩性。可伸缩点云编码能够以分层的方式表示数据，在资源有限的情况下传输基本的低分辨率版本点云。当带宽或计算能力增加时，可以传输更多的层级以提升细节与精度。然而，现有的点云压缩技术未能充分利用可伸缩编码，无法创建适应不同比特率和质量需求的分层表示。这些方法未遵循最小描述原则，使压缩效率低下，难以满足实际应用需求。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新的可伸缩点云压缩范式，旨在优化压缩效率与视觉质量。具体而言，我们提出了一种分层表示方法，将点云划分为基础层和增强层，以分层方式保留关键细节，同时最小化数据大小。基于率失真优化，我们引入了一种可伸缩编码方法，利用层间预测和条件编码来减少层之间的冗余，大幅提升压缩性能。 此外，为了解决压缩后视觉质量下降的问题，我们提出了一种基于最优传输理论的增强技术，用于优化压缩后点云的感知质量。

13300125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13300125.value: 图神经网络的数学建模与分析

13300125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13300125.value: Dr Li, Lingfeng Prof Tai, Xue-Cheng

13300125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13300125.value: Deep neural networks (DNN) have tremendous success in various fields, including computer vision, natural language processing, and scientific research and discovery. Numerous neural network architectures, such as UNet, ResNet, and Transformer, have been designed for different tasks. Their impact, especially from the large language models like ChatGPT, is seen across diverse sectors of our society. Despite their success, DNNs are often regarded as black-box models. Their decision-making processes are unclear, making understanding why and how they obtain their predictions difficult. This opacity heavily limits our understanding of their internal mechanism and generalization properties and can cause severe problems, especially in some high-stake applications, such as healthcare, autonomous systems, and finance, where trust, interpretability, and reliability are critical. In recent years, numerous studies have focused on providing a mathematical interpretation for DNNs by establishing connections between DNNs and some classical mathematical frameworks, including dynamical systems, control theory, and optimization algorithms. These efforts have brought valuable insights into the behavior of DNNs and provided new perspectives to explain them. Nevertheless, while these interpretations have improved our understanding of DNNs, they mainly focused on networks operating on structured grids, e.g., convolutional neural networks. In contrast, DNNs designed for unstructured data, particularly Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), remain to be explored from a mathematical perspective. GNNs can model and learn from unstructured graph data where entities can be of various forms or sizes, and the relationships among the entities can differ by many degrees. Given the increasing applications of GNNs in various fields, like social network analysis, recommendation systems, molecular biology, and drug discovery, the theoretical gap needs to be filled urgently. Our proposal aims to extend our previous success in the mathematical studies of DNN models and graph models to GNN models. We propose three research directions here. First, we will develop a new mathematical framework to connect some existing GNNs with graph operator splitting methods that can interpret the GNNs as the discretization of graph control problems. Next, based on this framework, we will develop new robust and interpretable GNN models using control problems from graph models and compare the new GNN models with state-of-the-art GNNs. Lastly, we will derive an analytical upper bound for the generalization error of our GNN models. The error reflects how well the model can generalize to new unseen data, and the bound can provide valuable insights into the behavior and limitations of the GNNs. 近年来，深度神经网络（Deep neural network）在计算机视觉、自然语言处理和科学研究探索等领域取得了许多突破性的进展。以UNet、ResNet和Transformer为代表的各种神经网络架构已被广泛应用于不同场景。这些模型的快速发展正深刻影响着社会各个领域，其中以大语言模型的影响最为广泛。 尽管神经网络模型取得了显著成功，这类模型普遍被视为"黑箱"模型。他们的推理过程并不透明，这使人们不能完全理解和解释神经网络是如何得出结果。这种现象不仅阻碍了对模型内部工作机制和泛化能力的深入理解，也在医疗健康、自动驾驶和金融安全等高风险领域埋下了潜在隐患。 为了揭示深度学习的数学本质，近年来研究者们尝试从动力系统、控制理论和优化算法等传统数学框架入手，为深度神经网络提供理论解释。这些工作给深度神经网络带来了有价值的理论洞见和新颖的理解角度。 然而，这些研究主要聚焦的是作用与结构化网格上的神经网络（如卷积神经网络）。面向非结构化数据设计的模型，特别是图神经网络（Graph neural network），仍然缺乏系统性的数学分析框架。图神经网络可适用于非结构化图数据的建模与学习，能够处理不同形态、规模的实体，并有效处理实体间复杂的联系。考虑到图神经网络在社交网络分析、推荐系统、分子结构预测和药物研发等诸多领域日益广泛的应用，建立其严格的理论基础显得尤为迫切。 本研究旨在将前期对深度神经网络和图模型研究的基础推广至图神经网络。我们将重点关注三个方向。首先，我们将构建新的数学框架，建立图神经网络与图算子分裂方法间的联系，将图神经网络解释成图控制问题的一种离散形式。其次，基于我们的数学框架，我们将设计具有鲁棒性强、可解释性高的新型图神经网络模型，并与现有最优模型进行全面对比分析。最后，我们还将从理论上分析模型泛化能力，对泛化误差推导出理论的上边界。泛化误差可以反应模型对于新数据的泛化能力，误差的上边界可以帮助我们更好地理解图神经网络的机制和其在应用中的限制。

13300525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13300525.value: 源于動態系統的共同動態數據的降維預測學習

13300525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13300525.value: Complex engineering systems with extensive measurements have produced abundant large-dimensional time series for data-driven analytics. However, conventional time series models and deep neural networks typically assume full-dimensional dynamics, resulting in over-parameterization and difficulty in interpretation. In this proposed project, a reduced dimensional predictor (RDP) framework will be developed for monitoring, interpretation, and prediction. This proposed project aims to i) develop probabilistic theory and solutions to the RDP framework for latent dynamics learning with parsimonious and sparse models of co-dynamic data and ii) explore latent neural dynamic models with latent long short-term memory (LSTM) and transformer models. Unlike the traditional full-dimensional predictors that focus solely on dynamics prediction, the reduced-dimensional predictor also requires dimension reduction for interpretation and optimal parameterization. It involves the simultaneously optimal estimation of the dimension-reducing matrix and the low-dimensional predictor of the dynamic latent variables. Moreover, given the prevalence of nonlinear dynamics in real-world problems, this project will investigate deep neural RDPs. Thus, the key research questions to be tackled in this project include 1. how to estimate the dimension-reducing matrix and the latent variables simultaneously and whether they can be uniquely estimated; 2. how to determine the effective dimension of the latent dynamics and the statistical distributions of the model estimates; 3. how to make a sparse estimate of the dimension-reducing matrix to strip off insignificant contributors and facilitate the interpretation of the latent variables; 4. how to embed predictive neural networks for the RDP to capture nonlinear latent dynamics in complex systems. The project will begin with a general latent state space (GLaSS) model, which will be subsequently extended to incorporate neural networks for modeling nonlinear latent dynamics. Algorithms will be developed to estimate the models and tested on real-world datasets. The specific tasks are as follows: 1. Developing an optimal RDP solution with latent state space modeling, including the maximum likelihood estimation of model parameters and the determination of hyperparameters; 2. Estimating the RDP model uncertainty; 3. Developing a sparse dimension-reducing matrix for interpretation and diagnosis; 4. Developing RDP solutions with LSTM and transformers; 5. Verifying the developed algorithms on two real-world applications: i) a Dow Chemical manufacturing process and ii) the Shenzhen Subway passenger flow prediction. With these tests, we will provide a level-ground evaluation of the traditional principle of parsimony and the over-parameterization success of deep neural models.

13500025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13500025.value: 考虑消费者战略搜索行为的在线市场最优定价决策和推荐策略

13500025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13500025.value: The rapid advancement of information technologies has motivated merchants to sell their products online, which leads consumers to incur significant search costs [25]. As Vulkan [49] estimated, consumers often spend around $5 for each online search. Thereby, consumers are unlikely to conduct a comprehensive search for all available alternatives. Instead, they could limit their searches to only a subset of alternatives. Ursu et al. [48] indicates that, at Amazon.com, consumers perform 11 product searches on average and around 40% of these consumers only browse less than five products for a single transaction. To attract consumers, many online marketplaces adopt personalized product recommendation systems that use intelligent analytics technologies to identify consumer preferences and then provide product links to target consumers. At Amazon.com, 35% of online sales result from its product recommendations [28]. In the search process, most consumers exhibit a non-chaotic search order that tends to align with the product sorting recommended by marketplaces, or they follow a sequential, top-to-bottom approach to browse listed products [22, 41, 47]. We will find optimal product recommendation and marketing strategies when consumer search behaviors exist. Online marketplaces with recommendation service usually adopt the cost-per-sale (CPS; used by, e.g., the Taobao Spreader and the Maixuan) or cost-per-click (CPC; used by, e.g., the Baidu Marketing and Shopping.com). We will accordingly investigate whether an online marketplace implements the CPS or CPC scheme. We will consider an online system involving a marketplace and multiple sellers who sell substitutable products to serve a number of consumers with heterogenous product search behaviors. We will analyze a fixed-sample search model for consumers and resulting game-theoretic models for the case of no product recommendation, and will use the Bayesian updating process and dynamic programming to investigate consumers’ search decisions and study corresponding game models when recommendation service is available. We will address five major questions. (i) What are consumers’ optimal search strategies and stopping rules in the presence of online product recommendations? (ii) How does an online marketplace choose between the CPS and CPC payment schemes for its recommendation service? (iii) What is the impact of the marketplace’s recommendation strategy on the sale prices? (iv) What are the impacts of product recommendations and consumer searches on the marketplace’s and sellers’ profits as well as consumer surpluses? (v) How does the precision of product recommendation affect consumers’ search decisions and sellers’ pricing strategies? 信息技术的快速发展促使商家将产品转移到线上销售，这导致消费者承担了巨大的搜索成本[25]。据Vulkan [49]估计，消费者每次在线搜索通常花费约5美元。因此，消费者不太可能全面搜索所有可用的替代方案。相反，他们可能会将搜索范围限制在一小部分替代方案上。Ursu等人[48]指出，在亚马逊网站上，消费者平均每天进行11次产品搜索，其中约40%的消费者在单笔交易中仅浏览不到5种产品 为了吸引消费者，许多在线平台采用个性化产品推荐系统，利用智能分析技术识别消费者偏好，并向目标消费者提供产品链接。在亚马逊 (Amazon.com)，35% 的在线销售额来自其产品推荐 [28]。在搜索过程中，大多数消费者的搜索顺序较为平和，倾向于与平台推荐的产品排序保持一致，或者遵循自上而下的顺序浏览列出的产品 [22, 41, 47]。当消费者的搜索行为存在时，我们就能找到最佳的产品推荐和营销策略。 提供推荐服务的电商平台通常采用按销售成本（CPS；例如淘宝推广和脉选）或按点击成本（CPC；例如百度推广和购物网）。因此，我们会调查电商平台是否采用CPS或CPC方案。 我们将考虑一个在线系统，该系统包含一个市场和多个销售可替代产品的卖家，为具有异质产品搜索行为的众多消费者提供服务。我们将分析一个固定样本的消费者搜索模型，并由此建立无产品推荐情况下的博弈论模型，并使用贝叶斯更新过程和动态规划来研究消费者的搜索决策，并在有推荐服务的情况下研究相应的博弈模型。 我们将探讨五个主要问题：（i）在存在在线产品推荐的情况下，消费者的最佳搜索策略和停止规则是什么？（ii）在线市场如何在CPS和CPC支付方案之间进行推荐服务选择？（iii）市场的推荐策略对销售价格有何影响？（iv）产品推荐和消费者搜索对市场和卖家的利润以及消费者剩余有何影响？（v）产品推荐的精确度如何影响消费者的搜索决策和卖家的定价策略？

13500925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13500925.value: 双积分政策对中国电动车产业的动态效应

13500925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13500925.value: Prof Chan, Tat Prof Chen, Yijun Prof Xiao, Ping

13500925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13500925.value: The Chinese government has put enormous efforts to speed up the new energy vehicle (NEV) sector development and reduce its overall carbon emissions since 2010. In September 2017, the government introduced the Dual Credit (DC) policy, aiming to replace the fossil fuel cars with NEVs. According to this policy, car manufacturers have credit targets on both fossil fuel cars and NEVs. The credits are tradable. This policy marked a shift from subsidy-based incentives to innovation-based or market-based incentives for NEV development. Under the DC policy, automakers who fail to adapt and meet the NEV production targets may be compelled to exit the market due to the increased cost of purchasing NEV credits or facing penalties. Consequently, the policy necessitates the transformation of traditional vehicle manufacturers and encourages NEV companies to upgrade, resulting in dynamic effects on the passenger vehicle industry. However, the impact of this policy varies among manufacturers of different products. Since NEVs tend to replace fuel-efficient vehicles more than inefficient ones, manufacturers of fuel-efficient vehicles have less motivation to produce NEVs as it would cannibalize their fuel-efficient vehicle sales. To examine the influence of the dual credit policy on vehicle development and achieving fuel efficiency in the Chinese automobile industry, we employ a dynamic structural model. Based on the estimates from the structural model, we investigate how the design of the dual credit policy would affect the development of electric vehicles, the industry structure, and the attainment of fuel efficiency goals in distinct ways. This project intends to answer the following questions:  How could this policy further promote the development of the NEV sector?  Compared with the sales subsidy, is the DC policy more cost-effective?  What are the short-run and long-run effects of this policy on market equilibrium, including the number, prices and sales of NEVs. In particular, this project will focus on the equilibrium mix of electric vehicles (EVs).  How will manufacturers strategically respond to this policy and make their decisions on introducing the NEVs?  How will manufacturers make their short-run pricing decisions.  How will manufacturers’ strategies differ in their heterogeneous experience in ICEV and EV production.  What are the equilibrium and welfare effects of these decisions? This project will contribute to the literature on estimating dynamic model of imperfect competition, providing empirical evidence on the impact of environmental regulation on market structure, innovation adoption and firm strategic behavior. 自2010年以来，中国政府投入巨大努力加速新能源汽车产业发展，降低整体碳排放。2017年9月推出的双积分政策，旨在以新能源汽车替代传统燃油车。该政策要求汽车制造商同时完成燃油车与新能源汽车的积分目标，且积分可进行交易。 这标志着新能源汽车发展激励政策从补贴驱动转向创新驱动与市场驱动。在双积分政策下，未能适应新能源汽车生产目标的传统车企，可能因购买积分成本激增或面临处罚被迫退出市场。该政策不仅倒逼传统车企转型，也激励新能源车企升级，对乘用车行业产生动态影响。然而政策效应因厂商产品类型存在差异：由于新能源汽车对高燃效燃油车的替代性强于低燃效车型，生产高燃效燃油车的企业缺乏转型动力——新能源车会挤占其现有优势产品市场。 为探究双积分政策对中国汽车产业技术发展与燃油效率目标的影响，本研究采用动态结构模型。基于模型估计结果，系统分析该政策如何差异化影响三大维度：电动汽车发展进程、产业结构调整及燃油效率目标达成。 本项目致力于解答以下问题： • 该政策如何进一步促进新能源汽车产业发展？ • 相比销售补贴，双积分政策是否更具成本效益？ • 政策对市场均衡（新能源汽车数量、价格、销量）的短期与长期影响？重点探究电动汽车（EV）的均衡结构 • 制造商将如何制定新能源汽车引入策略应对政策？ • 企业短期定价决策机制如何形成？ • 具备差异化燃油车（ICEV）与电动车（EV）生产经验的厂商策略有何不同？ • 上述决策将产生怎样的均衡效应与福利效应？ 本项目将通过构建不完全竞争动态模型，为环境规制对市场结构、创新采纳及企业战略行为的影响提供实证依据，填补相关研究空白。

13501125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501125.value: 保险公司的年末债券抛售：动机及影响

13501125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13501125.value: Prof Wu, Juan Julie Prof Zanjani, George

13501125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501125.value: We observe intriguing seasonal patterns in U.S. insurers’ bond trading, with selling being especially heavy in December. The industry aggregate bond sales in December account for as much as 24% of yearly gross sales, as a result of collective December selling by individual insurers. We investigate three motivations driving large year-end bond sales: regulatory window dressing, tax saving, and liquidity management. 1) Driven by the requirement of risk-based capital (RBC), insurers might reduce holdings of risky bonds before filing statutory reports at the year-end. Consistent with the conjecture, Hagenberg, Hodder, and Miller (2022) have shown that insurers’ portfolio risk is significantly higher within the year than at the endpoint of the year. We will evaluate whether the portfolio rebalancing strategy undermines insurers’ RBC compliance. With daily transaction data, we can derive the trajectories of insurers’ RBC ratios to examine whether they cross the statutory threshold, and whether experience significant reduction that would trigger regulatory intervention. 2) Year-end security sales are common to harvest tax losses. We can evaluate the amount of tax savings achieved by realizing capital losses or gains through the year-end trading. We will explore the tax motivation by testing the association between realized capital losses (or gains) in bonds and insurers’ other taxable income. In addition, since insurers are the largest institutional bond investors, we will estimate the price effects imposed by the heavy year-end disposal, conjecturing a turn-of-the-year or the January effect on bond price. 3) Within year-end disposals, we observe a non-trivial proportion are risk-free bonds, mostly, government or agency bonds. This leads to the conjecture that liquidating these highly liquid bonds to pay off borrowing from credit lines periodically at the year-end. With these points addressed, this project will reveal different motivations shaping insurers’ portfolio choices. It will provide policy implications to insurance regulators by evaluating insurers’ intraperiod portfolio risk, and to security regulators by evaluating the price effects of the large year-end bond disposal. It will also help practitioners devise better portfolio-balancing strategies. Academically, our study will add to the literature on insurance investment decisions that interact with regulatory and accounting rules. 我们观察到美国保险公司债券交易中存在有趣的季节性模式。 我们调查了大规模债券抛售的三个可能动机：应对监管的包装、节税和流动性管理。1）在风险资本（RBC）监管要求的推动下，保险公司可能会在年底提交法定报告之前减少风险债券的持有量。与这一猜想一致，Hagenberg、Hodder 和 Miller（2022）表明，保险公司的投资组合风险在年内明显高于年终。我们将评估保险公司的这种年末投资组合变动是否意味着了他们风险资本的合规性应受到质疑。从日度交易数据中，我们可以推导出保险公司风险资本比率的轨迹，以检查它们是否超过法定阈值，以及是否经历了会引发监管干预的显着下降。2）年终证券抛售是常见的减少税务的策略。我们可以计算保险公司通过抛售债券实现资本损失所节省的税务金额。我们将通过验证通过抛售债券实现的资本损失与保险公司的其他应税收入之间的关联来探索这种税收动机。3） 在年终抛售的债券中，我们观察到无风险债券占比不小，其中主要是政府或机构债券。对应的猜测是清算这些高流动性债券以在年底定期偿还信贷额度的借款。此外，由于保险公司是最大的机构债券投资者，我们将估计年末的抛售对相关债券价格的影响，我们推测这种抛售会对债券价格有一月效应。致力于解决这些要点，该项目将揭示影响保险公司投资组合选择的不同动机。它将通过评估保险公司的年度内投资组合风险为保险监管机构的政策制定提供思路，并通过评估年末债券抛售对其价格的影响向证券监管机构的政策提供思路。它还将有意义于保险从业者制定更好的资产组合平衡策略。在学术上，我们的研究将丰富保险投资决策与监管和会计规则相互影响的文献。

13501525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501525.value: 家長式教育與內在動機：中國中學強制性“晚自習”課程的長期影響

13501525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501525.value: Paternalist education restricts students’ choices and limits their autonomy. Economists, psychologists and education scholars point out that paternalist education can crowd out students’ intrinsic motivation. In policy debates, critics even attribute China’s lack of world-class scientists to its paternalist education system. However, causal evidence to support these arguments is scant, due to measurement difficulties and the potential endogeneity of paternalism in common parent–child and teacher–student relationships. We propose to take advantage of a policy widely adopted in China’s secondary schools, namely mandatory evening self-study (ESS) sessions, to study the effects of paternalist education. The policy requires students to attend evening school sessions to do homework or revision after normal school hours, under teachers’ supervision. The policy is paternalist in that it makes school hours extremely long, running from the morning to the evening, and so leaves students little free time and little leeway to decide when, where, and how to work. Universities in China do not have ESS policies. To inform the relevant policy debates, we will study the long-term effects of secondary-school ESS experience on Chinese university students’ self-confidence, intrinsic motivation, study behavior, and academic performance. Inspired by the literature, we hypothesize that, other things equal, university students who regularly attended mandatory ESS sessions in secondary school have lower self-confidence in independent study, have weaker intrinsic motivation, spend less time on their work, and underperform academically relative to those without ESS experience. We will use surveys, psychological scales, and administrative data to measure the outcome variables of interest. The advantage of using ESS to study paternalist education is that it is easy to measure and is a school policy, making it somewhat exogenous to individual students. Our econometric identification strategy includes a novel instrumental variable, the average time of sunset at the school’s location. Schools located in places with late sunset are more likely to adopt an ESS policy, and the sunset time is unlikely to influence our outcome variables through channels other than the policy. We will also use Conley, Hansen, and Rossi’s (2012) method to evaluate our IV's robustness. With this design, we aim to provide evidence on the long-term impacts of a paternalist education policy on the abovementioned important education outcomes. 家長式教育限制了學生的選擇並限制了他們的自主性。經濟學家、心理學家和教育學者指出，家長式教育會擠壓學生的內在動機。在政策辯論中，批評者甚至將中國缺乏世界級科學家歸因於其家長式的教育系統。然而，由於在常見的親子和師生關系中家長式教育的測量困難和潛在的內生性，支持這些論點的因果證據卻很少。 我們打算利用在中國的中學里廣泛采用的一項政策，即強制性的晚自習政策，來研究家長式教育的影響。該政策要求學生在正常上課時間後參加晚間學校課程，在教師的監督下做作業或溫習。該政策具有家長式的特點，因為它使得學生的在校時間極長，從早晨到晚上學生幾乎沒有自由時間，也幾乎沒有決定何時、何地以及如何工作的余地。 中國的大學沒有晚自習政策。為了為相關政策辯論提供依據，我們將研究中學期間的晚自習經歷對中國大學生自信心、內在動機、學習行為和學術表現的長期影響。受文獻啟發，我們假設在其他條件相同的情況下，曾常規性地參加中學強制性晚自習的大學生在獨立學習中的自信心較低，內在動機較弱，花在學習上的時間較少，學術表現不如那些沒有晚自習經歷的學生。我們將使用調查、心理量表和行政數據來測量我們感興趣的結果變量。 使用晚自習來研究家長式教育的優勢在於它易於測量，並且是一項學校政策，使其對個別學生來說是相對外生的。我們的計量經濟學識別策略包括一個新的工具變量，即學校所在地的年平均日落時間。位於日落時間較晚的地方的學校更有可能采用晚自習政策，而日落時間不太可能通過政策以外的渠道影響我們的結果變量。我們還將使用Conley、Hansen和Rossi（2012）的方法來評估我們的工具變量的穩健性。 通過這項設計，我們旨在為家長式教育政策對上述重要教育成果的長期影響提供經驗證據。

13501725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501725.value: 貿易政策的部門偏向與政治經濟學：分析中美貿易戰期間中國的報復性關稅

13501725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
