13501725.value: There exist many trade frictions between China and the United States, the two largest trading countries in the world. Since 2017, the US has raised tariffs on imports of many Chinese goods at very high levels and with very high value. In response, China retaliated and has also raised tariffs on many US products. While a growing amount of research has been trying to address the issues of the US-China trade wars, most of them focus on understanding the effects of US trade policy. Our research focuses on China’s trade policy response. How did China set its retaliatory tariffs? This question is important both academically and in practice. China’s average tariff increased from 8% to 18.3%, with its retaliation covering nearly two-thirds of its imports from the United States. Moreover, while China did not raise tariffs on all imports of US goods, for those on which China did raise tariffs, the increased tariff levels range from 10 to 40%. We ask the following two questions in this project. Question 1: In what industries did China raise its retaliatory tariffs during the US-China trade war and why? Question 2: Among the industries in which China raised tariffs, why did some receive higher tariffs (e.g., 40%) whereas some received lower tariffs (e.g., 10%)? Our project will address these questions both theoretically and empirically. We will examine these issues from two different angles. First, we focus on non-political factors that are different between industries, such as technology intensities, knowledge spillovers, economies of scale, unemployment, etc., to examine their influences on China’s retaliatory tariffs. Second, we take the political-economy approach to understand these questions. The recent US-China trade war offers a great and unique opportunity for us to conduct such an analysis, as the observed tariffs are unconstrained by international agreements. We conduct our research sequentially in four phases. Phase 1: Establish stylized facts about China’s retaliatory tariffs across industries. Phase 2. Develop a theoretical model to generate predictions about certain industrial-level determinants of optimal tariffs. Phase 3. Develop a theoretical model of the political economy of trade policy in China. Phase 4. Empirical analysis. 作為世界最大的兩大貿易國，中國和美國之間存在著許多貿易摩擦。自2017年以來，美國對許多中國進口商品加徵了高額關稅。作為回應，中國也採取了反制措施，對許多美國產品加徵了關稅。儘管越來越多的研究試圖探討中美貿易戰的問題，但其中大多數研究都著重於理解美國貿易政策的影響。我們的研究重點在於分析中國在反制措施上的貿易政策。 中國是如何設定報復性關稅的？這個問題在學術和實踐中都至關重要。中國的平均關稅從8%上升至18.3%，其報復性關稅涵蓋了從美國進口的近三分之二。此外，雖然中國並未對所有美國進口商品提高關稅，但對於那些中國確實提高關稅的商品，其關稅增幅在10%至40%之間。在本研究項目中，我們提出以下兩個問題。 問題1：在中美貿易戰期間，中國對哪些產業提高了報復性關稅？為什麼？ 問題2：在中國提高關稅的產業中，為什麼有些產業關稅較高（例如40%），而有些產業關稅較低（例如10%）？ 我們的課題將從理論和實證兩個角度探討這些問題。我們從兩個不同的角度來研究這些問題。首先，我們關注不同產業之間存在差異的非政治因素，例如技術密集度、知識溢出、規模經濟、失業率等，以檢視它們對中國報復性關稅的影響。其次，我們採用政治經濟學的方法來理解這些問題。最近的中美貿易戰為我們進行此類分析提供了一個絕佳且獨特的機會，因為觀察到的關稅不受國際協定的約束。 我們的研究將分四個階段進行。 第一階段：建立中國各產業報復性關稅的典型事實。 第二階段：建立一個理論模型，以預測某些產業層面的最適關稅決定因素。 第三階段：建立一個中國貿易政策政治經濟學的理論模型。 第四階段：實證分析。

13502225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502225.value: 公共物品供给中惩罚机制的自我治理

13502225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502225.value: Prof Lien, Jaimie W. Prof Pang, Yu Prof Zhang, Dong Prof Zheng, Jie

13502225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502225.value: A substantial body of experimental research highlights the importance of penalizing free riders to sustain cooperation. However, subsequent experiments allowing for counter-punishment reveal that most free riders retaliate against their punishers, discouraging altruistic punishment and reducing the penalties for free riders over time. Some experimental economists, such as Nikiforakis (2008), argue that these findings cast doubt on Elinor Ostrom’s Nobel Prize-winning work on self-governance in common resource management. This project explores the ongoing debate on the effectiveness of self-governance by investigating a “collective punishment” mechanism, inspired by Ostrom (1990), to enhance cooperation through both theoretical and empirical approaches. Our theoretical analysis develops a model where members of a community or group contribute their resources to a public good, guided by two social norms. Initially, the norm of contributing to the public good incentivizes higher contributions. Subsequently, the norm of penalizing those who stray from cooperation leads some individuals to embrace the role of “altruistic punishers.” We aim to investigate how collective punishment can engender a greater number of “altruistic punishers,” especially in the face of potential counter-punishment from non-cooperating members. Our objective is to scrutinize the principles underpinning “collective punishment” within the self-governance of a group or community, focusing on the hierarchical relationship between these two social norms. Subsequently, we will analyze the subgame perfect equilibrium of this mechanism design. Regarding the empirical aspect, we plan to conduct laboratory experiments to test our theoretical conjectures. Participants will be randomly assigned to one of four treatments: (1) a control treatment featuring a standard public goods game, (2) an individual punishment treatment, (3) a collective punishment treatment without communication, and (4) a collective punishment treatment with communication. It is crucial to emphasize that in “collective punishment,” the act of punishment is individually chosen and voluntarily executed, serving as a mechanism of self-governance. In this framework, the absence of an external authority to enforce penalties highlights the importance of credibility in determining the suggested donation amounts and levels of punishment in the mechanism design. Based on our theoretical analysis, we hypothesize that Group (4) will exhibit the highest level of cooperation. Also, we will investigate whether participants in Groups (3) and (4) can select donation and punishment amounts that are credible for individual implementation, as predicted by our theoretical analysis. 大量实验研究强调，惩罚“搭便车者”（free riders）对于维持合作至关重要。然而，后续允许“反惩罚”（counter-punishment）的实验表明，大多数搭便车者会对惩罚他们的人进行报复，从而抑制了利他性惩罚行为，并随着时间推移降低了对搭便车者的惩罚力度。一些实验经济学家，例如Nikiforakis（2008），认为这些发现对埃莉诺·奥斯特罗姆（Elinor Ostrom）关于共有资源管理中自我治理的诺贝尔奖获奖理论提出了质疑。本研究项目通过理论与实证方法，探讨“集体惩罚”（collective punishment）机制，旨在提升合作水平，并回应关于自我治理有效性的持续争论。该机制的灵感源自Ostrom（1990）的研究。 在理论分析中，我们构建了一个模型，社区或群体成员根据两种社会规范向公共物品贡献资源。首先，促进公共物品贡献的规范激励了更高的贡献行为。随后，惩罚不合作行为的规范促使部分个体成为“利他性惩罚者”。我们希望探讨，在面对非合作者可能的反惩罚行为时，集体惩罚机制如何促使更多人成为“利他性惩罚者”。我们的目标是深入研究集体或社区自我治理中“集体惩罚”机制的基本原则，重点分析这两种社会规范之间的层级关系。进一步地，我们将分析该机制设计的子博弈精炼均衡（subgame perfect equilibrium）。 在实证方面，我们计划开展实验室实验以验证我们的理论假设。参与者将被随机分配到以下四种处理之一：（1）标准公共物品博弈的对照组；（2）个体惩罚处理组；（3）无沟通的集体惩罚处理组；（4）有沟通的集体惩罚处理组。 需要特别强调的是，在“集体惩罚”机制中，惩罚行为是由个体自主选择并自愿执行的，是一种自我治理机制。在该框架中，缺乏外部权威强制执行惩罚，凸显了机制设计中捐赠建议金额和惩罚水平的可信度问题。根据我们的理论分析，我们假设第（4）组将展现出最高水平的合作。此外，我们还将研究第（3）组和第（4）组的参与者是否能够选择出在个体层面具有可执行性的、理论上预测的捐赠与惩罚金额。

13502725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502725.value: 是敌是友？探究人工智能对员工的双重影响模型

13502725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502725.value: Artificial intelligence (AI), riding on the power of machine learning, has evolved to perform high-level cognitive tasks and generated significant revenue for various firms. In response, organizations are investing substantial resources to leverage AI-enabled technologies to enhance employee productivity and creativity. However, the impact of AI implementation on employees presents a complex picture. While AI promises benefits, recent studies reveal that AI usage can also induce counterproductive behaviors and reduce job performance. These conflicting findings highlight a crucial challenge: the effects of AI usage on employees are inconsistent and not fully understood. Without clear insights into these inconsistencies, organizations risk incurring substantial costs without achieving the desired improvements and may face unintended negative consequences. Therefore, it is imperative to investigate and reconcile these divergent findings. To uncover the underlying factors contributing to AI’s inconsistent impacts on employees, we draw on theories of technology to propose that AI implementation can yield contrasting experiences of AI as both an augmentor (e.g., streamlining the workflow, providing access to information, facilitating data-driven decision-making) and a stressor (e.g., overload, complexity, uncertainty, and insecurity). These competing experiences of AI provoke different work-related affective (e.g., work anxiety), cognitive (e.g., knowledge gain), and motivational (e.g., work self-efficacy) responses, further leading to varied outcomes including trust in AI and performance. On one hand, experiencing AI as an augmentor contributes to these positive mechanisms that enhance outcomes. On the other hand, experiencing AI as a stressor undermines these factors, negatively affecting outcomes. Our preliminary study supports that AI has dual facets (as an augmentor and a stressor) and affects outcomes oppositely. We plan two future studies to test our hypotheses. Study 1 involves a meta-analytic review to comprehensively understand AI’s dual facets and impacts on various outcomes. Our initial search has identified 88 relevant studies (45 quantitative), indicating ample studies to synthesize. Study 2 builds on Study 1 by empirically testing the dual impact model in an organizational setting. We will develop comprehensive measurement scales for experiencing AI as an augmentor and as a stressor, which are not established in existing literature. Using these scales, we will test the hypothesized model and explore moderators that may strengthen the positive impact while weakening the negative impact of AI. Our findings can contribute to understanding the inconsistent findings regarding the impact of AI at work. 依托机器学习技术的飞速发展，人工智能（AI）已能够执行高阶认知任务，并为诸多企业创造了可观的收益。为此，组织正投入大量成本，期待利用 AI技术提升员工生产力和创造力。然而，近期研究却发现使用AI对员工的影响并不总尽如人意：尽管使用AI具有诸多潜在优势，AI的使用也可能降低工作绩效并带来反生产行为。这些相互矛盾的研究发现指出我们现有研究对AI的使用如何影响员工尚未充分。若没有系统性地探究和理解这些分歧，组织不仅难以实现预期效益，还可能付出高昂代价，甚至产生意想不到的负面后果。本课题正旨在揭示AI的使用对员工影响不一致的深层因素。基于技术理论，我们提出AI实施会带来两种截然不同的体验。一方面，AI既可作为“赋能者”，例如：简化工作流程、提供信息、促进数据驱动决策；另一方面，AI也可能被视为“应激源”，例如：工作过载、技术复杂性、不确定性和不安全感。对 AI 的这两种不同的体验将激发员工在情感（如工作焦虑）、认知（如知识获取）和动机（如工作自我效能感）维度的不同反应，进而引发员工对 AI 信任度和工作绩效等相反的结果：一方面，将 AI作为赋能者有助于激活这些积极机制并提升绩效；另一方面，AI作为应激源会削弱上述机制，进而对员工行为和结果产生负面影响。我们的初步研究发现，AI 确实具备双重属性（赋能与应激），并分别以相反方向影响员工结果。为此，我们计划开展两项后续研究以检验相关假设。研究 1 将通过元分析系统梳理 AI 的双重属性及其对各类员工结果的影响。研究2将在组织环境中实证检验我们提出的AI双重影响模型。通过上述两项研究，我们期待能够厘清现有研究对AI 在工作场所影响的对立结果，为组织在推进 AI 应用时提供更具指导意义的理论与实践建议。

13503525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13503525.value: 需求侧政策与医药创新：来自药品集中带量采购的证据

13503525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13503525.value: Innovation is a pivotal driver of long-term economic growth and a critical factor in improving human well-being. Identifying factors that promote or hinder innovation is of significant practical importance and a central focus of economic research. While existing studies have largely concentrated on supply-side determinants, this project aims to investigate the effect of a demand-side policy on innovation. The project focuses on two unique aspects. First, it examines the pharmaceutical industry, where the value of innovation is exceptionally high, yet the process is notably risky, costly, and time-consuming. Second, the policy in question is a centrally planned, government-intervened demand-side initiative, providing a contrast to market-driven approaches. Consequently, this study is expected to offer policy insights pertinent to pharmaceutical innovation, which is vital for public health and welfare, and contribute to the broader debate on the efficacy of market versus command economies in fostering innovation. The policy we will examine is the Centralized Drug Procurement (CDP) rule implemented by the Chinese government since 2018. This rule consolidates hospital drug demand at the national level and reallocates it to a few pharmaceutical companies selected through a centralized sealed bidding process. Winning firms are awarded contracts to supply drugs to hospitals in specific regions for a fixed period, with set prices and quantities. By comparing firms that narrowly win or lose these bids, we will isolate the effect of reshuffled demand on innovation. Using granular patent data at the medicine-firm-year level, we aim to address the following questions: (1) What is the direct impact of the CDP policy on the intensity, quality, and collaborative networks of innovation for medicines selected through the bidding process? (2) Does the policy generate spillover effects on other drugs produced by the winning firms, and if so, do these effects enhance or crowd out other innovations, and change their collaborative networks? We will specifically differentiate drug patents by categories – new molecular entities, formulations, methods, and therapies – to detect nuanced changes in innovation and assess whether the policy fosters radical innovation. Additionally, we will explore the impact of CDP on overall R&D investment and identify potential channels driving these changes. As the CDP is implemented in phases, we will assess the policy's effects using a continuous, weighted measure based on varying drug selections and secured orders. We will also exploit instances where the CDP ends for specific firms as reverse shocks to further validate our findings. 创新是推动长期经济增长的核心动力，也是提升人类福祉的关键因素。识别促进或抑制创新的影响因素具有重要的现实意义，也是经济学研究的重要议题。现有文献多集中于供给侧因素，而本项目旨在研究一项需求侧政策对创新的影响。 本研究聚焦于两个独特维度：首先，以医药行业为研究对象，该领域创新价值极高，但创新过程风险突出、成本高昂且周期漫长；其次，所研究的政策为中央政府主导、通过政府干预实施的需求侧举措，与市场驱动型机制形成对比。因此，本研究有望为关乎公共卫生与福利的医药创新提供政策启示，并为市场与计划两种经济模式在促进创新方面的效能之争提供新的实证依据。 我们将重点分析中国政府自2018年起实施的“药品集中带量采购”政策。该政策通过国家层面整合医疗机构药品需求，采用集中密封招标方式遴选中选企业，将其药品重新分配至特定区域医院，并在约定周期内以确定的价格和数量供应。通过比较以微小差距中标或落标的企业，我们将识别需求再配置对创新的净影响。 利用药品—企业—年份层面的微观专利数据，本研究拟回答以下问题：（1）带量采购政策对中选药品的创新强度、质量及合作网络有何直接效应？（2）该政策是否对中标企业其他药品产生溢出效应？若有，这类效应会促进还是挤出其他创新，并如何改变其合作网络？我们将按药品专利类别——新分子实体、制剂、生产方法与治疗方案——进行细分，以识别创新的结构性变化，并评估政策是否推动根本性创新。此外，我们还将考察带量采购对企业研发总投入的影响，并挖掘其背后的作用机制。 由于带量采购政策分批次实施，我们将基于不同批次的药品遴选与订单份额构建连续型加权政策指标，进而评估其效应。同时，我们将利用政策对某些企业阶段性结束的实例作为反向冲击，进一步验证研究结论的稳健性。

13504225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13504225.value: 解锁潛能：在借助AI的培训中考虑受训者的神经多样性和主动性人格

13504225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13504225.value: Prof Crant, J. Michael Dr Meng, Jie

13504225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13504225.value: Organizations invest heavily in employee training, linking it to improved performance, motivation, and reduced turnover. However, ineffective training can cost organizations about $13.5 million per 1,000 employees(https://teamstage.io/training-statistics/). This underscores the need for actionable strategies to enhance training programs. We merge two cutting-edge topics to address this vital issue: artificial intelligence (AI) and neurodivergent employees. AI is sufficiently advanced to allow companies to use computer-generated entities to provide training programmes. An example is anthropomorphic presentation in training, involving using non-human entities with human-like qualities to convey information. The extent to which trainees benefit from anthropomorphic presentation in AI-based training relates to their training outcomes. Neurodivergence describes people whose brains work differently than neurotypical populations; examples are autism and ADHD. Do neurodivergent individuals respond to anthropomorphic presentations in training differently from neurotypical populations? We propose a complex multi-phase and multi-method research project that includes qualitative study of interview to understand challenged faced by neurodivergent learners, lab and online experimental work using eye-tracking technology to identify and classify neurodivergent learners and experimental and survey studies in a naturally occurring training setting, using anthropomorphic presentation. Our goal is to create an adaptive learning framework that incorporates structured content and allows trainees to identify their neurodivergent traits based on behavioral data. This research is groundbreaking as it aims to explore how AI training tools can cater to neurodivergent learners' distinct preferences. With approximately 15% of the population identified as neurodivergent, developing inclusive training modules is essential for effective learning outcomes. We draw on theories of parasocial interaction, which describe one-sided relationships, such as a social media user’s admiration for a celebrity, to formulate hypotheses about the dynamics between AI training, neurodiversity, and anthropomorphism. We suggest that anthropomorphic presentations in AI training can enhance engagement and well-being by fostering parasocial interactions. However, we posit that neurodiversity may moderate this relationship, potentially diminishing the effects of anthropomorphic presentation on engagement. Additionally, we introduce proactive personality as a trait-based moderator, given its action-oriented focus. The ultimate goal of this research is to enhance understanding of AI-based training for neurodiverse employees while emphasizing the role of anthropomorphism and proactivity. As the first study of its kind, we expect our findings to yield valuable insights and recommendations for policymakers looking to improve training effectiveness for diverse employee populations. By addressing the needs of neurodivergent learners, we aim to unlock their potential and create more inclusive workplaces.

13504725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13504725.value: 線上訂購店內取貨服務中的顧客隱私、位置信息與優先級設計

13504725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13504725.value: In the digital era, advances in mobile Internet technology have dramatically transformed service delivery. For instance, in quick-service restaurants, customers who previously had to travel to a restaurant, join a physical queue, and place an order can now place an order via mobile phones before traveling to the restaurant. The rationale is that customers can virtually join the processing queue earlier, making their orders closer to completion or even ready for pickup upon their arrival at the restaurant. Many mobile apps now enable service providers to collect customer personal data and use it to enhance their operations. For example, Starbucks and Dunkin’ Donuts use mobile devices’ GPS to collect customers’ location information and enable the order-ahead feature in their apps. This raises several important research questions. First, how should service providers utilize customers’ location information to enhance their operations? Since service requests originate from different locations, customers’ travel times to the store vary. Therefore, location information can help service providers prioritize order processing. Second, should customers share their private location information with service providers? While customers gain control over their location data, sharing this data with service providers could negatively impact them because their interests may not fully align with those of the service providers. Finally, how should policymakers regulate such location-sharing behavior on mobile apps? Policymakers need to consider the overall impact of location sharing on both customers and service providers. To address these research questions, we propose a game-theoretic queueing model in which a service provider serves customers originating from different locations and prioritizes them based on whether they share their location information and, if so, the exact location. We plan to investigate the optimal priority design for the service provider and the effects of location information sharing on customer welfare and the service provider's operations. Furthermore, this research aims to examine the role of policymakers in promoting social welfare through data protection regulations. This study contributes to the literature by investigating how customers’ private location information can be used to enhance service providers’ operations and the impact of location information sharing on customers and society in the context of online order and in-store pick-up services. 在數位時代，移動互聯網技術的進步極大地改變了服務的提供方式。例如，在速食餐廳中，以前需要親自前往餐廳、排隊並下單的顧客，現在可以通過手機在前往餐廳之前下單。其原理是顧客可以提前虛擬地加入處理隊列，使得他們的訂單在到達餐廳時已接近完成甚至準備好取餐。許多移動應用程式現在使服務提供者能夠收集顧客的個人數據並用於提升其運營。例如，星巴克和Dunkin’ Donuts使用手機的GPS功能來收集顧客的位置資訊，並在他們的應用程式中啟用提前下單的功能。這引發了幾個重要的研究問題。首先，服務提供商應如何利用顧客的位置資訊來提升運營？由於服務請求來自不同的位置，顧客到店的時間各不相同。因此，位置資訊可以幫助服務提供商優先處理訂單。其次，顧客是否應該與服務提供商分享他們的私人位置信息？雖然顧客對其位置信息擁有控制權，但與服務提供商分享這些數據可能對他們產生負面影響，因為他們的利益可能與服務提供商不完全一致。最後，政策制定者應如何規範這種在移動應用程式上的位置共享行為？政策制定者需要考慮位置共享對顧客和服務提供商的整體影響。 為了解決這些研究問題，我們提出了一個博弈論排隊模型，該模型中服務提供商為來自不同位置的顧客提供服務，並根據他們是否共享位置信息以及具體位置來優先處理。我們計畫研究服務提供商的最優優先級設計，以及位置資訊共享對顧客福利和服務提供商運營的影響。此外，本研究旨在探討政策制定者在通過數據保護法規促進社會福利方面的作用。這項研究通過調查顧客的私人位置信息如何用於提升服務提供商的運營，以及在在線訂單和店內取餐服務背景下，位置信息共享對顧客和社會的影響，為文獻做出了貢獻。

13600025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13600025.value: 後社會主義與資本主義社會的「傳統再造」：1949年以來中國大陸與香港粵劇制度的比較研究

13600025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13600025.value: Prof Chan, Sau Yan Mr Hong, Hai Prof Lane, Christel

13600025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13600025.value: Socio-cognitive categorization is crucial to institutional change and maintenance as it determines how and what institutional arrangements and organizational practices are deemed authentic and thus worth adopting by field members. The conceptualization and reconceptualization of authentic practices and products entail continual contestation in artistic legitimation – a process whereby the new and/or unaccepted cultural forms are rendered valid and accepted. Past studies offer important insights into this process but their accounts underplay the dynamic roles of the state in spawning ideas on which social groups would draw to compete for legitimacy. Also, most studies depict artistic legitimation as the intended outcome of the change agents’ efforts, and give insufficient attention to the impact of broader social change on actors’ interactions that may lead to diverse pathways for artistic legitimation. This points to a theoretical issue that remains understudied: How do the broader social change and its impact on actors’ interactions lead to divergent paths to artistic legitimation? To fill this lacuna, this study will compare the artistic legitimation of Cantonese opera in Hong Kong and mainland China since 1949. The field of Cantonese opera in these societies is beset with similar tensions that arise from competing interpretations of their traditions but elicit different patterns of socio-cognitive (re)categorization. We build on our previous GRF project (Ref.17602521) about the Hong Kong Cantonese opera sector and add on a novel comparative perspective on the social and cultural foundations of artistic legitimation. We examine why the Hong Kong incumbents promote a traditional form of Cantonese opera performance but their challengers espouse nouvelle performance. Conversely, the incumbents in mainland China support nouvelle Cantonese opera whereas their challengers advocate traditional performance. Answers to these questions will inform our understanding of the politics and social construction of cultural categorization, in particular how the fields evolve along with the 'cultural repertoires' that the key players assembled and deployed. This project develops an analytical framework based on insights from institutional theory and cultural sociology. It will compile an event-history database on the development of Cantonese opera in mainland China and Hong Kong between 1949 and 2025, and conduct about 70 in-depth interviews with practitioners, government officials, art critics, and representatives of Cantonese opera troupes and schools in the two fields in order to explicate the divergent patterns of professional identities construction and transformation, and the differing process of artistic legitimation in a comparative perspective. 「社會認知的分類」影響場域持份者如何制定和修改制度，文化產物和行為的價值也受社會和文化制度的影響。當制度被衝擊，文化產物和行為的認受性也受到爭議。過往的研究對制度的轉變過程提供了重要見解，但低估了政府和政權對場域持份者在理解和建構制度方面的影響。此外，大多數研究視制度為場域掌權者成功取得認受性的結果，主要聚焦於他們的掌權之道，卻未有仔細分析社會因素如何影響持份者在爭奪認受性時的互動及評核文化產物和行為的價值。 因此，本研究延續早前有關文化認受性的研究系列（《跨行業「制度再生」的比較研究：香港中醫與粵劇自1990年代的發展和比較》，優配研究金編號：17602521），採用文化社會學和制度研究方法，以香港和中國大陸的粵劇發展為案例，彙編由1949年至2025年兩地粵劇發展的重大事件資料庫，並訪問約70位粵劇從業員、政府官員、藝評人、學者及粵劇團和粵劇學校的代表，分析及比較社會因素及政府和政權如何影響場域持份者建構專業身份，爭取認受性，並制定發展傳統文化事業的策略。

13600325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13600325.value: 文化动态与人口可持续性：来自香港世界价值观调查的洞见

13600325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13600325.value: Dr Cheng, Wai Edmund Prof Kunst, Jonas Prof OLIVOS RAVE, Francisco Javier Prof Skirbekk, Vegard

13600325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13600325.value: Developed societies worldwide face an unprecedented demographic crisis, threatening their social and economic foundations. This project explores the relationship between culture and demographic sustainability in one such location, Hong Kong. Hong Kong’s demographic sustainability encompasses (1) fertility attitudes and behavior, (2) emigration, and (3) the ability to integrate migrants from Mainland China. In the face of declining birth rates, population aging, and emigration pressures, understanding how cultural factors shape these key demographic outcomes is critical for Hong Kong's long-term sustainability and position as a global city. Employing a multidisciplinary approach, this research aims to identify the cultural factors associated with fertility decisions, migration intentions, and integration processes. To investigate these problems, the study will conduct the World Values Survey (WVS) Wave 8, a probability-sample survey representing Hong Kong’s adult population (n=1,200), enabling reliable, generalizable conclusions for the entire society. Consisting of 300 master questions, the WVS is the world’s largest cross-national survey of values, attitudes, norms, and behaviors; it has been conducted repeatedly in over 120 countries/regions since 1981 and in Hong Kong since 2005. We will supplement the master questionnaire with approximately 30 local items and survey experiments covering fertility, migration intentions, and acculturation strategies of migrants and locals. Adding these tailored items allows making a significant advancement by bridging two extensive fields of research—culture and demography—that have often been studied in isolation. This integration will enable us to explore how cultural factors, such as individualism and flexibility, influence demographic outcomes. The study’s novelty lies in the development and inclusion of theoretically informed demography-related survey questions which, in combination with the core WVS questionnaire, offer a unique opportunity to investigate the relationship between culture and population dynamics. When linked to the remaining WVS datasets, our Hong Kong data will allow researchers to conduct cross-national and longitudinal comparisons adopting a global perspective. This comprehensive dataset will become a valuable public resource, available to local and international scholars, policymakers, educators, and general public. As part of the WVS, one of the most respected and widely used international datasets, this project will elucidate Hong Kong’s cultural dynamics in a global context, placing it on the cultural map alongside over 120 other societies. The findings will provide insights for policymakers and stakeholders to develop culturally informed strategies to enhance demographic sustainability in Hong Kong and similar developed societies. 在全球范围内，发达社会正临前所未有的人口危机，威胁着其社会与经济的根基。本项目旨在探讨文化与人口可持续性之间的关系，研究地点为香港。香港的人口可持续性主要体现在三个方面：（1）生育态度与行为，（2）移民外流，以及（3）融合来自中国大陆的移民的能力。在出生率下降、人口老龄化和移民压力的背景下，理解文化因素如何塑造这些关键的人口结果，对于香港的长期可持续发展及其全球城市地位至关重要。 本研究采用跨学科方法，旨在识别影响生育决策、迁移意图及融合过程的文化因素。为探讨这些问题，本研究将使用世界价值观调查（World Values Survey, WVS）第八波次调查的数据。WVS是一项覆盖香港成年人口的概率抽样调查（n=1,200），样本可靠且对整个香港社会具有代表性。WVS 由 300 道核心题目构成，是全球规模最大的跨国价值观、态度、规范与行为调查；自1981年以来已在120多个国家/地区反复开展，并自2005年起在香港实施。我们将在核心问卷的基础上，增加约30道本地化题目和调查实验，涉及生育、迁移意图以及移民与本地人的文化适应策略。通过增补这些针对性的题目，本研究将整合文化与人口学这两个常被割裂研究的领域。这种整合将使我们能够探讨文化因素（如个人主义与文化适应性）如何影响人口学结果。本研究的创新之处在于发展并纳入具有理论指导的人口学相关问卷题目，并与 WVS 核心问卷相结合，从而提供独特的机会去考察文化与人口动态之间的关系。结合其余的 WVS 数据集，我们的香港数据将允许研究人员在全球视角下开展跨国和纵向比较。 这一综合性数据集将成为宝贵的公共资源，供本地与国际学者、政策制定者、教育者及公众使用。作为 WVS（最受尊重且应用最广泛的国际数据集之一）的一部分，本项目将揭示香港在全球语境中的文化动态，并将其置于与120多个社会并列的文化地图之上。本研究成果将为政策制定者和其他相关机构提供启示，以制定符合文化特点的策略，从而提升香港及类似发达社会的人口可持续性。

13602925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13602925.value: Is there any value to having a diversity of animal species, or is it better to increase the population of whichever species has the highest welfare? Is there anything bad about species going extinct, and would it be good to create new species? If humans live the best lives, is there any reason to have animals at all? Is it ok to create sentient digital beings who want to serve us? These are some of the questions, at the intersection of population ethics, animal ethics, and AI ethics, which my research will answer. Population axiology is the study of the conditions under which one state of affairs is more valuable than another, when they differ in the number of people who will ever live, their identities and their welfare levels (Greaves, 2017). It aims to tell us how good things are. Population ethics more generally is the study of the moral issues which arise when our actions affect which individuals are born, how many, and what their welfare levels are. It aims to tell us what we should do, when our actions affect who will exist. Giving the right account of population ethics/axiology is vital for understanding the ethics of procreation/causing individuals to exist, understanding the value of the long-term future, and determining what, if anything, we owe to future beings. Despite its importance, population ethics faces very difficult theoretical challenges. One underexplored area is the application of population ethics to animal and AI ethics. Human actions affect animal populations, both wild and domesticated, on a massive scale. These acts affect both welfare levels and biodiversity. We may soon also have the capacity to create vast numbers of sentient digital beings, designed to do our bidding. Without an adequate account of nonhuman population ethics, it is difficult to assess the morality of such acts. We cannot simply apply standard positions in population axiology to nonhumans because the results of doing so are very counterintuitive. For example, Totalism (the theory that one population is better than another if and only if it has higher total welfare) suggests that the best population may be one composed of very large numbers of simple animals, sacrificing biodiversity if this maximizes welfare (O’Brien, forthcoming). In this project I will diagnose how standard theories fail to accommodate nonhumans and propose an account that can guide us in our actions which cause nonhumans to exist. 人口倫理學與非人類 摘要 動物物種愈多樣愈好，還是集中增加福祉潛力最高的物種數量更為理想？物種滅絕本身一定是壞事？創造新型物種又值不值得推崇？如果人類已經是福祉潛力最高的動物，保留其他動物的理據為何？創造具備情識，且真誠願意服務人類的數位生命，在道德上可接受嗎？我的研究聚焦於這些關於人口倫理學、動物倫理學及人工智能倫理學的問題。 所謂「人口價值論」旨在研究「世界情狀（state of affairs）」價值高低的衡量準則，尤其是人口數目、個體同一性，以及福利水平皆不盡相同的情況下（Greaves, 2017）。至於廣義的「人口倫理學」則處理道德問題：當影響到個體的出現與否、數目多寡，以及他們的福祉水平，甚麼行為才合符道德。事實上，生育倫理、長遠未來的價值，以及我們對未來個體的道德責任等議題，皆與人口價值論和人口倫理學息息相關。儘管如此，這領域仍面對諸多理論難題。 其中一個鮮為關注的問題，就是如何將人口倫理學應用於動物及人工智能的倫理議題。人類行為經常大規模地影響其他動物（不論野生或馴化）的數量、福祉水平，和生物多樣性。更甚者，我們可能很快便有能力大批製造有情識，且心甘情願服從命令的數位個體。假如缺乏一套適用於非人類情境的人口倫理理論，則難以評估上述行為是否道德。然而，隨便套用現有人口價值論亦可能引致嚴重違反直覺的結論。例如，若套用「總和主義（Totalism）」，以福祉總量來衡量價值高低，便可能意味著，只要能最大化福祉，即使犧牲生物多樣性，單純由簡單動物所組成的極龐大人口仍然具最高價值（O’Brien, 2024）。本研究旨在探討現有理論何以未能顧及非人類，並嘗試提出一套理論來評價創造非人類的行為。

13603125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13603125.value: 汉代政治文化话语中重译的隐喻意义

13603125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13603125.value: The frequent use of the verb chongyi 重譯 (to interpret in relay) in Chinese texts relating to Han China’s (202 BCE-220 CE) foreign contacts has intrigued interpreting historians and Sinologists over the past decade. While chongyi literally means “re-translation” in modern times, in early imperial China, it referred to the use of multiple interpreters to bridge communication gaps when no single interpreter was conversant in both languages involved. During the Han dynasty, this literal meaning was overshadowed by a new figurative significance in historical records, political commentaries, and literary writings. These texts reveal that chongyi symbolized Sinitic governing strength, cultural supremacy, peace, institutional advancement, and prosperity—all of which purportedly motivated non-Sinitic counterparts to visit and forge ties. The overt, and sometimes disproportionate, emphasis on chongyi contrasts sharply with the Western context, where interpreters' invisibility was historically common. Despite its prominence in early China, chongyi has only been mildly mentioned and superficially explained in scholarly discourse. This project aims to fill these gaps. I argue that the concept of chongyi was consciously utilized during the Han dynasty as a tool to channel and reinforce beliefs in the imperial heavenly mandate to rule and Sinitic superiority in both governance and culture. Furthermore, I contend that chongyi was repeatedly employed over centuries to underscore the asymmetric disparities between Sinitic centrality and the non-Sinitic periphery. Through textual analysis of 91 texts from Han standard histories, folklore, and political commentaries featuring the term chongyi, this project addresses four key questions: 1) Why was a translation concept consistently chosen to trumpet Sinitic centrality in writings for centuries? 2) How was the concept of chongyi integrated into political and cultural commentaries in Han China? 3) What were the recurring linguistic collocations of chongyi in these texts? 4) How was China’s linguistic and cultural hegemony over non-Sinitic counterparts reinforced using chongyi? The significance of this project is threefold. First, it connects the concept of chongyi to Han political and cultural thought by explaining its textual prominence and semantic construction from an interdisciplinary perspective. Second, it attempts to structure a historico-cultural approach to justify the marked presence of chongyi. Third, it contributes to exploring the non-linguistic functions of translation in Han China.

13603725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13603725.value: 中國跨區域集體行動研究：基於2008-2024年的事件分析

13603725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13603725.value: This project will investigate one of the most extraordinary forms of popular contention in China: cross-regional collective resistance. During the Xi Jinping era, China has witnessed the growth of cross-regional mobilization by a variety of claim-making groups, such as laid-off teachers, financial investors, bereaved parents, and veterans. This form of contention departs substantially from the dominant form of localized protests that have been prevalent in the past four decades. Although scholars have contributed intriguing case studies on cross-regional contention and provided conjectures, to date the field is characterized by a glaring absence of systematic evidence: first, little is known about even the most basic descriptive characteristics of cross-regional protests, such as protesters’ claims, targets of contention, the size and duration of protest, and geographical distribution of protests; second, the political logic of state responses to cross-regional protests (particularly its tolerance and concessions in some cases) remains not well understood, as scholars would assume there is little political space for broad-based mobilization in the Chinese context. This project aims to fill this gap. It will collect event data on cross-regional collective resistance between 2008 and 2024 from a wide range of media sources, and systematically code and analyze it in line with the standards developed in protest event analysis (PEA). The project will examine key attributes of cross-regional collective resistance and the changes over time. It will further study the links between these attributes and the patterns of state responses. Theoretically, the findings will contribute to scholarly discussions on the political opportunity structures in authoritarian settings by deciphering the political logic of selective repression or toleration of cross-regional collective resistance by the state. Methodologically, the new dataset can be used singly, or combined with event data collected by other scholars, to conduct within-country or cross-national comparative studies. Practically, this research will provide previously unavailable evidence about the patterns and evolution of cross-regional collective protests in China to scholars, policymakers, and the public. The project will be executed between 1st January 2026 and 31st December 2028, and is expected to produce journal articles, a publicly accessible dataset, and other outputs like policy analysis reports. 本項目將探讨中國社會存在的一種特殊的民眾抗議方式：跨區域集體行動。 在習近平新時代，中國社會一些群體却出現了跨區域動員，例如下崗民辦教師、金融詐騙受害者、失獨父母和退伍軍人。這種抗爭形式與過去四十年中占主導地位的地方性抗議形式有很大的不同。儘管學者們對跨區域抗爭提供了一些重要的案例研究和推測，但目前為止，該領域仍然缺乏系統性的證據：首先，對於跨區域集體行動的基本特徵，例如抗議者的訴求、抗爭目標、抗議規模和持續時間、抗議的地理分佈等，了解甚少；其次，對於國家對跨區域行動的政治邏輯（特別是在某些情況下的容忍與讓步）仍理解不夠，因為學者們一般認為在中國不會有廣泛動員的政治空間。 本項目旨在填補這一空白。它將收集從2008至2024年期間來自各種媒體來源的跨區域集體抗爭事件數據，並按照抗議事件分析（PEA）中的標準進行系統編碼和分析。項目將研究跨區域集體抗爭的關鍵屬性及其隨時間的變化，並進一步研究這些屬性與國家響應模式之間的聯繫。 理論方面，這些發現將通過解讀國家對跨區域集體抗爭的選擇性鎮壓或容忍的政治邏輯，促進學術界對中國政治體制下政治機會結構的討論。方法方面，新的數據集可以單獨使用，也可以與其他學者收集的事件數據結合，進行國內或跨國比較研究。應用方面，這項研究將為學者、政策制定者和公眾提供此前不可獲得的，關於中國跨區域集體抗議的模式和演變的證據。 該項目將於2026年1月1日至2028年12月31日期間執行，預計將產生期刊文章、公開可訪問的數據集，以及政策分析報告等其他成果。

13604125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604125.value: 走向共產主義生活：中國社會主義與日常生活，1962-1966 走向共產主義生活：中國這會主義與日常生活，1962-1966

13604125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604125.value: This project seeks to examine the ways that the transitional period between the Great Leap Forward (1958-1960) and the Cultural Revolution (1966-76) in the Chinese Revolution marked the emergence of a series of interrelated questions around the issue of everyday life. This period encompassed a series of challenges that ultimately coalesced into the figure of the “revolutionary successor.” This figure marked those who had been born after the founding of the People’s Republic in 1949 and whose ideological cultivation and transformation provided the basis on which to secure the future of the revolutionary process. This was the familiar problem of what to do with the young who did not undergo the political travails as their parents. The emergence of this figure as a site of both opportunity and crisis within the revolutionary project provides the point of departure for my proposal. I show how the figure of the revolutionary successor prompted a search for an adequate model of revolutionary subjectivity, itself linked to specific forms of material practice that together might comprise a communist everyday life. The issue of subjectivity marks a longstanding theoretical challenge within the vocabulary of Marxism insofar as it marks the quest to envisage subjectivity in terms different from the familiar modes of subjectivity in capitalist societies, meaning a revolutionary subjectivity capable of supporting a sustained process of social transformation. The category of the revolutionary successor itself sat alongside other terms – like the communist “new person” – as ways of thinking through these set of problems. The problem of the everyday sheds light on how the everyday, material practices that we take for granted – the matters of wearing clothes, family life, and so on – are sites of politics, especially when they foster the reproduction of old ideas within the new society. The connection between these categories lies in the way that the question of who we are – the kinds of subjects that we are, or might become – rests on the repeated everyday practices that shape our orientations and subjectivities. In integrating these problematics – that of subjectivity, and the everyday - through a close engagement with a particular historical moment, the early 1960s, this proposal seeks to retrieve that moment from its status as a mere interregnum, and demonstrate the ways that the problem of the revolutionary subject arose in China’s revolutionary experience. 社會主義的日常生活與資本主義有沒有根本上的區別？日常生活在社會著改造的過程中如何得到改變？為了能回答之一系列問題，本研究項目把日常生活當作一個理論概念以及改造對象，用中國社會主義的理論討論與檔案館的歷史資料來探索日常生活與革命之間的關係。

13605125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13605125.value: 對於「主動性尼特族」作為文化現象的探究：當代中國的青年失業與反工作政治

13605125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13605125.value: Dr Huang, Yanning Prof PUN, Ngai Prof Xia, Bingqing Dr ZHOU, Yang

13605125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13605125.value: This project explores the concept of ‘active NEET’ (Not in Employment, Education, or Training) in contemporary China, a phenomenon reflected in the rise of terms like ‘lying flat,’ ‘Buddha-like,’ and ‘full-time children.’ Unlike the common negative view of NEETs as passive or irresponsible, active NEETs consciously either refuse to work mainstream or meaningless jobs or abandon job hunting altogether. Many do this to escape exploitative working conditions, turning instead to alternative lifestyle choices, such as undertaking care work at home, or creative pursuits like travel, art, or volunteering. This research focuses on active NEETs’ views of professional and domestic work, life outside traditional employment, and their current anti-work practices. Using digital ethnography and in-depth interviews, the project seeks to uncover the social origins of the active NEETs phenomenon, map the changing cultural narratives surrounding them, and delve into their lived experiences. By examining active NEETs, this study addresses a gap in research about the heterogeneity among NEET youth, offering a deeper understanding of their cultural and political dimensions, as well as their subjectivities. To meet the research objectives, the project will use a framework based on Marxist and neo-Marxist theories of work, labour, alienation, and resistance. It will create a typology to explore the various ways individuals value and critique different kinds of work. The findings aim to provide a nuanced understanding of labour formation, resistance, and identity among young people in a rapidly changing political economic landscape. 本研究探討當代中國「主動性尼特族」（active NEET，NEET意指不在就業、教育或培訓中）的概念，這一現象反映在「躺平」、「佛系」以及「全職兒女」等詞語的興起。與普遍將尼特族視為被動或不負責任的負面觀點不同，主動性尼特族有意識地拒絕從事主流或無意義的工作，甚至完全放棄求職。許多人這樣做是為了逃避剝削性的工作環境，而轉向替代性的生活方式，例如在家承擔照護工作，或投入旅行、藝術、志願服務等創造性實踐。本研究聚焦於主動性尼特族對專業與家庭工作的看法、對傳統就業之外生活的態度，以及他們當下的反工作實踐。 透過數位民族誌與深度訪談，本計畫旨在揭示主動性尼特族現象的社會根源，勾勒圍繞其群體的文化敘事如何變化，並深入探討他們的生活經驗。透過對主動性尼特族的研究，本研究將填補對尼特青年異質性和多樣性研究的空白，提供對其文化與政治面向以及主體性的更深理解。 為達到研究目標，本研究將以馬克思主義與新馬克思主義關於工作、勞動、異化與抵抗的理論為框架，並建立一個類型學來探索個體如何評價與批判不同形式的工作。研究成果旨在提供對於勞動形態、抵抗與青年身份認同的細緻理解，特別是在快速變化的政治經濟格局之下。

13605525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13605525.value: 關懷建設能否緩解居住不穩定性？香港三個社區客廳的比較個案研究

13605525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13605525.value: Dr Chan, Crystal Ying Dr Leung, Ka Man

13605525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13605525.value: Background: Housing precarity, which often manifests in informal and inadequate housing in urban areas, has become a global crisis amid increasing within-country inequalities. Existing literature on housing informality in the Global North predominantly examines the operation and governance of informal housing sectors, with a particular emphasis on regulatory regimes. This focus has sidelined community-level collective solutions to housing inadequacy and informality, thereby overlooking the critical roles of gender and care in the intervention of housing precarity. This study focuses on Hong Kong and examines the initiative of community living rooms (CLRs), which refer to designated spaces that offer facilities and common areas for tenants of informal subdivided units (SDUs), to understand how urban care spaces and infrastructures could alleviate the housing precariousness of tenants in substandard housing and how gender dynamics play out within these socio-political processes. Objectives: The project builds on prior studies and aims to 1) examine SDU tenants’ lived experiences in the CLRs and their role in creating urban care spaces; 2) document how access to CLRs shapes family interactions and care practices; 3) compare different CLR models and investigate how organizational variations shape the operation of CLRs and the SDU tenants’ engagement; 4) investigate the effect of neighborhood attributes on CLRs in their role as urban care spaces within the community; and 5) analyze the impact of the CLR policy implemented in 2023 on the development of existing community initiatives. Methods: This mixed-method study includes ethnographic and participant observation in three selected CLRs and their respective neighborhoods, an online survey with a sample size of 500 SDU tenants, and 60 interviews with community workers and SDU tenants at the three CLRs. The project adopts a multilevel comparative case study approach to examine the developmental trajectories of three models of CLRs, government-funded, charity-commissioned NGO-run, and independently operated, and whether they function as care infrastructures that mitigate housing precarity at the individual, familial, organizational, and community levels. Significance: The project connects the emerging concept of care infrastructures with informal housing literature, highlighting their intersection with gender and urban spatial politics. It constructs a multilevel comparative framework to develop a typology of the varying types of urban infrastructures of care. Practically, it generates representative and contextualized evidence to advance service development that accommodates the needs of SDU tenants. It also evaluates existing policies and makes recommendations for addressing housing precarity and the gender gap within housing interventions. 背景：在日益加劇的結構性不平等下，居住不穩定性逐漸成為全球危機，當中以城市地區的非正規房屋和不適切房屋問題愈益嚴重。現存針對已發展地區非正規房屋的研究主要探討其運作、治理模式及監管制度，然而，這種研究取向忽略了社區層面的集體策略，從而忽視了性別與關懷倫理在緩解居住不穩定性中的重要角色。本研究聚焦香港並探討「社區客廳」介入模式—為劏房住戶提供互享設施與公共空間的社區場所—以了解城市照顧空間與關懷建設如何緩解弱勢租戶所面對的居住不穩定性，以及性別動態如何在這些社政結構互動過程中被形塑和展現。 研究目標： 本研究建立於既有研究基礎上，旨在： 1. 探討劏房住戶在社區客廳中的生活經驗及其在創造城市的照顧空間中的角色； 2. 記錄社區客廳的使用如何影響家庭互動與關懷實踐； 3. 比較不同社區客廳模式，並研究機構及組織差異如何影響其運作及住戶的參與； 4. 探討鄰里關係如何影響社區客廳作為社區照顧空間的功能； 5. 分析2023年實施的社區客廳政策對現有社區倡議發展的影響。 研究方法： 本研究採用混合研究方法，包括對三個選定的社區客廳及其所在社區的民族誌與參與式觀察、針對500名劏房住戶的網上問卷調查，以及對使用社區客廳的劏房住戶及社區工作者的60次深入訪談。本調查採用多層比較個案研究方法，探討三種社區客廳模式—政府資助、慈善基金委託及非政府組織營運，以及獨立營運—的發展軌跡，並分析它們能否在個人、家庭、組織與社區層面作為緩解居住不穩定性的關懷建設。 研究影響： 本研究嘗試把關懷建設理論概念扣連至非正規房屋研究，並分析此交織性與性別及城市空間政治的關係。透過建立一個多層比較框架，本研究將調查及分析不同城市關懷建設的類型。研究將提供具代表性且具情境獨特性的資料和觀察，以構思及推動能回應劏房住戶需求的服務，評估現行政策的成效並提出建議，以緩解居住不穩定性及消除房屋政策介入策略中的性別差距。

13606325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13606325.value: 心之理由：情感体验、认知与理性

13606325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13606325.value: The distinction between affect and cognition—between ‘the passions’ and ‘reason’—is a fundamental assumption of philosophy and the sciences of the mind. But it is also a piece of common sense. It is routine to feel oneself pulled between a calm judgment and a raging passion. So not only are affect and cognition distinct, but they vie for control of our thoughts and behaviors. Indeed, it is commonly held both by scholars and the folk that while affect and cognition may conflict, it always, or at least usually, cognition that should win the day. On this picture, to the extent that our conduct is guided by affect, it is either non-rational—subject to brute causes—or even irrational—in conflict with what we ought to do, rationally speaking. Though well-entrenched, this way of thinking about the relationship between affect and cognition faces serious challenges. A plethora of evidence from contemporary affective science points towards affective processes as playing an essential role in the proper operation of the mind. From this perspective, affect is not always an arational or irrational force, pulling us away from rational thoughts and decisions. Rather, part of our capacity for rationally responding to situations we face in the world is constituted by a well-functioning affective system. Philosophers, too, have reconsidered the role of affect in the mind, holding for instance emotional experiences are sensitive to evidence and provide us with good reasons to think and do certain things. While this reconsideration of the rational role of affect is a needed corrective, it remains difficult to see how affect and cognition can rationally relate to one another. A calm belief and raging passion certainly seem quite different from one another. In light of this deep difference, we need some way of understanding affective states that can explain how they rationally relate to cognition. My goal in this project is to address this deep and challenging question. In particular, I aim to explore recent Evaluativist views in philosophy and cognitive science, which hold that affective states are a distinctive type of evaluative representation. While this framework holds promise as a way of addressing this long-standing problems, this paradigm is relatively new and many questions remain. My goal here is to pose these questions sharply, and try to develop philosophically sophisticated but empirically well-supported answers to them. 情感与认知之间的区分——即"激情"与"理性"之间的区分——是哲学和心理科学的一个基本假设。但这也是一种常识。我们经常感到自己在冷静的判断和激烈的情感之间左右为难。因此，情感和认知不仅是不同的，而且它们还在争夺对我们思想和行为的控制权。实际上，学者和普通人都普遍认为，虽然情感和认知可能会发生冲突，但总是或至少通常应该由认知获胜。在这种观点下，我们的行为在受到情感指导的程度上，要么是非理性的——受到粗暴原因的支配——要么甚至是不理性的——与我们在理性上应该做的事情相冲突。 尽管这种思考情感与认知关系的方式根深蒂固，但它面临着严重的挑战。当代情感科学的大量证据表明，情感过程在心智的正常运作中发挥着重要作用。从这个角度来看，情感并不总是一种非理性或不理性的力量，将我们从理性思考和决策中拉开。相反，我们理性地回应我们在世界中面临的情况的能力，部分是由一个功能良好的情感系统构成的。哲学家们也重新考虑了情感在心智中的作用，认为例如情感体验对证据敏感，并为我们思考和做某些事情提供了充分的理由。 虽然这种对情感理性作用的重新考虑是一种必要的纠正，但我们仍然难以理解情感和认知如何能够理性地相互关联。冷静的信念和激烈的情感确实看起来彼此非常不同。鉴于这种深刻的差异，我们需要某种理解情感状态的方式，能够解释它们如何与认知理性地关联。我在这个项目中的目标是解决这个深刻而具有挑战性的问题。特别地，我旨在探索哲学和认知科学中最近的评价主义观点，该观点认为情感状态是一种独特类型的评价性表征。虽然这个框架作为解决这一长期存在问题的方式具有前景，但这个范式相对较新，仍然存在许多问题。我在这里的目标是尖锐地提出这些问题，并试图为它们发展出哲学上精致但经验上有充分支持的答案。

13606425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13606425.value: 鋼筋混凝土與二十世紀初香港現代建築的興起

13606425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13606425.value: This research examines Hong Kong’s journey to architectural modernism through the lens of material innovation, specifically focusing on reinforced concrete. While concrete is an ancient building material, its modern application, particularly when reinforced with steel, symbolizes progress and modernity. The introduction of reinforced concrete to Hong Kong in the early twentieth century rapidly catalyzed a shift from classical or vernacular architecture to modern design. Despite its pivotal role, the impact of reinforced concrete on Hong Kong’s early modern buildings remains understudied. This study addresses the following key questions: When and how did Hong Kong acquire reinforced concrete? Who were the pioneers in its use, and what breakthroughs did they achieve? How did its application influence the city’s architectural design and aesthetics? This research posits that, despite initial perceptions of reinforced concrete as foreign, Hong Kong’s building professionals skillfully integrated the material into local practices. The originality of this research lies in examining the local adaptation of reinforced concrete across four critical areas: production, application, regulation, and design. First, this research examines the history of Green Island Cement, the first cement factory on Chinese soil. Founded by a Chinese–British partnership, the company opened its initial factory in Macao in 1886 and a branch in Hong Kong in 1887. Over the decades, the Hong Kong factory became a major supplier of Portland cement—a crucial component of reinforced concrete—to both Hong Kong and Shanghai. Second, this research identifies the building professionals who pioneered the use of reinforced concrete in Hong Kong, highlighting their innovative approaches and challenges. Initially used for infrastructural projects such as dams and reservoirs, reinforced concrete later gained prominence in buildings, advocated by engineers (notably Hongkong Engineering & Construction Co. Ltd.) for its fire and typhoon resistance. Third, this research investigates the government’s policies and regulatory measures to ensure the safety, durability, and adoption of reinforced concrete. Lastly, this research traces the timeline of reinforced concrete usage, identifying key buildings that marked significant design breakthroughs. It portrays a gradual transformation from small reinforced concrete structures to buildings with reinforced concrete frames and brick and stone facades and, finally, to monolithic reinforced concrete buildings. By weaving together these four local adaptations, this research argues that Hong Kong followed a unique path of modernization and architectural production, distinct from Western models.

13606925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13606925.value: 產業自動化升級與社會保險：來自中國的證據

13606925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13606925.value: Prof NGOK, Kinglun Dr Peng, Zhaiwen Dr Zhao, Hui

13606925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13606925.value: The re-emergence of the welfare state-economic growth nexus as a central theme in social policy research has become increasingly evident in recent years, driven by concerns over automation in production systems and its potential impact on job loss and welfare system disruptions. These concerns stem from notable efficiency gains associated with robotization and AI-driven automation, as well as scholarly debates on whether the upgrading of production systems, labeled “Industry 4.0”, results in a crowding-out effect on social insurance coverage. This ongoing discourse reflects the nuanced and complex relationship between automation and social insurance. However, questions remain regarding this uncertain nexus due to a lack of empirical studies, particularly in the developing world. As late industrializers, many developing countries face intertwined challenges of global competition, production upgrading, employment, and social protection, creating a multifaceted landscape. To address this complexity and expand beyond existing research that focuses solely on the employer perspective, this study constructs a comprehensive framework and develops a set of competing research hypotheses. Utilizing an explanatory sequential research design, focusing on China as a case in point, the study will test these hypotheses using longitudinal panel data, followed by in-depth interviews with various policy actors and stakeholders to gather qualitative data that complements the quantitative insights. This study aims to contribute to theoretical discourse and provide policy implications in four key areas: (1) Theoretically, it enriches the discussion on the welfare state-economic growth nexus by exploring the relationship between automation and social insurance. (2) Empirically, it presents evidence derived from developing countries on this important topic. (3) Analytically, it differentiates between the short- and long-term effects of automation on social insurance while incorporating the perspectives of various policy actors and stakeholders, offering a multidimensional view on the issue. (4) Finally, it will provide informed recommendations for social policy reform in China, particularly in light of the government’s ongoing initiative to promote high-end and intelligent manufacturing through “new quality productivity”, with findings that may also have implications for other developing countries. 近年來，福利國家與經濟增長之間的關係再度成為社會政策研究的焦點，這主要源於生產體制的日益自動化，以及人們對其可能引發失業和衝擊現有福利體系的擔憂。這些擔憂一方面來自人工智能驅動的自動化所帶來的效率提升，另一方面則源於學術界對「工業4.0」所代表的產業自動化升級是否會對社會保險產生擠出效應的爭論。這些討論揭示了自動化與社會保險之間微妙而複雜的關係。然而，由於實證研究的不足，尤其在發展中國家，這一議題仍存在許多待解之謎。作為後發工業化國家，許多發展中國家正面臨全球競爭、產業升級、就業與社會保障相互交織的多重挑戰，形成了極為複雜的局面。為應對這一複雜性，本研究超越了現有以僱主為中心的單一視角，構建了一個綜合框架，並提出了一對競爭性研究假設。研究將以中國為例，利用縱向面板數據驗證這些假設，並通過與不同政策行動者和利益相關者的深度訪訪談，收集定性數據，以補充定量分析的發現。本研究不僅在理論上豐富了福利國家與經濟增長關係的討論，提供了來自發展中國家的實證證據，更在中國積極推動產業升級的背景下，為其社會政策改革提供相關的政策建議。

13607125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607125.value: 組織正當性的建構：以中美、中英合作大學為例的比較研究

13607125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607125.value: This study investigates the complex process of legitimacy construction by Sino-Foreign Collaborative Universities (SFCUs) within China's unique higher education landscape. As hybrid institutions combining Chinese and foreign educational models, SFCUs face distinct challenges in establishing their legitimacy among key stakeholders, particularly prospective students and their families. This research employs a comparative case study approach, examining five SFCUs (three Sino-US and two Sino-UK) to explore how SFCUs construct and maintain legitimacy in the Chinese higher education system and how prospective parents perceive and evaluate SFCUs’ legitimacy. Drawing on a theoretical framework that integrates pragmatic, sociopolitical, and cognitive dimensions of legitimacy, this study utilizes a three-stage mixed-methods design. The first stage involves content analysis of public communications to identify key narratives and framing strategies. The second stage combines ethnographic observations of recruitment events with semi-structured interviews of prospective parents to understand how legitimacy claims are perceived and evaluated. The final stage incorporates interviews with SFCU staff to gain insights into institutional decision-making processes and strategies. This research addresses critical gaps in our understanding of transnational higher education in contexts with strong state involvement. It explores how SFCUs navigate China's highly regulated environment, construct alternative forms of prestige outside traditional state-endorsed hierarchies, and justify their value proposition in a system where higher education is traditionally viewed as a public good. Furthermore, the study examines how geopolitical tensions and changing perceptions of Western education influence legitimacy construction and stakeholder responses. By comparing Sino-US and Sino-UK collaborations, this research will provide valuable insights into how different partnership models and national higher education traditions shape legitimacy-building strategies. The findings will contribute to theoretical understandings of organizational legitimacy in transnational education contexts and offer practical implications for policymakers, educational leaders, and scholars engaged in international higher education collaborations. The findings will illuminate the complex interplay between state policies, institutional actions, and stakeholder perceptions in shaping the success and acceptance of SFCUs. 本研究旨在深入探討中外合作大學，此類結合中、外教育模式的混合式高等教育機構，如何在中國獨特的教育環境中建構其正當性的複雜過程。這些大學在爭取潛在學生、家長等關鍵利害關係人的認同時，面臨著特殊的挑戰。本研究將採比較個案研究法，剖析五所中外合作大學（三所中美、兩所中英），藉此探討其在中國高等教育體系中建立與維持正當性的策略，以及準學生家長群體如何看待並評估其正當性。 在理論框架上，本研究整合了正當性理論中的實用、社會政治與認知三個維度，並採行三階段混合研究設計。第一階段，將對各大學的公開文宣進行內容分析，以辨識其關鍵敘事與論述框架。第二階段，將結合招生說明會的田野觀察，以及對準學生家長的半結構式訪談，藉以理解校方所主張的正當性如何被看待與評價。最後階段，則將訪談中外合作大學的教職員，以深入了解其機構內部的決策過程與策略。 在國家高度參與的脈絡下，跨國高等教育的運作模式是學界尚待深入的領域，本研究旨在填補此一知識空白。研究將探討中外合作大學如何應對中國高度監管的環境，在官方認可的傳統排名體系之外另闢蹊徑、建立聲望，並在一個向來將高等教育視為公共財的體系中，闡明自身的價值主張。此外，本研究亦將檢視當前的地緣政治情勢，以及社會對西方教育觀感的轉變，如何影響其正當性的建構與利害關係人的回應。 透過比較中美與中英兩種合作模式，本研究將就不同的夥伴關係及國家高教傳統如何形塑正當性的建構策略，提供有益的洞見。研究成果不僅有助於深化跨國教育脈絡下組織正當性的理論理解，也能為從事國際高教合作的政策制定者、教育領袖及學者，提供實務層面的啟示。本研究的發現，將闡明國家政策、校方作為及社會觀感三者之間錯綜複雜的相互關係，如何共同形塑了中外合作大學的成敗與社會接受度。

13607225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607225.value: 實用推理與片段表現主義

13607225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607225.value: Practical reasoning is the part of logic concerned with principles for sound reasoning on deciding what to do, as opposed to what (merely) to believe. Such reasoning typically involves probability claims ('if I wait for the bus, I will likely be late'), preference claims ('avoiding undue stress is best'), or statements of obligation or permission ('I should not be late'). Capturing the meaning and logical behaviour of this language is a complex but alluring task pursued by philosophers, computer scientists, and linguists. Fragmented Expressivism is a foundational view on linguistic meaning, composed of two theses. The first thesis -- Topic-sensitive Fragmentation -- says that the mind is best modeled as compartmentalized: divided into disjoint islands of information, each of which is highly coherent, but with no guarantee of joint coherence. The second thesis -- Semantic Expressivism -- says that the meaning of sentences like 'it is raining', 'it may be raining', 'it is probably raining', and 'it should not be raining' is fundamentally best understood in terms of assertability conditions: the conditions that determine for each sentence what sort of mental state an agent must possess in order to aptly assert that sentence. Fragmented Expressivism presents a natural combination. To develop Semantic Expressivism is to develop an account of how sentences relate to mental states. Topic-sensitive Fragmentation informs a mathematical model of the mind that is well-suited for such theorizing: it is highly abstract but resists pernicious simplifications that occur in more traditional models used in formal semantics. In previous work, I developed the foundations of Fragmented Expressivism, yielding a novel formal semantic framework for traditional expressivist stalking horses like the epistemic modal operators `might' and `must'. For this project, I intend to extend this framework to the language of practical reasoning (more specifically: probability operators, preference operators, and evaluative language). The resulting systems will be evaluated along three dimensions. First, the mathematical dimension: to what extent do the resulting accounts emulate or depart from rival accounts, especially with respect to the logical behavior of the relevant vocabulary? Second, the empirical dimension: to what extent do the resulting accounts succeed in matching prima facie linguistic data about how we ordinarily use such vocabulary, especially our robust intuitions about what counts as cogent reasoning with such language? Third, the conceptual dimension: to what extent do the resulting accounts succeed in overcoming traditional philosophical objections to such an enterprise? 實用推理是邏輯的一部分，著重於就「該做什麼」進行健全推理的原則，而非（僅僅）關於「該相信什麼」。這類推理通常涉及概率主張（「如果我等巴士，我可能會遲到」）、偏好主張（「避免不必要的壓力是最好的」）或義務或許可的陳述（「我不應該遲到」）。捕捉這種語言的意義和邏輯行為是一項複雜的任務，但吸引哲學家、計算機科學家和語言學家追求。片段表現主義是一種關於語言意義的基礎觀點，由兩個論點組成。第一個論點——主題敏感的片段化——主張心靈最適合被建模為一種分隔的架構：分為不相連的資訊島，每一個島都高度一致，但整體上不保證共同一致性。第二個論點——語義表現主義——認為像「正在下雨」、「可能正在下雨」、「可能正在下雨」和「不應該在下雨」這些句子的意義，最好從斷言條件的角度來理解：也就是決定對於每個句子而言，行動者必須具備何種心理狀態，才能恰當地斷言該句子的那些條件。片段表現主義提供了一個自然的組合。發展語義表現主義就是發展句子如何與心理狀態相關的理論。主題敏感的片段化提供了一個適合這類理論的數學模型：它高度抽象，但抵制了在形式語義中使用的更傳統模型的有害簡化。在以往的工作中，我已經建立了片段表現主義的基礎，產生了一個新的形式語義框架，用於傳統表現主義的追蹤對象，如「可能」和「必須」的認知模態運算符。對於這個項目，我打算將這個框架擴展到實用推理的語言（更具體地說：概率運算符、偏好運算符和評價語言）。結果將從三個層面進行評估。首先是數學層面：結果解釋在多大程度上上模擬或偏離競爭性詮釋，特別是在相關詞彙的邏輯行為方面。其次是實證層面：結果解釋在多大程度上成功匹配我們通常使用這些詞彙的語言數據，特別是我們對使用這種語言合理推理的直覺。第三是概念層面：結果解釋在多大程度上成功克服了傳統哲學對這項工作的反對意見。

13607325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607325.value: 轉廢還田：探討人類排遺在當代中國農村的永續性與循環經濟

13607325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607325.value: Human waste, commonly referred to as “humanure,” is increasingly recognized globally for its ecological and societal benefits as an organic fertilizer. China with its long history of using nightsoil in agriculture has specifically undergone significant changes in the two divergent phases—the socialist period and the post-socialist era, in which the role of human waste shifted from its deep and positive involvement in the collective management of environmental hygiene to detestation and exclusion formed by the discourse of modern hygiene practices. This research seeing the values and potential of human waste to respond to the pressing environmental issues focuses on sustainability and circularity of handling human waste in rural China. In Conghua, Guangzhou, an approach called “returning human waste to the field” (huantian) still can be observed. Therefore, this research will use Conghua as a case study to explore the complex dynamics of human waste management through farmers’ experiences, examining societal, technological, and ecological aspects in the post-socialist context. This mixed-methods research combines oral history, ethnography, and action research to investigate human excrement as a critical element in the social and ecological processes that sustain the mutual survival of humans, farmland, and soil organisms. The study will address key issues such as environmental hygiene, food security, sanitation technology, ecological crises, and circular economies. By emphasizing community perspectives in this specific case, this project hopes to develop a metabolic framework to explore the creation, maintenance, and disruption of human waste recycling practices in rural settings. Through action research, this project also propose cyclical approaches that bridge waste disposal and food production, exploring the tensions and synergies between these processes via the experiences of rural members. Ultimately, by re-evaluating the diverse materiality of human excrement, this project seeks to address environmental destruction and remediation, offering insights into a more sustainable (rural) future for China and beyond. 人類排泄物（俗稱「夜香」「水肥」）作為天然／有機肥料的生態與社會效益近年再受關注。中國農村長時段以來積累了豐富的人糞肥利用知識與技術，其在社會主義與後社會主義兩個分化時期呈現迥異的軌跡：前者將其納入集體化的環境衛生與農業治理，賦予「排遺—土壤—作物」以循環的正當性；後者則在現代衛生與潔淨敘事的塑形下，將其逐步邊緣化、污名化，從公共資源轉化為應被隔離的廢棄物。本研究正是在這種歷史斷裂與延續之間，重估人類排遺回應當前環境危機的可能，聚焦中國農村在處置與再利用上的永續性與循環性。 以廣州從化為田野，本研究關注「還田」（屎尿回歸田土）的在地實踐。透過貼近農戶的生活與技術歷程，我們描繪人糞管理的社會—技術—生態複合體：既關乎家計與勞動，也牽動衛生治理與土壤生命。研究將追蹤排泄物流從廁所、堆沤、運輸到田間的路徑，揭示規範、情感、風險感知與基礎設施如何交織出一套關於潔穢、價值與自然的在地秩序。 方法上，本研究結合口述歷史、民族誌與行動研究，將人類排泄物視為維繫人、田、土壤生物彼此互活的關鍵節點，從微觀的家戶實作到鄉鎮層級的制度安排，探討環境衛生、糧食安全、衛生技術、生態危機與循環經濟等核心議題。我們提出一個面向「社會—生態代謝」的分析框架，關注實踐如何被創生、維持與中斷：包括政策與市場的牽引、技術的可用性與可親近性、以及社群對潔淨與體面的再定義。 在行動研究層面，本計畫將與地方社群協作，試行銜接廢棄物處置與食物生產的循環方案，檢視其中的張力（如衛生風險、勞動負擔、法規限制）與協同（如土壤肥力恢復、成本節省、社群互助）。最終，透過對排泄物多元物質性的再評估，回應環境破壞與修復，為中國與更廣泛農村的永續未來提供可供公共對話的田野洞見。

13607425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607425.value: 超越自上而下與自下而上：中國蘇南鄉村發展的動態與演變

13607425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607425.value: Recent rural development initiatives and practices in China have garnered considerable scholarly attention, revealing a complex landscape characterised by the coexistence of government-led and locally-led approaches. The two approaches often blend exogenous and endogenous elements to varying degrees. This presents a unique opportunity for comparative analysis, allowing us to examine both the continuities and divergences from previous phases of rural development in China, as well as draw parallels and distinctions with international rural development models. Such analysis is crucial for understanding the complexities of rural restructuring in China and provides valuable insights into rural transformations worldwide. The research seeks to address three key objectives: 1) To compare the recent government-led versus locally-led development approaches in China, situating them within the historical context of rural development in post-reform China and the broader framework of international rural development paradigms; 2) To examine the dynamic and evolving interplay between forces from above, below, and outside in rural development; and 3) To assess the strengths and limitations of government-led versus locally-led development, with particular emphasis on sustainability, inequality, and inclusivity. The study will employ a comparative case study approach, examining two villages in Suzhou, a city chosen for its historical significance in rural development models and its current co-existence of government-led and locally-led initiatives. The research method combines primary data collection through participant observation and semi-structured interviews with secondary data analysis of policy documents, official statistics, and media reports. This research design enables a thorough investigation of development processes, stakeholder dynamics, and outcomes in both government-led and locally-led approaches. By situating the analysis within the broader context of China’s rural development history and global rural development theories, this research aims to contribute to a more nuanced understanding of China’s evolving rural development models and enrich the ongoing debate on rural development paradigms. It seeks to illuminate the complex dynamics between state intervention, local initiative, and external influences, while critically assessing the implications for sustainability, equity, and community empowerment. The findings of this study have the potential to inform both policy and practice in rural development. Ultimately, this research aims to contribute to the ongoing efforts to achieve sustainable and inclusive rural development in China and beyond. 中國近年的鄉村發展舉措與實踐引起了學術界廣泛關注，呈現出一個複雜格局：政府主導和地方主導的模式並存。這兩種模式通常以不同程度融合外生性和內生性元素。這為比較分析提供了獨特機會，讓我們能夠考察中國鄉村發展各階段的連續性與差異，同時與國際鄉村發展模式進行對比。這種分析對理解中國鄉村重構的複雜性至關重要，並為全球鄉村轉型提供寶貴見解。 本研究旨在實現三個關鍵目標：1）比較中國近期政府主導與地方主導的鄉村發展模式，將其置於改革開放後鄉村發展的歷史背景和更廣泛的國際鄉村發展範式框架中；2）考察鄉村發展中自上而下、自下而上及外部力量之間動態演變的相互作用；3）評估政府主導與地方主導鄉村發展的優勢和局限性，特別關注可持續性、不平等和包容性。 本研究採用比較案例研究方法，考察蘇州市的兩個村莊。選擇蘇州基於其在鄉村發展模式中的歷史重要性，以及當前政府主導和地方主導模式共存的特點。研究方法結合了參與式觀察和半結構化訪談的一手數據收集，以及對政策文件、官方統計和媒體報導的二手數據分析。這一設計能夠全面調查兩種發展模式中的發展過程、利益相關者動態和結果。 通過將分析置於中國鄉村發展史和全球鄉村發展理論的更廣泛背景中，本研究旨在促進對演變中的中國鄉村發展模式的深入理解，並豐富關於鄉村發展範式的討論。研究將闡明國家干預、地方倡議和外部影響之間的複雜動態，同時批判性評估其對可持續性、公平性和社區賦權的影響。本研究的發現有望為鄉村發展的政策和實踐提供參考，最終為中國及其他地區實現可持續和包容性鄉村發展做出貢獻。

13608125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13608125.value: 用人工智慧輔助反思來協助英語口語的自我調節學習

13608125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13608125.value: The problem this project aims to address is the weak English-speaking skills among Hong Kong university English as a foreign language (EFL) learners. As Self-regulated learning (SRL) requires students to independently assess their speaking performance, identify areas for improvement, set improvement goals, and develop actionable plans, many students struggle to achieve effective SRL. Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology can potentially solve the problem through enhancing the self-reflection phase of SRL by assisting students in self-assessment and providing real-time feedback and affective support. However, using AI alone does not guarantee effective reflection. Students must carefully select and strategically apply AI tools to support performance evaluation and obtain constructive feedback and suggestions. Many students lack this knowledge, while no established taxonomy or pedagogical model exists to guide their SRL with AI-assisted reflection (AIR). This project aims to develop a taxonomy of AIR strategies and a pedagogical model to guide EFL learners’ SRL with AIR. It will also assess the model’s effectiveness in improving speaking skills, increasing motivation, reducing speaking anxiety, and enhancing willingness to communicate. Moreover, it will evaluate the impact of pretraining in AIR on SRL for speaking development. The research follows a two-stage design. Stage 1 adopts a multiple case study approach to investigate the strategies students use during AIR for SRL of speaking. 20 university students will participate in weekly one-hour SRL with AIR over eight weeks. They will document their experiences in reflection logs and download their chat histories with AI tools. Data will also be collected through interviews, which will then be analyzed toghether with the reflection logs and chat histories to develop a taxonomy of AIR strategies. Stage 2 implements a quasi-experimental design with 12 first-year university classes to evaluate the effectiveness of the AIR model and pretraining. The students will be randomly assigned to three groups: a control group, an experimental group using AIR, and another experimental group receiving pretraining in AIR. Data will be collected through pre- and post-tests, questionnaires, and interviews. The research will contribute to the fields of AI-assisted language learning and SRL. Pedagogically, the taxonomy of AIR strategies and the pedagogical model for SRL with AIR will offer students strategies and procedures for conducting SRL with AIR, guide educators on integrating AI into English-speaking instruction, and provide insights into AI-assisted SRL. The long-term impact extends beyond speaking skills, promoting holistic learning strategies and sustainable AI integration in language education. 這個項目旨在解決的問題是香港大學英語作為外語（EFL）學習者在英語口說能力方面的薄弱表現。自我調節學習（Self-regulated learning, SRL）要求學生能夠自主評估自己的口說表現、識別改進的方向、設定學習目標，並擬定可執行的計劃，然而，許多學生在實踐有效的 SRL 方面仍面臨困難。人工智慧（Artificial Intelligence, AI）技術有潛力通過加強 SRL 中的自我反思階段來解決這一問題，協助學生進行自我評估，並提供即時的回饋與情感支持。 然而，僅依靠 AI 並不保證能實現有效的反思。學生必須有策略地選擇並應用 AI 工具，以支援其表現評估，並獲得具建設性的回饋與建議。許多學生缺乏這方面的知識，同時，目前尚無一套成熟的分類法或教學模式來指導他們如何結合 AI 輔助反思（AI-assisted reflection, AIR）進行 SRL。 因此，本研究旨在發展一套 AIR 策略分類法與一個教學模型，以指導 EFL 學習者在 AI 支援下進行自我調節學習。同時，本研究也將評估該模型在提升學生口說能力、增強學習動機、降低口說焦慮及提升溝通意願方面的效果。此外，也將探討在 SRL 前置訓練中導入 AIR 的影響。 本研究採取兩階段設計。第一階段採用多個個案研究法，探討學生在運用 AIR 進行口說 SRL 過程中所使用的策略。將邀請 20 名大學生參與為期八週、每週一小時的 AIR 自我調節學習。他們需記錄反思日誌並下載與 AI 工具的對話記錄。研究也將透過訪談收集資料，並結合反思日誌與對話記錄進行分析，從而建立 AIR 策略的分類法。 第二階段將進行準實驗設計，對象為 12 個大一新生班級，以評估 AIR 模型與前置訓練的成效。學生將被隨機分配至三組：控制組、使用 AIR 的實驗組，以及接受 AIR 前訓練的實驗組。資料將通過前後測、問卷與訪談收集。 本研究將對 AI 輔助語言學習與自我調節學習（SRL）領域做出貢獻。在教學實踐上，所發展的 AIR 策略分類法與教學模型將為學生提供一套明確的策略與程序來進行 SRL，亦能協助教師將 AI 有效整合於英語口說教學中，並深入理解 AI 輔助的 SRL 機制。從長遠來看，該成果將促進更全面的學習策略發展，並推動 AI 在語言教育中的可持續應用。

13609025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13609025.value: 適應力、應對衝擊能力與前瞻性：社會保障與災害管理週期的理論整合

13609025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13609025.value: Dr CUATON , Ginbert Permejo Prof Kaasch, Alexandra

13609025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13609025.value: Integrating social protection systems into mainstream disaster management frameworks has become an increasingly persistent need given the growing frequency and severity of major financial crises, health pandemics and extreme weather events. Whilst financial crises have underscored the necessity for economic stability and robust safety nets, health pandemics such as COVID-19 have highlighted the importance of responsive fiscal and emergency measures responding to the secondary impacts of public health measures. Concurrently, extreme weather events and climate change demand sustainable environmental policies and innovative emergency relief solutions to support vulnerable populations. This research aims to address this critical need by filling a gap in understanding how social protection systems can be more effectively integrated into the disaster management cycle to enhance community resilience. This research proposes an innovative conceptual extension of the welfare modelling approach in comparative social policy analysis. It aims to compare different ‘worlds of community resilience’ across the Asia-Pacific region, developing original indices for social protection adaptivity, shock-responsiveness and anticipation, inspired by Esping-Andersen’s (1990) welfare regime typology. Accordingly, the research methodology includes the following five interconnected phases: 1. Conceptual Foundation: A comprehensive literature review will evaluate the role of adaptive, shock-responsive and anticipatory social protection policies and their role in mainstream crisis management frameworks such as the Disaster Management Cycle and the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction. 2. Best Practice Examples: Systematic reviews will identify best practice cases in the Asia-Pacific and develop a benchmarking framework for effective social protection inclusion in those crisis management frameworks. 3. Typology Development: The project will develop three original indices and a typology measuring how different social protection policies are conducive to building community resilience. This process will facilitate the grouping of empirical cases in the Asia-Pacific region into ideal types according to their social protection responses to various crises. 4. Policy Analysis: Path dependency and critical juncture theories will be employed to analyse the political, institutional and socio-economic drivers of disaster management policymaking in representative cases for each identified ideal type. 5. Research Communication: Findings will be disseminated through conferences, publications, policy briefs, a project website and one public forum. This research will contribute to academic discussions by identifying how existing social protection structures can be integrated into the crisis management cycle to enhance community resilience. The project will offer practical insights for local, regional and international policymakers to develop adaptive, shock-responsive and anticipatory social protection systems. 鑑於重大金融危機、疫症全球大流行及極端天氣事件的頻率與嚴重程度不斷上升，將社會保障系統納入主流災害管理框架的需求比以往更迫切。金融危機突顯了維持經濟穩定和建立強大安全網的必要性，而像新冠疫情（COVID-19）般的公共衞生事件則揭示了具韌性的醫療系統，以及能夠靈活應對公共衛生措施次生影響的財政及緊急應對措施之必要。同時，極端天氣事件和氣候變化需要有可持續的環境政策與創新的緊急救援方案來支持弱勢群體。本研究旨在回應這項關鍵需要，填補現有研究的知識缺口，探索如何更有效地將社會保障系統整合到災害管理週期中，以增強社區韌性。 本研究提出創新的概念延伸，建基於比較社會政策分析中的福利模型方法，旨在比較亞太地區不同的「社區韌性模式」，進而發展有關社會保障的適應力、應對衝擊能力與前瞻性的原創指標，其靈感源自Esping-Andersen（1990）的福利體制類型學。 研究方法涵蓋五個相互關聯的階段： 1. 概念基礎：通過全面文獻探討，評估具適應力、應對衝擊能力與前瞻性的社會保障政策於主流災害管理框架（如災害管理週期及《仙台減災綱領》）中的作用。 2. 最佳實踐案例：以系統性回顧方法，識別亞太地區的最佳實踐案例並開發一套基準框架，促進社會保障有效納入危機管理框架。 3. 類型學開發：開發三個原創指標及一個類型學框架，用以衡量不同社會保障政策如何有助於培養社區韌性。這將使亞太地區的實證案例，根據其應對不同危機的社會保障方式，劃分至若干理想類型。 4. 政策分析：利用路徑相關及關鍵時刻等理論，分析每個理想類型代表案例中災害管理政策制定的政治、制度及社會經濟驅動因素。 5. 研究傳播：研究成果將透過學術會議、出版物、政策簡報、媒體活動、項目網站及一場公開論壇進行傳播。 本研究將為學術討論作出重要貢獻，闡明現有社會保障結構如何與危機管週期整合以增強社區韌性。此項目將為本地、區域及國際政策制定者提供豐富的實際啟示，以開發具適應力、應對衝擊能力與前瞻性的社會保障系統。

13609425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13609425.value: 《駱駝之城：北京的駱駝事業，1750-1950年》

13609425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13609425.value: This book project, Fueling the City: The Enterprise of Camels in Beijing, 1750–1950, will examine the vital role that Beijing camels played in transporting coal, the city’s primary fuel, from the Western Hills at the city’s fringe to the city itself. Drawing on a diverse range of primary sources from both within China and abroad, an animal agency approach will be adopted to explore the various aspects of camel-based society in Beijing, such as stabling and feeding, animal behavior, organization, migratory patterns, and trajectory of camels from the eighteenth century to the twentieth century. By looking into the largely neglected but indispensable beasts of burden in Beijing, this project will offer a new approach to understanding working animals’ power in shaping the urban history, and shed light on the dynamics of human–animal relationships in modern China. 《駱駝之城：北京的駱駝事業，1750-1950年》的課題研究駱駝在從西山運送煤炭到北京城所扮演的關鍵角色。藉助國內外所藏主要檔案，本課題以動物爲中心，探索北京駱駝社會從18世紀到20世紀的軌跡，如駱駝的飼養、組織、遷徙模式。通過研究這群在北京被忽視但不可或缺的駱駝，本課題將提供一種新的方法來理解動物在塑造城市曆史中的作用，並闡明中國近代人與動物的關繫。

13609825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13609825.value: 了解香港、新加坡和台灣青年跨性別和非二元性別身份與數位/網路性別暴力之間的關係

13609825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13609825.value: Prof Shah, Nishant Dr Tang, Shawna Ser-Wei

13609825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13609825.value: Transgender persons have been using social media platforms to seek support, to find information on transitions and to build communities since the advent of the Internet. In recent years, trans and non-binary youth are more motivated to express their gender identities and to find answers to various processes of gender affirmation. The term non-binary has fast emerged as a gender identity and expression among youth. Non-binary youth are at a higher risk of abuse and harassment while receiving lesser support from peer networks. They also have lesser access to trans-specific healthcare in comparison to trans youth.
