Besides, the heterogeneous nature of data across clients in FL settings is poorly distinguished in Euclidean spaces, leading to performance degradation. Recent advancements in Hyperbolic Representation Learning (HRL) offer promising solutions to these limitations. Hyperbolic spaces excel at representing hierarchical and tree-like structures with minimal distortion. However, these methods rarely consider distributed and privacy-preserving scenarios. This proposal aims to bridge this gap by incorporating hyperbolic geometry into the FL framework, enhancing both privacy preservation and model performance. It is challenging because the non-Euclidean nature of hyperbolic space complicates the conventional Euclidean FL algorithms. Therefore, special strategies need to be carefully designed. Our research will pioneer a new paradigm in FL, named as HyperFL, by systematically tackling the challenges in the following three-pronged aspects: (1) Client Representation Enhancement: We aim to design methods to improve local client representations by leveraging hierarchical semantics through semi-supervised learning and prototype learning techniques. We also plan to develop curvature-aware methods to better preserve data distributions and inherent properties of each client's dataset; (2) Server Communication Innovation: We aim to utilize hyperbolic geometry to improve communication quality and efficiency, especially for heterogeneous data. Specifically, we propose to design parameter aggregation strategies and server embedding constraints suitable for multiple hyperbolic backbones and various tasks; (3) Recommender Systems Application: We plan to deploy HyperFL in real-world recommender systems, demonstrating practical benefits and wide-ranging applicability. We aim to showcase its ability to improve performance while maintaining privacy in complex hierarchical data environments. In summary, by pursuing this cutting-edge research direction, our objective is to push the boundaries of FL, offering a more robust, versatile, and powerful framework capable of handling complex data structures while maintaining privacy and performance across diverse client distributions. 聯邦學習（FL）已成為協作機器學習的一種重要方法，能夠在我們日益重視數據隱私的社會中保護數據隱私。然而，傳統的聯邦學習方法主要是為歐幾里得空間中的模型設計的，在處理複雜數據結構時面臨重大限制。首先，層次和樹狀數據集在推薦系統、圖挖掘和語言處理中常見，無法在有限維的歐幾里得空間中嵌入而不造成重大失真。此外，聯邦學習環境中客戶端數據的異質性在歐幾里得空間中無法很好區分，導致性能下降。 最近在雙曲表示學習（HRL）方面的進展為這些限制提供了有希望的解決方案。雙曲空間在以最小失真的方式表示層次和樹狀結構方面表現優異。然而，這些方法很少考慮分佈式和保護隱私的場景。 本提案旨在通過將雙曲幾何納入聯邦學習框架，彌補這一空白，增強隱私保護和模型性能。這是具有挑戰性的，因為雙曲空間的非歐幾里得特性使傳統的歐幾里得聯邦學習算法變得複雜。因此，需要仔細設計特殊策略。我們的研究將開創一種新的聯邦學習範式，稱為HyperFL，系統性地解決以下三個方面的挑戰： 1. 客戶端表示增強：我們旨在設計方法，通過半監督學習和原型學習技術利用層次語義來改善本地客戶端表示。我們還計劃開發考慮曲率的算法，以更好地保護數據分佈和每個客戶端數據集的固有特性； 2. 伺服器通訊創新：我們旨在利用雙曲幾何改善通訊質量和效率，特別是對於異質數據。具體而言，我們提議設計適合多個雙曲主幹和各種任務的參數聚合策略和伺服器嵌入約束； 3. 推薦系統應用：我們計劃在現實世界的推薦系統中部署HyperFL，展示實際效益和廣泛的適用性。我們的目標是展示其在保持隱私的同時提高複雜層次數據環境中的性能的能力。 總之，通過追求這一前沿研究方向，我們的目標是推動聯邦學習的邊界，提供一個更強大、多功能且高效的框架，能夠處理複雜數據結構，同時在不同客戶端分佈中保持隱私和性能。

14204925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14204925.value: 用於增強中風康復任務導向訓練之軟體機械手套設計與開發：整合雙腔室設計與柔性磁彈性感測器

14204925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14204925.value: Prof Leung, Wai Hong Thomas Prof Yip, Yiu-wan Prof Zhang, Li

14204925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14204925.value: In recent years, there has been growing interest in developing advanced robotic technologies to assist individuals in regaining hand movement, especially those recovering from strokes or injuries. This research proposal aims to create innovative gloves that enhance hand rehabilitation through a unique combination of soft actuators and advanced sensing systems. Our primary goal is to design a soft robotic device that mimics the natural movements of the human hand while providing real-time feedback through integrated sensors that measure crucial touch and grip forces. We will develop custom-fitted gloves for stroke patients, utilizing a state-of-the-art handheld 3D scanner to capture the precise anatomy of each patient’s hand. The novelty of our design lies in the dual-chamber actuators incorporated into the thumb, index, and middle fingers, which facilitate two degrees of freedom, enabling complex movements such as flexion, extension, abduction, and adduction. This innovative mechanism allows users to grip and manipulate a diverse range of objects more effectively, which is essential for daily activities. Moreover, our flexible magnetoelastic sensors will not only provide precise measurements of posture and contact force but also contribute valuable data on fingertip-object interactions. This integration enhances the capabilities of object manipulation during rehabilitation exercises, ultimately improving the efficacy of task-oriented training (TOT) protocols tailored for hand rehabilitation. Additionally, we will implement a novel control system that combines the sensing glove with soft actuators, featuring a hybrid force and position control mechanism. This system will leverage electromyography (EMG) signals for intention detection, and regulating the movement and the contact for different tasks and objects, ensuring adaptive and precise control for rehabilitation tasks. Finally, a systematic clinical study involving sixty stroke patients divided into three groups will evaluate the effectiveness of our innovative design compared to conventional rehabilitation methods. By conducting a randomized controlled trial (RCT), we aim to provide robust evidence on the benefits of our advanced robotic glove design in stroke rehabilitation. We hope our work will significantly advance the field of rehabilitation robotics by improving therapeutic practices, enhancing recovery outcomes, and elevating the quality of life for those facing hand mobility challenges. By integrating new soft robotic glove design with practical application, we aim to create an effective rehabilitation solution for everyone who needs it. 開發一款整合雙腔室致動器與柔性磁彈性感測器的軟體機械手套，以提升中風患者的任務導向訓練成效。研究包含三大目標，分別針對硬體設計、控制系統開發及臨床驗證進行深入探討。 首先，本研究將設計專為拇指、食指與中指開發的雙腔室致動器系統。此創新設計可實現兩個自由度的運動控制，使患者手指在操作不同物體時能靈活調整姿勢。配合精心設計的柔性磁彈性感測器，系統能精確量測指尖與物體間的接觸力，為復健過程提供量化數據支持。這種硬體配置不僅能有效輔助手指完成伸展與抓握動作，更能擴展患者在日常生活活動中的操作能力範圍。相較於傳統復健手套，本設計特別強調對精細動作控制的支援，使患者能進行更為多樣化的功能性訓練。 其次，研究團隊將開發一套基於使用者意圖的即時適應性控制系統。該系統整合肌電圖訊號感測、雙腔室致動器與磁彈性感測器，形成一個閉環控制架構。系統核心採用混合力與位置控制策略，能根據患者實際表現動態調整輔助力度。透過"按需輔助"演算法，系統可針對個別患者的恢復程度提供客製化訓練方案。這種設計不僅能維持患者在訓練過程中的主動參與度，更能促進大腦運動功能的重塑，對於神經復健尤為重要。 最後，為驗證系統的臨床效益，本研究將進行嚴謹的隨機對照試驗。試驗計劃招募中風患者，隨機分為三組：任務導向訓練組、傳統手部開合訓練組及對照組。評估指標包括握力測試、功能性任務表現量表，以及日常生活活動能力評量。研究特別關注新型手套設計在精細動作控制與多樣化物件操作方面的優勢，期望能證實其相較於傳統方法的臨床價值。試驗結果將為軟體機械輔具在中風復健領域的應用提供實證依據。

14205625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14205625.value: 基於機器學習的二進制代碼信息恢復技術研究

14205625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14205625.value: In this project, we aim to explore innovative techniques for effective information recover from binary code by merging two complementary approaches. Our core idea is to enhance traditional rule-based methods through the integration of machine learning models. By combining these cutting-edge strategies, we anticipate achieving significantly better results than those obtained by employing either technique in isolation. Binary code analysis is important. As the behavior of computer systems is determined by the executable binary code running on them, binary analysis can have great impacts on system security, including but not limited to virus detection and vulnerability discovery. In essence, binary code analysis involves recovering various types of information(like variable types, function signatures, etc.) that are lost when compiling source code into executable binaries. The more information that can be recovered, the more effective the analysis will be for binary code analysis tasks. Existing techniques for binary code analysis use either traditional approaches based on rules and heuristics, and machine learning (ML) methods that rely on large volumes of training data. Each category has its strengths and limitations, and this proposal is based on the insight that these techniques are complementary. Guided by this insight, we aim to investigate novel methods and machine learning algorithms to enhance traditional binary code analysis techniques. Specifically, we will concentrate on the following three tasks. (1)Given a simple disassembler using the single rule of linear sweep, how can we enhance it with ML models to make the quality of its output comparable to other tools, and keep the human involvement minimized by letting machine learning models to uncover subtle disassembly rules for improved results. This important because the quality of disassemblers will have huge impacts on down-steam applications. (2) How to lift binary code into Intermediate Representation with the assistance of ML models. Existing lifters are either purely machine learning-based or rule-based; however, ML-based methods often lack guarantees of lifting correctness, while rule-based methods struggle to achieve optimal efficiency and completeness. We will study how integrating ML techniques into rule-based methods can yield better results. (3) Enhancing indirect call discovery through ML-based type information recovery algorithms is crucial. Existing methods leverage type information to identify indirect calls, and we aim to investigate whether using a machine learning-based type information recovery model can produce better results. The system security community and industry can benefit from this project with more effective algorithms and better tools. 二進制代碼分析是一項非常重要的任務，對系統安全性有重大影響。這是因為計算機系統的行為是由運行在其上的可執行二進制代碼決定的，要對系統進行病毒檢測或者發現系統漏洞都離不開二進制代碼分析。本質上，二進制代碼分析涉及恢復在將源代碼編譯為可執行二進制檔時丟失的各種資訊（如變量類型、函數原型等）。能夠恢復的資訊越多，二進制代碼分析任務的有效性就越高。現有的二進制代碼分析技術使用傳統的基於規則和啟發式的方法，以及依賴大量訓練數據的機器學習（ML）方法。 本提案通過分析指出了這兩種技術都有其優點和缺點，並提出了兩種技術路線是互補的見解。在這一見解的指導下，我們將通過結合兩種互補的方法，探索有效從二進制代碼中恢復資訊的創新技術。我們的核心思想是通過整合機器學習模型來增強傳統的基於規則的方法。通過結合這些前沿策略，我們預期能夠實現比單獨採用任一技術更顯著的結果。具體而言，我們將集中關注以下三個任務。 （1）給定一個使用線性掃描單一規則的簡單反匯編器，如何通過機器學習模型增強其功能，使其輸出質量可與現有工具相媲美，並通過讓機器學習模型發現微妙的反匯編規則來最小化人類參與。 （2）如何在機器學習模型的幫助下將二進制代碼提升為中間表示。現有的提升工具要麼完全基於機器學習，要麼基於規則；然而，基於機器學習的方法往往缺乏提升正確性的保證，而基於規則的方法則難以實現最佳效率和完整性。我們將研究如何將機器學習技術整合到基於規則的方法中，以獲得更好的結果。 （3）借助機器學習的類型資訊恢復演算法，來提高間接函數調用的識別準確率。現有方法利用類型資訊識別間接調用，我們旨在研究在二進位程式分析的場景下，如何使用基於機器學習的類型資訊恢復模型，以產生更好的結果。

14205925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14205925.value: 基於擴散模型的數據通路電路優化

14205925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14205925.value: The rapid advancement of semiconductor technology necessitates innovative methods for circuit design that are efficient, scalable, and adaptable to evolving requirements. This proposal addresses a critical challenge in datapath circuit optimization: achieving automated optimization that balances Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) metrics effectively. Current methods struggle to find Pareto-optimal designs due to the vast size of the design space, particularly for increasingly complex datapath circuits used in modern processors. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel diffusion-driven optimization framework for designing datapath circuits, such as adders, multipliers, floating-point units (FPUs), and arithmetic logic units (ALUs). Our approach leverages the generative capabilities of diffusion models, which are particularly effective in exploring large and complex design spaces while capturing intricate dependencies among circuit elements. Additionally, we employ a multimodal-aligned PPA predictor to provide early estimations of design quality, enhancing the diffusion process by predicting critical PPA metrics during optimization. By incorporating domain-specific constraints directly into the diffusion process, our framework ensures the generation of legal, high-quality circuit designs. Moreover, we enhance this exploration process by integrating reinforcement learning (RL), which uses predicted PPA as reward functions to guide the model towards efficient convergence and higher-quality solutions. Our research aims to establish an automated and scalable methodology for optimizing datapath circuits. We will benchmark our diffusion-driven framework against industry-standard IP cores (e.g., Synopsys DesignWare) and state-of-the-art RL-based methods, demonstrating substantial gains in PPA metrics, reduced computational overhead, and improved scalability. Specifically, we anticipate achieving up to 15% reduction in the area delay product compared to state-of-the-art solutions. These advancements pave the way for significant contributions: academically, by introducing a new paradigm for applying generative models in electronic design automation (EDA); practically, by providing a pathway to reduce design costs, improve chip performance, and accelerate time-to-market for semiconductor products. By addressing key challenges in circuit design, our work will help transform design practices, making them more capable of meeting the demands of next-generation computing systems, from consumer electronics to AI accelerators. 半導體技術的快速發展，使電路設計需要更高效、更具擴充性且能靈活適應未來需求的新方法。本計劃針對資料路徑（datapath）電路最佳化的核心挑戰，提出創新的自動化最佳化方法，以有效地平衡功耗（Power）、效能（Performance）及面積（Area）三項關鍵指標（統稱PPA）。目前的方法受限於設計空間龐大複雜，難以找到理想的帕雷托（Pareto）最優解，尤其在現代處理器所需的複雜資料路徑電路中，問題尤為嚴重。 為突破這些挑戰，我們提出以擴散模型（Diffusion Model）為核心的創新電路最佳化框架，專注於資料路徑電路設計，例如加法器、乘法器、浮點運算單元（FPU）及算術邏輯單元（ALU）等。我們的方法善用擴散模型卓越的生成能力，能有效探索龐大複雜的設計空間，並掌握電路元件間錯綜複雜的相依性。同時，我們搭配多模態對齊（multimodal-aligned）的PPA預測模型，在設計初期便能估算關鍵的設計品質指標，以提升擴散模型的搜尋效率。此外，我們將領域特定的設計限制直接融入擴散生成過程，確保產生的電路設計合法且具高品質。進一步地，我們整合強化學習（Reinforcement Learning, RL）技術，以預測的PPA作為獎勵函數，指引模型更有效率地收斂至更優的解決方案。 本計劃的研究目標，是建立一套自動化且具良好擴展性的資料路徑電路最佳化方法。我們將與業界標準的IP核（如Synopsys DesignWare）及目前最先進的強化學習方法進行比較，預期可達成顯著的PPA效能提升，並降低計算成本和提高方法的擴充性。具體而言，我們預期可較當前最先進的技術減少最高達15%的「面積-延遲積」（Area-Delay Product）。 這項研究的突破性貢獻包含學術與實務層面：在學術上，我們將為電子設計自動化（EDA）領域引入生成模型應用的新範式；在實務上，我們的方法有助於降低晶片設計成本、提升晶片效能，並加速半導體產品上市時間。透過解決電路設計領域的重要挑戰，我們的研究將促成設計方法的轉型，更好地滿足下一代計算系統的需求，涵蓋消費電子到AI加速器等多樣領域。

14206125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206125.value: 解耦多靶視覺語言導航磁驅膠囊機器人

14206125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14206125.value: Prof Bakheet, Nader Prof LI, Zhen Prof Tang, Raymond Shing-yan Prof Yuan, Wu

14206125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206125.value: Capsule endoscopy is a noninvasive diagnostic technique gaining significant global traction for visualizing the gastroduodenal tract. As a disposable alternative to traditional endoscopes, capsule endoscopy reduces the risks associated with flexible endoscopy, including infection, bleeding, and perforation. However, current capsule endoscopes are limited to passive observation and lack the capability for multi-targeting interventions. This limitation underscores the urgent need for a new generation of swallowable robots capable of performing multi-target biopsies and drug release in a single endoscopy session, thereby enhancing diagnostic efficiency and patient comfort. Existing swallowable capsule robots struggle with multi-targeting and effective navigation within the viscous environments of the gastroduodenal tract. This proposal introduces the development of the Magnetically Actuated Gastroduodenal Intervention Capsule robot to overcome these challenges. Our research focuses on four key objectives: 1) Decoupled Multi-targeting Capabilities: Enhance the robot’s ability to target multiple sites within the gastroduodenal tract, improving its diagnostic and therapeutic efficiency. The capsule biopsy module ensures sufficient tissue collection for clinically significant diagnostics by overcoming the limitations of conventional single-sample endoscopy. 2) Ultra-steerability: Develop advanced modeling and control strategies to ensure precise decoupled manipulation through the complex gastroduodenal mucus environment. 3) Simultaneous Tracking and Mapping: Implement real-time tracking and mapping technologies alongside self-supervised learning algorithms to accurately reconstruct endoscopic scenes and facilitate situation-aware navigation. 4) Intelligent Capsule Navigation: Develop vision and language processing modules to translate visual and linguistic inputs into actionable navigation maneuvers, validated through comprehensive case studies. The impact of this research is significant, as the proposed key technologies are set to meet essential clinical needs of multi-target interventions in a single capsule endoscopy session, thereby decreasing the frequency of conventional invasive endoscopy and minimizing patient risk. The potential benefits of this innovation are substantial: by increasing the efficiency and precision of endoscopic interventions, the proposed technologies can foster earlier and more accurate diagnoses. This innovative technology promises to minimize side effects while lowering healthcare costs through improved multi-function interventions by swallowable capsule robots. The proposed intelligent navigation technology in complex anatomical environments also addresses challenges associated with difficult-to-handle conditions during capsule endoscopy. In summary, this proposal aims to improve endoscopic practices by delivering an intelligent and adaptable capsule robotic multi-targeting solution for gastroduodenal tract examinations and treatments. Ultimately, the potential applications of these swallowable capsule robots are vast, enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of endoscopic procedures, advancing minimally invasive medical technologies and improving patient outcomes. 現有的膠囊機器人在胃十二指腸道的粘稠環境中面臨多目標定位和有效導航的挑戰。我們研究磁力驅動膠囊機器人以克服這些挑戰。專注於四個主要目標：1) 解耦多目標定位能力：增強機器人針對胃十二指腸道內多個部位的定位能力，提高其診斷和治療效率，克服傳統單樣本內視鏡的限制。2) 超高可操控性：開發先進的建模和控制機制，以確保在複雜的胃十二指腸粘液環境中精確導航。3) 同時追蹤和映射：實施實時追蹤和映射技術，並結合自我監督學習算法，準確重建內視鏡場景，感知導航。4) 智能膠囊導航：開發視覺和語言處理模塊，將視覺和語言輸入轉化為可行的導航操作。

14206325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206325.value: 一種用於自然腔道磁壓吻合術的新型機器人系統

14206325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206325.value: The aim of this project is to investigate robotic-assisted magnetic compression anastomosis (R-MCA) for non-invasive treatment of metabolic diseases, such as type-II diabetes and obesity, which are major global healthcare challenges nowadays. Bariatric surgery is highly effective in treating morbid obesity and diabetes. However, existing laparoscopic bariatric surgeries are traumatic, need long operation time, with postoperative pain, and costly. On the contrary, endoluminal approaches are non-invasive, with short operation time, less pain, and cost effective. Therefore, they have been gaining increasing interest. One promising approach is magnetic compression anastomosis (MCA), in which two magnets are placed inside the intestine through flexible endoscopes to create bypass. Compared to laparoscopic bariatric surgery, MCA is superior in forming anastomosis, reducing leaks, bleeding and strictures. However, existing MCA is still invasive and not widely adopted due to its technically challenges, particularly: 1) lack of real-time endoluminal magnets localization; 2) lack of effective endoluminal magnets delivery; and 3) lack of anastomosis pressure monitoring. As a result, current MCA relies on assistive laparoscopic tools to perform, and the magnets’ locations are measured intermittently by CT/X-Ray. To reveal the true benefits of MCA in treating metabolic disorders none-invasively, in this project, we propose a novel R-MCA. Three key technologies will be developed to address the challenges in existing MCA. At first, a multi-magnet localization system will be developed based on hall sensor arrays and wireless IMU, for 6D localization of multiple magnets. This helps to provide real-time localization of the endoluminal magnets, either intraoperatively or postoperatively. Secondly, a robotic magnetic actuation system and surgeon-robot collaborative control methods will be developed to provide autonomous lumen alignment and magnetic traction during flexible endoscope insertion. Together with the augmented endoscope view, this helps to reduce the complications in flexible endoscope insertion and enabling an effective, intuitive and safe magnet delivery. Thirdly, a magnetic compression force estimation method will be developed based on the magnets’ localization and the dipole model. This helps to continuously monitor the magnetic compression force and ensures a safe anastomosis. It is expected that our research could lead to a truly non-invasive, and safe MCA for treating metabolic diseases. We have a balanced team with strong track record, and we are confident in making this project a success, which could help to enhance Hong Kong’s position as a medical technology innovation hub both locally and internationally. 本計劃旨在研究機器人輔助磁力壓力吻合術（R-MCA）在胃腸道和代謝性疾病的非侵入性治療中的應用，這些疾病是當今全球醫療保健領域的重大挑戰。 到2022年，全球有超過10億人患有肥胖以及超過5億二型糖尿病患者。肥胖是第二型糖尿病的主要原因。減肥手術是治療病態肥胖的黃金標準，因為它比非手術方法更有效。根據肥胖外科聯合會（IFSO）的統計數據，超過99%的現有手術都是在腹腔鏡下進行的。然而，腹腔鏡減重手術創傷大、手術時間長、術後疼痛嚴重且費用昂貴。相反，自然腔道手術是一種非侵入性手術，手術時間短、疼痛輕且經濟實惠，因此越來越受到人們的關注。磁力壓力吻合術 (MCA)透過柔性內視鏡放置兩塊磁鐵來建立腸道旁路，是一種頗具前景的方法。與減肥手術相比，MCA 操作簡單且吻合口特性更佳，例如更高的抗拉強度和更好的癒合效果。然而，現有的 MCA 由於技術難度大而未能廣泛應用，具體問題包括：1）缺乏即時腔內磁體定位；2）缺乏有效的腔內磁體操控；3）缺乏吻合口壓力監測。因此，目前的 MCA 手術依賴腹腔鏡工具進行，並透過X光間歇性地測量磁鐵的位置。 為了發掘 MCA 在治療代謝性疾病方面的真正優勢，本計劃提出了一種新型機器人輔助磁應激吻合術 (R-MCA)。我們將開發三項關鍵技術來解決現有 MCA 的問題。首先，我們將基於霍爾傳感器陣列、三角測量原理和最優化方法開發一套多磁體定位系統，實現多磁體的六維即時定位。這有助於在術中或術後即時定位腔內磁體。其次，我們將開發一套混合磁驅動系統，在三維空間中提供所需方向的磁力/扭力。結合腔道偵測和磁體定位，磁力/扭力可與腸腔方向一致，從而方便磁體操控。第三，我們將基於磁鐵定位和偶極子模型開發一種磁壓力估算方法。這有助於即時監測磁力壓力，確保安全的MCA操作。我們的研究有望推動MCA成為一種真正非侵入性且安全的代謝疾病治療手段。

14206525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206525.value: 二次約束二次規劃中半正定鬆弛緊性與優化地形的關係

14206525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206525.value: Quadratically constrained quadratic programs (QCQPs) are ubiquitous in applications and have been extensively studied over the decades. One powerful technique for tackling this important class of optimization problems is the semidefinite relaxation technique. Although there is a large body of literature on establishing the tightness of semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations of structured QCQPs, the results therein typically do not yield scalable algorithms for solving those QCQPs. In recent years, there has been much interest in lightweight iterative methods that can directly tackle certain classes of possibly non-convex QCQPs and possess strong convergence guarantees. However, the convergence analyses of most existing methods are conducted on a problem-by-problem basis and do not exploit the fact that the QCQPs in question often have tight SDP relaxations. In a recent pilot study, the PI and his PhD students have identified some conditions under which it is possible to infer the optimization landscape of a QCQP from its tight SDP relaxation. This provides a powerful new approach to analyzing the convergence behavior of various iterative methods when applied to the QCQP. In particular, by applying this approach to a QCQP formulation of the phase synchronization problem, we are able to obtain sharper result than that in the literature, thereby demonstrating the potential of our approach. In this project, we intend to explore thoroughly the research directions manifested in our pilot study. The outcomes will not only contribute to our understanding of the relationship between the optimization landscape of a QCQP and the tightness of its SDP relaxation but also give impetus to further research in this fundamental topic. 現有關於二次約束二次規劃的研究集中在設計有效的半正定鬆弛與高效並具收斂保證的一階算法兩方面。前者的技巧具有廣泛的應用性，但現有用於求解半正定鬆弛的算法並不能有效地解決大規模問題。後者的算法雖然在計算上有很高的效率，但其分析高度依賴問題的結構，致使所用的技巧並不能輕易地推廣到不同的問題。本項目旨在研究二次約束二次規劃中，半正定鬆弛的緊性與優化地形的關係。本項目的成果將為求解具結構的二次約束二次規劃的數值算法提供一個有系統的分析框架，從而推動求解該類問題的高效數值算法的研究。

14206625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206625.value: 大模型驅動的可擴展和複雜圖問題的解決

14206625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206625.value: Large Language Models (LLMs) have largely transformed the natural language processing landscape but have not yet realized their potential in graph computation - a vital component of data science and database systems. Graph computation is essential for analyzing complex networks like social media graphs, biological systems, transportation networks, and knowledge graphs. While graph computational problems, such as shortest path and graph edit distance, have been investigated in graph theory, real-world queries over graphs are often more complex and contain richer semantics. For example, temporal, spatial, and node/edge label constraints can be imposed to the shortest path problem to make the answer more realistic and useful. However, classical algorithms may not be trivially extended to handle such constraints or data semantics. This project aims to leverage and further push LLMs' capabilities for scalable and complex graph computation by addressing three key challenges. First, LLMs have the potential to serve as high-level task planners, interpreting intricate queries and breaking them down into manageable graph computational tasks. This requires a deep understanding of user intent and the ability to translate and decompose complex queries into fundamental graph operations. Second, in order to serve the role of a task planner, LLMs must be equipped to handle both the semantic richness and structural nuances of graph data, which is challenging due to graphs' non-linear, permutation-invariant nature. Third, scaling LLMs for large graphs calls for the ability to overcoming the context length limitations and developing efficient computational techniques. We propose a comprehensive framework consisting of three main components. First, we will design methodologies that enable LLMs to act as a task planner, translating user queries over a graph expressed in natural language into a graph computational problem and decomposing it into a sequence of fundamental graph tasks. Second, we will develop advanced encoding techniques to capture the semantic and structural features of graph data, enabling LLMs to understand the complex structures more precisely. Third, we will implement a scalable system using dynamic partitioning of large graphs into smaller subgraphs and a mixture-of-experts model for specialized processing, which will optimize the performance while preserving essential graph information. The outcome of this research can democratize access to advanced graph analytics, allowing a broader spectrum of users to utilize these capabilities. By bridging the gap between the user query intent and graph computation, our project aims to significantly enhance the efficiency and usability of graph processing in various fields. 大語言模型在自然語言處理領域已經帶來了重大變革，但在圖計算方面尚未實現其潛力，而圖計算是數據科學和數據庫系統的重要組成部分。圖計算對於分析複雜網絡（如社交媒體圖、生物系統、交通網絡和知識圖譜）至關重要。儘管圖論已經研究了很多圖計算問題，例如最短路徑和頂點覆蓋等，但現實世界中對圖的查詢往往更為複雜，並包含更豐富的語義。例如，可以對最短路徑問題施加時間、空間和節點/邊標籤約束，以使答案更具現實性和實用性。然而，傳統演算法可能無法輕易擴展以處理這些約束或數據語義。 本項目旨在通過解決三個關鍵挑戰，利用並推動大語言模型在可擴展和複雜圖計算方面的能力。首先，大語言模型有潛力作為高級任務規劃器，解釋複雜查詢並將其拆解為可管理的圖計算任務。這需要對用戶意圖的深入理解，以及將複雜查詢轉換和分解為基本圖操作的能力。其次，作為任務規劃器，大語言模型必須能夠處理圖數據的語義豐富性和結構細微差異，這對於圖的非線性和排列不變性質來說是具有挑戰性的。第三，為了擴展到大型圖，大語言模型需要克服上下文長度的限制並開發高效的計算技術。 我們提出了一個包含三個主要組件的綜合研究框架。首先，我們將設計方法使大語言模型作為任務規劃器，將用戶在自然語言中表達的圖查詢轉換為圖計算問題。其次，我們將開發先進的編碼技術，以捕捉圖數據的語義和結構特徵，使大語言模型能夠更有效地推理這些複雜結構。第三，我們將實施一個可擴展的系統，通過動態將大型圖劃分為較小的子圖，並使用專家混合模型優化性能，保留重要的圖資訊。 本研究的成果將讓更廣泛的用戶群體能夠利用複雜圖計算的能力。通過縮短用戶查詢意圖與圖計算之間的距離，我們的研究旨在顯著提高各領域圖數據處理的效率和可用性。

14206725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206725.value: 基於膠囊內鏡的智能腸胃道疾病分析：三維重建、感知與建模

14206725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206725.value: Gastrointestinal (GI) diseases significantly impact global health, affecting approximately 40% of the global population. In 2020, the WHO reported 1.9 million new GI disease cases and over 930,000 deaths, with projections indicating a critical increase of 63%, reaching 3.2 million cases annually by 2040. Early detection is crucial for improving survival rates. For instance, the 5-year survival rate for stage I colorectal cancer is 90%, compared to 8% for stage IV. Hence, advancements in robust and efficient GI tract screening technologies, such as capsule endoscopy, are imperative for enhancing early GI diagnosis. However, traditional diagnostic solutions are hindered by low-quality and inflexible captured-2D images, resulting in a time-consuming diagnostic process that takes approximately two hours per patient. The key challenges include 1) the difficulty of assessing the gastrointestinal environment with low-quality and noisy videos; 2) limitations in observing lesions from various viewpoints, which impede prompt diagnosis; and 3) the labor-intensive nature of generating detailed medical reports and treatment plans that require extensive expert knowledge. The project aims to propose an intelligent capsule endoscopy via reconstruction, perception and modeling for automatic gastrointestinal disease analysis. Firstly, we will reconstruct 3D gastrointestinal tract based on medical prior information that transforms low-dimensional video streams into high-quality 3D scenes, thereby enhancing visualizations of gastrointestinal environments. To address the efficiency requirements of edge clinical devices, we will further develop a lightweight algorithm to offer rapid and accurate reconstruction. Secondly, building on this 3D reconstruction, we will develop a dynamic rendering algorithm that enables detailed perception of disease areas from different views, along with a panoramic diagnostic model to assist clinicians in accurately identifying lesion types. Thirdly, for modeling clinical follow-up, we propose an automated video report generation model with extensive medical knowledge to advance personalized medical evaluation. This is followed by a 3D surgical simulation platform that enables clinicians to perform preoperative rehearsals in a virtual environment, thereby enhancing the safety of surgical planning. Lastly, we plan to integrate these techniques into an intelligent capsule endoscopy framework and develop a graphical user interface for validation and visualization. This project represents pioneering efforts to comprehensively investigate the automation of capsule endoscopy. We have obtained preliminary results for the proposed research tasks with our already available dataset to confirm the feasibility of this project. The innovative techniques can significantly advance capsule endoscopy and provide insights into autonomous endoscopic robotics, thereby greatly enhancing intelligence and autonomy for clinical practice. 胃腸道疾病嚴重威脅全球健康，約40%的世界人口受其影響。世界衛生組織數據顯示，2020年新增190萬例胃腸道病例，死亡人數超93萬，據預測，到2040年病例數將激增63%，達到每年320萬例。早期診斷對提高生存率至關重要：一期結直腸癌患者五年生存率達90%，而四期患者僅8%。因此，發展膠囊內鏡高效可靠的消化道篩查技術對提升早期診斷率具有重大意義。然而傳統診斷方法受限於低質量、非柔性的二維影像，導致每位患者的診斷耗時約兩小時，主要面臨三大挑戰：1) 低質量噪點視頻難以準確評估胃腸環境；2) 疾病多視角觀察受限延誤診斷；3) 詳細診療報告生成耗時長。 本項目擬通過三維重建、智能感知與臨床建模，開發智能膠囊內鏡自動分析系統。首先基於醫學先驗信息將低維視頻流轉換為高質量三維場景，實現胃腸環境可視化；針對臨床設備算力需求，將開發輕量化快速重建算法。其次在三維重建基礎上，開發支持病變多視角精細觀察的動態渲染算法，構建全景診斷模型輔助醫生精準識別病變類型。第三在開發融合醫學知識的自動化視頻報告生成系統以推進個性化評估，並構建三維手術模擬平臺實現虛擬術前演練，提升手術方案安全性。最後將構建智能膠囊內鏡框架，開發可視化驗證界面。

14206825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206825.value: 向量數據庫中的混合搜索：索引設計，算法與實現

14206825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206825.value: The rapid advancement of machine learning has led to the widespread adoption of using machine learning models to convert various types of unstructured data such as texts, images, videos, and audios into high-dimensional vector representations. Vector databases have emerged as a new class of specialized databases that store these vector embeddings and provide various querying capabilities to leverage this data. Applications of vector databases include video search, movie recommendation, and, more recently, Retrieval-Augmented-Generation (RAG) for Large-Language-Models (LLMs). At the core of a vector database is its vector search capability. Unlike traditional database searches, vector searches are usually approximate due to the high dimensionality of the vectors. For instance, when a user searches for a product by uploading a picture Q taken with a cellphone, no one expects to find a product with an image identical to Q. Instead, users anticipate retrieving products that are semantically similar to Q. Therefore, in a vector database, a basic vector search can be defined as follows: given a query vector Q, retrieve from the database D the top-k vectors V = {v1, v2, · · · , vk} that are the most similar to Q based on a chosen similarity measure (e.g., Euclidean distance or inner product). Vector databases are still in their infancy and mostly support only basic search functionalities. In practice, many use cases demand query semantics that extend beyond simple vector searches. For instance, when searching for products by uploading a picture Q, a user may also want to specify a price range for the search results. This type of hybrid search, also known as attribute filtering, combines vector search in an embedding space with a traditional filtering on non-vector (e.g., numeric, categorical) attributes. Unfortunately, most state-of-the-art indexes are designed solely for basic vector searches, and the introduction of hybrid search often disrupts their balance between latency and result quality. Full support for hybrid search could revolutionize vector databases into their next generation. In this project, our goal is to bridge the gap by developing novel index structures and query processing algorithms that efficiently support hybrid searches in vector databases. Our outcomes will encompass not only cutting-edge index designs and efficient algorithms but also their high-performance implementations on modern hardware. Additionally, we will examine various system aspects related to integrating our work into open-source vector databases, including disk-based indexing and auto-tuning. 隨著機器學習的快速發展，越來越多的應用開始使用機器學習模型將各種非結構化數據轉換為高維向量表示。向量數據庫作為一種新型專用數據庫，存儲這些向量嵌入並提供各種查詢功能，以充分利用這些數據。 向量數據庫的核心是其向量搜索能力。與傳統數據庫搜索不同，向量搜索通常是近似的，因為向量的高維度使得精確匹配變得困難。向量數據庫仍處於起步階段，目前主要支持基本搜索功能。許多使用案例需要超越簡單向量搜索的查詢語義。 全面支持混合搜索將使向量數據庫進入下一代。我們的目標是通過開發新型索引結構和查詢處理算法，來縮小這一差距，有效支持向量數據庫中的混合搜索。我們的成果將包括尖端的索引設計和高效的算法，以及在現代硬件上的高性能實現。此外，我們還將研究與將我們的工作整合到開源向量數據庫相關的各種系統方面。

14206925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206925.value: 通過通用形狀優化方法逆向設計具有優異彈性與強度的新型殼式點陣結構

14206925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206925.value: Recent advances in additive manufacturing techniques have facilitated the design, fabrication, and application of lattice metamaterials with intricate microarchitectures. Lattice metamaterials are typically categorized into truss, plate, and shell lattices by the elementary structural type. Albeit exhibiting the highest stiffness/strength, the closed-cell property complicates the fabrication and application of plate lattices. In contrast, truss lattices possess open-cell topology, but their stiffness/strength are far from optimal. Shell lattices achieve a balance between the open-cell topology and mechanical properties and are extensively studied, among which the most widely explored are those based on triply periodic minimal surfaces (TPMSs). However, TPMS shell lattices exhibit a limited design space and cannot achieve targeted mechanical properties, such as isotropic elasticity and auxeticity. Therefore, the design space of shell lattices should be further explored and systematically studied. Structural design comprises two main types of approaches: forward and inverse design. Forward design generally involves a time-consuming and labor-intensive trial-and-error process. Inverse design, in contrast, allows for the customization of structures based on the target properties. Structural optimization is the most widely used tool among all inverse design approaches, which tries to achieve the target properties by optimizing the size/shape/topology of structures. A number of existing studies have adopted size/shape/topology optimization to devise novel shell lattices with tailored properties. However, the optimization framework either employed a limited design space, or only targets specific types of shell lattices. Therefore, the development of a generic optimization framework for the inverse design of shell lattices to fully explore their design space is of great importance. Here, we propose a generic shape optimization framework to devise novel shell lattices. The mid-surface is represented by an implicit B-spline parameterized level-set function, which ensures its high-order continuity. The optimization algorithm is a gradient-based algorithm customized for shell lattices, based on which the design velocity at the mid-surface is derived for iterative optimization. This framework enables the optimization of the mid-surface shape to achieve different target mechanical properties, including isotropic elasticity, tailored auxeticity, maximized elastic modulus, and enhanced strength. Afterwards, several representative lattices will be fabricated via high-precision laser powder bed fusion, and quasi-static compression tests will be performed to validate their mechanical properties. The success of this project will significantly advance the design/optimization and application of shell lattices with exceptional elasticity and strength. It will also promote their applications in various engineering fields, such as thermal management, biomedical implants, chemical catalysts, etc. 增材製造技術的最新進展促進了具有複雜微結構的點陣超材料的設計、製備與應用。根據基本結構類型，點陣超材料通常可分為桁架、板式和殼式三類。雖然板式點陣展現出最高的剛度/強度，但其閉孔特性使製備與應用變得複雜。相比之下，桁架點陣具有開孔拓撲結構，但其剛度/強度遠未達到最優。殼式點陣在開孔拓撲與力學性能之間取得了平衡，因而被廣泛研究，其中最受關注的是基於三週期極小曲面（TPMS）的殼式點陣。然而TPMS殼式點陣的設計空間有限，無法實現各向同性彈性、負泊松比等目標力學性能。因此，亟需對殼式點陣的設計空間進行系統性探索。 結構設計主要包含正向設計與逆向設計兩類方法。正向設計通常需要耗費大量時間進行試錯，而逆向設計能根據目標性能定制結構。在各類逆向設計方法中，結構優化是最常用的工具，其通過優化結構的尺寸/形狀/拓撲來實現目標性能。現有研究已採用尺寸/形狀/拓撲優化來設計具有定制性能的新型殼式點陣，但這些優化框架要麼設計空間有限，要麼僅針對特定類型的殼式點陣。因此，開發通用優化框架以充分探索殼式點陣的逆向設計空間具有重要意義。 本研究提出一種通用的形狀優化框架來設計新型殼式點陣。通過隱式B樣條參數化水準集函數表徵中曲面，確保其高階連續性。優化演算法採用專為殼式點陣定制的基於梯度演算法，據此推導中曲面設計速度場進行反覆運算優化。該框架可通過中曲面形狀優化實現不同目標力學性能，包括各向同性彈性、定制負泊松比、最大化彈性模量及增強強度。隨後將採用高精度鐳射粉末床熔融技術製備若干代表性點陣，並通過准靜態壓縮試驗驗證其力學性能。 本專案成果將顯著推動具有優異彈性與強度的殼式點陣的設計優化及應用，並促進其在熱管理、生物醫學植入物、化學催化劑等工程領域的應用。

14207425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207425.value: 開發用於片上非線性光學和聲光學的鉭酸鋰集成光子學

14207425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207425.value: This proposal aims to develop an integrated photonic platform in lithium tantalate and harness its large second-order nonlinearities, piezoelectric, and photoelastic effects for on-chip nonlinear optics and acousto-optics. Photonic integrated circuits (PICs), with miniaturized optical components integrated on a single chip, have demonstrated their advantages of enhanced efficiency, operating speed, and functionality. Traditionally, PICs are realized mostly on silicon (Si), silicon nitride (SiN), or indium phosphide (InP) platforms. Si photonics allows for the seamless integration of photonics with microelectronics, facilitating high-speed large-capacity computation and communication. SiN photonics features low loss and broad optical transparency range, making it ideal for telecommunication and biosensing applications. InP photonics excels in active photonics, where efficient light emission and detection are crucial. These platforms support many applications in burgeoning fields such as robotics, smart sensing, and autonomous driving in our society. In recent years, the development of wafer-bonding technology enabled PICs on thin-film lithium niobate, which has remarkable electro-optic and piezoelectric properties. With advantages in high-speed modulation, thin-film lithium niobate is considered a promising platform for the development of integrated photonics. However, further investigations have revealed the problems in this material including large photorefraction, high birefringence, and slow relaxation of its electro-optic response, which causes poor DC stability of on-chip electro-optic modulators. Compared with lithium niobate, lithium tantalate has the electro-optic and piezoelectric effects at similar levels, but benefits from a higher optical damage threshold, a broader transparency window, lower birefringence, lower microwave loss, and more stable electro-optic response. These advantages make lithium tantalate a better material for the development of next-generation PICs. Here, we propose to develop an integrated photonic platform in lithium tantalate, by demonstrating a photonic integrated circuit with the elementary components. Our preliminary attempts on the fiber-to-chip coupling interface, waveguide, and microring structures have shown promising results. We plan to harness the large second-order nonlinearities, piezoelectric, and photoelastic effects of this material to demonstrate on-chip nonlinear optical and acousto-optic processes on the lithium tantalate integrated photonic platform. This proposal has great significance to both fundamental physics and practical applications. With the superior properties of lithium tantalate, we will realize high-performance, high-stability acousto-optic devices on a chip, which will benefit the areas of signal processing and optical communication. We also expect the demonstrated on-chip nonlinear optical process to be exploited in classical nonlinear optics applications such as frequency comb generation and in quantum optics applications such as entangled photon-pair generation. 本提案旨在開發鉭酸鋰的集成光子平台，並利用其強二階非線性、壓電及光彈效應，應用於片上的非線性光學與聲光學。 光子集成迴路 (PIC) 將微型化的光學元件集成在單一芯片上，已展示其高效、高速和多功能性的優勢。傳統上，PIC 大多在矽 (Si)、氮化矽 (SiN) 或磷化銦 (InP) 的平台上實現。矽光子學可將光子學與微電子學完美集成，促進高速大容量運算與通訊。SiN 光子學具有低損耗和寬光學透明範圍的特點，使其成為電訊和生物傳感應用的理想選擇。InP 光子學在有源光子學方面表現優異，在此領域中，高效的光發射和探測至關重要。這些平台給我們社會許多蓬勃發展領域的應用提供支持，例如機械人、智能傳感和自動駕駛等。 近年來，晶圓鍵合技術的發展使得薄膜鈮酸鋰上的 PIC 得以實現。鈮酸鋰具有顯著的電光和壓電特性，薄膜鈮酸鋰具有高速調製的優勢，被認為是用於開發集成光子學的頗具前景的平台。然而，進一步的研究發現，這種材料存在大的光折射效應、高的雙折射以及慢的電光響應弛豫等問題，導致片上電光調製器的直流穩定性差。與鈮酸鋰相比，鉭酸鋰的電光和壓電效應水平相當，但具有光損壞閾值更高、透明窗口更廣、雙折射效應更低、微波損耗更低及電光響應更穩定等優點。這些優點使得鉭酸鋰成為開發下一代 PIC 的更佳材料。 在此，我們提出開發鉭酸鋰集成光子平台，展示具有基本元件的光子集成迴路。我們在光纖到芯片耦合介面、波導和微環結構上的初步嘗試已獲得有希望的結果。我們計劃利用這種材料的強二階非線性、壓電和光彈效應，在鉭酸鋰集成光子平台上展示片上非線性光學和聲光過程。 這項提案對基礎物理和實際應用都有重大意義。憑藉鉭酸鋰的優越特性，我們將實現高性能、高穩定性的片上聲光器件，這將有益於信號處理和光通訊領域。我們還期待所展示的片上非線性光學過程能用於經典非線性光學應用（如頻率梳產生）和量子光學應用（如糾纏光子對產生）。

14208425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208425.value: 氣溫上升與城市化下香港短時極端降水時空結構變化

14208425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14208425.value: Prof Chen, Yongqin David Prof Dai, Qiang

14208425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208425.value: Local (e.g., precipitation area within tens or hundreds of km2) and short-duration (i.e., from minutes to hours) extreme rainstorm events are one of the most emerging threats to the sustainable development of highly urbanized and populated cities because of their suddenness and tremendous impacts. Extensive studies have demonstrated that under global warming, temporal structure of rainfall events tends to be more concentrated around the occurrence of the peak and less distributed to other times during the rainfall duration. At the same time, short-term intense rainstorm events may suddenly occur in a particular small area within a city, but the rainfall in other parts of the city may be much less extreme. For instance, the extreme rainstorm on 4 May 2024 in Hong Kong was highly localized in the eastern regions of Hong Kong with an hourly rainfall of 145.5 mm (i.e., double of the rainfall intensity of the city’s highest rainstorm alert level - 70 mm/hour), while the rainfall in the majority of other regions of the city was less extreme. Such highly localized (or called highly spatially heterogenous) extreme rainstorm events may lead to under-response to potential urban floodings in heavy rain areas, but over-response in less rainy areas of the city. Nevertheless, much more scientific evidence and knowledge about whether, how, and why the spatial structure of short-duration extreme rainstorm events within a city scale has changed are urgently needed to provide references for cities to improve prevention for such highly localized rainstorms. Dominated by humid subtropical monsoon climate, Hong Kong frequently experiences intensive rainstorms. As a compact city with an extremely dense population and intensive economic activities, this international financial centre is highly vulnerable to urban flooding. In the proposed project, we will identify and track short-duration extreme rainstorm events based on high-resolution radar data (~ 1 km and 6 mins) and in-situ observations. A new Copula-based metric will be developed to characterize the spatio-temporal heterogeneity of extreme rainstorm events. The complex dependence between spatial and temporal structures of rainstorm events will be represented by joint probability distributions. The changes in spatio-temporal structures of extreme rainstorm events in Hong Kong and the impacts of temperature rising and urbanization will be evaluated. The research findings will contribute to improving scientific understanding of responses of short-duration extreme rainstorm events to environmental changes, and also carry practical significance in enhancing engineering and planning of flood prevention and adaptation. 局地（如降水區域在數十到數百平方公里）且短時（如持續幾分鐘到數小時）極端降雨事件由於其突發性和巨大影響，已經成為高度城市化且人口密集城市可持續發展的最大威脅之一。大量研究已經表明在全球變暖的影響下，降雨事件的時間結構更趨向於集中在降雨強度峰值，而在降雨事件持續的其他時間分佈較少。同時，短時強降雨事件可能會突發地在城市特定的較小區域發生，但在城市的其他區域降雨強度卻不高。例如，香港於2024年5月4日經歷高度集中於東部地區的強降雨，每小時降雨強度達145.5毫米（該降雨強度相當於香港最高級暴雨警報閾值70毫米/小時標準的兩倍），而在城市大部分其他地區此次降雨不及如此強烈。這類高度局地化（亦稱高度空間異質性）極端降雨事件可能導致強降雨區域應對潛在城市洪水風險不足，而城市其他相對少雨區域出現過度響應。然而，城市尺度內的短時極端降雨事件的空間結構是否、如何以及為何發生變化仍需更多科學研究證據與認識，從而為城市提高應對此類高度局地化降雨的防範能力提供參考依據。香港受濕潤的亞熱帶季風氣候影響，強降雨事件頻繁。作為一座高度緊湊、人口極度密集且經濟活動頻繁的城市，香港作為國際金融中心對城市洪水特別敏感。本項目擬基於高分辨率雷達數據（空間分辨率約 1 公里、時間分辨率約 6 分鐘）和實地觀測以識別和追蹤短時極端強降雨事件。我們將開發一種新的基於Copula的指標用於描述極端降雨事件的時空異質性特徵。通過構建聯合概率分佈來表示降雨事件空間結構和時間結構之間複雜的依賴關係。本項目還將評估香港極端暴雨事件時空結構的變化，以及氣溫上升與城市化的影響。本研究的成果預計可提高短時極端降雨事件對環境變化響應的科學認識，並且在提升防洪工程規劃與適應方面具有實際意義。

14208525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208525.value: 使用低分辨率數據準確預測RNA三維結構

14208525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208525.value: Since the breakthrough of the protein field (2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry), RNA-centric studies have drawn significant attention due to their central roles in gene expression regulation. Because proteins and RNAs play different roles in our body, further development of RNA therapeutics could complement the current pharmaceutical industry substantially (2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine). High-resolution structural information of RNAs is therefore demanded for RNA drug development. However, experimentally resolving RNA structures is notoriously hard. As of Sep 2024, researchers have resolved 200000 protein structures but only around 2100 RNA-only structures. Thus, computational methods emerge to predict RNA structures. Among them, the PI’s group developed RhoFold in 2022, which was considered the best deep learning method in CASP15 by the AlphaFold3 (Nature, 2024) paper. The PI’s recent work on predicting RNA 3D structures, RhoFold+, was published in Nature Methods in 2024. Despite the existing methods, RNA structure prediction is still not accurate enough. It is hard to achieve breakthroughs if we only have limited resolved RNA 3D structures. Meanwhile, low-resolution RNA structural data, such as RNA secondary structure profiles, could provide additional information to our method and are much easier to obtain than 3D structures. Unfortunately, the information was ignored by all the existing deep learning methods, including AlphaFold3 and RhoFold+. Furthermore, the functionality of considering experimental data is requested by our end users. Therefore, the PI proposes to incorporate the low-resolution RNA structural data into RhoFold+ and improve RNA structure prediction. More specifically, in addition to RNA sequences and their evolutionary information, the proposed method can optionally accept RNA secondary structure profiles or low-resolution distance maps from Cryo-EM as inputs, by integrating advanced RNA language models and diffusion models. Preliminary experiments suggest that the simple incorporation of low-resolution secondary structural information could bring a 2.8% improvement regarding lDDT and an 8.4% improvement in TM-score, compared with AlphaFold3 (Nature, 2024). Considering the low-resolution 3D structural information, the method can improve the RNA structural modeling by 13% regarding lDDT and 6.5% regarding TM-score, compared with EMRNA (Nature Biotechnology, 2024). The PI will develop more advanced incorporation models to fully utilize the experimental low-resolution information with comprehensive evaluations in this project. Our approach will improve RNA structural prediction and accelerate complex RNA structure determination, such as G-quadruplexes, using experimental low-resolution data that are previously omitted by existing RNA structure prediction tools, and thus promote the RNA field. 自蛋白質領域取得突破性進展（2024年諾貝爾化學獎）以來，以RNA為中心的研究因其在基因表現調控中的核心作用而備受關注。由於蛋白質和RNA在人體中發揮不同的作用，RNA療法的進一步發展有望極大補充目前的製藥業（2023年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎）。而RNA藥物開發需要高分辨率的RNA結構資訊。 然而，透過實驗解析RNA結構極為困難。截至2024年9月，研究人員已解析出20萬個蛋白質結構，但僅解析出約2,100個純RNA結構。因此，預測RNA結構的計算方法應運而生。其中，PI團隊於2022年開發了RhoFold。 它被AlphaFold3 (Nature, 2024)評為CASP15-RNA結構預測最佳深度學習方法。 PI 最近關於預測 RNA 3D 結構的研究 RhoFold+ 於 2024 年發表在《Nature Methods》上。 儘管已有方法，RNA結構預測仍不夠準確。如果僅掌握有限的RNA三維結構訊息，很難取得突破。同時，低解析度RNA結構數據（例如RNA二級結構圖）可以為我們的方法提供更多信息，而且比三維結構更容易獲取。遺憾的是，所有現有的深度學習方法（包括AlphaFold3和RhoFold+）都忽略了這些資訊。此外，我們的用戶希望我們能夠考慮實驗數據的功能。 因此，PI建議將低解析度RNA結構資料整合到RhoFold+中，進一步改善RNA結構預測。更具體地說，除了RNA序列及其演化資訊外，該方法還可以透過整合高階RNA語言模型和擴散模型，選擇性地接受RNA二級結構圖或來自Cryo-EM的低解析度距離圖作為輸入。初步實驗表明，與 AlphaFold3 (Nature, 2024) 相比，單純引入低解析度二級結構資訊即可使 lDDT 得分提高 2.8%，TM-score 得分提高 8.4%。考慮到低解析度三維結構訊息，該方法與 EMRNA (Nature Biotechnology, 2024) 相比，可將 RNA 結構建模的 lDDT 得分提高 13%，TM-score 得分提高 6.5%。PI將開發更先進的引入模型，以充分利用實驗中的低解析度訊息，並進行全面的評估。 我們的方法將利用現有RNA結構預測工具先前忽略的實驗低解析度數據，改善RNA結構預測並加速複雜RNA結構測定，例如G-四鏈體，從而促進RNA領域的發展。

14208625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208625.value: 兩階段分散式穩健最佳化的漸進最優簡化

14208625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208625.value: Operational decisions are often characterized by two properties: they are dynamic and need to deal with uncertainties. An emergent modeling framework for operational decision-making is two-stage distributionally robust optimization (DRO). In these problems, the decision maker commits to a capacitated first-stage decision, anticipating that second-stage recourse decisions can be executed after observing the realization of the uncertain parameters. The DRO approach hedges against all possible probability distributions for the uncertain parameter within an ambiguity set and promotes a min-max objective function. Unfortunately, two-stage DRO problems are notoriously difficult to solve, and this computational intractability has hindered the proliferation of this framework in industrial-scale applications. This project proposes a novel perspective on two-stage DRO problems. We propose to separate the forecasting and operations teams into two agents and consider an information design problem with the forecasting team being the first mover. The forecasting team will search for a mechanism that takes the ambiguity set as input, outputs a simpler distribution, and communicates this to the operations team. The operations team will, then, solve a simpler optimization problem to obtain an approximative first-stage decision. This project will study the conditions under which the simplification mechanism induces asymptotically optimal first-stage decision, i.e., when the performance gap vanishes as the problem parameters increase. We will examine two exemplary cases for moment-based and data-driven Wasserstein ambiguity sets, and we will also study the contextual mechanism when side information is available. 動態性和不確定性是營運決策的兩個典型特徵。兩階段分佈魯棒優化（Distributionally Robust Optimization, DRO）作為新興營運決策框架，決策者需在第一階段做出具有容量約束的決策，並預期在觀測到不確定參數的實際取值後，可在第二階段執行相應的補償決策。 DRO方法透過考慮不確定參數在某一模糊集內所有可能的機率分佈，以最小-最大目標函數的形式進行風險對沖，從而增強決策的穩健性。然而，兩階段DRO問題以計算複雜著稱，嚴重限制了該框架在工業級應用中的廣泛推廣。 本計畫為兩階段DRO問題提供了新的研究視角，將預測團隊與決策團隊劃分為兩個獨立的代理人，並建構一個以預測團隊為先行動者的信息設計問題。預測團隊旨在尋找一種以模糊集為輸入、被簡化的機率分佈為輸出的機制，並將簡化分佈傳遞給決策團隊；決策團隊則基於此簡化分佈求解一個更易處理的最佳化問題，從而近似獲得第一階段最優決策。 本計畫將研究此簡化機制在何種條件下能夠誘導漸近最優的第一階段決策，即當問題規模或相關參數趨於無窮時，近似決策的表現將收斂於最優決策表現。本計畫主要關注矩資訊模糊集和資料驅動的Wasserstein模糊集兩類經典情形，並進一步探討在存在輔助資訊時的情境機制設計。

14208725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208725.value: 可大規模製備，響應季節性環境溫度和陽光入射角變化的智能窗

14208725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208725.value: Building consumes ~40% of global electricity and arouses a critical concern about sustainability. As the cause for ~47% of a building's heat loss, window becomes the Achilles’ heel of the whole building envelope regarding energy efficiency. Intensive studies have been conducted to develop energy saving smart windows: To name a few: smart windows that respond to different stimuli, integrate outgoing thermal radiation modulation, and introduce thermal storage functions. However, most smart windows designs assume a static, perpendicular sunlight incident angle. In reality, the angle of sunlight incident changes dynamically due to the earth's rotation and revolution around the sun. The overlooking of seasonal sunlight incident angle change leads to the inaccurate determination of the window’s solar modulation ability and energy saving performance. In this project, we aim to develop a new type of smart window that responds to ambient temperature and seasonal sunlight incident angle changes. The proposed dual-response smart window consists of a periodic thermal-responsive vanadium dioxide array, an underneath high transparency polymer spacer, and low-E layer coated glass. In summer, the array will suppress the near-infrared to block the elevated sunlight. In winter, the array becomes near-infrared transparent to allow the low-angle sunlight to transmit into the room. Meanwhile, the vanadium dioxide array, transparent spacer and the low-E layer form a Fabry-Perot resonator for outgoing thermal radiation control. Fabry-Perot resonator becomes highly emissive when the ambient temperature exceeds the transition temperature of vanadium dioxide to promote the sky toward outgoing thermal radiation. When the ambient temperature is below the transition temperature, outgoing thermal radiation is suppressed by the Fabry-Perot resonator with the low emissive state. With the help of industrial-compatible fabrication techniques such as spray coating and mesh printing, the proposed window will possess promising scalability. The preliminary results show that the proposed smart window design can modulate its solar transmittance and broadband IR emissivity in response to temperature and incident angle change. Based on the preliminary observations, we will research smart windows' structural design and material selection to obtain the desired regulation performance. Moreover, the fabrication process of the smart window will be optimized for large-scale production with low production costs. Furthermore, the energy saving potential of the proposed smart window will be evaluated via actual-building simulation and field tests. The knowledge generated in this project will inspire the development of green buildings and contribute to the United Nation’s Sustainable Development Goals. 建築消耗全球 ~40% 的電力，並引起了人們對可持續性問題的嚴重關注。由於窗戶消耗建築物 ~47% 的熱量損失，成為整個建築圍護結構的致命弱點。大量已經進行的節能智能窗的研究，僅舉幾例：智能窗戶響應不同刺激，熱輻射調製窗，儲熱功能窗。然而，大多數智慧窗戶設計假設靜態、垂直的陽光入射角。實際上，太陽光入射角度由於地球的自轉和公轉而動態變化， 忽視季節性陽光入射角變化會導致窗戶太陽能調製能力和節能測定的不準確。 在這個項目中，我們的目標是開發一種響應環境的新型智能窗戶， 能同時相應溫度和季節性陽光入射角變化。此智慧窗由週期性熱響應二氧化釩陣列組成，一個下面是高透明度腔和低 輻射塗層玻璃。夏天，該陣列將抑制近紅外線以阻擋陽光。在冬季，陣列變得近紅外透明，允許低角度陽光透射進入房間。同時，二氧化釩陣列、透明腔和低輻射層形成法布里-珀羅諧振器，用於熱輻射控制。當環境溫度超過相變溫度，諧振器會變得高發射，以促進向外熱輻射。當環境溫度低於相變溫度時，低發射狀態可以保溫。我們將採用噴塗等與工業相容製造技術，以備將來可放大性。初步結果表明所提出的智能窗設計可以根據響應溫度和入射角變化調製太陽透射率和的紅外發射率。基於初步觀察，我們將繼續研究智能窗戶的結構設計和材料選擇以獲得所需的調節性能。此外，智慧窗的製造流程將針對大規模生產降低成本。此外，節能潛力智能窗戶將通過實際建築模擬和現場測試進行評估。這該項目產生的知識將促進綠色建築的發展，並為聯合國的可持續發展目標做出貢獻。

14208925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208925.value: 分散式神經網絡：透過硬件與算法創新實現快速可重構光計算

14208925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208925.value: Conventional integrated circuits (ICs) are increasingly struggling to meet the demands of modern computing for large-scale optimization problems such as machine learning, combinatorial optimization, bioinformatics, and drug discovery. The demise of Moore’s Law exacerbates these challenges. Optical computing offers promising solutions due to the inherent parallelism and ultrafast dynamics of light waves, enabling the exploration of large solution spaces at unprecedented speeds. However, current optical computing systems face significant limitations in scalability and programming speed, which restrict their application spectrum. The limited scalability prevents them from tackling large, complex problems, while the lack of rapid programmability confines their use to inference tasks with fixed parameters, limiting their potential for AI training and adaptive learning, where parameters must be adjusted frequently and quickly. This project aims to overcome these challenges, particularly addressing the scalability and programmability issues in optical computing. We propose a novel system, the dispersive neural network (NN), which leverages chromatic dispersion and wavelength multiplexing to establish a large-scale multilayered NN using only a minimal number of optical components and delivering extreme energy efficiency. The dispersive NN can enable rapid data loading and programming at rates approaching 100 GHz. Furthermore, we propose an innovative algorithm to mitigate imperfections in high-speed signaling and programming, creating a robust and accurate optical computing system capable of operating at ultra-high speeds. Conventional high-speed systems often struggle with inaccuracies due to imperfections in optoelectronic components such as ADCs, DACs, and transceivers, which suffer from quantization errors and bandwidth limitations. To address this, we propose a sharpness-aware training (SAT) algorithm that exploits the geometry of the loss landscape to ensure reliable and accurate computation, even at ultra-fast speeds and line rates approaching 100 GHz. Our system will significantly broaden the scope of optical computing, particularly in applications requiring fast programmability. Finally, we will demonstrate the expanded application spectrum of our system with two impactful applications that make full use of its fast programmability. The first demonstration accelerates training and sampling in Generative AI models, reducing training times from several days to just minutes. The second is an optical Ising machine capable of efficiently navigating vast solution spaces to solve combinatorial optimization problems. With its extraordinary scalability, ultra-fast programmability, and enhanced accuracy, we envision the proposed system will bring the potential to transform fields like machine learning, optimization, and beyond. 傳統積體電路（IC）日益難以滿足現代計算對大規模優化問題的需求，例如機器學習、組合優化、生物資訊學和藥物發現。摩爾定律的終結更加劇了這些挑戰。光學計算憑藉光波固有的並行性和超快動力學特性，能以前所未有的速度探索龐大的解空間，因而提供了極具前景的解決方案。 然而，當前光學計算系統在可擴展性和編程速度方面面臨重大限制，這制約了其應用範圍。有限的可擴展性使其無法處理大型複雜問題，而缺乏快速可編程性則將其用途局限於參數固定的推理任務，限制了其在需要頻繁快速調整參數的AI訓練和自適應學習中的潛力。 本項目旨在克服這些挑戰，特別是解決光學計算中的可擴展性和可編程性問題。我們提出了一種創新系統——分散式神經網絡，該系統利用色散和波長多工技術，僅需極少數量的光學元件即可構建大規模多層神經網絡，並實現極高的能源效率。分散式神經網絡能實現接近100 GHz的快速數據加載和編程速度。 此外，我們提出了一種創新算法，以緩解高速信號傳輸和編程中的缺陷，從而建立一個強大且精確的超高速光學計算系統。傳統高速系統常因光電元件（如ADC、DAC和收發器）的量化誤差和頻寬限制而導致計算不準確。為解決這一問題，我們提出了一種銳度感知訓練算法，該算法利用損失函數的幾何特性，確保即使在接近100 GHz的超高速率和線路速率下，仍能實現可靠且精確的計算。 我們的系統將大幅擴展光學計算的應用範圍，特別是在需要快速編程的場景中。最後，我們將通過兩個充分利用系統快速可編程特性的重要應用，展示其廣泛的應用潛力。第一個演示是加速生成式AI模型的訓練和採樣，將訓練時間從數天縮短至僅需幾分鐘；第二個演示是一種光學伊辛機，能夠高效探索龐大的解空間以解決組合優化問題。憑藉其卓越的可擴展性、超快編程能力和更高的精確度，我們預期該系統將為機器學習、優化等領域帶來變革性的潛力。

14209925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14209925.value: 提前期不確定下的庫存控制：一種分佈式魯棒優化方法

14209925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14209925.value: Effective inventory management amidst uncertainty is essential for maintaining the balance between supply and demand in supply chains. While much research has centered on uncertain demand, lead time variability presents significant challenges that require innovative solutions. This project aims to address inventory control issues by focusing on uncertain lead times through a novel approach grounded in cutting-edge optimization techniques. We explore scenarios involving order-crossover and those without it, as both influence lead time variability and complicate inventory management. Our research leverages open-loop policies to mitigate computational complexities associated with these uncertainties. Open-loop policies set decisions as constants at the planning horizon's outset, avoiding the need for adaptive changes. Supported by recent studies, these policies demonstrate asymptotic optimality in various settings, providing a robust framework for decision-making in uncertain environments. Despite the advantages of open-loop policies, significant computational challenges remain. Therefore, we further employ robust optimization and supermodularity. Robust optimization addresses distributional ambiguity, a common issue due to limited data or estimation errors, while supermodularity helps simplify complex optimization problems. Our preliminary studies reveal that the cost function within the inventory problem exhibits supermodularity, which is crucial for us to develop efficient algorithms. Our research plan includes several key tasks: formulating a low-dimensional mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to solve medium-sized instances, identifying conditions that prevent order-crossover, and hence simplifying analysis, and extending our findings to real-world applications. We begin by modeling a firm’s inventory replenishment decisions over multiple periods, taking into account various costs such as ordering, backorder, and holding costs. By concentrating on open-loop policies, we aim to leverage the interaction between robust optimization and supermodularity to reduce complexity and provide an equivalent low-dimensional MILP. Additionally, our study delves into cases with no order-crossover, where cumulative ordering vectors simplify the problem. This aspect of the project involves developing more efficient algorithms, based on the separability of the cost functions, such that we can even solve instances with large size. Finally, we intend to apply our theoretical insights to practical instances, collaborating with a large-scale retail firm to validate the applicability of our solutions. Given the prevalence of uncertain lead times in real-world supply chains, our research holds significant potential to enhance inventory management practices. By providing efficient strategies for handling uncertain lead times, this project aims to improve supply chain resilience and overall performance, offering valuable contributions to both academia and industry. 在不確定性環境下實現高效的庫存管理對於維持供應鏈供需平衡至關重要。儘管現有研究多聚焦於需求不確定性，但提前期的不確定性帶來的重大挑戰仍待創新解決方案。本項目通過基於前沿優化技術的新方法，重點研究不確定提前期條件下的庫存控制問題。我們同時考察存在訂單交叉與不存在訂單交叉的兩種情景，因其均會影響提前期變異並增加庫存管理複雜性。 本研究採用開環策略來降低不確定性帶來的計算複雜度。開環策略在規劃期初將決策變量設為常量，避免了適應性調整的需求。最新研究表明，這類策略在多種情境下具有漸近最優性，能為不確定環境中的決策提供可靠框架。 儘管開環策略優勢顯著，但仍存在重大計算挑戰。為此，我們進一步運用魯棒優化和超模性理論：魯棒優化可解決因數據不足或估計誤差導致的分佈模糊性問題，而超模性則有助於簡化複雜優化問題。前期研究表明，庫存問題中的成本函數具有超模性特徵，這對開發高效算法至關重要。 研究計劃包含多項關鍵任務：建立低維混合整數線性規劃（MILP）模型以求解中等規模問題；確定避免訂單交叉的條件以簡化分析；將研究成果拓展至實際應用。我們首先構建企業多周期庫存補貨決策模型，綜合考慮訂購成本、缺貨成本及持有成本等因素。通過開環策略，結合魯棒優化與超模性的協同效應，旨在降低複雜度並構建等效的低維MILP模型。 此外，本研究深入探討無訂單交叉情形；在此情況下，通過對累積訂購向量的處理可簡化問題。基於成本函數的可分離性特徵，該部分將開發更高效算法，甚至可求解大規模問題實例。 最後，我們擬將理論成果應用於實踐，計劃與大型零售企業合作驗證解決方案的適用性。鑒於不確定提前期在現實供應鏈中的普遍性，本研究對提升庫存管理實踐具有重要潛力。通過提供處理不確定提前期的有效策略，本項目致力於增強供應鏈韌性並提升整體績效，為學術界和產業界作出雙重貢獻。

14210225.value: 用於治療三陰性乳腺癌的多靶點免疫治療噬菌體

14210225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)

Using the in-house expertise in phage-based discovery and display of targeting peptides (Science 2004, Nature Materials 2015, Nature Communications 2024), the PI has discovered that filamentous phage fd, as a human-safe flexible bionanofiber, can display tumor-homing (TH) peptides at the tip and PD-L1-binding peptides on the sidewall to achieve efficient targeted anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy (Nature Nanotechnology 2024), avoiding the side effects caused by the lack of tumor-targeting capability of traditional ICIs. Aim 1 is to identify and validate PD1b and TREM2b peptides by in vitro biopanning. Aim 2 is to identify and validate TNBC TH peptides by in vivo biopanning. Successful completion of this project will lead to innovative immunotherapy for effectively eradicating TNBC without adverse effects. 三陰性乳腺癌（TNBC）具有高度侵襲性，預後極差，且轉移、復發和死亡風險極高。由於缺乏特定分子標靶，TNBC的治療至今仍是重大挑戰。免疫療法中的免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs），如阻斷程式性細胞死亡蛋白1（PD-1）或其配體（PD-L1）的藥物，是極具潛力的治療策略。然而，現行使用的抗PD-1或抗PD-L1抗體類ICIs因缺乏腫瘤靶向能力，導致TNBC免疫治療反應率低、副作用明顯，且需合併其他治療方式。我們計劃開發兩種靶向噬菌體：均在其頂端展示TNBC靶向肽，在側壁分別展示二種免疫相關蛋白的結合肽。我們提出以下假設：(1)二種靶向噬菌體經靜脈共同注射至TNBC小鼠模型後，能選擇性聚集於腫瘤組織；(2) 透過其中一種噬菌體阻斷巨噬細胞、另外一種噬菌體阻斷T細胞的PD-1，可協同增強抗PD-1免疫治療效果，從而有效治療TNBC。目標1：透過體外親和篩選鑑定並驗證二種免疫相關蛋白的結合肽。目標2：透過體內篩選鑑定並驗證TNBC靶向肽。目標3：評估二種靶向噬菌體透過共同阻斷蛋白1來增強TNBC免疫治療的效果。本專案的成功完成將開發出一種創新免疫療法，可有效根除TNBC且不產生副作用。

14210425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14210425.value: 探究並減輕Wi-Fi漫遊聯盟服務中的隱私洩露問題

14210425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14210425.value: Wi-Fi is an indispensible network access technology. As human mobility continues to grow at a global scale, increasingly more organizations now offer federated Wi-Fi roaming services to their affiliated members. Such services build on top of existing enterprise-grade Wi-Fi technology, and each organization in the federation acts as the identity provider to authenticate its members for the entire federated roaming service. Because of this, members of one organization can travel to another organization in the federation and be able to use the same Wi-Fi service there. One of the largest international federated Wi-Fi roaming services in the world is the eduroam network, which has tens of thousands Wi-Fi access points from participating organizations in over 100 countries. Some country, such as the United Kingdom, has its own national Wi-Fi roaming services for public sector organizations. While these federated roaming services can greatly forster collaboration between the participating organizations, their privacy implications have not been investigated before. Previous work studied the security problems related to client-side implementation and configuration issues in enterprise-grade Wi-Fi under an active impersonation attack, but did not address privacy leakages due to the design and implementation of the underlying protocols, which can reveal to a passive sniffer the identity and origin of a user. This poses a significant privacy concern, as a passive adversary can exploit this to track the location of specific users and threaten their personal safety. Furthermore, an adversary can also exploit the privacy leakages to determine which organizations are collaborating with each others, and such information can further enable insider trades or corporate espionage. In this project, we will investigate and attempt to mitigate these privacy leakages through three research thrusts. First, we will investigate the status quo of identity protection in federated Wi-Fi services, and then design and evaluate a protocol-level solution that can protect the confidentiality of messages that contain the user's identity. Second, we will study the leakages of payload size and timing, and investigate the effectiveness of domain fingerprinting attacks using encrypted handshake traffic. Finally, drawing inspiration from our previous research on certificate validation, we will build and evaluate a pragmatic server-side defense that can mask the handshake-size without special client support. Completion of this project will greatly enhance the understanding of hidden privacy threats in federated Wi-Fi roaming services, and deliver practical mitigation that can be deployed in real-world settings. Wi-Fi 是一項不可或缺的網路存取技術。隨著全球範圍內人員流動的持續增加，越來越多的組織為其附屬成員提供Wi-Fi漫遊服務。此類服務建立在現有的企業級 Wi-Fi 技術之上，在同一個漫遊聯盟中的各個組織擔當身分提供者，為整個漫遊聯盟驗證其附屬成員的身份。因此，一個組織的成員可以在同一個漫遊聯盟中的另一個組織裡使用相同的 Wi-Fi 服務。世界上最大的國際性Wi-Fi 漫遊聯盟服務是 Eduroam 網絡，它擁有來自 100 多個國家/地區參與組織的數萬個 Wi-Fi 接入點。此外，一些國家（例如英國）為其公共部門組織提供全國性的 Wi-Fi 漫遊服務。雖然這些Wi-Fi 漫遊聯盟可以極大促進組織之間的合作，但其潛在的隱私問題尚未得到透徹研究。之前的研究探討了在主動冒充攻擊下，企業級 Wi-Fi 中與客戶端實現和配置存在不同的安全問題，但沒有解決由於底層協議的設計和實現導致的隱私洩露，而這可能使用戶的身份和來源被被潛伏的被動攻擊者發現。這構成一個重大的隱私問題，因為被動攻擊者可以利用這一點來追蹤特定用戶的位置，並威脅他們的個人安全。此外，攻擊者還可以利用這類隱私洩露來確定哪些組織之間有彼此合作，而這些資料可能被用於內部交易或企業間諜活動。在這個項目中，我們將通過三個研究方向來調查並嘗試減輕這些隱私洩露。首先，我們將調查Wi-Fi 漫遊服務聯盟中身份保護的現狀，然後設計和評估一種協議級解決方案，以保護包含用戶身份資料的機密性。其次，我們將研究載荷大小和時序帶來的隱私洩露，並評估針對加密握手流量的指紋攻擊之有效性。最後，借鑒我們之前在證書驗證方面的研究，我們將構建和評估一種實用的伺服器端防禦，能夠在沒有特殊客戶端支持的情況下掩蓋握手大小。完成此項目將有助增強業界對Wi-Fi 漫遊聯盟服務中暗藏的隱私威脅的理解，並提供可以在現實環境中部署的實用解決方案。

14210525.value: 高速實時變形性細胞儀和單細胞機械型分類

Although traditional technologies, such as atomic force microscopy, provide high resolution, their low throughput and variations due to limited sample size pose major challenges in single-cell mechanotyping for routine clinical screening. Microﬂuidics-based real-time deformability cytometry has emerged as a promising solution for high-throughput single-cell mechanotyping. Existing imaging strategies are detail-demanding and thus unsuitable for clinical practice. The platform to be developed in the proposed project will outperform the existing techniques by combining accelerated image processing, high throughput and a well-integrated workflow. The proposed project will aim to develop a transformative platform by revamping the imaging system and processing algorithms for ultrafast and multiparametric single-cell mechanotyping and subsequent mechanotype-based sorting. The successful establishment and validation of this platform will allow researchers to fully utilise the potential of single-cell mechanotypes, especially for applications involving mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). We have collaborated with an expert in the field of tissue engineering and regenerative medicine to formulate protocols that comply with guidelines for clinical trials and translational applications, while we work on the technological aspects. This combined effort will expedite the dissemination of the proposed technology to the identified beneficiaries, both locally and globally. If successful, the proposed project will provide a valuable opportunity to translate scientific excellence in Hong Kong into societal impacts in the near future, thus helping transform the Greater Bay Area into an international powerhouse for improved diagnosis and the development of tangible MSC-based therapies. 越來越多的證據表明，單細胞機械分型（表徵單一細胞的機械特性）可作為檢測各種疾病的無標記生物標誌。儘管原子力顯微鏡等傳統技術能夠提供高分辨率，但由於其低通量和檢測的樣品數量有限使得結果間變異性大等因素，使得以其作為常規臨床篩檢中的單細胞機械分型仍具挑戰。基於以微流體剪力造成即時的細胞形變，作為高通量單細胞機械分型，因此成為一種有前景的解決方案。現有的成像策略對實驗細節要求較高，因此不適用於臨床應用。本項目擬開發的平台將基於現有的技術基礎上，結合加速影像處理、高通量和高度集成的工作流程。本項目旨在透過改進成像系統和處理演算法，開發一個革新性平台，用於超快速、多參數單細胞機械分型，以及隨後基於機械分型的分選。該平台的成功建立和驗證，將使研究人員能夠充分利用單細胞機械類型作爲分型，特別是涉及間充質幹細胞（MSC）的應用。 我們已建立與組織工程和再生醫學領域專家的合作，計劃制定符合臨床試驗和轉化應用指南的方案，同時我們也致力於技術層面的研究。如此的合作將加速本項目開發的技術在本地和全球的推廣。如果計劃成功，將為香港的科研成果在不久的將來轉化為社會影響力提供寶貴的機會，從而助力粵港澳大灣區成為診斷水平提升和基於間質幹細胞（MSC）療法研發的重要一員。

14210725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14210725.value: 自適應線上生成模型選擇：提升多樣性與保真度

14210725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14210725.value: Text-based generative models have been applied to numerous applications in recent years. The rapid advancement in this field has led to the development of various frameworks and architectures for training such models, resulting in a large number of generative models currently available to the public. Consequently, selecting a single model from this large pool has become a crucial yet challenging task for organizations and individuals seeking to leverage generative AI. This selection process is often complicated by budget and time constraints, as the generation of samples from each model incurs significant computational costs and time. In paid versions of generative AI services, users must also account for the financial cost of generating data, making it inefficient to rely on traditional offline model selection approaches, where a large set of samples is generated and analyzed for every model. This project aims to address these challenges by developing efficient online selection methods that dynamically choose and update a single generative model based on observations of samples generated by multiple models in real time. The proposed approach intends to enable a learner to receive a text prompt and identify the most suitable generative model for that prompt based on prior observations of samples produced by the candidate models. The performance of each model will be evaluated using a combination of criteria, including the fidelity of the generated samples, their alignment with the input text, and their diversity. The overall evaluation score will consider a weighted combination of these factors, resulting in a challenging online learning task. To achieve these objectives, this project proposes the design of online selection algorithms that converge to the optimal model without incurring significant sample generation costs from sub-optimal models. The aim is to develop a unified online model selection framework that can be applied to various prompt-based generative models, including text-to-text, text-to-image, and text-to-video generative models. The project will investigate both theoretical and empirical aspects of the proposed learning algorithms, analyzing their convergence properties and effectiveness in identifying the best generative model. In summary, this project has three primary objectives: (1) Develop a learning framework for the online selection of generative models, (2) Propose an online learning approach that considers multiple evaluation factors, including fidelity, relevance, and diversity of the generated data, and (3) Design and evaluate the learning algorithm on various data types, including text, image, and video. 基於文本的生成模型在近年來已被應用於眾多領域。隨著此領域的快速發展，各種訓練這類模型的框架與架構相繼出現，導致目前已有大量生成模型公開可用。因此，從這龐大的模型池中選擇單一模型，對於希望善用生成式人工智慧的機構與個人而言，成為一項至關重要卻又充滿挑戰的任務。這一選擇過程往往受到預算與時間限制的影響，因為從每個模型產生樣本都會消耗大量的運算成本與時間。在付費版本的生成式 AI 服務中，使用者還必須考量生成資料的金錢成本，使得傳統的離線模型選擇方法顯得低效，因為該方法需要為每個模型生成並分析龐大的樣本集合。 本計劃旨在透過開發高效的線上選擇方法來解決這些挑戰，該方法能夠基於多個模型即時生成的樣本觀察結果，動態地選擇並更新單一生成模型。所提出的方法希望使學習器能夠接收文字提示，並根據先前候選模型生成樣本的觀察結果，辨識出最合適的生成模型。每個模型的效能將根據多項標準進行評估，包括生成樣本的保真度、與輸入文本的一致性，以及其多樣性。最終的評估分數將綜合這些因素的加權組合，形成一項具挑戰性的線上學習任務。 為了達成這些目標，本計劃提出設計線上選擇演算法，使其能在不產生過多次優化模型的樣本生成成本下，收斂至最優模型。研究目標在於建立一個統一的線上模型選擇框架，可廣泛應用於各類基於提示的生成模型，包括文本生成文本、文本生成圖像，以及文本生成影片的模型。本計劃將探討所提學習演算法的理論與實證層面，分析其收斂性質以及在辨識最佳生成模型方面的有效性。總結來說，本計劃有三大主要目標：(1) 建立一個生成模型線上選擇的學習框架；(2) 提出一種兼顧多項評估因素（包含保真度、相關性與生成資料的多樣性）的線上學習方法；(3) 在多種資料型態（包括文本、圖像與影片）上設計並驗證該學習演算法。

14210825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14210825.value: 大規模下高效的矩陣電路簡潔非互動式知識論證：藉重新定義矩陣運算網絡使證明既簡潔又隱藏計算

14210825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14210825.value: Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) enable privacy-preserving verification of sensitive data without disclosure. A specific type, zero-knowledge succinct non-interactive arguments of knowledge (zkSNARKs), provides compact proofs with efficient verification, scaling sublinearly with input size. This efficiency is essential in decentralized systems, where many users need to download and verify proofs while minimizing data transfer and computational costs. zkSNARKs allow verifiers to confirm complex computations without re-running them; verifying the proof is often noticeably faster than performing the original computation itself. zkSNARKs have proven valuable across diverse sensitive, privacy-focused applications such as anonymous credentials, minimal-disclosure know-your-customer protocols, and private transactions. However, extending zkSNARKs to computationally intensive machine learning (ML) tasks poses challenges, particularly in balancing efficient verification with preserving not only input data privacy but also the privacy of model parameters. Current zero-knowledge machine learning (zkML) methods struggle with the superlinear complexity of matrix computations that underpin ML. Existing representations do not align well with the layered, large-scale matrix and non-linear operations typical in ML and do not adequately protect model privacy, a key limitation when models are costly to reveal. This proposal introduces a scalable cryptographic framework for efficient zero-knowledge verification of complex matrix computations in ML. Our approach reformulates matrix operations, including those central to ML, into a zkSNARK-friendly format, noticeably improving the proof size, verification speed, and privacy. By expressing computations as matrix expressions, we create zkSNARKs with logarithmic proof size and verification time while maintaining strictly linear prover time relative to input size. Key innovations include an $O(n^2)$-prover zkSNARK for matrix operations on $n × n$ matrices, a unified framework for both linear and non-linear computations, and efficient lookup and error-proof mechanisms for the non-linear activations essential to ML. Further, our high-dimensional R1CS (HD-R1CS) system introduces an additional privacy layer by concealing the computation structure itself while preserving efficiency. HD-R1CS leverages matrix sparsity and block transformations, achieving $O(n^2M)$ prover time and $O(log(nM))$ verification time for $M$ operations on $n × n$ matrices. To enhance efficiency further, we propose an inner-product argument inspired by the popular Bulletproofs, paired with a polynomial commitment scheme, reducing prover overhead. The proposed zkML framework enables diverse, verifiable ML applications, such as large language models and computer vision, with unmatched efficiency. For the first time, the model itself remains concealed from the verifier without incurring prohibitively high computation costs, making a significant impact by supporting secure, private AI inference and training, thereby enhancing digital trust across industries. 零知識證明可在不披露敏感數據的情況下進行保私隱的驗證。作為其一類型，零知識簡潔非互動式知識論證（zero-knowledge succinct non-interactive arguments of knowledge，zkSNARK）能提供短證明且驗證效率高；兩者對於輸入規模皆為次線性。此等效率在去中心化情境下尤其重要：眾多驗證者需要下載並核查證明，故須將數據傳輸與計算成本維持在低水平。zkSNARK 使驗證者毋須重做複雜計算即可確認其正確性；速度遠快於重算。zkSNARK 已有實務應用，涵蓋多種重視私隱的場景，例如匿名憑證、僅披露必要資料的客戶審查流程，以及保護私隱的交易。 然而，將 zkSNARK 擴展至計算密集的機器學習（machine learning，ML）並不容易；難點在於既要保持驗證效率，又要同時保障輸入數據與模型參數的私隱。現行的零知識機器學習（zkML）方法難以處理 ML 基礎的矩陣運算所需的超線性複雜度。既有計算表示法與 ML 典型的分層、大型矩陣與非線性運算不太契合，亦未能充分保護模型私隱；由於模型洩露代價高，這構成一項關鍵限制。 本計劃提出可擴展的密碼學框架，旨在實現對 ML 複雜矩陣運算的的高效率零知識驗證。我們的方法把矩陣運算重構為利於 zkSNARK 的表示形式，涵蓋 ML 核心運算，顯著縮短證明長度與驗證時間，同時強化私隱保障。透過將計算改寫為矩陣表達式，我們設計的 zkSNARK 可實現對數級的證明長度與驗證時間，且證明者時間與輸入規模呈嚴格線性。主要技術創新包括：在 n × n 矩陣上達成 O(n^2) 證明者時間的 zkSNARK；統一處理線性與非線性計算的框架；以及針對關鍵的非線性激活函數所設計的高效查表與防錯機制。 此外，我們的高維度秩一約束系統（high-dimensional rank-1 constraint system，HD-R1CS）在不犧牲效率的前提下，進一步隱藏計算結構，新增了一層私隱保護。HD-R1CS 善用矩陣稀疏性與分塊變換：對 n×n 矩陣進行 M 次運算時，可達 O(n^2 M) 證明者時間和 O(log(nM)) 驗證時間。我們還提出受主流 Bulletproofs 所啟發的內積論證，並配合多項式承諾方案，以進一步降低證明者開銷。 此 zkML 框架支援多樣化的可驗證 ML 應用，例如大型語言模型與電腦視覺，並提供前所未有的效率。本研究將首次實現在不引致過高計算成本的前提下，使模型本身對驗證者保持隱密，這將支援安全、具私隱的人工智能推理與訓練，提升跨行業的數碼信任度。

14211325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14211325.value: 透過主動漏洞檢測和修補來保護Node.js生態系統

14211325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14211325.value: Securing the Node.js ecosystem is essential due to its important role on the Internet: it is extensively used in the development of web applications and cross-platform desktop applications. A vulnerable Node.js application can accept malicious inputs from external sources without proper sanitization. These malicious inputs can be leveraged to manipulate the application's behavior in unintended ways. For example, an attacker could inject malicious code to change the application's database operations or system commands, which can potentially lead to data breaches or even arbitrary code execution. Despite the importance of the security of Node.js ecosystem, various vulnerabilities still exist in many Node.js applications and cannot be easily prevented by current solutions. A major difficulty of securing the Node.js ecosystem is how to effectively analyze the highly dynamic and flexible JavaScript code.
