Our aim is to combine several new techniques, such as inner-outer gluing methods developed by del Pino and the PI and their collaborators, Giga-Kohn monotonicity formula, Naber-Valtora stratification techniques, and also borrow some ideas of Colding-Minicozzi from mean curvature flows, to give a comprehensive study on this topic. 藤田方程式(Fujita equation) 是非線性拋物方程式的基本方程式之一，廣泛應用於化學反應、相變、微機電系統（MEMS）等眾多應用領域。本研究計畫運用變分法和幾何測度論，研究Fujita方程式在臨界或超臨界狀態下的爆破機制及其相關的濃縮現象。 Giga和Kohn、Merle和Zaag等人的工作，幾乎完全刻畫了亞臨界情況下的爆破過程。在臨界或超臨界情況下，人們發現了豐富而複雜的現象，但由於缺乏有效的工具和方法，文獻中的研究較少。我們的目標是結合多種新技術，例如del Pino及其合作者開發的內外黏合方法、Giga-Kohn單調性公式、Naber-Valtora分層技術，並借鑒Colding-Minicozzi在平均曲率流中的一些思想，對這一主題進行全面的研究。

14304025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304025.value: 特大城市鹵化有機物的生物地球化學特性

14304025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304025.value: The intensified use of bleach, a chlorine-based disinfectant, to control COVID-19 and other pathogens have increased worldwide. Besides eliminating pathogens, disinfectants can react with natural and anthropogenic organic matter to form a complex halogenated organic matter (XOM) that do not have a defined formula and structure. With heavy loads of organic matter in megacities and excess disinfectants used in sewage and drainage systems, high levels of XOM can be formed and released into nearby aquatic and coastal environments. To prevent the next pandemic, the usage of disinfectants and the production of XOM in urban environments are expected to continue increasing. Research efforts are urgently needed to examine the impacts and to develop corresponding management plans dealing with this post-COVID new normal in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, and other cities worldwide. Our Aquatic and Terrestrial Organic Matter (ATOM) Research Team at CUHK has conducted a preliminary study in South China and showed noteworthy levels of XOM in urban runoffs and wastewater discharges. We hypothesize that XOM has unique biogeochemical characteristics. The yield, characteristics, and degradability of XOM play important ecological roles in the coastal ecosystems receiving urban runoffs and wastewater discharges, as well as constraining landscape-to-global C and N cycles. Our ATOM team is collaborating with colleagues at seven universities in two megacities clusters of the Hangzhou Great Bay Area (Shanghai, Ningbo, Hangzhou) and the Greater Bay Area (Guangzhou, Dongguan Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Hong Kong) in China to conduct the first systematic study coupling basin-scale sampling and mesocosm experiments with molecular-level characterization. Environmental samples will be collected from wastewater utilities and waterways after major rainstorms for quantification and molecular characterization on XOM using advanced analytical techniques including FT-ICR-MS, NMR, and XANES. Biogeochemical characteristics of XOM from this study will be tabulated and compared with other carbon pools, as a part of on-going efforts to evaluate distinct carbon pools from disturbed environments. Noticeably, XOM and disinfection byproducts (DBPs) are formed during disinfection, but the study scopes and impacts are different. XOM does not have a defined chemical formula and is considered as a distant carbon pool with halogenated moieties. In contrast, DBPs generally refer to a set of identified compounds (e.g., trihalomethane and nitrosamine). DBP studies address their formation within engineering systems and impacts on human health. The proposed study here focuses on the roles of XOM in the carbon cycle and ecological impacts in the natural environment. 自新冠疫情以來，含氯消毒劑（如漂白水）在全球範圍内的使用量顯著增加，用以防控新冠病毒（COVID-19）及其他病原體的傳播。除了有效殺滅病原體外，此類消毒劑亦可與環境中的天然及人爲來源的有機質發生反應，生成結構複雜且無固定化學式的鹵化有機物（Halogenated Organic Matter, XOM）。在有機質負荷極高的特大城市中，污水及排水系統中消毒劑的過量與廣泛使用，極可能導致大量XOM的生成，並排放至鄰近的河口與沿海環境。為應對未來可能出現的新型傳染病，城市對消毒劑的使用强度及XOM的產量預計仍將持續增長。因此，亟需開展相關研究，以評估XOM的環境與生態影響，並制定有效的管理應對策略，以應對香港、粵港澳大灣區乃至全球其他城市在後疫情時代所面臨的新常態。 香港中文大學水體與陸地有機質課題組（Aquatic and Terrestrial Organic Matter, ATOM）已於華南地區開展初步調查，發現城市徑流與污水出水中的XOM處於高濃度水平。我們假設，XOM具有獨特的生物地球化學特性，其產量、性質和可降解性，在接受城市徑流與污水排放的沿海生態系統中扮演重要的生態角色，並可能影響從景觀尺度至全球尺度的碳氮循環。ATOM課題組將與粵港澳大灣區（廣州，東莞，深圳，珠海，香港）的四所高校合作，開展首個系統性研究，結合流域尺度采樣與中尺度生態模擬實驗，並應用分子水平技術手段對XOM進行全面表徵。本項目將主要於暴雨事件後采集城市徑流與污水出水樣品，利用尖端分析技術（如傅里葉變換離子迴旋共振質譜、核磁共振波譜、X射綫吸收近邊緣結構光譜）對XOM進行定量和分子水平表徵。研究將系統性地整合XOM的生物地球化學特性，並與其他有機碳庫特徵進行比較，這亦是識別環境干擾下所產生的不同有機碳庫的重要工作之一。 值得注意的是，XOM雖與消毒副產物（Disinfection Byproducts, DBPs）同樣於消毒過程中生產，但兩者的定義和研究重點有所不同。XOM通常是不具備明確定義的化學式，屬於結構多樣且含有鹵素取代基的新型有機碳庫；而DBPs主要指一系列已知的小分子化合物（如三滷甲烷、亞硝胺等），其研究多集中於工程處理系統内的生成機制與對人類健康的影響。本項目將聚焦於XOM在碳循環中的角色及其對於自然環境的生態影響。

14304125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304125.value: 條件極限定理與集中不等式

14304125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304125.value: In probability theory, approximations and inequalities are often employed when exact probability calculations are infeasible. Classical results in this area include the Law of Large Numbers (LLN), the Central Limit Theorem (CLT), and various concentration inequalities. The LLN asserts that the sample mean is close to the population mean when the sample size is large. The CLT states that the sample mean converges to a normal distribution as the sample size increases. Concentration inequalities provide upper bounds on the probability that the sample mean will differ significantly from its central value. These results play a pivotal role in statistical inference. Often, our interest lies in conditional probabilities or expectations. For instance, in statistical inference involving nuisance parameters, we condition on sufficient statistics for those parameters. In Bayesian inference, we update our estimates of parameters based on posterior information. Even when not the primary focus, computing conditional expectations can be a vital intermediate step, as seen in Stein's method of exchangeable pairs for distributional approximations. Compared to classical unconditional limit theorems and concentration inequalities, their conditional counterparts are less developed. Existing literature predominantly focuses on independent random variables conditioned on their sum. In practice, dependence is prevalent. Studying the conditional behavior of probability models involving dependence necessitates innovative approaches. In this proposed project, we will develop a combination of Stein's method, Markov Chain Monte Carlo, local limit theorems under dependence, and higher-order concentration inequalities to address this problem. While developing broadly applicable methods, we will focus on two probability models: the exponential random graph model and the Ising model. These are prominent models used to study real-world networks and statistical physics, respectively. We will address questions regarding these models, such as: conditional on a global observable, how does the model behave locally? How does the concentration of measure phenomenon change? Do we still have a CLT? The outcomes of this project will not only address important questions regarding specific models but also advance the asymptotic theory in probability in general. 概率論中，當無法精確計算概率時，通常會採用近似方法與不等式。此領域的經典結果包括大數定律（Law of Large Numbers, LLN）、中心極限定理（Central Limit Theorem, CLT）及各類集中不等式。大數定律表明，當樣本量足夠大時，樣本均值將趨近於總體均值；中心極限定理則指出，隨着樣本量增加，樣本均值會漸近服從常態分佈；而集中不等式則為樣本均值偏離其中心值的概率提供了上界。這些結果在統計推斷中具有關鍵作用。 研究往往聚焦於條件概率或條件期望。例如，在涉及干擾參數的統計推斷中，我們會以這些參數的充分統計量作為條件；在貝葉斯推斷中，則會根據後驗信息更新參數估計。即使條件期望並非主要研究目標，其計算亦可能成為關鍵的中間步驟，正如Stein基於可交換對的分佈近似方法所示。 相較於傳統的無條件極限定理與集中不等式，其條件對應理論的發展相對不足。現有文獻主要集中於「以隨機變量之和為條件」的獨立變量情形，然而實際應用中，變量間的相依性普遍存在。要研究涉及相依性的概率模型之條件行為，需要引入創新方法。在本項目中，我們將結合Stein方法、馬爾可夫鏈蒙特卡洛、相依性下的局部極限定理，以及高階集中不等式來解決此問題。 在發展普適性方法的同時，我們將重點研究兩個概率模型：指數隨機圖模型與伊辛模型。前者是研究現實網絡的重要模型，後者則是統計物理學的經典模型。我們將探討以下問題：當全局觀測量給定時，模型的局部行為如何變化？測度集中現象會發生怎樣的改變？此時是否仍存在中心極限定理？ 本項目的成果不僅能解答特定模型的重要問題，更將推動概率論中漸近理論的整體發展。

14304225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304225.value: 關於高雄上的漢密爾頓猜想及複里奇流

14304225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304225.value: The project aims at studying geometric structure of manifolds using Ricci flow. This is a geometric flow used by Hamilton- Perelman to resolve the long-standing Poincare conjecture in topology. And it was found to be very powerful in different areas. There are two themes in this project. The first goal of this project is to investigate the higher dimensional case of the Hamilton-Lott conjecture. The conjecture states that a complete three-manifold with non-negatively pinched Ricci curvature is necessarily either compact or flat. The conjecture has been solved in its full generality by a joint effort of Lott, Deruelle-Schulze-Simon and the PI with Topping. The 1-isotropic curvature is known to be a natural generalization of positive Ricci curvature in high dimension. It was shown by a deep work of Brendle that a compact manifold with positive 1-isotropic curvature must be a quotient of sphere. In light with Brendle's sphere theorem, Deruelle-Schulze-Simon proposed to investigate the flatness of complete manifolds with 1-isotropic curvature pinched. Recently, the question had been answered affirmatively under, either non-negative complex sectional curvature by the PI and Topping, or the Euclidean volume growth by Deruelle-Schulze-Simon. %One of the central difficulty is to find a way to control the volume lower bound if non-flat non-compact example exists. In this project, the PI proposed to use method in its Kaehler geometry to obtain volume growth control and attack the question in its full generality. The second theme of this project is to study the long-time behavior of compact immortal Kaehler-Ricci flow. The ultimate goal is to understand how the Kaehler-Ricci flow can be used to find the canonical metric on a manifold as proposed by a program of Song-Tian. In the presence of Iitaka fibration, it is now known that the normalized Kaehler-Ricci flow will converge to a singular Kaehler-Einstein metric weakly. It was proved by the PI with Hein and Tosatti that convergence happens in a smooth sense away from the singular fibre, confirming a conjecture of Song-Tian. It was conjectured by Song-Tian that global convergence holds in the Gromov-Hausdorff topology. In this proposal, the PI will continue his work in immortal Kaehler-Ricci flow and will address questions related to the metric completion of the limit. 該計畫旨在利用里奇流研究流形的幾何結構。里奇流是漢密爾頓-佩雷爾曼用來解決拓樸學中長期存在的龐加萊猜想的幾何流，並發現在不同領域非常有效。 此項目包含兩個主題。計畫的第一個目標是研究漢密爾頓-洛特猜想的高維情形。該猜想指出，具有非負緊縮里奇曲率的完全三流形必然是緊緻的或平坦的。洛特、德魯埃爾-舒爾茨-西蒙以及與托平合作的PI共同努力，已經完全解決了該猜想的普遍性。 1-各向同性曲率被認為是正里奇曲率在高維度空間的自然推廣。布倫德爾的深入研究證明，具有正1-各向同性曲率的緊緻流形必然是球面的商。 Deruelle-Schulze-Simon 依據 Brendle 球面定理，提出研究具有 1-各向同性曲率夾緊的完全流形的平坦性。近期，該問題已得到 PI 和 Topping 在非負復截面曲率下，以及 Deruelle-Schulze-Simon 在歐氏體積增長下給出的肯定答案。在本專案中，PI 提出利用其 Kaehler 幾何中的方法來獲得體積增長控制，並以其完全的普遍性來解決這個問題。 本計畫的第二個主題是研究緊緻永恆 Kaehler-Ricci 流的長期行為。最終目標是理解如何利用 Kaehler-Ricci 流來尋找流形上的正則度量，正如 Song-Tian 的一個方案所提出的那樣。在Iitaka纖維化存在的情況下，現已知道歸一化的Kaehler-Ricci流將弱收斂於奇異的Kaehler-Einstein度量。首席研究員與Hein和Tosatti共同證明了，收斂發生在遠離奇異纖維的方向上，從而證實了宋田的一個猜想。宋田猜想，全域收斂在Gromov-Hausdorff拓樸中成立。在本提案中，首席研究員將繼續他在不朽Kaehler-Ricci流方面的工作，並將解決與極限的度量完備相關的問題。

14304325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304325.value: 高維跨音速流動和混合型偏微分方程

14304325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304325.value: The mathematical theory for the steady compressible Euler system and its variants gives rise to many challenging problems for systems of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) which are mixed-type with strong nonlinearities and degeneracies. The theoretical studies of such PDEs (especially in multi-dimensions) are of fundamental importance both in the mathematical theory of nonlinear PDEs and in various important applications such as gas-dynamics. Substantial progress has been achieved in this direction in the past, yet due to the severe difficulties such as mixed and changing types of equations, strong nonlinearities and complexities, degeneracies and free boundaries, and nonlinear physical boundary conditions, there have been many open problems in the general well-posedness theory for the steady compressible Euler system and its variants. This is particularly so for multi-dimensional steady compressible transonic flows which involve some key features and core difficulties in the general theory. In this project, we plan to investigate analytically some basic steady transonic flows which have been studied extensively by experiments and numerical computations and are of great significance in applications, to establish the well-posedness theory (existence, uniqueness and structural stability (or instabilities)) of such flow patterns and their qualitative behaviors, to refine the current available methods and to develop new techniques and ideas to study solutions to nonlinear mixed type PDEs which may change types and have strong degeneracies with suitable boundary conditions or free boundaries. We will focus on the following typical problems: the existence and uniqueness of 3-dimensional smooth transonic steady flows in nozzles with non-zero acceleration and/or non-trivial vorticities; the well-posedness of the Courant-Friedrich’s transonic shock solution with sonic surfaces in finite De Laval nozzles, and the existence and qualitative behaviors of transonic jets. It is expected such studies may resolve some long-standing open problems in this area. 定常可壓縮歐拉方程組及其變型的數學理論導致了一系列對含有強非綫性或者蛻化的混合型偏微分方程組研究的挑戰性問題。對這些問題的深入研究（特別在高維）不僅具有重要理論意義（對偏微分方程組理論本身），而且在空氣動力學等重要領域有廣泛深刻的應用。 儘管眾多數學家在這方面過去已取得了很重要深刻的成就，但由於方程的混合型、可能的變型和蛻化、強非綫性、自由邊界及非綫性邊界條件等，仍然有許多重要的尚待解決的公開問題，特別是對於高維定常的無粘的跨音速流動，建立一般理論有著本質上的困難。本項目計劃建立一些具有重要數值計算和實驗背景的跨音速流動的嚴格數學理論（存在性、唯一性和結構穩性），並期待提出新的思想方法和技術來研究一般混合型偏微分方程。

14304425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304425.value: 時間序列之變點於不同變化下的漸近與自展推斷

14304425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304425.value: The goal of this project is to study the asymptotic distribution of change-points for time series under various break sizes, and to develop a unified framework for inference of change-point which works for any break size. In the past several decades, change-point analysis has attracted considerable attention and has been widely applied in many scientific areas. Nevertheless, some problems related to the asymptotic distribution of change-point estimators remain unresolved for time series models. For example, the maximum likelihood estimator is found to be distributed differently for two types break size orders, namely $n^{-alpha}$ with $alpha$ in (0,1/2), or fixed ($alpha=0$). However, it is not clear about other cases of $alpha$. Recently, Jiang et al.~(2018) established the asymptotic distribution of the least-squares estimator for a mean change of size $O(n^{-1/2})$ ($alpha$=1/2) using a technique involving a discretization of a continuous-time process. The asymptotic distribution is different from the cases of $alpha =0$ and $alpha$ in (0,1/2), and has a better finite sample performance. Later, Jiang et al.~(2020) extended the results to changes in AR(1) model parameter under a break size of order $O(n^{-1/2})$. However, their results rely on the specific structure of continuous-time process approximation to the change-in-mean or AR(1) models and is thus not straightforward to be extended to general time series models. In this project, we intend to derive the asymptotic distribution of a change-point estimator for a general time series model under break sizes order $O(n^{-alpha}$ of three regimes: $01 / 2$. Instead of using discretizations of continuous-time processes as in Jiang et al.~(2018, 2020), we propose to directly analyze the asymptotic behavior of the objective function used in the change-point estimation. This allows us to obtain different types of asymptotic distributions for the whole spectrum of values of $alpha$, instead of a specific range in the literature. Nevertheless, since the break size is typically unknown in practice, determining the appropriate type of asymptotic distribution for the change-point estimator in practical applications is challenging. Therefore, we intend to propose bootstrap procedures for inference of change-points which work under a range of break size orders. In summary, this study will provide a unified framework for inference of change-points in time series, where more accurate confidence intervals can be constructed regardless of break sizes. This project will facilitate significant progress in many fields of study including econometric, environmental sciences, finance, hydrology and physics. 本計畫的目標是研究不同變點大小下時間序列變點的漸近分佈，並開發一個適用於任何變點大小的統一變點推斷框架。 在過去的幾十年中，變點分析引起了人們的廣泛關注，並在許多科學領域中得到了廣泛的應用。然而，在時間序列模型中，一些與變點估計的漸近分佈相關的問題仍未解決。例如，研究發現，對於兩種類型的突變大小，即$n^{-alpha}$，$alpha$在(0,1/2)中，以及固定$alpha$（$alpha=0$），最大似然估計的分佈有所不同。然而，對於$alpha$的其他情況尚不清楚。最近，Jiang et.al（2018）利用一種涉及連續時間過程離散化的技術，建立了變異為$O(n^{-1/2})$（$alpha$=1/2）時最小二乘估計的漸近分佈。此漸近分佈不同於$alpha$=0$和$alpha$在(0,1/2)的情況，並且具有更好的有限樣本表現。後來，Jiang et al.（2020）將結果擴展到變異為 $O(n^{-1/2})$ 階的 AR(1) 模型參數的變化。然而，他們的結果依賴於平均值變化或 AR(1) 模型的連續時間過程近似的特定結構，因此不易推廣到一般的時間序列模型。 在本專案中，我們旨在推導一般時間序列模型在變異大小階為 $O(n^{-alpha}$ 的情況下，變點估計量的漸近分佈，並考慮以下三種情況：$01 / 2$。我們並不像 Jiang et al.那樣使用連續時間過程的離散化，而是提出直接分析變點估計中使用的目標函數的漸近行為。然而，由於在實踐中變異大小通常是未知的，因此在實際應用中確定變點估計量的合適漸近分佈類型具有挑戰性。因此，我們打算提出用於推斷變點的樞軸量，該樞軸量可在一系列變異大小階數下工作。 在綜上所述，本研究將為時間序列突變點的推論提供一個統一的框架，無論突變點大小如何，都能建構出更精確的置信區間。該計畫將促進計量經濟學、環境科學、金融學、水文學和物理學等眾多研究領域的重大進展。

14304525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304525.value: 非均勻麥克斯韋方程式的穩健多尺度計算方法

14304525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304525.value: Electromagnetic metamaterials are artificially structured materials engineered to control and manipulate electromagnetic waves in ways not possible with natural materials. By carefully arranging these structures on a scale smaller than the wavelength of interest, metamaterials can exhibit unusual electromagnetic properties. The magnificent phenomena of electromagnetic metamaterial are usually attributed to their strong heterogeneity. For the design of these materials, one convincing approach is the use of numerical simulations. Due to the high heterogeneity and contrast of these materials, classical numerical schemes for heterogeneous Maxwell's equations are inefficient and not robust. Multiscale computational methods, aiming to capture the small-scale information of solutions due to heterogeneity with a reduced computational cost, are particularly well-suited for the simulations. In contrast to classical elliptic problems, the coefficients in Maxwell's equations can deviate from being solely positive real values, and they can be negative-valued or complex-valued. This fact gives additional challenges in the design of efficient numerical schemes. Consequently, numerical stability, robustness to contrast ratios and heterogeneity are primary concerns in the design of multiscale computational methods for heterogeneous Maxwell's equations. In this project, our aim is to develop efficient and robust multiscale computational methods for heterogeneous Maxwell's equations. The proposed multiscale framework is based on the construction of multiscale basis functions for both trial and test spaces. The key ingredients are the use of local spectral decomposition, oversampling and energy minimization. The resulting basis functions satisfy exponential decay property and the convergence is robust with respect to the heterogeneity of the material. The proposed methodologies are significantly different from existing techniques, and can be applied to complex-valued coefficients. We will also develop stability and convergence results for the time-harmonic case. Furthermore, in order to efficiently address different heterogeneity, we will develop adaptive basis enrichment strategies. This is based on a novel error indicator that is robust with respect to the contrast and heterogeneity of the coefficients. The convergence of the proposed adaptive multiscale method will be analyzed. The proposed research provides a new class of multiscale computational methods for applications involving electromagnetic properties in complex materials. The research works contain novel mathematical ideas and computational techniques. We expect that our methodology will provide an accurate and efficient tool for many realistic applications. We also expect that our proposed methods will give significant impacts in both mathematical sciences and application areas where modeling by heterogeneous Maxwell's equations play a vital role. 電磁超材料是人工設計的結構材料，其設計目的是以天然材料無法實現的方式控制和操縱電磁波。透過精心排列這些結構，使其尺寸小於目標波長，超材料可以展現出不同尋常的電磁特性。電磁超材料的這些奇特現象通常歸因於其強大的異質性。對於這類材料的設計，一個令人信服的方法是使用數值模擬。由於這些材料的高度異質性和對比度，用於非均勻麥克斯韋方程式的經典數值方案效率低且不穩健。多尺度計算方法旨在以較低的計算成本捕捉由於異質性而產生的解的小尺度信息，因此特別適合於此類模擬。與經典橢圓問題不同，麥克斯韋方程中的係數可以不完全為正實值，它們可以是負值或複值。這一事實為高效數值方案的設計帶來了額外的挑戰。因此，數值穩定性、對比和異質性的穩健性是設計非均勻麥克斯韋方程組多尺度計算方法的主要考慮因素。 在本專案中，我們的目標是開發高效且穩健的多尺度計算方法，用於非均勻麥克斯韋方程組。所提出的多尺度框架是基於為試驗空間和測試空間建立多尺度基函數。 其關鍵要素是局部譜分解、過採樣和能量最小化。所得基函數滿足指數衰減特性，且收斂性對於材料的非均勻性具有穩健性。所提出的方法與現有技術有顯著不同，可以應用於復值係數。我們也將針對時諧情況開發穩定性和收斂性結果。此外，為了有效地處理不同的非均勻性，我們將開發自適應基底函數增強策略。這基於一種新的誤差指標，對於係數的對比度和非均勻性具有穩健性。我們將分析所提出的自適應多尺度方法的收斂性。 本研究為涉及複雜材料電磁特性的應用提供了一類全新的多尺度計算方法。研究成果包含新穎的數學思想和計算技術。我們期望，我們的方法能夠為許多實際應用提供精確且有效率的工具。我們也期望，我們提出的方法能夠在數學科學以及非均勻麥克斯韋方程組建模至關重要的應用領域產生重大影響。

14304925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14304925.value: 可用於室內外應用的寬動態範圍有機光伏器件的形貌優化研究

14304925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14304925.value: Organic photovoltaics (OPVs) have recently garnered considerable attention as promising power sources for self-powered electronic devices, such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and personalized health monitors. These devices require efficient operation in both outdoor and indoor scenarios, underscoring the need to develop wide-dynamic-range (WD) OPVs. Achieving high-performance WD OPVs that function efficiently under both outdoor and indoor conditions is challenging, as outdoor light spans a broader absorption spectrum and exhibits much higher intensity, while indoor light is much more narrow-banded with significantly weaker light intensity. Consequently, the charge carrier dynamics within the same device can differ dramatically under outdoor and indoor settings. A comprehensive understanding of the structure-performance relationship in OPVs across these different light conditions is still lacking, making it difficult to identify the optimal morphology required for favorable charge carrier dynamics. Based on previous works, common strategies employed to enhance outdoor OPV performance may not apply to indoor settings, and vice versa. Hence, this proposal aims at establishing a robust correlation between charge carrier dynamics and active layer morphology under different light conditions. We will use voltage-dependent capacitance spectroscopy to investigate the dependence of charge carrier mobility, lifetime, and drift-diffusion length on light intensities, focusing on the interplay between bimolecular recombination and trap-assisted monomolecular recombination. Morphology insights will be gained through grazing-incidence X-ray and neutron scattering and atomic force spectroscopy, linking structure to device characteristics. The goal is to understand the desired morphology for optimized charge carrier dynamics in both outdoor and indoor settings and to develop effective morphology tuning strategies for WD OPVs with power conversion efficiencies over 20 % outdoor and 30 % indoor. The successful implementation of this project will yield fundamental insights into the light-dependent charge carrier dynamics and the corresponding morphology requirement for high-performance WD OPVs, promoting their commercialization for real-world applications. 有機光伏器件近年來因其在物聯網與個性化健康監測等自供電電子設備中的潛在應用而備受關注。這類設備要求在室外與室內光照環境下均能高效運行，從而凸顯了開發寬動態範有機光伏器件的必要性。實現既能在室外強光、高強度、寬光譜範圍內高效工作，又能在室內弱光、窄波段條件下保持優異性能的有機光伏器件極具挑戰性。同一器件在兩種條件下的載流子動力學差異巨大。目前尚缺乏對在不同光照條件下有機光伏器件的結構–性能關系的系統認識，從而阻礙了最優形貌的設計。以往提升室外有機光伏器件性能的常用策略往往在室內條件下失效，反之亦然。 因此，本項目擬建立不同光照強度下載流子動力學與活性層形貌之間的關聯。我們將通過電壓依賴電容譜法研究載流子遷移率、壽命及漂移-擴散長度隨光強的變化，重點解析雙分子覆合與單分子覆合的作用機制。同時，借助掠入射X射線與中子散射及原子力譜學手段對形貌進行表征，將結構特征與器件性能進行關聯分析。明確室外與室內環境下優化載流子動力學所需的形貌特征，並制定高效的形貌調控策略，力爭實現室外光電轉換效率超20%、室內超30%的寬動態範圍有機光伏器件。該項目的成功實施將揭示光照依賴的載流子動力學機理及其相應的形貌需求，為高性能的寬動態範圍有機光伏器件的商業化應用奠定堅實的基礎。

14305025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14305025.value: 液滴的撞擊力與液滴形貌之間的關聯探究

14305025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14305025.value: This project is designed to experimentally investigate the impact force exerted by a liquid droplet when it impacts a solid substrate. Our focus is on understanding how variations in droplet morphology and topology influence this force. We intend to systematically manipulate droplet shapes by incorporating a range of aspect ratios, varying local curvatures from positive to negative, and altering droplet flatness characterized by the superellipse index. Additionally, we will examine the effects of different droplet topologies by comparing toroidal and spherical shapes. Our goal is to develop a comprehensive understanding of how these fundamental properties affect droplet impact force — a phenomenon that is prevalent in both everyday occurrences and diverse industrial processes. Drop impacts are omnipresent in activities such as inkjet printing, spray cooling, and surface coating, and their dynamics are critically important yet not fully understood. While high-speed photography has unveiled many aspects of droplet behavior, including deposition, rebound, and splash [1], direct measurements of impact forces are still largely lacking [2]. The impact forces are crucial to applications like soil erosion prevention, turbine blade maintenance, and jet cutting [2]. Historically, researchers have focused on spherical droplets due to the challenges in systematically varying drop shapes. However, non-spherical droplets are common in nature and industry, due to factors such as air drag and oscillation during droplet formation. This project aims to bridge this gap by creating non-spherical droplets, such as super-elliptical, concave, and doughnut-shaped droplets, using ferrofluids in a controlled magnetic field. The impact forces will be measured using piezoelectric sensors, complemented by high-speed photography. This combination provides a direct and comprehensive analysis of how droplet morphology and topology influence impact forces. As an experienced researcher in the field of droplet impact, with significant contributions to understanding droplet impact dynamics and the effect of droplet shape (PRL2005, PNAS2015, PRX2017, and Nat.Comm.2021), I am well-equipped to lead this investigation. This three-year project, with a proposed budget of approximately $200,000, seeks to extend our fundamental understanding of droplet morphology and topology's influence on impact forces. The insights gained could significantly benefit multiple industrial applications, potentially leading to advancements in related technologies. 本研究旨在通過實驗探究液滴衝擊力的形成機制，重點解析液滴形狀變化對衝擊力的影響規律。我們將系統性調控液滴形貌特徵，引入超橢圓形貌輪廓，並對比分析球形與超橢圓液滴的衝擊力差異，從而建立液滴基本形狀特性與衝擊力間的關聯模型。此物理現象廣泛存在於日常情境與工業製程中，例如噴墨印刷、噴霧冷卻及表面鍍膜等領域[1]。儘管高速攝影技術已揭示液滴沉積、回彈與飛濺等動態行為[1]，衝擊力的直接量測仍存在研究空白，而此參數對土壤侵蝕防治、渦輪葉片維護與噴射切割等應用至關重要[2]。 傳統研究受制於液滴形貌調控技術，多聚焦於理想球形液滴。然而在實際工業場景中，受空氣阻力與液滴成型震蕩等因素影響，非球形液滴普遍存在。本項目創新性地採用磁性流體在可控磁場中生成超橢圓形、凹面形及環形等特殊形貌液滴，結合壓電傳感器與高速攝影同步測量系統，實現對衝擊力特徵的多維度表徵。研究團隊在液滴衝擊領域具有深厚積累，已在PRL（2005）、PNAS（2015）、PRX（2017）及Nat.Comm.（2021）等頂刊發表系列成果，特別在液滴-基材相互作用機制與形貌效應研究方面具有國際領先優勢。

14305425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14305425.value: 自旋三重態超導中的自旋輸運

14305425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14305425.value: Superconductors are known as "perfect conductors," where a charge current flows without resistance—a supercurrent of charge. But can there be a supercurrent of spin, where spin angular momentum flows without decay? In conventional superconductors, a supercurrent cannot carry net spin due to spin-singlet Cooper pairs; the paired electrons have antiparallel spins, precluding any spin polarization. In contrast, spin-triplet superconductors, where Cooper pairs have parallel spins, could support a net spin supercurrent. Despite decades of searching, confirmed cases of spin-triplet superconductors are still lacking. Recently, promising candidate materials for spin-triplet pairing have emerged. Notably, the PI and collaborators conducted phase-sensitive experiments revealing odd-parity symmetry in superconducting β-Bi₂Pd—a key signature of the spatial wave function of a spin-triplet Cooper pair. This discovery opens a new material platform for spin transport in superconducting states. Long-distance, potentially dissipationless spin transport in a superconductor could both serve as key experimental evidence for spin-triplet pairing and pave the way for important applications, marking the intersection of superconductivity and spintronics. We propose using non-local spin valve (NLSV) experiments—a well-established method in spintronics for generating and detecting pure spin currents in diffusive metals—to study spin transport in spin-triplet superconductors. Preliminary experiments by the PI and Co-I on β-Bi₂Pd show promising results, indicating non-local spin transport over micrometer-scale distances in its superconducting phase. This suggests that a spin supercurrent may be realized in β-Bi₂Pd due to intrinsic spin-triplet pairing, which shall be verified through systematic experimental studies of spin current propagation, characteristic length scales, and temperature and magnetic field dependencies in the proposed study. We also aim to expand NLSV experiments to two other material categories of candidate spin-triplet superconductors. The first is noncentrosymmetric superconductors, represented by α-BiPd, where singlet-triplet pair mixing is expected due to broken parity symmetry. The second group is superconducting altermagnets, represented by RuO2, which is proposed to host spin-triplet pairing state. Our study could establish NLSV experiments as an effective method for probing spin configurations in unconventional superconducting pairing states. Simultaneously, it may achieve long-distance spin transport with minimal or no dissipation, a groundbreaking advancement for spintronics. 自旋三重態超導體因其庫珀對具平行自旋排列，有望實現無耗散的自旋超流，然而實驗上仍缺乏明確驗證。近期，我們透過相位敏感實驗在 β-Bi₂Pd 中觀察到奇宇稱配對對稱性，支持其為自旋三重態配對候選材料，並提供在超導態中研究自旋傳輸的全新平台。 本項目擬以非局域自旋閥實驗探測自旋三重態超導體中的自旋輸運行為。初步結果顯示，在 β-Bi₂Pd 的超導相中可觀察至微米尺度的非局域自旋流輸運的訊號，顯示可能存在自旋超流現象。我們將系統性研究其自旋電流傳播特性、相應長度尺度、及對溫度與磁場的依賴關係，以驗證其配對機制。 此外，項目亦將拓展至其他候選系統，包括具反對稱自旋軌道耦合的非中心對稱超導體以及具有交錯磁序的超導材料，以評估非局域自旋閥實驗作為探測非常規超導配對對稱性的普適性。此研究不僅有助於理解自旋三重態超導機制，也將推動超導自旋電子學的發展。

14306225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14306225.value: 一種新型 sp2-sp3 雙硼試劑在過渡金屬催化非對稱雙硼化中的應用

14306225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14306225.value: Incorporation of boron into organic molecules has found valuable applications in synthetic chemistry. Based on the versatile carbon-boron (C-B) bond, various functional groups can be introduced efficiently. As an alternative to traditional synthetic methods, such a “borylation-then-functionalization” strategy has shown its advantages in efficiency, atom-economy and universality. Its potential in the synthesis and late-stage derivatization of functional organic molecules has attracted considerable research interest in methodology development for borylation reactions. Among all the achievements, transition metal-catalysis has emerged as a pivotal strategy in C-B bond formation, due to its versatility across different reaction modes, broad substrate applicability, and excellent selectivity control. However, excess diboron reagents are usually used to prepare mono-borylation products, compromising the boron atom-economy. In comparison, transition metal-catalyzed diborylation transfers both boryl moieties in the diboron reagent to the target substrate, enhancing synthetic utility through introducing an additional editable boron moiety. Usually, borylation agents in these reactions are sp2-sp2 diborons, e.g. B2pin2, leading to the introduction of two identical or chemically similar boryls on substrates. This similarity complicates the subsequent differentiation of these boryls when aiming to introduce distinct functional groups via sequential C-B bond transformations. With constant research interest and efforts in creating new boron synthons, we have recently developed an unsymmetrical sp2-sp3 diboron reagent (UDB-G1) and demonstrated its advantages as a borylation agent. Utilizing UDB-G1, we have successfully incorporated chemically easily distinguishable sp2 and sp3 boryl groups into substrates, enabling controlled, stepwise C-B bond functionalization. Given the advantage of UDB-G1 and transition metal-catalysis in borylation reactions, we plan to integrate our diboron reagent into transition metal-catalyzed diborylation. However, the inherent reducibility and interference of B-H make UDB-G1 incompatible with many transition metal catalytic systems. In view of these research problems and based on our experience in boron chemistry, we plan, in this proposal, to develop a new generation of unsymmetrical sp2-sp3 diboron reagent (UDB-G2) and apply it in transition metal-catalyzed diborylation. Furthermore, the asymmetric diborylation will be explored, anticipating to find applications in the synthesis of centrally and axially chiral molecules. The anticipated outcomes of this project include enhanced understanding of the properties and reactivities of sp2-sp3 diboron reagents in various catalytic systems. The research is expected to provide a series of general synthetic methodologies, including selective diborylation and sequential derivatization of diborylated molecules. These advancements will further facilitate chiral organic molecules synthesis, potentially expanding the frontiers of both boron chemistry and organic synthesis. 將硼原子引入有機分子在合成化學中具有重要應用價值。得益於多功能的碳-硼（C-B）鍵，各類官能團皆可高效引入。與傳統合成方法相比，以「先硼化-再官能化」為核心的策略在合成效率、原子經濟性及普適性方面均展現優勢，並在功能分子合成及後期衍生化中顯示出巨大潛力，因而促使硼化反應方法學受到廣泛關注。 在眾多研究成果中，過渡金屬催化因其反應模式豐富、底物適用範圍廣及選擇性控制優異，已成為構建 C-B 鍵的關鍵手段。然而，在獲得單硼化產物時往往需要使用過量雙硼試劑，從而降低了硼的原子經濟性。相較之下，過渡金屬催化的雙硼化能夠將雙硼試劑中的兩個硼基全部轉移至目標底物，從而提高合成實用性。現有反應通常採用 sp2-sp2 型雙硼試劑（如 B2pin2），導致在底物上引入兩個相同或性質相近的硼基，進一步區分並選擇性轉化這兩個硼基頗具挑戰。 為尋求新型硼合成子，我們近期開發了非對稱 sp2-sp3 雙硼試劑 UDB-G1，並證明其在硼化反應中的優勢。利用 UDB-G1，可在底物上同時引入易於區分的 sp2 與 sp3 硼基，從而實現可控的分步 C-B 鍵功能化。 鑑於 UDB-G1 及過渡金屬催化在硼化中的互補優勢，我們計畫將該雙硼試劑應用於過渡金屬催化雙硼化。然而，UDB-G1 中還原性B-H 的干擾使其與諸多金屬催化體系不相容。鑑於此，本計畫擬開發新一代非對稱sp2-sp3 雙硼試劑 UDB-G2，並將其應用於過渡金屬催化雙硼化。此外，我們將探索不對稱雙硼化，以期用於合成中心手性及軸手性分子。 本項目預期成果包括：加深對 sp2-sp3 雙硼試劑在各類催化體系中性質與反應性的理解；建立一系列通用合成方法，如選擇性雙硼化及雙硼化產物的連續衍生化。上述進展將促進手性有機分子合成，並有望拓展硼化學與有機合成的研究邊界。

14306725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14306725.value: 主分層的因果公平性：利用最優傳輸實現公平性

14306725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14306725.value: The rapid advancement of machine learning methods has revolutionized decision-making across various domains, yet these algorithms frequently encounter significant challenges related to fairness and discrimination. This issue is particularly pronounced in healthcare, where machine learning is increasingly relied upon to inform clinical decisions. Biased data can lead to biased algorithms, undermining their reliability and perpetuating systemic inequities. As a result, the integrity of the entire decision-making process may be compromised, disproportionately affecting underrepresented populations that are often marginalized by existing systems.This proposal addresses the critical need for equitable algorithms that not only ensure predictive accuracy but also prioritize fairness. In healthcare, disparities in algorithmic treatment recommendations can lead to harmful outcomes, highlighting the urgency of this issue. To confront these challenges, we introduce a novel two-stage framework centered on the concept of principal fairness, which advocates for equitable treatment assignments based on similar treatment benefits. In the first stage, we will implement a causal representation learning model, augmented by preliminary prediction models, to effectively capture the intricate relationships within high-dimensional healthcare data. This approach will facilitate the identification of principal strata, which are essential for achieving our fairness objectives. In the second stage, we will employ optimal transport methods to explicitly integrate predicted potential outcomes into our fairness learning process. Our framework is designed to achieve principal parity guarantees while maintaining a defined boundary for accuracy loss. By systematically addressing the intertwined challenges of data complexity and fairness, our framework aims to enhance the integrity of healthcare decision-making, ultimately promoting more equitable patient outcomes. This research not only deepens the understanding of algorithmic fairness in healthcare but also plays a vital role in rebuilding trust in healthcare systems, ensuring that all populations receive the quality care they deserve. The proposal also outlines several promising future directions for our approach. We will investigate the establishment of an accuracy-fairness Pareto frontier to better understand and quantify the trade-offs between accuracy and fairness. Additionally, we aim to develop straightforward post-processing methods that minimize prediction discrepancies while ensuring fairness. To further enhance the interpretability of our causal inference, we will incorporate latent feature analysis and enforce sparsity constraints. These extensions will refine our framework, bolstering its robustness and applicability across diverse healthcare settings. By addressing these critical research gaps, we aspire to advance the field of algorithmic fairness and promote equitable healthcare practices that prioritize patient well-being and social justice. 機器學習方法的快速進步已徹底改變各領域的決策制定，然而這些演算法經常面臨與公平性與歧視相關的重大挑戰。此一問題在醫療照護領域尤為突出，因為機器學習日益被用以支援臨床決策。帶有偏見的信息可能導致偏誤的演算法，削弱其可靠性並延續系統性不平等。其結果是，整體決策流程的完整性可能遭到破壞，且影響會集中於那些常被現有系統邊緣化的、代表性不足的族群上。本項目會應對兼顧預測準確度與公平性的演算法之迫切需求。在醫療領域中，演算法對治療建議的差異可能導致不良結果，凸顯此議題的急迫性。 為了正面面對這些挑戰，我們提出一個以「主分層公平性」（principal fairness）為核心的創新雙階段框架，其主張根據相似的治療效益進行公平的治療指派。第一階段中，我們將實作因果表示學習模型，並輔以初步預測模型，以有效捕捉高維醫療資料中的複雜關係。此一方法將有助於辨識「主分層」（principal strata），這對達成我們的公平目標至關重要。第二階段中，我們將採用最優傳輸方法，將預測的潛在結果明確整合進公平學習流程。我們的框架旨在在維持有界的準確度損失下，達成主分層公平性（principal parity）保證。透過系統性地處理信息的複雜度並兼顧公平性，本框架期望強化醫療決策的完整性，最終促進更為公平的病患診斷治療結果。本研究不僅深化對醫療領域演算法公平性的理解，亦對重建社會對醫療體系的信任扮演關鍵角色，確保所有族群皆能獲得其應得的優質照護。 本研究同時也勾勒出多項具前景的未來方向。我們將探索建立「準確度—公平性」的帕累托前緣，以更好地理解並量化兩者之間的權衡。此外，我們將開發簡潔的後處理方法，在確保公平性的同時，將預測差異降至最低。為了進一步提升因果推論的可解釋性，我們將納入潛在特徵分析並施加稀疏性約束。這些延伸將精煉我們的框架，強化其穩健性與在多元醫療場域中的適用性。藉由彌補這些關鍵研究缺口，我們期望推進演算法公平性的發展，並促進以病患福祉與社會正義為優先的公平醫療實務。

14307125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307125.value: 帶有隨機變量的多尺度動理學方程的高效數值方法及離散次強製性分析

14307125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307125.value: Kinetic models have wide range of applications, from rarefied gas, plasmas, astrophysics to social and biological sciences. Its computational challenges include curse-of-dimensionality, multiple temporal and spatial scales, and uncertainties. This proposal proposes to address some of these issues, from both theoretical and computational aspects. Specially we plan to study the following problems: • Hypocoercivity analysis for multiscale Boltzmann equation with discrete velocity and uncertain spaces; • Hypocoercivity analysis for multiscale and linear kinetic equations with discrete time-space-velocity-uncertainty variables; • Efficient computational methods for the Vlasov-Poisson system with uncertainties in the quasi-neutral regime. Hypocoercivity analysis was developed to understand the long-time behavior of kinetic equations whose collision operators are usually degenerately dissipative. Using it to study numerical schemes will allow us to understand the long-time behavior of these schemes, which has seen only few recent activities, none for kinetic equations with random uncertainties. Our research aims to fill some of these gaps. Furthermore, we will develop efficient stochastic Asymptotic-Preserving and positivity-preserving schemes for the two-species Vlasov-Poisson system in the quasi-neutral regime, including uncertain boundary conditions, which has potential applications in plasma fusion research. 動理學模型的應用範圍極爲廣泛，涵蓋稀薄氣體、等離子體、天體物理，社會科學與生命科學等多個領域。然而，其計算過程麵臨諸多挑戰，例如維度災難、多尺度問題以及隨機參數等。本項目旨在從理論和計算兩個層麵入手，嚐試解決其中部分難題。 具體而言，我們將重點研究以下問題： 1. 針對具有離散速度與不確定性參數的多尺度玻爾茲曼方程，開展離散數值格式的次強製性分析； 2. 研究多尺度線性動力學方程在離散格式下的時間，空間，速度以及隨機空間的次強製性分析； 3. 開髮準中性狀態下含隨機參數的弗拉索夫–泊松模型的高效計算方法。 次強製性分析原本用於研究帶有碰撞算子，具有退化耗散特性的動理學方程解的長時間表現。將其應用於數值方法的分析研究，可幫助我們理解這些數值格式解的長時間表現。該領域對於確定性動理學問題的現有工作寥寥，而針對含隨機參數的動理學方程的研究更是空白，本項目試圖填補部分空白。此外，我們將針對準中性狀態下的多物種弗拉索夫–泊松繫統，開髮高效且兼具"漸近保持"與正性保持的數值算法，包括對不確定性邊界條件的處理。此項研究有望爲等離子體聚變領域提供潛在應用價值。

14307225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307225.value: 天文學亞毫米波偏振儀競賽

14307225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307225.value: Polarimetry plays a critical role in observational astronomy, contributing to the detection of primordial gravitational waves, interstellar medium (ISM) magnetic fields, and extrasolar planets, among other phenomena. Submillimeter polarimetry is often regarded as the "last frontier" in the observations of celestial electromagnetic waves. The atmosphere significantly emits and absorbs at submillimeter wavelengths, and the variations in atmospheric emissions, known as "sky noise," can be much stronger than celestial signals. Additionally, the polarization levels of the ISM are typically only a few percent, and even lower for the Cosmic Microwave Background B-mode, necessitating highly efficient polarimeters to handle these challenging conditions. Despite substantial progress in submillimeter detectors over the past two decades, the optics of polarimeters have not evolved. This stagnation is due to the remote locations and limited number of submillimeter observatories available for accessing sky noise for optical experiments. Our recent innovation, the Sky Noise Simulator (SNoS), has the potential to transform this landscape by accurately replicating sky noise in a laboratory setting. In the first application of SNoS, we will evaluate the performance of two state-of-the-art methodologies alongside a novel approach for constructing submillimeter polarimeters. For the first time, astronomical polarimeters can be developed based on experimental data rather than relying solely on theoretical models. 偏振測量在觀測天文學中扮演著關鍵角色，有助於探測原始引力波、星際介質（ISM）磁場以及太陽系外行星等現象。次毫米波偏振測量常被視為天體電磁波觀測的「最後疆界」。大氣在次毫米波波段有顯著的輻射與吸收，且大氣輻射的變化，稱為「天空噪聲」，其強度往往遠超過天體信號。此外，星際介質的偏振程度通常僅有幾個百分比，對於宇宙微波背景輻射的B模偏振更低，這就需要高效率的偏振儀來應對這些嚴峻的條件。 儘管過去二十年次毫米波探測器取得了重大進展，偏振儀的光學系統卻未見演進。這種停滯主要是因為次毫米波天文台位置偏遠且數量有限，難以利用天空噪聲進行光學實驗。我們近期創新的「天空噪聲模擬器」（Sky Noise Simulator，SNoS）有潛力改變這一現狀，能在實驗室中精確模擬天空噪聲。在SNoS的首次應用中，我們將評估兩種最先進方法以及一種新穎的次毫米波偏振儀構建方法的性能。這是首次能夠基於實驗數據，而非僅依賴理論模型，來開發天文偏振儀。

14307525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307525.value: 近似消息傳遞算法的非漸進理論

14307525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307525.value: The family of Approximate Message Passing (AMP) algorithms has emerged as a unified framework offering powerful solutions in sample-starved applications, with the potential to achieve efficient estimation near information-theoretic limits, accurately quantify the risk and uncertainty of estimators, and bridge the gap between information and computation. AMP is known for its rapid convergence and statistically efficiency, and it can also be employed as a powerful theoretical machinery to study other statistical procedures in high dimension. However, previous AMP theory is largely asymptotic, assuming problem dimensions tend to infinity while the number of iterations remains fixed. This approach fails to capture AMP's finite-sample dynamics, particularly when the number of iterations scales with the problem size. Building on our preliminary work to understand the non-asymptotic behavior of AMP, this project aims to advance the non-asymptotic theory of AMP, applying it to problems such as (generalized) linear models and low-rank matrix estimation, including sparse and robust regression, as well as $Z_2$ synchronization. Particularly, the primary goal of this research is to advance the foundations of AMP by developing a non-asymptotic framework capable of predicting the algorithm’s behavior in finite-sample settings. The proposed research program will be organized around three key tasks: (1) Task 1: Convergence analysis and uncertainty quantification for AMP; (2) Task 2: Universality phenomena beyond i.i.d. Gaussian case; (3) Task 3: Leveraging AMP in modern machine learning pipelines. 近似消息傳遞 (AMP) 算法已成為一個為樣本匱乏的應用提供有效的解決方案的統一的框架。它可在信息理論極限實現有效估計，準確量化估計量的風險和不確定性，並彌合信息與計算之間的差距。 AMP 以其快速收斂和統計效率而聞名，它也可以作為一種強大的理論工具來研究其他高維度統計過程。然而，先前的 AMP 理論在很大程度上是漸近的，即假設問題維度趨向於無窮大，而迭代次數保持不變。這種方法無法得到 AMP 的有限樣本動態（尤其是當迭代次數隨問題規模而改變時）。 基於我們對 AMP 非漸近行為的初步理解，本項目旨在推進 AMP 的非漸近理論，並將其應用於（廣義）線性模型和低秩矩陣估計等問題，包括稀疏回歸和穩健回歸，以及 $Z_2$ 同步。具體而言，本研究的主要目標是通過開發一個能夠預測算法在有限樣本設定下行為的非漸近框架來推進 AMP 的基礎研究。研究計畫將圍繞三個關鍵任務進行：(1) 任務1：AMP的收斂性分析和不確定性量化；(2) 任務2：獨立同分佈高斯分佈以外的普適性現象；(3) 任務3：在現代機器學習流程中利用 AMP。

14307825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307825.value: We propose to extend the recently developed analytic Langlands program to the setting of a Hausel-Proudfoot spaces or multiplicative hypertoric varieties, and more general integrable systems arising in geometric representation theory. Along the way, we propose to study the de Rahm and Dolbeault variants of the Langlands correspondence in this setting. We propose to thereby clarify aspects of the Langlands correspondence in more general settings. 我們建議將最近開發的分析朗蘭茲程序擴展到 Hausel-Proudfoot 空間或乘法高次元變種的環境，以及在幾何表示理論中出現的更一般的可整系統中。在此過程中，我們建議研究 Langlands 對應的 de Rahm 和 Dolbeault 變異。我們建議藉此釐清 Langlands 對應關係在更一般設定中的各個面向。

14307925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307925.value: 時間序列趨勢協方差和雜訊長期協方差：全局視角和局部視角

14307925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307925.value: What is correlation? It typically refers to the stochastic relationship among different series in the fields of statistics; however, it may sometimes be understood as the intrinsic relationship among various deterministic trends of data. Besides, most existing tools infer trend variation and relationships globally. With locally stationary time series becoming increasingly popular, it calls for research on local inference tools. There are three goals in this project. First, it provides new insights into testing trends that adapt to the dependence structure among multiple time series. Second, it addresses misconceptions about trend correlation in certain communities and offers powerful tools for inferring trend correlation. Third, it develops localized methods with comprehensive theoretical support for trend inference on locally stationary time series. The proposed research consists of five stages: Stage 1: Global trend variance. We develop a multivariate trend stationarity test that fully adapts to the serial dependence and cross-dependence among multiple time series. The test is derived based on an estimator of trend variance that converges faster than the root-n rate under the null hypothesis. We argue that trend covariance may be beneficial for testing stationarity in multivariate time series. The test is extended to a high-dimensional setting based on the assumption of component-wise weak dependence. Stage 2: Global trend correlation. We demonstrate that trend correlation and covariance are inconsistently estimated by standard measures, e.g., Pearson's correlation and linear regression coefficients. We provide new methodologies for trend correlation tests and argue that correlation-based tests are superior to covariance-based tests. A systematic treatment of different types of correlation tests, such as pair correlation and portmanteau correlation trend tests, is studied. Stage 3: Local long-run covariance function estimation. We propose a general difference-based long-run variance function estimator under a locally stationary setting. The detailed formulas for the optimal bandwidths are derived for the first time in the literature. The robustness properties are studied and enhanced by a rank-based modification. Stage 4: Local trend variance. We apply the proposed variance estimator to various trend-testing problems under local stationarity, e.g., change point tests and the construction of simultaneous confidence bands. Real-data applications are also explored. Stage 5: Local trend correlation. We generalize the proposed principles for trend correlation tests from two perspectives: a local trend correlation test at a specific resolution, and a lagged local trend correlation test aimed at identifying time intervals in different time series that exhibit trend correlation through a multi-scale test. 什麼是相關性？在統計領域，它通常指不同序列之間的隨機關係；然而，有時它也被理解為數據中各種確定性趨勢之間的內在聯繫。此外，大多數現有工具推斷的是全局趨勢變化和關係。隨著局部平穩時間序列的日益普及，這引導對局部推論工具的研究。本專案有三個目標：首先，它為檢驗適應多個時間序列之間依賴關係的趨勢提供新的見解。其次，它解決了某些領域對趨勢相關性的誤解，並提供了推斷趨勢相關性的強大工具。再者，它發展了具有全面理論支持的局部化方法，用於對局部平穩時間序列進行趨勢推論。本研究分為五個階段： 第一階段：全域趨勢變異數。我們開發了一種多元趨勢平穩性檢定方法，可以完全適應多個時間序列之間的序列依賴關係和交叉依賴關係。此檢定基於趨勢變異數估計量推導，其收斂速度快於零假設下的根-n收斂速度。我們認為趨勢協方差可能有利於檢定多變量時間序列的平穩性。基於分量弱相關性假設，此檢定擴展到高維環境。 第二階段：全局趨勢相關性。我們證明，趨勢相關性和協方差與標準測量（例如皮爾遜相關性和線性迴歸係數）的估計不一致。我們為趨勢相關性檢定提供了新的方法，並論證了基於相關性的檢定優於基於協方差的檢定。我們系統性地研究了不同類型的相關性檢驗，例如成對相關性和混成相關性趨勢檢驗。 第三階段：局部長期協方差函數估計。我們提出了一個在局部平穩環境下基於一般差分的長期方差函數估計量。首次在文獻中推導出最優頻寬的詳細公式。研究了其穩健性，並透過基於秩的修正進行了增強。 第四階段：局部趨勢變異數。我們將提出的變異數估計器應用於局部平穩性下的各種趨勢檢定問題，例如變點檢定和同時置信帶的建構。此外，我們也探索了實際數據的應用。 第五階段：局部趨勢相關性。我們從兩個角度概括了提出的趨勢相關性檢驗原理：特定分辨率的局部趨勢相關性檢驗，以及旨在透過多尺度檢驗識別不同時間序列中表現出趨勢相關性的時間間隔的滯後局部趨勢相關性檢定。

14308125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14308125.value: 基於細菌的生命物質中力學螺旋波的實驗研究

14308125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14308125.value: In this project we propose to carry out a systematic biophysical study on a novel type of self-sustained mechanical wave, i.e., spiral tension wave, in bacterial living matter. The study may provide novel strategies for designing mechanical functionality in bacteria-based living materials. As an emerging class of programmable autonomous matter, living materials consisting of live cells are promising for a range of applications such as cargo delivery, soft robotics, and self-driven biotherapeutics. In order to realize these mechanical functionalities it is crucial to understand and control the large-scale force generation as well as the cell-environment mechanical interaction in living materials. Microorganisms are the premier building blocks of living materials owing to their versatile behavioral repertoire and genetic amenability. In our recent work, we discovered large-scale spatiotemporal regulation of tension force in bacterial living matter, which takes the form of propagating spiral tension waves. Here we aim to understand the microscopic mechanism of the spiral tension waves and to control the tension wave dynamics. We will also study how bacterial living matter interacts with the mechanical environment via the tension waves. For the proposed experimental studies we will combine multiscale microscopy, synthetic biology, and fluorescence imaging techniques. The project lies at the interface of physics, materials science, and biology. The obtained results will be of interest to the communities of living matter physics and living materials engineering. Our study will provide guidance for the autonomous control of large-scale forces in engineered living materials, such as synthetic microbial consortia and microbiome. Meanwhile, mechanical forces are expected to play important roles in the life of microbial communities. Our findings will therefore shed light on the dispersal and morphogenesis of bacterial communities, which is relevant to bacterial colonization in environmental and clinical settings. 本項目旨在研究基於細菌的生命物質中一種新型的波動模式，亦即張力螺旋波。該研究可能為設計基於微生物的活體材料提供新的策略。 由活細胞組成的生命材料是一類可編程的自驅動物質，在物質遞送、軟體機器和自驅動生物醫學材料等領域具有廣闊前景。微生物具有多樣的行為模式和基因可操作性，是構建生命材料的主要對象之一。我們近期的研究在基於細菌的生命物質中發現一種大尺度張力調控機制，這種調控以張力螺旋波的形式在系統中傳播。本研究旨在揭示螺旋張力波的微觀作用機理，並實現對其動態過程的精准調控。對於計畫中的實驗研究，我們將結合多尺度顯微成像、合成生物學和螢光成像技術。 此項目涉及物理學，材料科學和生物學的交叉領域，所獲得的結果將引起生命物質物理學和生物材料工程領域的興趣。我們的研究將為工程化生命材料中設計力學功能提供理論依據。

14308325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14308325.value: 高餘維極小子流形和平均曲率流的正則化

14308325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14308325.value: In this project, the PI proposes to investigate the boundary behaviour of minimal submanifolds and mean curvature flows arising from Allen-Cahn and Ginzburg-Landau type functionals on Riemannian manifolds with boundary. The existence of minimal submanifolds has been a major topic of study in geometry and analysis, which has direct applications in dynamical systems and low-dimensional geometry. While the existence of weak solutions of minimal submanifolds and mean curvature flow have been introduced by Almgren and Brakke in their pioneering work about 50 years ago, it remains a major unsolved problem in geometric analysis about the full description of singularities in such geometric variational problems. Earlier work towards regularity theory make uses of deep results in geometric measure theory. There are some recent discoveries about the relationship between the variational theory for the area functional and the Allen-Cahn and Ginzburg-Landau type functionals that were well studied in phase transition and superconductivity theory. These have led to an alternative novel approach towards the existence and regularity theory for minimal submanifolds and mean curvature flows via regularization, hence providing a new methodology based on techniques from elliptic and parabolic partial differential equations. While major advances have been made for the interior singularities in codimensions at most two, the boundary behaviour has remained mostly unexplored. The main goal of this project is to fill in this gap and apply the state-of-the-art techniques developed to study the boundary effects on minimal submanifolds and their evolution problem. Such mathematical theories will have potential applications in studying the boundary effects in phase transition theory and superconductivity. 此項目旨在研究帶邊黎曼流形上由 Allen-Cahn 和 Ginzburg-Landau 泛函所產生的極小子流形和平均曲率流的邊界行為。極小子流形的存在性一直是幾何和分析領域的一個主要研究主題，在動力系統和低維度幾何中有著直接的應用。雖然 Almgren 和Brakke 在大約50年前的開創性工作中證明了極小子流形和平均曲率流弱解的存在性，但關於此類幾何變分問題中奇點的完整描述仍然是幾何分析中一個尚未解決的主要問題。 早期對於正則性理論的研究主要利用幾何測度論的技巧。最近從相變理論和超導理論中的Allen-Cahn和Ginzburg-Landau型泛函被發現跟面積泛函的變分理論存在密不可分的關係。這些發現為透過正則化研究極小子流形和平均曲率流的存在性和正則性理論提供了一種嶄新的、基於橢圓和拋物偏微分方程技術的新方法方法。雖然在餘維數少於三的情況中，內部奇點的研究已經取得了重大進展，但其邊界行為仍然鮮有探索。本項目的主要目標是填補這一空白，並應用於研究極小子流形邊界效應及其演化問題。這些數學理論將在研究相變理論和超導中的邊界效應方面具有潛在的應用價值。

14309125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14309125.value: 幾何映射問題的動態形式及其應用

14309125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14309125.value: Mapping problems are fundamental in various fields, including imaging and computer graphics, which involve finding optimal transformations to map one domain to another. For instance, mapping problems frequently arise in tasks such as image or surface registration, where the goal is to establish a meaningful one-to-one correspondence between two corresponding images or surfaces. Traditionally, these problems have been addressed using static mapping approaches, which give a single and fixed transformation between two corresponding domains. While extensive research has been conducted on static mapping problems, many real-world scenarios exhibit dynamic characteristics that require time-dependent mappings. Dynamic mapping problems involve computing transformations that evolve over time, adapting to changes in the underlying data or environment. This is crucial for applications such as tracking anatomical changes in medical imaging or modeling real-time object movements in computer vision. In our previous works, we successfully tackled static mapping problems using quasiconformal Teichmüller theories. This proposal aims to develop a novel framework for dynamic quasiconformal mapping problems, bridging the gap between static approaches and the time-varying nature of real-world phenomena. Our goal is to incorporate quasiconformal theories with the gradient flow of probability measures, enabling the computation of time-dependent quasiconformal mappings that evolve with underlying data. This unique combination allows for control over the regularity of the mappings and effective modeling of various phenomena arising from dynamic mapping problems. Our research plan involves two main objectives. Firstly, we will develop a dynamic framework for geometric mapping problems. For this objective, we will explore three main tasks: developing an algorithm for dynamic quasiconformal parameterizations with prescribed density, developing a method for dynamic mapping problems with obstacles, and addressing mapping problems with contraction and expansion. Secondly, we will apply this framework to address various medical imaging and computer graphics tasks, including dynamic high-genus surface remeshing, lung image registration, and medical image analysis for cardiac motion and lung nodule monitoring. Through this research, we aim to advance the understanding and solutions for dynamic mapping problems, with direct applications in medical imaging and computer graphics. 映射問題在包括影像處理與電腦圖形學等多個領域中是基礎性的，它們涉及尋找最佳的轉換方式將一個域映射到另一個域。例如，映射問題經常出現在影像或表面的配準（registration）任務中，其目標是在兩個對應的影像或表面之間建立有意義的一對一對應傳遞關係。傳統上，這些問題通常採用靜態映射的方法來解決，這些方法提供了在兩個對應域之間的單一且固定的轉換方式。儘管已有大量針對靜態映射問題的研究，但許多現實場景卻呈現出動態特性，需要時間相關的映射。動態映射問題涉及計算隨時間演變的轉換，能夠適應基礎數據或環境的變化。這對於如醫學影像中追蹤解剖結構的變化，或在計算機視覺中建模實時物體運動等應用至關重要。 在我們之前的研究中，我們成功地利用擬共形Teichmüller理論解決了靜態映射問題。本研究計劃旨在開發針對動態擬共形映射問題的新框架，彌合靜態方法與現實世界中時間變化特性之間的差距。我們的目標是將擬共形理論與概率測度的梯度流相結合，從而實現隨基礎數據演變的時間相關擬共形映射的計算。這一獨特結合使得我們能夠控制映射的規律性，並有效建模來自動態映射問題的各種現象。 我們的研究計劃包含兩個主要目標。首先，我們將為幾何映射問題開發動態框架。為達成此目標，我們將探索三個主要任務：開發具有指定密度的動態擬共形參數化算法、開發應對存在障礙物的動態映射方法，以及處理包含收縮和膨脹的映射問題。其次，我們將應用該框架解決多種醫學影像和電腦圖形學任務，包括動態高虧格曲面重新網格化、肺部影像配準，以及針對心臟運動和肺結節監測的醫學影像分析。 通過本次研究，我們旨在推進對動態映射問題的理解與解決方案，並將其直接應用於醫學影像和電腦圖形學領域。

14309925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14309925.value: 探討具有自適應空間位阻的高度可調膦配體，以解決空間極度擁擠的交叉偶聯反應：反應機制和瞬時空間按需相互作用的基礎研究

14309925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14309925.value: Palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling processes have emerged as essential protocols for assembling structurally diversified arene-containing molecules, in which they are crucial scaffolds in pharmaceuticals and materials. These convergent methods have revolutionized the traditional approaches to complex organic synthesis by utilizing readily available electrophilic and nucleophilic components. The development of new catalysts capable of facilitating challenging bond constructions is pivotal in advancing catalysis research and meeting the ever-growing demands of innovative organic synthesis. The development of new methodologies for connecting highly sterically hindered aromatic building blocks could significantly advance existing strategies in catalysis sciences. The purposes of this project are (1) to rationally design a new family of highly tunable phosphine ligands featuring adaptive-steric-hindrance that fit for fleeting steric-on-demand context, by providing effective steric bulkiness relief under overly crowded circumstance; (2) to explore the fundamental aspects, scopes and limitations of the underdeveloped palladium-catalyzed extremely steric-congested cross-coupling reactions and related arylation processes; (3) to conduct comprehensive mechanistic investigations using both experimental and theoretical approaches, for acquiring fundamental knowledge in this catalysis science; (4) to put forward of the newly developed catalyst systems in enantioselective cross-coupling processes. This project is aimed to explore new opportunities and potentials in cross-coupling reactions. The insightful knowledge gained from the catalyst development and manipulation, as well as the rationale of adaptable ligand-substrate interactions, holds significant value for both academic interest and potential industrial applications. Building upon our solid proof-of-concept initial results and previous success in the ligand and catalyst design and synthesis, along with extensive experiences in aromatic bond-construction research, the proposed investigations are positioned to advance the frontier of catalysis science. These new areas offer an excellent opportunity to establish a favorable foundation for fine-chemical industry in Hong Kong and Greater Bay Area. 鈀催化的交叉偶聯反應已成為組裝結構多樣化的芳烴分子的重要方法，芳烴分子是藥物和材料中的關鍵骨架。這些融合方法透過利用易於取得的親電和親核組分，徹底改變了傳統的複雜有機合成方法。開發能夠促進高難度鍵結建構的新型催化劑，對於推進催化研究和滿足創新有機合成日益增長的需求至關重要。 發展連接高空間位阻芳香結構單元的新方法，將顯著推進催化科學領域的現有研究策略。本計畫旨在：(1) 合理設計一類新型高度可調的膦配體，該配體具有自適應空間位阻特性，能夠在過度擁擠的條件下有效緩解空間體積，從而適應瞬時的空間按需調節環境；(2) 探索尚未開發的鈀催化極度空間擁擠理論偶聯反應及相關芳基化反應的基本原理、應用範圍和局限性 (3) 的實驗基礎和科學領域的全面性研究；提出在對映選擇性交叉偶聯過程中應用新開發的催化劑系統。 本計畫旨在探索交叉偶聯反應的新機會和新潛力。從催化劑開發和調控中獲得的深刻見解，以及對可調整配體-底物相互作用的原理的理解，對學術研究和潛在的工業應用都具有重要價值。基於我們堅實的概念驗證初步成果、先前在配體和催化劑設計與合成方面的成功經驗，以及在芳香鍵構建研究方面的豐富經驗，本計畫旨在推動催化研究的前沿發展。這些新領域為香港和大灣區精細化工產業的發展奠定了良好的基礎，提供了絕佳的機會。

14310025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14310025.value: 等周不等式與信息論不等式

14310025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14310025.value: There are well-established and rich connections between information-theoretic inequalities and probabilistic inequalities, including Marton's transportation inequalities and Talagrand's isoperimetric inequalities. This interdisciplinary proposal addresses a conjecture related to isoperimetric inequalities, which is known to have an equivalent formulation in information theory. Isoperimetric inequalities encompass a broad class of inequalities that establish fundamental relationships between the perimeter and volume of sets. These inequalities have received significant attention in the fields of probability and computer science. For example, Talagrand's isoperimetric inequality for a subset of graph vertices relates the size of the subset to the number of edges connecting it to its complement. Building on the recent work of the Principal Investigator (PI) regarding relay channels (in network information theory) and a newly identified property of information measures, this proposal aims to establish an important conjecture regarding isoperimetric inequalities within the context of the sensitivity of Boolean functions. Specifically, the conjecture posits that "the average square root sensitivity of any balanced Boolean function is greater than or equal to 1". Talagrand's isoperimetric inequality yields a lower bound of 1/sqrt(2), which has been subsequently improved by Bobkov and recently by others, reaching a current bound of 0.91-still below 1. This sensitivity conjecture has a corresponding formulation regarding information measures defined on the Boolean hypercube. Furthermore, the sensitivity conjecture is related to other important conjectures in information theory that have attracted considerable attention. This proposal is inspired by a novel information-theoretic inequality discovered in the principal investigator's recent work on relay channels. Determining the capacity of a relay channel is one of the three key open problems in network information theory, alongside finding the capacity regions of broadcast and interference channels. Having dedicated the past 15 years to exploring various aspects of information measures, the principal investigator and collaborators have previously established state-of-the-art bounds for all three of these open problems. 信息論與概率論領域中的許多不等式之間存在著成熟且豐富的聯繫，例如 Marton 的傳輸不等式（Marton’s transportation inequalities）和 Talagrand 的等周不等式（Talagrand’s isoperimetric inequalities）。這項跨學科研究旨在解決一個與等周不等式相關的猜想，該猜想已知在信息論中存在等價表述。等周不等式是一大類界定集合周長與其體積之間基本關係的不等式，其在概率論和計算機科學領域中備受關注。例如，在 Talagrand 關於圖頂點子集的等周不等式中，就將子集的大小與該子集連接到其補集的邊的數量聯繫起來。 基於首席研究員（PI）最近在網絡信息論中繼信道（relay channel）方面的研究成果以及新發現的信息測度性質，本研究旨在Boolean函數敏感度的背景下，確立一個關於等周不等式的重要猜想。該猜想斷言：「任何平衡Boolean函數的均方根敏感度（average square root sensitivity）大於等於 1」。Talagrand 的等周不等式曾給出了 1/sqrt(2) 的下界，後續研究由 Bobkov 等人不斷改進，目前達到 0.91（仍小於 1）。此敏感度猜想在Boolean超立方體上定義的信息測度方面存在對應的表述。此外，該敏感度猜想還與信息論中其他備受關注的重要猜想相關。 本研究靈感來源於首席研究員近期在中繼信道研究中發現的一個新穎的信息論不等式。確定中繼信道容量是網絡信息論中三個關鍵開放性問題之一，與確定廣播信道（broadcast channel）和干擾信道（interference channel）的信道容量區域並列。首席研究員及其合作者在過去 15 年致力於探索信息測度的各個方面，為這三個開放性問題中的信道容量建立已知最優的內外界。

14310425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14310425.value: 量子鏡像對稱中的微擾方法

14310425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14310425.value: This project is a continuation of the PI’s series of long-term projects aiming at applying perturbative methods in the study of mirror symmetry. In this project, the main theme is an extension of this perturbative approach to quantum mirror symmetry. Mirror symmetry was discovered by string theorists around 35 years ago. As a mathematical duality, it is mysterious yet powerful. Applying this mirror duality, string theorists were able to display a number of surprising mathematical predictions which stunned mathematicians. Since then, one major goal of the whole mathematical community is to crack the secret behind this powerful duality. Since its birth, people knew that mirror symmetry should be understood as a duality between families of geometric objects. On one side, one has a degeneration of complex Calabi–Yau manifolds to a large complex structure limit; on the other side, one has a family of symplectic Calabi–Yau manifolds going towards a large volume limit. A fundamental question in mirror symmetry is to understand how one goes from these limit points to nearby points, and it is expected that some information called quantum corrections will play a key role. The aim of this project, as well as others in the same series, is to study such quantum corrections using perturbative methods. The SYZ conjecture, which explains mirror symmetry geometrically as a type of Fourier transform, suggests that quantum corrections on the symplectic side should come from enumerative geometry of holomorphic disks and their higher genus counterparts. The PI will base on techniques in perturbative quantum field theories (QFTs) pioneered by Costello as well as previous work of himself and his collaborators. The first goal of this project is to extend the algebraic framework for smoothing Calabi–Yau varieties to holomorphic Poisson or symplectic varieties. A crucial step is to find an analogue of the normalization condition in the Gross–Siebert program for a degenerate Poisson structure. Applying a modification of Kontsevich’s quantization morphism, we then expect to obtain a DGLA which controls the deformation of the deformation quantization algebra of the smoothed family. The second goal of this project is to extract consistent quantum scattering diagrams from the Maurer–Cartan elements of this DGLA. Finally, we would like to explore some further applications such as a further development of our theory of tropical differential geometry and a theory of quantum log geometry. 本項目是PI一系列長期計畫的延續，旨在將微擾方法應用於鏡像對稱性的研究。本項目的主題是將這種微擾方法擴展到量子鏡像對稱。 鏡像對稱大約在35年前由弦理論家發現。作為一種數學對偶，它神秘莫測卻又威力無窮。利用這種鏡像對偶性，弦理論家們得到了許多令人驚訝的數學預言，令數學家們震驚不已。從那時起，整個數學界的一個主要目標就是破解這種強大對偶性背後的秘密。 自誕生以來，人們就知道鏡像對稱應該被理解為幾何空間族之間的對偶性。一方面，複Calabi-Yau流形退化到大的複結構極限；另一方面，辛Calabi-Yau流形族趨向於大的體積極限。鏡像對稱中的一個基本問題是理解如何從這些極限點到達鄰近點，預計一些被稱為量子修正的資訊將發揮關鍵作用。 本項目以及同一系列其他項目的主要目標是使用微擾方法研究此類量子修正。 SYZ猜想將鏡像對稱解釋為一種幾何傅立葉變換，它表明辛幾何方面的量子修正應該來自全純圓盤及其枚舉幾何。本項目的PI將以Costello開創的微擾量子場論 (QFT) 技術以及他本人及其合作者的先前工作為基礎。 本項目的首要目標是將用於平滑Calabi-Yau簇的代數框架擴展到全純Poisson簇或辛簇。關鍵的一步是找到Gross-Siebert方案中針對退化Poisson結構的正則化條件的類似物。應用Kontsevich量子化態射的修改，我們預期得到一個DGLA，它可以控制光滑族的形變量子化代數的變形。本項目的第二個目標是從該DGLA的Maurer-Cartan元素中提取一致的量子散射圖。最後，我們想探索一些進一步的應用，例如進一步發展我們的熱帶微分幾何理論和量子對數幾何理論。

14310625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14310625.value: 隨機矩陣乘積的熱力學原理與多重分形分析

14310625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14310625.value: The theory of products of random matrices has a large variety of applications across different fields in mathematics, as well as in science and engineering. It is closely related to the study of dimension theory in fractal geometry and dynamical systems. In this project, we plan to study the thermodynamic formalism and multifractal structure of products of random matrices. On the one hand, we aim to study the thermodynamic formalism for some nonadditive potentials generated by matrix products, in which we will investigate the variational principle, the existence and uniqueness of equilibrium measures, and the regularity of pressure functions. On the other hand, we plan to conduct the multifractal analysis for Lyapunov exponents of products of random matrices on regular trees. This research will deepen our understanding of the theory of random matrices. 隨機矩陣乘積理論在數學的不同領域，以及科學和工程中有著廣泛的應用。它與分形幾何和動力系統中維度理論的研究密切相關。在本項目中，我們計劃研究隨機矩陣乘積的熱力學性質和多重分形結構。一方面，我們旨在研究由矩陣乘積產生的某些非可加勢的熱力學公式，這包括探討變分原理、平衡測度的存在性及唯一性，以及壓力函數的正則性。另一方面，我們計劃對正則樹上隨機矩陣乘積的李雅普諾夫指數進行多重分形分析。此項研究將深化我們對隨機矩陣理論的理解。

14310925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14310925.value: 具有 Rapini-Papoular 勢的液晶相變

14310925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14310925.value: Materials can have different phases in different physical environments. Under normal atmospheric pressure, water has three phases if the temperature is different. Below 0 Celsius the water is solid (ice). Above 100 Celsius, the water is vaporous. Between 0 and 100 Celsius, water is liquid. The phases of water can change when the temperature is changed. In addition to water, phase transitions are also observed in liquid crystals. It is a ubiquitous phenomenon in nature. Many physical parameters can cause phase transitions in liquid crystals, such as the external electric and magnetic fields, pressure, concentration, thickness of liquid crystal film, etc. In this project, we focus on the transitions caused by the thickness of liquid crystal films. There are at least 3 phases in liquid crystal films. They are planar (P), hybrid aligned nematic (HAN), and periodically distorted HAN (PHAN) patterns. In the 1990s, experimental and numerical studies observed the transition from the P pattern to the HAN pattern. There is a critical threshold for the thickness of nematic film. The occurrence of the HAN pattern depends on whether the thickness of the nematic film is greater than the critical threshold. Later, it was discovered that the saddle-splay term can cause the transition from the P pattern to the PHAN pattern. The critical thickness for the P-PHAN transition is less than the critical thickness for the P-HAN transition. Interestingly, the PHAN pattern can also change into the HAN pattern in a certain range of thickness. In this project, we will apply the well-known Ericksen-Leslie model to theoretically analyze the transitions between P, HAN and PHAN patterns. In particular, we will focus on the effects of the external magnetic field and the Rapini-Papoular surface potential. The project has a strong physics background and can find application in various fields, e.g. projection diaplays. The project could be of interest to mathematicians and physicists. 在不同的物理環境下，物質會呈現不同的相態。在正常大氣壓力下，如果溫度不同，水會呈現三種相態。 0 攝氏度以下，水為固態（冰）。 100 攝氏度以上，水為氣態。 0 到攝氏 100 度之間，水為液態。溫度變化時，水的相態也會改變。除了水之外，在液晶中也會觀察到相變。相變是自然界中普遍存在的現象。許多物理參數都會造成液晶的相變，例如外部電場和磁場、壓力、濃度、液晶薄膜厚度等。在本專案中，我們將重點放在液晶薄膜厚度引起的相變。液晶薄膜中至少有 3 個相，分別是平面相（P）、混合取向向列相（HAN）和以及週期性扭曲的向列相（PHAN）。在1990年代，實驗和數值研究觀察到了從P相到HAN相的轉變。向列相薄膜的厚度存在一個臨界閾值。 HAN相的出現取決於向列相薄膜的厚度是否大於該臨界閾值。後來發現，馬鞍項可以導致從P相到PHAN相的轉變。 P-PHAN轉變的臨界厚度小於P-HAN轉變的臨界厚度。有趣的是，在一定的厚度範圍內，PHAN相也可以轉換成HAN相。在本計畫中，我們將應用著名的Ericksen-Leslie模型，對P、HAN和PHAN相之間的轉換進行理論分析。我們將特別關注外部磁場和Rapini-Papoular表面勢的影響。該專案具有強大的物理學背景，可應用於投影顯示等各個領域。該計畫可能會引起數學家和物理學家的興趣。

14311125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14311125.value: 數值求解和分析Helmholtz方程相應的大規模離散系統的兩層Schwarz方法

14311125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14311125.value: It is widely known that all high-performance supercomputers nowadays are of parallel structures, with mutliple CPUs that are grouped into compute nodes. A high-performance supercomputer may contain tens of thousands of nodes. Most popular fast and efficient numerical methods for solving large-scale scientific computing problems are still of sequential nature and have low parallel efficiency when supercomputers with a large number of compute nodes are used. It has been a great challenge how to design efficient numerical methods with high parallel efficiency for large-scale scientific computing problems. Domain decomposition methods (DDMs) have proved to be one of the most effective numerical strategies for solving various mathematical models of partial differential equations (PDEs). Efficient DDMs have been developed already for many important PDEs that are mainly "elliptic" in essence. But it has still been at an initial stage to construct efficient DDMs for more challenging large-scale problems from scientific computing. This is the main motivation of this project. The main task of this project is to design some efficient DDMs for the Helmholtz-type models with highly oscillatory solutions and develop a convergence theory to understand the performance and efficiencies of these methods. The Helmholtz-type problems can find wide applications in many important areas, but their efficient solutions are still a highly challenging topic in numerical PDEs. The main difficulties lie in the facts that very fine meshes are required to achieve desired numerical accuracy because of the highly oscillatory solutions, and the discrete systems arising from the discritization are large-scale, complex-valued, non-symmetric and indefinite. An efficient solver for such large-scale systems must be an iterative method with an effective and robust preconditioner. The key is how to construct an effective preconditioner so that the resulting preconditioned system are much easier to solve than the original system. We have made some very good progress in the study and understanding of one-level Schwarz-type preconditioned methods, but which do not work for the pure Helmholtz equations. In this project, we develop some novel and efficient two-level Schwarz-type preconditioned methods built upon a multiple domain decomposition of the computational domain, with the standard finite elements for the discretization but the localized orthogonal decomposition technique in the global coarse solve. Mathematical theory will be also developed to analyse the convergence and efficiencies of these methods. 眾所周知，現今所有高效能超級電腦都採用平行結構，由多個CPU或核組成運算節點。一台高效能超級電腦可能包含數萬個節點。目前，大多數用於解決大規模科學計算問題的快速高效數值方法本質上仍然是串行計算，在擁有大量計算節點的超級電腦上並行效率較低。如何設計高效的、高平行效率的數值方法來解決大規模科學計算問題一直是個巨大的挑戰。 區域分解法 已被證明是求解各種偏微分方程數學模型最有效的數值策略之一。對於許多重要的偏微分方程（本質上主要是「橢圓型」的），已經發展出了高效率的 區域分解法。但針對更具挑戰性的非「橢圓型」方程對應的大規模科學計算問題，建構高效的 區域分解法仍處於起步階段。這正是本研究計畫的主要動機。 本研究計畫的主要任務是針對具有高度振盪解的Helmholtz方程模型，設計一些並行並且高效的區域分解法，並發展收斂理論以理解這些方法的穩定性，精度和效率。Helmholtz方程問題在許多重要領域有著廣泛的應用，但如何設計它們的有效數值解在科學計算中仍是一個極具挑戰性的課題。主要困難在於，由於解具有高度振盪性，需要非常精細的網格才能達到所需的數值精度，且相應的離散系統具有大規模、複值、非對稱和不確定性等特點。 對於此類大規模系統，高效的求解器必須是一種迭代方法，並採用高效且穩健的預處理策略。最關鍵的技術在於如何建立一個高效的預處理方法，使預處理後的系統比原始系統更穩定更容易求解。我們在研究和理解單層Schwarz型預處理方法方面取得了一些重要進展，但這些方法不適用於真正的Helmholtz方程。在本研究中，我們基於數值計算區域的多子區域中的重疊分解，將開發一些新穎高效的雙層Schwarz型預處理方法，離散化採用標準有限元，但在整體計算區域的粗網上的求解採用局部正交分解技術。我們還將發展一些數學理論來分析這些方法的收斂性和效率。

14500125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500125.value: 電子產品以舊換新平臺的學習與定價

14500125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500125.value: An increasing number of electronics retailers, e.g., Apple, Sumsung, Amazon, have launched product trade-in programs to generate profit, increase new product sales, and extend the life cycles of products. Such programs target at customers who seek to upgrade their old devices as well as those who would consider to buy pre-owned products to save costs. The trade-in program offers cash to buy back the old product or offers a discount price for customers to buy a new product in exchange for the old product. In this project, we study the pricing problem of such trade-in programs that acquire different types of old products, refurbish and resell them. A firm operating the program dynamically sets the trade-in prices of old products and the resale prices of refurbished products (we will also extend to the case with new product sales) so as to maximize its expected total profit over a finite selling season. To set the trade-in and reselling prices, the firm needs to have a good knowledge of the underlying trade-in and demand functions, which in practice, however, is not always available to the firm. Therefore, one pressing issue for the firm is how to set the prices when the underlying trade-in and demand functions are unknown a priori. We aim to develop and analyze joint learning and pricing algorithms in both parametric and non-parametric settings for electronics trade-in programs that buy and sell multiple products. We will first study static learning and pricing policy, which divides the selling horizon into an exploration phase and an exploitation phase where in the latter, the prices are set based on a deterministic optimization problem using the estimated trade-in/demand functions from the exploration phase. Different from the classic network revenue management problem, the firm needs to learn and control both supply (trade-in) and demand and inventories of the refurbished products can either increase or decrease over time. In this static control algorithm, the prices will not be adjusted during the exploitation phase. To improve its performance, we will further develop more sophisticated algorithms where in the exploitation phase the firm will either separately or jointly adjust the trade-in and selling prices based on realized variabilities. We will also consider the so-called well-separated trade-in and demand. The theoretical performance of these different algorithms will be analyzed and compared. Extensive numerical studies based on real and synthetic data will be conducted. 越來越多的電子產品零售商（例如蘋果、三星、亞馬遜）推出了產品以舊換新計劃，以創造利潤、增加新產品銷量，並延長產品的生命週期。此類計劃的目標客群包括希望升級舊設備的消費者，以及考慮購買二手產品以節省成本的消費者。以舊換新計劃提供現金回購舊產品，或提供折扣價讓消費者以舊產品換購新產品。 在本專案中，我們研究此類以舊換新計劃的定價問題，這些計劃涉及收購不同類型的舊產品、翻新並轉售。運營該計劃的公司需動態設定舊產品的換購價格和翻新產品的轉售價格（我們也將延伸至包含新產品銷售的情境），以在有限的銷售季節內最大化其預期總利潤。為了設定換購和轉售價格，公司需要充分了解潛在的換購和需求函數。然而在實務中，公司往往無法事先掌握這些資訊。因此，公司面臨的一個迫切問題是：當潛在的換購和需求函數未知時，應如何定價？ 我們的目標是針對涉及多種產品收購與銷售的電子產品以舊換新計劃，開發並分析參數化和非參數化情境下的聯合學習與定價演算法。我們首先研究「靜態學習與定價策略」，該策略將銷售週期分為「探索階段」和「利用階段」：在後一階段中，價格是基於探索階段所估計的換購/需求函數，透過確定性優化問題設定的。 與經典的網絡收益管理問題不同，公司需同時學習並控制供給（換購）與需求，且翻新產品的庫存可能隨時間增加或減少。在此靜態控制演算法中，價格在利用階段不會調整。為了提升效能，我們將進一步開發更複雜的演算法，讓公司在利用階段能根據實際變動，單獨或聯合調整換購與銷售價格。我們也將考慮所謂的「分離式換購與需求」。 這些不同演算法的理論效能將被分析與比較，並基於真實與合成數據進行廣泛的數值研究。

14500225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500225.value: 拒絕算法建議的心理與行為後果

14500225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500225.value: As algorithms supplant human advisors across various sectors, it becomes crucial to understand how interacting with machine-generated advice shape human decision-making behavior. One concern is that collaborating with machines can drive individuals to be biased (e.g., overconfident) in their judgments (Kang and Kim, 2022). Drawing on the advice-taking literature, on top of simply receiving algorithm advice, I argue and propose that rejecting algorithm advice nudges humans to become more biased, thus in turn exacerbate their decision quality in subsequent tasks. From three independent studies, testing the theoretical model using an individual decision-making task (i.e., Study 1: a price prediction task), an interactional decision-making task (i.e., Study 2: a negotiation task), and a field data (i.e., Study 3: an archival data analyses), I posit that individuals who reject algorithm advice face enhanced levels of relationship anxiety, and this in turn leads them to exhibit higher levels of biasedness on future tasks relative to those who agree or conform with the advice provided. In Study 1, a price prediction task, I investigate the main effect of rejecting algorithm advice on individuals’ decision quality, compared to agreeing to the same algorithm advice.
