In Study 2, a negotiation task, I test not only the main effect of rejecting algorithm advice on negotiators’ decisions (e.g., first offer) but also the mechanism of relationship anxiety why rejecting algorithm advice drives negotiators to be more ruthless in their decision-making. In the first two studies, I examine the mechanism and consequences when individuals reject algorithm advice. On the flip side of this so-called “algorithm ruthlessness” effect, I investigate how people in general perceive leaders (e.g., CEOs) who are intuition-oriented or algorithm-rejecting (vs. analytics-oriented or algorithm conforming). In Study 3, an archival data analyses scraping and coding data from Glassdoor (for employee reviews and ratings) and Indeed (for job posting data), I further examine how people perceive leaders who are analytics-oriented or heavily reliant on algorithm advice, compared to those who make intuitive decisions based on their gut feels. The project as a whole provides insights for theory and practice on advice-taking, rejection, and the impact of technology on decision-making. 隨著算法在各個領域逐漸取代人類顧問，理解人類在與機器生成的建議互動時，其決策行為如何受到影響變得至關重要。其中一個重要問題是，與機器協作可能導致個體在判斷中產生偏見（例如，過度自信）。基於已有的「採納建議」研究文獻，本文不僅關注接受算法建議的情況，還提出拒絕算法建議會促使個體變得更加偏見，從而在後續任務中進一步惡化其決策品質。 通過三項獨立研究，本文驗證了一個理論模型：分別使用個體決策任務（研究一：價格預測任務）、互動決策任務（研究二：談判任務）以及實地數據（研究三：檔案數據分析）。研究結果表明，相較於接受或採納算法建議的人，那些拒絕算法建議的個體會經歷更強烈的人際焦慮，這種焦慮反過來會導致他們在未來任務中表現出更高程度的偏見。 在研究一中，我通過價格預測任務探討了拒絕與接受相同算法建議時，對個體決策品質的主效應。在研究二中，我使用談判任務，不僅檢驗了拒絕算法建議對談判者行為（如首次出價）的影響，還揭示了「人際焦慮」這一心理機制，解釋為何拒絕算法建議會使談判者在決策中更為強硬。 前兩項研究關注個體拒絕算法建議時的心理機制與行為後果。作為「算法強硬效應」（algorithm ruthlessness effect）的另一面，研究三進一步考察公眾如何看待不同類型的領導者（例如 CEO）：那些傾向直覺判斷或拒絕算法建議的領導者，和那些依賴分析或採納算法建議的領導者之間的差異。在這項研究中，我通過爬取和編碼 Glassdoor 上的員工評價數據以及 Indeed 上的招聘信息，對這兩類領導者在公眾眼中的形象進行了分析。 整體來看，本研究為「採納與拒絕建議」以及技術對人類決策行為影響的理論與實踐提供了新的見解。

14500325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500325.value: 異質性面板數據模型的CCE方法

14500325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500325.value: We generalize Pesaran's (2006) common correlated effects (CCE) estimation method to a general heterogeneous panel data model where the slope coefficients vary over both cross-sectional and time dimensions. To deal with the interactive fixed effects in the model, we use the cross-sectional averages of the data to proxy the unobservable factors, similar to Pesaran's (2006) CCE approach. However, with the slope coefficients varying over both cross-sectional and time dimensions, we have to jointly estimate the heterogeneous parameters over both dimensions, which is fundamentally different from Pesaran's (2006) approach. Therefore, we propose a new joint estimation method that involves inverting a number of large dimensional matrices. Furthermore, we propose an inference procedure for the parameters of interest that is uniformly valid over a large class of data-generating processes. Preliminary simulation evidence shows that the new estimators and inference procedures perform well in finite samples. In this project, we will systematically study the asymptotic properties of our new methods. Monte Carlo simulations will be conducted to show the finite sample performance of our methods. Empirical applications will be provided to demonstrate the usefulness of our new methods. 我們將 Pesaran（2006）提出的共同相關效應（CCE）估計方法推廣到一個更一般的異質性面板數據模型，其中斜率係數在橫截面和時間維度上都可變。為了處理模型中的交互固定效應，我們採用數據的橫截面平均值來估計不可觀測的因子，這與 Pesaran（2006）的方法類似。然而，由於斜率係數在橫截面和時間維度上都可變，我們必須在這兩個維度上聯合估計異質性參數，這在本質上不同於 Pesaran（2006）的方法。 因此，我們提出了一種新的聯合估計方法，該方法涉及對多個高維矩陣的求逆。此外，我們還提出了一種統計推斷的方法，可以在廣泛的數據生成過程中對感興趣的參數進行統一有效的推斷。初步模擬結果表明，新的估計量和推斷方法在有限樣本下表現良好。 在本項目中，我們將系統地研究這些新方法的漸近性質，並通過蒙特卡洛模擬展示其在有限樣本下的表現。我們還將提供實證應用，以展示這些新方法的實用性。

14500525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500525.value: 「全員治療」策略於基層醫療管理慢性乙型肝炎之經濟效益評估

14500525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14500525.value: Prof Easterbrook, Philippa Prof Lau , George Prof Wong , Eliza Lai-Yi Dr Yip, Cheuk Fung

14500525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500525.value: Introduction Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is a major public health issue, causing most liver cancer cases and deaths. Many patients remain undiagnosed and untreated under the current specialist-based algorithm-guided (SAG) care approach, leading to costly complications like cirrhosis and liver cancer. A “treat-all” approach in primary care could help diagnose and treat CHB earlier, reducing complications and healthcare costs. This project examines economic burden of CHB in Hong Kong and evaluates cost-effectiveness of shifting to a “treat-all” strategy in primary care to improve outcomes. Objectives This project aims to: 1. Estimate direct medical and indirect costs of CHB in public (2009 - 2022); and 2. in private healthcare sectors (as at present); 3. Compare the costs of SAG approach with the “treat-all” strategy; 4. Evaluate cost-effectiveness of the “treat-all” strategy in primary care. Methods Public sector CHB costs will be estimated using data from Hong Kong Hospital Authority’s Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System (CDARS) between 2009-2022. Direct medical costs will be calculated based on healthcare utilization and the unit costs, while indirect costs will be assessed using human capital approach. A fixed-effects panel regression will analyze trends across CHB stages. Private sector costs will be collected from three specialist clinics via a survey, including one (HnH) where the “treat-all” strategy has been implemented. With participants’ consent, their private sector data will be matched with their public sector records to provide a comprehensive estimate of CHB-related costs. Generalized linear models will estimate incremental costs across CHB stages. A patient-level discrete event simulation (DES) model will be developed to simulate the progression of CHB. This model will use a parametric proportional hazards framework, incorporating CHB transition and cost data from CDARS (representing SAG) and HnH (representing “treat-all”). The DES model will compare long-term costs between these two strategies. Additionally, the model will be extended to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of implementing the “treat-all” strategy in primary care by calculating the incremental cost per quality-adjusted life year. Implications Our findings will inform public health policies and optimize resource allocation to better manage CHB, and contribute to achieving the World Health Organization’s goal of eliminating viral hepatitis by 2030. Ultimately, our analysis will identify a cost-effective and scalable strategy for chronic disease management and ensuring sustainable healthcare system in future. 引言 慢性乙型肝炎（慢乙）為全球重要公共衛生議題，是導致肝癌發生及肝癌相關死亡的主要原因。在現行以專科醫師為主、臨床路徑指引（SAG）之照護模式下，許多患者未能及時診斷及接受治療，進而引發肝硬化、肝癌等高額醫療併發症。推行基層醫療「全員治療」策略，或能實現早期診斷與治療，降低併發症發生率及醫療成本。本項目旨在評估香港地區慢乙之經濟負擔，並探討將專科指引照護模式轉向基層醫療「全員治療」策略之成本效益。 研究目標 1. 估算2009至2022年間香港公共醫療體系中慢乙相關直接及間接醫療成本； 2. 估算現時私營醫療體系中慢乙相關成本； 3. 比較專科指引照護模式與基層醫療「全員治療」策略之成本差異； 4. 評估基層醫療「全員治療」策略之成本效益。 研究方法 本研究將利用香港醫院管理局臨床數據分析及報告系統（CDARS）2009至2022年間資料，估算公共醫療系統中慢乙之成本。直接醫療成本依據醫療服務使用量及單位成本計算，間接成本則採用人力資本法估算。透過固定效應面板迴歸分析慢乙不同病程階段之成本變化趨勢。私營醫療成本資料將透過對三間專科診所之問卷調查取得，其中一所診所（HnH）已實施「全員治療」策略。獲得參與者同意後，將其私營診療紀錄與公營數據配對以全面估算慢乙相關成本，並以廣義線性模型評估各疾病階段的增量成本。另建立個人層級離散事件模擬（DES）模型，采用參數比例風險模型架構模擬慢乙進展，整合CDARS（代表SAG）與HnH（代表「全員治療」）的慢乙疾病轉歸與成本數據，評估兩種照護策略之長期成本差異。此外，模型將延伸評估基層醫療實施「全員治療」策略之成本效益，計算每質量調整生命年（QALY）的增量成本。 預期影響 本研究結果將有助公共衛生政策制定，優化資源配置，提升慢乙管理效率，促進實現世界衛生組織2030年消除病毒性肝炎目標。最終將提出具成本效益且可推廣之慢性病管理策略，為構建可持續醫療系統提供科學依據。

14500925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500925.value: 中美貿易戰和全球供應鏈：一項實證研究

14500925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500925.value: After decades of increasing globalization in trade and production activities, the last six years have witnessed a sharp reversal. Concerns about import competition and domestic labor markets led to a global surge in protectionism and intensified trade tensions. Among these tensions, the US-China trade war, a large-scale trade conflict between the world's two largest economies, is particularly noteworthy. Understanding the economic consequences of the trade war is not only of interest to researchers but crucial to policymaking as well. Despite the growing interests, this important topic remains under-researched. In particular, there is limited micro-level evidence on how the trade war affects global supply chains. This project aims to fill this research gap by empirically analyzing the trade war effects on US imports and the adjustment of supply chain relationships. To carry out our analysis, we will manually merge three data sources. The first and our main source is the S&P's Panjiva shipment database. A key advantage of this database is that it provides detailed product shipment information at the customer-supplier-pair level and at the daily frequency, which allows us to accurately identify entry, exit, and replacement of a supplier-customer relationship. We will use the US import sample of the Panjiva data for which the data is the most complete. The second source is the MFN tariff data from the WITS database where we can obtain the initial US tariffs prior to the trade war. Finally, we also obtain trade war tariff hikes information from official sources. We plan to conduct three sets of empirical analysis. We first provide aggregate evidence on the effects of the US tariffs on its imports and its supply chain relationships at the product or country-product level. Second, we employ more disaggregate US firm-product-year or US firm-country-product-year level data to further analyze how the trade war affects US firms' importing and sourcing decisions. Finally, the third part utilizes the most disaggregate data at the supplier-customer-product-year level to study the effect on US buyer-supplier relationship adjustments with a focus on the termination (replacement) of relationships with Chinese (non-Chinese) suppliers. We will also make efforts to explore the underlying mechanisms. Specifically, we plan to identify and separate two different effects of the trade war, a tariff effect and a trade-war induced policy uncertainty effect. In addition, we will also explore the potential heterogenous effects across firms and industries. 貿易與生產活動的全球化在經歷了數十年的不斷深化過程後，在過去六年出現了急劇的逆轉。對進口競爭和國內勞動市場的擔憂，引發了全球保護主義的激增與貿易緊張局勢的加劇。在這些緊張局勢之中，美中貿易戰——即世界兩大經濟體之間的大規模貿易衝突——尤為引人注目。理解貿易戰的經濟後果，不僅對研究者具有重要意義，對政策制定更是至關重要。但這一重要議題的研究仍然不足。特別是有關貿易戰如何影響全球供應鏈的微觀層面證據仍然有限。 本項目旨在通過實證分析美中貿易戰對美國進口以及供應鏈關係調整的影響，以填補此研究空白。為進行分析，我們將手動合併三個數據來源。第一個也是我們的主要數據來源是標普的 Panjiva 貨運數據庫。該數據庫的一大優勢在於，它提供了客戶與供應商配對層級以及日度頻率的詳細產品貨運信息，使我們能夠準確識別供應商與客戶關係的建立、退出和替代。我們將使用 Panjiva 數據中的美國進口樣本，因為該部分數據最為完整。第二個數據來源是來自 WITS 數據庫的最惠國(MFN)關稅數據，我們可以從中獲得貿易戰前的美國初始關稅信息。最後，我們還將從官方來源獲取貿易戰關稅上調的信息。 我們計劃進行三組實證分析。首先，我們將提供美國關稅對其進口以及供應鏈關係影響的整體證據，分析層級為產品或國家-產品層面。其次，我們將採用更細化的美國企業-產品-年份或美國企業-國家-產品-年份層級數據，進一步分析貿易戰如何影響美國企業的進口和採購決策。最後，第三部分將利用最細化的供應商-客戶-產品-年份層級數據，研究貿易戰對美國買家與供應商之間關係調整的影響，特別關注美國企業與中國（非中國）供應商關係的終止（替代）。我們還將努力探索其背後的機制。具體而言，我們計劃識別並區分貿易戰帶來的兩種不同效應：關稅效應與貿易戰引發的政策不確定性效應。此外，我們還將探索對不同企業和行業可能產生的異質性影響。

14501425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14501425.value: 增強分類準確性的機器分類偏差處理：公平-準確性取捨在社會福利的算法應用之體現

14501425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14501425.value: Mitigating the bias in machine classification outcomes at algorithmic decision-making is a central aspect of Responsible AI that strives for unbiased AI algorithms and prevents AI misuse. In computer science and information systems studies, various methods for machine bias mitigation are developed, including pre-processing (treat data), in-processing (treat algorithms), and post-processing (treat outcomes). Beneath different bias mitigation methods lies the fairness-accuracy (FA) tradeoff in machine classification: good classification accuracy and fair classification outcome are two distinct objectives for optimizing machine classifiers and the highest extents of each cannot be simultaneously satisfied. As sufficient accuracy is the primary goal of machine classification, effective bias mitigation should bring substantial fairness increase with small accuracy sacrifice. In previous works, we proposed a pre-processing technique that allows desirable bias mitigation with small accuracy compromise. The method worked well for different classifiers and at different datasets. In this study, we amplify the method into an algorithmic framework that incorporates classification accuracy enhancement into bias mitigation, directly addressing the FA tradeoff. The framework relies on data transforms and iterates between the two modules: in each round, first achieve the primary goal of bias mitigation and then increase classification accuracy, with two distinct optimized data transforms. We engineer the framework over 400 combinations of design options and transparently visualize the FA tradeoff. ESG (environmental, social, and governance) data gain increasing attention along the society's growing awareness of sustainable development. Individuals'/organizations' environmental footprints can be used to classify their ecological impact. Although currently not as well-defined as gender or racial bias, ESG biases penetrate classifications. An example is CalEnviroScreen, a tool for determining environmentally disadvantaged neighborhoods as eligible for governmental funds: CalEnviroScreen is found to encompass serious risks of biased classification leading to false decision-making. Analyzing ESG biases is central to preventing the misuse of ESG classifiers. Our framework does not anchor on fairness metrics or predefined bias roots and is suited to deal with ESG biases. We apply the framework to recent ESG datasets that record the environmental footprints of individuals/businesses/public organizations. We protect different sensitive dimensions in ESG classifications, mitigating the discrimination on those dimensions while maintaining the effectiveness of target ESG classifications. We finally perform a security analysis on attack-defense interactions around the framework, exploring to what extent bias mitigation is robust to attacks from adversaries. Practical bias mitigation methods should analyze possible adversarial operations, which so far is insufficiently discussed in existing studies. 在演算法決策過程中，減輕機器分類結果的偏見是負責任的人工智慧的核心內容，它致力於實現無偏見的人工智慧演算法，並防止人工智慧被濫用。在電腦科學和資訊系統研究中，開發了各種減輕機器偏見的方法，包括預處理（處理資料）、中處理（處理演算法）和後處理（處理結果）。不同的偏見減輕方法的背後是機器分類中的公平性-準確性 (FA) 權衡：良好的分類準確性和公平的分類結果是優化機器分類器的兩個不同目標，並且兩者的最高程度無法同時滿足。由於足夠的準確性是機器分類的主要目標，有效的偏見減輕應該在準確率略有下降的情況下顯著提高公平性。 在先前的研究工作中，我們提出了一種預處理技術，可以在較小的準確率損失下實現理想的偏差緩解。此方法適用於不同的分類器和不同的資料集。在本研究中，我們將此方法擴展為演算法框架，將分類準確率的提升融入偏差緩解中，直接解決了FA的權衡問題。該框架依賴於資料轉換，並在兩個模組之間迭代：在每一輪中，首先實現偏差緩解的主要目標，然後透過兩種不同的最佳化資料轉換來提高分類準確率。我們設計了超過400種設計選項組合的框架，並透明地視覺化了FA的權衡。 隨著社會對永續發展意識的不斷增強，ESG（環境、社會和治理）數據也越來越受到關注。個人/組織的環境足跡可用於對其生態影響進行分類。儘管目前ESG偏見的定義不如性別或種族偏見明確，但它滲透到各種分類中。例如，CalEnviroScreen是一款用於確定環境弱勢社群是否有資格獲得政府資金的工具：CalEnviroScreen被發現有嚴重的分類偏差風險，從而導致錯誤的決策。分析ESG偏見對於防止ESG分類器的濫用至關重要。 我們的框架並非基於公平指標或預先定義的偏差根源，並且適用於處理 ESG 偏差。我們將此框架應用於近期的 ESG 資料集，這些資料集記錄了個人/企業/公共組織的環境足跡。我們保護 ESG 分類中不同的敏感維度，從而減輕了對這些維度的歧視，同時保持了目標 ESG 分類的有效性。 最後，我們圍繞著該框架對攻防互動進行了安全性分析，探索偏見緩解措施在多大程度上能夠抵禦來自對手的攻擊。實用的偏見緩解方法應該分析可能的對抗操作，而現有的研究對此的討論尚不充分。

14501525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14501525.value: 具有內生性與工具變量的多重處理效應：識別、估計與穩健推斷

14501525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14501525.value: This project studies the inference for the effect of multiple treatments in a linear regression framework. The multivariate treatment model is getting increasing attention as exploring multiple interventions/exposures to the outcome variable is becoming more common in economics, psychology, and epidemiology. In causal studies using observational data, however, the treatment variables are often associated with unobserved common confounders that affect the outcome, resulting in the endogeneity issue and inconsistent estimation. This project focuses on the causal inference with multivariate treatments, such as education attainment with multiple learning facility interventions (class size, teaching aid) that are confounded by unobserved factors that affect both the learning facilities and outcome. In empirical research, the instrumental variable method is commonly applied to address the endogeneity issue under the assumption that the IVs are valid, meaning that they affect the outcome only through the channel of the treatments. However, in many applications, the researchers often deal with some potentially invalid IVs without knowing which candidate IVs among the full IV set are invalid. While the literature has made strides in estimating treatment effects with potentially invalid instruments, this has primarily been within the context of a univariate treatment variable, as seen in the works of Kang et al. (2016), Guo et al. (2018), and Windmeijer et al (2021). However, the methods to address the same issue under multiple endogenous interventions are significantly less developed. In this proposal, we aim to fill this gap by first establishing the sufficient and necessary identification condition for the multivariate treatments model. We then delve into the theoretical relations between the identification conditions in the literature, including the plurality and majority rules, and the conditions proposed in recent literature, such as Liang et al. (2022). Our work also includes the development of an easy-to-implement algorithm that aligns with the identification condition, and a uniform inference procedure that is robust to finite sample IV selection errors. To ensure the practical relevance of our research, we will illustrate our methodology in two empirical applications. The first application will examine the multiple treatment effects of learning facilities on students’ achievement, and the second application will study employee satisfaction sentiment and workplace hazardous environments on product recalls. Additionally, to make implementation as user-friendly as possible, we will develop R/python packages, as well as other GitHub resources. These resources will enable practitioners to easily adopt our methods and apply them to their own studies. 本項目研究在線性回歸框架下對多重處理效應的推斷。多變量因果效應模型正受到越來越多的關注，因為在經濟學、心理學和流行病學中，探索多種干預/政策/暴露對結果變量的影響已變得更加普遍。然而，在使用觀察數據進行因果研究的過程中，處理變量往往與影響結果的未觀測共同混雜因素相關聯，導致內生性問題和估計的不一致性。本項目聚焦於多變量處理效應的因果推斷，例如教育成就與多種學習設施干預（班級規模、教學輔助工具），這些干預受到影響學習設施和結果的未觀測因素的混淆。在實證研究中，工具變量方法通常被用來解決內生性問題，其假設工具變量是有效的，即它們僅通過處理的渠道影響結果。然而，在許多應用中，研究人員常常需要處理一些可能無效的工具變量，而不知道在完整的工具變量集合中哪些候選工具變量是無效的。本項目提出新的工具變量因果推斷模型，探討多重處理變量與工具變量有效性不確定情形下的模型識別、估計與推斷問題，推導該模型的理論性質。本項目亦將進行相關的實證研究，並推出相關的軟體程式包，以推廣本方法在不同實際問題上的應用。

14502325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14502325.value: 雙邊市場中干擾偏差的貝葉斯最優分析

14502325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14502325.value: Prof Bernstein, Fernando Prof Keskin, N.Bora

14502325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502325.value: The proposed project focuses on how the inteference bias influences the platform revenue optimization problem. While past literature focus on reducing the interference bias in a two-sided controlled experiment, we focus on whether the platform could live with the bias and simultaneously achieve revenue optimization. The proposed project aims to understand whether conventional metric in a two-sided market experiment is consistent with the platform's objective of revenue optimization in a dynamic learning setting. 控制實驗一直是平台公司確定是否應該實施某項處理的常用方法。例如，Airbnb 進行大量 A/B 測試，以評估在其網站上新增功能的可行性。干擾偏差是這些實驗中被廣泛認可的挑戰，這為公司確定是否應該實施某項功能設定了障礙 。到目前為止，主要目標是對處理效果進行無偏估計。然而，從收益管理的角度來看，一個關鍵問題仍然存在：無偏估計是否是必要的，平台是否可以忍受其收益管理策略中的干擾偏差。

14502425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14502425.value: 洪水風險是否計入商業不動產價值：來自強制揭露的證據

14502425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502425.value: In September 2015, the United Nations General Assembly set up 17 interlinked global goals called the Sustainable Development Goals to provide a "shared blueprint for peace and prosperity for people and the planet, now and into the future" that is intended to be achieved by 2030. SDG 13, titled "Climate Action", is to "take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts". As emphasized in SDG 13, climate risk is one of the major threats to achieving social sustainability. Although the importance of the study of climate risk is self-evident, determining how to quantitatively measure climate change's effect is challenging. Flood risk is the most common and costly climate risk in the world, and our proposal aims to address its impact on commercial real estate, an important real estate market but one which is understudied in prior literature. For this purpose, we combine a hedonic model with a quasi-experiment. Specifically, we explore the State of New Jersey's Flood Risk Notification Law, which mandates disclosure of flood-risk information, such as whether the property is located in flood hazard areas, in commercial real estate transactions and leases. The project focuses on three areas of interest. First, we investigate how the disclosure of flood risk impacts commercial real estate values. We compare transaction prices for properties located in flood hazard areas with those in non-flood hazard areas before and after the effective date of the mandatory disclosure law. Second, we study the underlying mechanisms that drive those commercial real estate market responses. We come up with a tenant-based channel where the disclosure requirement increases tenants’ awareness of flood risk for properties located in flood hazard zones and thereby reduces their willingness to pay for leases, thus decreasing the potential cash flow that can be generated from the focal property. Third, we explore unintended consequences on business formation. A reduction in commercial real estate values and rents induced by the mandatory flood-risk disclosure may make it more affordable for financially constrained individuals or small institutions to enter entrepreneurship by either owning or leasing a commercial building. Overall, our project highlights the capitalization of flood risk into commercial real estate assets. By showing that properties with higher climate risk are valued at a discount, this project will underscore the importance of disclosing climate risks transparently and comprehensively to ensure that investors have access to accurate information and can make informed investment decisions. 2015 年 9 月，聯合國大會制定了 17 項相互關聯的全球目標——「永續發展目標」（Sustainable Development Goals, SDGs），旨在為「當下與未來的人類與地球提供一份共享的和平與繁榮藍圖」，並計畫於 2030 年前達成。第 13 項 SDG「氣候行動」（Climate Action）主張「採取緊急行動以因應氣候變遷及其影響」。正如 SDG 13 所強調，氣候風險是達成社會永續的一大威脅。 儘管研究氣候風險的重要性不言自明，如何量化衡量氣候變遷的影響仍具挑戰。洪水風險是全球最常見且代價最高的氣候風險，而本研究計畫旨在探討其對商用不動產的影響——商用不動產是重要但既有文獻相對匱乏的市場。為此，我們結合享樂價格模型與準實驗設計。具體而言，我們探討新澤西州的《洪水風險告知法》，該法規定在商用不動產的交易與租賃中必須揭露洪水風險資訊，例如標的物是否位於洪水危險區。 本研究關注三個面向。第一，我們檢驗洪水風險揭露如何影響商用不動產的價值：比較強制揭露生效日前後，位於洪水危險區與非危險區之不動產的交易價格。第二，我們探討驅動商用不動產市場反應的內在機制。我們提出一個以租戶為基礎的管道：揭露要求提高了租戶對位於洪水危險區物件之風險認知，因而降低其租賃支付意願，進一步減少標的資產可產生的現金流。第三，我們探討對企業設立的非預期影響：由強制洪水風險揭露所導致的商用不動產價格與租金下降，可能讓資金受限的個人或小型機構更能負擔，藉由購置或租賃商用建築而投入創業。 總體而言，本研究凸顯洪水風險在商用不動產資產中的資本化效應。透過顯示具較高氣候風險的不動產會以折價評價，本研究強調透明且全面地揭露氣候風險的重要性，以確保投資人能取得準確資訊並做出明智的投資決策。

14502825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14502825.value: 考慮貿易和勞動力市場調整的最佳動態政策

14502825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502825.value: Trade protectionism often relates to the prevalence of labor market concerns. A rich set of theoretical and empirical tools has been developed to analyze the impact of trade on domestic labor market adjustments. However, few works have studied the optimal responses of a home government to a trade shock and the slow adjustment of the labor market. In this project, we take the key labor market frictions emphasized in this literature and characterize the optimal dynamic policies. Our main contribution lies in providing a theoretical tax formula and quantifying the dynamic policies under labor market frictions. In relation to the literature on optimal trade policies, our work stands out as one of the few studies exploring dynamic policies. Moreover, we specifically consider an environment characterized by labor market frictions that result in slow adjustment following a trade shock. The project consists of three parts. In the first part, we develop a multi-sector trade model with two well-documented labor adjustment features. First, sectorial human capital depends on the production scale of the sector and is accumulated through learning by doing but is not transferable across sectors. Second, employment regulations could slow down the reallocation of workers. These two slow-adjusting features of labor are relevant for both developed and developing countries. For example, in developing countries like China, the Hukou system restricts worker migration; in developed countries, firing costs, minimum wage, and downward nominal wage rigidities generate inefficient labor adjustment. The second part theoretically characterizes the optimal dynamic policies under the two labor market features. We uncover a general dynamic tax formula that links domestic taxes to labor market frictions. Furthermore, optimal import tariffs are determined by foreign supply elasticity and Home purchase share in foreign production, both reflecting Home country’s purchase power in the foreign market. With slow labor adjustment, optimal import tariffs depend on the elasticity and purchase shares dynamically. In equilibrium, all taxes are jointly determined. In the final part, we quantitatively study China’s optimal policies. We first examine the short-run and long-run effects of trade on Chinese labor market adjustment to identify the key parameters that shape the labor market dynamics. With the estimated model, we quantitatively prescribe the optimal dynamic policies and study the associated welfare implications. We can further use our setup to evaluate alternative policies, such as a simple policy rule or when a government cannot use domestic policies. 貿易保護主義通常與勞動市場的關注相關。目前已發展出一系列豐富的理論和實證工具來分析貿易對國內勞動市場調整的影響。然而，針對本國政府對貿易衝擊及勞動市場緩慢調整的最佳應對的研究卻寥寥無幾。在本項目中，我們將重點關注文獻中強調的關鍵勞動市場摩擦，並刻畫最佳動態政策。我們的主要貢獻在於提供一個理論稅收公式，並量化勞動市場摩擦下的動態政策。在最優貿易政策文獻中，我們的研究是少數探索動態政策的研究之一。此外，我們特別考慮勞動市場摩擦的環境，這些摩擦導致勞動力在貿易衝擊後緩慢調整。 該項目分為三個部分。在第一部分中，我們建立了一個多部門貿易模型，該模型包含兩個已充分證實的勞動力調整特徵。首先，部門人力資本取決於該部門的生產規模，並透過邊學邊做積累，但無法跨部門轉移。其次，勞動法規可能會減緩工人的重新配置。勞動力的這兩個慢調整特徵對發展中國家和發達國家都具有現實意義。例如，在中國等發展中國家，戶口制度限制了工人的流動；在發達國家，解雇成本、最低工資和名義工資的下行剛性造成了低效的勞動調整。 第二部分從理論上刻畫了在這兩個勞動市場特徵下的最佳動態國內和貿易政策。我們揭示了一個通用的動態稅收公式，將國內稅收與國內勞動市場摩擦聯繫起來。此外，最佳進口關稅由外國供應彈性和本國在外國生產中的購買份額決定，這兩者都反映了本國在外國市場的購買力。隨著勞動調整緩慢，最佳進口關稅動態地依賴於彈性和購買份額。在均衡中，所有稅收是共同決定的。 在最後一部分，我們定量研究中國的最佳政策。我們首先檢視貿易對中國勞動市場調整的短期和長期影響，以確定影響勞動市場動態的關鍵參數。通過估計模型，我們定量最佳動態政策並研究相關的福利影響。我們還可以進一步利用我們的設置來評估替代政策，例如簡單的政策規則或在政府無法使用國內政策時的情況下的最佳政策。

14502925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14502925.value: 營銷活動中社交媒體意見領袖的優選策略：基於資訊性結構先驗的貝葉斯加性回歸樹方法

14502925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14502925.value: Mr Gu, Taize Mr SUN, Zixun Prof Yang, Sha

14502925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502925.value: The influencer economy has grown rapidly in recent years. The increasing prominence of social media has enabled influencers to play pivotal roles in product advertising and direct sales. However, selecting the most suitable influencer(s) for a company's marketing campaign is challenging for two primary reasons. First, the matter of attributing overall outcomes to individual endorsers is complex. Multiple influencers are often engaged to endorse a product, yet the collective impact of these endorsements is typically observed as a whole. Therefore, it is difficult to evaluate the effect of an influencer on the performance outcome. Secondly, the number of campaigns (i.e., the sample size, N) is much smaller than the number of influencers (P), leading to a classic N < P problem. This disparity in data size has hindered the effective application of many machine learning approaches and resulted in results that lack explainability. In this project, we propose an approach based on Bayesian Additive Regression Tree (BART) to effectively address the aforementioned challenges. The BART model leverages both the Bayesian framework and the tree-based machine learning algorithm. Specifically, we will integrate BART with informative structural priors and endogeneity correction and adapt this into a sales response model, aiming to assess the effectiveness of influencers, both individually and in combination, on the performance outcome. Subsequently, we will develop an optimization strategy based on this model for selecting the optimal mix of influencers for a marketing campaign. We will work with one of the largest video game developers in the world to implement this approach and evaluate its performance relative to existing machine learning approaches such as LASSO, XGBOOST, and random forest. The outcomes of the proposed project will assist companies in enhancing the effectiveness of their social media marketing campaigns. Essentially, we will aim to address a common challenge faced by firms seeking to choose an optimal mix of marketing strategies from numerous channels on social media. In Hong Kong, both companies and the government are increasingly embracing social media as a vital tool for their marketing endeavors. The proposed project will offer valuable insights to inform their practices. By improving the efficiency of influencer marketing, we will further facilitate the growth of the industry. 近年來，意見領袖經濟呈現迅猛增長態勢。 隨著社交媒體影響力的持續擴大，意見領袖在產品推廣和直銷中發揮著關鍵作用。 然而，企業要為其營銷活動選擇最合適的意見領袖仍面臨兩大核心難題： 其一，效果歸因的複雜性。 多個意見領袖常共同推廣同一產品，但其集體影響力往往以整體形式呈現，導致難以量化每位意見領袖的實際貢獻。 其二，數據維度的不對等性。 營銷活動數量（即樣本量N）遠少於意見領袖數量（P），形成典型的“N

14503125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503125.value: 動態資源分配：時變環境中的公平性

14503125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14503125.value: Prof Hougaard, Jens Leth Prof Jingyi, Xue

14503125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503125.value: Dynamic resource allocation is a critical challenge across various sectors, from distributing company profits to allocating government funding. Traditional methods often assume static conditions, but real-world scenarios involve fluctuating resources and cumulative efforts over time. This research aims to address the complexities of dynamic resource allocation, where resources and contributions vary across periods. The primary challenges include managing temporal dynamics, ensuring fairness, and dealing with practical constraints such as perishable resources that cannot be saved or borrowed across periods. The project proposes developing a dynamic allocation model that integrates historical performance and future potential. The model will be tested through various scenarios to ensure its robustness and fairness. Key steps include creating a formal model that incorporates temporal aspects and historical contributions, assessing different allocation rules such as proportional sharing and constrained equal awards, and conducting laboratory experiments to compare the proposed dynamic rules with traditional static rules. The expected outcomes of this research are multifaceted. Firstly, it will provide new knowledge by offering insights into the principles of fair resource allocation in dynamic settings, contributing to the theoretical understanding of the problem. Secondly, the developed model can be applied to various real-world scenarios, such as academic funding, public healthcare, and environmental management, ensuring more equitable and efficient resource distribution. Lastly, the findings will inform policymakers and organizations on best practices for dynamic resource allocation, promoting sustained effort and innovation. By addressing the challenges of dynamic resource allocation, this research aims to create a fairer and more effective system for distributing resources in environments where conditions change over time. The outcomes will have significant implications for both theoretical research and practical applications, fostering continuous improvement and equitable resource management. This project not only seeks to reward past achievements but also encourages continuous improvement and forward-thinking strategies, ultimately contributing to a more equitable and effective system for resource distribution in dynamic environments. 動態資源分配在各個領域中是一個關鍵挑戰，從企業利潤分配到政府資金配置皆是如此。傳統方法通常假設條件是靜態的，但現實世界的場景涉及資源波動和隨時間累積的努力。本研究旨在解決動態資源分配的複雜性，其中資源和貢獻在不同時期會有所變化。主要挑戰包括管理時間動態、確保公平性，以及處理實際限制，例如不可儲存或跨期借用的易腐資源。 本項目提議開發一個動態分配模型，整合歷史表現和未來潛力。該模型將通過多種場景進行測試，以確保其穩健性和公平性。關鍵步驟包括建立一個納入時間面向和歷史貢獻的正式模型，評估不同的分配規則，如比例分享和受限平等分配，以及進行實驗室實驗，比較提議的動態規則與傳統靜態規則。 本研究的預期成果是多方面的。首先，它將通過提供在動態環境中公平資源分配原則的見解，為問題的理論理解作出貢獻，從而提供新知識。其次，開發的模型可應用於多種現實場景，如學術資金、公共醫療和環境管理，確保更公平和高效的資源分配。最後，研究結果將為政策制定者和組織提供動態資源分配的最佳實踐建議，促進持續努力和創新。 通過解決動態資源分配的挑戰，本研究旨在創建一個在條件隨時間變化的環境中更公平、更有效的資源分配系統。其成果將對理論研究和實際應用產生重大影響，促進持續改進和公平的資源管理。本項目不僅尋求獎勵過去的成就，還鼓勵持續改進和前瞻性策略，最終為動態環境中的資源分配貢獻一個更公平、更有效的系統。

14503325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503325.value: 父母去世對青少年的影響

14503325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503325.value: Losing one’s parents is one of the most traumatic experiences. The effects of parental death on children’s outcomes and the underlying mechanisms vary substantially over an individual’s life cycle (Adda et al., 2011; Jensen and Zhang, 2024). In particular, the teenage years (between 12 and 18) are the most vulnerable and formative period in one’s life. Numerous studies have underscored the importance of this young adult phase in children’s development (Borghans et al., 2008; Blakemore, 2012). However, little is known about the effect of losing a parent during teenage years on children’s outcomes. Existing literature shows that parental health shocks have a substantial negative impact on educational and academic outcomes, with potential differences based on the gender of the child or the deceased parent (see e.g., Aaskoven et al., 2022; Alam, 2015; Adda et al., 2011; Chen et al., 2009; Corak, 2001; Kristiansen, 2021). However, most studies focus on the overall effect (children below age 18 or 14) and overlook the age-specific impact. Moreover, existing research often limits outcomes to academic and mental health measures, even though parental death could influence other aspects of behavior, such as substance abuse and criminal activity. In addition, due to data limitations, most studies can only examine short-term effects, without further insights into how parental death affects children’s long-term outcomes. In this project, we examine the impact of parental death during children’s teenage years (specifically ages 12-18) on both short-term and long-term outcomes, including academic performance, mental health, substance abuse, criminal behavior, and labor market outcomes. We have chosen this specific age range because, during this period, children make significant life decisions, such as whether to attend academic high school or college. Additionally, during this time, children’s mental health and behavior are more likely to be influenced by external life shocks. We further aim to identify the channels that drive these observed effects and examine different policy approaches that could mitigate the negative impacts of parental death on children’s outcomes. To achieve this, we will leverage a large, long-term administrative dataset covering the entire Danish population from 1980 to 2020, and we will explore variations in the timing of parental fatal health shocks using matched control difference-in-difference, within-sibling design, and using future treated individuals as controls to address our research questions. 失去雙親是人生中最痛苦不堪的經歷之一，但大多數人終將面對這一境遇。父母亡故與重大健康衝擊對子女成長的影響及其內在機制，會隨著個體生命週期的不同階段而呈現顯著差異。例如，幼年喪親更可能影響認知與非認知能力的形成，而成年後失去父母則主要改變家庭內部照料安排（Adda等，2011；Jensen和Zhang，2024）。特別需要指出的是，青春期（12至18歲）被強調為人生中最脆弱且最關鍵的塑造期——相較成年人，青少年尚未具備足夠成熟的心智應對重大人生衝擊；但與幼童相比，他們已具備一定自主決策能力，能夠就學業、職業、社交等事項做出選擇。大量研究揭示了這一階段對認知與非認知能力發展的決定性作用，這些能力將影響終身成就（Roberts等，2006；Borghans等，2008；Almlund等，2011；Blakemore，2012）。然而，關於青少年時期經歷喪親對短期及長期影響的證據仍十分匱乏。 現有文獻表明，父母在子女成長期遭遇健康衝擊會對其教育成就產生顯著負面影響，且影響程度可能因子女性別或逝者性別而異（參見Aaskoven等，2022；Alam，2015；Adda等，2011；Chen等，2009；Corak，2001；Kristiansen，2021）。但多數研究聚焦於整體效應（18歲或14歲以下兒童），忽視了特定年齡段（尤其是青春期）的差異化影響。此外，現有研究往往局限於學業成績與心理健康指標，未能考察喪親可能引發的藥物濫用、犯罪行為或成為犯罪受害者等其他行為改變。由於數據限制，大多數研究僅能觀測教育成果等短期效應，無法深入探究父母亡故如何影響子女長期發展，或青春期這一特殊階段的作用機制。雖然我們無法避免父母遭遇健康衝擊（尤其是致命性衝擊），但通過制定精準的、針對特定年齡段的干預政策，可以緩解喪親的負面影響。而這類政策的制定，正有賴於對喪親年齡特異性效應及其內在機制的深入理解。 本研究旨在探討12-18歲青少年經歷父母健康衝擊對短期與長期發展的多維影響，包括學業表現、心理健康、藥物濫用、犯罪行為及勞動力市場表現。選擇這一年齡段，是因為此時青少年正面臨升學等重大人生抉擇，其心理健康與行為模式也更容易受到外部衝擊的影響（Roberts等，2006；Borghans等，2008；Almlund等，2011；Blakemore，2012）。我們還將識別這些影響的作用渠道，並評估不同政策干預對緩解負面效應的效果。為此，我們將利用丹麥1980-2020年全國行政登記數據，採用匹配控制雙重差分法、同胞固定效應模型以及「未來處理個體作為對照」等方法，通過分析父母健康衝擊發生時間的變異來解答研究問題。

14503425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503425.value: 應對中美科技競爭：風險投資向核心技術的再配置

14503425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14503425.value: Prof Li , Hongfei Prof RAI, Arun

14503425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503425.value: The intensifying US-China tech rivalry has created a volatile environment that significantly influences global venture capital (VC) dynamics, particularly in China’s core technology sectors. This project aims to investigate how this geopolitical tension shapes VC investments in China’s core tech landscape. Our research addresses three pivotal questions: (1) How does the US-China tech rivalry affect the distribution of VC investments in China’s core technologies? (2) How do the investment strategies of Chinese and US VCs in China’s core tech sector evolve in response to the ongoing US-China tech rivalry? (3) How does the rivalry alter the risk profiles of VC investments, considering investment stages and the number of investors per deal? To explore these questions, we employ a comprehensive dataset covering over 110,000 IT VC deals globally from 2013 to 2023. We use a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, comparing China with other countries to estimate the rivalry’s relative impact on China’s VC ecosystem. Our analysis focuses on core technologies and further classifies these core tech investments based on VC features such as investment origin (China, US, both, or neither) and deal characteristics (early vs. late stage, single vs. syndicate investors). Preliminary findings reveal a strategic reallocation of VC towards China’s core technologies, with a 16.8% increase in core tech investments following the onset of the rivalry. This shift is primarily driven by Chinese investors, highlighting a domestic push towards technological self-sufficiency. Interestingly, the rivalry has also spurred collaborative investments, with a significant rise in co-investment deals involving both Chinese and US VCs, suggesting that US investors are willing to engage in China’s tech sector when risks are shared. We further observe a growing preference for risk mitigation strategies, marked by increased investments in both late-stage and syndicate deals. These trends suggest that investors are favoring mature companies and adopting collaborative approaches to navigate geopolitical uncertainties. This study contributes to understanding the intersection of geopolitical tensions and VC investment strategies, offering valuable insights for policymakers and investors. Future research will expand to explore the impact of VC exits and the strategic responses of individual VC firms and startups, providing a holistic view of the evolving VC ecosystem in an era of heightened geopolitical competition. 不斷加劇的中美科技競爭導致全球風險投資（VC）格局劇烈變化，尤其深刻影響了中國核心技術領域的投資環境。本項目旨在研究這種地緣政治緊張局勢如何塑造了中國核心科技領域的風險投資格局。我們的研究重點關注三個關鍵問題：（1）中美科技競爭如何影響中國核心技術領域VC投資的分佈格局？（2）在中美科技競爭背景下，中國和美國的風險投資機構在中國核心技術領域的投資策略如何演變？（3）考慮投資階段和每筆交易的投資者數量，中美科技競爭如何改變風險投資的風險特徵？ 為了探討上述問題，我們利用了一套全面的數據集，包括2013年至2023年全球超過11萬筆IT行業VC投資交易。研究方法採用雙重差分（DID）策略，通過對比中國與其他國家，估計中美科技競爭對中國風險投資生態系統的相對影響。我們的分析聚焦於核心技術領域，並進一步基於風險投資特徵進行分類，包括投資來源（中國、美國、兩國共同或其他）和交易特徵（早期或晚期階段、單一或聯合投資）。 初步研究結果表明，風險投資戰略顯著向中國核心技術領域重新配置，自競爭加劇以來，核心技術投資增長了16.8%。這種轉變主要由中國投資者推動，反映了國內追求技術自給自足的趨勢。有趣的是，中美科技競爭也促使雙方VC聯合投資交易顯著增加，這表明美國投資者在風險共擔的前提下願意繼續參與中國的科技領域。此外，我們進一步觀察到投資者趨向採用風險緩解策略，即增加對晚期項目和聯合投資交易的投入。這些趨勢表明，在地緣政治不確定性背景下，投資者更傾向於選擇成熟公司並採用合作的投資方式。 本研究有助於深入理解地緣政治緊張局勢與風險投資策略之間的交互作用，為政策制定者和投資者提供重要洞察。未來研究將進一步擴展，探討風險投資退出機制及個體風險投資機構和初創企業的戰略反應，從而全面揭示日益激烈的地緣政治競爭時代下風險投資生態系統的動態變化。

14503825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503825.value: 領導力和人格之間存在相互影響的關係嗎？一項連續時間元分析研究

14503825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503825.value: The trait theory of leadership has played a significant role in leadership research (Judge, 2023). Heavily influenced by this approach, leadership scholars have investigated influences of personality traits on leadership role occupancy/emergence and leadership effectiveness. Heavily affected by the dominant dispositional perspective, this line of inquiry has predominantly assumed that the causal direction in the relationship travels only from personality traits to leadership, but not vice versa (Li et al., 2021). Yet, personality science has shown that personality traits are not only relatively stable, but also able to develop as people adapt to various work experiences throughout one’s whole life span. Organizational research has yet to fully embrace this paradigm shift, which has limited further theoretical development and empirical research on leadership and resulted in a fixed mindset that leaders are born, not made. Three studies have challenged the dispositional perspective by examining whether assuming leadership roles prompts personality adaptation, but yielded mixed findings. We argue this may be because of three major reasons related to theorizing and modeling the role of time, moderators, and teasing apart between-person and within-person effects. We propose a continuous-time meta-analytic approach (Dormann, Guthier, & Cortina, 2020) to probing the socialization effect of leader role occupancy on personality development while controlling for the selection effect of personality traits, aiming to reconcile the inconsistent findings by drawing from the neo-socioanalytic model of personality. We will investigate reciprocal relationships between personality traits and leadership and how the selection and socialization effects change over time. Lastly, we will examine whether moderators may explain the different findings across studies. This research makes contributions to the literature by reconciling the divergent findings on how leadership affects personality development. Heeding to the call to conduct “more research in our field on how work experiences influence personality change” by Judge (2023: 14), it challenges and complements the dominant trait theory by offering compelling meta-analytic evidence showcasing that personality traits are both a producer and also a product of leadership experiences. It suggests that future leadership research may investigate the development of personality traits as a form of leadership development. By examining the role of time in shaping the socialization effect, it enriches a dynamic perspective in leadership research. Together, this research has practical implications for organizations and the society to implement leadership programs by taking into consideration of their influences on personality development and the optimal time lag. 領導力的特質理論在領導力領域有着重要影響。受到該理論的影響，領導力研究者研究了人格特質對擔任領導角色以及領導力有效性的影響。 深受該特質理論的影響，領導力領域的研究主要假設人格特質和領導力的因果關係總是解釋成人格特質影響領導力，而不是相反。然而，人格科學的研究表明，人格特質一方面相對穩定，同時又可以在人的一生中隨着人適應工作經歷而改變。組織研究中，這一觀點和研究範式的改變並沒有得到完全認可，從而進一步影響了領導力領域的理論和實證研究進展，導致了固定的心態，認爲領導是天生的，不是後天的。 目前有三個研究挑戰了領導力領域的特質理論，探討了成爲領導是否可以導致人格改變。但是這三個研究得到了不一致的結論。我們認爲，這可能是由三方面導致的：對時間變量的建模，調節變量以及區分個體間和個體內的效應。 基於此，我們提出連續時間的元分析方法可以幫助我們探討擔任領導角色對人格變化的影響，並且同時控制人格對領導力的影響，試圖解決以前研究結論不一致的問題。我們基於人格的新社會分析理論，探討人格和領導力的相互影響，以及這些作用是否受到時間的影響而改變。同時，我們還會分析一些調節變量的影響。 該研究可以解決以前研究結論不一致的問題，從而對文獻有重要貢獻。並且，該研究順應了Judge （2023）的增強對工作經歷如何改變人格的研究倡議。於此同時，該研究挑戰和豐富了領導力領域的特質理論，通過元分析的方法，有力證明了，人格既可以影響領導力，又受到領導力的影響。未來領導力研究可以將領導的人格發展作爲目標之一。該研究也對組織和社會中的領導力項目有着重要啓示。

14503925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503925.value: 誰揭發了氣候違規行為？

14503925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503925.value: This research project investigates the dynamics of whistleblowing in the context of corporate misconduct, with a particular focus on climate-related issues. Despite the critical role of whistleblowers in exposing fraud, existing literature primarily emphasizes traditional corporate governance actors—such as investors, regulators, and auditors—while overlooking non-traditional participants. This project aims to fill this gap by exploring who effectively monitors and detects climate misconduct, such as fraudulent emissions reporting and greenwashing. The study draws on empirical data from over 1,800 climate litigation cases involving U.S. firms between 2004 and 2024. By narrowing the focus to large-cap domestic companies, the research aims to identify the actors responsible for uncovering environmental misconduct and analyze their motivations and access to information. The role of moral incentives, particularly among non-governmental organizations (NGOs), will be emphasized alongside traditional monetary incentives. The project will test two primary predictions: first, that a diverse array of whistleblowers—beyond conventional actors—plays a significant role in monitoring climate misconduct; and second, that actors driven by moral imperatives, such as NGOs, are more likely to detect incidents of climate-related wrongdoing than other non-traditional players. To achieve this, a comprehensive dataset will be constructed, detailing the various parties involved in each case of climate misconduct and their respective motivations. To analyze the data, the research employs conditional logit models to understand the relationships between different types of whistleblowers and the severity of misconduct cases. This methodological approach will allow for the identification of key factors influencing whistleblower effectiveness, including career concerns and access to information. Additionally, the project will examine the market's reaction to whistleblowing incidents and the subsequent corporate responses to these revelations. Ultimately, this study aims to enhance our understanding of the mechanisms behind climate misconduct detection and the effectiveness of various actors in promoting corporate accountability. The findings will contribute to the discourse on corporate governance, environmental regulation, and the importance of diverse whistleblower participation in safeguarding public interest and fostering transparency in corporate practices.

14504525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14504525.value: 數據驅動的近似算法：基於需求學習的車輛共享網絡

14504525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504525.value: This research proposal plans to study online learning problems of optimizing on-demand vehicle sharing networks. Customers can pick up vehicles at one location and return them to another, necessitating effective management of limited vehicles. Moreover, firms in practice usually do not know the demand functions a priori and need to learn demands over time. To address this, this study will develop online learning algorithms that enable vehicle-sharing providers to adjust prices based on real-time demand data. By observing customer responses to pricing over time, the algorithms seek to identify optimal pricing strategies. We plan to develop the algorithms based on the combination of sophisticated convex optimization methods and carefully designed price search subroutines. We will establish theoretical performance guarantees of the algorithms and implement them using both synthetic and industry data. If successful, we will also conduct field experiments and extend the study to include vehicle repositioning decisions. The outcomes of this research have the potential to revolutionize the field of urban transportation, leading to more effective vehicle sharing network systems that significantly improve customer satisfaction and enhance the profitability of firms. These insights will be invaluable for service providers in the evolving landscape of urban transportation. 本研究提案旨在研究優化按需車輛共享網絡的在線學習問題。用戶可以在一個地點取用車輛並將其歸還至另一地點，這需要對有限車輛進行有效管理。此外，實際運營中，企業通常事先無法得知需求函數，需隨時間推移學習需求。為了解決這一問題，本研究將開發在線學習算法，使車輛共享服務提供商能夠根據實時需求數據調整價格。通過觀察顧客對價格的反應，這些算法旨在識別出最優定價策略。我們計劃基於凸優化方法與價格搜索子程序相結合來開發這些算法，並為其建立理論性能保證。此外，我們將利用合成數據和行業數據實現這些算法。如果研究成功，我們還將研究擴展至包括車輛重新定位決策。本研究有潛力改善城市交通領域，從而構建更高效的車輛共享網絡系統，提高顧客滿意度並增強企業的盈利能力。

14504725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14504725.value: Prof Aoki, Kosuke Prof Fujiwara, Ippei

14504725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504725.value: This project offers a new perspective on the "Lost Decade in Japan" literature built on the seminal work of Hayashi and Prescott (2002). Our research studies the inter-temporal and spatial allocation of Japan's fiscal resources and their macroeconomic implications. We demonstrate that Japan's fiscal resource allocation underwent significant changes in the 1990s, including growing inefficiencies in capital allocation between the public and private sectors, and more public investments allocated towards regions with lower productivity and lower returns to these investment. These findings suggest a deterioration in fiscal resource allocation efficiency during the "Lost Decade". Our study explains the fiscal pivot towards public investments and low-productivity regions from institutional perspectives. To explore the underlying institutional factors and quantify their macroeconomic consequences, we present a multi-region dynamic general equilibrium model. Utilizing the "institutional accounting" approach developed by Song and Xiong (2004), we back out the institutional parameters governing local governments' lobbying incentives and fiscal discipline. Our preliminary results reveal that Japanese local governments' lobbying incentives intensified during the 1990s, exacerbating the inter-temporal and sectoral allocation of capital. These lobbying incentives have consistently been stronger in lower-productivity regions, with no significant change in their spatial distribution during the 1990s. In contrast, local governments' fiscal discipline was substantially weakened in low-productivity regions compared to high-productivity regions during this period, indicating a worsened spatial misallocation of public investment. We next assess the quantitative importance of the inter-temporal and spatial aspects of these institutional changes. Our preliminary results suggest that the weakening of fiscal discipline in low-productivity prefectures plays a major role. Modest adjustments in the spatial allocation of public investments can lead to sizable aggregate productivity gains. This research aims to provide new insights into the spatial dimension of fiscal policy and its impact on economic stagnation. Using Japan's experience as a case study, our findings may have broader implications for other economies facing similar challenges. 本項目為基於Hayashi和Prescott（2002）開創性研究的"日本失去的十年"文獻提供了新視角。我們通過研究日本財政資源的跨期與空間配置及其宏觀經濟效益發現：上世紀90年代日本財政資源配置發生了重大轉變，表現為公私部門間資本配置效率持續惡化，以及大量公共投資流向生產率較低、投資回報較差的地區。這些發現揭示了"失去的十年"期間財政資源配置效率的衰退機製。本研究特別關注財政政策的空間維度對經濟停滯的影響，以日本案例為鑒，其研究成果對面臨類似挑戰的其他經濟體具有重要啟示意義。

14505125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505125.value: 雙重機器學習估計量的一般自助法一致性理論

14505125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505125.value: The integration of machine learning (ML) and econometrics has shown great promise in enhancing predictive accuracy and addressing confounding bias in causal inference. Double Machine Learning (DML) is a notable methodology that utilizes advanced ML algorithms to learn nuisance functions while accurately estimating parameters of interest, such as specific causal effects. Despite DML's success in providing robust point estimates in scenarios involving large datasets and complex models, the standard inference procedures, particularly confidence intervals based on normal approximations, often exhibit under-coverage in finite samples. One potential remedy is the application of bootstrap methods, known for their adaptability. However, a comprehensive theoretical framework for these methods in the context of DML is absent. Our proposal aims to address this gap by developing a unified bootstrap scheme tailored for DML estimators using general sample criterion functions. Applying a nonparametric bootstrap directly to DML is computationally intensive due to the heavy demands of ML algorithms in estimating nuisance functions, making it impractical for the thousands of replications typically required. Our project introduces an innovative approach where only the finite dimensional parameter needs recalculating in the bootstrap sample, with the nuisance estimand fixed from the original data. This method is theoretically sound because DML's orthogonality to the first-stage ML nuisance estimand ensures the source of the nuisance function—whether from the original or bootstrap sample—is irrelevant. This new procedure simplifies the estimation of standard errors and confidence intervals, essential for hypothesis testing and reliable predictive modeling. We aim to rigorously establish the large-sample consistency of this new bootstrap method for DML estimators across various weights and sample criterion functions. Preliminary results indicate a comprehensive theorem where the centered bootstrap estimand converges to the correct limiting distribution in probability. Further, we will explore modifications for non-smooth sample criterion functions and address potential failures in non-standard limiting distributions. Through extensive Monte Carlo simulations and real data applications, we plan to demonstrate the practicality and accuracy of our proposed bootstrap inference methods. 機器學習（ML）與計量經濟學的整合在提升預測準確性及處理因果推論中的混淆偏誤方面展現出極大潛力。雙重機器學習（DML）是一項重要的方法論，透過先進的機器學習演算法來學習干擾函數，同時準確估計感興趣的參數，例如特定的因果效應。儘管 DML 在處理大型資料集與複雜模型時能提供穩健的點估計，其標準推論程序——特別是基於常態近似的信賴區間——在有限樣本中常常表現出涵蓋率不足的問題。一項可能的解決方案是應用具有高度適應性的自助法方法。然而，目前尚缺乏針對 DML 背景下這些方法的完整理論架構。我們的提案旨在填補此空白，透過一般樣本準則函數，為 DML 估計量建立一套統一的自助法推論機制。 直接將非參數自助法應用於雙重機器學習（DML）在計算上非常密集，原因在於機器學習演算法在估計干擾函數時所需的運算資源極高，使得執行數千次重抽樣所需的計算量變得不切實際。我們的研究提出一種創新的方法，在自助樣本中僅需重新計算有限維度的參數，而將干擾估計值固定為原始資料中的結果。此方法在理論上是合理的，因為 DML 對第一階段機器學習干擾估計值具有正交性，確保干擾函數的來源——無論來自原始樣本或自助樣本——對最終估計結果無影響。 此新程序簡化了標準誤與信賴區間的估計，這對於假設檢定與可靠的預測建模至關重要。我們的目標是嚴謹地建立此新自助法在各種權重與樣本準則函數下，對 DML 估計量的大樣本一致性。初步結果顯示，一項完整的理論定理正在形成，其中中心化的自助估計值在機率上收斂至正確的極限分布。此外，我們將探討針對非平滑樣本準則函數的修正方法，並處理在非標準極限分布下可能出現的失效情況。透過大量的蒙地卡羅模擬與真實資料應用，我們計畫展示所提出自助推論方法的實用性與準確性。

14505225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505225.value: 理解數字處理的影響：評論數量增加在何時會變得適得其反？

14505225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505225.value: Research has shown that an increase in the number of reviews can lead consumers to infer a store’s popularity, thereby increasing interest (Dellarocas, Zhang, & Awad, 2007). However, little attention has been paid to the potential negative consequences of this increase. Our research seeks to explore this overlooked dimension, specifically how consumers react to negative reviews as the total number of reviews grows. Consider this scenario: a consumer sees a restaurant on Yelp.com with 11 reviews, of which 2 are negative. Later, they encounter another restaurant with 121 reviews, with 22 of them negative. Although the proportion of negative reviews is the same in both cases, the key question is how consumers perceive and evaluate these restaurants based on the review counts. Two mechanisms may explain why this increase could have negative consequences. First, the denominator neglect effect suggests that consumers may perceive 22 negative reviews as worse than 2, while overlooking the total number of reviews. Second, the small-numbers effect proposes that consumers may find it harder to comprehend 22 out of 121 compared to 2 out of 11, leading to reduced confidence in the low probability of negative reviews. Both mechanisms could contribute to more negative judgments as the number of reviews increases. Our research aims to distinguish between these two mechanisms and examine how both review content (the number of negative reviews) and emotional responses (feelings of confidence) affect consumers’ numerical processing. We also explore when a high number of reviews signals popularity versus when it triggers the negative effects we propose. In this proposal, we outline plans to use various methods to demonstrate our predicted effects in real-world marketing contexts. We also intend to analyze secondary data from Openrice.com and conduct an online experiment via Facebook A/B testing. Our research will contribute to the fields of numerical cognition, online reviews, and word of mouth, offering important marketing implications for the influence of online reviews. 研究表明，評論數量的增加會讓消費者認為一家店鋪更受歡迎，從而提高他們的興趣。然而，關於這一增長可能帶來的負面影響，目前研究關注較少。我們的研究旨在探討這一被忽視的方面，具體來說是：隨著評論總數的增加，消費者對負面評論的反應如何變化。 請考慮以下情境：一位消費者在 Yelp.com 上看到一家餐廳有 11 條評論，其中 2 條是負面的。後來，他們又看到另一家餐廳有 121 條評論，其中有 22 條是負面的。儘管兩家餐廳的負面評論比例相同，但關鍵問題在於，消費者如何根據評論數量來感知和評估這兩家餐廳。 有兩種機制可能解釋為何評論數量的增加可能導致負面後果。第一，分母忽視效應指出，消費者可能會認為 22 條負面評論比 2 條更糟，而忽視了評論總數的差異。第二，小樣本效應認為，消費者可能更難理解“121 條評論中有 22 條是負面的”這一資訊，相較於“11 條評論中有 2 條是負面的”，這會降低他們對負面評論概率較低這一判斷的信心。這兩種機制都可能導致評論數量增加時消費者評價更負面。 我們的研究目標是區分這兩種機制，並考察評論內容（負面評論的數量）與情感反應（信心程度）如何影響消費者的數文書處理方式。我們還將探討，在什麼情況下大量評論會被解讀為人氣高的信號，反之又在什麼情況下會引發我們提出的負面效應。 在本研究計畫中，我們將採用多種方法來驗證這些預測效應在真實行銷環境中的表現。同時，我們計畫分析來自 Openrice.com 的二手資料，並通過 Facebook 的 A/B 測試進行線上實驗。我們的研究將為數字認知、線上評論與口碑傳播領域做出貢獻，並為理解線上評論對消費者行為的影響提供重要的行銷啟示。

14505325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505325.value: 地緣政治風險下的全球供應鏈調整

14505325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14505325.value: Mr LI, ZHI Ms PENG, BOYA

14505325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505325.value: In an era of escalating geopolitical tensions, global supply chains face unprecedented challenges that demand a comprehensive understanding of their resilience and adaptability. This research project systematically investigates the complex relationship between geopolitical risks (GPR) and the restructuring of global supply chains. By leveraging comprehensive geopolitical risk indices and transaction-level global trade data, the study first quantifies how increasing GPR compels firms to adjust their import patterns, particularly by reducing imports from high-risk countries. Furthermore, it explores how product-specific characteristics, such as relationship specificity, external finance dependence, and product complexity, and firm-specific features, such as existing inventory buffers, R&D expenditures, and supply chain diversification, mediate these import adjustments. These supply chain adjustments in response to GPR may lead to increased production costs and greater output volatility, highlighting the significant economic implications of such changes. Additionally, while firms may successfully reduce their first-tier supply chain exposure to GPR, they may become indirectly exposed through their upstream suppliers, revealing hidden vulnerabilities within deep-tier global trade networks. This research advances our understanding of supply chain restructuring in volatile geopolitical landscapes and provides strategic insights for firms seeking to enhance their supply chain resilience. Ultimately, the findings aim to support more informed decision-making for businesses and policymakers striving to navigate and mitigate the impacts of GPR on global operations. 在地緣政治緊張局勢不斷升級的時代，全球供應鏈面臨前所未有的挑戰，需要全面了解其彈性和適應性。本研究計畫系統性地研究了地緣政治風險（GPR）與全球供應鏈重組之間的複雜關係。透過利用全面的地緣政治風險指數和交易層面的全球貿易數據，該研究首先量化了GPR的增加如何迫使企業調整其進口模式，特別是透過減少來自高風險國家的進口。此外，它還探討了產品特有的特徵，如關係特異性、外部融資依賴性和產品複雜性，以及公司特有的特徵（如現有庫存緩衝、研發支出和供應鏈多樣化）如何調節這些進口調整。為響應GPR而進行的這些供應鏈調整可能會導致生產成本增加和產出波動加劇，突顯出這些變化的重大經濟影響。此外，儘管企業可能成功地減少了其一級供應鏈對GPR的風險敞口，但它們可能透過上游供應商間接暴露，揭示了深層全球貿易網絡中隱藏的漏洞。這項研究深化了我們對動盪地緣政治環境中供應鏈重組的理解，並為尋求提高供應鏈彈性的公司提供了策略見解。最終，這些發現旨在為企業和政策制定者提供更明智的決策支持，以努力駕馭和減輕GPR對全球營運的影響。

14506125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506125.value: 基於假設檢驗的預期形成理論下的宏觀經濟

14506125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506125.value: An essential aspect in comprehending the decision-making process of economic agents lies in recognizing the significance of expectation formation. If households expect a positive outlook for the future economy, they are more likely to increase their consumption, and vice versa. Widespread pessimistic expectations of high inflation can lead firms to raise prices and workers to demand higher wages, thus reinforcing high inflation expectations in a self-fulfilling manner. Full information rational expectation (FIRE) has been the dominant expectation framework since the rational expectations revolution of the 1970s. However, it is inconsistent with human behaviours, especially during crisis. For example, AAA bonds, once considered safe assets that were both safe and profitable, were suddenly viewed as 'trash' with zero value during the financial crisis. This abrupt shift in confidence or subjective beliefs of agents underscores the necessity of a 'paradigm shift' in expectation formation. As the crisis unfolded, decision-makers began to question the reliability of their existing models and sought alternative frameworks that better accommodated the extreme circumstances of the crisis. In decision theory, Ortoleva (2012) introduces a Hypothesis Testing (HT) expectation formation framework that embodies features of a changing paradigm. Within this framework, decision makers (DMs) face uncertainty regarding the underlying data-generating process of the state of the economy. Based on the evidence received or data observed, DMs choose the 'most likely' model when assessing the relative likelihood of potential future contingencies. When a low-probability or zero-probability event occurs, surprised DMs subsequently reassess the relative credibility of potential models and revise their beliefs. DMs exhibit behavior akin to hypothesis testing the reliability of various models. This research aims to uncover the macroeconomic implications of HT models both empirically and theoretically. By utilizing survey data on expectations, this project intends to test the theoretical projections of HT models across business cycles and in the cross-section. Theoretically, this project delves into the general equilibrium effects of HT models, emphasizing how coordinated decisions on paradigm shifts impact the propagation mechanism of structural shocks in the economy. Furthermore, the project will explore the policy implications associated with HT models. 理解經濟個體的決策過程的一個關鍵在於意識到個體預期形成機制的重要性。如果家庭部門對於未來的經濟狀況有一個積極的展望，那麼他們更可能增加消費，反之亦然。廣泛的對於未來高通脹的悲觀預期可能導致企業提高售價，工人則會要求更高的工資，這進而以一種自我實現的方式強化了他們本來的高通脹預期。自1970年代的理性預期革命以來，完全信息下的理性預期模型（FIRE）成為了宏觀理論中占主導地位的預期建模框架。但是，很多時候它與人類的行為是不一致的，在危機發生時尤其如此。例如，在金融危機爆發時，一種危機前被認為兼顧低風險與高收益的資產 — AAA公司債券 —瞬間被市場視為一文不值。這種信心或者主觀信念的突然轉變強調了研究個體預期形成中的“範式切換”的重要性。當危機來臨，決策者開始對他們原來確信的經濟模型提出質疑，並會尋求能更好地解釋危機中所發生的極端情況的替代性框架。 在決策理論中，Ortoleva (2012) 提出了一個能體現範式切換的，被稱為假設檢驗（Hypothesis Testing）的預期形成框架。在此框架下，決策者對於決定當前經濟狀態的底層數據產生過程（也被稱為“模型”）是不確定的。在決策者評估未來各情況的可能性時，基於他們看到的證據和數據，他們會選擇其中一個“最有可能”的模型。當低概率或者零概率事件發生時，感到意外的決策者們會重新評估各個潛在模型的相對可信度，並調整他們的信念。決策者所展現的行為與他們對於模型可信度進行的假設檢驗之間存在關聯。這個研究旨在從實證和理論角度發掘假設檢驗模型對於宏觀經濟的影響。在實證上，通過利用對於預期的調查數據，這個項目計劃檢測假設檢驗模型對於經濟週期的和截面上的影響的理論預測。在理論上，這個項目計劃探究假設檢驗模型對於一般均衡的影響，並且強調在均衡中個體間相互協調的對於信念範式的切換決策如何影響結構性衝擊在經濟中的傳導機制。此外，這個項目還將研究與假設檢驗模型相關的政策啟示。

14506325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506325.value: We seek to understand the strategic use of ambiguity in contract design. It is widely observed that ambiguous mechanisms, with certain terms and conditions left open to interpretation, are commonly observed in real life. For example, to fulfil the promotion requirement in a tenure-track contract, a university professor needs to exhibit productivity and excellence in research, teaching and service. However, what these phrases precisely mean usually remains to be ambiguous. As for another example, Expedia Deals offer travelers hotel stays within certain regions of the city at a known price, but the exact name of the hotel remains unknown until the payment is completed. A natural question is how much a sophisticated seller could benefit from employing this type of ambiguity in contract design. While significant progress has been achieved in the last decade, all the previous studies make some common restrictions. In particular, agents are not allowed to use mixed strategies. This assumption facilitates the theoretical analysis but underestimates agents’ capacity to handle the ambiguous situation. This project aims to explore the optimal ambiguous mechanism without imposing restrictions on the agent side. Our goal is to identify the optimal ambiguous contract and determine how it can be effectively implemented in practical settings. Given that traditional methods may not be available in our setting, significant technical advancements may be needed, which could also have applications in other areas. Importantly, the optimal contract we identify could offer new insights into various practical situations. 契約設計中的模糊性策略在現實中廣泛存在，例如大學教授對終身教職評審要求 - 卓越的研究、教學與服務，或旅遊平臺以未明確標示的酒店選項吸引顧客。這種模糊性賦予設計者（如賣方或雇主）更大的契約操控空間，但過往研究多限制代理人（如買方或員工）僅能採用純策略，忽略其運用混合策略應對模糊性的能力。 本研究探討最優模糊機制的設計，並允許代理人使用混合策略，以更真實地反映其策略選擇。透過理論模型與數值範例，我們的發現如下。一. 混合策略對最優機製有關鍵影響：當代理人可採取混合策略時，傳統模糊機制的優勢可能消失。例如，在特定類型分佈下，模糊設計無法提升賣方收益，甚至需回歸傳統定價機制。二、混合策略引入無限多種誤報可能，使激勵相容的設計更複雜。我們刻畫了新的解決方案，如透過契約組合使最高類型代理人對真實申報與混合誤報無差異。 本研究突破既有文獻對純策略的限制，揭示混合策略如何重塑模糊契約的設計邏輯。成果不僅拓展機制設計理論，亦對實務（如學術評鑑、平臺經濟）提供新見解，例如：模糊條款的效益可能因代理人的策略靈活性而削弱，設計者需權衡模糊性與策略複雜性的交互作用。未來研究將進一步探討多類型環境下的最優契約結構與應用場景。

14507425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507425.value: 臨時預算下的政府採購合約：以美國持續決議為例

14507425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507425.value: The U.S. federal government agencies receive budgets through annual appropriations acts. However, in recent years, the enactment of these acts has frequently been delayed beyond the start of the new fiscal year, leading to the extensive use of Continuing Resolutions (CRs)—temporary budgets that support agency operations until a regular appropriations act is passed. While CRs can significantly impact agency operations, empirical evidence on their effects is limited. This proposal investigates the impacts of CRs on government procurement contracting by examining agencies’ contracting activities and contract designs during the CR period. Government agencies operating under a CR face heightened fiscal uncertainties regarding the total budgets available and unexpected provisions in the new appropriations act. Although a CR allows agencies to temporarily spend funds following the prior year’s rules, any spending during the CR period will be deducted from the new appropriations act, and any contracting activities inconsistent with the new act must be adjusted. Consequently, I hypothesize that agencies are likely to reduce contracting activities during the CR period and postpone contracts until the formal appropriations act is enacted. If government agencies need to contract during the CR period, fiscal uncertainties are likely to influence the contract design. I predict that agencies frequently use two contractual arrangements: (1) inserting options into contracts, which allow them to unilaterally elect to purchase additional products if needed, and (2) issuing smaller and shorter contracts for flexibility. I further argue that these arrangements have different implications. While options provide both flexibility and stability, they come with a price premium. When fiscal uncertainties are higher, the price premium during the CR period becomes more costly, leading agencies to prefer smaller and shorter contracts. Overall, this study will provide a systematic analysis of the impacts of CRs on federal government contracting. It will offer insights into how CRs affect the volume and design of procurement contracts, with potential implications for the efficiency of government operations during the CR period. 美國聯邦政府部門通常透過年度撥款法案獲得預算。然而，近年來這些法案的通過經常延遲至新財政年度開始之後，導致政府廣泛使用“持續決議”（Continuing Resolutions, CR）。CR是一種臨時預算，用以支持部門運作，直到正式的撥款法案通過為止。儘管CR可能對政府運作產生重大影響，目前針對其影響的實證研究仍然有限。本研究旨在透過分析政府部門在CR期間的合約活動與合約設計，探討CR對政府採購合約的影響。 在CR期間運作的政府部門，面臨更高的不確定性，包含可用總預算及新撥款法案中可能出現的新增條款。雖然CR允許部門依照前一年度的規則暫時使用資金，但在CR期間的任何支出都將從新撥款法案中扣除，且任何與新法案不一致的合約活動都必須進行調整。因此，本研究提出假設：政府部門在CR期間傾向減少合約活動，並延後簽訂合約，直到正式撥款法案通過。 若政府部門在CR期間仍需簽訂合約，財政上的不確定性可能會影響合約設計。本研究預測政府部門將常用兩種合約安排：（1）在合約中加入選擇權，使其能單方面選擇是否購買額外產品；（2）簽訂規模較小、期限較短的合約，以提高彈性。本研究進一步提出，雖然選擇權能提供彈性與穩定性，但會帶來價格溢價。當財政不確定性較高時，CR期間的溢價成本也會上升，促使機構偏好規模較小、期限較短的合約。 整體而言，本研究將系統分析CR對聯邦政府採購合約的影響，並提供CR如何影響合約活動與設計的洞見，對政府在CR期間的運作效率具有潛在啟示。

14507725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507725.value: 數據科學家與前美聯儲員工：誰對機構投資者在FOMC日的投資表現影響更大

14507725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14507725.value: Prof Cen, Ling Prof Han, Bing

14507725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507725.value: In today’s era of artificial intelligence and big data, institutional investors are increasingly hiring data scientists to improve their investment performance. This trend raises a critical question: can these data scientists help institutional investors predict macroeconomic shocks and in turn outperform their competitors? Our research project aims to answer this question by focusing on the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements that reveal the central bank’s monetary decisions, given their significant impact on stock markets and evidence of informed trading before FOMC announcements. We examine whether institutions with a larger number of data scientists are more likely to engage in informed trading before FOMC announcements, thereby achieving superior performance. We hypothesize that data scientists, armed with sophisticated analytical tools and machine learning algorithms, can produce valuable information from vast amounts of public information, which could be instrumental in accurately predicting monetary policy decisions. At the same time, we explore another interesting angle: the potential benefits of hiring former Federal Reserve employees. Some research indicates that information leaks might occur before FOMC meetings, and we posit these central bankers could provide valuable private information through their social connections. Our study will conduct comprehensive analyses by examining whether and how data scientists and former central bankers substitute or complement each other, creating synergies, and how these effects vary depending on the type of institution and whether monetary policy is tightening or easing. To address potential endogeneity concerns, we will exploit mergers and acquisitions among institutional investors to capture plausibly exogenous changes in data scientists and former central bankers. Our research will highlight the importance of specialized human capital in finance. By comparing the data scientists with former central bankers with potential access to private information through social connections, we seek to identify the sources of informed trading before FOMC announcements. This could uncover whether and how public and private information contribute to predicting monetary shocks and generating returns. Given Hong Kong’s status as a major financial hub with its currency tied to the US dollar, its market is particularly sensitive to US monetary policy. Our findings will offer valuable insights for Hong Kong institutional investors on how data scientists can effectively predict US monetary shocks and enhance investment performance. These insights could have significant implications for Hong Kong’s financial sector in terms of hiring practices, investment strategies, and risk management. 在當今人工智能與大數據時代，機構投資者越來越傾向於聘請數據科學家來提升投資表現。這一趨勢引發了一個關鍵問題：這些數據科學家能否幫助機構投資者預測宏觀經濟衝擊，從而超越競爭對手？ 我們的研究項目旨在通過聚焦聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）公告來回答這一問題，因為這些公告揭示了中央銀行的貨幣政策決定，對股市有重大影響，且有證據顯示在FOMC公告前存在知情交易。我們研究了擁有更多數據科學家的機構是否更可能在FOMC公告前進行知情交易，從而獲得優異表現。我們假設，憑藉先進的分析工具和機器學習算法，數據科學家能夠從海量的公共信息中提取有價值的信息，這對於準確預測貨幣政策決定至關重要。 與此同時，我們探索了另一個有趣的視角：聘用前聯邦儲備系統員工的潛在益處。一些研究表明，FOMC會議前可能存在信息洩露，我們推測這些前中央銀行職員可能通過其社交關係提供有價值的私人信息。 我們的研究將通過全面分析，探討數據科學家與前中央銀行職員如何相互替代或補充，創造協同效應，以及這些效應的變化如何取決於機構類型及貨幣政策是趨緊還是寬鬆。為了解決潛在的內生性問題，我們將利用機構投資者之間的併購活動，捕捉數據科學家和前中央銀行職員數量的外生變化。 我們的研究將突出金融領域專業化人力資本的重要性。通過比較數據科學家與可能通過社交關係獲取私人信息的前中央銀行職員，我們旨在識別FOMC公告前知情交易的來源。這將揭示公共信息和私人信息如何幫助預測貨幣政策衝擊並產生回報。 鑑於香港作為主要金融中心的地位，其貨幣與美元掛鉤，其市場對美國貨幣政策尤為敏感。我們的研究結果將為香港機構投資者提供寶貴見解，說明數據科學家如何有效預測美國貨幣政策衝擊並提升投資表現。這些見解對香港金融行業在招聘實踐、投資策略和風險管理方面可能具有重大意義。

14507825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507825.value: 未知買方估值下魯棒序列公示價格機制之績效

14507825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507825.value: The design of optimal mechanisms for selling items is crucial in modern marketplaces such as online advertising, e-commerce, and auctions for rare goods. Given the uncertainty in market conditions and the impracticality of overly complex mechanisms, there is a need for more robust mechanisms that perform well under limited information. Robust mechanism design addresses this issue by developing mechanisms that can handle worst-case scenarios, even when only partial information about buyer valuations is available. This proposal investigates the trade-off between simplicity and optimality in mechanism design, focusing on Sequential Posted-Price Mechanisms (SPMs). SPMs are easy to implement, reduce strategic manipulation, and require minimal information elicitation but are generally suboptimal. The central question is how much performance is sacrificed by choosing simplicity over the optimal auction mechanisms when the seller does not have complete information about buyers' valuation distributions. Our research aims to design a simple yet robust sequential posted pricing mechanism that ensures good performance relative to the optimal auction. We explore how the availability of partial information—such as support information or limited distributional knowledge—affects the structure and performance of these mechanisms. The study formalizes this by examining dominant strategy incentive-compatible (DSIC) mechanisms and measuring their performance through approximation ratios relative to idealized benchmarks. Through this approach, we provide insights into how simple mechanisms can be effectively designed under uncertainty, achieving good performance guarantees despite the lack of precise market information. 在現代市場所涉及的銷售情境（如線上廣告、電子商務與稀有商品拍賣）中，如何設計最適機制至關重要。由於市場條件存在不確定性，且過度複雜的機制在實務上往往難以落地，因此需要能在資訊有限下仍具穩健表現的機制。魯棒機制設計正是為此而生：即便僅掌握買方估值的部分資訊，也能在最壞情境下提供保證。 本計畫探討機制設計中「簡潔與最適性」之權衡，重點關注序列公示價格機制（Sequential Posted-Price Mechanisms, SPMs）。SPM 具備易於實作、降低策略操弄、資訊揭露需求低等優點，但相較於最優拍賣通常不具完全最適性。本研究的核心問題是：當賣方無法完整掌握買方估值分佈時，選擇簡潔機制相較於最優拍賣會犧牲多少績效？ 我們的目標是設計一種簡潔且魯棒的序列公示定價機制，使其相對於最優拍賣能達到良好績效。我們將探討可得的部分資訊（例如估值取值範圍或有限的分佈知識）如何影響機制的結構與表現。形式化方面，我們聚焦於支配策略誘因相容（DSIC）機制，並以相對於理想化基準的近似比來衡量其績效。透過上述途徑，本文提供在不確定性下設計簡潔機制的原則與保證，證明即便缺乏精確的市場資訊，仍可達成良好的績效界限。

14507925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507925.value: 企業所得稅稅率對家庭財富與消費的影響

14507925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507925.value: Corporate income taxes (CIT) are an important way for governments to raise revenue. However, CIT are often criticized for discouraging corporate investment, reducing economic growth, imposing an unfair double-taxation on shareholders, and either encouraging or discouraging particular types of corporate activities that may not be socially beneficial. Prior studies have examined the effects of corporate tax rates on firms’ capital structure [Heider and Ljungqvist, 2015], employment and business reallocation [Giroud and Rauh, 2019] and the distribution of the corporate tax burden among workers, landowners and firms [Serrato et al., 2016]. However, there is little evidence on how CIT affects local government stakeholders, i.e., households. The effects on households are important because household spending in developed economies represents a majority of GDP, and captures the implications of corporate tax incidence for within-state welfare. Therefore, the policy implications of CIT changes plausibly depend on the under-explored effects on household wealth and household consumption. 企業所得稅（CIT）是政府籌集財政收入的重要方式。然而，企業所得稅常被批評會抑制企業投資、降低經濟成長、對股東造成不公平的雙重課稅，並可能鼓勵或抑制某些對社會不一定有益的企業活動。先前的研究已經探討企業稅率對企業資本結構的影響 [Heider and Ljungqvist, 2015]、就業與企業重新配置 [Giroud and Rauh, 2019] 以及企業稅負在勞工、土地所有者與企業之間的分配 [Serrato et al., 2016]。然而，關於企業所得稅如何影響地方政府利害關係人，即家庭的證據仍然有限。家庭受到的影響十分重要，因為在發達經濟體中，家庭支出佔國內生產總值的大部分，並反映企業稅負對州內福利的影響。因此，企業所得稅變動的政策意涵，很可能取決於對家庭財富與家庭消費這些尚未充分探討的影響。

14508925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14508925.value: 具有多類顧客的閉排隊網絡的漸進最優控制

14508925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14508925.value: We plan to analyze a multiclass closed queueing network with two stations: the first station has sufficient servers serving one customer class, and the second station has one server serving multiple customer classes. Service times follow exponential distributions, and transfers are Markovian. Our aim is to maximize profit by determining the number of customers in the system and the scheduling rule at the second station. Profit is calculated as the revenue from serving customers minus staffing and congestion costs. The congestion costs are incurred by each customer class at the second station at a convex function rate. The described queueing network can model real-world service systems, such as a busy restaurant or emergency department. We will analyze the system within the heavy-traffic framework. The primary challenge of this project arises from the dependency of the workload at the second station on the scheduling rule. We intend to explore the lower-bound methodology to address this challenge. Using Ito’s formula, we will analyze the workload under different rules. The analysis is not straightforward because the drift of the workload is interconnected with the congestion costs. We will explore the related Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation to develop a policy and prove its asymptotic optimality. 我們計劃分析一個具有兩個站點、帶有多類顧客的閉排隊網絡：第一個站點有足夠的服務員為單類別顧客提供服務，第二個站點有單個服務員為多個顧客類別提供服務。服務時間遵循指數分佈，轉移是馬爾可夫的。我們的目標是通過確定系統中的顧客數量和第二個站點的調度來最大化利潤。利潤為服務顧客的收入減去人員配置和擁堵費用。擁堵費用由第二個站點中的每個顧客類別以凸函數的速率產生的。該排隊網絡可以用來建模繁忙的餐廳或急診室等服務系統。我們將在重話務框架內分析該系統。本項目的主要挑戰來自於第二個站點的工作負載依賴於調度規則。我們打算利用下界方法來應對這一挑戰。通過使用伊藤公式，我們將分析在不同規則下的工作負載。由於工作負載的漂移與擁堵成本相互關聯，因此分析並不簡單。我們將探討相關的HJB方程，以制定調度規則並證明其漸進最優性。

14509425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14509425.value: 多元化業務公司與人工智慧收購

14509425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14509425.value: The study of multi-business firms is a core topic in corporate strategy research and practice. Despite decades of research, the question of how to harness benefits from a diversified portfolio of business units is still not fully understood. The findings are decidedly mixed for the pros and cons of multi-business firms. Likewise, corporate acquisition is often found to negatively affect firm value. However, strategy research has posited that the core element for success for multi-business firms is complementary resources/capabilities across business units, and also it is mainly complementary resources/capabilities between the acquiring firm and the acquired firm that account for successful creation of synergies. The value to the acquiring firm can be realized if the resources/capabilities in the acquired firm are fully integrated into the acquiring firm, potentially generating new capabilities that positively augment the acquiring firm’s competitive advantage. It is against this background that this proposed research intends to focus on acquisition of AI resources/capabilities by multi-business firms. Recent years have witnessed the immense potential and promise of AI even in everyday business applications, and its introduction has been widely regarded as a disruptive innovation, or even potentially revolutionary for business. In light of the applicability of AI technologies across a wide range of businesses, the question of whether and how AI represents a significant source of cross-unit synergies becomes particularly relevant and important for the study of multi-business firms in corporate strategy research.
