The rise of AI presents an attractive opportunity for multi-business firms to harness potential synergies from across business units more effectively and efficiently. Hence, this proposed research focuses on multi-business firms in the era of AI, a core corporate strategy topic re-examined in the context of a new phenomenon. We are interested in understanding whether acquisition of AI technologies by a multi-business firms is positively related to market valuation. More specifically, we posit that the matching of the business scope of the multi-business firm and the types of AI resources/capabilities acquired (value-creation AI and value-capture AI) the business scope of the multi-business firm (horizontal scope and vertical scope) is crucial for achieving positive outcomes. What is more, managing a multi-business firm usually involves a high level of complexity in strategic execution and implementation as well as organizational structure. We plan to further examine whether level of firm complexity will renders the acquisition of AI even more appealing and fruitful for multi-business firms. 多元化業務公司研究是企業策略研究與實務的核心課題。儘管已有數十年的研究，但如何從多元化的業務單位組合中獲益這一問題仍未得到充分理解。關於多元化業務公司利弊的研究結果也參差不齊。同樣，企業收購也常被發現會對公司價值產生負面影響。然而，策略研究認為，多元化業務公司成功的核心要素是跨業務單位的資源/能力互補，而收購方與被收購者之間資源/能力的互補性也是成功創造協同效應的關鍵。如果被收購方的資源/能力能夠完全融入收購方，並可能產生新的能力，從而積極增強收購方的競爭優勢，那麼收購方的價值就能得以實現。正是在此背景下，本研究旨在關注多元化業務公司對人工智慧資源/能力的收購。近年來，人工智慧在日常商業應用中展現出巨大的潛力和前景，其引入被廣泛視為一項顛覆性創新，甚至可能對企業產生革命性的影響。鑑於人工智慧技術在各行各業的廣泛應用，人工智慧是否以及如何成為跨部門協同效應的重要來源，對於企業策略研究中的多業務公司而言，變得尤為重要。人工智慧的興起為多業務公司提供了一個極具吸引力的機會，使其能夠更有效地利用跨業務部門的潛在協同效應。因此，本研究聚焦於人工智慧時代的多業務公司，這是一個在新現象背景下重新審視的核心企業策略主題。我們旨在探討多業務公司對人工智慧技術的收購是否與市場估值呈正相關。更具體地說，我們認為，多元化企業的業務範圍與所獲取的人工智慧資源/能力類型（價值創造型人工智慧和價值獲取型人工智慧）以及多元化企業的業務範圍（橫向範圍和縱向範圍）的匹配對於取得積極成果至關重要。此外，管理多元化企業通常涉及策略執行和實施以及組織結構的高度複雜性。我們計劃進一步研究企業的複雜程度是否會使獲取人工智慧對多元化企業更具吸引力和效益。

14509525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14509525.value: 全球價值鏈重構時代的動態知識管理與網絡權力提升

14509525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14509525.value: Prof Narula, Rajneesh Dr WU, Xiaosong

14509525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14509525.value: This project studies dynamic knowledge management of local suppliers and their network power enhancement during global value chain (GVC) reconstruction era. The emergence of GVCs has changed not only the reorganization of production process, but also the production and use of knowledge. As a new pattern of international division of labor, GVC linkage typically revolves around sliced task partitioning, which further triggers knowledge partitioning. Since lead firms (e.g., Apple) regularly renew their list of GVC suppliers (e.g., Chinese suppliers), GVC participation is an ongoing reconstruction process. However, existing studies have largely ignored the inherent dynamics of GVCs. We attempt to close this remarkable gap to address three theoretically important and practically relevant questions as below. First, how do local suppliers manage the GVC linkage by dynamically adjusting internal knowledge accumulation? We propose that while local suppliers respond to GVC connectivity by increasing component knowledge and decreasing architectural knowledge, they dynamically adjust such choice as product life cycle/domestic market position changes. Second, how do different types of knowledge affect network power of local suppliers? We propose that while component knowledge has an inverted U-shaped impact on network power, architectural knowledge has a positive impact on it, and such power-enhancing effects are contingent on GVC linkage duration and breadth. Third, what are the pathways to enhancing network power of local suppliers? Given that power enhancement requires joint action of multiple factors, rather than a single factor (e.g., knowledge), we therefore explore which combinations of GVC linkage, knowledge accumulation, and product life cycles can boost network power. As GVC participation by nature is an ongoing reconstruction process, China’s access to WTO in 2001 offers an ideal empirical setting. We employ a mixed method by combining qualitative comparative analysis, field interviews, and robust empirical studies with a longitudinal dataset on Chinese manufacturing firms in smartphone industry (2001-2015). This project is expected to make three significant contributions. First, it is among the first to explicitly analyze the dynamic aspects of local suppliers’ knowledge management, advancing the understanding of the nature of their GVC engagement. Second, it offers novel insights into how local suppliers can increase network power by introducing a configurational perspective to explore the complex interactions between multiple driving factors. Third, with the rising tide of de-globalization, exploring how local suppliers enhance relative power in GVC connections through knowledge adaptation could provide more practice-relevant policy implications during the GVC reconstruction era. 本項目研究全球價值鏈（GVC）重構時代本地供應商的動態知識管理及其網絡權力的提升。 全球價值鏈的出現不僅改變了生產過程的重組方式，也改變了知識的生產與使用方式。作為一種新的國際分工模式，全球價值鏈的聯繫通常圍繞著「切片式任務分工」展開，這進一步引發了知識分工。由於主導企業（例如蘋果公司）會定期更新其全球價值鏈供應商名單（例如中國供應商），全球價值鏈的參與本質上是一個持續的重構過程。然而，現有研究在很大程度上忽略了全球價值鏈的內在動態性。我們試圖填補這一顯著的研究空白，並著重探討以下三個理論上重要且實踐中相關的問題： 第一，本地供應商如何通過動態調整內部知識積累來管理全球價值鏈的聯繫？我們提出，當本地供應商響應全球價值鏈的聯繫時，會增加部件知識的積累並減少架構知識的積累。然而，隨著產品生命週期或國內市場地位的變化，它們會動態地調整這種選擇。 第二，不同類型的知識如何影響本地供應商的網絡權力？我們提出，部件知識對網絡權力的影響呈倒U型，而架構知識對網絡權力有正向影響。同時，這種權力提升的效果取決於全球價值鏈聯繫的持續時間和廣度。 第三，本地供應商提升網絡權力的路徑是什麼？鑒於權力的提升需要多個因素的共同作用，而非單一因素（如知識）的驅動，我們進一步探討全球價值鏈聯繫、知識積累與產品生命週期的組合如何推動網絡權力的提升。 由於全球價值鏈參與本質上是一個持續的重構過程，中國在2001年加入世貿組織（WTO）為本研究提供了一個理想的實證背景。我們採用混合研究方法，結合定性比較分析、實地訪談，以及基於中國智能手機產業製造企業（2001-2015年）縱向數據的穩健實證分析。 本項目預計將做出三方面的重要貢獻： 本研究是首批明確分析本地供應商知識管理動態性的研究之一，推動了對其全球價值鏈參與本質的理解。 本研究通過引入配置視角，探索多種驅動因素之間的複雜互動，為本地供應商如何提升網絡權力提供了新的見解。 在去全球化趨勢加劇的背景下，本研究通過探索本地供應商如何通過知識適應提升其在全球價值鏈聯繫中的相對權力，能夠為全球價值鏈重構時代提供更多實踐相關的政策啟示。

14509625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14509625.value: 應對跨境碳稅的生產計劃和財務對沖

14509625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14509625.value: This research project proposes a production planning and financial risk hedging model that is motivated by a regulation from European Commission called carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM). The new trade policy will levy a carbon tax on imports of certain emission intensive products into the EU. Different from the conventional cross-border tariff which is typically a fixed rate on the value of an imported product, the carbon tax under CBAM is levied on the direct carbon emissions from the production process of an imported product and the carbon tax rate is dynamically determined by the price of carbon credits in the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS). It is widely believed by industry practitioners that the implementation EU carbon tax CBAM scheme will have significant disruptive impact on CBAM-covered emission-intensive businesses. In this research project, we propose a general modeling framework with production planning and financial hedging to help a firm to manage cost (e.g., uncertain carbon tax cost) and demand uncertainty risks, both of which are linked to certain external tradable financial assets. Our proposed study will contribute to the global green supply chain literature significantly. One of the novel features in our proposed research project is to study the impacts of the newly established EU carbon tax structure, which is linked to EU ETS, on a global firm’s production planning decisions. To our knowledge, this proposed project is among the first to consider CBAM in the global green supply chain setting. We expect that the proposed study will offer new managerial insights into the impacts of carbon tax and financial hedging on supply chain sustainability decisions. Our proposed research also has the potential to help businesses to review their sustainability practices and make action plans in the new global environment with expected increase of carbon costs. 本研究計畫提出了一個應對歐盟一項名為「碳邊境調整機制」（CBAM）的法規的生產計劃和財務風險對沖模型。與傳統的跨境關稅（通常是對進口產品價值的固定稅率）不同，CBAM下的碳稅對進口產品生產過程中的直接碳排放量徵收，而碳稅率由歐盟排放交易體系（EU ETS）中的碳信用價格動態決定。在本研究項目中，我們提出了一個包含生產計劃和金融對沖的建模框架，以幫助企業不確定的碳稅成本和需求不確定性風險。我們提出的研究計畫的創新之處之一是研究與歐盟排放交易體系 掛鉤的歐盟碳稅結構對全球企業生產計畫決策的影響。我們預期本研究能為碳稅和金融避險對供應鏈永續性決策的影響提供新的管理見解。

14509725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14509725.value: 做市商參與和流動性供給

14509725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14509725.value: This project studies liquidity (the ease of buying and selling financial securities at prices close to fundamental values) and its drivers and implications in the E-mini equity index futures market, the world’s largest derivative market. We show that depth (the total supply of quotes available to trade) in this market is highly time-varying and has seen an 80% reduction in recent years. Decomposing depth into the number of dealers offering quotes and the quote sizes they supply, we trace the reduction back to a decline in the number of active dealers willing to trade and provide immediacy at all times. To rationalise this phenomenon, we propose a model of liquidity provision where dealers are subject to balance sheet constraints. In line with model predictions, we show empirically that fewer active dealers implies higher absolute returns, larger price reversals, and higher volatility. Additionally, we show that dealer numbers provide information about market conditions not contained in commonly used liquidity measures such as price impact and the bid-ask spread. Since this is among the most active and liquid markets worldwide, if shortage of dealer capital leads to mispricings in the E-mini market, it signals shortage of capital, increased price deviations and volatility in other asset markets, too, leading to contagion and higher systemic risk. 本研究探討流動性（即以接近基本價值之價格買賣⾦融證券的難易程度）及其在 E-mini 股指期貨市場（全球最⼤的衍⽣品市場）中的驅動因素與影響。我們發現，該市場的深度（即可供交易的總報價量）具有顯著的時間變動性，並在近年來下降了約 80%。透過將深度分解為提供報價的做市商數量及其提供的報價規模，我們將此下降歸因於願意 隨時進⾏交易並提供即時性之活躍做市商數量的減少。為解釋此現象，我們提出了⼀個流 動性供給模型，其中做市商⾯臨資產負債表約束。 與模型預測⼀致，我們通過實證研究表明，活躍做市商數量減少意味著更⾼的絕對報酬、更⼤的價格反轉以及更⾼的波動性。此外，我們亦表明，做市商數量所涵蓋的市場狀況資訊，是常⽤流動性指標（如價格衝擊和買賣價差）所未能包含的。 鑒於 E-mini 市場屬全球最活躍、流動性最強的市場之⼀，若做市商資本短缺導致該市場 出現錯誤定價，則預示著其他資產市場同樣⾯臨資本短缺、價格偏差加劇以及波動性上升 的⾵險，進⽽引發⾵險傳染與更⾼的系統性⾵險。

14600125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600125.value: 在資料密集型技術時代重新審視香港的資料私隱框架

14600125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600125.value: Digital technologies have become a cornerstone of participation in many aspects of life. These technologies often involve the collection and processing of large amounts of personal information. New data-intensive technologies, such as artificial intelligence, facial recognition and extended reality, use personal information in powerful new ways that can generate significant benefits for all members of society. However, misuse of this personal information by these technologies has the potential to infringe on people’s privacy interest in more serious ways than was previously envisaged, including by creating risks for personal autonomy, fairness and transparency. Yet, Hong Kong’s data protection regime has not kept pace with the rapid development of these data-intensive technologies and is not adapted to provide sufficient safeguards for digital privacy. This project will be the first to systematically examine where Hong Kong’s data privacy regime has fallen behind international best practice and what reforms are needed to make its laws fit for the age of data-driven technologies. This includes engagement with stakeholders to seek their views on the strengths and weakness of Hong Kong’s current data protection laws. The project will then identify where Hong Kong’s data protection laws have become outdated when compared to the laws in mainland China, the European Union and selected common law countries. On that basis, the project will then develop detailed law reform proposals that will inform the policy debate on necessary updates of Hong Kong’s ageing data protection regime. The research will be of significant relevance to policymakers, regulators, legislators and the academic community in the field of data protection and privacy. Modernisation of its data privacy regime will provide greater legal certainty, place Hong Kong in a more competitive position in supporting the growth of its data-intensive industries and services, and enhance the privacy outcomes of the Hong Kong public. 數位技術已成為人們參與社會諸多層面的基礎。這些技術往往涉及大量個人資訊的收集與處理。新一代資料密集型技術，例如人工智慧、面部辨識與延展實境，以更具能量的方式運用個人資訊，為社會各界帶來潛在裨益。然而，這些技術對個人資訊的不當使用，可能以過去難以預見的方式，更嚴重地侵害個人的私隱利益，包括對個人自主、公平性與透明度構成風險。儘管如此，香港的資料保障制度並未隨資料密集型技術的迅速發展而同步調整，亦未能充分回應數位私隱所需的保障。 本研究將首次系統性檢視香港資料私隱制度在何處落後於國際最佳實踐，並探討其法律如何改革，以回應資料驅動技術時代的需求。研究內容包括與相關利益方交流，了解他們對香港現行資料保障法律之優劣勢的觀點；進一步比較香港資料保障法律與中國內地、歐盟及若干普通法法域的異同，辨識其已顯陳舊之處；在此基礎上，提出具體的法律改革建議，以促進有關更新香港資料保障制度的政策討論。 此項研究對資料保障與私隱領域的政策制定者、監管機關、立法者及學術界皆具重要意義。資料私隱制度的現代化將有助於提升法律的確定性，增強香港在支持資料密集型產業與服務發展方面的競爭力，並改善香港公眾的私隱保障結果。

14600225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600225.value: 近代澳門與華南地區的法律多元主義

14600225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600225.value: The Pearl River Delta region has long attracted merchants from the rest of Asia and beyond. This is documented from almost the very beginning of Chinese dynastic history, but took on particular significance in the late-Ming and early-Qing periods when Portuguese and other European merchants (as well as missionaries and various hangers-on) were permitted to set up shop in Macau. This resulted in several centuries of cross-cultural interactions that inevitably touched on questions of law. While there are scattered articles on the constitutional status of early modern Macau and its sources of law, we know almost nothing about the overlaps and interactions between the different legal systems that existed in Macau itself and bridged the Ming and Qing states’ equivalent of the Macau-Mainland boundary. In addition, the scholarship that exists is divided between Chinese and Portuguese traditions that rarely interact. Finally, any endeavour to understand the legal landscape of Macau and its environs is complicated by the fact that globally pre-modern law was more capacious than its modern equivalents embracing universalizing cosmovisions, law-adjacent systems of rules, religious ideas and local customs. This project will offer the first detailed study of cross-boundary law (i.e. the interactions of different legal systems without necessarily crossing sovereign borders) in sixteenth- to eighteenth-century Macau that takes these various complicating factors into account, and argues that the framework of legal pluralism can help us comprehend the complex historical reality. To achieve its aim, the project will treat the most important legal domains in early modern Macau. This includes the interactions between the Portuguese and Chinese systems of contracts and dispute resolution. One hitherto unstudied aspect of this project centres on cross-boundary crime, including human trafficking and the smuggling of valuable commodities, e.g. crocodile skins. As the surviving official correspondence shows, both Chinese and the Portuguese authorities took such infractions seriously, although their success in suppressing cross-boundary crime was ultimately limited. These efforts at enforcement are documented in printed, archival and manuscript sources in Chinese, Portuguese and Latin. The project will result in three articles to be submitted to major Anglophone historical journals, one article to a leading Sinophone historical journal as well as four conference presentations. 珠江三角洲長期以來吸引著來自亞洲及其他地區的商人，在明末清初，歐洲商人和傳教士定居澳門，由此產生了重要的跨文化交流。這些交流引發了複雜的法律問題，然而，關於澳門法律史的研究仍支離破碎，研究成果有限，尤其關注中葡法律體系在澳門與內地邊界之間的相互作用。現有研究主要著重於中葡傳統，鮮有交叉。此外，前現代法律涵蓋了更廣泛的體系，包括宗教規則和習慣法，這使得分析更加複雜。本計畫首次對16至18世紀澳門的跨國法律進行了詳細的研究，運用法律多元論來理解該地區複雜的法律格局。它將考察葡萄牙和中國法律體系之間的合約法和爭議解決等關鍵領域，並探討跨境犯罪（包括人口販運和走私）等研究不足的領域。來自中文、葡萄牙語和拉丁語系的證據表明，儘管成效有限，但雙方當局都認真對待執法工作。該計畫將為主要的英語期刊撰寫三篇文章，為華語期刊撰寫一篇文章，並發表四篇會議論文。

14601025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601025.value: This project explores the relationship between China’s legal system, financial markets, and economic development. A strong capital market is essential for economic growth because it allows businesses to obtain equity finance at low costs, which promotes entrepreneurial activities and capital formation. However, the development of capital markets is influenced by a country’s legal system, which can be path-dependent and difficult to change over time. This project examine whether China’s law and finance are determined by its historical path. It intends to show that while China has made significant reforms to become more like Western countries, there are still fundamental differences between China and common law countries that dictate the different paths they take. For example, China did not have any law in the early 1990s but has since promulgated its first securities law. Meanwhile, China also developed its capital market initially for the privatization of state-owned enterprises (SOEs). This project will illustrate that understanding the nature of China’s legal system is crucial for understanding its economic development. China offers a valuable opportunity for examining the relationship between law and finance because its law and capital market have changed drastically over time in the past few decades. One theory that the project will discuss is the legal origin theory developed by four economists collectively known as LLSV. The basic proposition of this theory is that a state’s legal origin affects its current laws. There are criticisms of this theory. For example, some scholars argue that other factors such as political stability or cultural norms may be more important than legal origin in determining economic outcomes. Overall, this project will provide an insightful analysis of how China’s legal system impact its financial market. It highlights how path-dependence can make it difficult to change a country’s legal system and how this affects the development of capital markets. The project will also provide a critical evaluation of the legal origin theory and its implications for China’s unique path. 本项目探讨中国法律制度、金融市场与经济发展之间的内在关联。健全的资本市场通过降低企业股权融资成本、促进创业活动与资本形成，对经济增长具有基础性支撑作用。然而资本市场的发展轨迹深受一国法律制度的影响，这种制度演进具有显著的路径依赖性特征。 本研究旨在论证中国金融法治发展是否受到历史路径的约束，并揭示尽管中国通过重大法律改革逐步趋近西方模式，但其与普通法系国家仍存在根本性制度差异，这种差异决定了二者不同的发展路径。典型例证包括：上世纪90年代初期中国证券法律体系尚属空白，而后方逐步建立证券基本法律制度；同时，中国资本市场的初始功能定位是为国有企业股份制改革服务。 本研究将论证，理解中国法律制度的本质特征对把握其经济发展模式具有关键意义。中国为观察法律与金融的互动关系提供了独特样本——过去数十年间，其法律制度与资本市场经历了深刻的制度变迁。研究将重点讨论由LLSV学者提出的"法律起源理论"，该理论的核心命题是：一国法律渊源对其现行法律制度具有决定性影响。但该理论亦存在争议，有学者指出政治稳定性、文化传统等因素可能比法律渊源对经济绩效产生更实质性的影响。 本研究的理论贡献在于：第一，系统阐释路径依赖性如何形成法律制度变迁的约束条件，进而影响资本市场发展；第二，对法律起源理论进行批判性检视，揭示其在中国特殊制度语境下的解释力与局限性；第三，通过中国经验为法律与金融领域的比较研究提供新的实证依据。研究将最终论证，中国金融法治的发展轨迹既受到传统法律制度的塑造，又在改革进程中呈现出独特的制度创新。

14601125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601125.value: 中國如何改善司法不公

14601125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601125.value: China's capital punishment system is characterized by a striking "leniency-innocence paradox." Recent reforms have dramatically reduced executions, yet paradoxically failed to address wrongful convictions with equal vigor. This study investigates why the judicial apparatus's newfound willingness to exercise leniency hasn't translated into greater receptivity towards innocence claims, examining the broader institutional, social, and political factors that sustain and shape this disconnect. The research addresses three interconnected questions, encompassing descriptive, conceptual, and theoretical dimensions: 1) Institutional dynamics and resistance: How do criminal justice institutions actively resist or passively fail to correct errors in capital cases? 2) Leniency-innocence paradox: What systematic priorities, competing goals, and institutional constraints are reflected in the coexistence of growing leniency with reluctance to righting wrongs? 3) Theoretical implications: What insights does the leniency-innocence paradox reveal about the intricate dance between justice, political legitimacy, and social stability in China's evolving governance model? This study employs a mixed-method approach, combining doctrinal analysis with empirical research. The empirical component comprises: a) semi-structured interviews with criminal justice personnel, lawyers, exonerees, and their families, aimed at uncovering the lived experiences and decision-making processes; b) statistical analysis based on the creation of a comprehensive database chronicling both exonerated capital defendants and those in the process of exoneration, utilizing meticulous archival information retrieval; and c) content analysis of media reports, court documents, and official statements to track the evolution of public discourses and judicial policy. This multi-faceted approach will uncover critical patterns of individual and organizational behaviors within broader sociopolitical contexts. The novelty of this project lies in its shift of focus from the causes of wrongful convictions to how they are corrected. Moreover, this research moves beyond the diagnosis of individual and procedural causes as explanations for the occurrence of errors. It extends its analysis beyond the specificities of criminal procedures to identify the nexus between the reluctance to rectify errors and China's judicial politics. The study offers a prism through which to view the collision of reforms and backlashes, leniency and punitiveness, the pursuit of justice and the persistence of entrenched institutional practices. Using China as a case study, this project offers insights into how authoritarian systems maintain stability and legitimacy through managing contradictory judicial policies and practices. 中國的死刑制度呈現出顯著的"寬宥-冤錯悖論"特徵。儘管近年來的司法改革大幅減少了死刑執行，卻未能以同等力度糾正冤假錯案。本研究旨在探究：爲何司法系統在展現量刑寬宥意願的同時，對無罪申訴仍保持審慎態度？通過考察維繫這種割裂態勢的制度、社會與政治因素，本研究將圍繞三個相互關聯的問題展開多維度分析：（1）制度動力與阻力機制——刑事司法機關如何通過主動抵制或消極不作爲阻礙死刑錯案糾正；（2）寬宥-冤錯悖論——在日趨寬鬆的量刑政策與糾錯惰性並存的表象下，折射出何種系統性的制度優先項、目標衝突與結構約束；（3）理論啓示——該悖論如何揭示中國治理模式轉型中司法正義、政治合法性與社會穩定之間的複雜博弈？

14601325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601325.value: DIRECT 與漢達文庫的結合：就上古擬音重探中國古代文獻數據庫

14601325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601325.value: Mr Budak, Nick Prof Kern, Martin Prof Kwok, Bit Chee Prof Rominger, Gian Duri

14601325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601325.value: The D. C. Lau Research Centre for Chinese Ancient Texts at The Chinese University of Hong Kong established the CHANT Database in 1988, aiming to digitise all transmitted texts from the Pre-Han, Han, and Six Dynasties. All inputted texts were based on the best available editions with minimal tampering, facilitating rigorous research. The research team embarked on the project entitled “A Complete Study of the Parallel Passages Found in Pre-Han and Han Traditional Texts,” leveraging computer technology to analyse all parallel passages in these ancient texts. Parallel passages found in five ancient texts have been published under the category “Parallel Passages Found in Pre-Han and Han Texts” within The CHANT Series, offering essential insights into the transmission of these texts and their mutual influences. Investigating parallel passages is crucial for the scholarship of Chinese ancient texts, since it aids scholars in rectifying errors, verifying composition dates, establishing authenticity, addressing influence and plagiarism, conducting textual criticism, and exploring taboo subjects. However, this study necessitates the processing of substantial data. To advance this research, it is vital to leverage the advantages of digitisation while honoring traditional philology’s core principles, particularly the importance of clarifying the distinction between textual versions. The integration of these principles with information technology can facilitate significant advancements in parallel passages research. This project aspires to incorporate phonology in parallel passages identification, moving beyond previous frameworks and pursuing new developments in this area of research. Collaborating with Martin Kern from Princeton University, Gian Duri Rominger from University of Washington, and Nick Budak from Stanford University, the project will use DIRECT, a grapheme-to-phoneme transduction algorithm, to facilitate searches for parallel passages through phonological reconstructions. Specifically, the project will apply the grapheme-to-phoneme transduction algorithm of DIRECT on pertinent parts of the CHANT Database to discover intertextual references. Using homophonic character relationships to pinpoint parallel passages will improve the identification of variant characters that may differ in writing but sound alike. With advancements in Old Chinese phonology, our understanding of ancient phonological systems improves, supporting the development of a search system focused on ancient sounds. This will facilitate the identification of homophonic characters via tone group detection commands, presenting a groundbreaking approach to ancient texts studies. 香港中文大學中國文化研究所劉殿爵古籍研究中心於1988年建成「漢達文庫」，先後將先秦兩漢以及魏晉南北朝全部傳世文獻電腦化，所錄文獻皆依據舊刻善本，研究者可據此從事更深層的研究工作。本研究團隊曾進行「先秦兩漢一切傳世古籍互見文獻研究計劃」，全面蒐集先秦兩漢所有典籍的互見文獻，借助電腦科技，全面歸納、分析先秦兩漢傳世文獻相互傳承的情況；又據此編纂《先秦兩漢典籍重見資料系列》，至今已出版五種文獻的相關互文，俾便學者掌握此等文獻相互因襲的情況，探究古代文獻的傳承關係。 互見文獻對古籍研究裨益甚大，可以校勘古書的訛誤殘衍，補足文獻的各種缺失，例如考證成書年代、辨偽、因襲與剽竊、校勘、考察避諱等。研究互見文獻需要處理大量數據，如要更進一步研究，在利用電子化的優勢之餘，亦必需重視傳統文獻學的核心價值，即以講究版本作為根本，復結合資訊科技電子化之優勢，才能為互見文獻研究帶來突破。 本計劃擬另辟蹊徑，運用科技將古籍文獻擬音化，以尋求突破過去框架，望能在互見文獻及相關研究範疇出現新發展，為互見文獻研究帶來新方向。本計劃將與普林斯頓大學Martin Kern、華盛頓大學Gian Duri Rominger及史丹佛大學Nick Budak合作，將使用DIRECT字形音素轉換算法，通過音韻重建文獻資料，以搜尋互見文獻。具體而言，本計劃擬結合漢達文庫收錄的先秦兩漢文獻資料，以及DIRECT系統的擬音化功能，透過識別同音異體字擴大互見文獻的搜尋範圍，有助發現文本間的參照關係。隨着漢語音韻學研究的發展，無論是對上古漢語語音系統的了解，以及對漢字的上古音構擬都越趨成熟，為研發以上古音為基礎的比對系統提供有利條件。

14601525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601525.value: 人們在交流中會將擬人化的大型語言模型視為人類嗎？

14601525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601525.value: Prof Cowan, Benjamin Prof Martin, Clara

14601525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601525.value: Large language models (LLMs) have evolved to engage in humanlike conversations, and As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into our daily lives, these LLMs are being customized to embody specific personas (e.g., teacher in tutoring, doctor in healthcare). However, the question arises: do we, as humans, alter our language comprehension and production when interacting with personalized LLMs, just as we do when communicating with another person? Imagine conversing with an AI that sounds like a child or an adult, a male or a female. Would you be more surprised to read or hear a male AI say, "The first time I got pregnant I had a hard time," compared to a female AI? This research seeks to address such fascinating questions by conducting four studies in Cantonese, comparing human-LLM communication with human-human communication. The first two studies will investigate how people interpret sentences differently based on the persona of the LLM or human they're communicating with. By measuring brain responses that reflect degree of surprise (e.g., of males being pregnant), we test the hypothesis that people will use the persona of an LLM to interpret sentences when communicating with an LLM, just as they would when communicating with a human. These effects are expected to be more pronounced when the LLM speaks rather than writes, as a speaking LLM appears more humanlike. The last two studies will delve into how people tailor their utterances when speaking to personalized LLMs. For instance, if an LLM or human has previously used the word "sofa", would people be more inclined to say "sofa" instead of "couch" to ensure they are understood? Prior research has demonstrated that people tend to reuse words more frequently when speaking to children (compared to adults) or non-native speakers (compared to native speakers) in human-human conversations. We anticipate similar persona effects when people interact with LLMs in speaking, although these effects may be less pronounced when people interact with LLMs in writing. By examining how individuals communicate with AI chatbots versus real people, this research aims to illuminate the intricacies of human-AI communication. The findings can contribute to the development of AI chatbots that adapt to users' individual needs and preferences. Through a better understanding of these interactions, we may be able to create AI systems that communicate more effectively, behave in ways that align with human expectations, and engage in more natural and meaningful conversations with users. 大型語言模型（LLM）已能進行類人對話，隨著人工智慧（AI）日益融入日常生活，這些模型正被客製化以體現特定角色（如教學情境的教師、醫療場景的醫生）。但一個關鍵問題隨之浮現：當人類與擬人化LLM互動時，是否會像面對真人般調整語言理解與產出方式？ 設想您正與聲音像兒童或成人、男性或女性的AI對話。若聽到男性AI說「我第一次懷孕時很辛苦」，是否比女性AI說出同樣話語更令人驚訝？本研究將通過四項粵語實驗，比較人機與人人溝通差異來探討此現象。 首兩項研究檢視人們如何依據對話對象（LLM或人類）的角色特徵來理解語句。透過測量腦部對意外訊息（如男性懷孕）的反應強度，驗證以下假設：人們會如同理解人類話語般，運用LLM的角色設定來解讀其語句，且此效應在語音交互時比文字對話更顯著——因語音LLM更具擬真性。 後兩項研究深入探討人們如何為個性化LLM調整表達方式。例如當LLM或人類先前使用「交通燈」一詞時，對話者是否會更傾向沿用「交通燈」而非「紅綠燈」以確保理解？既有研究表明，人類與兒童（相較成人）、非母語者（相較母語者）對話時會更頻繁重複用詞。我們預測人機互動中將出現類似角色效應，但文字溝通中的效應強度可能弱於語音互動。 本研究透過比較人機與人人溝通模式，旨在揭示人機交互的複雜性。研究成果可助力開發更貼合用戶需求與偏好的AI對話系統。深入理解這些互動機制，將有助構建溝通更有效、行為更符合人類預期，並能與用戶進行自然深度對話的AI系統。

14601625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601625.value: 《萌芽、繁盛、綻放與流轉：中國植物知識翻譯的演化與流傳》

14601625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601625.value: As research of environmental history and history of science has passed through a cultural and linguistic turn, it is about time for translation studies to embrace an environmental turn. Co-existence between human beings and the environment has drawn researchers toward the research of environmental history, and new paradigms have also arisen in translation studies, including employing ecology as a theme (e.g., focusing on the naming of species) and as a metaphor (e.g., metaphorical analogies between the translational ecosystem and the natural ecosystem (Hu, 2020, xvii)). However, eco-translations, exploring the relationship between translators and the environment, are not just restricted to contemporary environmental discussions. Translations of Chinese botanical knowledge also burgeoned, flourished, bloomed, and then traveled after the Jesuits first came to China in the 16th century. Their construction of new images of Chinese flora via translations later blossomed into a greater craving for new understanding of the plants, environment, and civilization of China. This research will treat the translations of Chinese botanical knowledge as organisms that developed over three stages—burgeoning, flourishing, blossoming—in late imperial China. First, “burgeoning” from seeds. Through his focus on ancient theology, Athanasius Kircher borrowed from Michał Boym’s Flora Sinensis and Martino Martini’s Novus Atlas Sinensis beautiful images and knowledge of Chinese flora. These “seeds” motivated the Figurists translating the plants in the Book of Poetry, such as the lotus, bamboo, chrysanthemum, and plum blossoms, which resonated with ancient Chinese values and Christian themes. Second of the phases is “flourishing” with the support of secular powers. Some Jesuits, including Boym and Cibot, collected and translated information on Chinese medicinal plants, supplementing them with transcriptions and annotations. Indigenous and vernacular knowledge of Chinese plants, subjected to the secular powers, enhanced the West’s understanding of Chinese herbal medicine. Third, chinoiserie in “bloom.” Past scholarship has explored these works from an art history perspective. My research will adopt a micro-historical lens to re-examine how these Jesuits’ translations helped disseminate these plants to European gardens, and how Canton became a translation zone and a cultural hub for Chinese flora translations. I aim in this research to investigate their significant efforts in enriching the Western understanding of Chinese flora and in reflecting these new cultural “grafts” in an age in which Europe was fascinated with Chinese culture and aesthetics. 隨著環境史與科學史研究經歷了文化與語言學的轉向，翻譯研究也正是時候擁抱一場「環境轉向」。人類與環境之間的共存關係吸引了研究者投身環境史的探索，而翻譯研究中也出現了新的範式，包括將「生態」作為主題（例如關注物種命名問題）以及作為隱喻（例如在翻譯生態系統與自然生態系統之間建立類比式的隱喻關係（胡庚申，2020，第17頁）。然而，「生態翻譯」對譯者與環境之間關係的探討，並不限於當代的環境議題。自十六世紀耶穌會士來華以來，有關中國植物知識的翻譯開始萌芽、繁盛、綻放，並隨後向外傳播。他們通過翻譯構建了中國植物的新形象，這種形象後來轉化為對中國植物、環境和文明新理解的強烈渴望。 本研究將把中國植物知識的翻譯視為有機體，在晚期帝制中國歷經三個階段的發展——萌芽、繁盛、綻放。首先是「萌芽」，如種子破土而出。阿塔納斯·珂雪（Athanasius Kircher）透過其對古代神學的關注，援引了卜彌格（Michał Boym）的《中國植物志》（Flora Sinensis）與衛匡國（Martino Martini）的《新中國地圖集》（Novus Atlas Sinensis）中的精美植物圖像與知識。這些「種子」啟發了耶穌會索隱派（Figurists）在翻譯《詩經》中的植物——如蓮、竹、菊、梅等——這些植物與古代中國價值觀和基督教主題產生共鳴。第二階段是「繁盛」，來自世俗權力的支持推動。一些耶穌會士，如卜彌格與錢德明（Pierre-Martial Cibot），收集並翻譯了有關中國藥用植物的資料，並補充了筆錄與註釋。中國本土與方言系統中的植物知識，經由這些譯介並在世俗權力的加持下，豐富了西方對中國草藥醫藥的理解。第三階段為「綻放」，體現在歐洲的中國風（chinoiserie）潮流之中。過往的研究多從藝術史的視角來探討這些翻譯成果，而本研究將採取微觀史的視角，重新審視這些耶穌會士的翻譯如何促使中國植物在歐洲庭園中流傳開來，以及廣州如何成為中國植物翻譯的轉譯地帶與文化樞紐。本研究旨在探討這些翻譯的演化與流傳如何在歐洲熱衷中國文化與美學的時代，豐富了西方對中國植物世界的認識，並形塑出一種新的文化「嫁接」。

14602625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14602625.value: 信仰作為交際性抗爭：菲律賓的政治犯及其他囚犯

14602625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602625.value: This research proposal is a strongly revised project that studies Christian faith in one specific penal context of Southeast Asia, the Philippines. In response to peer reviewers' feedback, the scope has been narrowed from multiple contexts to a single one and a more specific focus within the broader subject of religious faith in the penal context. The study seeks to explore the concept of faith as a form of resistance by examining the ongoing challenges faced by political prisoners in the Philippines, including their interactions with religious groups and civil society organizations beyond prison walls. The research then aims to extend this theory to encompass non-political inmates. From a theoretical standpoint, the study investigates how religious faith creates a space for resistance and counter-cultural practices within an environment of extreme external control. It also examines how faith-based practices challenge prevailing narratives that portray prisoners as hardened criminals at the bottom of society's moral hierarchy. Drawing inspiration from James Scott's theories on subtle, everyday forms of resistance employed by marginalized groups against dominant power structures, this study investigates the extent to which religious faith and practices can be understood as a form of "infrapolitics." This concept refers to the development of resistance strategies within the confines of imprisonment, encompassing a set of tactics and hidden narratives of resistance when overt, organized opposition is not possible. This research is part of a broader endeavor to gain insight into and comprehend the world as experienced by incarcerated individuals. Methodologically, it uses a multi-method design combining participant observation, semi-structured interviews, focus discussions, and document analysis. 這份研究計畫是一個經過重大修訂的專案，研究東南亞特定監獄環境下的基督教信仰，即菲律賓。根據同行評議的回饋，研究範圍已從多個環境縮小到單一環境，並在監獄環境中的宗教信仰這一廣泛主題下確定了更具體的研究重點。本研究旨在探討信仰作為一種抗爭形式的概念，通過考察菲律賓政治犯所面臨的持續挑戰，包括他們與監獄圍牆外的宗教團體和公民社會組織的互動。研究隨後致力於將這一理論擴展到非政治犯。從理論角度來看，本研究探討宗教信仰如何在極端外部控制的環境中創造出抗爭和反主流文化實踐的空間。同時也研究基於信仰的實踐如何挑戰將囚犯描繪為道德等級底層的頑固罪犯的主流敘事。 本研究借鑒詹姆斯·斯科特關於邊緣群體對主導權力結構採取微妙的、日常形式抗爭的理論，研究宗教信仰和實踐在多大程度上可以被理解為一種"底層政治"。這一概念指的是在監禁環境下發展出的抗爭策略，包括當無法進行公開、有組織的反抗時所採用的一系列策略和隱藏的抗爭敘事。本研究是深入瞭解和理解在押人員所經歷世界的更廣泛努力的一部分。在方法論上，採用多方法設計，結合參與式觀察、半結構化訪談、焦點討論和文獻分析。

14603025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603025.value: 本研究計畫考察青年魯迅如何吸收明治日本知識人轉化自德國「Kulturkritik」的「文明批評」資源，形塑其獨特的文明觀與文學實踐。以往研究多關注魯迅與尼采、高山樗牛、齋藤野之人等思想家的個別聯繫，未能從跨文化研究的角度將他們共同放置在「文明批評」全球流動的脈絡中。本研究計畫循跨文化路徑分析青年魯迅創制的媒介與文本，揭示他如何一面回應反思現代性的全球思想議題，一面探索中國文明的走向。 本研究計畫主要含括三個方面。一是分析魯迅如何轉化承載「文明批評」思潮的媒介。明治後期，高山樗牛等思想家取法德國，編譯文明史，編輯「文明批評」雜誌；魯迅融合並重塑上述媒介，構想《新生》雜誌，撰寫文言論文。二是勾勒魯迅擇取轉化「文明批評」資源的具體思路。以鉤沉〈文化偏至論〉全部材源及日語資料的德語材源為基礎，能夠揭示魯迅如何將域外思路移植到中國語境。三是論述魯迅如何塑造《域外小說集》的媒介形式與文本型態，賦予文學翻譯「文明批評」的功能。 This research project examines how the young Lu Xun absorbed and transformed the resources of “civilization critique” (bunmei hihyō)—a conceptual framework adapted by Meiji Japanese intellectuals from the German “Kulturkritik”—to shape his unique civilizational vision and literary practice. While previous studies have focused on Lu Xun’s individual connections with thinkers such as Nietzsche, Takayama Chogyū, and Saitō Takayoshi, they have failed to situate these relationships within the broader transnational circulation of “civilization critique.” Adopting a transcultural approach, this project analyzes the media and texts created by young Lu Xun to reveal how he simultaneously engaged with global discourses reflecting on modernity while exploring the trajectory of Chinese civilization. The research comprises three main components. First, it analyzes how Lu Xun transformed media that carried the “civilization critique.” In late Meiji Japan, thinkers like Takayama Chogyū drew upon German sources to compile histories of civilization and edit journals dedicated to “civilization critique.” Lu Xun synthesized and reconfigured these media forms, conceptualizing the journal New Life (Xinsheng) and composing classical Chinese essays. Second, the project delineates the specific logic through which Lu Xun selected and adapted “civilization critique” resources. By tracing all source materials in “On Imbalanced Cultural Development” (Wenhua pianzhi lun)—including their Japanese intermediaries and original German references—we can reveal how Lu Xun transplanted foreign frameworks into the Chinese context. Third, it investigates how Lu Xun shaped the media format and textual strategies of his Anthology of Short Stories from beyond the Border (Yuwai xiaoshuo ji), imbuing literary translation with the critical function of “civilization critique.”

14603825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14603825.value: 超越人類的提示：追溯結合生成式人工智慧的藝術實踐中不斷轉變的行動者網絡

14603825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603825.value: In recent years, generative artificial intelligence (GAI), a branch of artificial intelligence (AI), has emerged as one of the most transformative fields, impacting nearly every sector. Together with large language models, which are trained to understand and generate human language, GAI has demonstrated unprecedented capabilities in analyzing data, making predictions, and creating new content. The rise of multimodal models like DALL·E 2, Midjourney, and Stable Diffusion, among others, which combine text interpretation with image generation, has further expanded creative possibilities, enabling a broad range of creative applications across text, images, and multimedia. GAI has had a profound impact on creativity. For instance, in 2018, Christie’s New York auctioned its first AI-generated artwork for $432,000. By 2022, Stable Diffusion alone had garnered more than 10 million daily users. Beyond global popularity, GAI has had a notable effect in Hong Kong, where governments, galleries, artists, and startup companies have begun showcasing AI-generated works. The vibrancy of the scene is further amplified by the international attention surrounding Sophia, a humanoid robot created by a Hong Kong company, which uses AI to produce art. As a result, new institutions, exhibitions, and agents are reshaping how art is created, presented, and perceived. Traditionally, human artists have been central to the creative process. However, GAI challenges the notion of human exclusivity in artistic creation, altering the relationships between artists, tools, and creative processes. This raises questions: Is AI merely a tool, or is it a collaborator? GAI depends on vast data networks to create art, and this shift redistributes creative authority, potentially displacing human artists. Consequently, GAI disrupts not only artistic networks but also the emerging culture, knowledge, and meaning of art. By considering AI as a crucial entity in co-creating the creative process, this project adopts Bruno Latour’s Actor-Network Theory as a theoretical framework to examine the changing roles of various entities in this evolving landscape, starting from Hong Kong and beyond. The project will explore how AI systems become mediators, upholding agency with their opaque complexity. Through ethnography, including fieldwork, interviews, and participatory observations, the project will situate AI systems within their social contexts, tracing the relationships between human and non-human actors, institutions, and computer models. As such, it aims to reveal the shifting networks that underlie AI and art, while examining their place within broader social power structures. 近年來，生成式人工智慧（GAI）作為人工智慧（AI）的一個分支，已成為最具變革性的領域之一，幾乎影響了每一個產業。GAI結合能夠理解與生成自然語言的大型語言模型， 展現出前所未有的能力，不僅能分析資料、進行預測，還能創造全新的內容。結合文字詮釋與圖像生成的多模態模型（例如 DALL·E 2、Midjourney、Stable Diffusion等）興起，大幅拓展了創意的可能性，促使跨越文字、圖像及多媒體的多元創作應用蓬勃發展。 GAI 對創造力產生了深遠的影響。例如，2018 年，佳士得紐約拍賣行首次拍賣 AI 生成藝術品，成交價達 43.2 萬美元。到2022 年，僅 Stable Diffusion 的每日用戶就已超過一千萬人次。除了在全球範圍內大受歡迎，GAI 在香港也有著顯著影響——政府、畫廊、藝術家與初創企業開始展出 AI 生成作品。香港一家公司打造的人形機械人 Sophia，能利用 AI 創作藝術作品，受到國際矚目，也使本地場景更為活躍。由此，新機構、新展覽及新代理正在重塑藝術創作、展示與被感知的方式。 傳統上，人類藝術家一直是創作過程的核心。然而，GAI 挑戰了藝術創作為人類獨有的觀念，改變了藝術家、工具與創作過程之間的關係。有人問：AI 只是工具，還是創作的協作者？GAI 仰賴龐大的資料網絡來創作藝術，這種轉變重新分配了創作的權限，甚至可能取代人類藝術家。因此，GAI 不僅擾動了藝術網絡，也影響了藝術中的新興文化、知識與意義。 本研究將 AI 視為共同參與創作過程的重要行動實體，採用布魯諾・拉圖（Bruno Latour）的「行動者網絡理論」（Actor-Network Theory）作為理論框架，探討在香港及其以外不斷演變的環境中，不同實體角色的轉變。研究將關注 AI 系統如何成為中介者，並以其不透明的複雜性維護代理權。透過民族誌方法，包括田野調查、訪談及參與式觀察，本研究將 AI 系統置於其社會脈絡中，追溯人類與非人類行動者、機構及電腦模型之間的關係，藉此揭示AI與藝術背後不斷轉變的網絡，同時檢視它們在更廣泛的社會權力結構中的位置。

14604325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14604325.value: 敗者何處去？——中古早期中國史上對戰利品、首級與降卒的處理

14604325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14604325.value: As the saying goes, “History is written by the victors.” Historical records usually direct us to read war from the perspective of the winning side, recounting their victory, gains, and treatment, lenient or brutal, of the losing side in the aftermath of wars, but the voice of the defeated is seldom heard. When recent interest in military and social history promotes the idea of “history from below” and draws attention to the experiences and activities of the voiceless ordinary soldiers and the civilians, historians have been painstakingly digging out the traces left by those who are long overlooked in the accounts of the past. The currently available records may not allow a detailed account of the losers, enough has survived to give insights into the cases of the defeated in wars. Focusing on the war-ridden early medieval China, the period roughly between the second and the sixth century A.D. that was notorious for its political disunion and ethnic conflicts, this project studies the history of the defeated, including the generals and their soldiers, as well as the property of the vanquished side, to provide another picture of warfare. It approaches the related history from three aspects. Firstly, it traces the role of war booty in early medieval warfare, the mechanism of distributing spoils, and the political and cultural meaning of certain significant trophies. It also examines the effectiveness of contemporary attempts at formulating laws and norms to limit plundering and other atrocities of war. Secondly, it examines the practice of severing enemy’s heads as a quantified assessment of military merits and looks closely at some notorious cases of trophy heads, which became symbols with significant meanings to political legitimation of the time. Thirdly, it analyzes how the winners absorbed the defeated or surrendering soldiers into their armies to meet the acute demand of manpower in incessant warfare. The integration of the defeated of mixed backgrounds into one’s army was a critical challenge to every state in the period, and its effectiveness not only underpinned one’s military capacity but also success in political consolidation. This project aims to place the stories of the defeated and their property in the wider military, political, social, and cultural context in early medieval China. It will also refer to cases in other civilizations, when appropriate, for brief comparisons. 雖說傳世史書多從勝利者的角度作出敘述，但是也不難從史料中爬梳戰場上失敗者的蹤影。本計劃採取關注戰敗者的視角，探尋在中國中古早期的歷史中（東漢至魏晉南北朝；公元一世紀至六世紀），戰敗者的遭遇與相關戰利品的流散情況，從而為認識中古早期的戰爭、政治文化與社會史提供新視野。計劃中將會探討具有政治象徵意義與文化價值的戰利品如何被戰勝一方處理，並會聚焦於從戰場上獲取的首級與政治文化的關係。同時，本計劃亦分析在戰爭中失敗並投降的將士將受到怎樣的待遇，特別是歸降的部隊如何經歷解散、收編與重組的歷程。本計劃的研究成果並可以進一步置於世界史的視野，與其他古代文明或社會處理降卒、戰俘、戰利品與首級進行比較。

14605025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605025.value: 揭開算法的黑盒子：高選擇性媒體環境中的個性化算法與審議性大眾的形成

14605025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14605025.value: Prof FENG, Fuli Prof LELKES, Yphtach Prof LIANG, Hai

14605025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605025.value: The rise of platform power is a defining feature of today’s information landscape that has transformed content curation, with algorithms taking on a significant role as curators. Algorithmic curation distinguishes platforms from the general web information ecosystem. Previous studies have generally focused on the overall effects of platform algorithms. While they offer comprehensive evaluations of algorithmic effects, they often treat the algorithmic system as a black box, overlooking its various components. A deeper understanding of individual components could provide richer theoretical insights into the mechanisms driving the effects of platform algorithms. This could also guide stakeholders in designing targeted strategies or interventions to tackle the global information crisis. A key algorithmic subsystem is the personalization algorithm, which is used across various digital platforms, including social media, search engines, and news aggregators. Many scholars looked at the effects of personalization algorithms. The concept of “filter bubble” is a prime example; it is believed to result in numerous negative outcomes, prompting several countries/regions such as mainland China and the European Union to implement regulations on personalization algorithms. Consequently, many platforms now offer users the option to modify the personalization algorithm. However, empirical assessments that characterize the effects of personalization algorithms are still limited, and the few exceptions report mixed findings and suggest very different theoretical claims regarding the algorithmic effects (e.g., automated serendipity vs. filter bubble). The proposed study will conduct two experiments to identify the causal effects of personalization algorithms on the lack of news consumption, misinformation use, and echo chamber effects, three challenges that prevent the formation of deliberative publics in high-choice media environments. Study I will leverage a field experiment in the United States on YouTube, one major social media platform and an important pathway to access news. Study II will conduct an online experiment on a designed platform with various recommendation algorithms in Hong Kong, which will not only test the generalizability of the findings from Study I but also explore and test alternative designs of personalization algorithms. By integrating two experimental techniques and examining two vastly different contexts, this project aims to provide a comprehensive and robust appraisal of the impact of personalization algorithms. The project’s findings will have both theoretical and practical significance. It should enrich our theoretical understanding of platforms and algorithms and guide platform moderators and policymakers in designing interventions to advance digital democratic citizenship across the globe. 平台權力的崛起是當今資訊環境的顯著特徵，已徹底改變了內容策展方式，算法在其中扮演了重要的策展者角色。算法策展使平台有別於一般的網路資訊生態系統。過去的研究通常聚焦於平台算法的總體效果，雖然對算法影響進行全面性評估，但往往將算法系統視為黑箱，忽略了其多個組成部分。若能更深入理解各個組件，將有助於豐富理論上的洞見，揭示推動平台算法影響的機制，也能協助制定更有針對性的策略或干預措施，以應對全球資訊危機。 其中，一個關鍵的算法子系統是「個性化算法」，它廣泛應用於各類數位平台，包括社交媒體、搜尋引擎與新聞聚合器。許多學者探討過個性化算法的影響。「同溫層」（filter bubble）概念就是典型例子，被認為導致諸多負面結果，使得中國大陸、歐盟等多個地區制定了與個性化算法相關的法規。結果，許多平台現今提供用戶修改個性化算法的選項。然而，針對個性化算法影響的實證評估仍然有限，少數例外則得出結論不一，並提出截然不同的理論主張（例如自動的偶發性與同溫層效應）。 本研究擬進行兩項實驗，釐清個性化算法對於新聞攝取不足、錯誤資訊使用、以及同溫層效應等問題的因果影響，而這三者正是高選擇媒體環境下，妨礙審議性大眾形成的挑戰。研究一將於美國主要社群媒體平台 YouTube 上進行田野實驗，該平台是獲取新聞的重要途徑。研究二則於香港設計的平台上，對不同推薦算法進行線上實驗，不僅可驗證研究一的結果是否具一般化性，也可探索與測試個性化算法的替代設計。透過結合兩種實驗技術並檢驗兩個截然不同的情境，本計畫旨在全面且有力地評估個性化算法的影響。 本計畫成果將兼具理論與實務意義，不僅能豐富我們對平台與算法的理論認識，更能協助平台管理者與政策制定者設計介入措施，促進全球數位民主公民素養的發展。

14605325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605325.value: 網絡變化與績效：針對強制性公共服務網絡演進之分析

14605325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14605325.value: Dr Hsu, Yu Cheng Dr Kwok, Pak Ki

14605325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605325.value: Networks have been recognized as a preferred mode of governance owing to their facilitation of inter-organizational collaboration, which is presumed to enhance network performance. However, in public service settings, where organizational networks are often externally arranged, mandated actors may not collaborate with one another due to limited mutual trust. This weak integration in mandated networks has challenged the theoretical foundation of network governance, where networks are emphasized as an effective means of improving public performance. This research aims to make two theoretical contributions to the network governance literature. First, it will study the malleability of mandated networks, a crucial but under-studied area in public governance. Second, it will investigate the rarely explored causal relationship between network change and network performance. Specifically, can an improvement in inter-organizational collaboration in a mandated network subsequently improve its performance for public purposes? Integrating notions from complexity science and network intervention, two hypotheses (bottom-up self-organization and top-down network coordination) on how collaboration in a mandated network can be enhanced are proposed. Then, on the basis of the theoretical foundation of network governance, increase in inter-organizational collaboration is hypothesized as leading to an improvement in network performance. We carefully selected a policy system in Hong Kong that embraces social entrepreneurship for public service delivery as our study site since it has a three-tiered network governance structure. The system consists of four mandated networks, and changes in the collaboration structure in those four networks over time have created valuable experimental conditions for hypothesis testing. Implemented for 10 years, the system has more than 350 public service delivery projects, providing a sufficient sample for statistical examination. We will collect inter-organizational collaboration data on the four mandated networks and measure the social and economic performance of the projects in these networks. To test the two hypotheses on network change, dynamic network analysis (SAO model) will be performed. A multi-level regression analysis with variables at the project level, network level, and macro-economic level will also be conducted to examine the relationship between network change and project performance. Since the measures of the collaboration structure of the mandated networks are lagged terms, this will permit the testing of causal influence. Overall, this research will add clarity to the on-going theoretical debate on the effectiveness of network governance in the context of public and mandated networks and will derive practical insights on effective mandated network implementation. 網絡治理因能促進跨組織協作而被視為理想治理模式，並被認爲能提升網絡績效。然而，在公共服務環境中，組織網絡往往是由外部安排的，強制參與的各方可能因互信不足而無法有效協作。此種強制性網絡中的整合薄弱現象，對網絡治理強調網絡作為提升公共績效有效手段的理論基礎構成了挑戰。 本研究旨在對網絡治理文獻做出兩項理論貢獻。首先，本研究將探究強制性網絡的可塑性。其次，本研究將探討網絡變化與網絡績效之間的因果關係。具體而言，強制型網絡中組織間合作的改善是否能進一步提升其公共目標的績效？ 本研究結合複雜性科學與網絡干預之概念，提出兩項關於如何強化強制性網絡中協作的假設（自我組織與網絡協調）。然後，基於網絡治理的理論基礎，本研究假設組織間合作的增加將提升網絡績效。 我們選擇了香港一個以社會企業推動公共服務系統作為研究場域，因其具有三層次的網絡治理結構。該系統由四個強制性網絡組成，而此四個網絡協作結構隨時間的變化，為假設檢驗創造了寶貴的實驗條件。 我們將收集這四個強制性網絡中的組織間合作資料，並衡量這些網絡中項目的績效。為了檢驗網絡變化的兩項假設，將進行動態網絡分析。同時，亦將進行多層次回歸分析，涵蓋項目層級、網絡層級與宏觀經濟層級的變量，以檢視網絡變化與項目績效之間的關係。由於強制性網絡合作結構的測量項為滯後項，此設計將允許對因果影響進行檢驗。 本研究將有助釐清當前圍繞公共與強制性網絡背景下網絡治理有效性的理論辯論，並將為有效實施強制性網絡提供實務見解。

14606225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14606225.value: 音樂教育與國民及文化身份的培育：幼稚園教師的自我效能、觀感及實踐

14606225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14606225.value: The Hong Kong SAR government recently released the Values Education Curriculum Framework (Education Bureau, 2021), which identifies “national identity” as a priority value to be nurtured in school education, starting with early childhood education (ECE). The Education Bureau explicitly recognizes music education as an age-appropriate means to cultivate children’s understanding of and interest in Chinese culture, and recommends that kindergartens offer opportunities for children to engage in musical activities that embrace Chinese cultural elements. Scholarship has established a strong connection between music education, cultural identity, national awareness, and national identity. However, in Hong Kong, early childhood teachers face challenges due to insufficient training in music education and a predominant background in Western music. This hinders their ability to effectively utilize music education in cultivating children's interest and knowledge in Chinese culture. As the first study focusing on the utilization of music education as a means to cultivate cultural identity and national awareness in Hong Kong's ECE, we aim to: (i) investigate teachers’ perceptions and self-efficacy in utilizing music education to nurture cultural identity and national awareness in children; (ii) examine current practices in utilizing music to foster children's interest and knowledge in Chinese culture; (iii) explore the necessary content knowledge, musical skills, and pedagogical competencies required by teachers to cultivate cultural identity and national awareness through music education. This project will employ a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design. The initial phase will involve a survey to gather teachers' perspectives on cultural and national identity education in ECE, and the role of music education in its implementation. The survey will also examine teacher self-efficacy, drawing on Bandura's self-efficacy theory. A cluster sampling approach will be used to distribute the questionnaire to kindergartens across Hong Kong. In Phase 2, a multiple-case study consisting of interviews and observations will be conducted in 12 purposively selected Hong Kong kindergartens. Our findings will bridge an important gap in theoretical and professional knowledge by offering a scholarly understanding of how music education may cultivate cultural identity and national awareness in ECE. Moreover, the results will provide evidence-based recommendations to teacher education institutions on developing teacher training frameworks that address the pressing professional needs of kindergarten teachers, with broader implications for various study areas within ECE that are tasked with national education. Ultimately, the project's outcomes may inform future policymaking of cultural and national education—a significant policy agenda in Hong Kong. 香港特別行政區政府近期頒布《價值觀教育課程架構》（教育局，2021），確立「國民身份 」為學校教育之優先培育價值，並應從幼兒教育階段開始。教育局明確認可音樂教育乃符合幼兒發展階段之教學媒介，可培養兒童對中華文化的認知與興趣，建議幼稚園提供涵蓋中華文化元素的音樂活動契機。 學術研究已證實音樂教育、文化認同、國家意識與身份建構存在密切關聯。然香港幼兒教育工作者面臨雙重挑戰：音樂教育專業培訓不足，且多具西方音樂背景為主，致使其運用音樂教育培育兒童中華文化認知與興趣之效能受限。作為首項聚焦香港幼兒教育領域運用音樂教育培養文化認同與國家意識之研究，本計畫旨在：（一）探究教師運用音樂教育培育兒童文化身份與國家意識之認知取向及自我效能感；（二）檢視現行運用音樂活動促進兒童中華文化認知與興趣之教學實踐；（三）剖析教師透過音樂教育培育文化身份與國家意識所需之學科知識、音樂技能及教學能力。 本研究採用解釋型序列混合方法設計。第一階段將透過問卷調查蒐集教師對幼兒階段文化與國民身份教育之觀點，以及音樂教育在相關實踐中的角色功能。問卷設計援引阿爾波特·班杜拉自我效能理論，測量教師自我效能感。採用集群抽樣法，面向全港幼稚園分發問卷。第二階段將於十二所經目的性抽樣選取的香港幼稚園展開多重個案研究，透過深度訪談與教學觀察蒐集質性資料。 本研究發現將填補理論與專業實踐之重要斷層，提供學術界理解音樂教育如何於幼兒教育階段培育文化身份與國家意識之實證依據。研究結果更將提出循證導向建議，供師資培育機構建構符合幼稚園教師迫切專業需求之培訓框架，並對幼兒教育之各學科產生跨領域啟示。最終研究成果可望為香港重要政策議程——文化及國民教育之未來政策制定提供學理參照。

14606525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14606525.value: 超越冷科技：教師對生成式人工智能的認知評估、情緒與應對及其前因與後果

14606525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14606525.value: Prof Chen, Gaowei Prof Chiu, Kin-fung Thomas Dr Xia, Qi Prof Zhan, Zehui Prof Zhou, Mingming

14606525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14606525.value: Aim This project aims to examine primary school teachers’ cognitive appraisals, emotional responses, and coping strategies for using generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in educational settings in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and seeks to explore the interactions between these elements and their relationships with the antecedents and consequences of GenAI use. Background GenAI has emerged as a transformative tool in education, significantly impacting teaching and learning processes. However, there is limited understanding of the mechanisms influencing teachers’ acceptance and utilization of GenAI. While existing technology acceptance models identify factors affecting technology adoption, they often overlook the emotional dimension of teachers’ experiences. Additionally, scholars advocate for a more comprehensive framework that includes GenAI-specific characteristics and considers individual, contextual, and technological factors to enhance our understanding of GenAI adoption and its effects on teacher outcomes. This study aims to address these gaps in the literature. Brief Description The research employs a convergent parallel mixed-methods design, integrating quantitative and qualitative approaches to explore teachers’ experiences with GenAI. The quantitative phase will involve a survey assessing cognitive appraisals, emotional responses, coping strategies, and their relationships to antecedents (e.g., social influence, hedonic motivation, anthropomorphism) and outcomes (e.g., work meaningfulness, GenAI-powered productivity and innovation). It will also examine how these relationships differ across gender, age/years of teaching, subject taught, and region. Stratified random sampling will be used to recruit approximately 3,080 teachers from 172 schools across the GBA. Data analysis will involve multivariate analysis of variance, hierarchical linear modeling, multi-level structural equation modeling (SEM), and multi-group comparisons. An exploratory multiple-case study will also be conducted to obtain in-depth information about teachers’ GenAI usage experiences. Data will be collected through online semi-structured interviews with around 64 participants, supplemented by website records of GenAI usage and relevant documents. Thematic analysis will be employed to gain deeper insights into their experiences and the contextual, personal, and technical factors influencing their appraisals, emotions, and coping strategies related to GenAI usage. Significance This proposed study will contribute to understanding how cognitive appraisal, emotion, and coping shape teachers’ interactions with GenAI. By identifying effective coping strategies and emotional responses, the research aims to inform the development of targeted interventions for teacher training and support, ultimately enhancing the integration of GenAI into educational practices. The findings will have implications for educational policy and practice, providing insights that can help educators navigate the complexities of GenAI technology.

14607125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14607125.value: 懷舊干預措施對減輕社區長者孤獨感的成效：集群隨機化等待名單對照試驗

14607125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14607125.value: Dr Choi, Kai-chow Dr Ho, Ken Hok Man Prof Kwok, Yan Yan Dr Mann, Stephen Ka Fai

14607125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14607125.value: Loneliness has been recognised by the World Health Organisation as a social determinant of health. It encompasses three interrelated dimensions: emotional loneliness (perceived lack of close relationships), social loneliness (perceived lack of social connections) and existential loneliness (perceived lack of meaning in life). Our survey of 316 community-dwelling older adults revealed that 68.3% reported experiencing moderate to severe loneliness. However, current interventions mainly address only one single dimension of loneliness, overlooking the interplay amongst the three dimensions. Nostalgia intervention offers a novel and potentially effective strategy to address the three dimensions of loneliness by evoking nostalgic memories. This approach can help regulate negative emotions associated with emotional loneliness and foster a sense of social connectedness and meaning in life. Therefore, our team collaborated with older adults and stakeholders to co-design a nostalgia intervention to address the needs of older adults to combat loneliness. The proposed study will utilise a two-arm, cluster-randomised, waitlist-controlled trial to (1) examine the effects of the nostalgia intervention on loneliness, negative emotions, social connectedness, meaning in life and nostalgia amongst community-dwelling older adults in Hong Kong; (2) investigate whether the effect of the nostalgia intervention on loneliness is mediated by improvements in negative emotions, social connectedness and meaning in life; and (3) explore the experiences and perceptions of older adults participating in the nostalgia interventions, focusing on their views regarding the impact of the intervention on their loneliness. We will recruit a convenience sample of 294 older adults from six participating community centres, with 49 participants from each centre. Eligible older adults will be randomly assigned to either a waitlist control group (n = 147) or an intervention group (n = 147). Both groups will receive standard community support services, whilst the intervention group will also participate in five weekly face-to-face nostalgia sessions (approximately 90 min each) in a group format. Additionally, a purposive subsample of 30 participants from the intervention group will be invited for focus group interviews. The primary outcome (loneliness) and secondary outcomes will be assessed at baseline (T0), immediately post-intervention (T1), 3 months post-intervention (T2) and 6 months post-intervention (T3) using validated questionnaires. We will analyse the quantitative data using a generalised estimating equation model with intention-to-treat and path analyses. The qualitative data will be analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. The findings of this proposed study will inform healthcare professionals and policymakers, offering practical strategies to combat loneliness in this vulnerable group. 世界衛生組織已將孤獨感視為健康的社會決定因素。它包含三個相互關聯的維度：情感孤獨（感知缺乏親密關係）、社交孤獨（感知缺乏社會連繫）和存在孤獨（感知缺乏人生意義）。我們對316名社區長者的調查顯示，68.3%的長者表示經歷中度至重度孤獨。然而，目前的干預措施主要針對孤獨感的單一維度，而忽略了三個維度之間的相互作用。 懷舊干預措施透過喚起懷舊記憶，提供了一種新穎且可能有效的策略，以應對孤獨的三個維度。這種方法有助於調節與情緒孤獨相關的負面情緒，並培養社會連繫感和人生意義感。因此，我們的團隊與長者和持份者合作，共同設計了一項懷舊干預措施，以幫助長者減輕孤獨感。 本研究採用集群隨機化等待名單對照試驗，旨在：(1) 評估懷舊干預措施對香港社區長者的孤獨感、負面情緒、社會連繫、人生意義和懷舊情緒的影響；(2) 探究懷舊干預措施對孤獨感的影響是否透過負面情緒、社會連繫和感知人生意義的改善來調節；(3) 探討長者對干預措施對其孤獨感之影響。 研究將從六個參與社區中心（每個中心 49 名參與者）招募 294名長者。符合條件的長者將被隨機分配到等待名單對照組 (n = 147) 或干預組 (n = 147) 。兩組都將獲得通常的社區支持服務，干預組還將每週接受五次以小組形式的懷舊干預措施（每次約90分鐘）。此外，研究也會邀請 30 位干預組參與進行焦點訪談。 研究使用問卷在基線（T0）、干預後（T1）、干預後3個月（T2）和干預後6個月（T3）評估主要指標（孤獨感）和次要指標。我們將使用廣義估計方程模型，結合路徑分析來分析定量數據，而自反性主題分析將用於定性數據。研究結果將為醫療保健專業人員和政策制定者提供參考，為長者提供減輕孤獨感的實用策略。

14608025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608025.value: 預期形成與企業決策：基於中國企業調查數據的證據

14608025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14608025.value: Prof Huo, Zhen Prof Song, Michael Zheng

14608025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608025.value: Economic expectations have long been recognized as a fundamental aspect of economics that influences fluctuations and growth. Policymakers and the public also regard expectations as important indicators of understanding the real economy. Yet, research on firms’ expectations in China is scarce. Though challenging, tracking the expectations of firms, especially a broad range of small businesses, offers support on both academic frontiers and practices. In this project, we propose to explore the economic determinants and consequences of small businesses’ expectations in China. We plan to utilize surveys and experiments to study the expectations formation process for small businesses and identify their expectations' causal impact on their decisions and performance. We will first design and conduct surveys to collect information on their business performance, outlooks, and decisions. One advantage is relying on the two well-established survey projects by our collaborator, Peking University. Forecasts on both micro-level outcomes and macro-level indicators will be asked. Combined with the linked transaction history data from the Alipay platform, we will provide first-hand stylized facts on Chinese firms’ expectations formation process. We will then apply a randomized control trial approach. In particular, we will implement different information interventions for random-grouped interviewees to track changes in their expectations and economic behaviors. This enables us to directly test how firms’ expectations affect their following business decisions and outcomes. The empirical findings from the survey-based experiment will demystify the potential economic mechanisms and allow us to empirically examine the conventional economic theories on expectations. Based on the informative results from individual-level estimation, we will construct the theoretical model and quantify the aggregated effect on the macroeconomy. Overall, our research will contribute extensively to the study on small businesses and the formation and role of expectations at the individual level. The dataset and approach will benefit more scholars and further studies on small businesses. The project findings will also shed light on policy implications, generating significant impacts beyond academia. 經濟預期一直被視為是影響經濟波動與長期增長的核心驅動因素之一，政策制定者和社會公眾也將其視為實體經濟的重要指標。然而，目前針對中國企業預期的研究仍然匱乏。儘管存在挑戰，但追蹤企業（尤其是廣泛的中小微企業）的微觀和宏觀預期，能夠為學術前沿發展與政策實踐提供重要的支持。 本研究旨在探究中國中小微企業預期形成的決定因素及其影響。我們將結合問卷調查與隨機干預實驗等方法，研究中小微企業經營者的經濟預期形成過程，並識別其預期對企業決策與經營表現的因果效應。 首先，我們將設計並開展線上、線下的問卷調查，收集企業的經營狀況、未來預期及決策計劃等信息。本項目的優勢之一在於依託合作方北京大學的兩項成熟調查項目，涵蓋小微經營者的微觀經營指標與微觀、宏觀經濟預期等測度。結合與線上調查樣本關聯的支付寶平台交易數據，本研究將系統刻畫中國企業預期形成過程的典型事實。隨後，我們將採用隨機對照實驗方法，對分組受訪者實施差異化的信息干預，追蹤其預期與經濟行為的變化，從而直接檢驗企業預期如何影響後續決策與經營結果。基於調查實驗的實證發現將揭示潛在的預期-行為經濟機制，並驗證經典的宏觀預期理論。在個體層面估計的基礎上，我們將構建理論模型，量化預期對宏觀經濟的加總影響。 本研究將為中小微企業微觀層面的預期形成與作用機制等方面的學術前沿做出貢獻。收集構建的數據集將為更多研究者及相關的研究提供支持。項目成果還將為政策制定提供支持性證據，產生超越學術界的長期影響力。

14608525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608525.value: 檢討一個以「同儕協助、基於接受的疾病管理自學干預課程」 對近期發病的思覺失調症患者之成效的隨機對照試驗

14608525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14608525.value: Dr Cheung, Eric Fuk Chi Prof Chong, Yuen-yu Prof Gray, John Richard Dr Morris, Eric Ms Yip, Annie LK

14608525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608525.value: Psychosis is a very disabling mental illness with a wide range of dysregulations and disruptions in cognition, emotions, and behaviors, resulting in poor functioning and frequent relapses, especially in the first five years of the illness. People with recent-onset psychosis (ROP, <5 years of illness) are often unprepared for the illness, its disturbing symptoms and behaviors, unsatisfactory illness insight and treatment adherence and illness self-management, resulting in >30% with chronic syndrome and poor prognosis. Different approaches to psychosocial intervention such as medication management, psychoeducation, and relapse-prevention programs, have been conducted in community mental healthcare services, but inconsistent and inconclusive effects in other psychosocial health conditions, particularly in a longer-term (>12-month follow-ups). Despite having convincing short-term positive effects on psychotic symptoms and hospitalizations, there has been limited evidence on long-term effectiveness of psychosocial interventions for early-stage psychosis or ROP. With insufficient health resources and increasing emphasis on self-help and independence of living in chronic illness care, psychosocial intervention should optimize self-management of psychotic patients’ mental wellbeing, day-to-day functioning and personal recovery. In views of the above challenges, an innovative Peer-facilitated, Acceptance-based Self-learning for Illness Management (PASIM) program facilitating patients’ self-learning of illness management and enhancing functioning has shown preliminary benefits in controlled trials of nurse- or peer-led illness-management programs for first-episode severe mental illnesses. A multi-center randomized controlled trial with repeated measures, 3-arm design is proposed to test and compare the effects between two alternative interventions (PASIM and Psychoeducation Group program) and a usual-care-only group for 186 adults with ROP (62 per group) over an 18-month follow-up (i.e., outcomes measured at recruitment, and 1-week, 9-month, and 18-month post-intervention). Generalized Estimating Equation test will be used to compare mean-value changes in individual outcomes, and Kaplan-Meier survival-analysis used to analyze the relative risks of re-hospitalizations, between groups over follow-ups. It is hypothesized that the APSIM participants will show significantly greater improvements in patients’ functioning (primary outcome) and/or several secondary outcomes (e.g., mental state, illness insight, problem-solving, re-hospitalization rates, and service satisfaction) than the other two groups over 18-month follow-ups. Individual semi-structured interviews will be conducted to explore the strengths and weaknesses, therapeutic components and mechanism, and service satisfaction with the PASIM from the participants’ and facilitators’ perspectives. If significant results/effects are found, the PASIM can be adopted by community mental healthcare services locally, and replicated in other countries, to enhance early psychosis care by peer-supported illness self-management approach. 精神病是一種具有破壞性和困擾性的精神疾病，表現為認知、情緒和行為等多方面的功能失調/紊亂。它可導致功能下降和頻繁的復發，尤其是在初發疾病的五年內。早期精神病患者通常對疾病、其困擾性的症狀和行為、對疾病的洞察力、治療依從性和疾病自我管理能力缺乏準備，因此超過30%的患者遭受慢性綜合症和預後/康復不佳。社區精神保健服務已經嘗試了多種模式的社會心理干預方法，如藥物管理、心理教育和預防復發項目等，但在其他社會心理健康狀況下的效果並不一致且尚無定論，特別是長期（超過12個月）隨訪。儘管心理社會介入對精神病症狀和住院治療具有令人信服的短期正面影響，但關於心理社會介入對早期精神病 ( ROP) 的長期有效性的證據有限。在面臨健康資源不足和對慢性疾病照護中自助和獨立生活的重視不斷增加的背景下，社會心理干預應優化精神病患者心理健康和康復的自我管理。基於上述挑戰/機遇，一項創新性的以接納為基礎、同儕促進的疾病管理自我學習（PASIM）可促進患者在疾病管理方面的自我學習和有效性，並增強心理社會功能，該計劃整合了PI 參與由護理師主導的首發精神疾病門診患者的疾病管理計劃。 這項多中心隨機對照試驗採用重複測量、三組設計來檢查/比較兩種替代性干預措施（PASIM和心理教育小組計劃）與僅常規護理組在186名中國首發精神病患者（每組62人）的效果，在為期18個月的隨訪期內進行（即在招募時、干預後1周、9個月和18個月測量結局）。廣義估計方程檢驗將用於比較各組個體結局的均值變化，並採用Kaplan-Meier生存分析法分析隨訪期間各組之間再次住院的相對風險。據推測，與其他兩組相比，PASIM受試者在為期18個月的隨訪期內將顯著改善患者的心理社會功能（主要結局）和/或若干次要結局（如精神狀態、疾病病悉感、再住院率和服務滿意度）。 將進行個人半結構化訪談，從參與者和輔導者的角度探討 PASIM 的優點和缺點、治療成分和機制以及服務滿意度。如果發現顯著的效果，PASIM可以被本地的社區精神保健服務採用，並在其他國家複製，透過同儕促進、自學的疾病管理方法來加強早期精神病護理。

14609525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609525.value: 了解面對喪失親友的年輕香港成年人的悲傷軌跡及其相關社會心理預測因素：一項縱向混合方法研究

14609525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14609525.value: Prof Chan, Chi Ho Wallace Dr SUN, Iris Rong Wei Prof Wong, Evaon Prof Wu, Man Sze Anise

14609525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14609525.value: Bereavement is common among emerging adults worldwide, including university students in Hong Kong. Research suggests that bereaved students are exposed to increased vulnerability to mental health problems, academic setbacks, and even future occupational outcomes. Despite the significance of this issue, current research has not extensively explored the more nuanced aspects in people’s bereavement journey, such as the impacts of bereavement-related secondary losses (e.g., loss of social support, identity, or disrupted life plans), disenfranchised grief (grief that is not socially recognized), and culturally-salient coping dynamics that might influence grief processes and outcomes over time (e.g., symptom trajectories). Additionally, recent Western studies have examined posttraumatic growth (PTG)—the positive psychological changes following traumatic events—the factors associated with PTG differ across individuals with different grief trajectories within the Chinese cultural context. A purposive sample of 625 recently-bereaved university students will be recruited from Hong Kong universities for this retrospective mixed-methods study. Phase 1 involves a quantitative three-wave longitudinal survey study (baseline, 6-month, and 12-month follow-ups) assessing grief symptoms, PTG, and other psychosocial variables using structured questionnaires. Guided by the Dual Process Model of Bereavement (DPM) and the Conservation of Resources Theory (COR), we aim at identifying distinct grief trajectories and will investigate the potential psychosocial predictors of these trajectories (e.g., type of bereavement, secondary losses, disenfranchised grief, social support, individual and family coping strategies). A growth mixture modeling (GMM) will be used to identify distinct grief trajectories among the participants, while multinomial logistic regressions will explore predictors of grief trajectory class membership. After identifying the different grief trajectories, we will examine if the levels and associated factors of PTG at 12-month follow-up vary across people with different grief trajectories through structural equation modeling. In Phase 2, a subgroup of Phase 1 participants will complete qualitative interviews to provide more in-depth explanations for the quantitative findings and insights into university students’ bereavement journey in a Chinese cultural context (particularly how secondary losses, disenfranchised grief, social support and coping strategies might affect grief outcomes) and the suggestions for future grief-related services for university students. The findings will have significant implications for clinical practice by identifying early predictors of grief adaptation patterns. By integrating the DPM and COR through a Chinese cultural perspective, the study will offer valuable insights for healthcare professionals, enhancing grief counseling services to better support bereaved university students in a localized context. 喪失親友在全球年輕成年人(18-29歲)中相當普遍。研究指出，經歷喪親的年輕成年人有更高風險面臨心理健康問題、學業受挫，甚至影響職涯發展。即使此議題十分重要，現有研究對於喪親歷程中尚未有深入探討，例如與喪親相關的次級損失（如失去社會支持、身份認同改變或人生計劃被打亂）、不被認可的哀傷（即未被社會認可的哀傷），以及與文化相關而可能影響哀傷歷程和應對策略（如哀傷症狀變化）。近期西方研究探討了人們喪失親友後的正向心理變化（又稱創傷後成長），但有研究指出在華人文化中，與創傷後成長相關的因素會因個人所經歷的不同哀傷軌跡而有所差異。 本研究以混合方法研究並招募近期喪親的香港年輕成年人。第一階段將進行三輪縱向量化問卷調查（基線、六個月及十二個月追蹤），透過問卷評估他們的哀傷症狀、創傷後成長及其他心理社會因素。研究將以「哀傷的雙向遊動模式」（Dual Process Model of Bereavement）及「資源保存理論」（Conservation of Resources Theory）為理論基礎，旨在識別不同的哀傷軌跡，並探討與哀傷軌跡有關的心理社會因素（如喪親類型、次級損失、不被認可的哀傷、社會支持、個人及家庭的應對策略等）。研究將採用成長混合模型以辨識參與者的哀傷軌跡，並以多項式邏輯迴歸分析探討哀傷軌跡類別的預測因素。識別出不同哀傷軌跡後，研究將進一步以結構方程模型分析十二個月追蹤時的創傷後成長水平及其相關因素是否因哀傷軌跡而有所不同。 第二階段將邀請第一階段的部分參加者進行深入訪問，以了解問卷得出的結果，探討年輕成年人在華人文化中的喪親歷程（特別是次級損失、不被認可的哀傷、社會支持及應對策略如何影響哀傷結果），以及對未來年輕成年人哀傷支援服務的建議。研究結果將對臨床服務帶來重要啟示，特別是識別哀傷適應模式的早期預測因素，以提升本地的哀傷輔導服務質素，更有效地支援喪親的年輕成年人。

14609625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609625.value: 以演算法素養與聊天機器人提升新聞多元性之探討

14609625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14609625.value: Prof Shuning, Lu Prof Song, Yunya

14609625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14609625.value: The increasing reliance on news recommendation algorithms (NRAs) has sparked concern among scholars, governments and the public, as algorithms actively curate content to cater to user preferences, which deepens filter bubbles and reinforces selective exposure. While recent studies have shown that modifications to NRAs can promote exposure to diverse content, an inherent bias remains in NRA choice structures, which prioritize content that aligns with users’ pre-existing attitudes. This project focuses on the unbalanced content supply and proposes two interventions — algorithm literacy and conversational chatbots — as user- and system-driven approaches to mitigate the bias. It explores whether these interventions can alleviate the influence of NRAs’ biased choice structure on information consumption and facilitate exposure to diverse viewpoints. To understand the effectiveness of the interventions, this project takes a comparative approach and examines the research questions in the U.S. and China given their distinct political and media contexts. In light of the NRA platforms with algorithms that operate in different ways in each country, citizens in the U.S. and China likely have distinct understandings of how algorithms filter and present information, as well as differing behaviors in coping with these algorithms. The user-driven intervention applies algorithm literacy to explore how a) awareness of the existence of algorithms, b) understanding of how algorithmic processes curate online content, and c) curatorial behaviors to counteract algorithmic influence can empower users to resist manipulation by NRAs and preserve their autonomy. The system-driven intervention introduces three types of conversational chatbots that a) provide feedback on media diet, b) alert users to an article’s information (i.e., source and ideological leaning), and c) suggest alternative viewpoints. These tools aim to assess whether they can attenuate the negative influence of the biased choice structure in NRAs. To grasp the implications of the interventions that could alleviate the adverse effects of NRAs on individuals and society as a whole, the project not only examines their impact on information consumption, but also explores broader political and civic outcomes (i.e., political knowledge, affective polarization, and political/civic participation) using surveys and experiments in both the U.S. and China. In practice, the findings of this project have the potential to inform algorithm literacy education programs, offer actionable solutions for the media industry seeking to balance popularity with the promotion of diverse viewpoints, and provide critical insights to policy discussions on enhancing transparency, oversight, and accountability in algorithmic systems. 隨著對新聞推薦演算法的依賴程度日益增加，學界、政府與公眾都對演算法依據使用者偏好來主動篩選與呈現內容表達了高度關切。因為這會進一步加深「過濾氣泡」並強化「選擇性接觸」。雖然近年的研究顯示，對新聞推薦演算法進行調整可以促進多元內容的接觸，但在其選擇結構中仍存在內在偏差，即傾向優先推送與使用者既有態度相符的內容。 本研究聚焦於不平衡的新聞內容供給，並提出兩種干預措施：演算法素養(使用者驅動)與聊天機器人(系統驅動)。本研究探討這些干預措施是否能降低演算法導致的偏差選擇結構對資訊消費的影響，並是否能促進多元觀點的接觸。本研究採取比較研究方法，分別在美國與中國兩個不同政治與媒體環境的國家進行檢驗以理解這些干預的效果。由於兩國的演算法平台運作方式各異，人們在理解演算法如何篩選與呈現資訊方面也可能存在差異，並且在應對這些演算法的行為模式上也有所不同。 在使用者驅動的干預方面，本研究透過演算法素養的三個面向：a) 對演算法存在性的認知；b) 對演算法如何策展線上內容的理解；c) 抗衡演算法影響的內容策展行為，來了解如何強化使用者抵禦新聞推薦演算法操控的能力，並維護其自主性。 在系統驅動的干預方面，本研究設計三種類型的聊天機器人：a) 提供媒體使用回饋；b) 提醒使用者文章的相關資訊（例如來源與意識形態傾向）； c) 建議不同觀點。這些工具的目的在於檢驗其是否能減弱因新聞推薦演算法而生成的偏差選擇結構的負面影響。 為了理解這些干預措施在緩解新聞推薦演算法對個人及整體社會之負面影響上的意涵，本研究不僅考察它們對資訊消費的影響，還將透過在美國與中國進行的調查與實驗，探討更廣泛的政治與公民層面結果（如政治知識、情感極化、以及政治／公民參與）。在實務層面，本研究成果有望為演算法素養教育計畫提供實證基礎，為媒體產業在平衡內容受歡迎程度與推廣多元觀點之間提供可行的解決方案，並為提升演算法系統的透明度、監督與問責機制之政策討論，提供關鍵的參考依據。

14609725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609725.value: 亞洲人群中極端氣溫與子癇前症的關係

14609725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14609725.value: Dr Chong, Ka Chun Dr NGUYEN HOANG, Long Prof POON, Liona Chiu-yee Prof Ren, Chao

14609725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14609725.value: The prolonged and intensified extreme temperature events in the context of global climate change impose an increasing health threat on vulnerable populations, particularly pregnant women. The physiological changes during pregnancy, such as augmented metabolism and increased blood volume, could compromise the ability to regulate the body. Previous studies reported a significant association between ambient temperature and preeclampsia, though the magnitude and direction of the association were inconsistent. No study has identified the critical window of non-optimal ambient temperature exposure for preeclampsia onset, which could help understand the potential mechanism. The single-centre study design, which led to the limitation of the climate type and missing preeclampsia-related gestational factors, could be attributable to these incongruent results. In addition, a limited number of studies investigated the mediation effect of socioeconomic factors on temperature-preeclampsia association.
