These debates are reflected in the UNESCO report Guidance for Generative AI in Education and Research. Therefore, GenAI-based learning activities may motivate and demotivate students in SRL. The needs satisfaction and thwarting of self-determination theory (SDT), and the three SRL phases of forethought, performance, and self-reflection help explain the student motivation and demotivation. Furthermore, pedagogy with GenAI should be discipline-specific. Hence, it is vital to investigate how needs satisfaction and thwarting caused by GenAI in a particular disciplinary context. This project is based on PI’s two completed funded projects, and will bridge the research gaps between Early Career Scheme (ECS, needs satisfaction on STEM interest and identity) and Quality Education Fund (QEF, SRL activities supporting needs satisfaction) by connecting the findings and adding a needs-thwarting perspective in integrated STEM education. Its three main goals are to (i) develop a taxonomy with a full list of GenAI-based learning activities for students that support and thwart SDT needs; (ii) determine whether the activities satisfy needs in each SRL phrase and foster STEM interest and identity; and (iii) explain how the activities affect the results of the second research goal. Accordingly, this 24-month project will use a three-round Delphi study and a sequential explanatory mixed-method longitudinal study. In the Delphi study, an international panel of five members and a teacher experts panel of 30 members will work together to develop the taxonomy. In the 15-week intervention study, we will randomly assign 96 Secondary Three school students into two groups: taxonomy and non-taxonomy. The qualitative study will elucidate the impact of the taxonomy on needs satisfaction and thwarting, as well as STEM interest and identity development. We will collect data via questionnaires (5 times), individual interviews (after intervention), and prompts (every lesson). The findings will have a significant impact on (i) researchers, teachers, school leaders, and policymakers in the short term by adding the taxonomy and perspective of needs satisfaction; (ii) educational policy related to GenAI and STEM education in the medium term by designing digital learning guidelines for GenAI in education; and (iii) on the economy and society as a whole in the long term by integrating GenAI in school STEM education. 生成式人工智能工具在促進學生自主學習方面可能比非人工智能技術更具潛力。然而有觀點認為，過度依賴此類技術可能導致人際社交弱化及高階思維能力下降，這一爭議已體現在聯合國教科文組織《教育科研領域生成式AI應用指南》中。因此，基於生成式人工智能的學習活動既可能激發亦可能抑制學生的自主學習動機。自我決定理論中的需求滿足與需求阻礙機制，結合自主學習三階段模型（前瞻規劃、執行表現、自我反思），為解釋上述動機變化提供了理論框架。值得注意的是，基於生成式人工智能的教學方法應具學科針對性，故極需在特定學科情境下探究生成式人工智能引發的需求滿足/阻礙效應。 本項目整合了主持人兩項已完成基金研究（早期職業計劃「STEM興趣認同的需求滿足機制」與優質教育基金「支持需求滿足的自主學習活動」），通過融合研究發現並引入需求阻礙視角，致力填補綜合STEM教育領域的以下研究空白：(1) 建立支持/阻礙自我決定理論需求的生成式人工智能學習活動分類框架；(2) 驗證活動在SRL各階段的需求滿足效能及其對STEM興趣認同的培養作用；(3) 闡釋活動影響第二目標結果的機制。 這項為期24個月的研究將採用：三輪德爾菲研究（5名國際專家+30名教師專家協同構建分類框架）與順序性解釋型混合方法縱貫研究（96名中三學生隨機分為「框架組/非框架組」進行15週教學實驗）。通過五輪問卷、干預後個別訪談及每課引導問題收集數據，質性分析將闡明分類框架對需求滿足/阻礙及STEM興趣認同發展的影響。 研究成果預期產生三重影響：(1) 短期為研究者、教師、學校管理層及政策制定者提供需求滿足分類框架與新視角；(2) 中期通過設計《教育用生成式人工智能數字學習指南》影響GenAI與STEM教育政策；(3) 長期藉由生成式人工智能與學校STEM教育的深度融合，推動經濟社會整體發展。

14617025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14617025.value: 老年人親社會性期望的跨文化比較

14617025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14617025.value: Prof Freund, Alexandra M. Dr Lee, Saein Ms Lin, Hongmei Dr Zhang, Xin

14617025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14617025.value: Population aging has led to the development of various societal expectations on how older adults should behave. One of the most controversial of these expectations is that older adults should benefit others and society, called "prosociality." For example, older adults are often expected to provide financial or childcare assistance to their adult children. These expectations have become particularly acute since the COVID-19 pandemic, with the belief that older adults should sacrifice themselves for the greater good of society. However, these demands can create significant pressure and intergenerational conflicts for older adults who may not wish to, or be able to, conform to these societal expectations. Demanding prosociality from all older adults in every situation risks harming intergenerational relationships and constitutes a new form of ageism. Yet, the existing literature focuses on how older adults are like (i.e., descriptive views of aging), but not how older adults should be like (prescriptive views of aging). The scant literature available focuses on broad-stroke principles such as older people should not consume too many resources and should give them to younger people. But whether these principles can be translated into specific expectations about whether older adults must be prosocial has not been examined. Neither do more nuanced questions on WHO hold those expectations or prosocial to WHOM. Furthermore, prosocial expectations influence not only how older adults are perceived and treated by others, but also become internalized, shaping older adults' own behaviors and self-perceptions. This process of HOW social norms get internalized to become personal views on older adults' prosociality, and how this process differs across cultures with different levels of societal tolerance of deviations from social norms (tight vs. loose cultures) should be examined. The proposed project aims to address these questions. This project focuses on China (Hong Kong, a tight culture) and Switzerland (Zurich, a loose culture) to examine age and cultural differences in expectations for older adults' prosociality. Study 1 will use a population-based big data analysis to explore societal expectations of age-related prosociality in China and Switzerland. Study 2 will investigate how younger, middle-aged, and older adults differentially endorse expectations for older adults' prosociality toward social relationships of various levels of closeness. This study will also explore the role of cultural tightness/looseness in these age-related expectations. Study 3 will examine the internalization of social norms in shaping expectations for older adults' prosociality in the two cultures. 人口老齡化日益加劇，社會對老年人應盡的責任與義務產生了多樣的期望。其中，最具爭議的觀點之一是認為老年人應更加貢獻於社會福祉，展現出更高的「親社會性」。例如，社會普遍期望老年人能向成年子女提供經濟或育兒上的協助。自COVID-19疫情爆發以來，對老年人的社會期望變得尤為迫切，人們認為老年人應為社會的更大利益而自我犧牲。然而，對於不願或無法符合這些社會期望的老年人而言，這無疑造成了巨大的壓力與代際衝突。若要求所有老年人在任何情境下皆展現親社會性，不僅可能損害代際關係，更構成一種新型的年齡歧視。現有的研究多側重於描述老年人是什麼樣的（即老化的描述性觀點），而較少探討老年人應該做什麼（即老化的規範性觀點）。目前少數研究關注較為廣泛的原則，如老年人不應過度消耗資源，而應將資源讓與年輕世代。然而，這些原則能否轉化為對老年人親社會性期望的具體要求，仍缺乏充分的驗證。此外，究竟哪些人更可能抱持這些期望，以及這些親社會性期望應針對哪些對象展現，亦有待進一步探討。更重要的是，親社會期望不僅影響他人對老年人的觀感與待遇，更可能透過內化，進而影響老年人的自我認知與行為。社會規範如何內化為個人對老年人親社會性的看法，以及此過程在對社會規範偏差具有不同容忍度的文化（緊密型文化與鬆散型文化）中如何表現，皆有深入研究的價值。本研究項目旨在解決上述相關問題。 本研究項目旨在透過比較中國（香港，屬於緊密型文化）與瑞士（蘇黎世，屬於鬆散型文化），檢驗不同年齡層與文化背景下，社會大眾對於老年人親社會性期望的差異。研究一將採用大數據分析方法，探討中國與瑞士社會對於老年人親社會性的期望。研究二將比較不同年齡群體（年輕人、中年人與老年人）對於老年人在不同親疏程度的社會關係中，應如何展現親社會行為的期望是否存在差異，並深入探討文化緊密度／鬆散度所造成的影響。研究三將進一步檢驗社會規範內化如何影響這兩種文化中對於老年人親社會性的期望。

14617125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14617125.value: Prof Chien, Wai Tong Prof Chong, Yuen-yu Dr Fung, Hong Wang Dr Yeung, Chi Yan Cheryl

14617125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14617125.value: The escalating demands of end-of-life care highlight the indispensable role of family caregivers. These caregivers not only perform essential tasks but also shoulder a significant psychological burden, particularly in the form of compassion fatigue, which is a form of secondary traumatic stress that has long-term implications for both the family caregivers and the patients. Current support structures inadequately address this unique challenge, highlighting a pressing need for targeted interventions. This research proposal aims to assess the effectiveness of a trauma-informed Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (TIACT) program in alleviating compassion fatigue among family caregivers in end-of-life scenarios. Traditional applications of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) have shown promise in enhancing psychological flexibility, but they often lack a specialized focus on the specific traumatic stressors that end-of-life caregivers face. In response, this research proposes the development and evaluation of a trauma-informed ACT approach. Grounded in the Compassion Fatigue Process (CFP) model, TIACT aims to directly address the emotional and psychological toll that leads to compassion fatigue. By incorporating an understanding of trauma dynamics into ACT, TIACT offers a nuanced approach that targets secondary traumatic stress and complex ethical challenges intrinsic to end-of-life caregiving. A two-arm randomised controlled trial (RCT) will be employed to assess the efficacy of the TIACT program against a control group receiving treatment as usual. The objectives are to (1) examine the effectiveness of the trauma-informed ACT program on improving compassion fatigue (primary outcome) as compared to a control group receiving treatment as usual, and (2) evaluate the program’s effectiveness on caregiving burden, PTSD symptom severity, psychological flexibility, and general quality of life (secondary outcomes) among these family caregivers. Potential participants will be recruited by consecutive sampling. The estimated sample size is 150, with 75 subjects in both the treatment and control group. Participants in the treatment group will participate in an 8-week program rooted in TIACT program which will be conducted in weekly face-to-face group sessions. Participants in the control group will receive treatment as usual, in which the research team will provide self-help information on managing compassion fatigue to the participants. Process evaluation will be conducted using semi-structured interviews to evaluate the strengths, shortcomings, and therapeutic components of the TIACT. Our intervention will be a low-cost, easily accessible, and highly generalisable option which will fit within the stepped-care model in which low-intensity interventions and supports can be delivered at the population level. 14617325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14617325.value: 權衡之道：探討附加費用與帳戶創建對電商購物車放棄率與營收的影響

14617325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14617325.value: Prof Animesh, Animesh Prof Gumus, Mehmet

14617325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14617325.value: Despite booming global online retail sales, cart abandonment—where consumers add items to their shopping carts but leave without completing the purchase—continues to pose significant challenges for e-commerce platforms. This phenomenon not only results in direct revenue loss but also impacts platform operations extensively. This research aims to deepen our understanding of the two most pressing causes of cart abandonment, often overlooked in the existing literature: additional surcharges, particularly shipping surcharges, and the requirement to create an account. We will specifically focus on consumers who initially show the intention to purchase but ultimately decide to abandon their carts. To facilitate the research, we collaborate with a growing online grocery platform in North America that enables online consumers to purchase groceries from local suppliers, offering them various options for shipping methods and surcharges at checkout. The study will be conducted in two main phases, and Phase I involves three stages. In Phase I, stage 1, we employ a reduced-form regression to identify the overall impact of shipping surcharges and other related factors on cart abandonment among registered consumers. Due to potential endogeneity issues, in Phase I, Stage 2, we propose a dynamic structural model to quantify and understand how shipping surcharges affect consumers throughout their shopping journeys. In Phase I, Stage 3, we plan to use simulation-based techniques to help the platform identify more effective shipping strategies. The effectiveness of these strategies will subsequently be tested through randomized field experiments. In Phase II, we will expand our collaboration with the platform to gather data focusing on non-registered consumers. This phase aims to understand the impact of registration requirements on cart abandonment within a register-then-pay decision process. This research aims to bridge the gap between academic research and practical application by advancing the understanding of the primary causes of cart abandonment. Moreover, our findings will provide an opportunity for e-commerce platforms, including local platforms such as HKTV mall, to reassess their shipping surcharges. In the long run, our study can guide platforms to refine their account creation policy to enhance customer engagement, improve conversion rates, and boost financial performance. 儘管全球線上零售額蓬勃發展，但購物車放棄（消費者將商品添加到購物車但未完成購買就離開）問題仍然對電商平台構成重大挑戰。這種現像不僅導致直接收入損失，也對平台營運造成廣泛影響。本研究旨在加深我們對現有文獻中經常被忽視的兩個最緊迫的購物車放棄原因的理解：額外附加費，尤其是運費附加費，以及創建帳戶的要求。我們將特別關注那些最初有購買意願但最終決定放棄購物車的消費者。 為了方便研究，我們與北美一家蓬勃發展的線上雜貨平台合作，該平台允許線上消費者從本地供應商購買雜貨，並在結帳時提供多種配送方式和附加費選擇。研究將分兩個主要階段進行，第一階段包含三步。在第一階段第一步，我們採用簡化形式迴歸模型來確定運費附加費及其他相關因素對註冊消費者購物車放棄率的整體影響。由於潛在的內生性問題，在第一階段的第二步，我們提出了一個動態結構模型，用於量化和理解運費附加費如何影響消費者的購物旅程。在第一階段的第三步，我們計劃使用基於模擬的技術來幫助平台識別更有效的配送策略。這些策略的有效性隨後將透過隨機現場實驗進行測試。在第二階段，我們將擴大與平台的合作，收集未註冊消費者的資料。此階段旨在了解註冊要求在「註冊後付款」決策過程中對購物車放棄的影響。 本研究旨在透過加深對購物車放棄主要原因的理解，彌合學術研究與實際應用之間的差距。此外，我們的研究結果將為電商平台（包括像HKTV mall這樣的本地平台）提供重新評估其運費附加費的機會。從長遠來看，我們的研究可以指導平台改善其帳戶創建策略，以增強客戶參與度、提高轉換率並提升財務績效。

14618225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14618225.value: 以新型頻率跟隨反應測量探索生態化語境下的聲調加工：感知語境與注意力在自然及複雜聆聽環境中的角色

14618225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14618225.value: Humans engage with continuous speech in noisy real-world environments, where the perception of speech elements, such as lexical tones, is influenced by ongoing contexts and selective attention. However, one prominent neural measure for understanding lexical tone processing in tonal languages—the Frequency Following Response (FFR)—has primarily been conducted in quiet laboratory settings using isolated syllables without context. While traditional FFR methods provide valuable insights, they are time-consuming and fail to capture the complexity of real-world auditory experiences. These limitations are particularly significant given that FFR is linked to language development. Current FFR methods lack the efficiency and ecological validity needed to understand the mechanisms of speech perception in natural settings and to develop practical diagnostic applications that could benefit children with abnormal language development. This proposal, by addressing the limitations of traditional FFR methods, aims to advance our understanding of neural processing of lexical tones in Mandarin and Cantonese, two major tonal languages spoken in Hong Kong, within naturalistic listening environments—specifically, lexical tone processing in ongoing speech within noisy setting. In our preliminary research, using electroencephalography (EEG) recordings, we developed a machine learning-based encoding model, capable of capturing FFR signals across a broad frequency range within half an hour of naturalistic listening. Building on this preliminary finding, the study has two key objectives. First, we aim to use this FFR method to examine how sensory contexts in running speech of Mandarin and Cantonese influence lexical tone processing and compare it with traditional FFR measures. Second, we will explore how attention modulates lexical tone processing in complex environments, a multi-talker "cocktail party" scenario, where the brain must focus on specific speech streams amidst competing sounds. This proposal promises both novel scientific insights and practical relevance. By advancing FFR measurement techniques for tonal languages in natural settings, this project will provide an ecological understanding of speech processing mechanisms that complement the insights gained from analyzing isolated speech elements with traditional FFR methods. Practically, this innovative approach offers faster, more efficient, and ecologically valid measurements, making it possible to conduct quick FFR assessments outside the laboratory in daily environments. The outcomes of the proposed research will provide deeper insights into how Cantonese and Mandarin speech is understood in everyday contexts and pave the way for novel diagnostic tools that use FFR to address language development disorders, particularly in populations that rely on tonal language processing in Hong Kong. 人類日常生活中經常需要在嘈雜的真實環境中理解連續語音。在這些情境下，對語音要素（例如聲調）的感知會受到語境與選擇性注意的影響。然而，目前用於研究聲調加工的重要神經指標——頻率跟隨反應（Frequency Following Response, FFR），大多是在安靜的實驗室環境下，以缺乏語境的單音節進行測量。雖然傳統的 FFR 方法提供了寶貴的見解，但其測試耗時，且難以真實反映自然聆聽中的複雜性。由於 FFR 與語言發展密切相關，這些限制尤其值得關注。目前的 FFR 方法缺乏效率和生態效度，限制了我們理解自然環境中語音感知機制的能力，以及其在兒童語言發展障礙診斷上的應用潛力。 本研究計劃旨在突破傳統 FFR 方法的限制，推進我們對普通話與廣東話（香港兩大主要聲調語言）在自然化聆聽環境中聲調加工的神經機制的理解，特別是研究在嘈雜語境下連續語音的聲調處理。在前期研究中，我們利用腦電圖（EEG）紀錄，開發了一種基於機器學習的編碼模型，能夠在半小時的自然化聆聽中提取涵蓋寬頻率範圍的 FFR 訊號。基於這一成果，本研究有兩個核心目標：第一，利用該方法檢驗普通話與廣東話的連續語音中，感知語境如何影響聲調加工，並與傳統 FFR 測量進行比較；第二，探討注意力在複雜環境中的作用，即在多說話者的「雞尾酒會」情境下，大腦如何專注於特定語音流並忽略競爭性聲音。 這項研究不僅具備重要的科學意義，亦具有實際應用價值。透過改進 FFR 測量方法，使其更快速、高效並具備生態效度，本計劃將有助於在實驗室外的日常環境中進行快速 FFR 測試。研究成果將深化我們對廣東話與普通話在日常情境下理解機制的認識，並為發展基於 FFR 的創新診斷工具奠定基礎，特別能為依賴聲調加工的兒童語言發展障礙提供全新的評估手段。

14618825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14618825.value: 建立韌力對抗氣溫上升 - 高強度間歇運動（HIIE）對耐熱性、體溫調節適應及體能的影響：一項比較隨機對照試驗

14618825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14618825.value: Prof Huang, Wendy Yajun Prof Siu, Parco Ming-Fai Prof Wong, Martin Chi Sang

14618825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14618825.value: Rising global temperatures and the increasing frequency of extreme heat events pose significant health risks, particularly for individuals with low physical fitness, sedentary behavior, and impaired thermoregulatory capacity. Developing lifestyle strategies to enhance heat resilience among the general population is therefore an important public health priority. High-intensity interval exercise (HIIE) has gained widespread popularity as an evidence-based, time-efficient exercise strategy for the public in recent years. While the efficacy of HIIE in promoting cardiometabolic health and fitness in less active individuals has been demonstrated (e.g., in the PI's previous work), its potential benefits in inducing rapid physiological adaptations that may enhance heat tolerance and resilience remain largely unexplored. This randomized controlled study aims to address the abovementioned research gaps by examining the effects of HIIE, compared to conventional exercise modalities, on heat tolerance, thermoregulatory adaptation, and physical fitness in a non-active general population cohort. A total of 100 healthy, physically inactive participants will be randomly assigned to one of four groups: 1) HIIE, 2) conventional moderate-intensity continuous exercise (MICE), 3) light-intensity walking (WALK) or, 4) a non-exercise control group (CON). Participants in the exercise groups will go through health screening and engage in their respective exercise programs 3 times per week for 12 weeks. Assessments will take place in a controlled environment designed to simulate heat stress (i.e., climatic chamber at 30°C and 70% relative humidity). Participants will undergo evaluations at baseline, mid-intervention (6 weeks), postintervention (immediately after intervention), and 4-month after postintervention to assess changes in thermoregulatory responses and physical fitness. Primary outcomes will include exercise tolerance capacity under heat, thermoregulatory biomarkers (heat shock protein), core and skin temperature, sweat rate, and heart rate variability. Secondary outcomes will assess overall physical fitness including cardiorespiratory fitness, muscular function and body composition, as well as psycho-perceptual responses and exercise adherence. The scientific findings from this research will provide valuable insights to the government and allied health professionals, aiding in the development of evidence-based exercise interventions to enhance individual resilience in a warming climate. By identifying optimal exercise modalities for improving heat resilience, this study can significantly promote health and safety among the general population in Hong Kong and globally amidst increasing environmental challenges. 全球氣溫持續攀升，極端酷熱天氣事件日益頻繁，對體能欠佳、久坐少動及體溫調節功能較弱人士構成重大健康威脅。在此背景下，為普羅大眾制訂有效提升耐熱適應能力的生活策略，已成為公共衛生領域的當務之急。近年來，高強度間歇訓練（HIIE）憑藉其科學實證基礎與時間效益優勢，逐漸發展成為備受推崇的大眾健身方式。雖然過往研究（包括項目負責人先前工作）已證實HIIE對改善靜態生活人群心代謝健康與體能水平的顯著功效，但該訓練模式能否誘導人體產生快速生理適應機制，從而增強耐熱能力與氣候適應韌性，至今仍是待解之謎。 本研究採用隨機對照試驗設計，旨在系統比較HIIE與傳統運動模式對非活躍人群耐熱性、體溫調節適應能力及綜合體能指標的影響效果。研究計劃招募100名健康但缺乏規律運動的受試者，隨機分配至高強度間歇訓練組（HIIE）、傳統中等強度持續運動組（MICE）、低強度步行組（WALK）及非運動對照組（CON）。所有運動組受試者須先完成健康篩查，其後進行為期12週、每週3次的指定訓練方案。為準確評估訓練效果，研究將在嚴格控制的熱壓力環境（人工氣候室設定為30°C溫度與70%相對濕度）中進行系列測試，分別於訓練前、訓練中期（第6週）、訓練結束時及結束後4個月追蹤期，全面監測受試者體溫調節功能與體能指標的動態變化。 研究主要觀察指標包括高溫環境下的運動耐受能力、熱休克蛋白等體溫調節相關生物標記水平、核心體溫與皮膚溫度變化趨勢、出汗效率及心率變異性等生理參數。同時亦將系統評估受試者的整體體能狀況，涵蓋心肺適能、肌肉功能表現、體成分變化等客觀指標，以及運動過程中的心理感知反應與長期訓練依從性等行為學數據。 本項研究成果將為特區政府衛生部門與醫療專業團隊提供重要科學參考，助力制訂基於實證基礎的氣候適應性運動處方。通過釐清不同運動模式對提升人體耐熱韌性的相對效益，本研究不僅對強化香港市民應對氣候暖化的適應能力具有現實意義，更可為全球各地面臨類似環境挑戰的城巿提供可借鑒的公共健康干預方案。在極端天氣事件日益頻密的當下，此類前沿性研究對保障大眾健康安全、提升社會整體氣候適應韌性，具有深遠的戰略價值。

14619725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14619725.value: 胡塞爾現象學中的表徵與意識

14619725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14619725.value: This research project explores whether the notion of representation has a place in Husserl’s account of consciousness. While I agree with scholars who argue that Husserl would reject both weak and strong forms of representationalism, I also contend that a specific concept of representation plays a crucial role in his theory of intentionality. The project consists of four papers: 1. “The Notions of Repräsentation in Early Husserl”: Husserl used several German terms translated into English as “representation,” yet no systematic study has examined their connections and distinctions. This paper clarifies Husserl’s different notions of Repräsentation, focusing on two key texts: "Psychological Studies in the Elements of Logic" and §44 of the Fifth Logical Investigation. Importantly, Husserl distinguishes between “representation” as Vergegenwärtigung and “representation” as full content. The latter concept is “more primitive” and can be reconstructed as a crucial part of Husserl’s general account of intentionality. 2. “Husserl and Representationalism”: After a clarification of the different senses of “representationalism”, this paper refutes the claim that Husserl is a representationalist about consciousness. It shows that Husserl lacks the motivations typical of representationalism, such as the transparency of experience and reductionism. It also argues that it arises from the confusion of Husserl's two senses of consciousness. Lastly, it contends that viewing Husserl as a weak representationalist conflicts with his principle of experiential flux, which holds that the contents of the stream of consciousness are in continuous change from one moment to the next. 3. “Husserl and Anti-Representationalism”: This paper compares Husserl's anti-representationalism with Papineau’s “qualitative view.” It also argues against inseparatist interpretations of Husserl and show that Husserl's distinction between qualitative experience and intentionality is central to his rejection of empiricism. 4. “Revisiting Husserl’s Critique of Brentano’s Conception of Intentionality”: This paper addresses the issue from a new perspective: Husserl’s general theory of representation as outlined in (1). It argues that the fundamental difference between Brentano and Husserl lies in Brentano’s failure to recognize that intentional objects must be apprehended or constituted, not merely given. It also demonstrates that Husserl’s tripartite account of intentionality surpasses standard representationalism and Tim Crane’s impure intentionalism.

14620225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14620225.value: 中國的塑料現代性： 塑料產品、 廣告、技術和消費 1960-1990

14620225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14620225.value: Plastic has radically transformed our modern daily lives, from household electronics, kitchen wares to furniture. For many decades, the material development of plastic has been associated with scientific progress, industrial take-off, a culture of modernity, even a design revolution in the West. While China remains the biggest plastic production country in the world, the ways the materiality of plastic has shaped people’s everyday life, urban consumer culture and industrial development is yet to be thoroughly investigated. This research weaves together history of plastic, history of industrial and technological design, consumer culture and China studies. It contributes to an understanding of plastic as an industrial material and an everyday visual design, shaped by specific political ideologies and technological developments. The research investigates the kinds of plastic modernity differentially configured across the Hong Kong China border. How did plastic figure in Chinese people’s lives when the malleable material enter this part of the continent? What were the major plastic products and how were they promoted and narrated in specific socio-politico regime? After 1949, the Communist party-state rose to power and started nationalization of the economy. Hong Kong became the major plastic manufacturing hub producing all kinds of plastic products for the world. Plastic flowers pedals and stems, for instance, were major products that brought hundreds and thousands of women and kids to informally work in the colonial city. At around the same time, plastic flower was also a signature product by the Guangzhou Zhujiang or Pearl River state-owned enterprise but media promotion of it was related to the rhetoric of the people and workers. This research examines the images and politics of plastics in both Hong Kong and mainland China by contextualizing them in different political and cultural milieus from the mid 1960s to 1990s. The purpose of this research is threefold 1) to enrich the understanding of culture and politics of plastic by examining the industrial advertising and design representations of selected plastic products 2) to examine the technological transformation of plastic by analyzing the ways in which the technology and production narratives were influenced by different political regimes and socio-economic needs across the Hong Kong China border 3) to contribute to the socio-cultural history of plastics by analyzing how the new material was used and related to different forms of urban identity in modern China. 塑膠徹底改變了我們現代的日常生活，從家用電子產品、廚具到家具。數十年來，塑膠材料的發展一直與科學進步、工業起飛、現代文化，甚至是西方的設計革命密切相關。中國雖然仍是全球最大的塑膠生產國，但塑膠的材質如何影響人們的日常生活、城市消費文化及工業發展，尚未被深入探討。本研究將塑膠歷史、工業與技術設計史、消費文化及中國研究結合，致力於理解塑膠作為工業材料及日常視覺設計的角色，並探討其如何受到特定政治意識形態與技術發展的形塑。本研究調查塑膠現代性在香港與中國內地地區所展現的差異。 當這種可塑性材料進入中國大陸時，塑膠如何融入中國人的生活？主要的塑膠產品是什麼？在特定的社會政治體制下，這些產品又是如何被推廣和敘述？1949年後，中共政權崛起，開始推行經濟國有化。香港成為主要的塑膠製造中心，生產各類塑膠產品供應全球市場。例如，塑膠花瓣與花枝是重要產品，吸引了數以百計的婦女和兒童在殖民城市從事非正式工作。大約同時期，廣州的珠江國有企業也以塑膠花作為代表性產品，但其媒體宣傳更強調「人民」與「工人」的論述。 本研究通過將塑膠的形象與政治置於不同政治與文化環境中，考察1960年代中期至1990年代的香港與中國內地。研究目的有三：第一，通過分析選定塑膠產品的工業廣告與設計表現，深化對塑膠文化與政治的理解；第二，通過分析技術及生產敘述如何受到不同政治體制與社會經濟需求影響，檢視塑膠技術的轉型；第三，通過探討新材料在現代中國城市身份中的運用與關聯，對塑膠的社會文化歷史作出貢獻。

14620425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14620425.value: 得益、徒勞或痛苦：中國家庭場域內家長參與對學生教育與健康的影響

14620425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14620425.value: Parental involvement in education is critical to students’ acquisition of human, social, and cultural capital. As such, it has become a global phenomenon, particularly in China following the introduction of the Family Education Promotion Law in 2021. Despite a vast body of literature on parental involvement and student outcomes, findings remain inconsistent, with at least four unresolved limitations. First, regarding the occurrence of parental involvement, the existing reactive hypothesis focuses on how parental involvement changes when students’ academic performance declines, while overlooking a more logically reasonable factor – whether students perform below parental expectations/requirements. Second, existing studies often lack a consistent theoretical framework to differentiate between various types of parental involvement (i.e., parental help, communication, and regulation), leading to inconsistent findings about both the signs and the magnitude of the relationship between parental involvement and student outcomes. Third, it remains debatable, especially in the Chinese context, whether parental involvement matters more for advantaged students (i.e., the advantage multiplication hypothesis) or disadvantaged students (i.e., advantage compensation hypothesis). Fourth, research on whether early parental involvement has long-term relationships with students’ educational and health outcomes in adulthood (i.e., the critical period hypothesis) or whether its significance diminishes over time (i.e., the diminished significance hypothesis) has been scant. To address these limitations, this study focuses on home-based involvement, investigating four research questions. First, does parental involvement increase when students perform below parents’ expectations? Second, what are the relationships (i.e., gain/positive, vain/neutral, or pain/negative) between different types of parental involvement and students’ educational and health outcomes? Third, do these relationships exhibit heterogeneities between high- and low-SES students, as well as between high- and low-performing students? Fourth, over the long term, is parental involvement associated with educational and health outcomes in adulthood, and do these long-term relationships exhibit heterogeneities between high- and low-SES students, and/or between high-and low-performing students? I will combine fixed-effects models and structural equation models to analyze two large-scale longitudinal datasets – the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS, 2013-2014, 2014-2015) and the Gansu Survey of Children and Families (GSCF, 2000, 2004, 2015). The results will address the various theoretical debates on the occurrence, short-and long-term implications, and heterogeneity of parental involvement. Practically, they will shed light on the diverse relationships between parental involvement and student outcomes in different contexts, and for different students. This will provide more scientific guidance for both involvement practices and policy intervention. 家長參與教育對於學生的人力資本、社會資本和文化資本的獲得至關重要。因此，它已成為一種全球性的現象，尤其是在中國，自2021年《家庭教育促進法》出台以來更是引發廣泛關注。儘管關於家長參與與學生發展之間關係的研究文獻已經十分豐富，但研究發現仍不一致，至少存在四個尚未解決的局限。 首先，在家長參與的發生機制方面，現有的“反應假說”主要關注當學生學業表現下降時家長如何做出反應，而忽視了一個在邏輯上更為合理的因素——即學生的表現是否低於家長期望或要求。第二，現有研究常缺乏統一的理論框架來區分不同類型的家長參與（如家長幫助、溝通與管教），這導致關於家長參與與學生結果之間的關係在方向和效應大小上都存在不一致。第三，尤其在中國情境下，家長參與對哪些學生更有益仍存在爭議：是對優勢學生更有幫助（優勢累積假說），還是對劣勢學生更具補償作用（優勢補償假說）？第四，對於早期家長參與是否與成年階段的教育與健康結果存在長期關係（關鍵期假說），抑或其重要性隨時間推移而逐漸減弱（重要性遞減假說），現有研究仍較為稀缺。 為解決上述局限，本研究聚焦於場域內的家長參與，圍繞四個核心問題展開探討。第一，當學生表現低於家長期望時，家長是否會增加參與？第二，不同類型的家長參與與學生的教育和健康結果之間分別呈現何種關係（即收益／正向、中性或傷害／負向）？第三，這些關係在高社會經濟地位與低社會經濟地位學生之間、高表現與低表現學生之間是否存在異質性？第四，從長期來看，家長參與是否與成年階段的教育和健康結果相關？這些長期關係是否在不同社會經濟地位或學業表現水平的學生中存在異質性？ 本研究將結合固定效應模型與結構方程模型，分析兩個大型縱向調查數據——中國教育追蹤調查（CEPS，2013-2014、2014-2015）和甘肅兒童與家庭調查（GSCF，2000、2004、2015）。研究結果將回應關於家長參與的發生機制、短期與長期作用機制以及作用異質性的多項理論爭議。在實踐層面，研究將揭示家長參與在不同情境與不同學生群體中與學生發展之間的多樣化關係，從而為家長實踐與政策干預提供更具科學性的指導。

14621525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14621525.value: 重新思考“基建黃金時代”：透過基建工程敘述香港城市歷史

14621525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14621525.value: In recent years, infrastructure has emerged as a key research subject in critical urban studies. By examining how varied infrastructures were planned, constructed, managed, and used in different geopolitical contexts, these works have revealed uneven patterns of socio-spatial development, changing rationalities of public-private investment, and the production of aspirations and disenfranchisements among citizens. This research builds on this scholarship by tracing the histories of infrastructure development in Hong Kong through three projects that transformed the territory’s physical landscapes and reshaped urban life: the Cross Harbour Tunnel completed in 1972, Mass Transit Railway completed in 1979, and Plover Cove Reservoir completed in 1968. Along with other initiatives, these schemes have been portrayed in popular narratives as engineering feats that ushered Hong Kong into a global modern city in the 1970s and 1980s, earning this period the name “golden age of construction.” Although infrastructure continues to captivate the public imagination in Hong Kong, the disposition towards large-scale development has turned more critical over the last decade. Emergent concerns over environmental protection, resource redistribution, and territorial integration have incited new debates over the long-term sustainability of infrastructure initiatives and calls for greater transparency in decision-making. These concerns have ironically enhanced the positive connotations of infrastructure enacted in earlier eras, where the “golden age of construction” takes on new historical significance as a distinct period of modernization and social progress that contrasts sharply against an increasingly politicized present. This research challenges the synchronic interpretations of Hong Kong's history by investigating the processes of infrastructure, which is defined not as a set of stable, well-bounded objects but as an assemblage through which new social-material relationships are continuously generated. Using a range of archival sources combined with interviews of key personnel involved in the conception and operation of the projects, the research will illustrate the “state-of-becoming” of each scheme and the ongoing challenges in sustaining their technical, economic, and symbolic performance. Crucially, the inquiry will elucidate how infrastructure provisions have contributed to the production of new knowledge and expertise and the shaping of the public realm, which, taken together, became the basis for constructing Hong Kong’s urban identity and new social imaginaries. Ultimately, this historical analysis will enable critical reflections on the role of infrastructure as a technology of government and the political rationalities underpinning Hong Kong’s urban development in the past and present. 近年來，基建工程已成為批判性城市研究中的一個重要課題。通過考察不同地緣政治背景下各類基建設施的規劃、建設、管理和使用，這些研究揭示了社會空間發展的不均衡格局、公共和私人投資的邏輯轉變，以及公民願景被排擠等問題。本研究在此基礎上，考察香港基建工程發展的歷史，聚焦於三個改變了香港城市景觀並重塑市民生活的項目：1972年竣工的海底隧道、1979年竣工的地下鐵路，以及1968年竣工的船灣淡水湖。這些項目與其他舉措一道，在一般敘事中被描繪為工程壯舉，推動了香港在1970至1980年代邁向全球化與現代化，因此這一時期被稱為“基建黃金時代”。 儘管基建工程在香港仍持續引發公眾想象，人們對大型發展項目的態度在過去十多年開始變得有所保留。對環境保護、資源再分配及區域整合的新關注，引發了關於基建設施項目可持續性的討論，以及對決策過程更高透明度的呼聲。諷刺的是，這些擔憂反而加強了對早期基建工程的懷緬，使“基建黃金時代”作為代表香港戰後現代化與社會進步的時期，在當今日益政治化的環境下被賦予了新的歷史意義與價值。 本研究通過考察香港基建工程的發展過程，重新思考城市的空間演變與歷史。在這研究裡，基建設施並非被視為一套穩定且界限清晰的個體，而是作為一種不斷互動的社會—物質關係。研究將結合多種檔案資料及對相關項目策劃與運營關鍵人員的訪談，揭示每個項目的“生成狀態”及其在維繫技術、經濟與象徵性績效方面所面臨的持續挑戰。至關重要的是，研究將闡明基建工程如何促成專業技能與新知識的形成，如何塑造了新的公共領域，以及鞏固了香港城市身份與新社會想象的基礎。最終，這一歷史分析將有助於對基建工程作為治理技術及其背後政治邏輯的批判性反思，審視其在香港城市發展的過去、現在與未來的持續影響。

14621925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14621925.value: 優化微氣候資料代表性評估：從理論提煉到城市微氣候研究實踐

14621925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14621925.value: In the context of accelerating urbanization, well-executed and reliable microclimate studies have become crucial for understanding the urban environment to determine the appropriate planning and design actions. Many researchers around the world are conducting urban microclimate studies. Many studies are case-based short-term field or simulation campaigns. Based on their respective studies, researchers propose action recommendations for industry stakeholders. However, the climatic representativeness of these short-term research efforts is mostly missing or ignored. Thus, any action recommendation made may not be comprehensive enough to represent the diverse climatic conditions of the areas under study. Not addressing this issue of climatic “representativeness” limits the reliability and applicability of short-term, case-based urban microclimate studies. Our pilot research introduced a weather data evaluation framework based on the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) statistic to quantify the “representativeness” of short-term meteorological data towards long-term climate (Gao et al., 2024). While this approach shows initial promise, the following improvements may be needed for the framework’s wider technical application: A) The concept of "temporal representativeness of long-term climate" in microclimate research, being relatively new, requires quantification and refinement, including the determination of critical empirical parameters. B) The framework needs simplification for practical application while maintaining its effectiveness. There is a need to conduct further performance & sensitivity testing. C) The feasibility of developing a prognostic framework to guide researchers selecting more representative conditions for the field studies and simulation. This proposed study aims to address these challenges by: A) Refine the quantitative definition of "temporal representativeness of long-term climate" and determine critical empirical parameters within the framework. This involves analyzing sensitivity to various factors such as seasons, weather variable combinations, and climate types, as well as urban surface characteristics. B) Developing simplified methods based on easy-to-access weather variables that achieve comparable performance to the sophisticated approach. And C) Establish a prognostic framework capable of predicting the representativeness of future measurement days, utilizing weather forecasting data and probability models, using Hong Kong as a primary case study. The proposed climatic “representativeness” framework will provide researchers a scientific basis of quantifying, describing and assessing the scope and limits of their studies when making action recommendations. Based on this understanding, stakeholders can make more context-reliable and appropriate decisions. In addition, any conflicting study results may be harmonized and collated to become a more comprehensive picture based on their respective representativeness of different climatic circumstances. 在城市化進程加速的背景下，進行高效可靠的微氣候研究對於理解城市環境、確定合適的規劃和設計措施至關重要。 世界各地許多研究人員正在進行城市微氣候研究。許多研究是基於案例的短期實地或模擬活動。研究人員基於各自的研究成果，為產業利害關係人提出行動建議。然而，這些短期研究的氣候代表性大多缺失或被忽略。因此，任何提出的行動建議都可能不夠全面，無法代表研究區域多樣化的氣候條件。不解決氣候「代表性」問題，會限制短期、以案例為基礎的城市微氣候研究的可靠性和適用性。 我們的先導研究引入了一個基於柯爾莫哥洛夫-斯米爾諾夫（KS）統計量的氣象資料評估框架，用於量化短期氣象資料對長期氣候的「代表性」（Gao等人，2024）。雖然該方法初步顯示出良好的前景，但為了使其在技術上得到更廣泛的應用，可能需要進行以下改進：A）微氣候研究中「長期氣候的時間代表性」概念相對較新，需要進行量化和細化，包括確定關鍵的經驗參數。 B）該框架需要在保持其有效性的同時進行簡化，以便於實際應用。有必要進行進一步的性能和敏感性測試。 C）發展一個預測框架的可行性，以指導研究人員為實地研究和模擬選擇更具代表性的條件。 本研究旨在透過以下方式應對這些挑戰：A）完善「長期氣候的時間代表性」的定量定義，並確定框架內的關鍵經驗參數。這涉及分析對各種因素（例如季節、天氣變數組合、氣候類型以及城市地表特徵）的敏感性。 B）基於易於獲取的天氣變量，開發簡化方法，以實現與複雜方法相當的性能。 C）利用天氣預報資料和機率模型，以香港為主要案例研究，建立一個能夠預測未來測量日代表性的預測架構。 所提出的氣候「代表性」框架將為研究人員提供科學依據，以便在提出行動建議時量化、描述和評估其研究的範圍和限制。基於此，利害關係人可以做出更可靠、更合適的決策。此外，任何相互矛盾的研究結果都可以根據其對不同氣候狀況的代表性進行協調和整理，形成更全面的圖像。

14622425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14622425.value: 神祇、神山與「象形文字」：翻譯中國西南一則多語言、多族群的「Saiddo」儀式文本

14622425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14622425.value: The Naxi people of southwest China celebrate their national deity, Saiddo, through a significant three-day festival that highlights their cultural and spiritual landscape. Saiddo is believed to be an incarnation of the Jade Dragon Mountain that rises above Lijiang, the capital of the Naxi community. This festival, known in Chinese as Sanduo Jie (三朵节/三多节), stands as the most important indigenous celebration of the Naxi calendar. Central to the festival is the ceremonial worship of Saiddo, orchestrated by the Naxi religious specialists, the dongba. During the festival, these dongba perform rituals that include reading from special pictographic texts and making offerings to Saiddo in exchange for blessings. Despite the significance of these texts, they remain enigmatic; efforts to translate them have been ongoing since the 1940s, starting with the renowned botanist and anthropologist Joseph Rock. These efforts have consistently encountered difficulties, partly due to the Saiddo texts' multilingual composition which includes elements of neighbouring Bai and Tibetan languages—languages with which the Naxi ritualists are not typically familiar. The festival and its associated rituals connect Saiddo not only to the Naxi but also to historical figures and deities from neighbouring cultures, including a legendary Tibetan king and a Bai household deity. This intertwining of cultural narratives underscores the complex cultural interactions in Yunnan province. Addressing the challenge of translating these important texts, this project proposes a new approach: a collaborative, multilingual, and multiethnic effort to decipher the manuscripts. By forming a team that includes specialists native to the languages represented in the texts alongside Naxi ritualists, there is potential to finally unlock the meanings preserved in these pictographs. Deciphering the Saiddo texts is important for the dongba specialists and the broader Naxi community who celebrate Saiddo every year. The ethnic tourism boom has risked the commodification of culture, but restoring the textual meaning of the manuscripts may help preserve some of the traditional elements of the ritual celebrations. The project is also important for the academic field of Naxi studies: it promises to shed light on the multilingual textual practices among the ethnic groups of Yunnan. This collaborative translation project thus represents an exciting frontier in terms of both cultural preservation and academic research, offering new insights into Naxi cultural heritage and its relationship with the natural landscape. 中國西南的納西族透過為期三日的盛大節慶，來慶祝其民族守護神「Saiddo」，此節慶彰顯了他們獨特的文化與精神地景。Saiddo被認為是聳立於納西社群核心地區麗江之上的玉龍雪山化身。這個節慶在中文裡稱為「三朵節」（亦作三多節），是納西曆法中最為重要的本土節慶。 節慶的核心，是由納西族的宗教祭司「東巴」所主持的Saiddo祭拜儀式。在節慶期間，東巴會舉行儀式，包含誦讀特殊的象形文字經書，並向Saiddo獻上祭品以求庇佑。儘管這些經書意義重大，至今卻依舊神秘難解；相關的翻譯工作自1940年代便持續進行，由知名的植物學家兼人類學家約瑟夫・洛克（Joseph Rock）開啟先河。這些努力持續面臨困難，部分原因在於Saiddo文本的多語言組成，其中包含鄰近白族與藏族的語言元素，而這些語言通常並非納西祭司所熟悉。 此節慶及其相關儀式，不僅將Saiddo與納西族連結，也將其與鄰近文化中的歷史人物及神祇聯繫起來，包括一位傳奇的藏王和一位白族的家神。這種文化敘事的交織，凸顯了雲南省複雜的文化互動。 為應對此翻譯挑戰，本計畫提出一種新方法：即透過合作、多語言、多族群的方式來解讀這些手稿。藉由組建一個團隊，成員不僅包含納西祭司，也納入以文本中出現的語言為母語的專家，將有望最終解開封存於這些象形文字中的意涵。 對於每年慶祝Saiddo的東巴祭司與廣大的納西社群而言，解讀Saiddo文本至關重要。民族旅遊業的蓬勃發展帶來了文化商品化的風險，但恢復手稿的文本意義，將有助於保存儀式慶典中的部分傳統元素。此計畫對於納西學的學術領域同樣重要，它有望闡明雲南各族群間的多語言文本實踐。因此，此合作翻譯計畫無論在文化保存或學術研究上，都代表了一個令人振奮的前沿領域，為深入理解納西族的文化遺產及其與自然景觀的關係，提供了嶄新的視角。

14623125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14623125.value: 基督教多樣性的呈現：香港新界傳道會的歷史研究

14623125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14623125.value: Most extant material on missionary activity in Hong Kong focuses on the initial arrival of European missionaries in the early periods of the colony, when its geographical area only encompasses Hong Kong Island and Kowloon south of Boundary street. They may have come to convert the population of Hong Kong, or use it as a springboard to spread the Gospel to China itself, nonetheless they often ended up playing roles in secular fields as well as spiritual ones, with prominent names including Gutzlaff and Legge. Nonetheless, there is much less material available on missionary activity in the New Territories save for footnotes in the faith’s development in the colony. This study aims to rectify that by studying the activities of Hong Kong and New Territory Evangelisation Society (HKNTES) to understand the dynamics of this second stage of Christianity in Hong Kong, as the HKNTES is a local-led organisation focused on the New Territories. This would lead to further insights on how tenets of the faith adapt to local situations in a colonial context. It would examine the processes of indigenisation throughout the organisational level by archival material and textual analysis. On a comparative level, this study would complement “first-contact” studies in missiology and provide material for the mechanisms of incorporating native agents in an enterprise originally spearheaded by those with a foreign origin, to add to the understanding of how features present in Hong Kong at the time are comparable with other localities with similar background, such as southern China due to cultural and geographical proximities. 現存的香港傳教活動資料大多集中於殖民地初期歐洲傳教士初次抵港，他們的足跡主要涵蓋界限街以南的香港島和九龍。他們來港的目的或許是為了皈依香港的民眾，或以此為跳板，將福音傳播到中國本土，但最終，他們往往在世俗和精神領域都扮演著重要的角色，其中不乏著名人物，例如郭實臘和理雅各。然而，關於新界傳教活動的資料少之又少。本研究旨在透過研究香港新界傳道會（HKNTES）了解香港基督教第二階段的動態。香港新界傳道會是1898年英國租借新界後，一個由本地主導、專注於新界傳道組織。1933年正式結束，並將有關新界傳道事工轉移至當時的中華基督教會廣東協會第六區會。這個歷史研究將有助於進一步理解信仰信條如何在殖民地背景下調節和展現基督教的多樣性。本研究將透過檔案資料和文本分析，檢視整個組織層面的本土化。這歷史研究將補充香港基督教傳教事業中的「首次接觸」研究，並探看最初由外籍人士主導的傳道事業經聘用本土傳道同工下的本土化實踐，並與其他具有類似背景的地區（例如因文化和地理位置接近而形成的華南地區）進行比較。

14623425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14623425.value: 單語及雙語兄弟姊妹中的「輸入稀釋」和「輸入補充」

14623425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14623425.value: Dr Deng, Xiangjun Dr Pang, Vanessa Prof Yip, Virginia Choy Yin

14623425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14623425.value: With the end of the one-child policy, children in China are beginning to grow up with siblings again, with many of them bilingual in their home language/dialect and in the school/majority language. Previous studies of mostly Western populations show that language development of secondborn toddlers is sometimes slower than firstborns, probably because parents with multiple children have to split their time and attention between children, leading to “dilution” of the language input directed to each child. This dilution can have a larger negative impact on the younger sibling, since parental (especially maternal) input often constitutes the main source of language input for the youngest children. However, new evidence has suggested that some secondborns are able to outperform age-matched firstborns, likely because the older siblings in these cases have provided helpful language input for the younger sibling, potentially compensating for the diluted input from the parents and boosting language development of the secondborns (“input supplementation”). Nevertheless, existing studies have only been able to provide indirect evidence for input dilution and supplementation, and the focus has been on monolingual siblings. Important variables such as language proficiency and relationship of the siblings have not been systematically investigated or controlled for. Sibling input as a major factor in early language development and bilingualism has been overlooked. The proposed study fills the theoretical and empirical gap and addresses new societal needs by investigating input dilution and supplementation in monolingual (Mandarin) and bilingual (Cantonese-Mandarin, Cantonese-English) siblings in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, China. We will recruit 120 mother-firstborn-secondborn triads with closely-spaced siblings between ages 3 and 9, controlling for gender of the firstborn and factoring in the siblings’ language proficiency and relationship. Parental report and direct observation of dyadic and triadic free play will be employed to measure aspects of input dilution and supplementation in the status quo. An innovative “treasure-hunt game” paradigm will be developed to explore the potential of the firstborn as an input provider in conditions optimized for sibling interaction. The elicited language samples will interface smoothly with AI-assisted transcription pipelines and allow analyses of multilingual input at fine-grained linguistic, conceptual and interactional levels. The proposed project is a sequel to the PI’s on-going RGC projects to study the complex and dynamic linguistic environment of young children and its role in language acquisition, and to construct open-access databases to benefit the research community. 隨著中國內地獨生子女政策的終止，許多家庭又迎來了年幼的兄弟姊妹。在較年幼的手足出生時，不少較年長的手足已經在家庭和學校環境中掌握了不同程度的雙語能力（例如中文和英文，或中國方言和普通話）。先前以西方人口為主的研究表明，第二子女（次胎）在幼年時期的語言發展有時會稍遜於第一子女（頭胎），這可能源於多子女父母不得不將時間和注意力分配給各個子女，導致每個子女獲得的語言輸入被「稀釋」。這種稀釋對同一家庭中較年幼子女的負面影響可能更大，因為幼兒最主要的語言輸入通常來自父母（尤其是母親）。然而，新的研究證據顯示，部分第二子女的語言發展有可能超越第一子女在同齡時的表現，這很可能是因為年長手足為年幼手足提供了有益的語言輸入，從而抵消了父母輸入的稀釋效應，並促進了年幼手足的語言發展（「輸入補充」）。但現有研究僅能提供關於輸入稀釋與補充的間接證據，且主要關注單語環境中的兄弟姊妹，尚未對語言熟練度、手足關係等重要變量進行系統的研究或控制。作為早期語言發展和雙語習得的關鍵因素，年長手足的語言輸入的作用被長期忽視。 本研究將考察中國香港和深圳的單語（普通話）與雙語（粵語-普通話、粵語-英語）家庭中第一子女和第二子女的語言互動，旨在填補這一理論與實證空白，同時回應新的社會訴求。我們將招募120組「母親-第一子女-第二子女」的三人組合（第二子女年齡為3-9歲，且與第一子女的年齡間隔較小），在控制第一子女的性別變量的同時，將手足各自的語言能力以及手足關係納入分析框架。我們將邀請家長進行訪談，並直接觀察雙人/三人自由遊戲時的語言互動，以評估第二子女所獲實際語言輸入的稀釋與補充狀況。同時，我們將開發創新的「尋寶遊戲」實驗範式，探索年長的子女在手足協作活動中擔當語言輸入提供者的潛力。所採集的語言樣本將與AI輔助轉錄系統無縫對接，從微觀語言特徵、認知概念表達和人際互動模式等多個層面對多語言輸入進行精細化考察。 本研究計劃是首席研究員現時正在進行的香港研究資助局「優配研究金」和「傑出青年學者計劃」項目的延伸研究。這三項研究計劃之間緊密關聯，旨在從不同維度探究幼兒所處的複雜多變的語言環境對早期語言習得的影響，並建設開源數據庫以惠及學界。

14624725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14624725.value: 語義距離如何驅動實時語句解讀——漢語話題句的理論及認知神經研究

14624725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14624725.value: Prof Feng, Rui Prof Lu, Shuo

14624725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14624725.value: Chinese language is known for its reliance on semantic factors rather than overt syntactic markers. The topic-comment sentence structure exemplifies this characteristic, often violating syntactic rules like island conditions while adhering to semantic conditions such as aboutness condition (Chafe, 1976). This prevalence of topic-comment constructions has led to Chinese being classified as a topic-prominent language, in contrast to subject-prominent languages like English (Li and Thompson, 1981). This project aims to investigate how and to what extent semantic factors influence the generation and comprehension of Chinese sentences, focusing on topic-comment constructions. We propose a multi-faceted approach combining theoretical analyses and neurocognitive experimental methods. In the theoretical part, we will develop a formal semantic framework to analyze the impact of semantic relationship on the interpretability of sentences and their interaction with syntax. Building on our previous findings about semantic licensing (Pan & Hu, 2008, Lu & Pan, 2014), we hypothesize that lexical semantic distance plays a more prominent role in constructing Chinese topic sentences, driving real-time interpretation across various linguistic levels, including morphemes, words, phrases, and sentences. We define semantic distance and extract the metrics from the following three dimensions: 1) Topic-cue distance between the topic and the nominal word carrying the key information in the comment; 2) Content word distance between any two content words; 3) Dynamic integration distance cumulatively refreshing along online sentence integration. To quantify these features objectively, we utilize a leading-edge computational semantic vector embedding methods based on Large Language Models (LLMs). We predict that semantic distances will be sensitive to sentence interpretability and correlate with real-time decoding processes. To better characterize this uniqueness of Chinese, we will conduct comparative analyses with topologically diverse languages, e.g., English. In the experimental part, we will employ eye-tracking and high-density electroencephalogram (HD-EEG) to investigate the underlying neurocognitive mechanisms for validation and further exploration. Naturalistic paradigms for both visual and auditory modalities will be designed to comprehensively capture mental representation and spatiotemporal neural dynamics. These methods allow us to analyze how semantic distance hierarchically modulates the decoding process along time course. We expect semantic distance effects to launch in the early processing stage and act as connecting hubs coordinating distributed brain regions for semantics-syntax integration. As a pilot exploration, we will then try intracranial electrocorticogram (ECoG) studies on patients with brain diseases (e.g., brain tumor, epilepsy, Parkinson’s disease) to explore practical potentials in preoperative evaluation and language function rehabilitation. 漢語的典型特徵是其較強地依賴語義因素而非外顯的句法標記或屈折變化，話題-述題結構典型地體現了這一特徵，這類結構通常被語義條件所允准而違反某些句法上限制條件。這種話題-述題結構的普遍性，使得漢語被稱為“話題突出型語言”，與英語等“主語突出型語言”形成對比。本研究聚焦於話題-述題結構，旨在研究語義因素如何以及在何種程度上影響漢語句子的生成與理解。本研究提出一個結合理論分析與神經認知實驗方法的交叉研究路徑。在理論部分，我們將建立一個形式語義學的分析框架，分析語義關係對句子可解釋性的影響及其與句法的互動。基於我們先前關於語義允准條件的研究發現，我們假設語義距離在構建漢語話題句時扮演更關鍵的角色，驅動從詞素、詞語、短語到句子等各語言層面的實時解讀。我們將從三個維度定義並提取量化語義距離的指標：（1）話題與述題中蘊含關鍵信息的名詞性短語之間的“話題-線索距離”；（2）句子中任意兩個實詞之間的“實詞距離”；（3）隨句子實時解讀而動態整合累積的“動態整合距離”。為客觀量化這些特徵，我們將採用基於大語言模型的語義向量嵌入的計算方法。我們預測語義距離將對句子可解釋性表現出敏感性，並與實時解碼過程相關聯。為更深入地探索漢語的這一獨特性，我們將與英語等不同類型的語言進行比較分析。在實驗部分，我們將使用眼動追蹤和高密度腦電圖來驗證和進一步探索語義驅動語句解讀的神經認知機制。我們將設計針對視覺閱讀與聽覺感知的語言解讀自然主義範式，捕捉人在進行語句解讀時的心理表徵與腦神經活動的時空動態。這些方法讓我們能分析語義距離如何在時間進程上分不同層級調控句子解碼過程。我們預測語義距離效應將在早期神經加工階段顯現，並作為功能連接中樞協調不同的腦區進行語義-句法的整合過程。作為嘗試探索，我們還將嘗試在腦部疾病（如腦腫瘤、癲癇、帕金森症）患者中進行顱內皮層腦電圖研究，以探索我們提出的語義驅動語句解讀模型在疾病的術前評估與語言功能康復中的應用價值。

14624925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14624925.value: 見未見之人：多重方法探究香港難民及庇護申請者健康之社會、法律與道德決定因素

14624925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14624925.value: Dr Chung, Ka Ki, Gary Prof Huang, Shixin

14624925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14624925.value: Refugees and asylum seekers (RAS) are forcibly displaced migrants who constitute a diverse and heterogeneous population. Globally, RAS are found to have worse health outcomes in countries of transit and destination due to a variety of barriers, including language obstacles, cultural and religious differences, institutional discrimination, and restrictions on healthcare service use. As a result, they face higher risks for both communicable and non-communicable diseases. In Hong Kong, there are nearly 15,000 RAS, many of whom are trapped in a limbo characterized by poor living conditions, loss of livelihoods, enduring uncertainty, and deteriorating health status. However, there is a notable lack of empirical studies in Hong Kong that provide evidence on RAS’s healthcare needs, service utilization, and disease burden. This study aims to assess the health conditions, well-being, past experiences with healthcare services, healthcare needs, and barriers to accessing healthcare among RAS in Hong Kong. Building on insights from a pilot study and guided by a newly constructed theoretical framework—the social, legal, and moral determinants of health—the study seeks to explore the influence of these determinants on the health and well-being of this community. The study will employ a multi-method design grounded in community engagement principles, encompassing three components: (1) semi-structured, individual in-depth interviews with RAS and key community stakeholders; (2) World Café workshops involving RAS and key community stakeholders; and (3) a questionnaire-based survey among RAS. By combining qualitative and quantitative methods, we aim to capture the complexity of healthcare challenges faced by RAS while ensuring their active participation throughout the research process. The findings will provide the first comprehensive exploration of RAS’s health conditions, access to healthcare, and service utilization in Hong Kong. By analyzing the social, legal, and moral barriers that RAS face, this research will offer a deeper understanding of the complex factors influencing their health outcomes. It will highlight key gaps in current healthcare services, the impact of restrictive legal frameworks, and the moral obligations of host societies to support vulnerable populations. This research will also serve as a critical tool for advocacy, enabling the RAS community and other stakeholders to develop policies that not only improve healthcare access and quality for RAS but also address broader issues such as social integration, legal protections, and the ethical treatment of displaced individuals. 難民與庇護申請者（Refugees and Asylum Seekers, RAS）為被迫流離失所的移民群體，其成員背景多元且異質性高。全球而言，RAS 在過境國與目的地國的健康狀況普遍較差，原因包括語言障礙、文化與宗教差異、制度性歧視，以及醫療服務使用的限制。結果使其在傳染性與非傳染性疾病方面皆面臨較高風險。 在香港，目前約有 15,000 名 RAS，其中許多人長期陷於生活條件惡劣、失去生計來源、承受持續不確定性與健康狀況惡化之懸空狀況。然而，香港在此領域的實證研究極為缺乏，尚未提供關於 RAS 醫療需求、服務利用情況與疾病負擔的系統性證據。 本研究旨在評估香港 RAS 的健康狀況、整體福祉、以往的醫療服務經驗、醫療需求以及獲取醫療服務的障礙。基於先導研究成果，並以新建構的理論框架——「健康的社會、法律與道德決定因素」為指引，本研究將探討這些決定因素對該群體健康與福祉的影響。 研究採用結合社區參與原則的多方法設計，包括三個部分：（1）對 RAS 與主要社區持分者進行半結構式的個人深入訪談；（2）舉辦包含 RAS 與主要社區持分者在内的「世界咖啡館」（World Café）工作坊；（3）在 RAS 群體中開展問卷調查。透過質性與量化方法的結合，本研究旨在全面呈現 RAS 在醫療照護上所面臨的複雜挑戰，並確保其在整個研究過程中的積極參與。 本研究的成果將提供香港首個關於 RAS 健康狀況、醫療可及性與服務利用的全面性探討，並為制定以實證為基礎的政策提供依據，以回應這一高度邊緣化群體的特殊醫療需求。同時，本研究亦將成為政策倡導的重要工具，協助 RAS 社群及其他持份者制定政策，不僅改善其所能獲得的醫療服務可及性及其品質，亦能回應更廣泛的議題，如社會融入、法律保障，以及使用尊重人性尊嚴且合乎倫理的原則來對待被迫流離人士。

14625025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14625025.value: 翻譯、殖民統治與漢學知識：駱克（1858-1937）在十九世紀香港的雙重譯者角色研究

14625025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14625025.value: This research project explores the intricate dynamics of translation, colonial rule, and Chinese knowledge production in nineteenth-century Hong Kong. It provides the first in-depth study of James Stewart Lockhart (1858–1937), a British colonial official in Hong Kong from 1879 to 1902, as both a government and cultural translator. Lockhart joined the Hong Kong government through the Interpreter Cadetship Program and later assumed positions including Registrar General and Colonial Secretary. He also established himself as a scholar in Chinese language and culture. Examining his translation activities and publications, this study offers insights into how translation played an important part in colonial rule and Sino-British relations while contributing to the production of knowledge about China in Hong Kong. This project primarily draws on Lockhart’s extensive personal papers, “Acc. 4138 Papers of Sir James Haldane Stewart Lockhart,” now held at the National Library of Scotland in Edinburgh. This collection contains rich first-hand documents of his civil service duties, interpersonal relations, and publications that allow us to identify and reconstruct his translation practice in colonial Hong Kong. This study examines his dual role as a translator in both colonial governance and Chinese-English cultural exchange through two main lines of inquiry: first, it investigates Lockhart’s administrative translation work in the government, particularly his contribution to the acquisition of the New Territories in 1898. It explores the nature and scope of the translation tasks he undertook in the daily operation of colonial governance and how translation facilitated the broader English-Chinese communication. This reveals the nuanced ways in which power was negotiated and exercised in colonial Hong Kong through the lens of translation. Second, this project explores Lockhart’s role as a cultural translator of Chinese knowledge. Focusing on his seminal translation, A Manual of Chinese Quotations, and the subsequent scholarly debate over the translation among contemporary Sinologists, this research illuminates Sinological translation as an academic practice and sheds light on Hong Kong’s unique position as a central site of cross-cultural knowledge production in the late nineteenth century. With this microscopic study of Lockhart’s translation activities and publications, this research project discusses the larger power and cultural dynamics at play that shaped the political, administrative, and cultural landscape of colonial Hong Kong. It reshapes our understanding of Hong Kong’s history by highlighting the crucial yet often overlooked role of translators and translation. 本研究計畫旨在探討十九世紀香港殖民管治背景下，翻譯、殖民統治與中文知識生產三者之間複雜的互動關係。本研究以殖民政府官員駱克（James Stewart Lockhart, 1858–1937）為個案，探索其身兼政府譯員與文化譯者的雙重身份。駱克透過「官學生計劃」投入公職，於1879年至1902年間服務於香港殖民政府，歷任總登記官及輔政司等要職，並在任內研究中國文化，樹立其漢學家之聲望。透過檢視其翻譯活動及出版著作，本研究旨在闡明翻譯如何在殖民管治及中英關係中發揮關鍵作用，並促使香港發展為一個生產關於中國知識的重要樞紐。 本計畫主要使用現存於愛丁堡蘇格蘭國家圖書館的駱克個人檔案（Acc. 4138 Papers of Sir James Haldane Stewart Lockhart），這批檔案為本研究提供了大量關於其公務職責、人際關係及學術出版的一手資料，是重構其殖民時期翻譯實踐的基石。本研究將從兩大主軸切入，探討駱克在殖民管治與中英文化交流中所扮演的雙重譯者角色：首先，本研究聚焦其在政府內部的行政翻譯工作，尤其是1898年在英國租借新界事件中的表現，以此檢視他在殖民政府日常運作中所承擔的翻譯任務之性質與範圍，並揭示權力關係如何透過翻譯這一媒介，在殖民香港展開微妙的協商與運作。其次，本研究探討駱克作為中文知識轉譯者的角色，分析其代表譯作《成語考》（A Manual of Chinese Quotations）以及該書在當時漢學界所引發的學術辯論，旨在闡明漢學翻譯的學術實踐面貌，並突顯香港在十九世紀末作為跨文化知識生產中心的獨特地位。 通過對駱克翻譯活動與出版的微觀考察，本計畫旨在揭示翻譯與譯者此一關鍵卻常被忽略的因素，並由此論析翻譯活動背後更為宏大的權力結構與文化互動如何形塑了香港殖民時期的政治、行政及文化景觀，藉此重新審視我們對香港歷史的既有認知。

15100225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100225.value: 使用無創螢光素眼底血管造影生成技術診斷糖尿病視網膜病變的臨床驗證：多中心、隨機對照試驗評估準確性與效益

15100225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100225.value: Prof DING, Xiaoyan Prof GE, Zongyuan Prof HE, Mingguang Prof LEUNG, Christopher Kai-shun Prof XU, Xun

15100225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100225.value: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of irreversible blindness in Hong Kong and globally, underscoring the need for early diagnosis and intervention. Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) is the gold standard for diagnosing and monitoring DR, as it highlights critical lesions like non-perfusion areas, macular edema, and neovascularization, which may be missed in color fundus photography (CF), a widely used imaging method. However, FFA is invasive, uncomfortable, and can cause side effects such as nausea and allergic reactions, and is contraindicated for patients with kidney disease or pregnancy. FFA is also about five times more expensive than CF. As DR cases continue to rise, there is a growing demand for a non-invasive, safe, and cost-effective alternative to FFA. To address this challenge, we have developed an innovative CF2FFA framework that generates high-resolution, realistic, lesion-preserving FFA images from CF, eliminating the need for fluorescein injection. We have further extended this framework to ultra-widefield imaging (UWF2FA) and image-to-video generation (Fundus2Video), allowing dynamic lesion tracking over time. The generated FFAs have been rigorously validated through quantitative metrics and visual assessments by retinal specialists. Additionally, the generated FFA has improved DR screening accuracy across multiple external datasets. Despite these advancements, the clinical value of the generated FFA remains unproven in real-world settings despite its significant potential. We hypothesize that generated FFA will be non-inferior to traditional FFA for diagnosing DR and guiding treatment decisions within specific operational limits, providing an optimal balance of efficacy and safety. Therefore, we propose a multicenter, prospective trial across three centers involving 500 DR patients who require FFA examinations. Participants will be randomized into two groups: the control group will receive diagnosis and treatment based on traditional FFA and clinical data, while the experimental group will be based on generated FFA and clinical data. The primary objectives are to compare the accuracy of DR diagnosis, treatment decision agreement, and treatment outcomes over a 12-month follow-up period. We will also evaluate the time and cost efficiency of each approach. We expect that the generated FFA will offer diagnostic accuracy comparable to traditional FFA within operational limits without negatively impacting treatment outcomes, while providing a non-invasive, cost-effective solution. This study has the potential to integrate cutting-edge artificial intelligence into clinical practice, introducing a groundbreaking and affordable method for DR evaluation using clinically viable FFA generated from simple retinal scans. 糖尿病視網膜病變（DR）是香港及全球導致不可逆性失明的主要原因之一，凸顯了早期診斷與干預的重要性。螢光素眼底血管造影（FFA）是診斷與監測 DR 的金標準，能夠清晰顯示無灌注區、黃斑水腫、新生血管等關鍵病灶，這些病灶在臨床廣泛使用的彩色眼底照相（CF）中可能被遺漏。然而，FFA 屬於有創檢查，過程不適，並可能引發噁心、過敏反應等副作用，且腎病患者及孕婦禁用。此外，FFA 檢查費用約為 CF 的五倍。隨著 DR 病例的持續增長，臨床迫切需要一種無創、安全且具成本效益的 FFA 替代方案。 為解決這一挑戰，我們研發了創新性的 CF2FFA 框架，可直接由 CF 生成高解析度、逼真且保留病灶特徵的 FFA 圖像，從而無需注射螢光素。該框架進一步拓展至超廣角成像（UWF2FA）以及圖像到視頻的生成（Fundus2Video），能夠實現病灶的動態追蹤。所生成的 FFA 已通過定量指標評估及視網膜專科醫生的視覺評估進行嚴格驗證，並在多個外部資料集上顯著提升了 DR 篩查的準確性。 儘管取得了這些技術進展，生成 FFA 在真實臨床環境中的應用價值仍未得到驗證。我們假設，在特定操作條件下，生成的 FFA 在 DR 診斷與治療決策指導方面不會劣于傳統 FFA，並可在療效與安全性之間實現最佳平衡。 因此，我們擬在三個中心開展一項多中心、前瞻性研究，納入 500 例需要進行 FFA 檢查的 DR 患者。參與者將被隨機分為兩組：對照組基於傳統 FFA 及臨床資料進行診斷和治療，實驗組則基於生成 FFA 及臨床資料進行診斷和治療。主要研究目標包括比較兩組在 DR 診斷準確率、治療決策一致性及 12 個月隨訪期內治療結局的差異；同時評估兩種方案在時間與成本效率方面的表現。 我們預期，生成的 FFA 在滿足操作限制的前提下，其診斷準確率將與傳統 FFA 相當，不會對治療結局造成負面影響，同時提供一種無創且具成本優勢的解決方案。本研究有望將前沿人工智慧技術引入臨床實踐，開創一種基於簡單眼底照相生成、可直接應用於臨床的低成本創新 DR 評估方法。

15100625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100625.value: 自噬通過假尿苷合酶（PUS）依赖的mRNA假尿苷修飾調控脊椎動物造血

15100625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100625.value: Background: Hematopoiesis is tightly regulated by multiple pathways and deregulations will result in blood disorders. Understanding the regulation of developmental hematopoiesis is therefore, important in deciphering the pathogenesis of various blood disorders. Autophagy and RNA pseudouridylation have emerged as novel regulators of hematopoiesis. Autophagy is an essential cellular self-degradation process, whereas pseudouridylation refers to the modification of uridine into pseudouridine (Ψ) in RNAs. While both processes were shown to involve in hematopoiesis and blood disorders, their precise roles and potential interplays in regulation of vertebrate hematopoiesis remain unknown. Preliminary data: We previously demonstrated that vertebrate hematopoiesis is autophagy-dependent using zebrafish model. Autophagy aberration resulted in up-regulation of pseudouridine synthases, pus7 and trub1, which are key catalytic enzymes of pseudouridylation. Autophagy modulators also regulate PUS7 and TRUB1 in human leukemic cells, highlighted the undescribed and conserved autophagy-pseudouridylation regulation axis in vertebrate hematopoiesis. Using bisulfite-induced deletion (BID)-sequencing platform, we preliminarily observed that Ψ distribution in mRNA is different between leukemic cells and normal peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC), suggested a novel role of mRNA pseudouridylation in pathogenesis of leukemia. Importantly, opposite to mutations in atgs, targeting pus7 increased the number of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSCPs) and myeloid progenitor cells. Therefore, we proposed to use zebrafish model to study the novel regulation axis in vivo. Objectives: 1. Investigate if autophagy exhibits cell-autonomous regulation on vertebrate hematopoiesis and pseudouridine modification. 2. Examine if pseudouridine synthase 7 (pus7), regulates vertebrate hematopoiesis. 3. Identify Atg13- and Pus7-dependent key mRNA pseudouridine signatures in hematopoietic lineages. Methods: We will generate inducible HSPC- or leukocyte-specific atg13 and pus7 knock-out zebrafish genetic models. Effects of atg13 and pus7 targeting on various hematopoietic lineages at embryonic and adult stages will be quantified by imaging and flow cytometry as described in our previous works. In particular, we will investigate if autophagy regulates vertebrate hematopoiesis through pseudouridylation by concomitant atg13 and pus7 knockout. Lastly, to identify Atg13- and Pus7-dependent key mRNA pseudouridine signatures in hematopoietic lineages, we will establish the mRNA pseudouridine landscape in HSPCs and leukocytes from our zebrafish mutant models using the BID-sequencing platform. Conclusion: Pilot studies have been performed to support our novel hypothesis and ensure feasibility of the study. We are in unique position to undertake this project, which will provide novel research tools and information about the previously undescribed role of RNA pseudouridine modification in autophagy-mediated regulation of vertebrate hematopoiesis.

15100825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100825.value: 赫布型成對關聯刺激調節大腦半球間交互促進腦中風後上肢康復

15100825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100825.value: Dr Bai, Zhongfei Prof Fong, Nai Kuen Prof Lau, Gary Kui Kai Prof Sack, Alexander Dr Tang, Michael Prof Ziemann, Ulf

15100825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100825.value: Stroke remains the primary cause of long-term neurological disabilities both in Hong Kong and worldwide. Effective rehabilitation solutions are essential to alleviate the burden that poststroke survivors impose on hospitals and community services. Following unilateral stroke, interhemispheric balance is disrupted. Prior studies have extensively documented that exaggerated interhemispheric inhibitory flow from the contralesional to the ipsilesional hemisphere prevents maximal motor recovery after stroke. Non-invasive brain stimulation using inhibitory repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has further been applied in poststroke rehabilitation since the 2000s, with the aim of suppressing the activity of the contralesional hemisphere, to thereby reduce abnormal interhemispheric inhibitory flows between the cerebral hemispheres. However, the clinical efficacy of LF rTMS varies across previous trials with small to moderate sample sizes. Moreover, one recently published multicenter randomized controlled trial with around 200 poststroke participants showed that its clinical benefit is limited, possibly due to the limited precision of single-site stimulation of the interregional interaction between the two hemispheres. Timing-dependent associative plasticity via the Hebbian learning mechanism (neurons that fire together, wire together) has been described as the neurobiological foundation of behavioral learning and neuroplasticity. Inspired by our preliminary work on healthy adults and poststroke patients, we aim to test the modulatory effects of a Hebbian-type plasticity induction paradigm using corticocortical paired associative stimulation (ccPAS) over the bilateral motor cortex. This approach aims to reverse the abnormal inhibitory flow from the contralesional to the ipsilesional hemisphere and therefore leads to measurable clinical benefits on upper extremity motor recovery in patients with stroke. In this randomized controlled trial, we hypothesize that Hebbian-type ccPAS would be more effective than sham ccPAS and conventional single-site inhibitory rTMS delivered to the contralesional hemisphere at improving hemiplegic upper limb motor functionality and modulating interhemispheric activity to an equilibrium state among patients with stroke. In this context, the present study aims to initiate a paradigm shift in poststroke neuromodulation therapy, transitioning from single-target stimulation to inter-regional connectivity neuromodulation. This noninvasive rehabilitative approach aims to address diseases related to brain network impairments, such as stroke. This project will provide insights into the recovery mechanisms activated following neurological diseases from the perspective of the Hebbian learning rules of associative plasticity, thereby offering a unique opportunity to address the long-standing question in poststroke clinical rehabilitation: how to precisely modulate the interregional interaction between the two cerebral hemispheres to re-establish interhemispheric balance, to thereby maximize functional recovery from stroke. 腦中風乃本港及全球導致神經性殘疾之主要疾患。有效的神經康復策略能夠減輕腦中風後遺症人士的醫療及社會負擔。半球間失衡是單側大腦半球受損後的病理性特徵。既往研究發現，健側半球對患側半球過度提高的抑制性投射是妨害腦中風後功能康復的病理原因。自21世紀以來，研究中常常採用非侵入式的神經刺激技術，如低頻經顱磁刺激，去抑制健側大腦功能，以求壓制病理性的半球間抑制。然而，抑制性的經顱磁刺激的臨床療效在不同研究中並不確切。近期的一項基於約200名腦中風後遺症人士的多中心研究顯示，抑制性經顱磁刺激對腦中風後偏癱上肢的康復效果並不優於假刺激。這可能是由於單靶點的刺激並不能精確地調控半球間的交互以實現腦中風後半球間平衡狀態。 峰時依賴的關聯可塑性是一種赫布式的學習機制（即所謂的同步激發的神經元間連接增強），此屬性乃行為學習和神經可塑性之基。基於我們以往在健康人及腦卒中患者的研究，本項目旨在測試一種赫布式的神經可塑性誘導範式，即皮質成對關聯刺激（ccPAS）對腦中風後人士雙側運動區的調控作用。此種範式旨在逆轉由健側到患側異常提高的抑制性投射，從而改善腦卒中後上肢運動功能的臨床恢復。本隨機對照試驗之假說如下：赫布式的ccPAS在調控半球間活動及腦中風後上肢運動功能的效果將優於單靶點抑制性重複性經顱磁刺激及偽刺激對照。本項目旨在促進腦中風後神經調控技術由單靶點刺激到腦連接刺激的範式轉移，從而為腦網絡異常的臨床人群（包括腦中風）提供一種全新的康復治療策略。本項目將從赫布式學習機制的角度出發，探究神經系統疾病後功能恢復的腦神經機制，並同時為解決腦中風康復領域一個長久懸而未決的問題---如何精准調控腦區間交互以最大化功能恢復---提供一種新思路。

15101625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15101625.value: 應用人工智能和三維超聲為青少年特發性胸椎脊柱側彎患者分析脊旁肌不對稱與脊椎變形的關係及規劃非手術治療

15101625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15101625.value: Prof Cheung, Jason Prof Ling, Sai-Ho, Steve Dr SCHLÖSSER, Tom Pieter Cornelis Prof Zheng, Yongping

15101625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15101625.value: Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent 3D musculoskeletal deformity affecting young individuals, particularly females. Literature and pilot data suggest distinct coupling patterns in 3D spinal deformity and paraspinal muscle asymmetry between thoracic and lumbar AIS. Additionally, no studies have assessed the reliability of ultrasound and possibility of the application of deep learning for evaluating the cross-sectional area (CSA) of superficial and deep thoracic paraspinal muscles due to the absence of a systematic protocol for obtaining high-quality, repeatable ultrasound images. Therefore, this study aims to establish a reliable protocol for reproducible ultrasound imaging of thoracic paraspinal muscles, investigate the impact of postures and imaging modalities on muscle asymmetry, explore differences in asymmetry patterns between thoracic and lumbar AIS, and develop a deep learning algorithm for automatic segmentation and analysis of paraspinal muscles. The study will be divided into several stages: 1) Develop a systematic protocol to acquire optimal transverse ultrasound images for accurate paraspinal muscle annotation, ensuring repeatability and precision in capturing muscle morphology; 2) Assess the intra- and inter-rater reliability of 3D ultrasound in evaluating the CSA of these muscles, comparing findings with MRI to determine interchangeability across standing and prone positions, and validate the effectiveness of 3D ultrasound as a diagnostic tool; 3) Explore the coupling relationship between thoracic spinal deformity and muscle asymmetry in weight-bearing positions. Muscle asymmetry patterns between thoracic and lumbar AIS will also be compared, leveraging data from our previous study on lumbar AIS; 4) Develop deep learning algorithms for automatic muscle segmentation, validating these algorithms against manually annotated data to ensure accuracy and efficiency. By addressing the current gaps in AIS assessment, our study aims to enhance understanding of the musculoskeletal dynamics involved, ultimately improving patient outcomes and treatment strategies. In specific, we aim to identify new prognostic factors for scoliosis management, focusing on how muscle morphology correlates with spinal curvature in patient with thoracic AIS. Comparison of muscle asymmetric pattern and muscle-deformity coupling mechanism will help determine if distinct patterns exist between different curve types, enhancing personalized treatment approaches. It is also hypothesized that 3D ultrasound, combined with deep learning, will provide reliable and valid measurements of thoracic paraspinal muscles, revealing significant asymmetry patterns and coupling effects with spinal deformities. We anticipate that this research will transform AIS management by integrating muscle evaluation into non-operative treatment planning, offering a comprehensive, cost-effective, and radiation-free diagnostic tool.

15102425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102425.value: 基於智能電話的自我步行質量評估對預測長者跌倒風險之效度

15102425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102425.value: Dr Fong, Ching Hang Gabriel Prof KWOK, Timothy Chi-yui Mr Leung, Jason Chi Shun Prof Lord, Stephen Prof PANG, Marco

15102425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102425.value: Falls are the leading cause of injury-related death and hospitalisation among older individuals. According to the latest world guidelines for fall prevention, older persons who have suffered a fall in the past year, are worried about falling, or feel unsteady while standing or walking should undergo screening for gait and balance to stratify their fall risk for further follow-up actions. Accordingly, over 300,000 older persons in Hong Kong should receive fall-risk screening annually; this number is expected to double within 30 years. To manage this massive demand, a simple and accurate fall-risk screening tool is essential. Walking stability has long been recognised as a critical fall-risk factor. However, due to the complexities associated with objectively measuring gait quality, time-based measurements are frequently used as proxy measures for stability. For instance, the Timed-Up-and-Go test (TUG) and walking speed are recommended by local and international guidelines as the fall-risk screening tools. Unfortunately, these time-based measurements have limited predictive ability for falls among community-dwelling older persons, yielding areas under the receiver operating curve (AUC) ranging from only 0.50 to 0.57. An assessment of gait quality that requires minimal operational resources is necessary to provide accurate and objective fall-risk screening while accommodating the large number of screenings required. To address this need, we have developed a smartphone application that assesses gait characteristics using the built-in accelerometers and devised a protocol to facilitate self-screening by older persons. We have validated the application for measuring temporal gait parameters and examined its acceptability and test-retest reliability in older persons. Pilot data indicates that gait characteristics assessed by older people independently in their neighbourhoods using our smartphone protocol yielded an AUC of 0.75 in distinguishing older people with or without a fall history in the past year. An important next step is to evaluate its fall-prediction accuracy and identify a clear fall-prediction algorithm based on the examined gait characteristics. Therefore, the proposed study aims to (1) develop a fall-prediction model using gait characteristics assessed by the smartphone-based self-administered gait assessment and (2) compare it with the current gold standards of fall-risk screening - the TUG test and gait speed. The proposed study will illuminate the clinical utility of smartphone-based, self-administered gait assessment in fall-risk screening for older persons. It offers a promising solution to the increasing number of older individuals requiring fall-risk screening. We hypothesise that our smartphone solution will outperform TUG and gait speed in predicting falls. 跌倒是導致長者住院和受傷死亡的首要原因。根據最新的國際跌倒預防指南建議，過去一年內曾跌倒、對跌倒感到憂慮，或在站立行走時感到不穩定的長者，應接受步行與平衡能力的篩查，以評估其跌倒風險並採取相應的預防跌倒措施。據估算，香港每年有超過30萬名長者需要接受跌倒風險篩查，且此數字預計在30年內翻倍。為滿足如此龐大的需求，開發一套簡便且準確的跌倒風險篩查工具至關重要。 長久以來，步行穩定性被公認為評估跌倒風險的關鍵指標。然而，由於客觀測量步行質量存在技術複雜性，臨床上常以基於測量時間的參數作為評估步行穩定性的替代指標。例如，香港本地及國際指引均推薦採用「計時起走測試」與「步行速度」作為跌倒風險的篩查工具。然而，這些主要以步行速度為基準的測量方法對於預測社區居住長者的跌倒風險效果有限，其準確度（AUC）僅介於0.50至0.57之間，預測準確度不甚理想。為滿足大規模篩檢需求，極需開發一套操作簡便、資源需求低的步行質量評估工具，以提供精確且客觀的跌倒風險檢測。 為解決此需求，我們研發了一套智能手提電話應用程式，透過内置的加速度計分析步行特徵，並設計了簡易的操作和測試流程讓長者能在數分鐘內自主完成跌倒風險篩查。我們已針對此應用程式進行全面驗證，包括測量時序性步行參數的準確性，並評估其在長者人群中的接受度與重覆測量信度。初步研究數據顯示，長者使用我們的智能手提電話應用程式在社區環境中自主評估的步行特徵，對於區分過去一年有或無跌倒史的長者，其準確度較現時標準顯注提高。關鍵的下一步是驗證此評估系統的跌倒預測準確度，並基於已分析的步行特徵建立明確的預測演算法。因此，本研究旨在：（1）利用智能手提電話自主步行評估系統所測得的步行特徵，開發跌倒預測模型；（2）將此模型與現行跌倒風險篩查黃金標準——計時起走測試及步行速度，進行比較。本前瞻性研究將闡明智能電話自主步行評估應用於長者跌倒風險篩查的臨床實用價值。為日益增長的老年人口跌倒風險篩查需求，提供了一個潛在的解決方案。我們預計：智能電話自主步行評估在預測跌倒風險的準確度上，將顯著優於傳統的計時起走測試與步行速度評估方法。

15105625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15105625.value: 基於理論的失眠障礙睡眠衛生教育：一項非劣效性隨機對照試驗及混合方法過程評估與成本效益分析

15105625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15105625.value: Dr Chan, Christian Shaunlyn Dr Cheng, Eileen Huilin Dr Chung, Ka Fai Dr Ho, Fiona Yan-Yee Dr Ho, Lai-ming Prof Lo, Ka Ying Heidi Dr Wong, King Ho Carlos

15105625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105625.value: Sleep Hygiene Education (SHE) is an accessible and low-cost intervention for insomnia. However, SHE is pedagogical and relatively neglects behavioral modifications, leading to suboptimal effectiveness. Consequently, SHE has not been widely recommended as a standalone treatment for insomnia patients. To address this issue, our proposed study will examine a theory-based, behavioral modification-focused SHE approach, incorporating Behavior Change Techniques from relevant theories, potentially unlocking the full therapeutic potential of SHE.
