Existing studies have enabled versatile edge AI systems with full-life cycles, and moreover, our previous projects have further extended low-shot modeling and enhanced robustness onto edges for optimized deployment. Despite all these enabling techniques and advanced functionalities, the ‘Systematic Scalability’ of edge AI systems is, however, still understudied and incurs new bottlenecks for evolving real-world edges, especially in the ear of FLMs. First, the requirements of service can evolve over time in model complexity and version iteration. Despite successful migrations of FLMs onto the edges, e.g., Gemini Nano (Google, 2023) and MM1 (Apple, 2024), the edge models are mostly fixed and cannot evolve simultaneously due to constrained computing capabilities, i.e., flexible architectures and on-device retraining, which we define as ‘Model Scalability’. Next, edge tasks also evolve dynamically in actual deployment, including both incremental and compositional tasks. However, existing edge systems can hardly address such ‘Task Scalability’ flexibly due to the commonly used cloud-edge collaboration paradigm. Last but not least, although locally generated data (i.e., sensors) can also evolve simultaneously, its representational scarcity remains a bottleneck in real-world edges. Thus, the ‘Representation Scalability’ should also be considered for more complex edge inferences. This project endeavors to harness the evolving edges with the above-mentioned scalability trio and explores their systematic synergy to push the limits of edge AI functionality. First, to maximize model scalability, especially for scaling edge-side FLMs, we design a Model Coupling and Correlation Synergy Framework to provide extremely flexible and lightweight architectures and further enable on-device retraining. Second, to tackle task scalability, we design a Domanial and Compositional Meta-task Synergy Framework to support fast on-device task adaptation and evolution. Third, to deal with representation scalability, we design an Edge-native Side Information Synergy Framework that fully exploits inherent and structural representations from edge-side FLMs. These three frameworks progressively integrate full-stack and systematic scalability onto the edges, i.e., model-task-representation, and open up a new frontier of opportunities for next-generation self-evolving edge AI systems. Last, we develop a prototypical platform based on the proposed synergidal scalability co-design to support a wide range of real-world applications. 近年以來，邊緣人工智能（Edge AI）引發了大量學界和業界關注。相較於依賴集中式的運算與數據的基礎模型/大模型所提供之雲端服務，邊緣人工智能聚焦於普及型低成本裝置實現近用戶服務，兼具即時響應與強化安全優勢。儘管現有研究已建立全生命週期多功能系統，且我們過往專案進一步提升邊緣低樣本建模與部署強健性，然系統化可擴展性仍是核心局限，尤其在基礎模型/大模型時代下，此缺陷已成為制約動態演進邊緣系統的新瓶頸。 服務需求隨時間動態演進的特性，具體體現於模型複雜度升級與版本迭代。縱使基礎模型/大模型已成功部署至邊緣設備（如Gemini Nano、MM1），受限裝置運算能力，現有模型多屬固定架構，無法實現模型可擴展性所需的彈性架構調整與裝置端再訓練。同時，實際部署中的邊緣任務呈現動態演進特徵（含增量型與組合型任務），然主流雲邊協作範式難以靈活應對任務可擴展性需求。更關鍵的是，本地感測資料雖持續演進，其表徵匱乏性仍阻礙複雜推論，由此凸顯表徵可擴展性的必要性。 本項目提出協同可擴展性聯合設計，通過系統化整合上述三重可擴展性機制驅動邊緣演進。首先開發模型耦合與關聯協同框架，突破邊緣基礎模型/大模型擴展瓶頸，實現極致輕量架構並支援裝置端再訓練；其次構建領域化組合式元任務框架，使裝置端能動態適應任務演進；最後設計邊端原生輔助資訊協同框架，深度萃取邊緣基礎模型/大模型內在結構化表徵。此三層協同架構從模型擴展、任務適應至表徵強化逐級推進，將全堆疊系統化可擴展性（從底層架構至高階應用）深植邊緣系統，為新一代自演進邊緣人工智能開拓技術路徑，最終通過原型平台驗證廣泛應用場景可行性。

15211625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15211625.value: 磁場與超聲複合輔助金剛石切削難加工材料的研究

15211625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15211625.value: Prof To, Suet Sandy Prof Zhang, Jianguo

15211625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15211625.value: Difficult-to-cut materials such as tungsten and titanium alloys exhibit excellent mechanical properties, making them valuable in industries like aerospace, biomedical, and mold industries. However, they pose significant challenges in ultra-precision machining (UPM) due to their high hardness, low plasticity, and low thermal conductivity. Current UPM technologies, including ultrasonic vibration, laser, and magnetic field assisted UPM, have made progress in improving machinability. Nevertheless, they still encounter issues such as diamond tool wear, and insufficient surface quality. These challenges limit the potential of UPM for these materials in advanced applications. To address these issues, a novel hybrid magnetic field and ultrasonic vibration assisted diamond turning (HMUDT) technology is first to propose for UPM of difficult-to-cut materials. Unlike current UPM technologies, HMUDT employs a unique dual machining mechanism that not only offers benefits of each field assistance but also synergizes effects of magnetic field and ultrasonic vibration to enhance machining performance. The magnetic field lowers bond energy and critical pinning force, increasing material ductility, while ultrasonic vibrations create a dynamic "fluid-like" state to reduce dislocation viscosity and drag forces. By combining these approaches, the magnetic field improves the effect of ultrasonic vibrations by maintaining a dynamic environment whereas ultrasonic vibrations complement the magnetic field by reducing drag forces in UPM. The project involves developing a synchronized UPM apparatus that integrates magnetic field and ultrasonic vibration. Comprehensive theoretical and finite element models (FEM) incorporating principles of magneto-plasticity theory, Lorentz law, and Stokes law will be developed to investigate synchronizations between magnetic fields and ultrasonic vibrations in diamond turning. Following this, experiments will be conducted to examine and validate the unique dual machining mechanism. Surface characterization and analyses on mechanical properties will be performed to assess HMUDT samples. Finally, practical applications of HMUDT will be demonstrated through fabrication of microstructures and mirror-grade finishes on difficult to cut materials, with validation on optical and biomedical applications. This proposal is groundbreaking as it introduces HMUDT with a unique dual machining mechanism for the first time. The benefits include (1) enhanced machinability of difficult-to-cut materials in UPM, (2) extended diamond tool life, (3) superior surface integrity of these materials beyond the current UPM level, and (4) broader applications of these materials for advanced uses. Additionally, HMUDT integrates magnetic, material sciences, and mechanical engineering, fostering significant impacts across various fields. This project offers a new opportunity in UPM for difficult-to-cut materials, greatly expanding their practical applications in advanced industries. 難加工材料如鎢和鈦合金具有優異的力學性能，在航空航天、生物醫療及模具等行業中具有重要應用價值。然而，由於其高硬度、低塑性和低熱導率，這些材料在超精密加工過程中面臨巨大挑戰。當前的超精密加工技術，包括超聲振動、激光及磁場輔助超精密加工，雖在提升可加工性方面取得了一定進展，但仍存在金剛石刀具磨損嚴重、表面品質不足等問題，限制了這些材料在高端領域的應用潛力。為解決上述難題，本項目首次提出了一種新型磁場與超聲複合輔助金剛石切削技術，用於難加工材料的超精密加工。與現有超精密加工技術不同，磁場與超聲複合輔助金剛石切削技術採用獨特的雙重加工機制，不僅結合了磁場和超聲輔助各自的優勢，還通過協同效應顯著提升加工性能。磁場能夠降低材料的結合能，提高材料延展性；而超聲振動則可在切削區形成動態「流體態」，降低位錯和切削阻力。兩者結合，磁場增強了超聲振動的動態環境，超聲振動則進一步減小了磁場輔助下的切削阻力，從而實現更優的加工效果。 本項目將開發磁場與超聲振動同步整合的超精密加工裝置，建立基於磁塑性理論、洛倫茲定律和斯托克斯定律的理論與有限元素模型，深入研究磁場與超聲振動在金剛石切削中的協同作用機制。隨後，將通過實驗驗證該雙重加工機制的獨特性，並對加工樣品進行表面表徵及力學性能分析。最後，通過在難加工材料上製備微結構和鏡面級表面，展示項目實際應用，並在光學和生物醫療領域進行驗證。 本項目的創新性在於首次提出了具有獨特雙重加工機制的磁場與超聲複合輔助金剛石切削技術。其優勢包括：（1）顯著提升難加工材料在超精密加工中的可加工性；（2）延長金剛石刀具壽命；（3）獲得優於現有超精密加工水準的表面完整性；（4）拓寬難加工材料在高端領域的應用。本項目為難加工材料的超精密加工提供了全新機遇，拓展了其在先進產業中的實際應用。

15212425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15212425.value: 面向6G無線通訊的先進異相功率放大器

15212425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15212425.value: This proposal aims to tackle substantial challenges in the broadband design of outphasing power amplifiers (OPAs) for contemporary wireless communication systems, especially in the context of 6G technologies. As the demand for higher communication rates and enhanced data capacity keeps escalating, wideband modulated signals featuring a high peak-to-average-power ratio (PAPR) have grown increasingly prevalent. This trend has given rise to efficiency problems within the RF front-end across wide frequency bands. Outphasing power amplifiers constitute one of the high-efficiency power amplifier technologies, manifesting an additional high-efficiency peak at deep back-off points (>8 dB); nonetheless, their performance is circumscribed by operational bandwidth constraints. Accordingly, the application of OPAs in contemporary wireless communications has been hampered over the past decades. To surmount the design predicaments of broadband configuration, this proposal proffers three novel broadband architectures for OPA: phase-flexible load modulation network (PF-LMN), single-loop load modulation network (SL-LMN), and flexible conjugation load modulation network (FC-LMN). Firstly, the proposed PF-LMN theory augments design flexibility by accommodating both voltage and current-mode combiners, enabling effective load modulation without being confined to the CG plane. This flexibility is of paramount significance for attaining efficient operation in diverse communication scenarios. Secondly, the SL-LMN architecture further expands design prospects by introducing multiple current combining points, facilitating multi-point load modulation essential for enhancing bandwidth and overall efficiency. Thirdly, the proposed FC-LMN offers a comprehensive design methodology that optimizes impedance matching and phase compensation, addressing the prevalent issue of narrow bandwidth in traditional OPAs. Furthermore, the proposed FC-LMN technology is also suitable for the PA design at the mm-wave frequency band due to its simple structure and compact size. In conclusion, this proposal constitutes a considerable stride in responding to the evolving requirements of 6G wireless communications. Through the introduction of effective methodologies that augment design flexibility and freedom, it makes a significant contribution to the advancement of broadband outphasing power amplifier topology, rendering it highly appropriate for the demands of next-generation wireless communication. The findings will be of immense value to researchers and engineers, providing a roadmap for future developments in this crucial area.

15212525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15212525.value: 低成本GNSS與MEMS IMU輔助之電離層約束無人機編隊協同定位系統

15212525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15212525.value: Prof Chen , Wu Dr Khodabandeh, Amir Prof Teunissen , Peter

15212525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15212525.value: The concept of using multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) working together in a coordinated manner has gained significant interest due to its potential to improve mission efficiency, reliability, and scalability. However, one of the main challenges in operating these UAV swarms is achieving autonomous real-time localization, which requires precise positioning and time synchronization. Current Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) technologies, while accurate and cost-effective, fall short of the stringent requirements needed for these UAV formations. Technologies like Precise Point Positioning (PPP) for absolute positioning and Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) for relative positioning and time synchronization either require constant external communication or a dense network of ground stations, which are not feasible for UAVs with limited external communication capabilities. Additionally, ionospheric delays further complicate achieving high-precision positioning and time synchronization. This research project aims to develop innovative algorithms for precise positioning and time synchronization for UAV formations using low-cost GNSS and Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems Inertial Measurement Units (MEMS IMUs). The project has three main objectives: First, we will develop a novel mixed-frequency PPP model to achieve sub-decimeter absolute positioning for a leading UAV. This model will use all available GNSS data and corrections broadcast by GNSS augmentation services, allowing for autonomous localization without external communication. By integrating ionospheric corrections and MEMS IMU data, we aim to speed up the positioning process. Second, the project will focus on achieving centimeter-level relative positioning and microsecond-level time synchronization between UAVs. This will be done using GNSS and MEMS IMU data with integer ambiguity resolution. Our algorithms will use mixed-frequency observations and optimize solutions through advanced mathematical techniques to ensure high precision even in complex environments. Third, we will optimize the data processing methods to ensure that our models can be effectively used in UAV formations. This involves improving the algorithms for quadratic programming and integer ambiguity resolution through distributed data processing. This project brings together the expertise of Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Delft University of Technology, and University of Melbourne in GNSS positioning, time synchronization, integer ambiguity resolution and GNSS+IMU integrated navigation. Successful implementation of this research will enable real-time high-precision localization of UAV formations, enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of their applications such as precision agriculture, large-scale terrain mapping, and disaster management. This will not only advance Hong Kong’s emerging expertise in UAV technology but also bring significant economic benefits to the region’s low-altitude applications in the coming years and beyond. 多架無人機（UAV）協同作業的概念，因其可顯著提升任務效率、可靠性及擴展性，近年來受到廣泛關注。然而，實現這些無人機編隊自主實時定位仍面臨巨大挑戰，主要在於對高精度定位及時間同步的嚴格要求。現有的全球衞星導航系統（GNSS）技術雖具有一定準確性及成本效益，但難以滿足無人機編隊的苛刻需求。絕對定位的精密單點定位（PPP）及相對定位與時間同步的實時動態（RTK）等技術，往往需要持續外部通訊或部署密集地面基站，這對外部通訊受限的無人機來說並不可行。同時，電離層延遲亦進一步加劇高精度定位與時間同步的困難。 本項目旨在開發創新演算法，利用低成本GNSS與微機電系統慣性測量單元（MEMS IMU），實現無人機編隊的高精度定位與時間同步。研究設有三大目標：首先，將構建新型混合頻段PPP模型，使領航無人機達到分米級絕對定位精度。該模型結合所有可用GNSS數據及GNSS增強服務的校正資訊，無須外部通訊即可自主定位，同時融合電離層校正與MEMS IMU數據，以加速定位收斂。其次，項目將通過GNSS與MEMS IMU的整合及整數模糊度解算，實現無人機之間厘米級相對定位與微秒級時間同步。新演算法將善用混合頻段觀測數據，並以先進數學方法優化解算，確保在複雜環境下亦能維持高精度。第三，將優化資料處理架構，使上述模型能高效應用於無人機編隊，包括通過分散式處理強化二次規劃及整數模糊度解算等核心技術。 本計劃匯聚香港理工大學、代爾夫特理工大學及墨爾本大學於GNSS定位、時間同步、整數模糊度解算及GNSS+IMU融合導航方向的專業力量。預期成果有望促成無人機編隊實時高精度定位，大幅提升其在精密農業、大範圍地形測繪及災害管理等應用的準確性與效率。此舉不僅將推動香港於無人機技術領域的發展，更有望為區域低空經濟及相關產業帶來長遠經濟效益。

15212925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15212925.value: 点云与图像融合的高效三维场景建模方法

15212925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15212925.value: Unleashing the full potential of 3D scene modeling through the harmonious integration of point clouds and images represents a revolutionary advance. A long-standing objective in machine intelligence is to infer underlying structures, appearance, and semantics from these two fundamental representations. Existing methods struggle to effectively merge these complementary properties, relying on excessive memory, intensive computation, and extensive datasets, making them resource-expensive and operation-restrictive in open-world scenarios. Consequently, these constraints manifest throughout processes of scene expression, optimization, and interpretation, ultimately restricting scalability and broader applicability. This project envisions a transformative shift in efficient 3D scene modeling by bridging point clouds and images. This is particularly challenging and remains largely unexplored, even with the impressive emergence of neural Gaussians and vision-language models. The fundamental challenge arises from the lack of compact, lightweight, and foundational scene representations. To address this bottleneck, we introduce geometric, textural, and semantic priors from raw point clouds and images and then integrate meaningful inductive biases as cohesive signals. Our research will bring forward several pioneering techniques. First, this project will establish compact representations that capture intricate structures and appearance of scenes with unparalleled efficiency by harnessing underlying geometric and textural correlations. This pipeline not only addresses irregular and massive Gaussians but also guarantees a 10× improvement in memory-efficiency. Second, this project will construct lightweight representations that fortify the optimization of structure and appearance, preserving geometric consistency and intrinsic visibility. Through significantly minimizing the requirement for redundant or irrelevant computations, this approach enables a 10× acceleration in computation-efficiency. Lastly, this project will spearhead the development of foundational representations for scene interpretation, delivering expressive and consistent semantics via forming hierarchical complexities and selective fusion. By resolving ambiguities and asymmetries in vision-language features, this framework eliminates the dependence on costly datasets and annotations, achieving unprecedented label-efficiency. This project is expected to reimagine possibilities of 3D scene modeling and pave the way for a new era in spatial intelligence. By significantly enhancing memory and computation efficiency without relying on annotated datasets, our research opens up new opportunities for frontier applications such as intelligent surveying and autonomous driving. Our encouraging preliminary results demonstrate the feasibility of these approaches and highlight the substantial potential for impact. Beyond technical breakthroughs, this project represents a paradigm shift at the intersection of spatial perception, computer vision, and machine intelligence, establishing a concrete foundation for reliable, insightful systems capable of interpreting and interacting with intricate, dynamic physical environments. 充分释放三维场景建模的潜力，通过点云与图像的和谐融合实现革命性突破。机器智能领域长期以来的核心目标之一，便是从这两类基础表征中推断场景的结构、外观与语义。然而，现有方法在有效整合这些互补特性方面仍存在明显不足，往往依赖庞大的存储开销、密集的计算资源和大规模的数据集，使得方法在开放环境中呈现出高成本和受限性的特征。由此引发的约束贯穿于场景的表达、优化与解释全过程，最终限制了方法的可扩展性与广泛应用。 本项目旨在通过桥接点云与图像，推动高效三维场景建模的变革性发展。这一方向极具挑战性，即便在神经高斯建模和视觉-语言模型快速涌现的背景下，仍属基本未被充分探索的前沿领域。根本性的挑战在于缺乏紧凑、轻量且具有基础性的场景表征。为突破这一瓶颈，本项目将从原始点云与图像中引入几何、纹理与语义先验，并将其凝练为内在的归纳偏置，作为统一而有机的建模信号。 项目将提出若干开创性的研究技术。首先，通过挖掘几何与纹理之间的深层关联，构建能够高效捕获复杂结构与外观的紧凑表征，从而解决高斯表示的冗余与无序问题，并实现存储效率提升一个数量级（10×）。其次，提出轻量化表征以强化结构与外观的优化过程，在保证几何一致性与可见性约束的同时，大幅降低无关或冗余计算的需求，使计算效率同样获得一个数量级（10×）的加速。最后，本项目将探索面向场景解释的基础性表征方法，通过层次化复杂度与选择性融合机制，生成具备表现力与一致性的语义描述。在消解视觉-语言特征中的歧义与不对称性的同时，摆脱对昂贵数据集与人工标注的依赖，从而实现前所未有的标注效率。 本项目有望重塑三维场景建模的可能性，开辟空间智能发展的新篇章。在显著提升存储与计算效率、同时不依赖标注数据的前提下，本研究将为智能测绘与自动驾驶等前沿应用带来全新机遇。已有的初步成果显示出本研究路径的可行性，并凸显了其巨大的应用潜力。除技术突破外，本项目更代表了空间感知、计算机视觉与机器智能交叉领域的一次范式转变，为能够可靠、深刻地理解和交互复杂动态物理环境的系统奠定了坚实基础。

15213625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15213625.value: 深入理解蜘蛛牽引絲複雜的蛋白質成分及其對纖維力學性能的影響

15213625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15213625.value: Prof Liu, Wei Prof Numata, Keiji Prof Wang, Xungai

15213625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15213625.value: In natural world, the orb-weaving spider, say Trichonephila clavipes, can produce five different types of silks with distinct mechanical properties for task-specific applications on the web. By forming the framework of spider’s web to provide the strength and toughness, dragline silk is the focus of intense research by scientists attempting to mimic this unique material marvel. The dragline silk consists of two major spidroins, namely MaSp1 and MaSp2, which have been intensively investigated in recent years. Interestingly, a low-molecular-weight nonspidroin component, despite a low content (~ 1%), was identified from the complex constituent proteins of dragline silk to show remarkable effect on the resultant mechanical property. The underlying mechanism for the improved mechanics remains unclear. Therefore, it gives rise to a key research question: Why spider dragline silk retains complex protein components across species? To help answer this question, a comprehensive study is carried out in this project to understand the interactions among spidroins during self-assembly, unveiling their impacts on the structure (i.e., hierarchical and crystalline structure) and providing implications on the mechanical property. A noteworthy subtype, MaSp3, was recently identified to be the third component after MaSp1/MaSp2 with different amino-acid compositions. MaSp3 is an enigma with high charge level. By this context, these three proteins are exposed to a well-established biomimetic spinning system, where a series of naturally occurring triggers are introduced for fiber assembly. Advanced facilities, such as synchrotron radiated XRD will be employed to provide accurate and rapid analysis on the silk structure from the soluble, transition to solid state. Very little is known about how each protein component of dragline silk contributes to the mechanical properties. The motivation of this project is to establish such a link and to inspire the biomimetic design of high-performance materials based on the understanding of component-structure-property relationship within dragline silk. This project will bring the beneficiaries to the development of liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), which is not only a paradigm for spider silk self-assembly mechanism, but also a significant phenomenon involved in human’s neurodegenerative diseases. Therefore, this project is of great value for the advancement of both material science and medical engineering. 在自然界中，圓網蜘蛛（如金絲圓蛛 Trichonephila clavipes）能夠製造出五種具有不同機械性能、用於特定任務的絲。牽引絲作為蜘蛛網的骨架，賦予其強度與韌性，因此成為科學家們試圖模仿這一獨特材料奇蹟的研究焦點。牽引絲主要由兩種絲蛋白（MaSp1 和 MaSp2）組成，這兩種蛋白近年來已被廣泛研究。有趣的是，研究人員還從牽引絲複雜的蛋白質成分中發現了一種低分子量、非絲蛋白組分，雖然含量僅約 1%，卻對最終機械性能產生了顯著影響。然而，其提升機械性能的機制仍不明確。 因此，這引發了一個關鍵的研究問題：為什麼蜘蛛牽引絲在不同物種間都保留了複雜的蛋白質成分？為了回答這一問題，本項目將開展全面研究，深入理解絲蛋白在自組裝過程中的相互作用，揭示其對結構（如層次結構與結晶結構）的影響，並進一步闡明其對機械性能的啟示。值得注意的是，最近發現了一種新的亞型 MaSp3，作為繼 MaSp1 和 MaSp2 之後的第三種組分，其氨基酸組成不同，且帶有較高的電荷，至今仍是一個謎團。在本研究中，這三種蛋白將被引入全方位的仿生紡絲系統，並通過一系列自然觸發條件進行纖維組裝。同時，將利用先進的同步輻射 X 射線衍射（XRD）等設施，對絲從可溶態、過渡態到固態的結構進行準確且快速的分析。 目前，關於牽引絲中每一種蛋白質成分如何影響其機械性能的認識仍十分有限。本項目的動機在於建立這一關聯，並以對牽引絲成分-結構-性能關係的理解，啟發高性能仿生材料的設計。本項目還將推動液-液相分離（LLPS）研究的發展，它不僅是蜘蛛絲自組裝機制的典範，也是與人類神經退行性疾病相關的重要現象。因此，本項目對於材料科學與醫學工程的發展都具有重要價值。

15214025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15214025.value: 混合滑移-搖擺節段柱支撐的橋樑結構跨斷層抗震性能研究與設計

15214025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214025.value: Traditional monolithic columns-supported bridges (MCSBs) may suffer from serious damage during a severe earthquake, which may significantly influence the functionality of bridge structures. Segmental columns-supported bridge (SCSB) is deemed as a good alternative to solve such problem. Extensive research efforts have been devoted to investigating the seismic behaviour of segmental column itself. The study on the whole bridge structure (i.e., SCSB) is limited, and almost all these studies considered far-field and near-fault ground motions. In fact, the special layout of segmental column can accommodate large permanent ground displacements resulting from fault ruptures, making it ideal for bridges crossing fault-rupture zones. The research in this area is, however, very limited: only two papers have been published so far, and the PI is a co-author of these papers. Considering the very different characteristics of far-field, near-fault and across-fault ground motions, these two studies are obviously not enough. This project aims to develop an innovative SCSB to cross two typical fault ruptures, namely the strike-slip and dip-slip ruptures. The following key innovations and research tasks are included: (1) to effectively accommodate the large permanent ground displacements in the transverse (for strike-slip rupture) and longitudinal and vertical (for dip-slip rupture) directions, a novel hybrid sliding-rocking (HSR) segmental column is proposed in the project; (2) the first-ever shaking table tests on SCSBs subjected to fault ruptures will be carried out to examine the effectiveness of the proposed bridge; (3) high-fidelity finite element (FE) models will be developed to reveal the influences of the key fault- and bridge-related parameters on its seismic performance; (4) based on the outcome of this research project and the PI and Co-I’s existing in-depth understanding on the seismic performances of SCSBs subjected to the far-field and near-fault ground motions, the seismic behaviours of SCSBs under all the possible ground motion types will be systematically evaluated, and the optimal seismic performance will be obtained by properly designing the bridge. The successful completion of the project will complement and advance the current understanding on the seismic performances of SCSBs, making it cover all the possible earthquake ground motion types from far-field to near-fault, and further to across-fault ground motions. This research is expected to further promote the application of SCSBs in seismic-prone areas, especially in the fault-rupture zones. 傳統整體柱支撐的橋梁結構（MCSB）在強震中可能遭受嚴重破壞，從而嚴重影響震後救援工作。節段拼裝柱支撐的橋梁結構（SCSB）被認為是解決這一問題的理想替代方案。目前，大量研究集中於節段拼裝柱本身的抗震性能，但對節段拼裝柱支撐的橋梁結構（即SCSB）的研究仍較為有限，且幾乎所有研究僅考慮遠場和近斷層地震動。事實上，節段柱的特殊構造可適應斷層破裂引起的較大永久地面位移，使其成為跨越斷層破裂帶的理想橋梁選擇。然而，該領域的研究極為匱乏：目前僅發表兩篇論文（項目負責人為共同作者）。考慮到遠場、近斷層及跨斷層地震動的顯著差異，這兩項研究顯然不足。 本項目旨在開發一種創新型SCSB，以應對兩種典型斷層破裂（走滑型與傾滑型）的影響。項目主要創新點與研究任務包括：1、提出一種新型混合滑移-搖擺節段柱，以有效適應走滑型破裂引起的橫向位移，以及傾滑型破裂引起的縱向與豎向位移；2、針對SCSBs的跨斷層地震作用，開展首例振動台試驗，驗證所提出橋梁方案的有效性；3、建立高保真有限元模型並進行參數分析，揭示關鍵斷層參數與橋梁參數對其抗震性能的影響；4、基於本項目研究成果，結合項目負責人對遠場及近斷層地震動下SCSB抗震性能的深入理解，系統評估SCSB在所有可能地震動類型下的抗震行為，並通過合理設計實現最優抗震性能。 本項目的成功實施將完善並推動當前對SCSB抗震性能的認識，使其涵蓋從遠場、近斷層到跨斷層地震動的所有可能類型。該研究有望進一步促進SCSB在地震高發區（尤其是斷層破裂帶）的應用。

15214125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15214125.value: 具有狀態和分佈約束的平均場奇異控制問題的系統性研究

15214125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214125.value: Tremendous applications in modern finance and engineering incur the decision making for a large cooperative multi-agent system, for which the mean-field control formulation has been proposed as a successful and tractable approximation. Notably, many large stochastic systems inherently involve the collective singular control strategies, featuring the possible impulsive control actions that can bring abrupt changes to the state dynamics. Moreover, some intricate dynamic constraints on stochastic systems are often mandated in real-life applications due to risk regulations, budget restrictions or limited recourses. Despite the great importance in applications, theoretical foundations in the context with constraints such as the existence theory and the characterization of the optimality are underdeveloped. We take this challenge and propose to investigate general mean-field control problems with singular control under pathwise constraints imposed jointly on the state process and its distribution flow. The scope of our research is to advance mean-field theories by developing novel and impactful probabilistic and analytical methods to cope with dynamic constraints and to characterize the optimal singular control. Our systematic study is broken down into two main problems. In the first problem, our main goals are to confirm the existence of an optimal singular control and prove the dynamic programming principle (DPP). To this end, we propose some new arguments reminiscent of relaxed control formulation and the compactification method by considering admissible controls as probability measures to embed the pathwise constraints in a relaxed sense. Based on some new measurable selection arguments by embedding the constraints, we can establish the DPP and derive the Hamiltonian-Jacobi-Bellman variational inequality on the Wasserstein space of probability measures. In the second problem, we propose a generalized Lagrange multipliers method, new to the literature, by treating the controlled McKean-Vlasov process as an infinite-dimensional equality constraint. The original problem can be framed as an optimization problem on canonical spaces with constraints on Banach space, allowing us to carry out some unconventional steps to prove the stochastic maximum principle (SMP) and derive the constrained backward stochastic differential equation. Consequently, our proposed research contributes to two pillars of methodologies in mean-field models, namely DPP and SMP, and will push the frontier of the relevant research via our newly developed methods and tools. We will also strive to undertake some case studies and provide valuable insights and guidance for practical financial applications. 大量的現代金融和工程領域的應用都涉及到大型協作多智能體系統的決策制定。平均場控制問題的提出和發展，為這類複雜系統的決策問題提供了有效且易於處理的近似方法。值得注意的是，許多大型隨機系統都涉及到集體性的奇異控制策略，且這類脈衝式控制能夠引起群體狀態的突變。此外，在實際應用中，由於風險監管，預算限制或資源限制等原因，通常還需要對隨機系統施加一些複雜的動態約束。然而，雖然這類約束在實際應用中極為重要，但基於約束限制的理論基礎研究，例如存在性理論和最優性刻畫等，尚未得到充分的發展。我們希望應對這一挑戰，展開針對狀態和分佈的路徑受限的平均場奇異控制問題的研究。我們的研究課題旨在通過發展創新性且有影響力的概率和分析方法，來應對狀態和分佈的動態約束並刻畫最優奇異控制，從而推動平均場理論在約束限制下的前沿發展。 我們的系統性研究主要分為兩個問題。在第一個問題中，我們的主要目標是證明最優奇異控制的存在性，並證明在約束限制的平均場框架下的動態規劃原理 (DPP)。為此，我們提出了一些新的論證方法，其借鑑了鬆弛控制的思想和緊致化方法。通過將可行控制視為概率測度，我們可以把狀態和分佈的路徑約束嵌入到鬆弛控制的選擇中，從而基於一些新的可測選擇的理論方法，我們可以在約束嵌入的問題中，建立動態規劃原理，並在概率測度的Wasserstein空間上推導出Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman變分不等式。在第二個問題中，我們提出了一種廣義拉格朗日乘子法，這在現有文獻中尚屬首次。該方法將受控McKean-Vlasov過程視為無限維的等式約束。基於此，原控制問題可以被表述為軌道空間上的優化問題，並在Banach空間上施加約束，這使得我們能夠採取一些全新的步驟來推導隨機最大值原理 (SMP)， 並進一步得到受約束後的倒向隨機微分方程。因此，我們所提出的研究將為平均場模型中的兩大方法論支柱-動態規劃原理和隨機最大值原理-做出全新的貢獻，並通過我們新提出的方法和工具推動平均場理論的進一步發展。我們也將努力開展一些應用方面的研究，通過具體實例為金融應用提供有價值的見解和指導。

15214225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15214225.value: 宽带四次及高偶数阶色散孤子的理论与实验研究

15214225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15214225.value: Prof Luo, Zhichao Prof Tam, Hwa-yaw Prof Wai, Ping Kong Alexander

15214225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214225.value: Optical solitons, discovered by A. Hasegawa in 1973, have been extensively investigated for more than 50 years. However, most of the research has focused on solitary waves either dominated by the balances between self-phase modulation and group velocity dispersion in optical fibers, or together with filtering and gain-loss dynamics in laser cavities. Higher-order dispersions are considered as perturbations that distort the solitons or as constraints to obtain ultrashort pulses and broadband spectra. This situation has changed since the experimental demonstration of pure quartic solitons (PQSs) in a photonic crystal waveguide by A. Blanco-Redondo in 2016. The PQSs balance self-phase modulation by fourth-order dispersion and they have a Gaussian-like main lobe with oscillatory tails in the temporal waveform and a flatter peak in the spectrum. The energy of PQSs is inversely proportional to the cubic power of the pulse duration. Thus, for the same pulse width, PQSs have higher energy than conventional solitons. Higher even-order dispersion (HEOD) solitons have also been proposed and demonstrated and are emerging as a promising technique for generating flat and broadband spectra with higher pulse energy. Recently, there has been much interest in quartic and HEOD solitons because of their rich nonlinear dynamics and potential in spectrum and pulse engineering. However, a complete understanding of the dynamics of quartic and HEOD solitons remains challenging because analytical solutions of these solitons are not available, and it is difficult to obtain a dispersion curve with negative HEODs in practice. In this project, we will perform a comprehensive study of the nonlinear dynamics of quartic and HEOD solitons governed by nonlinearities including self-phase modulation, higher-order dispersions including quartic dispersion, filtering, and nonlinear losses in laser cavities. We will build a generalized theoretical model to study the balance of different physical effects in quartic and HEOD solitons and to determine the optimal analytical description of the soliton solutions. We will study the stability and accessibility of the soliton solutions. We will study the complex interaction of different physical effects using the differential Gabor transform. We will design different types of waveguides including photonic crystal fibers and on-chip waveguides with tailored dispersion curves to support the propagation of quartic and HEOD solitons. Finally, flat-top spectrum and high-energy higher even-order femtosecond solitons in fiber lasers will also be investigated both theoretically and experimentally by engineering dispersion and filtering. 光孤子由 A. Hasegawa 于 1973 年发现，50 多年来对其进行了广泛研究。然而，大多数研究都集中研究受光纤中自相位调制和群速度色散之间的平衡所主导的光孤子，或者由激光腔中的滤波和增益损耗动力学共同作用而形成的光孤子。高阶色散被认为是扰动，会限制超短脉冲宽度和光谱带宽。2016 年 A. Blanco-Redondo 在光子晶体波导中实验演示纯四次孤子 (PQS) ，纯四次孤子通过四阶色散平衡自相位调制，它们具有类似于高斯的主瓣，时间波形中有振荡尾部，光谱中的峰值更平坦。纯四次孤子的能量与脉冲持续时间的立方成反比。因此，在相同脉冲宽度下，纯四次孤子的能量高于传统孤子。高偶数阶色散 (HEOD) 孤子也已被提出并得到验证，并有望成为一种产生具有更高脉冲能量的平坦宽带光谱的新兴技术。近年来，四次和高偶数阶色散孤子因其丰富的非线性动力学特性以及在光谱和脉冲工程中的潜力而备受关注。然而，全面理解四次和 高偶数阶色散孤子的动力学仍然具有挑战性，因为这些孤子目前尚无解析解，而且在实践中很难获得具有负高偶数阶色散的色散曲线。 在本项目中，我们将全面研究四次和高偶数阶色散孤子的非线性动力学，这些动力学受非线性因素（包括自相位调制、高阶色散（包括四次色散）、滤波以及激光腔中的非线性损耗）的控制。我们将建立一个广义理论模型，研究四次和高偶数阶色散孤子中不同物理效应的平衡，并确定孤子解的最优解析描述。我们将研究孤子解的稳定性和可达性。我们将利用差分Gabor变换研究不同物理效应的复杂相互作用。我们将设计不同类型的波导，包括光子晶体光纤、片上波导和光纤布拉格光栅，并定制色散曲线以支持四次和高偶数阶色散孤子的传播。最后，我们还将通过色散和滤波工程，从理论和实验两个角度研究光纤激光器中的平顶光谱和高能高偶数阶飞秒孤子。

15215025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15215025.value: 用於卒中早期腕指康復之疲勞調控及靶向神經通路重塑的腦肌接口外神經肌骨系統

15215025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15215025.value: Prof Li, Zengyong Prof Ng, Sheung Mei Shamay Prof Poon, Wai Sang

15215025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215025.value: Effective motor restoration poststroke requires early and intensive physical intervention starting from the subacute stage with voluntary motor effort (VME) from the ipsilesional neuromuscular pathways to achieve rehabilitative neuroplasticity in the brain while minimizing compensation from the contralesional pathways. However, overloaded physical training in early stroke may result in further brain lesions because of hypoxia during cortical fatigue easily experienced by subacute patients. Unfortunately, the regulation of cortical fatigue during physical training in subacute stroke has not been well investigated clinically. On the other hand, the hybrid of neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and mechanical actuation, i.e., NMES-robot, is new in rehabilitation robot design, augmenting labor-demanding physical rehabilitation. It demonstrated better rehabilitative effects than sole assistance in chronic stroke studies. However, NMES could introduce fast fatigue, and its coactivating effects with robotic assistance have not been investigated in subacute rehabilitation. Additionally, robot-assisted rehabilitation, including NMES-robots, suffered significant compensatory neuroplasticity because the current robotic controls cannot recruit the intact VME from the ipsilesional motor pathways. In this project, we propose to design a novel neural interface (NI) in a soft wrist-hand NMES-robot, i.e., exoneuromusculoskeleton (ENMS) invented by the team. It will guide the cortical neuroplasticity towards the ipsilesional descending neural track by facilitating the corticomuscular connection from desired cortical regions to a targeted muscle through corticomusuclar coherence (CMC) and electromyography (EMG) of the muscle (CMC-EMG) in wrist-hand physical training. Meanwhile, the cortical fatigue will be regulated under a moderate level by monitoring the oxygenated hemoglobin (HbO2) level via functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). We will first research the real-time patterns of the CMC and the varying range of HbO2 level in rehabilitation of subacute stroke. Then, the NI-ENMS will be designed by including the CMC-EMG control and cortical fatigue regulation in each wrist/hand extension and flexion. The ipsilesional neuromuscular pathway of the targeted muscles will be progressively enhanced through repetitive recruitment. Meanwhile, temporary rests will be provided when the HbO2 reaches a moderate fatigue level. The rehabilitative effectiveness of the new system will be compared with that of traditional EMG-driven mechanical robot assistance by a randomized controlled trial in terms of motor behavioral improvements and neuroplastic effects in the brain and muscles. The project's success will bring breakthroughs in the effectiveness of current robots with safe and cost-effective technology for early poststroke rehabilitation, and the NI design can be applied to other body parts for broader applications. 中風後實現有效的運動功能恢復，需要從亞急性階段開始，盡早進行高強度的物理干預。此過程應依賴患側神經肌肉通路的自主運動（VME），以促進腦部的康復性神經可塑性，同時盡量減少對健側通路的代償性使用。然而，在中風早期進行過度的體能訓練，可能因亞急性患者易出現皮層疲勞，導致皮層缺氧，從而引發進一步的腦損傷。然而，目前臨床上對亞急性中風患者在訓練過程中皮層疲勞的調控機制尚缺乏系統研究。 與此同時，神經肌肉電刺激（NMES）與機械驅動相結合的混合系統——即 NMES-robot，是康復機器人設計中的新興方向，能夠有效緩解傳統康復訓練對人力的高度依賴。在慢性中風的研究中，該系統已顯示出優於單一機械輔助的康復效果。然而，NMES 可能引發快速疲勞，其與機器人輔助之間的協同激活效應在亞急性康復中的作用尚未被深入探討。此外，現有的機器人控制系統難以有效調動患側運動通路中的VME，導致康復過程中出現顯著的代償性神經重塑。 本項目擬在團隊自主研發的柔性腕-手 NMES-robot——外神經肌骨系統（ENMS）中，設計一種創新的腦肌接口（NI）。該接口將通過皮層肌肉相干性（CMC）與肌電（EMG）信號（即 CMC-EMG）建立從特定皮層區域到目標肌肉的皮層-肌肉連接，從而在腕指訓練中引導神經可塑性朝向患側下行神經通路。同時，借助功能性近紅外光譜（fNIRS）監測氧合血紅蛋白（HbO₂）水平，實現對皮層疲勞的適度調控。 我們將首先研究亞急性中風康復過程中 CMC 的實時變化模式及 HbO₂ 水平的波動範圍。隨後，基於這些研究結果，構建包含 CMC-EMG 控制與皮層疲勞調控機制的 NI-ENMS 系統，應用於每次腕/手的伸展與屈曲訓練中。通過重復性患側訓練，目標神經肌肉通路將逐步得到強化；當 HbO₂ 水平達到中度疲勞閾值時，系統將自動提供短暫休息。我們將通過隨機對照試驗，將該新系統與傳統 EMG 驅動的ENMS輔助進行比較，評估其在運動行為改善及腦部與肌肉神經可塑性方面的康復效果。 本項目的成功將為中風早期康復提供一種安全、經濟且高效的機器人輔助技術，顯著提升現有康復機器人的臨床應用效果。同時，該腦肌接口設計具有良好的可拓展性，可推廣至身體其他部位，拓展其在康復醫學中的應用範圍。

15215125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15215125.value: 一種用以持續監測血糖的可穿戴水凝膠微針超聲設備

15215125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215125.value: Despite the widespread application of high-frequency ultrasound (HFU) for biomedical imaging (i.e., ultrasonography), its use to directly access biochemical or physiological information (e.g., hemoglobin, glucose and cholesterol levels) in vivo from body fluids (e.g., blood and interstitial fluid) remains rare. This rarity is due to challenges such as inadequate understanding of the correlations between HFU features and biochemical or physiological parameters, and the lack of convenient, in situ implementation methods. Motivated by these challenges, we aspire to a novel research framework, aiming to equip the conventional HFU with a new capability: minimally invasive, continuous, quantitative, convenient and in situ monitoring of glucose-related bioinformation carried by interstitial fluid. In our preliminary in vivo study, we have demonstrated that when a microneedle patch made of glucose-responsive hydrogel was placed between an ultrasound probe and the skin of an anesthetized nude mouse, the swelling degree of the microneedles could serve as an exclusive indicator of blood sugar variation. Building on this preliminary study, we propose to theoretically and experimentally investigate the modulation mechanism of glucose on hydrogels, through a multiphysics model encompassing coupled mechanics, chemical equilibrium, chemical reactions and solvent transport in actual physiological environments. This will help establish quantitative correlations between glucose variation and hydrogel swelling. We will prototype a wearable, ultrasound-readable and enzyme-free hydrogel microneedle patch by using a dedicated projection micro-stereolithography process. This patch will serve as an acoustically augmentative interface between a standard ultrasound probe and skin. Each microneedle will slightly puncture the epidermis yet without reaching the hypodermis, allowing interstitial fluid to swell hydrogels. The swelling degree will be calibrated using an ultrasound probe. With the above obtained correlations, glucose levels can be calibrated quantitatively, rapidly and minimally invasively. The key originality of this research lies in: instead of attempting to use HFU for directly accessing physiological and biochemical parameters in body fluids—a highly challenging task, HFU will only be used as a standard tool to calibrate the swelling of hydrogel microneedles embedded in a wearable patch beneath an ultrasound probe—a straightforward task. In a sense, the patch is analogous to an “accessory” for conventional ultrasound transducers, while the deliverable will be minimally invasive, continuous, convenient and in situ glucose monitoring. Results are expected to facilitate innovative approaches towards daily, low-cost, self-monitoring of cardiovascular health. 雖然高頻超聲波已廣泛應用於生物醫學影像（如超聲檢查），但將其直接用於獲取體內體液（如血液或組織間液）中生化或生理信息（例如血紅素、葡萄糖及膽固醇濃度）的應用仍然鮮有報道。此一缺失主要源於兩項挑戰：其一為尚未充分理解高頻超聲波信號特徵與生化／生理參數之間的關聯性，其二為缺乏原位且便利的臨床實現手段。 鑒於上述挑戰，本研究提出一種新穎的研究框架，旨在賦予傳統高頻超聲波以嶄新之功能：對組織間液所攜帶的與葡萄糖相關之生理信息，進行微創、持續、定量、原位且便利的監測。我們在前期預備研究中已經證實，當一片由葡萄糖響應型水凝膠製成的微針貼片置於超聲探頭與麻醉裸鼠皮膚之間時，微針的膨脹程度可作為專屬指標以反映血糖變化。 基於此，我們後續研究將從理論與實驗層面探討葡萄糖濃度對水凝膠調變的作用機制，建立一多物理耦合模型，以模擬實際生理環境中水凝膠的力學行為、化學平衡、化學反應及溶劑傳輸，有助於量化葡萄糖濃度變化與水凝膠膨脹程度之間的關聯性。我們亦將利用專用的投影式微立體光刻技術，製作出一類可穿戴、可由超聲波讀取、無酶的水凝膠微針貼片。此貼片將作為標準超聲探頭與皮膚之間的聲學拓展介面，每根微針僅輕微穿刺表皮，並不觸及真皮層，使組織間液得以滲入水凝膠內並誘發其膨脹。常規超聲探頭可用於校準膨脹程度，基於該結果，用户即可定量、快速且微創地獲取血糖水平。 本研究之創新性在於：相較於挑戰單獨以高頻超聲波讀取體液中的生化或生理參數，不如將高頻超聲波作為測量工具，用以分析置於其下方貼片中葡萄糖響應型水凝膠微針之膨脹變化，此作法更為直接且可行。從某種程度而言，此貼片猶如傳統超聲探頭之“拓展配件”，而整體實現方法則為一種具備微創、持續、便利與原位測量特性的血糖水平監測手段。本研究成果可望推動面向心血管問題的日常、低成本且自主的創新健康監測發展。

15215325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15215325.value: 大語言模型驅動的工業肆點零下的環境、社會及公司管治披露

15215325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15215325.value: Prof Huang, George Q Prof Yang, Hongxia

15215325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215325.value: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) has launched the ESG Reporting Guide in 2013. In the past eleven years, the guide has been changing always towards reporting in a more rigorous manner. In addition to HK, the US, UK and EU have frequently updated their disclosure regulations to address increasing climate concerns Undoubtedly, all jurisdictions have tightened their governance over ESG disclosure to facilitate more transparent and creditable green behaviors for achieving sustainable aims. However, the differences among regional ESG disclosure regulations, as well as the changes exhibited by reporting frameworks, have generated enormous challenges for firms that need to report, at least on a yearly basis. Industry 4.0 has offered a sound data infrastructure to collect and store front-end real-time manufacturing data for ESG reporting. However, this is still far away from drafting a complete ESG report. Now ESG reporting consultancy is very popular, but expensive. One report will cost 0.2 -1.2 million HK$ and until 2023, there are 5051 listed companies at HKEX. This huge market stimulates us to explore how ESG reports can be prepared in a more efficient and less costly manner. The emerging large language models (LLMs) have brought more opportunities for writing ESG reports. While the hard-to-interpretability of LLMs provide significant concerns about data security and privacy. LLMs need mass data to become perfect but they may leak sensitive data inadvertently via crafty queries, even if multiple secure auditing mechanisms can be applied. Inspired by a famous deduction-based party game, ‘The Resistance: Avalon’, this project aims to reconstruct the responsibility allocation scheme among LLMs to realize data protection. This game includes a role called Merlin. He knows the identities of some or all evil players but must be careful not to reveal them to the evil Assassin. Thus, he must comment on others’ speeches to influence the situation silently. This role motivates design of two LLMs. One is a private Author LLM that only depends on local data for writing ESG reports. The other one is a Reviewer LLM, which has global information but can only comment on the reports generated by the private Author LLM in terms of specific dimensions. To protect the transparency and security of raw ESG data between LLMs and firms, a time series blockchain-enabled secure multiparty data circulation approach will be developed to accelerate the data queries with multimodal, time series and heterogeneous features. 港交所於2013年推出了《環境、社會及管治 (ESG) 報告指南》。在過去的十一年中，該指南一直在朝著更嚴謹的披露形式發展。除香港外，美國、英國和歐盟也頻繁更新其ESG揭露規則，以應對日益增長的氣候問題。毫無疑問，所有司法管轄區都加強了對 ESG 揭露的監管，從而促進更透明、更可信的綠色行為，實現可持續發展目標。然而，ESG 揭露規則的地區差異以及報告框架的持續變更給需要進行年度ESG披露的公司帶來了巨大挑戰。雖然工業 4.0 提供了完善的數據基礎設施，可用於收集和存儲 ESG 報告事項的原始數據。然而，擁有原始數據距離撰寫一份完整合規的 ESG 報告相去甚遠。因此，目前ESG 報告諮詢非常受歡迎，但費用昂貴。一份編撰ESG報告的成本約為20萬至120萬港幣，而截至2023年，香港交易所共有5051家上市公司。如此龐大的市場需求促使我們探索如何以更有效率、更低成本的方式編製ESG報告。新興的大型語言模型（LLM）為ESG報告的編寫帶來了更多機會。然而，LLM的不可解釋性也引發了數據安全和隱私方面的擔憂。 LLM需要大量數據才能達到更好的性能，但即使可以應用多種安全審計機制，它們也可能透過巧妙設計的查詢無意中洩露敏感資料。 本項目受著名推理類派對遊戲《反抗軍：阿瓦隆》的啟發，旨在通過多個LLM之間的責任分配重建，以實現數據保護。這個遊戲中有一個名為梅林的角色。他知道部分或所有邪惡玩家的身份，但他必須小心謹慎，防止邪惡玩家的刺殺。因此，他只能通過引導其他玩家的言論，以悄無聲息地影響局勢。這一角色引導我們在本項目中設計兩種 LLM 。一種是私有LLM作者，僅依賴本地數據編寫 ESG 報告。另一種是 LLM審閱者，它擁有全局訊息，但只能在特定維度上對私有 LLM作者生成的報告進行評論。為了保障 LLMs 和公司之間原始 ESG 數據的透明度和安全性，本項目還將開發一種基於時間序列區塊鏈的安全多方數據流通基礎設施，以加速具有多模態、時間序列和異質特徵的數據在區塊鏈上的多級緩存及查詢。

15215525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15215525.value: 數據中心內高速相干多模光纖互聯技術的理論與實驗研究

15215525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215525.value: Fiber optical communications, as one of the most important communication systems to achieving fast and reliable exchange of data and information, support the developing of economy and society, the operation of industries, businesses and finance and fast and reliable exchange of data and information. With the emergence of new applications such as Augmented/Virtual Reality, cloud computing, storage, and other software-as-a-service (SaaS) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) drive the huge demand for data centers (DCs) which were established to store, process and distribute data between servers and users. For intra-DC interconnects, the volumes of installed Multi-Mode Fiber (MMF) links are thus still huge. And they are still being installed in numbers of more than 20million per year and represent 50% of the total rates up to 100Gbit/s and 30% for rates up to 400G. Replacing MMFs to SMFs will bring the increase of human cost and financial resources, especially in harsh environments. Therefore, in principle, it is very important and interesting to upgrade achievable transmission rate without sacrificing transmission distance by using the installed MMFs, which can achieve a huge cost saving. In this project, we propose a systematic and comprehensive research plan to explore coherent communications over multi-mode fiber links to overcoming the limitation of bit-rate distance product of deployed MMFs for intra-data center interconnects. First, we will build the theory and simulation platform of coherent communication over MMFs. The coherent communications are made by optical components operating at O band or C band. The analytical and numerical simulation will be performed. Second, we will propose to mitigate the frequency power fading due to mode dispersion by using digital subcarrier modulation, which will enable high transmission bit rate under mismatch between SMF and MMF. Third, a residual carrier based frequency offset and phase noise compensation method will be proposed. This will enable the adoption of low-cost DFB laser for coherent transceiver, which reduce the over-all cost and power consumptions. Fourth, we will propose a symbol rate receiver digital signal processing, which require only symbol rate sampling for ADCs, to further reduce the power consumption for coherent systems. Finally, we will carry out experimental demonstration for propose coherent communications over MMFs with a bit rate from 800Gbit/s to 1.6Tbit/s per wavelength and transmission distance up to 300m. It is believed the success of this project will promote the accelerate Hong Kong’s research and innovation in optical communication and photonics related fields. 光纖通信技術作為實現快速可靠的數據與信息傳輸的重要通訊系統之一，支撐社會經濟的發展，促進工業、商業與金融的運作，實現信息的高速可靠的傳輸。增強/虛擬實境、雲端運算與儲存，以及其他軟體即服務（SaaS）與基礎建設即服務（IaaS）等新興應用的出現與發展，推動了社會對實現數據存儲、計算與交換的數據中心的巨大需求。在數據中心內部互聯通信方面，多模光纖鏈路的部署量仍然龐大。每年有超過2000萬多模光互聯鏈路被投入使用，其在100Gbit/s光互聯鏈路中佔比達50%，在400Gbit/s光互聯鏈路中佔比達30%. 如果將所有多模鏈路更改成單模光纖鏈路將需要付出巨大的人力和資金。因此，在已部署的多模鏈路的基礎上提升現有系統的傳輸速率將帶來巨大的成本節約，這是一項非常重要且具有吸引力的研究。 在本研究計劃中，我們提出一項系統全面的研究方案，旨在探索相干傳輸技術在多模光纖鏈路中的應用，以突破已部署多模光纖鏈路在數據中心內部互連中比特率-距離乘積的限制。首先，我們將建立多模光纖鏈路的相干光傳輸系統的理論與模擬平台進行理論與數值模擬研究。相干光傳輸系統將採用在O波段或C波段光器件實現。其次，我們將提出使用數字子載波調製技術，以減緩因模式色散所造成的頻率功率衰減，從而在多模光纖鏈路情況下實現高比特率傳輸。第三，我們將提出一種基於殘留載波的頻率偏移與相位噪聲補償方法，使得低成本的DFB激光器可應用於相干收發器，進一步降低相干光傳輸系統整體成本與功耗。第四，我們將提出一種符號率接收端數字信號處理算法架構，僅需符號率取樣的數模轉換器（ADC），以進一步降低相干光傳輸系統的功耗。最後，我們將搭建實驗平台，傳輸速率從800Gbit/s至1.6Tbit/s、傳輸距離達300米的多模光纖相干傳輸系統的性能。我們相信，本計畫的成功將加速香港在光通訊與光子學相關領域的科研與創新發展。

15215825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15215825.value: 面向電子鼻應用的超靈敏微型光纖針尖光機械微天平氣體傳感器

15215825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215825.value: This project aims to investigate the synergetic optical and micromechanical resonances in a micrometer-scale optomechanical resonator (OMR) that is 3D micro-printed on the end-face of optical fiber and thereby develop ultra-sensitive/miniature optical fiber-tip multi-parameter gas sensors for electronic nose (e-nose) applications. E-noses have long attracted significant attention due to their potential in various important applications, such as agricultural production, food quality/safety assessment, disease diagnostics, and environmental monitoring. Essentially, they are gas/odor sensor arrays capable of recognizing multiple gas species and determining their concentrations. One of the typical sensor technologies used in e-nose devices is quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) gas sensors. These sensors have advantages of high sensitivity, room-temperature operation, low cost, and ease of functionalization. However, their typical size, about 0.5 to 1 inch in diameter, limits their use in many space-restricted applications. Optical fiber sensor technology offers a promising solution for creating compact high-sensitivity e-nose devices. For example, a widely acclaimed artificial nose was demonstrated by depositing dye-immobilized polymers on the individual end-faces of an optical fiber bundle to sense multiple gases via fluorescence. However, such a fluorescence intensity-based sensor is susceptible to environmental and system disturbances. Additionally, its specificity is generally lower than that of QCM gas sensors, partly because it requires gas-sensing materials with more sophisticated molecules that can not only selectively capture target gases but also exhibit gas-sensitive fluorescence. In this project, we will tackle these challenges by developing a new kind of microbalance-based gas sensor, called optical fiber-tip optomechanical-microbalance (OMM) gas sensor. It is a micrometer-scale high-Q OMR designed on optical fiber end-face, utilizing both optical and micromechanical resonances for ultrasensitive mass-type gas sensing. Specifically, a multimode quad-planar spring OMR is devised to harness multiple resonant vibration modes for simultaneous monitoring of gas concentration and temperature/humidity fluctuations. Our in-house optical 3D micro-printing system will be upgraded to enable the direct printing of OMM sensor array on the end-face of optical fiber bundle and in-situ modification with functional materials for multi-parameter gas sensing. Furthermore, artificial intelligence-based algorithms will be developed for multi-gas recognition and cross-sensitivity resolving, and the application of the fabricated optical fiber-bundle multi-sensory device in food production control will be demonstrated. The successful implementation of this project will lead to a new generation of small-size high-performance optoelectronic nose devices. These devices have the potential to revolutionize multi-gas/odor sensing across a wide range of important applications ranging from food production/quality monitoring to industrial safety surveillance. 本項目旨在探索3D微打印於光纖端面上的微米級光機共振器(OMR)光學和微機械共振的協同效應，開發超靈敏微型光纖針尖多參數氣體傳感器及其電子鼻應用。 電子鼻因其在各種重要應用中的潛力，例如農業生產、食品質量/安全評估、疾病診斷和環境監測，而長期受到廣泛關注。從本質上講，它們就是能夠識別多種氣體並確定其濃度的氣體/氣味傳感器陣列。 在眾多電子鼻技術中，一種典型的感測技術是石英晶體微天平(QCM)氣體傳感器。這些傳感器具有高靈敏度、室溫操作、低成本和易於功能化的優點。然而，它們的典型尺寸約為0.5至1英寸的直徑，限制了它們在許多空間有限應用中的使用。 光纖傳感器技術為創造緊湊高靈敏度的電子鼻設備提供了有前途的解決方案。例如，一種廣受讚譽的人工鼻是通過將染料固定的聚合物沉積在光纖束的各個端面上來展示的，從而通過螢光來檢測多種氣體。然而，這種基於螢光強度的傳感器容易受到環境和系統擾動的影響。此外，由於其需要具有更複雜分子的氣體感測材料。它們不僅要能選擇性捕獲目標氣體，還需能展現氣體敏感性螢光，因此其特異性通常低於QCM氣體傳感器。 在此項目中，我們將通過開發一種基於新型微天平技術的氣體傳感器，稱為光纖針尖光機械微天平(OMM)氣體傳感器，來應對這些挑戰。這是一種設計在光纖端面的微米級高品质因子OMR，能利用光學和微機械共振進行超靈敏質量型氣體檢測。具體而言，我們設計了一種四平面彈簧結構的多模OMR，利用其多個共振振動模式來同時監測氣體濃度和溫度/濕度波動。我們將升級自建的光學3D微打印系統，直接在光纖束的端面上打印OMM傳感器陣列，並用功能材料進行原位改性，以便進行多參數氣體檢測。此外，我們將開發基於人工智能的算法以實現多氣體識別和交叉靈敏度解析，從而開發應用於食品生產控制的光纖束多傳感器設備。 本項目的成功實施將開發出新一代小型高性能光電電子鼻設備。這些設備有望徹底改變多氣體/氣味感測技術，並廣泛應用於食品生產/質量監控、工業安全監測等重要領域。

15216125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216125.value: 重复经颅磁刺激治疗卒中患者神经源性膀胱过度活动症：疗效与机制研究

15216125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15216125.value: Dr Chung, Raymond Chi Keung Prof KRANZ, Georg Prof LIAN, JinXiao Prof MILLER, Tiev

15216125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216125.value: Neurogenic overactive bladder (OAB) occurs following damage to the brain and/or spinal cord and is common among stroke survivors. Neurogenic OAB is mediated by involuntary detrusor muscle contractions, resulting in urinary urgency, urgency incontinence, and frequent urination. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has been used to treat pelvic floor disorders for the last two decades. Low frequency rTMS’s efficacy for treating neurogenic OAB in upper motor neuron dysfunctions such as Parkinson’s disease is well-established; however, there is a lack of evidence for its equivalent use in stroke survivors. To determine if such a study was feasible, we conducted a pilot randomised controlled trial (n=60) alongside a cost-utility analysis. We compared OAB treatment outcomes and cost-utility among stroke survivors receiving active rTMS plus pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) and sham rTMS plus PFMT. The results from the pilot RCT indicated that rTMS was safe for stroke survivors and that the participants who received rTMS found the intervention to be acceptable. The preliminary results showed that active rTMS plus PFMT was more effective than sham rTMS plus PFMT in improving OAB symptom severity and quality of life (QoL). Preliminary cost-utility analysis indicated potential cost-saving in favour of active rTMS intervention. The next step is to evaluate the clinical and cost-effectiveness of rTMS in treating neurogenic OAB among stroke survivors in a full-scale RCT, while also investigating the mechanisms underlying its effectiveness when combined with PFMT. Based on the results of our pilot RCT and literature reporting that rTMS and PFMT-induced contractions in the anal and external urethral sphincters may lead to suppression of involuntary detrusor contraction, we hypothesise that (1) rTMS combined with PFMT will significantly improve OAB symptom severity (primary outcome) and QoL of stroke survivors with neurogenic OAB and be more cost-effective than sham rTMS combined with PFMT; and (2) stroke survivors assigned to the active rTMS plus PFMT group will demonstrate greater PFM strength and a larger decrease in detrusor wall thickness, resulting in better functional outcomes than stroke survivors assigned to the sham rTMS plus PFMT group. To test these hypotheses, we propose to conduct a prospective two-arm, parallel-group RCT in 154 stroke survivors with neurogenic OAB. Outcomes and mediator variables will be assessed at baseline, 4, and 8 weeks after randomisation. Treatment effects, mediation effects and economic evaluation will be assessed using analysis of covariance, theoretical PROCESS model-4 analysis, and cost-effectiveness analysis, respectively. 神经源性膀胱过度活动症（neurogenic overactive bladder, OAB）是一种由脑和/或脊髓损伤引起的常见病症，在卒中患者中尤为普遍。其主要病理机制是逼尿肌的非自主性收缩，临床表现为尿急、尿频及急迫性尿失禁。在过去二十年中，重复经颅磁刺激（repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation, rTMS）已被广泛用于治疗盆底功能障碍。研究表明，低频rTMS在治疗帕金森病等上运动神经元功能障碍所致的神经源性OAB方面具有显著疗效；然而，目前尚缺乏rTMS应用于卒中患者的相关研究证据。 为探讨相关研究的可行性，我们开展了一项样本量为60的试点随机对照试验，并结合成本效益分析，比较了rTMS联合盆底肌训练（pelvic floor muscle training, PFMT）与假rTMS联合PFMT治疗对卒中患者OAB症状和成本效益的影响。初步研究结果表明，rTMS治疗在卒中患者中安全可行，且接受rTMS治疗的患者对干预措施的接受度较高。研究结果显示，rTMS联合PFMT在改善OAB症状严重程度及提升生活质量方面优于假rTMS联合PFMT。同时，初步成本效益分析显示，rTMS干预可能具有潜在的成本节约优势。下一步将通过大规模随机对照试验进一步评估rTMS治疗卒中患者神经源性OAB的临床疗效和成本效益，同时深入探讨其与PFMT联合使用时的作用机制。 基于本次试点研究结果以及既往文献报道（rTMS和PFMT通过诱发肛门括约肌和尿道外括约肌收缩，可能抑制逼尿肌的非自主性收缩），我们提出以下假设：(1) rTMS联合PFMT可显著改善卒中患者神经源性OAB的症状严重程度（主要结局）和生活质量，并在成本效益方面优于假rTMS联合PFMT；(2) 与假rTMS联合PFMT组相比，接受rTMS联合PFMT治疗的卒中患者将表现出更强的盆底肌力量、更显著的逼尿肌壁厚度减少以及更优的功能性结局。 为验证上述假设，我们计划在154例神经源性OAB的卒中患者中开展一项前瞻性双组平行随机对照试验。研究将在基线、随机分组后4周及8周对治疗效果和潜在中介变量进行评估。治疗效应将通过协方差分析评估，中介效应通过理论PROCESS模型4分析探讨，经济效益评估则采用成本效益分析进行全面评估。

15216225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216225.value: 以事件為中心的自適應多模態事件檢測之圖學習框架

15216225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216225.value: In the age of social media, the ability to accurately detect and understand events from diverse online content is crucial for various applications, from crisis management to trend analysis. However, current event detection systems face significant challenges when dealing with the complex, multimodal nature of social media data, which often includes text, images, and temporal information. More specifically, these systems struggle to effectively integrate information across different modalities, handle various data quality issues, perform sophisticated reasoning about complex events, and adapt to new types of events. In this project, we aim to address these challenges by developing a novel framework for multimodal event detection in social media. At the core of our approach is an Event-Centric Graph Learning (ECGL) framework that represents diverse data types (e.g., text, images, time) and their intricate relationships in a single, coherent structure, which allows for more effective integration and analysis of multimodal information. To tackle the common problem of data quality issues in social media posts, we propose an Adaptive Multi-granular Contrastive Learning (AMCL) framework that can handle missing information, cross-lingual scenarios, and class imbalance by leveraging the hierarchical nature of our graph structure. To verify the effectiveness of our proposed ECGL framework, we plan to apply it to address the limitations of current systems in understanding complex events. Specifically, we propose a Knowledge-Enhanced Cross-modal Reasoning (KECR) framework to integrate external knowledge sources with our graph-based representation and perform more sophisticated analysis and inference by large language models, leading to a deeper understanding of events. Finally, recognizing that new types of events constantly emerge in the dynamic social media landscape, we design a Hierarchical Adaptive Prototypical Network (HAPN) for open-set event detection. This adaptive capability ensures that our event detection remains effective and relevant over time, even as the nature of social media content evolves, by quickly adapting to and learning from novel event types. The resulting system will be more accurate, robust, and adaptable to extract meaningful insights from the vast and complex world of social media data, enhancing our understanding of real-world events. 在社群媒體時代，從危機管理到趨勢分析等各種應用中，準確檢測和理解來自多樣化線上內容的事件的能力都至關重要。然而，目前的事件偵測系統在處理社群媒體資料（通常包含文字、圖像和時間資訊）的複雜性和多模態特性時面臨著巨大的挑戰。更具體地說，這些系統難以有效整合不同模態的訊息，難以處理各種資料品質問題，難以對複雜事件進行複雜的推理，也難以適應新型事件。 在本项目中，我們旨在透過開發一個用於社群媒體多模態事件偵測的全新框架來應對這些挑戰。我們方法的核心是一個以事件為中心的圖學習 (ECGL) 框架，該框架將各種資料類型（例如文字、圖像、時間）及其錯綜複雜的關係表示在一個單一、連貫的結構中，從而能夠更有效地整合和分析多模態資訊。為了解決社群媒體貼文中常見的資料品質問題，我們提出了一個自適應多粒度對比學習 (AMCL) 框架，該框架利用圖結構的層次化特性，能夠處理資訊缺失、跨語言情境和類別不平衡等問題。為了驗證我們提出的 ECGL 框架的有效性，我們計劃將其應用於解決當前系統在理解複雜事件方面的限制。具體而言，我們提出了一個知識增強型跨模態推理框架，將外部知識源與我們基於圖的表示方法相結合，並透過大型語言模型執行更複雜的分析和推理，從而加深對事件的理解。最後，鑑於動態社群媒體環境中不斷湧現的新事件類型，我們設計了一個用於開放集事件偵測的分層自適應原型網路。這種自適應能力能夠快速適應和學習新的事件類型，從而確保我們的事件偵測能夠始終保持有效性和相關性，即使社群媒體內容的性質不斷演變。最終的系統將更加準確、強大、適應性更強，能夠從龐大而複雜的社群媒體數據世界中提取有意義的見解，增強我們對現實世界事件的理解。

15216325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216325.value: LoRa同頻全雙工網關的設計與實現

15216325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216325.value: Unlike traditional data collection applications (e.g., environment monitoring) dominated by uplink transmissions, the newly emerging Internet of Things (IoT) applications (e.g., device actuation, firmware update, packet reception acknowledgement) pose ever-increasing demands on downlink transmission capabilities in Low Power Wide Area Networks (LPWAN). However, current LoRaWANs - one of the representative LPWAN technologies - fall short in supporting such new IoT applications due to highly unbalanced downlink-uplink performance, which we term downlink-uplink asymmetry in this proposal. While LoRa gateways can concurrently receive multiple packets over multiple channels, downlink transmissions are constrained to a single logical channel at a time, which fundamentally hinders the widespread adoption of LoRaWAN technologies in downlink-hungry applications. Moreover, current half-duplex LoRa gateways cannot receive ultra-weak uplink packets over long communication ranges while sending downlink packets due to the high power self-interference signals. Thus, the precious wireless spectrum is extremely under-utilized during downlink transmissions. To tackle these practical issues, this project develops in-band full-duplex LoRa gateways so that the gateways can send downlink packets without throttling the uplink receptions. To this end, we propose novel algorithms and present new system design and implementation of full-duplex LoRa gateways, which will lead to the following intellectual breakthroughs: 1) We reexamine the current design philosophy of LoRa gateways and reveal the root cause of downlink-uplink asymmetry problem in LoRa networks; 2) Based on the new findings, we propose novel self-interference cancellation methods by exploiting the unique feature of LoRa modulation schemes; 3) To unleash the full potential of the in-band full-duplex gateways, we further develop a new concurrent downlink transmission framework that can fully utilize all logical channels of all available gateways while mitigating the inter-gateway interference among coexisting gateways in downlink transmissions. This project will generate and maintain new datasets and artifacts for academia and industry. The outcomes of this project will uncover various practical factors that can affect the overall system performance of LoRa networks, and build solid foundation for the development of large-scale LoRa networks with the novel in-band full-duplex LoRa gateways. 與傳統以上行傳輸為主的數據收集應用不同，新興的物聯網應用對低功耗廣域網路（LPWAN）中的下行傳輸能力提出了日益增長的需求。然而，現有的 LoRaWAN 技術在支持這些新型 IoT 應用方面表現不佳，原因在於其上下行性能極度不平衡。我們在本提案中將此稱為「上下行非對稱性」。 儘管 LoRa可以同時在多個通道上接收多個數據包，但下行傳輸卻受限於一次只能使用一個邏輯通道，這在根本上阻礙了 LoRaWAN的廣泛採用。此外，現有的半雙工 LoRa網關在發送下行數據包時，無法接收上行數據包。為解決這些實際問題，本計畫開發同頻全雙工 LoRa網關，使其能夠在不影響上行接收的情況下發送下行數據包。 為此，我們提出創新的演算法，並設計與實作新的全雙工 LoRa網關系統，預期將帶來以下幾項突破：1）我們將重新檢視現有 LoRa 網關設計理念，並揭示 LoRa 網路中上下行非對稱性問題的根本原因；2）基於新的發現，我們將提出新型自我干擾消除方法；3）為了充分發揮同頻全雙工網關的潛力，我們進一步開發一套新的並行下行傳輸架構，以充分利用所有可用網關的邏輯通道。 計畫成果將揭示多種影響 LoRa 網路整體系統效能的實際因素，並為建構具備創新同頻全雙工 LoRa網關的大規模部署奠定堅實基礎。

15217625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15217625.value: 面向类脑高能效具身智能：整合大脑突触学习规则的视角

15217625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15217625.value: Prof Deng, Lei Prof Kay Chen, TAN Dr Yu, Fangwen

15217625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15217625.value: Empowering embodied AI with brain-like learning capabilities aims to fill an important gap in the AI landscape: enabling intelligent agents to continuously and adaptively learn in dynamic, resource-constrained environments. Unlike current AI learning methods, the brain leverages diverse synaptic learning mechanisms, known as synaptic plasticity rules. Each plasticity rule has its own computational principles, contributing uniquely to advanced cognitive functions. By modeling and integrating these plasticity mechanisms into embodied AI models, we aim to create a complementary hybrid learning system that achieves high computational and learning efficiency. However, building such a hybrid system poses significant challenges in both algorithmic and system design aspects. These challenges include: (1) developing AI models that represent diverse brain-inspired learning mechanisms in a computationally feasible way; (2) integrating these plasticity mechanisms—each with distinct operational dynamics—into a unified and synergistic learning framework; and (3) deploying such a hybrid learning system on real-world, resource-constrained computing devices. To address these challenges, we draw inspiration from recent advances in neuroscience research on synaptic learning mechanisms, neuronal architecture, and information processing pathways. First, we will develop general computational models that represent key learning mechanisms found in the brain, including Hebbian learning, behavioral timescale non-Hebbian learning, and neuromodulated learning. To enable flexible learning, we will create a multi-compartmental spiking neuronal architecture that can support these learning mechanisms across different timescales. Second, we will explore how diverse plasticity rules can be integrated into robotic perception and memory processes using meta-learning paradigms and architecture search methods. Additionally, to build adaptive and robust memory systems, we will leverage the distinct functions of diverse plasticity rules and investigate different synergistic learning strategies in both spatial and temporal domains during memory formation. Third, we will develop an information integration module inspired by neural circuits in the brain's prefrontal cortex to ensure that both perception and memory effectively work together as part of a cohesive system. Ultimately, this proposed hybrid learning system will be implemented through software-hardware co-optimization on ultra-low-power neuromorphic hardware platforms previously developed by our team, for robotics application validation, including one-shot navigation, robust tracking, and real-time continual learning. Through this project, we aim to foster collaborative research between the AI and neuroscience communities, positioning Hong Kong as a frontrunner in driving scientific advancements in brain-inspired AI technologies. 类脑学习能力的突破将是人工智能（AI）发展的下一个关键里程碑——它将使智能体真正具备在动态、资源受限环境中持续学习和适应的能力。与当前主流AI采用的端到端学习范式不同，人类大脑通过多样化的突触可塑性机制实现高效学习，每种机制都具有独特的计算原理和功能定位。这种"混合学习"策略为构建新一代AI系统提供了重要启示，但目前相关研究仍面临三大核心挑战：（1）如何在可控计算复杂度下建模多样化的可塑性规则；（2）如何整合具有不同计算原理的可塑性机制；（3）如何在现实场景中验证这类系统的有效性。 本项目将基于神经科学最新发现，创新性地构建多尺度融合的类脑学习系统。具体而言，我们将：1）建立包含Hebbian、非Hebbian和神经调制可塑性的统一计算框架，开发计算高效且支持多尺度可塑性机制的神经元模型；2）提出创新的多尺度元学习方法，实现不同可塑性机制在感知与记忆过程中的协同工作；3）借鉴前额叶皮层的信息整合机制，构建自适应、鲁棒的智能学习系统。最终，所提出的混合学习系统将通过系统原型构建与多类型任务验证来评估可行性与性能。通过本项目，我们期望促进人工智能与神经科学领域的深度交叉合作，并推动香港在类脑人工智能技术的科学前沿占据领先地位。

15217825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15217825.value: 基於先進的視覺語言模型實現經耳道內窺鏡耳科手術訓練、規劃、和演練的交互虛擬環境

15217825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15217825.value: Prof Chang, Wai-tsz Prof So, Tiffany Yuen Tung Prof Wong, Tien-Tsin

15217825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15217825.value: With the advancement of endoscopic technologies, transcanal endoscopic ear surgery (TEES) has become an important minimally invasive approach for treating complex ear canal pathologies. However, it is still quite challenging for surgeons to conduct a successful TEES owing to (1) the complex (and patient-specific) TEES anatomy and (2) limited surgical views and sophisticated surgical manipulations. While some extended reality (XR) based TEES training, planning, and rehearsal systems have been developed, they are still incapable of sufficiently fulfilling the demanding clinical requirements. The main shortcomings include inaccurate segmentation due to limited training data, imprecise registration between CT scans and surgical videos, and unrealistic surgical scene reconstruction and simulation. In this project, we aim at comprehensively addressing these challenges by developing a set of novel algorithms based on advanced vision-language models (VLMs). Our key thought is that, language, as one of the most powerful tools to convey information, transmit knowledge, and express thoughts/ideas, has not yet be sufficiently harnessed to construct XR-based surgical simulation systems, where, we believe, language has potential to play a prominent and pivotal role to enhance the interactivity and preciseness of these systems. Recent progress in VLMs shed new lights on integrating both visual and textual supervision for more effective and natural interactions, which not only makes the systems more realistic and interactive, but paves new ways to naturally integrate surgeons’ knowledge and experience into the systems. Specifically, we shall conduct the following R&D tasks. First, we shall propose an interactive language-guided TEES anatomy segmentation model via a new prompt chaining mechanism. Second, we shall propose a novel multimodal cross-dimensional image registration model based on 2D-text-3D alignment prompting and language-interactive inference for real-time registration between endoscopic videos and CT scans. Third, we shall propose a novel method that leverages complementary advantages of CT scans and surgical videos to reconstruct virtual TEES scenes based on 3D Gaussian splatting equipped with an innovative interactive editing module. Fourth, we shall develop a VLM-guided physics-informed neural networks with biomechanical models for interactive deformation modelling. Finally, we shall integrate above techniques to develop an XR-based computer-assisted TEES system. In summary, this is a joint project with a strong interdisciplinary team including experts in medical image computing, XR, computer graphics, and TEES. The proposed innovative techniques can not only strengthen TEES but provide insights on how to integrate visual and linguistic information into a computer-assisted surgery system to improve its preciseness and efficiency. 隨著內窺鏡技術的進步，經耳道內窺鏡耳科手術 （TEES） 已成為治療複雜耳道病變的重要微創方法。 然而，由於（1）TEES 解剖結構複雜（且因患者而異），以及（2）手術視野有限且手術操作複雜，成功實施 TEES 對外科醫生來說仍頗具挑戰性。 目前，研究者們開發了一些基於擴展現實 （XR） 的 TEES 訓練、規劃、和演練系統，但它們仍然無法充分滿足嚴苛的臨床需求。 其主要缺點包括：由於訓練數據有限導致的分割不準確、CT 圖像與手術視頻之間配準不精確，以及手術場景重建和模擬不真實。 本專案中，我們旨在基於先進的視覺語言模型 （VLM） 開發一系列全新演算法來全面應對上述挑戰。 我們的核心思想是，語言，作為傳遞資訊、傳播知識、和表達思想/觀點的最有力工具之一，尚未在構建基於 XR 的手術模擬系統中得到充分利用。 我們相信，語言有潛力在提升這些系統的交互性和精確度方面發揮突出且關鍵的作用。 VLM 的最新進展為整合視覺和文本監督以實現更有效、更自然的交互提供了新思路，這不僅使系統更加逼真、更具交互性，也為將外科醫生的知識和經驗自然地融入系統開闢了新途徑。 具體而言，我們將開展以下研發任務。 首先，我們將提出一種基於新型提示鏈機制的互動式語言引導的TEES解剖結構分割模型。 其次，我們將提出一種基於2D圖像-文本-3D圖像對齊提示和語言交互推理的新型多模態跨維度圖像配準模型，用於內窺鏡視頻和CT掃描圖像之間的即時配準。 第三，我們將提出一種基於3D高斯滾雪球技術的虛擬TEES場景重建新演算法，該演算法將充分利用CT掃描和手術視的互補優勢頻優勢，並配備創新的互動式編輯模組。 第四，我們將開發一種新的基於VLM引導的融合生物力學模型的物理資訊神經網路，用於互動式形變模擬。 最後，我們將整合上述技術，開發基於XR的計算機輔助TEES系統。 總之，這是一個由強大的跨學科團隊共同開展的聯合專案。 團隊成員包括醫學圖像計算、擴展現實 （XR）、計算機圖形學，和 TEES 的各領域專家。 我們所提出的創新技術不僅可以增強 TEES，還能為如何將視覺和語言資訊集成到計算機輔助手術系統中，從而提高其精確度和效率，提供新見解。

15218125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15218125.value: 纤维水泥板覆面冷弯薄壁型钢立柱墙面板的性能研究

15218125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15218125.value: Prof Lawson, Robert Mark Prof Young, Ben

15218125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15218125.value: Driven by the need of sustainable development, prefabricated modular structures have been increasingly used in construction industry, due to their advantages of fast installation, reduced labour cost, and low carbon emissions compared with traditional construction methods. Cold-formed steel (CFS) wall panel is one of the commonly used prefabricated structural systems, especially in residential and commercial buildings. Despite of the streamlined construction process in CFS wall panels, its fabrication efficiency is hindered by the installation of K- and X- bracings for lateral resistance, which requires labour-intensive assembling procedure. Typically, however, CFS wall panels are also cladded with sheathing boards, which act as diaphragms that can enhance the lateral load resistance and stiffness of the panels. Current design specifications mainly consider the sheathing boards as non-structural components, which are only designed for serviceability (i.e. weather resistance, thermal and acoustic insulation) instead of utilizing their loading resistance. This leads to a conservative design and excessive use of bracing. In contrast, the effect of sheathing is already routinely accounted for in timber framing industry. Therefore, it is essential to examine the behaviour and propose design recommendations for sheathed CFS wall panels, allowing exploitation of the structural benefits provided by the sheathings and contributing to sustainability of construction industry. This project aims to develop a feasible and efficient structural solution that reduces the reliance on bracing systems, by characterizing and utilizing the composite action between sheathing and steel stud wall. This project will focus on fibre cement board (FCB) due to its excellent fire resistance, durability and sustainability. Pioneering research on an innovative bi-metal self-drilling screw will also be carried out. An extensive experimental and numerical investigation is proposed to study the influence of panel configuration and connection details in racking resistance of the sheathed CFS panels. A large data pool with 48 test results and 648 numerical results of FCB sheathed CFS panel racking resistance will compare with the design values obtained from existing design rules. Design recommendations will be proposed to facilitate effective structural applications of FCB sheathings and bi-metal screws in CFS frames. This research aligns well with the Sustainable Development Goals 9 (innovation in industry and infrastructure), 11 (sustainable cities and communities) and 12 (responsible consumption and production). This research project will benefit the wider steel construction industry by increasing its competitiveness, contribute to net-zero goal by efficient structural design, and tackle the global housing crisis by streamlining the construction process. 受可持续发展需求驱动，预制模块化结构因其安装迅速、人工成本降低及碳排放量少于传统建造方式等优势，在建筑行业应用日益广泛。冷弯型钢（CFS）墙板作为常用预制结构体系，广泛应用于住宅与商业建筑领域。尽管CFS墙板建造流程已高度标准化，但用于抗侧向力的K形与X形支撑安装过程仍依赖密集型人力，制约着整体生产效率。值得注意的是，覆面板材作为墙板覆层时实际可发挥隔板作用，显著提升墙板的抗侧向荷载能力与刚度。现行设计规范主要将覆面板材视为非结构构件，仅基于使用性能（如耐候性、保温隔声性）设计，未能充分利用其承载潜力，导致设计保守且支撑系统过度使用。相比之下，木结构行业早已系统性考量覆面板的结构贡献。因此，亟需深入研究覆面CFS墙板的力学性能并提出设计建议，以挖掘覆面板的结构效益，推动建筑行业可持续发展。 本项目旨在通过表征覆面板与钢立柱墙体的复合作用，开发减少支撑系统依赖的高效结构解决方案。研究将聚焦具有优异耐火性、耐久性及环保特性的纤维水泥板（FCB），并首创研发双金属自攻螺钉。通过系统的试验与数值模拟，深入探究墙板构造与节点细部对覆面CFS墙板抗侧性能的影响规律。基于48组试验与648组数值模拟构建的FCB覆面CFS墙板抗侧性能数据库，将与现行设计规范值进行对比分析，最终提出促进FCB覆面板及双金属螺钉在CFS框架中高效应用的设计建议。 本研究深度契合可持续发展目标9（产业创新与基础设施）、目标11（可持续城市社区）及目标12（负责任消费生产）。研究成果将通过提升钢结构产业竞争力惠及全行业，借助高效结构设计助力净零目标实现，并通过优化建造流程应对全球住房危机。

15218225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15218225.value: 光热介导的单原子催化选择性糖酵解回收涤棉废弃物

15218225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15218225.value: Prof Fan, Jintu Prof Wang, Xungai

15218225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15218225.value: Tens of millions of tons of post-consumer textiles are discharged into the environment annually but less than 1% are recycled, resulting in colossal resource waste and environmental burdens. The mixture of polyester/cotton or polycotton blends dominates the textile industry, while its separation and recycling pose a huge challenge to practical textile recycling. Photothermal technology is an emerging non-contacting heating mode that develops the local heat field to promote plastic depolymerization, but it needs a further design for the selective recycling of mixed waste. This proposal proposes to load the Zn atoms on the carbon materials to develop a photothermal single atoms catalyst (Zn-SAC), as the photothermal materials and catalyst simultaneously, for selective glycolysis of polyester fiber and recycle the intact cotton fiber from the polycotton blends. The oxygen groups of Zn-SAC will be modulated in this project to strengthen its electrostatic repulsion with cotton fiber for selective adsorption on the polyester fiber surface. Under irradiation, the local heat field (>150℃) developed by the photothermal conversion of carbon substrate will in-situ boost the Zn atoms catalysis for the polyester glycolysis to the bis(2-hydroxyethyl terephthalate) (BHET), which can be directly used for the commercial polyester production. Meanwhile, the local heat fields on the Zn-SAC surface avoid heating the whole solution to minimize the harmful impact on the recycled cotton fiber. The coordinated structure of the Zn-N atoms will be well-tuned to optimize their activity and reduce the Zn ions leaching to improve the purity of the BHET product. More importantly, the distribution of the local heat field and its further boosting effect on the Zn-atoms-catalyzed glycolysis efficiency will be studied by the experiment and theoretical simulation to provide fundamental knowledge of the photothermal SAC for selective textile recycling. Additionally, the different polycotton blends and mixtures from the industry and the practical waste will be conducted for the mechanism study and application demonstration, and the influence of the dyes and finishing agents on this recycling technology will be evaluated to promote its further application. The results of this project will provide a knowledge base for upgrading the application of SAC or photothermal technology from single-type polymer to mixed waste recycling. The successful completion of the project will open a new avenue of selective textile recycling through photothermal technology coupling with SAC, which will make a meaningful contribution to the global sustainable textile industry and circular economy. 每年有数千万吨消费后的纺织品被排放到环境中，但回收率不到1%，造成了巨大的资源浪费和环境负担。在纺织废弃物中涤纶/棉或涤棉混纺占主导地位，但是其选择性分离和回收具有非常大的挑战。光热转换是一种新兴的非接触式加热方式，这种方法可以产生局部热场来促进塑料的解聚，但其需要进一步设计用于混合纺织废弃物的选择性回收。 本文提出将Zn原子负载到碳材料上，以开发一种新型的纳米光热单原子催化剂（Zn-SAC）作为光热材料。同时，Zn-SAC可以对聚酯纤维进行选择性糖酵解并完整回收涤棉混纺中的棉纤维。Zn-SAC上的官能团将被调控以增强其对棉纤维的静电斥力，从而可以在聚酯纤维表面进行选择性附。在光照下，Zn-SAC光热产生的局部热场（>150℃）可以原位促进Zn单原子催化聚酯糖酵解产生对苯二甲酸双羟基乙酯（BHET），而分解产物BHET可直接用于商用聚酯生产。与此同时, Zn-SAC表面的局部热场避免了整个溶液温度的升高，从而极大的降低了对再生棉纤维的结构影响。我们将调整Zn-N的配位结构从而优化催化剂的活性，减少锌离子的浸出，并提高BHET产品的纯度。更重要的是，我们将通过实验和理论模拟相结合的方式研究Zn-SAC表面局域热场的分布及其对锌原子催化糖酵解效率的促进作用。此外,来自于不同工业和实际废料的涤棉混纺废弃物将被用于进行机理研究和应用论证，并探究其表面的染料和整理剂对整个回收工艺的影响。 该项目将单种聚合物的SAC或光热技术升级利用在混合纺织废弃物的回收，开辟了一条全新的光热单原子催化选择性回收路径。该项目的顺利完成将为全球可持续纺织产业和循环经济做出贡献。

15218325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15218325.value: 交通網絡中出行選擇集異質性與內生性的行為交互建模研究

15218325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15218325.value: Prof Bekhor, Shlomo Dr Xu, Zhandong

15218325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15218325.value: Smart planning and operation of transportation systems entail understanding and predicting travel choice behavior, which reflects how people use travel alternatives (e.g., modes and routes) and how they react to mobility services. In transportation networks, travel choice behavior manifests unique features and challenges. Because of limited cognitive capability, users (i.e., travelers) consider only a part of the vast number of available alternatives encoded in networks. The set of considered alternatives (i.e., choice set) depends on the preferences of individual users and is unobservable to the analyst. Moreover, when performing network-wide analysis, it is important to account for the diverse preferences across the population. These features could become more prominent with the provision of new mobility services and personalized travel guidance systems. The choice behavior of travelers in transportation networks is mainly described by discrete choice models at the disaggregate level and is integrated into network equilibrium models for the aggregate travel demand analyses with diverse individual choices. However, existing studies heavily rely on arbitrary/heuristic rules to exogenously determine the choice set, overlooking the dependence of choice sets on user preferences. This assumption of independence precludes the capture of user-specific choice sets incurred by heterogeneous preferences. As both the estimation, interpretation, and prediction of discrete choice models are rather sensitive to choice sets, the traditional modeling approach may yield systematically biased travel demand analysis results and considerably degrade the quality of planning schemes. The proposed project will aim to address the abovementioned challenges by developing a new discrete choice model that can simultaneously account for choice set endogeneity (i.e., preference-dependent choice sets) and user heterogeneity.
