Moreover, under this new design, the impact from items-on-pod diversity and planning horizons in handling urgent orders will be evaluated. This project will generate new knowledge and bring practical contributions. Our breakthrough design contributes to the advancement of AMRs applications in RMFS to maximize item-picking efficiency, meanwhile our findings will provide new insights for e-commerce industry in operating intelligent warehouses, and for AMR developers in designing new functions/features. This novel IWBM-RMFS design is essential to support the rapid development of e-tailers/ecommerce centers. 如今，電子零售商（例如亞馬遜）在其智慧倉庫中廣泛使用機器人行動履行系統 (RMFS)，以處理來自線上銷售的種類繁多的小件產品和數量龐大的訂單。訂單揀選流程始於自動移動機器人 (AMR) 將所需的貨艙從儲存區移動到工作站進行揀選。由於訂單通常包含多個商品，因此通常需要多個貨艙將一個訂單整合到同一個工作站中，而工作站通常配置有貨箱（一個訂單對應一個貨箱）和兩側的傳送帶。 RMFS 的現有缺陷在於無法在工作站之間移動貨箱。理論上，可以將包含相同商品類型的訂單分配到同一工作站，以增加從貨艙中揀選商品的次數。然而，這類「相同訂單」其實非常罕見。因此，在現有 RMFS 設計中，由於貨箱無法在工作站之間移動，許多沒有相同商品類型的訂單最終會停留在同一個工作站（直到完成）。這會導致揀選效率（系統效率）低下，以及貨艙頻繁移動（從而導致碳排放增加）。 為了克服這個缺陷，我們提出了一種名為「工作站間箱體移動RMFS」（IWBM-RMFS）的新型最佳化設計，旨在利用AMR實現工作站間的箱體移動。此外，我們將開發一個決策支援工具，用於支援該新設計中關於訂單分配到工作站以及貨品揀選艙調度的決策，旨在最大限度地縮短訂單完成時間並最大限度地提高貨品揀選效率。由於先前的RMFS優化研究未涵蓋工作站間箱體移動（IWBM），因此我們將開發一種新穎的客製化高效演算法。在中國一家AMR先驅開發商和香港一家領先的電子商務中心的支持下，我們將使用真實和半真實數據進行數值實驗，以評估所提出的決策支援工具，並探索IWBM對RMFS效率的重要性。此外，我們將在這種新設計下，研究貨品在艙體上的多樣性和規劃時限對緊急訂單處理的影響。該項目將產生新的知識並帶來實際貢獻。我們的突破性設計有助於推進AMR在RMFS中的應用，從而最大限度地提高物品揀選效率。同時，我們的研究成果也將為電商產業營運智慧倉庫以及AMR開發人員設計新功能和特性提供新的有益見解。這種新穎的IWBM-RMFS設計對於支援電子零售商的快速發展至關重要。

15239725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15239725.value: 解碼真菌網絡：堆填區空氣中β-內酰胺抗性及其對人類健康的影響

15239725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15239725.value: Prof Rillig, Matthias Prof Wu, Dong 教授 Yang, Lin

15239725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15239725.value: The elevated presence of β-lactam antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in landfill-associated air poses a significant public health risk, potentially affecting 16% of the global population through resistant infections. Our prior research has highlighted this issue, but the mechanisms and associated hazards remain poorly understood. Based on our preliminary findings, we propose a novel hypothesis that Penicillium fungi, prevalent in landfill air, may produce β-lactam antibiotics that promote the proliferation of ARGs, thus creating significant inhalation risks. Our study aims to fill these critical knowledge gaps by collecting ambient air samples from landfill sites and urban backgrounds, alongside nasopharyngeal swabs from individuals both exposed and unexposed to these environments. We will utilize advanced metagenomic sequencing to profile the antibiotic resistome and identify site-specific β-lactam ARGs using machine learning classifiers. This will allow us to discern patterns of ARG distribution and integrate these findings with environmental data to devise predictive models. Further, we will explore the mechanisms by which Penicillium influences the presence of β-lactam ARGs by employing isotopically labeled Penicillium cultures and Escherichia coli aerosols in a controlled environmental simulation chamber. This setup will enable us to examine the synthesis and impacts of β-lactam antibiotics under varied environmental conditions. Through transcriptomic analysis of the β-lactam antibiotic biosynthetic gene cluster, we aim to clarify how environmental factors and Penicillium affect ARG dynamics. Additionally, long-read sequencing will improve the accuracy of our genomic analyses, facilitating the construction of detailed plasmidome datasets through DNA methylation signals. These plasmids will be matched with their bacterial hosts, shedding light on the dominant taxa within airborne bacterial communities. We will also identify pathogenic bacteria that harbor β-lactam ARGs and assess their potential inhalation exposure risks to humans. By integrating metatranscriptomic sequencing and metagenomics-based quantification, our project seeks to delineate the structural impact of ARGs on the composition and resistance profiles of the respiratory microbiome. This project is designed to deepen our understanding of the unique antibiotic resistance challenges posed by landfills and develop informed strategies for their effective management.

15239925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15239925.value: 基於思路鏈規劃的視頻理解的邊緣運算：框架、演算法與實現

15239925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15239925.value: Large Language Model (LLM) has demonstrated its promising capability to perform video understanding tasks, e.g., “describe the road signs”. When the task becomes complex, e.g., “why did the collision occur between the car and the bus?” it is necessary to find useful clues in the video frames and to reason the inherent connections of the clues to obtain the answer. LLM-based agents with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) planning have been developed to serve complex tasks by decomposing the task into sub-tasks, the so-called a chain of thoughts (or thought prompts). In many scenarios, the prompts and the videos are generated in the edge. Given privacy concerns and latency requirements, edge computing should be performed. Edge devices have limited resources. An interesting question is whether existing edge computing systems can support the new video understanding tasks effectively, and if not, how should new frameworks and algorithms be developed? LLM-based agents with CoT planning have three modules: Perception to extract the video parts that are most beneficial for CoT planning and task completion; Planning to formulate a CoT plan for completing the task; and Action to translate the CoT plan into actions. Our preliminary experiments reveal new resource challenges in the edge introduced by the new video understanding tasks: (1) Planning: executing the thought prompts one-by-one can lead to resource consuming LLM inference for each thought prompt; (2) Perception: the input video needs to be transformed into the embeddings that the LLMs can understand. The execution of the transformer introduces significant computing workloads even though not every part of the video is equally useful to the CoT planning; and (3) Perception: the input video can contain sensitive information. Conducting privacy-preserving schemes is resource consuming and should be considered jointly with the CoT planning. In this project, we develop a new edge computing framework LLM-CoTEdge to support LLM-based agent with CoT planning for video understanding tasks. We develop new algorithms with the objectives to optimize the video understanding accuracy, latency, and privacy leakage given the resource constraints of the edge devices. We implement a prototype on top of Microsoft AutoGen which can be deployed on different edge hardware and support video understanding applications with minimum resource footprints. The proposed research advances the literature of edge computing in supporting new video understanding applications. We will broaden the project impact by developing educational materials and outreach activities to industry. 大型語言模型 (LLM) 已展現出其在執行視頻理解任務，例如“描述路標”，方面的卓越能力。當任務變得複雜時，例如“為什麼汽車和公共汽車會發生碰撞？”，就需要在視頻幀中找到有用的線索，並推理線索之間的內在聯繫以獲得答案。基於 LLM 的智能體已經發展出具有思維鏈 (CoT) 規劃能力的智能體，透過將任務分解為子任務（即所謂的思維鏈（或思維提示））來處理複雜任務。在許多場景中，提示和影片都是在邊緣生成的。考慮到隱私問題和延遲要求，應該使用邊緣運算。邊緣設備的資源有限。一個有趣的問題是，現有的邊緣運算系統是否能夠有效地支援新的視頻理解任務？如果不能，應該如何開發新的框架和演算法？ 基於 LLM 且具備 CoT 規劃能力的智能體包含三個模組：感知模組，用於提取對 CoT 規劃和任務完成最有利的視頻部分；規劃模組，用於製定 CoT 任務完成計劃；以及行動模組，用於將 CoT 計劃轉化為行動。我們的初步實驗揭示了新的視頻理解任務在邊緣運算中帶來的新資源挑戰：(1) 規劃：逐一執行思維提示會導致每個思維提示的 LLM 推理耗費大量資源；(2) 感知模組：輸入視訊需要轉換為 LLM 能夠理解的嵌入向量。即使影片的每個部分對 CoT 規劃的用處不盡相同，Transformer 的執行也會帶來大量的計算負載；(3) 感知模組：輸入視訊可能包含敏感資訊。實施隱私保護方案會耗費資源，應與 CoT 規劃一同考慮。 在本專案中，我們開發了一個新的邊緣運算框架 LLM-CoTEdge，以支援基於 LLM 的智慧體進行 CoT 規劃，從而完成視頻理解任務。我們開發了新的演算法，旨在在邊緣設備資源受限的情況下優化視頻理解的準確性、延遲和隱私洩露。我們將在 Microsoft AutoGen 基礎上實現了一個原型，該原型可以部署在不同的邊緣硬體上，並以最小的資源佔用支援視頻理解應用程式。 本研究將推動邊緣運算在支援新型視訊理解應用方面的研究進展。我們將透過開發教育材料和開展面向行業的推廣活動來擴大該項目的影響力。

15240025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15240025.value: 利用低軌通訊衛星信號的PNT服務

15240025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15240025.value: The Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) services are crucial for the economic development and currently Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS, including GPS, GLONASS, Beidou, and Galileo) are the backbone of global PNT provision. The vulnerability of GNSS is well-known due to its low signal strength, narrow signal bands, and known signal structure. In addition, GNSS does not perform well in urban environment as the signals are frequently blocked or reflected by buildings. On the other hand, Low Earth Orbit (LEO) communication constellations have been rapidly developed, such as SpaceX’s Starlink and China Satellite Network communication system, and these constellations will have more than a few tens of thousands satellites in sky in the near future. These communication satellites may provide much better signals for positioning than GNSS signals, thanks to their higher frequency (over 10 GHz), and wider signal bands (a few hundred MHz). However, because the signal structures of the communication signals are not known, most studies related to positioning with LEO communication satellites are based on Doppler measurements. From previous experience, positioning with ranging measurements have many advantages over Doppler-based method (comparing GPS (range based) and Transit system (Doppler based)), i.e. 3D vs 2D, high dynamics vs low dynamics. This research will develop receiver algorithms to provide ranging measurements from LEO communication signals without knowing the signal structures. Three methods for ranging with LEO signals are proposed in this proposal. A data simulator and a software defined radio receiver will be developed in this project for simulating LEO satellite signals and receiving LEO satellite communication signals. Both simulation and real data experiments will be carried out to evaluate the performances of different ranging algorithms and to compare with GNSS performance under strong multipath and ionosphere scintillation environments. It is expected that with LEO ranging measurements, positioning accuracy of decimeter level can be achieved even under strong multipath environment, which is crucial for many high precision navigation applications, such as autonomous vehicle and UAV. 定位、導航和授時 (PNT) 服務對經濟發展至關重要，目前全球導航衛星系統 GNSS(包括 GPS、GLONASS、北鬥和伽利略) 是全球 PNT 服務的支柱。因GNSS訊號強度低、訊號頻段窄和訊號結構已知,GNSS PNT服務的脆弱性以引起大家的高度重視。此外，由于GNSS訊號經常被建築物阻擋或反射， GNSS 在城市地區也難以正常運作，。 近年來，基於低地球軌道 (LEO) 的通訊星座發展迅速，例如 SpaceX 的 Starlink 和中國的星網通訊系統，在不久的將來將有數萬顆衛星在天空中運行。由於這些通訊衛星的頻率更高（超過 10 GHz）且訊號頻段更寬（幾百 MHz），因此可以提供比 GNSS 訊號更好的定位訊號。然而，由於通訊訊號的結構尚不清楚，大多數與 LEO 通訊衛星定位相關的研究都基於多普勒測量。 根據以往經驗，基於測距測量的定位方法相較於多普勒方法（相比GPS（基於測距）和Transit系統（基於多普勒））具有諸多優勢，例如三維定位優於二維定位、高動態性能優於低動態性能。本研究將開發接收機演算法，以便在不知道通訊衛星訊號結構的情況下利用低軌通訊訊號進行測距測量。本提案提出了三種利用低軌訊號進行測距的方法。本計畫將開發一個數據模擬器和一個軟體無線電接收機，用於模擬低軌衛星訊號和接收低軌衛星通訊訊號。我們將進行模擬和實際數據實驗，以評估不同測距演算法的性能，並與強多路徑和電離層閃爍環境下的GNSS性能進行比較。 我們預計即使在強多路徑環境下，低軌測距測量也能達到分米級的定位精度，這對於許多高精度導航應用（如自動駕駛汽車和無人機）至關重要。

15240225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15240225.value: 透過聲發射監測與成像識別岩石節理的臨界應力區

15240225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15240225.value: Prof LEUNG, Yat Fai Dr Tong, Ping

15240225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15240225.value: Rock slope landslides pose a worldwide challenge, especially in hilly regions such as Hong Kong. This geohazard is exacerbated by rapid urban development and changing climate conditions. Presently, the monitoring and early warning systems for rock slope failures largely rely on observations from the slope surface. However, these techniques are incapable of capturing the evolving conditions on the rock joint surfaces, due to limitations in directly accessing the joint surfaces for observations and measurements. Rock joints are rough, and small patches on the joint surface that are in actual contact (known as asperities) bear the majority of the load. The increase in size and intensity of stress concentration on these asperities indicate interlocking and increased shear loading, drawing parallels to a growing tumour that may lead to catastrophic failure at a critical stage. We currently lack a clear understanding of the evolution of such heterogeneous stress over the joint surface. This creates difficulties in identifying and monitoring critically stressed asperities, hindering the progress towards improved rock slope monitoring and maintenance strategies. This project proposes an innovative approach for assessing the “health condition” of rock joints. We will incorporate laboratory direct shear tests, acoustic emissions monitoring and surveying, P-wave velocity measurement under different stress conditions, and state-of-the-art imaging technology. The combination of these methodologies intends to quantitatively evaluate the time-lapse stress conditions on the joint and identify the precursory phenomena preceding the shear failure. This will enable the detection of the location of critically stressed asperities, thus providing an early warning for joint failure – analogous to medical imaging techniques determining tumour location and growth. To ensure future field-scale application of the proposed approach, we developed the proposed framework with scalability in mind. The outcome of this project could enhance our scientific understanding of evolving stress conditions on deforming rock joints and provide a theoretical foundation for identifying critically stressed asperities. Thus, facilitating more accurate slope failure forecasting and improving slope maintenance efficiency. Ultimately, this proposal aspires to bolster the safety of communities residing in hilly regions.

15240325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15240325.value: 基於電信級激光器的前向振動傳感與相干通信系統的集成

15240325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15240325.value: Recently, telecom operators have shown great enthusiasm in leveraging the existing fibers for sensing purposes, thereby realizing extra values for optical networks. Among all the feasible solutions, forward vibration sensing through tracking the optical phase stands out and is becoming more important. This is because optical phase is highly sensitive to vibrations and able to offer good localization capability. Another benefit is that forward-based sensing are more compatible and can be integrated into current digital coherent transceivers relatively easily, resulting in a practical pathway forward to incorporate sensing capabilities. However, the laser phase noise should be controlled to a relatively low level to make the vibration-induced phase change more distinct and detectable. Narrow linewidth lasers with linewidth < 100Hz are typically used, which requires significant cost and becomes a main disadvantage for widespread commercialization of optical phase sensing technologies. There are only a few works to date on the topic of relaxing the laser linewidth requirement while all these solutions are not applicable to standard transmission links. The objectives of the proposed research are to provide feasible sensing solutions to standard transmission links with the impact of laser phase noise removable. As a result, telecom grade lasers including external cavity lasers (ECLs) or distributed feedback lasers (DFBs) can be used, which means the cost of the integrated optical sensing and communication system can be largely reduced. Four system designs are derived. In particular, we will 1) use an optical pilot to help remove the transmitter side laser phase noise. The proposed integrated vibration sensing and communication solution can be applied to traditional single carrier coherent transmission systems where ECLs are widely used; 2) investigate the integration of vibration sensing and standard DWDM communications with laser frequency comb. The linewidth requirement will be further relaxed, enabling the use of DFBs. 3) study the localization of vibration events based on dispersion walk-off effect, which enables event localization in unidirectional transmission systems; 4) study a novel forward vibration sensing and single carrier communication with DFBs by using manually constructed continuous light. The successful completion of the proposed research will provide key practical methodologies to use low-cost lasers to integrate optical phase sensing into optical fiber networks, enabling vibration sensing with high sensitivity and good localization but low cost, as a result facilitating the commercial popularization. All of these will promote and accelerate Hong Kong's innovation and breakthroughs in optical communication and sensing fields. 近年來，電信運營商們對於利用現有的光纖實現外界環境感知從而增加現有光網路的額外價值展現出來極高的興趣。在現有可行的解決方案之中，利用前向傳輸光信號的相位信息進行振動傳感的方案脫穎而出並變得越來越重要。這是因為光學相位對外界振動高度敏感並能提供良好的事件定位能力。此外，前向振動傳感系統與現行光纖通信系統的兼容性更強，可以更容易地集成到現行的相干通信收發裝置中。然而，前向振動傳感系統對光源的噪聲水平要求很高，激光器的相位噪聲需要保持相對較低的水平，使振動引起的相變更加明顯。常用的線寬<100Hz的窄線寬激光器相對於商用電信級的激光器來説成本高出很多。高昂的成本成爲了阻礙基於前向傳輸相位傳感的通感一體化系統的商業化的主要因素。而目前，僅有少數關於在基於前向傳輸相位傳感系統中放寬激光器線寬要求的研究被報道，而所有這些解決方案都不適用於標準的通信傳輸鏈路。 本研究的目標是提供可行的前向相位振動傳感和相干通信系統集成的解決方案，以去除由於使用商用寬綫寬激光器所引起的振動相位信號的惡化。因此，電信級激光器，包括外腔激光器 (ECL) 或分佈式反饋激光器（DFB）可以被用在基於前向傳輸相位傳感的通感一體化系統，從而大大減少通感一體系統的成本。四種系統設計將被研究。 具體來說，我們將 1）使用光學導頻來幫助消除發射端激光器相位噪音。所提出的解決方案可以應用於傳統的單載波相干傳輸系統；2）研究振動感測與標準DWDM的集成。通過利用激光頻率梳進一步降低激光器線寬的要求。 3）基於色散走離效應，使得事件定位在單向傳輸系統中可以實現； 4）研究一種新型的振動傳感和單載波相干通信系統的結合。我們將人爲構建一種連續光用於實現相位噪聲消除以及相干通信。

15241025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15241025.value: 用於超精密自由曲面原位測量的智能單次立體條紋投影輪廓術（S3FPP）

15241025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15241025.value: Dr Ho , Lai Ting Dr LI, Da Mr Wang, Bo Prof Wang, Chunjin

15241025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15241025.value: Ultra-precision freeform surfaces (UPFSs) have been widely used in various industries including optometry, bio-medical, energy, automotive, aerospace, etc. Significant progress has been made in the development of various precision metrology and measuring instruments for UPFSs, with most of them realizing off-line measurement. With the increasing geometrical complexity of UPFSs and their challenges regarding the manufacturing accuracies of workpieces with low surface roughness, it is indispensable to develop in-situ measurement methods and systems for UPFSs. As a result, this project aims to develop a novel smart single-shot stereoscopic fringe projection profilometry (S3FPP) measurement method and its associated metrology system to perform the in-situ measurement of UPFSs. An innovative composite fringe pattern will be projected onto the measured object to produce abundant information in both the frequency spectrum and photometric distribution, and the generation mechanism and decoding strategy of the composite fringe patterns will be studied. Through a coding method of the composite fringe pattern, it can achieve one vertical fringe pattern and three horizontal fringe patterns from this single-shot composite fringe pattern through band-pass filters. The corresponding phase maps will be determined by three-step phase shift methods and Fourier transform profilometry. A photometry-phase-united analysis method will be developed to infer depth cues including the phase values extracted from the composite fringe patterns, the phase-consistence in stereoscopic views, the sparse feature point matching, and the photometric consistence among different views. An energy minimization model will be built to combine the different depth cues into the final depth map, and an iterative procedure will be designed to optimize the depth determination. A deep learning-based model will be integrated into the depth estimation process for fringe quality enhancement, phase extraction, and stereo-matching, improving the measurement precision and speed. The Scheimpflug principle will be used to design the optical system to reduce the impact of the shallow depth of field of the microscopic imaging. A smart adaptive fringe projection strategy will be exploited for high dynamic range surfaces to reduce the impact of underexposure or overexposure on the measurement accuracy. The proposed method will achieve sub-micrometer form accuracy with a field of view of 3 cm x 4 cm and measurement speed of 80 ms during the in-situ measurement of UPFSs. The S3FPP measurement method and hence the system will be verified through a series of experiments conducted for the in-situ measurement of various types of UPFSs and intercommunication with experts in precision manufacturing worldwide. 超精準自由曲面（UPFSs） 在光學工程、生物醫學裝置、新能源設備、汽車工業及航空航太等領域的應用日益廣泛。針對此類曲面，現有精密計量技術與測量儀器的研究已取得顯著進展，但絕大多數仍限於離線測量模式。隨著超精密自由曲面幾何複雜度的持續提升，加之低表面粗糙度工件在製造精度控制方面面臨的技術挑戰，開發適用於UPFSs的原位測量方法及系統已迫在眉睫。基於此，本研究提出一種創新型智慧單次立體條紋投影輪廓測量法（S3FPP）及其配套計量系統，旨在實現超精密自由曲面的原位高精度測量。透過設計多維複合條紋結構投射至被測表面，在空間頻域與光度分佈維度產生高資訊密度的調變訊號，並利用頻分編碼策略結合帶通濾波器實現單次投影下的複合條紋解耦，最終分離出1組垂直條紋與3組水平條紋分量。融合三步驟相移法與傅立葉變換輪廓術，透過互補演算法優勢擷取高精度相位圖，在保留高頻形貌細節的同時增強相位解包裹的穩定性。建構光度-相位聯合分析框架，系統融合條紋相位主成分、立體視圖相位一致性約束、稀疏特徵點匹配對應性及多視點光度一致性等深度特徵，並建立基於能量最小化模型的迭代重加權演算法，實現多源深度線索的非線性融合與高置信度深度場輸出。引入卷積神經網路實現條紋影像品質增強、抗干擾魯棒相位提取及基於特徵描述子學習的立體匹配加速，顯著提升測量精度與效率。基於Scheimpflug配置建立顯微成像光路，擴展景深至毫米級以匹配複雜曲面形貌測量需求；同步開發自適應條紋投射演算法，依據表面反射特性動態調節投射強度，規避高動態範圍表面的局部過曝/欠曝問題。本系統預期達到3 cm × 4 cm視場覆蓋能力及≤80 ms的單次測量速度。 S3FPP 測量方法及相關係統將透過一系列針對各類超精密自由曲面的原位測量實驗，並與全球精密製造領域專家展開交流探討，進行有效性驗證 。

15241325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15241325.value: 航空業中AI驅動自動化的行為與政策分析——受監管服務中人機替代性與互補性的影響

15241325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15241325.value: Prof Wang , Lihui Prof Li, Zhichun Prof Michiel, Bliemer

15241325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15241325.value: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the ability to learn, adapt and perform sophisticated tasks. AI-powered-automation may replace medium- or even high-skilled jobs, producing “the automation jobless”. Job security concerns could reduce employee morale, and consequently poor work performance and customer experiences. More importantly, if employees lack trust in AI or are reluctant to cooperate with it, automation systems may be underutilized, hindering the successful implementation. Many challenges (to be) brought by AI-powered-automation are beyond the control of individual firms, calling for government REGULATION and POLICY. This study aims to contribute to those questions by exploring possible complementarity between AI and human, and consequently the effects of alternative regulatory policies in the context of the aviation industry. Civil aviation is an ideal “test-bed” because it is a technology-driven sector, yet regulations and policies have played important roles in the adoption of new technologies. Due to safety regulation, the industry has been very prudent in removing human supervision over automation/autopilot systems, thereby imposing human-automation complementarity. Besides, passenger services are “experience-services” where human engagement/presence is critical, and there is sharp competition which is an important determinant for AI investment. We study human behavior and optimal policy for AI-powered-automation in aviation with two modules: Module I develops the FIRST EXPERIMENT STUDY on how to enhance trust and collaboration between passenger, workers and AI system in the context of aviation security check. It (a) models the factors that encourage/discourage PASSENGERS’ trust in and satisfaction with AI-powered-automation, and whether human engagements have significant moderating effects; and subsequently (b) it models the factors that encourage/discourage EMPLOYEES’ trust in and collaboration with AI, focusing on the effects of providing control to human and ensuring job security through regulation. Module II develops the FIRST ECONOMIC MODEL on human-AI collaboration which simultaneously and explicitly models the effects of (a) human-AI COMPLEMENTARITY; (b) INFORMATION ASYMMETRY when government has less information on production technology than firms, and (c) firm COMPETITION. The modeling result quantifies the effects of afore-mentioned factors (in terms of welfare, industry outputs, investment in AI and labor displacement), and evaluate alternative polices under realistic information asymmetry contexts. Module I and II are complementary. Empirical estimates (e.g., degrees of complementarity) in Module I help calibrate analytical models developed in Module II, thus practical guidance on policy formulation can be obtained for aviation in particular and AI applications in general. 過去的自動化浪潮主要在初期階段取代了低技能職位。隨著時間推移，創造了新的工作任務與職位。然而，人工智能（AI）具備學習、適應及執行複雜任務的能力。由AI驅動的自動化可能取代中等甚至高技能的工作，導致所謂的「自動化失業」。對工作保障的擔憂可能會降低員工士氣，進而導致工作表現不佳及客戶體驗下降。更重要的是，若員工缺乏對AI的信任或不願與其合作，自動化系統可能無法被充分利用，阻礙其成功實施。許多由AI驅動的自動化帶來的挑戰超出了個別企業的控制範圍，因此需要政府的監管與政策介入。 本研究旨在探討AI與人類之間可能的互補性，並進一步分析在航空產業背景下，不同監管政策的影響。民用航空是一個理想的「測試平台」，因為它是一個以科技為主導、擁有先進自動化應用的產業，且在各種商業決策與營運要求上都受到法規與政策的規範。旅客服務屬於「體驗型服務」，其中人員的參與與在場至關重要，且產業競爭激烈，這也是推動AI投資的重要因素。

15300025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300025.value: 探討石珊瑚在海洋酸化下作為微塑料生物匯的作用

15300025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300025.value: The total plastic debris discovered in seawater represents just 1% of the plastics that have entered the world’s oceans. The “missing” plastics, including microplastics (MPs; 1–5000 µm), conceivably could have been accumulated in environmental sinks like marine sediment. Interestingly, recent research has revealed that MPs can become embedded within developing coral skeletons, indicating the potential for stony corals to act as a long-term biological sink for MPs. Our own research has also shown that the number of MPs accumulated in coral skeletons can be nine times higher than that found in the surrounding sediment. These discoveries provide an explanation for the “missing” plastics in the marine environment. Motivated by these discoveries, we propose a systematic study to quantify the encapsulation of MPs in stony corals and assess the capacity of stony corals to serve as a long-term sink for MPs, using Hong Kong as a case study, under both the present-day conditions and a future scenario of ocean acidification (OA). Part I of this study will involve field surveys in Hong Kong to sample corals of opportunity, i.e. dislodged coral fragments that would otherwise not survive, aiming to evaluate the quantity and particle size distribution of MPs encapsulated in the skeletons of three common coral genera. The data collected will be compared with MPs found in coral tissue, ambient seawater, and sediment, to explore the role of stony corals as a biological sink for MPs at a territory-wide scale. The issue of MPs will persist alongside OA, associated with climate change. OA has the potential to diminish the carbonate saturation state in seawater, posing risks to coral health, skeletal growth, and subsequently, the encapsulation of MPs. In light of this, Part II will encompass factorial design experiments in laboratory settings to study the physiological responses of corals to MPs under present-day and future OA scenarios. Factors such as polymer types, shapes and particle sizes of MPs, as well as coral genera and life stages, will be taken into account. The proposed work will establish the baseline information for monitoring the long-term impacts of OA on the fate and dynamics of MPs in the environment. Another highlight of this study is the application of optical-photothermal infrared spectroscopy to assess MPs smaller than 1 µm within stony corals and their habitats, representing a significant advancement in the environmental monitoring of MPs. 海水中發現的塑料碎片總量僅佔全球海洋塑料污染總量的1%。其餘「消失」的塑料（包括微塑料；1–5000微米）很可能已累積於海洋沉積物等環境匯。值得注意的是，最新研究揭示微塑料可嵌入珊瑚骨骼的發育過程中，顯示石珊瑚可能成為微塑料的長期生物匯。我們的研究更發現，珊瑚骨骼中累積的微塑料數量可達周圍沉積物的九倍。這些發現為海洋環境中「消失」的塑料提供了合理解釋。基於上述發現，本研究擬以香港為案例，系統性量化石珊瑚對微塑料的封存能力，並評估其在當代與未來海洋酸化情境下作為長期微塑料匯集體的潛力。 研究第一部分將於香港進行野外調查，採集「機會珊瑚」（即已脫落且無法存活的珊瑚碎片），分析三種常見珊瑚屬骨骼中封存的微塑料數量與粒徑分佈。所獲數據將與珊瑚組織、周邊海水及沉積物中的微塑料進行比對，從區域尺度探討石珊瑚作為生物性微塑料匯集體的作用。微塑料問題將與氣候變化引發的海洋酸化長期共存。海洋酸化可能降低海水碳酸鹽飽和度，進而影響珊瑚健康、骨骼生長及微塑料封存效率。有鑑於此，研究第二部分將通過實驗室控制實驗，探討珊瑚在當代與未來海洋酸化情境下對微塑料的生理影響。實驗將考量微塑料的聚合物類型、形狀、粒徑，以及珊瑚屬別與生命階段等關鍵因子。本項工作將為監測海洋酸化對環境中微塑料歸趨與動態的長期影響建立基礎數據。本研究另一亮點在於應用「光學光熱紅外光譜技術」檢測石珊瑚及其棲息地中小於1微米的微塑料，此技術將顯著提升環境微塑料監測的精準度。

15300125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300125.value: 靶向細菌轉錄的雙芳基抑制劑Nusbiarylin的骨架躍遷：新型抗菌劑開發

15300125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300125.value: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a significant public health threat, as declared by the World Health Organization (WHO). There is an urgent need for antimicrobials with novel modes of action. Transcription, the process of making RNA from DNA, is an underutilized target with only two antibiotics (rifamycins and fidaxomycin) currently in use. Bacterial transcription is carried out by RNA polymerase (RNAP) and regulated by transcription factors like NusB and NusE. The NusB-NusE complex, essential for cell viability and highly conserved across bacteria but not in humans, is an attractive target for new antimicrobial agents. We previously discovered a small molecule inhibitor MC4 targeting the NusB-NusE protein-protein interaction (PPI) through rational design and in silico screening. A library of MC4 derivatives was synthesized, showing excellent antimicrobial activities with minimum inhibitory concentrations as low as 0.5 microgram/ml against significant pathogens without AMR. These compounds, named “nusbiarylins,” reflect their biaryl structure and target, NusB. This proposal aims to use the structure-activity relationship (SAR) and quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) of MC4 derivatives to optimize the biaryl scaffold in nusbiarylins through scaffold hopping. Scaffold hopping is a key strategy in medicinal chemistry that involves modifying the core structure of a known bioactive molecule to discover novel compounds with improved pharmacological profiles. This can enhance drug efficacy, selectivity, safety, and address issues related to patentability. Preliminary attempts have synthesized several 1- and 2-substituted indole and benzimidazole derivatives through scaffold hopping, showing improved antimicrobial activity with minimum inhibitory concentrations down to 0.125 microgram/ml against S. aureus. Encouraged by these results, we plan to design a series of indole, azaindole, azaindazole, benzimidazole, pyrrolopyrazine, and pyrrolopyrimidine derivatives using computational and AI tools. These compounds will undergo chemical synthesis, mechanistic validation, antimicrobial activity assessment, and toxicity evaluation. By the end of this project, a library of new heterocyclic derivatives of nusbiarylins targeting the NusB-NusE PPI will be synthesized and evaluated at molecular and cellular levels. This research will provide representative compounds with antimicrobial activity for further animal studies and serve as standard chemical probes in academic research. In the long term, this proposal will pave the way for developing new classes of antimicrobial drugs with unique modes of action targeting protein-protein interactions. This will impact society by providing new drug candidates against pathogenic bacteria and establish a comprehensive platform for transcription-targeting antibiotic discovery. 抗菌素抗藥性（AMR）已被世界衛生組織（WHO）宣佈為重大的公共衛生威脅。當前迫切需要具有新穎作用機制的抗菌劑。轉錄，即從DNA合成RNA的過程，是一個尚未被充分利用的抗菌標靶，目前僅有兩種抗生素（利福黴素類和菲達黴素）被應用於臨床。細菌轉錄由RNA聚合酶（RNAP）負責，並受NusB和NusE等轉錄因子的調控。NusB-NusE複合物對細胞生存至關重要，且在細菌細胞中高度保守，但在人類細胞中不存在，因此成為極具吸引力的新型抗菌劑標靶。 此前我們通過理性設計與電腦虛擬篩選，發現了一種針對NusB-NusE蛋白質-蛋白質相互作用（PPI）的小分子抑制劑MC4。進一步合成了一系列MC4衍生物，這些化合物對主要病原菌展現出優異的抗菌活性，最低抑菌濃度可達0.5 微克/毫升，且未出現抗藥性。這些化合物被命名為“nusbiarylins”，反映其雙芳基結構及標靶NusB。 本計劃旨在利用MC4衍生物的結構-活性關係（SAR）及定量結構-活性關係（QSAR），通過骨架躍遷優化nusbiarylins的雙芳基骨架。骨架躍遷是藥物開發的重要策略之一，通過改變已知活性分子的核心結構，發現具有更佳藥理特性的全新化合物，從而提升藥物效力、選擇性、安全性，並解決專利相關問題。 我們的初步研究已通過骨架躍遷合成了多種1-及2-取代吲哚和苯並咪唑衍生物，對金黃色葡萄球菌的最低抑菌濃度低至0.125 微克/毫升，抗菌活性顯著提升。在這些成果的鼓舞下，我們計畫運用計算機與人工智能工具，設計一系列吲哚、氮吲哚、氮吲唑、苯並咪唑、吡咯並吡嗪及吡咯並嘧啶衍生物。這些化合物將進行化學合成、機制驗證、抗菌活性評估及毒性測試。 本計畫結束時，將合成並評估一系列以NusB-NusE PPI為靶點的新型nusbiarylins雜環衍生物，並在分子及細胞層面進行評價。此研究將提供具代表性的抗菌活性化合物，供後續動物實驗及學術研究中的標準化學探針使用。 長遠來看，本計畫將為開發以蛋白質-蛋白質相互作用為靶點、具有獨特作用機制的新型抗菌藥物奠定基礎，對社會產生深遠影響，為對抗病原菌提供候選新藥，並建立一套完整的轉錄靶向抗生素發現平台。

15300225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300225.value: 分層化流體中邊界層的數學分析

15300225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300225.value: Understanding the interactions of high-Reynolds-number flows with physical boundaries is fundamental in mathematical fluid mechanics. In 1904, Ludwig Prandtl introduced the seminal concept of boundary layers to describe the fluid behavior near the boundary. He proposed that, away from the boundary, fluid dynamics are effectively governed by Euler equations, while within the boundary layer, a balance between convection and viscous forces results in the Prandtl equation. Prandtl's theory has significantly impacted fields such as aerodynamics, fluid mechanics and engineering. Despite repid development in boundary layer theories for homogeneous fluids, research on stratified fluids remains limited. The interactions of vorticity stretching, buoyancy forces, and thermal convection create complex dynamics in stratified flows. This project aims to understand how these mixing effects influence stability of boundary layers. Our first objective is to investigate potential instability mechanisms in stratified boundary layers. We propose to construct an inviscid unstable mode when the Miles-Howard condition (for stability) breaks down, and a viscous unstable mode when it is satisfied. These mechanisms will determine the critical Gevrey index for boundary layer stability, which differs from homogeneous fluids due to distinct singular structures near the critical layer. Our second objective is to justify the Prandtl's boundary layer expansion for stratified fluids in the critical Gevrey function class. The results are expected to illuminate new phenomena in stratified boundary layers and enhance our understanding of geophysical fluid mechanics. Furthermore, the mathematical techniques developed in this project are expected to be applicable in analyzing boundary layer phenomena in complex fluids.

15300625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300625.value: 非光滑方程的安德森加速高效算法

15300625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300625.value: Nonsmooth equations have numerous applications in engineering and economics and provide a unified formwork for the study of many important optimization problems in machine learning and artificial intelligence. The first-order optimality condition of a constrained optimization problem is a system of nonsmooth equations, whose solution set is the same as the set of the first-order stationary points of the optimization problem. When the optimization problem is convex, a stationary point is an optimal solution. Almost all algorithms for optimization problems are iterative based on fixed point formulations, and the aim is to find a first-order stationary point. Anderson acceleration is an iterative method for fixed point problems, which utilizes a history of prior iterates to accelerate the fixed point iteration. Despite a long history and remarkable numerical performance of Anderson acceleration in a wide range of applications, the understanding of its convergence is still far from complete. Moreover, most existing algorithms with Anderson acceleration do not have rigorous convergence analysis for nonconvex optimization problems in machine learning. This project aims to establish innovative convergence theorems of Anderson acceleration and develop efficient algorithms with Anderson acceleration for nonsmooth equations arising from large-scale nonconvex optimization problems in machine learning. In particular, we will prove that Anderson acceleration can improve the fixed point iteration regarding convergence rate or factor for some special nonsmooth fixed point problems. These new theoretical results will benefit development of new algorithms with Anderson acceleration for some special class of fixed point iterations. We will add trust region steps and restarting steps in Anderson acceleration for finding first-order stationary points of nonconvex optimization problems. We will prove the global convergence and local r-linear convergence of the variants of Anderson acceleration. Moreover, we will develop codes for implementation of the new acceleration algorithms on high-performance computers to solve large-scale nonsmooth equations. Real data from smart cities research will be used to demonstrate the applications of the new theory and algorithms. The outcomes of this project will have a long-term and significant impact, because nonsmooth equations arise from many applications in data science and urgently need efficient algorithms for implementation. The new acceleration algorithms for nonsmooth equations with rigorous convergence analysis will attract attention from the international scientific community through excellent collaboration with world leading researchers and publications in leading journals and conferences. 非光滑方程在工程和經濟學中有著廣泛的應用，並為研究機器學習和人工智能中許多重要的優化問題提供了統一的框架。約束優化問題的一階優化條件是一組非光滑方程，其解集與優化問題的一階稳定點集相同。 當優化問題是凸的時候，稳定點就是最佳解。幾乎所有的優化問題算法都是基於不動點公式的迭代方法，目標是找到一個一階稳定點。安德森加速是一種針對不動點問題的迭代方法，它利用之前迭代的歷史來加速不動點迭代。儘管安德森加速在廣泛應用中有著悠久的歷史和顯著的數值表現，但對於其收斂性的理解仍然遠未完整。此外，大多數現有的使用安德森加速的算法對於機器學習中的非凸優化問題並沒有嚴謹的收斂分析。 本項目旨在建立安德森加速的創新收斂定理，並為機器學習中源自大規模非凸優化問題的非光滑方程開發高效的安德森加速算法。特別地，我們將證明安德森加速可以改善某些特殊非光滑不動點問題的不動點迭代的收斂速率或因子。這些新的理論結果將有助於為某些特殊類別的固定點迭代開發新的安德森加速算法。我們將在安德森加速中添加信賴區域步驟和重啟步驟，以尋找非凸優化問題的一階稳定點。我們將證明安德森加速及其變型的全局收斂性和局部線性收斂性。此外，我們將開發求解器，以在高性能計算機上實現新的加速算法，解決大規模非光滑方程。來自智慧城市研究的實際數據將用於展示新理論和算法的應用。 這個項目的結果將會產生長期且重大的影響，因為非光滑方程在數據科學的許多應用中出現，並迫切需要高效的實現算法。針對非光滑方程的新加速算法，並進行嚴謹的收斂分析，將通過與世界頂尖研究人員的優秀合作以及在領先期刊和會議上的發表，吸引國際科學界的關注。

15301025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301025.value: 随机Wasserstein几何流的保结构算法

15301025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301025.value: Stochastic Wasserstein geometric flow describes the evolution of shapes and distributions over time under the influence of random effect and uncertainty. It is a burgeoning area of research with many emerging real-world applications in machine learning (such as diffusion generative models), computational physics (such as stochastic Schrodinger equations with applications in optical fiber), control and image processing. In addition, many classical problems, like the stochastic Schrodinger equation, stochastic continuity equation and stochastic Vlasov equation, can be reformulated as stochastic Wasserstein geometric flows. Our study provides a new viewpoint for analyzing and computing the solutions of those equations. This research focuses on the development of structure-preserving numerical methods for stochastic Wasserstein geometric flows. Traditional numerical methods often fail to maintain the essential properties of the original equations, leading to inaccurate or unstable simulations. Our goal is to create algorithms that not only approximate the solutions to these flows efficiently but also retain their geometric and probabilistic characteristics. We shall begin by studying the mathematical properties and geometric structures of these flows through different stochastic particle systems, which is essential for understanding how shapes and distributions evolve. Next, we will develop numerical methods that are specifically designed to preserve the geometric structures of these flows on the density space. These methods are constructed by exploiting the parametric stochastic geometric flows via the pullback Wasserstein metric, which is a key innovation in this research. Another one is adapting temporal symplectic integrators and auxiliary variable methods in the stochastic setting. Additionally, we will incorporate techniques from probability theory and stochastic analysis to handle the random components of these flows and present the error analysis of proposed methods under the Wasserstein distance. The results of our research will have significant implications for various fields. For instance, in optical fiber, our methods can be used to simulate the propagation of nonlinear wave under random influences. In computer science, they can improve algorithms for image processing and machine learning. In conclusion, this research shall advance the field of numerical analysis by providing robust and efficient methods for simulating stochastic Wasserstein geometric flows. By preserving the structures of the original equations, our methods will offer more accurate and reliable simulations, paving the way for new discoveries and applications in multiple disciplines. 随机Wasserstein几何流描述了在随机效应和不确定性影响下，形状与分布随时间演化的过程。这是一个新兴的研究领域，在机器学习（如扩散生成模型）、计算物理（如应用于光纤的随机薛定谔方程）、控制与图像处理等众多实际应用中展现出广阔前景。此外，许多经典问题，如随机薛定谔方程、随机连续性方程和随机Vlasov方程，都可以重新表述为随机Wasserstein几何流。我们的研究为这些方程的分析与数值计算提供了新的视角。 本研究的核心在于发展能够保结构的随机Wasserstein几何流数值方法。传统的数值方法往往难以保持原方程的基本性质，导致模拟结果不准确或不稳定。我们的目标是设计出既能高效逼近这些流的解，又能保留其几何和概率特性的算法。我们首先将通过不同的随机粒子系统，研究这些流的数学性质和几何结构，这是理解形状和分布演化机制的基础。随后，我们将设计专门用于保持密度空间上几何结构的数值方法。这些方法的创新之处在于利用参数化的随机几何流和pullback Wasserstein度量进行构造。此外，我们还将在随机背景下引入时间辛积分子和辅助变量方法。与此同时，我们将结合概率论和随机分析的技术，处理流中的随机成分，并在Wasserstein距离下对所提出方法进行误差分析。 我们的研究成果将在多个领域产生重要影响。例如，在光纤领域，我们的方法可用于模拟非线性波在随机影响下的传播过程；在计算机科学中，可提升图像处理和机器学习算法的性能。总之，本研究将通过提供稳健高效的随机Wasserstein几何流数值模拟方法，推动数值分析领域的发展。通过保留原方程的结构特性，我们的方法将带来更为准确可靠的模拟结果，为多个学科的创新应用和新发现奠定基础。

15301425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301425.value: 透過層間菱面體堆積結合 In2Se3 層內離子極化實現二維鐵電性

15301425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301425.value: Recently, van der Waals (vdW) layered materials have demonstrated remarkable stacking engineering capabilities compared other non-layered materials. While the spontaneous intralayer ionic polarizations in two-dimensional (2D) layers, such as In2Se3, SnTe, and CuInP2S6 (CIPS), have attracted significant attention, the interlayer stacking can lead to the emergence of distinct charge transfer polarizations, such as sliding ferroelectricity. This phenomenon has been observed in h-BN and transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) layers. Of particular interest is the rhombohedral stacking (commonly referred to as 3R stacking) which can induce both robust in-plane and out-of-plane polarizations, holding great potential for future device applications. The ferroelectric behavior induced by interlayer stacking in vdW layered h-BN or TMDs is a result of charge transfer between layers lacking inverse symmetry. However, in materials such as In2Se3, the impact of intralayer and interlayer charge transfer on ferroelectricity remains largely unexplored. Understanding how the combination of intralayer and interlayer polarizations can influence and potentially enhance ferroelectric properties is a key area of interest for future device applications. Furthermore, exploring interface effects in heterogeneous structures, particularly at boundaries between different stacking orders or domains, offers unique opportunities. By leveraging the stacking order effects in conjunction with intralayer intrinsic polarization, it may be possible to create highly confined and tunable interface regions. These specialized areas could be ideal for developing non-volatile memristive devices with enhanced tunability and performance. The focus of our project lies in exploring the synthesis, characterization, and applications of metastable 3R stacked In2Se3 (compared to 2H stacking), which combines intralayer and interlayer polarizations to enhance polarization intensity and stability. Our approach involves utilizing chemical vapor deposition (CVD) for large-area synthesis of 3R stacked 2D In2Se3, enabling atomic-scale insights into charge and electric field distributions. Simultaneously, CVD methods will be employed for the synthesis of 2H stacked In2Se3, with the objective of achieving the 2H/3R mixed stacked structure. Additionally, anti-ferroelectric β’-In2Se3 will be manipulated to form 2H and 3R stacking 2D layers, facilitating seamless conversion or integration with ferroelectric α-In2Se3. Through state-of-the-art characterization techniques, such as 4D-scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) and differential phase contrast (DPC)-STEM characterizations, we aim to gain deep understanding of the polarization and electric potential in the novel 3R-In2Se3, as well as the mixed stacking order or phase structures and boundaries. The last objective of this project is to identify optimal candidates with best ferroelectric properties for memory devices, including memory transistors and memristors. 最近，與其他非層狀材料相比，范德華 (vdW) 層狀材料表現出了卓越的堆疊工程能力。雖然二維 (2D) 層（例如 In2Se3、SnTe 和 CuInP2S6 (CIPS)）中的自發層內離子極化已引起廣泛關注，但層間堆疊可導致出現不同的電荷轉移極化，例如滑動鐵電性。這種現像已在 h-BN 和過渡金屬二硫屬化物 (TMD) 層中觀察到。特別令人感興趣的是菱面體堆疊（通常稱為 3R 堆疊），它可以誘導強大的平面內和平面外極化，在未來的裝置應用方面具有巨大潛力。 vdW 層狀 h-BN 或 TMD 中的層間堆疊引起的鐵電行為是缺乏逆對稱性的層間電荷轉移的結果。然而，在諸如In2Se3之類的材料中，層內和層間電荷轉移對鐵電性的影響仍未被充分探索。了解層內和層間極化的組合如何影響並潛在地增強鐵電性能是未來裝置應用的關鍵研究領域。此外，探索異質結構中的界面效應，特別是在不同堆疊序列或疇界之間的界面效應，提供了獨特的研究機會。透過利用堆疊序效應與層內本徵極化相結合，有可能創建高度受限且可調的介面區域。這些特殊區域對於開發具有增強可調性和性能的非揮發性憶阻裝置而言，可能是理想的選擇。我們專案的重點在於探索亞穩態3R堆疊In2Se3（相對於2H堆疊）的合成、表徵和應用，這種結構結合了層內和層間極化，以增強極化強度和穩定性。我們的方法包括利用化學氣相沉積 (CVD) 進行大面積合成3R堆疊二維In2Se3，從而能夠在原子尺度上洞察電荷和電場分佈。同時，我們將採用CVD方法合成2H堆疊In2Se3，以實現2H/3R混合堆疊結構。此外，反鐵電β’-In2Se3將被操縱形成2H和3R堆疊2D層，從而促進與鐵電α-In2Se3的無縫轉換或整合。我們旨在利用先進的表徵技術，例如四維掃描透射電子顯微鏡 (STEM) 和差分相襯 (DPC)-STEM 表徵技術，深入了解新型 3R-In2Se3 的極化和電勢，以及混合堆疊層序或相結構和邊界。本專案的最後一個目標是為儲存裝置（包括儲存電晶體和憶阻器）尋找具有最佳鐵電性能的候選材料。

15301725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301725.value: 硅铝分子筛活性中心的吸附诱导转变：从布朗斯特酸中心到受阻路易斯酸碱对

15301725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301725.value: Zeolites are highly important heterogeneous catalysts widely applied in many industrial processes. Understanding of zeolite catalysis is closely tied to what we know about the features and structure of active sites. The classic active sites for adsorption or catalysis on zeolite surfaces, such as the Brønsted acid site (BAS) and Lewis acid site (LAS), are generally believed to be located at specific crystallographic positions with rigid structures. However, recent studies indicate that zeolite frameworks exhibit dynamic flexibility, which can induce active site reconstruction in response to external substrate molecules or stimuli. I have extensive experience in the characterisation of active sites on zeolite catalysts. Very recently, I have found that BAS in silicoaluminophosphate (SAPO) zeolites can be reformed into Frustrated Lewis Pairs (FLP) via breaking the Al-O bond in Si-O(H)-Al of BAS upon small polar molecule adsorption. Besides, I also found that increasing temperature can promote the BAS transformation to FLP sites. Those works open a new avenue to understanding the dynamic change of zeolite acid sites, which are critical in understanding zeolite catalysis. Therefore, further investigations with a broader range of probe/adsorbate molecules on different types of zeolites are imperatively needed. Inspired by my previous findings, in this project, I propose that the flexibility of BAS structures in SAPO zeolites could be extended to other aluminosilicate zeolites, such as MFI, FAU, and MOR. By using trimethylphosphine oxide (TMPO) as a solid-state NMR (SSNMR) probe, I have preliminarily observed significant TMPO adsorption signal for LAS in some ZSM-5 and Beta zeolite (MFI type) samples, which initially contained only BAS. I anticipate that LAS may come from the TMPO adsorption by inducing the BAS site over these zeolite structures to change to FLP. This project will address the critical challenge of understanding dynamic creations of active sites in aluminosilicate zeolites: from BAS to FLP through interactions with substrate molecules. By employing advanced characterisation techniques, the structural changes of BAS will be investigated by analysing their distribution in different environments and their response to various adsorbates/reactants. Furthermore, quantitative information regarding the percentage of induced FLP from BAS across different zeolite frameworks will be obtained. Ultimately, the insights gained from this study will pave the way for a deeper understanding of the mechanisms underlying zeolite-catalysed reactions, leading to the tailoring of the zeolites to specific catalytic reactions. 分子筛（沸石）是广泛应用于多种工业过程的重要多相催化剂。对沸石催化作用的理解与其活性位点的特征和结构密切相关。传统上，人们认为沸石表面用于吸附或催化的经典活性位点，如布朗斯特酸中心（Brønsted Acid Sites, BAS）和路易斯酸中心（Lewis Acid Sites, LAS），通常位于晶体结构中的特定位置，具有较为刚性的构型。然而，近期研究表明，沸石骨架具有一定的动态柔性，这种柔性可在外部分子或外界刺激作用下诱导活性位点的重构。 本人长期从事沸石催化剂表面活性位点的表征研究。在最近的研究中，发现硅铝磷酸盐（SAPO）沸石中的布朗斯特酸中心在吸附小分子极性分子时，其Si-O(H)-Al结构中的Al–O键会发生断裂，从而形成受阻路易斯酸碱对（Frustrated Lewis Pairs, FLP）。此外，升高温度也有助于布朗斯特酸中心向FLP位点的转变。这些研究为理解沸石酸性位点的动态变化提供了新视角，对深入认识沸石催化机制具有重要意义。因此，迫切需要在更广泛的探针分子和不同种类的沸石体系中进一步开展相关研究。 受本人前期研究的启发，本项目提出假设：SAPO沸石中布朗斯特酸中心的结构柔性可能也存在于其他铝硅酸盐沸石中，例如MFI（如ZSM-5）、FAU（如Y型）和MOR型沸石。初步实验表明，利用三甲基氧化膦（TMPO）作为固体核磁共振（Solid-State NMR, SSNMR）探针分子，在原本仅含BAS的某些ZSM-5和Beta沸石（MFI型）样品中观察到了显著的LAS吸附信号。据此推测，该LAS信号可能来源于TMPO吸附诱导BAS位点转变为FLP的结果。 本项目旨在解决铝硅酸盐沸石中活性位点动态生成这一关键科学问题：即布朗斯特酸中心在与反应物分子相互作用过程中如何转化为受阻路易斯酸碱对。通过采用先进的表征技术，研究不同环境条件下BAS的分布及其对多种吸附分子/反应物的响应行为，从而揭示其结构演变规律。此外，项目还将定量分析不同沸石骨架中由BAS转化而来的FLP位点的比例。最终，本研究有望为深入理解沸石催化反应的微观机制提供理论依据，并为针对特定催化反应定制化设计沸石催化剂提供指导。 关键词：铝硅酸盐沸石；表面布朗斯特酸中心重构；吸附诱导受阻路易斯酸碱对；先进表征技术；多相催化

15301825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301825.value: 复杂流体不可压模型的适定性

15301825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301825.value: As fundamental models in complex fluids, the magnetohydrodynamic fluid and the nematic liquid crystal flow are hot topics in the scientific community. The magnetohydrodynamic fluid is the study of dynamical behaviour of fluid under the effect of magnetic fields and involves parabolic-hyperbolic coupling as the magnetic diffusivity is neglectable, while the nematic liquid crystal flow studies the parabolic coupling systems between fluid flows and heat flows of harmonic maps. Despite of their importance in physics and the recent development in mathematical analysis, the global-in-time wellposedness theories of incompressible magnetohydrodynamic fluids around nontrivial equilibrium, and the global-in-time regularity of incompressible nematic liquid crystal flow with large initial data in critical spaces, remain as challenging open problems in the community, even though a state-of-the-art small perturbation theory near a constant equilibrium was successfully formulated during the past several decades. In this research proposal we intend to push forward the mathematical understanding of incompressible magnetohydrodynamic fluids with zero magnetic diffusivity around nontrivial equilibrium. The first topic in this proposal focuses on the global-in-time wellposedness of classical solutions of incompressible magnetohydrodynamic fluid with zero magnetic diffusivity in two or three dimensions, when the initial data is a small perturbation around an equilibrium with a Beltrami magnetic field and zero velocity. This proposed problem is difficult because of the degeneracy of the linear system and the variable coefficients in the linear system. These phenomena produce several hurdles to control the growth of norms of nonlinear terms. The success of this proposed problem needs a careful analysis of both the linear system and nonlinear terms, and sheds lights on understanding multi-dimensional quasilinear hyperbolic-parabolic equations with degenerated variable coefficients. The second topic in this proposal aims to address the global existence of scale-invariant solutions with large homogeneous initial data to three-dimensional incompressible nematic liquid crystal systems. The harmonic map structure makes the dissipation of director weaker, and a partial regularity argument can not be applied directly. To overcome these two difficulties, a better understanding of nonlinearity is necessary and a profile decomposition argument will be applied to deal with the possible concentration. The success of this proposed problem helps the mathematical understanding of wellposedness of incompressible flows with supercritical nonlinearity when the concentration/bubble phenomenon presents. 不可壓縮流體動力學在物理學中具有重要意義，並且在數學分析領域也取得了長足的發展。但圍繞非平凡平衡態的全局時間適定性理論，以及在臨界空間中具有大初始數據的不可壓縮向列液晶流的全局時間正則性，仍然是科學界極具挑戰性的開放性問題，儘管在過去幾十年中建立了平凡平衡態全局時間適定性。 在本研究提案中，我們旨在推進對非平凡平衡態附近磁擴散率為零的不可壓縮磁流體動力學流體的數學理解。本提案的第一個主題集中於二維或三維中，當初始數據是圍繞具有貝爾特拉米磁場和零速度的平衡態的小擾動時，具有零磁擴散率的不可壓縮磁流體動力學經典解的全局時間適定性。由於線性系統的退化及其可變係數的存在，此問題十分困難。這些現象為控制非線性項範數的增長帶來了許多障礙。此問題的成功需要對線性系統和非線性項進行仔細的分析，並為理解具有退化可變係數的多維擬線性雙曲-拋物方程式提供啟示。 本提案的第二個主題旨在解決三維不可壓縮向列液晶系統在具有大量均勻初始值的情況下尺度不變解的全局存在性。调和映射結構使得指向矢的耗散較弱，且部分正則性論證無法直接應用。為了克服這兩個難題，需要更好地理解非線性，並將應用輪廓分解論證來處理可能出現的集中现象。此問題的成功有助於在出現集中/氣泡現象時，從數學上理解具有超臨界非線性的不可壓縮流的適定性。

15301925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301925.value: 手性鈣鈦礦量子阱超晶格的室溫超螢光研究

15301925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301925.value: This proposal focuses on the study of room-temperature superfluorescence (RT-SF) from chiral perovskite quantum well superlattices (QW-SLs). Superfluorescence is a quantum optical phenomenon characterized by collective emission from synchronized quantum emitters, resulting in intensified bursts of coherent light with shorter lifetimes compared to conventional fluorescence. While SF has been extensively investigated in various systems, achieving it at room temperature in solid-state materials poses challenges due to thermal dephasing. Recent advances have demonstrated SF in perovskite nanocrystal superlattices and quasi-2D perovskite thin films; however, integrating chirality into these systems represents a novel frontier. This project aims to explore RT-SF in our recently developed non-chiral and chiral perovskite QW-SLs. Our preliminary results demonstrate the perovskite QW-SLs exhibit clear evidence of RT-SF, providing a strong foundation for investigating several un-explored fundamental questions in these newly developed SLs such as (1) How to achieve wavelength tunable RT-superfluorescence? (2) Why can superfluorescence be observed at room temperature in perovskite quantum well superlattices? What role does polaron play in this process? (3) Can circularly polarized superfluorescence (CP-SF) be achieved in chiral perovskite quantum well superlattices, and if so, how? Through systematic tuning of perovskite QW thickness and halide composition, we aim to explore the wavelength-tunable RT SF. Additionally, utilizing state-of-the-art ultrafast spectroscopy techniques, such as transient terahertz emission, in conjunction with our collaborator’s theoretical first-principles calculations, we aim to explore the role of polarons in RT-SF within these perovskite QW structures. Furthermore, by exploring circularly polarized SF in chiral perovskite QW-SLs with varying handedness, we will leverage our collaborator’s theoretical quantum optics calculations to understand the influence of chirality on the generation of circularly polarized (CP) SF. These results of this project will significantly advance the fields of quantum materials and optics, contributing valuable insights into the mechanisms of RT-SF, CP-SF and its potential applications in next-generation optical, electronic devices, and quantum technologies. 本計畫重點研究手性鈣鈦礦量子阱超晶格（QW-SL）的室溫超螢光（RT-SF）。超螢光是一種量子光學現象，其特徵是同步量子發射器的集體發射，產生強度增強的相干光爆發，其壽命比傳統螢光更短。雖然SF已在各種體系中廣泛研究，但由於熱相移效應，在室溫下在固態材料中實現SF仍面臨挑戰。最近的進展已證明SF存在於鈣鈦礦奈米晶體超晶格和準二維鈣鈦礦薄膜中；然而，將手性融入這些體系代表著一個全新的前沿領域。本計畫旨在探索我們近期開發的非手性和手性鈣鈦礦QW-SL中的RT-SF。我們的初步結果表明，鈣鈦礦量子阱超晶格表現出明顯的室溫超螢光（RT-SF）特徵，為研究這些新開發的超晶格中幾個尚未探索的基本問題奠定了堅實的基礎，例如：(1) 如何實現波長可調的即時超螢光？ (2) 為什麼在室溫下鈣鈦礦量子阱超晶格中可以觀察到超螢光？極化子在此過程中扮演什麼角色？ (3) 手性鈣鈦礦量子阱超晶格中能否實現圓偏振超螢光 (CP-SF)？如果可以，如何實現？我們旨在透過系統地調節鈣鈦礦量子阱厚度和鹵化物成分，探索波長可調的超螢光。此外，我們利用最先進的超快光譜技術（例如瞬態太赫茲光谱）結合我們合作者的理論第一原理計算，旨在探索極化子在這些鈣鈦礦量子阱結構中室溫超螢光中的作用。此外，透過探索不同手性手性鈣鈦礦量子阱結構（QW-SL）中的圓偏振超螢光，我們將利用我們合作者的理論量子光學計算來理解手性對圓偏振（CP）超螢光的影響。 此計畫的成果將顯著推動量子材料和光學領域的發展，為室溫超螢光和手性對圓偏振-室溫超螢光的機制及其在下一代光學、電子裝置和量子技術中的潛在應用提供寶貴的見解。

15302225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302225.value: 基於流數據的統計排名方法

15302225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302225.value: The Paris Olympics concluded with a series of thrilling competitions, drawing attention to the climactic moments that determine the champions. This phenomenon is often referred to as “league table mentality,” reflecting an inherent human nature to focus on ranking outcomes. From a statistical perspective, the data generated from such competitions is considered a form of ranked data. Therefore, it is possible to utilize statistical models to synthesize the order information of data to provide quantitative evaluations of participants. However, in the era of big data, the rapid growth of ranked data as well as the diverse data structure presents new challenges for ranked data analysis. Some recent advancements have demonstrated that traditional methods either lack computational efficiency or introduce bias when applied to such complex data. Consequently, new approaches are needed to effectively analyze ranked data in this evolving landscape. This project focuses on developing a novel statistical method for analyzing ranked data in a streaming context. The study begins with a fundamental online ranking method: the Elo rating algorithm. First, we address the potential bias introduced by the Elo algorithm and establish the asymptotic properties of its output as the number of objects approaches infinity. Building on this, we incorporate auxiliary covariates to enhance prediction accuracy and introduce dynamic ranking. Furthermore, we investigate various practical scenarios, including multi-level outcomes, multiway comparisons, and team-based comparisons. This project aims to address fundamental problems in statistical ranking, with results that have broad applications in recommendation systems, sports competitions, information retrieval, and other areas. 巴黎奧運以一系列激動人心的比賽落下帷幕。人們的目光往往聚焦於決定冠軍歸屬的關鍵時刻。這種現象常被稱為排名情結，它反映了人類關注排名結果的內在天性。從統計學角度看，此類比賽產生的數據被視為一種排序數據。因此，我們可以利用統計模型來綜合數據的排序信息，從而對參與者進行量化評估。然而，在大數據時代，排序數據的快速增長以及其多樣化的數據結構，為排序數據分析帶來了新的挑戰。近期的研究進展表明，傳統方法在處理此類複雜數據時，要麼計算效率低下，要麼會引入偏差。因此，需要新的方法來有效分析這個不斷演變的排序數據。本項目致力於開發一種新穎的統計方法，用於在流數據場景下分析排序數據。研究將始於一個基礎的在線排名方法：埃洛評分算法。首先，我們將探討埃洛算法可能引入的偏差，並建立其輸出結果在比較對象數量趨於無窮大時的漸近性質。在此基礎上，我們還將引入協變量以提高預測準確性，並提出動態排名方法。此外，我們還會考慮多種實際場景，包括多級結果、多主體比較和團隊比較。本項目旨在解決統計排名領域中的基礎性問題，其研究成果在推薦系統、體育競賽、資訊檢索等領域具有廣泛的應用前景。

15302525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302525.value: 超圖嵌入：一種具有遞增維度的新穎方法

15302525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302525.value: Hypergraphs generalize graphs by allowing each edge, known as a hyperedge, to connect multiple vertices. Recently, hypergraph theory has gained attention for its ability to represent complex relationships in fields like social networks, collaboration networks, and brain networks. Statistical modeling of hypergraphs allows researchers to analyze these intricate structures, uncovering hidden patterns, relationships, and properties. Despite their significant advantages, hypergraph embeddings have been underexplored compared to pairwise graphs due to the inherent complexity of the hypergraph topologies. Specifically, the joint consideration of latent dependencies among hyperedges of varying orders, node heterogeneity, and sparsity remains unexplored. On the other hand, existing approaches often rely on fixed-dimensional embeddings, where the relative closeness among nodes is fixed, regardless of hyperedge order. This fixed-dimensional setting encourages heredity among hyperedges of different orders and fails to offer a flexible projection to capture the complex relationships among nodes. In this project, we propose a novel increasing dimensional embedding approach that jointly considers sparsity and node heterogeneity, including both degree heterogeneity and node heterogeneity in the latent dependencies among hyperedges of different orders. We have developed an efficient estimation procedure using penalized loss functions. The resulting embeddings will be applied to downstream tasks such as linkage prediction and community detection. Additionally, we introduce extensions using a surrogate loss approach to handle large hypergraphs. The proposed increasing dimensional embedding framework offers a more flexible approach to capturing diverse features of hypergraphs and could potentially provide new insights in different real applications. 超圖通過允許每條邊（稱為超邊）連接多個頂點，從而推廣了圖的概念。近年來，超圖理論因其在表示社交網絡、協作網絡和腦網絡等領域的複雜關係而受到關注。超圖的統計建模使研究人員能夠分析這些複雜結構，揭示隱藏的模式、關係和屬性。儘管超圖具有顯著優勢，但與成對圖相比，超圖嵌入的研究仍顯不足，這是由於超圖拓撲結構的固有複雜性。具體而言，對於不同階數超邊之間的潛在依賴、節點異質性和稀疏性的聯合考慮仍未被充分探索。另一方面，現有方法通常依賴固定維度的嵌入，其中節點之間的相對接近度是固定的，與超邊階數無關。這種固定維度設置鼓勵不同階數超邊之間的遺傳性，無法提供靈活的投影來捕捉節點之間的複雜關係。 在本項目中，我們提出了一種新穎的遞增維度嵌入方法，該方法聯合考慮了稀疏性和節點異質性，包括不同階數超邊之間潛在依賴中的度異質性和節點異質性。我們開發了一種使用懲罰損失函數的高效估計程序。所得嵌入將應用於下游任務，如鏈接預測和社群檢測。此外，我們引入了使用代理損失方法的擴展，以處理大型超圖。所提出的遞增維度嵌入框架提供了一種更靈活的方法來捕捉超圖的多樣特徵，並可能在不同的現實應用中提供新的見解。

15302825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302825.value: 關於具有負毒物趨向性的群體-毒物模型：分析和建模的新見解

15302825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302825.value: This project consists of two main parts. In the first part, we study the spreading dynamics of a population-toxicant system describing the interaction between aquatic species and toxicants in a polluted aquatic system with a toxicant avoidance response by aquatic species characterized by the negative toxicant-taxis. We consider the strong and weak toxicant-taxis and find conditions under which traveling wave solutions exist with unique (or minimal) wave speed. Furthermore, we identify the dependence of the wave speed on the model parameters and explore how the strength of toxicant-taxis affects the wave properties (like smoothness or monotonicity) and wave speed. The main difficulty encountered in the analysis comes from the toxicant-taxis term, which not only makes many well-established mathematical methods or theories inapplicable due to its cross-diffusion nature but also generates degeneracy in the analysis of traveling wave solutions. We resolve these issues by using the singular perturbation theory, change of variables, Banach fixed-point theorem, energy estimates, and so on. In the second part, we consider the toxicant-taxis system with temporally and spatially varying input of toxicants, which extends the applicability of the existing models with the toxicant input rate uniform in time and space. With this new ingredient, the considered model is a non-autonomous system with toxicant-taxis for which no well-established theory nor empirical methods are available. In this proposal, we shall employ multiple ideas, such as perturbation method, principal eigenvalue theorem, theory of monotone dynamical systems, method of upper-lower solutions, implicit function theorem, Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction method and so on, to study the qualitative behavior of solutions to the system and investigate the deleterious effects of toxicants on the persistence and extinction of aquatic species. By finding the conditions for the existence and stability (local and/or global) of the coexistence and exclusion steady states or periodic solutions, we pinpoint the key factors that determine the fate (long-time dynamics) of aquatic species in the polluted environment. We illustrate our ideas and results by numerical simulations. 本項目包含兩個主要部分。 第一部分中，我們研究種群 - 毒物系統的擴散動力學，該系統描述了污染水體中水生生物與毒物的相互作用，其中水生生物的毒物回避反應以負向毒物趨避為特徵。我們考慮了強、弱兩種毒物趨避情形，得到了行波解存在且具有唯一（或最小）波速的條件。此外，我們明確了波速對模型參數的依賴性，並探究了毒物趨避強度如何影響行波性質（如光滑性或單調性）及波速。分析中遇到的主要難點源於毒物趨避項：其交叉擴散性質不僅使得許多成熟的數學方法或理論不再適用，還在行波解分析中產生了退化性。我們通過奇異攝動理論、變量替換、巴拿赫不動點定理、能量估計等方法解決了這些問題。 第二部分中，我們考慮了具有時空變化毒物輸入的毒物趨避系統，這拓展了現有毒物輸入速率時空均一模型的適用性。引入這一新要素後，所研究的模型成為帶毒物趨避的非自治系統，目前尚無成熟的理論或經驗方法可用於此類系統。本研究將採用多種方法，如攝動方法、主特徵值定理、單調動力系統理論、上下解方法、隱函數定理、李雅普諾夫 - 施密特約化方法等，研究該系統解的定性行為，並探究毒物對水生生物持續生存與滅絕的有害影響。通過得到共存與排斥平衡態或周期解的存在性及穩定性（局部和 / 或全域）條件，我們將明確決定污染環境中水生生物命運（長時間動力學行為）的關鍵因素。最後，我們透過數值模擬來闡述我們的想法和結果。

15303025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15303025.value: 高階及SARS-CoV-2 RNA 鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸激發態動力學的组合超快光譜研究

15303025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15303025.value: Prof Kwok, Wai-Ming Prof Wong, Ka-Leung

15303025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15303025.value: Guanine-Quadruplexes (GQs) are non-canonical nucleic acid structures formed by G-rich sequences in the human genome and viruses, including SARS-CoV-2. They play crucial roles in gene expression and viral lifecycle regulation and are targets for anti-cancer and anti-viral drug design. Their controllable formation and structural polymorphism enable significant applications in nanobiotechnology and molecular device engineering. Like other nucleic acid structures, GQs strongly absorb UV irradiation, leading to electronic excitation and the formation of excited states. Understanding these excited states is crucial, as they significantly impact the biological functionality and application performance of GQs. However, this is challenging due to the intrinsic complexity of the electronic excitation and decay of the excited states, which may involve various short-lived species and rapid processes occurring in timescale from femtoseconds to nanoseconds, depending on the specific GQ structure and environmental conditions. Previous research on GQs’ excited states is limited to right-handed monomeric GQs, primarily derived from DNA G-rich sequences. Recent studies, however, have identified higher-order GQs composed of multiple GQ sub-units in diverse folding topologies, including conventional right-handed, rare left-handed, and hybrid helix progressions. Additionally, GQs in SARS-CoV-2 RNA within live cells have been identified as promising therapeutic targets for COVID-19, with ultrafast UV irradiation potentially inactivating the virus. These higher-order GQs and SARS-CoV-2 RNA GQs differ from the monomeric systems, featuring unique structural elements such as varied interfacial subunit interactions and extensive loop compositions, adding complexity to the already intricate dynamics of excited states. Aiming to explore this uncharted area, herein we propose utilizing our state-of-the-art ultrafast broadband time-resolved spectroscopy to develop an effective protocol for directly studying the excited states of several top-ranked SARS-CoV-2 RNA GQs and a series of carefully selected prototype higher-order GQs that feature diverse folding scaffolds, helix progression directions, and loop and termini base arrangements. The research will be conducted under controlled conditions, including cell-mimicking environments. This study will enable the first real-time probing of the excited states and tracking their dynamic evolution, providing comprehensive and quantitative spectra and dynamics parameters characteristic of the chosen GQs. It will identify key structural and environmental factors that regulate the excited state processes and fluorescence properties. This research will decode the complexity and provide novel insights to advance molecular-level understanding of the interplay between structure and excited state dynamics. The results will be valuable for developing label-free GQ sensors, GQ-based nanotechnology, anti-viral drug design, and inactivating the SARS-CoV-2 RNA virus. 鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸（GQs）是由富含鳥嘌呤序列形成的非經典核酸結構，廣泛存在於人類基因組及包括SARS-CoV-2在內的病毒中。GQs在基因表達和病毒生命週期調控中發揮關鍵作用，是抗癌和抗病毒藥物設計的重要標靶。其可控的組裝特性和結構多樣性，使其在奈米生物技術和分子器件工程中具有重要應用前景。與其它核酸結構類似，GQs強烈吸收紫外光，導致電子激發並形成激發態。深入理解GQs的激發態對於揭示其生物功能和應用性能至關重要。然而，GQs激發態的電子結構及弛豫過程極為複雜，涉及多個瞬態物種及飛秒至納秒時間尺度的輻射和非輻射動力學，受結構和環境影響，研究難度極大。先前對 GQs 激發態的研究僅限於由DNA富鳥嘌呤序列形成的單體右旋 GQs。近年來，研究發現由多個GQ單體聚合形成的、具有不同拓樸結構的高階GQs，包括較常見的右旋式構型及罕見的左旋式構型和混旋式構型。此外，活細胞內SARS-CoV-2 RNA形成的GQs被證實為COVID-19治療的重要靶點，超快紫外線輻射有望實現病毒失活。與單體GQs相比，高階GQs及SARS-CoV-2 RNA GQs具有獨特的界面交互作用及複雜環區結構，進一步增加了其激發態動力學的複雜性。針對此尚未探索的前沿領域，本項目擬利用尖端超快寬頻時間分辨光譜技術，建立一套全面、系統研究多種SARS-CoV-2 RNA GQs及不同拓樸構型高階GQs激發態動力學的實驗方案，並在細胞模擬等受控環境下進行研究。項目將首次實現對上述GQs激發態的實時探測與動力學追踪，獲得其激發態的指紋光譜和動力學參數，揭示調控其激發態過程及螢光特性的關鍵結構與環境因素。研究將為從分子層面解釋GQs結構與激發態動力學的關係提供直接證據。項目成果對無標記GQ探針、GQ奈米技術及SARS-CoV-2 RNA病毒紫外線失活等應用具有重要意義。

15303125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15303125.value: 遠端非活化亞甲基碳-氫鍵的區域與對映選擇性分子間醯胺化：用於調控金屬-醯胺基自由基氫原子轉移反應性的配體設計

15303125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15303125.value: Achieving site-selective intermolecular catalytic C(sp3)–H amidation reactions is critical for developing sustainable pharmaceutical and bioactive natural product synthesis. Conventionally, site-selectivity is primarily substrate-controlled based on bond dissociation energies and steric differentiation. Realizing catalyst-controlled site-selective C(sp3)–H amidation is a highly desirable goal. Notably, Dauban’s group developed the [Rh2(S-tfpttl)4] catalyst that selectively targets the nonactivated tertiary C(sp3)–H bond without affecting the benzylic ones. However, intermolecular site-selective amidation of methylene C–H bonds within an alkyl chain remains challenging. Due to similar electronic and steric properties, spatial differentiation of different methylene units is notoriously problematic. Recently, we successfully developed the Cu-catalyzed lactam synthesis via intramolecular acylnitrene transfer reactions using dioxazolones as the nitrene source. The corresponding enantioselective C(sp3)–H amidation is also successful with chiral bis(oxazoline) ligands. Combined experimental and computational studies revealed that the amidation is mediated by reactive Cu-amidyl radical complexes. With 2-bromophenanthroline as ligand, the Cu-amidyl complex would perform regioselective 1,6-hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) to form delta-lactams. Yet, with 2,9-diphenylphenanthroline ligand, the same Cu-amidyl complex reacted by regioselective 1,5- HAT to afford gamma-lactam products. Our results constitute a strong foundation for designing ligands that modulate the reactivity of metal-amidyl radical complexes toward site-selectivity control. This project aims to develop catalysts for intermolecular site-selective amidation of nonactivated beta- and gamma-methylene C(sp3)–H bonds of aliphatic carboxylic acids. We will design functionalized chelating pyridinophane ligands that effectively assemble the aliphatic carboxylic acids substrates with the metal center for regiocontrolled nitrene transfer reactions. We surmised that the metal-amidyl radical complex would react with the unactivated beta-methylene C–H bond via 1,6-HAT, en route to beta-lactam formation. We anticipate that the more challenging 1,7-HAT can become feasible through careful catalyst design. Thus, the gamma-methylene C–H bond amidation can be realized for streamlined regiocontrolled gamma-lactam synthesis. Achieving site-selective distal methylene C–H functionalization of aliphatic carboxylic acids is a long-standing challenge in organic synthesis. This project will develop powerful transition metal catalysts that enable straightforward synthetic access to valuable beta- and gamma-amino carboxylic acids from inexpensive carboxylic acid feedstocks. This research will generate fundamental knowledge to address the unmet site-selectivity challenge in methylene C–H functionalization. Through structure-activity study, we would characterize the structural landscapes for catalyst design and selectivity tuning. This knowledge would be applied to data-driven AI-assisted catalyst engineering, opening a new avenue for computer-based catalyst design. 實現位點選擇性的分子間催化C(sp3)–H酰胺化反應，對於發展可持續的藥物及生物活性天然產物合成至關重要。傳統上，位點選擇性主要依賴於底物的鍵解離能與立體差異進行控制。實現由催化劑主導的位點選擇性C(sp3)–H酰胺化是一個極具吸引力的目標。值得注意的是，Dauban團隊開發了[Rh2(S-tfpttl)4]催化劑，能選擇性地作用於非活化的三級C(sp3)–H鍵，而不影響苄基C–H鍵。然而，烷基鏈中亞甲基C–H鍵的分子間位點選擇性酰胺化仍然具有挑戰性。由於不同亞甲基單元在電子性與立體性上的相似性，空間區分這些亞甲基單元極為困難。 近期，我們成功開發了以二氧唑酮為亞硝基來源，經由分子內酰亞硝基轉移反應的銅催化內酰胺合成方法。利用手性雙(噁唑啉)配體，也實現了對映選擇性的C(sp3)–H酰胺化。綜合實驗與計算研究顯示，該酰胺化反應是由高活性的銅-酰胺基自由基錯合物介導。當以2-溴菲咯啉作為配體時，銅-酰胺基錯合物會進行區域選擇性的1,6-氫原子轉移（HAT），生成δ-內酰胺；而以2,9-二苯基菲咯啉為配體時，則同樣的銅-酰胺基錯合物會經由區域選擇性的1,5-HAT反應，產生γ-內酰胺產物。我們的結果為設計可調控金屬-酰胺基自由基錯合物反應性的配體，進而實現位點選擇性控制，奠定了堅實基礎。本計畫旨在開發用於脂肪族羧酸非活化β-與γ-亞甲基C(sp3)–H鍵分子間位點選擇性酰胺化的催化劑。我們將設計具功能化的螯合吡啶啉配體，有效將脂肪族羧酸底物與金屬中心組裝，以實現區域控制的亞硝基轉移反應。我們推測，金屬-酰胺基自由基錯合物將可經由1,6-HAT與非活化β-亞甲基C–H鍵反應，進而生成β-內酰胺。我們預期，經由精心設計催化劑，更具挑戰性的1,7-HAT亦可實現，從而達到γ-亞甲基C–H鍵的酰胺化，實現高效區域控制的γ-內酰胺合成。 實現脂肪族羧酸遠端亞甲基C–H鍵的位點選擇性官能化，是有機合成領域長期以來的挑戰。本計畫將開發高效的過渡金屬催化劑，使得由廉價羧酸原料直接合成有價值的β-與γ-氨基羧酸變得簡便可行。本研究將產生關鍵基礎知識，以解決亞甲基C–H官能化中尚未克服的位點選擇性難題。透過結構-活性關係研究，我們將描繪催化劑設計與選擇性調控的結構圖譜。這些知識將應用於數據驅動的AI輔助催化劑工程，為基於電腦的催化劑設計開闢新途徑。

15304125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15304125.value: 具有糖尿病傷口代謝調控功能的高分子納米促愈材料開發

15304125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15304125.value: Unlike normal skin wounds that typically heal spontaneously within weeks, diabetic wounds display significantly delayed or non-healing characteristics, causing patients to endure these chronic wounds for months or even years. The healing process of a typical skin wound is regulated by the body's immune system. However, diabetes often leads to metabolic disorders of arginine in wounds. As a result, the regulation of the microenvironment at the wound site is disrupted, leading to a lack of signals necessary for initiating wound closure and skin tissue regeneration. The conventional wound care process and wound dressing materials for diabetic wounds remain almost the same as normal podiatric wounds, utilizing inert materials as physical barriers to protect the wound, as well as pharmacological interventions for anti-inflammation and anti-infection. However, conventional treatments do not address the specific wound environment associated with diabetic wounds, particularly in relation to arginine metabolic disorders. Arginine metabolism represents an alternative strategy for the development of wound healing materials that can effectively regulate the wound microenvironment. As an essential amino acid, arginine can be metabolized via two pathways: 1) the nitric oxidase (NOS) pathway for the production of pro-inflammatory nitric oxide (NO) at the early stage of wound healing; and 2) the arginase pathway for cell proliferation and collagen regeneration. However, arginine metabolism in diabetic wounds exhibits chronic inflammatory characteristics, including persistently elevated arginase activity and insufficient levels of nitric oxide synthase (NOS) activity. The overexpression of arginase and the upregulation of arginase activity in diabetic wounds may persist until day 13. Imbalanced arginine metabolism is a significant marker associated with the non-healing characteristics of diabetic wounds. However, investigations into the regulation of arginine metabolism using biomaterials as a healing strategy for diabetic wounds have not been thoroughly explored. In this context, it is crucial to develop an effective therapeutic strategy to improve the response rate and expedite the healing of diabetic wounds by addressing the diabetes-specific disorder in arginine metabolism. As a continuation of previous research on pseudo-protein wound healing materials, this study aims to develop a novel pseudo-protein nano-formulation designed to enhance arginine metabolism and promote healing in diabetic wounds. The restoration of arginine metabolism balance is essential to initiate a series of reparative events for spontaneous wound healing. The proposed research aims to provide insights into the regulation of the wound microenvironment through biomaterials and to explore the translational potential of pseudo-protein nano-formulations in promoting diabetic wound healing. 不同於通常數週內可自癒的正常皮膚創傷，糖尿病傷口呈現顯著延遲或無法癒合的特徵，緻使患者承受持續數月乃至數年的慢性創傷。典型皮膚創傷的癒合進程受機體免疫繫統調控，然糖尿病常導緻傷口精氨酸代謝紊亂，進而破壞傷區微環境調節機製，造成啟動傷口閉合與皮膚組織再生所需的關鍵信號缺失。現行糖尿病傷口照護流程與敷料材質基本沿用常規創傷處理模式，採用惰性材料作為物理屏障保護創麵，輔以抗炎抗感染的藥理幹預。然傳統療法未能針對糖尿病傷口的特異性病理環境尤以精氨酸代謝紊亂為核心實施精準幹預。 精氨酸代謝調控為開發創傷癒合材料提供了新興策略。此必需氨基酸可經由雙重途徑代謝：1）創傷癒合初期通過一氧化氮合酶（NOS）途徑生成促炎性一氧化氮（NO）；2）經精氨酸酶途徑促進細胞增殖與膠原再生。然糖尿病傷口的精氨酸代謝呈現慢性炎症特徵：精氨酸酶活性持續昇高，一氧化氮合酶（NOS）活性則長期不足。糖尿病創麵中精氨酸酶的過度表達與活性上調可持續整個創麵愈合週期。此代謝失衡實為糖尿病傷口難癒特性的關鍵標誌，然利用生物材料調控精氨酸代謝作為糖尿病傷口癒合策略的研究尚未繫統性展開。 在此背景下，亟需開發針對糖尿病特異性精氨酸代謝紊亂的有效療法，以提昇應答速率並加速創麵癒合。本研究延續前期仿生蛋白創傷修復材料研究成果，旨在開發新型仿生蛋白促愈材料，專注於改善糖尿病傷口精氨酸代謝並促進組織再生。恢復精氨酸代謝平衡乃啟動自發性創傷修復級聯反應的核心關鍵。本項研究旨在揭示生物材料調控傷口微環境的作用機製，並探索仿生蛋白製劑促進糖尿病傷口癒合的轉化應用潛能。

15304825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15304825.value: 採用原位析出和離子交換方法開發質子導體陶瓷燃料電池高性能陰極材料

15304825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15304825.value: Protonic ceramic fuel cells (PCFCs) are efficient and clean power sources, but their actual performance is limited by the cathode due to the sluggish oxygen reduction reaction (ORR). In-situ exsolution of nanoparticles from the ABO3-type perovskites is effective for enhancing electrode performance, but it can cause B-site vacancies, A-site segregation, or instability of the structure in the long-term operation. Topotactic ion exchange can introduce guest species on the perovskite’s surface for exchange with the B-site cation, which may improve the electrode stability due to the B-site cation supplement. As the guest ion is exchanged (doped) to the B-site, it can affect the bulk transport properties. However, exsolution and topotactic ion exchange studies are usually conducted for the anode in a reducing environment, not cathode in an oxidizing environment. Only recently, the research team demonstrated in-situ exsolution of NiO nanoparticles from BaCo0.4Fe0.4Zr0.1Y0.1O3-δ (BCFZY) in an oxidizing environment. Moreover, no study has been conducted to evaluate the effects of topotactic ion exchange on the bulk transport properties of the cathode materials. Therefore, it’s still unknown: (1) whether other metal (i.e. Co) or alloy (i.e. CoNi) can be exsolved from the PCFC cathode in an oxidizing environment? (2) what’s the effects of topotactic ion exchange on the in-situ exsolution process of the PCFC cathode? and (3) what’s the effects of topotactic ion exchange on the bulk transport properties of the cathode? This project is purposely designed to address the above-mentioned issues by developing La0.8Sr0.2Co0.7Ni0.3O3-δ (LSCN), BaCo0.7Fe0.22Sc0.08O3−δ (BCFSc), and PrNi0.5Co0.5O3−δ (PNC)-based PCFC cathode materials by in-situ exsolution and topotactic ion exchange. LSCN, BCFSc, and PNC are selected due to their excellent activity towards ORR. Fe (with 5 different amounts) will be used as the guest species on the perovskite surface for ion exchange with Co or Co/Ni. 18 new materials will be synthesized, characterized, tested, and theoretically studied by density functional theory (DFT). Multiphysics model will be developed for simulating and optimizing the PCFC with the newly developed cathode materials. In this project, new materials will be developed and new knowledge on the in-situ exsolution and the topotactic ion exchange process in PCFC cathodes will be generated. If successfully implemented, the project will make a significant contribution to the development of efficient and durable PCFC for clean power generation, which will help HK achieve the carbon neutrality goal.

15305325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305325.value: 相场铁磁流体动力学模型中变化物理参数的二阶解耦无条件稳定数值方法的数学研究

15305325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305325.value: Ferromagnetic fluids have the characteristics of both liquid flow and solid magnetism, and can be controlled by applying a magnetic field. Hence the ferrohydrodynamics (FHD) has a wide range of applications in micro and nano-technologies, fluid transport and control, sorting of biological cells, etc. One fundamental problem for this kind of two-phase FHD problems is the interfacial dynamics between two incompressible flows with different physical properties. In this project, we consider a phase field FHD model with varying density, viscosity, and magnetic susceptibility, for the two-phase ferrofluid flows. The model nonlinearly couples Cahn-Hilliard equation (free interface), Navier-Stokes equation (hydrodynamics), and a magnetic potential equation arising from the magnetostatic Maxwell equation (magnetic field). To efficiently and accurately solve the coupled nonlinear system, we need to develop a temporal discretization scheme which is unconditionally stable, linearized, and satisfying a discrete energy law.
