This is by no means an easy task as we have to conquer a few significant challenges including: (i) the coupling of the velocity and pressure through the incompressibility constraint; (ii) the stiffness of the phase equation associated with the interfacial width; (iii) the costly solver that involves varying density, viscosity, and magnetic susceptibility; (iv) the coupling of the phase field variables, flow field variables, and magnetic field variables through nonlinear convection, stresses, and varying density/viscosity/magnetic susceptibility. The key idea is based on the recently proposed zero-energy-contribution (ZEC) method to first identify the nonlinear terms which lead to zero total energy, and then utilize them to construct a new auxiliary variable. This auxiliary variable plays a key role in rewriting the original model into a new format for which it is much easier to design a decoupled, linearized, and unconditionally stable method. Significant analysis difficulties and technical issues arise from the strong coupling, nonlinearity, stiffness, the varying density of the fluid, the varying hydrodynamic viscosity, and the varying magnetic susceptibility. In order to prove the wellposedness of the phase field FHD model directly based on the weak formulation, we plan to utilize the framework of a branch of non-singular solutions to deal with the difficulty arising from the nonlinearity of the system. After establishing the basic energy law of the target model, we can mimic the basic energy law for the discrete energy law of the proposed decoupled finite element method. Both of the semi-discretization errors and the full-discretization errors will be analyzed. 铁磁流体兼具液态流体和固体磁性的特性，且可通过施加外部磁场控制。因此铁磁流体动力学（FHD）在微纳技术、流体输运控制、生物细胞分选等领域具有广泛应用。此类两相铁磁流体问题的一个基本问题是具有不同物理性质的两种不可压缩流体间的界面动态变化。在本项目中，我们考虑针对密度、黏度和磁化率变化的两相铁磁流体的相场FHD模型。该模型用非线性方式耦合了Cahn-Hilliard方程（自由界面）、Navier-Stokes方程（流体动力学）以及由静磁Maxwell方程导出的磁势方程（磁场）。 为高效精确求解此耦合非线性系统，我们需要开发无条件稳定、线性化且满足离散能量定律的时间离散格式。这绝非易事，我们必须克服若干重大挑战。其中包括：（i）速度与压力通过不可压缩约束的耦合；（ii）相场方程中界面宽度相关的刚度；（iii）涉及变化密度、黏度和磁化率的高成本求解器；（iv）相场变量、流场变量和磁场变量通过非线性对流、应力及变化密度/黏度/磁化率的耦合。关键思想基于最近提出的零能量贡献（ZEC）方法：首先识别导致总能量为零的非线性项，然后利用它们构造新辅助变量。该辅助变量在将原始模型重写为新形式时起关键作用，从而更易设计解耦、线性化且无条件稳定的方法。 强耦合、非线性、刚度、流体密度变化、流体动力粘度变化以及磁化率变化带来了重大的分析困难和技术问题。为了直接基于弱公式证明相场FHD模型的适定性，我们计划利用非奇异解分支的框架来处理系统非线性带来的困难。在建立目标模型的基本能量定律后，我们可以将其模拟为所提出的解耦有限元方法的离散能量定律。我们将分析半离散化误差和全离散化误差。

15305525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305525.value: 具有光致發光特性的鑭系摻雜氧化鉿鐵電薄膜的生長與表徵

15305525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305525.value: Ferroelectric doped hafnium oxide thin films have garnered significant research interest due to their unique nanoscale ferroelectricity and high compatibility to the current CMOS technology. Despite these merits, some persistent challenges hinder the practical deployments of ferroelectric hafnium oxide such as electrical wake-up effect and limited endurance to polarization switching. It is known that the emergent ferroelectricity in hafnium oxide originates from a metastable orthorhombic phase, which crucially requires dopants (e.g., Si, Zr and Y) for an effective stabilization. Noticeably, lanthanide dopants have been proven beneficial for greatly improving electrical properties in various classes of functional materials. However, their incorporation into the hafnium oxide remains a largely untapped area to explore its ferroelectricity and other properties. Therefore, it is intriguing to know whether lanthanide dopants with unique characteristics can be applied into hafnium oxide to stabilize ferroelectric phase and address the aforementioned challenges. Furthermore, it offers an opportunity to explore more functions of the novel material system via lanthanide doping. In this proposal, some lanthanides (e.g., Er and Eu)-doped hafnium oxide (HLnO) thin films will be designed and grown by thin-film deposition techniques such as pulsed laser deposition (PLD). The goal of this project is to investigate the resultant ferroelectricity of HLnO thin films, which is expected to be comparable or even outperforming the existing doped hafnium oxide systems. In addition, thanks to the optically active transitions of the intentionally selected lanthanide dopants in this project, HLnO can simultaneously show attractive up- and down-conversion photoluminescence phenomenon, which has not been observed in ferroelectric hafnium oxide previously. In order to achieve the goals, we will establish a comprehensive understanding on the thin-film deposition processes, resultant structural properties, and their relationships with the electrical and optical properties characterized by various techniques. We will study on the interplay between ferroelectricity and photoluminescence tuning in hafnium oxide thin films for the first time. The proposed study will build on the PI’s extensive expertise in ultra-thin ferroelectrics and recent success of ferroelectric Er(III)-ion-doped hafnium oxide grown by PLD. The physical mechanism behind the observations will be comprehensively investigated by combining experimental results and theoretical simulations. It is expected that the introduction of lanthanide dopant can not only provide a compelling solution for enhancing the ferroelectric performance of the hafnium oxide thin films, but also broaden the horizon for ferroelectric hafnium oxide research towards multifunctional device applications.

15305625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305625.value: 二維高介電常數介電材料場效電晶體研究

15305625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305625.value: As device dimensions continue to shrink, the effective electrostatic control of semiconducting channels has become a grand challenge. To maintain the effective control of nanoscale transistors, it demands the concurrent downward scaling of both channel thickness and dielectric thickness. Recent studies on ultrathin two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors have shown their great potential for short-channel devices. However, the systematic studies on ultrathin 2D dielectrics is still relatively scare. Conventional dielectrics face challenges related to leakage currents and reduced capacitance when their thicknesses scale down. The dangling-bond-free and atomically flat surfaces of van der Waals (vdW) dielectrics are highly suitable for applications in 2D electronics. The dielectric constant of the widely used vdW dielectric material is h-BN, which has a large Eg (≈ 6.0 eV) but a dielectric constant of less than 5.5; whereas Bi2GeO5 has a relatively high κ (≈ 40) but a smaller Eg (≈ 3.3 eV). The search for 2D vdW insulator with higher dielectric constants is of high importance for enabling continued scaling and performance enhancements of 2D electronic devices. There is still no ideal dielectric material with wide bandgap and large dielectric constant. In this proposed research project, we aim to study the fabrication and characterization of 2D high-k dielectrics for electron devices. (1) Ferroelectric materials typically exhibit high dielectric constants due to their inherent property of high ion displacement polarization. However, the Tc of most ferroelectric materials is usually above room temperature. By reducing Tc to near room temperature, the dielectric constant of these materials can be greatly amplified, following the Curie-Weiss law. (2) For most dielectrics, there is an inverse correlation between the dielectric constant and band gap. The trade-off between dielectric constant and band gap significantly undermines the universality of the dielectrics when integrated into miniaturized 2D devices. We will investigate ionic dielectrics with high dielectric constant and large band gap. (3) We will integrate these 2D high-k dielectrics with 2D semiconductors for high-performance transistors. High-performance logic circuits can be constructed by rationally integrating high-k-gated n-type MoS2 and p-type WSe2 FETs. The anticipated outcomes of this research include the identification of optimal 2D high-k materials for use in semiconductor devices, the development of innovative fabrication methods, and a deeper understanding of the underlying mechanisms governing dielectric behavior at the nanoscale. Ultimately, this investigation aims to pave the way for the next generation of high-performance electron devices. 隨著元件尺寸持續微縮，半導體通道的有效靜電控制已成為重大挑戰。為維持奈米級電晶體的有效调控，必須同步縮減通道厚度與介電層厚度。近期關於超薄二維（2D）半導體的研究顯示其在短通道元件中的巨大潛力，然而針對超薄二維介電材料的系統性研究仍相對匱乏。傳統介電材料在厚度微縮時面臨漏電流增加與電容下降等問題。 van der Waals (vdW)介電材料具有無懸鍵且原子級平坦的表面特性，極適合應用於二維電子元件。目前廣泛使用的vdW介電材料h-BN雖具高能隙（≈ 6.0 eV），但其介電常數僅有5.5以下；而Bi₂GeO₅雖具較高介電常數（κ ≈ 40），能隙卻較小（≈ 3.3 eV）。尋找更高介電常數的二維vdW絕緣體，對於持續推進二維電子元件微縮與性能提升至關重要。目前仍缺乏兼具寬能隙與高介電常數的理想介電材料。 本研究計畫旨在探討二維高介電常數材料於電子元件的製備與特性：（1）鐵電材料因高離子位移極化特性通常展現高介電常數，但多數鐵電材料的居禮溫度（Tc）高於室溫。透過將Tc調降至接近室溫，可依據居禮-外斯定律大幅提升其介電常數。（2）多數介電材料的介電常數與能隙呈反比關係，此權衡效應嚴重限制介電材料在微型化二維元件中的通用性。我們將研究兼具高介電常數與大能隙的離子性介電材料。（3）我們將整合這些二維高κ介電層與二維半導體以構建高效能電晶體，透過合理設計高κ閘極控制的n型MoS₂與p型WSe₂場效電晶體，實現高性能邏輯電路。 本研究預期成果包括：確立適用於半導體元件的最佳二維高κ材料、開發創新製程方法，以及深化對奈米尺度介電行為機制的理解。最終，此研究將為新一代高效能電子元件開拓發展路徑。

15305725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305725.value: 杂化钙钛矿铁电畴的平面手性现象

15305725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305725.value: Abstract Planar chirality has gained significant interest for its applications in chiral photonics and quantum communication, as it arises from ordered arrangements that break mirror symmetry rather than inherent molecular chirality. Chiral organic-inorganic hybrid perovskites provide a promising platform for developing non-linear chiro-optical applications and chiral-induced spin selectivity. Departing from the common approach of introducing chirality via chiral organic ligands, this proposal aims to verify for the first time that achiral hybrid perovskites with highly ordered ferroelectric domains can behave as chiral metasurfaces that can modify the propagation of light and changes its phase and amplitude. We will address the challenge of achieving electrical control over HOIP chiral metasurfaces to enhance optical device functionalities and system performance. Using spatially resolved optical spectroscopy techniques, we will examine if the domains exhibit alternatingly switchable planar chirality with strong second harmonic generation-circular dichroism (SHG-CD). Key scientific questions include growing crystals with specific domain alignments for optimal SHG-CD responses, demonstrating electrical control over SHG-CD, comparing responses at domain walls versus domains, and unveiling the atomic structure of ferroelectric domains. To uncover the origins of planar chirality in these domains, we will employ a QPlus AFM & scanning tunneling microscope (STM) to investigate various ferroelectric domains and domain walls in hybrid perovskites, revealing distinct arrangements of atomic rows that indicate planar symmetry breaking. 手性是一个材料的结构所具有的几何特性，即该结构无法与其镜像结构重合，这与左手和右手的区别类似。分子手性源于其原子环境的不对称性，而“平面手性”则可能源于那些并非原本就具有手性的结构元素，但通过其有序排列打破了镜像对称性而变得具有手性。 手性有机-无机杂化钙钛矿为开发非线性手性光学应用和手性诱导的自旋选择性提供了一个有前景的平台。与通过手性有机配体引入手性的常见方法不同，该提案旨在首次验证具有高度有序铁电畴的非手性杂化钙钛矿能够表现出交替可切换的平面手性，并具有强的二次谐波圆偏振光（SHG-CD）特性。为了揭示这些铁电畴中平面手性的起源，我们将使用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）来研究杂化钙钛矿中的各种铁电畴和畴壁，揭示原子的不同排列，这些排列表明平面对称性被打破了。此外，铁电材料固有的不对称性缺失可能会导致这些区域出现Rashba自旋分裂。我们将进行空间分辨的双光子光致发光测试，以确定铁电畴中的Rashba劈裂能。此外，还将进行密度泛函理论计算，以了解铁电畴的电子特性。铁电杂化钙钛矿铁电畴中的相关手性和自旋性质的发现，对于畴或畴壁逻辑器件的发展具有巨大的潜力。

15305925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305925.value: 建立一種化學蛋白基因組學方法用於從微蛋白中發現新激酶

15305925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305925.value: Noncanonical microproteins are translated from genomic sequences that have been annotated as noncoding to date. These novel translating genomic sequences, termed small open reading frames (sORFs), may originate from long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs), untranslated regions (UTRs), and intergenic frameshifts. Although sporadic reports have demonstrated that novel microproteins play significant roles in various physiological and pathological processes, their functions appear diverse and unrelated. Furthermore, there is a notable lack of systematic studies capable of classifying multiple microproteins into specific families due to the absence of effective approaches. We propose integrating a chemical proteomics approach, specifically activity-based proteome profiling (ABPP), with proteogenomics to identify novel protein kinases from the non-coding regions of the human genome. We intend to employ chemical probes that target kinase activity domains to enrich endogenous kinases from the entire proteome. Subsequently, we will search for unknown kinases encoded by sORFs using established proteogenomic methods. As a proof-of-concept, we analyzed public datasets and identified a novel kinase, SEP119. SEP119 contains a conserved ATP-binding domain and unique N-terminal nuclear localization signal, resulting in prominent condensation in the nucleolus. In vitro kinase assays demonstrated that SEP119 catalyzed the phosphorylation of protein substrates. In this project, we aim to investigate SEP119 and other novel microproteins with kinase activity. First, large-scale chemical proteomics experiments will be conducted using the broad-spectrum kinase probe XO44 to enrich kinases from multiple cell lines, followed by extensive fractionation and deep mass spectrometry (MS) analysis. Next, through proteogenomic searches, we will identify potential novel kinases and evaluate their translation, kinase activity, and clinical relevance. We will comprehensively study the functions and interacting partners of these novel kinases using cell-based phenotypic assays, phosphoproteomics, and affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS). Additionally, we will elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which micropeptides exert their functions, with a particular focus on SEP119. This multidisciplinary project will employ chemical biology, mass spectrometry, genomics, and bioinformatic methodologies. The project aims not only to discover novel protein kinases or kinase isoforms but also to develop valuable strategies for the broader research community interested in new microproteins with enzymatic activities. 非規範微蛋白是由迄今被註釋為非編碼的基因組序列翻譯而來的。這些新發現的翻譯基因組序列，被稱為小型開放閱讀框（sORFs），可能源自長鏈非編碼RNA（lncRNAs）、未翻譯區（UTRs）以及基因間移碼。儘管零星的報告已證明新型微蛋白在各種生理和病理過程中扮演重要角色，但其功能看似多樣且無關聯。此外，由於缺乏有效的方法，顯著缺少能將多種微蛋白分類到特定家族的系統性研究。 我們提議整合化學蛋白質組學方法，特別是基於活性的蛋白質組分析（ABPP），與蛋白質基因組學相結合，以識別來自人類基因組非編碼區域的新型蛋白激酶。我們計劃使用針對激酶活性結構域的化學探針，從整個蛋白質組中富集內源性激酶。隨後，我們將利用已建立的蛋白質基因組學方法，搜索由sORFs編碼的未知激酶。作為概念驗證，我們分析了公開數據集，並識別出一種新型激酶SEP119。SEP119含有一個保守的ATP結合結構域以及獨特的N端核定位信號，導致其在核仁中顯著凝聚。體外激酶試驗顯示，SEP119能夠催化蛋白質底物的磷酸化。 在此項目中，我們旨在研究SEP119及其他具有激酶活性新型微蛋白。首先，將使用廣譜激酶探針XO44進行大規模化學蛋白質組學實驗，從多個細胞系中富集激酶，隨後進行廣泛的分離和深度質譜（MS）分析。接下來，通過蛋白質基因組學搜索，我們將識別潛在的新型激酶，並評估其翻譯、激酶活性及臨床相關性。我們將利用基於細胞的表型試驗、磷酸化蛋白質組學及親和純化-質譜（AP-MS）全面研究這些新型激酶的功能和相互作用夥伴。此外，我們將闡明微肽發揮功能的分子機制，特別關注SEP119。此跨學科項目將採用化學生物學、質譜、基因組學及生物信息學方法。 此項目不僅旨在發現新型蛋白激酶或激酶同工酶，還希望為對具有酶活性新微蛋白感興趣的更廣泛研究社群開發有價值的策略。

15306125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306125.value: 一種用於求解退化非光滑方程的超線性收斂算法及其在複合優化問題等領域的應用

15306125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306125.value: This research project focuses on addressing the challenges of solving large-scale nonsmooth equations (NEs), which provides a unified framework for investigating optimization problems, variational inequalities, and complementarity problems. These models have broad applications in fields such as artificial intelligence, data science, economics, game theory, and so on. A significant hurdle is efficiently solving NEs and obtaining a high-quality solution with desirable properties, especially when the NEs are degenerate with non-isolated solutions. This project aims to overcome the challenge by developing a novel modified nonsmooth Levenberg-Marquardt Newton (mNLMN) algorithm with a local superlinear convergence guarantee for solving strongly semismooth degenerate NEs under practical conditions, where the restrictive ``uniform semismoothness'' condition over the solution set is not required. More specifically, the mNLMN algorithm iteratively updates the current solution by solving at most k+1 linear systems, where k is the rank of the kernel space of the (arbitrarily) selected element in the generalized Jacobian of the NE at the current point. Preliminary results provided in this proposal indicate promising local superlinear convergence of the mNLMN algorithm for solving degenerate NEs. Supported by the inspiring numerical evidence, we will extensively investigate the properties of the kernel spaces of the generalized Jacobians of the sequences generated by the mNLMN algorithm to establish the local superlinear convergence rate. We will develop an efficient hybrid algorithm to globalize the mNLMN algorithm for solving NEs, utilizing the fully parallelizable Halpern accelerating algorithm. We will carefully design the "switching conditions" for the hybrid algorithm to guarantee the efficiency of the hybrid algorithm and investigate its iteration complexity. To overcome the computational challenges in solving the involved linear systems in the mNLMN algorithm, we will develop a novel dimension reduction technique, called feasible adaptive sieving, which can fully exploit the intrinsic sparsity of the solution to reduce the dimension of the structured NEs. Based on the efficient algorithms designed in this research project, we will develop an efficient and robust solver in C++ with GPU acceleration. The outcomes of this research project will significantly advance the theoretical understanding and numerical computation of solving degenerate NEs, thereby contributing to the applications of NEs in contemporary data-driven fields. 這個研究項目聚焦於解決求解大規模非光滑方程所面臨的挑戰，這類方程為優化問題、變分不等式及互補問題的研究提供了一個統一的框架。這些問題包含的模型在人工智能、數據科學、經濟學、博弈論等領域具有廣泛的應用。當前，我們面臨的一大難題是如何高效地求解非光滑方程並獲得具有理想性質的高精度解，特別是在所求解的非光滑方程為退化且解非孤立的情況下。本項目旨在通過開發一種新穎的非光滑Levenberg-Marquardt Newton（mNLMN）算法來克服這一挑戰。該算法可對具有強半光滑性的（退化）非光滑方程進行求解並在更實際條件下具有局部超線性收斂速度保證。更具體地說，mNLMN算法通過每次最多求解k+1個線性系統來迭代更新當前解，其中k為非光滑方程在當前點的廣義雅可比算子集合中（任意選取的）元素的核空間秩。初步數值結果顯示，mNLMN算法在求解退化非光滑方程時展現出局部超線性收斂性。我們將深入研究mNLMN算法所產生的點列的廣義雅可比算子集合中元素的核空間的性質，以建立其局部超線性收斂理論。我們還將結合可高度並行化的Halpern加速算法和mNLMN算法開發一種混合算法，用於全局求解（退化的）非光滑方程。我們將精心設計混合算法的“切換條件”，以保證其效率，並研究其迭代複雜度。為了解決mNLMN算法中所涉及線性系統的求解挑戰，我們將開發一種新穎的降維技術，稱為可行自適應篩選法，該方法能充分利用解的內在稀疏性，從而降低結構化非光滑方程的維度。基於本研究項目設計的高效算法，我們將開發一個高效且穩健的C++求解器，並利用GPU加速。本研究項目的成果將推進退化非光滑方程求解的理論與數值計算，從而促進非光滑方程在當代數據驅動應用領域中的落地。

15306425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306425.value: 機器學習加速原子催化劑设计以克服二氧化碳還原生成 C3 產品挑戰

15306425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306425.value: Electrochemical CO2 reduction reaction (CO2RR) is a promising technology to effectively convert CO2 into different value-added liquid fuels, which not only benefits carbon emission reductions and carbon neutrality. However, the production of C3 products by CO2RR is still challenging due to the low conversion efficiency and selectivity due to high barriers and complicated mechanisms. Although many electrocatalysts can convert CO2 into C1 or C2 products, their applications for C3 products (e.g. acetone, propanol) are still very limited. As an alternative solution, the development of atomic catalysts (ACs) supported by stable and robust carbon materials such as graphdiyne (GDY) and phthalocyanine (Pc) becomes attractive to overcome the current challenges of C3 product formation, which supplies tunable electronic structures by flexible compositions, efficient electron transfer by intrinsic high conductivity, and robust stability under different electrocatalysis environments. Therefore, based on these research motivations and foundations, we propose a theoretical exploration-guided strategy to accelerate the development of ACs and overcome the challenges in CO2RR for realizing efficient C3 product generation. In this project, we will focus on three key research questions by the first-principles machine learning (FPML) method including: (1) Investigate reaction mechanisms of C3 product formation in electrocatalytic CO2RR; (2) Identify the suitable pairing of metals and carbon supports for C3 products.; and (3) Establish fast screening of ACs for C3 product generation by integrated FPML. For C3 product formation mechanisms, we will build over 40,000 AC models including single atomic catalysts (SACs) and dual atomic catalysts (DACs) on GDY and Pc with all metals in the periodic table. The electronic modulations induced by multi active sites in ACs will be compared regarding the electronic structures and stability. The synergistic effect induced by different metal/metal and metal-support interactions will be investigated to reveal the influences on C-C-C coupling mechanisms. By parameterizing all the calculation data of this project and previous research, we will construct a large dataset to apply the FPML method to effectively screen and identify novel and robust ACs with efficient generation of C3 products. The research output will significantly strengthen the understanding of electrochemical CO2RR and supply guidance to the experiments to develop novel ACs for C3 product generation and offer new opportunities for broad industrial applications. This research offers potential collaborations with frontier experiment groups in the future to achieve material advances, which accelerate technological developments and promote carbon neutrality in Hong Kong with long-term impacts. 電化學二氧化碳還原反應 (CO2RR) 是一種很有前景的技術，可以有效地將二氧化碳轉化為不同的加值液體燃料，不僅有利於減少碳排放和實現碳中和。然而，由於高障礙和複雜機制導致轉化效率和選擇性較低，透過 CO2RR 生產 C3 產品仍然具有挑戰性。雖然許多電催化劑可以將二氧化碳轉化為 C1 或 C2 產品，但它們對C3產品（例如丙酮、丙醇）的應用仍然非常有限。作為一種替代方案，開發由穩定而堅固的碳材料（例如石墨炔 (GDY) 和酞菁 (Pc)）支撐的原子催化劑 (AC) 變得很有吸引力，可以克服當前 C3 產品形成的挑戰，透過靈活的組合可以提供可調的電子結構，基于固有的高電導性可以提供高效的電子轉移，並在保持不同的電催化環境下保持穩定性。因此，基於這些研究動機和基礎，我們提出了一種以理論探索為導向的策略，以加速活性碳的開發，並克服CO2RR中實現高效C3產物生成的挑戰。 在本計畫中，我們將利用第一原理機器學習（FPML）方法來研究三個關鍵問題，包括：（1）研究電催化CO2RR中C3產物產生的反應機制；（2）確定C3產物的金屬和碳載體的合適搭配；（3）透過整合FPML建立用於產生C3產物的活性碳的快速篩選方法。對於C3產物生成機制，我們將在GDY和Pc上建構超過40,000個活性碳模型，包括包含元素週期表所有金屬的單原子催化劑（SAC）和雙原子催化劑（DAC）。我們將比較活性碳中多活性位點引起的電子結構和穩定性的電子調製，我們將研究不同金屬/金屬以及金屬-載體交互作用所引起的協同效應，以揭示其對C-C-C偶聯機制的影響。透過參數化前期研究的所有計算數據，我們將建構一個大型數據集，應用FPML方法有效地篩選和識別能夠高效生成C3產物的新型原子催化劑。 本研究成果將顯著加深對電化學CO2RR的理解，並為開髮用於生成C3產物的新型活性碳的實驗提供指導，並為廣泛的工業應用提供新的機會。本研究為未來與前沿實驗團隊合作提供了潛在的機會，以推動材料領域的進步，從而加速技術發展，並促進香港實現碳中和，並產生長遠影響。

15306525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306525.value: 时间分数阶演化模型反问题的数值分析

15306525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306525.value: Time-fractional evolution models have gained significant attention for their excellent ability to describe anomalous diffusion processes. These models have a wide range of applications, including protein diffusion in cells, contaminant transport in groundwater, subsurface flows, and thermal diffusion in fractal media. The fractional derivatives in these models significantly alter diffusive dynamics and impact solution theory. Additionally, the nonlocal nature of fractional derivatives makes many traditional PDE and numerical analysis tools inapplicable, posing challenges in both mathematical and numerical analysis. While numerical analysis for direct problems has been extensively studied over the past two decades, the inverse problems remain underexplored, particularly in designing discrete numerical schemes with provable error bounds. This project aims to investigate several nonlinear inverse problems for time-fractional evolution models. We will propose efficient numerical reconstruction schemes with provable error analysis, focusing on suitable conditional stability and integrating advancements in numerical analysis for direct problems. This project consists of three parts. First, we plan to develop and analyze numerical schemes for recovering the initial condition in nonlinear time-fractional evolution models from terminal observations. The approach used for linear models, which relies on directly inverting the linear solution operator, is not applicable to nonlinear models, creating a significant gap. We will propose a novel stability analysis using a fixed-point argument. By combining this with refined numerical analysis for the direct problem, we will develop an iterative solver for the fully discrete scheme and derive an a priori error bound for the discrete reconstruction. Second, we will explore the simultaneous recovery of both initial data and potential in the time-fractional evolution model using terminal observations at two different time levels. This problem is challenging because the coefficients-to-state map is more complex than for a single coefficient, and the decoupling method is unclear. Our investigation will address critical aspects of numerical treatment and analysis, including exploring conditional stability, designing a discrete reconstruction scheme with a provable error estimate, and developing an efficient solver. Finally, we will discuss the numerical recovery of point sources in the time-fractional evolution model from boundary measurements. This problem has important applications, such as locating pollutant sources when internal measurements are not possible. The numerical analysis is technically demanding, even for the direct problem, due to the weak nature of the problem data. To overcome this difficulty, we will apply a splitting strategy along with suitable conditional stability to achieve a highly accurate numerical reconstruction. 时间分数阶演化模型因其能够描述异常扩散过程而备受关注。这些模型在多个领域具有广泛的应用，例如细胞内蛋白质扩散、地下水中的污染物迁移、地下流动以及分形介质中的热扩散。然而，分数阶导数的非局部特性使得许多传统数学工具难以适用，从而为理论研究和数值分析带来了重大挑战。本项目旨在针对时间分数阶演化模型中的若干非线性反问题，设计具有可证明误差界的离散数值方法。我们计划提出高效的数值重建方法，并提供严格的误差分析，重点关注适当的条件稳定性，同时结合正问题数值分析的最新理论成果。 本项目由以下三个部分组成：首先，我们将开发并分析数值方案，从终端观测数据中恢复非线性时间分数阶演化模型的初始条件。与线性模型不同，线性模型可以通过直接反演解算子来解决问题，而非线性模型缺乏这种直接方法，从而带来了显著的困难。其次，我们将研究如何利用两个不同时间点的终端观测数据，同时恢复模型的初始条件和势函数。由于系数到状态的映射比单一系数的情况更为复杂，且缺乏明确的解耦方法，这一问题极具挑战性。我们的研究将重点解决数值处理和分析中的核心问题，包括确保条件稳定性、设计高效的迭代算法，以及开发具有可证明误差估计的离散数值方案。最后，我们将研究如何通过边界测量数据恢复时间分数阶演化模型中的点源问题。该问题在实际应用中具有重要意义，例如在无法获取区域内部数据时用于定位污染源。然而，由于问题数据的正则性较弱，即使是正问题的数值分析也充满技术挑战。为了解决这一难题，我们将采用分裂策略，并结合适当的条件稳定性，最终实现高精度的数值重建。

15306925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306925.value: 使用低劑量冷凍四維掃描透射電子顯微鏡探究高分子球晶的多層次結構

15306925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306925.value: As the foundation of plastics and fiber industry, semicrystalline polymers possess unique structures involving repeated chain folding to form lamellar crystals, which can be further organized into higher-order structures such as spherulites. Despite the wide presence of spherulite structures in polymers, it remains a grand challenge to probe such hierarchical structures at multiscale. The current spherulite structure models are largely based on indirect derivation from observations on relatively coarse scale, leaving ambiguities and uncertainties on structure details, especially at nanoscale. Recently four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) has emerged as a promising technique to unveil manifold structure information of organic materials down to nanoscale. Nevertheless, application of 4D-STEM on polymers is still limited to several pioneering studies, and its potential on characterizing the complex hierarchical structures in polymer spherulites is yet to be assessed. The objective of this project is to establish the optimized low-dose cryo-4D-STEM, and to demonstrate its characterization capability on hierarchical polymer spherulites. The technique will be developed based on the cutting-edge aberration-corrected Spectra300 STEM, which is equipped with i) direct-electron detectors with ultrahigh sensitivity and ultrafast acquisition to enable low-dose 4D-STEM, ii) the liquid-nitrogen-cooling holder to provide cryo-protection on susceptible polymer materials, and iii) the small beam-forming aperture to generate a nanometer-sized probe with sharp electron diffraction. Such optimized low-dose cryo-4D-STEM can probe nanoscale structures to achieve previously inaccessible information in spherulites. As a preliminary test, we have applied low-dose cryo-4D-STEM onto poly(ε-caprolactone) (PCL) spherulites to map the distribution of lamellae orientation, which successfully reveals the overall circular symmetry consisting of two major zone-axis orientations without noticeable beam effect. Next, by adding cryo-protection from the liquid-nitrogen-cooling holder, the sample dose limit will be increased, enabling low-dose cryo-4D-STEM with nanometer resolution. With such a powerful tool, we will further 1) probe various nanoscale structures especially at spherulite boundaries and interfaces between different zone axes, 2) resolve individual lamellae at edge-on orientation, and even measure the molecular chain tilt within the lamellae, 3) and map the local crystallinity from spherulite centers to boundaries. Combined with the large-scale orientation mapping, we will obtain a comprehensive picture of PCL’s hierarchical structure. Similar analyses will be extended to other polymers such as polyethylene banded spherulites to interrogate the intriguing structure of twisted lamellae. The achieved exclusive information will be correlated with property measurements, which will significantly advance the understanding of polymer spherulite structures and the underpinned functionalities. 作為塑膠與纖維工業的基礎，半結晶性高分子具有獨特的結構，其分子鏈反覆摺疊形成片狀晶體（片晶），這些片晶進一步組織成更高階的結構，如球晶。儘管球晶結構在高分子材料中廣泛存在，但在多尺度下探測這類多層次結構仍是一項挑戰。目前的球晶結構模型大多基於對較大尺度觀察的間接推導，對於結構細節，特別是在奈米尺度上，仍存在模糊與不確定性。近年來，四維掃描透射電子顯微鏡（4D-STEM）作為一項有前景的技術，已經能揭示有機材料在奈米尺度下的多種結構信息。然而，4D-STEM在高分子材料上的應用仍僅限於少數先驅性研究，其在解析高分子球晶的複雜多層次結構上的潛力尚待評估。 本項目的目標是建立優化的低劑量冷凍4D-STEM技術，並展示其表徵高分子球晶多層次結構的能力。該技術將基於最先進的像差校正Spectra300 STEM開發。該儀器配備有：一、具備超高靈敏度與超高讀取速度的直接電子偵測器，可實現低劑量4D-STEM；二、液態氮冷卻樣品台，為脆弱的高分子材料提供冷凍保護；三、小型成束光圈，可生成奈米級電子束並獲得清晰的電子衍射圖。這樣優化的低劑量冷凍4D-STEM能夠探測奈米尺度結構，獲取以往無法取得的球晶結構信息。 作為初步測試，我們已將低劑量冷凍4D-STEM應用於聚己內酯（poly(ε caprolactone), PCL）球晶，獲得片晶取向分布圖，成功揭示了由兩個主要晶帶軸取向組成的球形對稱結構，且未見明顯的電子束損傷。接下來，藉由液態氮冷卻台提供的冷凍保護，樣品的劑量上限將進一步提升，從而實現具奈米解析度的低劑量冷凍4D-STEM。利用這一強大工具，我們將進一步：一、探測各種奈米結構，特別是球晶邊界及不同晶帶軸間的界面；二、解析豎直取向的單層片晶，甚至測量片晶內分子鏈的傾斜角度；三、繪製從球晶中心到邊緣的局部結晶度分布。結合大尺度的晶體取向分佈，我們將獲得PCL球晶多層次結構的全貌。類似的分析也將擴展至其他高分子材料，如聚乙烯帶狀球晶，以探究片晶扭曲的奇特結構。所獲得的獨有信息將與性能測試結果相關聯，將大幅推進對高分子球晶結構及其功能性的理解。

15307025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15307025.value: 二氧化碳电还原耦合阳极析氢降低全电池电压研究

15307025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15307025.value: Electrocatalytic CO2 reduction (ECO2R) to high-value chemicals and feedstocks (such as CH4, CH3OH, and C2H4) using renewable energy sources is recognized as a promising technology for reducing CO2 emissions and utilizing CO2 effectively. Over the past decade, significant advancements have been made in designing high-performance catalysts to improve product selectivity and yield. For instance, the selectivity (Faradaic efficiency: FE) of C2H4 has increased from approximately 20% to 80%, and its partial current density (yield) has reached the A/cm2 level. However, the reaction overpotential remains a challenge, affecting the overall energy efficiency of the reaction. In the industry-preferred membrane-electrode-assembly (MEA) cell, the operating cell voltage for ECO2R typically exceeds 3.2 V, often reaching over 4 V. This is above the US Department of Energy (DOE) standard of 3 V for the industrialization of ECO2R technology, leading to low and economically unviable energy efficiency. To address this issue, replacing the paired anodic oxygen evolution reaction (OER), which has a high theoretical potential of up to 1.23 V (vs. RHE) and limited economic value, with an oxidation reaction with a lower theoretical potential is necessary. Furfural oxidation is gaining attention due to its low anodic half-cell potential (0.05 V vs. RHE) and the high added value of its oxidation product, furoic acid (FA). This oxidation reaction can facilitate the release of H2 at the anode (anodic hydrogen evolution reaction: A-HER). A-HER is not limited to furfural; non-enolizable aldehydes such as 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) can also be used. Importantly, A-HER of furfural/HMF can produce high-value products like FA and 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid (FDCA), which the US DOE identifies as promising high-value-added chemicals and platform chemicals. The Principal Investigator’s team has developed a stable and durable pure-H2O-fed MEA ECO2R-to-C2H4 system, setting a new stability record for ECO2R-to-C2H4 (>1000 h). However, the operating cell voltage exceeds 4.2 V, resulting in low energy efficiency (~18%). Therefore, we propose exploring A-HER as the paired oxidation reaction for ECO2R in our stable and durable MEA system to reduce the operating cell voltage and enhance the economic value of the products. We anticipate that coupling ECO2R-to-C2H4 with A-HER can achieve ultra-low cell voltage (< 3 V) while maintaining high C2H4 selectivity and yield. This proposal aims to provide experimental and theoretical foundations for ECO2R technology, promote its industrial deployment, and accelerate progress toward a sustainable energy system. 電催化二氧化碳還原（ECO2R）利用可再生能源將二氧化碳轉化為高價值化學品和原料（如甲烷、甲醇和乙烯）被認為是一項有前景的減碳及有效利用二氧化碳的技術。在過去十年中，設計高性能催化劑以提升產物選擇性和產率方面取得了顯著進展。例如，乙烯的選擇性（法拉第效率，FE）已從約20%提升至80%，其部分電流密度（產率）也達到了A/cm²等級。然而，反應過電位仍是一大挑戰，影響了整體反應的能量效率。在工業上偏好的膜電極組（MEA）電池中，ECO2R的操作電壓通常超過3.2 V，甚至常常高於4 V，這高於美國能源部（DOE）針對ECO2R工業化技術所設定的3 V標準，導致能量效率低且經濟上不可行。為了解決這一問題，有必要以理論電位較低的氧化反應取代理論電位高達1.23 V（相對於RHE）且經濟價值有限的陽極析氧反應（OER）。糠醛氧化因其低陽極半電池電位（0.05 V，相對於RHE）及其氧化產物呋喃酸（FA）具有高附加價值而受到關注。該氧化反應還可促進陽極釋放氫氣（陽極析氫反應，A-HER）。A-HER不僅限於糠醛，像5-羥甲基糠醛（HMF）等不可烯醇化的醛類也可用於此反應。更重要的是，糠醛/HMF的A-HER可產生如呋喃酸（FA）和2,5-呋喃二甲酸（FDCA）等高價值產品，這些均被美國能源部認定為極具潛力的高附加值化學品及平台化學品。 本計畫團隊已開發出一套穩定且耐久的純水進料MEA ECO2R製乙烯系統，創下ECO2R製乙烯的穩定性新紀錄（>1000小時）。然而，其操作電壓超過4.2 V，導致能量效率偏低（約18%）。因此，我們提出在我們穩定且耐久的MEA系統中，探索A-HER作為ECO2R的配對氧化反應，以降低操作電壓並提升產品的經濟價值。我們預期，將ECO2R製乙烯與A-HER耦合，可在保持高乙烯選擇性和產率的同時，實現超低電池電壓（<3 V）。本計畫旨在為ECO2R技術提供實驗與理論基礎，促進其產業化推廣，加速邁向可持續能源系統的進程。

15307625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15307625.value: 高通量設計可適用於自旋電子器件的二維室溫磁性異質結

15307625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15307625.value: The emergence of spintronic devices that utilize both spin and charge of electrons as information carriers has led to transformative applications such as data storage and sensors. Due to their exceptional properties, integrating two-dimensional (2D) magnetic materials into spintronics can improve device performance, offering enhanced integration capabilities, superior electrical controllability, and improved energy efficiency. However, the advancement of 2D spintronic devices is substantially hampered by the limited availability of room-temperature 2D ferromagnetic materials. While 2D van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures can tune the magnetic properties, the understanding of how they can be enhanced to room temperature remains limited. These challenges impede the design and development of high-performance 2D spintronic devices. In this proposal, we aim to address these barriers by designing 2D ferromagnetic vdW heterostructures with high Curie temperature using high-throughput first-principles calculations and experiments. First, we will employ high-throughput screening techniques to identify stable and synthesizable 2D ferromagnetic materials that exhibit high Curie temperatures from the vast materials space; Second, we will design 2D vdW heterostructures based on these 2D ferromagnetic materials, aiming to enhance the Curie temperature to or above room temperature; Third, we will investigate the impact of dimensionality and interface effects, including thickness, stacking order, internal electric field, charge transfer, orbital hybridization, and interface proximity, on the magnetic properties of these 2D vdW heterostructures; Finally, we will fabricate spin-orbit torque devices based on the designed 2D magnetic vdW heterostructures and evaluate their performance. This synergistic combination of computational and experimental investigations is expected to deepen our understanding of high Curie temperature 2D magnetic heterostructures and accelerate the development of non-volatile, programable, and low-power 2D spintronic devices. Successful implementation of this project has the potential to catalyze a broad spectrum of emerging applications ranging from embedded memories to the Internet of Things, thereby significantly influencing cutting-edge technologies and enhancing our everyday lives. 自旋電子器件的出現，利用電子的自旋與電荷雙重特性，已帶來儲存與傳感器等領域的變革性應用。由於其卓越的特性，將二維（2D）磁性材料整合進自旋電子器件中，有望提升器件性能，提供更優越的整合能力、更佳的電控性與更高的能源效率。然而，二維自旋電子器件的發展受到有限的室溫二維鐵磁材料的嚴重限制。儘管二維范德瓦耳斯（vdW）異質結構可調控磁有序性，然而對於如何將磁性提升至室溫的理解仍相當有限。這些挑戰阻礙了高效能二維自旋電子器件的設計與開發。 在本項目中，我們旨在突破上述障礙，透過高通量第一性原理計算與實驗，設計具有高居里溫度的二維鐵磁范德瓦耳斯異質結構。首先，我們將運用高通量篩選技術，從龐大的材料空間中尋找穩定且可合成的高居里溫度二維鐵磁材料；其次，基於這些材料設計二維范德瓦耳斯異質結構，目標是將其居里溫度提升至室溫或更高；第三，我們將研究維度與界面效應（包括厚度、堆疊順序、內部電場、電荷轉移、軌域雜化與界面鄰近效應）對這些二維異質結構磁性之影響；最後，我們將製作基於所設計的二維磁性范德瓦耳斯異質結構的自旋軌道轉矩器件，並評估其性能。這種結合計算與實驗的協同研究，有望深化我們對高居里溫度二維磁性異質結構設計的理解，並加速非揮發性、可程式化且低功耗之二維自旋電子器件的研發。本計畫的成功執行，將有潛力促進從嵌入式記憶體到物聯網等多種新興應用，對尖端科技產生重大影響，進而提升我們的日常生活品質。

15308125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15308125.value: 金屬-配體間次級作用力之探討：可調式膦配體的理性設計以提升催化效能

15308125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15308125.value: Cross-coupling reactions are integral to modern synthetic organic chemistry, enabling the efficient formation of carbon–carbon and carbon–heteroatom bonds through the use of transition metal catalysts. These versatile methodologies provide streamlined access to structurally complex and diverse molecules, which are essential in the synthesis of pharmaceuticals, natural products, agrochemicals, and functional materials. The development of catalysts, particularly through the design of innovative ligand frameworks, remains a central focus in modern catalysis research. Key challenges, such as improving reactivity with challenging substrates, achieving precise selectivity, and simplifying operational complexity, need to be addressed to meet the evolving demands of chemical synthesis. This research project aims to develop a new class of phosphine ligands to advance cross-coupling protocols. The project has four main objectives: (1) Design and synthesize a library of tunable phosphine ligands via streamlined synthetic routes, enabling efficient modification of electronic and steric properties to optimize catalytic performance. (2) Investigate challenging and unexplored substrate scopes in depth. (3) Perform mechanistic studies, including computational analysis, to elucidate the factors driving ligand activity and selectivity, providing insights to guide rational ligand design. (4) Develop chiral phosphine ligands for enantioselective cross-coupling reactions, with a focus on asymmetric transformations to synthesize chiral molecules with high enantioselectivity. The expected outcomes of this project include the development of innovative cross-coupling methodologies and a broader substrate scope. With significant potential for academic and industrial impact, this research leverages the Principal Investigator's expertise in ligand design and cross-coupling chemistry to address existing challenges and advance synthetic capabilities. It also offers an opportunity to drive progress in catalysis research and contribute to advancements in pharmaceutical chemistry, materials science, and related fields. 交叉偶聯反應是現代有機合成化學中的核心技術，能夠藉由過渡金屬催化劑高效地構建碳–碳及碳–雜原子鍵結，廣泛應用於藥物合成、天然物、農用化學品及功能性材料的製備。這些多樣化的方法提供了進入結構複雜且多樣化分子的便捷途徑。然而，如何透過創新配體骨架的設計來開發新型催化系統，仍是當前催化研究的重要課題。面對具挑戰性的底物、選擇性控制及操作簡便性等問題，仍有待進一步突破以滿足日益多樣化的合成需求。 本研究計畫旨在開發一類新穎的膦配體，以推進交叉偶聯反應的應用與效率。計畫包含四大目標：（1）透過簡潔的合成途徑設計並建立一組具可調控性的膦配體庫，藉以有效調節其電子與立體效應，以優化催化活性；（2）深入探討具挑戰性與未被充分研究的底物範疇；（3）結合機構研究與計算分析，釐清配體對催化活性與選擇性的關鍵影響因素，作為理性設計配體的重要依據；（4）開發手性膦配體，應用於不對稱交叉偶聯反應中，目標合成具高對映選擇性的手性分子。 本計畫預期可建立創新的交叉偶聯方法並拓展底物適用範圍，對學術與產業均具潛在貢獻。研究結合首席研究員在配體設計與交叉偶聯領域的專業，致力於解決現行合成技術面臨的關鍵挑戰，推動催化科學的發展，並促進在藥物化學、材料科學等相關領域的進一步應用。

15309625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15309625.value: 一類非線性優化問題的KKT解映射的穩定性分析

15309625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15309625.value: Stability (sensitivity or perturbation) analysis is a fundamental research subject in optimization studying how the optimal solutions or stationary points of an optimization problem vary as the problem-defining data (parameters) change. In this project, we focus on characterizing two significant concepts in stability analysis, i.e., the Aubin property and the semi-isolated calmness, of the solution mapping associated with the Karush– Kuhn–Tucker (KKT) system for the canonically perturbed version of nonlinear constrained optimization problems. Since the two concepts are implicitly defined but of remarkable theoretical and practical value, explicit characterizations of the two conditions have been considered a central research topic in mathematical optimization. When the set in the constraint system is convex and polyhedral, how to characterize both concepts is very clear now. Nevertheless, extending these results to the general case is much more involved and has thus been regarded as an open question for a long time. Recently, the PI and his coauthors achieved equivalent characterizations for the Aubin property of KKT solution mapping at a locally optimal solution for nonlinear second-order cone programming and nonlinear semidefinite programming, which encourages us to study a broader class of problems, in which the set in the constraint system is C^2-cone reducible. We plan to achieve this by establishing the equivalence between the Aubin property and the strong regularity via utilizing the constraint nondegeneracy joint with the generalized strong second-order sufficient condition. Moreover, to be less restrictive and more practical, we will also investigate characterizing the semi-isolated calmness of the KKT solution mapping. We will achieve this by further studying the variational analysis regarding a refined definition of non-critical multipliers, focusing on the non-polyhedral properties of the set in the constraints. Additionally, we will investigate the applications of semi-isolated calmness by analyzing the convergence properties of important algorithms, including the celebrated augmented Lagrangian method and the stabilized sequential quadratic programming method. The outcomes of this project will have a long-term and significant impact on mathematical optimization from both theoretical and practical perspectives. 穩定性（亦稱靈敏度或擾動）分析是優化領域中的一項根本研究課題，旨在研究當定義問題的數據（參數）發生變化時，優化問題的最優解或駐點如何隨之變化。在本研究計畫中，我們聚焦於刻畫穩定性分析中兩個重要概念：Aubin性質與半孤立平緩性，這兩個性質是與典型擾動版本的非線性約束優化問題的Karush–Kuhn–Tucker（KKT）系統的解映射相關聯的。由於上述兩個概念均為隱性定義，但在理論與應用上具有深遠的價值，對它們作出具體刻畫已長期被視為數學優化中的核心研究課題之一。當約束系統中的集合是凸且具多面體結構時，這兩個性質的刻畫方法已相當明確。然而，將這些成果推廣到更一般的情況則複雜得多，因此長期以來一直被視為是開放問題。最近，PI與其合作者已針對非線性二階錐規劃與非線性半正定規劃中的KKT解映射，在局部最優解處成功建立了Aubin性質的等價刻畫，這促使我們進一步研究一類更廣泛的問題，其中約束系統中涉及的集合是二階可微錐可約的。我們計畫利用約束非退化條件與廣義強二階充分條件，來建立Aubin性質與強正則性之間的等價性，以達成此目標。此外，為了使條件更寬鬆並符合實際需求，我們也將探討KKT解映射的半孤立平緩性的具體刻畫。我們會進一步研究變分分析，針對非臨界乘子提出更細緻的定義，並聚焦於約束集合的非多面體特性。最後，我們也將透過分析包括著名的增廣拉格朗日法與穩定序列二次規劃法等重要演算法的收斂性質，探索半孤立平緩性在數值演算法中的具體應用。本研究計畫的成果，將從理論與應用層面，對數學優化領域產生長遠且深遠的影響。

15309825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15309825.value: 微像素可重新編程軟多晶磁鐵

15309825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15309825.value: The application of magnets is abundant nearly everywhere from consumer electronics, robotics, and sensors to medical sectors. Conventional solid magnets enjoy enormous success, but have limited magnetization programmability, mechanical deformability and processability, and thus could not meet our nowadays demand. Molding & assembly and 3D printing have been recently applied to manufacture soft magnets with some enhanced programmability and deformability, but still been unsatisfactory, especially in reprograming the magnetization at micro pixels and reprograming the shape. We propose a facile effective technology to create soft poly-magnets with both micro-pixelwise reprogrammable magnetization and reprogrammable shape. We use “poly” in this proposal to stand for physically separated multiple pixels in the magnet. Microfluidics’ capability in precisely engineering materials’ composition and structure and convenience with crosslinking and thermal solidification readily embed magnetic pixels, magnetic particles in phase change materials (PCM), inside a soft transparent fiber. When the laser heating is applied to the target magnetic pixel, PCM melts, allowing the realignment of magnetic particles at that pixel with the aid of an external magnetic field. When the PCM solidifies with the laser heating turned off, the alignment direction is fixed. The soft nature of fibers enables shape reprogrammable as well via simple mechanical means like bending, twisting, and weaving. We aim to define this promising powerful technology in terms of its potential for creating soft poly-magnets with micro-pixel-wise reprogrammable magnetization, reprogrammable shape, wide applicability, and economical production at a commercial scale; this will be done with coated neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) particles (NdFeB particles with wettability pre-modified by the coating technique), modified alkanes (eicosane, octacosane and hexatriacontane with viscosity pre-modified) and biocompatible-modified sodium-alginate hydrogel as the example of magnetic particles, PCM and soft transparent fiber, respectively. The success of this project will change the way magnets are created for reprogrammable magnetization, mechanical deformability and processability, wide applicability, and economical production at a commercial scale. The project’s findings will pave the way for further progress in creating magnets by design, and in tailoring their property and performance to suit a desired application. The project will also generate revolutionary magnets that offer magnet tools/solutions in addressing multiple challenges arising from climate change, food safety, an aging population, COVID-19 and other public health concerns, and in meeting the demand for the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

15310125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15310125.value: 解析並應對高電壓無負極鈉離子電池的異常容量衰減

15310125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15310125.value: The natural abundance and wide geographical availability of sodium has driven the revival of Na-ion batteries (NIBs). Several promising cathodes relying on cobalt-free compounds have also been developed. Collectively, it makes NIBs the most attractive complements to Li-ion batteries (LIBs) in reducing cost and raising sustainability. Nevertheless, the energy density of NIBs lags much behind LIBs, hampering their broad application. These could be resolved through designing novel cathodes and anodes. While high-energy cathodes are being intensively explored, there is a large room for innovation on the anode side. Without resorting to new insertion chemistry, applying Na metal anode would significantly boost the energy density of NIBs. Na metal has a higher electrode potential than its Li counterpart, which alleviates the electrolyte decomposition to achieve a superior Na plating/stripping Coulombic efficiency (CE). An average CE of over 99.9% has been reported, allowing the construction of anode-free NIBs, i.e., depositing the Na provided solely by cathode on the anode current collector without excessive Na. Nevertheless, a rapid capacity degradation has been observed in the cell coupling with a high-voltage (>4V) cathode, which is essential to realizing competitive energy density. This project is dedicated to exploring the underlying mechanism associated with such an abnormal fast capacity decay in high-voltage anode-free NIBs that is inconsistent with the high CE achieved in the Na metal half cell. The phenomenon indicates the average CE obtained in Na metal anode alone is ill-suited to predicting the full cell performance, on the one hand. On the other hand, our preliminary result implies the presence of anode attack by the acidic species generated from the parasite reactions at a high voltage. Concurrent approaches in boosting the Na metal plating/stripping CE and building stable interfaces to inhibit side reactions are proposed. A dual-coating of the current collectors will be adopted to prevent the structural collapse of the coating layer and increase the resistance to corrosion from the crossover products. The electrochemical and mechanical properties of the interfaces on both the cathode and anode will be explored to enhance the interfacial stability. The efficacy of these strategies will be examined in full cells under critical conditions such as wide temperatures and lean electrolytes. The implanted optical fiber-based sensing techniques will be employed for disclosing the reaction pathway and monitoring battery safety to guide further development. 由於鈉的自然豐度高且地理分布廣泛，並且多種有前景的無鈷正極材料已被開發，推動了鈉離子電池的復興。其成本和可持續性優勢使其成為最具吸引力的鋰離子電池補充選擇。然而，鈉離子電池的能量密度遠低於鋰離子電池，限制了其廣泛應用。通過設計新型正極和負極材料，有望解決這一問題。高能量正極材料正被廣泛研究，負極方面也有很大的創新空間。在不採用新的嵌入化學體系的情況下，應用鈉金屬負極將顯著提升能量密度。鈉金屬的電極電位高於鋰金屬，有助於減緩電解液分解，從而實現更高的鈉沉積/剝離庫倫效率。已有研究報導其平均庫倫效率超過99.9%，這使得無負極鈉離子電池的構建成為可能，即僅利用正極提供的鈉在負極集流體上沉積。然而，在與四伏以上正極材料配對的電池中，觀察到容量迅速衰減，而高電壓正極對於實現有競爭力的能量密度至關重要。本項目致力於探索高電壓無負極鈉離子電池異常快速容量衰減的內在機制，這一現象與在鈉金屬半電池中獲得的高庫倫效率並不一致。一方面，這一現象表明，僅通過鈉金屬負極獲得的平均庫倫效率並不適用於預測全電池的性能。另一方面，我們的初步結果顯示，高電壓下寄生反應產物會對負極造成破壞。為此，本項目提出了提升鈉金屬沉積/剝離庫倫效率和構建穩定界面以抑制副反應的多種方法。我們將採用集流體雙層塗覆技術，以防止塗層結構坍塌並增強其抵抗破壞的能力。同時，將系統研究正負極界面的電化學和力學性能，以提升界面穩定性。這些策略的有效性將在寬溫度範圍和貧電解液等嚴苛條件下的全電池中進行驗證。我們還將採用植入式光纖傳感技術，揭示反應路徑並監測電池安全性，以指導後續開發。

15310525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15310525.value: 半導體模擬中滿足高斯定律的新型局部蒙特卡羅方法

15310525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15310525.value: The simulation of semiconductor devices has garnered significant attention in both industry and academia in recent years. The Boltzmann equation is pivotal in semiconductor modeling, providing a kinetic description of transport phenomena and serving as the foundation for other widely used macroscopic models, such as hydrodynamic and drift-diffusion models. Monte Carlo methods are particularly well-suited for solving the seven-dimensional Boltzmann equation, effectively circumventing the curse of dimensionality that plagues deterministic methods. Classical Monte Carlo simulations involve two primary steps: free flight and scattering. Free flight, governed by Newton’s second law, requires the calculation of the electric field, while scattering is determined randomly by the Monte Carlo algorithm. The frequent and timely calculation of the electric field often consumes a significant amount of time. In this project, we propose the development of a novel Gauss’s law-satisfying algorithm for Monte Carlo simulations in semiconductors. Specifically, we introduce a new approach that simultaneously updates the electric field and calculates the positions of charge carriers, strictly adhering to Gauss’s law while enhancing computational efficiency. This is the first application of this idea in semiconductor simulations, and it is expected to perform well. Additionally, the condition for a curl-free electric field can be achieved through a local curl-free relaxation approach. We will demonstrate that, under the constraints of Gauss’s law, the partition function derived from the updating scheme can be expressed as the Coulomb partition function multiplied by a constant. Rigorous mathematical analysis will also be conducted to derive the errors of the finite difference discretization, ultimately proving the convergence of the proposed local Monte Carlo method. This project aims to advance efficient and accurate computational techniques in semiconductor physics, paving the way for future developments in the field. 近年來，半導體元件的模擬在工業界與學術界皆受到高度關注。玻爾茲曼方程在半導體建模中扮演關鍵角色，它不僅提供了傳輸現象的動力學描述，更是其他廣泛使用的宏觀模型（如流體力學模型與漂移擴散模型）的基礎。蒙地卡羅方法特別適合求解七維的玻爾茲曼方程，能有效避開確定性方法所面臨的維度災難問題。傳統蒙地卡羅模擬主要包含兩個步驟：自由飛行與散射。自由飛行遵循牛頓第二運動定律，需計算電場；而散射過程則由蒙地卡羅算法隨機決定。其中，頻繁且即時的電場計算往往耗費大量時間。 本計畫提出一種新穎的、滿足高斯定律的算法，專為半導體蒙地卡羅模擬設計。具體而言，我們引入一種同步更新電場與計算載子位置的新方法，在嚴格遵守高斯定律的同時提升計算效率。此構想首度應用於半導體模擬，預期將展現優異性能。此外，無旋電場的條件可透過局部無旋鬆弛法達成。我們將證明：在高斯定律約束下，更新方案所推導的配分函數可表為庫侖配分函數乘以常數。團隊亦將進行嚴謹的數學分析，推導有限差分離散化的誤差，最終證明所提局部蒙地卡羅方法的收斂性。本計畫旨在推進半導體物理中高效精確的計算技術，為該領域未來發展鋪路。

15310625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15310625.value: 可印刷有機和鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的反向偏壓韌性研究

15310625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15310625.value: Organic solar cells (OSCs) and perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have garnered significant attention from both academia and industry, showcasing impressive efficiencies exceeding 20% and 26% in laboratory settings, respectively. However, to advance these technologies towards commercial viability, the development of solar modules is essential. An often-overlooked issue in the practical deployment of solar modules is their stability under reverse bias induced by shadow effects. The stability issue under reverse bias is particularly challenging for PSCs due to their electron-ion hybrid conducting property, while research on reverse-bias stability for OSCs is lacking. Therefore, understanding the behavior and underlying mechanisms of OSCs under reverse bias is crucial, and addressing the stability issue of PSCs under reverse bias is urgent. Building on our preliminary findings, we propose a comprehensive research plan to investigate the stability issues of both OSCs and PSCs under reverse bias. Initially, we will systematically investigate the performance and underlying mechanisms of OSCs under reverse bias, correlating nanoscale morphology and sub-bandgap trap density with breakdown behavior. Subsequently, we will employ various methods, including ternary strategies and additive-assisted sequential deposition, to optimize power conversion efficiency (PCE) and voltage reverse breakdown (VRB) in PSCs. Furthermore, the introduction of perovskite-organic tandem solar cells (POTSCs) aims to enhance the PCE and VRB of perovskite-based solar cells through sub-cell and interconnecting layer optimizations, offering a comprehensive approach to address the inherent stability issues associated with PSCs under reverse bias conditions. POTSC modules will be designed and demonstrated to exhibit stability under shadow conditions in practical outdoor applications. This proposal introduces a new direction for OSCs and PSCs by further investigating the reverse bias stability issues in organic and perovskite photovoltaics. By achieving a targeted VRB threshold for OSCs, PSCs, and POTSCs, such as -30V, we aim to effectively resolve the stability concerns induced by shadows, thus enhancing the commercial viability of these solar technologies. The proposed research involves investigating theoretical mechanisms, developing materials and devices, and introducing innovative concepts to address the critical stability issue under reverse bias conditions. Successful outcomes of this project have the potential to advance the field of OSCs, PSCs, and POTSCs, potentially expediting the commercialization of these promising technologies. 有機太陽能電池（OSCs）和鈣鈦礦太陽能電池（PSCs）在學術界和工業界均受到了廣泛的關注，並在實驗室環境中展現了超過20%和26%的卓越效率。然而，為了將這些技術推進到商業可行性，開發太陽能模組是必不可少的。一個常被忽視的問題是太陽能模組在陰影效應引致的反向偏置下的穩定性。由於鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的電子-離子混合導電特性，反向偏置下的穩定性問題對其來說尤其具有挑戰性，而對於有機太陽能電池的反向偏置穩定性研究仍然不足。因此，理解有機太陽能電池在反向偏置下的行為及其潛在機制至關重要，同時迫切需要解決鈣鈦礦太陽能電池在反向偏置下的穩定性問題。 基於我們的初步發現，我們提出了一個綜合研究計劃，以調查在反向偏壓下有機太陽能電池（OSCs）和鈣鈦礦太陽能電池（PSCs）的穩定性問題。最初，我們將系統地研究OSCs在反向偏壓下的性能和基本機制，將納米尺度的形態和次帶隙陷阱密度與崩潰行為相關聯。隨後，我們將採用各種方法，包括三元策略和添加劑助力的順序沉積，來優化PSCs的功率轉換效率（PCE）和電壓反向崩潰（VRB）。此外，引入鈣鈦礦有機串聯太陽能電池（POTSCs）旨在通過子電池和互連層的優化來提高基於鈣鈦礦的太陽能電池的PCE和VRB，提供一種綜合方法來解決與PSCs在反向偏壓條件下相關的固有穩定性問題。POTSC 模組將被設計和展示以在實際戶外應用中表現出在陰影條件下的穩定性。 本提案通過進一步研究有機和鈣鈦礦光伏中的反向偏置穩定性問題，為 OSCs 和 PSCs 引入了一個新的方向。通過實現針對 OSCs、PSCs 和 POTSCs 的目標 VRB 閾值，例如 -30V，我們旨在有效解決由陰影引起的穩定性問題，從而增強這些太陽能技術的商業可行性。所提出的研究涉及研究理論機制、開發材料和裝置，以及引入創新概念以解決反向偏置條件下的關鍵穩定性問題。該項目成功的結果有可能推進 OSCs、PSCs 和 POTSCs 的領域，並可能加速這些有前景技術的商業化進程。

15500025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500025.value: 探討企业碳披露策略及其影響

15500025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500025.value: As governments place increasing emphasis on carbon transparency, firms face growing pressure to disclose product-related carbon emissions. Currently, companies are implementing diverse carbon disclosure strategies that differ in both scope and format. Commonly observed strategies include (i) partial revelation, where firms disclose only their emissions; (ii) full and aggregated revelation, where firms disclose total emissions from both their operations and their suppliers in an aggregated manner; and (iii) full and separated revelation, where firms disclose emissions from both themselves and their suppliers separately. Meanwhile, consumers are becoming more environmentally conscious and increasingly consider carbon emissions when making purchasing decisions. Consumer behavior is further influenced by behavioral factors such as reference-dependent preferences and mental accounting, which can be influenced by a firm's carbon disclosure strategy. However, the interaction between firms' carbon disclosure strategies and consumer behavior remains unclear. Our proposed research project aims to address the following key questions: (1) How does a firm’s carbon disclosure strategy affect its pricing and consumer purchasing decisions? (2) How do market composition and consumer characteristics influence a firm's choice of disclosure strategy? (3) Under what circumstances might a firm engage in partial disclosure to reveal its low emissions while concealing higher emissions from its supply chain, a practice known as greenwashing? (4) What are the broader implications for the firm, consumers, and society? To answer these questions, we will develop a game-theoretical model where a firm sells the product to environmentally-conscious and reference-dependent consumers. The firm chooses its carbon disclosure strategy and pricing, which in turn impact consumer purchase behavior. We will first derive the optimal pricing and purchasing decisions under each disclosure strategy, and then determine the equilibrium carbon disclosure strategy. The equilibrium outcomes will help identify conditions under which firms may engage in greenwashing. We will further conduct sensitivity analyses to explore how market compositions and consumer characteristics influence a firm’s disclosure strategy and the likelihood of greenwashing. Finally, we will explore model extensions to check the robustness of our main findings. This project will provide valuable insights for both business practitioners and policymakers. Firms can use these insights to make better-informed carbon disclosure decisions, while policymakers can leverage the findings to design more effective carbon transparency regulations that promote accountability and reduce the prevalence of greenwashing. 隨著各國政府日益強調碳透明度，企業在披露產品相關碳排放方面面臨與日俱增的壓力。企業的碳披露策略呈現多樣性，其披露範圍與形式均有差異。常見的策略包括：(i), 部分披露，企業僅披露自身的排放量；(ii)，全面匯總披露，即企業以匯總方式披露其自身及供應商的總排放量；(iii)，全面拆分披露策略，即企業分別披露自身與供應商的排放量。同時，消費者環保意識漸趨增強，在做出購買決策時越發將碳排放納入考量範疇。同时，消費者行為受到參考依賴偏好、心理帳戶等行為因素的影響，這些因素又會受到企業碳披露策略的影響。然而，企業碳披露策略與消費者行為之間的相互作用仍有待釐清。本研究拟解决以下問題：（1）企業的碳披露策略如何影響其定價和消費者購買決策？ （2）市場構成與消費者特徵如何影響企業的披露策略選擇？ （3）在何種情况下，企業採取部分披露的方式？（4）這對企業、消費者及社會而言，有哪些影響？ 為了回答上述問題，我們將構建一個博弈模型。企業向具有環保意識及存在參考依賴的消費者銷售產品。企業决定其碳披露策略及定價，進而影響消費者的購買行為。我們將推導出每種披露策略下的最佳定價及購買決策，然後確定均衡碳披露策略。透過均衡結果，找出企業可能進行漂綠的條件。我們將進一步進行敏感度分析，以探討市場構成和消費者特徵如何影響企業的披露策略及其發生漂綠的可能性。最後，我們將拓展模型以檢驗核心结果的穩健性。本研究將為企業和政策制定者提供極具價值的見解：企業可借鉴這些見解做出更為明智的碳披露決策；政策制定者可以利用研究結果來設計更有效的碳透明度法規，以強化企業責任並減少漂綠。

15500225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500225.value: 人工智能時代創意知識的生產與價值分配

15500225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15500225.value: Prof CHO, Erin Prof SCHOTTER, Andreas

15500225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500225.value: This research project examines how artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming the production and value appropriation of creative knowledge. It investigates the reconfiguration of roles among AI technology platform owners (e.g., Google, OpenAI), creative entities (professional artists, craftsmen, Small-Medium-Enterprises (SMEs) in creative industries and outsiders (e.g., social media influencers) within the broader creative ecosystem. Following a what-why-how logic, the study addresses three key questions: What is the optimal AI-human interaction (high-quality AI adoption) model for creative ecosystems? Why do AI adoption rates and patterns differ among different creative entities within the same field? How can creative businesses and professionals maintain independence and competitiveness when adopting AI? The project unfolds in three interconnected phases. First, through comprehensive literature review and comparative case studies, we will identify core mechanisms by which AI adoption impacts the creative knowledge production. Second, we will develop a novel multi-reference point performance feedback model to dynamically predict AI adoption patterns among creative entities, revealing behavioral heterogeneity and its impact on the creative ecosystem. This model, considering factors such as personal growth experiences, domain-specific trajectories, and peer comparisons, captures the complex decision-making processes behind AI adoption behaviors. It explains seemingly contradictory behaviors in AI adoption and reveals the dynamic nature of AI adoption in creative fields. Third, we will conduct a longitudinal case study to examine the evolving dynamics of AI-induced conflicts in creative ecosystems, focusing on value appropriation conflicts between human creators and AI technology platform owners. By redefining AI as a change agent in the broader ecosystem rather than merely a new technology, our research reveals emerging asymmetric power dynamics in the creative ecosystem. This structural perspective enables us to explore how creative professionals and SMEs can maintain their unique artistic identities while leveraging AI capabilities. The findings will inform responsible AI adoption policies and practices, fostering synergy between human creativity and AI capabilities in the evolving landscape of creative ecosystems. 本研究項目探討人工智能（AI）如何轉變創意知識的生產與價值分配，研究了AI技術平臺擁有者（如Google、OpenAI）、創意實體（專業藝術家、工匠、創意產業中的中小企業）以及外部參與者（如社交媒體網紅）在更廣泛的創意生態系統中的角色重構。遵循「是什麼-為什麼-怎麼樣」的邏輯，研究聚焦三個關鍵問題：創意生態系統中最佳的AI-人類交互（高品質AI採用）模型是什麼？為何同一領域內不同創意實體的AI採用率和模式存在差異？創意企業和專業人士在採用AI時如何保持獨立性和競爭力？本項目分為三個相互關聯的階段展開。首先，通過全面的文獻綜述和比較案例研究，我們將識別AI採用影響創意知識生產的核心機制。其次，我們將開發一個新穎的多參考點績效反饋模型，動態預測創意實體之間的AI採用模式，揭示行為異質性及其對創意生態系統的影響。該模型考慮了個人成長經歷、領域特定軌跡和同行比較等因素，捕捉AI採用行為背後的複雜決策過程，解釋AI採用中的看似矛盾行為，並揭示創意領域AI採用的動態特性。第三，我們將考察創意生態系統中AI引發的衝突演變動態，重點關注人類創作者與AI技術平臺擁有者之間的價值分配衝突。通過將AI重新定義為更廣泛生態系統中的變革推動者，而非單純的新技術，我們的研究揭示了創意生態系統中新興的非對稱權力動態。這種結構化視角使我們能夠探索創意專業人士和中小企業如何在利用AI能力的同時保持其獨特的藝術創作者身份。研究結果將為負責任的AI採用政策和實踐提供參考，促進人類創造力與AI能力在不斷演變的創意生態系統中的協同發展。

15500325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500325.value: 预留与按需服务器的动态配置与优化

15500325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15500325.value: Prof Janakiraman, Ganesh Dr Qi, Anyan

15500325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500325.value: Modern firms operating queueing-based service systems face a critical challenge in managing their service capacity effectively. They must balance the costs of hiring servers with the waiting costs of jobs, while considering the tradeoff between reserved and on-demand servers. On-demand servers offer flexibility but are expensive, whereas reserved servers are cheaper but require long-term commitment. This tradeoff is particularly relevant in industries such as call centers, cloud computing, and healthcare services, where combining long-term reserved capacity with short-term on-demand capacity is becoming increasingly popular. This trend has created a need for effective strategies to manage these capacities. However, existing approaches often rely on restrictive assumptions or heavy-traffic approximations, which may not be suitable for many business applications with limited scale of operations. This project aims to address the challenge of managing reserved and on-demand servers in queueing systems with general parameter values. To achieve this, we use a continuous-time Markov chain to analyze the evolution of the number of jobs in the system, considering practical settings such as non-preemption, different service rates for reserved and on-demand servers, and a limited number of on-demand servers. Firms make a one-time decision on the number of reserved servers to hire and real-time decisions on the number of on-demand servers to use, with the objective of minimizing the infinite-horizon discounted cost incurred in hiring servers and in the waiting of jobs. As a preliminary analysis, we examine a special case with unlimited on-demand servers. This serves as a foundation for analyzing the more sophisticated setting where the number of on-demand servers is limited. Our analysis reveals that the optimal on-demand capacity control is a hire-down-to policy with a specific target, where on-demand servers are hired to reduce the number of jobs in the system to the target level. Building on this preliminary analysis, we propose a comprehensive research plan to develop optimal staffing policies under constrained availability of on-demand servers. Further, we plan to validate the performance of our policies using a real dataset from a bank call center. By completing this project, we expect to provide novel insights and practical tools that will enhance capacity management in service systems with both reserved and on-demand servers, ultimately leading to improved efficiency and reduced operational costs. 现代排队型服务系统在容量配置上面临关键抉择：一方面需控制长期预留与按需雇佣服务资源的成本，另一方面还要兼顾顾客等待所带来的损失。预留服务器成本较低但缺乏灵活性，按需服务器灵活但价格高昂，这一权衡在呼叫中心、云计算与医疗等行业尤为突出。现有方法多基于特定的假设或依赖高负载近似，难以适用于规模有限的实际业务场景。 本项目在通用参数设定下研究同时拥有预留与按需服务器的排队系统。我们以连续时间马尔可夫链刻画系统中任务数量的演化，并纳入更贴近实际的设定：禁止抢占、预留与按需服务器服务率可不同，以及按需服务器数量受限。企业需一次性决定预留服务器数量，并在系统运行中实时决定按需服务器的数量，以最小化雇用服务器和任务等待所产生的总成本。 作为初步分析，我们研究了按需服务器数量不受限制的情形，为后续分析按需服务器数量有限的场景奠定了基础。我们的分析揭示，最优的按需容量控制是一种带有特定目标水平的动态配置策略：当系统中的任务数超过某一目标水平时，立即启用足够的按需服务器将其降至该目标。 基于此初步分析，我们提出了一项全面的研究计划，旨在按需服务器供应受限的条件下，制定出最优的动态容量配置策略。此外，我们计划利用现实中的数据集来验证我们所提策略的性能。通过完成此项目，我们期望能帮助企业在“预留＋按需”的混合架构下提升运营效率、降低运营成本。

15503525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503525.value: 认知模糊性下的基于购买行为的质量歧视研究

15503525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503525.value: Product quality has consistently been a critical factor for consumers when making purchasing decisions, alongside price. However, accurately assessing quality levels poses significant challenges for consumers due to cognitive ambiguity, which can arise from various reasons, including cost of information processing, limited and conflicting quality information, and insufficient reasoning abilities and cognitive efforts. Consequently, most purchasing decisions are not made through meticulous calculation and comparison of subjective expected utilities but rather relying on prior experiences with bounded rationality. The assessment of product quality becomes even more challenging when firms dynamically adjust quality levels based on consumers' purchase histories, a practice facilitated by advancements in information technologies and data tracking. This practice, known as behavior-based quality discrimination (BQD), involves offering products of varying quality levels to repeat and new consumers. Practical examples of BQD abound, including exclusive in-game items for veteran players in Riot Games, additional benefits for long-term subscribers in Blizzard's World of Warcraft, various privileges for repeat customers in Starbucks and Didi, etc. As firms increasingly utilize information technologies for data tracking, scholars have focused on the potential use of consumer data for price discrimination. However, the effects of BQD, particularly in cases of quality ambiguity, have rarely been examined. Existing studies on behavior-based price discrimination often assume fully rational consumers, overlooking the bounded rationality that consumers exhibit when confronted with quality ambiguity. Hence, developing appropriate behavior-based quality and price discrimination strategies to accommodate quality ambiguity and understanding the associated profit implications are crucial for firms to survive in today's highly competitive environment. Motivated by these observations, this proposal aims to systematically understand how consumers' cognitive ambiguity alters the value and operational implementation of BQD and affects competing firms' quality and pricing strategies, profitability, and associated welfare. Specifically, we will investigate the effects of quality ambiguity on firms' quality decisions, determining whether there is an inherent difference when BQD is employed versus when it is not. We will also examine the distribution of quality enhancement and price discounts between repeat and new consumers, identifying which group benefits more when BQD is employed. Furthermore, we will analyze how quality ambiguity affects these strategies of quality and price discrimination. Finally, we will investigate whether the implementation of BQD improves firms' profitability under quality ambiguity. Addressing these questions will generate valuable managerial insights, enhancing firms' understanding of cognitive ambiguity and enabling better utilization of behavior-based discrimination strategies in the digital era. 产品质量历来与价格并重，是消费者购买决策的关键考量因素。然而，由于认知模糊性的存在，消费者对质量水平的准确评估面临显著挑战。这种模糊性源于多重原因：信息处理成本、有限且可能矛盾的质量信息、推理能力与认知努力不足等。因此，多数购买决策并非基于对主观期望效用的精密计算与比较，而是依赖有限理性下的既往经验。 当企业基于消费者购买历史动态调整产品质量时（这种实践因信息技术与数据追踪的进步得以实现），质量评估变得更为复杂。这种行为被称为"基于购买行为的质量歧视"（BQD），即向回头客与新客户提供不同质量水平的产品。BQD的实例广泛存在：拳头游戏为资深玩家提供专属游戏道具，暴雪《魔兽世界》为长期订阅者增设额外福利，星巴克与滴滴对回头客授予各类优先权益等。 随着企业日益利用信息技术进行数据追踪，学界多聚焦于消费者数据在价格歧视中的应用潜力。然而在质量模糊情境下，BQD的影响却鲜被探讨。现有基于购买行为的价格歧视的研究常假设消费者完全理性，忽视了其在质量模糊时表现出的有限理性。因此，制定适配质量模糊性的基于购买行为的质量与价格歧视策略，并理解相关利润影响，对企业在当今高度竞争环境中生存至关重要。 基于上述观察，本项目旨在系统研究：消费者认知模糊性如何改变BQD的价值与实施，如何影响竞争企业的质量定价策略、盈利能力及相关福利。具体将探究：质量模糊性对企业质量决策的影响，识别采用BQD与否时的本质差异；分析BQD实施中质量提升与价格折扣在回头客与新客户间的分配，明确哪方获益更多；解析质量模糊性如何调节此类质量与价格歧视策略；最终验证在质量模糊下实施BQD能否提升企业利润。 解答这些问题将产生宝贵的管理洞见：既增强企业对认知模糊性的理解，亦推动其在数字时代更有效地运用行为歧视策略。

15503725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503725.value: 碳边境调整机制和碳泄漏及全球供应链

15503725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503725.value: Carbon leakage refers to firms relocating or outsourcing their carbon-intensive production to countries with less stringent climate regulations or lower carbon prices. This phenomenon not only undermines the effectiveness of climate policies aimed at reducing global emissions, but also places firms in regions with more strict carbon regulations and higher carbon prices at a competitive disadvantage. Therefore, curbing carbon leakage is essential for achieving global carbon emission reductions and ensuring fair competition. At the forefront of global climate action, the European Union (EU) has been the first to establish a carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) to curb carbon leakage and ensure that the carbon price of imports is equivalent to that of domestic production. Under the CBAM, EU firms importing carbon-intensive goods from non-EU sources are required to pay additional carbon price to close the carbon price gap between the EU and non-EU supplying regions. The CBAM will be implemented starting in 2026, following a transitional phase from 2023 to 2025. This cross-border price adjustment mechanism is expected to significantly affect the corporate climate and economic activities of both EU and non-EU firms, thereby reshaping their carbon emission strategies and customer-supplier relationships. This project will be the first to shed light on whether CBAM can effectively curb carbon leakage and level the playing field between EU and non-EU firms. 碳泄漏是指企业将其碳密集型生产活动转移或外包到气候监管较宽松或碳价格较低的国家。这一现象不仅削弱了旨在减少全球排放的气候政策的有效性，也使处于碳监管更严格、碳价格更高地区的企业在竞争中处于劣势。因此，遏制碳泄漏对于实现全球碳减排和确保公平竞争至关重要。 作为全球气候行动的先锋，欧洲联盟 率先建立了碳边境调整机制(CBAM)以遏制碳泄漏，并确保进口产品的碳价格与欧盟境内生产的产品相当。根据CBAM，从非欧盟地区进口碳密集型产品的欧盟企业需要支付额外的碳价格，以弥补欧盟与非欧盟供应地区之间的碳价格差距。CBAM将于2023年至2025年的过渡期后，于2026年正式实施。 这一跨境价格调整机制预计将显著影响欧盟和非欧盟企业的气候应对举措和经济活动，从而重塑其碳排放战略和客户-供应商关系。本项目将首次揭示CBAM是否能有效遏制碳泄漏，并在欧盟与非欧盟企业之间创造公平的竞争环境。

15504525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15504525.value: 在线零售中具有随机供货期与有限顾客等待时间的库存管理

15504525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504525.value: In today’s global supply chain network, the lead time uncertainty has become increasingly prevalent, posing significant challenges for online retailers in managing their inventory. When lead times are random and stock-out happens, on retailers’ side, they are unable to commit to any specific shipping time, whereas on customers’ side, they may cancel their orders before the product becomes available if the wait is too long. Consequently, retailers face a mixture of backorders and lost sales, referred to as partial backorders. In this project, we propose to study an inventory control problem with stochastic lead times and partial backorders. We model the lead time process following the classical approach proposed by Kaplan (1970). Since the optimal policy for this class of systems is very difficult to solve, we propose two classes of heuristic replenishment policies: the base-stock policy and the approximate myopic policy. Existing literature and our preliminary study show that the two policies perform well and are close to optimal in several simpler systems. In this project, we propose to investigate the theoretical and empirical performances of the two policies in the more complex system. Specifically, we aim to establish the asymptotic optimality for the two policies as the unit backlogging cost and/or the unit lost-sales penalty cost grows large when the distributional information is known and develop a data-driven learning algorithm for the best base-stock policy when the distributional information is unknown. We will also conduct an extensive numerical study to investigate the empirical performances of the proposed policies and explore the extension to more general lead time processes. If successful, our research output will not only contribute to the inventory theory with random lead times, but also help online retailers better understand customers’ behavior and more effectively manage their inventory. 在当今全球供应链中，供应商交货期的不确定性日益突出，给在线零售商的库存管理带来挑战。交货期随机且库存不足时，零售商无法承诺消费者具体发货时间，消费者若等待时间过久则可能取消订单，导致系统同时存在缺货订单和损失订单。本项目研究具有随机供货期和有限顾客等待时间的库存控制问题。我们采用Kaplan（1970）提出的经典方法对供货期进行建模。由于最优策略难以求解，我们提出两类启发式补货策略：基准库存策略和短视库存策略。文献和初步研究表明，这两种策略在简化的系统中表现接近最优。本项目将进一步分析两种策略在复杂系统中的理论与实际表现，特别是在单位缺货成本或流失成本较高时，研究其渐近最优性，并在分布未知时开发数据驱动的基准库存学习算法。我们还将通过数值实验评估策略效果，并探索更一般的交货期过程。研究成果将丰富具有随机交货期的库存理论，并帮助在线零售商更好理解顾客行为和提升库存管理效率。

15504825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15504825.value: 加强巨型区域目的地的发展：通过分析游客旅行模式探索区域空间整合

15504825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15504825.value: Prof Hsu, Cathy Prof Shoval , Noam Prof Stantic, Bela

15504825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504825.value: A mega-region is a large, integrated network of metropolitan areas interconnected through economic, social, environmental, and infrastructural relationships, forming a new spatial structure that enhances regional development. Spatial structure refers to the arrangement of various elements within a geographical area, which influences how cities and regions develop, interact, and function. Examples of mega-regions include the US Northeast Corridor, Coastal California, Northwest Europe, the Taiheiyō Belt in Japan, and the Greater Bay Area (GBA) in China. Mega-regions act as catalysts for economic growth, making it critical to understand their spatial structures to enhance regional connectivity and efficiency. As tourists move between locations, their patterns create demands, prompting the development of infrastructure and services to accommodate these demands. Understanding tourist travel patterns aids in identifying major tourism hubs and secondary cities, influencing how resources are allocated and infrastructure is developed to support tourism product development in mega-regions. However, studies on spatial structure used to focus on single destination, falling short in addressing the complexities of tourist movements and preferences within mega-regions and current models that assess spatial structure have largely overlooked the deeper reasons for travel patterns among mega-region cities. The proposed project will seek to address these significant gaps in understanding tourism spatial structures, using the GBA mega-region as the study site. It will begin with a comprehensive analysis of tourists’ spatial-temporal behaviours in the GBA, derived from social media posts. The proposed project will harness advanced deep-learning techniques and large language models to investigate in-depth the topics and sentiments expressed in social media. The insights will be used to build a framework that uncovers the underlying reasons for such travel patterns and construct a new spatial interaction model (SIM) to evaluate the mega-region’s spatial structure. Finally, the findings of these analyses will be corroborated with secondary data (such as transportation options, distances between cities, and official tourist statistics) and validated through in-depth interviews to ensure that they align with the social media analysis results. The project will also enrich spatial interaction theory and the gravity model by integrating psychological and social factors, such as tourist sentiment and discussion topics, into traditional models. Practically, the insights will provide tourism planners, policymakers, and developers with findings to inform infrastructure investment, marketing, and cross-city collaboration. The findings will support coordinated tourism efforts, enhancing the GBA’s position as an interconnected destination and offering insights for other mega-regions globally. 巨型区域是一个庞大的、一体化的都市地区网络，通过经济、社会、环境和基础设施的相互联系，形成了一种新的空间结构，促进了区域发展。空间结构指的是地理区域内各种元素的排列方式，这种排列方式影响了城市和地区的发展、相互作用和功能。巨型区域的例子包括美国东北走廊、加州沿海地区、西北欧洲、日本太平洋带以及中国的大湾区（GBA）。巨型区域作为经济增长的催化剂，理解其空间结构对于增强区域连通性和效率至关重要。 当游客在不同地点间移动时，他们的旅行模式会产生需求，促使基础设施和服务的发展以满足这些需求。理解游客的旅行模式有助于识别主要的旅游中心和次级城市，影响资源的配置和基础设施的发展，以支持巨型区域内的旅游产品开发。然而，之前的空间结构研究通常只关注单一目的地，未能充分解决巨型区域内游客运动和偏好的复杂性，现有评估空间结构的模型也大多忽视了巨型区域城市间旅行模式的深层原因。 该提议项目将寻求解决这些在理解旅游空间结构方面的重大差距，以GBA为研究场所。它将从对GBA内游客的空间-时间行为的全面分析开始，这些数据来源于社交媒体帖子。该项目将利用先进的深度学习技术和大型语言模型来深入研究社交媒体中表达的话题和情绪。洞察力将用来构建一个框架，揭示这些旅行模式的潜在原因，并构建一个新的空间互动模型（SIM）来评估巨型区域的空间结构。最后，这些分析的发现将与二手数据（如交通选项、城市间距离和官方旅游统计数据）相印证，并通过深入访谈来验证，以确保它们与社交媒体分析结果一致。 项目还将通过将心理和社会因素（如游客情绪和讨论话题）整合到传统模型中，丰富空间互动理论和引力模型。从实际角度来看，这些洞察将为旅游规划师、政策制定者和开发商提供信息，以指导基础设施投资、营销和跨城市合作。这些发现将支持协调的旅游努力，增强GBA作为一个相互连接的目的地的地位，并为全球其他巨型区域发展提供案例。

15504925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15504925.value: 应对气候变化对山地旅游的影响：基于社区的混合方法，探索再生型旅游发展路径

15504925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15504925.value: Prof Becken, Susanne Prof RUHANEN, Lisa

15504925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504925.value: Mountain ecosystems and communities are among the most vulnerable to climate change, facing unique natural hazards (e.g., high seismic risks), alongside anthropogenic risks like rapidly melting glaciers and extreme weather events. This research focuses on regenerative sustainability, where tourism not only minimizes its environmental impact but actively seeks to restore and renew socio-ecological systems through transformative actions. This approach is particularly relevant to mountain tourism, where tourism often exacerbates existing social, economic and environmental vulnerabilities. Drawing on complexity theory and stimulus-organism-response model, this study will explore how climate and environmental changes in these interconnected systems can create ripple effects (e.g., disrupt local water supplies), while external stimuli (e.g., climate change) drive adaptive environmental responses by local communities. Using Hawkins et al.’s (2017) community-based research approach, this project will unfold in four phases. The first phase draws upon a range of secondary data sources published between 2000 and 2024, including media articles and visitor commentary, to assess the impacts of climate change on local livelihood and tourist experiences in the Himalayas. This data will be organized into a panel dataset, identifying thematic clusters and sentiment patterns.
