In the second phase, qualitative data, including go-along conversations, interviews and observations, will be collected at three mountain destinations between China and Nepal: Makalu Barun National Park, Manasalu Conservation Area, and Sagarmatha National Park. These insights will reveal the impact of climate change on local livelihood and tourism ecosystems, as well as the adaptive environmental management practices (e.g., sustainable waste management) employed by local communities and tourism stakeholders. The third phase will validate insights from phase two and generate new insights into regenerative mountain tourism through co-creative engagement with local communities and tourism stakeholders. This community-based research approach (Hawkins et al., 2017) aims to co-create strategies that are locally relevant and effective in enhancing resilience. Finally, the fourth phase will employ a multi-criteria decision analysis approach to identify the most effective climate adaptation practices for mountain tourism destinations. This phase also involves co-creating a model of regenerative mountain tourism with local communities and tourism stakeholders, including the development of actionable principles and training modules for adopting and applying regenerative tourism practices. This research acknowledges the multi-faceted complexity of regenerative sustainability in mountain tourism, emphasizing the interconnectedness of ecological, social, and economic systems. The study findings will provide valuable insights and recommendations for fostering long-term resilience and sustainability in mountain tourism destinations. 山地生态系统和社区是最容易受到气候变化影响的群体，因为他们面临着独特的自然灾害（如高地震风险），以及人为风险，如冰川快速融化和极端天气事件。本研究聚焦于再生性可持续发展，即旅游业不仅要尽量减少对环境的影响，还要通过变革性行动积极修复和更新社会—生态系统。这一方法对于山地旅游尤为重要，因为该旅游活动往往加剧了现有的社会、经济和环境脆弱性。借助复杂性理论和刺激—有机体—反应模型，本研究将探讨相互关联系统中的气候和环境变化如何产生涟漪反应（如扰乱当地供水），同时外部刺激（如气候变化）如何驱动当地社区的适应环境。 本项目将采用Hawkins等人（2017）提出的社区参与型研究方法，分为四个阶段展开。第一阶段将收集2000年至2024年间发布的多种二手数据来源，包括媒体报道和游客评论，评估气候变化对喜马拉雅地区当地生计和游客体验的影响。这些数据将被整理为面板数据集，识别主题集群和情感模式。第二阶段将在中国和尼泊尔之间的三个山地旅游目的地——马卡鲁巴伦国家公园、马纳斯鲁保护区和萨加玛塔国家公园——收集定性数据，包括随行访谈、深度访谈和观察法。这些见解将揭示气候变化对当地生计和旅游生态系统的影响，以及当地社区和旅游利益相关者所采取的适应环境管理的措施（如可持续垃圾管理）。第三阶段将验证第二阶段的研究发现，并通过与当地社区和旅游利益相关者的共同创造，获得关于再生型山地旅游的新见解。 这种社区参与型研究方法（Hawkins等，2017）旨在共同制定切合地方情况和提升韧性的战略。最后，第四阶段将采用多标准决策分析方法，识别对山地旅游目的地最有效的气候适应实践。同时，将与当地社区和旅游利益相关者共同创建再生型山地旅游模型，包括制定可操作的原则和培训模块，以推动和应用再生型旅游实践。本研究承认山地旅游再生性可持续发展的多层次复杂性，强调生态、社会和经济系统的相互联系。研究成果将为促进山地旅游目的地的长期韧性和可持续发展提供宝贵的见解和建议。

15505325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505325.value: 超越合規：價值創造的永續發展治理範疇與特徵

15505325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505325.value: As sustainability performance comes under serious scrutiny, large European companies (and in due course, international companies with European operations) are subject to mandatory sustainability reporting for 2025 publication under the European’s Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive. While this new requirement heightens market entry barriers by emphasizing on corporate accountability, it calls for corporate efforts to develop sustainability governance (SG). SG refers to the practices and framework defining the scope of monitoring and control, rules and policies, and stakeholder responsibilities that align with organizational objectives, strategic oversight, resource allocation, and compliance. SG is instrumental to pinpoint risks and opportunities, and address impacts in operations. It is essential for prioritizing and directing organizational efforts and resources to address environmental and social impacts while achieving economic gains. However, despite the listed firms in Hong Kong disclosing their sustainability efforts since 2016, and many others voluntarily reporting their sustainability performance, only a few provide the SG scope and guidelines of monitoring and controls on firms’ sustainability efforts. Little is known about SG with oversight that concerns accountability, integrity, compliance, and performance monitoring in operations. Although prior studies have examined the performance implications of SG in terms of sustainability disclosure and board member composition, the performance impacts of different scopes of SG and their key characteristics remain unknown. This hinders establishment of SG as firms have little reference of practices and lack justification to develop SG. Managers are also uninformed about the operating conditions that benefit (or impede) SG performance. Process complexity, resources availability, and stakeholder involvement as key operating conditions affect the success of firms’ sustainability efforts. These research gaps are undesirable as managers are unable to strategize SG to cater to their operating conditions to achieve desirable results. A multimethod research design that includes topic modeling with machine learning and event studies will be adopted. The results will contribute to theoretical and practical advancements, providing insights into (i) the scope and characteristics of sustainability governance, (ii) the environmental, social, and financial performance values of sustainability governance, (iii) the operating conditions that benefit (or impede) performance outcomes of sustainability governance, and (vi) managerial and policy insights into sustainability governance and its development. 隨著可持續發展績效受到嚴格審視，歐洲大型企業（以及隨後在歐洲有業務的國際企業）將根據歐盟《企業可持續發展報告指令》（CSRD），於2025年起強制披露可持續發展報告。這一新規定提高了市場准入門檻，並強調企業在環境和社會方面的努力，因此企業必須加強可持續發展治理（SG），以促進價值創造。可持續發展治理（SG）指的是界定監督與控制範疇、規則與政策，以及利益相關者責任的實踐和框架，這些都需與組織目標、戰略監督、資源分配和合規要求保持一致。SG有助於識別風險與機遇，並處理營運中的影響。它對於組織優先分配和引導資源以應對其環境和社會影響，同時實現經濟效益至關重要。 然而，儘管香港上市公司自2016年起已披露其可持續發展工作，且許多其他公司也自願報告其可持續發展績效，但只有少數公司提供有關可持續發展治理範疇及監督控制指引。關於涵蓋問責、誠信、合規及績效監控的SG監督機制，現有認識甚少。此外，雖然以往研究探討了SG在可持續發展披露和董事會成員組成方面的績效影響，但不同SG範疇及其關鍵特徵對績效的影響仍屬未知。這阻礙了SG的建立，因為企業缺乏實踐參考和發展SG的正當理由。管理者也不了解有利（或阻礙）SG績效的運作條件。流程複雜性、資源可用性和利益相關者參與等運作條件會影響企業可持續發展工作的成效。這些研究空白不利於管理者根據自身運作條件制定SG策略以取得理想成果。本研究將採用多方法研究設計，包括機器學習主題建模和事件研究。研究結果將有助於理論和實務發展，並提供以下見解：(i) 可持續發展治理的範疇與特徵，(ii) 可持續發展治理的環境、社會及財務績效價值，(iii) 有利（或阻礙）可持續發展治理績效結果的運作條件，以及 (iv) 有關可持續發展治理及其發展的管理和政策啟示。

15505625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505625.value: 共同基金表现：中国交易与持仓数据的分析

15505625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505625.value: We utilize new proprietary data on daily fund holdings from the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) to examine the performance of active Chinese mutual funds. Existing research documents three surprising stylized facts on Chinese mutual funds. Chinese mutual funds 1) earn high alphas (9\% annually), 2) trade frequently (500\% turnover annually), and 3) exhibit persistence performance. Our proposal seeks to rationalize these findings by developing and testing two related hypotheses. First, we hypothesize that fund performance is related to fund turnover because it reflects superior information or the ability to exploit arbitrage opportunities at certain times. Second, we examine the periods when funds increase their trading. Given the strong influence of government policy on Chinese equities, we hypothesize that the ability to anticipate and incorporate policy uncertainty may partially explain fund performance and turnover in China. Our granular data allow us to extend existing studies because we can construct daily fund turnover measures and link turnover directly to performance. Although our focus is on policy shocks and macro news, we compare trading around periods of policy uncertainty with trading around firm-level market moving information, such as corporate earnings announcements, mergers and acquisitions, and reverse mergers. Hence, we can investigate the ability of fund managers to incorporate both private information and public information, and also examine whether fund managers are providing liquidity. To our knowledge, no study examines whether mutual fund managers can time and profitably trade on policy uncertainty. Developing research on the Chinese asset management industry aligns with the RGC's goals of creating significant impact for Hong Kong, China, and Asian economies. Our findings should have important consequences for investors, regulators, and policy makers. Investors can use the findings to better understand the risks and rewards of investing in Chinese mutual funds. Regulators and policymakers can use the findings to develop more effective policies to protect investors and support the development of Chinese capital markets. 我们利用上海证券交易所（SSE）提供的有关基金每日持仓情况的全新专有数据，来研究中国主动型共同基金的表现。现有研究总结出了有关中国共同基金的三个令人惊讶的典型事实：中国共同基金 1）获得较高的阿尔法收益（年均9%）；2）交易频繁（年换手率达500%）；3）表现出持续的业绩表现。 我们的研究提案旨在通过提出并检验两个相关假设来合理解释这些发现。首先，我们假设基金表现与基金换手率相关，因为在某些时期，换手率反映了基金拥有更优质的信息或具备把握套利机会的能力。其次，我们研究基金增加交易的时期。鉴于中国政府政策对股票市场的重大影响，我们假设能够预期并吸收政策不确定性的能力，可能部分解释中国基金的表现和换手率。 我们的精细数据使我们能够扩展现有研究，因为我们可以构建每日基金换手率的度量指标，并将换手率直接与基金表现挂钩。尽管我们的重点是政策冲击和宏观经济新闻，我们也会将政策不确定性时期的交易情况与公司层面影响市场的信息（如企业盈利公告、并购活动和反向并购）时期的交易情况进行比较。因此，我们可以研究基金经理整合私人信息和公共信息的能力，并检验基金经理是否在提供市场流动性。据我们所知，目前尚无研究探讨共同基金经理是否能够把握政策不确定性时机并从中盈利。 对中国资产管理行业开展深入研究，符合香港研究资助局（RGC）致力于为香港、中国以及亚洲经济体创造重大影响的目标。我们的研究结果对于投资者、监管机构和政策制定者都将具有重要意义。投资者可以借此更好地理解投资中国共同基金的风险与回报；监管机构和政策制定者则可以据此制定更有效的政策，以保护投资者利益并推动中国资本市场的发展。

15506125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506125.value: 混合助推，切實見效：推動活動參與者踐行塑料環保行為

15506125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15506125.value: Prof Benckendorff, Pierre Dr Jiang, Yawei

15506125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506125.value: The escalating plastic waste crisis significantly contributes to greenhouse emissions, exacerbating the effects of climate change. While governmental regulations play a crucial role in reducing plastic waste, substantial behavioral changes are essential for effective mitigation. The events sector faces a critical challenge as plastic constitutes a large portion of waste generated by attendees. Engaging event-goers to reduce plastic waste is paramount, yet the effectiveness of current interventions remains limited. Prior research has explored nudging as a behavioral intervention, primarily through green nudging (promoting pro-environmental behaviors) and digital nudging (influencing decisionmaking through altering digital interfaces). As digital technologies become increasingly integrated into events, they present opportunities to deliver targeted behavioral interventions. However, the effectiveness of digital nudging in driving actual behavior change remains controversial. Despite the urgent need for effective interventions, there is a notable lack of nudging strategies that go beyond government regulations to drive event-goers’ on-site plastic-wise behavior. Investigating the integration of digital nudging with green nudging will provide valuable insights to inform the design and implementation of more effective nudging techniques. This research addresses this critical gap by introducing “blended nudging”, involving building up nudging effects over time (different phases of event) across different spaces (digital, physical, and blended environments) to encourage plastic-wise behaviors among event-goers. We conceptualize blended nudging as a cumulative process comprising two modes: temporal and spatial nudging. Temporal nudging involve applying interventions consistently over a period to reinforce behavior change, whereas spatial nudging represent applying interventions across different spaces to create a widespread impact. For instance, an event-goer might view a website with visual emphasis on reducing plastic waste when booking event tickets (framing), notice strategically placed recycling bins, receive pop-up reminders through smartphone during the event (in-time prompts), and obtain insights on plastic consumption after the event (feedback). Through this blended nudging process, the effectiveness of nudging may be enhanced. This research contributes to knowledge on three fronts:1) theorizing nudging as a blended behavioral intervention system involving temporal and spatial modes as two intertwining components; 2) advancing nudging effects by examining a mixture of different nudging techniques across time and space; 3) developing a comprehensive picture of nudging by considering an event-goer’s entire journey. Lastly, this research provides manageable insights into the feasibility and effect of nudging to promote plastic-wise behaviors and facilitate green event planning management. 不斷加劇的塑膠廢棄物危機是溫室氣體排放的重要誘因，進一步加劇了氣候變化的影響。儘管政府監管在減少塑膠廢棄物方面發揮著關鍵作用，但要有效緩解這一問題，還需依靠人們行為方式的重大轉變。活動行業正面臨一項嚴峻挑戰：參與者產生的廢棄物中，塑膠占比極高。推動活動參與者減少塑膠廢棄物至關重要，但當前干預措施的效果仍十分有限。 此前的研究已將「助推」作為一種行為干預手段展開探索，主要包括綠色助推（促進親環境行為）和數位助推（通過改變數位介面影響決策）。隨著數位技術日益融入各類活動，它們為實施有針對性的行為干預創造了機會。然而，數位助推在推動實際行為改變方面的有效性仍存在爭議。儘管迫切需要有效的干預措施，但目前除政府監管外，能夠推動活動參與者在現場踐行塑膠環保行為的助推策略明顯不足。研究數位助推與綠色助推的融合，將為設計和實施更有效的助推方法提供寶貴啟示。 本研究通過提出「混合助推」概念填補這一關鍵空白，即通過在活動不同階段（時間維度）和不同空間（數位空間、物理空間及混合空間）逐步累積助推效果，鼓勵活動參與者踐行塑膠環保行為。我們將混合助推定義為一個包含時間助推和空間助推的累積過程：時間助推指在一定時期內持續實施干預以強化行為改變，空間助推則指在不同空間實施干預以擴大影響範圍。例如，活動參與者可能在預訂門票時看到強調減少塑膠廢棄物的網站頁面（框架效應），在現場注意到精心放置的回收箱，活動期間通過智慧型手機收到彈窗提醒（即時提示），活動結束後還能獲取自身塑膠消費情況的反饋。通過這種混合助推過程，助推的整體效果有望得到提升。 本研究在三個方面貢獻新知：1）將助推理論化為包含時間和空間兩個交織維度的混合行為干預系統；2）通過檢驗不同時空下多種助推技術的組合應用，提升助推效果；3）通過關注活動參與者的完整參與歷程，構建更全面的助推圖景。最後，本研究將為推動塑膠環保行為、助力綠色活動規劃管理的助推策略提供切實可行的見解，包括其可行性與實際效果。

15507425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15507425.value: 探索人機協作對研發與設計從業者創造力與工作繁榮的雙重影響

15507425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507425.value: Creativity, traditionally seen as a hallmark of human ingenuity, is now being redefined by the advent of generative AI (GenAI), which can produce human-like novel content across text, images, and music. This shift is profoundly impacting the creative industry, making it essential to understand how collaboration with GenAI influences creative professionals. This proposed research aims to explore the effects of human-AI (HAI) collaboration on creative performance and personal growth among creative professionals, with a focus on potential changes in their self-perceptions. We examine the work experiences of these professionals following the integration of GenAI technologies in their work and propose a dual-path framework. This framework conceptualizes the dual effects of HAI collaboration on creative performance and thriving at work, depending on the tendencies of HAI collaboration in the creative process. By investigating how HAI collaboration affects self-perceptions and subsequent work outcomes, we aim to reveal how different HAI collaboration tendencies can enhance or hinder professionals' creativity and personal growth. Understanding these mechanisms and factors will help individuals and organizations develop strategies to optimize GenAI usage for improved creative outcomes and personal development. To achieve these objectives, we will employ a mixed-methods approach, combining a field experimental study with a multi-wave, multi-source field study. Data will be collected among creative professionals from multiple organizations in different industries to ensure the generalizability of our findings. In doing so, we aim to gain rigorous insights into the impact of collaboration with GenAI on important work outcomes and identify key factors influencing different implications. This research seeks to generate knowledge with significant implications for both academia and practice. The outcomes could provide practical recommendations for organizations to effectively integrate GenAI into their creative processes. By identifying best practices and potential pitfalls, we aim to assist organizations in leveraging GenAI as a transformative tool that empowers employees, fosters creative outputs and personal growth, and sustains competitive advantage. By bridging the gap between HAI collaboration and employee creativity and development, we hope to unlock new avenues to empower organizations to navigate the digital age, and cultivate a workforce that thrives on sustainable innovation. 創造力一直被視為人類智慧的獨特之處，但隨著生成時人工智能的出現及廣泛使用，這一理解似乎正在被重塑。生成時人工智能在文字、圖像、音樂等多種媒介上能產生近似人類的原創內容，此趨勢對創意產業影響深遠，使我們有必要理解與 生成時人工智能協作如何影響研發及設計從業者。 本研究計畫旨在探討人機協作，特別是人與生成式人工智能的協作，對研發及設計從業者的創意表現與工作繁榮的影響，重點關注他們的自我認知可能發生的變化。我們將考察在工作中引入生成時人工智能技術後這些從業者的工作感受，並提出一個基於自我認知變化的雙路徑架構。該架構提出人機協作對創意表現與工作繁榮的雙重影響，且影響方向取決於創作流程中人機協作的不同模式。據此，我們希望探究人機協作的不同模式如何影響從業者的創新產出與個人學習與成長。 為達成上述目標，我們將採用混合方法研究設計，結合實地實驗研究與多輪次、多來源的實地研究。我們期望以嚴謹的研究方法探究人與生成式人工智能的協作對關鍵工作結果的影響，並找出導致差異性影響的關鍵因素。 本研究期望產出有助理解人機協作的實證洞見，並提供組織如何更有效把生成時人工智能整合進創作流程的實務建議，這將有助於個人與組織擬定策略，優化生成式人工智能的運用，以提升組織的創意成果與創新專業人士的個人發展。透過辨識最佳實踐與潛在風險，我們旨在協助組織把生成式人工智能作為具轉型力量的工具，賦能員工、促進創意產出與個人成長，並維持持久競爭優勢。

15508125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15508125.value: 环保诉讼与企业绿色创新

15508125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508125.value: With manually-collected data on the establishment of environmental courts in world-wide countries, we will evaluate whether the increase in firms’ expected environmental litigation cost affects firms’ green innovation outcomes. Relying on country-level institutional variables and firm-specific attributes, we will examine the heterogeneous effects of ECT-establishment in provoking green innovations. Furthermore, we will carry out path analysis to identify channels for environmental courts to enhance firms’ green innovations, possibly the reduction in financing cost or the improvement in ownership of socially institutional investors/internal sustainability infrastructure/media coverage on environmental controversies. Though green innovations help firms to adapt to and mitigate the climate risk, it is costly for firms to do so. Our project, with a large sample of international firms, will provide first evidence on the effectiveness of litigations in promoting firms to undertake such abatement efforts. 因为需要投入大量能源、人力和外包服务，企业减少污染（或减排）成本高昂。因此，尽管有研究认为环保投资可能带来收益，多数企业对此并不积极。政府作为重要的持份者，都会进行不同程度的引导和干预。本项目研究环保法庭的设立会否促进企业的绿色创新（减排的关键环节）。传统司法和行政部门在环保诉讼（如水污染、森林火灾、有毒排放等）中效率不足，而环保法庭具有以下特点：1）放宽起诉资格，便于公众参与环境诉讼；2）简化流程，配备技术专家，采用灵活解决方案，因此，一般认为环保法庭会增加企业的环保诉讼风险。与此同时，反对者质疑环保法庭是否真的改变了环保诉讼的本质。 我们将分析不同国家/地区环保法庭对企业进行绿色创新的影响。我们将手动收集各国首个环保法庭的设立时间（因其影响力最大），采用双重差分法比较企业的绿色创新的变化。我们预期：若环保法庭提高企业违规成本，将倒逼其增加绿色创新从而减少污染。我们预期这个效应在环保诉讼风险更高或者民众的环保意识更强烈的地区更明显。我们还将检验各企业的内部改革（如设立可持续发展部门、将高管薪酬与环保目标挂钩）或者面对的外部压力（如媒体监督、责任投资、融资成本变化）会否对绿色创新有影响。本研究首次通过全球数据揭示环境诉讼如何驱动企业绿色创新。尽管各界对环保法庭的效用有争议，但相关研究匮乏，我们的发现将填补这一空白，助力政策制定。

15508825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15508825.value: 稀缺的力量：揭示稀缺性在直播销售中的作用

15508825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508825.value: Livestream selling has rapidly become a dominant force in e-commerce, with the market in China surpassing 5 trillion yuan and projected to reach $57 billion in the U.S. by 2025. Scarcity, a powerful psychological driver of consumer behavior, has been eagerly adopted by influencers and brands. However, does the power of scarcity still hold in livestream selling? This research aims to explore this central question in the following ways. First, what are the scarcity tactics involved in the strategic planning of product offerings and session assortments in livestream selling? While prior research has examined how an influencer’s promotional pitches create a sense of scarcity, it is crucial to explore how supply restrictions imposed by brands and influencers function in this context. Through in-depth interviews with 10 practitioners, we identified two specific scarcity tactics: debut offers (new product introductions) and exclusive offers (products available only in a particular livestream). However, how these tactics impact both product-level and session-level sales remains unknown. Second, does the extensive use of scarcity tactics on individual products affect the overall perception of scarcity within a livestream session, and how does such session-level scarcity influence session sales? This distinction is crucial, as influencers and platforms are motivated not only to maximize individual product sales but also to enhance overall session performance. We propose that while perceived value drives the linear, positive effect of offer-specific scarcity on individual product sales, its interplay with perceived manipulativeness results in an inverted U-shaped relationship between session-level scarcity and session sales. Preliminary evidence from a dataset of one-month Douyin livestream sessions supports this inverted U-shaped effect, which we plan to further validate through a longitudinal dataset and controlled experiments. Third, under what boundary conditions do the effects of offer-specific and session-level scarcity on sales vary? We predict that both influencer size and thematic nature of livestream sessions act as double-edged swords. While these factors strengthen the positive impact of scarcity on perceived value, they also heighten the negative impact of excessive proportion of scarce offers rises on consumer suspicion of manipulative intent. This research offers a comprehensive examination of scarcity in livestream selling, providing actionable insights for brands and influencers seeking to optimize their use of scarcity tactics. By distinguishing between offer-specific and session-level scarcity, our study contributes to the broader literature on scarcity marketing and the evolving field of influencer-driven livestream commerce. 直播销售已迅速成为电子商务中的主导力量。在中国，该市场规模已突破5万亿元人民币，在美国则预计将在2025年达到570亿美元。作为一种强大的消费者心理驱动因素，稀缺性已被众多网红和品牌积极运用。然而，稀缺的力量在直播销售中是否有效？本研究旨在通过以下几个方面探索这一核心问题。 首先，在直播销售中，品牌在产品策划和场次组合的战略规划中采用了哪些稀缺策略？ 尽管已有研究探讨了网红如何通过促销话术营造稀缺感，但有必要进一步研究品牌和网红所施加的供给限制在该情境中的实际作用。通过对10位从业者的深度访谈，我们识别出两种具体的稀缺策略：首发优惠（新品首发）和专属优惠（仅在特定直播中可购买的产品）。然而，这些策略对产品层级和场次层级销售的影响仍未得到充分了解。 其次，在单个产品上广泛使用稀缺策略，是否会影响消费者对整个直播场次的稀缺性感知？而这种“场次层级稀缺性”又将如何影响整体销售表现？ 这一区分至关重要，因为网红和平台的目标不仅是最大化单品销售，更是提升整场直播的表现。我们提出：产品层级稀缺性的积极作用主要通过感知价值驱动，呈现线性正向关系；但在场次层面，稀缺性的作用则与感知操控性互动，呈现倒U型关系。来自抖音直播的一个月数据提供了初步证据，支持这一倒U型效应。我们计划通过更长期的追踪数据与控制实验进一步验证该效应。 第三，在什么样的边界条件下，产品层级和场次层级稀缺性对销售的影响会发生变化？ 我们预测，网红的影响力大小以及直播场次的主题性质将呈现“双刃剑”效应：一方面，这些因素会强化稀缺性对感知价值的正面影响；另一方面，当稀缺优惠的比例过高时，也会加剧消费者对操控行为的怀疑，从而削弱其正面效果。 本研究对直播销售中的稀缺性进行了系统性探讨，为品牌和网红优化稀缺策略的使用提供了可操作的洞见。通过区分“产品层级稀缺性”与“场次层级稀缺性”，本研究不仅丰富了稀缺性营销的理论体系，也为日益发展的直播电商领域贡献了新的研究视角。

15509625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15509625.value: 現代企業的生產技術與成本結構

15509625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15509625.value: Prof Chang, Xin Dr Kwok, Wing Chun

15509625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509625.value: “Our understanding of how markets and businesses operate was passed down to us more than a century ago … It is an understanding based squarely upon the assumption of diminishing returns … And it still thrives in today’s economics textbooks. But steadily and continuously in this century, Western economies have undergone a transformation … As this shift has occurred, the underlying mechanisms that determine economic behavior have shifted from ones of diminishing to ones of increasing returns.” - (Brian Arthur, 1996) The corporate production function describes how firms convert their inputs into outputs. For more than a century, diminishing marginal productivity (or diminishing returns) has been a fundamental principle of economics, and a concave production function has been used in most economic analyses, with important implications for corporate decisions and resource allocation (see e.g., Mas-Colell, Whinston and Green, 1995). However, some studies argue that economic analysis should not be limited to a narrow class of concave production functions (see e.g., Skiba, 1978; Azariadis and Drazen, 1990; Penharkar, Rodger, and Subramanian, 2008). In particular, Li, Ma, and Su (2023) document that the corporate production function changed from concave to sigmoid (convex-concave) in the 1990s, and that the shape of the production function varies across firms. They show that such sigmoid production function has implications for firms’ net earnings, market power, and asset prices—implications that appear to find support in real-world data and are inconsistent with the traditional assumption of a concave production function. Does production technology (as captured by the shape of the production function) change over time and vary across firms? If so, what are the implications for firms’ choice of committed fixed vs variable activity resources (i.e., their cost structure [or equivalently, operating leverage] decision)? This project attempts to answer these questions. Specifically, this project will apply the Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo changepoint estimation method to estimate the underlying shape of the corporate production function over time and across firms. As there is no existing theory informing us on how the shape of the sigmoid production function affects firm cost structure choice, this project will develop one based on Banker, Byzalov, and Plehn-Dujowich’s (2014) cost structure choice model and derive the theoretical predictions. These predictions will then empirically be tested using the estimated shape of the corporate production function. 企業生產函數描述了公司如何將投入轉化為產出。超過一個世紀以來，邊際生產力遞減（或報酬遞減）一直是經濟學的基本原則，而凹型生產函數在大多數經濟分析中被廣泛使用，對企業決策和資源配置具有重要影響（參見例如 Mas-Colell、Whinston & Green，1995）。然而，一些研究認為，經濟分析不應侷限於狹窄的凹型生產函數類別（參見例如 Skiba，1978；Azariadis & Drazen，1990；Penharkar、Rodger & Subramanian，2008）。 特別是，Li、Ma & Su（2023）指出，企業生產函數在1990年代由凹型轉變為S型（凸-凹型），且生產函數的形狀在不同公司之間有所差異。他們展示了這種S型生產函數對企業淨收益、市場力量和資產價格具有影響——這些影響在現實數據中似乎得到了支持，並與傳統凹型生產函數的假設不一致。那麼，生產技術（由生產函數的形狀所反映）是否會隨時間改變並在不同公司之間有所差異？如果是這樣，對企業在固定與變動活動資源（即其成本結構或營運槓桿）選擇上會有什麼影響？本研究計畫旨在回答這些問題。 具體而言，本研究將應用貝葉斯馬可夫鏈蒙地卡羅變點估計方法，以估計企業生產函數在時間和公司間的潛在形狀。由於目前尚無理論告訴我們S型生產函數的形狀如何影響企業成本結構的選擇，本研究將基於Banker、Byzalov & Plehn-Dujowich（2014）的成本結構選擇模型，發展相關理論並推導理論預測。這些預測將以估計出的企業生產函數形狀進行實證檢驗。

15509825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15509825.value: 国际财务报告准则可持续性披露标准在全球的采用

15509825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509825.value: Sustainability is a defining issue of our time. As of today, firms’ sustainability disclosures are largely voluntary. While there has been significant investors’ demand for globally consistent sustainability disclosure standards, it was only recently that such standards have been introduced. Specifically, the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Foundation’s International Sustainability Standards Board in 2023 issued IFRS S1 General requirements for disclosure of sustainability-related financial information and IFRS S2 Climate-related disclosures. Effective from annual reporting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2024, IFRS S1 and S2 require an entity to disclose information about all sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities, respectively, that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s cash flows, its access to finance or cost of capital over the short, medium or long term. These standards are expected to revolutionize mandated sustainability disclosures. We propose to study the jurisdiction-level determinants and firm-level consequences of IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards adoption. Regarding the determinants, we observe that many jurisdictions are gradually adopting these standards, as they are taking time to evaluate the costs and benefits of the adoption, as well as to consider whether to make any modifications prior to adoption. We intend to focus on three determinants: i) economic development, ii) reporting enforcement, and iii) prior experience of adopting sustainability disclosure standards. Regarding adoption consequences, we focus on four: i) the firm’s sustainability performance, ii) its financial performance, iii) media coverage of the firm’s sustainability-related issues, and iv) its equity ownership held by environmental, social and governance (ESG) funds. When studying the consequences, we also plan to conduct further heterogeneity analyses based on governmental focus on sustainability issues. To conduct more comprehensive analyses, we will use a mixed methods approach comprising i) empirical archival analyses, using the staggered difference-in-differences research design, ii) surveys, and iii) interviews. We expect to write both academic and practitioner articles, as well as engage in industry collaborations, as a result of our research. Since the standards only came into effect earlier this year, significant funding is required for this study because much of the data will need to be acquired and processed as it becomes available, including data obtained through the conduct of surveys and interviews. We believe that the findings in our study will extend the literature on sustainability disclosures and contribute to policymaking on mandated sustainability disclosures.

15510925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15510925.value: 打造供应链韧性：基于数据驱动的网络设计

15510925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510925.value: In recent years, there have been numerous disruptions in global supply chains, drawing significant attention to the concept of supply chain resilience. Supply chain resilience refers to the ability of a supply chain to withstand and recover from disruptions. Our project aims to enhance supply chain resilience through a network design model that simultaneously optimizes decisions regarding supply chain configuration, manufacturing, inventory, and transportation. We explicitly consider two resilience metrics: time to recover (TTR) and time to survive (TTS). TTR measures the duration required for the supply chain to fully recover from disruptions, while TTS determines how long the customer service level can be sustained after a disruption occurs. Our objective is to achieve predetermined levels of TTR and TTS while minimizing the total expected supply chain cost. This specific feature is novel in the existing literature, and we believe it will result in improved supply chain resilience. Furthermore, our optimization framework enables us to examine the impact of resilience on various supply chain performance indicators, including cost, service level, and lead time. This analysis provides valuable insights into determining the appropriate level of resilience for a given supply chain. Additionally, we can evaluate the effectiveness of various supply chain risk mitigation strategies, shedding light on which strategies should be implemented under different scenarios. To formulate the network design model, we plan to adopt a data-driven distributionally robust optimization approach within a two-stage framework. This approach offers the advantage of leveraging historical data while mitigating the risk of overfitting. However, the resulting model poses significant computational challenges due to the presence of binary integer decision variables for network considerations, distributionally robust objectives aimed at minimizing the worst-case expected cost within an ambiguity set of probability distributions, and distributionally robust chance constraints that must be satisfied for all distributions within the ambiguity set. To address these challenges, we will employ various techniques to analyze the model's structural properties and utilize specialized methods for distributionally robust optimization, integer programming, and large-scale optimization. In our preliminary study, we have developed a cutting-plane algorithm for the model with TTS considerations. In this project, we aim to enhance this algorithm and examine the model with both TTR and TTS. Our goal is to create customized algorithms that efficiently solve the proposed model while also advancing solution techniques for network design and distributionally robust problems. 近年来，全球供应链屡遭中断，引发了对供应链韧性的广泛关注。供应链韧性是指供应链抵御中断并从中迅速恢复的能力。本项目旨在通过网络设计来增强供应链韧性。在优化供应链网络配置、制造、库存和运输方面的决策过程中，我们特别考虑了两个韧性指标：恢复时间（TTR）和生存时间（TTS）。TTR衡量供应链从中断中完全恢复所需的时间，而TTS则决定了发生中断后客户服务水平能够持续多久。我们的目标是在实现预定的TTR和TTS水平的同时，最小化预期供应链总成本。我们相信这一研究特色能有效增强供应链韧性，在文献中也具有创新性。此外，该优化框架让我们能够研究韧性对成本、服务水平和交货时间等供应链绩效指标的影响。这些分析能为确定供应链应具备的韧性水平提供重要见解。我们还可以评估各种供应链风险缓解策略的有效性，从而明晰在不同情境下应采取哪些策略。 为构建网络设计模型，我们计划采用两阶段数据驱动的分布式鲁棒优化方法。此方法的优势在于利用历史数据的同时降低过度拟合的风险。然而，该模型的求解却具有相当的难度，具体表现在以下方面：网络设计中存在0-1决策变量，分布式鲁棒目标需要在概率分布的模糊集合内最小化最坏情况下的预期成本，以及分布式鲁棒机会约束需要在分布模糊集内所有分布下均得到满足。为应对这些挑战，我们将采用各种技术来分析模型的结构属性，并运用针对分布鲁棒优化、整数规划和大规模优化等问题的专门求解方法。在初步研究中，我们已就考虑TTS的模型开发了相应的割平面算法。在本项目中，我们将进一步改进此算法，并研究同时考虑TTR和TTS的模型的求解方法。我们的目标是通过特定的算法有效地解决所提出的模型，并期望能推动一般性网络设计和分布鲁棒问题的求解方案研究。

15511925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511925.value: 基于最优传输的双边特征选择建模方法

15511925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511925.value: Choice modeling is a pivotal technique for analyzing and forecasting consumer preferences and behaviors, widely applicable across fields such as operations management and economics. Traditionally, this modeling has been constrained to a singular perspective, typically analyzing homogenous consumers' choices over products to develop analytical tools that predict choice probabilities based on diverse product features. However, the conventional one-sided approach fails to capture the complexities of modern market dynamics where both sides of the market are heterogeneous and make decisions simultaneously. A typical example is the seller-consumer dynamics over digital marketplaces: while consumers are searching among various sellers that provide the best-fit products & services, sellers are also seeking consumers who are willing to provide the highest price. Developing choice models that can effectively account for these two-sided dynamics introduces several challenges: How can we integrate and compare the heterogeneity from both sides? How can we model the random choices made by both sides while also considering their impact on corresponding revenue management decision-making? Furthermore, can we develop effective learning algorithms for the two-sided model and provide insights for the study of choice estimation? In essence, two-sided choice modeling, which considers the heterogeneity and simultaneous choice-making of both sides, is vital for both practical applications and academic understanding. It provides deeper insights into the complexities of interactions within digital marketplaces and represents a valuable extension of traditional one-sided choice models, warranting thorough exploration and analysis. In this proposal, we plan to examine a two-sided feature-based choice model, employing optimal transport theory to facilitate simultaneous choice-making and seamlessly integrate features from both consumers and sellers into a cohesive framework. We conceptualize the two-sided choice interactions between sellers and consumers as a matching process, where each participant aligns optimally with the best possible counterpart. To effectively capture the inherent randomness in these choices, we incorporate a random surplus function into the traditional optimal transport framework. Our research will focus on evaluating how this two-sided choice model can enhance revenue management decisions, particularly in the platform's service fee design and sellers' pricing and assortment planning, and extract managerial insights from these analyses. Additionally, we will develop a novel learning algorithm for the two-sided choice model that leverages the structure of the optimal transport framework and demonstrates its asymptotic properties. Comprehensive numerical experiments, utilizing both synthetic and real data, will be conducted to assess the model and learning algorithm's effectiveness. 选择建模是分析和预测消费者偏好与行为的重要技术，在运筹管理与经济学等众多领域均有广泛应用。传统上，这类建模通常仅限于单一视角，主要分析同质化消费者对产品的选择，并据此开发能够基于多样化产品特征预测选择概率的分析工具。然而，经典的单边建模方法难以刻画现代市场中双边主体异质且同时决策所带来的复杂动态。以数字化市场平台上的买卖双方为例：消费者在众多商家中寻找最契合的商品和服务，而商家则在追寻愿意支付最高价格的消费者。有效刻画这种双边互动的选择模型带来诸多挑战：我们如何整合并比较双边主体的异质性？如何同时建模双方的随机选择行为，并将其对相关收益管理决策的影响纳入考虑？此外，能否针对双边模型开发有效的估计算法，并为选择估计的研究提供新见解？实质上，考虑双方异质性与同步决策的双边选择建模，对于实际应用与理论理解都具有重要意义。这一建模方法能更深入揭示数字化市场中互动关系的复杂性，是对传统单边选择模型的重要拓展，值得系统深入地研究与分析。 本项目计划考察一种基于特征的双边选择模型，采用最优传输理论以实现消费者与商家的同步选择，并将双方的特征无缝整合到统一框架中。我们将商家与消费者之间的双边选择互动建模为一个匹配过程，使每一方都能与最优对象配对。为有效捕捉选择过程中的随机性，我们在传统最优传输框架中引入随机盈余函数。研究将聚焦于探讨该双边选择模型如何助力平台服务费设计、商家定价及产品组合规划等关键收益管理决策，并由此提炼管理洞见。此外，我们将开发一种新型的双边选择模型学习算法，充分利用最优传输框架的结构，并论证其渐近性质。最后，我们将通过大量数值实验（涵盖合成与真实数据）对所提模型与算法的有效性进行评估。

15512225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512225.value: 揭示隐藏收费：信息披露对房地产市场的影响

15512225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512225.value: The proliferation of e-commerce and online platforms has significantly enhanced the transparency of product information, aiding consumers in price discovery and comparison. However, transparency in pricing for one of life’s most significant purchases—housing—lags behind other markets. While property transaction prices are readily available online, real estate agents’ commission rates remain opaque. This proposed research empirically investigates the impact of information disclosure on real estate agent commission rates. Leveraging a regulatory intervention, we construct a unique dataset from a major property transaction platform, encompassing detailed information on property transactions and agent commissions from 2012 to 2023 across 12 metropolitan areas. This study aims to address four pivotal questions: (1) How has the enforcement of information disclosure affected real estate agents’ commission rates? (2) To what extent has this policy disrupted traditional brokerage industry commission norms, enhanced market competition, and mitigated moral hazard? (3) How has increased transparency influenced real estate market performance and property owners’ welfare? And (4) how have these effects varied across different residential areas and ethnic communities? Furthermore, by exploring the underlying mechanisms, we aim to unpack any pre-existing racial disparities in market information access and assess whether information disclosure can mitigate these disparities and reduce segregation in residential property transactions. This research offers comprehensive insights into commission rate transparency, providing valuable guidance for policymakers and industry stakeholders. By bridging the gap between theory and practice, this study aims to contribute to the literature on real estate economics and market transparency. 随着电子商务和在线平台的快速发展，产品信息的透明度显著提升，极大地方便了消费者进行价格发现与比较。然而，就人生最重要的消费之一——住房而言，其价格透明度却远远落后于其他市场。尽管目前房产成交价格已可便捷查询，但房地产经纪人的佣金费率依然不透明。本研究拟以实证方法考察信息披露制度对房地产经纪人佣金费率的影响。 我们将以一项监管政策为契机，利用某大型房产交易平台的数据，构建涵盖2012年至2023年间、覆盖12个主要城市的独特数据集，囊括了详尽的房产交易与经纪人佣金信息。研究将围绕以下核心问题展开：1. 信息披露政策的实施，对房地产经纪人的佣金水平产生了怎样的影响？2. 该政策在多大程度上打破了传统的中介行业佣金定价惯例，是否提升了市场竞争？3. 透明度的提升对房地产市场绩效和消费者福利的作用如何？ 此外，研究还将采用双重差分（DID）方法框架，探讨不同族裔社区中上述政策效果的异同；通过剖析背后的作用机制，揭示原有的信息获取种族差异，并进一步评估信息披露政策是否有助于缩小这些差距、减少居住区隔离现象。整体而言，本研究将系统分析佣金透明度的影响，为政策制定者和行业参与者提供重要参考，也有望在理论与实践之间建立桥梁，进一步推动房地产经济学和市场透明度领域的学术发展。

15512325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512325.value: 基于消费者购物轨迹和前沿机器学习算法对消费者偏好进行洞察

15512325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512325.value: My recent work (Hao and Yao 2024) develops a machine learning algorithm, based on the popular word-to-vector (word2vec) approach, to obtain insights about marketing structure within shopping malls using customer shopping trajectories. The algorithm can accommodate the specific context of each store visit, or what other stores are visited prior to as well as immediately after this particular visit. This proposal seeks to further develop this line of research on understanding shopper preferences and behaviours using shopping trajectory data and advanced machine learning algorithms. One direction is to develop a machine learning algorithm, based on hypergraph learning, which can accommodate the fact that multiple store visits, or the co-occurrence of stores, take place in a single shopping trajectory. Another direction is to, based on dynamic graph learning, accommodate the fact that customers may have dynamic perceptions about the different stores within a shopping malls, which consequently lead to dynamic relationships among stores. It is expected that the proposed studies will deepen our understanding of the shoppers and make better predictions about their behaviours, which can shed light on optimal layout plans of shopping malls and useful marketing strategies to engage with shoppers. 我最近进行中的工作（Hao and Yao 2024）开发了一种机器学习算法，基于流行的词向量（word2vec）方法，利用客户购物轨迹来提取关于商场内的市场结构的见解。该算法考虑到了每次商店访问的特定上下文，也就是说，在每次商店访问之前以及之后，购物者还访问了哪些其他商店。本研究提案旨在进一步开发利用消费者购物轨迹数据、基于前沿机器学习算法的新模型，以更好地了解购物者偏好和行为。本提案有两个具体方向。第一个方向是开发一种基于超图学习的机器学习算法，它会考虑到如下情况：单个购物轨迹往往包含了多次商店访问，也就是多个商店同时出现在一次购物轨迹中，体现了它们之间的相似性。另一个方向基于动态图学习，并考虑如下情况：顾客对商场内的不同商店的认知和喜好可能会随时间而变化，这种变化进而导致了商店之间有动态关系。这两个方向的研究成果预计将加深我们对购物者的了解，并对他们的行为做出更好的预测，这可以为商场的最佳布局计划以及开发与购物者有效互动的营销策略提供参考。

15513125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15513125.value: 共享经济赋能上游制造端：基于网约车服务与汽车质量改进的实证研究

15513125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15513125.value: This research explores whether the sharing economy can benefit upstream manufacturers. The sharing economy, characterized by platform-based models that facilitate the efficient exchange of underutilized resources, has revolutionized downstream industries like ride-hailing. However, its potential to enhance upstream production processes remains underexplored. Focusing on automobile manufacturers, this study addresses the critical question of whether ride-sharing services can improve product quality and feedback mechanisms for vehicle manufacturers. In this study, we empirically explore this question through a two-step analysis. First, we examine whether ridesharing can enhance both the volume and quality of reviews from drivers on platforms. Subsequently, we investigate whether ridesharing can assist upstream manufacturers in improving product quality. We propose that vehicle models involved in ride-sharing services, such as those operating on platforms like Didi, experience more frequent and intensive use compared to personal-use vehicles. This higher level of utilization accelerates wear and tear, revealing design flaws and performance issues more rapidly. However, the sharing economy’s bidirectional feedback systems offer manufacturers a unique opportunity to leverage high-frequency, high-quality input from ridesharing drivers, who are more engaged and reliant on their vehicles for professional use. This feedback is not only more frequent but also more technical and detailed, allowing manufacturers to address product deficiencies faster and improve vehicle robustness. To examine these postulations, we employ a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) methodology, using data from the Didi platform, Autohome, Marklines, and the China Auto Recall Network. Our dataset will cover 1,823 car models from 139 brands in China, spanning the period from 2013 to 2023. We will analyze review volume and quality, frequency of product updates, and product recall rates to assess whether ride-sharing participation influences the quantity and quality of vehicle reviews and subsequently vehicle quality. We will examine if car models involved in ride-sharing services receive more reviews and higher-quality feedback compared to vehicle models which are not involved in ridesharing. We further postulate that these cars experience more frequent updates from manufacturers and exhibit lower recall rates, suggesting that the sharing economy might indeed benefit upstream manufacturers by expediting product improvements and reducing costly recalls. This research will contribute to the literature by testing if the sharing economy’s benefits extend beyond downstream service providers and consumers, offering significant advantages for upstream manufacturers through enhanced feedback loops and accelerated product refinements. 本文旨在探究共享经济对上游制造商的赋能作用。作为一种以平台化资源配置为核心的新型经济范式，共享经济在网约车等下游服务领域已实现显著变革，但其对上游制造业生产优化的潜在影响尚未得到系统性验证。本研究聚焦汽车制造业，从产品质量升级与反馈机制优化双重视角，揭示网约车服务对上游制造商的赋能路径。 本研究首先从信息反馈角度出发，检验网约车服务是否能够促进司机端评价的数量与质量；在此基础上,进一步研究网约车服务是否有助于上游制造商改进产品质量及其驱动机制。研究提出，网约车运营车辆（如滴滴平台认证车型）相较于私家车具有更密集的使用强度，这种差异化使用模式会通过两种渠道影响质量演进：（1）物理加速机制：高强度使用加速零部件损耗，使设计缺陷更早暴露；（2）信息强化机制：职业司机群体因经济依赖性和专业认知，其反馈信息具有更高技术密度与问题指向性，从而优化制造商的缺陷识别效率。 为验证上述假设，本研究构建2013-2023年中国汽车行业面板数据集，覆盖139个品牌的1,823款车型，数据来源包括滴滴平台运营数据、汽车之家数据、Marklines供应链数据库及国家质检总局召回公告。研究采用双重差分法（DiD）作为主模型，聚焦汽车评价的数量与质量、产品更新频率及召回率等核心变量，探究网约车服务是否影响汽车评价的数量与质量，并最终改善产品质量。本研究为共享经济赋能制造业转型升级提供了微观证据，揭示了"使用场景-数据反馈-质量迭代"的正向循环机制，对供应链协同创新具有重要启示。

15600125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600125.value: 針對香港華語及非華語一年級學童的中文語素意識混合式動態評估：一項多階段混合方法研究

15600125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15600125.value: Dr Jin, Rui Dr Lin, Chin-Hsi Prof Sheng, Li Dr Yan, Xun

15600125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600125.value: Dynamic assessment (DA), which focuses on learning potential by measuring responses to teaching, offers an alternative to static assessments that often yield inaccurate predictions for children from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. However, the impacts of DA vary, mainly due to differences in DA implementation approaches (quantitative interventionist, qualitative interactionist, and hybrid), learning potential measurement, teachers’ appraisals, and educational contexts. This research explores a hybrid approach to implementing computerized DA of Chinese morphological awareness, a critical predictor of Chinese reading development, for Chinese-speaking and non-Chinese-speaking children in Hong Kong. It addresses four research questions: (1) How do Hong Kong primary school Chinese teachers perceive computerized DA of Chinese morphological awareness? (2) Does computerized DA of Chinese morphological awareness, compared to static assessment, provide more accurate predication and classification of Chinese reading ability at Grade One for both Chinese-speaking and non-Chinese-speaking students? (3) Do the teachers’ ratings of students’ learning potentials change before and after the computerized DA of Chinese morphological awareness? If yes, are teachers’ ratings associated with teaching experience and self-perceived efficacy? (4) How do the teachers use the dynamic assessment outcomes to make instructional decisions? A mixed-method study of multiphase exploratory sequential design is conducted. In Phase One, we conduct a focus group interview to gather teachers’ feedback, which informs the adaptation of the DA in Phase Two. In Phase Two, we conduct a teacher survey asking for ratings of individual students’ learning potentials to be used for Phase Three analyses. We also examine the predictive power of DA scores for Chinese reading at Grade One, controlling for static reading measures. Assessment reports and recommendations are generated for teachers to review. In Phase Three, we ask the teachers to provide learning potential ratings again and we compare their ratings between Phase One and Phase Three. In Phase Four, we track teachers’ use of the DA outcomes in relation to instructional decision-making one month, three months, and six months post-DA. Theoretically, this research will provide new evidence by testing the DA framework with an under-represented learner group in a less-examined educational context (i.e., Chinese-speaking and non-Chinese-speaking first graders in Hong Kong). Methodologically, it adopts a multiphase mixed-method design and explores a hybrid DA model that is useful for Chinese reading prediction, classification and classroom differential instruction. Practically, this project delivers instruction-integrated and more equitable Chinese assessment for Hong Kong primary school stakeholders.

15600225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600225.value: 以功能映射網絡與分層摺紙結構為基礎的動態數據驅動女性運動員運動內衣設計

15600225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15600225.value: Dr MO, Shiwei Dr SUN, Yue Prof Yip, Yiu-wan

15600225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600225.value: Sports bras control excessive breast motion, provide support, ensure freedom of movement, and protect female athletes against breast injuries during sports related activities. Despite advancements made in sports bra designs, exercise induced breast motion has yet to be adequately controlled, thus female athletes suffer from breast pain and injuries, in particular, those who engage in repetitive movements and high-impact multiplanar activities. Nevertheless, research on breast motion has mainly focused on measuring vertical breast displacement and acceleration, so there is a lack of understanding of multiplanar breast displacement and bra support requirements for other sports. To address the complex, nonlinear, and time-varying nature of breast motion and support requirements for competitive athletes, this project proposes a hybrid approach that combines functional maps and deep learning with finite element (FE) models to fully exploit 4D scanning technology for data-driven sports bra designs. As such, deformations and changes in the topology of the breast during different sports activities can be accurately and efficiently quantified. Bra features and material structures that allow customised cushioning for optimal breast protection during high intensity sports activities are also necessary which cannot be met through traditional foam pad materials. An efficient optimisation strategy is therefore developed in this study to design origami-based metamaterial structures that enhance flexibility of fit, and specific levels of bra cushioning and support for different sporting conditions. Along with optimisation algorithms, this method allows for a strategic balance of mechanical performance and geometric parameters in designing bra padding. Four tasks are involved. The first is implementing dynamic 3D body scanning (4D scanning) with various sports movements, and establishing correspondence between breast and body shape with functional maps. Then, a data-driven design for bra features and pads is derived with customisable cushioning properties and origami-based metamaterial structures. FE models of the body and bra are subsequently built. Finally, the results of the predictive and numerical simulation models are validated against experimental data. The work offers groundbreaking methods that quantify the deformation of breasts in biomechanical analyses, particularly for multiplanar sports activities. The findings enhance the accuracy of correspondence estimation and tasks during sports activities, give designers insights into new materials to meet specific requirements in sports applications through computational design optimisation methods, FE models and 3D printing techniques. Finally, a scientific foundation is established for future research on human dynamic behaviour and biomechanical analysis, and the promising use of 4D scanning in sportswear design. 運動內衣能有效控制過度的乳房運動，提供支撐，確保運動自由度，並在運動相關活動中保護女性運動員免受乳房損傷。儘管運動內衣設計已有進步，但運動引起的乳房運動仍未得到充分控制，導致女性運動員，特別是從事重複動作及高衝擊多平面運動者，仍然面臨乳房疼痛及損傷的問題。目前對乳房運動的研究多集中於垂直位移及加速度的測量，對多平面乳房位移及不同運動對內衣支撐需求的了解仍然不足。 為應對競技運動員乳房運動及支撐需求的複雜、非線性及時變特性，本項目提出結合功能映射、深度學習與有限元模型的混合方法，充分利用動態掃描技術進行數據驅動的運動內衣設計。此方法能準確高效地量化不同運動下乳房的變形及拓撲結構變化。傳統泡棉墊料已無法滿足高強度運動下對乳房保護的個性化緩衝需求，因此本研究開發了高效的優化策略，設計以摺紙為基礎的超材料結構，提升貼合靈活性及針對不同運動條件的支撐與緩衝效果。 本研究為乳房在多平面運動下的生物力學變形分析提供突破性方法，提升運動過程中對應估算的準確性，並通過計算設計優化、有限元模型及列印技術，為設計師提供新材料應用的見解。最終，為未來人體動態行為及生物力學分析研究，以及動態掃描於運動服裝設計的應用奠定科學基礎。

15601325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601325.value: 中文語言處理與大型語言模型中的語義適配性研究

15601325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601325.value: Prof Hsu, Yu-yin Prof Huang, Chu-ren Prof Lenci, Alessandro

15601325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601325.value: The notion of semantic fit in psycholinguistics refers to the compatibility between a verb head and its argument nouns, depending on the extent to which a noun (e.g. "doctor") is a typical/plausible filler of a verb role (e.g. the agent of "to advise"). It is close to the linguistic concept of selectional preference, although the latter defines the verb requirement as a "yes/no" constraint, while the former sees it as a gradient. In English, semantic fit was used to account for the increased speed showed by humans in recognizing typical filler nouns for a verb role in naming tasks (e.g. “professor” is quickly recognized as a typical agent of teaching-events) or for the facilitation effects with sentences that display typical rather than atypical argument combinations (e.g. “The mechanic was checking the brakes today” is read faster than “The mechanic was checking the article today”; Bicknell et al., 2010). In Computational Linguistics, semantic fit was modelled via word embedding models of verb-argument composition, which can predict human typicality ratings for verb-noun pairs (Sayeed et al., 2016) and typicality-related processing differences in human reading times (Chersoni et al., 2019). With the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), providing increasingly human-like semantic embedding representations (Aw et al., 2023; Yu et al., 2024), language technologies are likely to improve their ability of dealing with such typicality relations between words. Semantic fit effects are relatively unexplored in the literature on Chinese. An account of the phenomenon in Chinese would be extremely meaningful, because in Chinese it does not only concern verb-argument combinations, but also the matching between classifiers and nouns: such matching is driven by the semantic features of the noun (Huang and Ahrens, 2003) and thus it should be predictable by a LLM-based model of semantic fit. Our first goal, after collecting an evaluation dataset of human typicality ratings for Chinese (both in Mandarin and in Cantonese), is to test Chinese LLMs on the prediction of typicality between verbs and arguments, and classifiers and nouns. Secondly, we aim at seeing whether such models can predict variations in human reading times on Chinese sentences containing typical/atypical argument combinations or congruent/incongruent classifier-noun matches. Finally, we will train a new type of Chinese LLM on structured linguistic representations, i.e. syntactic and semantic graphs, and test if this type of knowledge leads to better estimations of semantic fit on our data.

15601425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601425.value: 財務素養、權力與經濟虐待：中國農村與城市幼兒母親的研究

15601425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601425.value: Prof Kong, Dexia Prof Wong, Janet Yuen Ha

15601425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601425.value: Economic abuse—a form of intimate partner violence (IPV) involving control, exploitation, and sabotage of financial resources—is an understudied but critical issue. Distinct from other IPV forms, it traps victims in financial dependence, operates covertly, and persists with minimal contact. Legal and financial complexities further entangle victims, yet support remains inadequate. In China, economic abuse against mothers of young children is especially concerning, because their disproportionate childrearing burden increases their vulnerability to economic abuse. To inform targeted interventions, researchers have identified financial literacy and power (im)balance as key factors associated with economic abuse. Financial literacy includes the knowledge, confidence, and behaviors to manage finances. Power (im)balance reflects the extent to which partners achieve equity. Adequate financial literacy is linked to reduced economic abuse directly and via promoting balanced power. Significant gaps remain, however. First, the lack of longitudinal studies limits the understanding of how financial literacy, power (im)balance, and economic abuse interconnect and intensify each other over time. Second, few studies have examined economic abuse in China, particularly how sociocultural factors shape women’s experiences. Third, rural women’s economic abuse experiences are often neglected, which is a particular limitation in China where the hukou system creates substantial rural-urban disparities. This study will address these gaps through three aims: (1) investigating longitudinal, reciprocal associations among financial literacy, power (im)balance, and economic abuse; (2) exploring how sociocultural factors shape each construct and their associations; and (3) comparing how financial literacy, power (im)balance, economic abuse, and sociocultural factors manifest in rural and urban settings. Focusing on economically abused rural and urban Chinese women with young children, this mixed-method research will start with two-wave surveys of 640 participants at baseline and follow-up. Advanced analyses including cross-lagged panel models and latent moderated structural equation modeling will be conducted to identify quantitative trends. At follow-up, semi-structured interviews with a subsample of 60 informative participants will be conducted. Thematic analyses will be performed for in-depth understanding. Collectively, this project will be the first to examine how to break the vicious cycle of inadequate financial literacy, powerlessness, and economic abuse victimization, particularly in China’s sociocultural context and the hukou system. It will inform targeted interventions and policies to address economic abuse and associated social inequities. Additionally, the research will extend government efforts to protect mothers’ welfare, which can inform policies addressing China’s low birth rate challenge. 經濟虐待是親密關係暴力的一種形式，涉及對財務資源的控制、剝削與破壞。相較於其他類型的親密關係暴力，經濟虐待更為隱蔽，常使受害者陷入長期的財務依賴，即便伴侶之間的接觸減少，控制仍可持續發生。法律與財務制度的複雜性進一步加深受害者的困境，而現有的支援資源卻明顯不足。在中國，針對育有年幼子女的母親進行的經濟虐待更為值得關注，因為她們承擔了高度不均的育兒責任，導致其面對經濟控制時更加脆弱。 為發展有效的介入策略，研究者指出「財務素養」與「權力（不）平衡」是與經濟虐待密切相關的兩大關鍵因素。財務素養指的是個體在管理財務上的知識、自信與行為能力；而權力（不）平衡則反映伴侶之間是否實現權力上的對等。研究顯示，良好的財務素養不僅可直接降低經濟虐待的風險，亦可透過促進伴侶間的權力平衡發揮間接作用。 然而，目前在此領域仍存在三項重要的研究缺口。首先，現有研究多為橫斷設計，缺乏縱向資料，難以深入瞭解財務素養、權力（不）平衡與經濟虐待之間如何隨時間交互作用與惡化。其次，中國相關研究相對匱乏，尤其缺乏探討社會文化因素如何影響女性經歷的實證研究。第三，農村女性的經濟虐待經驗長期遭到忽視，而中國戶籍制度下的城鄉差距，則使這一盲點更加嚴重。 為回應上述缺口，本研究設定三大目標：（1）探討財務素養、權力（不）平衡與經濟虐待之間的縱向與雙向關係；（2）分析社會文化因素如何影響各構念本身及其相互關聯；（3）比較農村與城市情境中，財務素養、權力（不）平衡、經濟虐待與社會文化因素的異同。研究對象為曾經歷經濟虐待、且育有年幼子女的中國農村與城市母親，採混合方法進行。量化部分將招募640位參與者，進行兩波次問卷調查，並運用交叉滯後面板模型與潛在交互結構方程模型進行資料分析。質性部分則將於追蹤階段邀請其中60位資訊豐富的受訪者進行半結構式訪談，並進行主題分析，以深入探索其經歷。 本研究將首次系統性探討在中國特有的社會文化與戶籍制度脈絡下，如何打破「財務素養不足—權力失衡—經濟虐待受害」的惡性循環。研究結果可為經濟虐待的介入策略與政策設計提供重要實證依據，亦有助於回應更廣泛的社會不平等議題。此外，本研究亦將有助於擴展政府對母職福祉的保障措施，為應對中國當前的低生育率挑戰提供政策參考。

15601725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601725.value: 針對認知障礙症患者家庭照護者的抑鬱症狀和生命凝聚感的基於健康本源學-內在能力理論所開發的社交機器人輔助干預的效果

15601725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601725.value: Prof Broadbent , Elizabeth Prof Holroyd, Eleanor Prof Leung, Angela Yee Man Dr MONTAYRE, Jed Ray Gengoba

15601725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601725.value: Family caregivers of persons with dementia (PwD) are well known to be “invisible patients.” Existing studies have suggested that sense of coherence (SOC), a core inner strength, could be a protective factor against depression among family caregivers of PwD. However, few interventions are available to enhance the SOC and thereby the emotional and psychological health of this population. While in-home social robots are viewed as a useful addition to caring for PwD, the use of social robots with family caregivers as the primary audience is vastly under-investigated. In response, we have developed a strength-based, robot-assisted intervention based on Antonovsky’s theory of saluotogenesis for family caregivers of PwD. The feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary effects of the robot on family caregivers of PwD have been confirmed, with recommendations for examining its applicability among this population in a full trial. This study aims to examine the effects of a salutogenic strength-based, robot-assisted intervention on improving depressive symptoms in family caregivers of PwD. This is a mixed-methods study, including a prospective, single-blinded, two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial and semi-structured individual interviews. A group of 148 family caregivers of PwD will be randomized to the intervention group (IG) or the control group (CG), who will receive reading materials on dementia care weekly. Each IG participant will engage with a robot integrated with an AI-powered chatbot at home for 6 weeks. Individual interviews will be conducted at week-6. Purposive sampling will be used to ensure diversity among the participants. Descriptive statistics, t-test and/or Chi square test, generalized estimating equation (GEE), linear regression and thematic analysis will be used. Primary hypothesis: Participants in the intervention group (IG) will report a greater improvement in depressive symptoms than the control group (CG) immediately post-intervention at 6 weeks (T1), 1-month (T2) and 3-month (T3) after completing the intervention. Secondary hypothesis: 1) Participants in the IG will report a greater improvement in SOC, perceived caregiving burden, coping, and caregiving self-efficacy than the CG at T1, T2, and T3; 2) The frequency of engaging with specific robot features is associated with improved depressive symptoms, SOC, caregiving burden, coping, and caregiving self-efficacy. The findings may: 1) advance our understanding of the application of the salutogenesis theory to robotic technology, 2) boost the inner strength of family caregivers to maintain their emotional and psychological health in stressful situations, and provide a new paradigm to strengthen the informal care system.

15601825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601825.value: 東亞海域的第二次佛教傳播，1600-1800

15601825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601825.value: The sixteenth to eighteenth centuries witnessed what was arguably the largest and most far-reaching Buddhist transmission from China to maritime East Asia since the Tang Dynasty (618-907). The circulation took the form of migrant monks, primarily from the Linji and Caodong schools of the Chan sect, and texts, including sutras, morality tales, and precious scrolls (baojuan). China during the Ming (1368-1644) and Qing (1644-1912), as well as Korea, Japan, and Vietnam, the states heavily influenced by the Chinese world order and defined as part of the Sinosphere, were no strangers to various Buddhist teachings. However, this latest major wave of transmission profoundly altered not just the religious, but also the social, cultural, political, and intellectual landscape of all four countries. Buddhism was not simply a religion, but represented an entire package of Chinese ideas, culture, popular practices, and systems of governance current as of the late imperial period. It opened up channels for the dissemination of later intellectual currents during the Qing, especially the School of Evidential Learning. It also penetrated from the ruling circles and elites down to the level of commoners. The spread of Buddhism further solidified and consolidated the identity and coherence of overseas Chinese communities. The bonds of religion could sustain connections within a particular Chinese settlement, link these communities to others across the sea, and forge bonds with the hierarchies and bureaucracies of the states where they resided. They also provided a legitimate autonomous space for prominent monks or sojourner patrons to form a surrogate gentry and exercise leadership over their communities without the need to pass the Confucian civil service examinations. The horizontal networks forged by Buddhism served as a gateway for the introduction of later secular organizations, such as merchant guilds and native place associations. The cumulative result of this round of Buddhist transmission was a greater synchronization and homogenization of the Sinosphere. 十六至十八世紀見證了中國佛教向東亞海域規模最宏大、影響最深遠的傳播浪潮，堪稱唐朝（618-907）以來之最。這種文化流通以移民僧侶（主要來自禪宗臨濟宗和曹洞宗）與宗教文本（包括佛經與寶卷）為載體。處於明清時期的中國，以及深受中華世界秩序影響、同屬漢文化圈的朝鮮、日本、越南諸國，本不陌生於各類佛教教義。但這股新的傳播浪潮深刻改變了四國的宗教圖景，更重塑了社會、文化、政治與思想格局。佛教不僅是宗教信仰，更承載著整套中國思想文化體系、民間實踐與治理制度。它為清代考證學等後續思想潮流的傳播開闢通道，亦從統治階層與精英群體滲透至平民百姓。佛教的傳播進一步鞏固了海外華人社群的認同感與凝聚力：宗教紐帶既能維繫特定華人聚居區的內部聯繫，又能串聯跨海相望的社區，並在僑居國建立起與當地層級制度及官僚體系的聯結。佛教構築的橫向人際網絡，更成為後期商幫、同鄉會等世俗團體傳入的橋樑。此輪佛教傳播的累積效應，最終推動了整個漢文化圈更高程度的同步化與同質化發展

15601925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601925.value: 透過沉浸式遊戲化虛擬實境訓練提升專注力不足及過度活躍症兒童社交技能：混合研究法探討

15601925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601925.value: Dr Lai, Yuen Yi Cynthia Dr Poon, Kei Yan Kean Prof Qin, Jing Prof Shum, Ho Keung David Dr Wong, Yau Kai Herrick

15601925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601925.value: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder in children, characterised by symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity. These symptoms hinder children's ability to focus on conversations, control impulses, and follow social cues, leading to challenges in social interactions and difficulties in forming friendships. Consequently, children with ADHD may experience social isolation and low self-esteem. In Hong Kong, approximately 6.4% of children and adolescents are affected by ADHD, with a significant increase in diagnoses within public schools over the past decade. Traditional social skills training (SST) for children with ADHD, although widely utilised, has several limitations, including practical challenges, time constraints, and high costs. Previous studies have demonstrated inconsistent outcomes due to methodological limitations, such as small sample sizes, gender imbalances, lack of self-reported data, and the absence of comparison groups to detect the intervention effect. This project aims to address these limitations by introducing iGameVRT, an immersive, gamified virtual reality (VR)-based training designed to enhance social skills and executive functions in children with ADHD, and by comparing its effectiveness with traditional SST. The research will employ a mixed-methods design, combining a randomised controlled trial (RCT) with post-trial qualitative interviews. In the RCT, children with ADHD will be randomly assigned to one of three groups: iGameVRT, Traditional Training (SST), or Waitlist Control (WC). The iGameVRT and SST groups will participate in 12 training sessions over three weeks, while the WC group will not receive any training during the study period. Participants will be assessed for social skills (primary outcome), and executive functions before and after the training, motion sickness (iGameVRT group only) every session, and satisfaction immediately after the training. Follow-up assessments will occur at three and six months to evaluate the sustained effects of the interventions. We hypothesise that children using iGameVRT will show greater improvement in social skills and executive functions than those undergoing traditional SST. Post-trial interviews with participants from iGameVRT and SST groups will be conducted to gain deeper insights into their experiences, perceived benefits, and challenges encountered during VR-based and traditional training. Additionally, a cost-effectiveness analysis will evaluate the potential economic advantages of iGameVRT compared to SST. This project will provide empirical evidence on the effectiveness of iGameVRT, guiding policymakers, social workers, and educators in adopting innovative and cost-effective interventions. This could facilitate the integration of VR-based training in schools and community centres, significantly enhancing support systems for children with ADHD. 專注力不足及過度活躍症（ADHD）是兒童常見的神經發育障礙，其特徵為注意力不集中、過度活躍及衝動等症狀。這些症狀妨礙兒童專注於對話、控制衝動及理解社交線索的能力，導致社交互動困難及難以建立友誼關係。因此，患有ADHD的兒童可能面臨社交孤立及自尊心低落的問題。在香港，約有6.4%的兒童及青少年患有ADHD，而公立學校的確診個案在過去十年間顯著增加。針對ADHD兒童的傳統社交技能訓練（SST）雖然廣泛應用，但存在多項局限性，包括實務挑戰、時間限制及高昂成本。過往研究因方法學上的局限而呈現不一致的結果，例如樣本規模過小、性別比例失衡、缺乏自我報告數據，以及缺少對照組以檢測介入效果等問題。 本項目旨在透過引入iGameVRT—一個沉浸式遊戲化虛擬實境（VR）訓練系統，以提升ADHD兒童的社交技能和執行功能，並與傳統SST比較其成效，藉此解決上述局限性。研究將採用混合研究方法，結合隨機對照試驗（RCT）與試驗後定性訪談。在RCT中，患有ADHD的兒童將隨機分配至三組：iGameVRT組、傳統訓練組（SST）或候補對照組（WC）。iGameVRT組和SST組將在三週內參與12次訓練課程，而WC組在研究期間將不接受任何訓練。參加者將在訓練前後接受社交技能（主要結果指標）和執行功能評估，iGameVRT組將在每次訓練後評估動暈症狀，並在訓練結束後立即評估滿意度。追蹤評估將於三個月和六個月後進行，以評估介入措施的持續效果。我們假設使用iGameVRT的兒童在社交技能和執行功能方面的改善程度將較接受傳統SST者為佳。 試驗後將對iGameVRT組和SST組的參加者進行訪談，以深入了解其體驗、感知效益及在VR訓練和傳統訓練過程中遇到的挑戰。此外，成本效益分析將評估iGameVRT相對於SST的潛在經濟優勢。本項目將提供iGameVRT有效性的實證證據，指導政策制定者、社工及教育工作者採納創新且具成本效益的介入措施。這有助於在學校和社區中心推廣VR訓練，大幅提升對專注力不足及過度活躍症兒童的支援系統。

15602425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602425.value: 為革命繪畫：毛澤東時代的群眾美術史 1949–1979

15602425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602425.value: My project writes an alternative history of the state fine arts project during the Mao Zedong era (1949-1979) through the lens of mass art 群众美术, also known variously as worker-peasant-soldier art 工农兵美术, amateur art practice 业余美术创作, worker art 工人画, peasant art 农民画, or soldier art 战士画. Mass art refers to the organizing of untrained working class individuals as artists, and mass art was cultivated throughout the socialist period in the People’s Republic of China, with precedents in the Republican period. By considering the production of artwork by industrial factory workers, rural commune members, and soldiers in formal and informal militias, I ask how we might take seriously an art history that exists outside, or even in opposition to the P.R.C.’s centralized institutions of cultural authority, particularly the art academy. I frame my inquiry using the parameters of "worker-peasant-soldier art," a period term for mass art emphasizing the class identity of amateur artists as workers, peasants, or soldiers. By adopting "gongnongbing" as a framing device, I excavate the meaning of a period term as well as maintain the integrity of labor as a category of aesthetics. My work goes beyond the limits of art historical frameworks that dismiss the content of mass art as propaganda and its form as unskilled, showing instead how mass art rejected concepts of the aesthetic based in the autonomy of aesthetics or the expertise of the artist. Instead, mass art project sought to disrupt the separation of the fine arts from the everyday by subsuming its aesthetic and material claims within the social relations of the proletarian worker. The result was a decommodification of artistic labor that ran parallel to wider experiments to discard with wage labor through collectivization, as in the people’s commune. By restoring the mass art movement to its labor context, this project takes stock of the successes and failures of the Maoist fine arts project. This project contributes to the fields of twentieth century Chinese art history and cultural studies, but the results bear upon the study of propaganda, amateurism, and socially engaged art. The goal is to produce the first comprehensive study of the mass art movement in socialist China, and to make the findings accessible to audiences beyond Chinese studies. 本項目旨在透過群眾美術（又稱工農兵美術、業餘美術創作、工人畫、農民畫或戰士畫）的視角，探索毛澤東時代（1949-1979年）的別樣藝術試驗。群眾美術，是指未經訓練的工人階級，經由集體組織而參與的藝術實踐。在整個毛澤東時代，群眾美術獲得了官方的肯定與製度性的培養，這種現象在民國時期亦已出現先例。通過考察工廠工人、農村公社成員與正規及非正規民兵的藝術創作，本項目試圖發掘這一存在於中央集體文化體制（尤其是專業美術學院體系）之外的、甚至與之相抗的藝術實踐，由此揭示出另一種藝術史脈絡。 本項目以“工農兵美術”為主軸展開，這一概念突出強調了業餘藝術家作為工人、農民或戰士的階級身份。通過以“工農兵”作為框架，本項目旨在闡釋這一時期術語的意義，同時亦致力於維繫“勞動”作為美學範疇的完整性。本項目試圖超越傳統藝術史框架的局限——這些框架往往將群眾美術的內容簡化為宣傳工具，將其形式貶抑為缺乏技巧。與之相對，本研究則著重展現群眾美術如何拒斥基於美術自主性或藝術家專業知識的美學概念，並試圖打破美術與日常生活的分離，通過將美學理念和物質訴求納入無產階級工人的社會關係，最終實現了藝術勞動的去商品化。這一美術實踐與更廣泛的社會實驗同步展開，例如人民公社中以集體化取代僱傭勞動的嘗試。 本項目將群眾美術運動還原到其勞動語境中，以此回顧毛澤東時代美術實踐的得失成敗。本研究致力於推進二十世紀中國藝術史和文化研究領域的學術探索，同時為政治宣傳、業餘美術及社會性介入藝術（socially engaged art）的研究帶來深刻洞見。本項目旨在提供毛時代中國群眾美術運動的首次全面考察，並使研究成果能夠為中國研究以外的學者和讀者所理解和運用。

15603225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603225.value: 評估人工智能輔助譯後編輯的有效性：一項基於眼動追踪、鍵盤記錄和翻譯表現評估的過程與産出研究

15603225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603225.value: In the era of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), integrating advanced AI technologies into translation workflows presents both opportunities and challenges for the translation industry and translator training programs. While post-editing (PE) of machine translation outputs has become an established practice to enhance translation efficiency and quality, there is a notable lack of research investigating the incorporation of GenAI into PE tasks, particularly regarding its effectiveness across translators of varying expertise levels and in different translation scenarios. This project proposes to evaluate a hybrid translation workflow termed AI-assisted post-editing (AIPE), which integrates GenAI tools, such as GPT-4, into the PE process. By synergizing human translators’ expertise with GenAI’s conversational interaction capabilities, the study seeks to investigate the advantages and limitations of AIPE in alleviating cognitive effort and enhancing translation quality compared to traditional post-editing (TPE). The effectiveness of AIPE will be examined across translator experience levels—untrained bilinguals, translation trainees, and professional translators—and in both English-to-Chinese and Chinese-to-English translation directions. Grounded in Krings’ (2001) Effort Model, a mixed-methods approach will be employed to assess cognitive effort, incorporating eye-tracking, key-logging, and subjective ratings using the NASA-TLX. For PE performance evaluation, the study will utilize both automatic metrics, such as BLEU Score and TER, alongside manual assessments based on the Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) framework. The anticipated outcomes are multifaceted: First, the study will introduce AIPE as a hybrid translation workflow and empirically assess its effectiveness in reducing cognitive effort and improving translation quality, potentially informing the development of translator training programs incorporating GenAI technologies. Moreover, by examining the PE processing patterns leading to high-quality translation, the research may provide insights into guiding translators and practitioners in developing effective practices for AI-assisted translation tasks. Finally, by revealing the advantages and limitations of GenAI in assisting PE tasks, the project holds the potential to assist developers in creating computer-assisted translation tools that better cater to the specific needs of the translation industry. Overall, the outcomes are expected to benefit translators, educators, AI developers, and the broader field by providing a deeper understanding of how human expertise and AI could be synergistically combined to improve translation processes and outputs. 在生成式人工智能時代，將先進的人工智能技術整合到翻譯工作流程中爲翻譯行業和譯員培訓帶來了機遇和挑戰。儘管機器翻譯譯後編輯已成爲提高翻譯效率和質量的常規操作，但將生成式人工智能整合到譯後編輯任務中的研究明顯不足，其在不同專業水平的譯員中的使用以及在不同翻譯場景中的有效性研究尤其缺乏。 本研究聚焦於評估一種創新的混合式翻譯工作流程，即人工智能輔助譯後編輯，該流程將生成式人工智能模型（如GPT-4）整合到譯後編輯過程中。通過綜合考察人類譯員的專業知識與人工智能互動對話的協同作用，本研究旨在揭示與傳統譯後編輯相比，人工智能輔助譯後編輯在減輕認知負荷和提高翻譯質量方面的優勢和局限性。研究將從兩個維度展開實證考察：其一為譯員經驗水平差異，涵蓋未受訓的雙語人士、翻譯專業學生及職業譯員；其二為翻譯方向差異，包含英譯中與中譯英。在研究方法上，本研究採用混合研究取徑。認知負荷評估以Krings（2001）的理論框架為基礎，整合眼動追踪、鍵盤記錄和NASA任務負荷指數（NASA-TLX）等多元測量工具。翻譯品質評估則兼採自動化指標（如BLEU評分和TER）與基於多維質量指標（MQM）框架的人工評估方法。 本研究預期有以下成果：首先，本研究將介紹人工智能輔助譯後編輯作爲新型混合式翻譯工作流程的潛力，並用實證方法評估其在減輕認知負荷和提高翻譯質量方面的有效性，爲融入生成式人工智能的譯員培訓課程設計提供實證依據。此外，通過研究高質量翻譯的譯後編輯處理模式，本研究可以指導譯員和翻譯業界採取有效的方法來實現人工智能輔助翻譯任務。最後，通過揭示生成式人工智能在輔助譯後編輯任務中的優勢和局限性，本研究有助於開發人員設計出可以更好地滿足翻譯行業特定需求的計算機輔助翻譯工具。 總體而言，本研究成果將為譯員、教育工作者、人工智能開發人員及相關領域專業人士提供重要參考，促進人類專業知識和人工智能的深度融合，進而推動翻譯過程優化和翻譯產出質量的持續提升。

15603425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603425.value: AI在法庭證據審查中的應用：以香港司法語音鑒定為例

15603425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603425.value: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into various sectors, including healthcare, education, and forensic sciences, is transforming our daily lives. In forensic science, particularly in biometric recognition such as facial and voice recognition, AI adoption has surged. Forensic voice omparison (FVC) is a critical area where AI-integrated automatic speaker recognition (ASR) systems are increasingly used to compare voice recordings from unknown offenders and known suspects. Despite the advancements in ASR technology, which has shown high accuracy in controlled conditions, the reliability of these systems under varying real-world conditions remains a significant concern. This distinction between accuracy and reliability is crucial, especially in forensic contexts where errors can lead to wrongful convictions or acquittals, as well as miscarriages of justice. This research aims to investigate the reliability of AI-integrated ASR systems in forensic contexts, focusing on the three most commonly spoken languages in Hong Kong: Cantonese, English, and Mandarin. We will examine how various conditions, such as speech feature extraction, natural variability in a speaker’s voice over time, and the choice of AI models, impact the reliability of these systems. The study will also investigate how these conditions might cause errors, such as misidentifying different speakers as the same person, leading to miscarriages of justice. The proposed study will be conducted in two working stages. In the first stage, we will focus on system reliability under different conditions, addressing whether ASR systems with better accuracy also ensure greater reliability concerning speech features, speech style, speech duration, and sample size. We will also investigate whether these attributes are influenced by specific languages or accents. In the second stage, we will investigate how speech samples from same- or different-speakers interact with and respond to various AI-integrated ASR systems. We aim to investigate how the strength of evidence varies for individual speakers using different systems and what systematic properties of individual speakers make them more or less challenging for ASR systems to distinguish. The research will deliver new knowledge on the reliability of AI-integrated ASR systems in forensic contexts, providing empirical evidence on how various conditions and individual speaker characteristics impact system performance. This knowledge is crucial for forensic experts to demonstrate the reliability and accuracy of the methods employed in forensic comparison, ensuring that forensic evidence evaluation in court is based on reliable and consistent methods, thereby minimising the risk of miscarriages of justice. 人工智能（AI）在醫療、教育及法證科學等領域的整合正深刻變革社會運作。於法證科學中，生物特徵識別（如人臉與語音識別）的AI應用尤為顯著。其中，法證語音鑒定（Forensic Voice Comparison, FVC）作為關鍵技術，日益採用基於AI的自動說話人識別系統（ASR）比對未知犯罪者與已知嫌疑人的語音樣本。儘管ASR技術於受控環境中展現高準確度，其在真實多變條件下的可靠度（reliability）仍存重大隱憂。此「準確度與可靠度之辨」於法證領域至關重要，因系統誤判可能導致錯誤定罪、無罪開釋或司法誤判（miscarriages of justice）。 本研究旨在探究基於AI的ASR系統於法證場景的可靠度，聚焦香港三大常用語言：粵語、英語及普通話。我們將檢視多變條件對系統的影響，包括： • 語音特徵提取方法 • 說話人嗓音隨時間的自然變異性（natural variability） • AI模型選擇差異 同時剖析上述條件如何引發「異說話人誤判為同一人」等錯誤，進而導致司法誤判。研究採用兩階段工作框架： • 第一階段：驗證ASR系統於不同條件（語音特徵；語音風格；語音時長；樣本量）下的可靠度，釐清「高準確度系統是否必然具高可靠度」，並探討語言/口音特異性影響； • 第二階段：解析同源與異源語音樣本在各AI-ASR系統中的交互響應，量化個體說話人的證據強度（strength of evidence），識別致使ASR系統判別難易度產生系統性差異的說話人特徵。 本研究將產出AI-ASR系統法證應用可靠度的創新知識，提供語境條件與個體特徵影響系統表現的實證依據。此成果有助法證專家驗證語音鑒定方法的準確性與可重複性，確保法庭證據評估基於可靠且一致的方法論，從而最小化司法誤判風險。

15603625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603625.value: 中風康復者與照顧者對於利用戶外運動設施及公園空間進行自我復康訓練管理的經驗與觀點：多元質性方法研究

15603625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15603625.value: Prof Ho, Rainbow Tin Hung Dr Li, BingYu Dr Lo, Temmy Lee Ting Prof PANG, Marco Dr Shi, Shulin Prof WONG, Arnold

15603625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603625.value: In Hong Kong, stroke is the leading cause of long-term disability. However, after one-year post-stroke, professional rehabilitation services are not typically provided by the public healthcare system, leaving stroke survivors to rely on themselves and their caregivers for long-term rehabilitation. Interestingly, it has been observed that some stroke survivors and their caregivers in Hong Kong utilize outdoor exercise facilities in parks to self-manage their long-term rehabilitation. Given that outdoor exercise facilities and the exercise spaces were not originally designed for rehabilitation purposes, there has been a lack of research on their use for post-stroke self-managed rehabilitation. There is much to be learned about how some stroke survivors and their caregivers utilize these outdoor exercise facilities and spaces for rehabilitation and health maintenance and which facilitating elements of outdoor exercise equipment and exercise space design in parks could better support them in the future. The proposed project will seek to bridge this knowledge gap through a multi-method qualitative study. Go-along interviews and participatory design model-making focus groups will be used to investigate the topic.
