Upon completing this project, the EMS will provide the means for substantially upgrading the wastewater treatment quality, which will benefit Hong Kong and other regions with high-salinity wastewater. 傳統污水處理廠旨在有效去除有害污染物與病原體，從而保護環境與公共健康。然而，污水處理廠在效能方面仍面臨多項廣受關注的挑戰：(i) 污水處理廠對於不可生物降解的污染物，特別是新興污染物的去除效率不佳；(ii) 缺乏高價值產品的回收或生成機制；(iii) 由於大量溫室氣體的產生以及高能源與化學藥劑的消耗，污水處理廠的碳排放量偏高。與世界多數地區不同，香港的市政污水因採用海水沖廁制度，而含有高濃度的氯離子，這為藉由高級氧化技術進行污水處理提供了適當的化學來源。 本研究提出電化學膜技術，一種新型低碳排的高級氧化技術，可高效去除多種污染物，並回收及生成高價值產品，以解決上述挑戰。透過此電化學膜技術，將利用氧化能力驅動氯離子活化，產生足量的反應性氯物種，以去除有機污染物（包括新興污染物）及大腸桿菌。同時，在電場與膜分離的協同作用下，可回收氨氮，並藉由還原能力驅動氫氧化物與氫氣的產生。 本系統預期可有效克服傳統污水處理廠的限制：(i) 透過原位氯活化高效分解新興污染物；(ii) 回收氨氮並生成氫氣與氫氧化物，使污水處理成為具附加價值的過程；(iii) 因減少溫室氣體產生，並藉由高價值產品的生成抵銷碳排放，有助於降低整體碳足跡。本研究將全面探討在連續流操作模式下提升實驗室規模電化學膜技術效能的策略，釐清電化學膜技術實現多功能處理所需的關鍵機制，並評估具創新模組化結構的大型電化學膜技術處理實際含鹽污水的可行性。 所提出的電化學膜技術系統預期能滿足未來污水處理的需求，因其具備提升出水水質、實現廢棄物轉化為高值產品，以及邁向淨零技術的潛力。本項目將為實現多功能含鹽污水處理提供嶄新見解與基礎理論知識。據我們所知，目前全球尚未有類似技術應用於含鹽廢水處理領域。完成本項目後，電化學膜技術將大幅提升污水處理品質，造福香港及其他同樣面臨高鹽度污水處理挑戰的地區。

16207725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16207725.value: 凸錐規劃求解加速器的算法硬件協同設計與自動化FPGA設計生成

16207725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16207725.value: Convex optimization plays a crucial role in many performance-critical applications across diverse fields, including machine learning, finance, control engineering, power systems, and signal processing. Its range of applications is continually growing due to two key factors. First, transforming complex problems from various domains into equivalent convex forms, enabling efficient solutions with polynomial time complexity, has been proven to be effective. Second, the development of tools that automate the conversion of problems into standard convex forms has been instrumental in this expansion. As the complexity and scale of problems in various applications increase, there is a pressing need for substantial improvements to convex program solvers’ performance and efficiency. For instance, back-testing in finance requires solving millions of quadratic programs or second-order cone programs daily within a 7-hour trading window to optimize parameters such as scaling factors for holding and transaction costs. However, a single software solver might take about a month to complete this task. To enhance solver speed and efficiency, domain-specific hardware accelerators can be manually designed by leveraging sparsity structures and optimizing numerical representations within solver algorithms, while also aligning hardware architecture with the computational characteristics of these algorithms. However, developing such accelerators demands extensive expertise in both hardware and algorithms, as well as considerable dedicated effort. Moreover, the process of designing an optimal accelerator must be repeated for each category of convex optimization problems. Therefore, systematic exploration and automatic synthesis of the accelerator that accounts for the unique nature of convex programs is highly desirable. We introduce an automated algorithm-hardware co-design framework aimed at improving the speed and power efficiency of solvers for conic programs, while ensuring solution accuracy. This framework will automatically synthesize dedicated and efficient FPGA implementations for any convex conic optimization problem derived from diverse applications, tailored to meet specific requirements for latency, power budget, and hardware resource utilization. Specifically, we will explore innovative quantization and operation reduction strategies for addressing two mainstream conic solver techniques: the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) for handling large-scale problems and Interior-Point Methods (IPM) for achieving high-precision solutions. The proposed framework will be rigorously evaluated across a diverse range of convex optimization applications, including portfolio optimization in finance, model predictive control, least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) in machine learning, and optimal power flow in power grids. Furthermore, it will be integrated with domain-specific languages for convex optimization, providing significant benefits to practitioners in these fields. 凸優化在機器學習、金融、控制工程、電力系統及信號處理等諸多領域的性能關鍵型應用中發揮至關重要的作用。其應用範圍的持續擴展主要得益於兩大因素：其一，將各領域的複雜問題轉化為等效凸形式以實現多項式時間複雜度的高效求解已被證實具有顯著效益；其二，將原始問題自動轉換為標準凸形式的工具開發有力推動了這一發展。隨著各應用領域問題複雜度與規模的不斷提升，亟需大幅提升凸規劃求解器的性能與效率。以金融領域的回測為例，需在7小時交易窗口期內每日求解數百萬個二次規劃或二階錐規劃問題以優化持倉成本與交易成本的縮放因子等參數，而單一軟件求解器完成此類任務需耗時約一個月。 為提升求解器的速度與效率，可通過利用稀疏結構、優化求解器算法中的數值表示，並使硬件架構契合算法計算特性，手動設計領域專用的硬件加速器。然而此類加速器的開發需同時具備硬件與算法領域的深厚專業知識，且需投入大量專項研發精力。此外，針對不同類別的凸優化問題需重複進行最優加速器設計流程。因此，亟需建立系統性探索機制並實現針對凸規劃問題特性的自動化硬件設計生成。 本研究提出一種自動化算法—硬件協同設計框架，旨在提升錐規劃求解器的運算速度與能效，同時保證求解精度。該框架可針對源自不同應用的任意凸錐規劃問題，自動生成滿足特定延遲要求、功耗預算與硬件資源利用率需求的專用高效FPGA實現方案。 具體而言，我們將探索創新的量化與運算精簡策略，以應對兩類主流錐規劃求解技術：處理大規模問題的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）與實現高精度求解的內點法（IPM）。擬建框架將在包括金融投資組合優化、模型預測控制、機器學習中的最小絕對收縮與選擇算子（LASSO）以及電網最優潮流等多元化凸優化應用中進行嚴格評估。此外，該框架將與凸優化領域專用語言實現集成，為相關領域的從業者提供重要技術支持。

16207825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16207825.value: 新型超越對角線可重構智慧表面的設計

16207825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16207825.value: Annual mobile network data traffic in wireless communication cellular systems is predicted to increase from 145 Exabytes in 2024 to 450 Exabytes in 2029 (Ericsson Mobility Report, June 2024). Such continuously increasing demand requires new technology developments and breakthroughs to meet it. New technologies being explored include novel configurations of electromagnetic structures and antennas. Of these, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) are seen as having potential to enhance wireless communications in two ways. The first is to have RIS positioned in the environment to smartly control the propagation environment and increase wireless communication performance. The second is through integrating RIS into transmitter and receiver structures to control the radiated and received electromagnetic waves in new ways and perform radio frequency (RF) signal processing. Recently an extended form of RIS has been proposed that has become known as beyond diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RIS). BD-RIS extends conventional RIS by allowing individual elements in the RIS to be coupled together to enhance the required scattering performance. BD-RIS could become one key to fulfilling the potential of RIS. It has been shown that significant improvement in performance over conventional RIS can be obtained. However there have been very few designs or prototypes for BD-RIS reported. The challenges for their design and development is the need for linking structures between the elements in the RIS. In this proposal the objective is to be one of the first to design novel BD-RIS structures. Novel techniques for meeting the design challenges will be developed. They include the development of surface structures with reconfigurable coupling, integrated antennas, pixel element coupling and electronically steerable parasitic antennas. In addition a general model for modelling all types of BD-RIS, including those made with sub-wavelength elements and with no external ports will also be developed to aid the design process. The importance of developing BD-RIS is that they can provide conventional RIS with a performance enhancement that strengthens the case for potential applications of RIS. They therefore could have an important impact on wireless communication applications from enhanced communication and sensing to single-RF transceiver designs. They can also be a more fundamental contribution in areas such as signal processing units and metamaterial processing units. Therefore, there could be significant opportunities for technology transfer and impact beyond academia. 無線通信蜂窩系統中的年度移動網路數據流量將預計從 2024 年的 145 艾位元組增加到 2029 年的 450 艾位元組（資料來源: 2024 年 6 月的愛立信行動報告）。這種不斷增長的需求需要新的技術發展和突破來配合，包括正在探索的新技術如電磁結構和天線的新配置。其中的可重構智慧表面 （RIS） 被認為具有通過兩種方式來增強無線通信的潛力。首先是將RIS定位在環境中，以智慧控制傳播環境並提高無線通信性能。其次是將RIS集成到發射機和接收機結構中，以新的方式控制輻射和接收電磁波，並進行射頻（RF）信號處理。 最近提出了一種擴展形式的 RIS，它被稱為超越對角線可重構智慧表面（BD-RIS）。BD-RIS可以成為發揮RIS潛力的關鍵之一。在傳統的RIS 上，BD-RIS通過允許RIS中的單個元件耦合在一起來增強所需的散射性能，並已經證實與傳統RIS相比，可以獲得顯著的性能改進。然而，目前還沒有報導 BD-RIS 的任何設計或原型。它們的設計和開發面臨的挑戰是需要在 RIS 中的元素之間進行連接結構。 在該提案中，目標是成為首批設計新型 BD-RIS 結構的團隊之一。我們將開發應對設計挑戰的新技術，其中包括開發具有可重構耦合的可程式超表面結構、集成天線、圖元元件耦合和電子可縱寄生天線設計。此外，我們還將開發一個用於對所有類型的 BD-RIS 進行建模的通用模型，包括那些用亞波長元件製成且沒有外部埠的 BD-RIS，以説明設計過程。 開發 BD-RIS 的重要性在於它們可以為傳統 RIS 提供性能增強，從而加強 RIS 的潛在應用。因此，它們會對無線通信應用產生重要影響，從增強的通信和傳感到單射頻收發器設計。它們還可以在信號處理單元和超材料處理單元等領域做出根本的貢獻。因此，這項研究除了對學術界影響之外，還提供了重大的技術轉讓機會。

16209225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16209225.value: 使用剪切力增強冷凍海水淡化技術中的除鹽率

16209225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16209225.value: The formation of ice in seawater is associated with a phenomenon termed ion rejection, where salts are apt to be expelled by ice and tend to stay in the liquid phase (brine). The percentage of ions in the aqueous solution is defined as the ion rejection rate. A high ion rejection rate corresponds to a low salt concentration in the ice. This phenomenon is the basis for an emerging desalination technique, i.e., freeze desalination, where salts are removed by freezing seawater. Freeze desalination is a promising approach compared with conventional desalination methods. It requires 1/7 of the energy consumed in thermal desalination due to the low latent heat of freezing. It is also superior to membrane-based desalination in terms of maintenance costs and environmental impact. However, ion rejection is a dynamic process, and ion trapping in ice is a common issue that reduces the ion rejection rate and the efficiency of freeze desalination. Improving the ion rejection rate is thus a critical practical issue in freeze desalination. Recently, we studied the microscopic mechanisms of ion rejection through molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and found that ion rejection is the consequence of the fact that ion-water interactions are stronger than ion-ice interactions. Furthermore, the dynamics of ions at ice-water interfaces is mainly determined by the competition between two factors: the growth rate of ice and the diffusion of ions. To enhance ion rejection rates, the diffusion of ions needs to be faster than the growth rate of ice. This ensures that ions have sufficient time to diffuse into the aqueous solution under relatively strong ion-water interactions. In this project, we propose a new method to enhance the ion rejection rate by increasing the ion diffusion coefficient using external shear. This idea is inspired by one of our previous studies, where we found that shear flows can enhance molecular diffusion at ice-water interfaces. Preliminary results show that the ion rejection rate can be greatly improved by shear forces (see Fig. 7 in the proposal). Both MD simulations and experiments will be conducted. MD simulations will be performed to explore the effects of shear rates and temperature on the ion rejection rate. Experiments will be conducted to qualitatively confirm the idea and MD results. The proposed work will offer insights into the design of novel freeze desalination systems and advance the commercialization of freeze desalination. 海水中冰的形成與一種稱為離子排斥的現象有關，其中鹽分容易被冰排出，並傾向於停留在液相（鹽水）中。 水溶液中離子的百分比定義為離子去除率。 高離子去除率對應於冰中的低鹽濃度。 這種現象是新興冷凍海水淡化技術的基礎，即通過冷凍海水去除鹽分。 與傳統的海水淡化方法相比，冷凍海水淡化是一種很有前途的方法。它需要能量是傳統蒸餾方法的 1/7。 在維護成本和環境影響方面，它也優於膜式海水淡化。 然而，去除離子是一個動態過程，離子滯留在冰中是一個常見問題，它會降低離子去除率和冷凍海水淡化的效率。 因此，提高離子去除率是冷凍海水淡化技術中一個關鍵的問題。 最近，我們通過分子動力學（MD）仿真研究了離子排斥的微觀機制，發現離子排斥是離子-水相互作用強於離子-冰相互作用的結果。 此外，冰水介面處離子的動力學主要由冰的生長速率和離子擴散兩個因素之間的競爭決定。 為了提高離子去除率，離子的擴散需要快於冰的生長速度。 這確保了離子有足夠的時間擴散到水溶液中。 在本專案中，我們提出了一種利用外部剪切力增加離子擴散係數來提高離子去除率的新方法。 這個想法的靈感來自我們之前的一項研究，我們發現剪切流可以增強冰水介面的分子擴散。 初步結果表明，剪切力可以大大提高離子去除率（見方案圖7）。 我們將進行 MD 模擬和實驗。 利用 MD 模擬以探索剪切速率和溫度對離子去除率的影響。 用實驗定性證實該想法和 MD 結果。 擬議的工作將為新型冷凍海水淡化系統的設計提供見解，並推動冷凍海水淡化技術的商業化。

16209625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16209625.value: 快速有效的蛋白質結構比對

16209625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16209625.value: A protein molecule is composed of a chain of amino acids folded in the three-dimensional (3D) space. An important computational task for studying evolutionary information and predicting protein functions is protein structure alignment -- aligning proteins along their 3D structures -- to identify overlaps and variations. Because of the high complexity of protein structures as well as that of the alignment task itself, current methods either take a long running time or produce low-quality alignment results. Therefore, in this project, we propose to improve the speed and effectiveness of protein structure alignment. Specifically, we will first conduct a performance study comparing representative protein structure alignment methods, including both traditional non deep learning (non-DL) algorithms and recent deep learning (DL) models. We will not only measure the alignment result accuracy but also the performance of downstream tasks including protein classification, evolution history construction, and protein function inference. These downstream tasks exercise alignment intensively, and their results are of scientific or practical importance. With insights from the proposed performance study, we will develop a new GPU-accelerated non-DL protein structure alignment algorithm with high alignment accuracy. In particular, we will accelerate FTalign, a state-of-the-art non-DL method, with the GPU, by designing GPU-friendly data structures to represent proteins, developing GPU kernel programs to parallelize the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to perform a global search in the 3D space, and scheduling CPU-GPU co-processing to speed up the entire workflow. Finally, we will design a new DL-based evolution-aware protein structure alignment algorithm. DL models perform poorly on pair-wise alignment accuracy, but they may embed evolutionary information and can potentially assign higher scores to amino acids that are evolutionarily more important. Based on this observation, we will design a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to encode a 3D protein structure with evolutionary information preserved, and develop a novel model architecture that predicts evolution-aware alignment scores, which will enhance the effectiveness of downstream tasks such as protein function prediction. In summary, our proposed research will advance the state of art by (1) revealing the performance characteristics of a wide selection of existing structure alignment tools, (2) accelerating a non-DL method with high alignment accuracy on the GPU, and (3) developing a new DL method that is effective for downstream tasks. Our code packages will be put in the public domain for researchers and practitioners to follow up and apply in real-world protein structure alignment and downstream tasks. 蛋白質分子由氨基酸序列組成，並在三維（3D）空間中摺疊。研究進化資訊和預測蛋白質功能的一個重要計算任務是蛋白質結構比對——沿著其3D結構比對蛋白質，以識別重疊和變異。由於蛋白質結構的高度複雜性以及比對任務本身的複雜性，目前的方法要麼需要較長的運行時間，要麼產生低質量的比對結果。因此，在本項目中，我們提出改善蛋白質結構比對的速度和有效性。具體而言，我們將首先進行性能研究，對比代表性的蛋白質結構比對方法，包括傳統的非深度學習（non-DL）算法和近期的深度學習（DL）模型。我們不僅將測量比對結果的準確性，還將評估下游任務的性能，包括蛋白質分類、進化歷史構建和蛋白質功能推斷。這些下游任務強烈依賴比對，其結果具備科學或實用的重要性。根據所提議的性能研究，我們將開發一種新的GPU加速的non-DL蛋白質結構比對算法，以實現高準確性的比對。特別是，我們將通過設計適合GPU的數據結構來表示蛋白質，開發GPU核心程序以並行化快速傅立葉變換（FFT）來進行3D空間中的全局搜索，並安排CPU-GPU共同處理來加速整個工作流程，從而加速FTalign這一先進的非-DL方法。最後，我們將設計一種新的基於DL的進化感知蛋白質結構比對算法。雖然DL模型在成對比對準確性方面表現不佳，但它們可能嵌入進化資訊，並且能夠對進化上更重要的氨基酸賦予更高的分數。基於這一觀察，我們將設計隱馬可夫模型（HMM）來編碼保留進化資訊的3D蛋白質結構，並開發一種新穎的模型架構來預測進化感知的比對分數，這將提升下游任務如蛋白質功能預測的有效性。總之，我們提議的研究將通過（1）揭示多種現有結構比對工具的性能特徵，（2）在GPU上加速一種高準確性的非-DL方法，以及（3）開發一種對下游任務有效的新DL方法，來推進這一領域的最新進展。我們的代碼包將公開供研究人員和實務工作者跟進並應用於實際的蛋白質結構比對和下游任務。

16209725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16209725.value: 塊石泥石流沖擊多重柔性防護結構的試驗與數值模擬研究

16209725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16209725.value: Debris flows are fast-moving mixtures of water, soils and often with different amounts of boulders. They pose significant hazards in mountainous urban areas like Hong Kong, where more than 30% of the land has inclinations steeper than 30°. The increasing intensity and frequency of extreme rainfall events due to climate change have amplified landslide and debris flow risks in such densely populated hilly areas. Landslides and flooding have caused more than US$ 40 billion in damages and over 26,000 deaths between 2000 and 2014, with 70% of these losses occurring in Asia alone. Debris flows with a large number of boulders in the flow front can exert enormous forces on rigid and flexible barriers, leading them to failure. However, we currently have only a limited understanding of how boulder content (amount) affects the behaviour of debris flows and its impact against multiple barriers, especially flexible barriers. To mitigate geohazard risks, it is therefore vital to improve our fundamental understanding of the complex interactions between debris flows mixed with boulders and multiple barriers. This improved knowledge will help us to save thousands of lives, reduce damage to infrastructure and minimise significant economic losses globally. In this proposed project, we will utilise the newly established the world’s largest man-made flume testing facility, measuring 190-m long and 6-m wide, to conduct experiments of debris flows mixed with different boulder contents impacting on multiple flexible barriers, which reduce carbon footprints significantly. This facility was jointly developed by my university and the Chinese Academy of Sciences. These proposed experiments will produce unique physical test data for validating existing design guidelines worldwide and our newly proposed coupled numerical model capable of simulating debris flow-boulder-barrier interactions. The validated numerical model will be used for back-analysis and parametric studies to offer new insights into how boulders influence flow dynamics and impact forces. The effects of boulder contents on pore pressure evolution in debris flow dynamics and the dissipation of energy during impacts will be elucidated. This research will fill the knowledge gaps regarding complex interactions between debris flow and multiple barriers, providing the scientific basis for advancing new design guidelines for multiple barriers that will enhance their reliability in debris flow hazards mitigation. By enhancing our understanding of these complex interactions, we aim to foster safer environments and better preparedness for communities at risk from debris flows in Hong Kong and other regions worldwide.

16210025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16210025.value: 基於非均勻量化增強技術與層次化KV緩存管理的存算一體大語言模型處理器

16210025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16210025.value: Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLM) represent a revolutionary breakthrough in AI development, offering unprecedented capabilities in understanding and generating human language. However, LLM's large modelsize and computation amount lead to the Von Neumann bottleneck of conventional AI processors, which significantly harms both performance and energy efficiency. Computing-in-memory (CIM) offers a solution to this bottleneck by integrating compute into memory. Prior research has demonstrated that CIM is a promising architecture for energy-efficient Transformer model acceleration. However, distinct from conventional encoder-dominant Transformers, LLM consists of two stages: Compute-intensive Prefill and memory-intensive Decoding. The Decoding stage is a new bottleneck for LLM inference latency and energy, resulting in three challenges for designing CIM-based LLM processors, in the CIM macro, memory management, and processor architecture aspects. 1) Non-uniform quantization (NUQ) are regarded as an promising solution to extreme bitwidth reduction while maintaining high accuracy for LLM, but its index-based computation is not suitable for conventional CIM's multiply-accumulation (MAC) structure. 2) The Decoding stage requires repeatedly fetching KV cache for token generation, leading to massive off-chip memory access. 3) Prefill/Decoding ratios, layer parameters, and token length vary across different LLMs. Previous processor architectures lack adequate flexibility to handle the workload diversity, causing resource underutilization. This project will propose a CIM-based LLM processor with NUQ-MAC enhancement and hierarchical KV cache management to address the three challenges. Three research tasks will be completed: 1) [Mixed-Quantization CIM Macro] Design a double-wordline digital CIM macro with a content-addressable-memory-based index searching unit to support uniform MAC mode for Prefill and NUQ-MAC mode for Decoding. Develop an automated explorer for rapid CIM circuit and layout optimizations. 2) [KV Cache Management] Exploit algorithm-hardware co-design to reduce off-chip KV cache access. Design a hierarchical KV cache management unit supporting a static+dynamic KV cache fetching mechanism and long/short-term memory management mechanism. 3) [Architecture and Chip Design] Design and fabricate an LLM processor with a reconfigurable network-on-chip architecture for flexible CIM core organization. Develop a resource scheduling framework and verification system based on the fabricated chip to demonstrate the proposed techniques and design methodology. The completion of this project will establish a cross-stack co-design methodology that integrates algorithm, architecture, and circuit innovations to realize high-performance and energy-efficient AI processors. Beyond academia, the proposed CIM-based LLM processors will facilitate intelligent applications across various domains, including edge devices and cloud services. This advancement will significantly contribute to the AI computing infrastructure development in Hong Kong and globally. 基於Transformer的大語言模型（LLM）代表了人工智能發展的革命性突破，在人類語言理解和生成方面展現出前所未有的能力。然而，LLM龐大的模型規模與計算量導致傳統AI處理器面臨馮諾依曼瓶頸，嚴重製約了性能與能效。存算一體（CIM）技術通過將計算單元嵌入存儲器，為解決這一瓶頸提供了新途徑。已有研究表明，CIM架構在高能效Transformer模型加速方面已展現出巨大潛力。 然而，與傳統以編碼器為主的Transformer不同，LLM包含計算密集的預填充（Prefill）和訪存密集的解碼（Decoding）兩個階段。解碼階段已成為LLM推理延遲和能耗的新瓶頸，為基於CIM的LLM處理器設計帶來三大挑戰：1）非均勻量化（NUQ）雖能通過極低位寬維持高準確度，但其基於索引的計算模式與CIM傳統的乘累加（MAC）結構不兼容；2）解碼階段需反覆讀取KV緩存以生成token，導致大量片外內存訪問；3）不同LLM的預填充/解碼比例、層參數和token長度差異顯著，現有處理器架構缺乏靈活性，導致資源利用率不足。 本項目將研究一種支持非均勻量化增強與層次化KV緩存管理的存算一體LLM處理器，通過三項研究任務解決上述挑戰：1）混合量化CIM宏單元：設計雙字線數字CIM宏單元，集成基於內容尋址存儲的索引搜索單元，支持預填充階段的統一MAC模式和解碼階段的NUQ-MAC模式，並開發自動化工具實現電路與版圖快速優化；2）KV緩存管理：通過算法-硬件協同設計減少片外KV緩存訪問，構建支持靜態+動態KV緩存預取機制與長短時內存管理的層次化緩存管理單元；3）架構與芯片實現：設計可重構片上網絡架構的LLM處理器芯片，開發基於流片驗證的資源調度框架，完整展示技術方案與設計方法學。 本項目將建立涵蓋算法、架構與電路的跨層級協同設計方法，推動高性能高能效AI處理器實現。所提出的存算一體LLM處理器不僅具有學術價值，還可賦能邊緣設備與雲服務等智能應用，為香港乃至全球AI計算基礎設施建設作出重要貢獻。

16210425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16210425.value: 为智能物联网构建可泛化可扩展的机器学习方案

16210425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16210425.value: This proposal outlines a project aimed at enhancing the Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) systems through the development of generalizable and scalable deep learning models. The project addresses key challenges, such as the heterogeneity of IoT data, computational limitations of IoT devices, and the need for affordable data and computing management solutions. To overcome these challenges, the project proposes a three-pronged approach. First, it aims to leverage massive amounts of unlabeled IoT data to build foundation models using self-supervised learning techniques. These models will extract fundamental features from sensor data to improve generalizability across diverse domains and applications. Second, the project will develop a collaborative framework for deep learning inference that integrates heterogeneous computing resources across the device hardware and IoT network, including edge devices and cloud servers. This framework will optimize workload partitioning and dynamic load balancing, thereby enhancing computational efficiency and improving scalability. The project also introduces the task of physics-informed deep learning to incorporate physical principles into model design, reducing the reliance on labeled datasets and improving model robustness. The research must address significant obstacles, such as the diversity of IoT data, which complicates the creation of models that generalize effectively, and the limited computational power of many IoT devices, which restricts the scale and timeliness of model inference. Additionally, managing large-scale data collection and computing infrastructure involves high costs that hinder widespread adoption. Innovative solutions are needed to manage data diversity, optimize resource allocation, and ensure cost-effective model training and deployment. Overall, this proposal presents a comprehensive strategy for advancing AIoT systems by devising advanced learning techniques, resource-efficient frameworks, and physics-based methodologies. These innovations are expected to lead to generalizable, scalable, and cost-effective AIoT solutions across multiple industries. 本项目旨在通过开发具备可泛化和可扩展性的深度学习模型，提升人工智能物联网（AIoT）系统的能力。该项目重点解决物联网数据的异构性、物联网设备的计算限制，以及对低成本数据与计算管理方案的迫切需求。为应对这些挑战，项目提出了三方面的策略。首先，利用海量的无标注物联网数据，通过自监督学习技术构建基础模型。这些模型将从传感器数据中提取核心特征，从而提升在多种领域和应用中的泛化能力。其次，项目将开发一个深度学习推理的协作框架，整合设备硬件和物联网网络中的异构计算资源，包括边缘设备与云服务器。该框架能够优化任务划分与动态负载均衡，从而提高计算效率并增强可扩展性。此外，项目还引入物理信息驱动的深度学习，将物理规律纳入模型设计，减少对标注数据集的依赖，并提升模型的鲁棒性。研究需应对的主要障碍包括：物联网数据的多样性使得模型难以实现有效泛化；多数物联网设备计算能力有限，制约了模型推理的规模和实时性；同时，大规模数据收集和计算基础设施的管理成本高昂，阻碍了广泛应用。因此需要创新的解决方案来管理数据多样性、优化资源分配，并确保模型训练与部署的经济性。

16210625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16210625.value: 基於圖索引的大規模最大內積搜索研究

16210625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16210625.value: Vector data refers to numerical representations of data objects for different types of data, such as text, images, or audio, using machine learning models to transform them into embeddings that can capture their semantic meanings. Vector databases provide scalable storage solutions and fast similarity-based searching capability for millions of vectors in several thousand dimensions. Similarity search plays a pivotal role in enhancing the robustness and adaptability of AI systems, addressing concerns such as hallucination and data privacy, and supporting more efficient and effective use of LLM (e.g., through Retrieval Augmented Generation or RAG). There are two main types of similarity searches: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) and Maximum Inner-Product Search (MIPS). ANNS finds a data point close to the query, while MIPS maximizes the inner product between a query and data items, essentially solving a nearest-neighbor search. MIPS is used widely in big data applications like recommendation algorithms and machine learning, being more computationally intensive and can be seen as a generalization of ANNS. Vector database research has predominantly concentrated on metric spaces for ANNS query processing. There is a pressing requirement to investigate efficient MIPS query processing. This is due to its versatility in supporting a broader range of applications, compatibility with non-metric similarity functions and out-of-distribution (OOD) issues, and its capability to integrate data from diverse domains such as text and images. This proposal will design accurate and scalable indexing and query optimization methods for MIPS query processing. Based on an extensive range of research work we have done for high-dimensional data management and ANNS query processing, in this project we set to take the challenges to support scalable MIPS query processing by addressing major limitations of the current vector database technology to support the MIPS operation. Our research focuses on (1) developing new index structures for efficient MIPS query processing using divide-and-conque and novel neighborhood discovery techniques in non-metric spaces, (2) devising efficient strategies to handle MIPS queries for extensive high-dimensional vector datasets, and (3) incorporating these approaches into a database system with specialized tools to optimize vector database queries. This study contributes to fundamental research on vector data management and query processing. 向量數據是指使用機器學習模型將不同類型的數據（如文本、圖像或音頻）轉換為保持語義信息的向量數值表示。向量數據庫提供可擴展的儲存解決方案，支持基於相似性的大規模高維向量快速搜索。這一功能在提升 AI 系統的穩健性與適應性方面扮演關鍵角色，是應對如幻覺生成和保護數據隱私等問題的基礎技術，可以高效支持大模型的各種應用（例如透過檢索增強生成，RAG）。 相似性搜索主要分為兩類：近似最近鄰搜索（ANNS）與最大內積搜索（MIPS）。ANNS 尋找與查詢接近的數據點，而 MIPS 則最大化查詢與數據項之間的內積，本質上也是一種最近鄰搜索。MIPS 廣泛應用於大數據場景，如推薦算法與機器學習，可視為 ANNS 的泛化和推廣。MIPS 更具通用性，能支持更廣泛的應用場景，與非度量相似性函數及分布外（OOD）問題兼容，並能整合來自文本與圖像等多種領域的數據。過去向量數據庫的研究主要集中在度量空間中的 ANNS 查詢處理，目前迫切需要探索高效的 MIPS 查詢處理方法。 本研究計劃將設計準確且可擴展的索引與查詢優化方法以支持 MIPS 查詢處理。基於我們在高維數據管理與 ANNS 查詢處理方面的前期研究成果，本項目旨在突破當前向量數據庫技術在支持 MIPS 操作方面的主要限制。我們的研究重點包括：（1）在非度量空間中使用分而治之的鄰域發現新技術，開發高效的 MIPS 查詢索引結構；（2）制定處理大規模高維向量數據集的 MIPS 查詢的高效策略；（3）將這些方法整合進一個數據庫管理系統，並配備專門工具以優化向量數據查詢處理。 本研究預期對向量數據管理與查詢處理基礎技術的研究做出重要貢獻。

16210725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16210725.value: 基於大型語言模型的偽代碼至代碼轉換之多面向框架

16210725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16210725.value: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable natural language understanding and code generation capabilities. However, their effectiveness in translating pseudocode to executable code remains understudied. Pseudocode, a popular method for sketching algorithmic solutions, bridges the gap between natural language and formal programming languages. Despite its widespread use, there is a lack of systematic research on LLMs' performance, limitations, and potential hallucinations in pseudocode-to-code translation. Automated pseudocode-to-code translation holds significant potential for various computer science and software engineering applications, including idea prototyping, legacy code maintenance, educational enhancement, and cross-language development. The translation process faces significant challenges due to inherent information gaps in pseudocode. These challenges stem from lacking crucial details such as data types, language syntax, memory management, error handling, and edge cases. In addition, pseudocode is not primarily written to be self-contained. For example, it often lacks information about the utilized data structures and the calling functions. It may also omit some initialization, computation, and optimization steps implicitly assumed by domain experts. The ambiguity in naming conventions, lack of proper documentation, and missing test specifications further hinder accurate code generation. To address these challenges, we propose to (1) develop a family of benchmarks to evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs' performance in pseudocode-to-code translation, identifying their strengths and limitations, (2) conduct an empirical study to systematically characterize the challenges in the translation process, focusing on types and frequency of missing information in typical pseudocode, (3) design and implement a multi-faceted framework to (a) resolve missing information, incorporating methods such as API documentation mining, partial code execution, abstract syntax tree construction, and (b) develop a novel validation framework for the generated code through compilation, runtime execution, and semantic analysis. By integrating these techniques, we aim to provide a comprehensive solution to the pseudocode-to-code translation problem. This research has the potential to significantly advance automated programming and software engineering, enhancing productivity and facilitating knowledge transfer between abstract algorithmic concepts and practical implementations. The outcomes of this study will contribute to a deeper understanding of LLMs' capabilities in pseudocode-to-code generation and pave the way for more effective automated programming tools. We will implement the multi-faceted framework and make it available to the public. The usefulness of this project receives strong support from the industry, which includes Huawei and Tencent. 大型語言模型（LLMs）已展現出卓越的自然語言理解與程式碼生成能力。然而，其在將偽代碼轉譯為可執行代碼方面的效能仍缺乏深入研究。偽代碼作為描述演算法解決方案的常用方法，能銜接自然語言與正式程式語言之間的鴻溝。儘管偽代碼被廣泛使用，學界仍缺乏對LLMs在偽代碼至代碼轉譯中的表現、限制及潛在幻覺問題的系統性研究。 自動化偽代碼至代碼轉譯對於電腦科學與軟體工程領域具有重要應用潛力，包含構思原型設計、遺留代碼維護、教育強化及跨語言開發等。然而，由於偽代碼本身存在資訊缺口，此轉譯過程面臨重大挑戰。這些挑戰源自偽代碼通常缺乏關鍵細節，例如資料型態、語言語法、記憶體管理、錯誤處理與邊界案例。此外，偽代碼的設計本質並非自我完備——它常省略資料結構與呼叫函式的相關資訊，也可能忽略領域專家默認的初始化步驟、運算過程或最佳化方法。命名慣例的模糊性、缺乏適當文件說明，以及測試規格的缺失，皆進一步阻礙了準確的代碼生成。 為解決這些問題，本研究提出：(1) 建立一套基準測試集，用於評估頂尖LLMs在偽代碼轉譯任務中的表現，釐清其優勢與限制；(2) 進行實證研究，系統性歸納轉譯過程中的挑戰，重點分析典型偽代碼缺失資訊的類型與頻率；(3) 設計並實作一個多面向框架，包含：(a) 解決資訊缺失的技術（如API文件挖掘、部分代碼執行、抽象語法樹構建），(b) 透過編譯檢查、運行時執行與語意分析，開發新型代碼驗證架構。 整合上述技術後，我們期望為偽代碼至代碼轉譯提供全面解決方案。此研究有望顯著推動自動化程式設計與軟體工程的發展，提升生產力並促進抽象演算法概念與實作之間的知識轉移。研究成果將深化學界對LLMs偽代碼生成能力的理解，為更高效的自動化編程工具奠定基礎。我們將實作此多面向框架並開源釋出。

16211125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16211125.value: 無人機旋翼寬頻噪聲混合預測框架：理論與數據驅動融合

16211125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16211125.value: Recent years have witnessed significant advancements in the field of multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Their applications have expanded across various industries. However, the noise generated by the rotor blades of these vehicles has brought significant concerns. Accurate noise prediction during the design phase is crucial for effective low-noise optimization. While traditional physics-based approaches have shown effectiveness in predicting tonal noise, the accurate prediction of broadband noise remains challenging, especially for small UAV rotors operating at low Reynolds numbers, where flow transition is highly sensitive to operating conditions. Furthermore, pure data-driven approaches, while promising, suffer from limitations in data availability and physical interpretability for rotor noise prediction. This project aims to address these limitations by developing a hybrid modelling framework that integrates physics-based and data-driven methodologies. The research will focus on three key areas: (1) developing a novel algorithm to infer the turbulent wall pressure spectrum (WPS) distribution from far-field noise measurements using a combination of beamforming and physics-based regularization; (2) establishing a transfer learning framework to improve the accuracy of empirical WPS models associated with different noise mechanisms (e.g., trailing edge noise, tip vortex formation noise) using limited high-fidelity experimental data; and (3) designing and validating a system using miniature on-board microphones to collect noise data during real-world UAV operations, enabling the inference of far-field noise levels with the consideration of acoustic scattering by the UAV airframe. The research will utilize a combination of semi-analytical modelling, numerical simulations, and experimental validation. Experiments will be conducted in anechoic wind tunnels and chambers using various wing and rotor models, complemented by real-world UAV flights. The resulting hybrid model will provide a more accurate yet cost-effective method for predicting UAV rotor noise. The proposed on-board microphone system will allow for a better assessment of the impact of UAV noise during real-world operation. The project’s findings will directly inform the design of quieter UAVs and contribute to the development of effective noise mitigation strategies. 近年來，多旋翼無人機領域取得了顯著進展，其應用已擴展至各行各業。然而，這類飛行器旋翼產生的噪音問題引發了高度關注。在設計階段準確預測噪音對於有效的低噪音優化至關重要。雖然傳統基於物理原理的方法在預測單頻噪音（tonal noise）方面已展現成效，但對於寬頻噪音（broadband noise）的準確預測仍存在挑戰，特別是針對低雷諾數運作的小型無人機旋翼——此類條件下流場轉捩對運行參數極為敏感。此外，純數據驅動方法雖具潛力，卻受限於旋翼噪音預測所需的數據可獲性與物理可解釋性。 本項目旨在開發一種融合物理建模與數據驅動方法的混合框架以突破這些限制，研究將聚焦三個關鍵方向：(1) 結合波束成形技術與物理正則化方法，開發新型演算法以從遠場噪音量測反推湍流壁面壓力頻譜（WPS）分佈；(2) 建立遷移學習框架，利用有限的高精度實驗數據提升針對不同噪音機制（如後緣噪音、葉尖渦流噪音）的經驗性WPS模型精度；(3) 設計並驗證微型機載麥克風系統，於真實飛行條件下採集噪音數據，同時考量機身聲散射效應以推估遠場噪音級。 研究將整合半解析建模、數值模擬與實驗驗證，於消音風洞及實驗室環境測試多種機翼與旋翼模型，並輔以實機飛行實驗。最終開發的混合模型將為無人機旋翼噪音預測提供兼具精度與成本效益的方法，而提出的機載麥克風系統能更準確評估實務操作中的噪音影響。研究成果將直接應用於靜音無人機設計，並為噪音緩解策略制定提供科學依據。

16211625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16211625.value: 面向多樣化環境的自適應知識編輯驅動的邊緣基礎模型演化

16211625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16211625.value: Foundation models (FMs) such as GPT-4 and Claude have demonstrated unprecedented performance across a variety of artificial intelligence (AI) applications, revolutionizing human life. Following this trend, deploying and running FMs in edge environments has become increasingly attractive as it offers reduced latency, guaranteed data privacy, and personalized user experiences. Existing work has successfully fulfilled on-device FM deployment through techniques like quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation, enabling localized AI services for end users. However, despite the compelling progress made in deploying FM services at the edge, its cloud-reliant properties on adapting large-scale FM into a lightweight version hinder further applications on broader scenarios, namely, all of them lack the flexibility to fully refactor the FM service life-cycle in diverse edge environments. Accordingly, the proposed project will aim to develop a novel editing framework to evolve edge FM services throughout the entire life-cycle, including architecture editing during FM construction, computation editing during FM inference, and output editing during FM maintenance. However, developing an ideal edge-based editing framework presents several practical difficulties. First, considering the fragmented, distributed, and heterogeneous resources (i.e., model and data) in the edge environment, it is infeasible to edit or reconstruct the deployed FM into a large-scale one by using a traditional centralized training framework. Second, the varying user requests and limited resources on the edge servers make it difficult to balance high throughput with performance during inference. A groundbreaking inference methodology with editable computation is required to provide users with faster, more efficient and friendly AI services. Third, although the introduction of edge environments brings more potential for FM deployment, the corresponding impact on the reliability of FM services has not yet been investigated by the research community. The complex edge environments make reliably editing the output of FM services during maintenance much more difficult than when they are deployed in the cloud. In this project, we will aim to address these challenges by developing a full-stack editing framework to enable flexible model scaling, elastic inference optimization, and reliable content generation in the diverse edge environments. Our proposed edge-based editing paradigm can be expected to serve as a fundamental infrastructure that revolutionizes the utilization patterns of FMs, offering accessible and cost-effective solutions for developers and users to harness the power of AI. 以 GPT-4 和 Claude 為代表的基礎模型（Foundation Models，FMs）在多種人工智能（AI）應用中展現了前所未有的性能，正在深刻改變人類生活。順應這一趨勢，將基礎模型部署並運行於邊緣環境已愈發受到關注，其優勢包括降低延遲、保障數據隱私以及提供個性化用戶體驗。現有研究已通過量化、剪枝和知識蒸餾等技術，實現了基礎模型的端側部署，為用戶提供了本地化 AI 服務。然而，儘管在邊緣部署方面取得了顯著進展，這些方法在將大規模基礎模型靈活重構為輕量化版本時仍依賴雲端處理，缺乏在多樣化邊緣環境下全面重構基礎模型服務生命周期的能力。 針對這一問題，本項目擬提出一種新型編輯框架，實現對邊緣基礎模型服務在全生命周期內的演化，包括模型構建階段的體系結構編輯、推理階段的計算編輯以及維護階段的輸出編輯。然而，構建理想的邊緣編輯框架仍面臨多重挑戰：首先，邊緣環境中模型與數據資源的碎片化、分佈式與異構化特徵，使得基於傳統集中式訓練框架將已部署模型重構為大規模版本變得不可行；其次，用戶請求的動態變化與邊緣服務器的資源受限，使得在推理過程中難以兼顧高吞吐與高性能，因此亟需一種支持可編輯計算的突破性推理方法，以提供更快速、高效和友好的 AI 服務；最後，儘管邊緣環境為基礎模型部署帶來更多潛力，但其對服務可靠性的影響尚未被充分研究，複雜的邊緣環境使得在維護階段可靠地編輯模型輸出比雲端環境更加困難。 為此，本項目將設計一個全棧編輯框架，實現靈活的模型擴縮容、彈性的推理優化以及可靠的內容生成，以適應多樣化的邊緣環境。所提出的基於邊緣的編輯範式有望成為革命性基礎設施，重塑基礎模型的使用模式，為開發者與用戶提供可及且具成本效益的 AI 解決方案。

16211825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16211825.value: 運用機器學習方法研究從離心機試驗與物質點法數值模型測試的非飽和土靜力觸探試驗（CPTu）結果

16211825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16211825.value: Prof WANG, Yu Prof Yerro-Colom , Alba

16211825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16211825.value: To support the vast infrastructure development plans outlined in ‘Hong Kong 2030+’ spatial development strategy and to provide a sound engineering design for the underground structures laid out in these plans, effective site investigation methods that accurately determine soil profiles and characterise in-situ soil properties are vital. Piezocone penetration testing (CPTu) is one such method, and it has been widely used to obtain a near-continuous profiles of soil information both in Hong Kong and internationally. A major challenge with this method involves interpreting the data on unsaturated soils, which are typically found in tropical and subtropical regions where the groundwater table is usually low. Due to the severe lack of fundamental understanding of cone penetration in unsaturated soils and also a lack of effective and efficient modelling tools, it is not clear how matric suction should be accounted for in CPTu data–soil property correlations. Ignoring the effects of suction during data interpretation may lead to biased characterisation of soil types inaccurate estimates of soil properties and thus to improper geotechnical design of structures embedded in unsaturated soils. This project will combine the use of geotechnical centrifuge and numerical modelling methods to investigate the fundamentals of cone penetration process in unsaturated soils. Miniature piezocones that are capable of measuring matric suction will be developed to conduct comprehensive centrifuge CPTu in unsaturated soil profiles with varying plasticity, for the first time of its kind in the literature. The new datasets will be used to validate a new material points method (MPM) numerical model for effectively simulating large-deformation, hydromechanically fully-coupled cone penetration process. Advanced constitutive models of unsaturated soils and unsaturated soil–cone interfaces will be implemented in the model. An adaptive-learning algorithm will be developed to reduce the number of fully-coupled MPM analyses of CPTu required to establish new correlations between CPTu data and matric suction in a computationally efficient manner. Existing and new field CPTu data derived from unsaturated soil profiles (both local and international) will be collected and used to evaluate the accuracy of the new CPTu data–suction correlations. The project outcome will provide engineers with new insights and modelling tools for CPTu in unsaturated soils. Engineers will benefit from this new set of verified CPTu correlations, which will aid their routine analysis and interpretation of CPTu data, leading to more accurate soil characterisation and engineering design of structures embedded in unsaturated soils. 為響應《香港2030+》空間發展策略中大規模基建的規劃，並為相關地下結構工程提供可靠的設計依據，極需採用能精確測定土層剖面與原位土體特性的現場勘察技術。靜力觸探試驗（CPTu）作為國際通用的原位測試方法，在全球範圍內被廣泛用於獲取近乎連續的土層信息。然而，此方法在解譯非飽和土層（常見於地下水位較低的熱帶/亞熱帶地區）數據方面仍面臨重大挑戰。由於對非飽和土中貫入機制的基礎認知嚴重不足，且缺乏高效建模工具，目前尚不明確如何將基質吸力效應納入CPTu數據-土體參數關聯體系。若在數據分析中忽略吸力影響，將導致土體類別以及參數判斷偏差、最終造成嵌入非飽和土層的土工結構的設計缺陷。 本項目將融合岩土工程離心機模型與數值模擬方法，系統地研究非飽和土的錐貫入機制。研究團隊將自主開發可同步測量基質吸力的微型靜力觸探儀，首次在不同塑性非飽和土層中進行一系列離心機CPTu試驗。所獲的新數據將用於驗證新開發的物質點法（MPM）數值模型－該模型考慮了先進的非飽和土本構模型及土-錐界面模型，能有效模擬大變形的錐貫入過程。同時，項目將研發自適應學習演算法，減少全耦合MPM計算次數，透過高效率的數據驅動模擬方法建立CPTu數據與基質吸力的新型關聯體系。研究也將整合香港非飽和土現場CPTu數據，用於驗證新建立關聯關係的準確性。 項目成果將為工程師在非飽和土CPTu測試領域提供全新的理論認知與建模工具。經過嚴格驗證的新型CPTu關聯體系將顯著提升常規測試資料的分析解譯效率，實現更精確的非飽和土體特性判別與土工結構工程設計。

16212125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16212125.value: 開發用於下一代衛星網路的環形發射極離子液體電噴霧推力器

16212125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16212125.value: Prof Shen, Yan Prof Yang, Zhengbao

16212125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16212125.value: The global satellite and application industry has experienced continuous growth over several decades. It now plays a vital role in boosting the global aerospace economy. Electric propulsion systems are key for launching commercial satellites. Small satellites require propulsion systems that have high specific impulse, adjustable thrust, high efficiency, and are compact in size and weight. Traditional propulsion systems are complex to manage and difficult to miniaturize. This project will develop a Circular-emitter Ionic liquid Electrospray Thruster (CILET) employing microfabrication processes to significantly improve the thrust density and performance of satellites. This will address the problems of low efficiency, large volume, and high cost associated with traditional electric propulsion systems. At the same time, the proposed CILET will provide innovative power system capabilities to support the construction of next-generation low-orbit satellite networks like SpaceX’s Starlink. The low-orbit satellite network is expected to not only replace existing fiber optic networks in remote regions but also serve as the backbone for the sixth generation of cellular networks (6G). In fact, there is a growing trend of fully replacing fiber optic networks with this type of satellite network, except in large cities. The development of high-performance electric propulsion technology in this project will be the key technology to achieving this breakthrough. 幾十年來，全球衛星及應用產業持續增長，如今在推動全球航空航天經濟發展方面發揮著至關重要的作用。 電推進系統是商業衛星發射的關鍵。小型衛星所需的推進系統需具備高比沖、推力可調、高效率以及體積小、重量輕的特點。傳統推進系統管理複雜，且難以小型化。本專案將研發一種採用微製造工藝的環形發射器離子液體電噴霧推進器，以顯著提高衛星的推力密度和性能。這將解決傳統電推進系統效率低、體積大、成本高的問題。 同時，擬研發的 環形發射器離子液體電噴霧推進器將提供創新的動力系統能力，為下一代低軌道衛星網路（如太空探索技術公司的 “星鏈”）的建設提供支援。低軌道衛星網路有望不僅在偏遠地區取代現有的光纖網路，還將成為第六代蜂窩網路（6G）的骨幹。事實上，除大城市外，用這類衛星網路全面替代光纖網路的趨勢正日益明顯。本專案中高性能電推進技術的研發，將是實現這一突破的關鍵技術。

16212425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16212425.value: 多模態知識圖譜賦能領域特定情境感知VLM智能體以輔助建築安全智能監測

16212425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16212425.value: The Development Bureau of HKSAR has mandated the adoption of a Smart Site Safety System since 2023, advocating smarter safety practices in construction management. In response to the governmental policy, the proposed project will revolutionize safety monitoring through innovative artificial intelligence (AI)-driven solutions that address the shortcomings of traditional computer vision techniques. Traditional vision-based monitoring solutions lacks the integration of domain-specific knowledge, semantic correlation among data, and adaptiveness to site-specific conditions, and is therefore inefficient in dynamic construction environments. Hence, this project will exploit vision-language models (VLMs), which are well suited for visual question answering, human-like reasoning and personalized query responses. In the context of construction safety monitoring, VLMs may enable compliance checking against a given set of safety rules. However, owing to the complex structure and representation of safety-related knowledge, the existing solutions fail to integrate construction-domain knowledge into AI-based safety monitoring systems. Although some studies have proposed using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based on an external database to support AI inference, only textual data sources (e.g., documents) have been considered, while the domain knowledge related to multimodal construction data sources is underexplored. More importantly, existing AI-based systems are not capable of self-adaptation, which would enable efficient knowledge updating for site-specific conditions or changing safety requirements. Therefore, the proposed project will develop a VLM-driven analytical framework for construction safety monitoring that integrates multimodal data sources into a construction safety knowledge graph to support more context-aware on-site safety monitoring and adaptive knowledge updating. The project will include three key tasks: (1) the integration of construction-specific knowledge graph learning with VLM-based safety monitoring using an automatic knowledge graph generation pipeline and a graph embedding method to enable knowledge-enhanced VLM inference, (2) the integration of multimodal construction-specific knowledge graph learning into a RAG framework using an algorithm to generate knowledge graphs from multimodal construction data sources and a RAG algorithm to improve VLM inference, and (3) the development of a virtual assistant capable of interacting with a construction site–specific knowledge graph using a knowledge graph-driven context-aware VLM prompting strategy and a semiautomatic workflow for site-specific knowledge graph learning. The developed system will be deployed and validated on site to ensure its applicability to real-world construction sites. The developed system will help prevent construction accidents, standardize safety monitoring practices, and promote a safety-first culture. 自2023年起，香港特別行政區發展局強制推行“智慧安全工地系統”，倡導在建築管理中採用更智能化的安全實踐。為回應政府政策，本項目旨在透過創新的人工智能技術革新建築工地安全監測方式,以解決傳統計算機視覺技術的不足。傳統基於計算機視覺的監測方案缺乏對領域特定知識的融合、數據間語義關聯的考慮以及對具體工地條件的靈活適應性，因此在動態的建築環境中效率低下。為此，本項目將利用視覺語言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）以輔助建築工地安全監測,VLM模型擅長視覺問答、類人推理及個人化查詢回應。 在工地安全監測領域，VLMs有望實現基於既定安全規則的合規性檢查。然而，由於安全相關知識的結構與表述複雜，現有方案未能將建築領域知識有效整合到基於人工智能的安全監測系統中。儘管部分研究提出利用基於外部資料庫的檢索增強生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）來支援人工智能推理，但僅考慮了文字資料來源（如文件）而對涉及多模態建築資料來源（如圖像、文字等）的領域知識挖掘尚不充分。更重要的是，現有基於人工智能的系統缺乏自適應能力，難以針對特定工地條件或變更的安全要求進行高效知識更新。因此，本計畫將發展一個由VLM驅動的智能工地安全監測分析架構，該框架將多模態資料來源整合至建築安全知識圖譜中，以支援更具情境感知能力的現場安全監測與自適應知識更新。 本項目包含三項核心任務： (1) 知識增強的VLM推理：將建築領域知識圖譜學習與基於VLM的安全監測融合，透過自動化知識圖譜產生流程和圖嵌入方法，實現知識增強的VLM推理。 (2) 多模態知識增強的RAG框架：將多模態建築領域知識圖譜學習融入RAG框架，利用演算法從多模態建築資料來源產生知識圖譜，並應用RAG演算法優化VLM推理。 (3) 情境感知虛擬助理開發：開發能與工地特定知識圖譜互動的虛擬助手，採用知識圖譜驅動的上下文感知VLM提示策略與半自動化工地領域專業知識圖譜學習流程。 所開發的系統將在實際工地推行及驗證，以確保其在真實工地環境中的適用性，該系統將有助於預防工地安全事故、規範安全監測實踐並推廣安全第一的文化。

16212825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16212825.value: 利用混合键合技术的三维集成电路架构和设计探索

16212825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16212825.value: As Moore's Law slows, shrinking transistors and boosting performance with 2D integrated circuits is increasingly difficult due to power density, heat dissipation, and rising costs. **3D integration**, especially **hybrid-bonding**, presents a promising solution, offering fine-grained connections between stacked dies. This technology can significantly improve performance but requires rethinking computer architecture, design automation, and software. In 2D circuits, as chip size grows, interconnects get longer, leading to increased latency and power consumption. Heat management also becomes more difficult, limiting further performance gains. These factors drive the need for alternatives like 3D integration to overcome 2D limitations. 3D integration stacks semiconductor devices vertically, reducing interconnect length, latency, and power usage, while boosting bandwidth. Unlike 2D systems, it allows for continued performance scaling by using the vertical dimension. Hybrid-bonding, an advanced 3D technique, bonds dies with fine-pitch interconnects, enabling high-density, low-latency, and energy-efficient communication, ideal for tighter integration of compute and memory resources. Rethinking Computer Architecture: Hybrid-bonding calls for a shift in computer architecture. It enables compute-in-memory (CIM) and near-memory computing, reducing data movement and improving efficiency for tasks like AI and machine learning. It also supports heterogeneous architectures, where different processing elements (CPUs, GPUs, accelerators) are tightly integrated in the same 3D stack, offering better performance and resource sharing. Design Automation Challenges: New design automation tools are needed to handle hybrid-bonding's complexity. Current EDA tools, built for 2D or older 3D designs, must adapt to manage placement, routing, and thermal management in finer-grained 3D systems. Advanced optimization techniques and multi-physics simulations will be critical for reliable designs. Software Stack Considerations: The software stack must evolve to fully use 3D systems' benefits, like reduced memory latency and increased parallelism. Compilers, memory management, and runtime systems must adapt to efficiently use the bandwidth and processing power within a 3D stack, minimizing off-chip communication. To summarize, Hybrid-bonding 3D integration offers a new path forward in the post-Moore's Law era, promising major improvements in computing performance. However, to fully realize its potential, innovations in architecture, design automation, and software are essential for the next wave of computing advancements. 随着摩尔定律放缓，依靠传统的二维集成电路继续缩小晶体管、提升性能已愈发艰难：功耗密度激增、散热瓶颈凸显、制造成本飙升。三维集成电路，尤其是混合键合（Hybrid-bonding）技术，正成为破局之道。它可在堆叠芯片间实现微米级乃至亚微米级互连，为性能跃迁打开新通道；但要真正落地，计算机体系结构、设计自动化与软件栈必须彻底重构。 混合键合是一种先进三维集成电路工艺，可在芯片间实现超细间距互连，带来高密度、低延迟、低能耗的通信通道，尤为适合计算与内存资源的深度融合，推动近存计算或者是存内计算的新计算架构的发展。另一方面，现有EDA工具面向二维或早期三维工艺，难以处理混合键合的精细结构。新一代工具需同时优化布局、布线、热/电/机械的多物理场耦合，并借助先进算法与仿真确保可靠性。同时，要充分利用三维系统带来的低内存延迟与高并行度，软件工具比如编译器、内存管理、运行时均须升级，从而能智能调度片上带宽与算力，最大限度减少片外通信，以及面向3D拓扑重构数据布局与任务划分。 总之，利用混合键合的三维集成为“后摩尔时代”指明新路，有望带来计算性能的量级提升。唯有在体系结构、设计自动化与软件层面同步创新，方能释放其全部潜能，开启下一轮计算革命。

16213025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16213025.value: 基於彈性波的全固態熱彈性製冷

16213025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16213025.value: Space cooling accounts for more than 30% of the indoor energy consumption in modern cities and the cooling demand keeps increasing rapidly amid global warming. The widely used vapor-compression cooling systems generally adopt refrigerants with enormous global warming potential, and the development of non-vapor-compression cooling technologies is in urgent demand. Among various cooling technologies, thermoelastic cooling is recognized as one of the most promising alternatives owing to its merits of eco-friendly refrigerants, large cooling capacity, and high energy efficiency. However, current thermoelastic coolers still need heat transfer liquids to operate, which complicates the system design and limits the cooling performance as well as operation temperature. To address these issues, we propose to develop all-solid-state thermoelastic coolers by adopting elastic waves as heat carriers, which exploit the phase differences between the elastic waves and the induced thermal waves in solids to generate directional heat flow. Our preliminary analysis shows the proposed cooler could potentially achieve a much wider temperature span than the conventional thermoelastic cycle and a high COP >10. To further the proposed research, we will first develop comprehensive theoretical models to describe the heat transfer process and thermodynamic details in these elastic-wave-enabled thermoelastic coolers in both the elastic and elastocaloric regimes. Numerical simulations will be conducted to verify the theoretical modeling and investigate the effects of various design factors on the cooling performance. The knowledge attained will be used to design an optimized prototype of the proposed cooling structure, whose performance will be experimentally characterized by an integrated platform. By changing the driving force/strain and heat loading, the cooling performance of the optimized design, including the temperature span, the cooling power and COP, will be experimentally studied and evaluated under various operation conditions. The successful development of this new-concept cooler may address many challenges faced by traditional thermoelastic devices and pave the way for developing high-performance all-solid-state thermoelastic cooling technology that is more eco-friendly and more efficient. 在現代城市中, 製冷佔室內能耗的30%以上，且在全球變暖背景下，製冷需求正持續快速增長。廣泛使用的蒸氣壓縮製冷系統通常採用具有很強溫室效應的製冷劑，因此非蒸汽壓縮冷卻技術的研發迫在眉睫。在各類冷卻技術中，熱彈性製冷因其採用環保製冷劑、冷卻容量大且能效高的優勢，被視為最具潛力的替代方案之一。然而，當前的熱彈性冷卻器仍需依賴傳熱液體運行，這不僅使系統設計複雜化，還限制了製冷性能與工作溫度範圍。為解決這些問題，我們提出通過採用彈性波作為熱載體開發全固態熱彈性製冷器，利用固體中彈性波與誘導熱波之間的相位差生成定向熱流。我們的初步分析表明，該冷卻器有望實現比傳統熱彈性迴圈更寬的溫度跨度及高於10的能效（COP）。 為推進這一研究，我們將首先建立綜合理論模型，描述彈性波驅動熱彈性冷卻器在彈性區與熱彈性區的傳熱過程及熱力學細節；通過數值類比驗證理論模型，並探究多種設計因素對冷卻性能的影響。基於所獲知識，我們將優化冷卻結構原型設計，並通過集成實驗平臺對其性能進行表徵。通過調節驅動力/應變與熱負荷，我們將在不同工況下實驗研究並評估優化設計的冷卻性能，包括溫度跨度、製冷功率及COP。這種新型製冷器的成功研發有望應對傳統熱彈性器件所面臨的諸多挑戰，並為開發更環保、更高效的高性能全固態熱彈性製冷技術鋪平道路。

16213625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16213625.value: 动态zkSNARKs：更高效零知识证明的新范式

16213625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16213625.value: Zero-knowledge succinct arguments of knowledge (zk-SNARKs) allow an untrusted prover to convince a verifier about the outcome of a computation while the latter spends only minimal effort checking the proof and learns nothing besides the outcome itself. Over the past years, zk-SNARKs have evolved from cryptographic novelties of mostly theoretical interest to core components of secure systems deployed in practice, e.g., for scaling and "bridging'' blockchains, anonymizing digital-asset transactions, or decentralized identity management. Our starting point for this project is the observation that, despite long lines of research exploring various designs for zk-SNARKs and tremendous performance optimizations, existing zk-SNARKs share a common characteristic: even a single change to the input of the computation, e.g., a database element insertion or mining the next block in a chain, requires re-running the entire prover. To put it simply, producing a new proof after input changes is as costly as computing it "from scratch''. This is particularly bad since the prover's computational overhead for producing proofs is arguably the weakest performance aspect of zk-SNARKs---often orders of magnitude slower than simply performing the computation. Motivated by this, we will explore the notion of dynamic zk-SNARKs that allow the prover to update a previously computed proof if the input data changes. This should take time proportional to the part of the computation affected by the change and ideally be (asymptotically and concretely) faster than re-running the whole proving algorithm if the change is only partial. First, we note that existing general-purpose zk-SNARKs do not achieve this property because, at a high level, they typically encode the entire computation as a "monolithic'' set of constraints, such that any perturbation requires effort linear to the encoding size. For instance, modern SNARKs encode the computation circuit as polynomials of degree proportional to its number of gates. For security purposes, it may be necessary to evaluate this polynomial at freshly chosen random points after input changes. The focus of this project is to develop and implement dynamic zk-SNARKs with good practical performance and showcase their potential for use in practice, e.g., in blockchain computations or for highly dynamic database queries. One technical challenge is identifying techniques to ensure the necessary constraints are satisfied, in an updatable manner. We believe our notion of dynamic zk-SNARKs can be a step towards a new paradigm for zero-knowledge proof computation, processing, and maintenance, that will facilitate their further practical adoption. 零知识简洁知识论证（zk-SNARKs）允许不受信任的证明者在不泄露除结果本身以外任何信息的前提下，以极低的验证成本说服验证者某项计算结果的正确性。近年来，zk-SNARKs 已从理论上的密码学新奇事物，发展为实际部署安全系统的核心组件，例如区块链扩容与跨链、数字资产匿名交易、去中心化身份管理等领域。本项目的出发点在于观察到：尽管已有许多 zk-SNARK 设计与性能优化，现有zk-SNARKs 依然普遍存在一个问题——即便输入仅有细微变动（如数据库元素插入或新区块挖出），也需要让证明者重新运行整个计算，生成新的证明。换言之，输入发生变化后，生成新证明的成本与“从头开始”计算几乎一样高。考虑到生成证明的计算开销往往比直接执行计算慢几个数量级，这一缺陷尤其突出。 基于此，我们提出了“动态zk-SNARKs”（dynamic zk-SNARKs）的概念，使得证明者能够在输入数据变化时，对已有证明进行高效更新。理想情况下，更新所需时间应与受影响的计算部分成正比，并且无论从渐近意义还是实际中都应显著快于完全重算。首先需要指出，现有通用zk-SNARKs 不具备这一特性，因为它们通常将整个计算编码为“整体化”的约束集合，任何微小变动都需要付出与整个编码规模线性相关的计算成本。例如，现代 SNARKs 会将计算电路编码为次数与电路门数量成正比的多项式。为保证安全性，输入变动后还需在新选取的随机点上对多项式重新计算。本项目致力于开发并实现具有优良实际性能的动态zk-SNARKs，并展示其在区块链计算、高动态数据库查询等实际应用场景下的潜力。主要技术挑战在于如何以可更新的方式持续满足必要约束。 我们相信，动态zk-SNARKs 的提出将推动零知识证明在计算、处理与维护方面迈向新范式，并促进其更广泛的实际应用。

16213825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16213825.value: 口服可降解微針機器人的設計、製作與驅動

16213825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16213825.value: Micro-robots, with their small scale, high precision, and adaptability, offer vast potential in biomedical applications. Their ability to navigate within the human body and operate with precision makes them valuable for overcoming the limitations of traditional therapeutic methods. Especially in complex environments, these micro-robots can adapt to dynamic conditions, enabling targeted control and precise delivery, which enhances treatment effectiveness while minimizing side effects. Despite the advantages of existing micro-robots, many therapeutic molecules, especially large ones like proteins or vaccines, struggle to reach their target areas in the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, as they are often degraded quickly or poorly absorbed. As a result, therapies involving these molecules generally require injections, which can be inconvenient and uncomfortable for patients. This project aims to address these challenges by introducing a new kind of orally-taken micro-needles robot. This innovative micro-robot will be designed to deliver larger therapeutic molecules effectively and with precision within the GI tract. The micro-needles robot features a three-layer structure that enhances its movement, safeguards soft tissues, and allows controlled release at target locations. The inner layer consists of a magnetic core, enabling remote control through an external magnetic field so that the robot can navigate the GI environment. The middle layer includes a microneedle array that facilitates direct penetration into the intestinal wall for large molecules targeted delivery. Finally, an outer layer made from a sugar-based coating protects the soft tissue and gradually dissolves at the desired location. This design will allow the robot to withstand the acidic stomach environment and only release its therapeutic payload in the target area. After constructing and refining the micro-needles robot, we will further conduct in vivo experiments to test its effectiveness in managing conditions like diabetes, where precise protection, penetration, releasing and absorption of large molecules is essential. Compared to current intravenous injection methods for delivering macromolecular therapies, our micro-needles robot offers controlled movement, painless penetration, and adaptable delivery within the GI tract. This innovation will open new possibilities for administering macromolecular treatments orally, offering the benefits of higher patient compliance and a reduced risk of infection. By successfully implementing this project, we aim to contribute to the advancement of small-scale biomedical robots, potentially expanding their applications to a broad range of medical treatments. This could open the door to more comfortable and efficient delivery methods for therapies traditionally limited to injection, revolutionizing treatments for cancer and beyond. 微型機器人憑藉其體積小、精度高和適應性強等特點，在生物醫學應用領域展現出巨大的潛力。它們能夠在人體內精準導航和操作，有助於克服傳統治療方法的局限性。尤其是在複雜環境中，這些微型機器人能夠適應動態條件，實現精準控制和靶向遞送，從而提高治療效果，同時將副作用降至最低。儘管現有的微型機器人具有諸多優勢，但許多治療分子，尤其是蛋白質或疫苗等大分子，在胃腸道（GI）中往往難以到達目標區域，因為它們容易迅速降解或吸收不良。因此，涉及這些分子的療法通常需要注射，這給患者帶來了不便和不適。 本項目旨在通過引入一種新型口服微針機器人來解決這些難題。這種創新的微型機器人將被設計用於在胃腸道內有效且精準地遞送大分子治療藥物。這種微針機器人具有三層結構，增強了其運動能力，保護了軟組織，並能在目標位置實現可控釋放。其內部層由磁芯構成，可通過外部磁場實現遠程控制，使機器人能夠在胃腸道環境中導航。中間層包含微針陣列，便於直接穿透腸壁，實現大分子的靶向遞送。最後，外層採用糖基塗層，保護軟組織，並在預定位置逐漸溶解。這種設計使機器人能夠承受胃酸環境，並僅在目標區域釋放其治療有效載荷。在構建並完善微針機器人後，我們將進一步開展體內實驗，以測試其在糖尿病等疾病管理中的有效性，在這些疾病中，大分子的精確保護、穿透、釋放和吸收至關重要。與目前用於輸送大分子療法的靜脈注射方法相比，我們的微針機器人具有可控的運動、無痛穿刺以及在胃腸道內靈活輸送的特點。這一創新將為口服大分子治療藥物開闢新的可能性，帶來患者依從性更高和感染風險更低的優勢。通過成功實施該項目，我們旨在為小型生物醫學機器人的發展做出貢獻，有可能將其應用範圍擴展到廣泛的醫療治療領域。這可能會為傳統上僅限於注射的療法開闢更舒適、更高效的輸送方式，從而徹底改變癌症、炎症性疾病等的治療方法。

16214025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16214025.value: 用於生物機械能量收集的新型生物有機壓電複合材料的設計與製造

16214025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16214025.value: Prof LIU, Jun Prof YAO, Xi

16214025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16214025.value: The demand for wearable electronics, medical implants, and healthcare devices has surged, driving the need for flexible and biocompatible energy harvesting and sensing technologies. However, most commercial piezoelectric materials, such as lead zirconate titanate (PZT), are rigid, unbiodegradable, and toxic, limiting their biomedical applications. Piezoelectric biomaterials offer a promising alternative due to their biocompatibility and sustainability, but they often suffer from rigidity, brittleness, and weak piezoelectric properties, hindering integration into soft bio-interfaces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel manufacturing method aimed at developing piezoelectric biomaterial composites with customizable properties, including enhanced piezoelectricity, flexibility, and biodegradability. Leveraging our extensive research experience in piezoelectric biomaterials and energy harvesting, we introduce an electrohydrodynamic spraying technique combined with microfabricated shadow masks for the efficient fabrication of piezoelectric bio-organic materials and devices. Central to our approach is the electrohydrodynamic spraying method, which enables precise, one-step, and cost-effective fabrication of the composites. This technique facilitates the manipulation of biomolecules at the nanoscale, allowing for improved polarization alignment and composition control. The project comprises four main tasks: first, we will develop three platforms to fabricate different bio-organic piezoelectric materials composed of piezoelectric amino acids and flexible polymers. Next, we will analyze the key factors that affect the film formation and alignment of these crystalline materials, optimizing the piezoelectric performance. Third, we will refine the mechanical properties to enhance flexibility without sacrificing functionality. Finally, we will develop practical applications, including biomechanical energy harvesters and pressure sensor arrays, demonstrating the real-world potential of our materials. The anticipated outcomes include the creation of flexible piezoelectric biomaterial composites with significantly improved performance metrics, such as a large piezoelectric coefficient and low Young's modulus. This advancement will not only contribute to the field of materials science but also pave the way for the next generation of biomedical devices that are both efficient and environmentally sustainable. Ultimately, this project aims to transform the landscape of energy harvesters and sensors in healthcare, providing innovative solutions that enhance patient monitoring and treatment while reducing reliance on traditional batteries and their associated environmental impacts. Through collaboration with medical institutions, we aim to ensure that our research directly benefits society, making significant strides in both healthcare and sustainability. 對可穿戴電子設備、醫療植入物和健康護理設備的需求激增，推動了對柔性、生物相容的能量收集和感測技術的需求。然而，大多數商業壓電材料，如鋇鈦酸鉛（PZT），是剛性、不可生物降解且有毒的，這限制了它們在生物醫學領域的應用。壓電生物材料因其生物相容性和可持續性而提供了一種有前景的替代方案，但它們通常存在剛性、脆性和壓電性能弱的問題，這阻礙了其與軟性生物界面的整合。 為應對這些挑戰，我們提出一種新穎的製造方法，旨在開發具有可定制特性的壓電生物材料複合材料，包括增強的壓電性、柔韌性和生物可降解性。借助我們在壓電生物材料和能量收集方面的廣泛研究經驗，我們引入一種電動流體力學噴塗技術，並結合微加工陰影面具，以實現壓電生物有機材料和設備的高效製造。 我們方法的核心是電動流體力學噴塗法，該方法能夠實現複合材料的精確、一步式和高性價比的製造。該技術有助於在納米尺度上操控生物分子，從而改善極化排列和成分控制。該項目包括四項主要任務：首先，我們將開發三個平台，用於製造由壓電氨基酸和柔性聚合物組成的不同生物有機壓電材料。其次，我們將分析影響這些晶體材料薄膜形成和排列的關鍵因素，以優化其壓電性能。第三，我們將改進其機械性能，以在不犧牲功能性的前提下增強其柔韌性。最後，我們將開發實際應用，包括生物力學能量收集器和壓力感測器陣列，以展示我們材料的實際應用潛力。 預期成果包括創造出性能指標顯著改善的柔性壓電生物材料複合材料，例如高壓電係數和低楊氏模量。這一進步不僅將為材料科學領域做出貢獻，還將為下一代高效且環境可持續的生物醫學設備鋪平道路。最終，該項目旨在改變醫療保健領域能量收集器和感測器的格局，提供創新解決方案，以加強患者監測和治療，同時減少對傳統電池及其相關環境影響的依賴。通過與醫療機構的合作，我們旨在確保我們的研究能直接造福社會，在醫療保健和可持續性兩方面取得重大進展。

16214125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16214125.value: 面向6G的語義感知和通信一體化研究：實現超越物理層的協同效應

16214125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16214125.value: The field of wireless communications is evolving rapidly, with each network generation pushing the boundaries of possibility. While fifth generation (5G) technology has enabled exciting applications such as industrial automation and remote healthcare, the forthcoming sixth generation (6G) promises even more immersive experiences and integrated functionalities, including communication, sensing, computing, and learning. A critical component of this vision is the integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework, which allows wireless networks to gather real-time environmental data alongside communication services. Recent advancements in machine learning further enhance our ability to interpret both communication and sensing information, transforming raw data into meaningful insights and opening up significant opportunities for more efficient integration. Semantic communication improves information exchange by emphasizing the importance of meaning, leading to more intelligent, context-aware interactions. Similarly, semantic sensing enhances the effectiveness of sensing systems by focusing on the relevance of the information collected, enabling a deeper understanding of the environment. Integrating sensing and communication at the semantic level can significantly expand their synergy beyond the physical layer. However, several challenges must be addressed before we can fully realize the potential of integrated semantic sensing and communication (ISSAC) systems. For instance, due to the performance metrics at the semantic level, the fundamental limits of ISSAC systems differ from those of traditional ISAC systems and remain largely unknown. Additionally, designing ISSAC systems requires novel techniques to address joint design at the semantic level and efficient algorithms for semantic extraction in complex, dynamic environments. This research project aims to unlock the potential of ISSAC systems and develop enabling technologies for 6G. First, we will explore new performance metrics for sensing and communication at the semantic level and investigate the fundamental limits of ISSAC systems. Second, we will design efficient transceiver architectures and resource allocation algorithms powered by machine learning techniques to achieve these fundamental limits. Finally, to tackle the challenge of semantic sensing information being obscured by irrelevant data and the difficulty of extracting it in a single snapshot, we will propose successive semantic extraction protocols. These protocols will efficiently derive varying levels of semantic information from complex environments. The successful execution of this project, encompassing capacity characterization, system design, and efficient algorithms, will reveal the true potential of ISSAC systems and contribute to the development of innovative applications such as autonomous driving, ultimately fostering a more sustainable and interconnected society. 無線通信領域正在迅速發展，每一代網絡都為我們帶來了前所未見的應用。第五代（5G）技術已經使工業自動化和遠程醫療等令人興奮的應用成為可能，而即將到來的第六代（6G）將提供更具沉浸感的體驗和集成功能，包括通信、感知、計算和人工智能的一體化設計。實現這一願景的關鍵技術是通感一體化（ISAC）框架，使無線網絡能夠收集實時環境數據並提供通信服務。 機器學習的最新進展進一步增強了我們解釋通信和感知信息的能力，將原始數據轉化為有意義的信息，並為更高效的功能集成開闢了重要機會。 語義通信通過強調語義的重要性來改善信息交換，從而獲得更智能且與上下文一致的互動。同樣，語義感知專注於所收集信息的相關性，提高感知系統的有效性，幫助我們深入理解環境。 在語義層面上集成感知與通信可以顯著擴展它們超越物理層的協同效應。然而，實現語義感知與通信一體化（ISSAC）系統的潛力面臨幾個挑戰。首先，ISSAC 系統的性能上限與傳統 ISAC 系統不同，且在很大程度上未知。此外，設計 ISSAC 系統需要新穎的技術來解決語義層面的通感一體化設計及在複雜動態環境中進行語義提取的高效算法。 本研究項目旨在釋放 ISSAC 系統的潛力並開發面向 6G 的使能技術。我們將探索語義層面上感知與通信的新性能指標，研究 ISSAC 系統的性能上限，並設計高效的收發器架構和資源分配算法，利用機器學習技術來達到這些性能上限。為了解決語義感知信息被無關數據遮蔽的挑戰以及在單次快照中提取信息的困難，我們將提出連續的語義提取協議，這些協議將有效地從複雜環境中提取不同層次的語義信息。 這個項目在容量分析、系統設計和高效算法方面的成功執行，將揭示 ISSAC 系統的真正潛力，並促進自動駕駛等創新應用的發展，最終促進一個更可持續和互聯的社會。

16214525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16214525.value: 深海採礦中沉積物-流體-礦物結核相互作用的可微計算框架

16214525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16214525.value: Prof Kumar, Krishna Dr ZHAO, Shiwei

16214525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16214525.value: Polymetallic nodules (referred to as "nodules" hereafter) are abundant on the deep-sea seabed, with reserves of critical metals significantly surpassing those found on land. These essential mineral resources are vital for developing new energy technologies, such as lithium-ion batteries used in electric vehicles. As technology advances, the extraction of these deep-sea resources is becoming increasingly viable for commercial exploitation, positioning deep-sea mining as an emerging industry. However, this practice carries potential environmental risks, such as sediment plumes, highlighting the need for responsible exploration. Understanding the complex interactions between sediments, nodules, and fluids during the hydraulic collection of nodules from the seabed is crucial. Several factors influence these interactions, including the properties of the sediment-nodule mixture and the speed and angle of the water jets used in the mining process. These complexities make it challenging to assess operational efficiency and sediment plume formation. Currently, there is a lack of physics-based analytical tools to effectively model these interactions and provide a computationally efficient approach for optimizing deep-sea mining designs. This proposal aims to develop an innovative, highly efficient computational framework that integrates three advanced methods: Material Point Method (MPM), Discrete Element Method (DEM), and Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) for modeling sediments, irregularly shaped nodules, and fluids, respectively. By utilizing powerful parallel computing on graphics processing units (GPUs), this framework will serve as a numerical tool to investigate the interplay of key factors affecting sediment-nodule-fluid interactions. Moreover, we will enhance this framework by incorporating data-driven machine learning techniques. Specifically, we will improve the LBM solver using the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) and replace the MPM and DEM solvers with a new approach based on the Graph Network Simulator (GNS). This cutting-edge differentiable framework will be trained on high-quality data from our simulations, enabling it to predict the complex behaviors of fluid-particle systems more efficiently than traditional methods. Its differentiable feature makes it outperform conventional approaches, such as finite differences and Bayesian methods, in optimization tasks. The framework will undergo rigorous benchmarking against established solutions, experimental results, and real-world data to ensure its reliability. Once validated, it will be applied to practical assessments of operational efficiency and sediment plumes in deep-sea mining. Furthermore, this framework can be readily adapted for use in other fields, such as chemical engineering, energy, and agriculture, where understanding fluid-particle interactions is essential. Ultimately, this research aims to enhance our understanding of deep-sea mining while promoting environmentally sustainable practices. 深海海床富含多金屬結核（後稱礦核），其關鍵金屬儲量遠超陸地資源，這些礦物對新能源技術（如電動車鋰電池）發展至關重要。隨著技術進步，深海礦藏商業化開採的可行性日益提升，使深海採礦成為新興產業。然而此舉潛藏環境風險（如沉積物羽流），凸顯負責任開發之必要性。理解水力採集礦核過程中沉積物、礦核與流體間的複雜相互作用至關重要，此過程受多重因素影響：沉積物-礦核混合特性、採礦水射流速度與角度等，致使作業效率評估與沉積羽流預測極具挑戰性。目前尚缺乏基於物理機制的分析工具來有效模擬這些相互作用，並提供運算高效的深海採礦設計優化方案。本提案旨在開發一套創新高效的可微計算框架，整合物質點法（MPM）、離散元法（DEM）與格子玻爾茲曼法（LBM），分別模擬沉積物、不規則礦核及流體行為。透過GPU平行計算與機器學習技術強化——採用傅立葉神經算子（FNO）優化LBM求解器，並以圖網絡模擬器（GNS）取代MPM/DEM傳統解法——該框架經高品質模擬數據訓練後，可較傳統方法更高效預測流體-顆粒系統複雜行為，其可微特性在優化任務中顯著優於有限差分法與貝葉斯方法。經實驗數據與真實場景驗證後，將應用於深海採礦作業效率評估與沉積物羽流預測，同時具備擴展至化工、能源等領域的潛力，最終推動深海資源開發與環境永續性實踐。

16214625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16214625.value: CMOS D波段110GHz-140GHz FMCW收發器前端的設計與集成

16214625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16214625.value: Frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radars have found extensive applications in various emerging applications such as automotive sensing, vital-signal detection, gestures recognition, synthetic aperture radar, and joint radar-communication systems. As compared to other sensor types, such as cameras and lasers, FMCW radars offer several key advantages, including inherent distance and velocity detectability, robustness in extreme environmental conditions, and cost-effectiveness. However, the performance of existing FMCW radars in terms of ranging resolution and accuracy is still limited not only due to their narrow continuous chirp bandwidth and relatively high phase noise but also their large self-interference between the transmitter TX and the receiver RX. The objective of this proposed project is to leverage the investigator’s expertise and strengths in mm-Wave and sub-THz integrated circuits and systems to design an FMCW transceiver front-end with ultra-wide continuous chirp bandwidth, good phase noise, and good cancellation of the self-interference. To achieve the proposed objectives, the proposed transceiver front-end will require not only novel system architecture and integration but also innovative design techniques for key building blocks. First, a system architecture will be investigated for the proposed FMCW transceiver front-end, for which the specifications of the system and of the building blocks will be derived and verified by behavioral system simulations. Second, the key building blocks will be designed and demonstrated, including an ultra-wide-continuous-chirp-bandwidth low-phase-noise FMCW frequency synthesizer, a linear high-output-power power amplifier, a linear low-noise amplifier, and a linear wideband mixer. Finally, these building blocks will be integrated to realize the FMCW transceiver front-end, which will be simulated, laid out, fabricated, and demonstrated with state-of-the-art performance.

16215225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16215225.value: 分佈式彈性狀態估計與控制：一種數據驅動的方法

16215225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16215225.value: As artificial intelligence technologies advance rapidly, the interest in learning distributed estimators and controllers for unknown cyber-physical systems (CPS) directly from data has grown significantly. CPS plays a crucial role in industrial facilities and critical infrastructures, including smart grids, intelligent transportation, and environmental monitoring networks. However, accurately modeling these systems can be challenging or even unfeasible due to their complexity and interconnected nature. Consequently, developing distributed data-driven estimators and controllers for unknown CPS presents a viable solution and has great theoretical values and practical impacts. The pressing need to advance distributed data-driven state estimators and controllers for CPS with unknown system models reveals several key gaps in the current research. Existing data-driven research primarily focuses on a single system. However, in a complex CPS, multiple components/agents are involved, and data from a single component or agent is often limited. There is a notable lack of studies on designing distributed estimators and controllers that employ efficient data fusion strategies to fuse limited data from various agents. Additionally, less studies have focused on various data-driven CPS attack scenarios, detection mechanisms, and the development of resilient estimators and controllers that can withstand attacks both from pre-collected data and during normal operations. Furthermore, the effects of data volume, inadequate data fusion, and CPS attacks remain insufficiently understood, posing significant challenges to the advancement of data-driven solutions. This research addresses the design challenges of distributed data-driven state estimators and controllers for CPS with unknown system models. We propose methods for designing these estimators and controllers using limited data by developing efficient distributed data fusion strategies and cooperative design approaches. Additionally, we focus on creating resilient algorithms capable of withstanding various CPS attacks, including DoS, replay, and false-data injection attacks. Lastly, we will analyze the performance of these algorithms considering factors such as data informativity, data fusion, and data pollution, using mathematical tools from advanced control, optimization and statistical theories. The research will be validated through experiments and the development of a software toolbox, with the goal of translating the findings into practical industrial applications. 隨著人工智能技術的迅猛發展，直接從數據中學習模型未知的信息物理系統（CPS）的分佈式估計器與控制器，已日益受到學界重視。CPS在工業設備與關鍵基礎設施中扮演著重要角色，涵蓋智慧電網、智能交通及環境監測網絡等領域。然而，這類系統因為自身複雜性與互聯特性，建立精確的模型往往充滿挑戰，甚至是不可行的。因此，為模型未知的CPS開發分佈式數據驅動估計器與控制器，不僅是一種可行方案，更具備重要理論價值與實際意義。針對模型未知的CPS，發展分佈式數據驅動狀態估計器與控制器的需求日益迫切，此需求更凸顯當前研究的關鍵缺口。現有數據驅動研究多聚焦于單一系統，但在複雜的CPS中涉及多個組件和智能體，而單一智能體數據往往是有限的。現有文獻明顯缺乏透過高效數據融合策略整合各智能體的有限數據，以設計分佈式估計器與控制器的研究。此外，針對各類數據驅動的CPS攻擊方案、檢測機制，以及能同時抵禦來自數據收集與正常運行兩階段中攻擊的彈性估計器與控制器算法開發，相關探討仍屬不足。而且，學界對數據量的作用、不充分的數據融合，以及CPS攻擊對系統的影響機制尚未釐清，為數據驅動方案的發展帶來重大挑戰。本研究旨在解決模型未知CPS的分佈式數據驅動狀態估計器與控制器設計難題。我們提出透過開發高效的分佈式數據融合策略與協同設計方法，利用有限數據實現分佈式估計器與控制器的設計；同時專注開發能抵禦包括阻斷服務、重放攻擊與虛假數據注入等多元CPS攻擊的彈性算法。最後，我們將結合先進控制方法、優化技術與統計理論，系統性分析數據信息性、融合效能與數據污染等因素對算法性能的影響。我們將透過實驗驗證與軟體工具箱開發推動研究成果的落地，實現工業應用的技術轉化。
