Limited medical resources and the uncertainty of patients' true health status further exacerbate the difficulty. This project proposes a weakly coupled partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) model to address this problem. We aim to analyze the model's properties and also develop scalable algorithms with performance guarantees, to efficiently solve it. Additionally, we will explore applications of our method in rheumatic chronic disease management where more practical constraints will be incorporated to demonstrate our model’s applicability. Our ultimate goal is to deliver a practical decision-making tool that can support clinicians in improving patient outcomes and healthcare resource utilization in Hong Kong. 在医疗保健领域，为大规模人群（尤其是慢性病患者）确定最优的诊断测试与治疗决策是一项富有挑战性的工作。有限的医疗资源以及患者真实健康状况的不确定性进一步加剧了这一困难。 本项目旨在构建一个弱耦合部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（weakly coupled POMDP）模型来应对该问题。我们的目标是分析此模型的特性，并开发出具备性能保证的可扩展算法以实现高效求解。 此外，我们还将探索该方法在风湿性慢性病管理中的应用，通过引入更多现实世界中的约束条件，以验证模型的实际适用性。我们的最终目标是提供一个实用的决策支持工具 ，帮助香港地区的临床医生改善患者的治疗效果并提升医疗资源的利用效率。

16600225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16600225.value: 人口老化與經濟下行雙重衝擊下的中國社會保障體系：政策反饋現象研究

16600225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16600225.value: Dr Zhang, Chunni Prof Zhu, Ling

16600225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16600225.value: The rapidly ageing population, and the economic downturn are creating enormous pressure on both the Chinese economy and its social security system. Once promising comprehensive social security for all, the Chinese government has been grappling with increasing fiscal stress, declining coverage, and cost escalation. Old-age pensions and health care are most affected. With the increasing voluntary suspension of contributions—particularly among the younger population with no formal employment, people’s faith in the system’s sustainability is being eroded. This tension provides a real-world setting in which to review the prominent policy feedback theory in a continent-sized authoritarian country. This theory posits that existing policies can shape political behavior, public perceptions, and future policymaking in significant ways. Positive feedback generates beneficial outcomes that reinforce public support for the policy, leading to its continuation and expansion, whereas negative feedback produces adverse outcomes that undermine the policy itself. However, there have been debates about the actual mechanisms of policy feedback that require further theoretical treatment and empirical testing. If the positive feedback argument holds, we should observe relatively stable popular support for social security institutions but higher demand for government spending. By contrast, if the negative feedback argument prevails, popular support for the system should decline and people may prefer significant reforms or alternative provisions. This study seeks to explain Chinese people’s attitudinal and behavioral responses to the country’s strained social security system. Are they still willing to support the system not only in principle but also with monetary contributions? What are the policy feedback mechanisms that characterize the trajectory of social security policy in a rapidly ageing nation that is also grappling with economic volatility? What are the implications for the development of social policy and individuals’ social protection in a large middle-income country? These broad questions will be answered using a three-phase mixed-methods design. Comprised of a policy scientist, a sociologist, and a political scientist, the interdisciplinary research team has extensive disciplinary expertise, domain knowledge, and methodological experience. Upon completion, this project will not only have significant scholarly impact by contributing to the policy feedback literature but also generate policy impact with an in-depth investigation of Chinese people’s attitudes and behavioral choices regarding social security development in the country. 快速高齡化的人口與經濟下行正對中國經濟及社會保障體系造成巨大壓力。承諾實現全民社會保障的中國政府，如今正面臨日益加劇的財政壓力、社會覆蓋面萎縮及費用攀升等問題，其中養老金與醫療保障首當其衝。隨著民間自願斷保情況增加（在非正式就業的年輕族群中尤甚），民眾對社會保障制度可持續性的信心正逐漸降低。上述嚴峻的形勢為檢視政策反饋理論在一個大陸型威權國家的實踐提供了現實場域。 該理論指出，現行政策能以顯著方式形塑政治行為、公眾認知及未來政策制定：正向反饋產生良性循環，鞏固公眾支持促使政策延續擴張；負向反饋則引發惡性循環，動搖政策根基。然而關於政策反饋的實際運作機制仍存爭議，需進一步理論探討與實證檢驗。若正向反饋論成立，應可觀察到民眾對社保制度保持相對穩定支持，但同時要求更多政府支出；反之若負向反饋主導，民眾支持度將走低，直至對社保體制失去信心。 本研究旨在解釋中國民眾對重壓之下的社保體制的態度與行為反應：他們是否仍願意在觀念與經濟上支持社保？在同時面臨快速高齡化與經濟波動的情況下，主導社會保障政策走向的反饋機制為何？這些問題對大型中等收入國家的社會政策發展與個人社會保障有何意涵？ 研究團隊由政策科學、社會學及政治學學者組成，將採用三階段混合方法設計。本計畫完成後，不僅能透過政策反饋理論的實證貢獻產生學術影響，更將藉由深入剖析中國民眾對社保發展的態度與行為選擇，對政策制定產生實質影響。

16600425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16600425.value: 青年與長者於廣東話聲調雙耳分聽任務中的注意力控制：雙語經驗的作用

16600425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16600425.value: Prof Myachykov, Andriy Prof YANG, Xiaohu

16600425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16600425.value: Bilinguals who use two or more languages daily have been suggested to outperform monolinguals in cognitive capacities. This research investigates the bilingual effect on executive functions in younger and older adults. As one of the core executive functions, attentional control is often enhanced among bilinguals in the visual domain. An auditory task of forced-attention dichotic listening (henceforth, FADL), with simultaneous presentation of two stimuli (lexical tones) to both ears, is an ideal tool to investigate the bilingual effect on attentional control in the understudied auditory domain. While recent meta-analyses have challenged the bilingual effect, almost all the studies included in the meta-analyses have adopted a binary grouping of monolinguals versus bilinguals. In addition, a relatively robust bilingual effect might be claimed in older adulthood. Therefore, the proposed project research will adopt a gradient approach to quantify bilingualism continuously and examine the key component of bilingualism on attentional control among (younger and) older adults. Specifically, this study focuses on bilinguals of different ages, who speak two typologically distant languages (tonal-Cantonese vs. non-tonal-English) and have a wide range of bilingual experience (e.g., L2-English proficiency). The proposal adopts the FADL paradigm on Cantonese tone processing across three attentional conditions (from non-forced to two forced conditions), with two experiments conducted separately on younger and older adults with bilingual experience measured through LHQ3. The effects of attentional control, bilingualism, and age are examined using the hypotheses stated below: (1) The attentional control effect: Cantonese tones trigger a left-ear advantage (LEA) in the non-forced condition, a larger LEA in the Forced-left congruent condition, and an opposite pattern in the Forced-right incongruent condition. (2) The bilingual effect: bilinguals with higher L2 proficiency are expected to show a larger increase in instructed ear accuracy in the incongruent condition, which calls for the most attentional control, than their lower-proficiency counterparts. (3) The age effect: older bilinguals are expected to benefit more from lifelong bilingualism by showing a more pronounced bilingual effect than younger bilinguals. This two-year project aims to advance our understanding of the bilingual effect by examining its effect on attentional control in auditory domains and focusing on Cantonese tone processing by younger and older adults. The findings will help to reveal age-related changes in Cantonese tone processing, offer insights into the generalizability of the bilingual effect between diverse populations, and have broad implications on cognitive reserve and neural resilience in older adulthood. 前人研究指出，在日常生活中運用兩種或兩種以上語言的雙語者，在認知能力方面往往較單語者具優勢。本研究旨在探討雙語經驗對青年及長者執行功能的影響，尤其關注作為核心執行功能之一的注意力控制能力。既有研究顯示，雙語者（相對於單語者）在視覺注意力控制方面的表現普遍較佳。然而，本研究將聚焦於聽覺層面，採用「強制注意力雙耳分聽範式」（forced-attention dichotic listening，FADL），即同時向雙耳呈現兩種聲調刺激，以檢視雙語效應在聽覺注意力控制上的作用。雖然近年的元分析文獻對雙語效應提出質疑，但相關分析所涵蓋的大部分研究僅以雙語者與單語者作二分比較。此外，年長人士的雙語效應或較為明顯。有鑒於此，本研究將採用梯度方法將雙語能力作連續量化，並分析其關鍵成分對（青年及）長者聽覺注意力控制的影響。 具體而言，本研究的對象為不同年齡層的雙語者。他們均使用兩種語言類型差異較大的語言，即廣東話（聲調語言）與英語（非聲調語言），並具備不同程度的雙語經驗（例如第二語言英語的水平）。本研究採用 FADL 範式，選取廣東話聲調作為刺激，並設置三種注意力條件（非強制注意力條件和兩種強制注意力條件）。實驗將分別於青年組及長者組進行，並透過語言背景調查問卷（Language History Questionnaire-3，LHQ-3）測量雙語經驗。研究假設包括： （1）注意力控制效應：在非強制注意力條件下，廣東話聲調的識別預期引發左耳優勢；於強制左耳（一致）條件下，左耳優勢將更為明顯；而在強制右耳（不一致）條件下，則預期出現相反的右耳優勢。 （2）雙語效應：在強制注意力條件下，尤其强制右耳的情況（所需的注意力控制需求最高），第二語言水平較高的雙語者預期比低水平者能在更大程度上提升强制耳聲調識別的正確率。 （3）年齡效應：年長的雙語者或因長期使用雙語而受益更多，其雙語效應將較青年雙語者更為顯著。 本研究為期兩年，旨在深入探討雙語效應對聽覺注意力控制的影響，並聚焦不同年齡層於廣東話聲調處理的表現。研究成果有助揭示廣東話聲調處理的年齡變化，評估雙語效應於不同群體的適用性，並為長者認知儲備與神經韌性研究提供重要啟示。

16600925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16600925.value: 馬丁·布伯、道家與跨文化哲學

16600925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16600925.value: This research project is a genealogical (and conceptual-historical) investigation of the European reception and history of “non-doing” (wuwei) with specific focus on its pivotal role in the formation of Martin Buber’s philosophical and religious thought. The project will trace the historical-conceptual contexts of Buber's lifelong engagement with the Daodejing and the Zhuangzi, including the enthusiasm for Daoism (as he conceived it) as a form of poetic anarchism in the Berlin literary circle of the brothers Heinrich and Julius Hart, two prominent exponents of aesthetic naturalism. This circle has been underexplored in the European history of the Daodejing and the Zhuangzi. The interests of the Hart brothers influenced the young Buber, as well as emerging literary modernists and anarchists, introducing several themes that became pivotal in early twentieth-century German-language interpretations and appropriations of "Daoism" as a philosophy of freedom, naturalness, and non-coercive cooperation. The project will recontextualize Buber's early mystical interpretation of Daoism, his 1910 German language edition of selections from the Zhuangzi based on two English translations, and the role that freedom and non-doing played in his self-described transformation of his thought from mysticism to an ethics of encounter and dialogue. Suggestive traces are found throughout his central work I and Thou (1923) as well as his social-political reflections of the 1920s and 1930s. Several of his political insights are developed in dialogue with the Daodejing, interpreted in relation to his anarchistic political theology, as evident in his 1924 Ascona lectures on the Daodejing. My project is not only historical, as it will systematically examine the implications, as an example and model, for the contemporary theory and practice of intercultural interpretation (hermeneutics) and philosophy by considering the continuing relevance of Buber's practice of intercultural interpretation and his philosophy of dialogical intersubjectivity. Drawing on archival and rare library materials, this project will result in individual and conference lectures, articles, and book chapters on select aspects of the European history of "non-doing" and a draft of a book on Buber, Daoism, and Intercultural Philosophy that questions the scope and limits of Buber's intercultural thinking as a model for contemporary intercultural philosophy. 本項研究旨在從系譜學的角度（兼具概念史視野），探討「無為」這一概念在歐洲的接受過程及演變發展，並聚焦於「無為」對馬丁·布伯（Martin Buber）哲學與宗教思想成形的關鍵影響。 布伯終其一生，都在與《道德經》及《莊子》進行對話。本研究將追溯此思想對話的歷史與概念脈絡，其中包括當時的柏林文化圈，這個圈子由海因里希·哈特（Heinrich Hart）與尤利烏斯·哈特（Julius Hart）兄弟領銜。根據布伯的觀察，這一文化圈是審美自然主義的重要代表，對「道家」熱烈推崇，並認為道家是一種詩性的無政府主義。在歐洲人對《道德經》與《莊子》的研究脈絡當中，該文化圈迄今仍鮮有學者關注。 哈特兄弟的旨趣影響了青年時代的布伯，也啟發了當時正在崛起的文學現代派與無政府主義者。而且，哈特兄弟還引入了若干主題。在20世紀初，德語世界將「道家」解讀並吸納為倡導自由、自然與非強制性合作的哲學思想；在這一過程當中，這些主題至關重要。 本研究將把以下議題放回當時的脈絡中加以審視：（一）布伯早期對道家的神祕主義式解讀；（二）他在1910年根據兩種英文譯本編纂的《莊子》德語選本；以及（三）在他所說的從神祕主義轉向「相遇」（encounter）與對話倫理的過程當中，「自由」與「無為」這組概念扮演了何種角色。關於上述議題，相關線索散見於布伯的核心著作《我與你》（1923年）以及上世紀二、三十年代他對社會政治的思考之中。布伯的若干政治洞見是在與《道德經》的對話中形成的，並在無政府主義政治神學的視野下獲得詮釋：他於1924 年在阿斯科納（Ascona）所作的《道德經》講座即為明證。 本研究不僅着眼於歷史層面，還將聚焦布伯的跨文化詮釋與對話主體間性哲學（philosophy of dialogical intersubjectivity），系統探討它們對當今跨文化詮釋學以及哲學理論與實踐的啟示。依托檔案與珍稀圖書館藏資料，本項目的成果，將針對「無為」在歐洲學術脈絡的多個面向，呈現為若干專題與學術會議講座、論文及著作章節，並將初步完成一部關於布伯、道家與跨文化哲學的書稿，以審視布伯之跨文化思考作為當代跨文化哲學典範的視閾與限度。

16601025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601025.value: 沉默的終極倖存者：松下一珍所經歷的三場戰爭、六支軍隊、聯合國戰俘營與戰後日本

16601025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601025.value: Matsushita Kazutoshi (1923–2005) was the only Japanese soldier captured by the United Nations forces in the Korean War while serving in the Chinese People’s Volunteer Army. Drawing on newly uncovered sources from China, Japan, the United States, Switzerland, Taiwan, and South Korea, as well as interviews with Matsushita’s family members and peers in his hometown, the PI and Co-I plan to write a book documenting Matsushita’s life. Within the span of a decade (1944–1954), Matsushita served in six military forces across three countries, including the Imperial Japanese Army, Chinese Nationalist guerillas, Chinese Nationalist Army, Chinese Communist People’s Liberation Army, Chinese People’s Volunteer Army, and the Republic of Korea Army. Despite his extraordinary trajectory, Matsushita epitomized the archetypal East Asian foot soldier: a non-ideological young man with rudimentary education thrust into war and revolution, compelled to rely on his wits, skills, and luck for survival. His marginal status allowed him to switch allegiances multiple times, either by choice or necessity, embodying a liminal existence shared by millions of soldiers from China, Korea, and Japan during the Second World War, the Chinese Civil War, the Korean War, and the Cold War. Matsushita’s history challenges the conventional geographical boundaries and temporal periodization dictated by Western powers. His story underscores that the origins of the Long Cold War in East Asia should be traced to the final years of the Second World War and the Chinese Civil War. Like many veterans who remained silent about their wartime experiences, Matsushita left no writings about his past. Besides a 1952 newspaper report, most likely based on a letter he sent home from the UN prison in South Korea, and a local newspaper interview immediately following his repatriation to Japan in 1954, he never again publicly discussed his war experiences. Moving beyond the conventional explanation of war trauma, Matsushita’s silence may be linked to his desertion and defection to the Chinese Nationalist guerrilla during Operation Ichigo in late 1944. This revelation holds the key to explaining Matsushita’s lifelong silence and the Japanese society’s collective forgetting of this ultimate survivor. 松下一珍（1923–2005）是唯一一名在朝鮮戰爭中被聯合國軍俘虜的日本籍中國人民志願軍士兵。他的經歷因歷史學者Tessa Morris-Suzuki發表於2015年一篇論文而為人所知。本研究計畫的主持人與共同主持人已從中國、臺灣、日本、美國與韓國發掘出更為全面且詳盡的史料。其中，共同主持人亦已採訪松下的家屬及戰友。他們計劃撰寫這位「沉默的終極倖存者」的完整歷史 —— 涵蓋20世紀中葉發生在東亞的三場重大戰爭，即第二次世界大戰、中國內戰與韓戰。在短短十年間（1944–1954），松下服務於三個國家的六支軍隊。 研究者旨在重建松下一珍的生命史：從他在宮崎縣一座小漁村的童年、少年時期在臺灣擔任漁工、以及在大阪當焊工的經歷，到他加入日本帝國陸軍鐵道部隊、參與「一號作戰」、並於1944年12月脫逃；從他在國民黨游擊隊的活動、加入國民革命軍正規軍、在孟良崮戰役中被共軍俘虜，再到他在中國人民解放軍及志願軍服役；從他叛逃至聯合國陣營、被囚禁於聯合國戰俘營、1953年6月與北韓戰俘一同越獄、轉而加入大韓民國陸軍，到1954年最終遣返回日本，以及戰後的生活。 他非凡的人生軌跡，不僅凸顯出戰爭、革命、殖民與去殖民化對個體的深刻衝擊，也對戰勝國所建構的空間疆界與時間分期提出挑戰與質疑。本研究透過將松下的人生置於更廣泛的歷史脈絡與在地條件中，深入分析他在各個轉折點上的動機與抉擇、面對的偶然性與歷史所施加的壓力。為了解釋松下一生對戰爭經歷的沉默，以及日本社會對此集體遺忘的現象，研究亦將探討造成這種沉默的多重因素，並揭示日本記憶政治與遺忘政治的深層結構。

16601425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601425.value: 透過計算模型理解面部掃描行為與自閉症特徵之間的關係

16601425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16601425.value: Prof Chan, Antoni B. Dr Chan, Kit Wa Dr Shum, Kar Man Kathy

16601425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601425.value: Current theories of autism have primarily focused on social-cognitive mechanisms as the main areas of impairment. However, deficits in social attention have not been consistently observed among autistic children. Additionally, abnormalities in processing non-social visual stimuli associated with a detail-oriented visual processing style have been reported. These findings suggest a potential relationship between detail-oriented visual processing and social-cognitive impairment. Indeed, detailed-oriented visual processing may lead to atypical perceptual category learning, which may subsequently affect social cognition. Nevertheless, the possible underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here we aim to investigate the potential connection between detail-oriented visual processing and deficits in social attention through computational modeling and corresponding human studies. In children with autism, abnormalities in face scanning patterns have not been consistently observed. Instead, we have recently found that face scanning consistency during face recognition (i.e., how well one uses a consistent visual routine) correlates with autism diagnosis and autistic traits. Using a computational model that integrates a deep neural network and a hidden Markov model (DNN+HMM) to simulate visual routine learning, we have further demonstrated that face scanning consistency reflects how well the learner can discover important features for recognition. Accordingly, we will test the hypothesis that detail-oriented visual processing, a significant dimension of autistic traits, can lead to face recognition deficits and reduced face scanning consistency due to difficulty in discovering essential global information during learning. If so, deficient visual cognition and reduced visual scanning consistency may also be observed in the recognition of non-social stimuli that requires similar global information. We will first test this hypothesis through training DNN+HMM to perform face recognition and a non-social object recognition task that relies on global information with restricted attention window sizes, and examine whether this manipulation results in impaired performance and reduced visual scanning consistency in contrast to an object categorization task that requires less global information. We will then verify the modeling predictions through human studies with both recognition and passive viewing tasks. This project seeks to elucidate a critical relationship between visuoperceptual processing and social attention deficits through a robust approach that combines computational and experimental methodologies, thereby providing both theoretical and empirical support. It will significantly enhance our understanding of the mechanisms linking autistic traits in visuoperceptual and sociocognitive domains, with important implications for early screening and intervention for autism. The proposed interdisciplinary framework can also be applied to other developmental disorders, further amplifying the project impact. 目前的自閉症理論主要聚焦於社會認知過程，認為其是核心缺陷領域。然而，關於自閉症兒童社會注意力缺陷的研究結果尚不一致。此外，研究還發現，自閉症群體在處理非社會性視覺刺激時存在異常，這可能與其偏向細節的視覺處理方式有關。這些發現表明，細節導向的視覺處理方式可能與社會認知能力的缺陷存在潛在關係。事實上，這種偏向細節的視覺處理可能導致異常的知覺類別學習，進而影響社會認知。然而，其內在機制尚不清楚。 本研究旨在通過計算模型與相關人類研究，探討細節導向的視覺處理與社會注意力缺陷之間的潛在關係。在自閉症兒童中，有關面孔掃描模式異常的研究結果尚未達成一致。然而，我們最近發現，在面孔識別過程中，面孔掃描的一致性（即個體視覺掃描路線的一致性程度）與自閉症診斷及自閉症特質顯著相關。我們進一步使用融合了深度神經網絡與隱馬可夫模型（DNN+HMM）的計算模型來模擬視覺掃描路線的學習過程，證明面孔掃描的一致性能夠反映學習者在識別過程中發現關鍵特徵的能力。 據此，我們將驗證以下假設：細節導向的視覺處理作為自閉症特質的一個重要維度，可能因學習過程中難以發現關鍵的整體信息而導致面孔識別缺陷及視覺掃描一致性的降低。若該假設成立，在需要處理類似整體信息的非社會性刺激識別任務中，也可能觀察到視覺認知缺陷及視覺掃描一致性的降低。我們將首先訓練深度神經網絡與隱馬可夫模型（DNN+HMM），完成面孔識別任務及依賴整體信息且限制注意力窗口的非社會性物體識別任務，並檢驗此操作，相較於對整體信息要求較低的物體識別任務，是否會導致識別表現受損及視覺掃描一致性的降低。隨後，我們將通過包括識別任務及被動觀測任務的人類研究驗證模型的預測結果。 本研究通過結合計算與實驗方法的綜合性研究策略，闡明視覺感知處理與社會注意力缺陷之間的重要關係，為理論與實證提供支持。該研究將顯著增進我們對自閉症特質在視覺感知與社會認知領域中關聯機制的理解，並對自閉症的早期篩查與干預具有重要應用價值。此外，本研究提出的跨學科框架亦可應用於其他發展性障礙，進一步擴大其影響力。

16601525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601525.value: 优化寻求建议的沟通方式

16601525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601525.value: Although people ask for and give advice often, good advice is rare. Research on ineffective advice pins the source of its shortcomings on advice-givers. Advice-givers can lack sufficient expertise, perspective-taking abilities, or the communication skills required to verbalize their knowledge effectively to others. However, research on the determinants of advice quality has neglected the advice-seekers and the role they may play in soliciting suboptimal advice. The proposed project will investigate differences in advice quality and interpersonal consequences as a function of how advice requests are communicated. We plan to undertake the proposed project by conducting several experimental studies. In this proposed study, we will predict that when people are faced with a decision among options and seek counsel, they commonly ask for an endorsement (What should I do?) rather than seek information on what factors to consider (What should I think about in making this choice?). We will argue that advice requests that are outcome-focused occur frequently but are suboptimal to process-focused advice requests. Specifically, we predict that the latter will elicit more helpful advice because the advice-seeker receives information that enables them to make a customized decision accounting for individual needs. We will also predict that such advice-seekers are perceived positively because asking for advice on the underlying thought process is seen as a sign of competence, whereas asking for endorsement advice places the burden of responsibility on the advice-seeker. We will argue that process-focused advice requests lessen the negative impact of advice-seekers choosing not to follow the advice given, because it prevents the advice-givers from feeling that their advice was rejected; instead, they consider that advice-seekers made their own decision considering their individual needs. The findings from the proposed experimental studies will advance the advice literature by: (1) documenting the frequency with which we ask for (and give) outcome-focused, rather than process-focused advice; (2) exploring differences in advice quality as a function of how advice is solicited; and (3) documenting that interpersonal relations can be improved between advice-seekers and advice-givers by the way in which advice requests are communicated. This proposed research project will provide practical implications for people seeking and giving advice. Advice-seekers will benefit from receiving more helpful advice that improves their interpersonal impressions, and advice-givers will learn how to provide more helpful advice. This will minimize the negative effects of advice being rejected through giving or seeking process-focused (versus outcome-focused) advice. 人们常常寻求或者提供建议，但是有效的建议并不常见。无法沟通更有效的建议通常被归咎于建议者存在种种缺点。他们也许没有足够的专业知识，缺少足够的换位思考能力，或者无法清楚地沟通并传达他们的想法。寻求建议的人，作为这个沟通中的重要角色，却常常在关于建议质量的讨论中被忽视。在这个项目中，我们提出，如何寻求建议很大程度上决定所收到的建议质量，而且对人际关系有重要影响。 在拟议的研究中，我们预测，当人们面对多个选择并寻求建议时，他们通常会寻求直接的推荐（“我应该做什么？”），而不是了解在做出决策时应考虑哪些因素（“在做出选择时，我应考虑哪些方面？”）。尽管寻求结果导向的建议很常见，但是寻求过程导向的建议会收获更有帮助的建议。更具体地说，这是因为寻求过程导向的建议能让寻求者收获更多的客观信息，而他们能利用这些信息根据自身需求做出选择。寻求过程导向的建议同时也象征着寻求者有足够的能力为自己做决定，而寻求结果导向的建议则有可能被视为推卸责任的表现。因此，寻求过程导向的建议更有可能被建议者正面评价。并且，当所提供的建议未被采纳时，过程导向的建议能够减轻建议者被拒绝的感觉，因为他们会认为寻求者是基于所提供的信息结合自身需求自主做出的决策，从而最大程度地避免对人际关系造成负面影响。 拟议的实验研究将从一下三个方面推动关于建议的研究。第一，记录并比较寻求（并提供）结果导向的建议与过程导向的建议的频率；第二，探索不同寻求建议的方式对建议质量之间的影响；第三，证明通过优化寻求建议的方式，寻求者与提供者之间的人际关系可以得到改善。 本研究对实际生活具有重要指导意义。通过了解不同导向建议的区别，建议寻求者可以通过过程导向的建议获得更有帮助的指导，并留下积极的人际印象；建议提供者也能够学习如何提供更高质量的建议。同时，提供或寻求过程导向（而非结果导向）的建议能够最大限度地减少因建议未被采纳而产生的负面影响。

16601625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601625.value: 战后菲律宾共和国卫生部门的重建 1946–1953

16601625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601625.value: This project will investigate the post-conflict reconstruction of the health sector in the postwar Philippines from 1946 to 1953, focusing on the Philippine Rehabilitation Act of 1946 and its broader implications for health systems. Following the devastation of the Second World War, the Philippines faced a public health crisis, with widespread disease and malnutrition and its infrastructure in ruins. The U.S.-sponsored Rehabilitation Act allocated significant financial and material aid to rebuild the country’s healthcare system, including hospitals, medical supplies, and training for health professionals. The proposed project will explore the interactions between international donors, the central government, local governments, and non-state actors in this context, revealing how foreign aid—driven by geopolitical interests and complicated by the fragmented geography of the archipelago and socio-political conditions—shaped public health policies and outcomes in the postwar period. The project will employ archival research, drawing from both U.S. and Philippine sources, and integrate qualitative and quantitative analyses to assess the effectiveness of postwar health interventions. The project’s broader contribution will lie in its historiographical analysis of how post-conflict health reconstruction in the Philippines intersected with larger political, economic, and socio-cultural systems. By situating this reconstruction within the larger context of international aid and local cultural practices, the study will highlight the tensions between global health priorities and local needs. This research will also provide critical insights into how post-conflict policies contributed to long-term health disparities in this setting, offering valuable lessons for contemporary post-conflict health rebuilding efforts in other regions. 本计画将研究1946年至1953年战后菲律宾卫生部门的重建，重点在于《1946年菲律宾复兴法案》及其对卫生系统的广泛影响。在第二次世界大战的破坏之后，菲律宾面临公共卫生危机，疾病和营养不良广泛蔓延，基础设施一片废墟。由美国资助的《复兴法案》提供了大量的财政和物资援助，用于重建国家的医疗系统，包括医院、医疗物资以及医护人员的培训。本计画将探讨在这一背景下国际捐助者、中央政府、地方政府和非国家行为体之间的互动，揭示外援如何在地缘政治利益的驱动下，并在群岛的地理分散性和社会政治条件的复杂性中，塑造了战后公共卫生政策和结果。 本计画将采用档案研究方法，利用美国和菲律宾的历史资料，并结合定性和定量分析，评估战后卫生介入的效果。本研究的更广泛贡献在于其对战后菲律宾卫生重建如何与更大的政治、经济和社会文化系统交织的史学分析。透过将这项重建置于国际援助和地方文化实践的更大背景中，研究将突显全球卫生优先事项与地方需求之间的张力。本研究也将深入探讨战后政策如何导致长期健康不平等，为其他地区当代战后卫生重建工作提供宝贵的经验教训。

16601725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601725.value: 現代中國的跨語際情感關鍵詞

16601725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601725.value: In 1936, prominent scholar Chen Yinke famously stated that “whenever one explains a word, a cultural history is being written” (2001:172). This project provides a semantic examination of eight to ten keywords relating to modern emotional and aesthetic life. They include “facial expression” (biaoqing), “spiritual life” (jingshen shenghuo), “sympathy” (tongqing), “happiness” (xingfu), “intuitions” (zhijue), and similar terms, all of which were either coined, translated, or redefined at the end of the Qing dynasty and during the Republican era. Utilizing contemporary critical insights from the methodology of the “history of ideas” and various studies of emotion and translation, this project not only traces the etymological history of the chosen words and their convoluted origins (whether from the Han dynasty, Meiji Japan, or the Weimar Republic), but also their usages in specific linguistic contexts ranging from well-known literary texts to newspapers and print media. Collectively forming a dynamic semantic field in the early twentieth century, these transcultural lexicons unveiled and shaped the intuitive, communicative, spontaneous, and expressive characteristics of modern emotional landscapes. These feelings are also accompanied by innovative literary, aesthetic, and cultural forms, offering insights into the social climate of these eras. The critical questions examined include: how the origins and evolution of these keywords and concepts can enlighten us concerning literary and cultural modernities and their hybrid nature; how translation and the traveling of words and ideas fostered new kinds of representation, ingenuity, and aesthetic engagements; and in what ways language, by expressing modern emotions and sensations, contributes to radical social and cultural transformations. By offering previously unexamined historical accounts of modern vocabularies and their intricate development, this project will elucidate a range of critical issues concerning the entangled relationships between history and language, highlighting the role of language as a mediator in shaping historical experience and reflecting diverse social and cultural contexts. These emotional expressions and aesthetic concepts have instigated changes in literary thought and form, thus providing a new understanding of the modern development of aesthetic feelings and literary practices. Words, crystallized with thoughts and lived experiences, are fossils representing specific eras; words also serve as tools that enable social change in the world. Words allow us to imagine the early twentieth century, an imaginary that has shaped Chinese emotional and “spiritual life” to this day. 1936年，陳寅恪先生有言，“凡解釋一字即是作一部文化史。” 本研究援引“概念史”方法論，結合當代情感研究、翻譯研究的相關理論，遴選一組關乎現代情感與審美生活的關鍵詞彙。旨在追溯這些語彙在晚清民國是如何被肇造、迻譯或重釋的，同時考察它們在具體文本語境中的演變軌跡。這批跨語際的詞彙，交織成二十世紀初一動態語義場，揭示了現代情感的直覺性、自發性以及交際性等特性。這些新興情感體驗同時伴隨着新的文學形式、美學實踐，為我們提供了洞觀彼時世風心態與寫作風貌的鎖鑰。本研究的核心議題包括，關鍵詞的源流演變如何有助於我們理解文學/文化現代性的駁雜本質？ 語詞翻譯與概念傳播，如何催生新的表達方式與美學參與？ 通過梳理這些現代詞彙被遮蔽的發展脈絡，本研究試圖揭示語言作為中介如何“製造”現代情思與歷史經驗、映射社會文化的圖景。詞語凝結着思想與生活經驗，是特定時代的文化化石；詞語也是改變世界的實踐工具。正是通過這些語彙，我們得以構建對二十世紀初期的集體想像。這些詞語所形塑的中國情感結構與“精神生活”，其影響延續至今。

16602025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602025.value: 新法規，舊困境：探析監管變革對化學工業綠色創新的影響

16602025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602025.value: What are the impacts of regulation on technological innovations designed to protect the safety of people and the environment? Do these regulations incentivize, or hinder, the emergence of greener and more sustainable technologies? These questions are the subject of ongoing debate as industries come under increasing policy and public pressure to decarbonize, and as the public becomes increasingly aware of potential harms arising from the production and use of the goods they consume. The chemical industry plays a pivotal role in modern society, enabling advancements like improved sanitation, food preservation, increased crop yields, and disease prevention and treatment. The sector plays a dual role in producing both final products and critical inputs for many other sectors; chemical production was valued at approximately US$5.72 trillion in 2022, establishing it as a significant component of international trade (Statista, 2024). However, it also contributes significantly to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, environmental degradation, and lasting harm to human health. The chemical industry creates approximately 2 billion metric tons of CO2 (GtCO2) annually from direct and energy-related emissions, accounting for approximately 5% of GHG emissions. Green chemistry has emerged as a guiding framework for the industry to adopt more sustainable practices, but its integration is often hindered by complex regulatory frameworks that can inadvertently stifle innovation. The research objectives include identifying barriers to green chemistry innovations, analyzing stakeholder positions in the rulemaking process, examining trends in green innovation, and gathering perspectives on the impact of regulatory changes on domestic and international innovation. The study will employ a mixed-methods approach, combining quantitative data analysis with qualitative insights from industry stakeholders, policymakers, and community leaders. The project will analyze regulatory frameworks and agencies’ (e.g. EPA) actions, conduct bibliometric analysis, stakeholder interviews, industry surveys, and patent analysis to identify trends and barriers in green chemistry innovation. In-depth case studies will focus on plastics, non-toxic textile pigments, and CO2-based chemical feedstocks. The project will compare the impacts of regulatory frameworks in three of the largest production areas: China, the EU, and the US. Dissemination efforts will include high-impact journal articles, policy reports, and stakeholder engagement through workshops and roundtable discussions. This research aims to foster innovation that aligns with policy and industrial objectives to improve sustainability within the chemical enterprise. The project's findings have the potential to make significant contributions to academia and inform the development of policies that promote sustainable growth and competitiveness in this critical sector. 監管措施對旨在保障人類安全和環境保護的技術創新有何影響？這些監管措施是促進還是阻礙了更環保、更可持續技術的出現？當各行業面臨日益增大的脫碳化政策和公眾壓力，以及公眾對消費品生產和使用過程中可能帶來的潛在危害的關注度日益提高，這些問題正成為討論的焦點。化學行業在現代社會中發揮著關鍵作用，推動了衛生條件改善、食品保鮮、作物產量提升以及疾病預防與治療等領域的進步。該行業在生產最終產品和為其他行業提供關鍵投入品方面發揮著雙重作用；2022年化學品生產價值約為5.72萬億美元，使其成為國際貿易的重要組成部分（Statista，2024）。然而，它也嚴重導致了溫室氣體（GHG）排放、環境惡化以及對人類健康的持久危害。化學行業每年通過直接排放和能源相關排放約20億公噸二氧化碳（GtCO2），約佔GHG排放量的5%。綠色化學已成為該行業採取更可持續實踐的指導框架，但其整合往往受到複雜監管框架的阻礙，這可能會無意中扼殺創新。 本研究目標包括確定綠色化學創新的障礙、分析規則制定過程中利益相關者的立場、研究綠色創新的趨勢以及收集有關監管變化對國內和國際創新的影響的觀點。研究將採用混合方法，將定量數據分析與行業利益相關者、政策制定者和社區領導的定性見解相結合。為了識別綠色化學創新的趨勢和障礙，項目將分析監管框架和各機構（例如美國環保署）的行動，並開展文獻計量分析、利益相關者訪談、行業調查和專利分析。案例研究將聚焦三大領域：塑料製品、無毒紡織染料及二氧化碳基化學原料，並對比中國、歐盟和美國三大主要生產區的監管框架影響。研究成果將通過高影響力期刊文章、政策報告以及在研討會和圓桌會議上與利益相關者互動等方式進行傳播。本研究旨在促進與政策和行業目標相一致的創新，以提升化學企業的可持續性。項目成果有望為學術界做出重要貢獻，並為制定促進這一關鍵領域可持續發展與競爭力提升的政策提供依據。

16603225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16603225.value: 法外种族暴力的世代影响

16603225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16603225.value: Black Americans have faced disproportionate levels of violence, from both state and non-state actors, throughout the history of the United States. Beginning with the system of chattel slavery in which persons of African descent could legally be owned, an all-encompassing culture consisting of laws, norms, and customs evolved to perpetuate and reinforce a racial caste hierarchy with whites at the top and blacks at the bottom. When slavery was eventually outlawed, the racial caste system persisted, often reinforced through violence. From the period following the end of legal slavery until the mid-twentieth century, a common method of violent reinforcement was the lynching: a type of mob violence that eventually became nearly synonymous with brutal, terroristic, extrajudicial executions committed in response to perceived transgressions against the rules of the caste system. Multidisciplinary teams of scholars have extensively investigated the correlates that predict and explain lynching events, as well as geographic variation in the long-term structural correlates of lynching prevalence. However, though there is widespread recognition that lynchings had devastating consequences for the families of the victims, actual examinations of the intergenerational impacts of this extreme form of racial violence have been limited to small-scale qualitative analyses. Though extremely valuable, individual family-level analyses have not yet leveraged the increasing breadth of information available about victims and their descendants to understand the systematic intergenerational impacts of lynchings. The proposed project will use newly available deanonymized census data and other sources of digitized publicly available information to build a unique database of lynching victims and their descendants linked to a variety of other life outcomes, including education, incarceration, and death records. Using the first steps of genealogical analysis, the investigation will begin with the most widely used biographical inventory of lynching victims and attempted lynching victims from 10 states in the Southern United States, and link them to their census records from the 1880 through 1950 American censuses. Records found in censuses can then be associated with other household members, allowing for a select group of cases to be linked to across generations. These records will then be further linked with databases of educational enrollment, incarceration, voter files, and obituaries. Comparing the various life outcomes of the descendants of lynching victims and those of similarly situated non-lynching victims will present the best opportunity yet for scholars to draw causal conclusions about the impacts of extrajudicial racial violence on family outcomes in subsequent generations. 黑人在美国历史上经历了不成比例的暴力，这种暴力既来自国家，也来自非国家施暴者。从非洲后裔奴隶合法化开始，美国社会形成了一种包括法律、规范和习俗的文化。这种文化维持和强化了一个种族等级制度，即白人为上，黑人在下。奴隶制最终被取缔时，种族等级制度依然存在，常常通过暴力得以加强。从奴隶合法化结束到二十世纪中期，一种常见的暴力强化等级制度的手段是私刑，即一种群体暴力。私刑几乎与残酷、恐怖的法外处决同义，这些处决被视为对违反等级制度行为的反应。 不同学科的学者对能够预测和解释私刑的因素以及导致私刑地区差异的结构性因素进行了广泛的研究。然而，尽管人们普遍认识到私刑给受害者家庭带来了毁灭性的影响，但对这种极端种族暴力的世代影响的研究仅限于小规模的定性分析。尽管家庭层面的分析极具价值，但现有研究未能利用越来越多的私刑受害者及其后代的信息，来理解私刑的系统性代际影响。 本研究计划利用新近获得的去匿名化的人口普查数据和其他数字化公开信息来源，建立一个独特的私刑受害者及其后代数据库。该数据库将与私刑受害者后裔的教育、监禁和死亡记录等其他各种生活事件结果匹配。本研究将首先采用家谱分析的方法，从美国南部私刑最泛滥的10个州的私刑受害者和私刑未遂受害者的传记清单入手，并将其与1880年至1950年美国人口普查记录进行匹配。之后，从人口普查中找到的记录可以与受害者其他家庭成员匹配，从而得到一组案件的跨代链接。这些记录随后将进一步与教育入学、监禁、选民档案和讣闻等数据库进行匹配。通过比较私刑受害者后代与处境相似的非私刑受害者后代的不同生活结局，研究者可以充分验证私刑对受害者后代家庭造成影响的因果关系。

16603425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16603425.value: 财政压力下的政企关系

16603425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16603425.value: Fines not only serve as a tool of policy enforcement, but they also generate revenue for the government. When the government faces fiscal stress, fines become a legally justifiable option to raise revenue. This proposed research aims to address how the government that faces fiscal stress maximize fines to over shortfalls. By analyzing more than 10 million cases in which firms were fined by local governments in China, this study will examine whether fiscal stress has led local governments to collect more fines from firms. As fines harm local business environment, this study will also examine whether local firms are motivated to stop their business when they face fines. 罚款不仅是政策执行的工具，还能为政府创造收入。当政府面临财政压力时，罚款成为一种合法的增收方式。本研究旨在探讨面临财政压力的政府如何最大限度地提高罚款额度以弥补财政缺口。通过分析中国超过一千万起被地方政府罚款的企业案例，本研究将探究财政压力是否导致地方政府向企业征收更多罚款。鉴于罚款会损害地方的营商环境，本研究还将探讨地方企业在面临罚款时是否有停业的动机。

16603525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16603525.value: 從眾行為的動態揭示：跨情境下幼兒對從眾者與非從眾者的偏好研究

16603525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16603525.value: As social beings, we sometimes adopt the beliefs and actions of the groups to which we belong, a phenomenon known as conformity. Conformity can have wide-reaching social consequences, such as swaying election outcomes and jury decisions in criminal trials. Previous research highlights how broad cultural factors shape views of conformity, suggesting it is more valued in collectivistic cultures than in individualistic ones. However, previous research often overlooks the role of specific contexts in shaping evaluations of conformity. This sensitivity to context could emerge as early as childhood, yet it remains underexplored. This proposal seeks to explore how members of a group endorse and enforce conformity. In particular, it will examine the potential presence of conformity preferences in early childhood and their dynamic nature across different contexts. Focusing on Chinese children—a large but relatively understudied population within a collectivistic society—we aim to address three key research questions. First, do young children generally prefer conformists (those who align with group norms) over nonconformists (those who deviate from group norms)? Second, how do contextual factors impact young children’s preferences for conformists or nonconformists? Third, across different contexts, are these preferences reflected both in children’s perceptions and their behaviors? We will conduct four studies with 4-to-7-year-old children in China. Across these studies, children will hear stories featuring group conformists and nonconformists, and express their preferences for these types of people, both in terms of how they perceive them and how they would behave toward them. The context in which conformity occurs will vary across the three studies. Study 1 investigates a context where neither the costs nor benefits of conformity are revealed. Study 2 explores a context where conformity comes at a personal cost. Study 3 tests a context where conformity benefits the whole group. Study 4 examines a context where conformity entails personal costs but benefits the whole group. This research will address critical gaps in the literature by examining how young children in a major collectivistic culture evaluate conformity across various contexts. The findings may challenge the conventional notion that appreciation for conformity is fixed by culture, showing that even within a collectivistic culture and from early childhood, children’s evaluations of conformity are context-dependent. This nuanced perspective will advance our understanding of when, why, and where conformity preferences exist, thereby offering valuable insights into mitigating conformity-induced biases in personal and societal decision-making. 作為社會性生物，我們有時會採納所屬群體的信念與行為，這種現象稱為「從眾行為」。從眾行為可能產生廣泛的社會影響，例如左右選舉結果或刑事審判中陪審團的決策。過去研究強調宏觀文化因素如何形塑對從眾的觀點，認為集體主義文化比個人主義文化更重視從眾。然而，這些研究往往忽略具體情境在評價從眾行為時的作用。這種對情境的敏感性可能在童年早期就已出現，但至今仍缺乏深入探討。 本研究旨在探索群體成員如何認可與強化從眾行為，尤其關注幼兒階段是否存在從眾偏好，以及這些偏好如何因情境而動態變化。我們以中國兒童為研究對象，試圖回答三個核心問題：第一，幼兒是否普遍偏好從眾者（遵循群體規範者）勝於非從眾者（偏離群體規範者）？第二，情境因素如何影響幼兒對從眾者或非從眾者的偏好？第三，在不同情境中，這些偏好是否同時反映於兒童的認知與行為層面？ 我們將對中國4至7歲兒童進行四項實驗。兒童會聽到關於從眾者與非從眾者的故事，並表達對這兩類人物的偏好（包括認知評價與互動行為）。四項實驗將操縱不同的從眾情境：實驗1探討從眾行為未揭露任何代價或利益的情境；實驗2研究從眾需付出個人代價的情境；實驗3測試從眾能為群體帶來利益的情境；實驗4則檢視從眾雖需付出個人代價但能為群體帶來利益情境。 本研究將填補文獻重要缺口，揭示集體主義文化下個人從童年起如何評估不同情境中的從眾行為。研究結果可能挑戰「文化決定從眾價值」的傳統觀點，證明即使於集體主義文化中，兒童對從眾的評價仍具情境依賴性。此細緻視角將深化我們對從眾偏好何時、何地以及為何出現的理解，進而為緩解個人與社會決策中因從眾導致的偏誤提供關鍵啟示。

17100225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17100225.value: 利用多流数据识别流感与新冠等呼吸道病毒的动态相互作用以及预测它们在后疫情时期的共同传播的负担

17100225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17100225.value: Prof Cowling, Benjamin John Prof He, Daihai Prof Lau, Eric Ho-Yin Prof Opatowski, Lulla Dr Ryu, Sukhyun Dr Wang, Dong Dr Wu, Peng

17100225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100225.value: Background: During post-pandemic period, influenza and COVID-19 continuing to have substantial impacts on global public health burden with millions of infections and their severity burden annually. While influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2 viruses shares several similar epidemiological characteristics, hence individual infected with one could have impact on the likelihood of infection with another. This interaction could drive the dynamics of the co-circulation of these respiratory viruses and their associated burden in the community. Objective: The general aim of this study is to identify and quantify the putative interaction and their impacts on the co-circulation of these respiratory diseases including influenza and COVID-19. The specific objectives are to (a) infer the time-varying population immunity for these viruses first, (b) detect and quantify the dynamical interaction and their impact on 4-key impact outcomes (susceptibility, transmissibility, pathogenesis and infectiousness), (c) assess impact of COVID-19 on the interaction in influenza type/subtypes and finally (d) predict the dynamical interaction of these respiratory viruses and their co-circulation burden during post-pandemic period in Hong Kong and other locations. Methods: We will use the multiple steam data on syndromic, phylogenetic, genetic-antigenic serological-titre, and virological surveillance data. We proposed to develop a mechanistic framework for multi-strain state-space models to assess the dynamical interaction and the co-circulation burden for influenza and COVID-19 in the post-pandemic period in Hong Kong and other locations. We will allow the model to be reparametrized based on the data-driven hypotheses on the possible impact outcomes for interactions. A statistical modeling framework with functional convolution will be incorporated to reconstruct the time-varying population immunity, which is further used to tune the mechanistic models for time-varying susceptibility. We will use likelihood-based iterated filtering algorithms (IF2), Monte Carlo-adjusted profile (MCAP), and particle filtering to estimate the parameter. We will assess the impact of these 4-key impact outcomes (ϕ(ij), θ(ij), ξ(ij), k (ij)) on the co-circulation burden and simulate counterfactual scenarios for realizing better intervention and vaccination strategies. Implication: We expect that understanding the potential impact of these diseases on each other's transmission dynamics and mechanism can provide a valuable epidemiological insights for how these diseases may affect each other's spread, the effectiveness of preventive measures, and the overall burden on healthcare resources. This information can be crucial for planning and implementing effective public health strategies, vaccine strategies, clinical management, and disease surveillance to manage and control similar respiratory diseases. 背景：在疫情后时期，流感和新冠肺炎(COVID-19)持续给全球公共卫生带来沉重负担，每年导致数百万例感染。尽管流感病毒与SARS-CoV-2病毒有一些相似的流行病学特征，但感染其中一种病毒可能会影响个体感染另一种病毒的风险。这种相互作用可能会改变这些呼吸道病毒在社区中的共同传播动态及其相关负担。 目标：本研究的总体目标是识别并量化流感与COVID-19等呼吸道疾病之间的潜在相互作用，及其对共同传播的影响。具体目标是：(a) 推断这些病毒随时间变化的群体免疫力；(b) 检测并量化这些病毒之间的动态相互作用，及其对易感性、传播性、致病性和传染性这四个关键结果的影响；(c) 评估COVID-19对不同流感类型/亚型间相互作用的影响；以及(d) 预测这些呼吸道病毒之间的动态相互作用，及其在香港及其他地区疫情后共同传播的负担。 方法：我们将利用涵盖综合征、系统发育、遗传抗原血清学滴度及病毒学监测数据的多重序列数据。我们计划开发一个多菌株状态空间模型的机制框架，用于评估香港及其他地区疫情后时期流感与COVID-19的动态相互作用及其共同传播负担。我们将基于数据驱动的假设（即相互作用可能产生的影响结果）重新参数化模型。我们将结合函数卷积的统计建模框架，重建群体免疫力的时间动态，并将其用于调整易感性的时间动态机制模型。我们将采用基于似然的迭代滤波算法(IF2)、蒙特卡洛调整轮廓(MCAP)及粒子滤波进行参数估计。我们将评估这四个关键影响结果（ϕ_ij、θ_ij、ξ_ij、k_ij）对共同循环负担的影响，并模拟反事实情景，为制定更有效的干预及疫苗接种策略提供依据。 意义：我们期望，了解这些疾病对彼此传播动力学及机制的潜在影响，能够提供宝贵的流行病学见解，帮助我们理解它们如何相互影响传播、预防措施的有效性以及医疗资源的总体负担。这些信息对于规划和实施有效的公共卫生策略、疫苗策略、临床管理及疾病监测，以管理和控制类似呼吸道疾病至关重要。

17101325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101325.value: 非結構蛋白 1 介導的宿主-病毒相互作用是禽流感病毒在哺乳動物中傳播的潛在傳播

17101325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17101325.value: Prof Chan, Michael Chi Wai Prof Poon, Leo Lit Man

17101325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101325.value: Transmissibility, particularly airborne transmission (AT), is a critical determinant of the pandemic potential of zoonotic avian influenza A viruses (AIVs). Despite this, a major knowledge gap in this field is an understanding of transmission itself. Whilst the upper respiratory tract is known to be the determinant anatomic site of influenza virus AT, very little is known about the host-virus interactions that lead to AT. With the continuing and perhaps increasing possibility of the emergence of AIVs with mammalian AT during the current outbreaks and widespread dissemination of H5N1 AIVs, a greater understanding of AIV mammalian transmissibility is urgently needed to inform surveillance and response activities. Our study is uniquely placed to provide mechanistic insights into the host-virus interactions underlying AIV AT in mammals. We have a unique group of AIVs isolated during ongoing wild bird surveillance in North America with highly similar genomes but different AT phenotypes in the ferret model of human influenza virus transmission. We also found a novel role for the smallest influenza virus protein, non-structural 1 (NS1), as a determinant of AT, such that a single amino acid change at S213P changed AT phenotypes. Using this model, we obtained a novel transcriptomic dataset at the ferret upper respiratory tract yielding insights into the transcriptomic responses differentially elicited by AIV of different AT phenotypes. We also revealed how these responses correlated to different tissue pathology in the upper respiratory tract. Therefore, we have identified host responses underlying AIV AT, and, a single viral mutation mediating these responses. We propose to leverage our unique model and preliminary data to gain mechanistic insights of host-virus interactions underlying AT of AIVs in the human respiratory epithelium. As human studies are not feasible, we propose to use primary respiratory epithelial cells obtained from the nasal and bronchial epithelium of multiple healthy human donors. These cultures are differentiated to form an air-liquid interface, as per the respiratory tract, and exhibit functional characteristics such as motile cilia and the secretion of mucus. Therefore, this study has the potential to form a basis of understanding of host-virus interactions that determine AIV AT. This is urgently needed to addresses an important knowledge gap in the field that would inform future risk assessment efforts, leading to more rapid responses and potentially reduced risks of zoonotic influenza virus outbreaks in human populations. 传播性，特别是空气传播 （AT），是人畜共患甲型禽流感病毒 （AIV） 大流行潜力的关键决定因素。尽管如此，该领域的一个主要知识差距是对传输本身的理解。虽然已知上呼吸道是流感病毒 AT 的决定性解剖部位，但对导致 AT 的宿主-病毒相互作用知之甚少。随着在当前疫情期间出现带有哺乳动物 AT 的 AIV 的可能性持续增加，并且 H5N1 AIV 的广泛传播，迫切需要更好地了解 AIV 哺乳动物的传播性，以便为监测和应对活动提供信息。 我们的研究具有独特的优势，可以为哺乳动物中 AIV AT 背后的宿主-病毒相互作用提供机制见解。我们在北美正在进行的野生鸟类监测中分离出一组独特的 AIV，它们具有高度相似的基因组，但在人类流感病毒传播的雪貂模型中具有不同的 AT 表型。我们还发现最小的流感病毒蛋白非结构蛋白 1 （NS1） 作为 AT 的决定因素具有新的作用，即 S213P 的单个氨基酸变化会改变 AT 表型。使用该模型，我们在雪貂上呼吸道获得了一个新的转录组数据集，从而深入了解不同 AT 表型的 AIV 差异引发的转录组学反应。我们还揭示了这些反应如何与上呼吸道的不同组织病理学相关。 因此，我们已经确定了 AIV AT 背后的宿主反应，以及介导这些反应的单一病毒突变。 我们建议 利用我们独特的模型和初步数据来获得对人类呼吸道上皮中 AIV AT 背后的宿主-病毒相互作用的机制见解。由于人体研究不可行，我们建议使用 从多个健康人类供体的鼻腔和支气管上皮细胞中获得的原代呼吸道上皮细胞。这些培养物根据呼吸道分化形成气液界面，并表现出活动纤毛和粘液分泌等功能特征。因此，这项研究有可能为理解决定 AIV AT 的宿主-病毒相互作用奠定基础。迫切需要这样做来解决该领域的重要知识差距，这将为未来的风险评估工作提供信息，从而更快地做出反应，并可能降低人群中人畜共患流感病毒爆发的风险。

17102225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102225.value: 高維影像特徵與風險因素開發可解釋性之矯正治療誘發牙根外吸收預測模型

17102225.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17102225.value: Dr AI, Qiyong Prof Bornstein, Michael Dr Lu, Ming-Yi Prof Shan, Zhiyi Dr Wong, Lun Matthew Dr Yu, Dedong

17102225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102225.value: Orthodontically-induced external root resorption (OIERR) is the second most common adverse event and the major iatrogenic consequence of orthodontic treatment. This irreversible root structure loss causes many clinical problems, including potential early tooth loss, significantly affecting patients’ quality of life, particularly young patients. Although various patient- and treatment-related risk factors have been proposed, they were reported as poor predictors with low levels of evidence. This may result from the subjective nature of qualitative assessment methods. Currently, there are no reliable predictors for identifying high-risk OIERR teeth. Artificial intelligence (AI) and quantitative imaging technologies can analyse high-dimensional image features beyond human visual perception, advancing personalised medicine. They have helped identify explainable features that characterize tissues and correlate with specific underlying biology, pathology, and clinical endpoints. Recent studies have found significant correlations between CT-derived quantitative image features and OIERR in anterior teeth. These features quantify the heterogeneity of tooth roots and could potentially identify high-risk OIERR teeth. However, they were assessed individually, without integrating AI techniques to develop a risk prediction tool. Moreover, previous studies only investigated limited image features, leaving a great amount of other high-dimensional features unexplored. Our team members have developed image-based screening and diagnostic models for a range of oral, head and neck diseases using deep learning and quantitative imaging technologies, and proposed a novel feature selection approach (BB-RENT), leading to more robust and stable AI models and increased model applicability in clinical workflows. Our single-centre pilot study identified several CBCT-derived high-dimensional image features from 360 tooth roots and surrounding alveolar bone on 30 pre-operative CBCT images that correlated with OIERR as identified from the post-operative scans. Our initial OIERR risk prediction AI model built based on the features with high selection frequency and importance achieved promising performance with an accuracy of 0.876, sensitivity of 0.8, specificity of 0.867. Thus, this multi-centre project aims to develop and validate an interpretable AI model for OIERR risk prediction using stable CBCT-derived high-dimensional image features from tooth roots and surrounding alveolar bone as well as patient- and treatment-related variables. The project will assess whether this AI tool could improve the accuracy of clinicians with different qualifications in identifying high-risk OIERR teeth and would affect their treatment and referral decisions. The ultimate goal is to create an interpretable, translatable AI tool that can contribute to personalised patient management and improved monitoring for early detection and treatment plan adjustments, improving patient outcomes. 正畸誘發的牙根外吸收（OIERR）是正畸治療中第二常見的醫源性併發症。此不可逆的牙根結構喪失會導致許多臨床問題，包括潛在的早期失牙，顯著影響患者的生活品質，特別是年輕患者。雖然目前已提出各種與患者及治療相關的風險因素，但這些因素預測效果不佳。目前，尚無可靠的指標能辨識存在高風險OIERR的牙齒。 人工智慧（AI）與定量影像技術能分析超越人類視覺感知的高維度影像特徵，推動個人化醫療的發展。這些技術協助辨識可解釋的組織特徵，並與特定的生物學、病理學與臨床結果相關聯。近期研究發現，來自電腦斷層（CT）的定量影像特徵與前牙OIERR之間存在顯著相關性。這些特徵可量化牙根的異質性，並有潛力辨識高風險的OIERR牙齒。然而，目前這些特徵多為單獨評估，尚未結合AI技術開發風險預測工具。此外，過去研究僅探討有限的影像特徵，許多其他高維度特徵仍未被挖掘。 我們團隊成員已利用深度學習與定量影像技術，開發出多種口腔、頭頸疾病的影像篩檢與診斷模型，並提出新穎的特徵選擇方法（BB-RENT），提升AI模型的穩健性及臨床應用性。本多中心計畫旨在基於牙根及周圍齒槽骨的穩定CBCT高維度影像特徵，結合患者及治療相關變項，發展並驗證具可解釋性的OIERR風險預測AI模型。本計畫將評估此AI工具是否能提升不同資歷臨床醫師辨識高風險OIERR牙齒的準確性，並影響其治療與轉診決策。

17102425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102425.value: 細胞遷移中黏着斑信號傳導動態的光遺傳學解析與調控

17102425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102425.value: Cell migration and communication from the extracellular matrix (ECM) are essential in many physiological contexts, from wound healing, to immunity, to cancer. At the heart of these processes, integrins sense the extracellular environment on which cells crawl and transduce chemical and mechanical cues through focal adhesion complexes. Adhesions play multifunctional roles throughout their lifetimes - recognizing different substrates, maturing under force, and associating with the cytoskeleton differently as their position changes in a migrating cell. However, owing to the difficulty of controlling the precise location and timing of the formation of new adhesions, we have been unable to directly observe how adhesion state links to cell signaling and motility in different contexts. In order to surmount these challenges, we will harness the power of optogenetics. Optogenetics allows for precise control in space and time, using light to dictate activity or localization of proteins. Thus, we will engineer a tool that can dynamically control adhesion formation, allowing us to directly control the formation, size, and lifetime of adhesion complexes. Using this tool, we will investigate under different contexts how adhesion formation and lifetime modulate signaling dynamics and cell motility in ways not previously possible. We will systematically control adhesion dynamics in various cellular regions and in the presence of different ECMs while monitoring cell motility and signaling with live biosensors. Doing so will enable us to understand how signaling, and thus motility, is modulated by different matrix conditions and cytoskeletal states. Gradients in surface-absorbed ligands, such as ECM, can guide migration (haptotaxis) in both normal tissues and, erroneously, in disease cases ranging from retinal disease to cancer metastasis. By creating gradients of adhesion/integrin activity with light gradients, we can directly test the sufficiency of potential mechanisms for haptotaxis. Our preliminary data demonstrate that we are able to modulate adhesion dynamics in a local fashion while imaging the resulting signaling dynamics using live biosensors of their activity. The aim of the proposed work is to improve our fundamental understanding of cell biology, and will be integral to the development of treatments of diseases which result in erroneous deposition of matrix or in improving the healing of wounds where cells can be guided by matrix cues. 細胞遷移以及細胞與細胞外基質 (ECM) 的通訊，在許多生理情境中至關重要，從傷口癒合、免疫反應到癌症皆然。這些過程的核心在於整合素 (integrins)，它們能感知細胞遷移所依存的細胞外基質環境，並通過黏着斑複合體 (focal adhesion complexes) 轉導這些化學和機械信號。黏着斑於存續期間需動態執行多重功能：識別差異化細胞外基質、響應機械力信號誘導成熟化，並隨遷移細胞內定位變化而差異化調控細胞骨架聯結。然而，由於新黏着斑的生成時空定位難以精確操控，我們始終無法直接解析黏着斑狀態如何於不同微環境中耦聯細胞信號傳導與運動行為。 為突破此技術瓶頸，我們將應用光遺傳學（optogenetics）技術。該技術藉由光控蛋白質活性與亞細胞定位，實現時空精度的分子操控。據此，我們擬開發新型光控工具，動態調節黏着斑複合體之生成時序、尺寸演變與壽命週期，從而首次實現於多種生理情境下，直接解析黏着斑動力學特徵如何調控信號傳導動態與細胞遷移表型。通過整合活細胞生物探針即時成像技術，在系統性操控不同細胞區域及差異化胞外基質（ECM）環境中的黏着斑動態的同時，同步監測細胞運動參數與信號傳導網絡。這將使我們能夠解析信號傳導與細胞運動性如何受不同基質條件與細胞骨架狀態的調控。此外，表面吸附配體（如ECM組分）梯度可引導細胞遷移（趨觸性，haptotaxis），此機制不僅存在於正常組織，更在從視網膜病變到癌症轉移等病理過程中異常活化。通過光梯度構建黏着斑/整合素活性梯度，我們將直接驗證趨觸性潛在機制的充分性。 初步數據顯示，我們已實現局部精準調控黏着斑動態，並同步運用其活性對應的活細胞生物感測器，即時成像由此誘發的信號傳導動態。此研究將深化細胞遷移的基礎機制認知，且對基質異常沉積疾病的靶向治療開發，以及基質信號導引型傷口癒合技術的臨床轉化，具關鍵性價值。

17102525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102525.value: 研究抑制性中間神經元在阿茲海默症發病機制中的角色

17102525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102525.value: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder that is becoming an urgent public health concern worldwide due to the increasing aging population. There is growing evidence that neuronal network dysfunction and excitatory/inhibitory(E/I) imbalance are early symptoms that potentially underlie brain dysfunction in AD. Recent studies have demonstrated that AD patients and animal models exhibit hippocampal excitatory neuron hyperactivity due to dysfunction in inhibitory GABAergic interneurons and reduced gamma oscillations in multiple brain regions. GABAergic parvalbumin interneurons (PVINs) are a type of interneurons that exert strong inhibition on excitatory pyramidal neurons, which play a crucial role in generating gamma oscillations and orchestrating E/I balance in the brain. Gamma frequency entrainment by 40Hz optogenetic stimulation of PVINs or by non-invasive 40Hz auditory/light flickering have been found to attenuate amyloid plaque accumulation and memory impairments in AD mouse models. Our preliminary data also showed that chemogenetic excitation of PVINs rescued learning impairment in a spatial navigation contextual memory task in the postdrome stage. However, the roles of PVINs in the early to late stages of AD progression remain unknown. Moreover, it is still unclear whether PVIN dysfunction is the cause or an effect of network dysfunction in AD. Based on these findings, we hypothesise that PVIN dysfunction leads to E/I imbalance, pyramidal neuron hyperactivity, and amyloid plaque accumulation in the hippocampus during the pathogenesis of AD. To test this hypothesis, we will use the 5XFAD mouse model in three specific aims. 1) We will use in vivo two-photon microscopy to examine the structural plasticity of dendritic spines in pyramidal neurons and axonal boutons of PVINs longitudinally to delineate the sequential and spatiotemporal synaptic loss and the accumulation of amyloid plaque in the dorsal hippocampus. We will also use awake, free-moving mice coupled with a dual colour miniature microscope for calcium imaging of PVIN and pyramidal neuron activity simultaneously to investigate network dysfunction in the dorsal hippocampus during a spatial navigation contextual memory task. 2) We will employ gamma frequency entrainment using a non-invasive auditory stimulation during sleep to evaluate its potential beneficial effects on preventing and treating early to late stage AD. 3) We will examine the role of PVINs in gamma frequency entrainment by specific PVIN activity manipulation by optogenetics. In summary, this study will reveal the fundamental role of PVINs in the progression of AD and explore a potential non-invasive approach for the prevention and treatment of AD. 阿茲海默症（AD）是一種常見的神經退行性疾病，隨著全球老齡化人口的增加，已成為迫切的公共衛生問題。越來越多的證據表明，神經元網絡功能失調以及興奮/抑制（E/I）失衡，是早期可能導致腦功能障礙的症狀。近期研究顯示，AD患者與動物模型中，由於抑制性GABAergic中間神經元功能障礙，以及多個腦區γ振盪減弱，海馬體的興奮性神經元出現過度活躍。GABAergic parvalbumin 中間神經元 (PVIN) 是一類具有強大抑制作用的中間神經元，主要抑制興奮性神經元，在產生γ振盪和調節腦內E/I平衡方面扮演關鍵角色。研究發現，通過40Hz光遺傳刺激PVIN或非侵入性40Hz聽覺/光閃爍刺激，能減緩阿茲海默鼠模型中淀粉樣蛋白斑塊的積聚與記憶障礙。我們的初步數據也顯示，化學遺傳激活PVIN能在疾病的後期階段挽救空間導航記憶任務中的學習障礙。然而，PVIN在AD早期至晚期的作用尚不清楚，也不明確PVIN功能障礙是引起網絡失調的原因還是結果。基於這些發現，我們假設：PVIN功能失常會導致E/I失衡、奮性神經元過度活躍，以及在AD發病過程中海馬體內淀粉樣蛋白斑塊的積聚。 為了驗證此假設，我們將在五重轉基因（5XFAD）小鼠模型上進行三個具體研究目標：1）利用體內雙光子顯微鏡，縱向觀察奮性神經元樹突棘的結構可塑性以及PVIN軸突末端，描繪突觸喪失的時序與空間-時間分布，並追蹤背側海馬的淀粉樣蛋白斑塊積聚。同時，使用迷你顯微鏡進行PVIN與奮性神經元活動的鈣成像，以研究在空間導航記憶任務中，背側海馬的網絡功能失調。2）在睡眠過程中利用非侵入性聽覺刺激進行γ頻率的同步，評估其在預防及治療早期至晚期AD中的潛在益處。3）通過光遺傳技術，特定操控PVIN活動，研究PVIN在γ頻率同步中的作用。總結而言，本研究將揭示PVIN在AD進展中的核心角色，並探索一種潛在的非侵入性預防與治療策略。

17102825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102825.value: 運用微生理系統的構建來解密光生物調節療法在牙周炎治療中的作用機制

17102825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17102825.value: Prof LI, Zhong Prof Wang, Yulan Prof Yang, Weifa Prof Yang, Yanqi Prof Zhang, Chengfei

17102825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102825.value: Background: Periodontitis, a prevalent inflammatory oral condition, causes irreversible damage to the periodontium, significantly impacting patients' oral function and quality of life. Despite its widespread occurrence, effective and less traumatic treatments remain elusive. Photobiomodulation therapy (PBM), a non-invasive and comfortable treatment modality, shows promise in managing periodontitis. Previous clinical studies have demonstrated its potential to reduce inflammation, promote tissue regeneration, and improve overall periodontal health. However, the efficacy of PBM remains debatable due to inconsistent parameter settings and limited understanding of its underlying mechanisms. Key issues: Our group has extensive experience investigating PBM's effects on periodontitis patients through clinical and laboratory studies. Despite our consistent efforts, significant research gaps persist, including a lack of reliable periodontitis models, undetermined optimal PBM settings, and incomplete overview of metabolic activities. These limitations underscore the critical need for a validated micro-physiological model to investigate PBM's effects on periodontitis. Our team has made progress in developing a periodontitis-on-a-chip (PoC) model. We’ve acquired proficiency in key techniques such as primary cell isolation, 3D cell culturing and co-culturing, microtissue characterization, and have completed the preliminary design of the PoC to simulate extracellular interactions within the micro-physiological system. Objectives: In the proposed study, we have assembled a multidisciplinary team to achieve the following three objectives: 1) Establish, fabricate, and validate the PoC model; 2) Identify the effects of PBM on periodontium microtissues under different parameters; 3) Uncover the mechanisms of PBM on periodontitis, focusing on cellular activities and mitochondrial changes. Research Plan: We will harvest periodontal cells from healthy patients to create gingival, periodontal ligament, and bone microtissues. These will be integrated into 3D-printed PoC tanks with a multifluidic channel system for replicating periodontium. To mimic periodontitis, pathogens and their derivatives will be introduced into the gingival components with verification of microtissue responses. The effects of PBM at different parameters will be investigated in the PoC to determine the optimal settings for periodontitis treatment. Cellular activities and mitochondrial changes will be examined to interpret the mechanisms. Significance: This project will contribute to more effective and targeted PBM treatments for periodontitis patients. With growing evidence supporting PBM's application in dentistry, we aim to produce clinical guidelines and encourage its wider adoption. Moreover, our validated PoC will offer a valuable tool for the broader research community, enabling more efficient and ethical testing of various periodontal treatments beyond PBM. 研究背景： 牙周炎作為全球盛行率極高的慢性發炎性疾病，其特徵性病理變化會導致牙周支持組織（包括牙齦、牙周韌帶及齒槽骨）的不可逆損傷，不僅嚴重影響患者的口腔功能與生活品質，更可能引發全身性系統疾病。現有治療方式雖能緩解症狀，但在組織再生與長期療效方面仍存在明顯局限。光生物調節療法（Photobiomodulation therapy, PBM）憑藉其非侵入性、無痛且具生物刺激效應等優勢，近年來被視為極具潛力的輔助治療選項。臨床研究顯示，PBM能顯著降低牙周發炎反應、促進組織修復並改善臨床附著水平；然而，由於作用參數（如波長、能量密度、照射時間）缺乏標準化，加上對其分子層級作用機轉認識不足，致使現有證據呈現高度異質性，嚴重阻礙了PBM在臨床的轉化應用。 關鍵問題與研究基礎： 本團隊長期致力於PBM治療牙周炎的轉化醫學研究，通過系列臨床試驗與基礎實驗，已累積豐富的治療參數優化經驗。然而，現有研究面臨三大核心瓶頸：（1）傳統動物模型與二維細胞培養難以模擬人類牙周微環境的複雜性；（2）PBM能量參數與組織反應的劑量效應關係尚未建立；（3）對PBM調控細胞代謝，特別是在粒線體功能與免疫微環境互動方面的機制認知存在重大缺口。為突破這些限制，本項目旨在創新性地開發“牙周炎芯片”（Periodontitis-on-a-Chip, PoC）微生理系統。 研究目標： 本研究擬整合組織工程、光醫學與系統生物學方法，實現三大突破性目標：1. 建立標準化PoC平台：通過原代細胞分選、3D生物打印與微流體技術，構建仿生牙周微組織誘導炎症模型；2. 解析PBM劑量效應：利用高通量光學調控系統，定量分析不同波長與能量密度對組織修復的影響，建立參數-療效預測模型；3. 闡明作用機轉：結合單細胞轉錄組與代謝組學，揭示PBM通過調控粒線體促進組織再生的分子路徑。 研究設計： 我們將從健康患者中採集牙周細胞，用於構建牙齦、牙周膜和骨微組織。這些組織將被整合到具有多流體通道系統的3D打印PoC中。為模擬牙周炎，牙齦組件中會引入病原體及其衍生物，並驗證微組織的反應。我們將在PoC平台中系統性測試PBM參數組合，以確定治療牙周炎的最佳設置。同時，我們將檢測細胞活動和粒線體的變化，以解釋其作用機制。 研究意義： 本項目將有助於建立基於實證的PBM治療參數，為牙周炎患者提供更精準有效的非侵入性治療方案。此外，驗證的PoC模型不僅解決傳統研究模型的局限性，更能作為多功能平台，高效評估各類牙周治療方法的有效性與安全性。最後，該模型大幅降低對動物實驗的依賴，為牙周疾病研究提供更符合倫理要求的替代方案。

17103425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17103425.value: 使用二胺氟化銀凝膠預防幼兒齲齒的隨機臨床試驗

17103425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17103425.value: Prof Lo, Edward Chin Man Dr Zheng, Faith Maiomaio

17103425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103425.value: Background: Childhood tooth decay (early childhood caries, ECC) affects 55% of 5-year-old children in Hong Kong. Untreated ECC causes pain and infection and can result in long-term negative impacts on health and quality of life. The standard of care involves applying 5% sodium fluoride (NaF) varnish (22,600 ppm fluoride) up to four times per year to prevent ECC. However, in practice, this frequency is seldom achieved and the consensus regarding its efficacy is mixed. As a potentially more effective alternative, the World Health Organization (WHO) Model List of Essential Medicines endorses silver diamine fluoride (SDF) for caries management. SDF is typically available in a 38% aqueous solution (44,800 ppm fluoride), which is runny and difficult to apply. Additionally, the applied SDF can be diluted or washed away by saliva. A 38% SDF viscous gel was recently introduced and has been shown to be qualitatively similar to the 38% SDF solution. However, it has not been tested clinically for the prevention of ECC. Objective: To compare the efficacy of SDF gel with that of NaF varnish in preventing ECC when applied at half-yearly intervals. Methods: This is a single-centre, double-blind, active-controlled, stratified, parallel-group, two-arm, randomised clinical trial, with the primary outcome of new caries increment at the tooth level at 24 months. The trial will recruit and randomise 1,500 three-year-old kindergarten children to receive either SDF gel or NaF varnish every 6 months. This sample size is sufficient for a superiority trial with a power of 80%, allowing for a 15% dropout rate. A calibrated examiner will perform dental examinations in the kindergartens every 6 months over 24 months. Caries will be diagnosed at the cavitation level to achieve a high reproducibility in assessment. Each child will receive either SDF gel or NaF varnish on all twenty of their primary teeth after examination. The examiner, the children, and the children’s parents will be blinded to the treatment allocation. The parents will be surveyed to assess the children’s oral health-related behaviours and their socioeconomic backgrounds to adjust for effect modification. Significance: We expect that SDF gel will be more effective than NaF varnish in preventing ECC. If so, this study will help change the standard of preventive care. If SDF gel is adopted in Hong Kong, it could prevent children from developing ECC, thus reducing the burden of ECC among children, their families, and on dental care services. 背景：香港五歲兒童中，55%患有幼兒齲齒（Early Childhood Caries, ECC）。未經治療的ECC會引發疼痛和感染，並可能對健康及生活品質造成長期負面影響。現行標準預防措施為每年最多四次塗抹5%氟化鈉（NaF）塗漆（含22,600 ppm氟化物），但實際應用中鮮少達到此頻率，且其效果尚存爭議。世界衛生組織（WHO）基本藥物清單推薦使用二胺氟化銀（Silver Diamine Fluoride, SDF）作為齲齒管理的潛在更佳替代方案。SDF通常以38%水溶液形式（含44,800 ppm氟化物）提供，但其流動性高、難以精準塗抹，且易被唾液稀釋或沖刷流失。近期推出的38% SDF黏性凝膠，經定性分析證實與38% SDF溶液性質相似，但尚未經臨床驗證用於預防ECC。 目的：比較每半年塗抹一次SDF凝膠與NaF塗漆在預防ECC上的效果。 方法：本試驗為單中心、雙盲、活性對照、分層、平行組、雙臂隨機臨床試驗，主要終點為24個月後牙齒層面的新齲齒增量。研究將招募1,500名三歲幼稚園兒童，隨機分配至SDF凝膠組或NaF塗漆組，每六個月接受一次治療。此樣本量足以支持一項優效性試驗（檢定力80%），並預留15%脫落率。由經過校準的檢查員於24個月內每六個月在幼稚園進行牙科檢查，以「齲洞形成」為診斷標準以確保評估的高再現性。每次檢查後，所有兒童的20顆乳牙將塗抹SDF凝膠或NaF塗漆。檢查員、兒童及其家長均對治療分組不知情。家長需填寫問卷以評估兒童口腔健康行為及社會經濟背景，用於調整效應修飾因子。 意義：我們預期SDF凝膠在預防ECC上優於NaF塗漆。若結果證實此假設，本研究將推動預防護理標準的變革。若香港採用SDF凝膠，可有效預防兒童ECC，從而減輕兒童、家庭及醫療服務的ECC負擔。

17103525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17103525.value: 定義人類腸神經系統形成背後的訊號動力學和相互作用

17103525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103525.value: Around 40% of people worldwide are affected by various bowel disorders such as diarrhea and constipation, impacting individuals of all ages. Severe conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, necrotizing enterocolitis and Hirschsprung disease (HSCR) are life-threatening if left untreated. Despite the complex nature of these diseases, most compromise the enteric nervous system (ENS). Current treatments largely focus on targeting the immune system, with limited effect in ENS recovery, leading to enduring changes in bowel habits. Hence, a comprehensive therapeutic approach addressing the immune system and ENS recovery may be more effective. Additionally, patients with severe ENS disorders such as HSCR disease may benefit from stem cell replacement therapy. Therapies directing the resident or xenografted ENS progenitor cells to form functional ganglia would benefit ENS recovery. However, guiding neuron formation remains challenging, necessitating a deeper understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying human ENS development. With human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived cell-based models, we have defined cellular metabolism is a key pathway underlying the formation of functional ENS. Our hPSC-derived innervated colonic organoid (inHCOs) model comprising functional ENS further illustrated that mesenchymal cells support ENS maturation and plexus development. Intriguingly, our preliminary data indicated that the ENS progenitors originating from different axial levels work coordinately to form ENS in the colon. All these data highlight that the signal cross-talks among the ENS progenitors and their neighboring cells are essential for the proper formation of ENS. Here, we hypothesize that manipulating these pathways alone or in combination would facilitate the formation/regeneration of ENS, representing the potential therapeutic targets. To test this hypothesis, we aim to (1) identify metabolic modulators for boosting up the neurogenic potentials of ENS progenitors; (2) build the signaling entropy among ENS progenitors of different origins and the gut mesenchyme along ENS development in the human colon using our second generation of inHCO model to define new signal pathways that enhance ENS maturation and plexus development; (3) elucidate the potential functional impacts of these signals in ENS formation using multi-lineage bowel models to determine their therapeutic values. Defining the key pathways regulating ENS formation and the dynamic interactions among ENS and other bowel cells will deepen our knowledge of human ENS development. Establishing a new generation of multi-lineage bowel models will further expand the therapeutic armamentarium for bowel diseases, paving the way for developing targeted therapies for ENS recovery.

17104025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17104025.value: 探討維生素D水平與攝取模式對嬰兒期至兒童期生長發育的相互影響

17104025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17104025.value: Dr Ho, Frederick Ka Wing Prof Ip, Patrick Prof Lee, Albert Dr Li, Shi-ying, Christine Dr Wong, Rosa Sze Man

17104025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104025.value: Background: Insufficient vitamin D intake is frequently observed among infants and toddlers. Previous research, primarily based on cross-sectional studies, has shown that vitamin D insufficiency is associated with suboptimal childhood outcomes, including poor metabolic health, reduced cognitive ability, and increased psychosocial and behavioural problems. Nonetheless, there is limited understanding of the longitudinal changes in vitamin D levels over time and their implications on long-term health and wellness. To address this gap, a good-quality cohort study is necessary to monitor the dietary intake and vitamin D levels over time and explore their potential influences on various health outcomes and related trajectories. Objectives: The proposed study will assess and compare the concurrent and longitudinal effects of vitamin D status and levels on the growth (height, weight, body mass index) and development (behavioural problems, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder symptoms and health-related quality of life) of Hong Kong Chinese children. It will also explore how vitamin D intake patterns from infancy to childhood may moderate these effects. Study Design: The study will be the follow-up phase of a study of a representative sample of Chinese infants and toddlers (aged 7 to 23 months) initially recruited from 2019 to 2021 from 6 maternal and child health centres in various districts of Hong Kong. At baseline, a detailed assessment of the participants’ dietary patterns was conducted to assess their vitamin D intake. Key variables such as vitamin D level and anthropometric measurements were also collected during the baseline assessment. The proposed study will revisit the cohort in 2026 (aged 6 years) to examine their vitamin D levels, dietary patterns, and growth and developmental outcomes. Our experience in the previous follow-up suggests that we should be able to recruit at least 70% (n = 443) of the initial cohort. Study Contributions: The proposed cohort study will provide robust evidence about the influence of longitudinal dietary intake variations on the relationship between early vitamin D status and subsequent growth and development in children. Specifically, it will demonstrate whether improvements in dietary intake can ameliorate the adverse consequences of insufficient vitamin D levels during early childhood. The results of this study have the potential to instigate new public health initiatives that underscore the significance of maintaining optimal vitamin D levels through a balanced diet for the long-term well-being of children. 背景： 嬰幼兒維生素D攝取不足的現象極為普遍。過往研究指出維生素D不足或引致代謝健康不佳、認知能力下降以及心理社交和行為問題增加等兒童健康問題。儘管如此，嬰幼兒時期維生素D不足的長遠健康影響還未有足夠證據支持，因此我們提議一個高質量的縱向研究來監測兒童膳食攝取和維生素D水平，並探討其對健康及相關發展軌跡的潛在影響。 研究目的： 本研究旨在評估和比較維生素D狀態和水平對香港兒童生長（身高、體重、體重指數）和發育（行為問題、注意力缺乏/過度活躍症及健康相關生活質素）的同期和縱向影響。同時，研究還將探討從嬰兒期到兒童期的維生素D攝取模式的變化如何調節這些影響。 研究設計： 研究對象為2019年至2021年從香港母嬰健康中心招募月齡為7至23個月的嬰幼兒。在基線階段，研究人員對參與者的膳食模式進行了詳細評估，同時收集了維生素D水平和體格測量等關鍵變量。本研究擬於2026年進行跟進研究，再評估其維生素D水平、膳食模式以及生長發育軌跡。 研究貢獻： 本研究將為早期維生素D狀態與兒童後續生長發育之間的關係提供有力的證據。研究將揭示改善膳食攝取是否能夠緩解嬰幼兒期維生素D水平不足帶來的不良後果。研究結果有望推動新的公共衛生倡議，強調通過均衡飲食維持最佳維生素D水平對兒童長期健康的重要性。

17104225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17104225.value: 鸚鵡紅橙色羽毛顏色變異的遺傳基礎

17104225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104225.value: Bird coloration has contributed tremendously to our understanding of the evolution of phenotypic diversity. Parrots (order Psittaciformes) have one of the most striking colorations in nature. Different from most birds, which use diet-derived carotenoids, parrots have evolved a unique ability to endogenously synthesize pigments to color their feathers from yellow to red. The genetic basis of psittacofulvin pigmentation was an unknown until recent research identified the involvement of an uncharacterized polyketide synthase (MuPKS) in yellow psittacofulvin synthesis and of an aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH3A2) in modulating the ratio of red-to-yellow psittacofulvin deposition in parrot feathers. However, our understanding of this evolutionary innovation in parrots is still very limited. The interactions between pigments and proteins have been suggested to be partly responsible for the red plumage color of parrots. Pigment-protein interactions are a widespread mechanism in animal coloration, and parrots may develop their psittacofulvin-based color spectrum by modulating the interaction of psittacofulvins with structural proteins. To further decipher the genetic basis of psittacofulvin-based pigmentation and the role of pigment-protein interactions in plumage color development, the proposed study will investigate the mechanism underlying parrots’ ability to generate a spectrum of colors ranging from orange to red using genomics and transcriptomics approaches. We will study the genetic basis of phenotypic varieties in parrots that have a mutation causing the development of orange rather than red plumage by identifying the underlying genomic region(s) and gene(s) associated with the color variation and validating the role of the identified candidate gene(s) using a functional test. The knowledge obtained in this project will be crucial for understanding the genetics and evolution of parrot plumage color and the evolution of phenotypic diversity in parrots and other birds. 鳥類體色對我們理解表型多樣性的演化貢獻巨大。鸚鵡（鸚鵡形目）擁有自然界中最引人注目的體色之一。與大多數利用食物來源的類胡蘿蔔素的鳥類不同，鸚鵡進化出了一種獨特的能力，能夠由體內合成色素，將羽毛變為黃色或紅色。鸚鵡黃素合成的遺傳基礎先前一直不為人知，直到最近的研究發現，一種聚酮合成酶（MuPKS）參與了黃色鸚鵡黃素的合成，以及一種醛脫氫酶（ALDH3A2）參與了鸚鵡羽毛中紅色和黃色鸚鵡黃素比例的調節。然而，我們對鸚鵡這演化革新的理解仍然非常有限。色素和蛋白質之間的相互作用被認為是鸚鵡羽毛呈現紅色的部分原因。色素-蛋白質相互作用是動物顏色的普遍機制，鸚鵡可能透過調節鸚鵡黃素與結構蛋白的相互作用來形成基於鸚鵡黃素的色彩光譜。為了進一步闡明鸚鵡黃素色素形成的遺傳基礎以及色素-蛋白質相互作用在羽毛顏色發育中的作用，本研究將利用基因組學和轉錄組學方法，探討鸚鵡能夠產生從橙色到紅色一系列色彩光譜的機制。我們將透過識別與顏色變異相關的潛在基因組區域和基因，並透過功能測試驗證已識別候選基因的作用，來研究發生突變導致羽毛發育為橙色而非紅色的鸚鵡表型變異的遺傳基礎。本計畫所獲得的知識對於理解鸚鵡羽毛顏色的遺傳和演化以及鸚鵡和其他鳥類表型多樣性的演化至關重要。

17104325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17104325.value: 患者衍生的小型細胞外囊泡富集的 S100A11 重塑微血管微環境並激活巨噬細胞，以形成促進遠端轉移的前轉移微環境，從而增強三陰性乳腺癌向肺部的遠端轉移

17104325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17104325.value: Prof Kwong, Ava Prof YAM, Judy Wai Ping

17104325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104325.value: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) accounts for approximately 15% of all breast cancer (BC) cases and is characterized by a poor prognosis and limited therapeutic options. The tumor microenvironment (TME) is a heterogenous and complex milieu that supports tumor cell growth and dissemination. Emerging evidence has revealed the crucial role of small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) in cell-to-cell communication within the TME, both locally and distantly. Using a clinically relevant approach, sEVs isolated from the plasma of late-stage TNBC patient with lung metastasis (MBC-sEV) demonstrated a significant ability to enhance the mobility, survival, and metastatic potential of BC cells. Proteomic profiling identified S100A11 as one of the top upregulated proteins in MBC-sEV, a finding validated with both public databases and in-house clinical cohorts. Knockdown of endogenous S100A11 reduced the tumorigenic capabilities of TNBC cells. Modulating the levels of S100A11 within sEVs influenced the functional impact on Human Umbilical Vein Endothelial Cells (HUVECs), both in vitro and in vivo. This indicates that sEV-S100A11 enhances the lung colonization of TNBC cells by inducing pulmonary vessel leakage, disrupting vascular endothelial barrier integrity, and promoting angiogenesis. Further investigation demonstrated that sEV-S100A11 activates macrophages, leading to their infiltration into the lung TME. This process is responsible for recruiting granulocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells (gMDSCs), but not monocytic MDSCs (mMDSCs), thereby establishing an immune-suppressive pre-metastatic niche (PMN) that favors distant lung metastasis in TNBC. While these preliminary findings strongly suggest the critical role of sEV-S100A11 in modulating lung metastasis of TNBC, there is still a need for a comprehensive study on the detailed molecular mechanism underlying microvascular niche remodeling and the dynamic changes in the immune landscape during lung PMN formation. Based on these initial results, we hypothesize that sEV-S100A11 derived from TNBC patients augments lung metastasis by modulating the microvascular niche and the immune landscape during PMN formation. The current proposal aims to 1) delineate the molecular mechanism underlying the effect of sEV-S100A11 on remodeling the microvascular niche, 2) elucidate the immune landscape modulated by sEV-S100A11 within the lung TME, and 3) evaluate the clinicopathological significance of sEV-S100A11 in TNBC patients. This study will uncover the detailed molecular mechanisms by which S100A11, present in sEVs, promotes TNBC metastasis, thereby bridging a gap in current TNBC research. Our findings will also have clinical implications for the diagnostics and therapeutics of TNBC.
