Comparing images of these two hemispheres, the most obvious manifestation of this difference is that the nearside is occupied by ~30% dark patches and farside only by ~2%. These dark patches represent mare basalts, the products of volcanic eruptions billions of years ago. This difference means ancient volcanism on nearside was much more extensive than farside (15 times larger by area). Scientists have proposed several hypotheses to explain what caused this dichotomy, however, none of them are widely accepted because of the lack of any farside samples. It becomes one of the largest lunar scientific questions waiting for answers. All previous lunar samples returned by a space mission were collected from nearside, including Chang’e-5, Apollo, and Luna missions. Chang’e-6 mission is the world’s first farside sampling mission which launched on May 3 and returned to the Earth on June 25, 2024, with 1935.3 g of samples. These precious samples have provided unprecedented opportunities to solve the lunar asymmetrical problem. The Chang’e-6 site is located in the south of the Apollo impact basin, within the much larger South Pole-Aitken basin. Samples collected are lunar soils developing on mare basalts which are past volcanic eruption products. A complete understanding of the magmatic histories of this region would dramatically benefit the studies on the Chang’e-6 samples, maximize the science returns and finally move a major step to solve the lunar dichotomy conundrum. Therefore, we propose this project to characterize the magmatism of the Apollo basin. Benefitting from the historic Chang’e-6 mission which measured scientific data from lunar surface and returned soil samples, this study aims to link remote sensing observations, surface explorations, and returned sample analyses together. Finally, we would piece together the past magmatic history of the Apollo basin, expanding more broadly to the South Pole-Aitken basin region with the ground truth provided by Chang’e-6, and finally rethink the origin of the lunar asymmetry. 對地球生物而言，月球僅有一端面向地球，這一端叫做正面。與正面相對，在地球上永不可見的另一端叫做背面。月背在1959年人類第一顆人造衛星（月球三號）環繞月球並拍攝第一張照片以前一直保持未知。在此之後，科學家突然意識到月球正面和背面在多個方面截然不同，這一現象被稱為二分性。比較月球正面和背面的多組數據，最大的不同表現在正面有約30%的區域被暗色玄武岩覆蓋，這一面積在背面僅佔約2%。這些月海玄武岩是數十億年前月球火山噴發的產物。這一差別指示月球正面火山活動相比背面更為活躍（面積大15倍）。科學家提出了多種模型解釋月球二分性，然而由於缺乏月背樣品，目前並未取得一致結論。這一問題成為現今月球探測最大的亟待解答的科學問題。以往所有月球返回樣品均來自月球正面，包括嫦娥五號、阿波羅和月球號任務樣品。嫦娥六號任務是世界首次月球背面採樣返回任務，於2025年5月3日發射，6月25日攜帶1935.3克樣品返回地球。這些前所未有的樣品為解決月球二分性難題提供了前所未有的機會。嫦娥六號著陸點位於阿波羅撞擊盆地南部，更大的南極-艾肯盆地內部。嫦娥六號採集的月壤樣品來自於過去多次火山噴發。徹底釐清區域岩漿活動歷史，將對嫦娥六號樣品研究，最大化嫦娥六號任務科學產出，解決月球二分性難題具有重要意義。因此，本研究計劃對阿波羅盆地岩漿作用進行研究。得益於嫦娥六號任務在月球表面採集的數據和樣品，這一研究計劃綜合研究軌道遙感數據、表面探測數據和返回樣品。最終，本研究將會重建阿波羅盆地岩漿活動歷史，以嫦娥六號樣品作為地面真值，擴展到更廣大的南極-艾肯盆地，以重新思考月球二分性起源。

17307425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17307425.value: 擴散模型訓練與推理的基礎理論與方法探究

17307425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17307425.value: Diffusion models have stood out among numerical generative models in recent years due to their strong interpretations and impressive empirical performance. The widespread use of diffusion models highlights the need for rigorous theoretical frameworks to ensure reliable data generation and efficient algorithm design. Generally, diffusion models involve two key steps: score learning, where trained neural networks approximate the data distribution along the diffusion path; and diffusion inference, where new samples are generated based on the learned score. Existing research has provided theoretical guarantees for these steps separately, offering bounds on the generation error and computational & sample complexities. Despite significant breakthroughs, current works are limited to relatively idealized theoretical settings. They often concern specific diffusion inference algorithms and overlook the neural network training process during score learning. Additionally, they typically concern worst-case scenarios across broad data distributions and conduct independent analyses for score learning and diffusion inference. This approach may not align with practical scenarios, where data distributions have favorable properties and the two steps are largely interdependent. These limitations hinder a precise understanding of how diffusion models perform in real-world applications and make it challenging to provide guidance for improving algorithm designs. This project aims to bridge existing gaps by developing more advanced theoretical frameworks for diffusion models. By developing a more fine-grained theory for score learning, diffusion inference, and their integration, we aim to better capture the practical behavior of diffusion model and explore improved algorithm designs. Specifically, for diffusion inference, the project will establish a general framework for designing inference algorithms and provide a flexible theoretical platform to analyze their complexities. Regarding score learning, the project will develop a training-dependent theory for neural networks, which can precisely characterize the implicit bias of the score network throughout training and help explore improved designs of the network architecture and training objectives. Finally, we will develop a unified analysis for diffusion inference and score learning, which can sharply characterize their interactions and joint effects on generation quality. The joint analysis will be leveraged to initiate further research on a broader family of diffusion models. We have conducted preliminary explorations on both algorithm design and theory, providing early validation of the proposed research objectives and plans. This project will deliver both new algorithms and theories. The algorithms will be made publicly available as open-source software. The theoretical insights will be used to develop course materials for teaching and training students. 近年來，擴散模型因其強大的可解釋性和令人印象深刻的實證表現，在數值生成模型中脫穎而出。擴散模型的廣泛應用凸顯了建立嚴格理論框架的必要性，以確保可靠的數據生成和高效的算法設計。一般而言，擴散模型包含兩個關鍵步驟：分數學習 —— 訓練神經網絡以逼近擴散路徑上的數據分佈；以及擴散推理 —— 基於學習到的分數生成新樣本。現有研究已分別為這兩個步驟提供了理論保證，給出了生成誤差以及計算和樣本複雜度的邊界。儘管取得了重大突破，當前的研究仍局限於相對理想化的理論設定。這些研究往往關注特定的擴散推理算法，而忽視了分數學習過程中的神經網絡訓練環節。此外，它們通常關注廣泛數據分佈中的最差情況，並對分數學習和擴散推理進行獨立分析。這種方法可能與實際場景不符，因為在實際場景中，數據分佈具有有利特性，且這兩個步驟在很大程度上相互依賴。這些局限性阻礙了對擴散模型在真實世界應用中表現的精確理解，也使其難以為改進算法設計提供指導。 本項目旨在通過開發更先進的擴散模型理論框架來彌合現有差距。通過為分數學習、擴散推理及其整合建立更精細的理論，我們力圖更好地捕捉擴散模型的實際行為，並探索改進的算法設計。具體而言，在擴散推理方面，本項目將建立一個用於設計推理算法的通用框架，並提供一個靈活的理論平台來分析其複雜度。在分數學習方面，將開發一種依賴於訓練過程的神經網絡理論，該理論能夠精確描述分數網絡在整個訓練過程中的隱式偏差，有助於探索網絡架構和訓練目標的改進設計。最後，我們將對擴散推理和分數學習進行統一分析，以清晰描述它們之間的相互作用以及對生成質量的聯合影響。這種聯合分析將用於啟動對更廣泛擴散模型家族的進一步研究。 我們已在算法設計和理論方面進行了初步探索，為擬議的研究目標和計劃提供了早期驗證。本項目將同時產出新的算法和理論。這些算法將以開源軟件的形式公開提供。理論見解將用於編寫教學材料，以培養學生。

17307725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17307725.value: 化學與酶促途徑聯合的免疫佐劑QS-21放大合成研究

17307725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17307725.value: QS-21 is one of the most potent immunostimulatory natural products and serve as adjuvant in several approved human vaccines and vaccine candidates. The current supply of QS-21 depends on the Quillaja tree bark, involving tedious separation efforts. In this project, we plan to develop a scalable approach towards QS-21 through joint chemical and enzymatic syntheses. The aglycone quillaic acid will be synthesized via two-step enzymatic oxidation under cell-free condition, while the trisaccharide and tetrasaccharide fragments will be synthesized in scalable manner with optimized protecting group patterns and glycosylation sequences. The final convergent fragment assembly will provide QS-21-Xyl in gram scale. QS-21是一種具有優異免疫促進功能的天然產物，目前作爲免疫佐劑應用於一系列上市和臨床研究的疫苗之中。目前該化合物的生產主要以從皂樹皮中分離提取為途徑，工藝繁瑣且產量受限。本項目旨在研發一條化學合成與酶促合成聯合且具有放大潛力的QS-21製備路綫。其中甙元部分將以廉價化合物齊墩果酸為原料，經兩步無細胞體系的酶促氧化反應製備。三糖與四糖片段將分別采用化學方法合成，並通過保護基策略和糖苷化流程的優化實現規模化製備。上述片段以匯聚方式組裝，最終實現免疫佐劑QS-21-Xyl的克級製備。

17307925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17307925.value: 利用廣義 Bell 定理與 Kochen-Specker 定理推動（半）器件無關量子密碼學的進展

17307925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17307925.value: Quantum Information Theory and the Foundations of Quantum Mechanics have evolved from theoretical curiosities to prolific industries in recent years. Quantum Cryptography represents the foremost application of the singular quantum features, promising security based on the very laws of nature rather than computational limitations of any adversary. Furthermore, unlike the tremendous investment needed to build full-scale quantum computers, compact quantum cryptographic devices can be built at low cost. Indeed, Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNG) have already been adopted by governments and corporations. Device-Independent (DI) quantum cryptography offers the highest security guarantee, where even the very devices used by consumers do not have to be trusted, the devices may have been tampered or even manufactured by adversaries. These build upon quantum features of Entanglement, Bell Non-locality and Kochen-Specker Contextuality to achieve QKD and QRNG with both information-theoretic and implementation security. However, much work remains to be done - both from foundational explorations of novel quantum properties such as network non-locality and generalisations of Bell theorem and the Kochen-Specker theorem, as well as expanding the scope of DI cryptography to new directions including conference key agreement, clock synchronization, message authentication, etc., while at the same time improving key rates, implementational feasibility and relaxing assumptions in existing protocols. With leading experts, we developed the first practical device-independent protocols for extraction of random bits from weak public seeds. We have also established breakthrough results in the foundational quantum features of monogamy of entanglement and non-locality, quantum contextuality and no-cloning that underpin the security of cryptographic protocols. Our first goal in this project is to pioneer new directions in Quantum Foundations, with an aim to relax the assumptions in the Bell Theorem, prove generalisations of the Kochen Specker Theorem and advance the recently developed field of quantum network non-locality. The second main goal is to apply these features for cryptography, to develop practical protocols for DI-QKD and SDI-QRNG using public weak seeds, allowing information leakage between devices, proving security against general no-signalling adversaries, as well as expanding the scope towards network protocols of multi-user conference key agreement and clock synchronization. Experimental implementations of our protocols with expert collaborators will enable us to build HKU as a prominent centre for quantum cryptography. This will also enable demonstrations in business and educational settings, powering the formation of start-up ventures in Quantum Information in Hong Kong within the next 4 years. 近年來，量子信息理論與量子力學基礎研究已從單純的理論探討發展為快速成長的產業。量子密碼學是量子特性最前沿的應用，它承諾的安全性依賴於自然規律本身，而非對手的計算能力限制。相比於構建大規模量子計算機所需的鉅額投入，緊湊型量子密碼設備能夠以低成本實現。事實上，量子密鑰分發（QKD）與量子隨機數發生器（QRNG）已被政府與企業廣泛採用。器件無關（DI）量子密碼學提供了最高等級的安全保證——使用者無需信任所用設備，即便設備被篡改或由對手製造，仍能確保安全。這類協議依托於量子糾纏、Bell 非局域性與 Kochen-Specker 互文性，從而實現具備信息論安全性與實現層面安全性的 QKD 與 QRNG。然而，相關研究仍有大量工作亟待完成：包括對新型量子特性（如網絡非局域性）的探索，對 Bell 定理與 Kochen-Specker 定理的推廣，以及拓展 DI 密碼學的應用範圍至會議密鑰協商、時鐘同步、消息認證等新方向；同時，還需提升密鑰生成速率、增強實現可行性，並放寬現有協議中的假設條件。我們與國際頂尖專家合作，首次提出了能夠從弱公共種子中提取隨機比特的實用 DI 協議；同時，在量子糾纏與非局域性的單一性、量子互文性以及不可克隆性等基礎特性方面取得了突破性成果，這些特性共同構成了量子密碼協議安全性的核心基礎。 本項目的首要目標是開闢量子基礎研究的新方向，旨在放寬 Bell 定理的前提假設，建立 Kochen-Specker 定理的廣義推廣，並推動新興的量子網絡非局域性研究。第二個核心目標是將這些量子特性應用於密碼學，設計出實用的 DI-QKD 與 SDI-QRNG 協議，利用弱公共種子，在允許設備間信息泄露的情況下，仍可證明其對一般相對論型竊聽者的安全性，並進一步拓展至多用户會議密鑰協商與時鐘同步等網絡協議。通過與實驗專家的合作，我們將推動這些協議的實驗實現，從而將香港大學建設為量子密碼學的重要研究中心。同時，這也將促成在商業與教育場景中的應用示範，推動未來四年內香港量子信息產業相關初創企業的形成。

17308425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308425.value: 利用內修飾瓜環探索特異性分子識別

17308425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308425.value: Achieving high specificity in molecular recognition, the process of selectively binding a specific organic molecule among a multitude of other possible targets, constitutes a longstanding challenge in supramolecular chemistry. Enzymes, through billions of years of evolution, have developed remarkable precision in recognizing substrates by matching their sizes, shapes and electrostatic landscapes. Incorporating polar recognition sites into the hydrophobic cavities of macrocycles serves as an ideal approach to mimic such complementarity observed in substrate-enzyme interactions, but a dearth of available tools has hampered the development of synthetic analogues with comparable specificity. This project aims to utilize cucurbiturils, a class of macrocycles known for their strong binding affinity towards various guest molecules, to create endo-functionalized hosts and evaluate their binding specificity in molecular recognition in water. By introducing recognition units with diverse sizes, polarities, and electrostatic properties in the hydrophobic cavities of cucurbiturils, it is envisioned that polar noncovalent bonding interactions can be established between the hosts and the guests. These modifications will not only provide docking sites for the guests but also change the shapes of the macrocycles to resemble enzyme-like cavities. Initial findings have demonstrated the feasibility of one of these proposed modifications, prompting the expansion of this strategy using cutting-edge synthetic organic chemistry techniques. The newly created endo-functionalized cucurbiturils will undergo a series of competitive binding assays in order to assess their binding specificity for hydrophilic, hydrophobic, and ionic molecules in water. Collectively, these new supramolecular tools hold the potential for the development of potent drug antagonists and delivery agents, the innovation of robust bioorthogonal recognition systems, and the invention of ultrasensitive molecular probes for disease diagnosis. 在超分子化學領域，實現高特異性的分子識別（即從眾多可能目標中選擇性結合特定有機分子的過程）始終是一項長期挑戰。經過數十億年演化，酶類已能透過精準匹配受質的尺寸、形狀及靜電特徵來展現卓越的分子識別能力。將極性識別位點引入大環化合物的疏水性空腔，是模擬這種酶-受質互補性的理想策略，然而可用工具的缺乏阻礙了開發具有可比特異性的人工類似物。本計畫擬運用瓜環（一類以對多種客體分子具強結合親和力著稱的大環化合物）來構建內壁功能化的主體分子，並評估其在水相中分子識別的结合特異性。通過在瓜環疏水空腔內引入具有不同尺寸、極性與靜電特性的識別單元，預期能在主客體間建立極性非共價鍵相互作用。這些修飾不僅能為客體分子提供錨定位點，更能使大環結構形變形成類酶空腔。初步研究已證實其中一種修飾方案的可行性，促使我們運用尖端有機合成化學技術擴展此策略。新創製的內壁功能化瓜環將進行系列競爭性結合實驗，以評估其對水相中親水性、疏水性及離子性分子的結合特異性。總體而言，這些新型超分子工具有望應用於：開發高效藥物拮抗劑與遞送載體、創新穩健的生物正交識別系統，以及發明用於疾病診斷的超靈敏分子探針。

17308625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308625.value: 早期火星凍融循環驅動化學風化的實驗模擬研究

17308625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308625.value: Modern Mars is very arid, cold and oxidizing, while early Mars was believed to be episodically warm, wet, reducing. Early Mars may have experienced frequent climate changes owing to variations in greenhouse warming. This was predominantly caused by the efficient loss and addition of reducing gases (e.g., H2), which played a crucial role in the warming of early Mars. During the climate transition from warm to cold on early Mars, freeze-thaw cycles were a common natural process on surface owing to Mars’seasonal and orbital cycles. While freeze-thaw cycles are often mentioned as a mechanism for physical weathering, we propose that freeze-thaw cycles also serve as an efficient proxy for chemical weathering owing to the acid concentration during the freezing stage and material exchange during the thawing stage. Based on the study of remote sensing and Mars rover data, we have hypothesized that freeze-thaw cycles could have been responsible for some intriguing compositional observations on the surface of Noachian terrains (~4.1-~3.7 billion years ago). These observations include Fe depletion, ancient olivine escaped from chemical weathering, and the formation of sulfates. In this proposal, we plan to examine the hypotheses by conducting systematic laboratory freeze-thaw cycles experiments. The mineralogical and elemental behaviors induced by freeze-thaw cycles will be studied in detail and compared with the observations on Mars. Specifically (1) we will compare the dissolution rate of olivine under freeze-thaw, completely frozen, and completely unfrozen environments to evaluate whether freeze-thaw cycles can drive efficient chemical weathering; (2) we will compare the dissolution rate of olivine and basaltic glass under completely frozen and freeze-thaw conditions to check whether basaltic glass is more susceptible to chemical weathering than olivine when freezing is involved; (3) freeze-thaw cycles under oxidizing conditions will also be conducted to determine if it could produce jarosite and Mg sulfate observed at Meridiani investigated by the Opportunity rover. This systematic laboratory work will demonstrate the role of freeze-thaw cycles, a universally occurring natural process, in chemical weathering from an experimental perspective. The results of these experiments will help determine whether the above compositional puzzles on the surface of early Mars can indeed be explained by freeze-thaw cycles. The study will shed light on the reconstruction of Martian paleoclimate as well as providing foundation base for future in-situ investigation at the landing sites of Mars rovers and the study of future samples returned from Mars.

17308725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308725.value: 解碼亞馬遜雨林葉齡物候：模式、驅動因素及其對區域性光合作用建模的啟示

17308725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308725.value: The Amazon rainforest is crucial for global ecological balance and climate stability, yet predicting its response to climate change remains uncertain. A key factor in this uncertainty is how photosynthesis in the Amazon will respond to current and future climates. Recent studies highlight the importance of leaf age phenology—the seasonal patterns of leaf age compositions—in understanding photosynthetic function, especially under seasonal water stress. Unfortunately, existing monitoring methods lack the precision and scalability needed, resulting in limited data on leaf age phenology. We aim to fill these gaps by studying the patterns and drivers of leaf age dynamics in the Amazon and evaluating their impact on large-scale photosynthesis modeling. The project has three objectives: (1) Advancing leaf age phenology monitoring—We will use 3m-resolution, near-daily PlanetScope CubeSats imagery combined with a tree-crown inventory method to monitor leaf age phenology. This method, initially developed for phenocam platforms, will be validated using ground-based data (e.g., phenocam and litterfall) and sub-meter resolution imagery from WorldView-2 and Google Earth. Once validated, it will be applied across the Amazon to fill the data gap in leaf age phenology; (2) Exploring patterns and drivers of leaf age phenology—Using the derived data, we will test four hypotheses for basin-wide variations in leaf age phenology: i) intrinsic rhythms linked to seasonal variations in insolation, ii) evolutionary adaptations for optimal resource use of light, water and nutrients, iii) herbivory avoidance, and iv) environmental cues from vapor pressure deficit (VPD), either as a direct defense strategy or due to the correlation between low VPD and increased insect herbivory during the humid season. This analysis will help us understand how light, water, nutrient limitations, and herbivory avoidance influence leaf age phenology patterns; (3) Incorporating leaf age phenology into models—We will integrate our leaf age data and the latest leaf area index (LAI) phenology product into models like the Breathing Earth System Simulator (BESS), enabling to explore how LAI and leaf age regulate photosynthetic function across the Amazon under current and future climate conditions. Model results will be cross-validated using eddy covariance flux tower data and satellite-derived solar-induced fluorescence as proxies for regional photosynthetic productivity. By achieving these objectives, we aim to enhance the understanding of the Amazon rainforest's photosynthetic function and its sensitivity to climate change, ultimately offering insights for preserving this crucial ecosystem and supporting global efforts to combat climate change.

17308825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308825.value: 蘇門答臘俯衝帶大規模劇烈噴發的誘發機制研究

17308825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308825.value: Large magnitude explosive eruptions were found to have occurred less frequently than smaller eruptions but generated more significant influences on the Earth’s climate, environment and habitability. Therefore, it is significant to study large volcanic eruptions from both scientific and societal perspectives. Previous studies of large Quaternary (i.e., 2.6 million years ago till present) eruptions show a great regional variation. One of the least studied volcanic regions is Sumatra Island of the Indonesian archipelago. Specifically, among more than sixty large Quaternary eruptions in Sumatra, only four have geochemical data reported and few have the eruption triggering mechanisms revealed. In this project, we propose to investigate the triggering mechanisms of the largest Quaternary eruptions at three calderas in Sumatra, using a combination of geochemical analyses, machine-learning based thermobarometer and hygrometer calculations, and thermodynamic modelling of the pre-eruptive magma volume change and overpressure. We will use the model results to determine whether over-pressurization (as an internal trigger) alone can trigger very large eruptions and whether external triggers are required. The outputs of this project will not only enhance understanding of volcanism in the Sumatra subduction zone, but also provide new insights into the relationship between the inter-eruption/system variability of eruption triggers and a variety of geological/tectonic parameters. The geochemical data to be acquired from this project will also be essential for tephrochronology studies that identify eruptions by pairing distal and proximal deposits, which in turn help refine the eruption frequency-magnitude relationship in the region. The overall findings will provide key information to volcanic risk assessments and eruption forecast, which are among the greatest challenges faced by earth scientists, yet urgent to improve for densely populated volcanic regions, such as Sumatra. 大規模、爆發式火山噴發雖然發生頻率通常低於更小規模的噴發，但對地球氣候、環境及宜居性能夠產生顯著影響。因此，研究大規模火山噴發的誘發機制，在科學、社會、經濟等各個層面，均具有重大意義。然而，對於第四紀大規模噴發的研究投入與成果存在明顯的地域性差異，其中印尼蘇門答臘島是研究最薄弱的區域之一：在已知的六十餘次第四紀大型噴發中，僅四次噴發有相關的地球化學研究，大部分噴發的誘發機制研究程度極低。本項目擬利用岩石地球化學分析、基於機器學習的岩漿溫壓及水含量計算、以及基於熱力學資料庫的岩漿體積變化及超壓計算，探究蘇門答臘俯衝帶多次大規模第四紀噴發的誘發機制，驗證岩漿超壓能否作為超大規模噴發的唯一誘因、以及特定規模的噴發是否需要外部誘因。本項目的研究成果將為蘇門答臘俯衝帶火山活動提供新的地球化學及岩礦學數據，為揭示同一火山及同一火山弧上不同火山的噴發誘因異同、噴發誘因與不同時代及不同區域地質環境的相關性等關鍵科學問題，提供新見解。本項目獲取的地球化學數據對於火山灰年代學研究也至關重要，通過補充目前缺少的多座火山的噴發產物化學成分數據，可以更準確地匹配遠源和近源的噴發物，有助於識別區域內潛在的其他噴發事件，建立區域內大型噴發的頻率與規模相關性模型。本項目的研究結果將為火山噴發風險評估及噴發預警提供關鍵信息，這對於蘇門答臘島這個火山眾多且人口密集的區域而言刻不容緩。

17308925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308925.value: 通过逆电子需求狄尔斯-阿尔得反应扩展核糖核酸邻近标记工具箱

17308925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308925.value: RNAs are dynamic biomolecules essential for cellular survival and development, performing their critical biological functions at specific subcellular locations. This makes RNA localization a pivotal aspect of RNA biology. However, current methods for studying RNA localization are limited, typically focusing on RNAs at a single location or time point. This limitation stems from the absence of chemical tools that can effectively differentiate RNAs across various locations or time intervals. Despite the availability of various chemical mechanisms for RNA proximity labeling in live cells, the prevalent use of terminal alkyne—a carbon-carbon triple bond—leads to limited diversity in RNA modification. This bio-orthogonal group facilitates the copper-catalyzed alkyne-azide cycloaddition (CuAAC) reaction, which, despite its efficiency, poses cytotoxicity risks due to the copper catalyst involved. To address these challenges, we propose the introduction of a new click chemistry reaction for RNA biotinylation. The Inverse Electron-Demand Diels-Alder (IEDDA) reaction serves as a promising orthogonal alternative that matches the efficiency of CuAAC. Inspired by the reactivity of propargyl amine towards oxidized guanosine, we plan to conjugate an activated olefin (a carbon-carbon double bond) with difluoro-substituted amine, which exhibits a similar low pKa to propargyl amine. This newly developed molecular structure can be sequentially applied with propargyl amine, enabling the monitoring of RNA dynamics across different locations and time points—an unprecedented capability. Our research will employ this new system to evaluate the biological impact of the proximity labeling step itself, aiming to resolve longstanding issues associated with radical or reactive species mediated proximity labeling. This foundational study is intended to lay the groundwork for more comprehensive investigations into RNA localization, thereby enhancing our understanding of RNA dynamics within live cells. This approach not only addresses current limitations in RNA localization studies but also paves new pathways for exploring the complex roles of RNA in cellular functioning and development. RNA是对细胞生存和发展至关重要的动态生物分子，在特定的亚细胞位置执行其关键的生物学功能。这使得RNA定位成为RNA生物学的关键方面。然而，目前研究RNA定位的方法有限，通常只关注单一位置或时间点的RNA。这种限制源于缺乏能有效区分不同位置或时间间隔的RNA的化学工具。尽管现有多种化学机制可用于活细胞中的RNA邻近标记，但广泛使用的末端炔烃(一种碳碳三键)导致RNA修饰的多样性受限。这种生物正交团体便于铜催化的炔-叠氮环加成反应(CuAAC)，尽管该反应效率高，但由于涉及铜催化剂，存在细胞性毒性风险。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出引入一种新的点击化学反应用于邻近标记中RNA的生物素化。逆电子需求 Diels-Alder (IEDDA)反应作为一种有前途的正交替代方案，其效率与CuAAC相匹配。受丙炔胺对氧化鸟苷反应性的启发，我们计划将一种活化的烯烃(一种碳碳双键)与二氟取代胺结合，后者展示了与丙炔胺类似的低酸碱度。这种新开发的分子结构可以与丙炔胺先后使用，实现在不同位置和时间点对RNA的动态进行监控。我们的研究将利用这一新系统评估邻近标记步骤本身的生物影响，旨在解决由自由基或反应性物种介导的邻近标记中长期存在的相关问题。 这项基础研究旨在为更全面的RNA定位调查奠定基础，从而增强我们对活细胞内RNA动态的理解。这种方法不仅解决了当前RNA定位研究的局限性，而且为探索RNA在细胞功能和发展中的复杂角色铺平了新的途径。

17309225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309225.value: 探究积极未来：更深的水层能否成为重要生态经济性无脊椎动物抵御表层海洋热浪的避难所？

17309225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309225.value: Our current understanding of marine heatwave (MHW) events comes from analysis of surface ocean temperatures in the open ocean. This focus is due to the availability of data from satellites with enough spatial and temporal resolution to enable detection of extremes in sea surface temperatures over large spatial scales. However, processes below the surface, and in more dynamic areas along the coast, are not resolved by satellite-based temperature estimates. This leads to a large gap in our understanding of the effects of MHWs in shallow nearshore areas, which are some of the most productive and important marine ecosystems globally. Over the last decade, many regions globally have experienced MHWs that are the largest ever recorded in terms of duration and intensity. Coastal areas are the most ecologically and economically impacted regions because of these MHW events, with losses from individual events estimated to be >$800 million USD in direct costs, especially in coastal production such as from aquaculture. Early warning of these events could mitigate some of the risk associated with marine industries such as aquaculture. But, predicting these events requires an understanding of the local environmental context, as well as a knowledge of how local biological communities will respond. The extent to which ecosystems are impacted by heatwaves is determined by the biological responses of species, the underlying physiological and molecular mechanisms, and whether these physiological changes impart increased thermal tolerance for subsequent events. Water depth is thought to potentially be a thermal refuge from extreme events for some species, but there is currently little understanding of if, or under what conditions, this may occur. Here, we will first analyse nearshore vertical profiles of MHWs globally to advance our understanding of the depth penetration of MHWs. Then, by establishing a local network of temperature loggers in Hong Kong we will identify if thermal refugia may exist across seasons. We will use this new information to quantify the effects of both surface and bottom water MHWs on the thermal physiology and fitness of ecologically and economically important subtidal invertebrates. The outcomes will elucidate not only the thermal tolerance and fitness of species through these extreme events, but whether living in deeper water may provide some refuge for ecologically and economically important marine species into the future as MHWs become more frequent and extreme. 海洋热浪（Marine Heatwaves, MHWs）作为全球海洋生态系统面临的重要威胁，已引起广泛关注。当前的研究主要依赖于卫星监测的外洋表层海温数据，利用其高空间和时间分辨率，在大尺度上识别极端温度事件。然而，基于卫星数据的温度估算难以解析次表层水体及高动态性近岸区域的热力过程，导致我们对全球最具生产力和生态价值的浅海近岸生态系统受MHW影响的认知仍存在重大空白。过去十年，全球多个海域经历了持续时间长、强度高的MHW事件，尤其是在近岸区域，这些事件对生态系统和沿岸产业造成了严重冲击，单次事件的直接经济损失估计超8亿美元。建立准确的早期MHW预警系统迫在眉睫，而实现这一目标需要深入理解局地环境背景、垂直渗透特征及生物群落的响应机制。 在生态系统层面，热浪影响的程度不仅取决于物种的生理响应和潜在的分子机制，还涉及这些变化是否增强物种的耐热能力。虽有研究显示水深可能为某些物种提供极端事件的热避难所，但相关产生条件和作用机制仍不清楚。本研究将通过分析全球近岸MHW的垂直剖面数据，揭示热浪事件的垂向渗透特征；在香港建立温度监测网络，探明季节性热避难区的存在性；最终结合表层与底层MHW事件数据，量化评估其对关键生态和经济型无脊椎动物的热生理适应性。研究将阐明物种在极端温度事件中的耐热性与适应机制，揭示随着MHW频发加剧，更深的水层能否成为重要海洋物种未来的气候庇护所，这对于理解和应对全球气候变化背景下的海洋生态安全具有重要意义。

17309625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309625.value: 可解釋且高效的高維張量時間序列自迴歸模型

17309625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309625.value: With the rapid advancement of information technology, multi-dimensional or tensor-valued data have been becoming ubiquitous, and particularly many of them are time-dependent. When conducting supervised learning tasks, say autoregression, on these data, we may frequently encounter the situation that the number of parameters to estimate is substantially larger than the available sample size. In the meanwhile, these data often possess hidden low-dimensional structures, which can be leveraged to improve the interpretability and estimation efficiency. A commonly used way to handle such type of data is to assume Tucker decomposition to the coefficient tensor of autoregressive models, however, although it good interpretation, it is lack of efficiency when the orders of both response and covariate tensors are high. In the meanwhile, CP decomposition is well recognized to compress tensor dramatically, however, it may be lack of interpretation when it is applied to tensor-on-tensor regression models. Motivated by the nice interpretation of supervised factor modeling arguments, this project first proposes a low-dimensional structure to the coefficient tensor of tensor-on-tensor regression models. It enjoys the good interpretation as for Tucker decomposition, while its estimation is more efficient since CP decomposition is employed to extract response and covariate features separately. Secondly, the proposed methodology is further applied autoregressive models, and hence an interpretable and efficient autoregressive model can be achieved. Thirdly, the exact low rank assumption can be limited, leaving the method susceptible to model misspecification or heterogenous signals. To solve this problem, this project also considers two low rank plus sparse models for tensor-on-tensor regression and tensor autoregressive models, respectively. Finally, this project discusses the high-dimensional estimation for these models, and their non-asymptotic properties will be established. 隨著資訊科技的快速發展，多維或張量值資料已變得無處不在，尤其其中許多是時間依賴的。在進行這些資料的監督式學習任務，例如自迴歸分析時，我們經常會遇到估計參數的數量遠遠超過可用樣本數的情況。同時，這些資料通常具有潛在的低維結構，這些結構可以被利用來提高模型的可解釋性與估計效率。 處理這類資料常用的方法之一是對迴歸模型的係數張量進行Tucker分解，雖然這種方法具有良好的解釋性，但當反應與協變量的張量階數較高時，效率則較低。同時，CP分解被廣泛認為能大幅壓縮張量，但在應用於張量對張量的迴歸模型時，可能缺乏解釋性。 受到監督式因子模型良好解釋性的啟發，本研究首先提出將低維結構引入張量對張量迴歸模型的係數張量中。該方法兼具Tucker分解的良好解釋性，同時由於採用CP分解來分別提取反應與協變量的特徵，使得估計過程更具效率。 其次，將所提出的方法進一步應用於自迴歸模型，從而實現一個具有良好解釋性與高效性的自迴歸模型。 第三，然而嚴格的低秩假設可能限制模型的彈性，使其容易受到模型錯誤或異質信號的影響。為了解決這個問題，本研究也考慮了兩類低秩加稀疏的張量對張量迴歸模型與自迴歸模型。 最後，本研究還討論了這些模型在高維情境下的估計問題，並將建立其非漸近性質的理論結果。

17309725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309725.value: 木星內磁層交換不穩定性研究：壓力各項異性與熱等離子體的影響

17309725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309725.value: The planetary magnetosphere is a region that connects a planet's atmosphere with outer space. It is mainly influenced by the interaction between the solar wind and the planet's magnetic field. In the case of Jupiter, the inner part of its magnetosphere, known as the inner Jovian magnetosphere, extends to about 20-30 times the radius of Jupiter. This area is strongly affected by Jupiter's powerful internal magnetic field, which is mostly directed southward near the equator. Within the inner Jovian magnetosphere, there are hazardous radiation belts that pose challenges for spacecraft exploration. Therefore, understanding and modeling this region is crucial for planning and designing space missions to Jupiter or with Jupiter flybys. Unlike Earth's inner magnetosphere, where dynamics are primarily driven by energetic particle drift and interactions with the ionosphere, Jupiter's inner magnetosphere is more complex due to its larger size and much faster rotation. Centrifugal forces play a significant role in shaping the structures within the Jovian magnetosphere, through a physical process called interchange instability. These structures impact the transport of mass, momentum, and energy, as well as the energization of particles within Jupiter's magnetosphere. The understanding of the Jupiter's inner magnetosphere is limited due to a lack of global measurements. Thus much of what we know about this important region is based on theoretical models and simplified simulations. While theories offer valuable insights into the driving forces behind, they often rely on linear models in simplified settings. Previous global simulations have been able to capture the overall behavior of these instabilities, but they have been constrained by either physics involved or limitations in grid resolution. To enhance our understanding of Jupiter's inner magnetosphere and potentially provide predictions, we aim to develop a new, three-dimensional simulation tool specifically designed to study this region. Building on our past successes in global modelling and expertise in numerical algorithm development, we propose a series of research activities to investigate the multi-scale, multi-physics dynamic evolution of Jupiter’s inner magnetosphere: 1. Develop a high-resolution 3-D regional model for simulating the Jovian inner magnetosphere with magnetosphere-ionosphere coupling; 2. Implement pressure anisotropy in the regional model to study the stability and evolution of the Jovian inner magnetosphere; 3. Investigate the role of hot plasma population on the configuration of the Jovian inner magnetosphere 4. Provide new knowledge of the multi-scale, non-linear, transient nature of the Jovian inner magnetosphere; with predictive outputs for future data-model comparisons. 行星磁層是連接行星大氣與外層空間的區域，主要受到太陽風與行星自身磁場相互作用的影響。以木星為例，它的內磁層，可以延伸到木星半徑的20到30倍的距離。在這個區域裡，木星強大的內部磁場起著主導作用。在木星內磁層中，還存在著強烈的輻射帶，這對太空船的探測構成很大的挑戰。因此，了解並建立關於這一區域的物理模型，對於規劃和設計飛往木星或者利用木星作為中轉站的太空任務來說非常重要。與地球的內磁層不同，地球的內磁層主要由高能粒子的漂移運動和與電離層的相互作用所驅動，而木星的內磁層因為體積更大、自轉更快，情況更加複雜。由於告訴旋轉，離心力在木星磁層結構的形成中起著重要作用，這個過程稱為「交換不穩定性」。這些結構會影響木星磁層內物質、動量和能量的傳輸，以及粒子的能量提升。目前我們對木星內磁層的了解還很有限，主要原因是缺乏全面性的觀測數據。因此，我們現在對這一區域的認知，大多依賴理論模型和簡化的模擬。雖然這些理論為我們提供了很多有價值的見解，但通常都是在比較理想化的條件下、用線性模型來研究的。以往的全球模擬雖然能夠大致反映這些不穩定現象的整體表現，但通常受限於物理過程的簡化或者模擬解析度的限制。為了更好地理解木星內磁層，並有可能做出預測，我們計畫開發一個全新的三維模擬工具，專門用來研究這一區域。基於我們之前在全球建模和數值算法開發方面的經驗，我們計畫展開以下幾項研究工作，來探索木星內磁層多尺度、多物理過程的動態演化： 1 開發一個高解析度的三維局域物理計算模型，用來模擬木星內磁層及其與電離層的耦合過程； 2 在模型中加入等離子體壓力各向異性物理，以研究木星內磁層的穩定性和演化； 3 探討熱等離子體在木星內磁層結構中的作用； 4 揭示木星內磁層多尺度、非線性和瞬態變化的本質，並為未來的數據與模型比對提供預測結果。

17309925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309925.value: 具有異質係數與不確定界面的亥姆霍茲特徵值問題的數值均質化

17309925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309925.value: The efficient and accurate numerical solution of parameterized Helmholtz eigenvalue equations with heterogeneous coefficients is essential for various practical applications. These equations govern the propagation of electromagnetic waves in periodic dielectric materials, such as photonic crystals, which are crucial in the design of optical transistors, photonic fibers, and low-loss optical mirrors. However, simulating these equations in composite materials poses a significant challenge due to the high oscillation of material coefficients and their varying values within a single cell. The complexity of discretization is elevated by the heterogeneous coefficient, and the noncoercive nature of the problem renders standard iterative methods unreliable. Additionally, the eigenfunctions exhibit poor regularity due to the high-contrast and discontinuous nature of the coefficient, leading to slow convergence of classical numerical methods. Moreover, inherent uncertainties stemming from modeling errors and manufacturing imprecision further complicate the quantification of material properties' influence. This research program aims to tackle these challenges by developing innovative numerical homogenization methods based on edge multiscale finite element techniques for parameterized Helmholtz eigenvalue equations with uncertain interfaces. The project will involve the creation of new mathematical analyses, computational algorithms, and convergence studies for these methodologies, allowing for an exploration of the impact of material coefficient uncertainties and the estimation of relevant quantities of interest. The research will leverage high-dimensional approximation theory, partial differential equations, multiscale analysis, and numerical analysis as primary tools. The outcomes of this project are expected to yield fresh insights into the analysis and numerical solutions for these complex problems, with practical implications for efficient simulations, particularly in the realm of inverse design for photonic crystals. 高效且準確地求解具有異質係數的參數化亥姆霍茲特徵值方程的數值方法，對於多種實際應用至關重要。這些方程描述了電磁波在周期性介電材料（如光子晶體）中的傳播，這在光學晶體管、光子纖維和低損耗光學鏡的設計中扮演著關鍵角色。然而，在復合材料中模擬這些方程具有較大挑戰，因為材料係數的高振盪性以及在單一單元內值的變化，增加了離散化的複雜度。異質性係數使得問題不具強化性，導致標準迭代方法不可靠。此外，由於係數的高對比度和不連續性，特徵函數的正則性較差，造成傳統數值方法收斂速度較慢。此外，模型誤差和製造不精確帶來的固有不確定性，也進一步增加了對材料性質影響的量化難度。 本研究計畫旨在通過開發基於邊界多尺度有限元技術的創新數值均質化方法，來應對這些挑戰，特別是針對具有不確定界面的參數化亥姆霍茲特徵值方程。該計畫將涉及這些方法的數學分析、計算算法以及收斂性研究，從而探索材料係數不確定性對結果的影響，並估算相關感興趣的量。 本研究將運用高維近似理論、偏微分方程、多尺度分析和數值分析等工具。預計該項目的成果將為這些複雜問題的分析與數值解提供新的見解，並在高效模擬方面產生實際應用價值，特別是在光子晶體的逆向設計領域。

17310125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17310125.value: 鲁棒因子化马尔可夫决策过程

17310125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17310125.value: Markov decision processes (MDPs) are a classical paradigm for sequential decision making under uncertainty, wherein a decision maker is tasked with controlling a stochastically evolving system by taking actions at a sequence of designated time points in order to maximize a reward function. However, MDPs suffer from two major drawbacks. The first one is the so-called curse of dimensionality, which refers to the fact that the computational complexity of MDPs depends exponentially on the dimension of the state space; and the second is the reliance on the precise knowledge of the transition dynamics of the system. These drawbacks significantly hamper the application of MDPs to modern real-world sequential decision making problems, where the state space can be very high-dimensional and the system's transition dynamics is typically unknown but estimated from data. In this project, the PI and co-I Professor Daniel Kuhn plan to develop a novel methodology for sequential decision making under uncertainty that can simultaneously tackle these two issues. Specifically, we will introduce and analyze a new form of MDPs, called robust factored MDPs (RFMDPs), which are not only robust against the impreciseness of the system's transition dynamics but also able exploit the hidden sparsity that is available in many real-world dynamics to effectively overcome the curse of dimensionality. Expected contributions are fourfold. First, two types of ambiguity sets that can efficiently represent the sparse structure of transition dynamics will be developed. Second, cutting-plane algorithms for solving the RFMDPs associated with each of the two ambiguity sets will be devised and analyzed. Third, the data-driven setting where samples of the system trajectory are available will be considered, and statistical properties of the proposed RFMDPs with data-driven ambiguity sets will be established. Finally, a comprehensive numerical study of the proposed RFMDPs and its cutting-plane algorithm will be conducted to delineate their strength, with using real-world sequential decision making scenarios. 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）是不确定性下序贯决策的经典范式，其中决策者的任务是通过在一系列指定时间点采取行动来控制随机演化的系统，以最大化奖励函数。然而，MDP存在两个主要缺陷。第一个是所谓的维数灾难，即MDP的计算复杂度与状态空间维数呈指数关系；第二个是对系统转移动态的精确知识的依赖。这些缺陷严重阻碍了MDP在现代现实世界序贯决策问题中的应用，在这些问题中，状态空间可能是高维的，系统的转移动态通常是未知的，只能从数据中估计。 在本项目中，主要研究者和共同研究者Daniel Kuhn教授计划开发一种新颖的不确定性下序贯决策方法，能够同时解决这两个问题。具体而言，我们将引入和分析一种新形式的MDP，称为鲁棒因子化MDP（RFMDP），它们不仅对系统转移动态的不精确性具有鲁棒性，而且能够利用许多现实世界动态中可用的隐藏稀疏性来有效克服维数灾难。预期贡献包括四个方面。首先，将开发两种能够有效表示转移动态稀疏结构的模糊集。其次，将设计和分析与这两种模糊集相关的RFMDP的割平面算法。第三，将考虑系统轨迹样本可用的数据驱动设置，并建立带有数据驱动模糊集的所提出RFMDP的统计性质。最后，将进行所提出RFMDP及其割平面算法的综合数值研究，通过使用现实世界的序贯决策场景来阐明它们的优势。

17310425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17310425.value: 地下水與海水流動及溶質運移耦合模擬

17310425.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17310425.value: Prof Gan, Jianping Dr Luo, Xin Dr Mao, Rong

17310425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17310425.value: Submarine groundwater discharge (SGD) is increasingly recognized as a significant contributor to chemical fluxes in coastal ecosystems, impacting nutrient cycling, marine ecology, and environmental management. However, existing studies predominantly focus on the marine side and often use natural geotracers such as radium (Ra) to estimate SGD. These studies typically employ budget analysis models that assume steady offshore water systems without significant stratification, or diffusion models that ignore seawater advection. Given the dynamic nature of seawater—with its complex currents, waves, and tides—these assumptions may not be physically reasonable. Geotracer distribution in the sea shows spatial and temporal variation, but budget analysis typically ignores these variations, providing only a total sum of SGD without detailing its spatial and temporal changes. Current models that couple seawater and groundwater, including vertically averaged two-dimensional (2D) numerical models in seawater and ocean hydrodynamic models with boundary-specified groundwater-borne chemicals, have limitations and cannot fully capture the generation and migration of groundwater-borne chemicals through both aquifers and seawater. This research proposes to develop a three-dimensional (3D) fully-coupled groundwater-seawater (GW-SW) interaction model to simulate water flow and solute transport in both aquifers and the sea, treating the two water bodies as a continuum. Using the coastal aquifer and Plover Cove, Hong Kong, as a case study, the project aims to address several key gaps. Firstly, it will investigate the spatial distribution and variability of natural tracers like Ra within coastal aquifers, particularly in freshwater-saltwater mixing zones. Secondly, it will develop and validate a coupled hydrodynamic model that integrates groundwater and seawater interactions to predict solute transport from aquifers to the sea. This model will be tested for convergence and computational efficiency using both 2D and 3D scenarios. Field data collection, including climatological data, water sampling, and tracer measurements, will be conducted in the coastal areas of Plover Cove to calibrate and validate the model. The research will also explore the biogeochemical impacts of groundwater-borne nutrients on seawater properties and marine ecology, with a particular focus on the implication of these nutrients on algal blooms and red tide outbreaks. By advancing the understanding of SGD processes and developing a robust fully coupled modeling framework through the collaboration among hydrogeologists, geochemists, and groundwater and ocean numerical modelers, this study aims to provide valuable insights for managing coastal water resources and mitigating environmental impacts. The findings will have significant implications for coastal hydrogeology, marine biogeochemistry, and environmental policy. 海底地下水排泄（Submarine Groundwater Discharge, SGD）日益被視為影響沿海生態系統化學物質通量的重要因素，對養分循環、海洋生態及環境管理皆有深遠影響。然而，現有研究多側重於海洋側，常利用鐳（Ra）等天然地球示蹤劑估算SGD。此類研究通常採用收支分析模型，假設離岸水體系統穩定且無明顯層化，或使用忽略海水對流的擴散模型。然而海水具有複雜的流動特性，包含洋流、波浪與潮汐等動態過程，上述假設在物理上未必合理。海中示蹤劑的分佈具有時空變化，但收支分析通常忽略此類變異，僅提供SGD的總量，無法揭示其空間與時間上的細節。現有耦合海水與地下水的模型，例如海水側的垂向平均二維（2D）數值模型，或結合邊界給定地下水溶質的海洋水動力模型，皆存在局限，難以完整模擬溶質在含水層與海水中的生成與遷移過程。 本研究擬發展一套三維（3D）完全耦合的地下水－海水（GW-SW）交互作用模型，將含水層與海水視為連續介質，模擬兩者之間的水流與溶質運移。以香港船灣沿海含水層為案例，本計畫旨在填補多項研究缺口：首先，探討鐳等天然示蹤劑在沿海含水層，特別是淡水－鹹水混合帶中的空間分佈與變異特性；其次，發展並驗證一套整合地下水與海水交互作用的耦合水動力模型，用以預測溶質由含水層向海洋的傳輸過程，並透過二維與三維情境測試模型的收斂性與計算效率。研究將於船灣沿海地區進行實地觀測，包括氣象資料、水體採樣與示蹤劑測量，以校正與驗證模型。此外，亦將探討地下水攜帶之營養鹽對海水性質與海洋生態的生物地球化學影響，特別關注其對藻華與赤潮爆發的潛在作用。透過水文地質學家、地球化學家與地下水及海洋數值模型專家的跨領域合作，本研究將深化對SGD過程的理解，並建立一套穩健的全耦合模擬架構，為沿海水資源管理與環境影響緩解提供科學依據。研究成果將對沿海水文地質學、海洋生物地球化學及環境政策制定產生重要影響。

17310725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17310725.value: 量子過程熱力學用於設計資源高效的量子技術

17310725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17310725.value: Quantum technologies hold significant promise in the fields of computation, communication, and sensing, offering unprecedented speed, security, and precision. However, the realization of this potential is impeded by several challenges, notably including limited scalability and high operating costs. Addressing these hurdles requires major advances in quantum engineering and, at the same time, prompts a deeper investigation of fundamental physics, calling for a quantification of the minimum physical resources needed to process information at the quantum scale. In recent years, research in quantum thermodynamics has developed powerful techniques to quantify the resource requirements of quantum machines. However, the ultimate efficiency limits to the realization of general information processing tasks still remain largely unknown. Basic problems, such as determining the minimum amount of work needed to implement a general quantum process, are still unsolved. A further challenge arises in quantum computing and other applications requiring the coordinated execution of multiple quantum processes, whose efficient realization requires an optimized allocation of resources in space and time. The lack of conclusive results in this area prevents an assessment of the full potential of quantum technologies, and at the same time represents a significant gap in our understanding of the interplay between physics and information processing. In this project, we will carry out a systematic investigation of the thermodynamic requirements of quantum processes and their composition into complex information processing tasks. We will start by establishing minimum requirements for the implementation of individual processes, designing concrete schemes that approach the ultimate efficiency limits in realistic noisy environments, and establishing benchmarks for the demonstration thermodynamic advantages of quantum information processing. Then, we will devise strategies to share resources among multiple quantum processes and to recycle them from one computational step to the next. Finally, we will develop a modular approach to the thermodynamics of quantum processes, providing ways to combine the efficient implementations of basic quantum processes into efficient implementations of increasingly complex networks. This project contributes to the field of quantum thermodynamics and to an ongoing effort to develop resource-efficient quantum technologies. Our results will provide performance benchmarks for the existing implementations of quantum information processing and working principles for the design of fully quantum control mechanisms. In the long term, this research will lay the foundations for a new generation of machines operating at the quantum scale and establish new links between thermodynamics, causal structure, and computational complexity. 量子技術在運算、通訊和感測領域擁有巨大的發展前景，能夠提供前所未有的速度、安全性和精確度。然而，實現這一潛力面臨諸多挑戰，其中最突出的是有限的可擴展性和高昂的營運成本。克服這些障礙需要量子工程的重大進步，同時也需要對基礎物理學進行更深入的研究，量化在量子尺度上處理資訊所需的最小物理資源。 近年來，量子熱力學的研究已經開發出強大的技術來量化量子機器的資源需求。然而，執行一般資訊處理任務的最終效率極限仍然很大程度上未知。諸如確定執行一般量子過程所需的最小工作量等基本問題仍未解決。量子計算和其他需要協調執行多個量子過程的應用面臨另一個挑戰，這些過程的有效實現需要對空間和時間資源進行最佳化分配。該領域缺乏確鑿的成果，這阻礙了對量子技術全部潛力的評估，同時也顯示了我們對物理學與資訊處理之間相互作用的理解存在重大差距。 在本專案中，我們將系統地研究量子過程的熱力學要求及其在複雜資訊處理任務中的組合。我們將首先確定單一製程實現的最低要求，設計在實際雜訊環境中接近最終效率極限的具體方案，並為量子資訊處理的熱力學優勢建立基準。然後，我們將設計在多個量子過程之間共享資源的策略，並將其從一個計算步驟循環到下一個計算步驟。最後，我們將開發一種量子過程熱力學的模組化方法，提供將基本量子過程的高效實現組合成日益複雜網路的高效實現的方法。 本計畫為量子熱力學領域以及持續開發資源高效的量子技術做出了貢獻。我們的研究結果將為現有的量子資訊處理實現提供性能基準，並為完全量子控制機制的設計提供工作原理。從長遠來看，這項研究將為新一代量子機器奠定基礎，並在熱力學、因果結構和計算複雜性之間建立新的連結。

17310825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17310825.value: 納維-斯托克斯方程解析半徑的精確化

17310825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17310825.value: This research project aims to explore the behavior of fluid flow in three-dimensional space by studying a mathematical model called the Navier-Stokes equation. We want to understand how smooth and well-behaved the solutions to this equation are over time. By using advanced mathematical techniques, we hope to develop a new framework that can provide insights into these complex fluid dynamics problems. Our goal is to create a general framework that can be applied to various scenarios involving fluid flow, leading to a better understanding of these phenomena. 本研究探討三維不可壓縮Navier-Stokes（納維-斯托克斯）方程解析半徑的關鍵影響因素。作為描述流體運動的核心方程，Navier-Stokes方程在氣象預報、空氣動力學和海洋模擬等眾多領域具有廣泛應用，其解的解析性質直接關係到流體行為的預測精度。研究重點包括：初始條件在不同函数空間下對解析半徑短期與長期下界的影響；非線性項、外力項及耗散效應對解的正則性和解析性的作用。通過分析這些因素，我們揭示了流體流動的穩定性與演化規律，為理解湍流等複雜現象提供理論支持。該研究不僅会深化對Navier-Stokes方程數學性質的認識，也對實際流體模擬與工程應用具有指導意義。

17310925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17310925.value: 發展用於選擇性環加成反應的高效銅光催化體系

17310925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17310925.value: Recent research has demonstrated that copper(I) complexes exhibit potential as visible-light photocatalysts for promoting a range of radical cross-coupling and cycloaddition reactions under ambient conditions. Nevertheless, the development of photoinduced copper-catalyzed organic transformations with precise chemo- and regioselectivity control is still in its early stages. The strategic design of new copper complexes and manipulation of solid supports to fine-tune selectivity in programmable photochemical synthesis are therefore of paramount importance from a scientific perspective. This proposed study endeavors to employ innovative methodologies to modulate electronic and steric effects on copper photocatalysis. Nitrogen-based bidentate ligands will be incorporated into heteroleptic copper complexes to align the transition energy of their photoexcited states with the activation energy of diverse organic substrates, enabling the realization of regioselective ring-forming reactions with broad scope. The selection of bridging ligands in photoactive copper dimers will be systematically explored to achieve selectivity-switchable cycloaddition reactions of functionalized alkenes via energy-transfer or electron-transfer pathways. Highly adaptable solid supports will be utilized to manipulate steric interactions between copper active sites and organic substrates, thereby governing cascade dearomative reactions with exceptional chemo-selectivity. The successful implementation of various organic transformations using efficient and selective copper photocatalysts is poised to facilitate the large-scale and sustainable synthesis of polycyclic bioisosteres and rigid organic scaffolds. This advancement holds significant promise for drug discovery efforts and the development of novel functional materials. 近年研究表明，一價銅配合物在環境條件下可作為可見光光催化劑，有效促進多種自由基交叉偶聯與環加成反應。然而，光誘導銅催化有機轉化反應的精準化學選擇性與區域選擇性調控研究仍處於起步階段。從科學角度而言，通過戰略性地設計新型銅配合物並調控固相載體來精確編程光化學合成的選擇性具有至關重要的意義。本研究擬采用創新方法調控銅光催化過程中的電子效應與空間效應：通過將氮基雙齒配體引入雜配位銅配合物，使其光激發態躍遷能與多種有機底物的活化能精準匹配，從而實現廣譜的區域選擇性成環反應；系統探索光活性銅二聚體中橋聯配體的選擇，通過能量轉移或電子轉移途徑實現功能化烯烴的選擇性可切換環加成反應；利用高適應性固相載體調控銅活性位點與有機底物間的空間相互作用，從而實現對具有卓越化學選擇性的級聯脫芳構化反應的精準控製。該研究計劃通過開發高效、高選擇性的銅光催化劑實現多樣有機轉化反應，有望推動多環生物電子等排體與剛性有機骨架的大規模可持續合成。此項進展將為藥物研發與新型功能材料開發開辟重要前景。

17311025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17311025.value: RNA假尿嘧啶修飾閱讀器的化學生物學研究

17311025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17311025.value: RNA modifications play crucial roles in regulating various biological processes and have been implicated in a range of diseases, including cancer, neurological disorders, and metabolic syndromes. Among these modifications, pseudouridylation— the isomerization of uridine to pseudouridine (Ψ)— is one of the most abundant and evolutionarily conserved. Despite its prevalence and significance, the molecular mechanisms by which pseudouridine exerts its biological effects remain poorly understood. Specifically, the identity of proteins that recognize and bind to pseudouridine-modified RNA ('readers') is largely unknown, representing a significant gap in our understanding of RNA biology. To address this knowledge gap, we propose a comprehensive chemical biology approach to identify and characterize pseudouridine-binding proteins. Our research will design and synthesize RNA photoaffinity probes that incorporate pseudouridine, enabling the capture of RNA-protein interactions in a native-like context. By employing our CLASPI (cross-linking-assisted and SILAC-based protein identification) methodology, the proteomic profiling will provide a comprehensive map of pseudouridine readers in various cellular contexts. We will also validate the identified unknown pseudouridine-binding protein and elucidate the recognition mechanisms at the molecular level. By leveraging this technique, we aim to uncover the molecular mechanisms by which pseudouridylation influences RNA function and to provide new insights into the regulatory roles of RNA modifications in cellular physiology and disease. This research will not only fill a critical gap in RNA biology but also potentially reveal novel therapeutic targets for diseases associated with dysregulated RNA modifications. The findings from this study could pave the way for new diagnostic tools and therapeutic strategies targeting RNA modification pathways. RNA 修飾在調節各種生物過程中扮演著關鍵角色，並且已被證實與包括癌症、神經疾病及代謝症候群等多種疾病有關。在這些修飾中，偽尿苷化——即尿苷異構化為假尿苷（Ψ）——是最豐富且演化上最保守的一種。儘管假尿苷化廣泛存在且意義重大，其發揮生物學效應的分子機制仍然知之甚少。特別是，能夠識別並結合假尿苷修飾 RNA 的蛋白質（稱為「閱讀器」）的身分仍然大多未知，這在我們對 RNA 生物學的認識中是一個重要的缺口。 為了解決這一知識缺口，我們提出以全面性的化學生物學方法來鑑定並特徵化假尿苷結合蛋白。我們的研究將設計並合成包含假尿苷的 RNA 光親和探針，從而能在類原生環境下捕捉 RNA-蛋白質互作。透過我們的 CLASPI（交聯輔助及 SILAC 基礎的蛋白質鑑定）方法，蛋白質組分析將在各種細胞情境下提供假尿苷讀者的完整圖譜。我們也將驗證所鑑定出的未知偽尿苷結合蛋白，並在分子層面釐清其識別機制。 藉由此技術，我們期望揭示假尿苷化如何影響 RNA 功能的分子機制，並對 RNA 修飾在細胞生理及疾病中的調控角色提供新的見解。本研究不僅能填補 RNA 生物學上的關鍵空白，還有可能發掘與 RNA 修飾失調相關疾病的新型治療標靶。本研究成果可望開創針對 RNA 修飾途徑的新型診斷工具及治療策略。

17311325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17311325.value: 基於高功函數外爾半金屬的p型二維半導體超低電阻接觸研究

17311325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17311325.value: Two-dimensional (2D) material complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) transistors are promising candidate for advanced semiconductor chip technology beyond the 1 nm technology node. However, the performance of existing 2D p-type transistor still lags far behind that of 2D n-type transistor due to the much higher contact resistance to p-type 2D materials. While previous research has developed low work-function semimetals such as bismuth (Bi) and antimony (Sb) that have significantly reduced the contact resistance in 2D nFET and advanced the device technology, forming low-resistance contacts to p-type 2D semiconductors remains a critical challenge towards the practical application of 2D CMOS technology. To address this challenge, we propose in this project a new approach to form ultra-low resistance contact with p-type 2D semiconductors using high work-function Weyl semimetals Co3Sn2S2. This new semimetallic contact material is expected to achieve near-zero Schottky barrier height at its interface with 2D semiconductor WSe2, and hence achieve low resistance contacts for p-type 2D semiconductors through innovation in material technology coupled with van der Waals interface engineering. The project consists of three research tasks: (1) synthesis of high work-function Weyl semimetal Co3Sn2S2 and formation of the contact interface with WSe2; (2) engineering the structural configuration of the contact between Co3Sn2S2 and p-type 2D semiconductors such as WSe2 to enhance carrier injection efficiency and achieve efficient carrier injection across the contact junction; (3) develop advanced hole doping techniques for 2D semiconductor WSe2 to increase its conduction modes and narrow the Schottky barrier width, and hence further enhance the carrier injection efficiency and reduce the contact resistance. DFT simulation will be carried out throughout this project to establish fundamental understanding of the semimetal properties, 2D semiconductor/semimetal van der Waals interface, and doping properties on 2D semiconductors. Landauer formulation method will be used to model the carrier transport. The successful completion of the project aims to achieve a solution to the key challenge currently hindering the advancement of 2D material logic transistor technology, using high work-function Weyl semimetals to achieve ultralow resistance contact for p-type 2D semiconductors and establish critical understanding about this interesting interface junction. 二維半導體是亞納米節點先進芯片晶體管溝道材料的重要技術選項。然而，目前p型二維半導體的接觸電阻遠高於n型器件，現有二維p型晶體管的性能也遠落後於二維n型晶體管。此前研究表明鉍（Bi）、銻（Sb）等低功函數半金屬可以顯著降低n型二維晶體管的接觸電阻，但如何實現p型二維半導體的低電阻接觸依然面臨重大技術挑戰。 針對這一挑戰，本項目提出一條全新的技術路徑 - 基於高功函數外爾半金屬Co₃Sn₂S₂與p型二維半導體實現超低電阻接觸。該新型半金屬接觸材料可以在與二維半導體WSe₂的界面處實現近乎零的肖特基勢壘高度，從而通過材料技術創新結合範德華界面工程實現p型二維半導體的低電阻接觸。 本項目的研究任務主要包括三個方面： 一. 合成高功函數外爾半金屬Co₃Sn₂S₂，並構建其與WSe₂的接觸界面； 二. 優化Co₃Sn₂S₂與WSe₂等p型二維半導體的接觸結構設計，提升載流子注入效率，實現跨越接觸界面的高效載流子輸運； 三. 開發針對二維半導體WSe₂的全新p型摻雜技術，增加其導電通道並縮窄肖特基勢壘寬度，從而進一步提升載流子注入效率，實現超低電阻接觸。 此外，本項目也將採用密度泛函理論（DFT）模擬計算半金屬特性、二維半導體/半金屬範德華界面性質以及相關摻雜效應；同時基於Landauer公式建立載流子傳輸模型。本項目總體目標是通過高功函數外爾半金屬實現p型二維半導體的超低電阻接觸，攻克當前阻礙二維晶體管技術發展的重要難題，為未來二維半導體材料的芯片級應用解決關鍵技術問題。

17311825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17311825.value: 發光離散型多核 d10 金屬配合物和團簇的設計與合成及其作為簇組裝和同金屬−配體及異金屬−配體組裝的構築模塊

17311825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17311825.value: With the growing interest in the understanding of noncovalent aurophilic interactions, which are interactions that bind gold(I) centers together with bond strengths similar to that of hydrogen bonds, there have been increasing studies to identify the existence of aurophilicity in closed-shell d10 gold(I) complexes, mostly relying on the isolation of solid-state crystal structures that require X-ray quality single crystals, which may not be always possible. Moreover, solid-state packing effects may also play a role in influencing the gold…gold distances. In this project, we will make use of spectroscopic methods, instead of X-ray structure determination alone, to study gold…gold interactions and the extent of their interactions through electronic absorption and emission spectroscopy. In particular, we will focus on the design and synthesis of discrete soluble polynuclear d10 metal clusters through the rational design and synthesis of bridging phosphine ligands with different bite angles/distances, steric bulk, electronic properties and solvation motifs as well as the nature of the bridging heteroatoms to study the factors that control the structural integrity of the metal clusters and their noncovalent metal…metal interactions. Their luminescence properties and their excited state origin will also be investigated. We envision that systematic in-depth comparison studies of these analogues of luminescent polynuclear gold(I) clusters can be made to advance our understanding of the nature and role of metal…metal interactions in these d10 gold(I) clusters, and their influence on the excited state origin and properties. Extension of the work will be made to advance our understanding of the lighter copper(I) and silver(I) congeners. Attempts will also be made to explore the impact of solvation to control the modulation of their solvation properties to manipulate the formation of the clusters and their assemblies, which would in turn affect their optical, luminescence and morphological behavior. Attempts will further be made to explore the possible formation of supramolecular assemblies, cluster assemblies, frameworks and homo- and heterometallic metal-ligand assemblies not only via solvation modulation, but also via introduction of coordination motifs, ligating groups, linkers, reaction-based moieties, and various noncovalent interactions. Their role and impact in modulating the spectroscopic and luminescence properties as well the nanostructured morphologies of the d10 metal clusters and the structure-property relationships will also be elucidated. 隨著人們對與氫鍵鍵能相約的非共價親金相互作用的興趣日益濃厚，主要依賴d10閉殼金(I)配合物的固態晶體結構來確認其親金性的研究日漸增加。但這需要X射線質量的單晶，並不總是可行。此外，固態堆積也可以影響金⋯金距離。在本項目中，我們除了使用X射線結構測定外，也將利用電子吸收和發射光譜，來研究金⋯金相互作用及其程度。我們透過合理設計和合成具有不同咬合角/距離、空間位阻、電子特性和溶劑化基團的橋聯膦配體，以及橋聯雜原子的性質，聚焦可溶性的離散型多核d10金屬簇的設計和合成，重點研究調控金屬團簇結構完整性及其非共價金屬⋯金屬相互作用的因素，並研究它們的發光性質及其激發態起源。我們預見對這些發光多核金(I)簇系列的深入系統性研究，可加深我們對其金屬⋯金屬相互作用性質和特性的理解，以及其對激發態起源和性質的影響。本研究將進一步拓展至銅(I)和銀(I)同類物。我們也將嘗試透過調節溶劑化作用，從而調控團簇及其組裝體的形成，進而影響其光學、發光和形貌行為。此外，我們還將進一步透過溶劑化調節和引入配位基團、配位基、連接基團、反應型基團以及各種非共價相互作用，探索超分子組裝體、團簇組裝體、框架及同金屬−配體和異金屬−配體組裝體的形成，並闡明它們在調節光譜和發光特性以及d10金屬簇的納米結構和結構−性質關係中的作用和影響。

17312325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17312325.value: 利用金屬蛋白質體學探索釩/鉻作為抗衰老劑及其分子作用機制

17312325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17312325.value: Metallodrugs play critical roles in the disease diagnostics and therapeutics. However, development of metallodrugs is of significant challenge owing to their multi-target modes of action. Thus, a system approach such as metalloproteomics, enabling the identification of metal associated proteins at a system level, is highly desirable to unveil their molecular mechanism. Aging has been recognized as the greatest risk factor for fatal chronic diseases, which poses a tremendous burden on public health, social services, and welfare systems. Up to now, there appears no effective anti-aging drugs clinically available. In addition to dietary regiments, low-molecular weight compounds such as metformin, the most widely-used oral hypoglycemic medication for type-2 diabetes, could retard aging in preclinical models and in humans, and reduce the incidence of aging-related diseases in humans. Vanadium(IV) compounds are known for their insulin-mimetic and cardioprotective roles in diabetes, chromium(III) compounds have also been demonstrated to exhibit beneficial effects to improve diabetes mellitus, however, their potentials as anti-aging agents are less-explored. Considering both vanadium(IV) and chromium(III) also show anti-diabetic capability, we have initially examined the efficacy of four chromium(III)/vanadium(IV)-based anti-diabetic compounds on postponing accelerated senescence in the mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) with Lamin AG609G/G609G mutant from mice of Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome (HGPS). We found nearly all compounds tested could reduce the senescence of cells, in particular, a vanadyl compound VO-OHpic being the most effective one and also showed excellent anti-aging activity in a premature mouse model of HGPS. Based on our exciting initial data and our combined expertise, we will synthesize more chromium(III) and vanadium(IV)-based compounds and examine their potentials as anti-aging agents in Lamin AG609G/G609G MEFs both in cells and in Lamin AG609G/G609G mice. We will also investigate molecular mechanism of action of the lead compound at a system level by our established fluorescence-based metalloproteomics approach together with different biochemical, biophysical or molecular biology approaches. The proposed project will serve as a fundamental basis for further exploration of anti-aging efficacies of vanadium(IV) and chromium(III) anti-diabetic agents. The findings from the proposed project will enhance our understanding on the molecular mechanism of action of vanadium(IV) and chromium(III) towards delay of accelerated aging, further expanding the pharmacological application of these anti-diabetic agents. The generated knowledge from this project will provide fundamental basis for rational design of of better anti-aging drugs. Through this project, we will also educate junior scientist in frontier research and stimulate pharmaceutical company to invest in this field. 金屬藥物在疾病診斷和治療中發揮著至關重要的作用。然而，由於其多標靶作用模式，開發金屬藥物面臨巨大的挑戰。因此，像金屬蛋白質體學這樣的系統方法能夠在系統層面上辨識金屬相關蛋白質，對於揭示其分子機制具有重要意義。 衰老已被公認為是致命慢性疾病的最大風險因素，為公共衛生、社會服務和福利體系帶來了巨大的負擔。迄今為止，臨床上尚無有效的抗衰老藥物。除了飲食療法外，小分子化合物，例如二甲雙胍（二甲雙胍是目前最廣泛使用的第2型糖尿病口服降血糖藥），可以在臨床前模型和人類中延緩衰老，並降低人類衰老相關疾病的發生率。釩(IV)化合物以其在糖尿病中的胰島素模擬和心臟保護作用而聞名，鉻(III)化合物也被證明具有改善糖尿病的有益作用，然而，它們作為抗衰老藥物的潛力尚不清楚。 鑑於釩(IV)和鉻(III)均具有抗糖尿病功效，我們初步研究了四種基於鉻(III)/釩(IV)的抗糖尿病化合物對延緩小鼠胚胎成纖維細胞(MEF)加速衰老的功效，該細胞來自患有哈欽森-吉爾福德早衰綜合徵(HGPS)的小鼠，其Lamin AG609G/G609G突變體。我們發現幾乎所有測試的化合物都能延緩細胞衰老，其中釩基化合物VO-OHpic最為有效，並且在早產小鼠HGPS模型中也表現出優異的抗衰老活性。基於我們令人興奮的初步數據和雙方的專業知識，我們將合成更多基於鉻(III)和釩(IV)的化合物，並研究它們在Lamin AG609G/G609G MEF細胞和Lamin AG609G/G609G小鼠中作為抗衰老藥物的潛力。我們也將利用基於螢光的金屬蛋白質體學方法，結合不同的生化、生物物理或分子生物學方法，在系統層面上研究先導化合物的分子作用機制。本計畫將為進一步探索釩(IV)和鉻(III)抗糖尿病藥物的抗衰老功效奠定基礎。 本計畫的研究成果將加深我們對釩(IV)和鉻(III)延緩老化的分子機制的理解，進一步拓展這些抗糖尿病藥物的藥理應用。本計畫所獲得的知識將為合理設計更有效率的抗衰老藥物提供基礎。透過該項目，我們還將培養青年科學家進行前沿研究，並激勵製藥公司在該領域進行投資

17312425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17312425.value: 鉍配合物提高多種抗生素對綠膿桿菌的抗菌活性

17312425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17312425.value: Bismuth(III) compounds has been used in medicine for decades for the treatment of various diseases. Bi(III) is almost harmless among the heavy metals in the periodic table. Several bismuth-based drugs, e.g. bismuth subsalicylate (Pepto-Bismol®), colloidal bismuth subcitate (De-Nol®), and bismuth-containing single capsule are available drugs for the treatment of bacterial infection (e.g. H. pylori) worldwide. We hypothesized that bismuth drugs could be repositioned as antibiotic adjuvants against resistant bacteria. Antimicrobial resistance (AMR), known as the silent pandemic, appears to be one of the world’s most serious public health threats and it is anticipated to be the next pandemic. There are at least five ways to tackle AMR, including combination therapy. Previously, we have successfully demonstrated that Bi(III) drugs can undo antibiotics resistance in certain bacteria strains through inhibition of metallo-beta-lactamase and disruption of iron homeostasis. Very recently, we showed that bismuth subsalicylate and colloidal bismuth subcitate can sensitize Pesudomonas aeruginosa (P. aeruginosa), a bacterium known for its rapid development of antibiotic resistance, to several classes of antibiotics. Our finding highlights the potential of bismuth-based approach to be repurposed to fight against P. aeruginosa infections together with clinically used antibiotics. Based on our exciting initial data and extensive expertise as well as unique resources (well-characterized collection of clinical isolates and tested animal models), in this project, we aim to develop bismuth compounds to enhance antimicrobial activity of certain antibiotics against P. aeruginosa. Specifically, we will (i) design and synthesize a series of Bi(III) complexes by conjugation of bismuth with a series of thiol-containing ligands considering appropriate stability of Bi(III) with thiol-containing ligands . We will subsequently (ii) screen the synergy of these bismuth complexes in infected cells. We will further (iii) examine the efficacy of those potent metal complexes in the combination approach in vivo, i.e. lung infection in mice. Finally, we will (iv) investigate the molecular mechanism of action (MOA) of the bismuth compounds by quantitative proteomics, and home-made metalloproteomic approaches. Based on the data from MOA, we will further optimize bismuth complexes. The proposed proposal is in line with Hong Kong government’s 2022 blueprint on “Tackling the threat of antimicrobial resistance”. Through this project, we will deepen our knowledge for combating AMR and train young generation of researchers. Our long-term goal is to offer a new therapy, and boom pharmaceutical industry in Hong Kong and Greater Bay Area. 幾十年來，鉍(III)化合物一直被用於醫學治療各種疾病。在元素週期表中的重元素中，鉍(III)幾乎無害。目前，全球已有多種含鉍藥物，例如次水楊酸鉍(Pepto-Bismol®)、膠體次水楊酸鉍(De-Nol®)和含鉍單膠囊用於治療細菌感染（例如幽門螺旋桿菌感染）。我們認為鉍類藥物可以重新定位為對抗抗藥性細菌的抗生素佐劑。抗生素抗藥性(AMR)，又稱“無聲大流行”，似乎是世界上最嚴重的公共衛生威脅之一，並預計它將成為下一個大流行。至少有五種方法可以應對AMR，包括聯合療法。 我們前期工作已成功證明鉍(III)基藥物能夠透過抑制金屬β-內醯胺酶和破壞鐵穩態來消除某些細菌菌株的抗生素抗藥性。我們最近又發現次水楊酸鉍和膠體次檸檬酸鉍能夠增強銅綠假單胞菌（P. aeruginosa）對多種抗生素的敏感性，銅綠假單胞菌是一種以快速產生抗生素抗藥性而聞名的細菌。我們的研究結果凸顯了以鉍為基礎的藥物療法在與臨床常用抗生素合併使用以對抗銅綠假單胞菌感染的潛力。 基於我們令人興奮的初始數據、豐富的專業知識以及獨特的資源（完善的臨床分離菌株和已測試的動物模型），本研究計畫旨在開發鉍化合物，以提高某些抗生素對銅綠假單胞菌的抗菌活性。具體而言，我們將 (i) 設計和合成一系列鉍(III)配合物，將鉍與一系列含硫醇配體結合，並考慮鉍(III)與含硫醇配體的適宜穩定性。我們接著將 (ii) 篩選這些鉍配合物在感染細胞中的協同作用。我們將進一步 (iii) 檢測這些強效金屬配合物在體內（例如小鼠肺部感染）合併治療的療效。最後，我們將 (iv) 透過定量蛋白質組學和自主研發的金屬蛋白質組學方法來研究鉍化合物的分子作用機制 (MOA)。在此基礎上，我們將進一步優化鉍的配合物。 本研究項目與香港特區政府2022年「應對抗生素抗藥性威脅」的藍圖相符。透過這個項目，我們將加深對抗菌藥物抗藥性的認知，並培養年輕一代的研究人員。我們的長遠目標是提供新的治療方法，並促進香港及大灣區製藥業的蓬勃發展。

17500325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17500325.value: 重复委托中的信号传递

17500325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500325.value: A major segment of the modern economics literature on decision-making in organizations is about how the headquarters, called the principal, should delegate decisions when important information lies with a subordinate agent. If the agent is allowed complete control, her bias in favor of a large division, known as an "upward bias," may introduce inefficiency and negate the advantage of her superior information. In response, seminal works by Bengt Holmstrom (1977; 1984) and others (e.g., Melumad and Shibano, 1991; Alonso and Matouschek, 2008; Armstrong and Vickers, 2010; Amador and Bagwell, 2013) have observed that an organization should settle on a compromise--allow the agent a free hand but impose an upper bound on how large the decision (or operation) can be. There are varied applications--implementation of projects from which the agent can select without knowing which projects are available to the agent; trade agreement and tariff caps under political uncertainty; and price-cap regulation. This literature has focused on one-shot static delegation. We seek to expand the analysis to repeated delegation. Focusing on two types of expert, a biased type who is upward-biased and an honest type whose objective coincides with that of the principal, we want to study the incentives of an expert to signal her honesty in early-period decisions so that the principal relaxes the upper bound in the later period. The signaling game can be complex given that a biased expert will have greater incentives to signal honesty than the honest type, as the former gains more from relaxed delegation. By allowing more permissible actions the principal loses in the early period but learns about the agent's type for improved delegation later on. It would be of interest to see whether the principal is at all able to learn about the agent because both biased and honest types would compete to be perceived as an honest type. Such signaling games have a novel characteristic, known as the double-crossing property (Chen, Ishida and Suen, 2022; 2023) that is very different from the standard notion of single-crossing due to Spence (1973) and Mirrlees (1971) that has been the driver of the enormous literature on signaling games so far. How this new signaling property will translate into the structure of optimal delegation in a dynamic setting will be a key contribution of this project. 现代经济学文献中关于组织内部决策的重要一部分，讨论了当关键信息掌握在下属代理人手中时，总部（即委托人）应如何委托决策权。如果代理人被允许完全自主决策，她对扩大部门规模的偏好（称为“向上偏差”）可能引入低效率，并抵消其拥有更优信息所带来的优势。对此，Bengt Holmstrom（1977；1984）及其他学者（如Melumad和Shibano，1991；Alonso和Matouschek，2008；Armstrong和Vickers，2010；Amador和Bagwell，2013）的开创性研究指出，组织应采取一种折衷方案——允许代理人有较大的决策自由，但要对决策（或操作）规模设置上限。这一思想在多个领域都有应用——例如，在项目实施中，代理人可以从一组项目中选择，尽管她并不清楚哪些项目可供选择；在政治不确定性下的贸易协定与关税上限；以及价格上限监管等。这一文献主要关注单次静态委托情形。 我们希望将分析扩展到重复委托。我们关注两类专家：一种是存在向上偏差的偏见型专家，另一种是其目标与委托人一致的诚实型专家。我们希望研究专家在早期决策中通过信号传递其诚实性的激励，以便委托人在后期放宽对决策上限的约束。这种信号博弈可能会很复杂，因为偏见型专家比诚实型专家更有动力去表现得诚实，因为前者从委托放宽中获得的收益更大。通过在早期允许更多可行行动，委托人虽然会有损失，但可以借此了解代理人的类型，从而在后续实现更优的委托安排。一个有趣的问题是，委托人是否有可能真正了解代理人的类型，因为偏见型和诚实型专家都会努力让自己被视为诚实型。这类信号博弈具有一种新颖的特征，被称为“双交性（double-crossing property）”（Chen, Ishida和Suen，2022；2023），这与以往Spence（1973）和Mirrlees（1971）提出、并一直主导信号博弈文献的“单交性（single-crossing）”概念有很大不同。该新信号特性的引入将如何在动态环境下影响最优委托结构，是本项目的一个关键创新点。

17500525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17500525.value: 跨组织企业非法行为的组织原则

17500525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17500525.value: Prof Lumineau, Fabrice Eric Paul Prof Oliveira, Nuno

17500525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500525.value: Corporate illegality refers to unlawful actions undertaken by organizations to gain unfair advantages. Existing research has focused on law-breaking behaviours within a single organization, with significantly less attention given to the complexities arising from interactions among different organizations. Interorganizational corporate illegality is both prevalent and consequential. It encompasses actions such as price fixing, bid rigging, and collusion, each of which can lead to substantial socioeconomic costs, as illustrated by recent cases in Hong Kong’s real estate and air conditioning industries. A critical issue for scholars relates to understanding the organizing principles of corporate illegality across organizational boundaries. Such illegality presents unique coordination challenges. First, the coordination of illegal activities between organizations is aimed at profit maximization, but the potential gains come with an increased risk of sanctions. Second, participants are driven by a desire for gains while also having incentives to defect, as regulators encourage firms to report illegal practices. Lastly, although covert coordination is crucial, creating formal structures can increase the likelihood of severe punishment. Interorganizational corporate illegality challenges both the central assumptions about and theoretical mechanisms of interorganizational governance. The aim of the proposed study is to illuminate the organizational underpinnings of interorganizational corporate illegality. To address this issue, we will draw on theories of interorganizational governance and hand-gather a novel, comprehensive dataset of European Commission investigations into the functioning of cartels (1952-2023). Cartels are a typical form of interorganizational corporate illegality. This research will investigate how cartel hierarchy influences the trade-off between cartel success and punishment, while examining the secretive governance mechanisms that enhance cartel effectiveness. By analysing how governance structures and secrecy practices impact longevity and profitability, this work aims to provide long-overdue insights into the organizing principles of interorganizational corporate illegality, which have often been overlooked in the literature. Ultimately, it seeks to illuminate the “dark side” of interorganizational relationships and develop a framework for understanding the organizational principles of corporate illegality. 企業違法行為是指組織為獲取不正當優勢而採取的非法行動。現有研究主要集中於單一組織內部的違法行為，而對不同組織之間互動所產生的複雜性關注較少。跨組織的企業違法行為既普遍又具有深遠影響，包括價格操縱、串標和合謀等行為，這些行為可能導致巨大的社會經濟成本，正如香港房地產和空調行業的近期案例所示。學者面臨的一個關鍵問題是理解跨越組織邊界的企業違法行為的組織原則。這類違法行為面臨獨特的協調挑戰。首先，組織之間的非法活動協調以利潤最大化為目標，但潛在收益伴隨著更高的制裁風險。其次，參與者一方面渴望獲利，另一方面由於監管機構鼓勵企業舉報非法行為，他們也有動機背叛。最後，雖然隱秘的協調至關重要，但建立正式結構可能會增加遭受嚴厲懲罰的可能性。跨組織的企業違法行為挑戰了關於跨組織治理的核心假設和理論機制。擬議研究的目標是揭示跨組織企業違法行為的組織基礎。為解決這一問題，我們將借鑒跨組織治理理論，並人工收集一套創新且全面的數據集，該數據集涵蓋了歐洲委員會對卡特爾運作的調查（1952-2023）。卡特爾是跨組織企業違法行為的一種典型形式。本研究將探討卡特爾的層級結構如何影響卡特爾成功與懲罰之間的權衡，同時分析提高卡特爾有效性的隱秘治理機制。通過分析治理結構和隱秘性實踐如何影響卡特爾的存續時間和盈利能力，本研究旨在為跨組織企業違法行為的組織原則提供長期被忽視的洞見。最終，本研究希望揭示跨組織關系的“黑暗面”，並建立一個理解企業違法行為組織原則的框架。

17500625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17500625.value: 實踐環保能否帶來回報？來自亞馬遜「氣候友善承諾」計畫的證據

17500625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500625.value: Can firms do well by doing environmental good? We undertake a fundamental test of societal valuation of corporate environmental initiatives, in the context of Amazon’s Climate Pledge Friendly (CPF) program. Launched in September 2020, the program highlights sustainable products by adding the CPF badge, at no cost, to qualified products. However, products must be certified by at least one of the sustainability certifications on Amazon’s certification page, with the certification cost ranging from a few thousand to several hundred thousand US dollars. In collaboration with a top consumer electronics vendor on Amazon, our proposal has three main objectives: (1) to investigate the causal effect of the environmental aspect of ESG on consumer demand (web visits, orders, and conversion rate), (2) to explore the underlying mechanisms from both the supply and demand side, and (3) to quantify the impact on firm profit and consumer welfare. Of the company’s 1,880 products, 498 products spanning 12 distinct categories have participated in the CPF program. We have obtained data both before and after a product’s CPF enrollment, alongside data for non-participating products. Since the enrollment is the company’s decision, we employ a synthetic difference-in-differences approach to correct for selection bias and achieve causal identification. We apply text mining techniques to product descriptions and consumer reviews as well as conduct consumer surveys to uncover the underlying mechanisms, with a particular focus on consumer awareness and perception of CPF, and the congruence between customer perceptions and corporate claims. We further quantify the profit and welfare implications of participating in Amazon’s CPF program through structural modelling and counterfactual experiments to answer the question of whether it pays off for firms to be environmentally friendly and how firms can do well by doing good. This approach compares firm profit and consumer welfare in the counterfactual scenario if the company had not participated in the CPF with the actual scenario. Our preliminary results indicate that, on average, participating in the CPF does not significantly affect sales. However, there is substantial heterogeneity across products. CPF participation significantly improves the sales performance of products in categories such as charger, connectivity, and wearables, but adversely affects sales in battery and power storage categories. These heterogeneous effects result from differences in consumer awareness of and disbelief in CPF, as well as the perceptual incongruence between the product and the CPF concept.

17501125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501125.value: 能力碎片化与热情提升：网红经济背景下“斜杠青年”的社会影响机制研究

17501125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17501125.value: Prof Chan, Kimmy Wa Prof McGill, Ann L.

17501125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501125.value: The trend of “Slashies”—individuals who broaden their careers by engaging in multiple fields—is gaining significant traction across various professional sectors. Platforms like Instagram and TikTok have become popular venues for showcasing these diverse career paths (e.g., “fashion/cooking”). However, existing research has largely ignored critical insights regarding whether brands should select influencers with expanded careers (e.g., “a fashion buyer/pastry chef”) or those with more focused careers (e.g., “a fashion buyer”) to effectively promote their products. This proposed research aims to shed light on the strategic selection of influencers to enhance key social media marketing outcomes, including engagement metrics like likes and shares, website traffic from social media referrals, and the selection of sponsored products.
