The research findings also help address important priorities related to migrant population targets in the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and data-specific aims in the Global Compact of Migration (GCM). 亚太地区拥有全球超过五分之三的人口，是国际迁移最活跃的区域之一。然而，该地区的国际移民监测仍较为薄弱，相关学术研究也相对匮乏。这种状况很大程度上源于人口普查、人口登记和抽样调查等传统移民数据来源的局限性。因信息发布滞后、各国收集流程差异以及跨国标准缺失，此类来源的数据往往时效性不足且内容不完整。基于此，本项目将传统数据源与新兴大数据（尤其是社交媒体平台数据）相结合，构建综合性数据整合方法，以预测亚太地区的移民人口规模。 利用Facebook广告API等平台提供的用户画像和迁移轨迹数据，本项目将整合实时社交媒体数据和传统移民统计，建立模型以及时估计亚太国家间双边移民存量规模，从而揭示新兴迁移趋势。方法上，本项目借鉴并调整了曾在欧盟背景下应用的贝叶斯层级建模框架，以应对亚太地区迁移数据的漏报、不完整和各国移民人口定义差异等问题。 引入社交媒体数据可有效弥补官方统计的缺口，即便在数据缺失或滞后的国家与走廊中也能生成预测性估计。该模型将支持对移民人口规模的持续监测与即时预测，为政策制定者应对迁移格局变化提供决策依据。这在迁移与劳动力市场、环境变化导致的人口流离失所以及地缘政治格局紧密相关的亚太地区尤为重要。此外，本项目的研究成果将推进联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）中与迁移相关的重要议程，并有助于实现移民问题全球契约（GCM）中以可靠数据支撑循证政策的具体目标。

17617525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17617525.value: 面向亚洲季风区水稻精确制图的多模态遥感时序基础模型研究

17617525.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17617525.value: Dr Chen, Yongzhe Dr Li, Wenyuan

17617525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17617525.value: The United Nations aims to end hunger and ensure global food security by 2030. Asia, home to one-third of the world's hungry and poor, demands special attention. Accounting for approximately 90% of global rice production and consumption, the region faces a significant challenge due to the lack of reliable agricultural statistics. Accurate rice mapping in Asia is essential for assessing regional food security and agricultural output. Satellite remote sensing provides the most robust means for large-scale paddy rice mapping. Despite significant efforts and the development of various rice maps, there is currently no high-resolution (30 m or finer) time series rice map covering all of Asia. Such maps are highly desirable due to the small field sizes prevalent in the region. The inability to produce high-resolution rice maps for Asia can be attributed to: 1) the coarser temporal resolution and frequent cloud contamination in high-spatial-resolution satellite optical data; 2) the limited temporal coverage and high noise levels of publicly available active microwave satellite data. Integrating multiple satellite data sources offers the best solution to these challenges, and can be effectively realized through the emerging AI foundation models. The proposed study aims to develop a multi-modal temporal remote sensing AI foundation model for accurate rice mapping in Asia during 2018–2025 at 10 m resolution. Specifically, we will: 1) develop a foundation model that integrates active microwave satellite data, optical images with various spatiotemporal resolutions, and high-level satellite products; 2) map rice cropping intensity (single, double, or triple cropping) across Asia at 10 m resolution during 2018–2025; 3) collect comprehensive ground reference data, validate our Asian rice map, and compare it with other AI foundation models and existing rice maps. Our extensive experience and the resources available at the Jockey Club STEM Lab, including adequate computing capability and massive satellite data, will ensure the success of this project. Compared to published remote sensing foundation models, our model will offer several unique features, including: (1) support of longer time-series data; 2) embedding of geographical knowledge; 3) more comprehensive support of multi-modal data. Our research will produce the first multi-year 10 m resolution rice maps for Asia, surpassing previous coarse resolution or regional maps. The results, which will be publicly available at our data sharing website (www.glass.hku.hk), will enhance national/regional statistics, facilitate water conservation and climate change mitigation, and contribute to Hong Kong's leadership in AI and satellite remote sensing. 联合国致力于在2030年前消除全球饥饿、保障粮食安全并推动农业可持续发展。亚洲作为全球饥饿与贫困人口最集中的地区（占总数三分之一），是实现这一目标的关键区域，需要得到特别的关注和研究。在亚洲季风区，水稻是主要口粮作物，全球约90%的水稻产消活动都集中于此。鉴于发展中国家统计数据可能存在偏差，开展时空连续的水稻种植面积监测和大范围制图，对准确评估该地区粮食安全状况和农业产出具有重要意义。此外，精准的水稻种植面积数据也是核算灌溉用水量、评估温室气体排放的关键依据，从而为水资源管理和气候变化应对提供支撑。 遥感技术已成为稻田制图的重要技术手段，其原理在于卫星影像能够捕捉水稻移栽期特有的农事特征——此时田间水体裸露而植被覆盖有限。然而要实现高分辨率（小于等于30米）的稻田测绘在季风亚洲地区仍面临挑战：该地区田块规模普遍细小，但光学遥感影像常受云层干扰，而卫星主动微波（如合成孔径雷达SAR）数据又存在显著噪声。 提升水稻测绘精度需综合利用多源传感器提供的不同分辨率卫星数据。要充分发挥这些异构数据的价值，必须依托先进的遥感多模态深度学习基础模型——这类模型能够有效融合并精准解译多源卫星数据，尤其在复杂环境条件下展现突出优势。但此类基础模型的开发面临三重挑战：数据固有的复杂多样性、卫星数据质量与获取能力的差异性，都需要高效的算法架构和强大计算资源作为支撑。 本研究旨在实现三个核心目标：其一，开发能够融合主动微波与多时空分辨率光学遥感数据的多模态时序遥感基础模型；其二，应用该模型生成30米分辨率的季风亚洲水稻分布与种植强度图谱；其三，系统收集地面验证数据， 比较评估现有基础模型与本项目多模态模型所生成水稻分布图的精度优劣。

17617625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17617625.value: 美國革命時期的奴隸貿易

17617625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17617625.value: This grant investigates the economics of the American Revolutionary ban on the slave trade, enacted by the revolutionaries' Continental Congress in 1774. The grant examines 1) the role of British trading networks in facilitating ways around it the ban, 2) the role of debt in building merchant support for the ban and, 3) the role of privateering as a way to continue the trade. Most Anglophone slave traders were not based in North America. In the period under study, most Anglophone slaving voyages began in Liverpool or London. North American-based slave traders thus relied on British trading networks in West Africa and the Caribbean to buy and sell enslaved persons. The first part of this project will investigate how some North American-based slavers were able to continue slaving through these networks during the early part of the Revolution. This study also hypothesizes that debt and other relationships between slave traders and slaveowners meant that a temporary ban on the slave could benefit merchants (creating a pause in sales to allow slave owners time to pay down debts), building greater support for the ban amongst slave traders in North America. Finally, this grant also investigates the role of privateering (state-sanctioned raiding of enemy shipping) as a way for merchants based in North America to engage in the slave trade by raiding British slave ships and selling their human cargoes. Thus while the American revolutionaries banned the slave trade on paper, in practice the American slave trade continued. 這項撥款旨在調查美國獨立戰爭期間的奴隸貿易禁令。國會於1774年頒布了這項禁令。撥款內容包括：1）英國貿易網絡在規避禁令方面的作用；2）債務在爭取商人支持禁令方面的作用；以及3）私掠船作為延續奴隸貿易的一種方式的作用。 大多數英語奴隸販子並非以北美為基地——當時，大多數英語奴隸貿易始於利物浦或倫敦。因此，北美奴隸販子依賴英國在西非和加勒比海地區的貿易網絡買賣奴隸。本計畫的第一部分將探討一些北美奴隸販子如何能夠透過這些網路繼續進行奴隸貿易。 本研究也假設，奴隸販子與奴隸主之間的債務及其他關係意味著，暫時禁止奴隸貿易可能使商人受益（暫停奴隸銷售，讓奴隸主有時間償還債務），從而在北美奴隸販子中爭取到更大的支持。 最後，本資助也調查了私掠船（國家批准的襲擊敵方船隻）在北美商人透過襲擊英國奴隸船並販賣人口進行奴隸貿易中所扮演的角色。 因此，儘管美國革命者表面上禁止了奴隸貿易，但實際上奴隸貿易仍在繼續。

17618125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17618125.value: 重新評估站點的鄰近性效應：軌道運能容量受限中的站點可達性對軌道交通出行的影響

17618125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618125.value: As cities strive to reduce carbon emissions from transport, particularly passenger road transport, rail systems have become a cornerstone of sustainable urban mobility. Rail travel, which produces the lowest emissions per passenger-kilometer, has been widely adopted in large Chinese cities, where high-speed and urban rail networks have supported transit-oriented development (TOD). Increasing rail accessibility is seen as a key strategy for encouraging residents to shift from road to rail transport. However, in some areas near rail stations, a surprising rise in automobile travel has been observed. This phenomenon can be broadly explained by two main hypotheses: (1) the Modal Competition Hypothesis, which suggests that on-demand travel modes (such as ride-hailing) directly compete with rail, particularly when public transit is less effective, such as during off-peak hours or in areas with limited rail service; and (2) the Induced Demand Hypothesis, which posits that socioeconomic factors, such as high car ownership among affluent residents or changes in land use, generate additional road travel that would not have otherwise occurred. These hypotheses suggest that either existing rail travel demand is diverted to more convenient travel modes or that newly induced demand is inadequately served by rail transport. However, they fail to fully account for why, in areas where rail transit should be most accessible, rail usage does not meet expectations. This research introduces the rail capacity factor—the ability of the system to accommodate growing ridership—as a critical but overlooked variable. When rail capacity is insufficient to meet demand, increasing accessibility alone may inadvertently lead to more road travel, as residents turn to alternative modes of transport. This study seeks to investigate whether, why, and how rail accessibility influences travel behavior when system capacity is constrained. Using mobile phone trajectory data from Shenzhen in the Greater Bay Area, the research will map the spatial-temporal distribution of both rail and road trips. The findings will offer new insights into how TOD strategies can be optimized by aligning rail capacity with accessibility, ultimately promoting a more effective shift toward low-carbon urban mobility by having an optimal balance development of population around rail station that can maximize the rail-capacity and, at the same time, avoid over the rail-capacity that generates more undesirable vehicular traffic. 隨著各大城市努力减少交通運輸（尤其是公路客運）的碳排放，軌道交通系統已成爲可持續城市交通的重要方法。鐵路交通是每乘客公里排放量最低的交通方式，已在中國各大城市得到廣泛應用，這些城市的高鐵和城軌網絡支持了公共交通導向型發展（TOD）。提高軌道交通的可達性被視爲鼓勵居民從公路交通轉向軌道交通的關鍵策略。 然而，在一些火車站附近的地區，汽車出行量却出現了出人意外的增長。這一現象大致可以用兩個主要假設來解釋：(1) 出行方式競爭的假設，該假設認爲按需出行方式（例如網約車）與鐵路直接競爭，尤其是在公共交通效率較低的情况下，例如在非高峰時段或鐵路服務有限的地區；(2) 誘導需求的假設，該的假設認爲，社會經濟因素，例如富裕居民的高汽車擁有率或土地用途的變化，會額外産生原本不會出現的道路出行。 儘管這兩種假設解釋了軌道需求被替代或新增需求未被軌道滿足的情况，却未能充分闡明在軌道可達性最優區域，軌道出行量爲何仍低於預期。因此本研究提出一個常被忽視的關鍵變量——“軌道運能因素”，即軌道系統承載增長客流的能力。當軌道運能飽和時，單純提升可達性反而可能因軌道運能力不足倒逼乘客轉向道路替代方式，導致汽車出行的增加。 因此，本研究旨在探討在軌道運能限條件下，軌道可達性如何、爲何以及在何種程度上影響居民出行行爲。研究將利用粵港澳大灣區深圳的手機軌迹數據，繪製軌道交通和道路交通出行在時空維度上的分布特徵與互動關係。研究結果將為優化TOD策略提供新視角，强調可達性提升必須與軌道運能容量協同並進，才能有效地促進城市交通向低碳模式的轉型。

17618725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17618725.value: 香港多元族裔青年的自我關懷、族裔身份有關經歷與豐盛生活的動態關係：一項混合方法研究

17618725.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17618725.value: Dr Bin Zainal Abidin, Muhammad Hafiz Prof Lo, Herman Hay Ming Dr Tang, Jessica Pui Shan Prof Yeung, Nelson, Chun Yiu
rows: Dr Bin Zainal Abidin, Muhammad Hafiz

17618725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618725.value: Background: Over the past decade, economic shifts in industrialized societies have created significant challenges for many young people. In Hong Kong, over 35,000 ethnic minority (EM) youth residents of South/Southeast Asian descent face not only the same challenges as their non-EM counterparts but also unique daily stressors, such as microaggressions, which significantly impact their mental health. Despite these adversities, research indicates that some EM youths flourish amid minority stress, although the mechanisms behind this process remain underexamined. By integrating microaggression and social mentality theories, self-compassion can provide insights into this process as evidence shows that this internal resource naturally varies within individuals over short periods, indicating an active dynamic adaptation to daily stressors (Neff et al., 2020). This study seeks to unpack how dynamic fluctuations in self-compassion contribute to EM youths’ sense of flourishing as they navigate daily ethnocultural identity-salient experiences (eISEs) in Hong Kong. Objectives: Adopting a dynamic process-oriented paradigm, this study aims to: (a) empower EM youths by providing tools for them to document their everyday eISEs and identify facilitators and barriers to self-compassion and flourishing; (b) elucidate the daily dynamics between eISEs, self-compassion, and flourishing both concurrently and prospectively; and (c) examine person-level factors that explain differences in the rates of encountering daily positive or negative eISEs and in the degree of stress response to daily negative eISEs. Methods: This study employs a two-phase sequential mixed-methods approach to address its objectives. The first phase utilizes an intensive longitudinal research design, comprising a Daily Diary study conducted over 21 consecutive days with 180 youths aged 16-29 of South/Southeast Asian descent, using validated quantitative measures. Multilevel structural equation modeling will be employed to examine the proposed conceptual model. The second phase adopts a participatory action research method, Photovoice, to engage ten participants purposively sampled from the previous phase. These young people will act as co-researchers, participating in data generation, analysis, and dissemination. Implications: This will be the first mixed-methods study prioritizing daily dynamic processes when examining the lived experiences and mental health of EM young people in Hong Kong. Findings will advance youth mental health research and compassion science by elucidating the daily dynamics between self-compassion, eISEs, and flourishing. Practically, the evidence generated can promote mental health awareness within the EM community and foster greater awareness of diversity, equity, and inclusivity in the broader society. 研究背景：在過去十年，香港的經濟迅速轉型，讓許多年輕人面臨重大挑戰。目前，香港有超過三萬五千名來自南亞或東南亞族裔的青年。他們不僅要與其他非多元族裔青年面對相同的困難，還需承受與族裔身份相關的壓力，例如微歧視(microaggression)，這些弱勢壓力對他們的精神健康造成了負面影響。儘管如此，過去的研究發現部分青年在面對這些壓力的同時，也活得豐盛(flourishing)。這項研究將運用「微歧視」(microaggression)和「社會心態」理論(social mentality theory)，探究自我關懷－一種內在心理資源－在多元族裔青年面對不同弱勢壓力中扮演的角色及機制。研究顯示，自我關懷並非一種固定的特質，而是能夠在短時間內改變，這反映了人會根據不同的壓力即時進行心理調節。因此，這項研究旨在探討多元族裔青年在日常生活中面對與族裔身份有關的經驗時，自我關懷如何隨之變化，並進一步了解這些變化如何影響每天的豐盛生活。 研究目標：我們將採用以動態歷程取向的研究架構(dynamic process-oriented paradigm)，主要包含以下三項目標： 1. 提供簡單的工具，讓多元族裔青年記錄與族裔身份有關經驗，從而辨識促進或阻礙自我關懷及豐盛生活的因素；2. 闡明族裔身份有關經驗、自我關懷及豐盛生活三者之間的並行(concurrent)及前瞻性(prospective)的動態關係；3. 探討個人層面的因素如何影響多元族裔青年經歷與族裔身份相關事件的頻率，以及面對負面經歷時其壓力反應程度的差異。 研究方法：我們將採用兩個階段且循序實施的混合方法(Two-phase sequential mixed-methods approach)以達成研究目標。第一階段會採用高密度縱向研究設計(intensive longitudinal research design)，進行為期21天的日記調查(daily diary study)，邀請180名年齡介乎16至29歲、來自南亞或東南亞族裔的青年參與。研究將使用具信效度的量表來測量自我關懷和豐盛生活，並以多層次結構方程模型 (multilevel structural equation modeling) 對我們所提出的概念進行統計分析。第二階段則採用參與式行動研究方法(participatory action research method)－影像聲音法(Photovoice)。我們將邀請10名參加者參與此階段的研究，他們會以共同研究者(co-researcher)的身份參與數據收集、分析及發佈研究成果的過程。 研究效益：這項研究將會是首個運用混合方法來探討香港多元族裔青年的親歷經驗與精神健康之間的動態關係研究。透過闡明與族裔身份有關經歷、自我關懷和豐盛生活三者之間的動態關係，研究成果將有助豐富現有對青年精神健康及自我關懷的討論和發展。在實務層面方面，這項研究將提升多元族裔社群對精神健康的關注，以及促進大眾對多元、平等及共融的理解與重視。

17619125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619125.value: his project aims to produce the first book-length study of the English Chronicle History Play in the Long Eighteenth Century. Emerging from Renaissance London's lively commercial theaters, dramatisations of British History staged England's historical wars and dynastic conflicts for popular consumption by combining medieval civic pageantry with the more recent prose histories of chroniclers like Ralph Holinshed and Edward Hall from the middle to later 1500s. The English History Play acquired recognition as an identifiable dramatic genre in the monumental 1623 First Folio, where Shakespeare’s plays focusing on English monarchs were labelled under ‘Histories’, with his Henriad cycle hailed as this emerging genre’s crowning achievement. Outside of Shakespeare's theater, the English History Play has migrated to other forms of modern media. Dramatic reworkings of Chronicle History like Maxwell Anderson's "Elizabeth the Queen" (1930) and "Anne of the Thousand Days" (1948) have become Broadway and cinema classics. Philippa Gregory's novelistic reimagining of the Wars of the Roses are popular in the genre fiction market, and Tudor England remains a prominent theme in popular culture through TV dramas like Gemma Burgess's "My Lady Jane" and the Tony Award-winning musical "Six" by Toby Marlow and Lucy Moss. Despite its historical significance, the development of the English History Play beyond the Renaissance period remains neglected in scholarly inquiry. This project aims to address this gap by investigating how the English History Play was revitalised for audiences during the Long Eighteenth Century, a transformative period marked by the ascent of constitutional monarchy in 1688 and the tumultuous aftermath of the French Revolution in the late 1780s. Focusing on the revival of the Chronicle History Play in the later Stuart era of the 1680s, this study will explore the evolution and adaptation of the genre throughout the Eighteenth Century. The project aims to analyse how theatres navigated shifting conceptions of monarchy, emerging forms of British nationalism following the union with Scotland and the defeat of Irish Jacobites, and evolving collective identities shaped by colonial and imperial aspirations. By tracing the evolution of the history play throughout the Eighteenth Century, this research endeavors to illuminate how historical fiction continues to influence our understanding of the past in the contemporary Anglo-Atlantic world. 17619225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619225.value: 中国城市化之文化与创新趋态：真实推动还是应对策略？

17619225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619225.value: Contrary to the popular perception of an urbanizing China as the world’s workshop specializing in manufacturing while advanced economies in the West take the lead in cultural and creative industries (CCIs), many Chinese cities have in recent years enthusiastically embraced CCI promotion as a new local development agenda. The "cultural turn" in China’s urbanization is manifesting itself through the establishment of thousands of CCI zones throughout the country. Internationally, the "culture/creativity syndrome” is heatedly debated between advocates who preach it as an imperative for a competitive urban fortune and critics who see it as a viral form of fast-policy contagion bringing nothing more than signs and symbols of framing and branding. Within China, the existing literature on culture-led urban (re)development (CUR) is based primarily on some tangible and visible aspects, with little attention paid to other hidden, rhetorical, symbolic, and yet strategic, elements. Theorization of China’s land politics has tended to treat the land-centered urbanization process and the emergence of CUR as two separate phenomena. Controversy and gaps are apparent in the extant literature warranting a novel approach and further investigation. The proposed project will work at the interface of three influential corpora of literature and investigate the pattern and process of China’s new wave of urbanization featuring CUR. Our objectives are to 1) identify the characteristics, growth pattern, and spatial variation of CUR as a state project; 2) investigate its social and political origins, including contextual changes in the political economy, the key stakeholders involved, and their respective motives and strategies; and 3) critically evaluate its impacts on the transformation of the local economy, society, and space. Our research will include cross-sectional analyses of statistical data at the national level and focused/longitudinal studies of cases from three city-regions—Beijing, Wuhan, and Guangzhou—where CUR is practiced within different geo-political and socio-economic environments. The project will include multivariate analyses of statistical data on cities at or above the prefectural level and collection of qualitative data through field surveys and interviews. Building on our extensive field experience and well-established local networks, the project promises to contribute novel and impactful knowledge to advance theoretical understanding of the changing dynamics and governance of China’s urbanization and facilitate better policymaking for the growth of cultural and creative economies in Chinese cities, in which Hong Kong holds significant and growing strategic interests. 本研究探讨中国城市化近年来以文化与创新产业为导向的城市更新的特征、过程和地理分布；调查其社会与政治根源；并评估其经济、社会与空间效应。研究采用对全国地级市单元系统的统计数据定量分析与对北京、武汉和广州地方的人文、经济、社会与地理条件的田野调研资料相结合的方法。建基于多年积累的经验和成熟的当地研究网络，本研究成果将为国际城市研究的理论进展和中国城市化的规划与管理提供真知灼见，并为促进香港与内地学术及社会经济交流提供重要信息。

17619325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619325.value: 实时课堂话语分析赋能教师：对课堂对话与学生学习的影响

17619325.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17619325.value: Prof Jacobs, Jennifer Prof Jong, Morris Siu-yung Prof LEUNG, Frederick Koon-Shing Prof Michaels, Sarah

17619325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619325.value: Advances in technology are reshaping the educational landscape worldwide, leading to a transformation within classrooms. Traditional methods of knowledge transmission are giving way to environments that provide social and emotional support for learning, where teachers employ productive talk to co-construct knowledge with students, fostering deep thinking and inquiry. However, this shift from teacher-dominated classrooms to more student-centric environments presents notable challenges for many teachers, particularly in fostering productive classroom talk. To address these challenges, our team has engaged in technology-supported teacher professional development (PD). Our model integrates PD with teaching practices, utilizing an analytics and visualization tool known as the Classroom Discourse Analyzer (CDA) to facilitate teachers’ reflection on classroom talk during post-class PD activities. Despite the benefits of the PD model, a persistent gap exists between teacher learning in post-class PD sessions and its practical application in the classroom. The dynamic and ever-changing nature of classroom interactions makes it difficult for teachers to apply what they learned from PD activities to their actual classroom teaching. To bridge this gap, we aim to develop a Real-Time Classroom Discourse Analyzer (RT-CDA) empowered by AI. Recent advances in AI have significantly improved the efficacy of automatic speech recognition, enabling more sophisticated discourse analytics and timely feedback. The RT-CDA will provide real-time feedback on classroom discourse, acting as a supportive companion for teachers to enable in-the-moment reflection and dialogic teaching in class. We will assess the utility of the RT-CDA through an experimental study involving 60 secondary-school mathematics teachers and approximately 1,500 of their students in Hong Kong. In the first semester, teachers will be randomly assigned to one of three groups: a business-as-usual group (conventional teaching without intervention), a comparison group (using CDA in post-class PD), and a treatment group (using RT-CDA in classroom teaching and CDA in post-class PD). In the second semester, all teachers will receive support in using RT-CDA for classroom teaching and CDA for post-class PD. The primary activities of this project include the development of RT-CDA and the real-time feedback approach, a pilot study, and a semester-long intervention with a pre- and post-test design to investigate the effects on classroom talk and students’ achievement in mathematics. This project holds considerable promise for innovating technology-supported teacher PD. The RT-CDA, as a real-time discourse analytics tool, has the potential to enhance PD efficacy, improve teachers’ reflection-in-action and dialogic teaching, and ultimately increase student learning outcomes. 技术进步正在重塑全球教育图景，课堂教学形态也随之发生转变：传统的知识传递模式正让位于能提供社会情感支持的学习环境，教师通过富有成效的对话与学生共同建构知识，促进深度思考与探究。然而，从教师主导的课堂向以学生为中心的环境转变，对许多教师而言挑战巨大，尤其是在促成高质量课堂对话方面。为应对这一难题，本团队开展了技术支持的教师专业发展（PD）项目，将 PD 与日常教学实践融合，帮助教师在课后 PD 活动中反思课堂对话。然而，教师课后所学与课堂所用之间仍存在持续落差。为弥合此落差，我们拟研发由 AI 驱动的实时课堂话语分析工具（RT-CDA）。我们将开展实验研究以检验 RT-CDA 的效用。项目主要任务包括：RT-CDA 及其实时反馈策略的开发、先导研究，以及为期一个学期的干预与前后测设计，以探究其对课堂对话与学生数学学业成就的影响。本项目有望为技术支持下的教师专业发展带来创新突破。RT-CDA 作为实时话语分析工具，预期能提升 PD 效果，促进教师的“行动中反思”与对话式教学，并最终提升学生的学习成果。

17619625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619625.value: 重新思考社會支持交換在健康老齡化中的角色：以時間銀行為案例的縱向混合方法研究

17619625.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17619625.value: Prof Cheng, Reynold Chun-Kong Prof Chui, Cheryl Hiu-kwan

17619625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619625.value: Social support (SS) is a key contributor to healthy aging, highlighted by WHO’s Decade of Healthy Aging (2020-2030). However, current research has predominantly concentrated on either received or given SS, neglecting the bidirectional and reciprocal nature of SS exchanges. Three research gaps exist. First, impacts of different SS exchange patterns (e.g., under-, over-, and balanced benefiting) on healthy aging remain unclear. Three contrasting theories persist: Social Exchange Theory supports over-benefiting (receiving more support than given); Generativity Theory favors under-benefiting (giving more support than received); and Equity Theory advocates for balanced exchanges, cautioning against dependency in over-benefiting and unfairness in under-benefiting. Second, while existing literature has emphasized quantitative dimensions of SS exchange (e.g., frequencies/hours/ratios), subjective aspects like psychological meaningfulness in SS exchanges are underexplored. Lastly, understanding how diverse SS exchange patterns and psychological meaningfulness influence healthy aging through personal mastery and sense of belonging pathways is limited. Methodologically, studies often use self-reported methods to capture SS exchanges, leading to recall bias and overlooking community-based SS exchanges, which is more important given strained familial resources. A longitudinal study emphasizing community-based SS exchanges using objective data is urgently needed to provide a solid theoretical understanding of how SS exchange shapes healthy aging. This project addresses these research gaps through a longitudinal mixed-method study using timebanking (a community-based SS exchange system) as a case study in Hong Kong. Phase 1 will encompass a longitudinal study involving a random sample of 450 older adults to investigate how different SS exchange patterns impact healthy aging (e.g., health and well-being), how psychological meaningfulness interacts with SS exchange patterns to influence healthy aging, and how personal mastery and sense of belonging mediate the longitudinal impact of SS exchange patterns and psychological meaningfulness on healthy aging. Objective data on one-year community-based SS exchange will be extracted from HINCare platform, an award-winning application designed for older adults to facilitate SS exchange, and then matched with longitudinal survey data. Phase 2 will include focus group interviews with 36 older adults to uncover how psychosocial meaningfulness in SS exchanges unfolds and what facilitates meaningful exchanges for healthy aging. This project aims to develop a novel theoretical framework by testing competing theories on older adults' SS exchanges and integrating both objective and subjective aspects of SS exchange to elucidate pathways to healthy aging. The findings will offer evidence-based insights for crafting community-based engagement initiatives, contributing to global efforts for Healthy Aging. 社會支持是促進健康老齡化的關鍵因素，世界衛生組織「健康老齡化十年計劃（2020-2030）」亦特別強調其重要性。然而，綜觀現有研究，大多僅聚焦於接受或提供社會支持的單向層面，忽略了社會支持交換所具有的雙向與互惠本質。既有文獻存在三大的研究缺口。首先，不同社會支持交換模式（如「付出多於獲得」、「獲得多於付出」與「互惠平衡」）對健康老齡化的影響機制尚未釐清。對此，學界存在三種相互競爭的理論觀點：社會交換理論（Social Exchange Theory）主張「獲得多於付出」；生成理論（Generativity Theory）傾向「付出多於獲得」；而公平理論（Equity Theory）則強調「互惠平衡」，並指出「獲得多於付出」可能導致依賴性，「付出多於獲得」則可能產生不公平感。其次，現有文獻雖重視社會支持交換的量化指標（如頻率、時數、比例等），卻較少探討其主觀層面（如參與者對社會支持交換所賦予的主觀意義）。最後，關於不同社會支持交換模式及其主觀意義如何透過個人掌控感及歸屬感（等心理機制影響健康老齡化的理解仍相當有限。 就研究方法而言，現有研究多依賴自我報告方式測量社會支持交換，此方法不僅容易產生回憶偏差，且多集中於代際支持互動，忽略了社區基礎的交換模式。在家庭照護資源日益緊縮的社會背景下，採用客觀數據開展縱貫研究，深入探討社會支持交換如何影響健康老齡化，已成為一項重要且迫切的學術課題。 本研究將以香港時間銀行為案例，採用縱貫性混合研究方法來填補上述研究缺口。研究分為兩個階段：第一階段將隨機抽取450名長者進行縱貫調查，重點探討：（1）不同社會支持交換模式對健康老齡化（如身心健康與生活福祉）的影響；（2）社會支持交換的主觀意義如何與交換模式產生交互作用，進而影響健康老齡化；（3）個人掌控感與歸屬感在社會支持交換模式、主觀意義與健康老齡化之間的中介作用。研究將在獲得參與者知情同意後，從「HINCare」提取為期一年的客觀交換數據，並與問卷調查結果進行配對分析。第二階段將透過36名長者的聚焦小組訪談，探討社會支持交換過程中主觀意義感的動態形成機制，以及促成有益於健康老齡化的關鍵要素。 本研究旨在透過實證研究方法，釐清當代社會背景下不同社會支持交換理論的適用性差異，整合社會支持行為的客觀表現與參與者的主觀心理體驗，建構一個創新性的理論框架，系統性地闡釋社會支持交換影響健康老齡化的多重作用路徑。研究成果不僅能為社區參與計劃的設計與實施提供科學依據，更能為全球健康老齡化行動提供兼具理論深度與實踐價值的政策指引。

17619725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619725.value: 中国司法中的法律职业及其经济影响：一项定量研究

17619725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619725.value: The proposed study will examine the impact of “revolving-door” judges in the Chinese judicial system. By compiling a comprehensive dataset of judges, lawyers, law firms, litigants, and lawsuits in China from 2014 to 2021, the principal investigator will investigate the judicial and economic implications of judges leaving their positions to practice law. Preliminary research by the principal investigator has identified over 14,000 judges who have made this transition, constituting 6.6% of all judges and 2.6% of all lawyers nationwide. The proposed study will explore three key questions: First, do revolving-door lawyers obtain more favorable court decisions for their clients in comparable lawsuits? Second, if so, does this advantage stem from their legal expertise (“know how”) or personal connections (“know who”)? Third, do revolving-door lawyers contribute to social inequality by using their connections and arguments to favor affluent clients, potentially biasing judicial decisions and exacerbating socioeconomic disparities? The overall aim of this research is to provide comprehensive analysis of the revolving-door phenomenon in the Chinese judicial system, shedding light on the role of highly connected and skilled lawyers in shaping judicial, economic, and social outcomes. 本研究将考察中国司法系统中法律职业的影响。通过整理涵盖法官、律师、律师事务所、诉讼当事人以及案件的全面数据集，项目将研究法律职业（精英律师）所带来的司法和经济影响。 初步的研究已识别出超过14,000名法官离职后担任律师的情形，占全国所有法官的6.6%，以及所有律师的2.6%。研究将围绕三个关键问题展开： 第一，精英律师在类案中是否能为客户争取到更有利的判决？ 第二，这种优势是否源于他们的法律专业知识（“know how”）或人脉关系（“know who”）？ 第三，精英律师是否加剧社会不平等，影响司法公正，扩大社会经济差距？

17620925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17620925.value: 用于提高单个城市和整个城市系统的经济和环境效率的城市尺度指标

17620925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17620925.value: Dr Chen, Chen Prof Kirkley, Alec William Dr Sarkar, Chinmoy Prof Zhang, Xiaohu

17620925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620925.value: City performance (GDP, environmental pollution, inventions, health) typically scale regularly with population size. GDP urban scaling ‘law’ can be derived by fitting a line to a plot of GDP against population for all the cities in a national urban system. That line can typically be summarized mathematically as a power law with an exponent of approximately 1.15. Since exponent of 1.0 is consistent with per-capita growth, this finding indicates that larger cities deliver more GDP per-capita, which is assumed to be a result of complex advantages of size (increasing agglomeration economies of scale). This is a crucial insight for understanding and managing urban systems. From power-law models like this, we can derive population-adjusted expected performance, and this can be used for more accurate targets, KPIs and policy. Our study will help that process. Equally important as the idea of city size-adjusted performance norms is the idea of variation around those norms. A systematic study of the influence of planned action on cities’ deviation from a national scaling curve hasn’t yet been undertaken. Based on time-series (2000-2022) data for city-level statistics in China, we will conduct research in three parts. Firstly, we fit urban scaling curves to measure cities’ size-adjusted performance on a set of urban performance dimensions including economic and environmental performance. We will then test whether a systematic set of factors relating to government policy, geographical location, market dynamics and competition, can explain patterns of under-and over-performance. Secondly, we will investigate how these patterns tend to be ‘sticky’ over time. Technically, we will measure path dependency of residual distributions around urban scaling curves, using cross-correlation analysis, serial autocorrelation analysis, and spatial autocorrelation analysis. Thirdly, we will use truncated power law models to capture patterns of elevated or depressed performance within certain population size ranges (eg small cities performing much lower than expected for their size on environmental technology investment). We will measure threshold effects, for example, asking at what city size, do environmental technology economies of scale start to kick-in? Our study will be able to theorise about the bounds of controllable (plan-able) city dynamics within a self-organising city system. Our findings will inform planning strategies for levelling-up of lagging urban regions, bespoke city improvement policy packages, and improving performance of whole city systems. They will help guide implementation of urban system changes envisaged in China’s New Urbanisation strategy. 城市绩效（GDP、环境污染、发明、健康）通常与人口规模呈正相关。GDP城市规模“规律”可以通过将全国城市体系中所有城市的GDP与人口关系图拟合成一条直线来推导。这条直线通常可以用数学方法概括为幂律，其指数约为1.15。由于指数1.0与人均增长率一致，因此这一发现表明，城市规模越大，人均GDP就越高，这被认为是规模优势（不断增强的集聚规模经济）的结果。 这对于理解和管理城市系统至关重要。通过此类幂律模型，我们可以推导出经人口调整的预期绩效，这可以用于制定更准确的目标、关键绩效指标和政策。我们的研究将有助于这一进程。 与城市规模调整绩效规范的概念同等重要的是，围绕这些规范进行变化的概念。目前尚无关于规划行动对城市偏离全国尺度曲线影响的系统研究。基于中国城市级统计数据（2000-2022），我们将分三部分开展研究。首先，我们将拟合城市尺度曲线，以衡量城市在一系列城市绩效维度（包括经济和环境绩效）上的规模调整后绩效。然后，我们将检验与政府政策、地理位置、市场动态和竞争相关的一系列系统性因素是否能够解释绩效不足和过度的模式。其次，我们将研究这些模式如何随着时间的推移而趋于“粘性”。从技术角度来看，我们将使用互相关分析、序列自相关分析和空间自相关分析来衡量残差分布围绕城市尺度曲线的路径依赖性。 第三，我们将使用截断幂律模型来捕捉特定人口规模范围内绩效提升或下降的模式（例如，小城市在环境技术投资方面的表现远低于其规模预期）。我们将测量阈值效应，例如，探究在何种规模的城市中，环境技术的规模经济才会开始发挥作用？我们的研究将能够理论化自组织城市系统中可控（可规划）城市动态的界限。我们的研究结果将为落后城市区域的升级规划战略、量身定制的城市改善政策方案以及提升整个城市系统绩效提供参考。这些研究结果将有助于指导中国新型城镇化战略中设想的城市系统变革的实施。

17621325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17621325.value: This research project investigates what I term “queer Sinophone visuality,” namely visual cultural productions spanning photography, print culture, cinema, and visual arts in Hong Kong during the 1980-2020s. While LGBT and queer Hong Kong films have garnered significant scholarly attention, queer visual cultures remain underexplored. My project addresses this gap in current scholarship by drawing on works in film studies, theory of visuality, queer theory, and Sinophone studies. Furthermore, it explores the intricate relationship between queer visual cultures and geopolitical processes, including the 1997 handover, postcolonialism, and capitalism in Hong Kong. Beginning in the 1980s, queer visual artists like Ellen Pau, Yau Ching, and others were already exploring issues of home, belonging, diaspora, and queer desire mediated by the anxiety regarding Hong Kong’s future as stipulated in the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration. The large exodus of Hong Kongers following the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests echoes the recent anxiety about Hong Kong’s future after the 2019 protests. Conceptually, I describe Hong Kong filmmakers, visual artists, and photographers who deploy queer visual aesthetics as offering “perverse visions” on Chineseness, modernity, and transnationalism. My concept of perverse visions expands on the recent scholarship in queer studies and ethnic studies by Gayatri Gopinath (2018) and Sarita See (2009), who deploy concepts such as “unruly visions” and “decolonized eye” to name how queer, racialized, and colonized bodies perform ways of seeing that defy the strictures of nationalism, colonialism, and late capitalism. I also wed this body of scholarship on postcolonial queer visuality to Sinophone studies (Shih 2007), which is the study of the global dissemination of the cultural productions of Sinitic-language communities on the margin of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and outside China. I define queer Sinophone visuality as visual forms (such as film, photography, installation arts, print cultures, etc.) that invoke Chineseness as a porous formation while pointing to parody, postmodern aesthetics, and affective forms that deviate from dominant modes of Chinese nationalism, late capitalism, and essentialist localism. In other words, queer Sinophone visuality gestures towards alternative ways of seeing “China” and Hong Kong-ness through the multiplicity of queer desire. My project intervenes at the intersection of queer theory, Sinophone studies, Hong Kong studies, and film and media studies by investigating Hong Kong’s queer Sinophone visual cultures from the 1980s to the present. 本研究計劃探討「酷兒華語語系視覺文化」，即 1980-2020 年代香港的視覺文化產品，涵蓋攝影、印刷文化、電影和視覺藝術。儘管香港同志電影已獲得學術界的高度關注，但酷兒視覺文化仍未受到充分探討。我的專題研究將參考電影研究、視覺性理論、酷兒理論和華語語系研究的成果，以彌補目前學術研究的不足。此外，本項目探討了酷兒視覺文化與地緣政治之間錯綜複雜的關係，包括香港的九七回歸、後殖民主義與資本主義。自1980年代開始，酷兒視覺藝術家如鮑藹倫、游靜等人已經開始探討家園、歸屬感、離散以及1984年《中英聯合聲明》所規定的香港前途所帶來的同性慾望和焦慮等問題。1989年天安門事件後，大批香港人外流，與最近2019年社會動盪後對香港前途的焦慮相呼應。在概念上，我形容香港的電影製作人、視覺藝術家和攝影師，他們運用酷兒的視覺美學，為中國性、現代性和跨國主義提供「反常的視覺」。我的 「反常視覺」概念擴展了 Gayatri Gopinath (2018) 與 Sarita See (2009) 近期在酷兒理論研究與族群研究中的學術成果。他們運用「不規則的視覺」與「非殖民化的眼睛」等概念來命名同性戀、種族化與殖民化的身體如何表現出違背民族主義、殖民主義與晚期資本主義的嚴格規範。我也將這套後殖民酷兒視覺性的學術體系與華語語系研究（Shih 2007）結合。我將 「酷兒華語語系視覺文化」定義為視覺形式（如電影、攝影、裝置藝術、印刷文化等），這些形式援引中國性作為多孔性的形成，同時指向戲仿、後現代美學，以及偏離中國民族主義、後期資本主義和本位主義等主流模式的情感形式。換句話說，酷兒華語語系視覺透過酷兒欲望的多樣性，以另一種方式看待「中國」和「香港性」。我的項目介入了酷兒理論、華語語系研究、香港研究、電影與媒體研究的交叉點，研究香港自1980年代至今的酷兒華語語系視覺文化。

17621825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17621825.value: 連繫或孤立？華人新移民的數碼離散社群悖論分析

17621825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17621825.value: Dr Stuart, Jaimee Dr Wong, Hoi Yan Gloria Prof Ye, Shaoyu

17621825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17621825.value: The proposed project will investigate the mental health implications of new Chinese migrants’ engagement in “digital diasporas”—communities of people who have left their homeland but maintain connections with their cultural heritage through digital technologies (e.g., social networking sites). It is imperative to understand the adjustment processes and challenges faced by new Chinese migrants given the major recent shifts in population dynamics in Hong Kong, particularly an increase in emigration and influx of students from mainland China. There are two key gaps in understanding of these issues. First, most research on diasporas focuses on economic and political issues; mental health receives less attention. Second, in today’s Internet age, digital diasporic communities (DDC) are on the rise, yet research in this area yields mixed findings, indicating that participating in such online communities can either strengthen migrants’ connection to their new environments or elicit feelings of disconnection. We will address these research gaps by examining how different motivations for and types of engagement in DDC, alongside variations in social capital accrual, influence new Chinese migrants’ adjustment to post-migration life. We will employ a multi-method approach to collect data from diverse sources, thereby enhancing the reliability of the findings. Study 1 will involve a longitudinal survey using validated questionnaires to collect quantitative data from two groups of new Chinese migrants: mainland Chinese students in Hong Kong and Hong Kong residents who have emigrated to the U.K. Study 2 will focus on observing actual engagement within DDC in a natural field setting, supplemented by interviews with members to obtain deeper insights. Study 3 will implement an intervention to promote the healthy use of DDC and evaluate changes in post-migration adjustment outcomes. This project is expected to generate novel and actionable insights into the adjustment of new Chinese migrants engaging in DDC. By revealing individual differences in DDC engagement patterns and social capital accrual, our three studies will identify migrant groups who are vulnerable to adjustment-related challenges. The findings can inform mental health interventions and community support programs tailored to the specific needs of migrant populations, enhancing their well-being. Our research may provide valuable guidance for DDC and non-profit organizations on developing more effective strategies to foster social connections and reduce isolation among new migrants. In summary, the project will fill knowledge gaps and offer practical recommendations for the healthier use of DDC to foster post-migration adjustment. 本研究計畫將探討華人新移民參與「數碼離散社群」（digital diasporas，即離開家鄉但透過數碼科技如社交網站維持與文化傳統聯繫的社群）對其心理健康的影響。鑑於香港近年人口結構的重大變化，特別是移民增加及來自大陸的學生湧入，了解華人新移民的適應過程與挑戰顯得尤為重要。現有研究在以下兩方面存在關鍵知識缺口：首先，關於離散社群的研究多聚焦於經濟與政治議題，心理健康問題較少受到關注；其次，在當今網路時代，數碼離散社群（DDC）日益興起，但相關研究結果不一，顯示參與此類線上社群可能增強移民與新環境的聯繫，或引發疏離感。 本研究將透過檢視參與DDC的不同動機與類型，以及社會資本累積的差異，探討這些因素如何影響華人新移民的後移民生活適應。我們將採用多方法研究策略，從多元來源收集數據，以提升研究結果的可靠性。研究一將進行縱向調查，採用經驗證的問卷收集兩組華人新移民的量化數據：香港的大陸學生及移居英國的香港居民。研究二將聚焦於自然場景中觀察DDC的實際參與情況，並輔以成員訪談以獲得更深入的見解。研究三將實施一項促進DDC健康使用的干預措施，並評估後移民適應結果的變化。 本計畫預計為華人新移民參與DDC的適應過程提供新穎且可操作的見解。通過揭示DDC參與模式及社會資本累積的個體差異，我們的三項研究將識別易受適應挑戰影響的移民群體。研究結果可為針對移民群體特定需求的心理健康干預措施及社群支持計畫提供資訊，從而提升其福祉。我們的研究亦可為DDC及非營利組織提供寶貴指導，幫助其制定更有效的策略，以促進新移民的社會聯繫並減少孤立感。總體而言，本計畫將填補知識缺口，並為促進DDC健康使用以改善後移民適應提供實務建議。

17621925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17621925.value: 目标以上：认定大型目标网络中的高影响力个体和团队目标

17621925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17621925.value: Goal-setting theory, one of the most renowned management theories, asserts that setting difficult and specific goals can significantly enhance job performance. Research in this area has isolated goal-related variables and studied their impacts in laboratory or field settings. For example, previous research either manipulated different levels of goal characteristics to observe subsequent attainment when individuals were assigned these goals, or invited employees to list and evaluate one or a few isolated goals and then linked goal pursuit processes to job performance. While previous research has laid a solid foundation for the main thesis of the theory, it often stripped away the complex goal dynamics present in real organizational settings. We leverage a unique archival dataset of a goal management platform used by a large technology company. This unique dataset provides rich, granular insights into how 1,825 employees and 121 teams set, track, and achieve as many as 10,410 goals every year. Individuals and teams, situated within different horizontal and vertical structures, set multiple goals throughout the year. Some of the goals are attained to different extents, while others are abandoned midway. Individuals and teams can link their goals to other goals when they see alignment or synergy, thereby forming a large goal network that indicates collaborative relationships between employees and teams. The goals also follow distinct timelines with its own start and end points and have varying durations that reflect the difficulty and scope of the tasks involved. We contend that not all organizational goals are of equal importance. We test this idea through developing two different studies. Study 1 is an individual-level study designed to investigate why some individual goals exhibit a stronger relationship between individual goal attainment and individual performance. Study 2 is a team-level study that similarly explores the moderators that can alter the relationship between team goal attainment and team performance. Taken together, this project aims to extend the explanatory scope of goal-setting theory from one or a few isolated goals to a complex system of goals embedded in various structures, hierarchies, and temporal contexts. Furthermore, this project breaks an implicit assumption in previous research that goal attainment is equivalent to job performance. Goal attainment is not the end of the story—even if some goals are achieved, they may not necessarily translate into performance. Our project seeks to identify the “right” individual and team goals that are more conducive to good performance. 目标设定理论指出，设定具体且具有挑战性的目标能够通过引导努力方向和增强持久性来提升个人绩效。该研究领域存在一个隐含假设，即目标达成等同于理想绩效。然而在现实组织环境中，由于目标动态机制更为复杂，这一假设可能并不成立。不同员工设定的组织目标具有不同程度的重要性，这些目标被嵌入横纵交错的协作网络中，并遵循具有特定起止时间节点的独立时间线。因此目标达成并非终点——即使部分目标得以实现，也不会自动转化为理想的个人或团队绩效。本项目旨在揭示不同类型的目标如何改变目标达成与个人或团队绩效结果之间的关系。 本项目包含两项研究。研究一采用个体层面的分析，探究个人如何通过战略性选择目标来优化目标达成对工作绩效的影响。关键问题包括：理解个人目标如何融入组织目标的大网络、其目标与高层管理者制定目标的契合程度，以及确定设定和完成目标的适当时机。研究二为团队层面研究，探索团队目标达成与团队绩效之间的关系。我们同样预期某些团队目标会因涉及跨职能协作、与其他团队目标联系更紧密、或被团队成员内化（体现为个人目标与整体团队目标的关联度）等因素而更具重要性。 本项目计划采用某大型科技企业的历史目标与绩效数据，该企业详细记录了个体和团队设定目标的时间、目标追求的进展与达成情况、目标间的关联结构以及个人或团队绩效记录。通过这种方法，我们的研究有望显著拓展目标设定理论的解释范围，并为理解目标在相互依存的组织环境中如何运作提供新见解。

17622025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17622025.value: 以生態演化模式發展人工智能素養課程和教師專業學習

17622025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17622025.value: Dr Pan, Qianqian Prof Wong, Ka Wai Gary

17622025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17622025.value: With rapid social and technological changes, particularly since the turn of the new millennium, significant attention has been given to renewing curriculum content, goals, and pedagogy in many education systems, including Hong Kong. The pressure for change and renewal is most prominent in the digital knowledge and skills area (often referred to as digital literacy or AI literacy) in terms of curriculum content, and in incorporating digital technology to enhance teaching and learning in terms of pedagogy. While there have been many changes in schools in these two areas in Hong Kong, the models of curriculum development and teacher professional development have largely remained unchanged. A modernist cascade model of expert-led curriculum development, followed by a program of in-service professional development, was still the model adopted when AI literacy was introduced to schools in July 2023. This process typically takes years to complete one cycle, while the speed of technological change escalates exponentially. In parallel to renewing digital skills-related curricula, there have also been significant efforts to provide teachers in different subject areas with professional development courses on how to use AI tools and applications in their teaching. However, this model of teacher learning still adopts a receptive approach, which contrasts with the collaborative inquiry and self-directed learning approaches for fostering 21st-century competencies and dispositions that have been promoted by the Hong Kong Government. This research proposal is a design-based implementation study aimed at validating and refining an ecological evolutionary model of curriculum development and implementation for AI literacy and AI-enhanced learning innovations across various subject disciplines. It posits that AI literacy is an integral part of digital literacy, and thus, the development of both literacies should be intertwined. The proposed model builds on an ecological model of multilevel multiscale connected learning (MLMS model) designed to sustain and scale technology-enhanced learning innovations (TELIs). The MLMS model was developed based on analyses of numerous TELI case studies from Europe, Asia, and Hong Kong, focusing on bottom-up curriculum and pedagogical innovations that were aligned with and supported by system-level policies and strategic initiatives. Design-Based Implementation Research (DBIR) studies have demonstrated the resilience and generative power of school-based innovation networks. This research extends the MLMS model by incorporating a mechanism for policy-level engagement, aiming to achieve system-level consolidation of schools’ bottom-up innovations into an organically evolving and living curriculum. This curriculum will serve as a pedagogical resource for digital and AI literacy. 隨著社會和科技的快速變化，尤其是新千禧年開始以來，包括香港在內的許多教育體系都高度重視課程內容、目標和教學法的更新。變革和更新的壓力主要體現在課程內容方面，尤其在數位知識和技能領域（通常稱為數碼素養或人工智能素養），而在教學法方面，則主要體現在融入數碼技術以提升教學效果。 雖然香港學校在這兩個領域發生了許多變化，但在課程發展和教師專業學習的模式上基本維持不變。當人工智能素養最近引進學校時，仍採用由專家主導的現代主義級聯課程發展模式，隨後開展在職專業發展計畫。這個過程通常需要數年才能完成一個週期，而技術變革的速度正呈指數級增長。 在更新數碼技能相關課程的同時，各學科領域也大力發展教師專業發展課程，指導教師如何在教學中運用人工智能工具與應用。然而，這種教師學習模式仍採用接受式教學，這與香港政府所倡導的、旨在培養21世紀能力和素質的協作探究和自主學習方法相悖。 本研究是一項基於設計的實施研究(DBIR)，旨在驗證和完善跨學科人工智能素養和人工智能增強學習創新課程開發與實施的生態演化模型。該模型認為，人工智能素養是數碼素養的組成部分，因此，兩種素養的發展應該相互交織。該模型建基於多層級多尺度互聯學習的生態模型（MLMS 模型），旨在維持和擴展技術增強學習創新（TELI）。 MLMS 模型是基於對歐洲、亞洲和香港眾多 TELI 案例研究的分析而開發，重點關注與教育政策和策略方向相一致，自下而上的課程和教學創新。基於設計的實施研究 (DBIR) 已證明學校創新網絡的韌性和生成力。 本研究擴展了 MLMS 模型，引入了政策層面的參與機制，旨在將學校自下而上的創新在系統層面整合成一個有機發展、充滿活力的課程體系。此課程體系將成為數碼和人工智能素養的教學資源。

17622225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17622225.value: 动态离散选择模型中折扣因子的识别 动态离散选择模型中折扣因子的识别 动态离散选择模型中折扣因子的识别

17622225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17622225.value: This research project will study the identification, estimation, and inference of the discount factor in dynamic discrete choice models. Identifying the discount factor in these models is crucial for evaluating agents’ responses to dynamic interventions. As shown by Rust (1994), the discount factor cannot be identified from choice data without further restrictions. Recently, Abbring and Daljord (2020) demonstrated that the discount factor can be identified up to a finite number of points from a variation that shifts expected discounted future utilities but not current utilities. However, Abbring and Daljord (2020) do not provide an upper bound on the number of candidate values for the discount factor. Using the same model as Abbring and Daljord (2020), we will show that the discount factor is identified as the solutions of a finite order polynomial whose coefficients are identified from the data and whose order is easily determined from the model. Since the maximum number of solutions of a polynomial equals its order, we can identify an upper bound on the number of candidate values for the discount factor. Furthermore, by solving a sample counterpart of the polynomial, we will provide an estimation and inference method for the identified set of discount factors. 本文研究了在平稳无限期动态离散选择模型中如何识别折扣因子与收益函数。在单智能体模型中，我们证明了对每期收益的常见非参数假设——如一次齐次性、单调性、凹性、零交叉差异和互补性——能为折扣因子提供识别约束。这些约束表现为由状态空间基数限定次数的多项式等式与不等式。在标准单行为归一化条件下，这些约束也能识别收益函数。在动态博弈模型中，我们论证了可通过其他企业滞后行为无关性、可交换性以及调整成本独立于其他企业行为等假设来识别企业特定折扣因子。研究结果表明，经济学分析中广泛采用的非参数假设能为动态结构模型提供强有力的识别依据。

17622425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17622425.value: 地缘政治认同的危机：欧盟与乌克兰战争

17622425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17622425.value: Geopolitical identities are forged in crisis when new meanings emerge from the ruins of the old. The war in Ukraine challenges the “Peace and Prosperity” identity that gave meaning to the European Union since the end of the Cold War. The EU is caught between its growing ambition to become a formidable global player, capable of shaping the world in its own image, and its limited ability to project power. There are four possible scenarios likely to shape the prospect of Europe becoming a major geopolitical actor: Actionable – It is possible and desirable for Europe to become a geopolitical actor; Regrettable – It is possible but undesirable; Lamentable – It is impossible, but would be desirable; and Insignificant – It is neither possible nor desirable. The research program will examine the theoretical-philosophical foundations of the four possible positions by contrasting the opposite views of two major German thinkers about Europe, Carl Schmitt and Jürgen Habermas, who represent opposing visions of the European Union. This research project is interdisciplinary, drawing on political theory, intellectual history, and international relations. Accordingly, it will draw on hybrid methodologies from these fields to examine the history, theoretical foundation, actual, and potential geopolitical identity of the European Union. 地缘政治认同往往在危机中锻造——当旧秩序崩塌时，新的意义便从废墟中浮现。乌克兰战争对自冷战结束以来赋予欧盟意义的“和平与繁荣”认同构成了挑战。欧盟正陷于两难境地：一方面怀抱日益增长的雄心，力求成为能够按照自身模式塑造世界的强大全球行为体；另一方面，其力量投射能力却十分有限。欧洲成为主要地缘政治行为体的前景可能呈现四种情景：可行——既可能又可取；可惜——可行但不可取；遗憾——不可能但可取；无关紧要——既不可行也不可取。本研究将通过对比两位在欧洲问题上持对立观点的德国重要思想家——分别代表欧盟不同发展愿景的卡尔·施密特与尤尔根·哈贝马斯——来探讨上述四种立场的理论-哲学基础。本研究项目具有跨学科性质，涵盖政治理论、思想史与国际关系领域，并将综合运用这些领域的方法论，以此考察欧盟的历史、理论基础、现实及潜在的地缘政治认同。

17622625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17622625.value: 共生的台港文化流動—邱剛健（1940-2013）的跨媒介前衛主義研究

17622625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17622625.value: Existing studies on Taiwan's modernism have predominantly focused on modernist fiction, its interactions with nativism, and its relationship with the dominant U.S.-centric literary establishment. This relatively narrow focus has resulted in overlooking other forms of media, such as plays, diminishing the agency of practitioners as mere imitations, and neglecting the vibrant inter-Asian cultural exchanges that took place. To address these shortcomings, this project seeks to re-examine Taiwan's postwar avant-garde modernism within the broader context of the Taiwan-Hong Kong cultural exchange, with Chiu Kang-chien (1940-2013) as a central case study. Chiu serves as an excellent example due to his engagement with various Sinophone cultural institutions and his diverse talents in poetry, scriptwriting, and directing. Utilising a range of methodologies, including close reading, inter-Asian contextual analysis, and intermedia studies, this project aims to position the efforts of modernists like Chiu as integral components of the global avant-garde movement. Rather than viewing their translations as a reflection of Taiwan's subordinate cultural status under Euro-American hegemony, this project approaches these endeavours through a transcultural lens, highlighting the localisation of Western-originated modernism. It also underscores the significance of the Taiwan-Hong Kong cultural exchange in providing a comprehensive understanding of the avant-garde in the contemporary Sinosphere. The project is structured into four main parts. Firstly, it examines Chiu's early poems and theatrical experiments. Secondly, it delves into Chiu's collaborations with the Shaw Brothers during his initial stay in Hong Kong, particularly focusing on his ability to balance market demands with his pursuit of eroticism in films like "Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan" (1972) directed by Chor Yuen. Thirdly, it explores Chiu's partnerships with Hong Kong's "new wave" directors such as Ann Hui and Stanley Kwan, as well as his own directorial ventures. Lastly, it analyses Chiu's two post-Millennium poetry collections, especially how he continued to emphasise corporeality and appropriate both Western and Chinese elements into his creative writing even in his late years. Through Chiu's case, this project puts forth three key arguments: 1) Taiwan's avant-garde movement did not come to a halt in the late 1960s; rather, it evolved along various trajectories and expanded into the Hong Kong context, 2) conducting a comprehensive intermedia evaluation of Taiwan's modernist practices is essential to understand its multifaceted nature, and 3) Taiwan and Hong Kong established a symbiotic cultural ecosystem characterized by the continual exchange of talent, enriching the cultural interchange between the two regions. 現有對台灣現代主義的研究，主要著重於其與本土主義的互動，以及其與以美國為中心的主流文學架構的關係。此類觀點導致其他形式的媒體例如戲劇被忽略，也貶低了實踐者的能動性，僅將其視為純粹的模仿，也忽略了亞際之間活潑的文化交流。本計畫以邱剛健（1940-2013）為個案，試圖在台港文化交流的背景下，重新檢視台灣戰後前衛現代主義。邱康乾（1940-2013）是為絕佳範例，因他曾參與多個華語文化機構，並涉足詩歌、編劇與導演等多媒介。透過包括細讀、跨亞際脈絡 分析與跨媒體研究等方法，本研究旨在將邱氏等的現代主義，定位為全球前衛運動中的一環。與其將他們的譯作視為台灣在歐美霸權下從屬文化地位的反映， ，本計畫透過跨文化視角來重探這些努力，強調源自西方的現代主義的在地化。同時亦強調台港文化交流對全面了解當代中華文化圈前衛藝術的重要性。計劃分四部分。首先檢視邱剛健早期的詩作和戲劇實驗，其次探究他在香港初期與邵氏的合作，聚焦他在楚原執導的《愛奴》（1972）裡平衡市場需求和其自身情色美學的能力。之後討論邱與香港「新浪潮」導演如許鞍華、關錦鵬的合作，以及他親執導演筒的嘗試。最後分析邱氏在千禧年後的兩本詩集，尤其是他在晚期創作中持續強調肉身性，並搬用中西元素的特色。透過邱的個案，本計畫提出三個主要論點： 1）台灣的前衛運動並未在1960年代末停頓，而是依循不同軌跡發展，並延伸到香港；2）對台灣現代主義實踐進行全面的跨媒介重估，對了解其多維度本質是必要的；3）台灣和香港建立了一個共生的文化生態系，以持續的人才交流為特徵，豐富了兩地的文化互動。

17622925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17622925.value: 數位時代的鄰里互動、社區依戀與心理健康：基於中國超大城市的實證研究

17622925.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17622925.value: Dr Chang, Jiang Prof Clark, William

17622925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17622925.value: Advances in ICT, especially social media apps, have brought profound changes to people’s lives. In the past decade, the national strategy of developing Digital China has rapidly transformed Chinese society through the promotion of digital economy and digitalisation of social services and governance. Notably, patterns of daily activities and social interactions within residential neighbourhoods have changed substantially, with increasing reliance on online interactions within virtual neighbourhoods (e.g. WeChat groups). Prior studies have examined how neighbourly interactions and attachment vary with neighbourhood characteristics and generally improve residents’ mental health. However, how extensive online and offline neighbourly interactions interplay and affect neighbourhood attachment and mental health in the digital era remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, the proposed research will examine three interrelated research questions. First, what are the general patterns of neighbourly interaction (both online and offline) and the variations across different neighbourhood types in the digital era? Second, how do different patterns of neighbourly interaction affect residents’ neighbourhood attachment? Third, to what extent do neighbourly interactions and neighbourhood attachment improve mental health? Guangzhou and Shanghai are chosen as the study areas for three reasons: 1) both cities spearheaded housing reform and digitalisation of urban governance and social services; 2) they represent different state-market-society relations and historical-cultural contexts that shape distinct modes of neighbourhood governance and neighbourhood attachment; 3) the PI and Co-Is have extensive research experience and collected rich datasets in both cities. Drawing on the household survey data in both cities (N=1500*2), we will identify prevalent patterns of neighbourhood interactions with different combinations of online and offline neighbourly interaction using a clustering analysis powered by machine-learning algorithm. We will then select study cases representing different patterns in each city and conduct focus groups with residents and 90 interviews with various stakeholders. 200 participants will be invited to participate in an Ecological Momentary Assessment using wearable devices to capture their spatial-temporal trajectories and real-time mental health fluctuations over a week. A mixed-methods approach combining discourse analysis, thematic analysis, clustering analysis, multilevel serial mediation analysis, and an integrated approach of propensity score matching, fixed effects regression, and mediation analysis will be employed to shed new light on the theoretical debates on neighbourly interactions and neighbourhood attachment in the digital era, as well as their importance to mental health. It will also inform policymaking to improve neighbourhood-level social cohesion and wellbeing in Chinese megacities. 資訊通信技術（ICT）的進步，尤其是社群媒體應用，深刻改變了人們的生活。過去十年間，「數位中國」國家戰略透過推動數位經濟和社會服務與治理的數位化，快速推動了中國社會的轉型。值得注意的是，居民日常活動模式與社區內社會交往發生了重大變化，對虛擬社區（如微信羣組）線上互動的依賴日益增強。已有研究探討了鄰里互動和社區依戀如何隨社區特徵變化，並普遍證實其對居民心理健康的提升作用。然而，在數位時代，線上與線下鄰里互動的廣泛交織如何影響社區依戀和心理健康，仍存在大量研究空白。 為填補這一空白，本研究將探討三個相互關聯的研究問題：第一，數位時代鄰里互動（線上與線下）的總體模式及其在不同社區類型中的差異？第二，不同鄰里互動如何影響居民的社區依戀？第三，鄰里互動與社區依戀對心理健康的改善程度如何？ 本研究選擇廣州和上海作為研究案例，主要基於三點考量：1）兩地在住房改革和城市治理、社會服務數位化方面處於領先地位；2）其政府-市場-社會關係及歷史文化背景差異塑造了不同的社區治理模式和社區依戀形態；3）研究團隊在兩市積累了豐富的研究經驗和數據基礎。基於兩市各1,500戶的住戶調查數據（N=1500*2），我們將運用機器學習演算法支援的聚類分析識別「線上-線下」不同組合的典型鄰里互動模式。隨後選取各城市典型案例，開展居民焦點小組討論，並對多元利益相關者進行90次深度訪談。邀請200名參與者透過可穿戴裝置進行為期一週的生態瞬時評估（EMA），捕捉其時空軌跡與即時心理健康波動。 研究採用混合方法：結合主題分析、話語分析、聚類分析、多層次鏈式中介分析，以及傾向值匹配-固定效應迴歸-中介分析的整合方法，旨在深化數位時代鄰里互動與社區依戀的理論探討，揭示其對心理健康的作用機制。研究成果將為提升中國超大都市社區層面的社會凝聚力和居民福祉提供政策啟示。

17623725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17623725.value: 人工島還是白象工程？亞太地區投機性城市化的發展軌跡

17623725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17623725.value: The intensifying reclamation of maritime spaces is transforming seascapes across Pacific Asia and other rapidly urbanising regions. In particular, large-scale land reclamation projects - often in the form of artificial islands - are now proliferating at increasingly larger scales. Many such projects have the stated objective of generating additional land for affordable and private housing, financing expensive transportation infrastructure, and generating economic growth. They are also framed as being ‘smart’, ‘sustainable’, and ‘green’, by developers and politicians. However, they tend to have substantial environmental and social impacts in the construction phase, often falling short of the ambitious economic and sustainability objectives. The prudency of such large-scale reclamation projects is also questionable in the face of accelerating climate change impacts, sea level rise, and extreme weather events. This project will be grounded in a comparative analysis of a proposed, ongoing and completed artificial island project, respectively: the Kau Yi Chau Artificial Islands in Hong Kong; Silicon Island, Penang, Malaysia and Songdo City, South Korea. This inclusion of projects at different stages of development will allow for generating productive insights regarding likely outcomes and challenges affecting implementation for projects in the proposal phase, like Kau Yi Chau. The objectives of this proposed research are to analyse and compare the urban sustainability discourses circulating through large-scale artificial island projects in Asia; evaluate the actual (or projected) economic, social and environmental sustainability of the projects and engage with various stakeholders to improve these outcomes. This will enable the development of policy and planning recommendations for mega projects in the design stage, such as the Kau Yi Chau Artificial Islands, to mitigate the potential risks. Theoretically, the project will adopt an urban political ecology lens to examine the socio-environmental dimensions of speculative and extended urbanization, theorizing how artificial island development is transforming socio-spatial relationships and urban futures more broadly. The project will employ a mixed-methods approach, including semi-structured interviews, focus groups, spatial analysis, site visits, reviews of policy and planning reports, in addition to social media data in each case study site. These sources will be analyzed through a deductive and inductive approach, which allows for a critical analysis of the socio-ecological and political-economic aspects of large-scale urban transformations at a variety of scales. Findings will be shared with relevant stakeholders in the case study sites, and in relevant scholarly publications and conferences. 在亞太地區及其他快速城市化區域，海洋空間的大規模填海造地活動正不斷改變著海景地貌。尤其是大型填海項目,常以人工島的形式呈現, 如今正以前所未有的規模激增。許多此類項目宣稱其目標是為保障性住房和私人住房提供更多土地、為昂貴的交通基礎設施融資以及促進經濟增長。開發商和政客們還將這些項目標榜為「智能」「可持續」和「綠色」的工程。然而，在施工階段，這些項目往往會產生重大的環境和社會影響，且在實現雄心勃勃的經濟和可持續發展目標方面常常不盡如人意。在氣候變化影響加劇、海平面上升和極端天氣事件頻發的背景下，此類大型填海項目的合理性也備受質疑。 本項目將對三個分別處於規劃中、建設中和已完工階段的人工島項目進行比較分析，這三個項目分別是：中國香港的交椅洲人工島、馬來西亞檳城的硅島以及韓國的松島新城。通過對不同國家處於不同發展階段的項目進行比較，能夠對比各類項目在實施過程中的動機、成果和面臨的挑戰。 本研究的目標包括：分析並比較亞洲大型人工島項目中流傳的城市可持續發展話語；評估這些項目實際（或預期）的經濟、社會和環境可持續性，以及未來風險（如氣候變化或海平面上升）在其發展過程中的考量程度。這將有助於為處於設計階段的大型項目（如交椅洲人工島）制定政策和規劃建議，以減輕潛在風險。從理論層面，本項目將探究擴展城市化的政治生態學，闡釋填海造地如何改變社會空間關係以及城市邊緣以外非城市空間的地理格局。 本項目將採用混合研究方法，包括在每個案例研究地點進行半結構化訪談、焦點小組討論、實地考察、政策和規劃報告審查，以及社交媒體數據分析。通過演繹和歸納相結合的方法對這些數據源進行分析，從而能夠在不同尺度上對大型城市轉型的社會生態和政治經濟方面進行批判性分析。研究結果將與案例研究地點的相關利益相關者分享，並在相關學術出版物和會議上發布。

17624225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17624225.value: 臨時棲地，海岸連結：1970年代以來香港與東南亞的氣候敘事與居所變遷

17624225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17624225.value: This research project explores how water and flooding contingencies are part of the tumultuous housing development processes in Asia’s “sinking” coastal cities. Intensifying heatwaves, floods, droughts, wildfires, and tropical cyclones have significant impacts, increasing the vulnerability of many uprooted by complex multi-causal situations of conflict and violence. Heng Fa Chuen, a private housing estate in Chai Wan, Hong Kong, sitting on a fifteen-hectare reclaimed land, suffered from inundation caused by the severe typhoon Hato in 2017 as well as building damages and electricity and water supply disruptions when Typhoon Mangkhut hit the city in 2018. In Jakarta, where forty percent of the land is below sea level, the multi-year occurrences of torrential rain between 2000 and 2020 flooded thousands of homes. How does one write an architectural history of housing predicated on climate contingency? “Habitat,” promulgated by the United Nations in the 1970s, encapsulates all human settlements marking a global environmental turn. How can a critical review of “habitat” probe the dilemma of housing and architecture? And how does one approach the housing site as an archive? This research takes housing as a contingent device and the housing site as a repository comprising histories embedded in the buildings, artifacts, and bodies within and between the buildings, the infrastructure, the ground on which they sit, and the actual and imagined boundaries that define them. Connecting coastal housing sites such as Hong Kong’s Heng Fa Chuen and Singapore’s Marine Parade Estate, with Jakarta’s Pluit, Bangkok’s Mekong and Chao Praya delta, and Manila’s Marikina City, it maps housing and home-building beyond the conventional boundaries of the single Asian city to study the relationships between experiential, historical, and climatological time. Utilizing a multi-scalar and trans-coastal analysis of time, space, and social organization to understand the processes of land creation and housing, the project attends to the tensions between the events, how, by, and for whom they were narrated, the institutions they enabled, and histories they produced. Based on archival research including government records, housing and climate reports, meteorological charts, geological data, photographs and video footage, films and documentaries, and field observation and documentation, it will be organized around three episodes of embedded narratives, each interrupted by a pivotal water event or series of water-related climatic occurrences in which the coastal housing sites are the main protagonists. 本研究探討水患與洪水應變措施如何成為亞洲「下沉」沿海城市動盪住房發展進程的一部分。日益加劇的熱浪、洪水、乾旱、野火與熱帶氣旋造成重大衝擊，加劇了許多因衝突與暴力等複雜多重因素而流離失所人群的脆弱性。香港柴灣恒發園——這座建於十五公頃填海土地上的私人住宅區，不僅在2017年遭颱風天鴿重創而淹水，更於2018年颱風山竹襲港時面臨建築損毀及水電供應中斷的困境。在雅加達，四成土地位於海平面以下，2000至2020年間多次暴雨導致數千戶住宅淹水。 如何撰寫一部基於氣候偶然性的住宅建築史？聯合國於1970年代倡導的「棲居地」概念，涵蓋所有人類聚居形態，標誌著全球環境思潮的轉向。如何透過批判性檢視「棲地」概念，深入探討住宅與建築的困境？又該如何將住宅場域視為檔案庫？本研究將住宅視為一種應變裝置，將住宅場域視為蘊含歷史的儲藏庫——這些歷史嵌藏於建築物、文物、建築物內外的人體、基礎設施、承載建築的土地，以及界定建築的實際與想像邊界之中。透過串聯香港杏花邨、新加坡濱海灣屋苑等濱海住宅場域，與雅加達普魯伊特、曼谷湄公河與湄南河三角洲、馬尼拉馬里基納市等區域，本研究突破單一亞洲城市的傳統疆界，繪製出跨越地域的居住圖譜，探究經驗時間、歷史時間與氣候時間的交織關係。 本研究運用多尺度與跨海岸的時空與社會組織分析，探究土地創造與住宅建構的歷程，著重於事件敘述間的張力——包括事件如何被敘述、由誰敘述、為誰而述，以及這些敘述所催生的制度與歷史產物。本研究基於檔案資料蒐集，涵蓋政府紀錄、住房與氣候報告、氣象圖表、地質數據、照片與影像紀錄、電影及紀錄片，並輔以田野觀察與文獻彙編。研究架構將圍繞三段嵌套敘事展開，每段敘事皆因關鍵水事件或系列水相關氣候現象而中斷，其中沿海住宅區始終是故事的主角。

17624625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17624625.value: 法律动员的国家化：公益法律实践在中国的转型

17624625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17624625.value: This project investigates China’s efforts to reshape public interest lawyering—from a civil society-based movement challenging the status quo to a state-centric practice prioritizing government objectives. By the late 2000s, China had developed a thriving public interest law sector, including human rights advocates and pro bono lawyers addressing issues such as environmental protection and religious freedom. However, policy shifts under the Xi Jinping administration have fundamentally altered this landscape. The first shift involves the systematic repression and cooptation of public interest actors. The state has imposed various restrictions, including criminal sanctions, heightened monitoring, and media censorship, on numerous NGOs and lawyers perceived as politically threatening, while simultaneously seeking to co-opt others by offering state funding, political protection, and opportunities to influence policymaking. Another major development is the rise of prosecutorial public interest litigation, which empowers the People’s Procuratorates to file lawsuits in defense of the public interest. Leveraging their political and resource advantages, prosecutors have expanded their litigation efforts to over 100,000 cases annually, addressing a broad range of issues such as women's protection and cybersecurity. As a result, the state, rather than civil society, has become the dominant force in China’s legal mobilization. This study represents the first systematic effort to theoretically and empirically assess the "nationalization" of China’s public interest legal sector. It will involve multiple rounds of fieldwork with lawyers, NGO leaders, prosecutors, and party officials, supplemented by an analysis of court cases, policy documents, and media reports. The primary output will be a book, tentatively titled Nationalizing Legal Mobilization: The Transformation of Public Interest Lawyering in China, alongside a journal article synthesizing its key findings. The book will feature empirical chapters on the transformation of both society- and state-led public interest lawyering, as well as chapters addressing the theoretical and comparative implications of these changes. This project will make significant contributions to scholarship on legal mobilization, authoritarian legality, and state-society relations, both within China studies and in comparative analyses of nondemocratic legal systems. In particular, it will contribute to the ongoing debate about the role of public interest lawyers under autocracies and hybrid regimes. Additionally, the project will offer practical insights for policymakers on structuring and funding legal actors to enhance the efficacy of public interest protection, while guiding legal actors on how to navigate this new state-dominated landscape. 本项目旨在考察中国如何重塑公共利益法律实践——从以公民社会为基础、挑战既有秩序的运动，转向以国家为中心、服务政府目标的运作模式。到二十世纪二十年代末，中国已形成颇具规模的公共利益法律部门，包括聚焦环保、刑事正义等议题的人权倡导者和公益律师。然而，在中国现任政府主导下的政策调整已从根本上改变了这一格局。第一重变化是对公共利益行动者的系统性压制与收编。国家针对被视为政治威胁的众多社会组织与律师实施刑事制裁、加强监控、媒体审查等多种限制；与此同时，又通过提供国家资助、政治保护及参与政策制定的机会，试图将部分行动者纳入体制。另一项重要发展是检察机关公共利益诉讼的兴起，赋予人民检察院以公共利益为由提起诉讼的权力。依托政治与资源优势，检察机关将此类诉讼拓展至每年十万余件，涵盖妇女权益保护、网络安全等广泛领域。因此，在中国的法律动员中，主导力量已由民间社会转向国家。 本研究是迄今为止首次从理论与实证层面系统评估中国公益法律部门“国家化”进程的尝试。研究将通过多轮田野调查，访谈律师、社会组织 负责人、检察官和党政官员，并辅以案例审判记录、政策文件和媒体报道的分析。主要成果包括一本暂定书名为《法律动员的国家化：公益法律实践在中国的转型》的专著，以及一篇综合其核心发现的学术论文。专著将设有实证章节，分别论述社会主导与国家主导的公共利益法律实践转变，并有专章探讨此种变化的理论与比较意义。本项目将对法律动员和国家—社会关系的研究产生重要贡献，不仅丰富中国研究领域，也有助于对其他非民主法制体系的比较分析。尤其是，它将为混合政体下公益律师的角色定位提供新的视角。此外，项目还将为政策制定者在公共利益保护领域如何构建和资助法律行动者提出切实建议，并为法律实践者在这一国家主导的新环境中提供应对思路。

17625125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17625125.value: 通過OPERA訓練課程、神經同步與計算建模提升閱讀理解能力

17625125.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17625125.value: Prof Chen, Fei (Felix) Dr Lee, Stephen Man Kit Prof Li, Yuanning Mr Zhou, Xinliang

17625125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17625125.value: Despite the importance of reading comprehension, or deriving meaning from written texts, 11%-21% of Hong Kong Chinese-English bilingual children experience difficulty in one or both languages (Fong & Ho, 2019; X. Tong et al., 2022). These challenges are often accompanied by deficiencies in oral language skills and prosody. Our pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT) of oral language interventions shows significant improvement in vocabulary, syntax, and text reading comprehension (S. X. Tong & Man, 2021). However, the focus on oral language skills and behavioral outcomes has overlooked prosodic weakness and the neural mechanisms related to enhanced reading comprehension. Our prosodic catalyzing hypothesis (PCH) suggests that prosodic reading, or reading with expressive pitch and pause patterns, binds lexical, syntactic, and semantic representations of texts to facilitate comprehension (S. X. Tong et al., 2024). The proposed project extends our previous investigation by developing the OPERA (Oral Prosody Enhancement and Reading Acceleration) program for Hong Kong bilingual children with and without reading comprehension difficulties. By combining RCT design with electroencephalography (EEG) and deep learning approaches, our study will examine the efficacy of OPERA, brain oscillatory changes, and neural mechanisms related to enhanced reading comprehension. After recruiting 500 neurotypical Chinese-English bilingual second graders for a web-based reading comprehension screening, we will identify four sub-groups comprising 200 comprehenders: 50 poor in Chinese only; 50 poor in English only; 50 poor in both Chinese and English; and 50 average in both Chinese and English. These children will be randomly assigned into OPERA intervention and waiting-list control (N = 100 each). The OPERA group will receive 32 hours of training on prosodic reading, oral language skills, and their connections. The waiting-list control group will receive intervention only after all assessments are completed. To evaluate the impacts of OPERA at behavioral and neural levels, behavioral tests and EEG recordings will be administered at preintervention, postintervention, and six months after postintervention. A deep learning model, i.e., attention-based convolutional-long short-term memory (Conv-LSTM) network, will be developed to uncover the neural mechanisms underlying reading comprehension. By elucidating the behavioral and neurophysiological changes evoked by OPERA intervention, this study will clarify cognitive and neural mechanisms underlying improved reading comprehension. Synergizing theory-driven intervention with a data-driven deep learning model will reveal core neural dynamic operations responsible for reading comprehension, and ultimately foster the development of novel technology that will enhance reading skills for all children. 儘管閱讀理解， 即從文本中獲取意義的能力，極為重要，但仍有11%-21%的香港中英雙語學童在其中一種或兩種語言存在閱讀理解困難（Fong & Ho, 2019; X. Tong et al., 2022）。這種困難往往伴隨著口語能力和韻律方面的不足。我們的一項先導隨機對照試驗（RCT）表明，口語干預訓練顯著提升了學童的詞彙、句法及文本閱讀理解能力（S. X. Tong & Man, 2021）。然而，過往的研究聚焦於口語能力與行為結果，忽略了韻律方面的缺失以及與提升閱讀理解能力有關的神經機制。我們的「韻律催化假說」（Prosodic Catalyzing Hypothesis, PCH）提出韻律朗讀，即以富有表現力的音高與停頓規律進行朗讀，能夠整合文本的詞彙、句法和語義表徵，從而促進理解（S. X. Tong et al., 2024）。本項目在我們先前的研究基礎上，為所有香港雙語學童開發一套「OPERA」（Oral Prosody Enhancement and Reading Acceleration, 口語韻律強化與閱讀加速）訓練課程。我們將結合隨機對照試驗設計、腦電（EEG）與深度學習方法，探討OPERA訓練課程在影響大腦神經振盪變化以及與提升閱讀理解能力有關的神經機制方面的效能。 本研究將招募500名一般發展的中英雙語二年級生進行線上閱讀理解篩查，並從中識別出四個子組：50名僅在中文上有困難、50名僅在英文上有困難、50名在中文及英文上均有困難，以及50名在中英文均達到一般發展水平的學童（合共200人）。這些學童將隨機分派至OPERA訓練課程干預組或等候對照組（各100人）。OPERA干預組將接受32小時有關韻律朗讀、口語能力及其相互關聯的訓練，而等候對照組會於所有評估完成後接受訓練。為評估OPERA訓練課程在行為與神經層面的影響，我們將於訓練前、訓練後及訓練後六個月實施行為及EEG測試，並開發深度學習模型揭示與閱讀理解能力有關的神經機制。 透過闡述OPERA訓練課程引發的行為與神經生理變化，本研究將釐清與改善閱讀理解能力相關的認知與神經機制。我們將結合理論導向的干預訓練與數據導向的深度學習模型，以闡明負責閱讀理解的核心神經動態運作，推動新技術發展以提升所有學童的閱讀能力。

17625825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17625825.value: 香港學前英語媒介教育：政策、實踐與展望

17625825.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17625825.value: Prof Jiang, Lianjiang George Prof Lin, Angel Mei Yi

17625825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17625825.value: English-medium instruction has extensively expanded in practice and research around the non-Anglophone world. This expansion has largely been realized in universities and school-level education. Although similar activities also exist in preschool education and significant research issues related to policies and practices of English-medium education (EME) can be investigated at this level, preschool/kindergarten EME has scarcely been researched. As preschool EME is envisaged to grow larger, researching its wide range of emerging problems is crucial for improving kindergarten EME in non-English-speaking contexts worldwide. Understanding EME at this level is vital for gaining a comprehensive image of EME at all levels a whole, and for enhancing preschool education in general as the foundation of students’ lifelong learning. This project aims to explore the uncharted landscape of preschool EME, examining pertinent policies, prevailing practices, and main stakeholders’ perspectives in Hong Kong. It will also probe the possible influence of embracing English through EME on young children’s language attitudes. The study will first investigate if/what specific policies of kindergarten EME are set by official educational and language-(in)-education documents of Hong Kong. Then the current processes and practices of preschool EME will be explored in terms of purposes, materials, and activities. The data for this exploration will be collected through the observation of K1–K3 classes at two local EME kindergartens (overall, six classes; around 120 students) for a period of six months (overall, 240 sessions). Moreover, the attitudes and opinions of kindergarten teachers and young learners’ parents about different aspects of EME at this educational level will be examined. Their perspectives will be studied through narrative frames completed by 60 parents and 30 teachers of these two kindergartens and other preschool institutions, as well as semi-structured interviews with 10 teachers and 20 parents (overall, 90 narrative frame respondents and 30 interview participants). Tentatively guided by the ROAD-MAPPING framework of EME research, the documents, observation/interview data, and narrative frame responses, will be analyzed through qualitative content analysis, inductive phronetic iterative coding, and deductive thematic analysis, respectively. On this basis, the project will offer insights into various dimensions of preschool EME policy and practice in Hong Kong, with implications for non-Anglophone contexts around the world. Moreover, as an internationally pioneering study, the project will provide theoretical perspectives and models for EME research at this educational level and will open pathways for preschool EME research as a distinct area of inquiry. 以英语为媒介语的教学（English-medium instruction, EMI）在非英语国家的实践和研究中已呈现显著扩张趋势，这一扩张主要体现在大学和学校阶段的教育中。尽管学前教育领域也存在类似的活动，且其在政策与实施层面均涉及值得深入探讨的重要研究议题，但有关学前/幼儿园英语媒介教育（English-medium education, EME）的研究仍十分匮乏。随着学前阶段EME的规模不断扩大，探究其在全球非英语语境下新近涌现的多样化问题，对于提升幼儿园EME的质量具有重要意义。 深入理解这一学段的EME，不仅有助于我们全面了解各教育阶段EME的整体图景，也能为作为终身学习基石的学前教育本身提供助力。本项目旨在探索学前EME这一尚待开发的领域，重点考察香港学前阶段EME的相关政策、主流实践以及核心利益相关方的观点，并探究通过EME接触英语可能对幼儿语言态度产生的影响。本研究将首先调查香港官方教育和语言教育（包括授课语言）的文件中是否含有及如何设定与幼儿园EME相关的具体政策。其次，研究将从教学目的、材料使用和活动设计方面考察学前EME的现行实施过程与模式。本次研究将在两所香港本地EME幼儿园进行约六个月的课堂观察（覆盖 K1-K3 共6个班级，约 120 名学生，总计观察 240 节课）。此外，本研究还将通过叙事框架（由60 名家长和 30 名教师填写）和半结构化访谈（与10 名教师和 20 名家长进行）的方式，系统地了解幼儿园教师和幼儿家长对该学段EME不同方面的态度和意见。在数据分析方面，本研究将初步采用EME研究中的 “发展规划（ROAD-MAPPING）” 框架，分别运用定性内容分析、归纳性迭代编码和演绎性主题分析等方法，对政策文件、观察访谈和叙事框架数据进行分析。在此基础上，研究成果将为香港学前EME政策与实践提供多维度的深刻洞见，并为全球其他非英语国家/地区提供借鉴意义。此外，作为一项国际先驱性研究，本项目将为该教育阶段的EME研究提供理论视角和分析模型，并为学前EME作为独立研究领域的发展开辟新路径。

17626025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17626025.value: 評估自然接觸在緩解短視頻應用對都市青少年負面心理健康影響中的有效性：一項實驗研究

17626025.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17626025.value: Prof Chang, Chun-yen Prof LU, Yi Miss Wang, Chuzhen 教授 Yang, Lin Prof Yang, Xue Prof Zhong, Hua

17626025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17626025.value: The excessive use of short-video apps among urban adolescents has emerged as a significant global phenomenon and resulted as a critical challenge of their mental health. Although previous studies suggest that nature exposure may be effective in addressing this issue, few studies have provided direct and comprehensive evidence by adopting multiple methods, measures, and primary life scenes. It’s a critical knowledge gap for policymakers, researchers, and professionals. To address the gap, the proposed study includes two experimental sub-studies related to adolescents’ two primary life scenes: the study scene and the rest scene. The first sub-study will be on the study scene. 90 adolescents will be participants. 30 participants will be randomly assigned to each of three conditions: short-video app condition, nature condition (VR naturalistic park presented in a multisensory cave lab (MCAVE)), and barren condition (VR urban streets; control group). The experiment includes six major steps: 3-min baseline stage, 10-min cognitive task, 10-min short-video or VR exposure, 10-min cognitive task, 10-min short-video or VR exposure, 10-min cognitive task, and a 3-min interview.
