21301325.value: Organic electronics have gained immense attention, since their device properties can be easily tuned by structural modification of organic functional molecules and by interfacial device engineering. Understanding the intrinsic properties of organic functional materials is the key to high-performance organic electronics. Thermally activated delayed fluorescent (TADF) material is an emerging class of metal-free luminescent materials for organic electronics and biological applications. Nowadays, red, green and blue (RGB) TADF materials have achieved excellent efficiencies and stabilities in organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs); however, broadband emission spectra of donor-acceptor-type (DA-type) TADF materials result in relatively low color purity when compared to other luminescent materials, which render DA-type TADF material less competitive. To achieve ultra-high-definition display, the color gamut of RGB color has to be advanced to BT. 2020 standard, in which narrow electroluminescent spectra are needed. Pure organic multi-resonance (MR) materials that possess narrow emissions are considered to be the next-generation luminescent materials. Nonetheless, MR materials reported in the literature always emit at high energy level (<500 nm), while reports on emissions at low energy, especially for red to deep-red color, are limited. Most importantly, NIR MR materials are rarely reported in any literature. Meanwhile, red to deep-red MR materials reported in the literature always exhibit moderate photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) and slow spin-flipping process, that is delayed lifetimes being in the millisecond range, which leads to poor device performance in organic electronics. Undeniably, red and NIR emissive materials are very useful for biological applications. As a result, the research and development of efficient MR materials with emissions at longer wavelengths and high PLQYs is highly demanded. This proposed project seeks to design and synthesize efficient red to NIR MR materials; particularly in an attempt 1) to expand the molecular library of boron-nitrogen-type MR materials with emissions in red/NIR region ; 2) to investigate structure-photophysics relationship of MR-TADF materials and to provide insight and designing principle of MR-TADF materials with efficient reverse intersystem crossing; 3) to demonstrate highly efficient red/NIR OLEDs. The successful implementation of this project will lay the foundation for future development of red and NIR MR materials not only in organic electronics, but also in biological applications. 熱活化延遲螢光材料（TADF）是一類新興的、用於有機電子學和生物應用的無金屬發光材料。目前，紅、綠、藍色（RGB）TADF材料在有機發光二極體（OLED）中已實現優異的效率和穩定性；但因發射光譜較寬導致其發光色純度較低，這削弱了TADF材料的競爭力。為實現超高清顯示，RGB光色的色域需要滿足BT.2020標準，而該標準要求使用窄光譜電致發光器件。具有窄譜發射的無金屬發光材料，多重共振型熱活化延遲螢光材料（MR-TADF）被認為是最有前途的第三代有機發光材料。由於其獨特的光物理性質、靈活的結構可調性、良好的生物相容性以及生產成本低等優勢，無金屬的TADF材料在生物醫學領域包括常規螢光成像、時間分辨成像、生物傳感以及光動力治療方面展現出巨大潛力。然而，相較於發展迅速的藍光和綠光MR材料，紅光材料受困於有限的紅移策略、較大的分子量以及複雜的合成方法，進展緩慢；同時，該類材料面臨著嚴重的濃度淬滅效應、發射半峰寬窄化困難、激發態壽命過長等諸多挑戰，導致相關電致發光器件效率不佳、發光色純度不高、穩定性難以提升。因此，在維持較高色純度的前提下，如何實現光譜窄化與紅移已成為學術界和工業界亟待突破的核心難題。 本專案旨在設計與合成高效的紅光及近紅外MR材料；特別致力於：1）擴展硼氮雜稠環體系的紅光/近紅外發射MR材料的分子設計框架；2）研究MR-TADF材料的結構-光物理關係，為具有高反向系間竄越（RISC）的MR-TADF材料的激子利用機制提供深入理解；3）設計並合成具有高反向系間竄越速率（kRISC）的MR紅光/近紅外材料，製備紅光/近紅外OLED器件。本專案的成功實施將為紅光及近紅外MR材料在有機電子學乃至生物醫學領域的未來發展奠定基礎。

21301925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21301925.value: 关于绝对连续分布的随机梯度流

21301925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21301925.value: As a research filed with rich background, stochastic analysis employs probabilistic techniques to address core problems in pure mathematics and applied fields. Well- known theories include Itô calculus, Malliavin calculus, and Dirichlet form theory. Applications of stochastic analysis have made significant contributions, as evidenced by awards such as the Nobel Prize in Economics (Merton and Scholes, 1997) and Fields Medals (Villani, 2010; Hairer, 2014). The study of the Wasserstein space originated from Monge’s optimal transport problem, for which Kantorovich's probabilistic solution earned a Nobel Prize in Economics in 1975. The Wasserstein space, with its rich topological, geometrical, and analytical structures, serves as an interdisciplinary research tool linking areas like probability theory and partial differential equations. To develop stochastic analysis in the Wasserstein space, measure-valued diffusion processes have been constructed by using Dirichlet forms and stochastic differential equations. However, these processes are either only supported on the space of singular measures or are highly degenerate, failing to provide the uniform non-degenerate noise necessary to drive stochastic systems in the Wasserstein space. Recently, the principal investigator and collaborators have constructed a class of Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (O-U) processes that could be candidates for the desired reference processes. However, it remains unclear whether these processes are supported on the space of absolutely continuous measures. This project aims to develop stochastic analysis in the Wasserstein space by constructing and solving stochastic gradient flows for absolutely continuous measures, using energy functionals(i.e. Hamiltonian potentials for interactions) defined by densities. A typical energy functional is entropy, widely used in probability theory and control theory, etc. Precisely, we will focus on the following problems: 1. Construct O-U Type Diffusion Processes: Develop O-U type diffusion processes on the space of absolutely continuous elements in the Wasserstein space. 2. Solve Stochastic Gradient Flows: Formulate and solve stochastic gradient flows for density functions driven by O-U type processes, with drifts given by the intrinsic derivative of energy functions. 3. Investigate Properties of Solutions:Analyse properties of solutions to stochastic gradient flows for density functions, including functional inequalities and the regularity of semigroups. By studying these problems, we aim to establish a new framework and develop new techniques for stochastic analysis in the Wasserstein space. The expected outcomes will be valuable for further development in related fields, such as the theory can be applied to characterize the well-posedness, regularities, and long-term asymptotic of Fokker-Planck equations in the Wasserstein space. 本项目旨在发展Wasserstein空间上的随机分析。通过解决以及构造由密度定义的能量泛函来考虑绝对连续测度的随机梯度流。相对熵就是经典的能量泛函，它们被广泛引用于概率论，信息论，控制论以及天体物理学等。 我们将主要研究以下的三类问题： 1）构造Wasserstein空间上由绝对连续的元素所组成的空间的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck型的扩散过程。 2）解决由Ornstein-Uhlenbeck型的过程所驱动的密度函数的随机梯度流,其中漂移系数是由能量泛函的内蕴形式给出。 3）研究由密度形式给出的随机梯度流的解的性质，比如泛函不等式以及半裙的正则性质。

21305525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21305525.value: 多人群全轉錄組關聯研究的統計方法開發

21305525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21305525.value: Although Genome-wide association studies (GWASs) have successfully identified many risk variants associated with complex human phenotypes, most variants are located in the non-coding region, suggesting their regulatory role through the change of gene expression. By integrating GWASs and resources from expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) mapping studies, transcriptome-wide association studies (TWASs) seek to determine the influence of genetically regulated gene expression (GREX) on complex traits. However, the diverse genetic backgrounds in eQTL samples presents significant challenges for conventional TWAS, which often rely on single-ancestry eQTL models. These methods are usually not generalizable to other ancestries due to variations in genetic architectures across different ancestries. Besides, the polygenic architecture of complex traits remains a major issue that causes inflation in TWAS. To address above challenges, we propose a unified statistical framework for multi-ancestry TWAS. In our pilot study, we propose a TWAS method to integrate multi-ancestry eQTL data and account for the polygenicity of complex traits (MAPO). A distinctive feature of MAPO is its ability to leverage ancestry-consistent eQTL signals, which enables more accurate characterization of eQTL effects across diverse ancestries, yielding enhanced TWAS power in a target ancestry. MAPO also explicitly characterizes the polygenic effects through its model design, producing well-controlled type-I errors. Unlike existing two-step TWAS procedures, MAPO employs a joint likelihood model that accounts for prediction uncertainty, which ensures statistical accuracy when working with eQTL data from under-represented ancestries. Preliminary results demonstrate MAPO's enhanced power and controlled type-I error compared to existing methods. Notably, we identified novel gene associations linked to complex traits, such as asthma, while successfully replicating known associations. Given the promising results, we propose several extensions for MAPO. First, it will be generalized to work with summary-level data, broadening its applicability to various phenotypes. Second, we plan to enhance computational efficiency by introducing a Monte-Carlo Expectation-Maximization algorithm. Third, we aim to extend MAPO to infer ancestry-specific gene-trait associations, facilitating the investigation of cross-ancestry heterogeneity in TWAS effects. The novelty of this research lies in its innovative unified model that utilizes multi-ancestry eQTL resources to overcome the generalizability issue of traditional TWAS methods. The unified model bridges the gap between diverse genetic backgrounds while naturally accounts for the uncertainty that was ignored by conventional methods. We believe that the proposed framework will advance the field of human genetics and deepen our understanding of complex traits across global populations, ultimately offering equitable healthcare and therapeutic guidance. 盡管全基因組關聯研究（GWAS）成功識別了許多與覆雜人類表型相關的風險變異，但大多數變異位於非編碼區，這表明它們可能通過改變基因表達發揮調控作用。通過整合GWAS和表達量性狀關聯位點（eQTL）研究的數據資源，全轉錄組關聯研究（TWAS）旨在確定由遺傳調控的基因表達（GREX）對覆雜表型的影響。然而，由於傳統TWAS方法通常依賴於單一祖源的eQTL模型，常見於eQTL樣本中的種群多樣性對傳統TWAS帶來重大挑戰。由於不同祖先群體中遺傳結構的差異，這些方法通常無法推廣到來自其他祖源的人群。此外，覆雜表型的基因多效性也可能導致TWAS的I類錯誤率不受控。為了應對這些挑戰，我們提出了一個用於多祖先TWAS的統一概率框架。在前期研究中，我們提出了整合多祖先eQTL數據，並考慮覆雜表型的基因多效性的TWAS（MAPO）。MAPO的獨特之處在於其可以利用不同種群中共享的eQTL信號，從而更準確地刻畫不同祖先群體中eQTL相似性，提高目標種群中TWAS的功效。MAPO通過其模型設計充分地考慮了多基因效應，使得I類錯誤得到有效控制。與現有的兩步TWAS方法不同，MAPO利用聯合似然模型考慮了基因表達預測的不確定性，從而在樣本量不足的低代表度人群中依然能夠保持統計準確性。初步結果表明，MAPO相比現有方法表現出更優異的統計功效和受控的I類錯誤率。值得注意的是，我們利用MAPO在成功發現了已知與覆雜表型（如哮喘）關聯的基因的同時，還發現了與之相關的新基因。基於上述前期研究的結果，我們提出了對MAPO的幾個擴展方向。首先，我們將推廣MAPO以允許其使用匯總數據，從而擴大其對各種表型的適用性。其次，我們計劃通過引入蒙特卡羅期望最大化算法來提高計算效率。第三，我們計劃將推廣MAPO用來推斷人群特異性的相關基因。

21306325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21306325.value: 擴散模型的數學基礎探索

21306325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21306325.value: Diffusion models are a powerful generative AI technology that has made significant strides in areas like computer vision, natural language processing, and computational biology. However, despite their empirical success, the mathematical understanding of diffusion models is still underdeveloped. This lack of theoretical grounding may limit further innovation and prevent the models from reaching their full potential. This research seeks to address these theoretical gaps, with a dual focus: (1) to enhance the computational efficiency of diffusion models by improving their convergence rates, and (2) to deepen the theoretical understanding of their robustness, especially when applied to datasets with challenges such as class imbalances, outliers, and non-Gaussian characteristics. Specifically, the project will concentrate on two main directions. First, we propose novel frameworks, along with new discretization schemes and parallelization techniques, to boost the efficiency of diffusion models while ensuring rigorous performance guarantees. Second, we plan to explore the behavior of diffusion models under heavy-tailed noise distributions and provide theoretical guarantees regarding their robustness and reliability. It is important to note that diffusion models are inherently related to sampling, as they generate samples by progressively transforming noise into data through a series of stochastic steps. In essence, diffusion models rely on the process of sampling from complex distributions, with the model's efficiency and accuracy closely tied to the effectiveness of the underlying sampling techniques. Building on the PI’s previous work in sampling theory, particularly in collaboration with Arnak Dalalyan on log-concave sampling, this research continues efforts to deepen the theoretical understanding of sampling methods. Ultimately, this project aims to generate new insights that strengthen the mathematical foundations of diffusion models, enhancing their real-world applications and supporting further advancements in AI. 擴散模型作為新一代生成式人工智慧的重要技術，在計算機視覺、自然語言處理、強化學習及計算生物學等領域取得了顯著成果。然而，儘管其在實踐中展現出卓越性能，對擴散模型的數學機理仍缺乏系統而深入的理論認識。這一不足不僅制約了方法論的持續創新，也可能限制其在更廣泛場景中的應用潛力。 本研究旨在彌補這一理論空白，圍繞兩個核心目標展開：（1）通過提升收斂速度以顯著提高擴散模型的計算效率；（2）深化其在複雜資料情境下的魯棒性理論分析，特別關注類別不平衡、離群點及非高斯特徵等典型挑戰。 在研究路徑上，專案將重點推進兩方面工作：其一，構建新的理論框架，並設計高效的離散化方案與平行化策略，在嚴謹的性能保證下提升模型效率；其二，系統刻畫擴散模型在重尾雜訊（如 α-穩定過程）驅動下的動態行為，並建立其魯棒性與可靠性的理論保障體系。 值得強調的是，擴散模型本質上依賴於採樣機制，即通過一系列隨機步驟逐步將雜訊轉化為資料。因此，其效率與精度高度依賴於底層採樣方法的有效性。基於專案負責人在採樣理論方面的前期成果，特別是與 Arnak Dalalyan 在對數凸採樣方向的合作研究，本專案將在理論分析與方法設計上進一步拓展與深化。 預期而言，該研究將為擴散模型奠定更加堅實的數學基礎，推動其在實際應用中的性能提升，並為人工智慧領域的持續發展提供重要的理論與方法支持。

21307225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21307225.value: 完全非线性Yamabe问题的存在性、紧性与奇点分析

21307225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21307225.value: This proposal focuses on fully nonlinear Yamabe problems and related fully nonlinear elliptic equations. The classical Yamabe problem, formulated as a semilinear elliptic equation, seeks a conformal metric with constant scalar curvature. The fully nonlinear Yamabe problem generalizes this by considering more general curvature quantities, often resulting in fully nonlinear, and possibly non-uniformly, elliptic equations. Building on my previous works on Liouville theorems, the first part of the proposal targets the existence and compactness of solutions to fully nonlinear Yamabe problems. Our research emphasizes the development of viscosity solution theories for those fully nonlinear elliptic equations arising from conformal geometry. In the second part, we investigate the removability of non-isolated singularities in these equations. Ultimately, we aim to develop a comprehensive viscosity theory that can advance the study of fully nonlinear Yamabe problems. 本项目围绕完全非线性 Yamabe 问题及相关椭圆方程展开研究。经典 Yamabe 问题可表述为一个半线性椭圆方程，目标是寻找常数量曲率的共形度量。完全非线性 Yamabe 问题在此基础上推广，涉及更一般的曲率量，通常导致完全非线性且可能非一致椭圆的方程，从而带来新的数学挑战。 本研究基于我们关于最优 Liouville 定理的近期工作，主要聚焦于两个核心方向： 一是存在性与紧性。 我们计划发展新的分析方法，在局部共形平坦流形上建立最优存在性与紧性定理，并研究一类复杂边值问题。前者的难点在于目标度量的数量曲率允许变号，导致传统分析工具失效；后者的挑战则在于边界导数估计的困难。 二是非孤立奇点的可去奇性。 我们计划进一步发展粘性解理论，以获得光滑及非光滑集合的最优可去奇性定理。最终，本项目旨在构建系统的粘性解框架，推进完全非线性 Yamabe问题的研究，并为相关PDE提供新的分析工具。

21309225.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21309225.value: 透過氧化還原可調控的共價有機框架酸實現常溫下胺再生應用於碳捕獲

21309225.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21309225.value: Effective carbon capture technologies are essential for mitigating climate change, particularly in light of the Paris Agreement’s goal to limit global temperature increases to below 2 °C. Traditional carbon capture methods, such as amine scrubbing, suffer from high energy demands, sorbent degradation, and operational complexity, limiting their scalability. Electrochemically mediated carbon capture (EMCC) has emerged as a promising alternative, using electricity from renewable sources to drive CO2 capture and release under ambient conditions. However, the development of efficient, stable redox-active materials remains a significant bottleneck for advancing this technology. This proposal aims to address these challenges by developing a new class of redox-tunable covalent organic framework (COF) acids, designed to enhance the efficiency and longevity of EMCC systems. These materials will enable electrochemical amine regeneration at ambient conditions, optimizing CO2 capture performance. We will investigate proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) mechanisms between the COF acids and amine-based CO2 sorbents and build a prototype fixed-bed EMCC device to demonstrate their practical application. The project has the potential to overcome key challenges in EMCC and electrochemically mediated amine regeneration (EMAR) technologies, such as sorbent degradation, insufficient CO2 capacity, and slow kinetics. The successful development of these redox-responsive materials could also open new avenues for applications in organic synthesis, catalysis, and energy storage. Moreover, by integrating renewable energy sources like wind power, this research could contribute to Hong Kong’s climate goals, including the Climate Action Plan 2030+ and the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals, while positioning Hong Kong as a hub for carbon capture innovation. 高效碳捕獲技術對緩解氣候變化至關重要，尤其基於《巴黎協定》將全球升溫控制在2°C內的目標。傳統碳捕集方法如胺液洗滌存在高能耗、吸附劑降解與操作複雜性等缺陷，限制其規模化應用。電化學介導碳捕獲（EMCC）作為新興技術，利用可再生能源電力驅動常溫條件下的二氧化碳捕集與釋放，展現顯著優勢。然而，高效穩定的氧化還原活性材料開發仍是該技術突破的關鍵瓶頸。本計劃擬研發新型氧化還原可調控共價有機框架酸（COF酸），突破現有EMCC系統效能限制。此材料將實現常溫條件下的電化學胺再生，優化二氧化碳捕集效率。研究重點包含：1) 闡明COF酸與胺基吸附劑間的質子耦合電子轉移（PCET）機制；2) 構建固定床EMCC原型裝置驗證實際應用。此技術有望解決電化學介導胺再生（EMAR）系統中吸附劑降解、二氧化碳吸附量不足及動力學遲緩等核心難題。所開發的氧化還原響應材料更可延伸應用於有機合成、催化及能源儲存等領域。 此研究特別結合風力發電等再生能源，不僅符合香港《氣候行動藍圖2030+》及聯合國可持續發展目標，更有助鞏固香港在碳捕獲創新技術的區域樞紐地位。通過跨學科材料設計與工程化驗證，本項目將為碳中和目標提供具有商業化潛力的技術解決方案。

21309625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21309625.value: 几何图像表示的变分基础

21309625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21309625.value: Image representation reflects how visual information is processed through perception, and the functional perspective of images leads to variational approaches in computational theory of vision. Mumford and Shah proposed a representation characterized by smooth regions separated by finitely many continuously differentiable boundaries. Although the Mumford and Shah (MS) model has been widely applied, it does not predict image features of all dimensions, including 0-dimensional curvature extrema and X-junctions. An alternative approach to enrich the model involves the explicit construction of the desired geometric elements, an approach largely relying on heuristics. This significant gap cannot be easily bridged by traditional Finite Element Method (FEM) for the MS functional nor by recent developments in network-based techniques. In this project, we focus on the variational foundation of geometric image representation. Our work advances the classical MS functional towards composability and controllability. The proposed new models will define and use piecewise smooth multidimensional primitives to characterize the interaction between the different image features. Our first goal is to establish novel variational frameworks for image representation containing critical visual cues across all dimensions. To allow for explicit modeling for these elements, we will develop our models in a subspace of SBV, the space of special functions with bounded variation initially introduced by the de Giorgi school to solve the Mumford-Shah conjecture. Notably, we aim for models with explicit regularization on representational complexity. This framework will improve our previous formalization for piecewise constant vector graphics and extend to piecewise smooth images. Our second goal is to propose an effective scheme to generate quadrilateral meshes which are compatible with image singularities. It bypasses the obstruction from two-dimensional patches to one-dimensional singular set of the traditional methods. Finally, we plan to develop publicly available programs accompanied with accessible online demos. 图像表示反映了视觉信息如何通过感知被处理，而图像的功能视角则导向了计算视觉理论中的变分方法。Mumford和Shah提出了一种以有限多个连续可微边界分隔的光滑区域为特征的表征方式。尽管Mumford-Shah（MS）模型已得到广泛应用，但它并不能预测所有维度的图像特征，包括零维曲率极值和X型交叉点。另一种增强模型的替代方法涉及对所需几何元素的显式构建，这种方法很大程度上依赖于启发式策略。无论是传统的有限元方法（FEM）处理MS泛函，还是近年来基于网络技术的新进展，都难以轻易填补这一重大空白。 本项目聚焦于几何图像表示的变分基础。我们的工作将经典MS泛函向可组合性和可控性推进。提出的新模型将定义并使用分段光滑的多维基元来表征不同图像特征间的相互作用。 我们的首要目标是建立包含全维度关键视觉线索的图像表示新型变分框架。为实现对这些元素的显式建模，我们将在SBV子空间（即由de Giorgi学派最初为解决Mumford-Shah猜想而引入的有界变差特殊函数空间）中开发模型。特别值得注意的是，我们致力于构建具有显式表示复杂度正则化的模型。该框架将改进我们先前对分段常数矢量图形的形式化方法，并扩展至分段光滑图像领域。第二个目标是提出生成与图像奇异结构兼容的四边形网格的有效方案，此举将突破传统方法从二维面片到一维奇异集的映射障碍。最后，我们计划开发配套可公开获取的程序及易于访问的在线演示平台。

21502725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21502725.value: 非均匀缺失下的广义张量补全

21502725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21502725.value: Tensor completion is a fundamental challenge in tensor data analysis, focusing on imputing missing or unobserved entries in partially observed tensors. Data incompleteness can arise from various unpredictable reasons, including system limitations and random missingness. Previous approaches predominantly addressed scenarios with random missing values, restricting their applicability in real-world situations. To overcome this limitation, we propose a generalized tensor completion model that effectively imputes missing entries by modeling the missing data mechanism using logistic regression, treating the unknown tensor entries as covariates. In our proposed model, the tensor entries is partially observed and subject to noise, making the true values unknown. The effect of this entry is flexible: when the effect is zero, the missingness is uniform; when it is non-zero, the missingness is nonuniform. Furthermore, the covariate effect is allowed to be substantial, then the probability of missing data can approach 0 or 1 as the number of dimensions increases. This flexibility enhances the generality of our model. The proposed model also accommodates multiple types of observed tensors, including continuous variable, binary variable and any other form of variables. This is achieved by employing different link functions, such as identity link, logit link and so on. This versatility enables our model to generalize across various data types. For estimation, we introduce a likelihood-based optimization function. This optimization problem is nontrivial, as it is a non-convex optimization with constraints and a complex loss. This is due to the presence of unobserved entries, the low-rank structure of the tensor and various form of link functions. To address this, we develop an alternating block updating algorithm that decomposes the original problem into several conditional maximization subproblems, each of which is convex and computationally tractable. The theoretical analysis presents challenges due to the non-convexity stemming from the tensor’s low-rank structure, logistic regression with unknown covariates, and the intricacies of the link functions. Our preliminary results demonstrate that when the link function is the logit function and the true rank is 1, our proposed algorithm converges geometrically to a neighbourhood that is statistically precise relative to the true parameter, given suitable initialization. This finding remains valid even when the missing probability approaches 1. 张量填充是张量数据分析中的一个重要问题，主要关注于对部分观测的张量中缺失数值的填补。数据不完整性可能由于各种不可预测的原因而产生，包括系统限制和随机缺失。大多数现有方法主要解决了随机缺失值的情况，这限制了它们在现实世界中的应用。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种广义的张量补全模型，该模型通过使用逻辑回归对缺失数据机制进行建模，将未知的张量条目视为协变量，从而有效地填补缺失条目。 在我们提出的模型中，张量条目是部分观测的，并且受到噪声的影响，使得真实值未知。这个条目的影响是灵活的：当影响为零时，缺失是完全随机的；当影响不为零时，缺失则是不完全随机的。此外，张量条目作为协变量的影响可能很显著，因此缺失数据的概率可以接近于0或1。这种灵活性增强了我们模型的普适性。该模型还适用于多种类型的观测张量，包括连续变量、二元变量和其他形式的变量。这是通过采用不同的连接函数来实现的，例如恒等连接、logit连接等。这种多功能性使我们的模型能够适用于各种数据类型。 为了进行估计，我们引入了一个基于似然的优化函数。这个优化问题并不简单，因为它是一个具有约束和复杂损失函数的非凸优化问题。这个问题的难点来自于未观测的张量条目、张量的低秩结构以及各种形式的连接函数。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种交替模块更新算法，将原始问题分解为若干条件最大化子问题，每个子问题都是凸的且计算上可处理的。 理论分析同样也面临着挑战，这些挑战来源于张量的低秩结构、未知协变量的逻辑回归以及连接函数的复杂性。我们的初步结果表明，当连接函数是logit函数且真实秩为1时，所提出的算法在合适的初始化条件下会收敛到一个真实参数的邻域，其邻域半径由统计误差决定。即使在缺失概率接近1时，这一发现仍然有效。

21505825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21505825.value: 具有长提前期的不可分产品库存管理的在线学习研究

21505825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21505825.value: Effective inventory management is crucial for businesses, particularly those dealing with indivisible products and long lead times. These challenges are prevalent in industries such as automobiles, semiconductor, and construction, where lead times can extend to several months. Traditional inventory models often assume divisible products and known demand distributions, leading to suboptimal decisions when applied to real-world scenarios with discrete items and uncertain demand. Recently, an efficient inventory policy, termed “bracket policy”, is proposed for indivisible products. This policy alternates between two consecutive integer order quantities and is proven to be asymptotically optimal as the lead time approaches infinity. However, implementing this policy requires prior knowledge of demand distribution, which is often unavailable in practice. This research proposal aims to bridge the gap between theoretical models and practical realities by developing an adaptive inventory management approach for indivisible products with large lead times. Our primary objectives are to develop an efficient online learning algorithm to balance the exploration-exploitation tradeoff while optimizing inventory decisions and to demonstrate the theoretical efficiency of our proposed algorithm by establishing a tight regret bound. We also plan to extend our approach to the more general setting of stochastic lead times. To achieve these objectives, we plan to leverage techniques from online learning theory, Markov chains, and insights from our previous work on bracket policies. If successful, the research output of this project will significantly contribute to the literature on inventory management with online learning. Moreover, the proposed adaptive approach will provide practical tools for practitioners to manage their inventory effectively in real-world settings with uncertain demand and long lead times. 有效的库存管理对企业至关重要，尤其是涉及不可分产品与长提前期的行业。此类挑战普遍存在于汽车、半导体和建筑等领域，其提前期可长达数月。传统库存模型通常假设产品可分割且需求分布已知，当应用于离散化产品与不确定需求的实际场景时，往往导致次优决策。近期，一种针对不可分产品的高效库存策略——"取整策略"被提出，该策略在相邻整数订单量间交替，并被证明在提前期趋近无限时具有渐近最优性。然而，其实施需预先获知需求分布，这在实际中往往难以实现。 本项目旨在通过开发面向长提前期不可分产品的自适应库存管理方法，弥合理论模型与实践的鸿沟。核心目标包括：1）设计高效的在线学习算法以平衡"探索-利用"权衡，优化库存决策；2）通过建立严格的遗憾界来保证算法的有效性；3）将方法拓展至随机提前期的更一般场景。为实现目标，我们将融合在线学习理论、马尔可夫链技术及前期关于取整策略的研究成果。若成功，本项目成果将为库存管理的在线学习研究作出重要贡献，同时为从业者提供实用工具，帮助其在需求不确定与长提前期的现实场景中实现高效库存管理。

21506425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21506425.value: 员工怀旧的双重性质：以情感和渴望为导向的怀旧及其对员工成果的影响

21506425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21506425.value: Research on nostalgia—a wistful affection or sentimental longing for the past—has primarily emphasized its benefits for individuals. However, recent studies suggest that nostalgia can also have a detrimental effect on individuals, leading to confusion regarding its nature and functioning. This project aims to reconcile these mixed findings by introducing two distinct types of nostalgia that can differentially impact employee outcomes: affection- and longing-oriented nostalgia. Drawing from self-regulation theory, we propose that affection-oriented nostalgia, characterized by fondness and affection for the past, is likely to enhance employee performance and citizenship behavior by fostering greater engagement. In contrast, longing-oriented nostalgia, characterized by a strong desire to return to the past, may promote employee withdrawal and counterproductive work behavior by depleting employees’ self-regulatory resources. In sum, this project seeks to reconcile conflicting findings in the literature and deepen our understanding of nostalgia, suggesting that it can be both beneficial and detrimental depending on the type of nostalgia being experienced. 怀旧——一种对过去的怀念或感伤的渴望——的研究主要强调其对个人的益处。然而，最近的研究表明，怀旧也可能对个人产生有害影响，导致人们对其性质和功能产生困惑。本项目旨在通过介绍两种不同类型的怀旧来调和这些不一致的研究结果，这两种怀旧类型会对员工绩效产生不同的影响：以情感为导向的怀旧和以渴望为导向的怀旧。借鉴自我调节理论，我们认为，以情感为导向的怀旧，其特征是对过去的喜爱和情感，可能通过促进更高的参与度来提高员工绩效和公民行为。相反，以渴望为导向的怀旧，其特征是强烈渴望回到过去，可能会通过耗尽员工的自我调节资源来促进适得其反的工作行为和员工的退缩。总之，该项目旨在调和文献中相互矛盾的发现，加深我们对怀旧的理解，表明根据所经历的怀旧类型，怀旧既可以是有益的，也可以是有害的。

21509125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21509125.value: 消費者信念兩極化與新聞供給

21509125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21509125.value: Consumers seek information to improve their understanding about the true state of the world. The value of such information typically depends on its accuracy, and the subsequent reduction in consumer uncertainty. To meet consumers’ needs, news media firms can invest in investigation to produce accurate information. However, polarization in consumers’ beliefs poses challenges to the provision of accurate information. In this project, we study the impact of polarization on news accuracy. Our preliminary analysis reveals that either an increase in the belief intensity of extreme consumers or an increase in the share of extreme consumers can make reporting less accurate. This is because polarization makes consumers more certain about the state of the world, reducing their perceived value of news. Interestingly, polarization may lead a monopolistic firm to change its target audience, increasing its accuracy under certain conditions. We also find that a larger share of extreme consumers can result in higher accuracy under competition. We plan to build on the preliminary analysis and incorporate several important factors to further illuminate the impact of polarization. We also plan to explore the implications of consumer heterogeneity in valuation for news, their objectives in news consumption, as well as media firms’ revenue models. Our results will provide insights for media firm managers on how to position their information products amid increasing consumer polarization and offer guidance for policymakers to improve the information environment. 消費者通過尋求資訊以加深對世界真實狀況的理解。資訊對於消費者的價值通常取決於其準確性，以及其在降低消費者的不確定性方面的效能。為了滿足消費者的需求，新聞媒體機構投入資源進行調查，以產出更為準確的資訊。然而，消費者信念的兩極化對準確資訊的提供構成了挑戰。本研究項目旨在探討信念極化對新聞的準確性的影響。我們的初步分析顯示，無論是持極端立場之消費者的信念變得更強烈，或是該群體在整體中的佔比上升，均可能導致新聞的準確性下降。這是因為信念極化使消費者對世界狀態更為確信，進而降低了其對的新聞價值的主觀評估。有趣的是，在某些條件下，信念極化可能促使壟斷媒體調整其目標受眾，從而提升其新聞的準確性。此外，在競爭性市場中，極端立場消費者的比例上升可能會提高新聞的準確性。我們計劃在初步分析的基礎上，納入若干關鍵因素，以進一步揭示信念極化對新聞供給的影響。我們亦將探討消費者在新聞價值評估上的異質性、其消費新闻的動機，以及媒體機構的盈利模式的影響。相關研究結果將為新聞媒體在日益極化的環境下如何定位其資訊產品提供洞見，並為政策制定者優化資訊環境提供參考。

21600325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21600325.value: ChatGPT 演绎莎士比亚：文学改编与生成式人工智能

21600325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21600325.value: On October 2, 2024, the news portal TechCrunch reported that OpenAI, creator of the generative AI (GenAI) ChatGPT, had just ‘closed the largest VC [Venture Capital] round of all time,’ raising 6.6 billion US dollars to increase its overall valuation to 157 billion US dollars (Wiggers 2024). AI is the boom industry of the moment. In the shadow of a media discourse dominated in equal parts by excitement and visions of doom, scholars from the humanities and social sciences are working to critically assess the material, social, and philosophical underpinnings and implications of GenAI. Machines can now produce convincingly human-like language based purely on statistical probabilities. What does this mean for traditionally anthropocentric concepts like meaning, subjectivity, and authorship? And how can we study a technology that is, as a deep neural network as well as by corporate fiat, a black box? This innovative interdisciplinary project will seek answers to these questions by studying GenAI through the lens of literary adaptation, particularly Shakespeare adaptation. The project builds on previous work by the PI (Winckler 2017; 2020; 2021) and employs theoretical frameworks developed in literary adaptation studies, Shakespeare studies, critical AI studies and digital humanities. The project’s goal is to demonstrate that understanding GenAIs as adaptation machines allows for new insights into the meaning and ethical import of AI-generated texts. Studying AI-generated adaptations of the plays of William Shakespeare, which are the most widely adapted works of literature in history and have played a crucial role in the development of modern western notions of authorship and subjectivity, creates an opening in the black box of AI. The PI will systematically generate, read, computationally analyse, and interpret GenAI adaptations of Shakespeare and compare them with their source texts as well as with human-made adaptations. This analysis will result in a clearer understanding of how GenAI output relates to human-made texts. The project will also put its AI-generated Shakespeare adaptations into practice by integrating them into university teaching and performing them in student theatre, bridging the gap between GenAI and the real world. The results of this project will have a major impact on current debates about GenAI’s ‘creative’ capabilities, agency, and authorship status, and will yield suggestions about how to address ethical dilemmas associated with AI outputs such as racist and sexist bias, plagiarism, and copyright violations. 024年10月2日，新闻门户网站TechCrunch报道称，生成式人工智能（GenAI）ChatGPT的创造者OpenAI刚刚“完成了史上最大规模的风险投资”，筹集了66亿美元，使其整体估值达到1570亿美元（Wiggers，2024）。人工智能是当下蓬勃发展的产业。在媒体话语中，兴奋与悲观的论调并存，人文社会科学领域的学者们正致力于批判性地评估GenAI的物质、社会和哲学基础及其含义。如今，机器可以仅基于统计概率，创造出令人信服的类人语言。这对于传统上以人类为中心的概念，例如意义、主观性和作者身份，意味着什么？那么，我们如何研究一项既像深度神经网络，又像企业指令般如同黑匣子的技术呢？这个创新的跨学科项目将通过文学改编（尤其是莎士比亚作品改编）的视角来研究GenAI，以寻求这些问题的答案。该项目以首席研究员（Winckler，2017；2020；2021）的先前研究为基础，并运用文学改编研究、莎士比亚研究、批判性人工智能研究和数字人文学科中发展起来的理论框架。该项目旨在证明，将GenAI理解为改编机器，能够为理解人工智能生成文本的意义和伦理意义提供新的视角。威廉·莎士比亚戏剧是历史上改编最广泛的文学作品，在现代西方作者身份和主观性观念的发展中发挥了至关重要的作用。研究人工智能生成的莎士比亚戏剧改编作品，将为人工智能的“黑匣子”打开一扇新的大门。该研究项目的主要负责人将系统地生成、阅读、计算分析和解读GenAI改编的莎士比亚作品，并将其与原著以及人工改编作品进行比较。这项分析将有助于更清晰地理解GenAI的输出与人工改编文本之间的关系。该项目还将把人工智能生成的莎士比亚改编作品付诸实践，将其融入大学教学并在学生剧场进行表演，从而弥合GenAI与现实世界之间的差距。该项目的成果将对当前关于GenAI“创作”能力、自主权和作者身份的争论产生重大影响，并将就如何解决与人工智能输出相关的伦理困境（例如种族主义和性别歧视、抄袭和版权侵权）提出建议。

21605425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21605425.value: Modern investors face a complex, high-dimensional prediction problem. To forecast asset returns, they must rely on a wide range of diverse and high-dimensional data sources, from credit card data and satellite imagery of crude oil tankers to web-forum discussions. Confronted with such vast datasets, investors have begun to utilize advanced learning methods, including statistical learning and stochastic optimization techniques, designed to address computational challenges and the curse of dimensionality (Chen, Bolton, Holmström, Maskin, Pissarides, Spence, Sun, Sun, Xiong, Yang et al., 2021; Goldstein, Spatt and Ye, 2021). Investor heterogeneity can generate endogenous, price-based signals that enable investors to extract information not only about asset fundamentals but also about the trading behaviors of other market participants. This is consistent with empirical observations, where institutional investors often analyze historical price and volume data to infer competitors' strategies and private information while simultaneously attempting to obscure their own forecasting and trading strategies through order submissions (Yang and Zhu, 2020). Due to the complexity in modeling agents' strategic behaviors in high-dimensional settings using game theory, the current literature lacks comprehensive game-theoretical models to analyze this intricate strategic interaction. For instance, Martin and Nagel (2020); Chen, Hu and Yang (2022); Da, Nagel and Xiu (2022) and my previous work, Balasubramanian and Yang (2019), focus on single-agent or single-period models. These simplifications limit our understanding of how investors dynamically learn about each other's strategies over time, as reflected in equilibrium trading volumes and asset return patterns. A dynamic model is essential to fully grasp the evolution of asset returns over time, providing valuable insights into the statistical properties of market efficiency tests. Such a model could illuminate future empirical research on market microstructure and asset pricing. N/A

21605525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21605525.value: 透過減少種族偏見及增強多元文化能力， 提升華人社會工作者對少數族裔兒童與青少年的服務能力

21605525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21605525.value: This study aims to develop an evidence-based model for an anti-racial prejudice and multicultural competence curriculum, especially for the Hong Kong Chinese context. The primary objectives are to enhance social workers’ knowledge, skills, and awareness to support ethnic minority (EM) children and youth, addressing the urgent need for culturally relevant anti-racism education. Motivated by evidence that racism adversely impacts mental and physical health, academic performance, and access to social services and healthcare (Bécares et al., 2022; Priest et al., 2014), this research highlights the ongoing systemic racism affecting non-Chinese EM populations in Hong Kong. Those from poorer backgrounds or with darker skin face barriers rooted in historical prejudices. The current social work curriculum inadequately addresses these issues, limiting practitioners’ effectiveness (Kwok et al., 2018; 2024). Furthermore, the Hong Kong Social Workers’ Registration Board does not mandate the elimination of racial discrimination and multicultural competence training (Kwan & Cui, 2022), and existing multicultural training offered by NGOs often overlooks anti-racist components. Literature shows a significant lack of culturally relevant anti-racism training for social workers in the Asian context, despite calls for its essential integration into multicultural competence training (Boyle & Springer, 2001; Danos, 2015; Sue et al., 2016). This study aims to bridge these gaps by incorporating indigenous knowledge and effective strategies into the training program, aligning local practices with international standards. The study employs a mixed-methods approach in two stages (30 months). The first stage involves developing a multicultural competence and anti-racism training curriculum based on the multicultural competence framework by Sue et al. (2016) and various anti-racial prejudice models (e.g., Beelmann & Heinemann, 2014), informed by focus-group interviews with EM community members and Chinese social workers. The second stage will consist of a controlled trial involving 216 Chinese social workers from community service, children and youth services, and rehabilitation services. This will include three arms: one receiving combined strategies, one without contact, and a waitlist control. Multilevel regression models will evaluate the effectiveness of the intervention programs. This research will enhance multicultural social work scholarship by examining different constructs within the Hong Kong context, integrating indigenous knowledge, and aligning local practices with international standards. Besides, it addresses global sustainable development initiatives (SDG 3 and 10), promoting health and equality. Expected outcomes include a refined conceptual model, a practical training manual, and policy recommendations for enhancing social work curricula and advocating for targeted prejudice reduction campaigns. 這項研究旨在為香港華人社會背景下的反種族偏見和多元文化能力培訓發展一個基於實證的理論模型。主要目標是提升社會工作者的知識、技能和意識，以更好地支援少數族裔兒童和青少年，滿足與文化相關的反種族主義教育的迫切需求。 以往的實證研究表明種族主義對心理和身體健康、學業表現以及獲取社會服務和醫療保健時有不利影響（Bécares et al., 2022; Priest et al., 2014）。這項研究突顯了在香港影響非華裔少數族裔人口的持續性以及系統性的種族主義。來自較貧困背景或皮膚較深的人士面臨根植於歷史和文化偏見的障礙。目前的社會工作課程未能充分解決這些問題，限制了從業者的服務有效性（Kwok et al., 2018; 2024）。此外，香港社會工作者註冊局並未強制要求消除種族歧視和多元文化能力培訓（Kwan & Cui, 2022），而非政府組織提供的現有多元文化培訓往往忽視反種族主義的組成部分。文獻顯示，儘管有學者呼籲將反種族主義納入多元文化能力培訓，在我們亞洲，社會工作者在這方面的培訓依然缺乏（Boyle & Springer, 2001; Danos, 2015; Sue et al., 2016）。本研究旨在通過將本土知識和有效策略納入培訓計劃，來填補這些空白，使本地實踐與國際標準對齊。 該研究採用混合模式，分兩個階段（30個月）進行。第一階段涉及根據Sue et al.（2016）的多元文化能力框架和各種反種族偏見模型（例如Beelmann & Heinemann, 2014）開發多元文化能力和反種族主義培訓課程，並通過與少數族裔社區成員和華人社會工作者的焦點小組訪談提供相關的培訓内容。第二階段將包括一項對216名來自社區服務、兒童和青少年服務以及康復服務的華人社會工作者進行的對照試驗。這將包括三個組別：一個接受綜合策略、一個不接觸的組別和一個等候名單對照組。多層次回歸模型將評估干預計劃的有效性。 這項研究將通過檢視香港背景下的不同構念、整合本土知識及使本地實踐與國際標準對齊，增強多元文化社會工作的學術研究。此外，它還針對全球可持續發展的倡議，促進健康和平等（SDG 3 和 10）。預期的結果包括改進的概念模型、實用的培訓手冊，以及針對加強社會工作課程和倡導針對性減少偏見的政策建議。

21605625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21605625.value: 莎士比亞對金庸的影響

21605625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21605625.value: The late Hong Kong author Louis Cha Leung-yung, pen-name Jin Yong, is one of the best-selling novelists of all time, in any language. His fifteen literary works, first serialised in Hong Kong newspapers from 1955–72, have been adapted over a hundred times for film and television and are regarded as ‘the common language of Chinese the world over’. One of the defining characteristics of Jin Yong’s fiction is its deep, creative engagement with Chinese history and traditional culture, which has often been cited as the reason for the restriction of his popularity to the Sinosphere. However, it is evident from his essays and interviews that he was widely read across European literature too. He regularly expressed appreciation for Walter Scott and Alexandre Dumas Sr., his forebears within the genre of historical fiction, but his greatest admiration was reserved for William Shakespeare. Many important research publications have examined the direct influence of classical and modern Chinese literature on Jin Yong’s fiction, but there has not yet been a substantial study of his use of European literature. My project will adopt folkloristic methods and categories of conceptualisation to systematically identify and study the ways in which motifs, character archetypes and plot devices from Shakespearian drama were directly borrowed and adapted by Jin Yong. These findings will be situated diachronically to illuminate the evolution of Jin Yong’s process of creative appropriation during his creative career. They will also be analysed within a transcultural framework, drawing on the aforementioned body of research on the novelist’s engagement with Chinese literature to provide fuller insights into his methods of cross-cultural synthesis. Contextual evidence, such as Jin Yong’s interviews and his little-discussed newspaper columns on various Shakespearian plays and contemporary film adaptations, will be drawn upon. This project will reframe scholarly understanding of Jin Yong’s creative process and add a new page to ongoing discourses on Shakespeare’s reception in East Asia. In shedding new light on the engagement of the most culturally influential Chinese-language author of modern times with the most culturally influential English-language author of all time, the project will establish the significance of Jin Yong’s fiction as sites of cross-cultural conversation and pave the way for further, ground-breaking studies of his use of European literature. 香港作家查良鏞，筆名金庸，是史上最暢銷的小說家之一。他的十五部小說於 1955-72年間首次在香港報紙上連載，至今已被改編為百餘部電影和電視劇，被譽為 「全球華人共同的語言」。金庸小說的一大特點是富有創造性和深刻的中國歷史和傳統文化，但這也經常被認為是他的知名度局限於中華文化圈的原因。然而，從他的散文和訪談中可看出，他也廣泛閱讀歐洲文學。他經常表達對史各特 (Walter Scott) 和大仲馬 (Alexandre Dumas Sr.) 的欣賞，他們都是他在歷史小說領域的前輩，但他最欽佩的還是莎士比亞 (William Shakespeare)。 許多重要的研究著作都探討過中國古典與現代文學對金庸小說的直接影響，但對於金庸對歐洲文學的運用，則尚未有實質的研究。 本項目將運用民俗學的方法和概念化的分類，有系統地鑑定和研究金庸如何直接借用和改編莎士比亞劇中的主題、人物原型和劇情手法。這些發現將以歷時性的方式，闡明金庸在其創作生涯中創作改編的演變過程。我們也會在跨文化的框架下分析這些發現，並參考前述有關金庸與中國文學關係的研究，以更全面地了解金庸的跨文化綜合方法。我們也會參考金庸的訪談、他在報紙上少為人知的專欄，以及他對各種莎士比亞劇本及當代電影改編的論述等背景證據。 本項目將重新建構學術界對金庸創作過程的理解，並為目前有關莎士比亞在東亞的接受情況的討論揭開新的一頁。本項目將闡明現代最具文化影響力的華語作家與史上最具文化影響力的英語作家之間的互動，從而確立金庸小說作為跨文化對話平台的重要性，並進一步開創性地為研究金庸對歐洲文學的運用鋪路。

21608125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21608125.value: 办公室里发生着什么？探索中国创意工作者混合办公的未来

21608125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21608125.value: Since COVID-19, predicting the future of office has become increasingly difficult, as different firms hold different views about how and where work should be done. Some firms (e.g., Google) embrace hybrid working (where workers work remotely for about two days a week) while some (e.g., Amazon) have abandoned it. China sees a particularly low hybrid working adoption even though the most convincing positive effects of hybrid working comes from a leading Chinese firm. This perplexity is mainly due to our insufficient understanding of the nuanced office needs among creative workers and the complex effects of hybrid working. Consequently, it becomes challenging for firms and developers to invest wisely in office space, and for planners and policy makers to design sustainable urban environment. To tackle the problem of accurately estimating office demand, more structured analyses of creative professions, more detailed experiments of hybrid working, and finer data on office activity are essential. In the proposed project, we will use a mixed methodology, combining state-of-the-art activity sensing and conventional surveys and interviews, to identify creative workers’ activity pattern and investigate effects of hybrid working. We will first examine architectural professionals in the Guangzhou branch of Tianhua to determine whether highly creative roles (concept designers and managers) exhibit a stronger need for office than less creative roles (construction-drawing architects). Second, we will evaluate whether hybrid working works better for less creative roles than for highly creative roles in Tianhua. Meanwhile, we will observe how hybrid working may change architectural professionals’ use of office. Finally, we will extend these research tasks to broader creative firms in China, starting from a wearable robotics start-up named Yrobot in Suzhou. The successful implementation of this project will not only benefit creative firms, developers, and relevant urban professionals with predictive office space insights, but also, by promoting more equitable distribution of talents with hybrid working, contribute to the urban regeneration and rural revitalization initiatives for China's second- and third-tier regions.

21611625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21611625.value: 最低企業稅與跨國企業知識溢出

21611625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21611625.value: In recognition that international tax rules were developed over the last century and did not fit the current situation of the modern global economy, in October 2021, over 130 countries agreed to a global tax reform plan of OECD. The plan has two pillars. Pillar one targets at large multinational corporations (MNCs) - with total revenue greater than 20 billion euros and profitability above 10% - and regulates how MNCs should allocate their profits to jurisdictions where their consumers are present. Pillar two, often referred to as global minimum corporate tax (GMCT), proposes a minimum tax rate of 15% for all multinational groups in scope. GMCT would change the relative costs of operation in different countries in the global economy. How would such changes affect the production in different countries? How would the change in production affect technology spillover and economic growth in the long run? Are such effects heterogeneous across countries? These questions are both intellectually intriguing and central to many policy discussions. Policymakers, especially those from developing countries and those from countries previously labelled as “tax havens”, would be very concerned with the consequences of GMCT. Also, what would be the economic consequences to countries that do not join the agreement? This project tries to provide a quantitative framework to address these questions. 過去一個世紀中制訂的國際稅收規則已不適合現代全球經濟的現狀。2021年10月，超過130個國家同意了經合組織的全球稅收改革計劃。該計劃有兩大支柱。支柱一針對大型跨國公司（總收入超過200億歐元且利潤率超過10%），並規定跨國公司應如何將利潤分配給其消費者所在的司法管轄權區域。支柱二通常被稱為全球最低企業稅（GMCT），建議對所有適用範圍內的跨國集團徵收15%的最低稅率。 GMCT將改變全球經濟中不同國家營運的相對成本。這種變化將如何影響不同國家的生產？生產的變化將如何影響技術溢出和長期經濟增長？這種影響在不同國家之間是否存在差異？這些問題既在學術上引人入勝，也是許多政策討論的核心。政策制訂者，特別是來自發展中國家和以前被標籤為「避稅天堂」的國家的政策制訂者，將非常關注GMCT的後果。此外，不加入該協議的國家將面臨甚麼經濟後果？該項目試圖提供一個定量框架來解決這些問題。

22101925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22101925.value: 低衝擊間歇訓練（LIIT）對減少中央肥胖成年人體外心包脂肪（EAT）的成效：一項隨機對照試驗

22101925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22101925.value: Excess adiposity or obesity is a major but modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular diseases (CVD), which are the leading cause of death globally and pose a substantial economic burden on the healthcare system worldwide. Not all fat depots in humans contribute equally to CVD. Epicardial fat, also known as epicardial adipose tissue (EAT), is the only fat depot in humans that has no anatomical barrier separating it from its target organ – the myocardium (i.e., they share the same microcirculation). The volume of EAT is an independent risk factor for CVD in individuals with obesity; a 1-SD increase in the volume of EAT is associated with a 37% increased risk of heart failure. An unhealthy lifestyle and aging result in the accumulation of EAT. Several clinical trials have attempted to modulate EAT volume using pharmacological interventions; however, this approach is expensive and comes with unpleasant side effects. Non-pharmacological interventions, such as endurance exercise, are effective in reducing the EAT volume, but fear of commitment to endurance exercise, physical limitations, and psychological barriers often prevent people with abdominal obesity from performing endurance exercise. Low-impact interval training (LIIT) could be an alternative way to safely, efficiently, and effectively reduce EAT in adults with abdominal obesity. Indeed, our pilot study showed that once-a-week LIIT (once-LIIT) safely and significantly reduced EAT and visceral fat and increased skeletal muscle mass. This proposed study aims to examine the efficacy of the once-LIIT in reducing EAT volume and improving health-related fitness in a clinical trial setting. Adults with abdominal obesity will be recruited and randomly assigned to intervention groups or exercise counseling control group (EC_con). EAT, abdominal adipose tissue, and gluteal-femoral adipose tissue will be assessed by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Health-related fitness, cardiometabolic disease risk factors, blood chemistry, psychological measures, physical activity level, and diet habits will also be carefully assessed. All measurements will be conducted at baseline (month 0), completion of the intervention (week 16), and follow-up (week 52). This study will provide high-quality clinical evidence of the efficacy of once-LIIT at reducing EAT volume in humans. Besides bridging the existing research gap between once-LIIT, EAT, and body composition, this novel exercise modality will also provide individuals with abdominal obesity an opportunity to lower their risk of developing CVD in an efficient and cost-effective manner. Given the convenience of once-weekly dosing, this intervention is expected to improve exercise adherence in inactive individuals with obesity. 肥胖是導致心血管疾病（CVD）的主要可控風險因素。心血管疾病不僅是全球首要死因，也為各國醫療系統帶來沉重的經濟負擔。然而，人體不同部位的脂肪對健康的影響並不相同。其中，心外膜脂肪組織（EAT）因直接包覆心肌且共用同一微循環系統，被視為一項獨特的風險指標。研究證實，EAT體積是心血管疾病的獨立風險因素，其體積每增加一個標準差，心臟衰竭的風險便隨之增加37%。 目前，減少EAT的方法存在局限。藥物介入成本高昂且伴隨不良副作用；而傳統的耐力運動雖然有效，卻因其對體能要求高、需時長，常令腹部肥胖人士因身體限制或心理障礙而卻步，難以持續。因此，開發一種安全、高效且易於堅持的新型介入措施至關重要。低衝擊間歇訓練（LIIT）正具備此潛力。我們的初步研究更發現，每週僅進行一次的LIIT（once-LIIT）便能安全且顯著地減少EAT與內臟脂肪，同時增加骨骼肌肉量。 本研究旨在透過一項隨機對照臨床試驗，嚴謹評估「每週一次LIIT」對減少腹部肥胖成年人EAT體積及改善其健康相關體適能的成效。我們將招募有腹部肥Pang的成年人，並隨機分配至介入組或運動諮詢對照組。我們將採用磁力共振成像（MRI）精準量度EAT、腹部及臀股脂肪的變化，並全面評估健康相關體適能、心血管代謝風險、血液生化指標、心理狀況及生活習慣。所有評估將於基線期（第0週）、介入結束時（第16週）及長期追蹤（第52週）進行。 本研究將為once-LIIT在減少EAT方面的成效提供高品質的臨床證據。除了填補現有研究空白外，此創新的運動模式更能為腹部肥胖人士提供一個省時、高效益的途徑，以降低他們患上心血管疾病的風險。我們預期，這種每週僅需一次的訓練模式將能顯著提升過往缺乏運動的肥胖人士的長期運動依從性。

22201125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22201125.value: 複雜水面反射環境下無人水面艇性能優化方法研究

22201125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22201125.value: Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) or drone boats are vital for maritime tasks like environmental monitoring and transport. Several mechanisms have been proposed to ensure its operational safety. However, the challenges posed by the reflection phenomenon on the water surface, aka Water Surface Reflection (WSR), have been largely overlooked. First, the WSR can create dangerous visual ambiguities. Such ambiguities generate false targets that could mislead USVs, potentially resulting in catastrophic collisions. Second, the WSR occludes critical details of the maritime landscape, blinding USVs to objects of interest. The goals of this project is to mitigate the visual ambiguities and occlusion caused by WSR, and ultimately enhance the reliability of USV operations. Two key challenges hinder current approaches from achieving the desired goals. First, USVs rely on integrating 2D and 3D data for effective operation. However, most reflection-related approaches focus solely on 2D data, such as images or videos, without accounting for spatiotemporal correlations in a 3D environment. This limitation leads to suboptimal outcomes, significantly affecting USV performance. Second, current methods are primarily designed for stable glass reflections. In contrast, water surface reflections in maritime environments change rapidly across different locations and times, making these methods ineffective in handling such swift variations. This project will address the challenges from three aspects. First, we will introduce a novel approach to model WSR via a base prior with 3D particle structure. The base prior segments the scene into a collection of small particles, each capable of modeling spatiotemporal variations at its position by fine-tuning associated trainable parameters. This base prior will then be continuously updated, ensuring accurate and timely modeling of WSR. Second, building on such a base prior, we will explore how to conduct in-prior reflection handling to control the ambiguities and occlusion effects in 3D. At last, we will develop a framework to seamlessly incorporate base prior into existing USV systems. Since our base prior is built on 3D particle structures, it naturally delivers the necessary information for USV operations. Our extensive experience and strong research teams in maritime tasks and computational imaging give us confidence in addressing WSR challenges via this project. This research will significantly enhance USV safety. The scientific advances from this three-year project are expected to have broad and lasting impacts beyond the initial timeframe. 無人水面艇或稱無人船，在海洋監測、運輸等任務中發揮著至關重要的作用。為確保其運行安全，已有多種機制被提出。然而，水面反射現象所帶來的挑戰卻長期被忽視。首先，水面反射會產生嚴重的視覺模糊，形成虛假目標，誤導無人艇的感知系統，可能導致災難性的碰撞事故。其次，水面反射會遮擋海洋環境中關鍵的視覺細節，使無人艇無法察覺感興趣的目標物體。本專案的目標是減輕由水面反射引起的視覺模糊與遮擋問題，從而提升無人艇運行的可靠性。

22203525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22203525.value: 基於簡化掃描協議的自動超聲波視頻摘要技術提升診斷質量

22203525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22203525.value: Ultrasound imaging is a widely used diagnostic tool for visualizing various tissues, such as blood vessels, internal organs, and fetal structures. Compared to X-ray, CT, and MRI, ultrasound offers significant advantages such as being non-radiative, non-invasive, portable, and cost-effective. However, traditional ultrasound examinations rely heavily on the expertise of trained sonographers, making it difficult to scale in underserved areas. Simplified ultrasound scanning protocols have been developed to enable non-experts to acquire diagnostic-quality images, but interpreting these scans is challenging due to the low quality ultrasound video, such as non-standard planes, non-standardized frame sequences, redundant information, and non-informative frames. To address this, we propose novel ultrasound video summarization models aimed at enhancing data quality and diagnostic accuracy while reducing reliance on specialized sonographer skills. (1) First, we propose a standard plane recognition and generation model that reconstructs high-quality standard planes from keyframes identified near anatomical landmarks. This will enable clinicians to extract critical diagnostic information from low-quality sweeps. (2) Second, we introduce a 3D reconstruction model that synthesizes a volumetric representation of the anatomy by estimating the 3D pose of video frames. This comprehensive 3D view will simplify diagnosis and enhance interpretability. (3) Third, we propose a memory-efficient video report generation model that dynamically compresses keyframes into a memory bank for long-term video analysis, providing clinicians with concise, informative textual summaries. (4) Lastly, we introduce a human-interactive video question localization model that allows clinicians to quickly locate and review diagnostically relevant frames by integrating human input into the AI workflow. This research represents a significant step forward in ultrasound video summarization by offering innovative solutions for generating both visual and textual summaries, improving the quality, interpretability, and accessibility of ultrasound examinations. Our approach has the potential to democratize ultrasound diagnostics, particularly in remote and underserved areas, while also advancing the field of medical image analysis. 超聲波影像是一種被廣泛應用於可視化各種組織的診斷工具，例如血管、內臟器官以及胎兒結構。與X光、電腦斷層掃描以及磁振造影相比，超聲波具有無放射性、非侵入性、可便攜性以及成本效益高等顯著優勢。然而，傳統的超聲波檢查高度依賴受過專業訓練的超聲檢查員的技術，這使得在醫療資源不足的地區難以推廣。為了讓非專業人員也能取得具有診斷品質的視頻，已經發展出簡化的超聲波掃描流程，但解讀這些掃描結果仍具挑戰性，因為低品質的超聲波影像常出現非標準切面、非標準化的視頻序列、冗餘信息以及無診斷價值的影像。 為了解決這個問題，我們提出創新的超聲波視頻摘要模型，旨在提升數據品質與診斷準確度，同時降低對專業檢查員技能的依賴。(1) 首先，我們提出一種標準切面辨識與生成模型，能夠從接近解剖標誌的關鍵影像中重建高品質的標準切面。這將使臨床醫師能從低品質掃描中擷取關鍵診斷信息。(2) 其次，我們引入三維重建模型，透過估計視頻影像的三維姿態，合成解剖結構的體積化表示。這種完整的三維視圖將簡化診斷並提升可解讀性。(3) 第三，我們提出一種記憶高效的影片報告生成模型，能將關鍵影像動態壓縮至記憶庫中，用於長視頻分析，並為臨床醫師提供精簡且信息豐富的文字摘要。(4) 最後，我們引入一種人機互動的視頻定位模型，透過將人類輸入整合至AI工作流程，使臨床醫師能快速定位並檢視具有診斷相關性的影像。 本研究在超聲波影片摘要領域邁出了重要一步，提供了生成視覺與文字摘要的創新解決方案，提升超聲波檢查的品質、可解讀性與可及性。我們的方法有潛力將超聲波診斷普及化，特別是在偏遠與醫療資源不足的地區，同時推進醫學影像分析領域的發展。

22304125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22304125.value: 稀疏矩-平方和鬆弛序列的緊性及應用

22304125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22304125.value: Sparse polynomial optimization problems (POPs) are optimization problems given by polynomials with a small number of variables. By exploiting the sparsity, one gets a semidefinite relaxation method for globally solving large-scale sparse POPs, which is called the sparse Moment-Sum-of-Squares (Moment-SOS) hierarchy of semidefinite relaxations. POPs with application backgrounds are usually equipped with sparsity, and the sparse Moment-SOS hierarchy has been applied to solve many sparse POPs from various fields, such as electric power systems, computer vision, and deep learning. In this project, the PI will study the sparse Moment-SOS hierarchy for solving sparse POPs. More specifically, we will investigate the tightness of the sparse Moment-SOS hierarchy for solving the reformulation of sparse POPs obtained by the correlatively sparse Lagrange multiplier expressions (CS-LMEs), which is called the CS-LME-type relaxations and proposed in the recent collaborative work by the PI. In computational practice, one can usually observe that the approximation for the global optimal value of sparse POPs provided by the CS-LME-type relaxation is exact, for which cases we say the relaxation is tight. We plan to investigate the theoretical property for the tightness of CS-LME-type relaxations, based on the results of the PI's recent collaborative work on characterizing the tightness of the sparse Moment-SOS hierarchy. Moreover, for CS-LME-type relaxations, we also plan to investigate how to detect the tightness for a computed optimal solution and get global optimizers for sparse POPs by studying the flat truncation condition. Besides that, we plan to investigate a novel approach that uses the sparse Moment-SOS hierarchy to solve low rank tensor completion problems, which has broad applications in image science, recommendation systems, signal processing, etc. In general, this research will broaden our ability to solve difficult problems given by sparse polynomials, such as sparse generalized Nash equilibrium problems of polynomials, which cannot be solved by existing approaches, and may lead to more globally solvable models from the application. 稀疏多項式優化問題（POPs）是由只包含少量變量的多項式構成的優化問題。通過利用這些問題的稀疏性，可以得到一種針對大規模稀疏POP全局求解的半正定鬆弛方法，這種方法被稱為稀疏矩陣-和平方（Moment-SOS）序列的半正定鬆弛。具有應用背景的POP通常都具有稀疏性，而稀疏Moment-SOS序列已被應用於解決來自電力系統、計算機視覺、深度學習等不同領域的許多稀疏POP。 在本項目中，項目負責人將研究用稀疏Moment-SOS序列來求解稀疏POP。具體來說，我們將研究通過相關稀疏拉格朗日乘子表達（CS-LME）重構的稀疏POP所得到的稀疏Moment-SOS序列鬆弛的緊致性（tightness）。這一鬆弛方式被稱為CS-LME型鬆弛，並在項目負責人最近的合作工作中提出。在實際計算中，經常可以觀察到CS-LME型鬆弛給出的稀疏POP全局最優值近似是精確的，這種情況下我們說該鬆弛是緊的。我們計劃基於項目負責人最近合作工作中對稀疏Moment-SOS序列鬆弛緊致性的刻畫結果，進一步研究CS-LME型鬆弛的理論緊致性。此外，對於CS-LME型鬆弛，我們還計劃研究如何檢測所計算最優解的緊致性，以及通過研究平滑截斷條件（flat truncation condition）來獲得稀疏POP的全局最優解。 除此之外，我們還計劃探索一種新方法，利用稀疏Moment-SOS序列來求解低秩張量補全問題，該問題在圖像科學、推薦系統、信號處理等領域有著廣泛應用。總的來說，本項目將拓展我們對於稀疏多項式描述的困難問題的求解能力，例如稀疏多項式廣義納什均衡問題，這類問題目前尚無現有方法可以求解，有望促成更多能夠全局求解的應用模型。

22613825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22613825.value: 亞非國際聯盟：萬隆時期的黑人左翼女權主義者與中國

22613825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22613825.value: The age of Bandung, named after the watershed conference held in the Indonesian city in April 1955, saw African and African diaspora activists, intellectuals, and politicians engaging intensively with the spirit of anticolonial and anti-imperialist solidarity in their efforts to imagine and create liberatory world orders. A range of such revolutionary alliances, both real and imagined, have been academically explored and/or publicly commemorated. But the crucial role of one coalitional relationship, that between Black leftist women activists and China, in shaping the practices and discourses of Bandung internationalism remains largely unstudied. “The Other Afro-Asian International” traces the history of the interactions of a network of Black left feminists with Chinese political leaders and intellectuals during the first three decades of post-World War II decolonization. Examining the engagements of women activists based in the US, the UK, and East and West Africa—particularly Eslanda Robeson, Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti, Claudia Jones, Mabel Williams, Shirley Graham Du Bois, Asha Babu, Vicki Garvin, Elaine Brown, and Olive Morris with China, this project seeks to advance third interrelated arguments that reveal African and African diasporic left feminists’ significant place in the history of Cold War Afro-Asian solidarity, thereby providing correctives to heteromasculinist narratives of mid-twentieth-century radical internationalism. First, Black women activist-intellectuals and the party-state weaved anti-racial-capitalist struggles within the imperialist core, China’s construction of socialism, Asian and African decolonial movements into an alliance for the construction of a just world order with the aid of the era’s transportation and communication technologies. Second, such political and intellectual exchanges were central to refining both Black left feminism’s and Chinese socialism’s conceptions of the enmeshment of racism, class exploitation, heteropatriarchal sexism, and imperialism, spawning Afro-Asian formations that challenged and at other times accommodated the racial, gender, sexual, and geopolitical status quo, both at the national and international level. Third, the geopolitics of the Cold War and of decolonization facilitated Black radical women’s feminist and internationalist worldmaking, but, at the same time, restricted the range of options available to them in pursuing revolutionary agendas. In exploring how they struggled to make their way through the uncertainties and complexities of the international politics of time, this project will show that Black left feminists sought to maintain independence in the envisioning and building of revolutionary alliances that would aid the emancipation of the global downtrodden. 「萬隆時代」以1955年4月在印尼城市萬隆舉行、具有分水嶺意義的亞非團結會議命名。非洲及非洲離散社群的社會行動者、知識分子與政治人物，為了構想並創建解放性的世界秩序，深入踐行反殖民、反帝國主義聯盟的精神。對於此類革命性聯盟，無論真實或想像，學界已有所探討，並且在公共領域也曾獲得紀念。然而，其中一種結盟關係——黑人左翼女權主義者與中國之間的關係——在塑造萬隆國際主義的實踐與話語方面所發揮的關鍵作用，迄今仍基本未獲深入研究。 《亞非國際聯盟：萬隆時期的黑人左翼女權主義者與中國》追溯的是二戰後去殖民化運動的前三十年間，一個黑人左翼女性主義者網絡與中國政治領導人和知識分子的互動歷史。透過考察活動於美國、英國以及東非與西非的女性社會活動家——特別是埃斯蘭達·羅布森、芬米拉約·蘭索姆－庫蒂、克勞迪婭·瓊斯、梅布爾·威廉斯、雪莉·葛蘭姆·杜波依斯、阿莎·巴布、維姬·加文、伊萊恩·布朗與奧利芙·莫里斯——與中國的交往，本研究擬提出三點相互關聯的結論，以彰顯非洲及其離散社群的左翼女性主義者在冷戰時期亞非團結史中的重要地位，從而矯正對20世紀中葉激進國際主義的異性戀常態化的男性中心主義敘事。其一，黑人女性行動者或知識分子與中國政府，借助當時的交通與通訊技術，將帝國主義核心內部的反種族資本主義鬥爭、中國的社會主義建設，以及亞洲與非洲的去殖民運動聯繫在一起，從而建構公正的世界秩序。其二，這些政治與思想交流對於發展黑人左翼女性主義至關重要，也對中國社會主義關於種族主義、階級剝削、異性父權制、性別歧視與帝國主義相互交織的認識產生影響。由此催生出亞非聯盟關係有時挑戰、而在另一些時候又順應了國家與國際層面的種族、性別、性秩序與地緣政治的現狀。其三，冷戰與去殖民化運動的地緣政治一方面促成了黑人激進女性在女性主義與國際主義層面的世界建構，另一方面也限制了她們在推進革命議程時可資選擇的路徑與空間。 在探討她們如何在當時國際政治的不確定性與複雜性中艱難前行的過程中，本計畫將表明：黑人左翼女性主義者在設想與建構有助於解放全球受壓迫者的革命聯盟時，力求保持獨立性。

22614025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22614025.value: 結盟競爭：中蘇在邊緣地區的分裂

22614025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22614025.value: In 1967, the Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas (PKP) split in two and within two years a second Communist Party (CPP) was founded. The split in the Philippine party followed the lines of the raging conflict in world Communism between the Soviet Union and China. At the same time it expressed sharpening tensions within the Philippine elite in a period of social upheaval. The pro-Moscow PKP supported Ferdinand Marcos and assisted in his imposition of dictatorship; the pro-Beijing CPP allied with Marcos' ruling class rival, Benigno Aquino Jr. Aligned Rivalries examines how the context of global social upheaval in the 1960s both sharpened the tensions between the erstwhile comrades in the Soviet Union and China and accelerated the scramble for dictatorship in ruling circles in the Philippines, bringing about an alignment of rivalries between Marcos and Moscow on the one hand, and Aquino and Beijing on the other. Around the world, and throughout the global south in particular, parties split in a similar fashion, the ideological struggle within the Communist bloc finding congruent alignment with rival sets of national social interests. The aligned ruptures were an outcome of a shared set of global class pressures rather than the product of external machinations or domestic disputes. In investigating the complex mechanisms of the Sino-Soviet split in the Philippines, Aligned Rivalries unearths a dynamic network of horizontal interconnections across the global south that ran through Jakarta and Hiroshima, Havana and Santiago. This network not only responded to developments in Moscow and Beijing, it also shaped them. The end result of my research is a study of the Sino-Soviet split from the periphery. 1967年，菲律賓共產黨（PKP）分裂成兩個黨派，兩年內又成立了第二個共產黨（CPP）。菲律賓共產黨的分裂與蘇聯和中國在世界共產主義領域的激烈衝突如出一轍。同時，這也反映出菲律賓菁英階層在社會動盪時期內部日益加劇的緊張關係。親莫斯科的PKP支持費迪南德·馬科斯，並協助他推行獨裁統治；親北京的菲律賓共產黨與馬科斯的統治階級對手小貝尼尼奧·阿基諾結盟。 《結盟的競爭》探討了1960年代全球社會動盪的背景如何加劇了蘇聯和中國昔日盟友之間的緊張關係，並加速了菲律賓統治階層對獨裁統治的爭奪，導致馬科斯與莫斯科以及阿基諾與北京之間形成了競爭聯盟。在世界各地，尤其是在全球南方，政黨也以類似的方式分裂，共產主義陣營內部的意識形態鬥爭與相互競爭的國家社會利益找到了一致的契合點。這種結盟的破裂是全球階級壓力共同作用的結果，而非外部陰謀或國內爭端的產物。 《結盟的競爭》一書探討了中蘇在菲律賓分裂的複雜機制，揭示了一個貫穿南半球的動態橫向互聯網，它貫穿雅加達、廣島、哈瓦那和聖地亞哥。這個網絡不僅對莫斯科和北京的發展作出了回應，也塑造了它們。我的研究最終成果是從邊緣視角來探討中蘇分裂。

23200925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23200925.value: 大規模視覺場景壓縮與智慧表示

23200925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23200925.value: In recent years, the proliferation of network and communication technologies has led to an explosive increase in image and video data. Visual information plays a crucial role in various applications, including virtual reality, augmented reality, remote sensing, autonomous driving, and city safety. As the demand for high-quality, immersive visual experiences rises, the need for efficient compression and representation techniques for large-scale visual scene data becomes increasingly critical. Visual scene data often encompasses extensive spatial and temporal details, far exceeding those found in standard media, with data volumes typically estimated in the hundreds of terabytes per scene and growing rapidly. This explosive growth introduces significant challenges in data transmission, storage, utility, and accurate scene reproduction. In this project, we present a unified system for Large-Scale Visual Scene Data Compression and Intelligent Representation, leveraging the power of artificial intelligence and generative techniques in compact data representation. The system is structured into two hierarchical levels: the underpinning level and the augmentation level. At the underpinning level, the focus is on maintaining signal fidelity through basic yet efficient video compression. The augmentation level builds at the cloud-end by enhancing scene presentation and compression. Within this framework, we plan to 1) study the high-efficiency visual scene data compression in the underpinning level; 2) establish the augmentation level and develop high-quality and rate-constrained visual scene representation; 3) investigate the joint optimization on the generalized rate-distortion and complexity model to improve the efficiency. More specifically, the underpinning level processes captured views to preserve signal fidelity and achieve video compression, facilitating transmission. Bitstreams of multi-view are transmitted to both user-side and cloud-side. On the user-side, bitstreams are parsed and decoded into visual signals, but limited camera viewpoints result in discrete scene depictions. The augmentation level, deployed in the cloud with substantial computational resources, enhances scene compression and reproduction by using a video generative model to predict and generate multi-view videos with denser viewpoints. Additionally, a rate-constrained 3D-Gaussian Splatting model is designed to render high-quality dynamic scenes, with model parameters compressed and sent to end-users. This framework is applicable in various scenarios, including autonomous and assisted driving, city safety, natural disaster monitoring, and dangerous scene reproduction. 近年來，網路與通訊技術的迅速發展導致影像與視訊資料呈現爆炸式成長。視覺資訊在多種應用中扮演關鍵角色，包括虛擬實境（VR）、擴增實境（AR）、遙測、 自動駕駛與城市安全。隨著人們對高品質、沉浸式視覺體驗的需求不斷提升，對於大型視覺場景資料的高效壓縮與表示技術的需求也日益迫切。視覺場景資料通常涵蓋極為豐富的空間與時間細節，遠超過標準媒體內容，其資料量每個場景動輒以數百TB計，並持續快速增長。這種成長趨勢對資料的傳輸、儲存、利用以及場景重建準確性帶來重大挑戰。 本計畫提出一套整合性的大規模視覺場景資料壓縮與智慧表示系統，結合人工智慧與生成式技術，以實現緊湊的資料表達。該系統分為兩個層級：基礎層與增強層。基礎層專注於透過基礎但高效的視訊壓縮方式來維持訊號保真度；增強層部署於雲端，進一步強化場景的表現力與壓縮效率。 在此框架下，我們計畫： 1. 研究基礎層中高效率的視覺場景資料壓縮技術； 2. 建立增強層，並開發具高品質與碼率約束的視覺場景表示方法； 3. 探討廣義的率失真與複雜度聯合最佳化模型，以提升整體效率。 更具體地說，基礎層處理所捕捉到的視角，以保留訊號保真並進行視訊壓縮，利於傳輸。多視角的位元流將同時傳送至用戶端與雲端。在用戶端，這些位元流會被解析並解碼為視覺訊號，但受限於攝影機視角的數量，所還原的場景影像通常較為離散。增強層利用雲端豐富的運算資源，透過視訊生成模型來預測並生成具有更密集視角的多視角影片，以強化場景的壓縮與重建能力。此外，我們設計了一種具碼率約束的三維高斯潑灑（3D-Gaussian Splatting）模型，用於渲染高品質動態場景，並將壓縮後的模型參數傳送至用戶端。本架構可應用於多種場景，包括自動駕駛與輔助駕駛、城市安全、天然災害監測以及危險場景重建等。

23300325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23300325.value: 調控鹵化物演變以克服鈣鈦礦光伏器件的不穩定性及光電壓平台

23300325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23300325.value: Photovoltaic (PV) devices are key renewable energy technologies that directly convert sunlight into electricity without carbon emissions. Improving power-conversion efficiency (PCE) and device stability is critical for continuously driving down their levelized cost of electricity (LCOE), thus enhancing market competitiveness. By integrating multiple subcells with complementary bandgaps, tandem solar cells (TSCs) offer great prospects to improve PCE by reducing thermalization and transmission losses. These devices can push PCE boundary beyond 40%, significantly surpassing the ~33% efficiency limit of traditional single-junction solar cells. Among prevalent semiconductors, metal halide perovskites with the typical formula ABX3 are ideal for wide-bandgap subcells in TSCs because their bandgaps can be tuned by adjusting the bromide-to-iodide ratio at the halide site (i.e., X-site) of perovskites. However, the use of I/Br mixed halides introduces challenges when the bromide fraction exceeds approximately 20%, leading to spatially separated iodide-rich and bromide-rich phases under illumination, a phenomenon known as halide segregation. Higher bromide content, on other hand, also contributes to an increased density of deep trap states in perovskites. These issues collectively result in instability and “photovoltage plateau” among wide-bandgap perovskite solar cells (PSCs), impeding the realization of efficient and stable wide-bandgap PSCs and TSCs. Therefore, modulating halide evolution is pivotal to address these challenges, yet this aspect has not been systematically studied. In this project, we will (1) reveal halide evolution, including their spatial distribution, migration/diffusion, and valence state, in I/Br mixed-halide perovskites throughout film formation and during device operation, utilizing advanced in-situ and operando characterization techniques; (2) establish relationships between halide evolution, the structural/optical/electrical properties of perovskites, and the device performance; (3) develop novel approaches to modulate halide evolution and eliminate its detrimental impacts on device performance through material innovation and device engineering; (4) demonstrate single-junction wide-bandgap PSCs targeting low photovoltage losses and superior long-term operating stability; (5) demonstrate high-performance perovskite-based TSCs with significantly improved PCEs and long-term operating stability. The successful accomplishment of this project will provide critical insights into modulating halide evolution and overcoming the instability and photovoltage loss in PSCs. The outcomes are expected to achieve exceptional efficiency and stability in state-of-the-art TSCs, thereby accelerating their commercialization and contributing to global renewable energy solutions. 光伏（PV）器件可在零碳排放的情況下直接將太陽光轉換為電能，是一種關鍵的可再生能源技術。持續提升其能量轉換效率（PCE）與器件穩定性，對於不斷降低其度電成本（LCOE）並增強市場競爭力至關重要。通過整合多個具互補帶隙的子電池，疊層太陽能電池（TSCs）可有效減少熱弛豫與透射損失，從而顯著提升PCE；其效率上限有望突破40%，遠超傳統單結太陽能電池約33%的理論限制。在常見半導體材料中，金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦（通式ABX3）因可通過調節X位鹵素中溴/碘比例以精確調控帶隙，成為TSCs中寬帶隙子電池的理想材料。然而，當溴含量超過約20%時，I/Br混合鹵化物在光照下易出現鹵素分離，形成空間上分離的富碘與富溴相。同時，較高的溴含量亦會導致材料中深能級缺陷態密度上升。以上問題疊加，造成寬帶隙鈣鈦礦太陽能電池（PSCs）的不穩定性與所謂的「光電壓平台」現象，從而制約高效、長壽命的寬帶隙PSCs與TSCs的實現。因此，如何調控鹵素演變是破解瓶頸的關鍵，但目前仍缺乏系統性的研究。在本項目中，我們將:（1）利用先進的原位與作業態（operando）表徵技術，揭示 I/Br 混合鹵化物鈣鈦礦於成膜全過程及器件運行期間的鹵素演變，包括其空間分佈、遷移/擴散與價態變化；（2）建立鹵素演變與鈣鈦礦結構、光電性質以及器件性能之間的關聯；（3）通過材料創新與器件工程，開發調控鹵素演變並消除其對器件性能不利影響的新策略；（4）製備並展示以低光電壓損失與優異長期運行穩定性為目標的寬帶隙單結PSCs；（5）製備並展示具備顯著效率提升與長期運行穩定性的高性能鈣鈦礦基疊層太陽能電池。本項目的順利完成將為調控鹵素演變、克服PSCs的不穩定性與光電壓損失提供關鍵理論與技術路徑；預期成果將在先進疊層電池上同時實現高效率與高穩定性，從而加速其商業化進程並為全球可再生能源解決方案作出貢獻。

23500125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23500125.value: 宏观经济预期与资产价格

23500125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23500125.value: Macroeconomic conditions are crucial drivers of asset prices and have received significant attention. Researchers have long been interested in the link between the macroeconomy and the financial market. Economic theory suggests that macroeconomic beta should be priced in the cross-section of stock returns. However, empirical evidence shows that stocks with high risk exposure do not earn higher returns than stocks with low risk exposure, contradicting theoretical predictions. Moreover, few studies have investigated the dynamics of macro factors despite their importance. To address these questions, this project studies how investors’ subjective beliefs about macro conditions affect stock prices in the cross-section. Recent research shows that not everyone instantaneously notices macroeconomic developments, and investors’ macroeconomic expectations are sticky. Motivated by this new evidence, the proposed study will explore the link between subjective macroeconomic expectations and macro factor returns. Addressing this question not only enriches our understanding of the subjective macroeconomic expectations but also sheds light on their impact on the financial market. This project will use sticky macro expectations to explain why high macro beta stocks do not earn significantly higher returns than low beta stocks, both theoretically and empirically. The sticky expectations lead to insufficient reactions from investors, leading to the overpricing of high-beta stocks relative to low-beta stocks. As investors gradually recognize their expectation errors, prices correct to their fundamentals, resulting in lower subsequent returns for high beta stocks. Our preliminary results show that errors in macroeconomic expectations comove positively with corresponding macro factors. Unexpected improvements in macro conditions indicate good news and translate into higher returns to high macro beta stocks. This suggests that as investors revise their macro expectations, there are consistent returns to macro factors. In addition, we show that macro factors positively predict errors in macro expectations, indicating underreactions in prices and expectations. We will examine whether the outperformance of low beta stocks relative to high beta stocks occurs following periods when investors have more sticky expectations. Additionally, we will investigate whether there are biases in expected risk at the individual stock level. The proposed project will contribute to both literature and practice by providing a comprehensive analysis of the unconditional returns and dynamics of macro factors. It will also deepen our understanding of the nexus between the macroeconomy and the financial market. 宏观经济条件是资产价格的关键驱动因素，备受学术界和业界关注。长期以来，研究者致力于探索宏观经济与金融市场之间的关联。经济理论认为，宏观经济贝塔应在股票回报的横截面中被定价。然而，实证研究表明，高宏观贝塔股票的回报并未显著高于低贝塔股票，与理论预测相悖。此外，现有文献对宏观因子动态变化的研究仍显不足。为解决这些问题，本研究聚焦于投资者对宏观经济条件的主观预期如何影响股票价格的横截面定价。近期研究揭示，投资者的宏观经济预期具有粘性。受此启发，本研究将深入探讨主观宏观经济预期与宏观因子回报之间的关系。这一探索不仅深化了对主观宏观经济预期的理解，还阐明了其对金融市场的影响。本项目通过理论与实证分析，运用粘性预期理论解释为何高宏观贝塔股票的收益未显著高于低贝塔股票。粘性预期导致投资者反应不足，致使高贝塔股票相对低贝塔股票被高估。随着投资者逐渐修正预期错误，价格回归基本面，高贝塔股票的后续回报随之下降。初步结果表明，宏观预期误差与相应宏观因子呈正相关，宏观条件的意外改善带来好消息，推动高宏观贝塔股票获得更高回报。这显示出投资者修正宏观预期时，宏观因子收益的一致性。此外，宏观因子能够正向预测预期误差，反映出价格和预期的反应不足。本研究将通过全面分析宏观因子的无条件回报及其动态变化，为学术研究和实践提供重要贡献，进一步深化对宏观经济与金融市场联系的认识。

23501925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23501925.value: 供應鏈中分銷商營運與融資職能之協同機制研究

23501925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23501925.value: In developing and emerging economies, distributors are essential to supply chains by connecting manufacturers with millions of small retailers. In China alone, distributor revenue reached $97.4 billion in 2022, according to a report by Electronic Components Industry Association. While existing research has primarily focused on their operational role—such as providing logistics and increasing retail demand—distributors also play a critical financing role by extending credit to cash-constrained retailers. For instance, Shenzhen Wisewheel Electronics Co., Ltd, one of China’s largest local electronic component distributors, offers 90-120 days credit terms to its core customers. Despite this prevalent practice, the financial role of distributors remains underexplored. Intuitively, while delegating the financing function to distributors provides additional incentives for them to assess retailers’ creditworthiness and boost sales, it may also create conflict of interests between manufacturers and distributors. Motivated by such strategic trade-offs, this project aims to better understand the interaction between the operational and financial roles of distributors by investigating the following three questions. First, how should a manufacturer contract with a distributor for the latter to better fulfill his operational and financial roles jointly (bilateral contract)? Specifically, when and how should the distributor be incentivized to assess retailers’ creditworthiness? What factors affect supply chain profitability under such a contract compared to an integrated supply chain? Second, should the distributor delegate the task of assessing retailers' creditworthiness to a bank if such an option exists? How would this affect the manufacturer’s profitability? Third, can a trilateral contract—where the manufacturer orchestrates a three-party relationship with the distributor and a bank—provide a better solution? If so, what should the optimal structure of such a contract look like? We will further compare it to the bilateral contract to identify the key operational and financial factors influencing the manufacturer’s contract choice. We expect this study to make significant contributions to literature.
