The hybrid ankle robotic system integrates a modular ankle robot with neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES). The robot assists ankle movement within a defined range, whereas NMES stimulates muscle contractions during movement. Participants will receive repeated, intensive stretching and game-based interactive training while seated, making this approach ideal for subacute stroke survivors with limited standing balance and ankle control. We previously demonstrated that ankle robotic training reduced impairments in subacute stroke survivors and hybrid ankle robotic training improved walking speed in chronic stroke survivors. An important next step is to conduct a rigorous clinical trial to (1) evaluate the effects of hybrid ankle robotic training on gait recovery in subacute stroke survivors and (2) explore the biomechanical mechanisms underlying these training effects on walking speed. We will conduct a randomized controlled trial with 88 subacute stroke survivors to compare the effects of an 8-week hybrid ankle training program with those of conventional ankle training. Assessments will be conducted at baseline, post-intervention, and 6 months after randomization. The primary outcome will be walking speed, and mediation analysis on paretic propulsive force will be conducted to explore mechanisms contributing to gait recovery. This proposed project will be the first fully powered randomized controlled trial to evaluate effects of hybrid ankle robotic training in subacute stroke survivors. It will address critical questions regarding the role of early, intensive, impairment-specific training post-stroke. Because persistent ankle impairments remain a common but unresolved issue post-stroke, the findings of this proposed project will provide crucial insights for developing novel stroke rehabilitation strategies. 踝關節在步行過程中擔當關鍵角色，透過每一步推動身體向前。然而，中風後，踝關節常出現肌力下降、關節活動度減低及控制困難等問題。現時的復康計劃主要著重整體下肢動作，往往忽略針對踝關節的專門介入。因此，不少中風康復者持續面對踝關節功能障礙及異常步態，對日常生活造成重大影響。改善踝關節功能是許多中風康復者的重要目標。 在中風後首六個月（即亞急性期）進行高強度的主動運動訓練，對運動功能恢復最為有效。由於嚴重的動作障礙會限制功能表現，建議於早期提供高劑量、針對特定障礙的訓練，以促進真正的功能恢復，而非僅依賴代償策略。基於上述發現，我們建議在亞急性期中風患者中，應用混合式踝關節機械人訓練計劃，以加強踝關節肌力、關節活動度及控制能力，從而提升步行能力。 混合式踝關節機械人系統結合模組化踝關節機械人及神經肌肉電刺激（NMES）。機械人可於設定範圍內協助踝關節運動，而NMES則於運動期間刺激肌肉收縮。參與者將在坐姿下接受反覆、高強度的牽伸訓練及遊戲互動訓練，對於站立平衡及踝關節控制能力有限的亞急性期中風患者尤其適合。我們早前的研究顯示，踝關節機械人訓練可減輕亞急性期中風患者的功能障礙，而混合式踝關節機械人訓練則能改善慢性期中風患者的步行速度。下一重要步驟是開展嚴謹的臨床研究，以（1）評估混合式踝關節機械人訓練對亞急性期中風患者步態恢復的成效，以及（2）探討該訓練在改善步行速度上的生物力學機制。 本研究將以隨機對照試驗形式，招募88名亞急性期中風患者，比較為期8週的混合式踝關節訓練與傳統訓練之成效。評估將於基線、介入結束後，以及介入結束後3個月及6個月進行。主要評估指標為步行速度，並將進行步態分析，以探討促進步態恢復的相關機制。 此項研究將是首個具足夠樣本量的隨機對照試驗，評估混合式踝關節機械人訓練於亞急性期中風患者中的成效，並解答有關中風後早期、高強度、針對性障礙訓練的關鍵問題。由於持續性踝關節功能障礙仍是中風後常見但未解決的問題，本研究的成果將為發展創新的中風復康策略提供重要啟示。

25206625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25206625.value: 利用超聲波碳化技術開發超細孔隙輕質水發泡混凝土

25206625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25206625.value: In the quest to reduce 'operational' carbon emissions in the building sector, foamed concrete (FC) has emerged as an energy-efficient material due to its high porosity, offering benefits like lightweight, thermal insulation, sound absorption, and fire resistance. Traditionally, FC is produced by integrating cement paste/mortar with air bubbles generated through either physical or chemical foaming method. However, these bubbles are thermodynamically unstable, leading to pore enlargement and compromised performance metrics such as compressive strength and thermal conductivity. Despite efforts to stabilize these bubbles, the pore sizes remain in the micrometer-level, limiting FC's practical application. In the cementitious system, aside from air, water is another medium capable of generating pores, though on a much smaller scale. During hydration, spaces initially occupied by unconsumed water evolve into capillary pores, ranging in size from 10 nm to 1000 nm. Theoretically, if excess water could be uniformly distributed and stabilized within the early-age cement matrix, alongside the rapid generation of hydration products, it would be feasible to create a lightweight concrete with ultrafine pores. While the three-dimensional network, known as flocculation or colloidal structure, that forms in early-age cement paste has a certain capability of retaining water, it is relatively weak and unstable. In cases with excessive water (e.g. water-to-cement ratio (w/c) >0.50), bleeding occurs as gravitational and capillary forces disrupt the structure, releasing the trapped water. Interestingly, the greenhouse gas CO2 might present a promising solution to enhance the aforementioned flocculation structure. OPC, while carbon-intensive to produce, displays high CO2 reactivity. Existing studies from the team demonstrated that early-age CO2 exposure rapidly increased the static yield stress of the subjected concrete, preliminarily indicating its capability of strengthening of the flocculation structure. Meanwhile, the use of ultrasonic waves during carbonation could markedly boost the carbonation efficiency. This proposal aims to develop lightweight water-foamed concrete (WFC) with ultrafine pores using ultrasonic carbonation, revolutionizing lightweight concrete production. By engineering the flocculation structure of early-age cement paste, water will innovatively serve as a pore-controlling medium, creating lightweight concrete with nanometer-size pores. Meanwhile, CO2 will be permanently sequestrated during this process, reducing the 'embodied' carbon emission. The project will thoroughly investigate the process of fortifying the flocculation structure, establish a numerical model, and examine the resulted microstructure. In addition, the performance and environmental impact of WFC will be rigorously evaluated, offering a building material that reduces both "operational" and "embodied" carbon emissions, advancing energy-efficient, low-carbon construction solutions. 在建築領域降低「運營碳排放」的追求中，發泡混凝土（FC）因其高孔隙率特性成為備受關注的節能材料，具有輕質、隔熱、吸音和防火等優勢。傳統FC通過物理或化學發泡法將氣泡導入水泥漿/砂漿製成，但這些氣泡存在熱力學不穩定性，易導致孔隙擴大，進而影響抗壓強度和導熱係數等關鍵性能指標。儘管已有諸多氣泡穩定化研究，其孔隙尺度仍停留在微米級，限制了實際應用。 水泥基體系中，除空氣外，水是另一種能形成孔隙的介質，且尺度更為微小。在水化過程中，未消耗水分子原本佔據的空間將轉化為10奈米至1000奈米級的毛細孔隙。理論上，若能將過量水均勻分散並穩定於早期水泥基體中，同時加速水化產物生成，即可製備具有超細孔隙的輕質混凝土。雖然早期水泥漿體形成的三維網絡結構（即絮凝/膠體結構）具有一定持水能力，但其強度低且不穩定。當水灰比（w/c）超過0.50時，重力與毛細力會破壞結構導致泌水現象。值得注意的是，溫室氣體CO₂可能成為強化絮凝結構的關鍵：雖然普通波特蘭水泥（OPC）生產過程碳排量高，卻展現出優異的CO₂反應活性。團隊前期研究證實，早期碳化處理能快速提升混凝土靜態屈服應力，初步顯示其強化絮凝結構的潛力。而超聲波技術的引入更能顯著提升碳化效率。 本提案擬採用超音波碳化技術開發具有奈米級孔隙的輕質水發泡混凝土（WFC），實現輕質混凝土生產的革命性突破。通過對早期水泥漿體絮凝結構的定向調控，創新性地以水作為造孔介質，同時在此過程中永久固存CO₂以降低「蘊含碳排放」。研究將系統探究絮凝結構強化機制、建立數值模型、解析微觀結構特徵，並全面評估WFC的性能表現與環境效益，最終提供一種能同步減少「運營碳排放」與「蘊含碳排放」的建築材料，推動節能低碳建築解決方案的發展。

25213425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25213425.value: 適用於光學複雜表面的新型原子級氣液噴射拋光方法

25213425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25213425.value: Optical complex surfaces (OCSs) with ultra-precision accuracy are essential components in critical applications such as X-ray reflectors, EUV lithography, super-resolution imaging, etc. These applications demand extremely high surface quality and form accuracy, making ultra-precision manufacturing crucial. Polishing, the final step in the machining process, directly determines the surface’s final accuracy and is vital for the entire manufacturing process of OCSs. However, current polishing methods with atomic-level accuracy are highly inefficient, hindering the mass production of ultra-precision OCS components. This project aims to develop a novel atomic-scale Aero-Hydro-Jet Polishing (ASAHJP) method, utilizing a new material nano-removal mechanism called ‘Aero-Hydro Dynamic (AHD)’ to achieve atomic-level accuracy and higher polishing efficiency. The AHD mechanism employs a high-velocity air jet in a nano-abrasive slurry directed at the target surface. The high-speed airflow (~571 m/s at 2 bar for pure air) creates low pressure, drawing water and nano-abrasive particles into the jet. These abrasive-laden droplets accelerate rapidly and impact the workpiece surface. Continuous water intake ensures a hydration layer on the workpiece, inducing chemical reactions that form hydroxylated structures. These structures bond with the silicon hydroxyl groups on the silica particles. As particles detach, they drag a layer of atoms from the surface, achieving precise material removal. The atomic-scale material removal and sub-surface evolution mechanisms will be explored using Molecular Dynamic (MD) Modelling. Additionally, both a single particle material removal model and a tool influence function model will be developed by combining multi-phase Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations and high-speed camera observations. This will result in a multi-scale material removal model, providing a deeper understanding of the process to guide polishing. A physics-informed machine learning-based multi-objective optimization algorithm will be created to implement intelligent process control even under a small number of samples. Finally, the ASAHJP prototype will be developed and integrated with the intelligent control system. Verification experiments on typical OCSs, including uniform and corrective polishing, will be conducted and compared to existing ultra-precision polishing methods. The success of this project will introduce a novel ultra-precision polishing method with both atomic-scale accuracy and high polishing efficiency for OCSs. It will also enhance scientific understanding of the fundamental mechanisms of the ASAHJP process. The proposed ASAHJP system, integrated with the intelligent control system, will offer an innovative turnkey solution for the ultra-precision polishing of high-value-added OCSs, potentially revolutionizing the polishing methods for these surfaces. 具有超精密精度的光學複雜曲面是X射線反射鏡、極紫外光刻、超分辨成像等關鍵應用中的核心元件。這些應用要求極高的表面品質和形狀精度，使得超精密製造至關重要。拋光作為加工過程的最終工序，直接決定表面的最終精度，對整個光學複雜曲面的製造過程具有決定性作用。然而，當前具備原子級精度的拋光方法效率極低，阻礙了超精密光學複雜曲面元件的大規模生產。 本專案旨在開發一種新型原子級氣液喷射拋光（ASAHJP）方法，利用一種稱為“氣液動力”的新材料納米去除機制，實現原子級精度和更高的拋光效率。氣液動力機制採用高速空氣射流噴射含有納米磨粒的漿料至目標表面。高速氣流（純空氣在2 bar壓力下速度約571米/秒）產生的低壓將水和納米磨粒吸入射流中。這些含磨粒的液滴被迅速加速並衝擊工件表面。持續的水流輸入確保工件表面形成水合層，引發化學反應生成羥基化結構。這些結構與二氧化矽顆粒上的矽羥基結合。當顆粒脫離時，會從工件表面拖拽出一層原子，從而實現精確的材料去除。該方法顯著提高了光學複雜曲面的拋光效率和精度。 項目將利用分子動力學建模探索原子級材料去除和亞表面演變機制。此外，通過結合多相計算流體動力學模擬和高速攝影觀測，將建立單顆粒材料去除模型和工具影響函數模型。這將形成一個多尺度材料去除模型，為拋光過程提供深入理解以指導實踐。項目還將創建一種物理資訊驅動的機器學習多目標優化演算法，以實現智慧程序控制。最終，將開發ASAHJP原型機並與智慧控制系統集成。在典型光學複雜曲面上進行均勻拋光和修形拋光等驗證實驗，並與現有超精密拋光方法進行對比。 本項目的成功將引入一種兼具原子級精度和高拋光效率的新型超精密光學複雜曲面拋光方法。同時，它將增進對ASAHJP過程基礎機制的科學理解。所提出的ASAHJP系統，結合智慧控制系統，將為高附加值光學複雜曲面的超精密拋光提供創新的交鑰匙解決方案，有望徹底革新此類表面的拋光方法。

25223525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25223525.value: 針對輕度認知障礙患者的自適應VR回憶系統的開發與評估：一項隨機對照可行性試驗

25223525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25223525.value: Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is a crucial stage between healthy aging and dementia, with 10% of MCI individuals progressing to dementia annually. This transition substantially impacts daily functioning, independence, and quality of life. While non-pharmacological interventions like one-on-one treatments have shown promise in addressing physical and cognitive frailty in individuals with MCI, these approaches are often hindered by challenges such as limited access to physiotherapists, the repetitive and monotonous nature of treatments, and the financial and temporal burden of frequent visits. Virtual reality (VR) technology emerges as a potential solution for MCI treatment. However, conventional VR programs often neglect the personal experiences, cognitive abilities, and physical constraints of those with MCI. The lack of adaptive design leads to generic treatment plans, limiting the efficacy in addressing MCI. Our preliminary work on VR-based interventions for MCI, including systematic reviews, semi-structured interviews with older adults and physiotherapists, and fieldwork has underscored the urgent need and importance of an innovative VR strategy that can provide dynamic, tailored, and interactive interventions for individuals with MCI. We aim to develop an Adaptive VR-based Reminiscence System (AVRS) and evaluate its efficacy and feasibility in MCI care. The specific objective is to comparatively analyze if the evidence-based therapeutic training delivered by the AVRS (intervention) outperforms the training through Non-reminiscence VR Exergames (NVE) (control-1) and traditional treatment (control-2) in terms of cognitive and physical functions for MCI individuals. Our project adapts a three-arm, 16-week randomized controlled feasibility trial involving 120 participants with MCI. These participants will be randomly allocated to either the AVRS group (intervention), NVE group (control-1), or traditional treatment group (control-2). Efficacy-related outcomes, focusing on cognitive and physical functions, will be assessed at baseline (T0), 16 weeks (T1) post-baseline, and 3 months post-intervention (T2) using validated assessment tools. Data will be analyzed following per-protocol and intention-to-treat principles using a generalized linear mixed model. Furthermore, feasibility outcomes, including usability, acceptability, and adherence, will be evaluated to identify potential facilitators and barriers for future large-scale implementation. Our study will align MCI research with contemporary technology-driven approaches, introduce a personalized angle to leveraging VR for enhanced treatments, and set a foundation example for future investigations into VR-based rehabilitative strategies. The empirical evidence gathered will support the use of adaptive VR designs to slow the progression of MCI potentially and hold promise in alleviating the caregiving burdens on families and society. 輕度認知障礙是健康老化與失智症之間的關鍵階段，每年有10%的輕度認知障礙患者會發展為失智症。這一轉變會嚴重影響日常功能、獨立生活和生活品質。雖然一對一治療等非藥物幹預措施在解決輕度認知障礙患者的身體和認知功能障礙方面已顯示出良好的前景，但這些方法往往受到諸多挑戰的阻礙，例如物理治療師的可及性有限、治療重複單調以及頻繁就診帶來的經濟和時間負擔。虛擬實境技術應運而生，成為輕度認知障礙治療的潛在解決方案。然而，傳統的虛擬實境程序往往忽略了輕度認知障礙患者的個人體驗、認知能力和身體限制。缺乏自適應設計導致治療方案千篇一律，限制了其治療效果。 我們基於VR的輕度認知障礙干預研究的初步工作，包括系統綜述、對老年人和物理治療師的半結構化訪談以及實地考察，強調了創新型虛擬實境策略的迫切需求和重要性，該策略能夠為輕度認知障礙患者提供動態、客製化和互動式介入。 我們旨在開發一套基於自適應虛擬實境的回憶系統（AVRS），並評估其在輕度認知障礙護理中的有效性和可行性。具體目標是比較分析AVRS提供的實證治療訓練（介入）在虛擬實境患者的認知和身體功能方面是否優於非回憶式虛擬實境（NVE）運動遊戲（對照組-1）和傳統治療（對照組-2）。 我們的計畫採用了一項三組、為期16週的隨機對照可行性試驗，涉及120名輕度認知障礙患者。這些患者將被隨機分配到AVRS組、NVE組或傳統治療組。我們將使用經過驗證的評估工具，在基線（T0）、基線後16週（T1）和介入後3個月（T2）評估療效相關結果，重點在於認知和身體功能。數據將遵循符合方案和意圖治療原則，使用廣義線性混合模型進行分析。此外，我們還將評估可行性結果，包括可用性、可接受性和依從性，以確定未來大規模實施的潛在促進因素和障礙。 我們的研究將使輕度認知障礙研究與當代技術驅動的方法相結合，引入個人化視角以利用虛擬實境增強治療，並為未來基於虛擬實境的復健策略研究奠定基礎。收集到的實證證據將支持使用自適應虛擬實境設計來潛在地減緩輕度認知障礙的進展，並有望減輕家庭和社會的照顧負擔。

25227525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25227525.value: 基於多普勒跟蹤誤差的GNSS接收機欺騙信號檢測與緩解：實現可靠連續的城市導航服務

25227525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25227525.value: GNSS is a low-cost solution for precisely locating people, vehicles, and other objects, and has become an integral part of our daily lives. Over the years, GNSS accuracy has improved significantly. Centimetre-level accuracy can be easily achieved with high-precision positioning techniques. While high accuracy is continuously desirable, high security is equally important in many applications like aviation, autonomous systems, public transport, banking transactions, etc. One rising threat to GNSS security is spoofing, which is a malicious attempt to alter a user’s positioning and timing information, causing unreliable GNSS services. Spoofing has become a rapidly evolving topic in the research community and has drawn attention from the industry. Although anti-spoofing solutions have been proposed from multiple angles, there is little focus on spoofing attack detection and mitigation for navigation services in urban areas, where over 55% of the world’s population resides and most location-based services are happening and need protection. A big challenge in tackling spoofing in urban areas is the interference from multipath signals, which can cause false alerts of spoofing, leading to intermittent denial of GNSS services. This project deals with spoofing from the perspective of receiver Doppler tracking, aiming for reliable and continuous urban navigation. First, we investigate the receiver carrier tracking loop to model Doppler tracking error under spoofing and multipath signals, serving as a cornerstone for the project. Second, we analyse various spoofing attack modes considering multiple scenarios like static and dynamic user cases, positioning spoofing and timing spoofing, etc. Doppler error models under these modes will be analytically established to develop effective spoofing detection metrics. Third, by characterizing multipath- and spoofing-induced Doppler errors, we will develop a discrimination algorithm to distinguish spoofing from multipath to reduce false alerts for spoofing detection. Finally, we will maintain reliable positioning under spoofing attacks by recovering true navigation measurements. This will be achieved by formulating a parameter estimation problem based on the previously established Doppler error models under spoofing. The models and algorithms will be evaluated using public spoofing datasets and a self-developed spoofing/multipath platform. With analytical modelling, quantitative analysis, algorithmic design, and comprehensive validation, reliable and continuous GNSS services can be achieved. The new models will deepen our understanding of receiver frequency tracking loops' behaviour under spoofing and multipath signals, hence guiding robust tracking loops design. The anti-spoofing algorithms will greatly safeguard our receivers, bringing safer GNSS services to every one of us. 全球導航衛星系統（GNSS）作為精確定位人員、車輛與物體的低成本解決方案，已成為日常生活不可或缺的技術。近年GNSS精度顯著提升，透過高精度定位技術可輕易實現厘米級定位。在航空、自主系統、公共交通、銀行交易等關鍵領域，高精度與高安全性同等重要。其中欺騙信號已成為GNSS安全的新興威脅——此惡意攻擊旨在篡改用戶定位與時間信息，導致服務失準。欺騙防護研究在學界快速發展，亦引發業界高度關注。 現有反欺騙方案雖從多角度提出，卻鮮少聚焦城市環境下導航服務的攻擊檢測與緩解。全球逾55%人口聚居城市環境，多數基於位置的服務在此運行且亟需保護。城市環境反欺騙的核心挑戰在於多路徑效應干擾，可能觸發欺騙誤報，造成GNSS服務間歇中斷。本項目從接收機多普勒追蹤視角切入，致力實現可靠連續的城市導航。 研究分四階段推進： 首先解析接收機載波追蹤迴路，建立欺騙信號與多路徑效應下的多普勒追蹤誤差模型，奠定研究基礎；次則剖析靜態/動態用戶、定位欺騙/時序欺騙等多情境攻擊模式，透過理論推導建立對應多普勒誤差模型，據此設計高效欺騙偵測指標；繼而透過多路徑與欺騙信號誘發之多普勒誤差特徵分析，開發辨識演算法區分兩類干擾，降低欺騙誤報率；最終基於欺騙情境多普勒誤差模型構建參數估計框架，復原真實導航量測值以維持定位可靠性。模型與演算法將透過公開欺騙數據集及自主開發之欺騙/多路徑平台驗證。 藉由理論推導、定量分析、演算法設計與全面驗證，本研究將實現可靠連續的GNSS服務。新建模型可深化對接收機頻率追蹤迴路在欺騙與多路徑環境下行為機制的認知，為設計強健追蹤迴路提供指引。反欺騙演算法將大幅提升接收機防護能力，為全民帶來更安全的GNSS服務。

25231725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25231725.value: 活性氯化學對大氣無機硝酸鹽生成的貢獻

25231725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25231725.value: Inorganic nitrate, which includes nitric acid and particulate nitrate ions undergoing gas-particle partitioning, plays a crucial role in the formation and growth of aerosol particles. This has profound implications for aerosol properties, air quality, and climate. In China, despite a significant reduction in anthropogenic emissions over the past decade, atmospheric particulate nitrate concentrations remain high, especially during haze events. While inorganic nitrate can form through various pathways in the atmosphere, the contribution of each pathway in different environments is not well understood. Recent studies using isotopic techniques suggest that reactive chlorine chemistry may have been overlooked in the rapid growth of inorganic nitrate during haze events in China. However, these studies lacked direct measurements of reactive chlorine species to support their hypothesis and did not account for regional transport influences. China is a major hotspot for anthropogenic chlorine emissions, and our research team has detected elevated levels of reactive chlorine species during recent field campaigns, highlighting the substantial impact of reactive chlorine chemistry on air quality. The primary objective of this research proposal is to quantify the contribution of reactive chlorine chemistry to inorganic nitrate formation in the lower atmosphere. To achieve this, we propose a combined approach involving laboratory measurements, field data analysis, and modeling. We will conduct laboratory measurements to determine the oxygen isotopic composition of inorganic nitrate for aerosol samples collected during our recent field campaigns in China, where key reactive chlorine species and inorganic nitrate precursors were measured simultaneously. We will then develop an isotopic version of the GEOS-Chem global chemical transport model to simulate the oxygen isotopic composition of inorganic nitrate, considering regional transport influences. By incorporating global anthropogenic chlorine emissions and an updated reactive chlorine chemistry scheme into the GEOS-Chem model, we will quantify the contribution of reactive chlorine chemistry to inorganic nitrate formation in China and globally. The observational data obtained in this project will provide a unique constraint on inorganic nitrate formation mechanisms in China during winter. The isotopic model scheme developed in this project will improve the simulation of the oxygen isotopic composition of inorganic nitrate in polluted regions (e.g., cities) with high emissions of nitrogen oxides, as well as in remote regions (e.g., the Arctic) where inorganic nitrate is significantly affected by long-range transport. 無機硝酸鹽在氣溶膠顆粒的形成與增長中起著關鍵作用，對氣溶膠特性、空氣品質及氣候具有深遠影響。過去十年間，儘管中國人為空氣污染物排放顯著降低，硝酸鹽氣溶膠濃度仍居高不下，尤其在霧霾事件期間。無機硝酸鹽在大氣中可通過多種途徑形成，不同大氣環境中各路徑的貢獻機制尚未明確。近期同位素技術研究表明可能忽略了活性氯化學對中國霧霾期間無機硝酸鹽快速增長的貢獻。然而這些研究既缺乏活性氯物種的直接測量數據支撐其假說，也未考慮區域傳輸的影響。中國是全球人為源氯排放熱點地區。本團隊在近期野外观測中檢測到高濃度活性氯物種，凸顯了活性氯化學對空氣品質的重大影響。 本研究計劃的核心目標是量化活性氯化學對低層大氣無機硝酸鹽生成的貢獻。為此我們提出實驗室測量、實地數據分析和模型模擬相結合的研究策略：首先通過實驗室測定中國近期實地觀測中採集氣溶膠樣本的無機硝酸鹽氧同位素組成（同步獲取了關鍵活性氯物種和無機硝酸鹽前體物數據）；繼而開發GEOS-Chem全球化學傳輸模型的同位素版本，在考慮區域傳輸影響的前提下模擬無機硝酸鹽氧同位素組成；通過將全球人為氯排放數據和更新的活性氯化學反應機制整合至GEOS-Chem模型，量化中國及全球範圍內活性氯化學對無機硝酸鹽生成的貢獻。本項目獲取的觀測數據將為解析中國冬季無機硝酸鹽形成機制提供獨特約束條件，所構建的同位素模型方案可顯著提升污染區域（如高氮氧化物排放城市）與偏遠地區（如受長距離傳輸顯著影響的北極）無機硝酸鹽氧同位素組成的模擬精度。

25233325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25233325.value: 探究密閉空間內的超快液體傳輸

25233325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25233325.value: Ultrafast liquid transport in confined spaces unlocks distinctive dynamics and interfacial phenomena that go beyond their bulk counterparts. Particularly, recent years have witnessed the intensive progress in the fundamental understanding of ultrafast water transport at the small scale and the versatile applications in water desalination and energy harvesting. Despite intensive advancements, understanding, regulating, and translating ultrafast water transport into practical water-energy applications remains challenging due to the involvement of complex multiscale, multi-phases, and multi-physical fields. In nature, many biologicals dynamically interact with and mechanically respond to surrounding environment through multiscale water transport, ranging from the gradual opening of pinecones to the rapid coiling of self-burying seeds and explosive release of pods. Inspired by nature, we preliminarily harnessed ultrafast water transport within MXene membranes to achieve a rapid, ordered and continuous moisture response in steady conditions, reminiscent of a continuous flapping motion (CFM). In contrast to conventional designs limited by slow kinetics and thermodynamics that often necessitate active manual intervention i.e., on-and-off switching of external stimuli to achieve continuous motion, such continuous moisture-responsive motion of CFM is fundamentally interesting and technically essential for diverse applications in soft robotics and electricity generators. Building on our preliminary work, this proposal aims to further probe the fundamental mechanisms underlying the continuous moisture-responsive motion of CFM and translate these insights into practical applications. To this end, we will first tailor our designs and explore the critical design principle, uncovering the intricate interplay among materials, structures, and mechanics that govern moisture-mechanical feedback loop for CFM. Then, we will experimentally and theoretically investigate the fundamental mechanism underlying CFM, with a focus on exploring microscopic water transport dynamics in confined spaces that responsible for adaptive moisture sorption and desorption. Moreover, we propose that the onset of CFM necessitates near-perfect timescale matching between water transport dynamics and its intrinsically elastic deformation. Moving one step forward, we will develop a physical model that elucidates the time competition between water transport dynamics and intrinsically elastic deformation, defining its boundary conditions for the onset of CFM. As a further demonstration, we will explore its potential application in electricity generation by translating CFM into the development of moisture electricity generators for moisture energy harvesting through the triboelectric effect. We envision that the implementation of this project will enrich and extend our fundamental understanding of water transport within low dimensional materials with confined spaces and bridge its gap with macroscopic applications. 受限空間中的超快液體傳輸產生了超越其塊體的獨特動力學和界面現象。近年來，人們在小尺度超快水傳輸的基礎理解及其在水和能量收集領域的廣泛應用方面取得了顯著進展。儘管如此，由於涉及複雜的多尺度、多相態和多物理場，理解和調控超快水傳輸，並將其轉化為實際的水能應用，仍然面臨挑戰。在自然界中，許多生物體透過多尺度水傳輸與周圍環境進行動態相互作用和機械響應，從松果的逐漸打開到自埋種子的快速捲繞，再到豆莢的爆發式釋放。受到自然界的啟發，我們初步利用MXene膜內的超快水傳輸，在穩定條件下實現快速、有序且連續的水分響應，類似於連續拍動運動（CFM）。傳統設計受限於緩慢的動力學和熱力學，通常需要主動的人工干預，即不斷切換外部刺激才能實現連續運動。CFM的這種連續濕度反應運動，不僅具有深刻的理論意義，對於技術上如軟體機器人和發電機等各種應用而言也至關重要。 本提案旨在基於前期工作，進一步探討CFM連續濕度反應運動背後的基本機制，並轉化為實際應用。為此，我們將首先探索關鍵的設計原理，揭示控制CFM濕度-機械回饋迴路的材料、結構和力學之間錯綜複雜的相互作用。接著，我們將透過實驗和理論研究CFM背後的基本機制，重點探討在密閉空間內負責自適應水分吸附和解吸的微觀水分傳輸動力學。此外，我們提出，CFM的啟動需要水分傳輸動力學與其固有彈性變形之間近乎完美的時間尺度匹配。更進一步，我們將發展一個物理模型，闡明水傳輸動力學與固有彈性變形之間的時間競爭，並定義其發生CFM時的邊界條件。作為進一步的應用展示，我們將探討其在發電領域的潛在應用，將CFM轉化為濕氣發電機，利用摩擦起電效應收集濕氣能量。

25233725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25233725.value: 氫燃料軸向分級燃燒系統：實驗研究與強化學習應用

25233725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25233725.value: Motivated by the Hong Kong Government's "Strategy of Hydrogen Development," which positions Hong Kong as a hub for advancing hydrogen technologies, and acknowledging the critical role of gas turbine combustors in global decarbonization efforts, this project seeks to address a key challenge: thermoacoustic instability in hydrogen-fueled gas turbine combustors. Tackling this issue is essential for decarbonizing the high-emission electricity generation and transport sectors, facilitating the transition to a carbon-free energy future. Thermoacoustic instability is an undesirable unsteady combustion phenomenon that manifests as strong flow oscillations. These unwanted flow oscillations degrade gas turbine performance and shorten maintenance intervals, resulting in tremendous economic losses. While thermoacoustic instability is already a challenge in conventional fossil-fueled combustors, it becomes even more severe when burning hydrogen, as burning hydrogen makes the combustor less thermoacoustically stable and amplifies flow oscillations demonstrated by recent studies, creating a major barrier to achieving carbon neutrality during the transition to zero-carbon fuels for gas turbines. In an axially staged combustion system, which is an advanced configuration of combustors designed to offer benefits such as lower emissions, higher thermodynamic efficiency, and greater fuel and operational flexibility, thermoacoustic instability, however, becomes even more complex due to the presence of the secondary flame. Recognizing both the industry's needs and gaps in current research, this project aims to resolve thermoacoustic instability in hydrogen-fueled axially staged combustors through a combination of experimental and numerical methods. The project's objectives are fourfold: (i) to validate and adapt classical active instability control strategies originally developed for fossil-fueled combustors for their effective use in hydrogen-fueled combustion systems, (ii) to advance theoretical understanding of thermoacoustic instability in hydrogen-fueled axially staged combustors, (iii) to develop an intelligent reinforcement learning-based control strategy to enhance combustor stability, and (iv) to validate and refine the theories and active instability control strategies in a larger-scale test bench operating under more realistic industrial conditions. This project will not only deepen our understanding of thermoacoustic instability in hydrogen combustion, directly contributing novel insights to the scientific community, but also provide a practical framework for developing robust active control strategies for industrial gas turbine carbon-free burners. The successful adaptation of these strategies to hydrogen-fueled systems will have profound implications for the design of next-generation, low-emission, carbon-free combustion systems, making them more stable and efficient, and better equipped to meet the demands of a decarbonized future. 鑑於香港政府近期頒布《香港氫能發展策略》，明確定位香港作為推進氫能技術的戰略平台，並考量到燃氣渦輪燃燒室在全球碳排放中的顯著影響，本專案旨在攻克氫燃料燃氣渦輪燃燒室的關鍵技術挑戰——​​熱聲不穩定現象​​。解決此問題對實現高排放發電產業的去碳化及清潔能源轉型至關重要。熱聲不穩定係指燃燒過程中產生的有害非穩態現象，其特徵為強烈流體振盪。此類振盪不僅降低燃氣渦輪性能、縮短檢修週期，更導致重大經濟損失。儘管傳統化石燃料燃燒室已面臨此挑戰，​​氫燃料的應用卻加劇問題嚴重性​​：近期研究證實，氫燃燒會削弱燃燒室熱聲穩定性並放大流體振盪，成為燃氣渦輪過渡至零碳燃料達成碳中和的主要障礙。在​​軸向分級燃燒系統​​（一種具備低排放、高熱效率及操作彈性優勢的先進燃燒構型）中，次級火焰的存在更使熱聲不穩定性呈現複雜耦合特徵。基於現有研究缺口，本專案整合​​實驗與數值模擬方法​​，系統性解決氫燃料燃燒室熱聲不穩定問題，具體目標包括：(i) 驗證並改造兩種傳統熱聲不穩定抑制策略，使其適用於氫燃料系統；(ii) 深化氫燃料軸向分級燃燒系統的熱聲不穩定機理認知；(iii) 開發基於強化學習的智能控制策略以實現燃燒穩定化； (iv) 在近工業級運轉條件下驗證理論模型與控制策略。本研究將突破氫燃燒熱聲不穩定機制的理論認知邊界，為學界提供創新見解，同時建構​​工業級燃氣渦輪燃燒器的穩健控制框架​​。相關策略成功移植至氫燃料系統後，將重塑新一代低排放燃燒系統設計範式——透過提升系統穩定性與效率，滿足去碳化時代的能源轉型需求。

25238325.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25238325.value: 寬能隙元件與新封裝技術的先進可靠性表徵方法

25238325.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25238325.value: Wide bandgap (WBG) semiconductors, like silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN), are revolutionizing power electronics such as renewable energy and electric vehicles. These devices can operate at higher temperatures, voltages, and frequencies than traditional silicon (Si) devices, making them ideal for next-generation power modules that demand higher efficiency and performance in harsh environments. However, current research on WBG devices largely focuses on circuit design and fabrication. The critical need for advanced characterization and compatible testing to ensure their reliability is overlooked. Without such tools, the development of next-generation power modules based on WBG devices faces critical challenges, such as thermal instability, inconsistent performance, and potential failures. Existing characterization and testing methods, which are originally developed for Si devices, often yield inaccurate or misleading results when applied to WBG devices. These challenges stem from three critical levels: device, packaging, and reliability. Specifically, the diverse properties of WBG devices introduce complexities that result in inconsistent thermal characterization. Smaller chip areas and more intricate packaging demand higher resolution in thermal structure analysis than traditional methods can provide. Moreover, long-term reliability testing, which can take months or even years, delays critical feedback for performance optimization and faster innovation. Thus, a holistic approach that integrates the three levels is essential for fully unlocking the potential of WBG devices. This project aims to address these challenges by developing advanced characterization and testing methods tailored to WBG devices and their new packaging. In device level, we aims to address the inconsistent thermal characterization challenge of WBG devices. By developing theory of underlying semiconductor physics, a better understanding of the governing mechanism enables reproducible methods. In packaging level, we aims to develop new schemes capable of capturing and analyzing faster thermal transients, which enable high-resolution thermal structure analysis for WBG devices. In reliability, this project aims to pioneer a new test-to-learn reliability concept. By exploring the few-probed early degradation mechanism of power semiconductors, intelligent learning methods can predict the lifetime instead of prolonged testing. This advancement can open up new pathways for reliability study and provide new knowledge for semiconductor degradation processes. The success of this project will advance our understanding of the fundamental behavior of WBG devices and deliver cutting-edge characterization tools. The novel reliability testing framework will have the potential to revolutionize reliability studies and help critical applications like renewable energy and electric vehicles achieve zero-defect goals. 寬能隙（WBG）半導體，如碳化矽（SiC）和氮化鎵（GaN），正在革新可再生能源與電動車等領域的電力電子技術。這些器件能在比傳統矽（Si）器件更高的溫度、电壓和頻率下運行，使其成為新一代需要在惡劣環境中實現更高效率和更高性能的功率模組的理想選擇。然而，目前對 WBG 器件的研究主要集中在電路設計與製造，對於確保其可靠性的先進表徵和相容測試的關鍵需求卻常被忽視。若缺乏這些工具，基於 WBG 器件的新一代功率模組在開發中將面臨重大挑戰，包括熱不穩定、性能不一致以及潛在失效等問題。 現有的表徵與測試方法最初是為矽器件開發的，當應用於 WBG 器件時往往會產生不準確或誤導性的結果。這些挑戰來自三個關鍵層面：器件、封裝與可靠性。具體來說，WBG 器件的多樣化特性增加了熱表徵的一致性難度。更小的晶片面積與更複雜的封裝設計，要求在熱結構分析中具備比傳統方法更高的解析度。此外，長期可靠性測試可能需要數月甚至數年，延遲了針對性能優化與快速創新的關鍵回饋。因此，整合這三個層面的整體方法對於充分釋放 WBG 器件的潛力至關重要。 本計劃將針對 WBG 器件及其新型封裝開發先進的表徵與測試方法。在器件層面，透過建立基於半導體物理的理論框架，實現熱表徵結果的可重複性。在封裝層面，開發能捕捉並分析更快熱瞬態的新方案，以支持高解析度的熱結構分析。本計劃的成果將深化對 WBG 器件基礎行為的理解，並提供最前沿的表徵工具，推動可靠性研究與新能源及電動車等應用的發展。

25307825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25307825.value: 經濟不確定性情形下的住房消費模式：基於隨機優化模型的多層次分析

25307825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25307825.value: Housing is one of the most important life-cycle decisions for households as both a durable consumption good and an investment asset. This dual role creates a close link to aggregate economic conditions. Its durable nature makes housing consumption highly responsive to economic shocks and stimuli, often signaling economic growth or contraction. Its investment aspect influences broader economic outcomes, serving as a key channel through which housing price fluctuations impact the overall economy. Recent housing market booms and busts across various countries underscore the need to better understand housing consumption patterns under economic uncertainty. This uncertainty arises when people lack information about the future performance of the economy. Empirical studies indicate that the housing market is informationally imperfect, with uncertainties stemming from factors such as government policies, monetary policies, and labor market conditions. In response, households adjust their beliefs and expectations, influencing their housing decisions. However, the traditional housing consumption model in mathematical finance literature relies on expected utility under rational expectation, unrealistically assuming that households make decisions with complete knowledge of economic fundamentals. This gap calls for the need of new theoretical formulations in stochastic control framework and related analysis, specifically to account for households' belief updates and interactions. Due to the mathematical complexity involved in modeling such a information structure, related topics have not been extensively explored. This research project aims to develop a comprehensive framework for analyzing housing consumption patterns under economic uncertainty, which incorporates modeling of beliefs and learning and spans over multiple perspectives. Our results will provide a quantitative basis for understanding housing market, valuable for assessing resilience to economic and social shocks like recessions. Beyond its practical implications, this research is methodologically interesting due to the infrequent nature of housing consumption, which motivates the use of Hindy-Huang-Kreps preferences and involves singular control optimization. Considering economic uncertainty, this leads to novel formulations of stochastic control problems and stochastic games on singular controls with incomplete information and learning. We propose an endogenous model where households dynamically update their beliefs based on observable signals. In later stages, we analyze the housing decisions among a heterogeneous population that incorporates learning or conformity to public opinions, and finally inferring households' belief from observed housing consumption patterns. This research is at the forefront of stochastic control research, with substantial novelty in modelings, theoretical derivations, and mathematical methodologies. 住房兼具耐用消費品與投資資產的雙重屬性，是家庭生命週期中最重要的決策之一。這種特性使住房消費與宏觀經濟狀況密切相關：其耐用性使住房消費對經濟衝擊和刺激高度敏感，常被視為經濟景氣的風向標；而其投資屬性則透過房價波動影響整體經濟，成為關鍵的傳導渠道。近年來，全球房地產市場的繁榮與蕭條進一步凸顯了在宏觀經濟不確定性下深入理解住房消費行為的迫切性。 這種不確定性主要來自經濟主體對未來走勢資訊的有限掌握。實證研究顯示，住房市場普遍存在信息不完全現象，這主要源於政府決策、貨幣政策及勞動力市場等多重外生因素的交互影響。在這樣的環境下，家庭會根據外部訊號動態調整自身信念與預期，進而影響其住房決策。 然而，現有文獻中的傳統住房消費模型多依賴理性預期下的期望效用理論，假設家庭能完全掌握經濟基本面資訊，這一前提與現實情況存在明顯差距。針對這一問題，本研究計畫提出在隨機控制框架下發展新的理論模型，重點納入家庭信念的動態更新與互動機制。由於這類資訊結構的數學建模極具挑戰，目前相關研究仍相對有限。本計畫旨在建立一套綜合分析框架，融合信念建模與學習機制，從多元角度探討宏觀經濟不確定性下的住房消費行為。預期研究成果將為理解住房市場提供量化依據，並有助於評估經濟衰退等重大社會衝擊下市場的韌性。 在方法論上，住房消費的「低頻發生」特性賦予其特殊的理論意義。因此，我們將採用Hindy-Huang-Kreps（HHK）偏好模型，並將奇異控制優化問題納入分析。結合宏觀不確定性，本研究將推導出兼具資訊不完全與學習機制的奇異控制問題及隨機博弈的新範式。我們將提出一套內生性模型框架：家庭根據可觀測訊號動態調整信念；後續將分析異質群體在融入學習機制或受輿論影響時的住房決策，並最終通過觀察實際消費模式反推出家庭信念。本研究在隨機控制模型構建、理論推導及數學方法上均具有顯著創新性，處於該領域的研究前沿。

25501625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25501625.value: 面向消费者的环境信息披露：半真还是全貌

25501625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25501625.value: In today’s society, with consumers becoming more aware of the environmental impacts of products, many firms are striving to improve their sustainability. A product’s environmental impact, however, is a credence attribute that is not directly observable by consumers. Ecolabels are widely used for environmental disclosure, but their proliferation has led to consumer confusion about label standards. Emerging Digital Product Passports (DPPs), powered by blockchain technology, offer an alternative solution. For consumers, ecolabels may cause confusion and provide incomplete environmental quality information (half-truth), while DPPs offer full transparency and complete environmental quality information (whole story). For companies, although DPPs might seem more beneficial, misjudgment arising from label confusion can lead ecolabels to increase firm profit. Additionally, from an environmental perspective, the flexibility in sustainable efforts empowered by DPPs may improve or reduce environmental quality. As such, it is unclear whether and when ecolabels or DPPs should be adopted. This proposed project examines how a firm should disclose its environmental quality to consumers and the impacts of this decision on various stakeholders, including companies, consumers, the environment, society, and governments/regulators. We propose a game-theoretic model where a firm discloses environmental quality through ecolabels or DPPs. Ecolabels can confuse some consumers, causing them to misestimate the firm's environmental quality, while DPPs provide full information to all consumers. Our analysis will determine the firm's optimal environmental quality, pricing, and profit under each disclosure method. We will compare these outcomes to identify when the firm prefers ecolabels or DPPs and examine how factors, such as consumer environmental awareness and label confusion, affect its decisions and profit. Additionally, we will explore the broader impacts of ecolabels and DPPs on the environment, consumers, and society, and discuss potential government regulations on environmental disclosure. Given the rising awareness of sustainability, the evolution of DPPs, and the Hong Kong Government's support for sustainability along with Web3 development and its underlying blockchain technology, our findings will be socially influential by enhancing the understanding of operational issues in the growing practices of environmental disclosure. Our research will also provide valuable insights for various stakeholders. Additionally, this project will significantly contribute to the literature on voluntary environmental certification/labeling by introducing DPPs as a new means of environmental disclosure and by considering unilateral or bilateral information asymmetry, and to that on blockchain applications from a sustainability perspective. 在当今社会，消费者的环保意识不断提升，企业日益重视可持续发展。然而，产品的环境影响属于消费者无法直接观察的信任属性。生态标签是常见的披露方式，但其种类繁多、标准不一，容易引发混淆。新兴的数字产品护照（DPP）依托区块链技术，可实现透明、完整的环境信息披露。对于消费者而言，生态标签可能仅传递部分信息（“半真”），而DPP可呈现全貌。对于企业而言，尽管DPP提供了更高透明度，但标签混淆带来的误判可能反而增加利润；从环境角度看，DPP赋予的投入灵活性可能改善或削弱环境质量。因此，企业应选择何种披露方式仍有待探讨。 本研究构建博弈论模型，比较企业在采用生态标签与DPP两种方式下的最优环境投入、定价与利润，分析消费者环保意识、标签混淆程度等因素的作用，并评估不同披露方式对环境、消费者与社会的影响。同时，研究将探讨政府在环境信息披露上的可能监管政策。 在可持续意识提升、DPP快速发展、香港政府推动可持续及Web3和区块链应用的背景下，本研究引入DPP作为新型披露机制，并纳入单边与双边信息不对称情境，将拓展自愿性环境信息披露与认证标签的理论研究；研究结果将为企业战略制定、政府监管设计及社会可持续发展提供参考。

25504425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25504425.value: 具身人工智能的好客性：模拟配备虚拟化身的餐厅自助服务技术

25504425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25504425.value: In the rapidly evolving landscape of the restaurant industry, the advent of self-service technologies (SSTs) has emerged as a transformative force, shaping how services are delivered and consumed. Valued at approximately US$ 3.5 billion (HK$27.2 billion), the SST market’s growth reflects a significant shift towards automation and customer-driven service models. Notably, nearly 60% of quick-service and fast-casual restaurants in Hong Kong have embraced SSTs, signaling a strong adoption rate within the Asia-Pacific region. The study focuses on understanding if AI avatars in restaurant SSTs can maintain genuine hospitality values. It also aims to examine how the realism of these avatars—how human-like they look and behave—affects customer perceptions and behaviors. To explore these questions, we will conduct two experimental studies using scenario-based simulations where customers interact with AI avatars embedded in SST devices. Study 1, including both field and simulation experiments, will evaluate the impact of having AI virtual assistants, with or without avatars, on customer responses. Participants will experience different SST modes: a standard self-service device, an AI device with voice-only assistance, and one with a human-like avatar. We will then compare customer satisfaction, their tendency to engage with AI employees, and their overall loyalty to the restaurant. Study 2 will further delve into the effects of avatar realism. It will investigate how variations in visual and behavioral aspects of the avatars influence customer perceptions. In particular, we will look at factors such as the avatars’ facial expressions and body movements, and how realistic these elements need to be to evoke a sense of hospitableness. By manipulating characteristics like polygon density (which affects visual detail) and dimensionality (2D vs. 3D representations), we will assess if higher realism leads to better hospitality experiences and customer engagement. The results from these studies will help us understand the potential of AI avatars to deliver genuine hospitality and their feasibility in enhancing customer satisfaction in tech-mediated restaurant services. 在餐饮业快速发展的背景下，自助服务技术（Self-Service Technologies, SSTs）的出现已成为一股具有变革性的力量，深刻影响着服务的提供与消费方式。当前，SST市场的价值约为35亿美元（约272亿港元），其增长趋势反映了服务模式正显著向自动化与顾客主导方向转型。值得注意的是，香港近60%的快速餐饮与休闲快餐企业已采用SST，这表明在亚太地区，该技术正处于较高水平的普及阶段。 本研究旨在探讨餐饮业中应用人工智能（AI）虚拟化身的SST，是否能够传递真实的待客之道。同时，研究将考察这些化身的拟人化程度——即其外观与行为的类人程度——对顾客感知与行为的影响。为深入探讨上述问题，我们将开展两项基于情境模拟的实验研究，模拟顾客与嵌入AI化身的SST设备之间的互动情境。 研究一（包括实地与模拟实验）将评估配备虚拟AI助理（有或无化身）的SST设备对顾客反应的影响。参与者将体验三种不同模式的SST：标准自助设备、仅具语音辅助的AI设备、以及配置类人化身的AI设备。我们将比较顾客在不同模式下的满意度、与AI“员工”的互动意愿以及对餐厅的整体忠诚度。 研究二将进一步探讨化身的拟真程度效应，聚焦化身的视觉与行为特征如何影响顾客感知。特别是，我们将关注化身的面部表情与身体动作等要素，以及这些特征的真实度在多大程度上能够激发顾客的好客感受。通过操控视觉多边形密度（影响视觉细节）及维度表现（二维与三维呈现之比较），评估更高的拟真性是否能够带来更佳的待客体验与顾客参与度。 本研究成果将有助于深入理解AI化身在传递真实待客价值方面的潜力，并评估其在科技介导的餐饮服务中提升顾客满意度的可行性。

25513625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25513625.value: 明星新员工社会化的过程和结果

25513625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25513625.value: The onboarding experience of newcomers plays a critical role in helping them quickly adjust to their roles, align with organizational objectives, and contribute to team effectiveness. Effective socialization not only speeds up this integration but also decreases turnover and boosts long-term performance, making it vital for building a competitive and cohesive workforce (Bauer et al., 2024; Kammeyer-Mueller et al., 2013). However, much of the existing newcomer socialization research has focused primarily on ordinary newcomers who featured by lacking of familiarity, relying on others, and facing uncertainty and stress (Bauer et al., 2007; Liu et al., 2024), often neglecting the unique challenges faced by star newcomers, who bring with them exceptional skills and high visibility, which can create distinct dynamics within teams (Boekhorst et al., 2024; Call et al., 2024). Unlike ordinary newcomers, star newcomers face the dual challenge of adjusting to the organization while simultaneously influencing its processes, norms, and overall performance. Take, for example, Victor Wembanyama when he entered the NBA as a rookie in 2023. His exceptional talent was clear, but his arrival sparked questions about how a high-profile newcomer would integrate into the established dynamics of the team. Unlike ordinary newcomers, star newcomers like Wembanyama bring not only extraordinary skills but also high expectations, increased visibility, and intense pressure to deliver results quickly. This creates a unique socialization process, where the team itself may need to make structural and strategic adjustments to fully leverage the star newcomer’s abilities. Would Wembanyama’s presence lead to an immediate improvement in team performance, or would it require a period of adaptation, potentially causing short-term disruptions? This example highlights the broader challenge of understanding how star newcomers adjust to new environments and how teams adapt to their arrival. This proposal aims to build on the earlier work by incorporating primary data collection methods, such as surveys and interviews with both star newcomers and their teammates, to delve into the psychological and social mechanisms of star newcomer socialization. The project will collect a wider range of variables, including newcomer behaviors, team perceptions, and performance over time, to better capture the dual adaptation process—how star newcomers adjust to their teams and how teams adapt to accommodate star newcomers. Ultimately, the findings will provide practical guidance for organizations looking to optimize the integration of star talent, particularly in Hong Kong’s highly competitive industries. 新员工的入职体验在帮助他们迅速适应岗位、对齐组织目标以及提升团队效能方面起着关键作用。有效的社会化过程不仅能够加快新员工的融入速度，还能降低离职率，并提升长期绩效，因此对于打造一支具有竞争力和凝聚力的员工队伍至关重要（Bauer et al.，2024；Kammeyer-Mueller et al.，2013）。然而，现有的大多数新员工社会化研究主要聚焦于“普通新员工”，这些人通常缺乏熟悉感、依赖他人，并面临不确定性与压力（Bauer et al.，2007；Liu et al.，2024）。这一研究趋势往往忽视了“明星新员工”所面临的独特挑战——他们具备卓越的技能和高度的可见性，这可能在团队中产生特殊的互动动态（Boekhorst et al.，2024；Call et al.，2024）。 与普通新员工不同，明星新员工面临着双重挑战：一方面要适应组织环境，另一方面又在同时影响组织的运作流程、规范以及整体绩效。以维克多·文班亚马（Victor Wembanyama）为例，他在2023年作为新秀加入NBA时就引发了广泛关注。他的卓越天赋显而易见，但他的到来也带来了一个问题：一位备受瞩目的新星如何融入一支已有既定运作模式的团队？不同于普通新员工，像文班亚马这样的明星新员工不仅具备非凡的技能，还承载着极高的期望、更高的可见度以及必须迅速产生成果的巨大压力。这种情境创造出一种独特的社会化过程，团队本身可能也需要在结构和战略上作出调整，以最大程度地发挥明星新员工的能力。文班亚马的加入是否会立刻提升团队表现？还是需要一段适应期，可能短期内还会带来一些扰动？这一案例凸显了一个更广泛的挑战：我们如何理解明星新员工适应新环境的过程，以及团队如何调整以迎接他们的到来。 本研究计划旨在在已有研究的基础上进一步拓展，通过采用问卷调查和访谈等一手数据收集方法，深入探讨明星新员工社会化过程中的心理和社会机制。项目将收集更广泛的变量，包括新员工的行为表现、团队成员的感知以及绩效表现，以更全面地捕捉“双重适应”过程——既包括明星新员工如何适应团队，也包括团队如何调整以容纳明星新员工。最终，研究成果将为希望更有效整合明星人才的组织提供实践指导，特别是在竞争激烈的香港本地产业中。

25601025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25601025.value: 療治非洲：冷戰時期中國社會主義醫學的海外探索

25601025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25601025.value: This project traces the origins of China’s contemporary global health initiatives to the Cold War, focusing on its medical missions in Africa. Beginning in 1963, China sent doctors and nurses to Algeria to provide primary healthcare in underserved areas. The program has since expanded to 76 countries, predominantly in Africa. While often overlooked in scholarship as part of China’s broader foreign aid strategy, this history of Chinese medical internationalism offers key insights into China-Africa relations and global health dynamics. At the heart of this project is the question of whether China’s medical engagement in Africa represented a distinct global health model or mirrored patterns of influence and control akin to colonial medicine and postwar Western humanitarianism. Using “socialist medicine” as both a conceptual lens and organizing framework, I examine China’s ambition to present itself as a solution to African health challenges. Moving beyond oversimplified and celebratory official narratives, this study aims to understand the nature and goals of China’s medical missions, alongside the development and evolution of its humanitarian aid networks with Third World countries. The project extends and deepens my previous research on China’s health interventions in Algeria by adopting a comparative and connective analysis that includes Morocco and Tanzania to identify shared dynamics and broader patterns. I will analyze how Chinese doctors, moving across these places, adapted centralized policies and circulated medical knowledge and practices. Drawing on archival sources in Chinese, Arabic, and French, I will investigate aspects of the missions, including resource management, the challenges of integrating Chinese, Western, and indigenous medical practices, and the creation of new medical and social knowledge. In-depth interviews with Algerian patients, healthcare staff, and officials will further illuminate local perspectives on Chinese aid. This project is uniquely positioned to investigate the crosscurrents of global health history, Cold War studies, and the history of medicine. I aim to expand our understanding of non-Western influences on global health and provide a nuanced analysis of the intersection between humanitarianism, political objectives, and ideological commitments. In analyzing how genuine humanitarian efforts intersected with soft power, the project will tell a compelling history of China’s early efforts to “heal” Africa, which is essential for grasping its evolving role in global health and its impact on postcolonial health development. 本研究探討中國對非洲醫療援助的冷戰起源，聚焦其自1960年代起派遣醫療隊至阿爾及利亞等國的實踐，並分析其如何影響當代全球衛生格局。中國的醫療行動曾擴及76國，主要集中於非洲，為資源匱乏地區提供基層醫療服務。儘管學界多將此視為中國對外援助的一部分而忽略其獨立意義，中國醫療國際主義的歷史為理解中非關係與全球衛生格局提供了關鍵視角。我以「社會主義醫學」為分析框架，檢視中國是否建立了一種不同於西方殖民醫療與冷戰權力結構的醫療模式。研究將比對阿爾及利亞、摩洛哥與坦尚尼亞三地的案例，結合中文、阿拉伯文與法文檔案文獻，以及實地訪談資料，以探討中國醫療隊的實際操作、知識傳播與在地回應。本計畫旨在深化我們對中國如何透過醫療援助結合人道關懷與政治意圖的理解，並為全球衛生與中非關係史提供新的視角。

25603525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25603525.value: 增強身體儲備以促進衰弱長者認知與生理韌性

25603525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25603525.value: Aging involves decline in cognitive function, physical function, and brain integrity as people progress towards physical frailty - defined as an age-related state of reduce physical functioning and increased risk for subsequent cognitive impairment, physical impairment, and adverse health outcomes. Consequently, frail older adults are among the greatest consumers of healthcare resources, placing a substantial economic burden on the individual and the healthcare system. As the brain is central to cognitive and physical function, strategies that aim to enhance the brain will be critical. However, the deleterious effects of aging do not impact every individual equally – some retain high levels of function even with significant brain pathology. This suggest that functional decline due to physical frailty can be averted. Physical reserve (PR) is a new construct under the Collaboratory Resilience Framework established in 2023. Instead of being a musculoskeletal attribute, PR is a property of the brain wherein the neuroprotective effects are based upon the ability of brain networks to adaptively maintain physical function in face of pathologies. Therefore, enhancing PR may be able to optimally mitigate the negative health consequences of frailty. Nevertheless, "how", "by what", "for whom" resilience can be enhanced is unknown. Aerobic and resistance training have different cognitive, physical and brain benefits. However, a 2023 umbrella review concluded that more exercise trials are necessary to confirm these benefits, as individual differences in the brain may underpin this equivocality. In light of this, our pilot study found that: (1) multimodal exercise may enhance PR; (2) effects of multimodal exercise may vary in individuals with different initial PR capacity; and (3) there exists an intricate relationship between exercise, brain network, and PR that require further investigation to fully unveil "how" resilience can be promoted. A larger trial will be necessary to confirm these pilot findings. Therefore, we propose to conduct a 3-month randomized controlled trial in 230 community-dwelling older adults with physical frailty. Half of the study participants will be randomly assigned to combined aerobic and resistance training; the other half will undergo usual care. We will quantify PR and assess exercise-related changes in PR as well as its neural underpinnings using fMRI. Findings from the study will help address critical knowledge gaps in aging clinical research regarding "how", "what", and "for whom" physical exercise builds resilience, and provide foundational evidence to guide individual-tailored intervention for promoting resilience in this population at high risk for functional decline. 衰老伴随認知功能、身體機能及大腦完整性的衰退，此過程最終導向身體衰弱——定義為與年齡相關的生理功能下降狀態，並伴隨認知障礙、身體失能及不良健康結局的風險提升。因此，衰弱長者成為醫療資源的最大消耗群體，對個人與醫療體系造成重大經濟負擔。由於大腦主導認知與生理功能，針對大腦的強化策略至關重要。然而，衰老的負面效應並非均質化影響所有個體：部分人群即使存在顯著腦部病變，仍能維持高功能水平。這表明因身體衰弱導致的功能衰退具有可逆潛能。 身體儲備（Physical Reserve, PR）是2023年建立的「韌性協作框架」下的新建構概念。PR並非肌肉骨骼系統屬性，而是大腦的特質，其神經保護效應源於腦網絡在面對病變時適應性維持生理功能的能力。因此，增強PR可能成為緩解衰弱負面健康影響的優化策略。然目前仍未知「如何」、「透過何種方式」、「針對哪些人群」方能有效提升韌性。 有氧與阻力訓練對認知、生理及大腦各有裨益，但2023年總括性綜述指出，因個體腦部差異可能導致效果不明確，需更多運動試驗驗證效益。據此，我們先導研究發現：(1) 多模態運動可提升PR；(2) 運動效應因個體初始PR能力而異；(3) 運動、腦網絡與PR存在複雜關聯，需深入探究「如何」促進韌性。為驗證上述結果，我們擬對230名社區衰弱長者進行為期3個月的隨機對照試驗：半數受試者接受有氧+阻力聯合訓練，對照組維持常規照護。透過功能性磁振造影（fMRI）量化PR變化並解析其神經機制。研究成果將填補衰老臨床研究的關鍵知識缺口——釐清運動「如何」、「透過何種機制」、「針對何種人群」建構韌性，並為制定個體化干預策略提供實證基礎，以預防高風險族群的功能衰退。

25604625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25604625.value: 長者資訊查證能力的調查與培訓：基於混合方法研究的干預計劃

25604625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25604625.value: In developed societies, older adults (especially those aged 55–74) have high information needs and easy access to digital media. However, older adults are more susceptible to, more engaged with, and suffer greater financial loss from, misinformation and scams. In Hong Kong, more than 80% of victims of phone scams are older than 60. Recent studies have indicated that cognitive decline is not the major reason for older adults’ active engagement with misinformation and scams; instead, they struggle to identify manipulated content and lack the skills to navigate the hybrid media environment. Information verification, which refers to actions designed to determine whether information exists or is accurate, has been considered an effective way to discern the presence of misinformation in digital media. Nevertheless, existing verification research and interventions focus on younger adults, neglecting older adults’ behavioral patterns in the digital age and their need for effective verification strategies. Prior to the implementation of interventions, a thorough understanding of the verification process among older adults—and the mechanisms behind that process—are needed. In addition, the current knowledge on verification comes primarily from self-reported survey data. Self-reported data is prone to recall bias, especially when investigating digital behaviors. Moreover, cross-sectional survey data cannot evaluate the causal relationship between verification and misinformation discernment. To fill these gaps, this project aims to reveal the verification route among older adults through behavioral data. Study 1 will examine what affects older adults’ verification intentions through a metadata survey that collects click data. Study 2 will investigate how older adults verify information and what affects the success rate of that verification. The verification process will be recorded through a web-tracking experiment. In Study 3, a follow-up interview will further examine older adults’ psychological mechanisms and the challenges they face in the verification process. Based on the research findings, the PI will collaborate with professional fact-checkers and media educators to customize a verification training course for older adults. This project is the first to investigate and intervene in the verification skills among older adults in Hong Kong. The research findings will help inform the verification process among older adults and extend the theories of digital inequalities, knowledge gaps, and metaliteracy. The verification training program can be widely applied in Hong Kong and other societies and has the potential to be included in lifelong education for older adults. 在社會發展較成熟的地區，長者，特別是年齡介乎55至74歲的「年輕長者」，不僅資訊需求高，亦能輕易接觸到各類數位媒體資源。然而，長者較易受到虛假資訊及詐騙的影響，參與相關事件的頻率亦較高，導致經濟損失更為嚴重。在香港，超過八成電話詐騙受害者年齡在60歲以上。最新研究指出，長者積極參與虛假資訊及詐騙的主因並非認知能力下降，而是他們難以辨識被操控的內容，並缺乏在混合媒體環境下識別資訊真偽的技能。 資訊查證，即核實資訊是否存在、真實及正確的行為，被視為辨識數位媒體虛假資訊的有效方法。然而，現有的查證研究及相關干預措施多集中於年輕人，較少關注長者在數位時代的行為模式及其對有效查證策略的需求。在推行相關干預措施前，有必要深入了解長者的查證過程及其背後的心理機制。此外，現時有關資訊查證的研究多以自我報告調查數據為主，這類數據容易受到回憶偏差影響，尤其是在探討數位行為時更為明顯。同時，橫斷面調查亦難以驗證查證行為與虛假資訊辨識之間的因果關係。 為填補上述研究空白，本計劃將透過行為數據，深入探討長者的資訊查證歷程。第一階段將利用可收集點擊數據的元數據調查，分析影響長者查證意願的因素。第二階段會進行網絡追蹤實驗，記錄長者的查證過程，並探討影響查證成效的關鍵因素。第三階段則透過後續訪談，進一步了解長者在查證過程中的心理機制及所面對的挑戰。根據研究結果，計劃負責人將聯同專業事實查核員及媒體教育者，為長者度身訂造資訊查證培訓課程。 本計劃為香港首個針對長者資訊查證技能進行研究及干預的項目。研究成果有助於理論化長者的查證過程，並拓展數位不平等、知識鴻溝及元素養等相關理論。資訊查證培訓課程亦可於香港及其他地區廣泛推廣，並有潛力納入長者終身教育體系。

25608525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25608525.value: 性別包容性的兒童編程工具設計研究

25608525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25608525.value: Computational literacy, namely the knowledge of computer use and programming, has become one of the most fundamental skills, akin to reading and writing, for supporting active participation in an increasingly digital world. Yet, the computing field remains largely male-dominated, with women and gender minorities significantly underrepresented, limiting equal opportunities for their personal development, social justice, and economic growth. Research suggests that these gaps are more related to gender preferences than abilities, and that early exposure to computing and the use of gender-inclusive designs in computational learning materials and activities can effectively engage underrepresented groups. Despite this, there is a lack of understanding about what young children, especially girls, want in the design of computational learning kits (or "coding kits"). The proposed project aims to address this gap by exploring how to design inclusive and appealing coding kits for young children (aged 6-8) of different gender identities. The study will use a combination of quantitative, qualitative, and design methods in three steps: 1) assessing how children of different gender identities perceive the gender orientations of existing coding kits through lab-based evaluations, 2) identifying their preferred design features in coding kits through participatory design workshops, and 3) developing design guidelines for creating inclusive and appealing coding kits for children of different gender identities. The findings will offer empirical insights into young children's gender-based preferences for various design features in both existing and new coding kits, upon which we will further develop a design guide for creating more gender-inclusive coding kits and other STEM learning materials. In summary, this work is essential for promoting inclusivity in computing and unlocking the potential of young children of different gender identities in the technology sector. 運算素養（涵蓋電腦應用與程式設計知識）已成為數位化社會參與的核心能力，其必要性可比擬讀寫能力。然而運算領域仍由男性主導，女性及性別少數群體代表性嚴重不足，此現象限制其個人發展、社會正義與經濟成長的平等機會。研究證實此差距主要源於性別偏好而非能力差異，早期接觸運算輔以性別包容設計能有效提升弱勢群體參與度。現階段關鍵缺口在於缺乏對兒童（尤其女童）在程式設計學習工具（簡稱「編程工具」）設計需求的深入理解。本研究針對6-8歲不同性別認同兒童，透過三階段混合方法開發包容性編程工具：首先經實驗室評估檢視兒童對現有工具性別導向的感知；繼以參與式設計工作坊釐清偏好特徵；最終建立包容性設計準則。研究成果將提供兒童性別化設計偏好的實證依據，據此制定性別包容編程工具與STEM教材設計指南，對促進運算領域平等參與、釋放多元性別兒童潛能具戰略意義。

25612125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25612125.value: 使用依存關係語言類型學指標探究口譯中的源語干擾：語料庫輔助的語言接觸研究

25612125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25612125.value: Language contact, which concerns how language production is being shaped by cross-linguistic influence due to the speaker’s active use of two languages, has been a major research interest in the study of bilingualism. The past two decades have seen an increasing trend to examine translational language from the perspective of language contact. Studies have shown the presence of source language interference in the production of translation. Some researchers posit that interference may be seen as a translation universal, which is a recurrent linguistic pattern that characterises translational language. Others, however, doubt its universality as interference is also found in other contact-induced language varieties, such as L2 speech. However, very little research exists to explore how the manifestation of interference may vary in different contact environments. In addition, most studies that explore interference as a translation universal have concentrated on written translation and largely neglect interpreting, an oral form of translation. Moreover, few research efforts have been taken to trace the observed interference to the underlying cognitive activities during bilingual language processing. With this background in mind, this project aims to investigate interference in two distinct contact-induced language varieties (interpreted speech and L2 speech) and its cognitive implications. The examination employs a set of dependency-based language typological indicators to assess the interference extent and its cognitive demand by measuring the typological proximity between language varieties. Generating data from three comparable corpora: the United Nations Simultaneous Interpreting Corpus (UNSIC, existing), the Simultaneous Interpreting Learner Corpus (SILC, to be compiled), and the Hong Kong Corpus of Spoken English (HKCSE, existing), this research project will address: 1) how interference manifests in different contact environments; 2) how the manifestation of interference in interpreting is affected by contextual factors, including interpreter’s qualification and interpreting direction; and 3) how the manifestation of interference is reflective of cognitive demand. The proposed project will be among the first to systematically model the respective exhibition of interference in different contact events and to explore its cognitive implications. Theoretically, it improves our understanding of language contact by showing how interference is contextually and cognitively confined via a set of language typological indicators. Practically, the observed convergent or divergent linguistic patterns between professional interpreters and interpreting learners can inform the design of training materials to support best practice, thus accommodating the increasing need for quality interpreting services in Hong Kong and beyond. 接觸語言學關注的是，由於說話者積極使用兩種語言，跨語言影響如何塑造語言產出。這一直是雙語研究的一個重要課題。在過去的二十年中，從語言接觸的視角研究翻譯語言的趨勢愈發顯著。研究表明，在翻譯產出中存在源語言干擾(interference)。一些研究者認為，干擾可以被視為翻譯普遍特徵，即一種表徵翻譯語言的反復出現的語言模式。然而，也有研究者質疑其普遍性，因為干擾同樣存在於其他接觸引發的語言變體中，例如第二語言（L2）話語。然而，目前很少有研究探討干擾在不同語言接觸環境中的表現差異。此外，大多數將干擾視為翻譯普遍特徵的研究集中於書面翻譯，而對口譯這種翻譯的口語形式關注較少。此外，幾乎沒有研究追溯觀察到的干擾與雙語語言加工中的潛在認知活動之間的關係。 基於此背景，本研究旨在探討兩種不同接觸引發的語言變體（口譯話語和第二語言話語）中的干擾及其認知意義。本研究採用一組基於依存關係的語言類型學指標，通過測量語言變體之間的類型學接近性，評估干擾的程度及其認知需求。本研究的數據來源於三個可比語料庫：聯合國同聲傳譯語料庫（UNSIC，現有）、同聲傳譯學習者語料庫（SILC，待建立），以及香港英語口語語料庫（HKCSE，現有）。研究將重點探討以下三個問題：1）干擾如何在不同語言接觸環境中表現出來；2）在口譯中，干擾的表現如何受到背景因素（包括譯員的資質和口譯方向）的影響；以及3）干擾的表現如何反映認知需求。 本研究將成為首批系統建模干擾在不同接觸事件中表現的項目之一，並探討其認知意義。從理論上來說，本研究通過一組語言類型學指標，揭示干擾如何在語境和認知層面受到約束，從而深化我們對接觸語言學的理解。從實踐上來說，專業譯員與學習者之間觀察到的趨同或趨異的語言模式，可以為設計培訓材料提供參考，以支持最佳實踐，從而滿足香港及其他地區對高質量口譯服務日益增長的需求。

25615025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25615025.value: 認知障礙非正式照顧者之電話輔導睡眠閱讀療法：隨機對照試驗

25615025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25615025.value: Informal caregivers of people with dementia play a crucial role in the global community health system. However, up to 94% of them experience sleep disturbances that negatively impact their well-being. While cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) is a first-line treatment for sleep issues, dementia caregivers face unique factors affecting their sleep, necessitating integrative interventions for effectiveness. However, research in this area remains limited. Moreover, caregivers face situational barriers to joining traditional face-to-face or group sessions, and insufficient access to community-based sleep therapists. In response to these challenges, our team has developed an innovative telephone-coached bibliotherapy that uses reading materials and telephone coaching for therapeutic purposes. The bibliotherapy manuals include all essential factors influencing caregiver sleep disturbances, and have shown satisfactory acceptability and improvements in caregiver mental health. In this project, we will modify our previous intervention protocol into sleep bibliotherapy by incorporating key components from CBT-I. Besides, non-sleep therapists will be trained to facilitate telephone coaching to address the shortage of therapists in community settings. This is a two-arm randomized controlled trial using a repeated measures design to examine the effects of telephone-coached sleep bibliotherapy among 156 informal caregivers of people with dementia. Participants in the intervention group will receive eight weekly sessions of telephone-coached sleep bibliotherapy, while the control group will receive check-in calls and an educational booklet. General linear mixed models will compare the effects of the intervention immediately post-intervention and at three months follow-up. Path analysis and qualitative interviews will explore the mechanism of change in sleep bibliotherapy immediately post-intervention. It is hypothesized that caregivers in the intervention group will experience significant improvements in sleep disturbances and secondary outcomes, including caregiving appraisal, dysfunctional beliefs and attitudes about sleep, emotional distress, patient neuropsychiatric symptoms, and dyadic quality of life immediately post-intervention and at three months follow-up. Changes in caregiving appraisal and beliefs and attitudes about sleep are expected to mediate the effect of the intervention on caregiver sleep disturbances. This project pioneers the use of sleep bibliotherapy globally. It will contribute to new knowledge by introducing an innovative resource-saving intervention for informal caregivers of people with dementia, shedding light on the overlooked issue of sleep disturbances in this population, both locally and internationally. If proven effective, community centres or caregiver support hotlines can adopt this project as part of their routine services. All intervention materials use simple language and graphics, making them easily adaptable for other countries. 非正式照顧者在全球社區健康體系中扮演著關鍵角色。然而，高達94%的認知障礙照顧者經歷睡眠障礙，對其身心健康造成負面影響。雖然失眠的首選治療方法為認知行為治療，但認知障礙照顧者面臨獨特的睡眠影響因素，因此需要整合性干預措施以提升治療成效。然而，相關研究仍然有限。此外，照顧者在參加傳統面對面或團體課程時，常遇到情境上的障礙，且社區內能提供睡眠治療的專業人員資源不足。 為應對這些挑戰，我們團隊開發了一項創新的「電話輔導閱讀療法」，結合閱讀教材與電話輔導以達到治療目的。閱讀療法手冊涵蓋所有影響照顧者睡眠障礙的重要因素，並已證實在可接受性及提升照顧者心理健康方面具有良好成效。本計畫將在既有干預方案基礎上，結合CBT-I的核心元素，修訂為「睡眠閱讀療法」。此外，將培訓非睡眠治療師進行電話輔導，以解決社區治療師人力短缺的問題。 本研究採用兩組隨機對照試驗及重複測量設計，評估電話輔導睡眠閱讀療法對認知障礙非正式照顧者的成效。干預組將接受為期八週的電話輔導睡眠閱讀療法，對照組則接受定期關懷電話及教育手冊。研究將運用一般線性混合模型，比較干預組在干預結束後及三個月追蹤時的成效。另將透過路徑分析及質性訪談，探討睡眠閱讀療法在干預後產生改變的機制。 本研究假設，干預組照顧者在睡眠障礙及次要結果方面，於干預後及三個月追蹤時將有顯著改善。照顧評價及對睡眠的信念與態度的改變，預期將仲介干預對照顧者睡眠障礙的影響。 本計畫為全球首創應用睡眠閱讀療法，將為認知障礙非正式照顧者帶來創新且節省資源的干預措施，並為本地及國際間長期被忽視的照顧者睡眠障礙議題帶來新知識。若證實有效，社區中心或照顧者支援熱線可將本計畫納入常規服務。所有干預教材均以簡明文字及圖像設計，便於其他國家推廣與應用。

25616125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25616125.value: 音樂訓練對廣東話語音感知的影響

25616125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25616125.value: The relationship between music training and language processing has been a topic of increasing scholarly interest in Language Sciences. Research has demonstrated that musical training can enhance skills such as pitch perception, phonological awareness, and speech segmentation. These abilities are crucial for efficient speech processing, particularly in tonal languages like Cantonese, where pitch differences convey semantic meaning. Musicians typically outperform non-musicians in these tasks, suggesting that musical training facilitates skill transfer from music to language, especially in speech perception. However, current evidence remains inconsistent, and the mechanisms underlying these effects continue to be subject to debate. Certain studies indicate that musicians do not consistently outperform non-musicians in challenging speech perception tasks, such as adopting nonspeech contexts for talker normalization for lexical tones. These inconsistencies may arise because research has treated musicians as a homogeneous group, overlooking the potential differences between vocalists and instrumentalists. Vocalists, who directly control pitch with their voices, may develop more robust pitch production skills, while instrumentalists may focus more on pitch perception through auditory feedback. This distinction has not been thoroughly investigated in terms of how different modalities of music training impact speech perception. This study contributes to the current understanding by investigating how vocal and instrumental music training affect speech perception in tonal languages, particularly in the context of talker normalization of Cantonese lexical tones. The research will also examine whether vocal and instrumental musicians will demonstrate different advantages in adopting various nonspeech musical contexts (vocal and instrumental) in facilitating speech variability adaptation, similar to how speech contexts do. Utilizing a combination of behavioral tests and neuroimaging techniques (ERP and source localization), the study will analyze the neural mechanisms underlying these effects. Additionally, a training study involving non-musicians will explore the causal relationship between short-term music training and improvements in speech perception. The findings from this research will advance our understanding of how specific types of music training influence speech processing. This could have significant implications for educational practices and speech therapy, particularly for individuals learning tonal languages or experiencing difficulties in speech variability adaptation. By contributing to the fields of music and language processing, the project aims to provide new insights into the neural plasticity associated with music training and its broader cognitive benefits. 音樂訓練與語言處理之間的關係，近年在語言科學領域引起越來越多學者關注。研究指出，音樂訓練可以提升如音高感知、語音覺識，以及語流切分等能力。這些能力對於高效語音處理至為關鍵，尤其在廣東話這類聲調語言中，音高差異直接傳遞語義。音樂家通常在這些任務上的表現優於非音樂家，顯示音樂訓練有助於相關技能從音樂領域轉移到語言領域，特別是語音感知方面。 然而，現有證據並不一致，這些效應背後的機制仍有爭議。有部分研究顯示，在某些具挑戰性的語音感知任務中，例如以非語音語境進行詞彙聲調的說話人歸一化時，音樂家並不一定比非音樂家優勝。這些不一致可能源於過往研究將音樂家視為同質群體，忽略了聲樂家與器樂家之間的潛在分別。聲樂家透過自身聲音直接控制音高，可能建立更強的音高產生能力；而器樂家則更側重於透過聽覺反饋進行音高感知。對於不同音樂訓練模式如何影響語音感知，這方面的分別仍未被詳細探討。 本研究將探討聲樂訓練與器樂訓練如何影響聲調語言的語音感知，特別聚焦於廣東話聲調的說話人歸一化現象。此外，研究亦會檢視聲樂家與器樂家在採用不同非語音音樂語境（如聲樂與器樂片段）以促進語音變異性適應時，是否展現不同優勢，類似於語音語境的效應。研究將結合行為測試及神經影像技術（事件相關電位ERP及源定位）來分析這些效應背後的神經機制。同時，亦會透過針對非音樂家的短期音樂訓練研究，探討音樂訓練與語音感知提升之間的因果關係。 本研究結果將深化我們對不同類型音樂訓練如何影響語音處理的理解，對教育實踐及言語治療具有重要啟示，尤其適用於學習廣東話及普通話等聲調語言，或在語音變異性適應方面有困難的人士。透過對音樂與語言處理領域的貢獻，本計劃旨在為音樂訓練相關的神經可塑性及其更廣泛的認知效益帶來新啟示。

25618825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25618825.value: 高科技的雙刃劍效應：中國大學生技術壓力與福祉的追蹤研究

25618825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25618825.value: The increasing pervasiveness of information and communication technology (ICT) in higher education, while beneficial for teaching and learning, also presents challenges for students adapting to rapidly evolving technological demands. The COVID-19 pandemic and accelerated advancements in artificial intelligence have further intensified these challenges, leading to a heightened prevalence of technostress—stress from technology use—among university students. This phenomenon is characterized by feelings of stress related to the constant pressure to adapt to new technologies, manage excessive information flow, and maintain online connectivity. Excessive technostress can have detrimental effects on both physical and psychological well-being, impacting various aspects of academic and personal life. Despite growing recognition of technostress as a significant issue among university students, research on technostress in this population is scarce. This issue is crucial as university students are developing the attitudes and skills necessary to navigate and shape the future digital landscape. By integrating the Transactional Stress-Coping model, the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) Theory, and the Positive Youth Development (PYD) approach, this project aims to investigate the development, impacts, and mitigating factors of technostress among university students. First, we will examine how different aspects of technostress (techno-overload, techno-invasion, techno-insecurity, techno-complexity, and techno-uncertainty) develop throughout the course of undergraduate years. Second, we will examine the differentiated effects of various technostress dimensions on students’ academic and psychological well-being. Third, we will explore the roles of technology-related resources (digital competence) and non-technology-related resources (positive psychological attributes) in moderating the relationships between technostress dimensions and student well-being. This project will employ a three-wave longitudinal design, administering three consecutive annual assessments to 880 university students in China. The findings will enhance our understanding of the dynamic nature and long-term consequences of technostress for this population, informing the development of targeted interventions to improve coping mechanisms in technology-driven higher education. Ultimately, this research aims to empower students to thrive in the digital age by minimizing the negative impacts of technostress on their academic success and overall well-being. 資訊與通信技術（ICT）在高等教育中的日益普及顯著提升了教學效率，但快速演進的技術更迭同時也為大學生帶來了諸多挑戰。新冠疫情的爆發以及人工智能技術的迅猛發展進一步加劇了這一趨勢，導致“技術壓力”（technostress）現象在大學生群體中愈發普遍。技術壓力，指因使用技術而產生的壓力，主要表現為個體在適應新技術、處理過量資訊，以及維持線上連接時所經歷的緊張感與壓力。過度的技術壓力不僅會損害大學生的身體健康，還會對其心理狀態產生負面影響，進而波及學業表現與日常生活的諸多層面。儘管大學生的技術壓力問題已逐漸受到關注，但相關的實證研究仍然不足。研究這一議題具有重要意義，因為大學階段是學生形成關鍵數字態度與技能的關鍵時期，對其未來應對與塑造數字化社會產生深遠影響。本研究將整合壓力調適行為理論（Transactional Stress-Coping Model）、工作要求資源理論（Job Demands-Resources Theory, JD-R）以及青少年正向成長理論（Positive Youth Development, PYD），旨在系統探究大學生技術壓力的發展趨勢、影響機制及調節因素。研究將聚焦以下方面：首先，考察技術壓力的不同維度（包括技術超載、技術侵入、技術不安全感、技術複雜性與技術不確定性）在大學四年期間的動態演變過程；其次，分析不同技術壓力維度對大學生學業表現與心理健康的差異化影響；最後，探討技術相關資源（如數碼能力）與非技術相關資源（如積極心理品質）在技術壓力與個人福祉之間的調節作用。本研究將採用三階段縱向設計，邀請880名中國大學生參與為期三年的年度調查。研究成果將有助於深化對大學生技術壓力動態變化及其長期影響的理解，為開發針對性的干預措施提供理論依據與實踐方向，以提升學生在技術驅動的高等教育環境中的應對能力。最終，本研究旨在助力大學生在數字時代實現積極發展，減緩技術壓力的負面影響，促進其學業成就與整體福祉的提升。

25619725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25619725.value: 多模態數位化非物質文化遺產保存模式的開發：香港長衫製作技藝的實踐導向研究

25619725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25619725.value: Hong Kong Cheongsam Making Technique (HKCMT) has been authenticated as a representative item of the intangible cultural heritage (ICH) of Hong Kong and China by the government and the state council under the category of traditional craftsmanship for its unique cultural value and essentiality of urgent preservation in 2017 and 2021 respectively. Based on the 2003 Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage adopted by the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), a series of safeguarding measures have been carried out by the Hong Kong government in league with universities, tailoring industry, and ICH practitioners since the release of the First ICH Inventory of Hong Kong in 2014. After ten years of collective efforts, the endangered situation of HKCMT is, however, worsening due to the decreasing number of master-tailors and several interwoven deficiencies in the previous safeguarding measures. A novel and strategic preservation approach is urgently needed. Digitalization is one of the acclaimed approaches in facilitating ICH preservation, especially for the artisan-reliant traditional crafts which are substantially marginalized by the development of modern societies under industrialization and globalization. The digital technology-aided approach provides new opportunities to investigate, document, analyze, and represent the practical know-how, skillful use of tools, and dexterous manipulation of materials of traditional craftsmanship. With appropriate applications, the findings and representations resulted can be used to facilitate the preservation, transmission, dissemination, and hence, sustainable safeguarding efficacy. With reference to the methodological approach of craftsmanship digitalization explored by pioneering researchers, this project proposed to employ advanced deep learning-based motion capture technology to systematically investigate HKCMT. With the professional supports attained from the authorities, veteran master-tailors, and registered ICH bearers under the Hong Kong Cheongsam Association (HKCA, the designated protection organization of HKCMT), a successful implementation of this proposed project will accurately document and analyze the tailoring techniques of diverse dress forms of Hong Kong cheongsam, and transfer the craft from the physical world to the digital world. An assemble of multimodal virtual representations (MVRs) of HKCMT, which are unprecedented in the previous preservation efforts, will be established and triangulated by the aforementioned supporting specialists. Secondly, with a parallel practice-led research, the difficulties in the transmission of the craft will be identified for the strategic development of a digitalized ICH preservation model with multimodality for HKCMT, addressing the current critically endangered situation faced by the craft. 「香港長衫製作技藝」於2017年和2021年分別獲香港特別行政區政府（特區政府）及中國國務院認證為香港和中國的非物質文化遺產（非遺）中傳統手工藝類別非遺的代表項目，確認其獨特的文化價值和急需保存的必要性。自2014年香港發布首份《香港非物質文化遺產清單》以來，特區政府與高等學府、裁縫業界及非物質文化遺產實踐者協作，根據聯合國教科文組織於2003年通過的《保護非物質文化遺產公約》實施了一系列的保護措施。然而，經過十年的共同努力，「香港長衫製作技藝」的瀕危情況仍然因裁縫師傅人數減少及先導性保護措施的不足而惡化。這項非遺迫切需要一種新穎且具有策略性的保存方法。 數位化是促進非遺保存的公認方法之一，特別是對於依賴工匠的傳統工藝，這些工藝在工業化和全球化的現代社會發展中受到邊緣化。數位技術輔助的方法為調查、記錄、分析和表現傳統工藝的實踐知識、工具和材料的使用與操作提供了新機會。適當的應用可促進保存、傳承、傳播，從而提高可持續的保護效能。參考先驅研究所探索的工藝數位化方法論，本項目提議利用基於深度學習的動作捕捉技術，系統性地研究「香港長衫製作技藝」。 在香港長衫協會（長協，「香港長衫製作技藝」的指定保護團體）、政府當局、資深裁縫大師和已登記的非遺傳承人的專業支持下，成功實施此項目將能準確記錄和分析各種香港長衫的裁縫技藝，並將這一工藝從物理世界轉移到數位世界，並建立前所未有的「香港長衫製作技藝」多模態虛擬表現。其次，通過平行的實踐導向研究，此項目將識別工藝傳承中的困難，為「香港長衫製作技藝」數位化非遺保存模式的策略發展提供依據及應對目前所面臨的嚴重瀕危情況。

26102725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26102725.value: 新型磷脂翻转酶在膜接触位点介导内吞体生物发生的分子机制

26102725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26102725.value: Endosomes are central organelles responsible for the recycling and degradation of receptors and membrane proteins. Once endocytosed, these proteins are sorted at endosomes into intralumenal vesicles (ILVs). The resulting multivesicular bodies (MVBs) then fuse with the lysosomes, leading to protein degradation for nutrients reuse. However, the biogenesis of MVB requires a constant lipid supply for efficient ILV formation. Membrane contact sites (MCSs), areas of close apposition between organelles, have been suggested to play essential roles in endosome biogenesis by providing lipids through lipid transport proteins. This protein-mediated lipid transport requires an endosomal scramblase to rebalance lipids between the two leaflets of endosomal membrane.
