However, the high dimensionality and complexity of assessment data pose challenges in estimating and inferring covariate effects conditioned on latent variables. Moreover, the observed item responses are often discrete or mixed-type, making common linear model assumptions unsuitable and further complicating the analysis. Motivated by these challenges, we will consider a high-dimensional covariate-adjusted nonlinear factor model and develop novel methods for estimating and inferring covariate effects. We will begin by exploring general identifiability conditions that allow for arbitrary dependence among latent variables, aligning with practical scenarios in which different latent skills may be correlated. Based on these conditions, our first aim is to develop estimation and inference methods for covariate effects in low-dimensional settings. Next, we will move one step further to address the problem in a high-dimensional context. Existing methods in the literature often rely on linearity assumptions or impose stringent assumptions on the dimensionality of covariates and their dependence structure with latent variables. To address these limitations, We propose a regularization-based estimation method that first derives a regularized estimator and uses it to construct a debiased estimator by generalizing debiasing techniques to our model. To solve the non-convex regularization problem, we propose a novel alternating algorithm and aim to provide theoretical justification by showing that the estimators in intermediate steps are consistent. With this theoretical guarantee, we further aim to establish estimation consistency and asymptotic normality for the debiased estimator. These advancements will significantly enhance the understanding of nonlinear factor models. We will demonstrate the performance of our proposed method by applying it to large-scale assessment data from international exams. Through these applications, we aim to address key scientific questions, contribute to test item calibration, and ultimately promote educational fairness. 隨著全球化的加速與科技的進步，國際大型教育評量在教育研究與政策制定中日益扮演舉足輕重的角色。為了從此類大數據中分析並推論受測者的潛在因子（如能力、技能等），研究人員已發展出多種統計方法，並持續進行改進。除了對潛在因子的分析之外，當前學術界亦日益關注在控制潛在因子的前提下，探討高維觀察協變數對受測者表現的影響。研究這些協變數的效應，對於評估教育公平性極為關鍵，有助於檢驗來自不同性別、族群及人口背景的學生在能力相當的情況下，是否能擁有平等的考試表現機會。然而，評估數據本身的高維性與複雜性，使得在控制潛在因子下進行協變量效應的估計與推論變得極具挑戰。此外，觀察到的作答資料往往為離散型或混合型數據，使得傳統線性模型的假設無法適用，進一步增加了分析的困難。 鑑於上述挑戰，本文考虑高維協變量調整下的非線性因子模型，並發展新穎的方法以進行協變量效應的估計與推斷。我們首先探討在潛在因子之間允許存在任意依賴結構的情況下，模型的可識別性條件，以契合實際應用中多個潛在能力之間可能存在相關性的設定。在此基礎上，我們的第一個目標是建立在低維協變量情境下的估計與推論方法。隨後，我們進一步拓展至高維協變量的情境。目前文獻中的相關方法普遍依賴線性假設，或對協變量的維度及其與潛在因子的依賴結構設下強烈限制。為了解决这些问题，本文提出一種基於正則化的估計方法：首先構造正則化估計量，並藉由推廣現有去偏技術，構造出去偏估計量。為了解決所涉及的非凸優化問題，我們設計了一種嶄新的交替算法，並提供理論保證，證明其中間步驟的估計量具一致性。在此基礎上，我們進一步建立去偏估計量的估計一致性與漸近常態性，為模型的統計推論奠定理論基礎。上述方法將有助於深入理解非線性因子模型的統計特性。我們將所提出的方法應用於來自國際性教育評估的真實數據中，以展示其有效性與實用性。透過這些應用，我們期望解答重要的科學問題、促進試題校準，並最終推動教育公平的實現。

27311125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27311125.value: 第一性原理驅動高遷移率金屬氧化物的材料探索與能源應用

27311125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27311125.value: Electronically conducting metal oxides are critical for advancing clean energy technologies. These materials play essential roles in numerous applications: they convert thermal energy into electricity at high temperatures, reflect radiative heat in energy-efficient windows, facilitate electron and hole transport in solar cells, and serve as cathode materials in aqueous batteries for energy storage. Central to these diverse functionalities is the electrical conductivity of metal oxides, yet despite extensive experimental efforts, the fundamental limits of charge transport in many of these materials remain largely uncharted. This challenge is compounded by the diverse structural polymorphs and defect states inherent to metal oxides, making the development of high-conductivity oxides a complex and labor-intensive task. Recently, we developed a first-principles computational tool that allows precise calculation of charge transport properties, providing unprecedented insights into the charge transport mechanisms at the atomic level. A notable example of this tool’s impact is our theoretical prediction of exceptionally high electron and hole mobilities (both exceeding 1500 cm2/V-s) in cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs), a semiconductor that outperforms conventional materials. This prediction was subsequently confirmed by our experimental work (Science 377, 437, 2022), demonstrating the immense potential of our theoretical tool for quantifying the various mechanisms influencing charge transport and paving the way for discovering new high-performance materials. This project aims to expand our search for high-mobility materials to metal oxide families through a comprehensive approach integrating first-principles computational modeling, experimental synthesis, and validation. Preliminary results already indicated the efficacy of our first-principles method in understanding carrier transport in oxides. We will systematically analyze electron scattering and carrier mobility in key oxide materials, experimentally validate these findings, and develop new strategies to enhance mobility and conductivity. Ultrafast transient grating spectroscopy will be employed to characterize carrier transport, enabling spatially resolved measurements of ambipolar diffusivity and offering a unique platform for assessing intrinsic properties. Furthermore, the insights gained from these analyses will form the basis for developing a predictive model capable of high-throughput screening for high-mobility oxides. The proposed project aims to deliver a fundamental understanding of carrier transport in metal oxides, enhance conductivity in existing materials, and potentially identify new electronically conducting oxides. Such advances will significantly impact a wide range of energy technologies, accelerating the transition to clean energy solutions. 具備優異導電性的金屬氧化物對於推動潔淨能源技術的發展至關重要。這類材料在多種應用中扮演不可或缺的角色，包括於高溫環境下將熱能轉換為電能、在節能玻璃中反射輻射熱、以及於太陽能電池中促進電子與電洞的高效傳輸。金屬氧化物的電導率正是支撐這些多元功能的核心。然而，儘管已有大量研究投入，許多金屬氧化物中電荷傳輸的根本極限仍未被充分揭示。這一挑戰因其多樣的晶體結構與複雜的缺陷態更加嚴峻，使得高導電性氧化物的開發成為一項複雜的任務。 近年來，我們開發了一套基於第一性原理的計算工具，能在原子尺度上揭示電荷傳輸機制。這項工具的重要應用例證之一，是成功預測立方砷化硼中電子與電洞均具有極高的遷移率。這一預測隨後也在實驗工作中得到驗證，展現了理論工具在定量分析電荷傳輸機制及發掘新材料上的巨大潛力。 本研究計畫旨在結合第一性原理計算、實驗合成與驗證等多項方法，拓展對高遷移率材料的探索至金屬氧化物家族。初步結果已顯示第一性原理方法於解析氧化物載流子傳輸特性方面的可行性。我們將系統性地分析主要氧化物材料中的電子散射與載流子遷移率，並配合實驗驗證相關結果，同時研發提升遷移率與導電性的全新策略。本計畫亦將應用超快瞬態光柵光譜技術，進行載流子傳輸的空間分辨測量，有效掌握雙極擴散率。此外，基於這些深入分析，我們將建立遷移率預測模型，推動高遷移率氧化物材料的高通量篩選。預期本研究將深化對金屬氧化物載流子傳輸機制的理解，提升現有材料的導電性，並有望發現新型導電氧化物，從而促進能源技術的發展。

27500125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27500125.value: 品牌叙事中的意义建构对品牌表现的助力与损害

27500125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27500125.value: Meaning-making, which involves actively seeking significance or purpose, contributes to the resilience of the human spirit and helps people cope with life’s challenges. Therefore, entrepreneurs often weave their personal meaning-making experiences into brand narratives to cast their brands in a positive light. For instance, Charles Coristine, CEO of LesserEvil, revitalized LesserEvil through his passion for high-quality snacks when feeling burned out, considering it as “a deeply personal journey”. Similarly, Sara Blakely founded Spanx after a tough day selling fax machines, driven by her desire to change her life. Given the trend of meaning-making in brand narratives and marketing communication, we must ask: should entrepreneurs incorporate meaning-making into their brand narratives, and if so, under what circumstances does this enhance, or negatively impact, brand-related outcomes? Research on meaning-making has focused on its positive impact on well-being, with two key antecedents of meaning consistently identified: feeling valued by others (significance) and having a sense of mission (purpose). In marketing, entrepreneurs create meaning by fulfilling a sense of purpose—such as making a positive impact on others and society, or by enhancing their significance—seeking to underscore their values and importance. However, little attention has been given to how people perceive these meaning-making efforts. As meaning-making is often considered a virtue, it is reasonable to believe it leads to positive impressions of entrepreneurs and their brands. However, I propose that meaning-making can sometimes have unintended negative consequences, depending on its motivation. Specifically, purpose-driven meaning-making results in more positive perceptions of the entrepreneurs, stronger purchase intentions, and better impressions of the brands, compared with significance-driven meaning-making. This is because purpose-driven narratives tend to inspire consumers more than significance-driven ones or those lacking such information. I aim to provide generalizable results across purchase and crowdfunding contexts. Moderators, including product types (green vs. non-green products) and consumer individualism, are discussed. Theoretically, this is the first empirical study to investigate perceptions of people who seek meaning and the downstream consequences, contributing to theories on meaning in brand narratives, impression formation, and brand evaluations. It reveals when and how meaning-making influences consumers’ attitudes and behaviors toward brands. Managerially, this research uncovers strategic approaches for incorporating meaning-making into brand narratives. The findings are also applicable to other contexts involving meaning-making narratives, such as loan applications. Therefore, this proposal offers both theoretical contributions and practical solutions for marketers and practitioners. 意义建构，即主动寻找意义或目标，有助于增强人类精神的韧性，帮助人们应对生活中的挑战。因此，创业者们常常将自身的意义建构经历融入品牌叙事中，以塑造品牌的积极形象。例如，LesserEvil公司的CEO Charles Coristine在感到身心俱疲时，出于对高品质零食的渴望而重新振兴了LesserEvil，并将这一过程视为“一段极为个人化的旅程”。Sara Blakely创立Spanx是因为她想要解决自己的困扰：她发现市面上缺乏既舒适又能修饰身形的打底内衣。作为一名传真机推销员，没有舒适的塑形内衣让她的推销工作变得更加艰难。正是这种对改善自己生活的强烈渴望，以及希望帮助更多女性自信地面对职场和生活的动力，促使她创立了内衣品牌 Spanx，并将其发展成了一个成功的品牌。鉴于意义建构在品牌叙事和营销传播中日益突出的趋势，我们需要思考创业者是否应将意义建构融入品牌叙事，以及在什么情况下意义建构会提升或反而损害与品牌相关的结果。 关于意义建构的研究主要关注其对幸福感的积极影响，并强调了两个关键前因：被他人重视（意义感）和拥有使命感（目标感）。在营销中，创业者通过强调使命感（如对他人和社会产生积极影响）或提升个人价值感（强调自身价值和重要性）来创造品牌意义，但是消费者如何感知这两种不同的意义建构却鲜有研究关注。 意义建构常被视为一种美德，因此人们普遍认为它有助于提升创业者和品牌的积极形象。然而，我认为，意义建构在不同动机驱动下，有时也可能带来意想不到的负面影响。具体而言，以使命感为导向的意义建构（强调目标和对社会的积极影响），相比以个人价值感为导向的意义建构（强调自身被重视），更能促进消费者对创业者的积极评价、增强购买意愿，并提升品牌形象。这是因为目标导向的品牌叙事往往比价值导向或缺乏此类信息的叙事更能激励消费者。这一结论适用于不同的消费和众筹场景。在本研究中，我还探讨了产品类型（如绿色产品与非绿色产品）和消费者个人主义倾向等调节因素的影响。 在理论层面，本研究首次实证探讨了消费者对意义建构的感知及其后续影响，为品牌叙事中的意义建构、印象形成和品牌评价等理论提供了新视角。本研究揭示了意义建构何时以及如何影响消费者对品牌的态度与行为。在管理实践层面，本研究为品牌如何将意义建构战略性地融入叙事提供了具体方法。研究结论同样适用于其他涉及意义建构叙事的情境，如贷款申请和众筹等。因此，本研究不仅具有理论价值，也为市场营销人员和政策制定者提供了可操作的实践建议。

27500925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27500925.value: 網絡中的最優資訊披露

27500925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27500925.value: Providing information can be a useful tool for influencing agents' incentives as a way of shaping desirable economic outcomes. This proposed project pursues the optimal design of information disclosure for multiple agents who face strategic externalities from others. In these strategic environments, providing more information need not always be desirable from a social perspective. For example, product reviews or traffic updates may help users make better decisions, but these can also lead to negative externalities such as congestion. Conversely, financial markets and macroeconomic environments often exhibit positive externalities. In these contexts, previous research has shown that higher central bank transparency can sometimes harm market efficiency since a policymaker's announcement can be a focal point for market participants and affects their behavior more than what can be justified by the actual informational content of the announcement. While the literature on information design has developed general solution methods for characterizing the optimal design of information disclosure for a single agent, the study of multiple agents remains sparse due to a technical challenge. Indeed, the case with multiple agents is fundamentally different from the single-agent case because agents face not only uncertainty about economic fundamentals but also strategic uncertainty about the behavior of others. In such environments, providing information to some agents can generate "spillover effects" for others, which cascade through a social network. This complex interplay is difficult to predict intuitively, and the primary objective of this project is to derive general insights into how the optimal information disclosure depends on the structure of agents' strategic interactions. To address this difficulty, we aim to provide a methodological innovation. Central to our approach is the use of semidefinite programming (SDP), a generalization of linear programming. Our foundational observation is that many information design problems in social networks can be formulated as an SDP problem. This enables us to utilize various tools developed in convex optimization, including SDP solvers, to numerically compute solutions. Beyond numerical simulations, we expect that the duality theory of SDP is instrumental in analytically characterizing the optimal information disclosure. Thus, another objective of this project is to develop a methodology for analyzing intervention problems in networks, which could be highly beneficial for other applications in network games. 提供資訊可以作為一種影響行為者誘因的工具，從而塑造理想的經濟結果。本研究計劃探討針對多個行為者的最優資訊披露設計，這些行為者的決策會受到他人的策略性外部性影響。在此類戰略環境中，單純提供更多資訊未必總是符合社會利益。例如，產品評論或交通更新可能幫助使用者做出更好的決策，但同時也可能帶來擁塞等負外部性。相反地，在金融市場與總體經濟環境中往往存在正外部性。在這些情境下，既有研究顯示，提高中央銀行的透明度有時可能損害市場效率，因為決策者的公告會成為市場參與者的「焦點」，對其行為的影響超過公告內容本身所能合理支持的程度。 雖然資訊設計的文獻已經發展出針對單一行為者的最優資訊披露方法，但關於多行為者的研究仍然有限，主要因為存在技術上的挑戰。事實上，多行為者的情境與單一行為者的情境有根本差異，因為前者除了面對經濟基本面的不確定性外，還面對他人行為的策略性不確定性。在這樣的環境下，向部分行為者提供資訊可能會對其他人產生「溢出效應」，並透過社會網絡連鎖傳遞。這種複雜的相互作用難以直觀預測，因此本計劃的主要目標是揭示最優資訊披露如何取決於行為者之間的策略互動結構。 為應對這一挑戰，本研究將提出方法上的創新。我們的方法核心在於運用半正定規劃（semidefinite programming, SDP），這是一種線性規劃的推廣。我們的基本觀察是，許多社會網絡中的資訊設計問題都可以表述為SDP問題。這使我們能夠利用凸優化中發展出的各種工具，包括SDP解算器，以數值方式計算解答。除了數值模擬之外，我們預期SDP的對偶理論將在分析上對刻劃最優資訊披露發揮關鍵作用。因此，本研究的另一個目標是發展一套分析網絡干預問題的方法，這對其他網絡博弈的應用也將具有重要價值。

27502925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27502925.value: 結構轉型與社會規範之間的生育競賽

27502925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27502925.value: The rapid decline in the fertility rate is one of the most important headwinds faced by major economies around the world in the next few decades. Understanding the source of fertility decline, making credible predictions, and identifying potential policy remedies jointly constitute an important research agenda. In this project, we document that fertility rates decline more rapidly in economies with faster structural changes. This fact holds after controlling for the pace of economic development. Motivated by this new fact, we develop a novel structural model where fertility trends are determined by a race between structural change and social norms. In particular, we construct an overlapping generations model with bargaining over fertility and childcare arrangements under the influence of social norms. The main innovation of the model is that social norms are endogenously determined by past choices and the demographic structure. The arrival of new cohorts with fertility and childcare arrangements that differs from their ancestors endogenously shapes the prevailing social norms. Hence, the model leads to rich interactions between these variables and roles for policy intervention. The project will proceed in several steps. Empirically, we will collect more detailed data on structural change, social norms, childcare arrangements, and fertility to document additional facts and conduct further empirical investigations. Quantitatively, we will further develop the model and calibrate it to match both the steady state and transition path of an economy that has experienced rapid structural change (e.g., China or South Korea). With the calibrated model in hand, we plan to conduct two quantitative exercises. First, we will extrapolate the model to predict long-run fertility rates when there is ample time for social norms to change. Second, we plan to use the model to examine the role of government policies that encourage a more equal sharing of childcare burden across genders. With endogenous social norms, such policies will have dynamic implications along the transition path. Therefore, current evaluations might severely underestimate the efficacy of such policies. With the model, we will be able to correct this bias. 本文探討生育率如何受到性別導向的技術進步與性別育兒分工的社會規範之間的相互拉鋸影響。我們構建了一個生育選擇模型，納入由各世代集體意見塑造的內生社會規範。根據模型預測，跨國數據顯示，在經歷快速結構轉型的經濟體中，生育率下降速度更快，尤其在社會規範較為嚴格或適應性較低的情況下，這一趨勢更為明顯。通過對南韓數據的校準，我們的模型揭示，在快速結構轉型的背景下，強烈的社會壓力與規範適應的抗拒不僅加劇了生育率下降，也進一步固化了僵硬的規範。此外，我們發現，雖然補貼女性育兒能在短期內顯著提升生育率，但補貼男性育兒則能通過加速向更平等的穩定狀態轉型，帶來更大的長期效益。

27503925.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27503925.value: 污染信息、環境公平與減排效率

27503925.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27503925.value: This project examines the distributional impact of mandatory environmental disclosure programs. Information-based environmental programs often contain facility-level information about the pollutants released by firms and the location in which the pollution occurs. Although polluters (firms) are not explicitly required to change their behaviors, prior studies have shown that transparency regulations could constrain pollution by creating public pressure on firms. However, the sensitivity of the population to pollutant information could vary significantly, which has implications for firms’ pollution control efforts. Firms are likely to face a higher cost of societal backlash for pollution in high socioeconomic status (SES) areas compared with low-SES areas (where residents are more silent about pollution). If actions taken by victims have a strong regional component, providing pollutant information could potentially lead to increased disparities in pollution among different communities. Another question is whether this distributional effect is economically efficient. Pollution abatement is arguably more cost-effective at high-polluting facilities due to the economies of scale. However, the existing pollution level is endogenously associated with population characteristics. High-polluting facilities are often located in low-SES areas. Therefore, firms might face a trade-off between abatement efficiency and the cost of societal backlash. Pollutant disclosure might cause firms to over/underinvest in pollution abatement in high/low-SES areas. This could also impact the aggregate pollution level in a society. Without this distributional effect, the same level of abatement investment could have resulted in a greater reduction in total pollution. My research setting is the Toxic Release Inventory (TRI) program in the US. Since the TRI information per se does not inform the public about their health risks (because the disclosed substance is not linked with health risks), my identification is the staggered recognition of carcinogens in the National Toxicology Program’s Report on Carcinogens (RoC), which changes the public’s perceptions of the riskiness of certain TRI chemicals (some TRI chemicals are reclassified as high-risk (RoC) chemicals). I use a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) design to test whether the increased high-risk pollutants in the disclosure program (RoC chemicals) lead to disproportionate changes in pollution outcomes and over/underinvestment in pollution abatement (measured by abnormal investment) in high/low-SES areas. This project sheds light on the hidden cost of information-based environmental regulations by showing that pollutant information provides leeway for shifts in welfare, which also comes at the cost of resource efficiency. 本項目研究強制性環境信息披露政策的分配效應。信息披露類的環保法規通常包含企業排放污染物及污染地點的詳細資料。雖然污染者（企業）未被明確要求改變行為，但先前研究表明，信息披露類法規可通過施加公眾壓力來抑制污染。然而，公眾對污染信息的敏感度可能存在顯著差異，這將影響企業的污染減排行為。與低社會經濟地位（SES）地區相比，企業在高SES地區面臨的污染社會反彈成本可能更高（因低SES居民對污染更沉默）。若受害者的行動具有明顯地域特徵，披露污染信息可能會加劇不同社區間的污染差距。 另一相關的問題在於這種分配效應是否具有經濟效率。從規模經濟角度，高污染設施的污染治理成本效益通常更佳。但現有污染水平與人口特徵存在內生關聯——高污染設施往往位於低SES區域。因此，企業可能面臨治理效率與社會反彈成本的權衡。污染信息披露可能導致企業在高/低SES地區過度/不足投資治污，這亦將影響社會總污染水平。若無此分配效應，相同治污投資本可實現更大的總污染減排。 本研究以美國有毒物質排放清單法規（TRI）為背景。由於TRI信息本身未揭示健康風險（因披露物質未與健康風險掛鉤），我採用美國國家毒理學計畫致癌物報告（RoC）對致癌物的分批認定作為自然實驗，該認定改變公眾對特定TRI化學品（被RoC重新歸類為高風險化學品）的風險認知。透過交錯雙重差分設計，檢驗高風險污染物（RoC化學品）的披露是否導致高/低SES地區出現不成比例的污染結果變化及治污投資過度/不足（以異常投資衡量）。本研究項目旨在揭示信息披露類環境法規的隱藏成本：披露污染信息可能導致福利轉移，並且以犧牲資源效率為代價。

27505625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27505625.value: 产品披露，需求信息与市场反馈效应

27505625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27505625.value: The growing literature on managerial learning shows that financial markets can affect the real economy through market feedback (Bond, Edmans, and Goldstein, 2012). The idea is that, by aggregating different pieces of information from numerous market participants, stock prices convey information to firm managers and guide their decision-making. Despite the conceptual appeal of managerial learning from market feedback, one fundamental question remain unclear is what information managers learn from the market, especially given that managers are supposed to be the most informed players (Goldstein, Liu, and Yang, 2021; Gelsomin and Hutton, 2023; Goldstein, 2023). This project attempt to answer this fundamentally important question by conjecturing and testing whether demand information is a specific type of information that managers learn from the stock market. Specifically, I focus on new product announcements, a setting where managers likely face significant demand uncertainty and investors likely have complementary private information about market demand for the new products, and studying how managers revise their forecasts and investment decisions in response to the market reaction to such announcements. I posit that managers gain insights into the market demand for their new products from the market responses to new product announcements and change their decisions accordingly. If the market response to new product announcements is more positive (i.e., indicating greater demand), I expect managers to revise their sales and earnings forecasts upward, and adjust production investments, marketing expenses, and price margins upward. I also expect such primary effects of managerial learning about demand information on firm decisions to be stronger when firms face more uncertain demand, when new products are more innovative, when managers have less internal knowledge about demand, and when stock prices contain more information. To further pin down managerial learning about demand information and help provide “smoking-gun” evidence, I plan to exploit product-level data and a tighter research design that links the market response to a new product announcement to the subsequent firm decisions associated with that specific product. I expect market responses to an announcement to be positively associated with the number of shops that the product is sold at upon initial launch, the initial selling price of the product, and negatively associated with the days it takes from the announcement of the new product to the date when the product is officially sold on the market (which reflects the additional efforts that managers take to launch the product). 关于管理者学习的文献表明，金融市场可以通过市场反馈效应影响实体经济（Bond, Edmans, and Goldstein, 2012）。其基本思路是，通过聚合来自众多市场参与者的不同信息，股票价格能够向公司管理者传递信息，并引导其决策。尽管管理者通过市场反馈进行学习的概念具有很强的理论吸引力，但一个根本性的问题仍未得到充分解答：管理者究竟从市场中学习到哪些信息，尤其是在考虑到管理者理应是最为知情的参与者时（Goldstein, Liu, and Yang, 2021; Gelsomin and Hutton, 2023; Goldstein, 2023）。 本项目力图回答这一根本性的重要问题。具体而言，我提出并检验的设想是：需求信息是管理者可能从股票市场学习到的一类特定信息。研究聚焦于新产品公告这一情境。在该情境下，管理者通常面临显著的需求不确定性，而投资者则可能掌握关于新产品市场需求的互补性非公开信息。基于此，本研究考察管理者如何根据市场对新产品公告的反应来修正其预测和投资决策。 本研究的核心观点是：管理者能够从市场对新产品公告的反应中获得关于新产品市场需求的洞见，并据此调整其决策。如果市场反应更为积极（即表明需求更高），我预期管理者会上调其销售和盈利预测，并提高生产投资、营销支出和价格加成。同时，我预期，这种管理者从需求信息中学习并影响企业决策的效应，在企业面临更高需求不确定性、新产品更具创新性、管理者掌握的内部需求信息较少以及股票价格信息含量更高时将更为显著。 为了进一步识别管理者对需求信息的学习，并提供更具说服力的直接证据，我计划利用产品层面的数据，构建更为严谨的研究设计，将市场对新产品公告的反应与该特定产品相关的后续企业决策直接联系起来。我预期，如果市场对新产品公告的反应更积极，该产品会在首发时进入更多门店、初始定价会更高，同时新产品公告到正式上市的时间也会更短。

27505725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27505725.value: 有限承诺下的集体选择：模糊政治的一个例子

27505725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27505725.value: In an era marked by a growing concern for citizen inclusion in the political process, informal political processes such as citizen advisory committees or petitions have gained prominence. The proposed research project aims to formulate a formal model of such processes to address this concern and contribute to policy discussions (e.g., OECD, 2020 and EU, 2021). The model adresses the following key questions: How can decision-makers effectively engage with citizens to encourage sharing their private information and, in this sense, ensure the citizen's proper inclusion? What policy responses should they commit to in response to citizens' voiced opinions? What is the optimal governance of informal political processes such as citizen advisory committees and petitions? In the model, a principal chooses how to structure his interaction with a large number of agents (citizens). We think of this as the choice of an ``informal political process’’, where we model the informality by considering a principal who is limited in her commitment to final policy outcomes. The principal cannot make precise promises about future policies. He can commit to (non-degenerate) policy intervals and how these will vary depending on the collected opinions of the agents. The preliminary model analysis suggests that the optimal process features extreme vagueness about future policies: The principal restricts his options only minimally, by an epsilon amount, excluding either the epsilon-lowest or epsilon-highest policy choices contingent on the agents' observed behavior. This conjectured finding carries several implications. It offers a rationale for political decision-makers' notorious reluctance to adopt a clear stance on emerging issues. It informs policy discussions about good governance of informal political processes, which have emphasized the importance of decision-makers’ commitment in response to citizens' recommendations (OECD, 2020). The theory also links to the classical dichotomy between representation by trustees with complete discretion or by delegates constrained to follow the citizens' recommendations, tracing back to the founding fathers (Madison, 1788), and a burgeoning body of literature on public protests that assumes zero commitment power, a polar case of our analysis (Lohmann, 1993; Battaglini, 2017; Lauermann and Ekmekci, 2024) In conclusion, this research advances our understanding of contemporary democratic processes like citizen advisory committee petitions, offering insights into designing mechanisms that promote effective citizen inclusion and policy-making. 在公民政治参与日益受到重视的时代背景下，公民咨询委员会、请愿等非正式政治进程逐渐成为焦点。本研究旨在构建此类进程的正式理论模型，以回应相关问题并为政策讨论提供学理支持（如OECD 2020、EU 2021等国际政策框架）。 模型着重探讨以下核心问题：(1) 决策者如何通过有效互动机制激励公民共享私人信息，从而实现实质性政治包容？(2) 针对公民意见表达，决策者应承诺何种政策响应规则？(3) 如何设计公民咨询委员会、请愿等非正式政治进程的最优治理模式？ 模型设定中，政策制定者（委托人）需设计与众多公民（代理人）的互动规则。此过程被定义为"非正式政治进程"的选择，其核心特征体现为委托人对最终政策结果的承诺能力受限：委托人无法对具体政策作出精确承诺，但可预先设定政策区间范围（non-degenerate policy intervals），并规定该区间如何随公民意见反馈动态调整。 初步分析表明，最优进程呈现显著的"政策模糊性"：委托人仅通过排除ε比例的最低或最高政策选项（具体方向取决于公民行为观测结果），以最小化对自身决策灵活性的约束。 这一发现具有三重意义：其一，为决策者面对新兴议题时惯常采取的模糊立场提供理论解释；其二，呼应OECD（2020）等政策文件中强调的"决策承诺"原则，为非正式政治进程的善治讨论注入新视角；其三，衔接政治代表理论中的经典二分法（Madison 1788提出的受托人-代理人范式），并与公共抗议研究中"完全无承诺能力"的极端假设形成理论呼应（Lohmann 1993、Battaglini 2017、Lauermann与Ekmekci 2024等）。 本研究通过形式化建模，深化了对公民咨询委员会请愿等当代民主机制的理解，为构建促进有效公民参与和政策制定的制度设计提供理论依据。

27507425.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27507425.value: 高频金融数据的深度信息提取：计量经济学创新与机器学习应用

27507425.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27507425.value: This project aims to develop new econometric methods to analyze high-frequency financial data that documents detailed intraday trading activities. While most existing research has focused on asset prices, this project extends the analysis to other market indicators, such as trading volumes and trading flows, which have been relatively underexplored in the literature. Different market indicators may carry different aspects of information. Prices reflect the average investor opinion, while trading activity reveals divergences in opinion. During events such as news releases, prices may not change significantly, but trading volumes can surge as investors disagree on how to interpret the news. The literature highlights that focusing solely on price movements may not fully capture market dynamics. Therefore, analyzing both price and trading behavior is crucial for better understanding market movements. Against this background, I propose a uniform inference procedure for general high-frequency financial data. In particular, this procedure enables researchers to use trading flows to detect significant monetary shocks, such as those resulting from central bank press conferences. To increase flexibility and applicability to real-world data, I develop a nonstandard asymptotic theory for the nonparametric functional estimator of risk indicators. This theoretical advancement will provide more robust and accurate tools for analyzing high-frequency data across various market scenarios. Additionally, the project provides a solution to integrate econometric analysis with machine learning techniques, which may help reduce the informational gap between ordinary market practitioners and professionals. Overall, the proposed methods have the potential to advance the field of high-frequency financial data analysis by offering more comprehensive insights into market dynamics, and to enhance the transparency as well as the interpretability of machine learning applications in finance. These tools could significantly benefit both academic research and practical applications, providing invaluable resources for investors, policymakers, and financial analysts. 本项目旨在发展适用于高频金融数据分析的新计量方法。由于不同金融数据可能携带不同种类的市场信息，单纯关注资产价格变动无法完全反映市场动态。因此，本项目将研究范围由传统的价格研究扩展到其他市场数据类型，例如交易量和交易强度等指标。本项目基于一类通用的高频状态空间模型，建立风险指标的非参数估计以及对应的的非标准渐近理论，可以解决高频风险指标的一致统计推断问题。本研究将应用以上方法分析股票市场交易强度指标，以探测美联储货币政策调整等事件对金融市场的即时影响。此外，本项目还将以上结果与基于机器学习的结果相结合以提升方法的实用性，为市场研究与政策分析提供更全面和有效的工具。

27601625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27601625.value: 超高齡社會下的住房欠保障：一項關於香港居住經驗和健康老化途徑的混合方法研究

27601625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27601625.value: Housing insecurity represents a substantial global challenge, and Hong Kong (HK) is a notable example of the severity of this issue. Private housing rents are skyrocketing, and people with low incomes have to live in tiny subdivided units and join long lines for public housing. The challenge is particularly acute among the older population, as HK became a super-aged society in 2024. Despite these pressing issues, housing insecurity is an overlooked social determinant of old age health in existing research. A careful literature review reveals three major research gaps. First, previous housing insecurity studies originated in Western countries, developed theories based on Western contexts, and targeted healthy adult populations. As a result, their theories cannot be applied to aging populations, HK society, or Eastern cultural contexts. Second, a comprehensive instrument for measuring housing insecurity is lacking, likely owing to the concept’s vague theoretical framework and multidimensional nature. Third, very few housing insecurity studies focus on older adults or examine pathways to health aging. To fill these gaps, the proposed project, comprising three studies, will adopt a mixed-method approach and focus on middle-aged and older adults (aged ≥45) in HK living in various types of housing (i.e., subdivided units, public housing, private housing). Study 1 will develop a sociocultural environmental framework of housing insecurity and old age health grounded in HK, drawing on an extensive literature review and qualitative evidence gleaned from interviews with 30 participants. Study 2 will develop a comprehensive housing insecurity instrument by testing and refining items via a Delphi study (30-item pool and 15 experts) and quantitative survey (429 respondents for exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis). Study 3 will use the same batch of respondents (n=429) as in Study 2 and examine the housing-health relationship among older adults in HK and its underlying pathways using advanced statistical methods (e.g., structural equation modeling, causal mediation analysis). The project will advance research on housing insecurity and old age health. From the theoretical perspective, it will develop a framework applicable to the aging population, HK society, and Eastern culture. From the methodological perspective, it will develop a housing insecurity instrument. From the practical perspective, the findings will inform policymakers and clinical professionals of how to promote healthy aging by addressing housing insecurity. The findings on HK experience will also prove informative for other regions and countries facing similar challenges related to housing insecurity and population aging. 住房欠保障是全球面臨的重大挑戰，而香港正是此問題嚴重性的典型例子。私人住宅租金飆升，低收入人士不得不居住在狹小的劏房中，並長期輪候公屋。這一挑戰在老年人口中尤為嚴峻，特別香港已於2024年進入超高齡社會。儘管問題迫切，住房欠保障在現有研究中仍是被忽視的老年健康社會決定因素。透過仔細的文獻回顧，可發現現有三個重要研究空白：第一，過往住房欠保障研究多源自西方國家，其理論建構基於西方背景，研究對象多為健康成年人，因此無法適用於老年人口、香港社會或東方文化背景；第二，目前缺乏全面的測量住房欠保障性的工具，可能因為其理論架構模糊且概念多面向；第三，極少有研究聚焦於老年人或探討住房欠保障與健康老化之間的關係與路徑。 為填補這些研究缺口，本研究計劃將採用混合方法，進行三項研究，聚焦於居住於不同類型住房（如劏房、公屋、私人住宅）的香港中老年人（年齡 ≥45歲）。研究一將透過文獻回顧及30位受訪者的質性訪談資料，建構一個以香港為基礎的住房欠保障與老年健康的社會文化環境理論框架。研究二將透過德爾菲研究（30題項池與15位專家）及量化調查（429位受訪者進行探索性與驗證性因素分析），開發一套全面的測量住房欠保障性的工具。研究三將使用研究二的同一批受訪者（n=429），運用進階統計方法（如結構方程模型與因果中介分析），探討香港老年人居住與健康之間的關係及其潛在途徑。 本研究將推進住房欠保障與老年健康領域的理論與實務發展。在理論層面，建構適用於老年人口、香港社會及東方文化的分析框架；在方法層面，開發測量住房欠保障性的工具；在實務層面，研究結果將為政策制定者與臨床專業人士提供促進健康老化的策略建議。香港的研究經驗亦可為其他面臨住房欠保障性與人口老化挑戰的地區與國家提供參考。

27601725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27601725.value: 日本藝術史上的中國和沈南蘋

27601725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27601725.value: The Chinese painter Shen Nanpin (1682–ca. 1760) would not exist in histories of East Asian art without Japan. In 1731, Nanpin travelled to Nagasaki, Japan for a brief sojourn of less than two years, and despite his subsequent absence, he later became an important figurehead of Japanese painting writ large. This project explores the transnational legacy of Shen Nanpin as a case study to illuminate processes of canon formation that undergird the modern-day field of East Asian art history. Why did this provincial Chinese painter become a canonical pillar of Japanese art history, and how does that inform the way we conceptualise him in the present? The various manifestations of Shen Nanpin comprise a complex portrait of a transregional and transhistorical visual phenomenon, all deceptively encapsulated in the name of one individual. While primary records relating to Nanpin are scant and inconclusive, the extant works bearing his name number in the thousands and are clearly not all painted by one person. Rather than working against this conundrum to recapture the individual himself, my approach takes as subject the many images and texts that fashioned the Chinese painter in premodern imaginaries and modern-day art histories. One of the primary contributions will be to re-evaluate the role of the “fake,” repositioning such negatively defined imagery as a critical category that constructs authenticity. As the first study to approach Nanpin as an assembled Sino-Japanese sensation rather than an influential Chinese patriarch, this project not only rewrites canonical narratives for East Asian art history but also further demonstrates the intimacies of production and reception that, just as my absent subject, cross both geographic and temporal boundaries. 中國畫家沈南蘋（沈銓，1682年 - 約1760年）於東亞藝術史上的記載與日本是密不可分的，他在1731年前往日本長崎，雖然停留不過兩年，但無礙他日後成爲日本繪畫界的風雲人物。本研究將探討他的跨國傳奇事跡，並以此為例，顯示現今東亞藝術史學中主流典範的建構過程。這位中國地區畫家是怎樣一躍成為日本藝術史上的經典大家？這又如何影響當下人們對他的理解？沈南蘋的各種表象描繪一個跨地域、跨時代的複雜視覺現象，誘使人錯誤認為這一切都只歸功於他一人而已。關於沈南蘋的一手歷史記錄數量少且難以定奪，曾被冠以其名的作品卻是數以千計，所以顯然全非經他一人之手，與其試圖還原畫家的真面目，我將審視這些在近現代想像和當代藝術史中塑造沈南蘋的諸多圖像和文本，並以它們作為本研究的主題。其中一項主要貢獻是重新評估「假畫」的角色，帶負面評價的圖像將被重新定位成一種定義真實性的批判類別。作爲首次把沈南蘋視作中日兼容的整體感覺而非具影響力的中國宗師去研究，本項目不僅重新編寫東亞藝術史的發展故事，也進一步展現了製作與觀賞之間的親密關係，就如我那消失的主角，同樣跨越地理和時間的界限。

27602025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27602025.value: 香港語言景觀的歷史變遷

27602025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27602025.value: The signs in public spaces that form a city’s linguistic landscape offer a fresh means of understanding its diversity, vibrancy, and inclusiveness. Despite growing research interest in this area, recent linguistic landscape studies predominantly adopt a synchronic approach to documenting language use. Hong Kong presents a complex and dynamic sociolinguistic context for linguistic landscape research. While English and Chinese are official languages that dominate the linguistic landscape, there are also minority languages of differing visibility relative to their sociocultural capital and economic value. Yet, no recent study has systematically examined diachronic changes in the linguistic landscape of Hong Kong and the presence or absence of these minority languages. As the territory undergoes significant socioeconomic transformation and becomes increasingly heterogeneous in its demographic composition, there is an urgent need to assess how its languages used have evolved over time in order to reveal important trends in urban multilingualism. This project aims to examine diachronic changes of the Hong Kong linguistic landscape using a quantitative approach. While conventional quantitative and ethnographic studies of linguistic landscapes tend to be insensitive to time or of limited scope, this research will address these shortcomings by drawing on both historical data from photographic archives and contemporary data from neighborhood fieldwork. To assess how urban multilingualism has evolved over time, I will conduct a semi-automated qualitative coding of languages on public signs, followed by statistical and modelling analyses. Results will be visualized using maps and plots in order to provide direct and accessible insights into changes in the visibility of different languages in public spaces This project will contribute to scholarship by further developing the quantitative paradigm of linguistic landscape research, innovating the approach with data visualization and modelling methods. It will provide fresh data of enduring value that will facilitate the tracing of changes in Hong Kong’s multilingualism. The quantitative method can be generalized to districts outside the sampling areas and replicated to examine linguistic diversity in other multilingual cities. The focus on language change as a distinguishing feature of Hong Kong’s social and historical development will offer an alternative perspective to sociological theories on urban transformation and multiculturalism. Findings of this project, especially regarding the presence and absence of minority languages in certain times and at particular neighborhoods, have public impact potential since they can inform government campaigns on developing diverse and pluralistic city space to accommodate minority languages. 香港的語言景觀展現其多樣性與包容性，英語與中文主導公共標牌，少數族裔語言的能見度因社會經濟價值而異。近期研究多採用共時分析，少有探討歷時變化。隨著香港社會經濟轉型與人口多元化，亟需研究語言使用的演變，以揭示城市多語言發展趨勢。本研究以量化方法探討香港語言景觀的歷時變化，針對傳統量化及民族誌研究時間敏感度低或範圍有限的不足，結合歷史照片檔案與當代社區實地數據進行分析。通過對公共標牌語言的統計、建模及視覺化分析，評估城市多語言的演變。本研究創新之處包括：一、優化語言景觀量化研究範式；二、提供追蹤多語言演變的珍貴數據；三、突顯香港社會歷史發展特色，為城市轉型與多元文化提供新視角。研究結果，特別是少數族裔語言的變動，具公共影響力，可為促進多元城市空間的政策提供參考。

27602125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27602125.value: 虛境2．0──探析社交媒體下對虛擬人陪伴與娛樂的行爲和看法

27602125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27602125.value: Virtual humans are AI-generated characters that appear human and are often mistaken for human beings due to their “realness.” They have names, physical appearances, lives, and interests, all meticulously curated and controlled by their human creators. However, their “realness” is sometimes questioned by the humans who interact with them. AI-enhanced communication offers benefits, such as providing entertainment and sociability, but can also manipulate our emotions and behaviors, blurring the line between what is real and what is not. Despite the prevalence of AI-enhanced communication, surprisingly little research explores how it is constituted, unfolds, and is understood. Consequently, scholars have very limited understanding of how AI shapes digital interactions in ways that evoke both what is “make-believe” and “real,” as well as how people derive meanings from such interactions. This study addresses important knowledge gaps regarding AI-human interaction patterns, user engagement with virtual humans, and the ethics of virtual humans on social media. It analyzes Instagram interactions between virtual humans and humans, using interactional sociolinguistics, a qualitative approach to discourse analysis that highlights meaning-making as co-constituted, context-bound, and sequentially unfolding. This project will demonstrate how virtual humans on Instagram are constructed: (1) as having everyday human experiences through narrative activities; (2) as possessing the human interactional capacity for playfulness; and (3) as engaging in the human practice of performing gendered identities, often in stereotyped ways. By analyzing how these three phenomena unfold through virtual humans’ posts, users’ comments on such posts, and their direct interactions in the comments section, the project will illuminate how the boundaries of social engagement between users and virtual humans are established, maintained, blurred, and, occasionally transgressed. This approach highlights the transposition of offline experiences and activities to online environments in a non-literal way, or what I term “make-believe 2.0,” in AI-enhanced communication contexts. To contextualize my analysis, I will also conduct focus-group discussions with young adults in Hong Kong to gain their perspectives and a broader understanding of virtual humans on social media. My project offers a nuanced understanding of the linguistic, multimodal, and interactive features of communication between virtual humans and humans. It also provides practical insights into how sociolinguistics enhances user engagement with AI creations, highlights the fine line between what is real and what is not, and addresses ethical uncertainties regarding the use and impact of virtual humans on social media.

27602525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27602525.value: 探究多维生活环境对成年人心脏代谢健康的影响

27602525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27602525.value: As of 2023, around 60% of the global population lives in cities. While urban living provides convenience, it also poses significant challenges for both the environment and public health. In 2021, nearly 10million deaths from non-communicable diseases (NCDs), such as diabetes and hypertension, were linked to environmental and occupational risk factors. Living environments (LEs), including natural, built, and social environments, are changeable, making them a powerful tool for NCD prevention. Unlike individual prevention strategies, such as exercise promotion, LEs-related policies have broader and more sustainable impacts on public health. The Urbanome framework recently emerged as a systematic and comprehensive approach to assessing multidimensional living environments (MLEs). It highlights the importance and urgency of continuous temporal and spatial monitoring of MLEs, assessing their health impacts, and implementing targeted interventions. However, relevant research remains limited, particularly in Asia. Given the high population density and extensive urbanisation, the disease burden linked to MLE factors could be even more pronounced in Hong Kong. Improving these LEs could have significant political and public health implications, potentially reducing the risk of developing NCDs or even reversing their progression. Further research is needed to address this gap. This project aims to assess the dynamic associations between MLEs and cardiometabolic diseases (CMDs). The objectives are to: 1) assess MLEs and identify key LE factors linked to CMDs; 2) investigate the longitudinal associations between MLEs and CMD development in Chinese adults; 3) create MLEs-related risk maps for CMDs; and 4) evaluate the impact of improved MLEs on CMD trajectories. A schematic environmental profile associated with CMDs will be developed. Using multiple methods, this project will quantify the MLE−CMD associations based on large longitudinal cohorts with detailed individual information. High-risk areas will be identified and the impacts of improved MLEs on CMDs progression will be quantified through emulated target trials. This project is among the first to explore the dynamic effects of MLEs on CMDs in Chinese adults. Changes in both MLEs and CMDs will be examined. It will provide new and timely data on MLE-related risk maps for CMDs, helping authorities efficiently allocate medical resources and make data-driven decisions for urban planning. The findings will also highlight the potential of improving MLEs to reduce the risk or even reverse the progression of CMDs on a large scale. This research will offer empirical and scientific insights into population-centred, non-pharmacological interventions to improve cardiometabolic health and promote healthier cities. 城市化已经成为全球的主流趋势，但其对环境与公共健康构成了严峻挑战。直至2021年，近1000万例非传染性疾病（NCDs）相关死亡都与环境有关。生活环境因此在预防NCDs方面具有巨大潜力。Urbanome框架近期作为一种系统性、综合性的评估多维生活环境（MLEs）的方法被提出。该框架强调持续在多个维度上监测MLEs、评估其对健康的影响并实施有针对性的干预措施的重要性与紧迫性。然而，相关研究目前仍较为有限，尤其是在亚洲地区。鉴于香港人口密度高、城市化水平高，与MLE因素相关的疾病负担可能更为严重。改善这些生活环境不仅具有显著的公共健康意义，也可能带来重要的政策影响，有望降低NCDs的发生风险。因此，迫切需要进一步开展相关研究以填补这一空白。本项目旨在评估MLEs与心脏代谢性疾病（CMDs）之间的关联。具体目标包括：1）评估MLEs并识别与CMDs相关的关键环境因素；2）探讨MLEs与CMDs在成年人中的关联；3）绘制CMDs的MLEs相关风险地图；4）评估改善MLEs对CMDs发展的影响。项目将通过多种研究方法，量化MLEs与CMDs之间的关联。同时将识别高风险区域，量化改善MLEs对CMDs的影响。本项目是首批探索MLEs对成年人CMDs影响的研究之一。研究结果有助于帮政府更有效地分配医疗资源，并为城市规划提供数据支持。本研究还将突出改善MLEs在大范围内降低CMDs风险，促进心脏代谢健康与建设更健康的城市。

27606525.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27606525.value: 基於遷移物理信息圖學習的AI輔助竹棚數碼孿生：用於結構評估與修復

27606525.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27606525.value: Sustainable construction is increasingly embracing natural materials, which presents unique challenges compared to industrial materials like steel and concrete due to their inherent variability and a lack of standardisation. Bamboo, widely used in Hong Kong as building scaffolding, exemplifies these challenges, with construction practices that are heavily reliant on empirical builder knowledge with limited performance-based feedback, impacting safety and efficiency. In response, this project proposes an AI-assisted framework for accessible, accelerated, and automated digital twinning of bamboo scaffolds. First, bamboo scaffold captured as image sequences are converted to graph-like digital twins (DTs) using a compilation of established segmentation approaches. They fuse observed structural responses to factors like self-weight and workers, obtained from sparse camera imaging and optionally sensor networks. A machine learning model is trained to solve the inverse system identification problem across DTs, predicting properties enabling structural assessment. A physical demonstrator will validate these predictions and serve as a platform for ongoing research refinement. Technically, the project builds upon a physics-informed geometric deep learning (GDL) framework developed by the PI that has successfully tackled several inverse modelling tasks. Departing from typical structural health monitoring approaches that are individually trained for each new structural system, this work leverages GDL to pretrain on a synthetic dataset of diverse scaffolds, thereby offering support for custom designs with varying connectivity and sizes while reducing requirement for real-life data. Additionally, DTs are designed to flexibly accommodate the variable combination of multi-modal data encountered across a scaffold's lifecycle; this offers flexibility, leverages diverse incomplete data to address uncertainty while ensuring support for both operational and assembly/dismantling phases where accidents typically occur. The model learns to reduce the discrepancies between observed displacement responses to those computed from the model’s inferred stiffness properties using an integrated auto-differentiable structural analysis solver. This approach blends the strengths of both physics-informed and data-driven approaches, enhancing model robustness by ensuring physically meaningful and interpretable results. It also enables this work to develop useful downstream applications providing actionable insights to designers. The research proposed here yields several long-term benefits. It will democratise access to structural analysis insights for bamboo builders and craftsmen, supporting both design and safety monitoring. The proposed framework also provides a template for modelling structures made from other natural and variable materials, contributing to more sustainable construction practices. Ultimately, this work represents a fundamental advance towards real-time human-AI collaborative and interactive design for complex, ad-hoc structures. 當代可持續建築日益採用天然物料，相較於鋼材及混凝土等工業化物料，這類物料因固有性能差異及缺乏標準化而帶來獨特挑戰。以在香港廣泛使用的建築竹棚為例，其施工方式高度依賴施工人員的經驗知識，缺乏以性能為本的反饋機制，從而影響安全與效率。 為此，本項目提出一套AI輔助框架，以實現便捷、高效及自動化的竹棚數碼孿生建模與分析。首先，透過整合成熟的分割算法，將由影像序列捕捉的竹棚結構轉化為圖結構數碼孿生體（DT）。該架構可融合來自稀疏攝像成像與可選感應器網絡的觀測數據，捕捉結構在自重、工人作業等作用下的響應。透過訓練機器學習模型，本研究將解決跨DT的逆向系統識別問題，預測材料特性以支持結構評估。本項目將利用實體示範平台驗證預測結果，並作為後續研究的迭代優化基礎。 在技術層面，本項目基於項目負責人開發的物理信息幾何深度學習（GDL）框架延伸，該框架已成功應用於多項逆向建模任務。不同於傳統結構健康監測（SHM）方法需為每一新結構系統單獨訓練，本研究利用GDL在多樣化的虛擬竹棚合成數據集上進行預訓練，從而支援不同連接方式及尺寸的訂製化設計，並減少對真實數據的依賴。此外，DT設計具高度靈活性，能適應竹棚生命週期中多模態數據的動態組合——此特性不僅提升應用彈性，更可利用多來源且不完整的數據應對不確定性，並在施工及拆卸兩個事故高發階段提供監測能力。模型透過整合自動微分結構分析求解器，學習縮小觀測位移響應與基於剛度特性計算值之間的差異。該方法融合物理模型與數據驅動的雙重優勢，確保結果具物理意義與可解釋性，從而增強模型穩健性，並為設計師開發具實用價值的下游應用提供可操作見解。 本研究具多重長遠效益。它將使竹棚的建造者與工匠能更便捷地獲取結構分析結果，從而支援設計及安全監測。該框架亦可推廣至其他由天然物料或高變異性物料製成的結構建模，為可持續建築實踐提供方法範本。最終，本研究將為複雜及臨時結構的即時人機協作與互動式設計奠定堅實基礎。

27607025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27607025.value: 中國市民氣候政策取向：科學、風險、成本、公平、經濟與全球競爭的影響

27607025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27607025.value: Addressing climate change requires strong public support for successful policy adoption and implementation. In China, a key global player in climate mitigation, understanding public preferences for climate policy is crucial. This research explores Chinese citizens’ preferences over various climate mitigation policy options, focusing on how they perceive each policy option regarding six considerations: climate risk reduction, co-benefits for local pollution reduction, household costs, negative impacts on fossil fuel-dependent regions, economic impacts, and global competitiveness. The central challenge this study addresses is the lack of understanding about what shapes public opinion on climate policies in China. While extensive research exists on public attitudes toward climate policy in Western countries, much less is known about how Chinese citizens view climate actions. Understanding these attitudes is essential for designing policies that can be successfully implemented and sustained. This project employs a large-scale survey to gather data on how Chinese citizens evaluate different climate policies. The survey will assess public beliefs about each policy option across six key considerations: climate risk reduction, pollution reduction, household costs, impacts on fossil fuel-dependent regions, economic growth, and global competitiveness, and how these beliefs shape support for each policy. Additionally, the research will examine how different framings of climate change influence citizens’ beliefs in the six key considerations, which in turn shape their support for climate policies. This study will identify key factors driving public support or resistance to climate policies in China. The findings will offer valuable insights for policymakers, NGOs, and businesses, providing a foundation for designing and communicating climate policies that resonate with the public and gain widespread support, contributing to the long-term success of global climate mitigation efforts. 應對氣候變化，需要廣泛而有力的公眾支持，方能促成政策的有效制定與落實。作為全球氣候減緩的重要參與者，中國的氣候政策取向備受關注，因此了解市民對氣候政策的偏好至為關鍵。本研究探討中國市民對各類氣候減緩政策選項的取態，並聚焦於他們如何就六個考慮因素作出評估：降低氣候風險、減少本地污染的協同效益、家庭成本、對依賴化石燃料地區的負面影響、經濟影響，以及全球競爭力。 本研究回應的核心挑戰，是我們對影響中國市民氣候政策觀點的因素缺乏深入理解。雖然西方國家已有大量有關公眾氣候政策態度的研究，但對中國市民如何看待氣候行動的實證分析仍然有限。掌握這些態度，對於制定可行且可持續的政策至關重要。 本計劃將進行大規模問卷調查，收集市民如何根據上述六個考慮因素評估不同氣候政策的數據，並分析這些看法如何影響他們對各項政策的支持程度。此外，研究亦會探討，不同的氣候變化論述方式如何塑造市民對六個考慮因素的看法，繼而影響他們的政策取態。 本研究將識別推動或阻礙中國市民支持氣候政策的關鍵因素。研究結果將為政策制定者、非政府組織及企業提供重要參考，協助設計與傳達更能引起市民共鳴並獲廣泛支持的氣候政策，從而為全球氣候減緩的長遠成功作出貢獻。

27608025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27608025.value: 青銅時代中“石”資源的考古學研究：長江中游地區商代的聚落與社會

27608025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27608025.value: This research project investigates the significance and role of stone resources in the Bronze Age society of China, specifically focusing on the settlements and social structures of the Shang dynasty in the Jianghan area of the Middle Yangtze River (ca. 1,600–1,050 BC). While past studies have concentrated on bronzes due to their association with power and religious rituals, this project addresses the underexplored domain of stone resources. Stones— unlike the rare and elite-associated bronzes—are ubiquitous and accessible, offering an opportunity to uncover different social dynamics across diverse settlement sizes. The project employs a multidisciplinary approach combining archaeological fieldwork, elemental analysis using X-ray fluorescence (XRF), and petrographic analysis. These methods will be used to explore stone resource acquisition, processing, and distribution across five carefully selected settlement sites representing different hierarchical levels: Panlongcheng, Jingnansi, Yishengsi, Baota, and Guoyuanzui. The analysis aims to identify raw material sources and reconstruct patterns of production and consumption. By aligning the origins of the stone resources with their usage at these sites, the study will assess whether centralized management similar to that of bronze resources existed or whether decentralized mechanisms prevailed. Geological surveys will aid in pinpointing the potential sources of raw materials from nearby geographical units, such as river basins, to understand better the material flow within/between settlements. Through XRF, elemental compositions will be matched against geological data to trace sources, while petrography will allow a detailed understanding of the structural properties of stone tool materials, offering insights into cultural choices in material selection and use. The project’s findings aim to provide a nuanced perspective on the organizational and social landscape of the Shang dynasty, considering whether distinct stone resources were subject to centralized control like bronze or managed in a more distributed manner, considering economic and geographical factors. This new understanding could reshape interpretations of the Bronze Age societal structures in ancient China, revealing the broader impact of stone resources on everyday life and social organization beyond elite-focused narratives. 本研究項目將探討中國青銅時代社會中石質資源的重要性與作用，重點關注商代（約公元前1600-1050年）長江中游江漢地區的聚落結構與社會形態。既往研究多聚焦於象徵權力與宗教儀禮的青銅資源，與稀有且專屬精英階層的青銅不同，石質材料無處不在且易於獲取，這為了解不同規模聚落間的社會動態提供了獨特視角，因此本項目將着力於探索尚未被充分重視的石質資源領域。 項目採用多學科交叉研究方法，結合考古田野調查、X射線螢光（XRF）元素分析和岩相學分析技術。通過對盤龍城、荊南寺、意生寺、寶塔和郭元嘴等五個代表不同層級結構的典型聚落遺址進行系統研究，重點考察石質資源的獲取、加工與流通模式。通過追溯石料來源並重建生產消費鏈條。本研究將探明商代石質資源是否存在與青銅類似的中央化管理體系，抑或呈現去中心化的資源配置機制。 地質調查將協助定位江漢地區附近流域等地理單元中的潛在石料來源，從而揭示聚落內部及聚落間的物資流動軌跡。XRF元素分析可通過成分比對實現石料溯源，而岩相學分析則能深入解析石質材料的微觀結構特性，從而揭示古人選擇與使用石材的文化邏輯。 本項目研究成果旨在構建商代社會組織形態的精細化認知圖景——通過辨析石質資源究竟如青銅般受中央集權控制，還是因經濟地理因素呈現分佈式管理，推動超越精英敘事框架的重新解讀。這一探索或將重塑對中國青銅時代社會結構的理解，揭示石質資源對日常生活與社會組織的深層影響。

27608725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27608725.value: 在香港承認同性伴侶關係： 憲法與人權的視角

27608725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27608725.value: The Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal (CFA) decided the Sham Tsz Kit v Secretary for Justice case in 2023. This landmark decision requires the government to introduce statutory recognition of same-sex couples within two years. The CFA however granted the government ample discretion concerning the form and substance of such recognition. ‘Core’ rights, the CFA ruled, should be granted to same-sex unions, whereas ‘supplementary’ rights may be reserved for married heterosexual couples. However, this core/supplementary distinction was left undefined. The CFA gave no clear guidance on the essential rights and obligations that same-sex couples must enjoy. This vagueness affects legal certainty and may generate discrimination against an already vulnerable minority. This project aims to define the essential rights and obligations that should be covered by a legal scheme recognising same-sex partnerships in Hong Kong. To do so, it will examine the constitutional and human rights framework that determines the legal position of same-sex couples in Hong Kong constitutional law, as well as the jurisprudence of the European Court of Human Rights, where similar questions have been discussed. It will also analyse pertinent international human rights law. The project will (1) investigate the meaning, shortcomings, and potential of the distinction between core and supplementary rights and obligations; (2) assess the transformation of legal notions of ‘family’, and the significance thereof, offering an intersectional and multidisciplinary critique of such transformation; and (3) examine the evolutions in equality law concerning same-sex couples. Indeed, and crucially, the CFA appears to have questioned the possibility of restricting the rights of same-sex couples to protect the traditional family, thereby possibly undermining the argument that has typically justified their differential treatment. The project will fill a significant knowledge gap and contribute to the global debate. It will define the essential guarantees that must be granted to same-sex couples when equal marriage is not constitutionally required. This problem is common to many jurisdictions and, to date, remains unresolved. The project will do so via a multidisciplinary and intersectional approach that draws on queer theory, sociology, and anthropology. This approach has not yet been used with reference to Hong Kong law. The project findings will also offer practical guidance to courts, advocates, and legislators. They will provide theoretical and doctrinal resources to use in resolving crucial questions before and after the statutory recognition of same-sex couples is introduced in Hong Kong. 香港終審法院於 2023 年就 Sham Tsz Kit v Secretary for Justice 一案作出裁決。這一具有里程碑意義的判決要求政府在兩年內於成文法中引入對同性伴侶關係的法定承認。然而，終審法院賦予了政府相當的自由裁量空間，以決定前述承認的具體形式和內容。終審法院判決中裁定，「核心性」權利應被授予給同性伴侶，而「補充性」權利則可保留給已婚異性伴侶。然而，核心/補充權利之間的區別並沒有被定義。終審法院沒有對同性伴侶必須享有的基本權利和義務提供明確的指導。這種含糊性影響了法律的確定性，並可能對已經處於弱勢的少數群體帶來歧視。本項目旨在界定香港承認同性伴侶關係的法律制度所應涵蓋的基本權利和義務。為此，本項目將檢視在香港憲法中決定同性伴侶法律地位的憲法和人權架構，並將檢視討論過類似問題的歐洲人權法院判例。本項目亦會分析相關的國際人權法律。本項目將：(1) 探討核心性的，與補充性的權利和義務之間區別的意義、缺點和潛力；(2) 評估「家庭」這一法律概念的轉變及其重要性，並對這種轉變提出跨領域和多學科的批判；以及 (3) 檢視有關同性伴侶的平等法的演變。事實上，而且關鍵的是，終審法院似乎質疑了通過限制同性伴侶權利以保護傳統家庭的可能性，而終審法院的質疑亦可能削弱了這一通常為差別待遇提供理據基礎的論據。本項目將填補一個重要的知識缺口，並為全球範圍內的討論做出貢獻。本項目將定義：當憲法沒有規定同性婚姻時，必須授予同性伴侶的基本保障。這個問題是許多司法管轄區的共通問題，且至今仍未解決。本項目將透過多學科與交叉的方法來解決這個問題，並運用同性戀理論、社會學與人類學等理論。這種研究方法尚未用於研究香港法律。本項目的研究結果也將為法院、律師和立法者提供實務指引。在香港引入對同性伴侶的法定承認之前和之後，本項目的研究結果將為解決關鍵問題提供理論和教義學幫助。

27608825.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27608825.value: 基於移動監測的弱勢社區空氣質量與環境正義研究

27608825.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27608825.value: Ultrafine Particles (UFPs, <0.1 µm) and Black Carbon (BC) in urban air pollution pose serious health risks. UFPs can penetrate deep into human tissues, while BC is highly toxic. Despite these dangers, both pollutants remain unregulated. Hong Kong’s extensive transportation infrastructure and a dense, aging population make understanding pollutant distribution vital for addressing environmental injustice - where certain communities bear disproportionate environmental burdens. However, traditional air quality monitoring networks lack the spatial resolution to capture localized variations, necessitating more precise monitoring techniques. This research proposes a two-phase approach to comprehensively assess traffic-related air pollution (TRAP) in Hong Kong. The study aims to identify factors associated with elevated UFP and BC concentrations across communities, focusing on contributors to environmental injustice, such as high-emission sources leading to locally elevated pollutant levels. Two mobile monitoring campaigns will be conducted from January to April in 2026 and 2027. Study 1 initiates a city-wide campaign to collect comprehensive data, generating air pollution concentration maps for Hong Kong using geospatial databases and street-view images. Interpretable machine learning models will be employed to predict UFP and BC levels and examine factors associated with pollution patterns. A key outcome will be the development of a Community Prioritization Index for Hong Kong (CPrI-HK), which quantifies a “triple burden” of air pollution exposure, socioeconomic disadvantage, and health vulnerability. This index will provide government agencies a data-driven and easy-to-use tool to identify communities most impacted by these challenges. Building on Study 1, Study 2 targets the disadvantaged communities identified by the CPrI-HK. In these neighborhoods, dense mobile air quality monitoring will cover every road in the neighborhood, capturing detailed pollutant distributions. Computer vision models will classify high-emitting sources associated with elevated pollution levels, such as diesel trucks and buses. This granular data is invaluable for transportation planning, public health, and regulatory enforcement, enabling authorities to implement targeted intervention measures. An additional dimension of Study 2 involves comparing data collected at the neighborhood level with the data collected in Study 1 to evaluate whether broad city-wide models can capture hyperlocal pollution patterns and the added value of neighborhood-specific models. This study aims to highlight limitations of one-size-fits-all approaches and emphasize the need for tailored mitigation strategies based on each community’s context. Findings will be shared with local communities through workshops to empower residents with air quality information and strategies to reduce exposure during daily activities. 超細懸浮微粒（UFPs，粒徑小於 0.1 微米）與黑碳（BC）是都市空氣中的重要污染物。UFPs 可以深入肺部並停留在人體組織中，而 BC 含有具危害性的成分，長期接觸可能對健康帶來風險。不過，這兩種污染物目前仍未受到監管，且在城市範圍內波動明顯，不同社區之間的差異很大。在香港，交通網絡發達，加上人口密集且逐漸老化，使得了解污染分佈對於改善環境不公義（部分社區承受較多污染負擔）特別重要。 由於傳統空氣監測站的覆蓋有限，往往難以反映每個社區的差異。本研究將採用流動監測的方法，在 2026 年與 2027 年各進行一次監測行動，以獲取更細緻的空氣數據。 在第一階段，研究團隊會在全港收集數據並繪製地圖，展示超細懸浮微粒與黑碳的分佈情況，並分析造成污染差異的主要因素。我們亦將發展一套方法，把污染暴露、社會經濟狀況與健康風險結合起來，協助政府更清楚地辨識哪些社區需要更多關注與支援。在第二階段，研究將集中於這些受影響較大的社區，進行更密集的監測，覆蓋社區內所有道路。我們同時會利用計算機視覺技術辨識高排放來源，例如柴油貨車與巴士，並比較全港與社區層級數據，檢視城市模型是否能反映局地污染情況。本研究希望說明單一化做法的限制，並推動更貼近社區情況的減排方案。研究成果將與政府部門、企業及社區共同分享，既提供空氣質素資訊，也推動更有效的減排與防護措施。

27609125.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27609125.value: 本地印刷/全球建筑：十九世纪建筑书籍在全球建筑经济扩张中的作用

27609125.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27609125.value: Printing Local / Building Global studies the impact of pattern books, building manuals and trade catalogues on architectural and infrastructure development in the Southeast Asia-Pacific region during the long nineteenth century. These practical building publications have largely been excluded from the canon of European architectural literature and its historiographies. Yet they emerged as instrumental in the industrial age and became essential tools of the transnational trade in early prefabricated building products and popular architectural styles. This project, drawing together histories of architecture and technology with those of international trade and population movements, will assemble and analyse a core set of nineteenth-century construction literature selling portable buildings and prefabricated ornament that circulated through Hong Kong and southern China to reach lucrative markets in the Australian colonies. It aims to uncover how printed materials from Britain, the US, and Europe were utilised internationally to market prefabricated building components, shaping the foundation for today's globalised architecture and construction industries. The research will investigate the impact of these building publications on the Southeast Asia-Pacific region, including their role as decorative models for copying, their influence on architectural styles, their contribution towards nation-building or religious narratives, their facilitation of infrastructure development as part of land acquisition practices, and their interactions with or transformations by local building knowledge systems. Additionally, the project will explore the role of local Chinese-language building publications that supplemented, translated or even challenged construction knowledge imposed in the European building guides, exploring how this knowledge was mediated on building sites and by local labour forces, and revealing tensions between colonial building cultures and local practices. These counterexamples will show that Hong Kong and southern China’s nineteenth century building literature was not strictly tethered to European printed example, but rather, operated within a more cosmopolitan and global frame. By positioning pattern books, manuals, and catalogues within the emerging global architectural discourse of empire, and as printed artefacts working both within and against colonial systems, the project considers them as objects that can open up new and more globally inclusive perspectives on architectural and cultural histories. The outcomes of the research will include presentations at conferences, two peer-reviewed journal articles, a book proposal, table of contents, and two draft chapters for a monograph. A curated online open-access archive/database of core primary source building publications uncovered in the research will be established to provide a valuable resource for future scholars and the public. 地方印刷/全球建筑》研究了 19 世纪漫长的东南亚-太平洋地区的图样书籍、建筑手册和贸易目录对建筑和基础设施发展的影响。这些实用的建筑出版物在很大程度上被排除在欧洲建筑文献及其史学著作之外。然而，它们却在工业时代发挥了重要作用，成为早期预制建筑产品和流行建筑风格跨国贸易的重要工具。 本项目将建筑史和技术史与国际贸易史和人口流动史结合起来，汇集并分析 19 世纪销售便携式建筑和预制装饰品的核心建筑文献，这些文献通过香港和华南地区流通到澳大利亚殖民地有利可图的市场。该研究旨在揭示英国、美国和欧洲的印刷材料是如何在国际范围内被用来推销预制建筑构件的，从而为今天的全球化建筑和建造业奠定基础。这项研究将调查这些建筑出版物对东南亚-太平洋地区的影响，包括它们作为装饰范本供人模仿的作用、它们对建筑风格的影响、它们对国家建设或宗教叙事的贡献、它们作为土地征用实践的一部分对基础设施发展的促进作用，以及它们与当地建筑知识体系的互动或改变。此外，该项目还将探讨当地中文建筑出版物的作用，这些出版物补充、翻译甚至挑战了欧洲建筑指南中强加的建筑知识，探讨了这些知识如何在建筑工地和当地劳动力中传播，并揭示了殖民建筑文化与当地实践之间的紧张关系。这些反例将表明，香港和华南地区十九世纪的建筑文献并不完全受制于欧洲的印刷范例，而是在一个更具世界性和全球性的框架内运作。通过将图样书、手册和目录定位在新兴的帝国全球建筑话语中，并将其作为在殖民体系内和与殖民体系对立的印刷品，该项目认为它们可以为建筑史和文化史开辟新的、更具全球包容性的视角。 研究成果将包括在会议上的发言、两篇经同行评审的期刊论文、一份出书建议、目录和两章专著草稿。还将为研究中发现的核心原始资料建设出版物建立一个经过整理的在线开放存取档案/数据库，为未来的学者和公众提供宝贵的资源。

27609725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27609725.value: 30個鄉村廁所設計要素 – 與周山村個別家庭共同探索出的衛生方案

27609725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27609725.value: Research Aim This research will develop 30 Rural Toilet Design Ingredients, with the support of local inhabitants of the project site, in order to expand local design solutions that are appropriate to the complex rural situation. These 30 design ingredients will be summarised into a book publication, and will be disseminated to stakeholders including rural communities, community workers, local authorities, and architecture professions. Research Background and Challenge Rural toilet and sanitation development has not progressed, due to the inappropriate approach about implementing large-scale sewerage systems, which conflicts to the organic rural settlements. Rural toilet designs have not responded to the complex local situation, due to the lack of understanding about rural inhabitants. Although the alternative off-grid toilets have been tested widely in rural communities, the lack of community engagement has caused misuse of the off-grid toilet system. Rural toilet design is a challenging task, and it requires close collaboration with local inhabitants to develop appropriate solutions. Research Approach and Knowledge In August 2023, the PI began collaboration with Zhoushan Village, in Henan Province, to explore toilet and sanitation issues. By August 2024, three households’ toilets were co-designed, co-built and tested with three voluntary families. This participatory approach has developed designs that suit local conditions, and improved the sanitation situations of the three families. With these successful experiments, this research will further develop comprehensive studies in the following three areas in order to generate knowledge for alternative rural toilet design. 1. Analysis about the richness of LOCAL COMPLEXITY 80-100 households will be visited and interviewed, to understand the complex relationships between three levels of issues: toilet design issues, site related issues and human factor issues. 2. Measured drawings about the potentials of LOCAL ASSETS 20 representative households will be studied through measuring and drawing to discover the potential assets that can be integrated into rural toilet design. 3. Evaluations about the diversities of LOCAL SOLUTIONS 10 representative households will be collaborated with to make design mock-up tests in their houses, in order to test and develop design solutions that are appropriate to them. The knowledge developed in this two-year research collaboration with Zhoushan villagers will form a set of comprehensive insights, which is lacking in current rural toilet research and practice. The 30 Rural Toilet Design Ingredients generated in this research will be invaluable reference material, for alternative rural toilet design development. 研究目標 本研究將在項目點村民的支持下，研究出30個鄉村廁所的設計要素，以拓展適合複雜鄉村狀況的設計。這30個設計要素將被匯總成書，並分發給鄉村社區、社區工作者、地方當局和建築專業人士在內的利益相關者。 研究背景與挑戰 大規模污水處理系統實施方法不完善，並與鄉村聚落的有機結構有衝突，鄉村廁所和環境衛生發展停滯不前。由於缺乏對鄉村居民的了解，鄉村廁所設計未能有效應對當地複雜的實際情況。儘管離網廁所已在鄉村社區進行了廣泛的測試，但由於項目過程中缺乏社區參與決策，導致離網廁所系統被錯誤使用。鄉村廁所設計是一項具有挑戰性的任務，需要與當地居民密切合作，才能研究出合適的解決方案。 研究方法與知識 2023年8月，本研究負責人開始與河南省周山村合作，探討廁所和衛生問題。至2024年8月，已經與三個自願參與的家庭共同設計、建造並測試了三戶人家的廁所。這種參與式方法研究出了符合當地情況的設計，並改善了這三個家庭的衛生狀況。基於這些成功的實驗，本研究將在以下三個領域進一步進行綜合研究，來創造更多鄉村廁所的設計知識。 1. 分析在地複雜關係與其豐富性 將訪問和訪談80-100戶家庭，以了解三個層面問題之間的複雜關係：廁所設計問題、場地相關問題和人為因素問題。 2. 測量與繪製在地資源圖紙 將透過測量和繪圖來研究20戶具有代表性的家庭，以發現可以融入鄉村廁所設計的潛在資源。 3. 評估在地解決方案的多樣性 將與10戶具有代表性的村民合作，在他們的房屋中製作實體測試模型，以測試和研究出適合個別家庭的設計方案。 這項與周山村民為期兩年的研究合作，將形成一套全面的見解，彌補目前鄉村廁所研究和實踐的不足。本研究探索出的30個鄉村廁所設計要素，將成為發展農村廁所設計的寶貴參考資料。

27614025.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27614025.value: 道德債務：就歷史不公義的補救公義

27614025.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27614025.value: From colonialism and slavery to unjust wars and large-scale misappropriation of natural resources, human history is rife with injustices. Do present generations possess any responsibilities in relation to such heinous wrongdoings – even ones committed in the distant past? This project offers an innovative and emphatic account of agents’ reparative responsibilities for historical injustices through the framework of moral debt. Moral debts are moral claims specific to the agents who accrue them, for which those responsible must answer, and cannot be easily dismissed through the arising of incidental benefits. Accordingly, the moral debt owed by colonisers to the colonised – in virtue of the racial hierarchies and severe rights violations perpetrated by the former – cannot be outweighed even if the latter did derive material gains from colonisation. Understanding how moral debt functions enables us to account for why it can be transmitted across generations. Descendants of victims possess distinctive claims to their ancestors’ unsettled moral debt, whilst inheritors of perpetrators similarly ‘inherit’ their predecessors’ moral debt. In unpacking this complex dynamic, I invoke imaginative thought experiments in moral philosophy, comprehensive jurisprudence and legal analysis, and political science and history in arguing that we should take historical injustices – and their ensuing moral debts – seriously. As for instances where injustices were committed by independent sovereign states and state actors, it would appear that an overtly individualistic and atomised framework exploring individual interactions would simply not suffice. In these cases, I advocate that citizens can conditionally be held responsible if they qualify as subjective or objective authorisers of their governments’ actions. Uniquely, my dualist authorisation-centric approach has the advantage of being able to account for citizens’ liabilities across both democratic and non-democratic contexts. In constructing the bridge between historical injustice-oriented discussions on reparations and reparative justice, and more recent debates over whether citizens residing under non-democratic governments can be held liable for state actions, I believe such theoretical synergy will go a long way in shedding light on both sets of ideas. My two proposed books delve into, respectively, a new framework for reparative justice anchored in moral debt, and the assignment of reparative responsibilities to citizens who are appropriately connected to their governments qua authorisers. My articles will further examine the political significance and role of solidarity in our responses to historical injustices. 從殖民主義和奴隸制度到不公正的戰爭以及大規模的自然資源壓榨，人類歷史充滿著不公不義。現代一代會否對這些遠古或近古的嚴重錯誤負有責任？本項目通過道德債務的框架，提供了一種創新且能於日常生活套用的框架，以論證曾進行歷史不公正行為的侵犯者補救責任。「道德債務」是一個針對特定行為者的概念主張，責任人必須接受「道德債務」，且不能僅因不公義偶然所帶來的利益而輕易推卸責任。因此，殖民者因種族等級制度和嚴重的權利侵犯對被殖民者所負的道德債務，即使被殖民者從殖民中獲得了物質利益，他們也不能被減免。 同時，理解道德債務的運作方式，有助於解釋為何這種債務可以跨越世代傳遞。受害者的後代擁有對祖先未清償的道德債務的特殊主張，而施害者的繼承者也能「繼承」他們前輩的道德債務。在分析這一複雜構思時，我借助道德哲學中的想像性思想實驗、全面的法學分析以及政治學和歷史學的觀點，強調我們應當認真對待歷史不公義及其引發的道德債務。 而由獨立主權國家和國家行為者所犯的不公正行為，似乎單純以強調個人互動的個體主義為主的框架不足以解釋這些問題，過度碎片化。在這些情況下，我主張假若一國公民被認定為其政府行為的主觀或客觀授權者，則可以有條件地追究他們的責任。我的雙重授權框架具備獨特優勢，能夠解釋在民主與非民主背景下公民的責任問題。在構建連接關於修復正義的歷史不公討論與更近期關於非民主國家中公民是否應為國家行為負責的辯論的橋梁時，我相信我所提出的理論將極大地促進對兩個政治哲學新興領域思想的理解。我的兩本擬出版的書分別探討基於道德債務的修復正義新框架，以及將修復責任歸於與其政府具有適當聯繫（作為授權者）的公民。我也會將進一步通過文章，探討團結在應對歷史不公中的政治意義和作用。

27614625.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27614625.value: 誰在定義謠言：中國闢謠策略與網絡分析

27614625.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27614625.value: While fact-checking holds global significance, scholarly research has predominantly focused on Western models that verify politicians’ claims to promote transparency and accountability. There is a notable lack of research on how fact-checking operates in the Global South, especially within authoritarian regimes like China. In China, fact-checking—often termed “rumor-debunking” (辟谣)—can serve as a tool for information governance and state propaganda. Existing studies on China’s rumor-debunking efforts have two main limitations: they are often confined to specific events like the COVID-19 pandemic, lacking a comprehensive examination of everyday practices; and they focus mainly on the content of rumor-debunking messages, overlooking the actors involved. This leaves a critical gap in understanding the collaboration among different social actors, including the government and media, within the rumor-debunking ecosystem. To address these gaps, this study has two main objectives: (1) to comprehensively examine the content characteristics of rumor-debunking messages on Chinese social media, aiming to understand the strategies in rumor selection and debunking methods; and (2) to explore the actors involved in rumor-debunking and how they coordinate or collaborate, thereby understanding the roles of different social actors in the government-led rumor-debunking campaign. To achieve these objectives, this research will employ computational methods and network analysis on a newly collected dataset of over 1 million rumor-debunking posts involving 4,388 Weibo accounts. Specifically, this study aims to use computational text classification to uncover the strategies behind rumor selection and analyze their trends over time, and to apply network analysis to identify key actors and main clusters within the rumor-debunking network on Weibo, examining how account-level attributes like the number of followers and affiliations influence interactions. The main hypotheses are: rumors that may damage the image of government will be more likely to be chosen for debunking (H1); accounts sharing similar affiliations (government vs media) are more likely to repost each other (H2); accounts located within the same geographic region (i.e., the same province) exhibit are more likely to repost each other (H3); accounts at a higher administrative level (provincial) are more likely to be reposted, whereas accounts at lower levels (city or county) are more likely to repost (H4). This research will contribute new knowledge to the fields of misinformation and digital governance by enhancing our understanding of how an authoritarian regime such as China manages information and shapes public perception through everyday rumor-debunking practices. 事實查核（fact-checking）在全球具有重要意義，但現有學術研究大多集中於西方的模式，特別是針對政治人物言論進行驗證，以促進透明度與問責制。相較之下，對於全球南方，事實查核如何運作的研究仍然十分有限。在中國，「事實查核」常以「闢謠」之名出現，不僅是資訊治理的工具，也可能服務於國家宣傳。既有研究對中國闢謠工作的探討存在兩大限制：其一，多聚焦於特定事件（如新冠疫情），缺乏對日常實踐的系統性檢視；其二，偏重於闢謠內容本身，而忽視參與其中的多元行動者。這導致我們對政府、媒體及其他社會行動者如何在闢謠生態系統中協作的理解仍有不足。為填補這些空白，本研究有兩個主要目標：（1）全面分析中國社交媒體上的闢謠訊息特徵，以揭示謠言選擇與闢謠策略；（2）探討參與闢謠的行動者及其互動模式，進而理解不同社會行動者在政府主導的闢謠行動中的角色分工與協作方式。本研究將運用計算方法與網絡分析，基於一個涵蓋逾一百萬則闢謠貼文、涉及 4,388 個微博帳號的新資料庫。具體而言，本研究將透過計算文本分類，探究闢謠訊息的選擇策略及其隨時間的變化；並應用網絡分析辨識闢謠網絡中的核心行動者與主要集群，進一步檢視帳號層級屬性（如粉絲數量與機構隸屬）如何影響互動。研究假設包括：（H1）更可能損害政府形象的謠言較易被選為闢謠對象；（H2）具有相似隸屬性（政府或媒體）的帳號更可能互相轉發；（H3）位於相同地理區域（如同一省份）的帳號更傾向互相轉發；（H4）高行政層級帳號（如省級）更可能被轉發，而低層級帳號（如地市或縣級）則更傾向轉發他人訊息。本研究將為錯誤資訊與數位治理領域提供新的知識貢獻，深化對政體如何透過日常化的闢謠實踐進行資訊管理並形塑公共認知的理解。

27616725.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27616725.value: 繪製哈薩克男男性行為與藥物使用人群（MSM-UD）的HIV暴露前預防（PrEP）照護連續體全貌：一項混合方法研究

27616725.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27616725.value: Globally, the number of HIV infections has steadily declined over the past decade. However, in Kazakhstan—the birthplace of the Belt and Road Initiative—the HIV epidemic has been rapidly expanding. This trend has accelerated among cisgender gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (MSM), who experienced nearly an eight-fold increase in prevalence between 2013 (1.2%) and 2023 (8.8%). Prior research has illustrated higher rates of HIV prevalence among subgroups of MSM who illicitly use drugs (15.6%), signaling an urgent need for renewed efforts of HIV prevention in this population. HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is an antiretroviral medication that has shown to effectively protect HIV-negative individuals at high risk of HIV from acquiring it. Clinical trials have demonstrated that PrEP, when taken as instructed, significantly reduced the sexual transmission of HIV among MSM. PrEP holds great potential for reducing HIV transmission among men who have sex with men and use drugs (MSM-UD) in Kazakhstan. Research on the PrEP care continuum—including awareness, uptake, and adherence—among MSM-UD in Kazakhstan is warranted and timely as oral PrEP was recently approved by the Kazakhstan government for national distribution. The Gelberg-Andersen Behavioral Model for Vulnerable Populations (BMVP) expands on the well-established Behavioral Model of Health Services Use to highlight unique needs of socially and structurally marginalized groups. As with the original model, the BMVP emphasizes that health service use is influenced by predisposing characteristics, enabling resources, and need factors.
